text_mt: See here, O Bharga, the injustice of the clouds, / that they beat down upon the peacock and the cātaka that follow them with a shower of hailstones.

sanskrit_iast:
śikhisāraṅgayordṛṣṭvā mitrādapi parābhavam |
haṃsā gacchanti giriśa vidūramapi mānasam || 17 ||
meaning:
शिखिसारङ्गयोर्दृष्ट्वा मित्रादपि पराभवम् |
हंसा गच्छन्ति गिरिश विदूरमपि मानसम् || 17 ||
text_mt: Seeing the humiliation of the peacock and the cātaka, even by a friend, / the geese, O Giriśa, are going far away to Lake Mānasa.

sanskrit_iast:
etasmin viṣame kāle nīḍaṃ kākāśca korakāḥ |
kurvanti tvaṃ vinā gehāt kathaṃ śāntimavāpsyasi || 18 ||
meaning:
एतस्मिन् विषमे काले नीडं काकाश्च कोरकाः |
कुर्वन्ति त्वं विना गेहात् कथं शान्तिमवाप्स्यसि || 18 ||
text_mt: At this harsh time, crows and water-crows build their nests; / without a house, how will you find peace?

sanskrit_iast:
mahatī bādhate bhītirmāṃ meghotthā pinākadhṛk |
yatasva tasmādvāsāya mā ciraṃ vacanānmama || 19 ||
meaning:
महती बाधते भीतिर्मां मेघोत्था पिनाकधृक् |
यतस्व तस्माद्वासाय मा चिरं वचनान्मम || 19 ||
text_mt: A great fear arising from the clouds afflicts me, O wielder of the Pināka; / therefore, strive to find a dwelling; do not delay, upon my word.

sanskrit_iast:
kailāse vā himādrau vā mahākauṣyāmatha kṣitau |
tavopayogyaṃ tvaṃ vāsaṃ kuruṣva vṛṣabhadhvaja || 20 ||
meaning:
कैलासे वा हिमाद्रौ वा महाकौष्यामथ क्षितौ |
तवोपयोग्यं त्वं वासं कुरुष्व वृषभध्वज || 20 ||
text_mt: "Either on Kailāsa, or on the snow-mountain, or on the broad earth, / make a dwelling suitable for yourself, O bull-bannered god!"

sanskrit_iast:
evamuktastadā śambhurdākṣāyaṇyā taya sakṛt |
iṣajjahāsa śīrṣasthacandraraśmisitānanaḥ || 21 ||
meaning:
एवमुक्तस्तदा शम्भुर्दाक्षायण्या तय सकृत् |
इषज्जहास शीर्षस्थचन्द्ररश्मिसिताननः || 21 ||
text_mt: Addressed thus at that time by Dākṣāyaṇī, Śambhu / smiled slightly, his face white with the rays of the moon on his head.

sanskrit_iast:
athovāca satīṃ devīṃ smitabhinnoṣṭhasampūṭaḥ |
mahātmā sarvatattvajñastoṣayan parameśvarīm || 22 ||
meaning:
अथोवाच सतीं देवीं स्मितभिन्नोष्ठसम्पूटः |
महात्मा सर्वतत्त्वज्ञस्तोषयन् परमेश्वरीम् || 22 ||
text_mt: Then, parting his lips in a smile, the great-souled one, / knower of all reality, spoke to the goddess Satī, gladdening the supreme lady:

sanskrit_iast: īśvara uvāca
meaning: ईश्वर उवाच

sanskrit_iast:
yatra prītyai mayā kāryo vāsastava manohare |
meghāstatra na gantāraḥ kadācidapi matpriye || 23 ||
meaning:
यत्र प्रीत्यै मया कार्यो वासस्तव मनोहरे |
मेघास्तत्र न गन्तारः कदाचिदपि मत्प्रिये || 23 ||
text_mt: "Where I must make a dwelling for your pleasure, O lovely one, / there the clouds shall never go, my beloved!

sanskrit_iast:
meghā nitambaparyantaṃ sañcaranti mahībhṛtaḥ |
sadā prāleyadhāmnastu varṣāsvapi manohare || 24 ||
meaning:
मेघा नितम्बपर्यन्तं सञ्चरन्ति महीभृतः |
सदा प्रालेयधाम्नस्तु वर्षास्वपि मनोहरे || 24 ||
text_mt: The clouds wander only up to the slopes of the mountain, / of the abode of snow, even in the rainy season, O charming lady!

sanskrit_iast:
kailāsasya tathā devī yāvadāmekhalaṃ ghanāḥ |
sañcaranti na gacchanti tasmādūrdhvaṃ kadācana || 25 ||
meaning:
कैलासस्य तथा देवी यावदामेखलं घनाः |
सञ्चरन्ति न गच्छन्ति तस्मादूर्ध्वं कदाचन || 25 ||
text_mt: Likewise, O goddess, clouds drift only as far as the girdle / of Kailāsa; they never ascend higher than that.

sanskrit_iast:
sumerorvāridherūrdhvaṃ na gacchanti balāhakāḥ |
jānumūlaṃ samāsādya puṣkarāvartakādayaḥ || 26 ||
meaning:
सुमेरोर्वारिधेरूर्ध्वं न गच्छन्ति बलाहकाः |
जानुमूलं समासाद्य पुष्करावर्तकादयः || 26 ||
text_mt: Above the sea of Sumeru the rain-clouds do not go; / reaching only to the base of its knees, the Puṣkarāvartakas and others halt.

sanskrit_iast:
eteṣu ca girīndreṣu yasyopari tavehate |
manaḥ priye nivāsāya tamācakṣva drutaṃ mayi || 27 ||
meaning:
एतेषु च गिरीन्द्रेषु यस्योपरि तवेहते |
मनः प्रिये निवासाय तमाचक्ष्व द्रुतं मयि || 27 ||
text_mt: Upon which of these great mountains your heart longs / to dwell, my beloved, tell me quickly!

sanskrit_iast:
svecchāvihāraistava kautukāni suvarṇapakṣānilavṛndavṛndaiḥ |
śakuntavargairmadhurasvanaiste sadopadeyāni girau himotthe || 28 ||
meaning:
स्वेच्छाविहारैस्तव कौतुकानि सुवर्णपक्षानिलवृन्दवृन्दैः |
शकुन्तवर्गैर्मधुरस्वनैस्ते सदोपदेयानि गिरौ हिमोत्थे || 28 ||
text_mt: Through wandering at will, wonders are ever to be enjoyed by you on the snow-born mountain, / with flocks of birds having gold wings and sweet voices fluttering in the breeze.

sanskrit_iast:
siddhāṅganāste sakhitāṃ sanātanīmicchantya evopakṛtiṃ sakautukām |
svecchāvihārairmaṇikuṭṭime girau kurvantya eṣyanti phalādidānakaiḥ || 29 ||
meaning:
सिद्धाङ्गनास्ते सखितां सनातनीमिच्छन्त्य एवोपकृतिं सकौतुकाम् |
स्वेच्छाविहारैर्मणिकुट्टिमे गिरौ कुर्वन्त्य एष्यन्ति फलादिदानकैः || 29 ||
text_mt: The wives of the Siddhas, desiring your eternal friendship and offering curious services, / will come wandering at will on the jeweled pavement of the mountain, bearing gifts of fruits and other delights.

sanskrit_iast:
yā devakanyā girikanyakāśca yā nāgakanyāśca turaṅgamukhyaḥ |
sarvāstu tāste satataṃ sahāyatāṃ samācariṣyantyanumodavibhramaiḥ || 30 ||
meaning:
या देवकन्या गिरिकन्यकाश्च या नागकन्याश्च तुरङ्गमुख्यः |
सर्वास्तु तास्ते सततं सहायतां समाचरिष्यन्त्यनुमोदविभ्रमैः || 30 ||
text_mt: The daughters of the gods, the daughters of the mountains, the daughters of the Nāgas, and the horse-faced Kinnarīs— / all of them will continually render assistance to you with joyous charms.

sanskrit_iast:
rūpaṃ tavedamatulaṃ vadanaṃ sucāru dṛṣṭvāṅganā nijavapurnijakāntisaṃgham |
helāṃ nije vapuṣi rūpaguṇeṣu nityaṃ kartāra ityanimiṣekṣaṇacārurūpāḥ || 31 ||
meaning:
रूपं तवेदमतुलं वदनं सुचारु दृष्ट्वाङ्गना निजवपुर्निजकान्तिसंघम् |
हेलां निजे वपुषि रूपगुणेषु नित्यं कर्तार इत्यनिमिषेक्षणचारुरूपाः || 31 ||
text_mt: Seeing this matchless beauty of yours and your very lovely face, women with charming forms and unblinking eyes / will daily hold their own bodies and their own assemblies of charms in low esteem beside your physical form and qualities of grace.

sanskrit_iast:
yā menakā parvatarājajāyā rūpairguṇaiḥ khyātavatī triloke |
sā cāpi te tatra manonumodaṃ nityaṃ kariṣyatyatha sūcanādyaiḥ || 32 ||
meaning:
या मेनका पर्वतराजजाया रूपैर्गुणैः ख्यातवती त्रिलोके |
सा चापि ते तत्र मनोनुमोदं नित्यं करिष्यत्यथ सूचनाद्यैः || 32 ||
text_mt: Menakā, the wife of the mountain king, renowned across the three worlds for her beauty and virtues— / she too will daily bring delight to your mind there through loving attentions and the like.

sanskrit_iast:
purandhrivargairgirirājavandyaiḥ prītiṃ vitanvadbhirudārarūpām |
śikṣā sadā te svakulocitāpi kāryānvahaṃ prītiyutā guṇaughaiḥ || 33 ||
meaning:
पुरन्ध्रिवर्गैर्गिरिराजवन्द्यैः प्रीतिं वितन्वद्भिरुदाररूपाम् |
शिक्षा सदा ते स्वकुलोचितापि कार्यान्वहं प्रीतियुता गुणौघैः || 33 ||
text_mt: With assemblies of matrons revered by the king of mountains spreading noble love, / instruction suitable to your lineage must daily be carried out with joy and hosts of virtues.

sanskrit_iast:
vicitrakokilālālāpamodakuñjagaṇāvṛtam |
sadā vasantaprabhavaṃ gantumicchasi kiṃ priye || 34 ||
meaning:
विचित्रकोकिलालालापमोदकुञ्जगणावृतम् |
सदा वसन्तप्रभवं गन्तुमिच्छसि किं प्रिये || 34 ||
text_mt: Enclosed by groves delighting with the varied songs of the cuckoo, / forever born of spring—do you wish to go there, my beloved?

sanskrit_iast:
nānā svacchajalāpūrṇaṃ saraḥśatasamāvṛtam |
padminīśatasaṃyuktamacalendraṃ himālayam || 34 a ||
meaning:
नाना स्वच्छजलापूर्णं सरःशतसमावृतम् |
पद्मिनीशतसंयुक्तमचलेन्द्रं हिमालयम् || 34 अ ||
text_mt: Filled with varied clear waters, surrounded by hundreds of lakes, / joined with hundreds of lotus pools—to the Himalayas, the lord of mountains?

sanskrit_iast:
sarvakāmapradairvṛkṣai śādvalaḥ kalpasaṃjñakaiḥ |
sañchannaṃ yasya kusumānyupayokṣyasi tatra vai || 35 ||
meaning:
सर्वकामप्रदैर्वृक्षै शाद्वलः कल्पसंज्ञकैः |
सञ्छन्नं यस्य कुसुमान्युपयोक्ष्यसि तत्र वै || 35 ||
text_mt: Covered with wishing-trees granting all desires and grassy lawns, / whose blossoms you will truly enjoy there;

sanskrit_iast:
praśāntaśvāpadagaṇaṃ munibhiryatibhirvṛtam |
devālayaṃ mahābhāge nānāmṛgagaṇairvṛtam || 36 ||
meaning:
प्रशान्तश्वापदगणं मुनिभिर्यतिभिर्वृतम् |
देवालयं महाभागे नानामृगगणैर्वृतम् || 36 ||
text_mt: where wild beasts are pacified, frequented by sages and ascetics, / the abode of the gods, O fortunate lady, surrounded by varied herds of deer;

sanskrit_iast:
sphaṭikasvarṇavaprādyai rājataiśca virājitam |
mānasādisarovargairabhitaḥ pariśobhitam || 37 ||
meaning:
स्फटिकस्वर्णवप्राद्यै राजतैश्च विराजितम् |
मानसादिसरोवर्गैरभितः परिशोभितम् || 37 ||
text_mt: resplendent with crystal and golden slopes and silver terraces, / adorned all around with lakes such as Mānasa;

sanskrit_iast:
hiranmayai ratnanālaiḥ paṃkajairmukulairvṛtam |
śiśumāraistathā śaṃkhaiḥ kacchapairmakarairjhaṣaiḥ |
niṣevitairmañjulaiśca tathānīlotpalādibhiḥ || 38 ||
meaning:
हिरन्मयै रत्ननालैः पंकजैर्मुकुलैर्वृतम् |
शिशुमारैस्तथा शंखैः कच्छपैर्मकरैर्झषैः |
निषेवितैर्मञ्जुलैश्च तथानीलोत्पलादिभिः || 38 ||
text_mt: filled with golden lotuses and buds on jeweled stems, / frequented by dolphins, conches, turtles, makaras, and fish, / charming and adorned with blue water-lilies and the like;

sanskrit_iast:
devīśatasnānasaktasarvagandhaiśca kuṅkumaḥ |
vicitrasraggandhajalairāpūrṇaiḥ svacchakāntibhiḥ || 39 ||
meaning:
देवीशतस्नानसक्तसर्वगन्धैश्च कुङ्कुमः |
विचित्रस्रग्गन्धजलैरापूर्णैः स्वच्छकान्तिभिः || 39 ||
text_mt: clinging with all perfumes and saffron from the baths of hundreds of goddesses, / filled with fragrant waters and varied garlands of clear beauty;

sanskrit_iast:
śādvalaistarubhistuṅgaistīrasthairūpaśobhitaiḥ |
nṛtyadbhiriva śākhaurṣairvyajayantaṃ svasambhavam || 40 ||
meaning:
शाद्वलैस्तरुभिस्तुङ्गैस्तीरस्थैरूपशोभितैः |
नृत्यद्भिरिव शाखौर्षैर्व्यजयन्तं स्वसम्भवम् || 40 ||
text_mt: adorned with grassy meadows and tall trees standing on the banks, / as if dancing with their branch-tips, displaying their innate joy;

sanskrit_iast:
kādambaiḥ sārasairmattacakrāṅgagrāmaśobhitaiḥ |
madhurārāvibhirmodakāribhirbhramarādibhiḥ || 41 ||
meaning:
कादम्बैः सारसैर्मत्तचक्राङ्गग्रामशोभितैः |
मधुराराविभिर्मोदकारिभिर्भ्रमरादिभिः || 41 ||
text_mt: graced by grey geese, cranes, and flocks of impassioned ruddy geese, / and by bees and other creatures humming sweetly and causing delight!

sanskrit_iast:
vāsavasya kuberasya yamasya varuṇasya ca |
agneḥ kauṇaparājasya mārutasya harasya ca || 42 ||
meaning:
वासवस्य कुबेरस्य यमस्य वरुणस्य च |
अग्नेः कौणपराजस्य मारुतस्य हरस्य च || 42 ||
text_mt: Or Meru, whose high peak is adorned with the cities of Vāsava, Kubera, / Yama, Varuṇa, / of Agni, of the king of rākṣasas, of the Wind-god, and of Hara,

sanskrit_iast:
purībhiḥ śobhiśikharaṃ merumuccaiḥ surālayam |
rambhāśacīmenakādirambhorugaṇasevitam ||
kiṃ tvamicchasi sarveṣāṃ sārabhūtaṃ mahāgirim || 43 ||
meaning:
पुरीभिः शोभिशिखरं मेरुमुच्चैः सुरालयम् |
रम्भाशचीमेनकादिरम्भोरुगणसेवितम् ||
किं त्वमिच्छसि सर्वेषां सारभूतं महागिरिम् || 43 ||
text_mt: the lofty abode of the gods, frequented by broad-hipped celestial nymphs such as Rambhā, Śacī, and Menakā— / do you desire that great mountain, the essence of all mountains?

sanskrit_iast:
tatra devīśatayutā sāpsarogaṇasevitā |
nityaṃ cariṣyati śacī tava yogyāṃ sahāyatām || 44 ||
meaning:
तत्र देवीशतयुता साप्सरोगणसेविता |
नित्यं चरिष्यति शची तव योग्यां सहायताम् || 44 ||
text_mt: There Śacī, accompanied by hundreds of goddesses and attended by hosts of Apsarases, / will constantly attend upon you with fitting companionship.

sanskrit_iast:
athavā mama kailāsamacalendraṃ sadāśrayam |
sthānamicchasi vitteśapurīparivirājitam || 45 ||
meaning:
अथवा मम कैलासमचलेन्द्रं सदाश्रयम् |
स्थानमिच्छसि वित्तेशपुरीपरिविराजितम् || 45 ||
text_mt: Or do you desire my Kailāsa, lord of mountains, a place of constant refuge, / adorned all around by the city of Kubera,

sanskrit_iast:
gaṅgājalaughaprayataṃ pūrṇacandrasamaprabham |
darīṣu sānuṣu sadā yakṣakanyābhirīhitam || 46 ||
meaning:
गङ्गाजलौघप्रयतं पूर्णचन्द्रसमप्रभम् |
दरीषु सानुषु सदा यक्षकन्याभिरीहितम् || 46 ||
text_mt: purified by the flood of the Ganges’ water, shining like the full moon, / sought after always in its caves and ridges by Yakṣa maidens,

sanskrit_iast:
nānāmṛgagaṇairjuṣṭaṃ padmākaraśatāvṛtam |
sarvairguṇaiśca sadṛśaṃ sumeroriva sundari || 47 ||
meaning:
नानामृगगणैर्जुष्टं पद्माकरशतावृतम् |
सर्वैर्गुणैश्च सदृशं सुमेरोरिव सुन्दरि || 47 ||
text_mt: frequented by various herds of deer, covered with hundreds of lotus pools, / equal to Sumeru in all virtues, O beautiful woman?

sanskrit_iast:
sthāneṣveteṣu yatrāsti tavāntaḥkaraṇaspṛhā |
taddrutaṃ me samācakṣva vāsaṃ kartāsmi tatra te || 48 ||
meaning:
स्थानेष्वेतेषु यत्रास्ति तवान्तःकरणस्पृहा |
तद्द्रुतं मे समाचक्ष्व वासं कर्तास्मि तत्र ते || 48 ||
text_mt: Among these places, wherever your inner heart longs to be, / tell me that quickly; I will make your dwelling there."

sanskrit_iast: mārkaṇḍeya uvāca
meaning: मार्कण्डेय उवाच

sanskrit_iast:
itīrite śaṃkareṇa tadā dākṣāyaṇī śanaiḥ |
idamāha mahādevaṃ ślakṣṇaṃ svecchāprakāśakam || 49 ||
meaning:
इतीरिते शंकरेण तदा दाक्षायणी शनैः |
इदमाह महादेवं श्लक्ष्णं स्वेच्छाप्रकाशकम् || 49 ||
text_mt: When this was spoken by Śaṅkara, Dākṣāyaṇī then slowly / spoke these gentle words to Mahādeva, expressing her wish:

sanskrit_iast: satyuvāca
meaning: सत्युवाच

sanskrit_iast:
himādrāveva vasatimahamicche tvayā saha |
na cirāt kuru vāsaṃ tvaṃ tasminneva mahāgirau || 50 ||
meaning:
हिमाद्रावेव वसतिमहमिच्छे त्वया सह |
न चिरात् कुरु वासं त्वं तस्मिन्नेव महागिरौ || 50 ||
text_mt: "On the snow-mountain alone I desire to dwell with you. / Without delay, make our dwelling upon that very mountain!"

sanskrit_iast: mārkaṇḍeya uvāca
meaning: मार्कण्डेय उवाच

sanskrit_iast:
atha tadvākyamākarṇya haraḥ paramamoditaḥ |
himādriśikharaṃ tuṅgaṃ dākṣāyaṇyā samaṃ yayau || 51 ||
meaning:
अथ तद्वाक्यमाकर्ण्य हरः परममोदितः |
हिमाद्रिशिखरं तुङ्गं दाक्षायण्या समं ययौ || 51 ||
text_mt: Hearing her word, Hara was exceedingly delighted; / he went together with Dākṣāyaṇī to the high peak of the snow-mountain,

sanskrit_iast:
siddhāṅganāgaṇayuktamagamyaṃ meghapakṣibhiḥ |
jagāma śikharaṃ tuṅgaṃ marīcavanarājitam || 52 ||
meaning:
सिद्धाङ्गनागणयुक्तमगम्यं मेघपक्षिभिः |
जगाम शिखरं तुङ्गं मरीचवनराजितम् || 52 ||
text_mt: a high peak accompanied by hosts of Siddha women, unapproachable by clouds or birds, / radiant with forests of rays of light.

sanskrit_iast:
iti śrīkālikāpurāṇe himādrinivālayavanaṃ pañcadaśo'dhyāyaḥ
ṣoḍaśo'dhyāyaḥ
meaning:
इति श्रीकालिकापुराणे हिमाद्रिनिवालयवनं पञ्चदशोऽध्यायः
षोडशोऽध्यायः
text_mt: Thus ends the fifteenth chapter, "The Description of the Residence on the Snow-Mountain," in the glorious Kālikāpurāṇa. / Sixteenth Chapter.

sanskrit_iast: mārkaṇḍeya uvāca
meaning: मार्कण्डेय उवाच

sanskrit_iast:
vicitraṃ kanakai rūpyaiḥ śikharaṃ ratnakarburam |
vālārkasadṛśaṃ tuṅgamāsasāda satīsakhaḥ || 1 ||
meaning:
विचित्रं कनकै रूप्यैः शिखरं रत्नकर्बुरम् |
वालार्कसदृशं तुङ्गमाससाद सतीसखः || 1 ||
text_mt: Together with Satī, he reached the lofty peak, wondrous with gold and silver, / variegated with jewels, resembling the rising sun,

sanskrit_iast:
sphaṭikāśmalaye tasmin śādvaladrumarājite |
vicitrapuṣpaballībhiḥ sarasībhiśca saṃyute |
praphullataruśākhāgraguñjadbhramarabhūṣite || 2 ||
meaning:
स्फटिकाश्मलये तस्मिन् शाद्वलद्रुमराजिते |
विचित्रपुष्पबल्लीभिः सरसीभिश्च संयुते |
प्रफुल्लतरुशाखाग्रगुञ्जद्भ्रमरभूषिते || 2 ||
text_mt: on that mountain of crystal stone, adorned with rows of trees on grassy lawns, / endowed with varied flowering creepers and lakes, / adorned with humming bees upon the tips of blossoming tree-branches,

sanskrit_iast:
paṅkeruhaiḥ praphullaiśca nīlotpalacayaistathā |
śobhite cakravākaughaiḥ kādambairhaṃsamadgubhiḥ || 3 ||
meaning:
पङ्केरुहैः प्रफुल्लैश्च नीलोत्पलचयैस्तथा |
शोभिते चक्रवाकौघैः कादम्बैर्हंसमद्गुभिः || 3 ||
text_mt: beautified with blooming lotuses and masses of blue water-lilies, / with flocks of ruddy geese, grey geese, swans, and water-crows,

sanskrit_iast:
pramattasārasaiḥ krauñcairnīlakaṇṭhaiśca śabdite |
puṃskokilakalasvānairmadhurairmūgasevite || 4 ||
meaning:
प्रमत्तसारसैः क्रौञ्चैर्नीलकण्ठैश्च शब्दिते |
पुंस्कोकिलकलस्वानैर्मधुरैर्मूगसेविते || 4 ||
text_mt: resounding with impassioned cranes, curlews, and peacocks, / and the sweet, low calls of male cuckoos, frequented by deer,

sanskrit_iast:
turaṅgavadanaiḥ siddhairapsarobhiḥ saguhyakaiḥ |
vidyādharībhirdevībhiḥ kinnarībhirvihārite |
purandhrībhiḥ pārvatībhiḥ kanyābhiśca samanvite || 5 ||
meaning:
तुरङ्गवदनैः सिद्धैरप्सरोभिः सगुह्यकैः |
विद्याधरीभिर्देवीभिः किन्नरीभिर्विहारिते |
पुरन्ध्रीभिः पार्वतीभिः कन्याभिश्च समन्विते || 5 ||
text_mt: where horse-faced Kinnaras, Siddhas, Apsarases along with Guhyakas, / Vidyādharīs, goddesses, and Kinnarīs sported, / and crowded with matrons, mountain women, and maidens,

sanskrit_iast:
vipañcītantrikāmandramṛdaṅgapaṭahasvanaiḥ |
nṛtyadbhirapsarobhiśca kautukotthaiḥ suśobhite || 6 ||
meaning:
विपञ्चीतन्त्रिकामन्द्रमृदङ्गपटहस्वनैः |
नृत्यद्भिरप्सरोभिश्च कौतुकोत्थैः सुशोभिते || 6 ||
text_mt: greatly adorned with the deep sounds of lutes, flutes, and mṛdaṅga drums, / and with dancing Apsarases full of gaiety.

sanskrit_iast:
daivīlatābhirdivyābhirgandhinībhiḥ samāvṛte |
ūrdhvapraphullakusumairnikuñjairūpaśobhite || 7 ||
meaning:
दैवीलताभिर्दिव्याभिर्गन्धिनीभिः समावृते |
ऊर्ध्वप्रफुल्लकुसुमैर्निकुञ्जैरूपशोभिते || 7 ||
text_mt: Covered with divine, celestial creepers full of fragrance, / and adorned with bowers of flowers blossoming upward,

sanskrit_iast:
śailarājapurābhyāse śikhare vṛṣabhadhvajaḥ |
saha satyā ciraṃ reme evambhūte suśobhane || 8 ||
meaning:
शैलराजपुराभ्यासे शिखरे वृषभध्वजः |
सह सत्या चिरं रेमे एवम्भूते सुशोभने || 8 ||
text_mt: on such a beautiful peak near the mountain king's city, / Vṛṣabhadhvaja long took delight with Satī.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmin svargasame sthāne divyamānena śaṃkaraḥ |
daśa varṣasahasrāṇi reme satyā samaṃ mudā || 9 ||
meaning:
तस्मिन् स्वर्गसमे स्थाने दिव्यमानेन शंकरः |
दश वर्षसहस्राणि रेमे सत्या समं मुदा || 9 ||
text_mt: In that place resembling heaven, for ten thousand years / by celestial measure, Śaṅkara joyfully took delight with Satī.

sanskrit_iast:
sa kadācittu tatsthānāt kailāsaṃ yāti śaṃkaraḥ |
kadācinmeruśikharaṃ devadevīvṛtaṃ purā || 10 ||
meaning:
स कदाचित्तु तत्स्थानात् कैलासं याति शंकरः |
कदाचिन्मेरुशिखरं देवदेवीवृतं पुरा || 10 ||
text_mt: Sometimes Śaṅkara went from that place to Kailāsa, / sometimes to the peak of Meru, formerly surrounded by gods and goddesses.

sanskrit_iast:
dikpālānāṃ tathodyānaṃ vanāni vasudhātalam |
gatvā gatvā punastatra reme tebhyaḥ satīsakhaḥ || 11 ||
meaning:
दिक्पालानां तथोद्यानं वनानि वसुधातलम् |
गत्वा गत्वा पुनस्तत्र रेमे तेभ्यः सतीसखः || 11 ||
text_mt: Likewise, going again and again to the gardens of the guardians of the directions, to the forests, and to the surface of the earth, / he who had Satī as his companion took delight there after [visiting] them.

sanskrit_iast:
na jajñe sa divārātraṃ na brahma na tapaḥ śamam |
satyāhitamanā śambhuḥ prītimeva cakāra ha || 12 ||
meaning:
न जज्ञे स दिवारात्रं न ब्रह्म न तपः शमम् |
सत्याहितमना शम्भुः प्रीतिमेव चकार ह || 12 ||
text_mt: He knew neither day nor night, neither Brahman nor asceticism nor quietude; / with mind fixed on Satī, Śambhu did nothing but make love.

sanskrit_iast:
ekaṃ mahādevamukhaṃ satī paśyati sarvaśaḥ |
mahādevo'pi sarvatra sadādrākṣīta satīmukham || 13 ||
meaning:
एकं महादेवमुखं सती पश्यति सर्वशः |
महादेवोऽपि सर्वत्र सदाद्राक्षीत सतीमुखम् || 13 ||
text_mt: Satī looked everywhere only at the face of Mahādeva, / and Mahādeva too always saw Satī's face everywhere.

sanskrit_iast:
evamanyonyasaṃsargādanurāgamahīruham |
vardhayāmāsatuḥ śambhusatyau bhāvāmbusecanaiḥ || 14 ||
meaning:
एवमन्योन्यसंसर्गादनुरागमहीरुहम् |
वर्धयामासतुः शम्भुसत्यौ भावाम्बुसेचनैः || 14 ||
text_mt: Thus, from their mutual union, Śambhu and Satī / made the tree of passion grow with waters of love.

sanskrit_iast:
etasminnantare sakṣo jagatāṃ hitakārakaḥ |
mahāyajñaṃ samārebhe yaṣṭuṃ vai sarvajīvanam || 15 ||
meaning:
एतस्मिन्नन्तरे सक्षो जगतां हितकारकः |
महायज्ञं समारेभे यष्टुं वै सर्वजीवनम् || 15 ||
text_mt: In the meantime, Dakṣa, who brings welfare to the worlds, / undertook to perform a great sacrifice, the life of all beings,

sanskrit_iast:
aṣṭāśīti-sahasrāṇi yatra juhvati ṛtvijaḥ |
udgātāraścatuḥ ṣaṣṭisahasrāṇi surarṣayaḥ |
adhvaryavo'tha hotārastāvanto nāradādayaḥ || 16 ||
meaning:
अष्टाशीति-सहस्राणि यत्र जुह्वति ऋत्विजः |
उद्गातारश्चतुः षष्टिसहस्राणि सुरर्षयः |
अध्वर्यवोऽथ होतारस्तावन्तो नारदादयः || 16 ||
text_mt: where eighty-eight thousand priests offered oblations, / sixty-four thousand divine seers were the chanters, / and as many, beginning with Nārada, were the adhvaryus and hotṛs.

sanskrit_iast:
adhisthātā svayaṃ viṣṇuḥ saha sarvamarudgaṇaiḥ |
svayaṃ tatrābhavad brahmā trayīvidhinidarśakaḥ || 17 ||
meaning:
अधिस्थाता स्वयं विष्णुः सह सर्वमरुद्गणैः |
स्वयं तत्राभवद् ब्रह्मा त्रयीविधिनिदर्शकः || 17 ||
text_mt: Viṣṇu himself presided with all the hosts of Maruts; / Brahmā himself was there, showing the rite of the three Vedas.

sanskrit_iast:
tathaiva sarvadikpālā dvārapālāśca rakṣakāḥ |
upatasthe svayaṃ yajñaḥ svayaṃ vedī dharābhavat || 18 ||
meaning:
तथैव सर्वदिक्पाला द्वारपालाश्च रक्षकाः |
उपतस्थे स्वयं यज्ञः स्वयं वेदी धराभवत् || 18 ||
text_mt: Likewise all the guardians of the directions were door-keepers and guards; / the sacrifice itself was present, and the earth itself became the altar.

sanskrit_iast:
tanūnapādapi nijaṃ cakre rūpaṃ sahasraśaḥ |
haviṣāṃ grahaṇāyāśu tasmin yajñamahotsave || 19 ||
meaning:
तनूनपादपि निजं चक्रे रूपं सहस्रशः |
हविषां ग्रहणायाशु तस्मिन् यज्ञमहोत्सवे || 19 ||
text_mt: Even the fire Tanūnapāt assumed a thousand forms / to receive the oblations swiftly at that great sacrificial festival.

sanskrit_iast:
āmantryāśu marīcyādyāḥ pavitraikaikadhāriṇaḥ |
sarvatra sāmidhenyā te jvālayāmāsurarcciṣam || 20 ||
meaning:
आमन्त्र्याशु मरीच्याद्याः पवित्रैकैकधारिणः |
सर्वत्र सामिधेन्या ते ज्वालयामासुरर्च्चिषम् || 20 ||
text_mt: Invited swiftly, Marīci and the others, each wearing a purifying ring, / kindled the flame everywhere with kindling verses.

sanskrit_iast:
saptarṣayaḥ sāmaghāthāḥ kurvanti sma pṛthak pṛthak |
gāndiśo vidiśaḥ khañca pūrayantaḥ śrutisvaraiḥ || 21 ||
meaning:
सप्तर्षयः सामघाथाः कुर्वन्ति स्म पृथक् पृथक् |
गान्दिशो विदिशः खञ्च पूरयन्तः श्रुतिस्वरैः || 21 ||
text_mt: The seven seers, singing the Sāman verses, performed separately, / filling the earth, the directions, intermediate quarters, and sky with the Vedic tones.

sanskrit_iast:
na vṛtāstatra yāgeṣu dakṣeṇa sumahātmanā |
na kecidṛṣayo devā na manuṣyā na pakṣiṇaḥ |
nodbhido na tṛṇaṃ vāpi paśavo na mṛgāstathā || 22 ||
meaning:
न वृतास्तत्र यागेषु दक्षेण सुमहात्मना |
न केचिदृषयो देवा न मनुष्या न पक्षिणः |
नोद्भिदो न तृणं वापि पशवो न मृगास्तथा || 22 ||
text_mt: There were no seers, gods, humans, or birds, / no plant life, grass, cattle, or wild animals / that were not invited to the sacrifices by the high-souled Dakṣa.

sanskrit_iast:
gandharvavidyādharasiddhasaṃghānādityasādhyarṣigaṇān sayakṣān |
sasthāvarānnāgavarān samastān vavre sa dakṣaḥ sumahādhvareṣu || 23 ||
meaning:
गन्धर्वविद्याधरसिद्धसंघानादित्यसाध्यर्षिगणान् सयक्षान् |
सस्थावरान्नागवरान् समस्तान् वव्रे स दक्षः सुमहाध्वरेषु || 23 ||
text_mt: The hosts of Gandharvas, Vidyādharas, and Siddhas, the groups of Ādityas, Sādhyas, and seers, together with the Yakṣas, / the immobile beings, and all the noble Nāgas—these Dakṣa invited to his very great sacrificial rite.

sanskrit_iast:
kalpa-manvantarayuga-varṣa-māsa-divā-niśāḥ |
kalā-kāṣṭhā-nimeṣādyā vṛtāḥ sarve samāgatāḥ || 24 ||
meaning:
कल्प-मन्वन्तरयुग-वर्ष-मास-दिवा-निशाः |
कला-काष्ठा-निमेषाद्या वृताः सर्वे समागताः || 24 ||
text_mt: Kalpas, manvantaras, yugas, years, months, days, nights, / kalās, kāṣṭhās, nimeṣas, and the rest—all invited, came.

sanskrit_iast:
maharṣirājarṣisurarṣisaṅghā nṛpāḥ saputrāḥ sacivaiḥ sasainyaiḥ |
vasupramukhyā gaṇadevatā yāḥ sarvā vṛtāstena gatā makhaṃ tam || 25 ||
meaning:
महर्षिराजर्षिसुरर्षिसङ्घा नृपाः सपुत्राः सचिवैः ससैन्यैः |
वसुप्रमुख्या गणदेवता याः सर्वा वृतास्तेन गता मखं तम् || 25 ||
text_mt: The hosts of great seers, royal seers, and divine seers, kings with their sons, ministers, and armies, / and the group deities headed by the Vasus—all invited by him went to that sacrifice.

sanskrit_iast:
kīṭāḥ pataṅgā jalajāśca sarve savānarāḥ śvāpadavighnaghorāḥ |
meghāḥ saśailāḥ sanadīsamudrāḥ sarāṃsi vāpyaśca gatā vṛtāste || 26 ||
meaning:
कीटाः पतङ्गा जलजाश्च सर्वे सवानराः श्वापदविघ्नघोराः |
मेघाः सशैलाः सनदीसमुद्राः सरांसि वाप्यश्च गता वृतास्ते || 26 ||
text_mt: Insects, moths, all aquatic creatures, monkeys, beasts of prey terrible with obstacles, / clouds with mountains, rivers with oceans, lakes and ponds—all invited went.

sanskrit_iast:
sarve svabhāgaṃ haviṣāṃ jivṛkṣavaḥ ṛtuṃ prajagmurdṛḍhayajvinaste |
pātālavāsā asurāḥ samāgatā nāgastriyo devasabhāḥ samastāḥ || 27 ||
meaning:
सर्वे स्वभागं हविषां जिवृक्षवः ऋतुं प्रजग्मुर्दृढयज्विनस्ते |
पातालवासा असुराः समागता नागस्त्रियो देवसभाः समस्ताः || 27 ||
text_mt: All, wishing to receive their own share of the oblations, went to the sacrifice of that steadfast sacrificer; / Asuras living in the netherworld, Nāga women, and all assemblies of gods arrived.

sanskrit_iast:
jagadvartyasti yatkiñcaccetanācetanaṃ punaḥ |
sarvaṃ vṛtvā samārebhe yajñaṃ sarvasva dakṣiṇam || 28 ||
meaning:
जगद्वर्त्यस्ति यत्किञ्चच्चेतनाचेतनं पुनः |
सर्वं वृत्वा समारेभे यज्ञं सर्वस्व दक्षिणम् || 28 ||
text_mt: Whatever there was existing in the world, animate or inanimate, / having invited all of it, he began the sacrifice wherein one gives away all possessions as priestly fee.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmin yajñe vṛtaḥ śambhurna dakṣeṇa mahātmanā |
kapālīti viniścitya tasya yajñārhatā na hi || 29 ||
meaning:
तस्मिन् यज्ञे वृतः शम्भुर्न दक्षेण महात्मना |
कपालीति विनिश्चित्य तस्य यज्ञार्हता न हि || 29 ||
text_mt: At that sacrifice, Śambhu was not invited by the high-souled Dakṣa, / having resolved: 'He is a skull-bearer; he certainly has no fitness for sacrifice.'

sanskrit_iast:
kapālibhāyerti satī dayitāpi sutā nijā |
nāhūtā yajñaviṣaye dakṣeṇa doṣadarśinā || 30 ||
meaning:
कपालिभायेर्ति सती दयितापि सुता निजा |
नाहूता यज्ञविषये दक्षेण दोषदर्शिना || 30 ||
text_mt: Thinking, 'She is the skull-bearer's wife,' Satī, though his beloved own daughter, / was not summoned to the sacrifice by fault-seeing Dakṣa.

sanskrit_iast:
śrutvā satī tathā yajñaṃ tātenārabdhamuttamam |
kapālibhāyerti vṛtā nāhamityapi tattvataḥ || 31 ||
meaning:
श्रुत्वा सती तथा यज्ञं तातेनारब्धमुत्तमम् |
कपालिभायेर्ति वृता नाहमित्यपि तत्त्वतः || 31 ||
text_mt: Hearing that such an excellent sacrifice had been undertaken by her father, / and truly knowing, 'Because I am the skull-bearer's wife, I have not been invited,'

sanskrit_iast:
uccaiścukopa dakṣāya raktanetrānanā tadā |
śāpena dakṣaṃ daghuṃ ca manaścakre tadā satī || 32 ||
meaning:
उच्चैश्चुकोप दक्षाय रक्तनेत्रानना तदा |
शापेन दक्षं दघुं च मनश्चक्रे तदा सती || 32 ||
text_mt: Satī then became exceedingly enraged at Dakṣa, her eyes and face turning red, / and she set her mind on burning Dakṣa with a curse.

sanskrit_iast:
kopāviṣṭāpi sā pūrvasamayaṃ smṛtavatyamum |
manaseti viniścitya na śaśāpa tadā satī || 33 ||
meaning:
कोपाविष्टापि सा पूर्वसमयं स्मृतवत्यमुम् |
मनसेति विनिश्चित्य न शशाप तदा सती || 33 ||
text_mt: Though filled with rage, she remembered her former agreement; / resolving this in her mind, Satī did not curse him then.

sanskrit_iast:
alaṃ śāpena me pūrvaṃ sudṛḍhaḥ samayaḥ kṛtaḥ |
astīti mayyavajñāyāṃ prāṇān mokṣye dhruvaṃ punaḥ || 34 ||
meaning:
अलं शापेन मे पूर्वं सुदृढः समयः कृतः |
अस्तीति मय्यवज्ञायां प्राणान् मोक्ष्ये ध्रुवं पुनः || 34 ||
text_mt: [She thought:] 'Away with a curse! A very firm agreement was made by me beforehand: / "If I am shown disrespect, I will surely abandon my life."

sanskrit_iast:
yadā stutāhaṃ dakṣeṇa suciraṃ tanayārthinā |
tadaiva samayo me'yaṃ śāpenālaṃkaromi tam || 35 ||
meaning:
यदा स्तुताहं दक्षेण सुचिरं तनयार्थिना |
तदैव समयो मेऽयं शापेनालंकरोमि तम् || 35 ||
text_mt: When I was praised by Dakṣa for a long time when he desired a daughter, / this agreement was made by me then; why should I adorn him with a curse?'

sanskrit_iast:
iti sañcintya sā devī nityarūpamathātmanaḥ |
sasmārātulamatyugraṃ niṣkalaṃ tu jaganmayam || 36 ||
meaning:
इति सञ्चिन्त्य सा देवी नित्यरूपमथात्मनः |
सस्मारातुलमत्युग्रं निष्कलं तु जगन्मयम् || 36 ||
text_mt: Thinking thus, the goddess then remembered her own eternal form, / peerless, exceedingly fierce, partless, and consisting of the universe.

sanskrit_iast:
pūrvarūpaṃ smarantī sā yoganidrāhvayaṃ hareḥ |
evaṃ sañcintayāmāsa manasā dakṣajā tadā || 37 ||
meaning:
पूर्वरूपं स्मरन्ती सा योगनिद्राह्वयं हरेः |
एवं सञ्चिन्तयामास मनसा दक्षजा तदा || 37 ||
text_mt: Remembering her former form, named the Yoganidrā of Hari, / Dakṣa's daughter then reflected thus in her mind:

sanskrit_iast:
brahmaṇoditadakṣeṇa yadarthamahamīḍitā |
tat kiñcidapi nojñātaṃ śaṃkaro'pi na putravān || 38 ||
meaning:
ब्रह्मणोदितदक्षेण यदर्थमहमीडिता |
तत् किञ्चिदपि नोज्ञातं शंकरोऽपि न पुत्रवान् || 38 ||
text_mt: 'That purpose for which I was praised by Dakṣa at Brahmā's command / has not been accomplished even slightly, nor has Śaṅkara obtained a son.

sanskrit_iast:
idānīmekamevābhūt kāryaṃ devagaṇasya ca |
yacchaṃkaraḥ sānurāgo matkṛte'bhūcca yopiti || 39 ||
meaning:
इदानीमेकमेवाभूत् कार्यं देवगणस्य च |
यच्छंकरः सानुरागो मत्कृतेऽभूच्च योपिति || 39 ||
text_mt: Now only one task of the host of gods has been accomplished: / that Śaṅkara has become impassioned and attached to a woman for my sake.

sanskrit_iast:
matto nānyā punaḥ śambho rāgaṃ vardhayituṃ punaḥ |
śaktā na kāpi bhavitā sa nānyāṃ saṃgrahīṣyati || 40 ||
meaning:
मत्तो नान्या पुनः शम्भो रागं वर्धयितुं पुनः |
शक्ता न कापि भविता स नान्यां संग्रहीष्यति || 40 ||
text_mt: No other woman besides me will ever be able / to increase Śambhu's passion; he will not accept any other woman.

sanskrit_iast:
tathāpyahaṃ tanuṃ tyakṣe samayāt pūrvayojitāt |
hitāya jagatāṃ kuryāṃ prādurbhāvaṃ punargirau || 41 ||
meaning:
तथाप्यहं तनुं त्यक्षे समयात् पूर्वयोजितात् |
हिताय जगतां कुर्यां प्रादुर्भावं पुनर्गिरौ || 41 ||
text_mt: Even so, I will abandon my body because of the agreement made before; / for the welfare of the worlds, I will manifest myself again on the mountain.

sanskrit_iast:
purā himavataḥ prasthe ramye devagṛhopame |
śambhuḥ sārdhaṃ mayā rantuṃ suciraṃ prītisaṃyutaḥ || 42 ||
meaning:
पुरा हिमवतः प्रस्थे रम्ये देवगृहोपमे |
शम्भुः सार्धं मया रन्तुं सुचिरं प्रीतिसंयुतः || 42 ||
text_mt: Formerly, on the delightful plateau of Himavat resembling the abode of the gods, / Śambhu, accompanied by love, took delight with me for a long time.

sanskrit_iast:
tatra yā menakā devī cārvaṅgī caritavratā |
suśīlā sā purastrīṇāmuttamā pāvatīgaṇe || 43 ||
meaning:
तत्र या मेनका देवी चार्वङ्गी चरितव्रता |
सुशीला सा पुरस्त्रीणामुत्तमा पावतीगणे || 43 ||
text_mt: There was the goddess Menakā, fair-limbed, observant of vows, / of good conduct, the foremost of the city's women among the mountain dwellers.

sanskrit_iast:
sā māṃ mātṛvadācaṣṭa sarvakarmasu narmakam |
tasyāṃ me'tyanurāgo'bhūt sā me mātā bhaviṣyati || 44 ||
meaning:
सा मां मातृवदाचष्ट सर्वकर्मसु नर्मकम् |
तस्यां मेऽत्यनुरागोऽभूत् सा मे माता भविष्यति || 44 ||
text_mt: She addressed me like a mother, charming in all deeds; / for her I had immense affection; she shall become my mother.

sanskrit_iast:
kanyābhiśca pārvatībhiśca pārvatībhiśca bālyakrīḍāmahaṃ ciram |
kṛtvā kṛtvā menakāyāḥ kariṣye modamuttamam || 45 ||
meaning:
कन्याभिश्च पार्वतीभिश्च पार्वतीभिश्च बाल्यक्रीडामहं चिरम् |
कृत्वा कृत्वा मेनकायाः करिष्ये मोदमुत्तमम् || 45 ||
text_mt: Playing childhood games for a long time with the girls of the mountain dwellers, / I will repeatedly bring supreme joy to Menakā.

sanskrit_iast:
punaścāhaṃ bhaviṣyāmi śambhojāyātivallabhā |
kariṣye devakāryāṇi tadupāyādasaṃśayam || 46 ||
meaning:
पुनश्चाहं भविष्यामि शम्भोजायातिवल्लभा |
करिष्ये देवकार्याणि तदुपायादसंशयम् || 46 ||
text_mt: And I will again become the very beloved wife of Śambhu; / through that means, I will accomplish the tasks of the gods without doubt.'

sanskrit_iast:
iti sañcintayantī sā punaḥ kopasamāvṛtā |
jajvāla dakṣatanayā dakṣadāruṇakarmaṇā || 47 ||
meaning:
इति सञ्चिन्तयन्ती सा पुनः कोपसमावृता |
जज्वाल दक्षतनया दक्षदारुणकर्मणा || 47 ||
text_mt: Thinking thus, Dakṣa's daughter, again overcome with wrath, / burned [with anger] on account of Dakṣa's cruel deed.

sanskrit_iast:
krodharaktekṣaṇā tatra tanuyaṣṭistadā satī |
sphoṭañcakāra dvārāṇi sarvāṇyāvṛtya yogataḥ || 48 ||
meaning:
क्रोधरक्तेक्षणा तत्र तनुयष्टिस्तदा सती |
स्फोटञ्चकार द्वाराणि सर्वाण्यावृत्य योगतः || 48 ||
text_mt: With eyes red with anger, Satī, whose slender body was like a staff, / closed all apertures through yoga and caused a rupture.

sanskrit_iast:
tena sphoṭena mahatā tasyāstu prāṇavāyavaḥ |
nirbhidya daśamadvāramātmanaste bahiryayuḥ || 49 ||
meaning:
तेन स्फोटेन महता तस्यास्तु प्राणवायवः |
निर्भिद्य दशमद्वारमात्मनस्ते बहिर्ययुः || 49 ||
text_mt: By that great rupture, her vital breaths / broke through her tenth aperture and went outside.

sanskrit_iast:
tyaktaprāṇāntu tāṃ dṛṣṭvā devāḥ sarve'ntarikṣagāḥ |
hāhākāraṃ tadā cakruḥ śokavyākulitekṣaṇāḥ || 50 ||
meaning:
त्यक्तप्राणान्तु तां दृष्ट्वा देवाः सर्वेऽन्तरिक्षगाः |
हाहाकारं तदा चक्रुः शोकव्याकुलितेक्षणाः || 50 ||
text_mt: Seeing her departed of life, all the gods moving in the sky / then raised a cry of lamentation, their eyes agitated with grief.

sanskrit_iast:
tatastu satyā bhaginīsutā tāṃ draṣṭumāgatā |
cukrośa śokādvijayā mṛtāṃ dṛṣṭvā satīṃ mahuḥ || 51 ||
meaning:
ततस्तु सत्या भगिनीसुता तां द्रष्टुमागता |
चुक्रोश शोकाद्विजया मृतां दृष्ट्वा सतीं महुः || 51 ||
text_mt: Then Satī’s sister's daughter, who had come to see her, / Vijayā, wept aloud again and again out of grief, seeing Satī dead.

sanskrit_iast:
hā satī kva gatāsīti hā satī tava kinvidam |
hā mātṛṣvasarityuccaistadā śabdo mahānabhūt || 52 ||
meaning:
हा सती क्व गतासीति हा सती तव किन्विदम् |
हा मातृष्वसरित्युच्चैस्तदा शब्दो महानभूत् || 52 ||
text_mt: “Alas, Satī, where have you gone? Alas, Satī, what is this of yours? / Alas, mother's sister!”—thus a great sound arose loudly then.

sanskrit_iast:
vipriyaśravaṇādeva prāṇāṃstyaktāstvayā sati |
ahaṃ kathantu jīvāmi dṛṣṭvedṛgvipriyaṃ dṛḍham || 53 ||
meaning:
विप्रियश्रवणादेव प्राणांस्त्यक्तास्त्वया सति |
अहं कथन्तु जीवामि दृष्ट्वेदृग्विप्रियं दृढम् || 53 ||
text_mt: “Just from hearing what was displeasing, your life-breaths were abandoned by you, O Satī! / How, then, shall I live, having seen such an intensely displeasing thing?

sanskrit_iast:
pāṇinā vadanaṃ satyā mārjayantī muhurmuhuḥ |
karuṇaṃ vilapantī sma mukhaṃ jighrati sā tadā || 54 ||
meaning:
पाणिना वदनं सत्या मार्जयन्ती मुहुर्मुहुः |
करुणं विलपन्ती स्म मुखं जिघ्रति सा तदा || 54 ||
text_mt: Wiping Satī’s face again and again with her hand, / she was lamenting piteously then, smelling her face,

sanskrit_iast:
siñcantī netrajaistoyaiḥ satyāḥ sā hṛdayaṃ mukham |
keśānullāsya pāṇibhyāṃ vīkṣantī vadanaṃ muhuḥ || 55 ||
meaning:
सिञ्चन्ती नेत्रजैस्तोयैः सत्याः सा हृदयं मुखम् |
केशानुल्लास्य पाणिभ्यां वीक्षन्ती वदनं मुहुः || 55 ||
text_mt: Sprinkling Satī’s heart and face with the waters born of her eyes, / smoothing her hair with both hands, looking at her face repeatedly,

sanskrit_iast:
ūrdhvādhaḥkampitaśirāḥ śokavyākulitendriyā |
hṛdayaṃ pañcaśākhābhyāṃ vinihantī tathā śiraḥ || 56 ||
meaning:
ऊर्ध्वाधःकम्पितशिराः शोकव्याकुलितेन्द्रिया |
हृदयं पञ्चशाखाभ्यां विनिहन्ती तथा शिरः || 56 ||
text_mt: Her head shaking up and down, her senses agitated with grief, / striking her chest and head with her five-fingered hands.

sanskrit_iast:
idaṃ ca vacanaṃ sāśrukaṇṭhā sā vijayā'bravīt |
śrutvā te maraṇaṃ mātā vīriṇī śokakarṣitā || 57 ||
meaning:
इदं च वचनं साश्रुकण्ठा सा विजयाऽब्रवीत् |
श्रुत्वा ते मरणं माता वीरिणी शोककर्षिता || 57 ||
text_mt: And with tears in her throat, that Vijayā spoke these words: / “Hearing of your death, your mother Vīriṇī, tormented by grief,

sanskrit_iast:
dhārayantī kathaṃ prāṇān sadyastyakṣyati jīvitam |
sa tathā niranukrośaḥ krūrakarmā pitā tava || 58 ||
meaning:
धारयन्ती कथं प्राणान् सद्यस्त्यक्ष्यति जीवितम् |
स तथा निरनुक्रोशः क्रूरकर्मा पिता तव || 58 ||
text_mt: How will she maintain her life-breaths? She will immediately abandon her life! / And so merciless, your father of cruel deeds,

sanskrit_iast:
pramītāṃ bhavatīṃ śrutvā kathaṃ dhāsyati jīvitam |
vicintya nūnaṃ karmāṇi svīyāni bhavatīṃ prati |
kṛtāni sa nṛśaṃsāni dakṣaḥ śokākulastadā || 59 ||
meaning:
प्रमीतां भवतीं श्रुत्वा कथं धास्यति जीवितम् |
विचिन्त्य नूनं कर्माणि स्वीयानि भवतीं प्रति |
कृतानि स नृशंसानि दक्षः शोकाकुलस्तदा || 59 ||
text_mt: Hearing that you have died, how will he maintain his life? / Surely reflecting upon his own cruel deeds done towards you, / that Dakṣa will then be overcome with grief.

sanskrit_iast:
yajvā sa ca jñānahīnaḥ kathaṃ yajñe pravartate |
niḥśraddhastyaktabuddhiśca kathaṃ vā sa bhavet kratau || 60 ||
meaning:
यज्वा स च ज्ञानहीनः कथं यज्ञे प्रवर्तते |
निःश्रद्धस्त्यक्तबुद्धिश्च कथं वा स भवेत् क्रतौ || 60 ||
text_mt: And how can he, as the sacrificer, devoid of understanding, proceed in the sacrifice? / Devoid of faith and bereft of sense, how indeed could he remain in the rite?

sanskrit_iast:
hā mātardehi vacanaṃ rudantyā bālavanmama |
bhavatyā nirdayā śokād dhriye śalyasamānasūn || 61 ||
meaning:
हा मातर्देहि वचनं रुदन्त्या बालवन्मम |
भवत्या निर्दया शोकाद् ध्रिये शल्यसमानसून् || 61 ||
text_mt: Alas, O mother, give an answer to me as I weep like a child! / Because you are merciless, out of grief I bear life-breaths that are like darts [in my chest]!

sanskrit_iast:
tvaṃ kiṃ smarasi me śambhorvihitasya kadācana |
tenāmarṣavaśaṃ prāptā mātarmāṃ kinna bhāṣase || 62 ||
meaning:
त्वं किं स्मरसि मे शम्भोर्विहितस्य कदाचन |
तेनामर्षवशं प्राप्ता मातर्मां किन्न भाषसे || 62 ||
text_mt: Do you remember something done to me by Śambhu at any time? / Fallen under the sway of resentment on that account, O mother, why do you not speak to me?

sanskrit_iast:
tadeva vacanaṃ cakṣurmukhaṃ sā nāsikā tava |
eteṣāṃ kva gatā sarve vibhramā hasitaṃ kva ca || 63 ||
meaning:
तदेव वचनं चक्षुर्मुखं सा नासिका तव |
एतेषां क्व गता सर्वे विभ्रमा हसितं क्व च || 63 ||
text_mt: That very voice, the eyes, the face, that nose of yours— / where have all their charms gone, and where has the laughter gone?

sanskrit_iast:
nanu te vibhramairhīnaṃ netrayugmaṃ sunāsikam |
smitahīnaṃ ca vadanaṃ dṛṣṭvā soḍhā kathaṃ haraḥ || 64 ||
meaning:
ननु ते विभ्रमैर्हीनं नेत्रयुग्मं सुनासिकम् |
स्मितहीनं च वदनं दृष्ट्वा सोढा कथं हरः || 64 ||
text_mt: Indeed, seeing the pair of eyes, the lovely nose, bereft of charms, / and the face bereft of a smile, how will Hara endure it?

sanskrit_iast:
kā sudhāsammitaṃ vākyaṃ harāśramasamāgatān |
sunṛtaṃ tvāmṛte mātarvadiṣyati muhurmuhuḥ || 65 ||
meaning:
का सुधासम्मितं वाक्यं हराश्रमसमागतान् |
सुनृतं त्वामृते मातर्वदिष्यति मुहुर्मुहुः || 65 ||
text_mt: Who, other than you, O mother, will repeatedly speak words / sweet as nectar, pleasing and true, to those who have come to Hara’s hermitage?

sanskrit_iast:
śraddhāvatī bāndhaveṣu patyurbhāvavaśānugā |
sarvalakṣaṇasampūrṇā tatsamā kā bhaviṣyati || 66 ||
meaning:
श्रद्धावती बान्धवेषु पत्युर्भाववशानुगा |
सर्वलक्षणसम्पूर्णा तत्समा का भविष्यति || 66 ||
text_mt: Full of faith towards kin, compliant to her husband’s disposition, / endowed with all auspicious marks—who will ever be equal to her?

sanskrit_iast:
tvadṛte devi deveśaḥ śokopahatacetanaḥ |
duḥkhitātmā nirutsāho niśceṣṭaśca bhaviṣyati || 67 ||
meaning:
त्वदृते देवि देवेशः शोकोपहतचेतनः |
दुःखितात्मा निरुत्साहो निश्चेष्टश्च भविष्यति || 67 ||
text_mt: Without you, O goddess, the Lord of the Gods, his consciousness struck down by grief, / will be sorrowful in soul, dispirited, and motionless.”

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ lapantī bhṛśaduḥkhitā satīṃ mṛtāṃ samīkṣyātiśayaṃ śucāhatā |
papāta bhūmau vijayā virāvaṃ vitanvatī cordhvabhujā pravepatī || 68 ||
meaning:
एवं लपन्ती भृशदुःखिता सतीं मृतां समीक्ष्यातिशयं शुचाहता |
पपात भूमौ विजया विरावं वितन्वती चोर्ध्वभुजा प्रवेपती || 68 ||
text_mt: Thus lamenting, severely distressed, seeing Satī dead, exceedingly stricken with grief, / Vijayā fell to the ground, uttering a cry, her arms raised, trembling violently.

sanskrit_iast:
iti śrīkālikāpurāṇe satīdeha-tyāgo nāma ṣoḍaṣo'dhyāyaḥ || 16 ||
saptadaśo'dhyāyaḥ
meaning:
इति श्रीकालिकापुराणे सतीदेह-त्यागो नाम षोडषोऽध्यायः || 16 ||
सप्तदशोऽध्यायः
text_mt: Thus ends the sixteenth chapter, named 'The Abandonment of Satī's Body', in the glorious Kālikāpurāṇa. / The seventeenth chapter.

sanskrit_iast: mārkaṇḍeya uvāca
meaning: मार्कण्डेय उवाच

sanskrit_iast:
etasminnantare śaṃbhuḥ śobhane mānase hrade |
samāpya sandhyāmāyātaḥ svamāśramapadaṃ prati || 1 ||
meaning:
एतस्मिन्नन्तरे शंभुः शोभने मानसे ह्रदे |
समाप्य सन्ध्यामायातः स्वमाश्रमपदं प्रति || 1 ||
text_mt: In the meantime, Śambhu, having completed his evening prayers / at the beautiful Mānasa lake, arrived at his own hermitage.

sanskrit_iast:
āgacchanneva saṃrāvaṃ vijayāyā vṛṣadhvajaḥ |
śuśrāva dāruṇaṃ tīvraṃ cakitaśca tato'bhavat || 2 ||
meaning:
आगच्छन्नेव संरावं विजयाया वृषध्वजः |
शुश्राव दारुणं तीव्रं चकितश्च ततोऽभवत् || 2 ||
text_mt: Even as he was coming, he whose banner is the bull heard the loud, / terrible, piercing wailing of Vijayā, and he was startled.

sanskrit_iast:
tata ukṣṇā balavatā manomārutaraṃhasā |
svamāśramapadaṃ śarva āsasāda tvarānvitaḥ || 3 ||
meaning:
तत उक्ष्णा बलवता मनोमारुतरंहसा |
स्वमाश्रमपदं शर्व आससाद त्वरान्वितः || 3 ||
text_mt: Then, on his powerful bull, with the speed of thought and the wind, / Śarva reached his own hermitage with haste.

sanskrit_iast:
āsādya devīṃ dayitāṃ tadā dākṣāyaṇīṃ haraḥ |
mṛtāṃ dṛṣṭvāpi na jahau mṛte'tipriyabhāvataḥ || 4 ||
meaning:
आसाद्य देवीं दयितां तदा दाक्षायणीं हरः |
मृतां दृष्ट्वापि न जहौ मृतेऽतिप्रियभावतः || 4 ||
text_mt: Approaching his beloved goddess, Dākṣāyaṇī, then, / Hara, though seeing her dead, did not abandon her, out of the most loving affection even though she was dead.

sanskrit_iast:
tato nirīkṣya vadanamāmṛjya ca punaḥ punaḥ |
papraccha kasmāt suptāsītyevaṃ drākṣāyaṇīṃ muhuḥ || 5 ||
meaning:
ततो निरीक्ष्य वदनमामृज्य च पुनः पुनः |
पप्रच्छ कस्मात् सुप्तासीत्येवं द्राक्षायणीं मुहुः || 5 ||
text_mt: Then, gazing at her face and stroking it again and again, / he asked Dākṣāyaṇī repeatedly, “Why are you asleep?”

sanskrit_iast:
tato bhargavacaḥ śrutvā tadā tadbhaginīsutā |
vijayā prāha nidhanaṃ dākṣāyaṇyā yathā tathā || 6 ||
meaning:
ततो भर्गवचः श्रुत्वा तदा तद्भगिनीसुता |
विजया प्राह निधनं दाक्षायण्या यथा तथा || 6 ||
text_mt: Then, hearing Bharga’s words, her sister's daughter / Vijayā related the death of Dākṣāyaṇī just as it was.

sanskrit_iast: vijayovāca
meaning: विजयोवाच

sanskrit_iast:
dakṣaḥ kartuṃ kratuṃ śambho devān sarvān savāsavān |
ājuhāva tathā daityān rākṣasān siddhaguhyakān || 7 ||
meaning:
दक्षः कर्तुं क्रतुं शम्भो देवान् सर्वान् सवासवान् |
आजुहाव तथा दैत्यान् राक्षसान् सिद्धगुह्यकान् || 7 ||
text_mt: “In order to perform a sacrifice, O Śambhu, Dakṣa summoned all the gods along with Indra, / as well as the Daityas, Rākṣasas, Siddhas, and Guhyakas,

sanskrit_iast:
brāhmaṇānatha govindamindrādīnapi dikpatīn |
devayonīṃstathā sarvān sādhyavidyādharādikān || 8 ||
meaning:
ब्राह्मणानथ गोविन्दमिन्द्रादीनपि दिक्पतीन् |
देवयोनींस्तथा सर्वान् साध्यविद्याधरादिकान् || 8 ||
text_mt: The Brāhmaṇas, then Govinda, and the guardians of the directions headed by Indra, / and all the divine beings—the Sādhyas, Vidyādharas, and the rest.

sanskrit_iast:
nāhūtāni kratau tena yāni sattvāni śaṃkara |
tāni dakṣeṇa no santi samastabhuvaneṣvapi || 9 ||
meaning:
नाहूतानि क्रतौ तेन यानि सत्त्वानि शंकर |
तानि दक्षेण नो सन्ति समस्तभुवनेष्वपि || 9 ||
text_mt: Whatever beings were not summoned by him to the sacrifice, O Śaṃkara, / those [beings] do not even exist in all the worlds according to Dakṣa.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ pravitataṃ yajñaṃ śrutvaiṣā vacanānmama |
vimṛṣyavatyanāhvāne hetuṃ śambhorathātmanaḥ || 10 ||
meaning:
एवं प्रविततं यज्ञं श्रुत्वैषा वचनान्मम |
विमृष्यवत्यनाह्वाने हेतुं शम्भोरथात्मनः || 10 ||
text_mt: Hearing of the sacrifice thus spread out from my words, / she reflected upon the reason for the non-invitation of Śambhu and of herself.

sanskrit_iast:
cintayānāṃ tathāhaṃ tāṃ satīṃ jñātvā yathāśrutam |
uktavatyasmi bhūteśa yajñānāhvānakāraṇam || 11 ||
meaning:
चिन्तयानां तथाहं तां सतीं ज्ञात्वा यथाश्रुतम् |
उक्तवत्यस्मि भूतेश यज्ञानाह्वानकारणम् || 11 ||
text_mt: To her as she was thus pondering, O Lord of Beings, having learned as it was heard, / I, Satī, spoke the reason for the non-invitation to the sacrifice:

sanskrit_iast:
śambhuḥ kapālī tajjāyā tatsaṃsargādvigarhitā |
ataḥ śambhuḥ satī cāpi nādhvare me miliṣyataḥ || 12 ||
meaning:
शम्भुः कपाली तज्जाया तत्संसर्गाद्विगर्हिता |
अतः शम्भुः सती चापि नाध्वरे मे मिलिष्यतः || 12 ||
text_mt: ‘Śambhu is a bearer of skulls; his wife is censured on account of association with him; / therefore, neither Śambhu nor Satī shall meet at my sacrifice.’

sanskrit_iast:
ityanāhvānaheturme śrutapūrvaḥ purā mukhāt |
dakṣasya vīriṇīṃ ślakṣṇāṃ gadatastasya mandire || 13 ||
meaning:
इत्यनाह्वानहेतुर्मे श्रुतपूर्वः पुरा मुखात् |
दक्षस्य वीरिणीं श्लक्ष्णां गदतस्तस्य मन्दिरे || 13 ||
text_mt: Thus the reason for the non-invitation was previously heard by me from the mouth / of Dakṣa, as he spoke softly to Vīriṇī in his dwelling.

sanskrit_iast:
etacchrutvā mama vacaḥ sā vivarṇamukhī kṣitau |
upaviṣṭā na māṃ kiṃciduktā kopaparāyaṇā || 14 ||
meaning:
एतच्छ्रुत्वा मम वचः सा विवर्णमुखी क्षितौ |
उपविष्टा न मां किंचिदुक्ता कोपपरायणा || 14 ||
text_mt: Hearing this speech of mine, with a pale face, / she sat down on the earth, entirely overcome with anger, not speaking anything to me.

sanskrit_iast:
babhūva vadanaṃ tasyāstatkṣaṇāt sarūpaṃ hara |
bhrukuṭīkuṭilaṃ śyāmaṃ yathā khaṃ dhūmaketunā || 15 ||
meaning:
बभूव वदनं तस्यास्तत्क्षणात् सरूपं हर |
भ्रुकुटीकुटिलं श्यामं यथा खं धूमकेतुना || 15 ||
text_mt: At that moment her face, O Hara, / became dark, distorted with knit brows, like the sky with a comet.

sanskrit_iast:
sā muhūrtamiva dhyātvā sphoṭena mahatā tataḥ |
prāṇānudasṛjaccaiṣā bhittvā mūrddhānamātmanaḥ || 16 ||
meaning:
सा मुहूर्तमिव ध्यात्वा स्फोटेन महता ततः |
प्राणानुदसृजच्चैषा भित्त्वा मूर्द्धानमात्मनः || 16 ||
text_mt: Having meditated for about a moment, then, with a great burst, / she released her life-breaths, splitting open her own skull.”

sanskrit_iast: mārkaṇḍeya uvāca
meaning: मार्कण्डेय उवाच

sanskrit_iast:
iti śrutvā vacastasyā vijayāyā vṛṣadhvajaḥ |
atīva kopāduttasthau didhakṣuriva pāvakaḥ || 17 ||
meaning:
इति श्रुत्वा वचस्तस्या विजयाया वृषध्वजः |
अतीव कोपादुत्तस्थौ दिधक्षुरिव पावकः || 17 ||
text_mt: Hearing these words of Vijayā, he whose banner is the bull / rose up in immense wrath, like fire wishing to burn.

sanskrit_iast:
tasya kopaparītasya karṇanāsākṣivaktrataḥ |
ghorā jalantyaḥ kaṇikāḥ sṛjantyo'gnermahāravam |
ulkā viniḥsṛtā vahvayaḥ kalpāntādityavarcasaḥ || 18 ||
meaning:
तस्य कोपपरीतस्य कर्णनासाक्षिवक्त्रतः |
घोरा जलन्त्यः कणिकाः सृजन्त्योऽग्नेर्महारवम् |
उल्का विनिःसृता वह्वयः कल्पान्तादित्यवर्चसः || 18 ||
text_mt: From his ears, nose, eyes, and mouth, as he was filled with wrath, / terrible, burning sparks came forth, emitting a great roar of fire, / numerous meteors having the radiance of the sun at the end of the aeon.

sanskrit_iast:
atha tatra jagāmāśu dakṣo yatra mahātapāḥ |
yajñañcakre haro gatvā yajñavāṭād bahiḥsthitaḥ || 19 ||
meaning:
अथ तत्र जगामाशु दक्षो यत्र महातपाः |
यज्ञञ्चक्रे हरो गत्वा यज्ञवाटाद् बहिःस्थितः || 19 ||
text_mt: Then Hara went quickly to where Dakṣa of great austerities / was performing the sacrifice; having arrived, he stood outside the sacrificial enclosure.

sanskrit_iast:
taṃ yajñaṃ dadṛśe bhargaḥ kopena mahatāvṛtaḥ |
mahādhanasamāpannaṃ pātrīyūpādibhirvṛtam || 20 ||
meaning:
तं यज्ञं ददृशे भर्गः कोपेन महतावृतः |
महाधनसमापन्नं पात्रीयूपादिभिर्वृतम् || 20 ||
text_mt: Covered with great wrath, Bharga beheld that sacrifice, / furnished with great wealth, filled with sacrificial vessels, posts, and other implements,

sanskrit_iast:
hutājyāhutisaṃvṛddhaṃ dīptavahnivirājitam |
yathāsthānasthitān sarvān dikpālān sāyudhadhvajān || 21 ||
meaning:
हुताज्याहुतिसंवृद्धं दीप्तवह्निविराजितम् |
यथास्थानस्थितान् सर्वान् दिक्पालान् सायुधध्वजान् || 21 ||
text_mt: Augmented with oblations of poured ghee, shining with blazing fire, / [and he saw] all the guardians of the directions stationed in their proper places, with weapons and banners.

sanskrit_iast:
vidhātāraṃ tathā viṣṇuṃ yajñamadhye vyavasthitam |
dadarśa kupitaḥ śambhustān dṛṣṭvātīva kopataḥ || 22 ||
meaning:
विधातारं तथा विष्णुं यज्ञमध्ये व्यवस्थितम् |
ददर्श कुपितः शम्भुस्तान् दृष्ट्वातीव कोपतः || 22 ||
text_mt: Likewise, the angry Śambhu beheld the Creator and Viṣṇu / seated in the midst of the sacrifice, and seeing them, out of extreme anger,

sanskrit_iast:
bhagaṃ sūryaṃ tathā somaṃ bhāryābhiḥ saha saṃvṛtam |
sahasrākṣaṃ gautamaṃ ca pūrve bhāge vyavasthitam || 23 ||
meaning:
भगं सूर्यं तथा सोमं भार्याभिः सह संवृतम् |
सहस्राक्षं गौतमं च पूर्वे भागे व्यवस्थितम् || 23 ||
text_mt: Bhaga, Sūrya, and Soma surrounded by their wives, / and Thousand-Eyed [Indra] and Gautama stationed in the eastern quarter.

sanskrit_iast:
sanatkumāramātreyaṃ bhārgavaṃ vinatāsutam |
marudgaṇāṃstathā sādhyānāgneyaṃ jātavedasam || 24 ||
meaning:
सनत्कुमारमात्रेयं भार्गवं विनतासुतम् |
मरुद्गणांस्तथा साध्यानाग्नेयं जातवेदसम् || 24 ||
text_mt: Sanatkumāra, the son of Atri, the descendant of Bhṛgu, the son of Vinatā, / the troops of the Maruts and the Sādhyas, and Jātavedas, [god] of fire;

sanskrit_iast:
kālaṃ ca citraguptañca kumbhayoniṃ sagālavam |
viśvedevāṃstathā sarvān kavyavāhādikān pitṛn || 25 ||
meaning:
कालं च चित्रगुप्तञ्च कुम्भयोनिं सगालवम् |
विश्वेदेवांस्तथा सर्वान् कव्यवाहादिकान् पितृन् || 25 ||
text_mt: and Kāla, Citragupta, the jar-born [Agastya] with Gālava, / and all the Viśvedevas, and the ancestors beginning with Kavyavāha;

sanskrit_iast:
agniṣvāttādikān sarvān bhūtagrāmaṃ caturvidham |
bhaumaṃ pretagaṇān siddhān dakṣiṇāśāṃ vyavasthitān || 26 ||
meaning:
अग्निष्वात्तादिकान् सर्वान् भूतग्रामं चतुर्विधम् |
भौमं प्रेतगणान् सिद्धान् दक्षिणाशां व्यवस्थितान् || 26 ||
text_mt: all [the ancestors] beginning with the Agniṣvāttas, the fourfold host of beings, / Bhauma, the hordes of ghosts, and the Siddhas, stationed in the southern quarter;

sanskrit_iast:
rakṣāṃsi ca piśācāṃśca bhūtāni mṛgapakṣiṇaḥ |
kravyādān kṣudrajantūṃśca tathā puṇyajaneśvaram || 27 ||
meaning:
रक्षांसि च पिशाचांश्च भूतानि मृगपक्षिणः |
क्रव्यादान् क्षुद्रजन्तूंश्च तथा पुण्यजनेश्वरम् || 27 ||
text_mt: and the rākṣasas, piśācas, spirits, beasts, and birds, / the carnivorous creatures, the small insects, and the lord of the Puṇyajanas;

sanskrit_iast:
maharṣi maudgalaṃ rāhuṃ nairṛtyāṃ kinnarāṃstathā |
mahoragāṃstathā nakrān matsyān grāhāṃśca kacchapān |
samudrān saptasindhūṃśca nadīstīrthāni guhyakān || 28 ||
meaning:
महर्षि मौद्गलं राहुं नैरृत्यां किन्नरांस्तथा |
महोरगांस्तथा नक्रान् मत्स्यान् ग्राहांश्च कच्छपान् |
समुद्रान् सप्तसिन्धूंश्च नदीस्तीर्थानि गुह्यकान् || 28 ||
text_mt: the great sage Maudgala, Rāhu, and the kinnaras in the southwest; / the great serpents, crocodiles, fish, alligators, and turtles, / the oceans, the seven rivers, the streams, the holy fords, and the guhyakas;

sanskrit_iast:
mānasādi hradān sarvān gaṃgāṃjambūnadīṃ tathā |
kāmaṃ madhuṃ vasantaṃ ca varuṇañca sahānugam || 29 ||
meaning:
मानसादि ह्रदान् सर्वान् गंगांजम्बूनदीं तथा |
कामं मधुं वसन्तं च वरुणञ्च सहानुगम् || 29 ||
text_mt: all the lakes beginning with Mānasa, the Gaṅgā, and the Jambū river; / Kāma, Madhu, and Vasanta, and Varuṇa with his followers;

sanskrit_iast:
śanaiścaraṃ girīn sarvān paścimāśāvyavasthitān |
prāṇādipaṃcavāyūṃśca sagaṇañca samīraṇam |
kalpadrumān himādriñca kaśyapañca mahāmunim || 30 ||
meaning:
शनैश्चरं गिरीन् सर्वान् पश्चिमाशाव्यवस्थितान् |
प्राणादिपंचवायूंश्च सगणञ्च समीरणम् |
कल्पद्रुमान् हिमाद्रिञ्च कश्यपञ्च महामुनिम् || 30 ||
text_mt: Śanaiścara, all the mountains stationed in the western quarter, / the five winds beginning with prāṇa, and the Wind-god with his troop, / the wish-fulfilling trees, Himādri, and the great sage Kaśyapa;

sanskrit_iast:
vāyavyāṃ kamalāvrātaṃ phalāni ca kalānidhim |
nānāratnāni haimāni manuṣyān parvatāṃstathā || 31 ||
meaning:
वायव्यां कमलाव्रातं फलानि च कलानिधिम् |
नानारत्नानि हैमानि मनुष्यान् पर्वतांस्तथा || 31 ||
text_mt: a cluster of lotuses in the northwest, fruits, the moon, / various golden jewels, men, and mountains;

sanskrit_iast:
himādrimukhyā yakṣāśca sthūṇakarṇādayo budhāḥ |
nalakūbereṇa sahito yakṣarānnaravāhanaḥ || 32 ||
meaning:
हिमाद्रिमुख्या यक्षाश्च स्थूणकर्णादयो बुधाः |
नलकूबेरेण सहितो यक्षरान्नरवाहनः || 32 ||
text_mt: the yakṣas headed by Himādri, the wise ones beginning with Sthūṇakarṇa, / and the king of yakṣas, who rides upon men, accompanied by Nalakūbara;

sanskrit_iast:
dhruvo dharaśca somaśca viṣṇuścaivānilo'nalaḥ |
pratyūṣaśca prabhāsaśca kauverīṃ saṃsthitānimān || 33 ||
meaning:
ध्रुवो धरश्च सोमश्च विष्णुश्चैवानिलोऽनलः |
प्रत्यूषश्च प्रभासश्च कौवेरीं संस्थितानिमान् || 33 ||
text_mt: Dhruva, Dhara, Soma, Viṣṇu, Anila, Anala, / Pratyūṣa, and Prabhāsa—these stationed in the northern [quarter];

sanskrit_iast:
vṛṣadhvajaṃ vinā sarvān rudrān jīvaṃ manūṃstathā |
vividhān bāhujān vaiśyānśūdrānapi samantataḥ || 34 ||
meaning:
वृषध्वजं विना सर्वान् रुद्रान् जीवं मनूंस्तथा |
विविधान् बाहुजान् वैश्यान्शूद्रानपि समन्ततः || 34 ||
text_mt: all the Rudras except the bull-bannered [Śiva], Jīva, and the Manus, / and the various kṣatriyas, vaiśyas, and śūdras on all sides;

sanskrit_iast:
aiśānyāṃ vividhānnāni vrīhīnapi tilānapi |
aiśānīpūrvayormadhye brahmarṣīn saṃśitavratān || 35 ||
meaning:
ऐशान्यां विविधान्नानि व्रीहीनपि तिलानपि |
ऐशानीपूर्वयोर्मध्ये ब्रह्मर्षीन् संशितव्रतान् || 35 ||
text_mt: various foods, rice, and sesame in the northeast; / between the northeast and the east, the brahmin seers of strict vows,

sanskrit_iast:
maharṣīṃścaturo vedān vedāṅgāni tathaiva ṣaṭ |
nerṛtyapaścimāntasthamanantaṃ śvetaparvatam || 36 ||
meaning:
महर्षींश्चतुरो वेदान् वेदाङ्गानि तथैव षट् |
नेरृत्यपश्चिमान्तस्थमनन्तं श्वेतपर्वतम् || 36 ||
text_mt: the great seers, the four Vedas, and likewise the six Vedāṅgas; / Ananta and the White Mountain, situated on the border of the southwest and the west;

sanskrit_iast:
kādraveyasahasreṇa sahitān saptabhoginaḥ |
ketuṃ tatraiva kuṣmāṇḍaṃ ḍākinīgaṇasaṃyuktam || 37 ||
meaning:
काद्रवेयसहस्रेण सहितान् सप्तभोगिनः |
केतुं तत्रैव कुष्माण्डं डाकिनीगणसंयुक्तम् || 37 ||
text_mt: the seven-hooded serpents accompanied by a thousand offspring of Kadrū; / Ketu right there, and Kuṣmāṇḍa accompanied by the host of ḍākinīs;

sanskrit_iast:
tathā jaladharānanyānnānāvarṇān savidyutān |
diggajānapi tatrasthānairāvatamukhān haraḥ || 38 ||
meaning:
तथा जलधरानन्यान्नानावर्णान् सविद्युतान् |
दिग्गजानपि तत्रस्थानैरावतमुखान् हरः || 38 ||
text_mt: and other clouds of various colours, accompanied by lightning; / and Hara [saw] the elephants of the quarters stationed there, headed by Airāvata,

sanskrit_iast:
yathāsthānasthitān sarvāndikkariṇyā ca saṃyutān |
tamevaṃ dūrato dṛṣṭvā yajñavāṭaṃ mahādhanam |
vīrabhadrāhvayaṃ tūrṇa preṣayāmāsa taṃ prati || 39 ||
meaning:
यथास्थानस्थितान् सर्वान्दिक्करिण्या च संयुतान् |
तमेवं दूरतो दृष्ट्वा यज्ञवाटं महाधनम् |
वीरभद्राह्वयं तूर्ण प्रेषयामास तं प्रति || 39 ||
text_mt: all stationed in their proper places and accompanied by the female elephants of the quarters. / Seeing from afar that sacrificial enclosure filled with immense wealth, / he swiftly dispatched against it the one called Vīrabhadra.

sanskrit_iast:
vīrabhadro'pi bahubhiḥ saṃvṛto vividhairgaṇaiḥ |
vyadhvaṃsayattato yajñaṃ dakṣasya sumahātmanaḥ || 40 ||
meaning:
वीरभद्रोऽपि बहुभिः संवृतो विविधैर्गणैः |
व्यध्वंसयत्ततो यज्ञं दक्षस्य सुमहात्मनः || 40 ||
text_mt: Then Vīrabhadra, surrounded by numerous and diverse hosts, / destroyed the sacrifice of the high-souled Dakṣa.

sanskrit_iast:
vikurvantaṃ mahāyajñaṃ vīrabhadraṃ samīkṣya vai |
vārayāmāsa vaikuṇṭhaḥ sarvadevagaṇāvṛtaḥ || 41 ||
meaning:
विकुर्वन्तं महायज्ञं वीरभद्रं समीक्ष्य वै |
वारयामास वैकुण्ठः सर्वदेवगणावृतः || 41 ||
text_mt: Beholding Vīrabhadra devastating the great sacrifice, / Vaikuṇṭha, surrounded by all the hosts of gods, checked him.

sanskrit_iast:
taṃ vāryamāṇaṃ dṛṣṭaiva krodhasaṃraktalocanaḥ |
svayaṃ viveśa taṃ yajñaṃ dhvaṃsayāmāsa ceśvaraḥ || 42 ||
meaning:
तं वार्यमाणं दृष्टैव क्रोधसंरक्तलोचनः |
स्वयं विवेश तं यज्ञं ध्वंसयामास चेश्वरः || 42 ||
text_mt: Seeing him checked, his eyes reddened with rage, / Īśvara himself entered that sacrifice and destroyed it.

sanskrit_iast:
viśantameva taṃ yajñe prathamaṃ purato bhagaḥ |
bāhū vitatya bhūteśamāsasāda tvarānvitaḥ || 43 ||
meaning:
विशन्तमेव तं यज्ञे प्रथमं पुरतो भगः |
बाहू वितत्य भूतेशमाससाद त्वरान्वितः || 43 ||
text_mt: As he was entering the sacrifice, Bhaga, right in front, / spread his arms and swiftly approached the Lord of Beings.

sanskrit_iast:
tamāgatamabhiprekṣya bhargo'pi bhṛśaroṣitaḥ |
aṃgulyagraprahāreṇa tasya netre jaghāna ha || 44 ||
meaning:
तमागतमभिप्रेक्ष्य भर्गोऽपि भृशरोषितः |
अंगुल्यग्रप्रहारेण तस्य नेत्रे जघान ह || 44 ||
text_mt: Seeing him come forward, Bharga, exceedingly enraged, / struck out his eyes with a blow from the tip of his finger.

sanskrit_iast:
hīnanetraṃ bhagaṃ dṛṣṭvā virūpākṣaṃ divākaraḥ |
sparddhamānastataḥ sarvamāsasāda tvarānvitaḥ || 45 ||
meaning:
हीननेत्रं भगं दृष्ट्वा विरूपाक्षं दिवाकरः |
स्पर्द्धमानस्ततः सर्वमाससाद त्वरान्वितः || 45 ||
text_mt: Seeing Bhaga deprived of his eyes, Divākara, / vying in rivalry against Virūpākṣa, then swiftly approached everything.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ sūryaṃ mahādevaḥ pāṇau dhṛtvā kareṇa ca |
dūrakṛtyātikupito yajñamevābhyadhāvata || 46 ||
meaning:
ततः सूर्यं महादेवः पाणौ धृत्वा करेण च |
दूरकृत्यातिकुपितो यज्ञमेवाभ्यधावत || 46 ||
text_mt: Then Mahādeva seized Sūrya with his hand, / cast him far away, and, intensely enraged, rushed right toward the sacrifice.

sanskrit_iast:
mārtaṇḍaśca hasan vegādvitatya vipulau bhujau |
ehi yotsye tvayetyuktvā tamagre pratyavārayat || 47 ||
meaning:
मार्तण्डश्च हसन् वेगाद्वितत्य विपुलौ भुजौ |
एहि योत्स्ये त्वयेत्युक्त्वा तमग्रे प्रत्यवारयत् || 47 ||
text_mt: Mārtaṇḍa, laughing, quickly spread his broad arms, / and saying, “Come, I will fight with you!” blocked him in front.

sanskrit_iast:
hasatastasya sūryasya krodhena vṛṣabhadhvajaḥ |
dantān karaprahāreṇa śātayāmāsa vaktṛtaḥ || 48 ||
meaning:
हसतस्तस्य सूर्यस्य क्रोधेन वृषभध्वजः |
दन्तान् करप्रहारेण शातयामास वक्तृतः || 48 ||
text_mt: As Sūrya laughed, the bull-bannered [Śiva] in fury / knocked the teeth out of his mouth with a blow of his hand.

sanskrit_iast:
vidantaṃ mihiraṃ dṛṣṭvā hīnanetraṃ bhagaṃ tathā |
sarve devāśca ṛṣayo ye cānye tatra dudruvuḥ || 49 ||
meaning:
विदन्तं मिहिरं दृष्ट्वा हीननेत्रं भगं तथा |
सर्वे देवाश्च ऋषयो ये चान्ये तत्र दुद्रुवुः || 49 ||
text_mt: Seeing Mihira toothless and Bhaga deprived of his eyes, / all the gods, the seers, and whoever else was there fled.

sanskrit_iast:
vidrāvya sarvān devādīn haraḥ paramakopanaḥ |
mṛgarūpenāpayāntaṃ yajñamevānvapadyata || 50 ||
meaning:
विद्राव्य सर्वान् देवादीन् हरः परमकोपनः |
मृगरूपेनापयान्तं यज्ञमेवान्वपद्यत || 50 ||
text_mt: Having routed all the gods and others, Hara, intensely enraged, / pursued the sacrifice itself, which was fleeing in the form of a deer.

sanskrit_iast:
yajño'pyākāśamārgeṇa brahmasthānaṃ viveśa ha |
vṛṣadhvajo'pi kupito brahmasthānaṃ jagāma ha || 51 ||
meaning:
यज्ञोऽप्याकाशमार्गेण ब्रह्मस्थानं विवेश ह |
वृषध्वजोऽपि कुपितो ब्रह्मस्थानं जगाम ह || 51 ||
text_mt: The sacrifice, through the path of the sky, entered the abode of Brahmā; / and the bull-bannered [god], enraged, also went to the abode of Brahmā.

sanskrit_iast:
brahmaṇaḥ sadanād yajño bhīto bhargādavātarat |
avatīrya satīdehaṃ praviveśa svamāyayā || 52 ||
meaning:
ब्रह्मणः सदनाद् यज्ञो भीतो भर्गादवातरत् |
अवतीर्य सतीदेहं प्रविवेश स्वमायया || 52 ||
text_mt: Terrified of Bharga, the sacrifice descended from the abode of Brahmā; / having descended, it entered the body of Satī by its own māyā.

sanskrit_iast:
bhargo'pi dakṣaduhiturmṛtāyā nikaṭaṃ yataḥ |
anvagacchatadā yajñaṃ dadarśa ca satīśavam || 53 ||
meaning:
भर्गोऽपि दक्षदुहितुर्मृताया निकटं यतः |
अन्वगच्छतदा यज्ञं ददर्श च सतीशवम् || 53 ||
text_mt: Bharga too went near Dakṣa's deceased daughter; / pursuing the sacrifice then, he saw the corpse of Satī.

sanskrit_iast:
mṛtāṃ dṛṣṭvā tadā devīṃ haro dākṣāyaṇīṃ satīm |
vismṛtya yajñaṃ tatprānte sthito vāḍaṃ śuśoca tān || 54 ||
meaning:
मृतां दृष्ट्वा तदा देवीं हरो दाक्षायणीं सतीम् |
विस्मृत्य यज्ञं तत्प्रान्ते स्थितो वाडं शुशोच तान् || 54 ||
text_mt: Seeing the dead goddess, Dākṣāyaṇī Satī, / Hara forgot the sacrifice, and standing beside her, he grieved deeply.

sanskrit_iast:
bahuvidhaguṇavṛndaṃ cintayañchūlapāṇirlalitadaśanapaṃktiṃ vaktṛmabjaprakāśam |
aruṇadaśanavastraṃ bhrūyugaṃ vīkṣya tasyāḥ kharatarapṛthuśokavyākulo'sau ruroda
|| 55 ||
meaning:
बहुविधगुणवृन्दं चिन्तयञ्छूलपाणिर्ललितदशनपंक्तिं वक्तृमब्जप्रकाशम् |
अरुणदशनवस्त्रं भ्रूयुगं वीक्ष्य तस्याः खरतरपृथुशोकव्याकुलोऽसौ रुरोद
|| 55 ||
text_mt: Contemplating the host of her manifold virtues, / beholding her face radiant as a lotus, her charming row of teeth, / her red lips, and her pair of eyebrows, / the spear-handed [god], overcome with piercing and vast grief, wept aloud.

sanskrit_iast:
iti śrīkālikāpurāṇe dakṣayajñabhaṅge saptadaśo'dhyāyaḥ || 17 ||
aṣṭādaśo'dhyāyaḥ
meaning:
इति श्रीकालिकापुराणे दक्षयज्ञभङ्गे सप्तदशोऽध्यायः || 17 ||
अष्टादशोऽध्यायः
text_mt: Thus ends the seventeenth chapter, on the destruction of Dakṣa's sacrifice, in the glorious Kālikāpurāṇa. / The eighteenth chapter.

sanskrit_iast: mārkaṇḍeya uvāca
meaning: मार्कण्डेय उवाच

sanskrit_iast:
dākṣāyaṇīguṇagaṇān gaṇayan goraṅgastadā |
vilalāpātiduḥkhārto manujaḥ prākṛto yathā || 1 ||
meaning:
दाक्षायणीगुणगणान् गणयन् गोरङ्गस्तदा |
विललापातिदुःखार्तो मनुजः प्राकृतो यथा || 1 ||
text_mt: Recounting the many virtues of Dākṣāyaṇī, / the fair-limbed [Śiva], tormented by extreme sorrow, then lamented like an ordinary mortal.

sanskrit_iast:
vilapantaṃ tadā bhargaṃ vijñāya makaradhvajaḥ |
ratīvasantasahita āsasāda maheśvaram || 2 ||
meaning:
विलपन्तं तदा भर्गं विज्ञाय मकरध्वजः |
रतीवसन्तसहित आससाद महेश्वरम् || 2 ||
text_mt: Knowing Bharga to be lamenting, the crocodile-bannered [Kāma] / approached Maheśvara together with Ratī and Vasanta.

sanskrit_iast:
taṃ śucātiparibhraṣṭaṃ yugapat sa ratipatiḥ |
jaghāna paṃcabhirvāṇai rudantaṃ bhraṣṭhacetanam || 3 ||
meaning:
तं शुचातिपरिभ्रष्टं युगपत् स रतिपतिः |
जघान पंचभिर्वाणै रुदन्तं भ्रष्ठचेतनम् || 3 ||
text_mt: The lord of Rati struck him who was utterly broken by grief, / weeping and bereft of consciousness, simultaneously with his five arrows.

sanskrit_iast:
śokābhihatacitto'pi smarabāṇa-samākulaḥ |
saṃkīrṇabhāvamāpannaḥ śuśoca ca mumoha ca || 4 ||
meaning:
शोकाभिहतचित्तोऽपि स्मरबाण-समाकुलः |
संकीर्णभावमापन्नः शुशोच च मुमोह च || 4 ||
text_mt: Though his mind was smitten with grief, yet agitated by Smara's arrows, / he fell into a confused state, and he both grieved and fainted.

sanskrit_iast:
kṣaṇaṃ bhūmau nipatati kṣaṇamutvāya dhāvati |
kṣaṇaṃ bhramati tatraiva nimīlati vibhuḥ punaḥ || 5 ||
meaning:
क्षणं भूमौ निपतति क्षणमुत्वाय धावति |
क्षणं भ्रमति तत्रैव निमीलति विभुः पुनः || 5 ||
text_mt: One moment he falls to the ground, one moment he rises and runs; / one moment he wanders right there, and again the all-pervading lord closes his eyes.

sanskrit_iast:
dhyāyan dākṣāyaṇīṃ devīṃ hasamānaḥ kadācana |
pariṣvajati bhūmiṣṭhāṃ rasabhāvairiva sthitām || 6 ||
meaning:
ध्यायन् दाक्षायणीं देवीं हसमानः कदाचन |
परिष्वजति भूमिष्ठां रसभावैरिव स्थिताम् || 6 ||
text_mt: Meditating on the goddess Dākṣāyaṇī, sometimes laughing, / he embraces her lying on the ground, as though she were present with emotional sentiments.

sanskrit_iast:
satīsatīti satataṃ nāma vyāhṛtya śaṃkaraḥ |
mānaṃ tyaja vṛthetyevamuktvā spṛśati pāṇinā || 7 ||
meaning:
सतीसतीति सततं नाम व्याहृत्य शंकरः |
मानं त्यज वृथेत्येवमुक्त्वा स्पृशति पाणिना || 7 ||
text_mt: Constantly uttering the name, “Satī! Satī!”, / Śaṃkara touches her with his hand, saying, “Abandon your wounded pride in vain!”

sanskrit_iast:
pāṇināparimārjyaināmalaṃkārān yathāsthitān |
tasyā viśliṣya ca punastatraivānuyuyoja ca || 8 ||
meaning:
पाणिनापरिमार्ज्यैनामलंकारान् यथास्थितान् |
तस्या विश्लिष्य च पुनस्तत्रैवानुयुयोज च || 8 ||
text_mt: Wiping her clean with his hand, he detached her ornaments / just as they lay on her, and then fastened them right back in place.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ kurvati bhūteśe mṛtā novāca kiñcana |
yadā satī tadā bhargaḥ śokādgāḍhaṃ ruroda ha || 9 ||
meaning:
एवं कुर्वति भूतेशे मृता नोवाच किञ्चन |
यदा सती तदा भर्गः शोकाद्गाढं रुरोद ह || 9 ||
text_mt: While the Lord of Beings was doing this, Satī, being dead, / said nothing at all; then Bharga wept bitterly out of grief.

sanskrit_iast:
rudatastasya patato vāṣpān vīkṣya tadā surāḥ |
brahmādayaḥ parāṃ cintāṃ jagmuścintāparāyaṇāḥ || 10 ||
meaning:
रुदतस्तस्य पततो वाष्पान् वीक्ष्य तदा सुराः |
ब्रह्मादयः परां चिन्तां जग्मुश्चिन्तापरायणाः || 10 ||
text_mt: Seeing the tears of him as he wept falling down, / the gods, headed by Brahmā, became absorbed in grave anxiety.

sanskrit_iast:
vāṣpāḥ patanto bhūmau ceddaheyuḥ pṛthivīmimām |
upāyastatra kaḥ kārya iti hāheti cukruśuḥ || 11 ||
meaning:
वाष्पाः पतन्तो भूमौ चेद्दहेयुः पृथिवीमिमाम् |
उपायस्तत्र कः कार्य इति हाहेति चुक्रुशुः || 11 ||
text_mt: "If the falling tears should touch the earth, they would burn up this world! / What remedy can be applied there?" they cried, weeping in distress.

sanskrit_iast:
tato vimṛṣyate devā brahmādyāstu śanaiścaram |
tuṣṭuvurmūḍhabhargasya vāṣpadhāraṇakāraṇāt || 12 ||
meaning:
ततो विमृष्यते देवा ब्रह्माद्यास्तु शनैश्चरम् |
तुष्टुवुर्मूढभर्गस्य वाष्पधारणकारणात् || 12 ||
text_mt: Then, having reflected, the gods led by Brahmā praised Śanaiścara, / so that he might catch the tears of the bewildered Bharga.

sanskrit_iast: devā ūcuḥ
meaning: देवा ऊचुः

sanskrit_iast:
śanaiścara mahābhāga lokānugrahakāraka |
mūlaśaktisamudbhūta namaste sūryasambhava || 13 ||
meaning:
शनैश्चर महाभाग लोकानुग्रहकारक |
मूलशक्तिसमुद्भूत नमस्ते सूर्यसम्भव || 13 ||
text_mt: O illustrious Śanaiścara, who bestow grace upon the worlds, / arisen from the primal energy, born of the sun, praise be to you!

sanskrit_iast:
namaste śūlahastāya pāśahastāya dhanvine |
tathā varadahastāya tamaśchāyātmajāya te || 4 ||
meaning:
नमस्ते शूलहस्ताय पाशहस्ताय धन्विने |
तथा वरदहस्ताय तमश्छायात्मजाय ते || 4 ||
text_mt: Praise be to you who hold a trident in hand, a noose in hand, armed with a bow, / and who show the gesture of granting boons, son of darkness and Chāyā!

sanskrit_iast:
nīlamegha-pratīkāśa bhinnāñjanacayopama |
namaste sarvalokānāṃ prāṇadhāraṇahetave || 15 ||
meaning:
नीलमेघ-प्रतीकाश भिन्नाञ्जनचयोपम |
नमस्ते सर्वलोकानां प्राणधारणहेतवे || 15 ||
text_mt: Resembling a dark rain-cloud, like a heap of crushed collyrium, / praise be to you, the cause of sustaining the breath of all worlds!

sanskrit_iast:
gṛdhradhvaja namaste'stu prasīda bhagavan dṛḍham |
vāṣpebhyaḥ śokajebhyaśca pāhi bhargasya naḥ kṣitim || 16 ||
meaning:
गृध्रध्वज नमस्तेऽस्तु प्रसीद भगवन् दृढम् |
वाष्पेभ्यः शोकजेभ्यश्च पाहि भर्गस्य नः क्षितिम् || 16 ||
text_mt: O you whose emblem is a vulture, praise be to you! Be thoroughly gracious, O Lord! / Protect our earth from the grief-born tears of Bharga!

sanskrit_iast:
yathā purā śataṃ varṣānavajagrāha varṣaṇam |
bhavāneva tu meghebhyastathā kuru harāmbuni || 17 ||
meaning:
यथा पुरा शतं वर्षानवजग्राह वर्षणम् |
भवानेव तु मेघेभ्यस्तथा कुरु हराम्बुनि || 17 ||
text_mt: Just as formerly you alone restrained rain from the clouds for a hundred years, / so do with the water of Hara!

sanskrit_iast:
tavacāpāṃ grahaṃ dṛṣṭvā meghāste puṣkarādayaḥ |
mumucuḥ satataṃ varṣaṃ mahendrasya kilājñayā || 18 ||
meaning:
तवचापां ग्रहं दृष्ट्वा मेघास्ते पुष्करादयः |
मुमुचुः सततं वर्षं महेन्द्रस्य किलाज्ञया || 18 ||
text_mt: Seeing you restrain the waters with your bow, those clouds beginning with Puṣkara / let loose perpetual rain, indeed by the command of Mahendra.

sanskrit_iast:
ākāśa eva varṣāmbhastatsarvaṃ bhavatā purā |
vināśitaṃ yathā vāṣpaṃ tathā nāśaya śūlinaḥ || 19 ||
meaning:
आकाश एव वर्षाम्भस्तत्सर्वं भवता पुरा |
विनाशितं यथा वाष्पं तथा नाशय शूलिनः || 19 ||
text_mt: All that rainwater in the sky was destroyed by you in the past; / likewise destroy the tears of the trident-bearer!

sanskrit_iast:
na tvāmṛte'nyaḥ śakto'sti haravāṣpanivāraṇe |
dahet sadevagandharvabrahmalokān saparvatān |
pṛthivīṃ patito vāṣpastasmāddhāraya māyayā || 20 ||
meaning:
न त्वामृतेऽन्यः शक्तोऽस्ति हरवाष्पनिवारणे |
दहेत् सदेवगन्धर्वब्रह्मलोकान् सपर्वतान् |
पृथिवीं पतितो वाष्पस्तस्माद्धारय मायया || 20 ||
text_mt: None other than you is capable of arresting the tears of Hara. / Falling, the tears would burn the earth along with the worlds of gods, gandharvas, and Brahmā, and with its mountains; / therefore catch them by your māyā!

sanskrit_iast: mārkaṇḍeya uvāca
meaning: मार्कण्डेय उवाच

sanskrit_iast:
ityevambhāṣaṇamāṇeṣu deveṣu mihirātmajaḥ |
pratyuvāca sa tān devānnātihṛṣṭamanā iva || 21 ||
meaning:
इत्येवम्भाषणमाणेषु देवेषु मिहिरात्मजः |
प्रत्युवाच स तान् देवान्नातिहृष्टमना इव || 21 ||
text_mt: While the gods were speaking thus, the son of the sun / answered those gods, looking as if not exceedingly pleased in mind:

sanskrit_iast: śanaiścara uvāca
meaning: शनैश्चर उवाच

sanskrit_iast:
kariṣye bhavatāṃ karma yathāśakti surottamāḥ |
tathā kintu vidadhaṃ hi na māṃ vetti yathā haraḥ || 22 ||
meaning:
करिष्ये भवतां कर्म यथाशक्ति सुरोत्तमाः |
तथा किन्तु विदधं हि न मां वेत्ति यथा हरः || 22 ||
text_mt: I shall do your work to the best of my power, O best of gods; / but arrange it in such a way that Hara does not perceive me.

sanskrit_iast:
duḥkhaśokākulasyāsya samīpe vāṣpadhāriṇaḥ |
kopānnaśyeccharīraṃ me niyataṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ || 23 ||
meaning:
दुःखशोकाकुलस्यास्य समीपे वाष्पधारिणः |
कोपान्नश्येच्छरीरं मे नियतं नात्र संशयः || 23 ||
text_mt: Near him who is overwhelmed by sorrow and grief, catching his tears, / my body would certainly be destroyed by his anger; of this there is no doubt.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmād yathā māṃ bhūteśo na jānāti satīpatiḥ |
tathā kurudhvaṃ netrebhyo haralotakadhāriṇam || 24 ||
meaning:
तस्माद् यथा मां भूतेशो न जानाति सतीपतिः |
तथा कुरुध्वं नेत्रेभ्यो हरलोतकधारिणम् || 24 ||
text_mt: Therefore, arrange it so that the lord of beings, the husband of Satī, / does not notice me as I catch the tears falling from Hara’s eyes.

sanskrit_iast: mārkaṇḍeya uvāca
meaning: मार्कण्डेय उवाच

sanskrit_iast:
tato brahmādayo devāste sarve śaṃkarāntikam |
gatvā hara sanmumuhuḥ sāsāryā yogamāyayā || 25 ||
meaning:
ततो ब्रह्मादयो देवास्ते सर्वे शंकरान्तिकम् |
गत्वा हर सन्मुमुहुः सासार्या योगमायया || 25 ||
text_mt: Then the gods led by Brahmā, all going near Śaṅkara, / thoroughly deluded Hara with the all-pervading yogamāyā.

sanskrit_iast:
śanaiścaro'pi bhūteśamāsādyāntarhitastadā |
vāṣpavṛṣṭiṃ durādharṣāmavajagrāha māyayā || 26 ||
meaning:
शनैश्चरोऽपि भूतेशमासाद्यान्तर्हितस्तदा |
वाष्पवृष्टिं दुराधर्षामवजग्राह मायया || 26 ||
text_mt: Śanaiścara too, having approached the lord of beings, then remained invisible / and restrained by his māyā the irresistible shower of tears.

sanskrit_iast:
yadā sa nāśakadvāṣpān sandhārayitumarkajaḥ |
tadā mahāgirau kṣiptā vāṣpāste jaladhārake || 27 ||
meaning:
यदा स नाशकद्वाष्पान् सन्धारयितुमर्कजः |
तदा महागिरौ क्षिप्ता वाष्पास्ते जलधारके || 27 ||
text_mt: When he, the sun’s son, could no longer contain the tears, / those tears were cast upon the great mountain Jaladhāraka.

sanskrit_iast:
lokālokasya nikaṭe jaladhārāhvayo giriḥ |
puṣkaradvīpapṛṣṭhasthastoyasāgara paścime || 28 ||
meaning:
लोकालोकस्य निकटे जलधाराह्वयो गिरिः |
पुष्करद्वीपपृष्ठस्थस्तोयसागर पश्चिमे || 28 ||
text_mt: Near Lokāloka stands the mountain named Jaladhāra, / situated on the back of Puṣkaradvīpa, to the west of the ocean of water.

sanskrit_iast:
sa tu sarvapramāṇena meruparvatasannibhaḥ |
tasmin vinyastavān vāṣpāṃstadāśaktaḥ śanaiścaraḥ || 29 ||
meaning:
स तु सर्वप्रमाणेन मेरुपर्वतसन्निभः |
तस्मिन् विन्यस्तवान् वाष्पांस्तदाशक्तः शनैश्चरः || 29 ||
text_mt: In every dimension it is equal to Mount Meru; / upon it the exhausted Śanaiścara deposited the tears.

sanskrit_iast:
sa parvato'pi tān vāṣpānna dhartuṃ kṣama īśituḥ |
vidīrṇastaistu vāṣpaughairbhagnamadhyo'bhavadadrutam || 30 ||
meaning:
स पर्वतोऽपि तान् वाष्पान्न धर्तुं क्षम ईशितुः |
विदीर्णस्तैस्तु वाष्पौघैर्भग्नमध्योऽभवदद्रुतम् || 30 ||
text_mt: Even that mountain was unable to bear those tears of the Lord; / cleft by those torrents of tears, its middle was quickly broken.

sanskrit_iast:
te vāṣpāḥ parvataṃ bhitvā viviśustoyasāgaram |
sāgaro'pi grahītuṃ tanna śaśāka kharānati || 31 ||
meaning:
ते वाष्पाः पर्वतं भित्वा विविशुस्तोयसागरम् |
सागरोऽपि ग्रहीतुं तन्न शशाक खरानति || 31 ||
text_mt: Cleaving the mountain, those tears entered the ocean of water; / the ocean too could not bear that extreme heat.

sanskrit_iast:
tatastu sāgaraṃ madhye bhitvā vāṣpāḥ samāgatāḥ |
toyadheḥ prāgbhavāṃ velāṃ sparśamātrādvibheda tām || 32 ||
meaning:
ततस्तु सागरं मध्ये भित्वा वाष्पाः समागताः |
तोयधेः प्राग्भवां वेलां स्पर्शमात्राद्विभेद ताम् || 32 ||
text_mt: Then, cleaving the ocean in its midst, the tears reached / its eastern shore, which split at their mere touch.

sanskrit_iast:
vibhidya velāṃ te vāṣpāḥ puṣkaradvīpamadhyagāḥ |
nadī bhūtvā vaitaraṇī pūrvasāgaragābhavat || 33 ||
meaning:
विभिद्य वेलां ते वाष्पाः पुष्करद्वीपमध्यगाः |
नदी भूत्वा वैतरणी पूर्वसागरगाभवत् || 33 ||
text_mt: Having split the shore, those tears, passing through the middle of Puṣkaradvīpa, / became the river Vaitaraṇī and flowed into the eastern ocean.

sanskrit_iast:
jaladhārasya bhedena saṃsargāt sāgarasya ca |
avāpya saumyatāṃ kiṃcidvāṣpāste nābhindan kṣitim || 34 ||
meaning:
जलधारस्य भेदेन संसर्गात् सागरस्य च |
अवाप्य सौम्यतां किंचिद्वाष्पास्ते नाभिन्दन् क्षितिम् || 34 ||
text_mt: Through the splitting of Jaladhāra and through contact with the ocean, / those tears, having acquired some coolness, did not split the earth.

sanskrit_iast:
vaivasvatapuradvāre yojanadvayavistṛtā |
adyāpi tiṣṭhatyapagā haralotakasambhavā || 35 ||
meaning:
वैवस्वतपुरद्वारे योजनद्वयविस्तृता |
अद्यापि तिष्ठत्यपगा हरलोतकसम्भवा || 35 ||
text_mt: At the gate of the city of Vaivasvata, two yojanas in width, / there still remains today the river born from the tears of Hara.

sanskrit_iast:
atha śokavimūḍhātmā vilapan vṛṣabhadhvajaḥ |
jagāma prācyadeśāṃstu skandhe kṛtvā satīśavam || 36 ||
meaning:
अथ शोकविमूढात्मा विलपन् वृषभध्वजः |
जगाम प्राच्यदेशांस्तु स्कन्धे कृत्वा सतीशवम् || 36 ||
text_mt: Then, his mind bewildered by grief, lamenting, he whose banner is the bull / went toward the eastern regions, carrying the corpse of Satī on his shoulder.

sanskrit_iast:
unmattavadgacchato'sya dṛṣṭvā bhāvaṃ divaukasaḥ |
brahmādyāścintayāmāsuḥ śavabhraṃśanakarmaṇi || 37 ||
meaning:
उन्मत्तवद्गच्छतोऽस्य दृष्ट्वा भावं दिवौकसः |
ब्रह्माद्याश्चिन्तयामासुः शवभ्रंशनकर्मणि || 37 ||
text_mt: Seeing his state as he wandered like a madman, the heaven-dwellers, / led by Brahmā, pondered on the deed of causing the corpse to fall.

sanskrit_iast:
haragātrasya saṃsparśācchavo nāyaṃ viśīrṇatām |
gamiṣyati kathaṃ tasmādasya bhraṃśo bhaviṣyati || 38 ||
meaning:
हरगात्रस्य संस्पर्शाच्छवो नायं विशीर्णताम् |
गमिष्यति कथं तस्मादस्य भ्रंशो भविष्यति || 38 ||
text_mt: "By the touch of Hara's body, this corpse will not decay; / how then will it fall away from him?"

sanskrit_iast:
iti sañcintayantaste brahmaviṣṇuśanaiścarāḥ |
satīśavāntarviviśuradṛśyā yogamāyayā || 39 ||
meaning:
इति सञ्चिन्तयन्तस्ते ब्रह्मविष्णुशनैश्चराः |
सतीशवान्तर्विविशुरदृश्या योगमायया || 39 ||
text_mt: Pondering thus, Brahmā, Viṣṇu, and Śanaiścara / entered inside the corpse of Satī, invisible through yogamāyā.

sanskrit_iast:
praviśyātha śavaṃ devā khaṇḍaśaste satīśavam |
bhūtale pātayāmāsuḥ sthāne sthāne viśeṣataḥ || 40 ||
meaning:
प्रविश्याथ शवं देवा खण्डशस्ते सतीशवम् |
भूतले पातयामासुः स्थाने स्थाने विशेषतः || 40 ||
text_mt: Then, having entered the corpse, the gods caused that corpse of Satī to fall / piece by piece upon the surface of the earth, especially at various places.

sanskrit_iast:
devīkūṭe pādayugmaṃ prathamaṃ nyapatat kṣitau |
uḍḍīyāne coruyugmaṃ hitāya jagatāṃ tataḥ || 41 ||
meaning:
देवीकूटे पादयुग्मं प्रथमं न्यपतत् क्षितौ |
उड्डीयाने चोरुयुग्मं हिताय जगतां ततः || 41 ||
text_mt: At Devīkūṭa the pair of feet first fell to the earth, / and then at Uḍḍīyāna the pair of thighs, for the welfare of the worlds.

sanskrit_iast:
kāmarūpe kāmagirau nyapatadyonimaṇḍalam |
tatraiva nyapatadbhūmau parvate nābhimaṇḍalam || 42 ||
meaning:
कामरूपे कामगिरौ न्यपतद्योनिमण्डलम् |
तत्रैव न्यपतद्भूमौ पर्वते नाभिमण्डलम् || 42 ||
text_mt: At Kāmarūpa on Mount Kāma the pudendum fell; / right there on the mountain, onto the ground, fell the navel.

sanskrit_iast:
jālandhare stanayugaṃ svarṇahāravibhūṣitam |
aṃśagrīvaṃ pūrṇagirau kāmarūpā tataḥ śiraḥ || 43 ||
meaning:
जालन्धरे स्तनयुगं स्वर्णहारविभूषितम् |
अंशग्रीवं पूर्णगिरौ कामरूपा ततः शिरः || 43 ||
text_mt: At Jālandhara fell the pair of breasts adorned with golden necklaces, / the shoulders and neck at Pūrṇagiri, and thereafter the head at Kāmarūpa.

sanskrit_iast:
yāvadbhuvaṃ gato bhargaḥ samādāya satīśavam |
pācyeṣu yājñiko deśastāvadeva prakīrtitaḥ || 44 ||
meaning:
यावद्भुवं गतो भर्गः समादाय सतीशवम् |
पाच्येषु याज्ञिको देशस्तावदेव प्रकीर्तितः || 44 ||
text_mt: As far as Bharga went over the earth, carrying the corpse of Satī, / so far was the land among the easterners proclaimed to be fit for sacrifice.

sanskrit_iast:
anye śarīrāvayavā lavaśaḥ khaṇḍitāḥ suraiḥ |
ākāśagaṃgāmagaman pavanena samīritāḥ || 45 ||
meaning:
अन्ये शरीरावयवा लवशः खण्डिताः सुरैः |
आकाशगंगामगमन् पवनेन समीरिताः || 45 ||
text_mt: The other limbs of the body, cut to pieces by the gods, / went to the heavenly Gaṅgā, impelled by the wind.

sanskrit_iast:
yatra yatrāpatan satyāstadāpādādayo dvijāḥ |
tatra tatra mahādevaḥ svayaṃ liṃgasvarūpadhṛk |
tasthau mohasamāyuktaḥ satīsnehavaśānugaḥ || 46 ||
meaning:
यत्र यत्रापतन् सत्यास्तदापादादयो द्विजाः |
तत्र तत्र महादेवः स्वयं लिंगस्वरूपधृक् |
तस्थौ मोहसमायुक्तः सतीस्नेहवशानुगः || 46 ||
text_mt: Wherever the feet and other parts of Satī fell, O twice-born, / there Mahādeva, assuming the form of a liṅga, / remained, filled with delusion, subservient to his love for Satī.

sanskrit_iast:
brahmaviṣṇuśaniścāpi sarve devaṃgaṇāstathā |
pūjayāñcakrurīśasya prītyā satyāḥ padādikam || 47 ||
meaning:
ब्रह्मविष्णुशनिश्चापि सर्वे देवंगणास्तथा |
पूजयाञ्चक्रुरीशस्य प्रीत्या सत्याः पदादिकम् || 47 ||
text_mt: Brahmā, Viṣṇu, and Śani, as well as all the hosts of gods, / worshipped the feet and other parts of Satī out of affection for the Lord.

sanskrit_iast:
devīkūṭe mahādevī mahābhāgeti gīyate |
satīpādayuge līnā yoganidrā jagatprasūḥ || 48 ||
meaning:
देवीकूटे महादेवी महाभागेति गीयते |
सतीपादयुगे लीना योगनिद्रा जगत्प्रसूः || 48 ||
text_mt: At Devīkūṭa the great goddess is sung as Mahābhāgā; / she who is merged in the pair of feet of Satī is Yoganidrā, the mother of the universe.

sanskrit_iast:
kātyāyanī coḍḍīyāne kāmākhyā kāmarūpiṇī |
pūrṇeśvarī pūrṇagirau caṇḍī jālandhare girau || 49 ||
meaning:
कात्यायनी चोड्डीयाने कामाख्या कामरूपिणी |
पूर्णेश्वरी पूर्णगिरौ चण्डी जालन्धरे गिरौ || 49 ||
text_mt: [She is sung as] Kātyāyanī at Uḍḍīyāna, Kāmākhyā who assumes forms at will [at Kāmarūpa], / Pūrṇeśvarī at Pūrṇagiri, and Caṇḍī on Mount Jālandhara.

sanskrit_iast:
pūrvānte kāmarūpasya devī dikkaravāsinī |
tathā lalitakānteti yoganidrā pragīyate || 50 ||
meaning:
पूर्वान्ते कामरूपस्य देवी दिक्करवासिनी |
तथा ललितकान्तेति योगनिद्रा प्रगीयते || 50 ||
text_mt: At the eastern border of Kāmarūpa, the goddess is Dikkaravāsinī; / likewise, Yoganidrā is sung as Lalitakāntā.

sanskrit_iast:
yatraiva patitaṃ satyāḥ śirastatra vṛṣadhvajaḥ |
upaviṣṭaḥ śiro vīkṣya śvasañchokaparāyaṇaḥ || 51 ||
meaning:
यत्रैव पतितं सत्याः शिरस्तत्र वृषध्वजः |
