tejogaṇāttasya babhūva loko yo'sau maharloka iti śruto'bhūt |
janāhvayo'bhūnmaruto'tha garbhād dhyānāttapolokavaro babhūva || 27 ||
meaning:
तेजोगणात्तस्य बभूव लोको योऽसौ महर्लोक इति श्रुतोऽभूत् |
जनाह्वयोऽभून्मरुतोऽथ गर्भाद् ध्यानात्तपोलोकवरो बभूव || 27 ||
text_mt: From His mass of radiance came the world which became known as Maharloka; / the world called Janas came from the wind, and from meditation in the womb arose the excellent Tapoloka.

sanskrit_iast:
aṇḍordhagatyāmabhavattu satyaṃ brahmāṇḍakhaṇḍopari viṣṇuracyutaḥ |
paraṃ padaṃ yannigadanti dhīrā yajjñānagamyaṃ pariniṣṭharūpam || 28 ||
meaning:
अण्डोर्धगत्यामभवत्तु सत्यं ब्रह्माण्डखण्डोपरि विष्णुरच्युतः |
परं पदं यन्निगदन्ति धीरा यज्ज्ञानगम्यं परिनिष्ठरूपम् || 28 ||
text_mt: In the upward course of the egg was Satyaloka; above the cosmic egg was the imperishable Viṣṇu, / which the wise describe as the supreme abode, accessible through knowledge, perfectly accomplished in form.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ vidhāya prathamaṃ babhūva viṣṇusvarūpī sthitaye sa eva |
svayaṃ samudbhūtatanuryato'yaṃ svabhūriti khyātiravāpa viṣṇuḥ || 29 ||
meaning:
एवं विधाय प्रथमं बभूव विष्णुस्वरूपी स्थितये स एव |
स्वयं समुद्भूततनुर्यतोऽयं स्वभूरिति ख्यातिरवाप विष्णुः || 29 ||
text_mt: Having thus created, He first assumed the form of Viṣṇu for maintenance; / because His body arose by itself, Viṣṇu gained the fame of being 'self-born' (svabhū).

sanskrit_iast:
tato'bhavat yajñavarāharūpī viṣṇurbhuvaḥ proddharaṇāya pīnaḥ |
nimajjamānāṃ pṛthivī sa madhye bhittvā gato dhartumadho'tivegā || 30 ||
meaning:
ततोऽभवत् यज्ञवराहरूपी विष्णुर्भुवः प्रोद्धरणाय पीनः |
निमज्जमानां पृथिवी स मध्ये भित्त्वा गतो धर्तुमधोऽतिवेगा || 30 ||
text_mt: Then Viṣṇu assumed the mighty form of the Sacrificial Boar to uplift the earth; / breaking through the middle, He went beneath with great speed to uphold the sinking earth.

sanskrit_iast:
daṃṣṭrāgradeśe vinidhāya pṛthvī sa udgataḥ sarvamatītya toyam |
tato'bhavat saptakaṇānvito'yamanantamūrtiḥ pṛthivīṃ vidhartum || 31 ||
meaning:
दंष्ट्राग्रदेशे विनिधाय पृथ्वी स उद्गतः सर्वमतीत्य तोयम् |
ततोऽभवत् सप्तकणान्वितोऽयमनन्तमूर्तिः पृथिवीं विधर्तुम् || 31 ||
text_mt: Placing the earth on the tip of His tusk, He rose up, passing beyond all the waters; / then He became Ananta, endowed with seven hoods, in order to support the earth.

sanskrit_iast:
prasārya śeṣo'pi phalāḥ sa vaiṣa madhye nidhāyaikaphaṇāṃ dharitrīm |
dadhāra toyopari toyasaṃsthitastato'tyajad yajñavarāha urvīm || 32 ||
meaning:
प्रसार्य शेषोऽपि फलाः स वैष मध्ये निधायैकफणां धरित्रीम् |
दधार तोयोपरि तोयसंस्थितस्ततोऽत्यजद् यज्ञवराह उर्वीम् || 32 ||
text_mt: Spreading His hoods and placing the earth upon a single hood in the middle, / Śeṣa, resting upon the waters, held it above the waters; then the Sacrificial Boar released the earth.

sanskrit_iast:
prasāritāḥ phaṇāḥ sarvāstāsāmekā tu pūrvataḥ |
aparā paścimāyāṃ tu dakṣiṇottarayoḥ pare || 33 ||
meaning:
प्रसारिताः फणाः सर्वास्तासामेका तु पूर्वतः |
अपरा पश्चिमायां तु दक्षिणोत्तरयोः परे || 33 ||
text_mt: All his hoods were spread out; one of them was to the east, / another to the west, and the others to the south and north.

sanskrit_iast:
ekā gatā phaṇaiśānyāmāgneyyāmaparā diśi |
pṛthvīmadhye sthitā caikā nerṛtyāṃ tasya vai tanuḥ |
śūnyā digvāyavī tatra tato namrā sthitā kṣitiḥ || 34 ||
meaning:
एका गता फणैशान्यामाग्नेय्यामपरा दिशि |
पृथ्वीमध्ये स्थिता चैका नेरृत्यां तस्य वै तनुः |
शून्या दिग्वायवी तत्र ततो नम्रा स्थिता क्षितिः || 34 ||
text_mt: One hood went to the northeast, another to the southeast direction; / one rested in the center of the earth, and his body was in the southwest. / The north-western direction was empty there, and so the earth rested tilted.

sanskrit_iast:
sa tu dīrghatanustoye yadānanto na cāśakat |
kūrmarūpī tadā bhūtvānantaṃ kāyamadhāddhariḥ || 35 ||
meaning:
स तु दीर्घतनुस्तोये यदानन्तो न चाशकत् |
कूर्मरूपी तदा भूत्वानन्तं कायमधाद्धरिः || 35 ||
text_mt: When Ananta of elongated body was unable [to support it] in the water, / Hari, having taken the form of a tortoise, then supported Ananta's body.

sanskrit_iast:
adho brahmāṇḍakhaṇḍaṃ sa padbhirākramya kacchapaḥ |
grīvāṃ vitatya vāyavyāṃ pṛṣṭhe'nantamadhārayat || 36 ||
meaning:
अधो ब्रह्माण्डखण्डं स पद्भिराक्रम्य कच्छपः |
ग्रीवां वितत्य वायव्यां पृष्ठेऽनन्तमधारयत् || 36 ||
text_mt: Having bestridden the lower section of the cosmic egg with his feet, / the tortoise, stretching out his neck in the northwest, supported Ananta on his back.

sanskrit_iast:
anantaḥ kūrmapṛṣṭhe tu navabhirveṣṭanaistanum |
nidhāya pṛthvīṃ dadhre sukhenaiva mahātanuḥ || 37 ||
meaning:
अनन्तः कूर्मपृष्ठे तु नवभिर्वेष्टनैस्तनुम् |
निधाय पृथ्वीं दध्रे सुखेनैव महातनुः || 37 ||
text_mt: Then Ananta of great body, having placed his form on the back of the tortoise / with nine coils, supported the earth with ease.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ phaṇāsvanantasya calantī pṛthivī sthitā |
varāhaḥ kartumacalāmacalāmakaroddṛḍhām || 38 ||
meaning:
ततः फणास्वनन्तस्य चलन्ती पृथिवी स्थिता |
वराहः कर्तुमचलामचलामकरोद्दृढाम् || 38 ||
text_mt: The earth, placed on the hoods of Ananta, was trembling; / then the Boar made the unshakable [earth] firm in order to make it steady.

sanskrit_iast:
meruṃ khuraprahāreṇa prahṛtya pṛthivītalam |
nyakhanat sa viveśātha pṛthvīṃ bhittvāntaraṃ tataḥ || 39 ||
meaning:
मेरुं खुरप्रहारेण प्रहृत्य पृथिवीतलम् |
न्यखनत् स विवेशाथ पृथ्वीं भित्त्वान्तरं ततः || 39 ||
text_mt: Striking with a stroke of his hoof, he dug into the surface of the earth, / and then penetrated into the interior, cleaving the earth.

sanskrit_iast:
yojanānāṃ sahasrāṇi ṣoḍaśaiva rasātalam |
praviveśa mahāśailo varāhāṅghriprahārataḥ || 40 ||
meaning:
योजनानां सहस्राणि षोडशैव रसातलम् |
प्रविवेश महाशैलो वराहाङ्घ्रिप्रहारतः || 40 ||
text_mt: The great mountain [Meru] entered sixteen thousand yojanas / into the nether world from the strike of the Boar's hoof.

sanskrit_iast:
dvātriṃśattu sahasrāṇi yojanānāṃ tu vistṛtam |
meroḥ śiro'bhavattena prahāreṇa dvijottamāḥ || 41 ||
meaning:
द्वात्रिंशत्तु सहस्राणि योजनानां तु विस्तृतम् |
मेरोः शिरोऽभवत्तेन प्रहारेण द्विजोत्तमाः || 41 ||
text_mt: By that strike, O best of the twice-born, the head of Meru / became thirty-two thousand yojanas in breadth.

sanskrit_iast:
maryādā parvatanāthasya pārśve potrī tadākarot |
yadā calati naivaiṣa parvataḥ pṛthivīdharaḥ || 42 ||
meaning:
मर्यादा पर्वतनाथस्य पार्श्वे पोत्री तदाकरोत् |
यदा चलति नैवैष पर्वतः पृथिवीधरः || 42 ||
text_mt: Then the Boar made a boundary on the side of the king of mountains, / so that this earth-supporting mountain would not shake at all.

sanskrit_iast:
himavatprabhṛtīnāñca bhāgaṃ bhāgaṃ sapañcakam |
padā kṣityantaraṃ cakre taducchrāyapramāṇataḥ || 43 ||
meaning:
हिमवत्प्रभृतीनाञ्च भागं भागं सपञ्चकम् |
पदा क्षित्यन्तरं चक्रे तदुच्छ्रायप्रमाणतः || 43 ||
text_mt: And with his foot he drove a fifth part of Himavat and the other [mountains] / into the earth, according to the measure of their height.

sanskrit_iast:
tato brahmā varāhāya namaskṛtya mahījase |
ardhanārīśvaraṃ kakṣād devadevaṃ vyajāyataḥ || 44 ||
meaning:
ततो ब्रह्मा वराहाय नमस्कृत्य महीजसे |
अर्धनारीश्वरं कक्षाद् देवदेवं व्यजायतः || 44 ||
text_mt: Then Brahmā, having bowed down to the Boar of great glory, / brought forth from his armpit the God of gods as Ardhanārīśvara.

sanskrit_iast:
prathamaṃ jātamātraḥ sa praruroda mahāsvanaḥ |
kiṃ rodiṣīti taṃ brahmā rudantaṃ pratyuvāca ha || 45 ||
meaning:
प्रथमं जातमात्रः स प्ररुरोद महास्वनः |
किं रोदिषीति तं ब्रह्मा रुदन्तं प्रत्युवाच ह || 45 ||
text_mt: As soon as he was born, he cried loudly at first. / Brahmā said to him as he was weeping, “Why do you weep?”

sanskrit_iast:
nama dehīti taṃ so'tha pratyuvāca maheśvaraḥ |
rudranāmā rodanācca mā rodīstvaṃ mahāśaya || 46 ||
meaning:
नम देहीति तं सोऽथ प्रत्युवाच महेश्वरः |
रुद्रनामा रोदनाच्च मा रोदीस्त्वं महाशय || 46 ||
text_mt: Then Maheśvara replied to him: “Give [me] a name!” / [Brahmā said:] “Your name is Rudra from your crying. Do not weep, O noble-minded one!”

sanskrit_iast:
evamuktaḥ punaḥ so'tha saptavārān ruroda saḥ |
tato'parāṇi nāmāni sapta brahmākarot punaḥ || 47 ||
meaning:
एवमुक्तः पुनः सोऽथ सप्तवारान् रुरोद सः |
ततोऽपराणि नामानि सप्त ब्रह्माकरोत् पुनः || 47 ||
text_mt: Addressed thus, he then cried again seven times. / Then Brahmā gave him seven other names:

sanskrit_iast:
śarvaṃ bhavaṃ ca bhīmañca mahādevaṃ caturthakam |
pañcamaṃ cogramīśānaṃ ṣaṣṭhaṃ paśupatiṃ param || 48 ||
meaning:
शर्वं भवं च भीमञ्च महादेवं चतुर्थकम् |
पञ्चमं चोग्रमीशानं षष्ठं पशुपतिं परम् || 48 ||
text_mt: Śarva, Bhava, Bhīma, Mahādeva as the fourth, / the fifth Ugra, Īśāna as the sixth, and the highest Paśupati.

sanskrit_iast:
mayā yathā vibhaktastvaṃ tathātmā svo vibhajyatām |
tvayāpi bhūrisṛṣṭyarthaṃ bhavāṃścāpi prajāpatiḥ || 49 ||
meaning:
मया यथा विभक्तस्त्वं तथात्मा स्वो विभज्यताम् |
त्वयापि भूरिसृष्ट्यर्थं भवांश्चापि प्रजापतिः || 49 ||
text_mt: [Brahmā said:] “Just as you were divided by me, so let your own self be divided / by you as well, for the sake of abundant creation; and you are also Prajāpati.”

sanskrit_iast:
tato brahmā dvidhā bhūtvā puruṣo'rdhena so'bhavat |
ardhena nārī tasyāṃ tu virājamasṛjat prabhuḥ || 50 ||
meaning:
ततो ब्रह्मा द्विधा भूत्वा पुरुषोऽर्धेन सोऽभवत् |
अर्धेन नारी तस्यां तु विराजमसृजत् प्रभुः || 50 ||
text_mt: Then Brahmā divided in two: with one half he became a man, / and with the other half a woman. Upon her the Lord created Virāj.

sanskrit_iast:
tamāha bhagavān brahmā kuru sṛṣṭiṃ prajāpate |
tapastaptvā virāṭ so'pi manuṃ svāyambhuvaṃ tataḥ || 51 ||
meaning:
तमाह भगवान् ब्रह्मा कुरु सृष्टिं प्रजापते |
तपस्तप्त्वा विराट् सोऽपि मनुं स्वायम्भुवं ततः || 51 ||
text_mt: The venerable Brahmā said to him, “O Prajāpati, perform creation!” / That Virāj, having performed austerities, then [created] Svāyambhuva Manu.

sanskrit_iast:
sasarja so'pi tapasā brahmāṇaṃ paryatoṣayat |
toṣitastena manasā dakṣaṃ sṛṣṭyai sasarja saḥ || 52 ||
meaning:
ससर्ज सोऽपि तपसा ब्रह्माणं पर्यतोषयत् |
तोषितस्तेन मनसा दक्षं सृष्ट्यै ससर्ज सः || 52 ||
text_mt: He created [him], and he too fully pleased Brahmā by means of austerities. / Pleased with him in mind, he created Dakṣa for creation.

sanskrit_iast:
sṛṣṭe dakṣe'tha daśadhā praṇato manunā vidhiḥ |
punareva sutānanyān sasarja daśa mānasān || 53 ||
meaning:
सृष्टे दक्षेऽथ दशधा प्रणतो मनुना विधिः |
पुनरेव सुतानन्यान् ससर्ज दश मानसान् || 53 ||
text_mt: When Dakṣa had been created, Vidhi, being bowed down to tenfold by Manu, / once again created ten other mind-born sons:

sanskrit_iast:
marīcimatryaṅgirasau pulastyaṃ pulahaṃ kratum |
pracetasaṃ vasiṣṭhañca bhṛguṃ nāradameva ca || 54 ||
meaning:
मरीचिमत्र्यङ्गिरसौ पुलस्त्यं पुलहं क्रतुम् |
प्रचेतसं वसिष्ठञ्च भृगुं नारदमेव च || 54 ||
text_mt: Marīci, Atri and Aṅgiras, Pulastya, Pulaha, Kratu, / Pracetas, Vasiṣṭha, Bhṛgu, and Nārada.

sanskrit_iast:
etānutpādya manasā manuṃ svāyambhuvaṃ punaḥ |
yūyaṃ sṛjadhvamityuktvā lokeśo'ntardadhe punaḥ || 55 ||
meaning:
एतानुत्पाद्य मनसा मनुं स्वायम्भुवं पुनः |
यूयं सृजध्वमित्युक्त्वा लोकेशोऽन्तर्दधे पुनः || 55 ||
text_mt: Having produced these with his mind, the Lord of the world said again to Svāyambhuva Manu: / “You all must create!” Having spoken thus, he vanished again.

sanskrit_iast:
varāho'pyatha potreṇa khanitvā saptasāgarān |
pṛthivyāṃ balayākārān sasarja parameśvaraḥ || 56 ||
meaning:
वराहोऽप्यथ पोत्रेण खनित्वा सप्तसागरान् |
पृथिव्यां बलयाकारान् ससर्ज परमेश्वरः || 56 ||
text_mt: Then the Supreme Lord, the Boar, having dug with his snout, / created the seven oceans in the form of rings on the earth.

sanskrit_iast:
saptadhā bhamaṇenāsau sṛṣṭvā saptātha sāgarān |
saptadvīpānavacchidya pṛthivyantaṃ tato gataḥ || 57 ||
meaning:
सप्तधा भमणेनासौ सृष्ट्वा सप्ताथ सागरान् |
सप्तद्वीपानवच्छिद्य पृथिव्यन्तं ततो गतः || 57 ||
text_mt: Having created the seven oceans by circling seven times / and having demarcated the seven continents, he then went to the edge of the earth.

sanskrit_iast:
lokālokāhvayaṃ śailaḥ kṛtvā pṛthvyāstu veṣṭanam |
lakṣadvayocchritaṃ mānād yojanānāṃ samantataḥ |
sudṛḍhaṃ sthāpayāmāsa bhittiprānte yathā gṛham || 58 ||
meaning:
लोकालोकाह्वयं शैलः कृत्वा पृथ्व्यास्तु वेष्टनम् |
लक्षद्वयोच्छ्रितं मानाद् योजनानां समन्ततः |
सुदृढं स्थापयामास भित्तिप्रान्ते यथा गृहम् || 58 ||
text_mt: Having made the mountain named Lokāloka an enclosure for the earth, / two hundred thousand yojanas in height by measure, / he firmly established it all around, like a house on the edge of a wall.

sanskrit_iast:
ādisṛṣṭiriyaṃ viprāḥ kathitā bhavatāṃ mayā |
pratisargamahaṃ vakṣye tacchṛṇvantu maharṣayaḥ || 59 ||
meaning:
आदिसृष्टिरियं विप्राः कथिता भवतां मया |
प्रतिसर्गमहं वक्ष्ये तच्छृण्वन्तु महर्षयः || 59 ||
text_mt: This primary creation, O brāhmaṇas, has been narrated to you by me. / I shall declare the secondary creation; let the great sages hear that!

sanskrit_iast:
iti śrīkālikāpurāṇe varāhasargo nāma pañcaviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ |
ṣaḍviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ
meaning:
इति श्रीकालिकापुराणे वराहसर्गो नाम पञ्चविंशोऽध्यायः |
षड्विंशोऽध्यायः
text_mt: Thus ends the twenty-fifth chapter, named ‘The Boar’s Creation’, in the glorious Kālikāpurāṇa. / The twenty-sixth chapter.

sanskrit_iast: mārkaṇḍeya uvāca
meaning: मार्कण्डेय उवाच

sanskrit_iast:
vārāho'yaṃ śrutaḥ sargo varāhādhiṣṭhito yataḥ |
pratisargaḥ śrutaḥ sarvairdakṣādyairyaḥ kṛtaḥ pṛthak || 1 ||
meaning:
वाराहोऽयं श्रुतः सर्गो वराहाधिष्ठितो यतः |
प्रतिसर्गः श्रुतः सर्वैर्दक्षाद्यैर्यः कृतः पृथक् || 1 ||
text_mt: This creation of the Boar has been heard, since it was presided over by the Boar; / the secondary creation made separately by Dakṣa and the others has been heard by all.

sanskrit_iast:
rudro virāṇmanurdakṣo marīcyādyāstu mānasāḥ |
yaṃ yaṃ sargaṃ pṛthak cakruḥ pratisargaśca sa smṛtaḥ || 2 ||
meaning:
रुद्रो विराण्मनुर्दक्षो मरीच्याद्यास्तु मानसाः |
यं यं सर्गं पृथक् चक्रुः प्रतिसर्गश्च स स्मृतः || 2 ||
text_mt: Whatever creation Rudra, Virāj, Manu, Dakṣa, and the mind-born sons beginning with Marīci / made separately, that is remembered as the secondary creation.

sanskrit_iast:
virāṭ-suto'sṛjadvaṃśyānmanūn yairvitataṃ jagat |
manuḥ sapta manūn sṛṣṭvā cakāra bahuśaḥ prajāḥ || 3 ||
meaning:
विराट्-सुतोऽसृजद्वंश्यान्मनून् यैर्विततं जगत् |
मनुः सप्त मनून् सृष्ट्वा चकार बहुशः प्रजाः || 3 ||
text_mt: The son of Virāj created the Manus of his lineage, by whom the world was expanded. / Having created seven Manus, Manu produced offspring in abundance.

sanskrit_iast:
prajāḥ sisṛkṣuḥ sa manuryo'sau svāyambhuvāhvayaḥ
asṛjat prathamaṃ ṣaḍ vai manūn so'tha parān sutān || 4 ||
meaning:
प्रजाः सिसृक्षुः स मनुर्योऽसौ स्वायम्भुवाह्वयः
असृजत् प्रथमं षड् वै मनून् सोऽथ परान् सुतान् || 4 ||
text_mt: Desiring to create offspring, that Manu named Svāyambhuva / first created six Manus, who were his supreme sons:

sanskrit_iast:
svārociṣaścauttamiśca tāmaso raivatastathā |
cākṣuṣaśca mahātejā vivasvānaparastathā || 5 ||
meaning:
स्वारोचिषश्चौत्तमिश्च तामसो रैवतस्तथा |
चाक्षुषश्च महातेजा विवस्वानपरस्तथा || 5 ||
text_mt: Svārociṣa, Auttami, Tāmasa, and Raivata, / Cākṣuṣa of great splendor, and another, Vivasvat;

sanskrit_iast:
yakṣarakṣaḥpiśācāṃśca nāgagandharvakinnarān |
vidyādharānapsarasaḥ siddhān bhūtagaṇān bahūn || 6 ||
meaning:
यक्षरक्षःपिशाचांश्च नागगन्धर्वकिन्नरान् |
विद्याधरानप्सरसः सिद्धान् भूतगणान् बहून् || 6 ||
text_mt: and yakṣas, rākṣasas, piśācas, nāgas, gandharvas, kinnaras, / vidyādharas, apsarases, siddhas, and many hordes of spirits;

sanskrit_iast:
meghān savidyuto vṛkṣān latāgulmatṛṇādikān |
matsyān paśūṃśca kīṭāṃśca jalajān sthalajāṃstathā || 7 ||
meaning:
मेघान् सविद्युतो वृक्षान् लतागुल्मतृणादिकान् |
मत्स्यान् पशूंश्च कीटांश्च जलजान् स्थलजांस्तथा || 7 ||
text_mt: clouds accompanied by lightning, trees, creepers, shrubs, grasses and the like, / fish, beasts, insects, water-born as well as land-born.

sanskrit_iast:
etādṛśāni sarvāṇi manuḥ svāyambhuvaḥ sutaiḥ |
sahitaḥ sasṛje so'nyaḥ pratisargaḥ prakīrtitaḥ || 8 ||
meaning:
एतादृशानि सर्वाणि मनुः स्वायम्भुवः सुतैः |
सहितः ससृजे सोऽन्यः प्रतिसर्गः प्रकीर्तितः || 8 ||
text_mt: All these types of things did Svāyambhuva Manu create / along with his sons; that is proclaimed as another secondary creation.

sanskrit_iast:
anye ṣaṇmanavo ye vai te'pi sve sve'ntare'ntare |
pratisargaṃ svayaṃ kṛtvā prāpnuvanti carācaram || 9 ||
meaning:
अन्ये षण्मनवो ये वै तेऽपि स्वे स्वेऽन्तरेऽन्तरे |
प्रतिसर्गं स्वयं कृत्वा प्राप्नुवन्ति चराचरम् || 9 ||
text_mt: The other six Manus who exist also each, in their own periods, / having themselves carried out secondary creation, attain the moving and unmoving.

sanskrit_iast:
yajñasya sambhūtaṃ yajñaṃ yūpaṃ prāgvaṃśameva ca |
dharmādharmau guṇān sarvān varāha iva sṛṣṭavān || 10 ||
meaning:
यज्ञस्य सम्भूतं यज्ञं यूपं प्राग्वंशमेव च |
धर्माधर्मौ गुणान् सर्वान् वराह इव सृष्टवान् || 10 ||
text_mt: Born of the sacrifice, like the Boar he created the sacrifice, / the sacrificial post, the central shed, righteousness and unrighteousness, and all attributes.

sanskrit_iast:
sutān bahūn samutpādya dakṣo devarṣisattamān |
maharṣīn somapāyīṃśca bahūn pitṛgaṇāṃstathā || 11 ||
meaning:
सुतान् बहून् समुत्पाद्य दक्षो देवर्षिसत्तमान् |
महर्षीन् सोमपायींश्च बहून् पितृगणांस्तथा || 11 ||
text_mt: Dakṣa, having begotten many sons, the best among divine sages, / great sages, soma-drinkers, and many groups of ancestors,

sanskrit_iast:
sṛṣṭiṃ pravarttayāmāsa pratisargo'sya sa smṛtaḥ |
ajāyanta mukhādviprāḥ kṣatriyā bāhuyugmataḥ || 12 ||
meaning:
सृष्टिं प्रवर्त्तयामास प्रतिसर्गोऽस्य स स्मृतः |
अजायन्त मुखाद्विप्राः क्षत्रिया बाहुयुग्मतः || 12 ||
text_mt: set creation in motion; that is remembered as his secondary creation. / Brāhmaṇas were born from his mouth, and kṣatriyas from his pair of arms;

sanskrit_iast:
ūrvorvaiśyāḥ padoḥ śūdrāścaturvedāścaturmukhāt |
brahmaṇaḥ pratisargo'yaṃ brāhmaḥ sargaḥ smṛtastataḥ || 13 ||
meaning:
ऊर्वोर्वैश्याः पदोः शूद्राश्चतुर्वेदाश्चतुर्मुखात् |
ब्रह्मणः प्रतिसर्गोऽयं ब्राह्मः सर्गः स्मृतस्ततः || 13 ||
text_mt: vaiśyas from his thighs, śūdras from his feet, and the four Vedas from his four faces. / This is the secondary creation of Brahmā, and is therefore remembered as the creation of Brahmā.

sanskrit_iast:
marīceḥ kaśyapo jātaḥ kaśyapāt sakalaṃ jagat |
devā daityā dānavāśca tasya sargaḥ prakīrtitaḥ || 14 ||
meaning:
मरीचेः कश्यपो जातः कश्यपात् सकलं जगत् |
देवा दैत्या दानवाश्च तस्य सर्गः प्रकीर्तितः || 14 ||
text_mt: From Marīci Kaśyapa was born, and from Kaśyapa the entire world: / the gods, daityas, and dānavas; [that] is proclaimed as his creation.

sanskrit_iast:
atrernetrādabhūccandraścandravaṃśastato'bhavat |
tena vyāptaṃ jagat sarvaṃ so'sya sargaḥ prakīrtitaḥ || 15 ||
meaning:
अत्रेर्नेत्रादभूच्चन्द्रश्चन्द्रवंशस्ततोऽभवत् |
तेन व्याप्तं जगत् सर्वं सोऽस्य सर्गः प्रकीर्तितः || 15 ||
text_mt: From Atri's eye arose the moon, and from that the Lunar dynasty came to be; / by it the entire world was pervaded; that is proclaimed as his creation.

sanskrit_iast:
atharvāgirasa putrāḥ pautrāśca bahuśo'pare |
mantrayantrādayo ye vai te sarve'ṅgirasaḥ smṛtāḥ || 16 ||
meaning:
अथर्वागिरस पुत्राः पौत्राश्च बहुशोऽपरे |
मन्त्रयन्त्रादयो ये वै ते सर्वेऽङ्गिरसः स्मृताः || 16 ||
text_mt: The sons of Atharvāṅgiras and many other grandsons, / and whatever mantras and yantras exist—all these are regarded as [the creation] of Aṅgiras.

sanskrit_iast:
ājyapākhyāḥ pulastyasya putrāścānye ca rākṣasāḥ |
pratisargaḥ pulastyasya balavegasamanvitāḥ || 17 ||
meaning:
आज्यपाख्याः पुलस्त्यस्य पुत्राश्चान्ये च राक्षसाः |
प्रतिसर्गः पुलस्त्यस्य बलवेगसमन्विताः || 17 ||
text_mt: Those named Ājyapas and other rākṣasas were the sons of Pulastya; / endowed with strength and speed, they were the secondary creation of Pulastya.

sanskrit_iast:
kādraveyā gajā aśvāḥ prajā bahutarāstathā |
sasṛje pulahenaiṣa sargastasya prakīrtitaḥ || 18 ||
meaning:
काद्रवेया गजा अश्वाः प्रजा बहुतरास्तथा |
ससृजे पुलहेनैष सर्गस्तस्य प्रकीर्तितः || 18 ||
text_mt: The descendants of Kadrū, elephants, horses, and many other creatures / were created by Pulaha; this is proclaimed to be his creation.

sanskrit_iast:
kratoḥ putrāḥ bālakhilyāḥ sarvajñā bhūritejasaḥ |
aṣṭāśītisahasrāṇi jvaladbhāskarasannibhāḥ || 19 ||
meaning:
क्रतोः पुत्राः बालखिल्याः सर्वज्ञा भूरितेजसः |
अष्टाशीतिसहस्राणि ज्वलद्भास्करसन्निभाः || 19 ||
text_mt: The sons of Kratu are the Bālakhilyas, omniscient and immensely radiant, / eighty-eight thousand [in number], resembling the blazing sun.

sanskrit_iast:
pracetasaḥ sutāḥ sarve te vai prācetasāḥ smṛtāḥ |
ṣaḍaśītisahasrāṇi pāvakopamatejasaḥ || 20 ||
meaning:
प्रचेतसः सुताः सर्वे ते वै प्राचेतसाः स्मृताः |
षडशीतिसहस्राणि पावकोपमतेजसः || 20 ||
text_mt: All the sons of Pracetas are known indeed as the Prācetasas, / eighty-six thousand [in number], whose radiance resembles fire.

sanskrit_iast:
sukālino vasiṣṭhasya putrāścānye ca yoginaḥ |
ārundhateyāḥ pañcāśadvāśiṣṭhaḥ sarga ucyate || 21 ||
meaning:
सुकालिनो वसिष्ठस्य पुत्राश्चान्ये च योगिनः |
आरुन्धतेयाः पञ्चाशद्वाशिष्ठः सर्ग उच्यते || 21 ||
text_mt: The Sukālins are the sons of Vasiṣṭha, as well as other yogins; / the sons of Arundhatī are fifty; this is said to be the creation of Vasiṣṭha.

sanskrit_iast:
bhṛgośca bhārgavā jātā ye vai daityapurodhasaḥ |
kavayaste mahāprājñāstairvyāptamakhilaṃ jagat || 22 ||
meaning:
भृगोश्च भार्गवा जाता ये वै दैत्यपुरोधसः |
कवयस्ते महाप्राज्ञास्तैर्व्याप्तमखिलं जगत् || 22 ||
text_mt: And from Bhṛgu were born the Bhārgavas, who are the priests of the Daityas; / they are poets, immensely wise, and by them the entire world is pervaded.

sanskrit_iast:
nāradāttārakā jātā vimānāni tathaiva ca |
praśnottarāstathaivānye nṛtyagītaṃ ca kautukam || 23 ||
meaning:
नारदात्तारका जाता विमानानि तथैव च |
प्रश्नोत्तरास्तथैवान्ये नृत्यगीतं च कौतुकम् || 23 ||
text_mt: From Nārada were born the stars, as well as aerial chariots, / as well as other riddles and answers, dance, song, and spectacle.

sanskrit_iast:
ete dakṣamarīcyādyāḥ kṛtadārān bahūn sutān |
utpādyotpādya pṛthivīṃ divaṃ ca samapūrayan || 24 ||
meaning:
एते दक्षमरीच्याद्याः कृतदारान् बहून् सुतान् |
उत्पाद्योत्पाद्य पृथिवीं दिवं च समपूरयन् || 24 ||
text_mt: These [sages], Dakṣa, Marīci, and the rest, having engendered many married sons / again and again, filled the earth and heaven.

sanskrit_iast:
teṣāṃ sutebhyaśca sutāstatputrebhyaḥ pare sutāḥ |
samutpannāḥ pravartante hyadyāpi bhuvaneṣu vai || 25 ||
meaning:
तेषां सुतेभ्यश्च सुतास्तत्पुत्रेभ्यः परे सुताः |
समुत्पन्नाः प्रवर्तन्ते ह्यद्यापि भुवनेषु वै || 25 ||
text_mt: From their sons, sons were born, and from those sons, other sons; / having arisen, they continue even today in the worlds.

sanskrit_iast:
viṣṇostu cakṣuṣoḥ sūryo manasaścandramāḥ smṛtaḥ |
śrotrādvāyu samudbhatomukhādagnirajāyata || 26 ||
meaning:
विष्णोस्तु चक्षुषोः सूर्यो मनसश्चन्द्रमाः स्मृतः |
श्रोत्राद्वायु समुद्भतोमुखादग्निरजायत || 26 ||
text_mt: From the eyes of Viṣṇu, the sun is traditionally held [to have arisen], and the moon from [his] mind; / from [his] ear the wind arose, [and] from [his] mouth fire was born.

sanskrit_iast:
pratisargo hyayaṃ viṣṇustathā cāpi diśo daśa |
sṛṣṭyarthaṃ candramā paścādatrinetrādavātarat |
bhāskaraṃ kaśyapājjāto bhāryayā ca samanvitaḥ || 27 ||
meaning:
प्रतिसर्गो ह्ययं विष्णुस्तथा चापि दिशो दश |
सृष्ट्यर्थं चन्द्रमा पश्चादत्रिनेत्रादवातरत् |
भास्करं कश्यपाज्जातो भार्यया च समन्वितः || 27 ||
text_mt: For this is the secondary creation of Viṣṇu, and also the ten directions. / Afterward, for the sake of creation, the moon descended from the eye of Atri, / [and] the sun was born from Kaśyapa, accompanied by his wife.

sanskrit_iast:
rudrāśca bahavo jātā bhūtagrāmāścaturvidhāḥ |
śvavarāhoṣṭrarūpāśca plavagomāyugomukhā || 28 ||
meaning:
रुद्राश्च बहवो जाता भूतग्रामाश्चतुर्विधाः |
श्ववराहोष्ट्ररूपाश्च प्लवगोमायुगोमुखा || 28 ||
text_mt: And many Rudras were born, and the four kinds of hordes of beings: / having the forms of dogs, boars, and camels, with the faces of monkeys, jackals, and cattle,

sanskrit_iast:
ṛkṣamārjāravadanā siṃhasyāghramukhāḥ pare |
nānā śastradharā sarve nānārūpā mahābalāḥ || 29 ||
meaning:
ऋक्षमार्जारवदना सिंहस्याघ्रमुखाः परे |
नाना शस्त्रधरा सर्वे नानारूपा महाबलाः || 29 ||
text_mt: having the faces of bears and cats, others with the faces of lions and tigers, / all bearing various weapons, of various forms, and of great strength.

sanskrit_iast:
eṣa va pratisargo'pi kathito dvijasattamāḥ |
dainandina ca pralaya śṛṇudhvaṃ kalpaśeṣataḥ || 30 ||
meaning:
एष व प्रतिसर्गोऽपि कथितो द्विजसत्तमाः |
दैनन्दिन च प्रलय शृणुध्वं कल्पशेषतः || 30 ||
text_mt: Thus the secondary creation has been told to you, O best of the twice-born; / now hear of the daily dissolution that occurs at the end of a kalpa.

sanskrit_iast:
iti śrīkālikāpurāṇe sṛṣṭikathane ṣaḍviśo'dhyāyaḥ || 26 ||
saptaviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ
meaning:
इति श्रीकालिकापुराणे सृष्टिकथने षड्विशोऽध्यायः || 26 ||
सप्तविंशोऽध्यायः
text_mt: Thus ends the twenty-sixth chapter in the glorious Kālikāpurāṇa, in the narration of creation. / Twenty-seventh chapter.

sanskrit_iast: mārkaṇḍeya uvāca
meaning: मार्कण्डेय उवाच

sanskrit_iast:
manvantaraṃ manoḥ kālo yāvat pālayate prajāḥ |
eko manuḥ sa kālastu manvantaramiti śrutam || 1 ||
meaning:
मन्वन्तरं मनोः कालो यावत् पालयते प्रजाः |
एको मनुः स कालस्तु मन्वन्तरमिति श्रुतम् || 1 ||
text_mt: A manvantara is the period of a Manu, as long as a single Manu / protects the creatures; that time is traditionally heard to be a manvantara.

sanskrit_iast:
tadekasaptatiyugairdevānāmiha jāyate |
taiścaturdaśabhiḥ kalpo dinamekaṃ tu vedhasaḥ || 2 ||
meaning:
तदेकसप्ततियुगैर्देवानामिह जायते |
तैश्चतुर्दशभिः कल्पो दिनमेकं तु वेधसः || 2 ||
text_mt: In this [reckoning], it comprises seventy-one yugas of the gods; / and fourteen of these [manvantaras] make a kalpa, which is one day of the Creator.

sanskrit_iast:
dinānte brahmaṇo jāte suṣupsā tasya jāyate |
yoganidrā mahāmāyā samāyāti pitāmaham || 3 ||
meaning:
दिनान्ते ब्रह्मणो जाते सुषुप्सा तस्य जायते |
योगनिद्रा महामाया समायाति पितामहम् || 3 ||
text_mt: When the day of Brahmā comes to an end, a desire to sleep arises in him; / Yoganidrā, the great Māyā, approaches the Grandfather.

sanskrit_iast:
nābhipadmaṃ praviśyātha viṣṇoramitatejasaḥ |
sukhaṃ śete sa bhagavān brahmā lokapitāmahaḥ || 4 ||
meaning:
नाभिपद्मं प्रविश्याथ विष्णोरमिततेजसः |
सुखं शेते स भगवान् ब्रह्मा लोकपितामहः || 4 ||
text_mt: Then, having entered the navel-lotus of Viṣṇu of immeasurable radiance, / the blessed Brahmā, the grandfather of the worlds, sleeps comfortably.

sanskrit_iast:
tato viṣṇuḥ svayaṃ bhutvā rudrarūpī janārdanaḥ |
pūrvavannāśayāmāsa sa sarvaṃ bhuvanatrayam || 5 ||
meaning:
ततो विष्णुः स्वयं भुत्वा रुद्ररूपी जनार्दनः |
पूर्ववन्नाशयामास स सर्वं भुवनत्रयम् || 5 ||
text_mt: Then Viṣṇu himself, having taken the form of Rudra, Janārdana / destroyed all the three worlds as [he had done] before.

sanskrit_iast:
vāyunā vahninā sārdhaṃ dāhayāmāsa vai yathā |
mahāpralayakāleṣu tathā sarvaṃ jagat trayam || 6 ||
meaning:
वायुना वह्निना सार्धं दाहयामास वै यथा |
महाप्रलयकालेषु तथा सर्वं जगत् त्रयम् || 6 ||
text_mt: Together with wind and fire, he burned all the three worlds, / just as [it happens] at the times of the great dissolution.

sanskrit_iast:
janaṃ yānti pratāpārtā maharlokanivāsinaḥ |
trailokyadāhasamaye pīḍitā dāruṇāgninā || 7 ||
meaning:
जनं यान्ति प्रतापार्ता महर्लोकनिवासिनः |
त्रैलोक्यदाहसमये पीडिता दारुणाग्निना || 7 ||
text_mt: Tormented by the heat, the dwellers of Maharloka go to Janaloka, / afflicted by the dreadful fire at the time of the burning of the three worlds.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ kālāntakairmeghairnānāvarṇairmahāsvanaiḥ |
samutpādya mahāvṛṣṭimāpūrya bhuvanatrayam || 8 ||
meaning:
ततः कालान्तकैर्मेघैर्नानावर्णैर्महास्वनैः |
समुत्पाद्य महावृष्टिमापूर्य भुवनत्रयम् || 8 ||
text_mt: Then, having produced a great downpour with destructive clouds / of various colors and loud roars, and filling the three worlds

sanskrit_iast:
calattaraṅgaistoyaughairādhruvasthānasaṃgataiḥ |
nidhāya jaṭhare lokānimāṃstrīn sa janārdanaḥ |
nāgaparyaṅkaśayane śete sa parameśvaraḥ || 9 ||
meaning:
चलत्तरङ्गैस्तोयौघैराध्रुवस्थानसंगतैः |
निधाय जठरे लोकानिमांस्त्रीन् स जनार्दनः |
नागपर्यङ्कशयने शेते स परमेश्वरः || 9 ||
text_mt: with masses of water having surging waves, extending up to the realm of Dhruva, / placing these three worlds in his belly, that Janārdana, / the supreme lord, lies down upon the bed of the serpent's couch.

sanskrit_iast:
śayāna nābhikamale brahmāṇaṃ sa jagadguruḥ |
saṃsthāpya trīnimāllokān dagdhvā jagdhvā śriyā saha || 10 ||
meaning:
शयान नाभिकमले ब्रह्माणं स जगद्गुरुः |
संस्थाप्य त्रीनिमाल्लोकान् दग्ध्वा जग्ध्वा श्रिया सह || 10 ||
text_mt: Having placed Brahmā asleep on his navel-lotus, that teacher of the universe, / having burned and consumed these three worlds, [lies down] with Śrī.

sanskrit_iast:
śete sa bhoyiśayyāyāṃ brahmā nārāyaṇātmakaḥ |
yoganidrāvaśaṃ jātastrelokyagrāsavṛṃhitaḥ || 11 ||
meaning:
शेते स भोयिशय्यायां ब्रह्मा नारायणात्मकः |
योगनिद्रावशं जातस्त्रेलोक्यग्रासवृंहितः || 11 ||
text_mt: Brahmā, who is of the nature of Nārāyaṇa, lies on the serpent bed, / having fallen under the power of Yoganidrā, swollen by swallowing the three worlds.

sanskrit_iast:
trailokyamakhilaṃ dagdhaṃ yadā kālāgninā tadā |
anantaḥ pṛthivī tyaktvā viṣṇorantikamāgagaḥ || 12 ||
meaning:
त्रैलोक्यमखिलं दग्धं यदा कालाग्निना तदा |
अनन्तः पृथिवी त्यक्त्वा विष्णोरन्तिकमागगः || 12 ||
text_mt: When the entire three worlds were burned by the fire of destruction, then / Ananta, abandoning the earth, went into the presence of Viṣṇu.

sanskrit_iast:
tena tyaktā tu pṛthivī kṣaṇamātrādadhogatā |
patitā kūrmapṛṣṭhe ca viśīrṇeva tadābhavat || 13 ||
meaning:
तेन त्यक्ता तु पृथिवी क्षणमात्रादधोगता |
पतिता कूर्मपृष्ठे च विशीर्णेव तदाभवत् || 13 ||
text_mt: Abandoned by him, the earth sank down in just a moment, / and falling upon the back of the tortoise, it became as if shattered then.

sanskrit_iast:
kūrmo'pi mahato yatnāccalantīṃ pṛthivīṃ jale |
brahmāṇḍaṃ padbhirākramya pṛṣṭhe dadhre dharāṃ tadā || 14 ||
meaning:
कूर्मोऽपि महतो यत्नाच्चलन्तीं पृथिवीं जले |
ब्रह्माण्डं पद्भिराक्रम्य पृष्ठे दध्रे धरां तदा || 14 ||
text_mt: With great effort, the tortoise, pressing the cosmic egg with his feet, / then bore on his back the earth that was tossing in the water.

sanskrit_iast:
brahmāṇḍakhaṇḍasaṃyogāccūrṇitā pṛthivo bhavet |
iti tāṃ parijagrāha kūrmarūpī janārdanaḥ || 15 ||
meaning:
ब्रह्माण्डखण्डसंयोगाच्चूर्णिता पृथिवो भवेत् |
इति तां परिजग्राह कूर्मरूपी जनार्दनः || 15 ||
text_mt: Thinking, “From contact with the shell of the cosmic egg, the earth might be pulverized,” / Janārdana in the form of the tortoise held it.

sanskrit_iast:
calajjalaughasaṃsargāccalantyā dharayā tadā |
kūrmapṛṣṭhaṃ bahutarairvaraṇḍairvitatīkṛtam || 16 ||
meaning:
चलज्जलौघसंसर्गाच्चलन्त्या धरया तदा |
कूर्मपृष्ठं बहुतरैर्वरण्डैर्विततीकृतम् || 16 ||
text_mt: From the contact with the surging mass of water, by the moving earth then / the back of the tortoise was covered with numerous ridges.

sanskrit_iast:
anantastatra gatvā tu yatra kṣīrodasāgaraḥ |
tatra svayaṃ śriyā yuktaṃ suṣupsantaṃ janārdanam || 17 ||
meaning:
अनन्तस्तत्र गत्वा तु यत्र क्षीरोदसागरः |
तत्र स्वयं श्रिया युक्तं सुषुप्सन्तं जनार्दनम् || 17 ||
text_mt: Ananta, having gone there where the ocean of milk is, / [saw] Janārdana wishing to sleep, accompanied by Śrī himself.

sanskrit_iast:
phaṇayā madhyayā dadhre trailokyagrāsabṛṃhitam |
pūrvaṃ phaṇāḥ vitatyordhvaṃ padmaṃ kṛtvā mahābalaḥ |
viṣṇumācchādayāmāsa śeṣākhyaḥ parameśvaram || 18 ||
meaning:
फणया मध्यया दध्रे त्रैलोक्यग्रासबृंहितम् |
पूर्वं फणाः वितत्योर्ध्वं पद्मं कृत्वा महाबलः |
विष्णुमाच्छादयामास शेषाख्यः परमेश्वरम् || 18 ||
text_mt: He who was named Śeṣa, of great strength, supported with his middle hood [Viṣṇu], swollen by swallowing the three worlds; / first spreading his hoods upward and forming a lotus, he covered the supreme lord, Viṣṇu.

sanskrit_iast:
tasyopadhānamakarodananto dakṣiṇāṃ phaṇām |
uttarāṃ pādayoścakre upadhānaṃ mahābalaḥ || 19 ||
meaning:
तस्योपधानमकरोदनन्तो दक्षिणां फणाम् |
उत्तरां पादयोश्चक्रे उपधानं महाबलः || 19 ||
text_mt: Ananta made his southern hood his pillow, / [and] the mighty one made the northern [hood] a footrest at his feet.

sanskrit_iast:
tālavṛntaṃ tadā cakre saśeṣaḥ paścimā phaṇām |
svapannaṃ bījayāmāsa śeṣarūpī janārdanam || 30 ||
meaning:
तालवृन्तं तदा चक्रे सशेषः पश्चिमा फणाम् |
स्वपन्नं बीजयामास शेषरूपी जनार्दनम् || 30 ||
text_mt: Then Śeṣa made his western hood a fan of palm leaves; / in the form of Śeṣa, he fanned the sleeping Janārdana.

sanskrit_iast:
śaṅkhaṃ cakraṃ nandakāsimiṣudhī dve mahābalaḥ |
aiśānyayātha phaṇayā sa dadhre garuḍaṃ tathā || 21 ||
meaning:
शङ्खं चक्रं नन्दकासिमिषुधी द्वे महाबलः |
ऐशान्ययाथ फणया स दध्रे गरुडं तथा || 21 ||
text_mt: The conch, the discus, the sword Nandaka, and the two quivers, / and likewise Garuḍa, the mighty one held with his northeastern hood.

sanskrit_iast:
gadā padmaṃ ca śārṅgaśca tathaiva vividhāyudham |
yāni cānyāni tasyāsannāgneyyā phaṇayā dadhau || 22 ||
meaning:
गदा पद्मं च शार्ङ्गश्च तथैव विविधायुधम् |
यानि चान्यानि तस्यासन्नाग्नेय्या फणया दधौ || 22 ||
text_mt: The mace, the lotus, the bow Śārṅga, and likewise various weapons, / and whatever others belonged to him, he held with his southeastern hood.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ kṛtvā svakaṃ kāyaṃ śayanīya tadā hareḥ |
pṛthvīmadharakāyena magnāmātramya cāmbhasi || 23 ||
meaning:
एवं कृत्वा स्वकं कायं शयनीय तदा हरेः |
पृथ्वीमधरकायेन मग्नामात्रम्य चाम्भसि || 23 ||
text_mt: Having thus made his own body the bed of Hari at that time, / and having held up the earth that had sunk in the water with his lower body,

sanskrit_iast:
trailokya brahmasahitaṃ salakṣmīkaṃ janārdanam |
sopāsaṅga jagadbīja jagatkāraṇakāraṇam || 24 ||
meaning:
त्रैलोक्य ब्रह्मसहितं सलक्ष्मीकं जनार्दनम् |
सोपासङ्ग जगद्बीज जगत्कारणकारणम् || 24 ||
text_mt: Janārdana, with the three worlds, together with Brahmā, accompanied by Lakṣmī, / together with [his] quivers, the seed of the universe, the cause of the causes of the universe,

sanskrit_iast:
nityānandaṃ vedamayaṃ brahmaṇya parameśvaram |
jagatkāraṇakartāra jagatkāraṇakāraṇam || 25 ||
meaning:
नित्यानन्दं वेदमयं ब्रह्मण्य परमेश्वरम् |
जगत्कारणकर्तार जगत्कारणकारणम् || 25 ||
text_mt: the eternal bliss, composed of the Veda, the friend of Brahmans, the supreme lord, / the maker of the cause of the universe, the cause of the causes of the universe,

sanskrit_iast:
bhūtabhavyabhavannātha parāvaragatiṃ  harim |
dadhāraṃ śirasā tāntu svayameva svakāṃ tanum || 26 ||
meaning:
भूतभव्यभवन्नाथ परावरगतिं  हरिम् |
दधारं शिरसा तान्तु स्वयमेव स्वकां तनुम् || 26 ||
text_mt: the master of what was, what will be, and what is, the supreme and lower refuge—Hari, / he bore [him] with his head, [which was] indeed his own body.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ brahmadinasyaiva pramāṇena niśāṃ hariḥ |
sandhyāṃ ca samabhivyāpya śete nārāyaṇo'vyayaḥ || 27 ||
meaning:
एवं ब्रह्मदिनस्यैव प्रमाणेन निशां हरिः |
सन्ध्यां च समभिव्याप्य शेते नारायणोऽव्ययः || 27 ||
text_mt: Thus for the measure of a day of Brahmā, the imperishable Nārāyaṇa, / Hari, sleeps, extending over the night and the twilights.

sanskrit_iast:
yasmādayantu pralayo brahmaṇaḥ syād dine dine |
tasmād dainandinamiti khyāpayanti purāvidaḥ || 28 ||
meaning:
यस्मादयन्तु प्रलयो ब्रह्मणः स्याद् दिने दिने |
तस्माद् दैनन्दिनमिति ख्यापयन्ति पुराविदः || 28 ||
text_mt: Because this dissolution of Brahmā occurs day after day, / therefore those who know the past proclaim it to be the daily [dissolution].

sanskrit_iast:
vyatītāyāṃ niśāyāṃ tu brahmā lokapitāmahaḥ |
tyaktvā nidrāṃ samuttasthau sa punaḥ sṛṣṭaye hitaḥ || 29 ||
meaning:
व्यतीतायां निशायां तु ब्रह्मा लोकपितामहः |
त्यक्त्वा निद्रां समुत्तस्थौ स पुनः सृष्टये हितः || 29 ||
text_mt:
When the night had passed, Brahmā, the grandfather of the worlds,
abandoned sleep and arose, disposed once again to creation.

sanskrit_iast:
trailokyaṃ toyasampūrṇaṃ śayānaṃ puruṣottamam |
nirīkṣya vaiṣṇavīṃ māyāṃ mahāmāyāṃ jaganmayīm |
yoganidrāṃ sa tuṣṭāva hareraṅge ca saṃsthitām || 30 ||
meaning:
त्रैलोक्यं तोयसम्पूर्णं शयानं पुरुषोत्तमम् |
निरीक्ष्य वैष्णवीं मायां महामायां जगन्मयीम् |
योगनिद्रां स तुष्टाव हरेरङ्गे च संस्थिताम् || 30 ||
text_mt:
Seeing the three worlds filled with water and Puruṣottama asleep,
he praised the Vaiṣṇava Māyā, Mahāmāyā, who consists of the universe,
Yoganidrā, who was seated in the body of Hari.

sanskrit_iast: brahmovāca
meaning: ब्रह्मोवाच

sanskrit_iast:
citiśaktiṃ nirvikārāṃ parabrahmasvarūpiṇīm |
praṇamāmi mahāmāyāṃ yoganidrāṃ sanātanīm || 31 ||
meaning:
चितिशक्तिं निर्विकारां परब्रह्मस्वरूपिणीम् |
प्रणमामि महामायां योगनिद्रां सनातनीम् || 31 ||
text_mt:
I bow to Mahāmāyā, eternal Yoganidrā,
the power of consciousness, free from alteration, whose essential nature is the supreme Brahman.

sanskrit_iast:
tvaṃ vidyā yogināṃ devi tvaṃ gatistvaṃ matiḥ stutiḥ |
tvaṃ sṛṣṭistvaṃ sthitiḥ svāhā svadhā tvamiha gītikā || 32 ||
meaning:
त्वं विद्या योगिनां देवि त्वं गतिस्त्वं मतिः स्तुतिः |
त्वं सृष्टिस्त्वं स्थितिः स्वाहा स्वधा त्वमिह गीतिका || 32 ||
text_mt:
You are the knowledge of yogins, O goddess; you are the goal, the intellect, and praise;
you are creation, you are maintenance, you are svāhā, svadhā, and sacred song here.

sanskrit_iast:
tvaṃ sāmagītistvaṃ nītistvaṃ hrīḥ śrīstvaṃ sarasvatī |
yoganidrā mahāmāyā mohanidrā tvamīśvarī || 33 ||
meaning:
त्वं सामगीतिस्त्वं नीतिस्त्वं ह्रीः श्रीस्त्वं सरस्वती |
योगनिद्रा महामाया मोहनिद्रा त्वमीश्वरी || 33 ||
text_mt:
You are the singing of the Sāman; you are moral conduct; you are modesty, prosperity, and Sarasvatī;
Yoganidrā, Mahāmāyā, sleep of delusion, you are the supreme mistress.

sanskrit_iast:
tvaṃ kāntiḥ sarvaśaktistvaṃ tvaṃ tanurvaiṣṇavī śivā |
tvaṃ dhātrī sarvalokānāmavidyāṃ tvaṃ śarīriṇām || 34 ||
meaning:
त्वं कान्तिः सर्वशक्तिस्त्वं त्वं तनुर्वैष्णवी शिवा |
त्वं धात्री सर्वलोकानामविद्यां त्वं शरीरिणाम् || 34 ||
text_mt:
You are beauty; you are all power; you are the auspicious, Vaiṣṇava body;
you are the sustainer of all worlds; you are the ignorance of embodied beings.

sanskrit_iast:
ādhāraśaktistvaṃ devī tvaṃ hi brahmāṇḍadhāriṇī |
tvameva sarvajagatāṃ prakṛtistriguṇātmikāṃ || 35 ||
meaning:
आधारशक्तिस्त्वं देवी त्वं हि ब्रह्माण्डधारिणी |
त्वमेव सर्वजगतां प्रकृतिस्त्रिगुणात्मिकां || 35 ||
text_mt:
You are the power of support, O goddess; you indeed are the bearer of the cosmic egg;
you alone are Prakṛti, possessing the nature of the three guṇas, of all the worlds.

sanskrit_iast:
tvaṃ sāvitrī ca gāyatrī saumyāsaumyātiśobhanā |
tvaṃ sisṛścā harernityā suṣupsā tvaṃ suṣuptikā || 36 ||
meaning:
त्वं सावित्री च गायत्री सौम्यासौम्यातिशोभना |
त्वं सिसृश्चा हरेर्नित्या सुषुप्सा त्वं सुषुप्तिका || 36 ||
text_mt:
You are Sāvitrī and Gāyatrī, gentle and fierce, exceedingly radiant;
you are Hari's eternal desire to create; you are the desire to sleep and deep sleep.

sanskrit_iast:
puṣṭirlajjā kṣamā śāntistvaṃ dhṛtiḥ parameśvarī |
tvameva kṣitirūpeṇa dhriyase sacarācaram || 37 ||
meaning:
पुष्टिर्लज्जा क्षमा शान्तिस्त्वं धृतिः परमेश्वरी |
त्वमेव क्षितिरूपेण ध्रियसे सचराचरम् || 37 ||
text_mt:
You are nourishment, modesty, forgiveness, peace, and steadfastness, O supreme mistress;
you alone, in the form of the earth, sustain what moves and what is still.

sanskrit_iast:
tvamāpastvamapāṃ mātā sarvāntargatacāriṇī |
stutiḥ stutyā ca stotrī ca stutiśaktistvameva ca || 38 ||
meaning:
त्वमापस्त्वमपां माता सर्वान्तर्गतचारिणी |
स्तुतिः स्तुत्या च स्तोत्री च स्तुतिशक्तिस्त्वमेव च || 38 ||
text_mt:
You are the waters; you are the mother of the waters; you wander within all things;
you are praise, the object of praise, the praiser, and the power of praise itself.

sanskrit_iast:
tvāmahaṃ kinnu stoṣyāmi prasīda parameśvari |
namastunyaṃ jaganmātaḥ prabodhaya janārdanam || 39 ||
meaning:
त्वामहं किन्नु स्तोष्यामि प्रसीद परमेश्वरि |
नमस्तुन्यं जगन्मातः प्रबोधय जनार्दनम् || 39 ||
text_mt:
How indeed shall I praise you? Be gracious, O supreme mistress!
Homage to you, O mother of the universe! Awaken Janārdana!

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ stutā mahāmāyā brahmaṇā lokakāriṇā |
netrāsyanāsikā-bāhu-hṛdayānnirgatā hareḥ |
rājasī mūrtimāśritya sā tasthau brahmadrśane || 40 ||
meaning:
एवं स्तुता महामाया ब्रह्मणा लोककारिणा |
नेत्रास्यनासिका-बाहु-हृदयान्निर्गता हरेः |
राजसी मूर्तिमाश्रित्य सा तस्थौ ब्रह्मद्र्शने || 40 ||

sanskrit_iast:
tato janārdano bhogiśayanānnidrayā kṣaṇāt |
parityaktaḥ samuttasthau sṛṣṭaye cākaronmatim || 41 ||
meaning:
ततो जनार्दनो भोगिशयनान्निद्रया क्षणात् |
परित्यक्तः समुत्तस्थौ सृष्टये चाकरोन्मतिम् || 41 ||
text_mt:
Then Janārdana, in an instant released from sleep
upon the serpent couch, arose and set his mind upon creation.

sanskrit_iast:
tato varāharūpeṇa nimagnāṃ pṛthivīṃ jale |
magnāṃ samuddadhārāśu nyadhācca salilopari || 42 ||
meaning:
ततो वराहरूपेण निमग्नां पृथिवीं जले |
मग्नां समुद्दधाराशु न्यधाच्च सलिलोपरि || 42 ||
text_mt:
Then, in the form of a boar, he quickly raised up the earth
that was submerged and sinking in the water, and placed it on top of the water.

sanskrit_iast:
tasyopari jalaughasya mahatī nauriva sthitā |
vitatatvācca dehasya na mahī yāti saṃplavam || 43 ||
meaning:
तस्योपरि जलौघस्य महती नौरिव स्थिता |
विततत्वाच्च देहस्य न मही याति संप्लवम् || 43 ||
text_mt:
It remained upon that flood of water like a great boat,
and because of the vastness of its mass, the earth does not drift away.

sanskrit_iast:
tato hariḥ kṣitiṃ gatvā toyarāśiṃ svamāyayā |
saṃhṛtya jantusthitaye pravṛttaḥ svayameva hi || 44 ||
meaning:
ततो हरिः क्षितिं गत्वा तोयराशिं स्वमायया |
संहृत्य जन्तुस्थितये प्रवृत्तः स्वयमेव हि || 44 ||
text_mt:
Then Hari, having gone to the earth and withdrawn
the mass of waters by his own Māyā, set himself to the preservation of creatures.

sanskrit_iast:
ananto'pi yathāpūrvaṃ tathā gatvā kṣitestalam |
pṛthivīṃ dhārayāmāsa kūrmasyopari saṃsthitaḥ || 45 ||
meaning:
अनन्तोऽपि यथापूर्वं तथा गत्वा क्षितेस्तलम् |
पृथिवीं धारयामास कूर्मस्योपरि संस्थितः || 45 ||
text_mt:
Ananta also, having gone to the underside of the earth as before,
held up the earth while resting upon the tortoise.

sanskrit_iast:
tato brahmā samutpādya sarvāneva prajāpatīn |
jagadutpādayāmāsa sarvalokapitāmahaḥ || 46 ||
meaning:
ततो ब्रह्मा समुत्पाद्य सर्वानेव प्रजापतीन् |
जगदुत्पादयामास सर्वलोकपितामहः || 46 ||
text_mt:
Then Brahmā, the grandfather of all the worlds,
having brought forth all the Prajāpatis, brought forth the universe.

sanskrit_iast:
brahmā vā kurute sṛṣṭi yadānye vāpi kurvate |
dakṣādyāstu prajāpālāḥ svayameva tadicchayā || 47 ||
meaning:
ब्रह्मा वा कुरुते सृष्टि यदान्ये वापि कुर्वते |
दक्षाद्यास्तु प्रजापालाः स्वयमेव तदिच्छया || 47 ||
text_mt:
Either Brahmā carries out creation, or others carry it out,
such as Dakṣa and the other protectors of creatures, spontaneously by his will.

sanskrit_iast:
parabrahmasvarūpīya so'nugṛhṇāti santatam |
prakṛtiścānugṛhṇāti mahābhūtāni pañca vai || 48 ||
meaning:
परब्रह्मस्वरूपीय सोऽनुगृह्णाति सन्ततम् |
प्रकृतिश्चानुगृह्णाति महाभूतानि पञ्च वै || 48 ||
text_mt:
He whose nature is the supreme Brahman constantly bestows favor;
Prakṛti also bestows favor, as do indeed the five great elements.

sanskrit_iast:
puruṣaścānugṛhṇati tathaiva mahadādayaḥ |
īśvarecchānvadhiṣṭhānāt puruṣādaṣṭasaṃcayāt || 49 ||
meaning:
पुरुषश्चानुगृह्णति तथैव महदादयः |
ईश्वरेच्छान्वधिष्ठानात् पुरुषादष्टसंचयात् || 49 ||
text_mt:
Puruṣa also bestows favor, and likewise the principles beginning with the great intellect,
from the presiding authority of the will of the Lord, [and] from Puruṣa, the aggregate of eight.

sanskrit_iast:
puruṣāṇāmadhiṣṭānānmahābhūtagaṇasya ca |
tathaiva mahadādīnāṃ kālasya ca mahātmanaḥ |
adhīṣṭhānāt pradhānasya yacca kiñcana jāyate || 50 ||
meaning:
पुरुषाणामधिष्टानान्महाभूतगणस्य च |
तथैव महदादीनां कालस्य च महात्मनः |
अधीष्ठानात् प्रधानस्य यच्च किञ्चन जायते || 50 ||
text_mt:
Whatever is born, from the presiding authority of the puruṣas
and of the host of the great elements,
and likewise of the principles beginning with the great intellect, of noble Time,
and from the presiding authority of pradhāna,

sanskrit_iast:
sthāvaraṃ jaṅgamaṃ vāpi sthiraṃ vāpyathavādbhūtam |
sarvametadadhiṣṭhānājjāyate dvijasattamāḥ || 51 ||
meaning:
स्थावरं जङ्गमं वापि स्थिरं वाप्यथवाद्भूतम् |
सर्वमेतदधिष्ठानाज्जायते द्विजसत्तमाः || 51 ||
text_mt:
whether immovable or movable, fixed or extraordinary—
all this is born from [that] presiding authority, O best of the twice-born.

sanskrit_iast:
iti vaḥ kathitaṃ sarvaṃ yathaivādarśayat purā |
harāya sṛṣṭisaṃhāra-kalpāstān bhagavān hariḥ || 52 ||
meaning:
इति वः कथितं सर्वं यथैवादर्शयत् पुरा |
हराय सृष्टिसंहार-कल्पास्तान् भगवान् हरिः || 52 ||
text_mt:
Thus all has been related to you, just as of old the blessed Hari
showed to Hara those aeons of creation and destruction.

sanskrit_iast:
yathā jagat prapañcasyāsāratā darśitā parā |
yacca sāraṃ darśitaṃ tanmattaḥ śṛṇvantu vai dvijāḥ || 53 ||
meaning:
यथा जगत् प्रपञ्चस्यासारता दर्शिता परा |
यच्च सारं दर्शितं तन्मत्तः शृण्वन्तु वै द्विजाः || 53 ||
text_mt:
Just as the supreme insubstantiality of the manifold universe was shown,
and what was shown to be the real essence, let the twice-born hear that from me.

sanskrit_iast:
iti śrīkālikāpurāṇe sṛṣṭikathena saptaviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 27 ||
aṣṭāviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ
meaning:
इति श्रीकालिकापुराणे सृष्टिकथेन सप्तविंशोऽध्यायः || 27 ||
अष्टाविंशोऽध्यायः
text_mt:
Thus ends the twenty-seventh chapter, on the narrative of creation, in the glorious Kālikāpurāṇa.
Chapter Twenty-Eight.

sanskrit_iast: mārkaṇḍeya uvāca
meaning: मार्कण्डेय उवाच

sanskrit_iast:
jagat sarvaṃ tu niḥsāramanityaṃ duḥkhabhājanam |
utpadyate kṣaṇādetat kṣaṇādetadvipadyate || 1 ||
meaning:
जगत् सर्वं तु निःसारमनित्यं दुःखभाजनम् |
उत्पद्यते क्षणादेतत् क्षणादेतद्विपद्यते || 1 ||
text_mt:
The entire universe is without essence, impermanent, and a vessel of sorrow;
in an instant it arises, and in an instant it perishes.

sanskrit_iast:
tathaivotpadyate sārānni sāraṃ jagadañjasā |
punastasmin vilīyante mahāpralayasaṅgame || 2 ||
meaning:
तथैवोत्पद्यते सारान्नि सारं जगदञ्जसा |
पुनस्तस्मिन् विलीयन्ते महाप्रलयसङ्गमे || 2 ||
text_mt:
Likewise the universe, devoid of essence, arises directly from that essence;
and they merge into it once more at the meeting of the great dissolution.

sanskrit_iast:
utpattipralayābhyāṃ tu jaganniḥsāratāṃ hariḥ |
śambhave darśayāmāsa bhāvena jagatāṃ patiḥ || 3 ||
meaning:
उत्पत्तिप्रलयाभ्यां तु जगन्निःसारतां हरिः |
शम्भवे दर्शयामास भावेन जगतां पतिः || 3 ||
text_mt:
Through arising and dissolution, Hari, the lord of the worlds,
showed in its true nature the insubstantiality of the universe to Śambhu.

sanskrit_iast:
ekaṃ śivaṃ śāntamanantamacyutaṃ parātparaṃ jñānamayaṃ viśeṣam |
advaitamavyaktamacintyarūpaṃ sāraṃ tvekaṃ nāsti sāraṃ tadanyat || 4 ||
meaning:
एकं शिवं शान्तमनन्तमच्युतं परात्परं ज्ञानमयं विशेषम् |
अद्वैतमव्यक्तमचिन्त्यरूपं सारं त्वेकं नास्ति सारं तदन्यत् || 4 ||
text_mt: The one, auspicious, tranquil, infinite, imperishable, higher than the highest, consisting of knowledge, distinct, / non-dual, unmanifest, of unthinkable form, is the one essence; there is no other essence than that.

sanskrit_iast:
yasmādetajjāyate viśvamagryaṃ yasmāllīnaṃ syāttu paścāt sthitañca |
ākāśavanmeghajālasya vṛttyā yadviśvaṃ vai dhriyate tattvasāram || 5 ||
meaning:
यस्मादेतज्जायते विश्वमग्र्यं यस्माल्लीनं स्यात्तु पश्चात् स्थितञ्च |
आकाशवन्मेघजालस्य वृत्त्या यद्विश्वं वै ध्रियते तत्त्वसारम् || 5 ||
text_mt: From which this foremost universe is born, into which it is afterwards dissolved, and [wherein] it rests, / by which, through the manner of a mass of clouds like space, the universe is held—that is the essential truth.

sanskrit_iast:
aṣṭāṅgayorgairyadavāptumicchan yogī punātyātmarūpaṃ sadaiva |
nivartate prāpya yaṃ neha loke tadvaisāraṃ sāramanyanna cāsti || 6 ||
meaning:
अष्टाङ्गयोर्गैर्यदवाप्तुमिच्छन् योगी पुनात्यात्मरूपं सदैव |
निवर्तते प्राप्य यं नेह लोके तद्वैसारं सारमन्यन्न चास्ति || 6 ||
text_mt: Desiring to attain which by means of the eightfold yoga, the yogin constantly purifies the nature of his self, / and having attained which he does not return to this world—that indeed is the essence, and there is no other essence.

sanskrit_iast:
sāro dvitīyo dharmastu yo nityaprāptaye bhavet |
yo vai nivartako nāma tatrāsāraḥ pravartakaḥ || 7 ||
meaning:
सारो द्वितीयो धर्मस्तु यो नित्यप्राप्तये भवेत् |
यो वै निवर्तको नाम तत्रासारः प्रवर्तकः || 7 ||
text_mt:
Dharma is the second essence, which leads to the attainment of the eternal—
that indeed which is called the path of cessation; in that respect, [the path of] engagement is devoid of essence.

sanskrit_iast:
dharma śanaiḥ sañcinuyādvalmīko mṛttikāṃ yathā |
sahāyārthaṃ pare loke pūrvapāpavimuktaye || 8 ||
meaning:
धर्म शनैः सञ्चिनुयाद्वल्मीको मृत्तिकां यथा |
सहायार्थं परे लोके पूर्वपापविमुक्तये || 8 ||
text_mt:
One should slowly accumulate dharma, just as an anthill [accumulates] earth,
for the sake of assistance in the other world and for release from previous sin.

sanskrit_iast:
eko dharmaḥ paraṃ śreyaḥ sarvasaṃsārakarmasu |
itare tu trayo dharmājjāyante'rthādayo'pare || 9 ||
meaning:
एको धर्मः परं श्रेयः सर्वसंसारकर्मसु |
इतरे तु त्रयो धर्माज्जायन्तेऽर्थादयोऽपरे || 9 ||
text_mt:
Dharma alone is the supreme good among all actions in worldly existence;
the other three, beginning with wealth, arise from dharma.

sanskrit_iast:
varaṃ prāṇaparityāgaḥ śiraso vātha kartanam |
na tu dharmaparityāgo loke vede ca garhitaḥ || 10 ||
meaning:
वरं प्राणपरित्यागः शिरसो वाथ कर्तनम् |
न तु धर्मपरित्यागो लोके वेदे च गर्हितः || 10 ||
text_mt:
Better is the relinquishment of life or the cutting off of one's head,
than the relinquishment of dharma, which is condemned in the world and in the Veda.

sanskrit_iast:
dharmeṇa dhriyate loko dharmeṇa dhriyate jagat |
dharmeṇaiva surāḥ sarve suratvamagaman purā || 11 ||
meaning:
धर्मेण ध्रियते लोको धर्मेण ध्रियते जगत् |
धर्मेणैव सुराः सर्वे सुरत्वमगमन् पुरा || 11 ||
text_mt:
By dharma the world is held up; by dharma the universe is sustained;
by dharma alone all the gods attained godhood in the past.

sanskrit_iast:
dharmaścatuspād bhagavān jagat pālayate'niśam |
sa eva mūlaṃ puruṣo dharma ityabhidhīyate || 12 ||
meaning:
धर्मश्चतुस्पाद् भगवान् जगत् पालयतेऽनिशम् |
स एव मूलं पुरुषो धर्म इत्यभिधीयते || 12 ||
text_mt:
The four-footed blessed Lord Dharma protects the universe day and night;
that very primal Person is designated as dharma.

sanskrit_iast:
sarvaṃ kṣarati loke'smin dharmo naiva cyuto bhavet |
dharmād yo na vicalati sa evākṣara ucyate || 13 ||
meaning:
सर्वं क्षरति लोकेऽस्मिन् धर्मो नैव च्युतो भवेत् |
धर्माद् यो न विचलति स एवाक्षर उच्यते || 13 ||
text_mt:
Everything perishes in this world, but dharma is never lost;
he who does not swerve from dharma is called imperishable.

sanskrit_iast:
etadvaḥ kathitaṃ sāraṃ niḥsāraṃ sakalaṃ jagat |
yathā svayaṃ dadarśāsau śambhurjñānena sve'ntare || 14 ||
meaning:
एतद्वः कथितं सारं निःसारं सकलं जगत् |
यथा स्वयं ददर्शासौ शम्भुर्ज्ञानेन स्वेऽन्तरे || 14 ||
text_mt:
Thus the essence has been told to you; the entire universe is devoid of essence,
just as Śambhu himself saw by means of knowledge within himself.

sanskrit_iast:
etadvai darśayāmāsa sa viṣṇurjagatāṃ patiḥ |
svayaṃ jagrāha amnasāṃ dhyānenātmani śaṃkaraḥ || 15 ||
meaning:
एतद्वै दर्शयामास स विष्णुर्जगतां पतिः |
स्वयं जग्राह अम्नसां ध्यानेनात्मनि शंकरः || 15 ||
text_mt:
This indeed Viṣṇu, the lord of the worlds, showed;
Śaṃkara himself received it in his self through meditation of the mind.

sanskrit_iast:
sāraṃ tattvaṃ paramaṃ niṣkalaṃ yanmūrtyā hīnaṃ mūrtimān dharma eṣaḥ |
sāro'nyo'sau sārahīnaṃ tadanyajjñātvaivetthaṃ yāti nityaṃ mahādhīḥ || 16 ||
meaning:
सारं तत्त्वं परमं निष्कलं यन्मूर्त्या हीनं मूर्तिमान् धर्म एषः |
सारोऽन्योऽसौ सारहीनं तदन्यज्ज्ञात्वैवेत्थं याति नित्यं महाधीः || 16 ||
text_mt: That which is the supreme essence, the principle without parts and devoid of form, is one; this dharma is embodied. / That is the other essence; everything else is devoid of essence—knowing this in this manner, the wise person goes to the eternal.

sanskrit_iast:
iti śrīkālikāpurāṇe sārāsāranirūpaṇaṃ nāma aṣṭāviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 28 ||
ūnatriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ
meaning:
इति श्रीकालिकापुराणे सारासारनिरूपणं नाम अष्टाविंशोऽध्यायः || 28 ||
ऊनत्रिंशोऽध्यायः
text_mt:
Thus ends the twenty-eighth chapter, entitled "Ascertainment of the Essence and Non-essence", in the glorious Kālikāpurāṇa.
Twenty-ninth chapter.

sanskrit_iast: ṛṣayaḥ ūcuḥ
meaning: ऋषयः ऊचुः

sanskrit_iast:
ye sṛṣṭāḥ śambhunā pūrvaṃ bhūtagrāmāścaturvidhāḥ |
kimarthaṃ te samutpannāḥ kathaṃ vānekarūpatāṃ || 1 ||
meaning:
ये सृष्टाः शम्भुना पूर्वं भूतग्रामाश्चतुर्विधाः |
किमर्थं ते समुत्पन्नाः कथं वानेकरूपतां || 1 ||
text_mt:
The fourfold hosts of beings that were previously created by Śambhu—
for what purpose were they produced, and how did they come to have manifold forms?

sanskrit_iast:
śarīramarddhaṃ vārāhamarddhaṃ dantābalaṃ tathā |
siṃhavyāghraśarīrācca kecit kecidgaṇādhipāḥ || 2 ||
meaning:
शरीरमर्द्धं वाराहमर्द्धं दन्ताबलं तथा |
सिंहव्याघ्रशरीराच्च केचित् केचिद्गणाधिपाः || 2 ||
text_mt:
Some leaders of the gaṇas had half a boar's body and half an elephant's,
and some had bodies of lions and tigers.

sanskrit_iast:
kathaṃ te vā gaṇāḥ krūrāḥ kiṃ bhogāste mahaujasaḥ |
etat sarva vayaṃ śrotumicchāmo dvijasattama || 3 ||
meaning:
कथं ते वा गणाः क्रूराः किं भोगास्ते महौजसः |
एतत् सर्व वयं श्रोतुमिच्छामो द्विजसत्तम || 3 ||
text_mt:
Why are those gaṇas cruel, and what are the pleasures of those of great splendor?
We wish to hear all of this, O best of the twice-born!

sanskrit_iast: mārkaṇḍeya uvāca
meaning: मार्कण्डेय उवाच

sanskrit_iast:
śṛṇvantu munayaḥ sarve yathā śambhugaṇābhavan |
yadarthaṃ te samutpannā yasmātte naikarūpiṇaḥ || 4 ||
meaning:
शृण्वन्तु मुनयः सर्वे यथा शम्भुगणाभवन् |
यदर्थं ते समुत्पन्ना यस्मात्ते नैकरूपिणः || 4 ||
text_mt:
Let all the sages listen to how Śambhu's gaṇas came to be,
for what reason they were born, and why they possess manifold forms.

sanskrit_iast:
etadvaḥ paramaṃ guhyamidaṃ dharmārthakāmadam |
etad hi paramaṃ tejaḥ satataṃ paramaṃ tapaḥ || 5 ||
meaning:
एतद्वः परमं गुह्यमिदं धर्मार्थकामदम् |
एतद् हि परमं तेजः सततं परमं तपः || 5 ||
text_mt:
This is a supreme secret for you; it bestows dharma, artha, and kāma.
For this is supreme power, constantly supreme asceticism.

sanskrit_iast:
idaṃ śrutvā mahākhyānaṃ paratreha na sīdati |
yaśasyaṃ dharmyamāyuṣyaṃ tuṣṭipuṣṭipradaṃ param || 6 ||
meaning:
इदं श्रुत्वा महाख्यानं परत्रेह न सीदति |
यशस्यं धर्म्यमायुष्यं तुष्टिपुष्टिप्रदं परम् || 6 ||
text_mt:
Having heard this great narrative, one does not languish in this world or the next.
It brings fame, aligns with dharma, grants long life, and gives the highest satisfaction and nourishment.

sanskrit_iast:
ādisarge'tha vārāhe sampūrṇe munisattamāḥ |
śaṃkaraḥ prāha sarveśaṃ varāhaṃ jagatāṃ patim || 7 ||
meaning:
आदिसर्गेऽथ वाराहे सम्पूर्णे मुनिसत्तमाः |
शंकरः प्राह सर्वेशं वराहं जगतां पतिम् || 7 ||
text_mt:
Then, O best of sages, when the primordial creation of the Boar was complete,
Śaṅkara spoke to the Lord of All, the Boar, the Master of the Worlds:

sanskrit_iast: īśvara uvāca
meaning: ईश्वर उवाच

sanskrit_iast:
yadarthaṃ bhavatā rūpaṃ vārāhaṃ kalpitaṃ vibho |
tatte pūrṇaṃ kṛtaṃ pṛthvī yathāvat sthāpitā tvayā || 8 ||
meaning:
यदर्थं भवता रूपं वाराहं कल्पितं विभो |
तत्ते पूर्णं कृतं पृथ्वी यथावत् स्थापिता त्वया || 8 ||
text_mt:
"That for which the form of a boar was assumed by you, O omnipresent Lord,
has been accomplished by you: the earth has been properly established by you.

sanskrit_iast:
sāgarāṇāṃ ca saṃsthānaṃ nadīnāṃ ca tathā kṣiteḥ |
sṛṣṭirbrahmakṛtā cāpi saṃjātā tvatprasādataḥ || 9 ||
meaning:
सागराणां च संस्थानं नदीनां च तथा क्षितेः |
सृष्टिर्ब्रह्मकृता चापि संजाता त्वत्प्रसादतः || 9 ||
text_mt:
The setting in place of the oceans, the rivers, and the earth,
and also the creation made by Brahmā, have come about by your grace.

sanskrit_iast:
tvaṃ hi sarvamayo yajñamayastejomayastathā |
gurūṇāmatha sarveṣāṃ tvaṃ gurustvaṃ parātparaḥ || 10 ||
meaning:
त्वं हि सर्वमयो यज्ञमयस्तेजोमयस्तथा |
गुरूणामथ सर्वेषां त्वं गुरुस्त्वं परात्परः || 10 ||
text_mt:
For you are identical with all, consisting of sacrifice, full of splendor;
you are the guru of all gurus, higher than the highest.

sanskrit_iast:
tvāṃ voḍhuṃ na kṣamā pṛthvī viśīrṇeva jagatpate |
yantritā śailasaṃghātairbhavatā sthāpiteḥ purā || 11 ||
meaning:
त्वां वोढुं न क्षमा पृथ्वी विशीर्णेव जगत्पते |
यन्त्रिता शैलसंघातैर्भवता स्थापितेः पुरा || 11 ||
text_mt:
The earth is unable to bear you; she is, as it were, shattered, O Lord of the World,
[though] formerly secured by you, established with masses of mountains.

sanskrit_iast:
tatmāttva tyaja vārāhaṃ śarīra jagatā pate |
jaganmayaṃ jagadrūpaṃ jagatkāraṇakāraṇam || 12 ||
meaning:
तत्मात्त्व त्यज वाराहं शरीर जगता पते |
जगन्मयं जगद्रूपं जगत्कारणकारणम् || 12 ||
text_mt:
Therefore, abandon the body of the boar, O Lord of the Worlds—
[you who] consist of the world, whose form is the world, the cause of the causes of the world!

sanskrit_iast:
kastvāṃ cānyaḥ kṣamo voḍhuṃ vārāhaṃ te vapurvibho |
viśeṣatastvayā pṛthvī sakāmā dhaṣitāḥ jale |
strīdharmiṇī tvattejobhiḥ sādhād garbhaṃ ca dāruṇam || 13 ||
meaning:
कस्त्वां चान्यः क्षमो वोढुं वाराहं ते वपुर्विभो |
विशेषतस्त्वया पृथ्वी सकामा धषिताः जले |
स्त्रीधर्मिणी त्वत्तेजोभिः साधाद् गर्भं च दारुणम् || 13 ||

sanskrit_iast:
rajasvalā kṣamā garbhaṃ yamādhatta jagatpate |
tasmādyastanayo bhāvī so'pyādāsyati duryaśaḥ || 14 ||
meaning:
रजस्वला क्षमा गर्भं यमाधत्त जगत्पते |
तस्माद्यस्तनयो भावी सोऽप्यादास्यति दुर्यशः || 14 ||
text_mt:
The menstruating Earth conceived a fetus, O Lord of the World;
therefore, the son who will be born will also bring about infamy.

sanskrit_iast:
eṣa prāpyāsura bhāva devagandharvahiṃsakaḥ |
bhaviṣyatīti lokeśaḥ prāha māṃ dakṣasannidhau || 15 ||
meaning:
एष प्राप्यासुर भाव देवगन्धर्वहिंसकः |
भविष्यतीति लोकेशः प्राह मां दक्षसन्निधौ || 15 ||
text_mt:
Having assumed an Asura nature, he will become a tormentor of gods and gandharvas—
so the Lord of the World told me in the presence of Dakṣa.

sanskrit_iast:
malinīratisaṃjātaṃ duṣṭante'niṣṭakārakam |
kāmukaṃ tyaja lokeśa vārāhaṃ kāyamīdṛśam || 16 ||
meaning:
मलिनीरतिसंजातं दुष्टन्तेऽनिष्टकारकम् |
कामुकं त्यज लोकेश वाराहं कायमीदृशम् || 16 ||
text_mt:
Born of an impure union, corrupted, bringing about misfortune,
[and] lustful—abandon such a boar-body, O Lord of the World!

sanskrit_iast:
tvameva sṛṣṭisthityantakārako lokabhāvanaḥ |
kāle prāpte sthitiṃ sṛṣṭiṃ saṃhāraṃ ca kariṣyasi || 17 ||
meaning:
त्वमेव सृष्टिस्थित्यन्तकारको लोकभावनः |
काले प्राप्ते स्थितिं सृष्टिं संहारं च करिष्यसि || 17 ||
text_mt:
You alone are the creator, sustainer, and destroyer, the animator of the worlds;
when the time comes, you will carry out sustenance, creation, and dissolution.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmāllokahitārthāya tyaktvā kāyaṃ mahābala |
kāle prāpte punastvanyaṃ kāyaṃ potraṃ kariṣyasi || 18 ||
meaning:
तस्माल्लोकहितार्थाय त्यक्त्वा कायं महाबल |
काले प्राप्ते पुनस्त्वन्यं कायं पोत्रं करिष्यसि || 18 ||
text_mt:
Therefore, having cast off that body for the welfare of the world, O one of great might,
when the time arrives, you will take on another boar-body."

sanskrit_iast: mārkaṇḍeya uvāca
meaning: मार्कण्डेय उवाच

sanskrit_iast:
iti tasya vacaḥ śrutvā śaṃkarasya mahātmanaḥ |
vārāhamūrtirbhagavān mahādevamuvāca ha || 19 ||
meaning:
इति तस्य वचः श्रुत्वा शंकरस्य महात्मनः |
वाराहमूर्तिर्भगवान् महादेवमुवाच ह || 19 ||
text_mt:
Having heard those words of that great-souled Śaṅkara,
the Lord in the form of the Boar said to Mahādeva:

sanskrit_iast: śrībhagavānuvāca
meaning: श्रीभगवानुवाच

sanskrit_iast:
kariṣye'haṃ tava vacastvaṃ yathāttha maheśvara |
imaṃ tu yajñavārāhaṃ kāyaṃ tyakṣye na saṃśayaḥ || 20 ||
meaning:
करिष्येऽहं तव वचस्त्वं यथात्थ महेश्वर |
इमं तु यज्ञवाराहं कायं त्यक्ष्ये न संशयः || 20 ||
text_mt:
"I will carry out your word as you have spoken, O Maheśvara;
I shall indeed abandon this sacrificial boar-body, without doubt.

sanskrit_iast:
kāle prāpte punastvanyaṃ kāyaṃ vārāhamadbhutam |
kariṣye'haṃ durādharṣaṃ lokānāṃ bhāvanāya vai || 21 ||
meaning:
काले प्राप्ते पुनस्त्वन्यं कायं वाराहमद्भुतम् |
करिष्येऽहं दुराधर्षं लोकानां भावनाय वै || 21 ||
text_mt:
When the time comes, I shall take on another wonderful boar-body,
unassailable, for the creation of the worlds."

sanskrit_iast:
ityuktvā sa mahākāyastatraivāntaradhīyata |
jagadgururjagatsraṣṭā jagaddhātā jagatpatiḥ || 22 ||
meaning:
इत्युक्त्वा स महाकायस्तत्रैवान्तरधीयत |
जगद्गुरुर्जगत्स्रष्टा जगद्धाता जगत्पतिः || 22 ||
text_mt:
Having spoken thus, that huge-bodied one vanished right there—
the teacher of the world, the creator of the world, the sustainer of the world, the lord of the world.

sanskrit_iast:
tasminnantarhite deve devadevo maheśvaraḥ |
nijaṃ sthānaṃ devagaṇaiḥ svagaṇaiśca jagāma ha || 23 ||
meaning:
तस्मिन्नन्तर्हिते देवे देवदेवो महेश्वरः |
निजं स्थानं देवगणैः स्वगणैश्च जगाम ह || 23 ||
text_mt:
When that god had vanished, Maheśvara, the god of gods,
went to his own abode with the hosts of gods and his own gaṇas.

sanskrit_iast:
vārāho'pi svayaṃ gatvā lokālokāhvayaṃ girim |
vārāhyā saha reme sa pṛthivyā cārurūpayā || 24 ||
meaning:
वाराहोऽपि स्वयं गत्वा लोकालोकाह्वयं गिरिम् |
वाराह्या सह रेमे स पृथिव्या चारुरूपया || 24 ||
text_mt:
The Boar also went of his own accord to the mountain named Lokāloka;
he sportively enjoyed himself with the earth who possessed the beautiful form of a sow.

sanskrit_iast:
sa tayā ramamāṇastu suciraṃ parvatottame |
nāvāpa toṣaṃ lokeśaḥ potrīparamakāmukaḥ || 25 ||
meaning:
स तया रममाणस्तु सुचिरं पर्वतोत्तमे |
नावाप तोषं लोकेशः पोत्रीपरमकामुकः || 25 ||
text_mt:
Enjoying himself with her for a very long time on that best of mountains,
the Lord of the World, exceedingly lustful as a boar, found no satiety.

sanskrit_iast:
pṛthivyāḥ potrīrūpāyā ramayantyāstataḥ sutāḥ |
trayo jātā dvijaśreṣṭhāsteṣāṃ nāmāni me śṛṇu || 26 ||
meaning:
पृथिव्याः पोत्रीरूपाया रमयन्त्यास्ततः सुताः |
त्रयो जाता द्विजश्रेष्ठास्तेषां नामानि मे शृणु || 26 ||
text_mt:
Then, from the Earth in the form of a sow who gave him pleasure, three sons
were born, O best of the twice-born; hear their names from me:

sanskrit_iast: suvṛttaḥ kanako ghoraḥ sarva eva mahābalāḥ || 27 ||
meaning: सुवृत्तः कनको घोरः सर्व एव महाबलाः || 27 ||
text_mt: Suvṛtta, Kanaka, and Ghora—all of them of immense strength.

sanskrit_iast:
śiśavaste merupṛṣṭhe kāñcane vaprasastare |
remire'nyonyasaṃsaktā gahvareṣu saraḥsu ca || 28 ||
meaning:
शिशवस्ते मेरुपृष्ठे काञ्चने वप्रसस्तरे |
रेमिरेऽन्योन्यसंसक्ता गह्वरेषु सरःसु च || 28 ||
text_mt:
Those young ones sported on the back of Meru, on the golden expanses of its slopes,
clinging to one another, in its caves and its lakes.

sanskrit_iast:
sa taiḥ putraiḥ parivṛto vārāho bharyayā svayā |
ramamāṇastadā kāyatyāgaṃ naivāgaṇaddhijāḥ || 29 ||
meaning:
स तैः पुत्रैः परिवृतो वाराहो भर्यया स्वया |
रममाणस्तदा कायत्यागं नैवागणद्धिजाः || 29 ||
text_mt:
Surrounded by those sons, the Boar, sporting with his own wife,
did not at all consider abandoning the body, O twice-born ones!

sanskrit_iast:
kadācicchiśubhistaistu saṃśliṣṭaḥ kardamāntare |
cakāra kardamakrīḍāṃ bhāryayā ca mahābalaḥ || 30 ||
meaning:
कदाचिच्छिशुभिस्तैस्तु संश्लिष्टः कर्दमान्तरे |
चकार कर्दमक्रीडां भार्यया च महाबलः || 30 ||
text_mt:
At times, embraced by those children in the mud,
that one of great strength engaged in play in the mire along with his wife.

sanskrit_iast:
sapaṅkalepaḥ śuśubhe varāho madhupiṅgalaḥ |
sandhyāghano yathātoyaṃ kṣaraṃstoyaṃ tathāvidhaḥ || 31 ||
meaning:
सपङ्कलेपः शुशुभे वराहो मधुपिङ्गलः |
सन्ध्याघनो यथातोयं क्षरंस्तोयं तथाविधः || 31 ||
text_mt:
Smeared with mud, the tawny-brown Boar shone
just like a twilight cloud shedding water.

sanskrit_iast:
sa putraiḥ paramaprīto bhāryayā ca pṛthivyayā |
virujaṃ dharaṇīṃ reme madhyanimnātha sābhavat || 32 ||
meaning:
स पुत्रैः परमप्रीतो भार्यया च पृथिव्यया |
विरुजं धरणीं रेमे मध्यनिम्नाथ साभवत् || 32 ||
text_mt:
Exceedingly pleased with his sons and with his wife, the Earth,
he enjoyed the painless earth, and then she became depressed in the middle.

sanskrit_iast:
ananto'pi samākramya kūrmaṃ sa pṛthivītale |
hariṃ vahan bhagnaśirāḥ sātaṅko'bhūtprapīḍayā || 33 ||
meaning:
अनन्तोऽपि समाक्रम्य कूर्मं स पृथिवीतले |
हरिं वहन् भग्नशिराः सातङ्कोऽभूत्प्रपीडया || 33 ||
text_mt:
Even Ananta, resting upon the Tortoise beneath the earth,
bearing Hari, had his heads crushed and was terrified by the pressure.

sanskrit_iast:
suvṛttena svarṇavapraṃ ghoreṇa kanakena ca |
vidāritaṃ potraghātaiḥ svarṇa-bhagnātkṛtaṃ samam || 34 ||
meaning:
सुवृत्तेन स्वर्णवप्रं घोरेण कनकेन च |
विदारितं पोत्रघातैः स्वर्ण-भग्नात्कृतं समम् || 34 ||
text_mt:
The golden rampart was torn apart by Suvṛtta, Ghora, and Kanaka
with blows of their snouts, leveled by the shattering of gold.

sanskrit_iast:
merupṛṣṭhe yāni yāni sauvarṇāni dvijottamāḥ |
racitāni surairyatnāttāni bhagnāni tatsutaiḥ || 35 ||
meaning:
मेरुपृष्ठे यानि यानि सौवर्णानि द्विजोत्तमाः |
रचितानि सुरैर्यत्नात्तानि भग्नानि तत्सुतैः || 35 ||
text_mt:
Whatever golden structures, O best of the twice-born, had been crafted
with effort by the gods on the peak of Meru were smashed by his sons.

sanskrit_iast:
mānasādīni devānāṃ sarāṃsi śiśavo'tha te |
āvilāni tadā cakru potradhātaiḥ samantataḥ || 36 ||
meaning:
मानसादीनि देवानां सरांसि शिशवोऽथ ते |
आविलानि तदा चक्रु पोत्रधातैः समन्ततः || 36 ||
text_mt:
Those young ones then made turbid all around the lakes of the gods,
such as Mānasa, with blows from their snouts.

sanskrit_iast:
pṛthivī vanitārūpā ramayāmāsa potriṇam |
sthāvareṇa tu rūpeṇa duḥkhamāpnoti vai dṛḍham || 37 ||
meaning:
पृथिवी वनितारूपा रमयामास पोत्रिणम् |
स्थावरेण तु रूपेण दुःखमाप्नोति वै दृढम् || 37 ||
text_mt:
The Earth in the form of a woman gave pleasure to the Boar,
but in her stationary form she experienced intense distress.

sanskrit_iast:
sāgarāśca suvṛttādyairavagāhyaṃ samantataḥ |
vikīrṇaratnaṃ potraughaiḥ sarvaṃ evākulīkṛtāḥ || 38 ||
meaning:
सागराश्च सुवृत्ताद्यैरवगाह्यं समन्ततः |
विकीर्णरत्नं पोत्रौघैः सर्वं एवाकुलीकृताः || 38 ||
text_mt:
Plunged into on all sides by Suvṛtta and the others, the oceans,
with their jewels scattered by the thrusts of snouts, were completely agitated.

sanskrit_iast:
itastataśca śiśubhiḥ krīḍadbhiḥ potribhistadā |
jaganti tatra bhagnāni nadyaḥ kalpadrumāstathā || 39 ||
meaning:
इतस्ततश्च शिशुभिः क्रीडद्भिः पोत्रिभिस्तदा |
जगन्ति तत्र भग्नानि नद्यः कल्पद्रुमास्तथा || 39 ||
text_mt:
Here and there, by those boar offspring playing at that time,
the worlds, the rivers, and the wish-fulfilling trees were broken.

sanskrit_iast:
jānannapi jagadbhartā varāhaḥ svayameva hi |
jagatpīḍāṃ sutasnehādvārayāmāsa naiva tān || 40 ||
meaning:
जानन्नपि जगद्भर्ता वराहः स्वयमेव हि |
जगत्पीडां सुतस्नेहाद्वारयामास नैव तान् || 40 ||
text_mt:
Even though he knew it himself, the Boar, the supporter of the world,
did not restrain them at all out of affection for his sons.

sanskrit_iast:
suvṛttaḥ kanako ghoro yadāgacchati vai divam |
tadā devagaṇā bhītāḥ pradravanti diśo daśa || 41 ||
meaning:
सुवृत्तः कनको घोरो यदागच्छति वै दिवम् |
तदा देवगणा भीताः प्रद्रवन्ति दिशो दश || 41 ||
text_mt:
Whenever Suvṛtta, Kanaka, and Ghora went up to heaven,
then the hosts of gods, terrified, fled in the ten directions.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ sutairbhāryayā yajñapotrī krīḍaṃstuṣṭiṃ nāpa kāñcit kadācit |
nityaṃ nityaṃ vardhate tasya kāmaḥ kāyaṃ tyaktuṃ naicchadeṣa pradiṣṭaḥ || 42 ||
meaning:
एवं सुतैर्भार्यया यज्ञपोत्री क्रीडंस्तुष्टिं नाप काञ्चित् कदाचित् |
नित्यं नित्यं वर्धते तस्य कामः कायं त्यक्तुं नैच्छदेष प्रदिष्टः || 42 ||
text_mt:
Thus, sporting with his sons and wife, the sacrificial Boar never attained any satisfaction;
day after day his desire increased, and he did not wish to cast off that body, though instructed [to do so].

sanskrit_iast:
iti śrīkālikāpurāṇe vārāhaśaṃkarasaṃvāde ūnatriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 29 ||
triṃśo'dhyāyaḥ
meaning:
इति श्रीकालिकापुराणे वाराहशंकरसंवादे ऊनत्रिंशोऽध्यायः || 29 ||
त्रिंशोऽध्यायः
text_mt:
Thus ends the twenty-ninth chapter, on the dialogue between the Boar and Śaṅkara, in the glorious Kālikāpurāṇa.
Thirtieth chapter.

sanskrit_iast: mārkaṇḍeya uvāca
meaning: मार्कण्डेय उवाच

sanskrit_iast:
tato devagaṇāḥ sarve sahitā devayonibhiḥ |
śakreṇa sahitā mantraṃ cakruḥ samyag jagaddhitam || 1 ||
meaning:
ततो देवगणाः सर्वे सहिता देवयोनिभिः |
शक्रेण सहिता मन्त्रं चक्रुः सम्यग् जगद्धितम् || 1 ||
text_mt:
Then all the hosts of gods, together with the divine beings
and accompanied by Śakra, held a consultation truly for the welfare of the world.

sanskrit_iast:
tato niścitya te sarve śakrādyā munibhiḥ saha |
śaraṇyaṃ śaraṇaṃ jagmurnārāyaṇamajaṃ vibhum || 2 ||
meaning:
ततो निश्चित्य ते सर्वे शक्राद्या मुनिभिः सह |
शरण्यं शरणं जग्मुर्नारायणमजं विभुम् || 2 ||
text_mt:
Then having resolved, all of them, Śakra and the others with the sages,
took refuge with the refuge-giver, the unborn, all-pervading Nārāyaṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
taṃ samāsādya govindaṃ vāsudevaṃ jagatpatim |
praṇamya sarve tridaśāstusṭuvurgaruḍadhvajam || 3 ||
meaning:
तं समासाद्य गोविन्दं वासुदेवं जगत्पतिम् |
प्रणम्य सर्वे त्रिदशास्तुस्टुवुर्गरुडध्वजम् || 3 ||
text_mt:
Approaching him, Govinda, Vāsudeva, the lord of the universe,
all the thirty gods bowed and praised the one whose emblem is Garuḍa.

sanskrit_iast: devā ūcuḥ
meaning: देवा ऊचुः

sanskrit_iast:
namaste deva deveśa jagatkāraṇa kāraka |
kālasvarūpin bhagavan pradhānapuruṣātmakaṃ || 4 ||
meaning:
नमस्ते देव देवेश जगत्कारण कारक |
कालस्वरूपिन् भगवन् प्रधानपुरुषात्मकं || 4 ||
text_mt:
Praise be to you, O god, lord of gods, origin of the cause of the universe,
whose form is Time, O Blessed One, consisting of pradhāna and puruṣa.

sanskrit_iast:
sthūla sūkṣma jagadvyāpin pareśa puruṣottama |
tvaṃ kartā sarvabhūtānāṃ tvaṃ pātā tvaṃ vināśakṛt || 5 ||
meaning:
स्थूल सूक्ष्म जगद्व्यापिन् परेश पुरुषोत्तम |
त्वं कर्ता सर्वभूतानां त्वं पाता त्वं विनाशकृत् || 5 ||
text_mt:
Gross and subtle, pervading the universe, supreme ruler, Puruṣottama!
You are the maker of all beings, you are the protector, you are the destroyer.

sanskrit_iast:
tvaṃ hi māyāsvarūpeṇa sanmohayasi vai jagat |
yadbhūtaṃ yacca vai bhāvyaṃ yadidānīṃ pravartate || 6 ||
meaning:
त्वं हि मायास्वरूपेण सन्मोहयसि वै जगत् |
यद्भूतं यच्च वै भाव्यं यदिदानीं प्रवर्तते || 6 ||
text_mt:
For in the form of Māyā you utterly delude the universe,
whatever has been, whatever is to be, and whatever now goes on.

sanskrit_iast:
tat sarvaṃ parameśa tvaṃ sthāvaraṃ jaṅgamaṃ tathā |
arthārthināṃ tvamarthastu kāmaḥ kāmārthināṃ tathā || 7 ||
meaning:
तत् सर्वं परमेश त्वं स्थावरं जङ्गमं तथा |
अर्थार्थिनां त्वमर्थस्तु कामः कामार्थिनां तथा || 7 ||
text_mt:
You are all that, O supreme lord: the immobile and the mobile.
You are the wealth of those seeking wealth, and desire for those seeking desire.

sanskrit_iast:
tvaṃ hi dharmārthināṃ dharmo mokṣo nirvāṇamicchatām |
tva kāmukastvaṃ mevārthī dhārmikastvaṃ sadāgatiḥ || 8 ||
meaning:
त्वं हि धर्मार्थिनां धर्मो मोक्षो निर्वाणमिच्छताम् |
त्व कामुकस्त्वं मेवार्थी धार्मिकस्त्वं सदागतिः || 8 ||
text_mt:
For you are dharma for those seeking dharma, and liberation for those wishing for nirvāṇa.
You are the lover, you are the seeker, you are the righteous, you are the ever-moving wind.

sanskrit_iast:
tvadvaktrād brāhmaṇā jātā bāhujāḥ kṣatriyāstava |
ūrvorvaiśyāstathā śūdrāḥ pādābhyāṃ tava nirgatāḥ || 9 ||
meaning:
त्वद्वक्त्राद् ब्राह्मणा जाता बाहुजाः क्षत्रियास्तव |
ऊर्वोर्वैश्यास्तथा शूद्राः पादाभ्यां तव निर्गताः || 9 ||
text_mt:
From your mouth the brāhmaṇas were born; from your arms the kṣatriyas arose;
from your thighs the vaiśyas; and the śūdras issued from your feet.

sanskrit_iast:
sūryo netrāttava vibho manojaścandramāstava |
śravaṇāt pavano jāto daśa prāṇāstathāpare || 10 ||
meaning:
सूर्यो नेत्रात्तव विभो मनोजश्चन्द्रमास्तव |
श्रवणात् पवनो जातो दश प्राणास्तथापरे || 10 ||
text_mt:
The sun came from your eye, O all-pervading one; the moon was born from your mind;
from your ear the wind was born, and likewise the other ten vital breaths.

sanskrit_iast:
ūrdhvaṃ svargādibhuvanaṃ tava śīrṣādajāyata |
tava nābhestathākāśaṃ kṣitiḥ pādatalādabhūt || 11 ||
meaning:
ऊर्ध्वं स्वर्गादिभुवनं तव शीर्षादजायत |
तव नाभेस्तथाकाशं क्षितिः पादतलादभूत् || 11 ||
text_mt:
Above, the realm of heaven and the like was born from your head;
likewise space came from your navel, and the earth came from the soles of your feet.

sanskrit_iast:
karṇābhyāṃ te diśo jātā jaṭharāt sakalaṃ jagat |
tvaṃ hi māyāsvarūpeṇa sammohayasi vai jagat || 12 ||
meaning:
कर्णाभ्यां ते दिशो जाता जठरात् सकलं जगत् |
त्वं हि मायास्वरूपेण सम्मोहयसि वै जगत् || 12 ||
text_mt:
From your ears arose the directions; from your belly the entire universe;
for in the form of Māyā you utterly delude the universe.

sanskrit_iast:
nirguṇo guṇavāṃstvaṃ hi śuddhaṃ ekaḥ parātparaḥ |
utpattisthitihīnastvaṃ tvamacyutaguṇādhikaḥ || 13 ||
meaning:
निर्गुणो गुणवांस्त्वं हि शुद्धं एकः परात्परः |
उत्पत्तिस्थितिहीनस्त्वं त्वमच्युतगुणाधिकः || 13 ||
text_mt:
You are without qualities and endowed with qualities, pure, the single one, higher than the highest;
you are free from origination and continuation, superior by your infallible qualities.

sanskrit_iast:
ādityairvasubhirdevaiḥ sādhyairyakṣairmarudgaṇaiḥ |
tvaṃ cintyase jagannātha munibhiśca mumukṣubhiḥ || 14 ||
meaning:
आदित्यैर्वसुभिर्देवैः साध्यैर्यक्षैर्मरुद्गणैः |
त्वं चिन्त्यसे जगन्नाथ मुनिभिश्च मुमुक्षुभिः || 14 ||
text_mt:
By the Ādityas, Vasus, gods, Sādhyas, Yakṣas, and the hosts of Maruts,
and by sages seeking liberation, you are meditated upon, O lord of the world.

sanskrit_iast:
tvāṃ vai cidānandamayaṃ vidanti viśeṣavijñā munayo vibhogāḥ |
tvameva saṃsāraṃ mahīruhasya bījaṃ jalaṃ sthānamatho phalaṃ ca || 15 ||
meaning:
त्वां वै चिदानन्दमयं विदन्ति विशेषविज्ञा मुनयो विभोगाः |
त्वमेव संसारं महीरुहस्य बीजं जलं स्थानमथो फलं च || 15 ||
text_mt:
Sages who have distinct knowledge, free of attachment, know you as consisting of consciousness and bliss;
you alone are the seed, the water, the soil, and the fruit of the tree of worldly existence.

sanskrit_iast: tvaṃ padmayā padmākaro vibhāsi varāsicakrābjadhanurdharastvam |
meaning: त्वं पद्मया पद्माकरो विभासि वरासिचक्राब्जधनुर्धरस्त्वम् |
text_mt: With Padmā, you shine forth as a lotus pool, bearing the excellent sword, discus, lotus, and bow;

sanskrit_iast: tvameva tārkṣe pratibhāsi nityaṃ svarṇācale toyayuto yathābhraḥ || 16 ||
meaning: त्वमेव तार्क्षे प्रतिभासि नित्यं स्वर्णाचले तोययुतो यथाभ्रः || 16 ||
text_mt: upon Garuḍa you always appear like a raincloud on the golden mountain.

sanskrit_iast:
tvameva pītāmbaraśaṃkarābjajāstvaṃ sarvametanna ca kiṃcidanyat |
na te guṇā naḥ paricintanīyā vidherharasyāpi diśāṃ patīnām |
bhītena bhaktyā śaraṇaṃ prapannā gatā vayaṃ naḥ parirakṣa viṣṇoḥ || 17 ||
meaning:
त्वमेव पीताम्बरशंकराब्जजास्त्वं सर्वमेतन्न च किंचिदन्यत् |
न ते गुणा नः परिचिन्तनीया विधेर्हरस्यापि दिशां पतीनाम् |
भीतेन भक्त्या शरणं प्रपन्ना गता वयं नः परिरक्ष विष्णोः || 17 ||
text_mt:
You alone are the yellow-robed one, Śaṃkara, and the lotus-born [Brahmā]; you are all this, and nothing else exists.
Your qualities are not to be comprehended by us, nor by Brahmā, nor by Hara, nor by the lords of the directions.
Frightened, we have approached and taken refuge with devotion; protect us, O Viṣṇu!

sanskrit_iast: mārkaṇḍeya uvāca
meaning: मार्कण्डेय उवाच

sanskrit_iast:
iti stuto devadevo bhūtabhāvanabhāvanaḥ |
sendrairdevagaṇairūce tān sarvānmeghanisvanaḥ || 18 ||
meaning:
इति स्तुतो देवदेवो भूतभावनभावनः |
सेन्द्रैर्देवगणैरूचे तान् सर्वान्मेघनिस्वनः || 18 ||
text_mt:
Thus praised, the god of gods, who brings about the welfare of creatures,
spoke to all of them with a voice like a cloud, together with Indra and the divine hosts:

sanskrit_iast: śrībhagavānuvāca
meaning: श्रीभगवानुवाच

sanskrit_iast:
yadarthamāgatā yūyaṃ yadvā bhayamupasthitam |
tatra yadvā mayā kāryaṃ tad devāstūrṇamucyatām || 19 ||
meaning:
यदर्थमागता यूयं यद्वा भयमुपस्थितम् |
तत्र यद्वा मया कार्यं तद् देवास्तूर्णमुच्यताम् || 19 ||
text_mt:
For what reason you have come, or what danger has arisen,
and what must be done by me in that regard, let that quickly be told, O gods.

sanskrit_iast: devā ūcuḥ
meaning: देवा ऊचुः

sanskrit_iast:
śīryate vasudhā nityaṃ krīḍayā yajñapotriṇaḥ |
lokāśca sarve saṃkṣubdhā nāpnuvantyupasāntvanam || 20 ||
meaning:
शीर्यते वसुधा नित्यं क्रीडया यज्ञपोत्रिणः |
लोकाश्च सर्वे संक्षुब्धा नाप्नुवन्त्युपसान्त्वनम् || 20 ||
text_mt:
The earth is continually shattered by the sport of the sacrificial boar,
and all the worlds are agitated and find no solace.

sanskrit_iast:
śuṣka tumbīphala ghātairyathā jarjaratā gatam |
varāhakṣuraghātena tathā jarjaritā kṣitiḥ || 21 ||
meaning:
शुष्क तुम्बीफल घातैर्यथा जर्जरता गतम् |
वराहक्षुरघातेन तथा जर्जरिता क्षितिः || 21 ||
text_mt:
Just as a dry gourd becomes shattered by blows,
so the earth has been shattered by the blows of the boar's hooves.

sanskrit_iast:
tasya ye vā trayaṃ putrā kālāgnisamatejasaḥ |
suvṛttaḥ kanako ghorastaiścāpyāghātitaṃ jagat || 22 ||
meaning:
तस्य ये वा त्रयं पुत्रा कालाग्निसमतेजसः |
सुवृत्तः कनको घोरस्तैश्चाप्याघातितं जगत् || 22 ||
text_mt:
And his three sons, whose splendour equals the fire of dissolution—
Suvṛtta, Kanaka, and Ghora—by them also the world is battered.

sanskrit_iast:
teṣā kardamalīlābhiḥ sarāṃsi jagatāṃ pate |
mānasādīni bhagnāni prakṛti yānti nādhunā || 23 ||
meaning:
तेषा कर्दमलीलाभिः सरांसि जगतां पते |
मानसादीनि भग्नानि प्रकृति यान्ति नाधुना || 23 ||
text_mt:
By their play in the mud, O lord of the worlds, the lakes,
Mānasa and the others, have been ruined and do not now return to their natural state.

sanskrit_iast:
bhagnāstairdevataravo mandārādyā mahābalaiḥ |
deva nādyāpi rohanti phalaṃ puṣpaṃ dalaṃ ca vā || 24 ||
meaning:
भग्नास्तैर्देवतरवो मन्दाराद्या महाबलैः |
देव नाद्यापि रोहन्ति फलं पुष्पं दलं च वा || 24 ||
text_mt:
The trees of the gods, the mandāras and others, have been broken by those mighty ones;
even now, O god, they do not grow fruit, flower, or leaf.

sanskrit_iast:
yadā trikūṭamāruhya te suvṛttādayastrayaḥ |
plutaṃ kṛtvā mahābāho patanti lavaṇārṇave |
tadā tat kṣubdhatoyaughaiḥ plāvyate sakalā mahī || 25 ||
meaning:
यदा त्रिकूटमारुह्य ते सुवृत्तादयस्त्रयः |
प्लुतं कृत्वा महाबाहो पतन्ति लवणार्णवे |
तदा तत् क्षुब्धतोयौघैः प्लाव्यते सकला मही || 25 ||
text_mt:
When having ascended Trikūṭa, those three, Suvṛtta and the others,
make a leap and plunge into the salt ocean, O mighty-armed one,
then the entire earth is flooded by the agitated masses of water.

sanskrit_iast:
utplavanti janāḥ sarve prayānti ca diśo daśa |
jīvitaṃ rakṣamāṇāste prayānti ca diśo daśa || 26 ||
meaning:
उत्प्लवन्ति जनाः सर्वे प्रयान्ति च दिशो दश |
जीवितं रक्षमाणास्ते प्रयान्ति च दिशो दश || 26 ||
text_mt:
All people leap up and flee to the ten directions;
protecting their lives, they flee to the ten directions.

sanskrit_iast:
yadā triviṣṭapaṃ yānti yajñavārāhaputrakāḥ |
itastatastadā bhagnā devāḥ śāntiṃ na lebhire || 27 ||
meaning:
यदा त्रिविष्टपं यान्ति यज्ञवाराहपुत्रकाः |
इतस्ततस्तदा भग्ना देवाः शान्तिं न लेभिरे || 27 ||
text_mt:
When the sons of the sacrificial boar go to heaven,
then the gods, routed here and there, found no peace.

sanskrit_iast:
sarve taiḥ parvatāḥ putrairvarāhasya jagatpate |
krīḍadbhiḥ śikhare nītārbhūribhāgamadhogatim || 28 ||
meaning:
सर्वे तैः पर्वताः पुत्रैर्वराहस्य जगत्पते |
क्रीडद्भिः शिखरे नीतार्भूरिभागमधोगतिम् || 28 ||
text_mt:
All the mountains, O lord of the world, by those sons
of the boar playing upon their peaks, have had a great part driven downward.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ vikrīḍatāṃ teṣāṃ krīḍābhiḥ sakalaṃ jagat |
nāśamāyāti vaikuṇṭha tasmādrakṣa jagatprabho || 29 ||
meaning:
एवं विक्रीडतां तेषां क्रीडाभिः सकलं जगत् |
नाशमायाति वैकुण्ठ तस्माद्रक्ष जगत्प्रभो || 29 ||
text_mt:
Thus as they sport, by their sports the entire world
is going to ruin, O Vaikuṇṭha; therefore protect [us], O sovereign of the universe.

sanskrit_iast: mārkaṇḍeya uvāca
meaning: मार्कण्डेय उवाच

sanskrit_iast:
iti teṣāṃ nigadatāṃ śrutvā vākyaṃ janārdanaḥ |
uvāca śaṃkaraṃ devaṃ brahmāṇaṃ ca viśeṣataḥ || 30 ||
meaning:
इति तेषां निगदतां श्रुत्वा वाक्यं जनार्दनः |
उवाच शंकरं देवं ब्रह्माणं च विशेषतः || 30 ||
text_mt:
Hearing this speech of theirs as they spoke, Janārdana
spoke to the god Śaṃkara, and especially to Brahmā:

sanskrit_iast: śrībhagavānuvāca
meaning: श्रीभगवानुवाच

sanskrit_iast:
yatkṛte devatāḥ sarvāḥ prajāśca sakalā imāḥ |
