pratyuvāca ahātmānaṃ kapilaṃ saṃśitavratam || 15 ||
meaning:
इत्येवमुक्तः स मनुः कपिलेन महात्मना |
प्रत्युवाच अहात्मानं कपिलं संशितव्रतम् || 15 ||
text_mt: Being thus addressed by the high-souled Kapila, / that Manu replied to the high-souled Kapila of strict vows:

sanskrit_iast: manuruvāca
meaning: मनुरुवाच

sanskrit_iast:
yadi tvayākhilajagaddhitārthaṃ jñānadīpikām |
cikīrṣūṇā yataḥ kāryaṃ kiṃ sthānārthanayā tava || 16 ||
meaning:
यदि त्वयाखिलजगद्धितार्थं ज्ञानदीपिकाम् |
चिकीर्षूणा यतः कार्यं किं स्थानार्थनया तव || 16 ||
text_mt: If you wish to make the lamp of knowledge for the welfare of the entire world, / what need have you of requesting a place, since the work is to be done?

sanskrit_iast:
hiraṇyagarbhaḥ sumahat tapastepe purādbhutam |
sa me yayāce tapase sthānaṃ kasmai na ca dvija || 17 ||
meaning:
हिरण्यगर्भः सुमहत् तपस्तेपे पुराद्भुतम् |
स मे ययाचे तपसे स्थानं कस्मै न च द्विज || 17 ||
text_mt: Anciently, Hiraṇyagarbha performed very great, wondrous austerity; / did he ask anyone for a place for his austerity, O twice-born one?

sanskrit_iast:
śambhuḥ sambhogarahito devamānena vatsarān |
āyutāni tapastepe so'pi sthānaṃ na caikṣata || 18 ||
meaning:
शम्भुः सम्भोगरहितो देवमानेन वत्सरान् |
आयुतानि तपस्तेपे सोऽपि स्थानं न चैक्षत || 18 ||
text_mt: Śambhu, devoid of sensual enjoyment, performed austerity / for tens of thousands of years by the measure of the gods, and yet he did not seek a place.

sanskrit_iast:
devendro vītihotraśca śamano rakṣasāṃ patiḥ |
yādaḥpatirmātariśvā dhanādhyakṣatathaiva ca || 19 ||
meaning:
देवेन्द्रो वीतिहोत्रश्च शमनो रक्षसां पतिः |
यादःपतिर्मातरिश्वा धनाध्यक्षतथैव च || 19 ||
text_mt: The lord of gods, the Fire-god, Yama, the lord of rākṣasas, / the lord of aquatic creatures, the Wind-god, and likewise the lord of wealth—

sanskrit_iast:
ete tepustapastīvraṃ dikpālatvamabhīpsavaḥ |
sthānaṃ na mārgayāmāsuḥ kiñcanāpi mahāmune || 20 ||
meaning:
एते तेपुस्तपस्तीव्रं दिक्पालत्वमभीप्सवः |
स्थानं न मार्गयामासुः किञ्चनापि महामुने || 20 ||
text_mt: these performed fierce austerity desiring to become guardians of the directions; / they did not seek any place at all, O great sage.

sanskrit_iast:
devāgārāṇi tīrthāni kṣetrāṇi saritastathā |
bahūni puṇyabhāñjyatra tiṣṭhanti kapila kṣitau || 21 ||
meaning:
देवागाराणि तीर्थानि क्षेत्राणि सरितस्तथा |
बहूनि पुण्यभाञ्ज्यत्र तिष्ठन्ति कपिल क्षितौ || 21 ||
text_mt: Temples of gods, holy bathing places, sacred fields, and rivers— / many such meritorious sites exist here on earth, O Kapila.

sanskrit_iast:
teṣāmekatamaṃ tvaṃ cedāsādya kuruṣe tapaḥ |
sthānaṃ brahmaṃstapaḥsiddhrna bhaviṣyati tatra kim || 22 ||
meaning:
तेषामेकतमं त्वं चेदासाद्य कुरुषे तपः |
स्थानं ब्रह्मंस्तपःसिद्ध्र्न भविष्यति तत्र किम् || 22 ||
text_mt: If you perform austerity after resorting to one of them, / O holy one, will your austerity not attain success in that place?

sanskrit_iast:
mattaḥ sthānārthanā tāvat kevalaṃ te vikatthanam |
ayaṃ vikatthano dharmo yujyate na tapasvinām || 23 ||
meaning:
मत्तः स्थानार्थना तावत् केवलं ते विकत्थनम् |
अयं विकत्थनो धर्मो युज्यते न तपस्विनाम् || 23 ||
text_mt: This request to me for a place is merely your boasting; / such boastful conduct is not befitting of ascetics.

sanskrit_iast: mārkaṇḍeya uvāca
meaning: मार्कण्डेय उवाच

sanskrit_iast:
etaccrutvā vacastasya manoḥ svāyambhuvasya tu |
cukopa kapilaḥ siddhaḥ provāca ca tadā manum || 24 ||
meaning:
एतच्च्रुत्वा वचस्तस्य मनोः स्वायम्भुवस्य तु |
चुकोप कपिलः सिद्धः प्रोवाच च तदा मनुम् || 24 ||
text_mt: Having heard this speech of Svāyambhuva Manu, / the perfected Kapila became angry and then spoke to Manu:

sanskrit_iast: kapila uvāca
meaning: कपिल उवाच

sanskrit_iast:
tvayi viśrambhamādhāya tapasaḥ siddhaye'cirāt |
sthānaṃ mayā prārthitaṃ te tanmāṃ kṣipasi hetubhiḥ || 25 ||
meaning:
त्वयि विश्रम्भमाधाय तपसः सिद्धयेऽचिरात् |
स्थानं मया प्रार्थितं ते तन्मां क्षिपसि हेतुभिः || 25 ||
text_mt: Placing trust in you, I requested a place from you / for the swift attainment of austerity, and yet you insult me with arguments!

sanskrit_iast:
anenātyugravacasā tavaivāhaṃ na cakṣame |
svayaṃ tribhuvanādhyakṣa iti te garva īdṛśaḥ || 26 ||
meaning:
अनेनात्युग्रवचसा तवैवाहं न चक्षमे |
स्वयं त्रिभुवनाध्यक्ष इति ते गर्व ईदृशः || 26 ||
text_mt: Because of these extremely harsh words of yours, I will not forgive you; / you have such pride, [thinking]: “I am myself the overseer of the three worlds.”

sanskrit_iast:
akṣamyaṃ te vaco me'dya prārthanāyāṃ vikatthanam |
yat tvaṃ vadasi tasya tvaṃ phalametadavāpnuhi || 27 ||
meaning:
अक्षम्यं ते वचो मेऽद्य प्रार्थनायां विकत्थनम् |
यत् त्वं वदसि तस्य त्वं फलमेतदवाप्नुहि || 27 ||
text_mt: Your boasting speech in response to my request today cannot be forgiven. / Whatever you say, obtain this fruit of it:

sanskrit_iast:
idaṃ tribhuvanaṃ sarvaṃ sadevāsuramānuṣam |
hataprahatavidhvastamacireṇa bhaviṣyati || 28 ||
meaning:
इदं त्रिभुवनं सर्वं सदेवासुरमानुषम् |
हतप्रहतविध्वस्तमचिरेण भविष्यति || 28 ||
text_mt: This entire three worlds, along with gods, asuras, and humans, / will before long be struck down, battered, and devastated.

sanskrit_iast:
yeneyamuddhṛtā pṛthvī yena vā sthāpitā punaḥ |
yo vāsyā annakartā svād yo vāsyāḥ parirakṣakaḥ || 29 ||
meaning:
येनेयमुद्धृता पृथ्वी येन वा स्थापिता पुनः |
यो वास्या अन्नकर्ता स्वाद् यो वास्याः परिरक्षकः || 29 ||
text_mt: By whom this earth was raised up, or by whom it was set down again, / or who became its provider of food, or who is its guardian—

sanskrit_iast:
ta eva sarve hiṃsantu sakalaṃ sacarācaram |
nacirāddrakṣyasi mano jalapūrṇaṃ jagattryam |
hataprahatavidhvastaṃ tava garvaviśātanam || 30 ||
meaning:
त एव सर्वे हिंसन्तु सकलं सचराचरम् |
नचिराद्द्रक्ष्यसि मनो जलपूर्णं जगत्त्र्यम् |
हतप्रहतविध्वस्तं तव गर्वविशातनम् || 30 ||
text_mt: let those very ones destroy all that moves and is still. / Before long, O Manu, you will see the three worlds filled with water, / struck down, battered, and devastated—the destruction of your pride.

sanskrit_iast:
evamuktvā munīndra'sau kapilastapasāṃ nidhiḥ |
antardadhe jagāmāpi tadā brahmasado muniḥ || 31 ||
meaning:
एवमुक्त्वा मुनीन्द्रऽसौ कपिलस्तपसां निधिः |
अन्तर्दधे जगामापि तदा ब्रह्मसदो मुनिः || 31 ||
text_mt: Having spoken thus, that lord of sages, Kapila, a treasury of austerities, / vanished, and the sage went then to the abode of Brahmā.

sanskrit_iast:
kapilasya vacaḥ śrutvā viṣaṇṇavadano manuḥ |
bhāvīti pratipadyāśu manurnovāca kiñcana || 32 ||
meaning:
कपिलस्य वचः श्रुत्वा विषण्णवदनो मनुः |
भावीति प्रतिपद्याशु मनुर्नोवाच किञ्चन || 32 ||
text_mt: Hearing the words of Kapila, Manu, his face dejected, / realized, “It will come to pass,” and said nothing at all.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ svāyambhuvo dhīmāṃstapase dhṛtamānasaḥ |
hitāya sarvajagatāṃ didṛkṣurgaruḍadhvajam || 33 ||
viśālāṃ badarīṃ yāto gaṅgādvārāntikaṃ khalu |
tatra gatvā jagaddhartā manuḥ svāyambhuvaḥ svayam |
dadarśa badarīṃ tatra puṇyāṃ pāpapraṇāśinīm || 34 ||
meaning:
ततः स्वायम्भुवो धीमांस्तपसे धृतमानसः |
हिताय सर्वजगतां दिदृक्षुर्गरुडध्वजम् || 33 ||
विशालां बदरीं यातो गङ्गाद्वारान्तिकं खलु |
तत्र गत्वा जगद्धर्ता मनुः स्वायम्भुवः स्वयम् |
ददर्श बदरीं तत्र पुण्यां पापप्रणाशिनीम् || 34 ||
text_mt: Then the wise Svāyambhuva [Manu], setting his mind on austerities / for the welfare of all worlds and wishing to see Garuḍadhvaja, / went to Viśālā Badarī, near Gaṅgādvāra. / Having gone there, Svāyambhuva Manu himself, the upholder of the world, / beheld there the holy Badarī that destroys sins,

sanskrit_iast:
sadā phalavatīṃ nityaṃ mṛduśādbalamañjarīm |
succhāyāṃ masṛṇāṃ śīrṇaśuṣkapatravivarjitām || 35 ||
meaning:
सदा फलवतीं नित्यं मृदुशाद्बलमञ्जरीम् |
सुच्छायां मसृणां शीर्णशुष्कपत्रविवर्जिताम् || 35 ||
text_mt: bearing fruit perpetually and always, with tender shoots of green turf, / possessing fine shade, smooth, and free of withered and dry leaves,

sanskrit_iast:
gaṅgātoyaudhasaṃsikta-śikhāmūlāntarākhilām |
upāsyamānāṃ satataṃ nānāmunitapodhanaiḥ || 36 ||
meaning:
गङ्गातोयौधसंसिक्त-शिखामूलान्तराखिलाम् |
उपास्यमानां सततं नानामुनितपोधनैः || 36 ||
text_mt: its entire crown, trunk, and roots drenched by the flood of the Gaṅgā’s water, / continuously attended upon by various sages rich in austerities.

sanskrit_iast:
tatsthānaṃ sarvato bhadraṃ nānābhṛṅgagaṇānvitam |
phullāravindasalilaṃ ramaṇīyaṃ vṛṣapradam || 37 ||
meaning:
तत्स्थानं सर्वतो भद्रं नानाभृङ्गगणान्वितम् |
फुल्लारविन्दसलिलं रमणीयं वृषप्रदम् || 37 ||
text_mt: That place was auspicious on all sides, filled with swarms of various bees, / with water of blooming lotuses, delightful, bestowing righteousness.

sanskrit_iast:
praviśya tapase yatnamakarollokabhāvanaḥ |
sa bhūtvā niyatāhāraḥ parameṇa samādhinā || 38 ||
meaning:
प्रविश्य तपसे यत्नमकरोल्लोकभावनः |
स भूत्वा नियताहारः परमेण समाधिना || 38 ||
text_mt: Entering it, the creator of the world exerted himself in austerities. / Having restrained his diet, through supreme contemplation

sanskrit_iast:
ārādhayāmāsa hariṃ jagatkāraṇakāraṇam |
sarveṣāṃ jagatāṃ nāthaṃ nīlameghāñjanaprabham || 39 ||
meaning:
आराधयामास हरिं जगत्कारणकारणम् |
सर्वेषां जगतां नाथं नीलमेघाञ्जनप्रभम् || 39 ||
text_mt: he worshipped Hari, the cause of the causes of the world, / the lord of all worlds, radiant like a dark cloud and collyrium,

sanskrit_iast:
śaṅkhacakragadāpadmadharaṃ kamalalocanam |
pītāmbaradharaṃ devaṃ garuḍoparisaṃsthitam || 40 ||
meaning:
शङ्खचक्रगदापद्मधरं कमललोचनम् |
पीताम्बरधरं देवं गरुडोपरिसंस्थितम् || 40 ||
text_mt: holding the conch, discus, mace, and lotus, with lotus-eyes, / the god wearing yellow garments, seated upon Garuḍa,

sanskrit_iast:
jaganmayaṃ lokanāthaṃ vyaktāvyaktasvarūpiṇam |
jagadbījaṃ sahasrākṣaṃ sahasraśirasaṃ prabhum || 41 ||
meaning:
जगन्मयं लोकनाथं व्यक्ताव्यक्तस्वरूपिणम् |
जगद्बीजं सहस्राक्षं सहस्रशिरसं प्रभुम् || 41 ||
text_mt: embodying the universe, the lord of the world, having the form of the manifest and unmanifest, / the seed of the world, thousand-eyed, the thousand-headed lord,

sanskrit_iast:
sarvavyāpinamādhāraṃ nārāyaṇamajaṃ vibhum |
japannetatparaṃ mantraṃ sarvavedamayaṃ manuḥ || 42 ||
meaning:
सर्वव्यापिनमाधारं नारायणमजं विभुम् |
जपन्नेतत्परं मन्त्रं सर्ववेदमयं मनुः || 42 ||
text_mt: all-pervading, the foundation, Nārāyaṇa, the unborn, all-powerful. / Manu recited this supreme mantra, composed of all the Vedas:

sanskrit_iast:
hiraṇyagarbhapuruṣapradhānāvyaktarūpiṇe |
oṃ namo vāsudevāya śuddhajñānasvarūpiṇe || 43 ||
meaning:
हिरण्यगर्भपुरुषप्रधानाव्यक्तरूपिणे |
ओं नमो वासुदेवाय शुद्धज्ञानस्वरूपिणे || 43 ||
text_mt: “To him who has the form of Hiraṇyagarbha, puruṣa, pradhāna, and the unmanifest, / oṃ, homage to Vāsudeva, whose form is pure consciousness.”

sanskrit_iast:
iti japyaṃ prajapato manoḥ svāyambhuvasya tu |
prasasāda jagannāthaḥ keśavo nācirādatha || 44 ||
meaning:
इति जप्यं प्रजपतो मनोः स्वायम्भुवस्य तु |
प्रससाद जगन्नाथः केशवो नाचिरादथ || 44 ||
text_mt: As Svāyambhuva Manu was thus chanting this prayer, / Keśava, the lord of the universe, became pleased before long.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ kṣudrajhaṣo bhūtvā dūrvādalasamaprabhaḥ |
karpūrakalikāyugma-tulyanetrayugojjvalaḥ || 45 ||
meaning:
ततः क्षुद्रझषो भूत्वा दूर्वादलसमप्रभः |
कर्पूरकलिकायुग्म-तुल्यनेत्रयुगोज्ज्वलः || 45 ||
text_mt: Then, having become a small fish with a luster like a blade of dūrvā grass, / radiant with a pair of eyes resembling a pair of camphor buds,

sanskrit_iast:
tapasyantaṃ mahātmānaṃ manuṃ svāyambhuvaṃ munim |
āsasāda tadā kṣudramatsyarūpī janārdanaḥ || 46 ||
meaning:
तपस्यन्तं महात्मानं मनुं स्वायम्भुवं मुनिम् |
आससाद तदा क्षुद्रमत्स्यरूपी जनार्दनः || 46 ||
text_mt: Janārdana, in the form of a small fish, then approached / the sage, the great-souled Svāyambhuva Manu, who was performing austerities.

sanskrit_iast:
uvāca taṃ mahātmānaṃ manuṃ svāyambhuvaṃ tadā |
susantrastaṃ sa kāruṇyayuktaṃ bhītisagadgadam || 47 ||
meaning:
उवाच तं महात्मानं मनुं स्वायम्भुवं तदा |
सुसन्त्रस्तं स कारुण्ययुक्तं भीतिसगद्गदम् || 47 ||
text_mt: He then spoke to that great-souled Svāyambhuva Manu, / greatly terrified, full of pathos, faltering with fear:

sanskrit_iast:
taponidhe mahābhāga bhītaṃ māṃ trātumarhasi |
nityamudvejitaṃ matsyairviśālairbhakṣituṃ prati || 48 ||
meaning:
तपोनिधे महाभाग भीतं मां त्रातुमर्हसि |
नित्यमुद्वेजितं मत्स्यैर्विशालैर्भक्षितुं प्रति || 48 ||
text_mt: “O treasury of austerities! O fortunate one! You ought to save me who am terrified, / continually frightened by large fish intending to eat [me].

sanskrit_iast:
pratyahaṃ māṃ mahābhāga mīnā dhāvanti bhakṣitum |
samantato'dhikāhantu tvaṃ nātha gopituṃ kṣamaḥ || 49 ||
meaning:
प्रत्यहं मां महाभाग मीना धावन्ति भक्षितुम् |
समन्ततोऽधिकाहन्तु त्वं नाथ गोपितुं क्षमः || 49 ||
text_mt: Every day, O fortunate one, fish rush to eat me; / they are larger all around, but you, O protector, are capable of sheltering [me].

sanskrit_iast:
adya prabhūtairvipulairdāritaḥ pṛthuromabhiḥ |
viśrānto'haṃ kṣudrataro na ca śaktaḥ palāyane || 50 ||
meaning:
अद्य प्रभूतैर्विपुलैर्दारितः पृथुरोमभिः |
विश्रान्तोऽहं क्षुद्रतरो न च शक्तः पलायने || 50 ||
text_mt: Today I have been torn by numerous, vast fish; / worn out, extremely small, I am not able to flee.

sanskrit_iast:
prāṇākāṅkṣī mahātmānaṃ bhavantaṃ śaraṇaṃ munim |
prāpto'hañcedanukrośaste'sti māṃ pratipālaya || 51 ||
meaning:
प्राणाकाङ्क्षी महात्मानं भवन्तं शरणं मुनिम् |
प्राप्तोऽहञ्चेदनुक्रोशस्तेऽस्ति मां प्रतिपालय || 51 ||
text_mt: Desiring life, I have sought refuge with you, the great-souled sage. / If you have compassion, protect me!

sanskrit_iast:
hayodbhrāntamanāścāhaṃ vṛkṣacchāyāṃ ca cañcalām |
dṛṣṭvā calataraṅgāṃśca matsyādiva vibhemyaham || 52 ||
meaning:
हयोद्भ्रान्तमनाश्चाहं वृक्षच्छायां च चञ्चलाम् |
दृष्ट्वा चलतरङ्गांश्च मत्स्यादिव विभेम्यहम् || 52 ||
text_mt: My mind is bewildered by agitation, and seeing the trembling shade of a tree / and the moving waves, I am afraid as if of a fish.”

sanskrit_iast: mārkaṇḍye uvāca
meaning: मार्कण्ड्ये उवाच

sanskrit_iast:
iti tasya vacaḥ śrutvā manuḥ svāyambhuvastataḥ |
kṛpayā parayā yuktaḥ proce'haṃ rakṣitā tava || 53 ||
meaning:
इति तस्य वचः श्रुत्वा मनुः स्वायम्भुवस्ततः |
कृपया परया युक्तः प्रोचेऽहं रक्षिता तव || 53 ||
text_mt: Hearing his speech, Svāyambhuva Manu then, / filled with supreme compassion, said: “I will protect you.”

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ karodare toyamādāyādhāya tatra tam |
samakṣaṃ kṣudramatsyasya vihāraṃ samalokayat || 54 ||
meaning:
ततः करोदरे तोयमादायाधाय तत्र तम् |
समक्षं क्षुद्रमत्स्यस्य विहारं समलोकयत् || 54 ||
text_mt: Then, taking water in the hollow of his hand and placing it there, / he watched with his own eyes the sport of the little fish.

sanskrit_iast:
tato dayāluṃ sa manustaṃ matsyaṃ cārurūpiṇam |
aliñjare toyapūrṇe nyadhādvipulabhogini || 55 ||
meaning:
ततो दयालुं स मनुस्तं मत्स्यं चारुरूपिणम् |
अलिञ्जरे तोयपूर्णे न्यधाद्विपुलभोगिनि || 55 ||
text_mt: Then that compassionate Manu placed that fish of handsome form / into a water-filled water-jar with a wide cavity.

sanskrit_iast:
sa tasmin maṇike matsyo vardhamāno dine dine |
sāmānyarohitaprāya-deho'bhūnnacirādatha || 56 ||
meaning:
स तस्मिन् मणिके मत्स्यो वर्धमानो दिने दिने |
सामान्यरोहितप्राय-देहोऽभून्नचिरादथ || 56 ||
text_mt: That fish, growing day by day in that vessel, / before long attained a body almost like an ordinary rohita fish.

sanskrit_iast:
daśaghaṭajalapūrṇaṃ pratyahaṃ sa mahātmā
maṇikamatikurvan vardhayāmāsa matsyam |
sa ca suviśadanetro matsyabālo'cireṇa
maṇikasalilamadhye lomaśaḥ pīnadehaḥ || 57 ||
meaning:
दशघटजलपूर्णं प्रत्यहं स महात्मा
मणिकमतिकुर्वन् वर्धयामास मत्स्यम् |
स च सुविशदनेत्रो मत्स्यबालोऽचिरेण
मणिकसलिलमध्ये लोमशः पीनदेहः || 57 ||
text_mt: Every day that great soul filled the vessel / with ten jars of water and nourished the fish. / And that young fish, bright-eyed, with a hairy and stout body, / soon [grew] in the water of the vessel.

sanskrit_iast:
iti śrīkālikāpuṇāṇe matsyarūpa-kathane dvātriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ ||
trayastriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ
meaning:
इति श्रीकालिकापुणाणे मत्स्यरूप-कथने द्वात्रिंशोऽध्यायः ||
त्रयस्त्रिंशोऽध्यायः
text_mt: Thus ends the thirty-second chapter in the glorious Kālikāpurāṇa, in the narration of the fish form. / Chapter thirty-three.

sanskrit_iast: mārkaṇḍeya uvāca
meaning: मार्कण्डेय उवाच

sanskrit_iast:
taṃ yathā pīvaratanuṃ dṛṣṭvā matsyaṃ manuḥ svayam |
gṛhītvā pāṇinā phullanalinīṃ sarasīṃ yayau || 1 ||
meaning:
तं यथा पीवरतनुं दृष्ट्वा मत्स्यं मनुः स्वयम् |
गृहीत्वा पाणिना फुल्लनलिनीं सरसीं ययौ || 1 ||
text_mt: Seeing that fish with such a stout body, Manu himself, / taking it with his hand, went to a lake of blooming lotuses.

sanskrit_iast:
tatsarastatra vipulaṃ puṇye nārāyaṇāśrame |
ekayojanavistīrṇaṃ sārdhayojanamāyatam || 2 ||
meaning:
तत्सरस्तत्र विपुलं पुण्ये नारायणाश्रमे |
एकयोजनविस्तीर्णं सार्धयोजनमायतम् || 2 ||
text_mt: That lake there at the sacred hermitage of Nārāyaṇa was vast, / one yojana wide and one and a half yojanas long,

sanskrit_iast:
nānāmīnagaṇopetaṃ śītāmalajalotkaram |
tadāsādya saro matsyaṃ vinidhāya manustadā || 3 ||
meaning:
नानामीनगणोपेतं शीतामलजलोत्करम् |
तदासाद्य सरो मत्स्यं विनिधाय मनुस्तदा || 3 ||
text_mt: filled with various schools of fish and a mass of cool, clear water. / Arriving at that lake then, Manu, having placed the fish [there],

sanskrit_iast:
pālayāmāsa sutavat kṛpayā parayā yutaḥ |
so'cireṇaiva kālena pīno vaisāriṇo'bhavat || 4 ||
meaning:
पालयामास सुतवत् कृपया परया युतः |
सोऽचिरेणैव कालेन पीनो वैसारिणोऽभवत् || 4 ||
text_mt: cared for it like a son, endowed with supreme compassion. / In a very short time, that swimming creature became huge.

sanskrit_iast:
na mamau tatra sarasi vṛhattvāt dvijasattamāḥ |
sa ekadā mahāmatsyaḥ pūrvāparataradvaye || 5 ||
meaning:
न ममौ तत्र सरसि वृहत्त्वात् द्विजसत्तमाः |
स एकदा महामत्स्यः पूर्वापरतरद्वये || 5 ||
text_mt: It did not fit in that lake because of its vast size, O best of the twice-born. / Once that great fish, on the eastern and western banks,

sanskrit_iast:
śiraḥ pucche nidhāyāśu tuṅgadehaḥ samucchritaḥ |
svāyabhuvaṃ mahātmānaṃ cukrośa trāhi māmiti || 6 ||
meaning:
शिरः पुच्छे निधायाशु तुङ्गदेहः समुच्छ्रितः |
स्वायभुवं महात्मानं चुक्रोश त्राहि मामिति || 6 ||
text_mt: swiftly placing its head and tail, its lofty body raised high, / cried out to the great-souled Svāyambhuva: “Save me!”

sanskrit_iast:
taṃ tathā ca manurjñātvā krośantaṃ sthūlapucchakam |
āsasāda tadā matsyaṃ jagrāha ca kareṇa tam || 7 ||
meaning:
तं तथा च मनुर्ज्ञात्वा क्रोशन्तं स्थूलपुच्छकम् |
आससाद तदा मत्स्यं जग्राह च करेण तम् || 7 ||
text_mt: Perceiving it crying out thus with its thick tail, / Manu then approached the fish and took it with his hand.

sanskrit_iast:
na śaknomyahamuddhartuṃ pṛtharomāṇamadbhutam |
iti sañcintayanneva proddadhāra kareṇa tam || 8 ||
meaning:
न शक्नोम्यहमुद्धर्तुं पृथरोमाणमद्भुतम् |
इति सञ्चिन्तयन्नेव प्रोद्दधार करेण तम् || 8 ||
text_mt: Thinking, “I am not able to lift this wondrous fish,” / even while reflecting thus, he lifted it out with his hand.

sanskrit_iast:
bhagavānapi viśvātmā matsyarūpī janārdanaḥ |
svāyambhuvakaraṃ prāpya laghimānamupāśrayat || 9 ||
meaning:
भगवानपि विश्वात्मा मत्स्यरूपी जनार्दनः |
स्वायम्भुवकरं प्राप्य लघिमानमुपाश्रयत् || 9 ||
text_mt: The Blessed One, the soul of the universe, Janārdana in the form of a fish, / upon reaching Svāyambhuva’s hand, assumed weightlessness.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ karāmyāmuddhṛtya skandhe kṛtvā drutaṃ manuḥ |
nināya sāgaraṃ tatra toye ca nidadhe tataḥ || 10 ||
meaning:
ततः कराम्यामुद्धृत्य स्कन्धे कृत्वा द्रुतं मनुः |
निनाय सागरं तत्र तोये च निदधे ततः || 10 ||
text_mt: Then, lifting it with both hands and swiftly placing it on his shoulder, Manu / carried it to the ocean and placed it there in the water.

sanskrit_iast:
yathecchamatra vardhasva na ko'pi tvāṃ vadhiṣyati |
acireṇaiva sampūrṇadehaṃ tvaṃ samavāpnuhi || 11 ||
meaning:
यथेच्छमत्र वर्धस्व न कोऽपि त्वां वधिष्यति |
अचिरेणैव सम्पूर्णदेहं त्वं समवाप्नुहि || 11 ||
text_mt: [Manu said:] “Grow here as you wish; no one will kill you. / In a very short time, attain a fully developed body!”

sanskrit_iast:
ityuktvā sa mahābhāgaḥ sarvaprāṇamṛtāṃ varaḥ |
laghutvaṃ cintayaṃstasya vismayaṃ paramaṃ gataḥ || 12 ||
meaning:
इत्युक्त्वा स महाभागः सर्वप्राणमृतां वरः |
लघुत्वं चिन्तयंस्तस्य विस्मयं परमं गतः || 12 ||
text_mt: Having spoken thus, that fortunate one, the best among all living beings, / considering its lightness, fell into supreme astonishment.

sanskrit_iast:
matsyo'pi nacirādeva pūrṇakāyastadā mahān |
sarvataḥ pūrayāmāsa dehābhogena sāgaram || 13 ||
meaning:
मत्स्योऽपि नचिरादेव पूर्णकायस्तदा महान् |
सर्वतः पूरयामास देहाभोगेन सागरम् || 13 ||
text_mt: Then the fish also, soon having attained a full body, large, / filled the ocean on all sides with the expanse of its body.

sanskrit_iast:
taṃ pūrṇakāyamālokya vyatītyāmbhaḥ samucchritam |
śilābhirnicitaṃ sphītaṃ mānasācalasaṃnibham || 14 ||
meaning:
तं पूर्णकायमालोक्य व्यतीत्याम्भः समुच्छ्रितम् |
शिलाभिर्निचितं स्फीतं मानसाचलसंनिभम् || 14 ||
text_mt: Beholding it of full body, rising high above the water, / densely covered with rocks, vast, resembling Mount Mānasa,

sanskrit_iast:
rundhantaṃ sāgaraṃ sarvaṃ dehābhogācalīkṛtam |
svāyambhuvo manurdhīmān mene matsyaṃ na taṃ tadā || 15 ||
meaning:
रुन्धन्तं सागरं सर्वं देहाभोगाचलीकृतम् |
स्वायम्भुवो मनुर्धीमान् मेने मत्स्यं न तं तदा || 15 ||
text_mt: blocking the entire ocean, made like a mountain by the expanse of its body, / the wise Svāyambhuva Manu did not then consider it [an ordinary] fish.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ papraccha taṃ sāmnā matsyaṃ svāyambhuvo manuḥ |
vicintya laghimānaṃ ca paśyan mūrti tadādbhutam || 16 ||
meaning:
ततः पप्रच्छ तं साम्ना मत्स्यं स्वायम्भुवो मनुः |
विचिन्त्य लघिमानं च पश्यन् मूर्ति तदाद्भुतम् || 16 ||
text_mt: Then Svāyambhuva Manu questioned that fish with gentle words, / reflecting upon its [former] smallness and beholding its wondrous form at that time.

sanskrit_iast: manuruvāca
meaning: मनुरुवाच

sanskrit_iast:
na tvāṃ matsyamahaṃ manye kastvaṃ me vada sattama |
mahattvaṃ laghimānaṃ te cintayan sumahattara || 17 ||
meaning:
न त्वां मत्स्यमहं मन्ये कस्त्वं मे वद सत्तम |
महत्त्वं लघिमानं ते चिन्तयन् सुमहत्तर || 17 ||
text_mt: I do not think you are a fish; tell me, who are you, O best of beings? / Reflecting upon your greatness and your smallness, O exceedingly great one,

sanskrit_iast:
tvaṃ brahmāhyathavā viṣṇuḥ śambhurvā mīnarūpadhṛk |
na cedguhyaṃ mahābhāga tanme vada mahāmate || 18 ||
meaning:
त्वं ब्रह्माह्यथवा विष्णुः शम्भुर्वा मीनरूपधृक् |
न चेद्गुह्यं महाभाग तन्मे वद महामते || 18 ||
text_mt: are you Brahmā, or Viṣṇu, or Śambhu bearing the form of a fish? / If it is not a secret, O fortunate one, tell that to me, O highly intelligent one!

sanskrit_iast: matsya uvāca
meaning: मत्स्य उवाच

sanskrit_iast:
ārādhyo'haṃ tvayā nityaṃ yo hariḥ sa sanātanaḥ |
taveṣṭakāmasiddhyarthaṃ prādurbhūtaḥ samāhitaḥ || 19 ||
meaning:
आराध्योऽहं त्वया नित्यं यो हरिः स सनातनः |
तवेष्टकामसिद्ध्यर्थं प्रादुर्भूतः समाहितः || 19 ||
text_mt: I, who am that eternal Hari, am to be worshipped by you constantly; / I have manifested, fully composed, to accomplish the desire wished for by you.

sanskrit_iast:
yat tvamicchasi bhūteśa mattastvaṃ mīnamūrtitaḥ |
tat kariṣye'dya tāṃ mūrtimimāṃ viddhi mano mama || 20 ||
meaning:
यत् त्वमिच्छसि भूतेश मत्तस्त्वं मीनमूर्तितः |
तत् करिष्येऽद्य तां मूर्तिमिमां विद्धि मनो मम || 20 ||
text_mt: Whatever you desire from me in the form of a fish, O lord of creatures, / I shall do that today; know this form to be mine, O Manu!

sanskrit_iast: mārkaṇḍeya uvāca
meaning: मार्कण्डेय उवाच

sanskrit_iast:
iti tasya vacaḥ śrutvā viṣṇoramitatejasaḥ |
jñātvā pratyakṣato viṣṇuṃ manustuṣṭāva keśavam || 21 ||
meaning:
इति तस्य वचः श्रुत्वा विष्णोरमिततेजसः |
ज्ञात्वा प्रत्यक्षतो विष्णुं मनुस्तुष्टाव केशवम् || 21 ||
text_mt: Having heard these words of Viṣṇu of immeasurable splendor, / knowing him perceptibly as Viṣṇu, Manu praised Keśava.

sanskrit_iast: manuruvāca
meaning: मनुरुवाच

sanskrit_iast:
namaste jagadavyaktaparāparapate hare |
pāvakādityaśītāṃśu netratrayadharāvyaya || 22 ||
meaning:
नमस्ते जगदव्यक्तपरापरपते हरे |
पावकादित्यशीतांशु नेत्रत्रयधराव्यय || 22 ||
text_mt: Obeisance to you, O unmanifest lord of the higher and lower in the universe, O Hari! / O imperishable one, who bear the triad of eyes consisting of fire, sun, and moon!

sanskrit_iast:
jagatkāraṇasarvajña jagaddhāma hare para |
parāparātmarūpātman pāriṇāṃ pārakāraṇa || 23 ||
meaning:
जगत्कारणसर्वज्ञ जगद्धाम हरे पर |
परापरात्मरूपात्मन् पारिणां पारकारण || 23 ||
text_mt: O omniscient cause of the universe, O abode of the universe, O supreme Hari! / O soul whose form is the nature of the higher and lower, O cause of the liberation of those crossing over!

sanskrit_iast:
ātmānamātmanā dhṛtvā dharārūpadharo hare |
vibharṣi sakalān lokānādhārātmaṃstrivikrama || 24 ||
meaning:
आत्मानमात्मना धृत्वा धरारूपधरो हरे |
विभर्षि सकलान् लोकानाधारात्मंस्त्रिविक्रम || 24 ||
text_mt: Holding yourself by yourself, bearing the form of the earth, O Hari, / you sustain all the worlds, O soul of support, O Trivikrama!

sanskrit_iast:
sarvavedamayaśreṣṭha dhāmadhāraṇakāraṇa |
suraughaparameśāna nārāyaṇa sureśvara || 25 ||
meaning:
सर्ववेदमयश्रेष्ठ धामधारणकारण |
सुरौघपरमेशान नारायण सुरेश्वर || 25 ||
text_mt: O best one, composed of all Vedas, O cause of sustaining the abode! / O supreme sovereign over the multitude of gods, O Nārāyaṇa, O lord of the gods!

sanskrit_iast:
ayonistaṃ jagadyonirapādastvaṃ sadāgatiḥ |
tvaṃ tejaḥ sparśahīnaśca sarveśastvamanīśvara || 26 ||
meaning:
अयोनिस्तं जगद्योनिरपादस्त्वं सदागतिः |
त्वं तेजः स्पर्शहीनश्च सर्वेशस्त्वमनीश्वर || 26 ||
text_mt: You are without origin, the origin of the universe; you are without feet, yet moving constantly; / you are radiance, yet devoid of touch; you are the lord of all, yet without a lord!

sanskrit_iast:
tvamanādiḥ samastādistaṃ nityānantaro'ntaraḥ |
yaddhaimamaṇḍaṃ jagatāṃ bījaṃ brahmāṇḍasaṃjñitam || 27 ||
meaning:
त्वमनादिः समस्तादिस्तं नित्यानन्तरोऽन्तरः |
यद्धैममण्डं जगतां बीजं ब्रह्माण्डसंज्ञितम् || 27 ||
text_mt: You are without beginning, the beginning of all; you are internal, eternally without interior; / that golden egg, the seed of the worlds, named the Brahmāṇḍa,

sanskrit_iast:
tadbījaṃ bhavatastejastvayoktaṃ salileṣu ca |
sarvādhāro nirādhāro nirhetuḥ sarvakāraṇam || 28 ||
meaning:
तद्बीजं भवतस्तेजस्त्वयोक्तं सलिलेषु च |
सर्वाधारो निराधारो निर्हेतुः सर्वकारणम् || 28 ||
text_mt: that seed was your splendor deposited in the waters by you; / the support of all, supportless, causeless, the cause of all!

sanskrit_iast:
nami namaste viśveśa lokānāṃ prabhava prabho |
sṛṣṭisthityantahetustvaṃ vidhiviṣṇuharātmadhṛk || 29 ||
meaning:
नमि नमस्ते विश्वेश लोकानां प्रभव प्रभो |
सृष्टिस्थित्यन्तहेतुस्त्वं विधिविष्णुहरात्मधृक् || 29 ||
text_mt: Obeisance, obeisance to you, O lord of the universe, O source of the worlds, O master! / You are the cause of creation, preservation, and dissolution, assuming the self of Vidhi, Viṣṇu, and Hara!

sanskrit_iast:
yasya te daśadhā mūrtirūrmiṣaṭkādivarjitā |
jyotiḥ patistvamambhodhistasmai tubhyaṃ namo namaḥ || 30 ||
meaning:
यस्य ते दशधा मूर्तिरूर्मिषट्कादिवर्जिता |
ज्योतिः पतिस्त्वमम्भोधिस्तस्मै तुभ्यं नमो नमः || 30 ||
text_mt: Whose ten-fold form is free from the six-fold waves and the like; / you are the lord of luminaries, you are the ocean; to that you, obeisance, obeisance!

sanskrit_iast:
kaste bhāvaṃ vaktumīśaḥ pareśa
sthūlātsthūlo yo'nurūporthavargāt |
tasmai nityaṃ me namo'stvadya yo'bhū-
dādityavarṇaṃ tamasaḥ parastāt || 31 ||
meaning:
कस्ते भावं वक्तुमीशः परेश
स्थूलात्स्थूलो योऽनुरूपोर्थवर्गात् |
तस्मै नित्यं मे नमोऽस्त्वद्य योऽभू-
दादित्यवर्णं तमसः परस्तात् || 31 ||
text_mt: Who is capable of expressing your true nature, O supreme sovereign, / who are grosser than the grossest, atom-formed beyond the category of objects? / To him let my perpetual obeisance be today, who existed / of sun-like color beyond the darkness!

sanskrit_iast:
sahasraśīrṣā puruṣaḥ sahasrapāt
sahasracakṣuḥ pṛthivīṃ samantataḥ |
daśāṅgulaṃ yo hi samatyatiṣṭhat
sa me prasīdatviha viṣṇurugraḥ || 32 ||
meaning:
सहस्रशीर्षा पुरुषः सहस्रपात्
सहस्रचक्षुः पृथिवीं समन्ततः |
दशाङ्गुलं यो हि समत्यतिष्ठत्
स मे प्रसीदत्विह विष्णुरुग्रः || 32 ||
text_mt: The Puruṣa with a thousand heads, a thousand feet, / and a thousand eyes, who stood encompassing the earth on all sides / and exceeding it by ten fingers— / may that fierce Viṣṇu be pleased with me here!

sanskrit_iast:
namaste mīnamūrte he namaste bhagavan hare |
namaste jagadānanda namaste bhaktavatsala || 33 ||
meaning:
नमस्ते मीनमूर्ते हे नमस्ते भगवन् हरे |
नमस्ते जगदानन्द नमस्ते भक्तवत्सल || 33 ||
text_mt: Obeisance to you, O one in the form of a fish! Obeisance to you, O blessed Hari! / Obeisance to you, O joy of the universe! Obeisance to you, O lover of devotees!

sanskrit_iast: mārkaṇḍeya uvāca
meaning: मार्कण्डेय उवाच

sanskrit_iast:
svāyambhuvena manunā saṃstuto matsyarūpadhṛk |
vāsudevastadā prāha meghagambhīraniḥsvanaḥ || 34 ||
meaning:
स्वायम्भुवेन मनुना संस्तुतो मत्स्यरूपधृक् |
वासुदेवस्तदा प्राह मेघगम्भीरनिःस्वनः || 34 ||
text_mt: Praised by Svāyambhuva Manu, Vāsudeva, / bearing the form of a fish, then spoke with a voice deep as a thundercloud:

sanskrit_iast: śrībhagavānuvāca
meaning: श्रीभगवानुवाच

sanskrit_iast:
tuṣṭo'smi tapasā te'dya bhaktyaḥ cāpi stuto muhuḥ |
saparyayā ca dānena varaṃ varaya suvrata || 35 ||
meaning:
तुष्टोऽस्मि तपसा तेऽद्य भक्त्यः चापि स्तुतो मुहुः |
सपर्यया च दानेन वरं वरय सुव्रत || 35 ||
text_mt: I am pleased today with your austerity, and being praised again and again with devotion, / and with your worship and your gift; choose a boon, O one of good vows!

sanskrit_iast:
iṣṭārthaṃ sampradāsyāmi tubhyaṃ nātra vicāraṇā |
varayasvepsitān kāmān lokānāṃ vā hitaṃ ca yat || 36 ||
meaning:
इष्टार्थं सम्प्रदास्यामि तुभ्यं नात्र विचारणा |
वरयस्वेप्सितान् कामान् लोकानां वा हितं च यत् || 36 ||
text_mt: I will grant you your desired object, there is no doubt about this; / choose your desired wishes, or whatever is beneficial for the worlds!

sanskrit_iast: manuruvāca
meaning: मनुरुवाच

sanskrit_iast:
yadi deyo varome'dya lokānāṃ yo hito bhavet |
tanme dehi varaṃ viṣṇo taṃ vakṣyāmi śṛṇuṣva me || 37 ||
meaning:
यदि देयो वरोमेऽद्य लोकानां यो हितो भवेत् |
तन्मे देहि वरं विष्णो तं वक्ष्यामि शृणुष्व मे || 37 ||
text_mt: If a boon is to be given to me today that would be beneficial for the worlds, / then give that boon to me, O Viṣṇu; I shall state it, listen to me!

sanskrit_iast:
śaśāpa kapilaḥ pūrvaṃ madarthe bhuvanatrayam |
hataprahatavidhvaṃstaṃ sakalaṃ te bhavediti || 38 ||
meaning:
शशाप कपिलः पूर्वं मदर्थे भुवनत्रयम् |
हतप्रहतविध्वंस्तं सकलं ते भवेदिति || 38 ||
text_mt: Formerly Kapila cursed the three worlds on my account, saying: / 'All yours shall become struck, beaten down, and destroyed!'

sanskrit_iast:
yeneyamuddhṛtā pṛthvī yeneyaṃ pratipālitā |
saṃhariṣyati yastvenāṃ te'dhunā plāvayantvimām || 39 ||
meaning:
येनेयमुद्धृता पृथ्वी येनेयं प्रतिपालिता |
संहरिष्यति यस्त्वेनां तेऽधुना प्लावयन्त्विमाम् || 39 ||
text_mt: By whom this earth was raised up, by whom it was protected, / he who will destroy it—may they now flood it!

sanskrit_iast:
tato'haṃ dīnahṛdaya stvāmeva śaraṇaṃ gataḥ |
na yathedaṃ tribhuvanaṃ bhaviṣyati jalaplutam |
hataprahatavidhvaste tathā tvaṃ dehi me varam || 40 ||
meaning:
ततोऽहं दीनहृदय स्त्वामेव शरणं गतः |
न यथेदं त्रिभुवनं भविष्यति जलप्लुतम् |
हतप्रहतविध्वस्ते तथा त्वं देहि मे वरम् || 40 ||
text_mt: Then, with a wretched heart, I have gone to you alone for refuge; / so that this threefold world will not become inundated with water / when struck, beaten down, and destroyed, grant me a boon in that manner!

sanskrit_iast: śrī bhagavānuvāca
meaning: श्री भगवानुवाच

sanskrit_iast:
na mattaḥ kapilo bhinnastathā na kapilādaham |
yaduktaṃ tena muninā mayoktaṃ viddhi tanmano || 41 ||
meaning:
न मत्तः कपिलो भिन्नस्तथा न कपिलादहम् |
यदुक्तं तेन मुनिना मयोक्तं विद्धि तन्मनो || 41 ||
text_mt: Kapila is not different from me, nor am I different from Kapila; / whatever was spoken by that sage, know that to have been spoken by me, O Manu!

sanskrit_iast:
tasmād yaduditaṃ tena tatsatyaṃ nānyathā bhavet |
kariṣye tatra sāhāyyaṃ svāyambhuva nibodha tat || 42 ||
meaning:
तस्माद् यदुदितं तेन तत्सत्यं नान्यथा भवेत् |
करिष्ये तत्र साहाय्यं स्वायम्भुव निबोध तत् || 42 ||
text_mt: Therefore, what was uttered by him is the truth and cannot be otherwise; / I shall provide assistance in that matter, O Svāyambhuva, understand that!

sanskrit_iast:
hataprahatavidhvaste toyamagne jagattraye |
a cirādeva tatroyaṃ bhīṣāryayāmi vai mano |
syāmalenātha śṛṅgeṇa tvaṃ māṃ jñāsyasi vai tadā || 43 ||
meaning:
हतप्रहतविध्वस्ते तोयमग्ने जगत्त्रये |
अ चिरादेव तत्रोयं भीषार्ययामि वै मनो |
स्यामलेनाथ शृङ्गेण त्वं मां ज्ञास्यसि वै तदा || 43 ||
text_mt: When the three worlds are struck, beaten down, destroyed, and submerged in water, / before long, O Manu, I shall indeed appear there in the water; / and you will recognize me then by my dark horn.

sanskrit_iast:
yāvajjalaplavastāvadyathā kāryaṃ tvayā mano |
tanme nigadataḥ pathyaṃ śṛṇuṣvāvahito'dhunā || 44 ||
meaning:
यावज्जलप्लवस्तावद्यथा कार्यं त्वया मनो |
तन्मे निगदतः पथ्यं शृणुष्वावहितोऽधुना || 44 ||
text_mt: As long as the flood of water lasts, what must be done by you, O Manu, / listen attentively now as I proclaim that beneficial course:

sanskrit_iast:
sarvayajñiyakāṣṭhaughairekā naukā vidhīyatām |
tāmahaṃ dṛḍhayiṣyāmi yathā no bhidyate jalaiḥ || 45 ||
meaning:
सर्वयज्ञियकाष्ठौघैरेका नौका विधीयताम् |
तामहं दृढयिष्यामि यथा नो भिद्यते जलैः || 45 ||
text_mt: Let a boat be constructed out of all kinds of sacrificial timbers; / I will make it sturdy so that it is not broken by the waters.

sanskrit_iast:
daśayojanavistīrṇāṃ triṃśadyojanamāyatām |
dhāriṇīṃ sarvabījānāṃ bhuvanatrayavardhinīm || 46 ||
meaning:
दशयोजनविस्तीर्णां त्रिंशद्योजनमायताम् |
धारिणीं सर्वबीजानां भुवनत्रयवर्धिनीम् || 46 ||
text_mt: Ten yojanas wide, thirty yojanas long, / holding all seeds, preserving the three worlds.

sanskrit_iast:
sarvayajñiyavṛkṣāṇāṃ bhūrivalvalatantubhiḥ |
navayojanadīrghāṃ tu vyāmatrayasuvistṛtām || 47 ||
meaning:
सर्वयज्ञियवृक्षाणां भूरिवल्वलतन्तुभिः |
नवयोजनदीर्घां तु व्यामत्रयसुविस्तृताम् || 47 ||
text_mt: With abundant cords of bark from all sacrificial trees, / nine yojanas long and three fathoms wide,

sanskrit_iast:
kuruṣva tvaṃ mano tūrṇaṃ bṛhatīmīrikā vaṭīm |
jagaddhātrī jaganmāyā lokamātā jaganmayī |
dṛḍhayiṣyati tāṃ rajjuṃ na trutyati yathātathā || 48 ||
meaning:
कुरुष्व त्वं मनो तूर्णं बृहतीमीरिका वटीम् |
जगद्धात्री जगन्माया लोकमाता जगन्मयी |
दृढयिष्यति तां रज्जुं न त्रुत्यति यथातथा || 48 ||
text_mt: make quickly, O Manu, a thick, strong rope; / the supporter of the world, Jaganmāyā, the mother of the world, who consists of the universe, / will make that rope strong so that it does not snap.

sanskrit_iast:
sarvāṇi vījānyādāya savedān sapta vai ṛṣīn |
tasyāṃ nāvi niṣaṇṇastvaṃ vartamāne jalaplave || 49 ||
meaning:
सर्वाणि वीजान्यादाय सवेदान् सप्त वै ऋषीन् |
तस्यां नावि निषण्णस्त्वं वर्तमाने जलप्लवे || 49 ||
text_mt: Taking all seeds, along with the Vedas and the seven sages, / seated in that boat when the flood of water occurs,

sanskrit_iast:
dakṣeṇa saha saṅgamya smariṣyasi mano mama |
smṛto'haṃ tūrṇamāyāsye bhavato nikaṭaṃ prati |
śyāmalenātha śṛṅgeṇa tvaṃ māṃ jñāsyasi vai tadā || 50 ||
meaning:
दक्षेण सह सङ्गम्य स्मरिष्यसि मनो मम |
स्मृतोऽहं तूर्णमायास्ये भवतो निकटं प्रति |
श्यामलेनाथ शृङ्गेण त्वं मां ज्ञास्यसि वै तदा || 50 ||
text_mt: having joined together with Dakṣa, you shall remember me, O Manu; / remembered, I will come quickly near to you; / and you will recognize me then by my dark horn.

sanskrit_iast:
yāvat prahatavidhvasta-hataṃ syādbhuvanatrayam |
tāvat pṛṣṭhena tāṃ nāvaṃ voḍhāhaṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ || 51 ||
meaning:
यावत् प्रहतविध्वस्त-हतं स्याद्भुवनत्रयम् |
तावत् पृष्ठेन तां नावं वोढाहं नात्र संशयः || 51 ||
text_mt: As long as the three worlds remain beaten down, destroyed, and struck, / for so long I will carry that boat upon my back, there is no doubt of this.

sanskrit_iast:
jahaplute tu sampūrṇe śṛṅge mama ca tāṃ tarīm |
tvaṃ tadā vaṭīrikayā sandhāniṣyasi vai dṛḍham || 52 ||
meaning:
जहप्लुते तु सम्पूर्णे शृङ्गे मम च तां तरीम् |
त्वं तदा वटीरिकया सन्धानिष्यसि वै दृढम् || 52 ||
text_mt: When the deluge of water is complete, to my horn that boat / you shall then bind firmly with that rope.

sanskrit_iast:
vaddhāyāṃ nāvi me śṛṅge devamānena vatsarān |
sahasraṃ prerayiṣyāmi tāṃ nāvaṃ śoṣayan jalam || 53 ||
meaning:
वद्धायां नावि मे शृङ्गे देवमानेन वत्सरान् |
सहस्रं प्रेरयिष्यामि तां नावं शोषयन् जलम् || 53 ||
text_mt:
When the ship is bound to my horn, for a thousand years
by the measure of the gods, I shall drive that ship, drying up the water.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ śuṣkeṣu toyeṣu protuṅge śikhare gireḥ |
himācalasya baddhvāhaṃ tasminnāvamahaṃ mano || 54 ||
meaning:
ततः शुष्केषु तोयेषु प्रोतुङ्गे शिखरे गिरेः |
हिमाचलस्य बद्ध्वाहं तस्मिन्नावमहं मनो || 54 ||
text_mt:
Then, when the waters have dried up, upon the lofty peak
of the Himācala mountain, I [shall] tie the ship, O Manu.

sanskrit_iast:
ahamārādhito yena japyena bhavatā mano |
sarvasiddhirbhavettasya yastoṣayati tena mām || 55 ||
meaning:
अहमाराधितो येन जप्येन भवता मनो |
सर्वसिद्धिर्भवेत्तस्य यस्तोषयति तेन माम् || 55 ||
text_mt:
I was propitiated by the mantra recited by you, O Manu;
all success shall belong to him who pleases me with that [same mantra].

sanskrit_iast: mārkaṇḍeya uvāca
meaning: मार्कण्डेय उवाच

sanskrit_iast:
iti dattvā varaṃ tasmai matsyastena namaskṛtaḥ |
antardadhe jagannātho lokānugrahakārakaḥ || 56 ||
meaning:
इति दत्त्वा वरं तस्मै मत्स्यस्तेन नमस्कृतः |
अन्तर्दधे जगन्नाथो लोकानुग्रहकारकः || 56 ||
text_mt:
Having thus granted him the boon, bowed to by him,
the Fish, the Lord of the Universe, who bestows grace upon the worlds, vanished.

sanskrit_iast:
svāyambhuvo'pi bhagavānantardhānaṃ gate harau |
yathoktaṃ hariṇā pūrvaṃ nāvaṃ rajjuṃ tathākarot || 57 ||
meaning:
स्वायम्भुवोऽपि भगवानन्तर्धानं गते हरौ |
यथोक्तं हरिणा पूर्वं नावं रज्जुं तथाकरोत् || 57 ||
text_mt:
When Hari had vanished, the divine Svāyambhuva [Manu] also
fashioned the ship and the rope just as Hari had previously spoken.

sanskrit_iast:
sarvayajñiyavṛkṣaughāñchitvā svāyambhuvastadā |
uddhṛtya kārayāmāsa vāsyādibhirasau tarim || 58 ||
meaning:
सर्वयज्ञियवृक्षौघाञ्छित्वा स्वायम्भुवस्तदा |
उद्धृत्य कारयामास वास्यादिभिरसौ तरिम् || 58 ||
text_mt:
Having cut down all kinds of trees suitable for sacrifice,
Svāyambhuva then raised them up and had a vessel made with adzes and other tools.

sanskrit_iast:
teṣāṃ alkasamudbhūtasūtrasaṅgharvaṭīrikām |
pūrvoktena pramāṇena kārayāmāsa vai manuḥ || 59 ||
meaning:
तेषां अल्कसमुद्भूतसूत्रसङ्घर्वटीरिकाम् |
पूर्वोक्तेन प्रमाणेन कारयामास वै मनुः || 59 ||
text_mt:
Manu had a thick rope made from a gathering of fibers
arising from the bark of those [trees], according to the measure spoken before.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ kālena mahatā vṛttaṃ yuddhaṃ mahādbhutam |
viṣṇoryajñavarāhasya śarabhasya harasya ca || 60 ||
meaning:
ततः कालेन महता वृत्तं युद्धं महाद्भुतम् |
विष्णोर्यज्ञवराहस्य शरभस्य हरस्य च || 60 ||
text_mt:
Then, after a great time, there occurred the exceedingly wondrous battle
between Viṣṇu, who was the sacrificial boar, and Hara, who was the Śarabha.

sanskrit_iast:
tato jalaplave jāte vidhvaste bhuvanatraye |
tathā rajjvā tariṃ badhvā vījānyādāya sarvaśaḥ || 61 ||
meaning:
ततो जलप्लवे जाते विध्वस्ते भुवनत्रये |
तथा रज्ज्वा तरिं बध्वा वीजान्यादाय सर्वशः || 61 ||
text_mt:
Then, when the inundation of water arose and the three worlds were destroyed,
having bound the vessel with the rope, and taking seeds of every kind,

sanskrit_iast:
vedānṛṣīṃstadā saptadaśancādāya vai manuḥ |
tasyāṃ nāvi samādhāya toyamagre carācare || 62 ||
meaning:
वेदानृषींस्तदा सप्तदशन्चादाय वै मनुः |
तस्यां नावि समाधाय तोयमग्रे चराचरे || 62 ||
text_mt:
and taking the Vedas and the seventeen sages,
Manu placed [them] in that ship, when the water was everywhere before the moving and unmoving [creation].

sanskrit_iast:
svāyambhuvastadā matsyaṃ hariṃ sasmāra naugataḥ |
tato jalānāmupari saśṛṅga iva parvataḥ || 63 ||
meaning:
स्वायम्भुवस्तदा मत्स्यं हरिं सस्मार नौगतः |
ततो जलानामुपरि सशृङ्ग इव पर्वतः || 63 ||
text_mt:
Then Svāyambhuva, seated in the ship, remembered Hari as the Fish;
then, above the waters, like a mountain endowed with a horn,

sanskrit_iast:
ditaścaikaśṛṅgeṇa viṣṇurmatsyasvarūpadhṛk |
āgatastatra nacirādyatrāste tariṇā manuḥ || 64 ||
meaning:
दितश्चैकशृङ्गेण विष्णुर्मत्स्यस्वरूपधृक् |
आगतस्तत्र नचिराद्यत्रास्ते तरिणा मनुः || 64 ||
text_mt:
shining with a single horn, Viṣṇu, bearing the form of a fish,
came there without delay, where Manu remained in the vessel.

sanskrit_iast:
tarimāruhya vipule toyarāśau bhayaṅkare |
yāvaccalācalaṃ toyaṃ tāvat pṛṣṭhe tariṃ nyadhāt || 65 ||
meaning:
तरिमारुह्य विपुले तोयराशौ भयङ्करे |
यावच्चलाचलं तोयं तावत् पृष्ठे तरिं न्यधात् || 65 ||
text_mt:
Mounting the vessel upon the vast, terrifying expanse of water,
as long as the water remained turbulent, so long he supported the vessel on his back.

sanskrit_iast:
jale prakṛtimāpanne śṛṅge badhvā vaṭīrikām |
tāṃ nāvaṃ nodayāmasa sahasraṃ daivavatsarān || 66 ||
meaning:
जले प्रकृतिमापन्ने शृङ्गे बध्वा वटीरिकाम् |
तां नावं नोदयामस सहस्रं दैववत्सरान् || 66 ||
text_mt:
When the water returned to its natural state, having tied the thick rope to his horn,
he propelled that ship for a thousand divine years.

sanskrit_iast:
svaṃ nāvamavaṣṭabhya dadhāra parameśvaraḥ |
yoganidrā jagadhātrī samāsīdadvaṭīrikām || 67 ||
meaning:
स्वं नावमवष्टभ्य दधार परमेश्वरः |
योगनिद्रा जगधात्री समासीदद्वटीरिकाम् || 67 ||
text_mt:
Supporting the ship with himself, the Supreme Lord held [it] fast;
Yoganidrā, the supporter of the world, took her place upon the thick rope.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ śanaiḥ śanaistoye śoṣaṃ gacchati vai cirāt |
paścimaṃ himavacchṛṅgaṃ sumagnaṃ toyamadhyataḥ || 68 ||
meaning:
ततः शनैः शनैस्तोये शोषं गच्छति वै चिरात् |
पश्चिमं हिमवच्छृङ्गं सुमग्नं तोयमध्यतः || 68 ||
text_mt:
Then, as the water gradually and slowly went to dryness after a long time,
the western peak of the Himavat, completely submerged in the midst of the water,

sanskrit_iast:
dve sahasre yojanānāmucchritastaya himaprabho |
pañcāśattu sahasrāṇi śṛṅgaṃ tattasya cocchritam || 69 ||
meaning:
द्वे सहस्रे योजनानामुच्छ्रितस्तय हिमप्रभो |
पञ्चाशत्तु सहस्राणि शृङ्गं तत्तस्य चोच्छ्रितम् || 69 ||
text_mt:
two thousand yojanas high, shining with snow,
and that peak of his rose fifty thousand [yojanas] high.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmin śṛṅge tato nāvaṃ badhvā matsyātmadhṛg hariḥ |
jagāma śoṣaṇāyāśu jalānāṃ jagatāṃ patiḥ |
evaṃ hi matsyarūpeṇa vedāstrātāśca śārṅgiṇā || 70 ||
meaning:
तस्मिन् शृङ्गे ततो नावं बध्वा मत्स्यात्मधृग् हरिः |
जगाम शोषणायाशु जलानां जगतां पतिः |
एवं हि मत्स्यरूपेण वेदास्त्राताश्च शार्ङ्गिणा || 70 ||

sanskrit_iast: mārkaṇḍeya uvāca
meaning: मार्कण्डेय उवाच

sanskrit_iast:
kapilasya tu śāpena kṛta ākāliko layaḥ |
akāliko'yaṃ pralayo yato bhagavatā kṛtaḥ |
iti vaḥ kathitaṃ sarvaṃ yathāvaddvijasattamāḥ || 73 ||
meaning:
कपिलस्य तु शापेन कृत आकालिको लयः |
अकालिकोऽयं प्रलयो यतो भगवता कृतः |
इति वः कथितं सर्वं यथावद्द्विजसत्तमाः || 73 ||

sanskrit_iast:
iti śrīkālikāpurāṇe akālapralayakathane trayastriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ |
catustriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ
meaning:
इति श्रीकालिकापुराणे अकालप्रलयकथने त्रयस्त्रिंशोऽध्यायः |
चतुस्त्रिंशोऽध्यायः
text_mt:
Thus ends the thirty-third chapter in the glorious Kālikāpurāṇa, in the recounting of the unseasonable dissolution.
Chapter thirty-four.

sanskrit_iast: mārkaṇḍeya uvāca
meaning: मार्कण्डेय उवाच

sanskrit_iast:
yathā punarabhūt sṛṣṭirakālapralaye gate |
yena caivoddhṛtā pṛthvī tacchṛṇantu dvijottamāḥ || 1 ||
meaning:
यथा पुनरभूत् सृष्टिरकालप्रलये गते |
येन चैवोद्धृता पृथ्वी तच्छृणन्तु द्विजोत्तमाः || 1 ||
text_mt:
Hear, O best of the twice-born, how creation arose again
when the unseasonable dissolution had passed, and by whom the earth was rescued.

sanskrit_iast:
vyatīte pralaye viṣṇuḥ kūrmarūpī mahābalaḥ |
pṛṣṭhe nidhāya pṛthivīmuddhṛtyātha saparvatām |
samāñcakāra sakalāṃ pūrvavatparameśvaraḥ || 2 ||
meaning:
व्यतीते प्रलये विष्णुः कूर्मरूपी महाबलः |
पृष्ठे निधाय पृथिवीमुद्धृत्याथ सपर्वताम् |
समाञ्चकार सकलां पूर्ववत्परमेश्वरः || 2 ||
text_mt:
When the dissolution had passed, Viṣṇu of great strength, taking the form of a tortoise,
having placed the earth with its mountains upon his back and raised it up,
the Supreme Lord leveled it entirely, just as before.

sanskrit_iast:
śarabhasya varāhasya tatputrāṇāṃ padakramaiḥ |
yatra bhūmirviśīrṇābhūttāṃ tāṃ samāṃ kamaṭho'karot || 3 ||
meaning:
शरभस्य वराहस्य तत्पुत्राणां पदक्रमैः |
यत्र भूमिर्विशीर्णाभूत्तां तां समां कमठोऽकरोत् || 3 ||
text_mt:
Wherever the earth had been shattered by the footsteps
of the Śarabha, the Boar, and their sons, Kamaṭha made it smooth.

sanskrit_iast:
kṛtvā samāṃ tato bhūmiṃ pūrvavat parameśvaraḥ |
anantaṃ dhārayāmāsa pṛthivītalasaṃśritam || 4 ||
meaning:
कृत्वा समां ततो भूमिं पूर्ववत् परमेश्वरः |
अनन्तं धारयामास पृथिवीतलसंश्रितम् || 4 ||
text_mt:
Having thus leveled the earth as before, the Supreme Lord
placed Ananta resting beneath the surface of the earth.

sanskrit_iast:
tato brahmā ca viṣṇuśca haraśca parameśvaraḥ |
nāvodarasthān saptamunīnmanuṃ svāyambhuvaṃ tadā |
naranārāyaṇau cobhau dakṣañcocuḥ samāgatāḥ || 5 ||
meaning:
ततो ब्रह्मा च विष्णुश्च हरश्च परमेश्वरः |
नावोदरस्थान् सप्तमुनीन्मनुं स्वायम्भुवं तदा |
नरनारायणौ चोभौ दक्षञ्चोचुः समागताः || 5 ||
text_mt:
Then Brahmā, Viṣṇu, and Hara, the Supreme Lord,
assembling together, spoke to the seven sages seated inside the ship,
to Svāyambhuva Manu, to both Nara and Nārāyaṇa, and to Dakṣa:

sanskrit_iast:
śṛṇvantu munayaḥ sarve naranārāyaṇau tathā |
dakṣasvāyambhuvamanau vayaṃ brūmo'dhunā ca yat || 6 ||
meaning:
शृण्वन्तु मुनयः सर्वे नरनारायणौ तथा |
दक्षस्वायम्भुवमनौ वयं ब्रूमोऽधुना च यत् || 6 ||
text_mt:
"Let all the sages, as well as Nara and Nārāyaṇa,
Dakṣa, and Svāyambhuva Manu, hear what we now say:

sanskrit_iast:
sṛṣṭirnaṣṭā varāhasya śarabhasya ca saṅgarāt |
ato'smākaṃ yathākāryā sṛṣṭirākarṇayantu tat || 7 ||
meaning:
सृष्टिर्नष्टा वराहस्य शरभस्य च सङ्गरात् |
अतोऽस्माकं यथाकार्या सृष्टिराकर्णयन्तु तत् || 7 ||
text_mt:
Creation was destroyed because of the battle between the Boar and the Śarabha;
therefore, hear how creation must be performed by us.

sanskrit_iast:
naranārāyaṇavetau sṛṣṭyarthaṃ samupasthitau |
saṃsthāpanāya devānāṃ paramaṃ tapyatāṃ tapaḥ || 8 ||
meaning:
नरनारायणवेतौ सृष्ट्यर्थं समुपस्थितौ |
संस्थापनाय देवानां परमं तप्यतां तपः || 8 ||
text_mt:
These two, Nara and Nārāyaṇa, have approached for the sake of creation;
for the re-establishment of the gods, let them perform supreme asceticism.

sanskrit_iast:
apyāyya tapasā cobhau janalokagatān surān |
ānayantvaparāñchaśvat saṃsṛjantu gaṇān bahūn || 9 ||
meaning:
अप्याय्य तपसा चोभौ जनलोकगतान् सुरान् |
आनयन्त्वपराञ्छश्वत् संसृजन्तु गणान् बहून् || 9 ||
text_mt:
Having nourished with asceticism the gods who have gone to the Janaloka,
let both bring others constantly and create numerous hosts.

sanskrit_iast:
nakṣatrāṇi grahāṃścaiva teṣāṃ sthānāni vai mune |
etayostapasā yāntu sthiratāṃ pūrvajanmano || 10 ||
meaning:
नक्षत्राणि ग्रहांश्चैव तेषां स्थानानि वै मुने |
एतयोस्तपसा यान्तु स्थिरतां पूर्वजन्मनो || 10 ||
text_mt:
Let the constellations and the planets, and their stations indeed, O sage,
attain the stability of their previous existence through the asceticism of these two.

sanskrit_iast:
sūryasya rathasaṃsthānaṃ tathā candrarathasthitim |
karotvayaṃ mahābhāgaḥ svayameva janārdanaḥ || 11 ||
meaning:
सूर्यस्य रथसंस्थानं तथा चन्द्ररथस्थितिम् |
करोत्वयं महाभागः स्वयमेव जनार्दनः || 11 ||
text_mt:
Let the fortunate Janārdana himself arrange
the placement of the chariot of the Sun as well as the position of the chariot of the Moon.

sanskrit_iast:
pṛthivyāṃ sarvavījāni svāyambhuvamano tvayā |
upyantāṃ sarvataḥ śasyapūrṇā bhavatu medinī || 12 ||
meaning:
पृथिव्यां सर्ववीजानि स्वायम्भुवमनो त्वया |
उप्यन्तां सर्वतः शस्यपूर्णा भवतु मेदिनी || 12 ||
text_mt:
Let all seeds be sown upon the earth by you, O Svāyambhuva Manu;
let the earth become full of grain on all sides.

sanskrit_iast:
prarohayoṣadhīrvṛkṣān latāvallīśca sarvataḥ |
svāyambhuva mahāntyetat prāptānyṛtuphalāni ca || 13 ||
meaning:
प्ररोहयोषधीर्वृक्षान् लतावल्लीश्च सर्वतः |
स्वायम्भुव महान्त्येतत् प्राप्तान्यृतुफलानि च || 13 ||
text_mt:
O Svāyambhuva, cause the herbs, trees, creepers, and climbing plants to sprout everywhere;
they have attained their great, seasonal fruits.

sanskrit_iast:
dakṣaḥ saptamunīndraistu yajñena yajatāṃ harim |
varāhaputradehotthamagnitrayamidaṃ yajan || 14 ||
meaning:
दक्षः सप्तमुनीन्द्रैस्तु यज्ञेन यजतां हरिम् |
वराहपुत्रदेहोत्थमग्नित्रयमिदं यजन् || 14 ||
text_mt:
Let Dakṣa worship Hari with sacrifice together with the seven foremost sages,
worshiping this triad of fires that arose from the bodies of the sons of the Boar.

sanskrit_iast:
asau yajño varāhasya dehājjātastu sṛṣṭye |
anenaiva tu yajñena dakṣaḥ sṛṣṭiṃ tanotvimām || 15 ||
meaning:
असौ यज्ञो वराहस्य देहाज्जातस्तु सृष्ट्ये |
अनेनैव तु यज्ञेन दक्षः सृष्टिं तनोत्विमाम् || 15 ||
text_mt:
This sacrifice was born from the body of the Boar for the sake of creation;
by this very sacrifice let Dakṣa expand this creation.

sanskrit_iast:
naranārāyaṇābhyāntu munibhiḥ saptabhistathā |
dakṣeṇa bhavatā cāpi yajñenaibhistathāgnibhiḥ ||
sampūryatāmiyaṃ sṛṣṭiḥ svarge bhuvi rasātale || 16 ||
meaning:
नरनारायणाभ्यान्तु मुनिभिः सप्तभिस्तथा |
दक्षेण भवता चापि यज्ञेनैभिस्तथाग्निभिः ||
सम्पूर्यतामियं सृष्टिः स्वर्गे भुवि रसातले || 16 ||
text_mt:
By Nara and Nārāyaṇa, by the seven sages,
by Dakṣa, and by you as well, through the sacrifice and through these fires,
let this creation be filled in heaven, on earth, and in the netherworld.

sanskrit_iast:
vayaṃ ca sṛṣṭimāpyāyya yathā sampadyate tviyam |
yatiṣyāmastathā nityaṃ yūyaṃ kuruta sarjanam || 17 ||
meaning:
वयं च सृष्टिमाप्याय्य यथा सम्पद्यते त्वियम् |
यतिष्यामस्तथा नित्यं यूयं कुरुत सर्जनम् || 17 ||
text_mt:
And we, having nourished the creation so that it may succeed,
shall always strive in that way; you must perform the emission [of beings].

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ sampadyatāṃ sṛṣṭiryathā pūrvaṃ tathaiva ca |
prathamaṃ tvantu vījāni prarohaya mano'dhunā || 18 ||
meaning:
ततः सम्पद्यतां सृष्टिर्यथा पूर्वं तथैव च |
प्रथमं त्वन्तु वीजानि प्ररोहय मनोऽधुना || 18 ||
text_mt:
Then let creation come to pass exactly as before;
first, however, O Manu, make the seeds sprout now."

sanskrit_iast: mārkaṇḍeya uvāca
meaning: मार्कण्डेय उवाच

sanskrit_iast:
ityāditya mahābhāgā vidhiviṣṇuvṛṣadhvajāḥ |
yathāsthānaṃ sthāpayituṃ parvatān prayayustataḥ || 19 ||
meaning:
इत्यादित्य महाभागा विधिविष्णुवृषध्वजाः |
यथास्थानं स्थापयितुं पर्वतान् प्रययुस्ततः || 19 ||
text_mt:
Having thus instructed, the illustrious Vidhi, Viṣṇu, and Vṛṣadhvaja
then went forth to establish the mountains in their proper places.

sanskrit_iast:
merumandarakailāsahimavatprabhṛtiṣvatha |
purāṇi sarvadevānāṃ te vai cakruḥ pṛthak pṛthak || 20 ||
meaning:
मेरुमन्दरकैलासहिमवत्प्रभृतिष्वथ |
पुराणि सर्वदेवानां ते वै चक्रुः पृथक् पृथक् || 20 ||
text_mt:
Then on Meru, Mandara, Kailāsa, Himavat, and other [mountains],
they fashioned the cities of all the gods, each separately.

sanskrit_iast:
parityaja tato nāvamavadhṛtya vasundharām |
svāyambhuvaḥ kṣitau vījānyavapat sarvasampade || 21 ||
meaning:
परित्यज ततो नावमवधृत्य वसुन्धराम् |
स्वायम्भुवः क्षितौ वीजान्यवपत् सर्वसम्पदे || 21 ||
text_mt:
Leaving the ship and holding fast to the earth,
Svāyambhuva then sowed the seeds in the soil for all prosperity.

sanskrit_iast:
tato vṛkṣalatāvallīgulmāni ca vanāni ca |
bālaśasyāni dhānyāni tathaivauṣadhayaḥ samāḥ || 22 ||
meaning:
ततो वृक्षलतावल्लीगुल्मानि च वनानि च |
बालशस्यानि धान्यानि तथैवौषधयः समाः || 22 ||
text_mt:
Then trees, creepers, climbing plants, shrubs, forests,
young crops, grains, and annual plants [flourished] alike.

sanskrit_iast:
bījakāṇḍaprarohāśca pratānā jalajāni ca |
praphullāni vikośāni phalakandadalāni ca || 23 ||
meaning:
बीजकाण्डप्ररोहाश्च प्रताना जलजानि च |
प्रफुल्लानि विकोशानि फलकन्ददलानि च || 23 ||
text_mt: Sprouts from seeds and stems, creepers and water-born [plants], / blossomed, opened wide, with fruits, bulbs, and leaves,

sanskrit_iast:
vabhūvuḥ śādbalānyeva sarveṣāṃ prāṇavṛddhaye |
pṛthivī śasyasampanā vṛkṣāste śādvalāḥ śubhāḥ |
dṛṣṭāḥ pūrvaṃ yathā tasmānmanunācittaharṣiṇā || 24 ||
meaning:
वभूवुः शाद्बलान्येव सर्वेषां प्राणवृद्धये |
पृथिवी शस्यसम्पना वृक्षास्ते शाद्वलाः शुभाः |
दृष्टाः पूर्वं यथा तस्मान्मनुनाचित्तहर्षिणा || 24 ||
text_mt: and grassy pastures came to be, for the thriving of all living beings. / The earth rich with grain, those trees, and the auspicious meadows / were seen as before by Manu, whose heart rejoiced.

sanskrit_iast:
tato naro mahāyogī tapastepe mahattamam |
nārāyaṇaśca devānāṃ bhāvanāya mahāmatiḥ || 25 ||
meaning:
ततो नरो महायोगी तपस्तेपे महत्तमम् |
नारायणश्च देवानां भावनाय महामतिः || 25 ||
text_mt: Then the great yogin Nara practiced the highest asceticism, / and the noble-minded Nārāyaṇa, for the manifestation of the gods.

sanskrit_iast:
nārāyaṇo naraścobhau paramāvṛṣisattamau |
tapasārādhya paramaṃ tejomayamanāmayam || 26 ||
meaning:
नारायणो नरश्चोभौ परमावृषिसत्तमौ |
तपसाराध्य परमं तेजोमयमनामयम् || 26 ||
text_mt: Both Nārāyaṇa and Nara, the supreme and best of ṛṣis, / having propitiated through asceticism the supreme, luminous, and sorrowless [being],

sanskrit_iast:
āninyāte janagaṇān devān devarṣisattamān |
ye mṛtā amarāḥ pūrvaṃ gaṇaśastān pṛthak pṛthak |
tapobalena mahata sarjayāmāsaturmuni || 27 ||
meaning:
आनिन्याते जनगणान् देवान् देवर्षिसत्तमान् |
ये मृता अमराः पूर्वं गणशस्तान् पृथक् पृथक् |
तपोबलेन महत सर्जयामासतुर्मुनि || 27 ||
text_mt: brought forth the hosts of beings, the gods, and the best of divine ṛṣis. / Those immortals who had died previously, troop by troop, each one apart, / the two sages brought into being by the great power of their asceticism.

sanskrit_iast:
sūryācandramasau devau dikpālāṃśca tathā daśa |
janārdanaḥ svayaṃ cakre pātālatalavāsinaḥ || 28 ||
meaning:
सूर्याचन्द्रमसौ देवौ दिक्पालांश्च तथा दश |
जनार्दनः स्वयं चक्रे पातालतलवासिनः || 28 ||
text_mt: The two gods, Sun and Moon, and likewise the ten guardians of the directions, / Janārdana himself fashioned, [as well as] the dwellers of the netherworld.

sanskrit_iast:
sūryācandramasoścakre yathāsaṃsthānamacyutaḥ |
purvavad yojayāmasa divārātrasthitau ca tau || 29 ||
meaning:
सूर्याचन्द्रमसोश्चक्रे यथासंस्थानमच्युतः |
पुर्ववद् योजयामस दिवारात्रस्थितौ च तौ || 29 ||
text_mt: Acyuta set the Sun and Moon in their proper places, / and he engaged them as before in the regulation of day and night.

sanskrit_iast:
oṣadhiṣu ca jātāsu yajñavṛkṣeṣu sattamāḥ |
śasyabījeṣu jāteṣu deveṣu ca pṛthak pṛthak || 30 ||
meaning:
ओषधिषु च जातासु यज्ञवृक्षेषु सत्तमाः |
शस्यबीजेषु जातेषु देवेषु च पृथक् पृथक् || 30 ||
text_mt: And when the plants had sprung up, and the sacrificial trees, O best of men, / when the seeds of grain had appeared, and the gods each in their place,

sanskrit_iast:
dakṣaḥ kartuṃ samārebhe jyotiṣṭomaṃ mahādhvaram |
kaśyapo'trirvasiṣṭhaśca viśvāmitro'tha gautamaḥ ||
jamadagnirbharadvāja ete saptarṣayo'malāḥ || 31 ||
meaning:
दक्षः कर्तुं समारेभे ज्योतिष्टोमं महाध्वरम् |
कश्यपोऽत्रिर्वसिष्ठश्च विश्वामित्रोऽथ गौतमः ||
जमदग्निर्भरद्वाज एते सप्तर्षयोऽमलाः || 31 ||
text_mt: Dakṣa began to perform the Jyotiṣṭoma, the great sacrifice. / Kaśyapa, Atri, Vasiṣṭha, Viśvāmitra, and Gautama, / Jamadagni, and Bharadvāja—these were the seven stainless ṛṣis.

sanskrit_iast:
etaiḥ saptamunīndraistu dakṣo brahmasutaḥ svayam |
mahāyajñaṃ tataścakre yāvaddvādaśavatsarān || 32 ||
meaning:
एतैः सप्तमुनीन्द्रैस्तु दक्षो ब्रह्मसुतः स्वयम् |
महायज्ञं ततश्चक्रे यावद्द्वादशवत्सरान् || 32 ||
text_mt: With these seven lords of sages, Dakṣa himself, the son of Brahmā, / then performed the great sacrifice for twelve years.

sanskrit_iast:
hūyamāneṣu tatraiva triṣvagniṣu punaḥ punaḥ |
ijyamāne varāhe tu yajñarūpe tadā dvijaiḥ |
caturvidhāḥ prajā jātā yajñādeva dvijottamāḥ || 33 ||
meaning:
हूयमानेषु तत्रैव त्रिष्वग्निषु पुनः पुनः |
इज्यमाने वराहे तु यज्ञरूपे तदा द्विजैः |
चतुर्विधाः प्रजा जाता यज्ञादेव द्विजोत्तमाः || 33 ||
text_mt: While offerings were repeatedly made there into the three fires, / and the Boar, who is the form of sacrifice, was worshipped by the twice-born, / from that very sacrifice the four kinds of creatures were born, O best of the twice-born.

sanskrit_iast:
tato dakṣasya sañjātāḥ putryaḥ puṇyāstrayodaśa |
svarūpaguṇasampannāḥ sṛṣṭyarthamamitaprajāḥ || 34 ||
meaning:
ततो दक्षस्य सञ्जाताः पुत्र्यः पुण्यास्त्रयोदश |
स्वरूपगुणसम्पन्नाः सृष्ट्यर्थममितप्रजाः || 34 ||
text_mt: Then thirteen holy daughters were born to Dakṣa, / endowed with beauty and virtue, of boundless offspring, for the sake of creation.

sanskrit_iast:
tāḥ putrīḥ pradadau dakṣaḥ kaśyapāya mahātmane |
tābhyo jātāśca bahavastairvyāptaṃ sakalaṃ jagat || 35 ||
meaning:
ताः पुत्रीः प्रददौ दक्षः कश्यपाय महात्मने |
ताभ्यो जाताश्च बहवस्तैर्व्याप्तं सकलं जगत् || 35 ||
text_mt: Dakṣa gave those daughters to the great-souled Kaśyapa. / And from them many were born, by whom the entire universe was pervaded.

sanskrit_iast:
sa sarvāsāṃ prajānāṃ tu kaśyapo janako hyabhūt |
niścitaṃ dvijaśārdūlāḥ kaśyapāt sakalaṃ jagat || 36 ||
meaning:
स सर्वासां प्रजानां तु कश्यपो जनको ह्यभूत् |
निश्चितं द्विजशार्दूलाः कश्यपात् सकलं जगत् || 36 ||
text_mt: For that Kaśyapa became the father of all creatures; / certainly, O tigers among the twice-born, the entire universe is from Kaśyapa.

sanskrit_iast:
tāsāṃ nāmāni tajjātāḥprajāḥ sarvāḥ pṛthak pṛthak |
śṛṇavantu munayaḥ sarve samyak kathayato mama || 37 ||
meaning:
तासां नामानि तज्जाताःप्रजाः सर्वाः पृथक् पृथक् |
शृणवन्तु मुनयः सर्वे सम्यक् कथयतो मम || 37 ||
text_mt: Their names and all the creatures born of them, each in turn, / let all the sages hear as I recount them properly.

sanskrit_iast:
aditirditirdanuḥ kālā danāyūḥ siṃhikā muniḥ |
krodhā pradhā variṣṭhā ca vinatā kapilā tathā ||
kadrūstrayodaśasutā etā dakṣasya kīrtitāḥ || 38 ||
meaning:
अदितिर्दितिर्दनुः काला दनायूः सिंहिका मुनिः |
क्रोधा प्रधा वरिष्ठा च विनता कपिला तथा ||
कद्रूस्त्रयोदशसुता एता दक्षस्य कीर्तिताः || 38 ||
text_mt: Aditi, Diti, Danu, Kālā, Danāyū, Siṃhikā, Muni, / Krodhā, Pradhā, Variṣṭhā, Vinatā, Kapilā, / and Kadrū—these thirteen daughters of Dakṣa are proclaimed.

sanskrit_iast:
sañjāto dakṣiṇāṅguṣṭhānmanasā dhyāyato vidheḥ |
tena devamanuṣyeṣu dakṣa ityeva kathyate || 39 ||
meaning:
सञ्जातो दक्षिणाङ्गुष्ठान्मनसा ध्यायतो विधेः |
तेन देवमनुष्येषु दक्ष इत्येव कथ्यते || 39 ||
text_mt: He was born from the right thumb of Vidhi as he meditated with his mind; / therefore he is called Dakṣa among gods and men.

sanskrit_iast:
brahmaṇo mānasāḥputrā daśa pūrvaṃ prakīrtitāḥ |
teṣāṃ ṣaṭsṛṣṭikartāro vyatīte'smin janakṣaye || 40 ||
meaning:
ब्रह्मणो मानसाःपुत्रा दश पूर्वं प्रकीर्तिताः |
तेषां षट्सृष्टिकर्तारो व्यतीतेऽस्मिन् जनक्षये || 40 ||
text_mt: Ten mind-born sons of Brahmā were previously proclaimed; / six of them became creators of beings when this destruction of life had passed:

sanskrit_iast:
marīciratryaṅgirasau pulastyaḥ pulahaḥ kratuḥ |
marīcestanayo jātaḥ kaśyapo lokabhāvanaḥ || 41 ||
meaning:
मरीचिरत्र्यङ्गिरसौ पुलस्त्यः पुलहः क्रतुः |
मरीचेस्तनयो जातः कश्यपो लोकभावनः || 41 ||
text_mt: Marīci, Atri and Aṅgiras, Pulastya, Pulaha, and Kratu. / Marīci’s son was born, Kaśyapa, who causes the world to thrive.

sanskrit_iast:
asyaiva dakṣakanyābhyaḥ prajā jajñe'tha bhūriśaḥ |
asya jāyāprajātānāṃ nāmato vinibodhata || 42 ||
meaning:
अस्यैव दक्षकन्याभ्यः प्रजा जज्ञेऽथ भूरिशः |
अस्य जायाप्रजातानां नामतो विनिबोधत || 42 ||
text_mt: From him indeed, through the daughters of Dakṣa, creatures were born in abundance. / Understand by name those born of his wives:

sanskrit_iast:
dhātā mitro'ryamā śakro varuṇaḥ soma eva ca |
bhargo vivasvān pūṣā ca savitṛtvaṣṭuviṣṇavaḥ || 43 ||
meaning:
धाता मित्रोऽर्यमा शक्रो वरुणः सोम एव च |
भर्गो विवस्वान् पूषा च सवितृत्वष्टुविष्णवः || 43 ||
text_mt: Dhātṛ, Mitra, Aryaman, Śakra, Varuṇa, and Soma, / Bharga, Vivasvat, Pūṣan, Savitṛ, Tvaṣṭṛ, and Viṣṇu.

sanskrit_iast:
aditerdvādaśasutā ādityāste prakīrtitāḥ |
eṣāṃ kanīyān guṇavān sadā yastapatiḥ prajāḥ || 44 ||
meaning:
अदितेर्द्वादशसुता आदित्यास्ते प्रकीर्तिताः |
एषां कनीयान् गुणवान् सदा यस्तपतिः प्रजाः || 44 ||
text_mt: These twelve sons of Aditi are proclaimed as the Ādityas. / The youngest of these is virtuous, he who always warms the creatures;

sanskrit_iast:
sa vai vaṃśakaro mukhyo gadyate vo divākaraḥ |
eka eva diteḥ putro hiraṇyakaśipurbalī || 45 ||
meaning:
स वै वंशकरो मुख्यो गद्यते वो दिवाकरः |
एक एव दितेः पुत्रो हिरण्यकशिपुर्बली || 45 ||
text_mt: he, the maker of the day, is spoken of to you as the foremost founder of the lineage. / Diti had only one son, the mighty Hiraṇyakaśipu.

sanskrit_iast:
catvārastasya tanayā hṛṣṭā madabalānvitāḥ |
prahlādo hyatha saṃhlādo vāṣkalaḥ śibireva ca || 46 ||
meaning:
चत्वारस्तस्य तनया हृष्टा मदबलान्विताः |
प्रह्लादो ह्यथ संह्लादो वाष्कलः शिबिरेव च || 46 ||
text_mt: He had four sons, joyful and endowed with pride and strength: / Prahlāda, Saṃhlāda, Vāṣkala, and Śibi.

sanskrit_iast:
prahlādasya trayaḥ putrāsteṣāmādyo virocanaḥ |
kumbho nikumbho balavāṃstrayaḥ prāhlādajāḥ smṛtāḥ || 47 ||
meaning:
प्रह्लादस्य त्रयः पुत्रास्तेषामाद्यो विरोचनः |
कुम्भो निकुम्भो बलवांस्त्रयः प्राह्लादजाः स्मृताः || 47 ||
text_mt: Prahlāda had three sons, the first of whom was Virocana; / Kumbha and the mighty Nikumbha—these three are remembered as sons of Prahlāda.

sanskrit_iast:
virocanasuto jāto dānaśauṇḍo balirmahān |
baleśca putro vidito vāṇo nāma mahābalī || 48 ||
meaning:
विरोचनसुतो जातो दानशौण्डो बलिर्महान् |
बलेश्च पुत्रो विदितो वाणो नाम महाबली || 48 ||
text_mt: Virocana's son was born, the great Bali, passionate in giving; / and Bali’s son is known, the very mighty one named Bāṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
śambhoranucaraḥ śrīmān mahākālāhvayaśca saḥ |
bāṇasya ca śataṃ putrāḥ kusumbhamakarādayaḥ || 49 ||
meaning:
शम्भोरनुचरः श्रीमान् महाकालाह्वयश्च सः |
बाणस्य च शतं पुत्राः कुसुम्भमकरादयः || 49 ||
text_mt: He is the glorious attendant of Śambhu, named Mahākāla. / And Bāṇa had a hundred sons, beginning with Kusumbha and Makara.

sanskrit_iast:
catvāriṃśaddanoḥ putrā vipracittipuraḥsarāḥ |
śambaro namuciścaiva pulomā ca tathaiva ca || 50 ||
meaning:
चत्वारिंशद्दनोः पुत्रा विप्रचित्तिपुरःसराः |
शम्बरो नमुचिश्चैव पुलोमा च तथैव च || 50 ||
text_mt: Danu had forty sons, headed by Vipracitti: / Śambara, Namuci, and Puloman likewise,

sanskrit_iast:
asilomā tathā keśī durjayo'yaḥśirāstathā |
aśvaśīrṣo kṣayaḥ śaṅkurviyanmūrdhā mahābalāḥ || 51 ||
meaning:
असिलोमा तथा केशी दुर्जयोऽयःशिरास्तथा |
अश्वशीर्षो क्षयः शङ्कुर्वियन्मूर्धा महाबलाः || 51 ||
text_mt: Asiloman, Keśin, Durjaya, and Ayaḥśiras, / Aśvaśīrṣa, Kṣaya, Śaṅku, and Viyanmūrdhan, of great might,

sanskrit_iast:
vegavān ketumāṃścaiva svayaṃ svarbhānureva |
aśvo hyaśvapatiḥ kuṇḍo vṛṣaparvājakastathā || 52 ||
meaning:
वेगवान् केतुमांश्चैव स्वयं स्वर्भानुरेव |
अश्वो ह्यश्वपतिः कुण्डो वृषपर्वाजकस्तथा || 52 ||
text_mt: Vegavat, Ketumat, and Svarbhānu himself, / Aśva, Aśvapati, Kuṇḍa, Vṛṣaparvan, and Ajaka,

sanskrit_iast:
aśvagrīvaśca sūkṣmaśca turuṇḍurmāṇḍalastathā |
ūrdhabāhuścaikacakro virūpākṣo harāharau || 53 ||
meaning:
अश्वग्रीवश्च सूक्ष्मश्च तुरुण्डुर्माण्डलस्तथा |
ऊर्धबाहुश्चैकचक्रो विरूपाक्षो हराहरौ || 53 ||
text_mt: Aśvagrīva, Sūkṣma, Turuṇḍu, and Māṇḍala, / Ūrdhvabāhu, Ekacakra, Virūpākṣa, Hara, and Ahara,

sanskrit_iast:
niyantraśca nikumbhaśca kūpaṭaścapaṭustathā |
sarabhaḥ sulabhaścaiva sūryācandramasautathā || 54 ||
meaning:
नियन्त्रश्च निकुम्भश्च कूपटश्चपटुस्तथा |
सरभः सुलभश्चैव सूर्याचन्द्रमसौतथा || 54 ||
text_mt: Niyantra, Nikumbha, Kūpaṭa, Capaṭu, / Śarabha, Sulabha, and likewise Sūrya and Candramas.

sanskrit_iast:
anyāvetau danoḥ putrau sūryācandramasau tathā |
divākara-niśānāthau tāvanyau devapuṅgavau || 55 ||
meaning:
अन्यावेतौ दनोः पुत्रौ सूर्याचन्द्रमसौ तथा |
दिवाकर-निशानाथौ तावन्यौ देवपुङ्गवौ || 55 ||
text_mt: These two sons of Danu, Sūrya and Candramas, were distinct; / the sun and the moon, those two other [luminaries], were foremost among gods.

sanskrit_iast:
eṣāṃ putraiśca pautraiśca tatputraiścaiva bhūribhiḥ |
jagadvyāptamidaṃ sarvaṃ balavīryasamanvitaiḥ || 56 ||
meaning:
एषां पुत्रैश्च पौत्रैश्च तत्पुत्रैश्चैव भूरिभिः |
जगद्व्याप्तमिदं सर्वं बलवीर्यसमन्वितैः || 56 ||
text_mt: By their sons, grandsons, and their numerous sons, / endowed with strength and valor, this entire world was pervaded.

sanskrit_iast:
danāyuṣo'bhavan putrāścatvāro balavattarāḥ |
vīrabhadro vikṣaraśca vatso vṛttastathaiva ca || 57 ||
meaning:
दनायुषोऽभवन् पुत्राश्चत्वारो बलवत्तराः |
वीरभद्रो विक्षरश्च वत्सो वृत्तस्तथैव च || 57 ||
text_mt: Danāyus had four sons of exceedingly great strength: / Vīrabhadra, Vikṣara, Vatsa, and Vṛtta.

sanskrit_iast:
eṣāṃ caturṇāṃ vahavaḥ putrā jātā dvijottamāḥ |
rūpasatvabalopetā ekaikasya śataṃśatam || 58 ||
meaning:
एषां चतुर्णां वहवः पुत्रा जाता द्विजोत्तमाः |
रूपसत्वबलोपेता एकैकस्य शतंशतम् || 58 ||
text_mt: From these four many sons were born, O best of the twice-born, / endowed with beauty, virtue, and strength, a hundred from each one.

sanskrit_iast:
kālāyāstanayā jātāḥ kāleyā iti viśrutāḥ |
vikhyātāste mahāvīryāścatvāro dānavādhipāḥ || 59 ||
meaning:
कालायास्तनया जाताः कालेया इति विश्रुताः |
विख्यातास्ते महावीर्याश्चत्वारो दानवाधिपाः || 59 ||
text_mt: The sons born of Kālā were renowned as the Kāleyas; / they were four celebrated, very valiant lords of the Dānavas:

sanskrit_iast:
vināśanaśca krodhaśca krodhahantā tathaiva ca |
krodhaśakrastathā caite kālāputrāḥ prakīrtitāḥ || 60 ||
meaning:
विनाशनश्च क्रोधश्च क्रोधहन्ता तथैव च |
क्रोधशक्रस्तथा चैते कालापुत्राः प्रकीर्तिताः || 60 ||
text_mt: Vināśana, Krodha, Krodhahantṛ, / and Krodhaśakra—these are proclaimed the sons of Kālā.

sanskrit_iast:
siṃhikāyāḥ suto jāto rāhuścandrārkamardanaḥ |
sucandraścandrahantā ca tathā candravimardanaḥ || 61 ||
meaning:
सिंहिकायाः सुतो जातो राहुश्चन्द्रार्कमर्दनः |
सुचन्द्रश्चन्द्रहन्ता च तथा चन्द्रविमर्दनः || 61 ||
text_mt: Siṃhikā's son was born, Rāhu, the crusher of the moon and sun, / and Sucandra, Candrahantṛ, and Candravimardana,

sanskrit_iast:
egavān ketumān caiva ayaḥ surbhānureva ca |
aśvodyapatiḥ kṛṣṭuraṣṭaparvājusrustathā || 62 ||
meaning:
एगवान् केतुमान् चैव अयः सुर्भानुरेव च |
अश्वोद्यपतिः कृष्टुरष्टपर्वाजुस्रुस्तथा || 62 ||
text_mt: [V]egavat, Ketumat, and Svarbhānu, / Aśva, [Aśva]pati, Kṛṣṭu, [Vṛṣa]parvan, and [A]jaka […].

sanskrit_iast:
krodhāyāstanayā jātāḥ krūrakarmakarāstathā |
siṃhikācaiva krodhā ca dve sute krūrike sadā ||
tābhyāṃ ca prabhavo vaṃśo hyataḥ krūrataraḥ smṛtaḥ || 63 ||
meaning:
क्रोधायास्तनया जाताः क्रूरकर्मकरास्तथा |
सिंहिकाचैव क्रोधा च द्वे सुते क्रूरिके सदा ||
ताभ्यां च प्रभवो वंशो ह्यतः क्रूरतरः स्मृतः || 63 ||
text_mt: The sons born of Krodhā were performers of cruel deeds. / Both Siṃhikā and Krodhā were two daughters who were ever cruel; / the lineage arising from the two of them is remembered as even more cruel.

sanskrit_iast:
eka eva muneḥ putro jātaḥ śukraḥ kavirmahān |
daityadānavakāleyaprabhṛtīnāṃ sadā guruḥ || 64 ||
meaning:
एक एव मुनेः पुत्रो जातः शुक्रः कविर्महान् |
दैत्यदानवकालेयप्रभृतीनां सदा गुरुः || 64 ||
text_mt: Muni had only one son born, the great poet Śukra, / who is ever the guru of the Daityas, Dānavas, Kāleyas, and others.

sanskrit_iast:
catvārastasya tanayā jātā asurayājakāḥ |
tvaṣṭāvarastathātriśca saukalaśceti vāgminaḥ || 65 ||
meaning:
चत्वारस्तस्य तनया जाता असुरयाजकाः |
त्वष्टावरस्तथात्रिश्च सौकलश्चेति वाग्मिनः || 65 ||
text_mt: Four sons were born to him, priests to the Asuras: / Tvaṣṭṛ, Vara, Atri, and Saukala, eloquent speakers.

sanskrit_iast:
tejasā sūryasadṛśā brahmalokaḥprabhāvanāḥ |
asurāṇāṃ sadaityānāṃ kāleyānāṃ tathaiva ca || 66 ||
meaning:
तेजसा सूर्यसदृशा ब्रह्मलोकःप्रभावनाः |
असुराणां सदैत्यानां कालेयानां तथैव च || 66 ||
text_mt: Equal to the sun in splendor, illuminators of the world of Brahmā; / likewise of the asuras, the daityas, and the kāleyas,

sanskrit_iast:
krodhātmajānāñca tathā siṃhikātanayasya ca |
sūtiprasūtibhiḥ sarvaṃ jagadvyāptaṃ carācaram || 67 ||
meaning:
क्रोधात्मजानाञ्च तथा सिंहिकातनयस्य च |
सूतिप्रसूतिभिः सर्वं जगद्व्याप्तं चराचरम् || 67 ||
text_mt: and of the offspring of Krodhā, and of the son of Siṃhikā: / with their offspring and descendants, the entire world of moving and unmoving beings was pervaded.

sanskrit_iast:
teṣāṃ tu yānyapatyāni vardhitāni kramaddvijāḥ |
teṣāṃ bahutvāt saṅkhyātaṃ cireṇāpi na śakyate || 68 ||
meaning:
तेषां तु यान्यपत्यानि वर्धितानि क्रमद्द्विजाः |
तेषां बहुत्वात् सङ्ख्यातं चिरेणापि न शक्यते || 68 ||
text_mt: As for the children of these, who grew in succession, O twice-born ones, / because of their vast number they cannot be counted even in a long time.

sanskrit_iast:
tārkṣyaścāriṣṭanemiśca anūrurgaruḍastathā |
āruṇirvāruṇiścaiva vinatātanayāḥ smṛtāḥ || 69 ||
meaning:
तार्क्ष्यश्चारिष्टनेमिश्च अनूरुर्गरुडस्तथा |
आरुणिर्वारुणिश्चैव विनतातनयाः स्मृताः || 69 ||
text_mt: Tārkṣya, Ariṣṭanemi, Anūru, and Garuḍa, / as well as Āruṇi and Vāruṇi, are remembered as the sons of Vinatā.

sanskrit_iast:
śeṣo vāsukirājaśca takṣakaḥ kulikastathā |
kūrmaśca sumanāśceti kādraveyāḥ prakīrtitāḥ || 70 ||
meaning:
शेषो वासुकिराजश्च तक्षकः कुलिकस्तथा |
कूर्मश्च सुमनाश्चेति काद्रवेयाः प्रकीर्तिताः || 70 ||
text_mt: Śeṣa, King Vāsuki, Takṣaka, and Kulika, / as well as Kūrma and Sumanas, are proclaimed the sons of Kadrū.

sanskrit_iast:
bhīmasenograsenaśca suparṇo garuḍastathā |
gopatirdhṛtarāṣṭra sūryavarcāśca vīryavān || 71 ||
meaning:
भीमसेनोग्रसेनश्च सुपर्णो गरुडस्तथा |
गोपतिर्धृतराष्ट्र सूर्यवर्चाश्च वीर्यवान् || 71 ||
text_mt: Bhīmasena, Ugrasena, Suparṇa, and Garuḍa, / Gopati, Dhṛtarāṣṭra, and the valorous Sūryavarcas,

sanskrit_iast:
arkadṛṣṭaḥ prayuktaśca viśrutaḥ suśrutastathā |
bhīmaścitrarathaścaiva vikhyātaḥ sarvavidbalī || 72 ||
meaning:
अर्कदृष्टः प्रयुक्तश्च विश्रुतः सुश्रुतस्तथा |
भीमश्चित्ररथश्चैव विख्यातः सर्वविद्बली || 72 ||
text_mt: Arkadṛṣṭa, Prayukta, Viśruta, and Suśruta, / Bhīma, Citraratha, and the famous, all-knowing, mighty one,

sanskrit_iast:
śāliśīrṣaśca parjanyaḥ kalirnārada eva ca |
ityete deva gandharvā muniputrāḥ prakīrtitāḥ || 73 ||
meaning:
शालिशीर्षश्च पर्जन्यः कलिर्नारद एव च |
इत्येते देव गन्धर्वा मुनिपुत्राः प्रकीर्तिताः || 73 ||
text_mt: Śāliśīrṣa, Parjanya, Kali, and Nārada— / these are proclaimed the divine gandharvas, the sons of the sage.

sanskrit_iast:
anavadyāṃ sānurāgāṃ saṃvarāṃ mārgaṇāṃ priyām |
asūyāṃ subhagāṃ bhīmāmiti kanyāmasūyata || 74 ||
meaning:
अनवद्यां सानुरागां संवरां मार्गणां प्रियाम् |
असूयां सुभगां भीमामिति कन्यामसूयत || 74 ||
text_mt: Anavadyā, Sānurāgā, Saṃvarā, Mārgaṇā, Priyā, / Asūyā, Subhagā, and Bhīmā—these daughters did she bear.

sanskrit_iast:
prādhā sarvaguṇotthānāt kaśyapāttu tapodhanāt |
viśvāvasuḥ sucandraśca suparaṇaḥ siddha eva ca || 75 ||
meaning:
प्राधा सर्वगुणोत्थानात् कश्यपात्तु तपोधनात् |
विश्वावसुः सुचन्द्रश्च सुपरणः सिद्ध एव च || 75 ||
text_mt: From Kaśyapa, rich in penance, who was the source of all virtues, Prādhā [bore]: / Viśvāvasu, Sucandra, Suparṇa, and Siddha,

sanskrit_iast:
barhiḥ pūrṇaśca pūrṇāṅgo brahmacārī ratipriyaḥ |
bhānuśca daśamaścaite prādhāputrāḥ prakīrtitāḥ || 76 ||
meaning:
बर्हिः पूर्णश्च पूर्णाङ्गो ब्रह्मचारी रतिप्रियः |
भानुश्च दशमश्चैते प्राधापुत्राः प्रकीर्तिताः || 76 ||
text_mt: Barhis, Pūrṇa, Pūrṇāṅga, Brahmacārin, Ratipriya, / and Bhānu as the tenth: these are proclaimed the sons of Prādhā.

sanskrit_iast:
ityete devagandharvāḥ santataṃ puṇyalakṣaṇāḥ |
prādhāsūta mahābhāgā devī devarṣisattamāt || 77 ||
meaning:
इत्येते देवगन्धर्वाः सन्ततं पुण्यलक्षणाः |
प्राधासूत महाभागा देवी देवर्षिसत्तमात् || 77 ||
text_mt: These divine gandharvas, who ever bear auspicious marks, / the fortunate goddess Prādhā bore from the best of divine sages.

sanskrit_iast:
alambuṣā miśrakeśī gāminī ca manoramā |
vidyutpannānadhārambhā hyaruṇā rakṣitātulā || 78 ||
meaning:
अलम्बुषा मिश्रकेशी गामिनी च मनोरमा |
विद्युत्पन्नानधारम्भा ह्यरुणा रक्षितातुला || 78 ||
text_mt: Alambuṣā, Miśrakeśī, Gāminī, and Manoramā, / Vidyutparṇā, Anadhā, Rambhā, Aruṇā, Rakṣitā, Atulā,

sanskrit_iast:
suvāhuḥ suratā caiva murajā supriyā tathā |
vapustilottamā ceti mukhyā apsarasaḥ smṛtāḥ || 79 ||
meaning:
सुवाहुः सुरता चैव मुरजा सुप्रिया तथा |
वपुस्तिलोत्तमा चेति मुख्या अप्सरसः स्मृताः || 79 ||
text_mt: Subāhu, Suratā, Murajā, Supriyā, / Vapu, and Tilottamā are remembered as the chief apsarases.

sanskrit_iast:
atibāhustumburuśca hāhā hūhūstathaiva ca |
gandharvāṇāmime mukhyā devatulyāḥ prakīrtitāḥ || 80 ||
meaning:
अतिबाहुस्तुम्बुरुश्च हाहा हूहूस्तथैव च |
गन्धर्वाणामिमे मुख्या देवतुल्याः प्रकीर्तिताः || 80 ||
text_mt: Atibāhu, Tumburu, Hāhā, and Hūhū: / these are proclaimed the chief gandharvas, equal to the gods.

sanskrit_iast:
amṛtaṃ brāhmaṇā gāvo munayo'psarasastathā |
kapilātanayāḥ proktā mahābhāgā mahotsavāḥ || 81 ||
meaning:
अमृतं ब्राह्मणा गावो मुनयोऽप्सरसस्तथा |
कपिलातनयाः प्रोक्ता महाभागा महोत्सवाः || 81 ||
text_mt: Amṛta, brāhmaṇas, cows, sages, and apsarases / are proclaimed the children of Kapilā, most fortunate and of great festival.

sanskrit_iast:
iti dakṣasutānāṃ ye kaśyapāttanayāḥ smṛtāḥ |
tairidaṃ sakalaṃ vyāptaṃ jagatsthāvarajaṅgamam || 82 ||
meaning:
इति दक्षसुतानां ये कश्यपात्तनयाः स्मृताः |
तैरिदं सकलं व्याप्तं जगत्स्थावरजङ्गमम् || 82 ||
text_mt: In this way, by those who are remembered as sons of Dakṣa's daughters born from Kaśyapa, / this entire world of unmoving and moving beings was pervaded.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ yajñavarāhasya yajñarūpasya pātanāt |
tribhyo'gnibhyo manostasmāt svāyambhuvamahātmanaḥ || 83 ||
meaning:
एवं यज्ञवराहस्य यज्ञरूपस्य पातनात् |
त्रिभ्योऽग्निभ्यो मनोस्तस्मात् स्वायम्भुवमहात्मनः || 83 ||
text_mt: Thus, after the falling of the sacrificial boar, who was the embodiment of the sacrifice, / from the three fires, from that great-souled Manu Svāyambhuva,

sanskrit_iast:
munibhyaścaiva saptamyaḥ kaśyapādibhya eva ca |
naranārāyaṇābhyāntu vyatīte'kālike laye |
punaḥ prajāḥ purā sṛṣṭā hariṇānekarūpiṇā || 84 ||
meaning:
मुनिभ्यश्चैव सप्तम्यः कश्यपादिभ्य एव च |
नरनारायणाभ्यान्तु व्यतीतेऽकालिके लये |
पुनः प्रजाः पुरा सृष्टा हरिणानेकरूपिणा || 84 ||
text_mt: from the seven sages, from Kaśyapa and others, / and from Nara and Nārāyaṇa, when the untimely dissolution had passed, / living beings were once again created of old by Hari of manifold forms.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ punarabhūt sṛṣṭiḥ sṛṣṭisthityantakāriṇaḥ |
harestasya prasādena naranārāyaṇātmanaḥ || 85 ||
meaning:
एवं पुनरभूत् सृष्टिः सृष्टिस्थित्यन्तकारिणः |
हरेस्तस्य प्रसादेन नरनारायणात्मनः || 85 ||
text_mt: In this way creation took place again by the grace of Hari, / the author of creation, preservation, and destruction, whose self is Nara and Nārāyaṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
iti śrīkālikāpurāṇe sṛṣṭikathane catustriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 34 ||
pañcatriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ
meaning:
इति श्रीकालिकापुराणे सृष्टिकथने चतुस्त्रिंशोऽध्यायः || 34 ||
पञ्चत्रिंशोऽध्यायः
text_mt:
Thus ends the thirty-fourth chapter, on the narrative of creation, in the glorious Kālikāpurāṇa.
Chapter Thirty-Five

sanskrit_iast: mārkaṇḍeya uvāca
meaning: मार्कण्डेय उवाच

sanskrit_iast:
īśvaraḥ śārabhaṃ kāyaṃ yathā tatyāja yatnataḥ |
tanme nigadato bhūyaḥ śṛṇudhvaṃ dvijasattamāḥ || 1 ||
meaning:
ईश्वरः शारभं कायं यथा तत्याज यत्नतः |
तन्मे निगदतो भूयः शृणुध्वं द्विजसत्तमाः || 1 ||
text_mt: How Īśvara deliberately cast off his Śarabha body— / hear that as I relate it further, O best of the twice-born.

sanskrit_iast:
hate yajñavarāhe tu brahmā lokapitāmahaḥ |
uvāca śarabhaṃ gatvā sāmayuktaṃ jagaddhitam || 2 ||
meaning:
हते यज्ञवराहे तु ब्रह्मा लोकपितामहः |
उवाच शरभं गत्वा सामयुक्तं जगद्धितम् || 2 ||
text_mt: When the sacrificial boar was slain, Brahmā, the grandfather of the worlds, / approached Śarabha and spoke words endowed with conciliation for the welfare of the world:

sanskrit_iast:
dehābhogena bhavataḥ pūritaṃ bhūriyojanam |
upasaṃhara tasmāt tvaṃ kāyaṃ lokabhayaṅkaram || 3 ||
meaning:
देहाभोगेन भवतः पूरितं भूरियोजनम् |
उपसंहर तस्मात् त्वं कायं लोकभयङ्करम् || 3 ||
text_mt: “By the expanse of your body many yojanas have been filled; / therefore, withdraw this body of yours that terrifies the world.

sanskrit_iast:
tava yuddhena sakalaṃ praṇaṣṭaṃ bhuvanatrayam |
ākāśaṃ gantuṃ tvāṃ dṛṣṭvā vibhetyadya janārdanaḥ |
tasmāt tvamūrdhalokānāṃ hitāya tyaja vai tanum || 4 ||
meaning:
तव युद्धेन सकलं प्रणष्टं भुवनत्रयम् |
आकाशं गन्तुं त्वां दृष्ट्वा विभेत्यद्य जनार्दनः |
तस्मात् त्वमूर्धलोकानां हिताय त्यज वै तनुम् || 4 ||
text_mt: By your battle all the three worlds have been ruined; / seeing you ascend into the sky, Janārdana is afraid today. / Therefore, cast off your body indeed for the benefit of the higher worlds.”

sanskrit_iast: mārkaṇḍeya uvāca
meaning: मार्कण्डेय उवाच

sanskrit_iast:
tatastasya vacaḥ śrutvā surajyeṣṭhasya śaṅkaraḥ |
tatyāja śārabhaṃ kāyaṃ toyoparyeva tatkṣaṇāt || 5 ||
meaning:
ततस्तस्य वचः श्रुत्वा सुरज्येष्ठस्य शङ्करः |
तत्याज शारभं कायं तोयोपर्येव तत्क्षणात् || 5 ||
text_mt: Then, having heard the words of the eldest of the gods, Śaṅkara / at that very moment cast off his Śarabha body upon the waters.

sanskrit_iast:
tyaktasya tasya dehasya śaṅkareṇa mahātmanā |
aṣṭau pādā aṣṭamūrtesteṣu cāṣṭasu bhejire || 6 ||
meaning:
त्यक्तस्य तस्य देहस्य शङ्करेण महात्मना |
अष्टौ पादा अष्टमूर्तेस्तेषु चाष्टसु भेजिरे || 6 ||
text_mt: Of that body discarded by the great-souled Śaṅkara, / the eight feet entered into the eight forms of him who has eight forms:

sanskrit_iast:
ādyantu dakṣiṇaṃ pādamākāśamagamaddrutam |
tadvāmaṃ mihiraṃ bheje paścād dakṣiṇajaṃ vidhau || 7 ||
meaning:
आद्यन्तु दक्षिणं पादमाकाशमगमद्द्रुतम् |
तद्वामं मिहिरं भेजे पश्चाद् दक्षिणजं विधौ || 7 ||
text_mt: The first right foot swiftly entered the sky; / the left of it entered the sun; the next right one entered the moon;

sanskrit_iast:
vāmantu jvalanaṃ bheje pṛṣṭhāgraṃ padgataṃ kṣitim |
pṛṣṭhāgravāmaṃ salilaṃ tatpaścād dakṣiṇaṃ tathā || 8 ||
meaning:
वामन्तु ज्वलनं भेजे पृष्ठाग्रं पद्गतं क्षितिम् |
पृष्ठाग्रवामं सलिलं तत्पश्चाद् दक्षिणं तथा || 8 ||
text_mt: the left [of that] entered fire; the fore-foot of the hind part reached the earth; / the front-left of the hind part entered water; the next right one likewise [entered the sacrificer];

sanskrit_iast:
vāyau vāmapadaṃ bheje hotāraṃ sarvatomukham |
evaṃ tasyāṣṭamūrtestu aṣṭamūrtiṣu tatkṣaṇāt |
aṣṭau pādāstathā bhejuḥ svaṃ tvaṃ tejo yayuḥ padam || 9 ||
meaning:
वायौ वामपदं भेजे होतारं सर्वतोमुखम् |
एवं तस्याष्टमूर्तेस्तु अष्टमूर्तिषु तत्क्षणात् |
अष्टौ पादास्तथा भेजुः स्वं त्वं तेजो ययुः पदम् || 9 ||
text_mt: the left foot entered wind, [and] the all-facing hotṛ. / Thus, of him who has eight forms, into the eight forms at that very moment / the eight feet entered accordingly; each went to its own place of power.

sanskrit_iast:
madhyaṃ tu śārabhaṃ kāyaṃ śaṅkarasya mahātmanaḥ |
kapālī bhairavo bhūtaścaṇḍarūpī durāsadaḥ || 10 ||
meaning:
मध्यं तु शारभं कायं शङ्करस्य महात्मनः |
कपाली भैरवो भूतश्चण्डरूपी दुरासदः || 10 ||
text_mt: The torso, however, of the Śarabha body of the great-souled Śaṅkara / became the Kapālin Bhairava, of fierce form, difficult to approach.

sanskrit_iast:
mastiṣkamedasā yuktaṃ māṃsaṃ juhvati te śucau |
brahmakapālapātrasthaṃ surābhirdevapūjanam || 11 ||
meaning:
मस्तिष्कमेदसा युक्तं मांसं जुह्वति ते शुचौ |
ब्रह्मकपालपात्रस्थं सुराभिर्देवपूजनम् || 11 ||
text_mt: They offer meat mingled with brain and fat into the pure [fire]; / the worship of the deity is performed with spirits placed in a vessel made of a human skull.

sanskrit_iast:
balirmanuṣyamāṃsena pānaṃ tu rudhiraṃ sadā |
surayā pāranaṃ yajñe kapālodbhaṭadhāraṇam || 12 ||
meaning:
बलिर्मनुष्यमांसेन पानं तु रुधिरं सदा |
सुरया पारनं यज्ञे कपालोद्भटधारणम् || 12 ||
text_mt: The oblation is with human flesh, and blood is always the drink; / the conclusion of the sacrifice is with wine, and they carry a terrible skull.

sanskrit_iast:
vyāghracarmaparidhānaṃ samalaṃ trivalīvṛtam |
evaṃ kurvanti satataṃ kapālavratadhāriṇaḥ || 13 ||
meaning:
व्याघ्रचर्मपरिधानं समलं त्रिवलीवृतम् |
एवं कुर्वन्ति सततं कपालव्रतधारिणः || 13 ||
text_mt: Their garment is a tiger skin, soiled and tied with three folds: / thus do the observers of the skull-vow ever behave.

sanskrit_iast:
kapālī bhairavasteṣāṃ devaḥ pūjyastu nityaśaḥ |
śmaśānabhairavo yo'sau yo mahābhairavāhvayaḥ || 14 ||
meaning:
