sanskrit_iast:
etasminnantare devo bhagavān lokabhāvanaḥ |
devakyā jaṭharājjāto vṛddho nandagṛhe'bhavat || 37 ||
meaning:
एतस्मिन्नन्तरे देवो भगवान् लोकभावनः |
देवक्या जठराज्जातो वृद्धो नन्दगृहेऽभवत् || 37 ||
text_mt: Meanwhile, the blessed Lord, creator of the worlds, / was born from the womb of Devakī and grew up in Nanda's house.

sanskrit_iast:
kaṃsakeśipralambādīn hatvā daityānanekaśaḥ |
akarod dvārakāvāsaṃ sāgare salilāntare || 38 ||
meaning:
कंसकेशिप्रलम्बादीन् हत्वा दैत्याननेकशः |
अकरोद् द्वारकावासं सागरे सलिलान्तरे || 38 ||
text_mt: Having slain Kaṃsa, Keśin, Pralamba, and many other daityas, / he made his dwelling in Dvārakā amidst the waters of the ocean.

sanskrit_iast:
tatrāṣṭau kanyakāstena svadharmeṇa ca svīkṛtāḥ |
kālindī mānuṣīrūpā rukmiṇī ramaṇī tataḥ || 39 ||
meaning:
तत्राष्टौ कन्यकास्तेन स्वधर्मेण च स्वीकृताः |
कालिन्दी मानुषीरूपा रुक्मिणी रमणी ततः || 39 ||
text_mt: There eight maidens were taken by him according to proper duty: / Kālindī in human form, Rukmiṇī the delightful,

sanskrit_iast:
nagnajittanayā satyā lakṣmaṇā cāruhāsinī |
suśīlā śīlasampannā tatha jāmbavatī satī || 40 ||
meaning:
नग्नजित्तनया सत्या लक्ष्मणा चारुहासिनी |
सुशीला शीलसम्पन्ना तथ जाम्बवती सती || 40 ||
text_mt: Nagnajit's daughter Satyā, Lakṣmaṇā of sweet smile, / Suśīlā rich in good conduct, and the virtuous Jāmbavatī.

sanskrit_iast:
etāsu strīṣu ca tato hyanuraktasya tasya vai |
ṣaṭtriṃśadvatsarā jātā baladevasahāyinaḥ || 41 ||
meaning:
एतासु स्त्रीषु च ततो ह्यनुरक्तस्य तस्य वै |
षट्त्रिंशद्वत्सरा जाता बलदेवसहायिनः || 41 ||
text_mt: Thirty-six years passed for him, accompanied by Baladeva, / devoted to these wives.

sanskrit_iast:
pradyumnasāmbapramukhāḥ putrāstasya mahābalāḥ |
jātāstatra dvijaśreṣṭhāḥ śāstre śastre ca kovidāḥ || 42 ||
meaning:
प्रद्युम्नसाम्बप्रमुखाः पुत्रास्तस्य महाबलाः |
जातास्तत्र द्विजश्रेष्ठाः शास्त्रे शस्त्रे च कोविदाः || 42 ||
text_mt: Sons were born to him there, chief among them Pradyumna and Sāmba, / O best of the twice-born, of great might and skilled in scriptures and weapons.

sanskrit_iast:
aneke nihatā daityā bhārabhūtāstadā kṣiteḥ |
prahṛṣṭaḥ krīḍamānaśca dvārakāyāmuvāsa saḥ || 43 ||
meaning:
अनेके निहता दैत्या भारभूतास्तदा क्षितेः |
प्रहृष्टः क्रीडमानश्च द्वारकायामुवास सः || 43 ||
text_mt: Many daityas who were a burden to the earth were then slain by him; / he dwelt in Dvārakā, rejoiced and sporting.

sanskrit_iast:
atha śakrastadāyāto narakeṇārdito bhṛśam |
dvārakāṃ prati kṛṣṇasya darśanāya gaṇaiḥ saha || 44 ||
meaning:
अथ शक्रस्तदायातो नरकेणार्दितो भृशम् |
द्वारकां प्रति कृष्णस्य दर्शनाय गणैः सह || 44 ||
text_mt: Then Śakra, sorely afflicted by Naraka, came / to Dvārakā along with his hosts to behold Kṛṣṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
tatra gatvā pariṣvajya kṛṣṇaṃ lokanamaskṛtam |
pūjitastena bahuśa āsane kāñcane sthitaḥ || 45 ||
meaning:
तत्र गत्वा परिष्वज्य कृष्णं लोकनमस्कृतम् |
पूजितस्तेन बहुश आसने काञ्चने स्थितः || 45 ||
text_mt: Having gone there and embraced Kṛṣṇa, who is worshipped by the worlds, / he was honoured by him with many courtesies and sat upon a golden throne.

sanskrit_iast:
kathayāmāsa haraye narakasya viceṣṭitam |
śakro yathā pūrvavṛttaṃ yathā vā vartate'dhunā || 46 ||
meaning:
कथयामास हरये नरकस्य विचेष्टितम् |
शक्रो यथा पूर्ववृत्तं यथा वा वर्ततेऽधुना || 46 ||
text_mt: Śakra related to Hari the deeds of Naraka, / how things happened previously and how he behaves now.

sanskrit_iast: śakra uvāca
meaning: शक्र उवाच

sanskrit_iast:
śṛṇu kṛṣṇa mahābāho yadarthamahamāgataḥ |
kathayiṣyāmi tat sarvaṃ tatra śaṅkāṃ na saṅkuru || 47 ||
meaning:
शृणु कृष्ण महाबाहो यदर्थमहमागतः |
कथयिष्यामि तत् सर्वं तत्र शङ्कां न सङ्कुरु || 47 ||
text_mt: Listen, long-armed Kṛṣṇa, to the purpose for which I have come; / I shall tell you all of it, have no doubt about it.

sanskrit_iast:
bhūmiputro'suro nāmnā narakaḥ suramardanaḥ |
cirañjīvī purā viṣṇukṣitibhyāṃ paripālitaḥ || 48 ||
meaning:
भूमिपुत्रोऽसुरो नाम्ना नरकः सुरमर्दनः |
चिरञ्जीवी पुरा विष्णुक्षितिभ्यां परिपालितः || 48 ||
text_mt: The son of the Earth, an asura named Naraka, a crusher of gods, / long-lived, was formerly protected by Viṣṇu and the Earth.

sanskrit_iast:
adhunā sa kṣitiṃ viṣṇumavajñāya durāsadaḥ |
vāṇasya vacanād bhaumo brahmā'ṃ paryatoṣayat || 49 ||
meaning:
अधुना स क्षितिं विष्णुमवज्ञाय दुरासदः |
वाणस्य वचनाद् भौमो ब्रह्माऽं पर्यतोषयत् || 49 ||
text_mt: Now, having disregarded the Earth and Viṣṇu, that unapproachable one, / born of the Earth, propitiated Brahmā on the advice of Bāṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
brahmataḥ sa varān labdhvā hyatīvābhūt pradarpitaḥ |
mādhavaṃ pṛthivīṃ vāpi sasmāra na kadācana || 50 ||
meaning:
ब्रह्मतः स वरान् लब्ध्वा ह्यतीवाभूत् प्रदर्पितः |
माधवं पृथिवीं वापि सस्मार न कदाचन || 50 ||
text_mt: Having obtained boons from Brahmā, he became exceedingly arrogant; / he never remembered Mādhava or the Earth at all.

sanskrit_iast:
pūrvamāsīt sa dharmātmā hyārādhitasuro vratī |
adhunā bādhate sarvānāsuraṃ bhāvamāśritaḥ || 51 ||
meaning:
पूर्वमासीत् स धर्मात्मा ह्याराधितसुरो व्रती |
अधुना बाधते सर्वानासुरं भावमाश्रितः || 51 ||
text_mt: Formerly he was righteous, an observer of vows who worshipped the gods; / now, having resorted to a demonic nature, he torments everyone.

sanskrit_iast:
aditeḥ kuṇḍale mohājjahārāmṛtasambhave |
devānṛṣīn bādhamāno viprāṇāmapriye rataḥ || 52 ||
meaning:
अदितेः कुण्डले मोहाज्जहारामृतसम्भवे |
देवानृषीन् बाधमानो विप्राणामप्रिये रतः || 52 ||
text_mt: Out of delusion, he stole the earrings of Aditi, which were produced from nectar; / oppressing the gods and sages, he delights in what is unpleasant to Brahmins.

sanskrit_iast:
māṃ cāpi bādhate nityaṃ kāmagāmī durāsadaḥ |
jetā tu suradaityānāmavadhyaḥ sarvadehinām || 53 ||
meaning:
मां चापि बाधते नित्यं कामगामी दुरासदः |
जेता तु सुरदैत्यानामवध्यः सर्वदेहिनाम् || 53 ||
text_mt: Moving at his own will, unapproachable, he torments me constantly as well; / he is a conqueror of gods and daityas, and cannot be slain by any embodied being.

sanskrit_iast:
tava cāpyantaraprekṣī taṃ pāpaṃ jahi bhūtaye |
tvadarthaṃ sarvadevairyā devagandharvakanyakāḥ || 54 ||
meaning:
तव चाप्यन्तरप्रेक्षी तं पापं जहि भूतये |
त्वदर्थं सर्वदेवैर्या देवगन्धर्वकन्यकाः || 54 ||
text_mt: He also looks for a weakness in you; slay that wicked one for [the world’s] welfare! / For your sake, the maiden daughters of gods and gandharvas,

sanskrit_iast:
purā parvatamukhye tu himavatyavatāritāḥ |
caturdaśa sahasrāṇi sahasre dvai śatādhike || 55 ||
meaning:
पुरा पर्वतमुख्ये तु हिमवत्यवतारिताः |
चतुर्दश सहस्राणि सहस्रे द्वै शताधिके || 55 ||
text_mt: who were brought down by all the gods formerly on Himavat, the foremost of mountains, / fourteen thousand, and two thousand and one hundred more,

sanskrit_iast:
tāḥ sarvāḥ kanyakāḥ pāpaḥ prasahya varadarpitaḥ |
jahāra sa durādharṣo hayagrīvasahāyavān || 56 ||
meaning:
ताः सर्वाः कन्यकाः पापः प्रसह्य वरदर्पितः |
जहार स दुराधर्षो हयग्रीवसहायवान् || 56 ||
text_mt: all those maidens, that wicked, unassailable one, arrogant with boons, / carried off by force, with Hayagrīva as his ally.

sanskrit_iast:
sāgare yāni ratnāni pṛthibhyāṃ ca triviṣṭape |
tāni sarvāṇi saṃhṛtya pramathya suramānuṣān || 57 ||
meaning:
सागरे यानि रत्नानि पृथिभ्यां च त्रिविष्टपे |
तानि सर्वाणि संहृत्य प्रमथ्य सुरमानुषान् || 57 ||
text_mt: Crushing gods and humans, and gathering all the jewels / that were in the ocean, on the earth, and in heaven,

sanskrit_iast:
tīre lauhityatīrthasya so'karonmaṇiparvatam |
tasmin girau purīṃ ramyāṃ kārayitvā'lakāhvayām || 58 ||
meaning:
तीरे लौहित्यतीर्थस्य सोऽकरोन्मणिपर्वतम् |
तस्मिन् गिरौ पुरीं रम्यां कारयित्वाऽलकाह्वयाम् || 58 ||
text_mt: he built the Maṇiparvata on the bank of the Lauhitya sacred ford; / having built on that mountain a charming city named Alakā,

sanskrit_iast:
tāḥ sarvā vāsayāmāsa devagandharvayoṣitaḥ |
ekaveṇīdharāḥ sarvāḥ sambhogaparivarjitāḥ || 59 ||
meaning:
ताः सर्वा वासयामास देवगन्धर्वयोषितः |
एकवेणीधराः सर्वाः सम्भोगपरिवर्जिताः || 59 ||
text_mt: he settled all those women of the gods and gandharvas there; / they all wear a single braid, refraining from sexual union.

sanskrit_iast:
tvāmeva tāḥ pratīkṣante sanāthāḥ kuru kṛṣṇa tāḥ |
yāvadāgacchati puraṃ bhavato nārado muniḥ || 60 ||
meaning:
त्वामेव ताः प्रतीक्षन्ते सनाथाः कुरु कृष्ण ताः |
यावदागच्छति पुरं भवतो नारदो मुनिः || 60 ||
text_mt: They are waiting for you alone: make them [women] with a protector, Kṛṣṇa! / ‘As long as the sage Nārada does not arrive at your city,

sanskrit_iast:
tāvanna maithune yatnaṃ bhauma tvaṃ saṃkariṣyasi |
iti tāḥ samayaṃ cakrurnarakasya durātmanaḥ || 61 ||
meaning:
तावन्न मैथुने यत्नं भौम त्वं संकरिष्यसि |
इति ताः समयं चक्रुर्नरकस्य दुरात्मनः || 61 ||
text_mt: so long you, son of the Earth, shall make no effort for sexual union’— / thus they made an agreement with the evil-minded Naraka.

sanskrit_iast:
nāradaśca tadāyātaḥ prāgjyotiṣapuraṃ prati |
yadā tvaṃ narakaṃ hantuṃ gantā tatpuramuttamam || 62 ||
meaning:
नारदश्च तदायातः प्राग्ज्योतिषपुरं प्रति |
यदा त्वं नरकं हन्तुं गन्ता तत्पुरमुत्तमम् || 62 ||
text_mt: And Nārada came then toward the city of Prāgjyotiṣa / at the time when you are going to go to that excellent city to slay Naraka.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmāt tvaṃ pāpakarmāṇaṃ narakaṃ narakopamam |
jahi devamanuṣyāṇāṃ kaṇṭakaṃ taṃ durāsadam || 63 ||
meaning:
तस्मात् त्वं पापकर्माणं नरकं नरकोपमम् |
जहि देवमनुष्याणां कण्टकं तं दुरासदम् || 63 ||
text_mt: Therefore, slay that evil-doing Naraka, who is like a hell, / that unapproachable thorn in the side of gods and humans!

sanskrit_iast:
badhāt tasya kṣitirdevī putraśokaṃ na cāpsyati |
svayameva vadhaṃ tasya devebhyo yadayācata || 64 ||
meaning:
बधात् तस्य क्षितिर्देवी पुत्रशोकं न चाप्स्यति |
स्वयमेव वधं तस्य देवेभ्यो यदयाचत || 64 ||
text_mt: Goddess Earth will not experience grief for a son from his killing, / since she herself begged the gods for his death.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmāt taṃ jahi pāpiṣṭhaṃ narakaṃ pāpapuruṣam |
strīratnānyapi ratnāni taṃ nihatya samuddhara || 65 ||
meaning:
तस्मात् तं जहि पापिष्ठं नरकं पापपुरुषम् |
स्त्रीरत्नान्यपि रत्नानि तं निहत्य समुद्धर || 65 ||
text_mt: Therefore slay that most wicked one, Naraka, the evil person; / having killed him, deliver the jewels of women as well as the treasures!

sanskrit_iast:
ityukto jagatāṃ nāthaḥ śakreṇa sumahātmanā |
pratijajñe kṣitisutaṃ hantuṃ prati tadaiva hi || 66 ||
meaning:
इत्युक्तो जगतां नाथः शक्रेण सुमहात्मना |
प्रतिजज्ञे क्षितिसुतं हन्तुं प्रति तदैव हि || 66 ||
text_mt: Addressed thus by the great-souled Śakra, the lord of the worlds / then indeed vowed to slay the son of the Earth.

sanskrit_iast:
pratijñāya vadhaṃ tasya śakreṇa saha keśavaḥ |
tadaiva yātrāmakarot prāgjyotiṣapuraṃ prati || 67 ||
meaning:
प्रतिज्ञाय वधं तस्य शक्रेण सह केशवः |
तदैव यात्रामकरोत् प्राग्ज्योतिषपुरं प्रति || 67 ||
text_mt: Having promised his death, Keśava, together with Śakra, / immediately set out toward the city of Prāgjyotiṣa.

sanskrit_iast:
āruhya garuḍaṃ kṛṣṇaḥ satyabhāmādvitīyakaḥ |
prāgjyotiṣamukhoa.gacchadvāsavastridivaṃ yayau || 68 ||
meaning:
आरुह्य गरुडं कृष्णः सत्यभामाद्वितीयकः |
प्राग्ज्योतिषमुखोअ.गच्छद्वासवस्त्रिदिवं ययौ || 68 ||
text_mt: Mounting Garuḍa, accompanied by Satyabhāmā, / Kṛṣṇa set off facing Prāgjyotiṣa, and Vāsava went to heaven.

sanskrit_iast:
divamākramya gacchantau kṛṣṇaśakrau mahādyutī |
yādavā dadṛśustatra sūryācandramasau yathā || 69 ||
meaning:
दिवमाक्रम्य गच्छन्तौ कृष्णशक्रौ महाद्युती |
यादवा ददृशुस्तत्र सूर्याचन्द्रमसौ यथा || 69 ||
text_mt: As Kṛṣṇa and Śakra of great splendour were going, traversing the sky, / the Yādavas saw them there like the sun and the moon.

sanskrit_iast:
saṃstūyamānau gandharvairdevairapsarasāṃ gaṇaiḥ |
kṛṣṇaḥ śakraḥ kṣaṇādeva gatau khe tāvadṛśyatām || 70 ||
meaning:
संस्तूयमानौ गन्धर्वैर्देवैरप्सरसां गणैः |
कृष्णः शक्रः क्षणादेव गतौ खे तावदृश्यताम् || 70 ||
text_mt: Being praised by gandharvas, gods, and hosts of apsarases, / Kṛṣṇa and Śakra became invisible in the sky in an instant.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ kṣaṇena garuḍenāsasāda jagatpatiḥ |
puraṃ prāgjyotiṣaṃ ramyaṃ narakeṇa vaśīkṛtam || 71 ||
meaning:
ततः क्षणेन गरुडेनाससाद जगत्पतिः |
पुरं प्राग्ज्योतिषं रम्यं नरकेण वशीकृतम् || 71 ||
text_mt: Then, in a moment, the lord of the world reached on Garuḍa / the charming city of Prāgjyotiṣa, brought under Naraka's subjugation,

sanskrit_iast:
sa durgaṃ mauravaiḥ pāśaiḥ ṣaṭsahasrairbhayaṅkaraiḥ |
kṣurāntairveṣṭitaṃ pārśve mṛtyupāśairivocchritam || 72 ||
meaning:
स दुर्गं मौरवैः पाशैः षट्सहस्रैर्भयङ्करैः |
क्षुरान्तैर्वेष्टितं पार्श्वे मृत्युपाशैरिवोच्छ्रितम् || 72 ||
text_mt: which was a fortress surrounded on its sides by six thousand dreadful nooses of Muru / edged with razors, raised like the nooses of Death.

sanskrit_iast:
nirgacchantaṃ purāt tasmāt nāradaṃ ca dadarśa saḥ |
sa tu devamuniḥ śrīmān yadāgānnarakaṃ prati || 73 ||
meaning:
निर्गच्छन्तं पुरात् तस्मात् नारदं च ददर्श सः |
स तु देवमुनिः श्रीमान् यदागान्नरकं प्रति || 73 ||
text_mt: And he saw Nārada coming out of that city; / when that glorious divine sage had approached Naraka,

sanskrit_iast:
tadā prāgjyotiṣaṃ gatvā satkṛtastena nāradaḥ |
saṅgame samayaṃ proce narakāya sa yoṣitām || 74 ||
meaning:
तदा प्राग्ज्योतिषं गत्वा सत्कृतस्तेन नारदः |
सङ्गमे समयं प्रोचे नरकाय स योषिताम् || 74 ||
text_mt: having gone to Prāgjyotiṣa then, honoured by him, / Nārada stated to Naraka the proper time for union with the women:

sanskrit_iast:
pravartate'dya caitrasya śuklapakṣasya pañcamī |
navamyāṃ tu dharāputra prāpnosimahadāpadam || 75 ||
meaning:
प्रवर्ततेऽद्य चैत्रस्य शुक्लपक्षस्य पञ्चमी |
नवम्यां तु धरापुत्र प्राप्नोसिमहदापदम् || 75 ||
text_mt: ‘Today is the fifth day of the bright fortnight of Caitra; / on the ninth day, however, son of the Earth, you will encounter a great misfortune.

sanskrit_iast:
tadā yadi caturdaśyāṃ susnātā yoṣitastvimāḥ |
surateṣu tvayā tatra proyoktavyā yathāsukham || 76 ||
meaning:
तदा यदि चतुर्दश्यां सुस्नाता योषितस्त्विमाः |
सुरतेषु त्वया तत्र प्रोयोक्तव्या यथासुखम् || 76 ||
text_mt: Then, if on the fourteenth day these women are well-bathed, / they should be employed by you in lovemaking at that time as you please.’

sanskrit_iast:
nāradasya vacaḥ śrutvā narako bhayamohitaḥ |
āsāraṃ ca prasāraṃ ca nagare sanyaveśayat || 77 ||
meaning:
नारदस्य वचः श्रुत्वा नरको भयमोहितः |
आसारं च प्रसारं च नगरे सन्यवेशयत् || 77 ||
text_mt: Hearing the words of Nārada, Naraka was bewildered by fear; / he stationed both the internal guard and external patrol in the city.

sanskrit_iast:
rakṣibhī rakṣitaṃ rājyaṃ rakṣitaṃ ca samantataḥ |
bhayaharṣayuto bhaumaḥ samayaṃ samavaikṣata || 78 ||
meaning:
रक्षिभी रक्षितं राज्यं रक्षितं च समन्ततः |
भयहर्षयुतो भौमः समयं समवैक्षत || 78 ||
text_mt: The kingdom was protected by guards, guarded on all sides; / filled with fear and joy, the son of the Earth awaited the appointed time.

sanskrit_iast:
tasminnavasare prāpa kṛṣṇaḥ prāgjyotiṣaṃ puram |
prathamaṃ paścimaṃ dvāramāsādya garuḍadhvajaḥ || 79 ||
meaning:
तस्मिन्नवसरे प्राप कृष्णः प्राग्ज्योतिषं पुरम् |
प्रथमं पश्चिमं द्वारमासाद्य गरुडध्वजः || 79 ||
text_mt: At that moment Kṛṣṇa reached the city of Prāgjyotiṣa; / he whose emblem is Garuḍa first reached the western gate.

sanskrit_iast:
pāśānāṃ ṣaṭsahasrāṇi kṣurān sañchidya naikadhā |
jaghāna sa muruṃ daityaṃ sānugaṃ ca sabāndhavam || 80 ||
meaning:
पाशानां षट्सहस्राणि क्षुरान् सञ्छिद्य नैकधा |
जघान स मुरुं दैत्यं सानुगं च सबान्धवम् || 80 ||
text_mt: Having cut the six thousand nooses and the razors in many ways, / he slew the daitya Muru, along with his followers and relatives.

sanskrit_iast:
ṣaṭsahasrā mahāvīrā dānavā dvāri saṃsthitāḥ |
hatāścakreṇa hariṇā tadaiva muruṇā saha || 81 ||
meaning:
षट्सहस्रा महावीरा दानवा द्वारि संस्थिताः |
हताश्चक्रेण हरिणा तदैव मुरुणा सह || 81 ||
text_mt: Six thousand heroic dānavas stationed at the gate / were slain at that very moment along with Muru by Hari with his discus.

sanskrit_iast:
muruṃ hatvā sahasrāṇi putrāṃstasyāparāṃśca ṣaṭ |
jaghāna cakreṇa tadā khaṇḍaśo'nyāṃśca dānavān || 82 ||
meaning:
मुरुं हत्वा सहस्राणि पुत्रांस्तस्यापरांश्च षट् |
जघान चक्रेण तदा खण्डशोऽन्यांश्च दानवान् || 82 ||
text_mt: Having killed Muru, he then slew his other six thousand sons / and other dānavas, cutting them to pieces with his discus.

sanskrit_iast:
tato'nekaśilāsaṃghānatikramya janārdanaḥ |
sagaṇaṃ sānugaṃ caiva nisundaṃ samapothayat || 83 ||
meaning:
ततोऽनेकशिलासंघानतिक्रम्य जनार्दनः |
सगणं सानुगं चैव निसुन्दं समपोथयत् || 83 ||
text_mt: Then, having overcome many heaps of stones, Janārdana / crushed Nisunda, along with his troop and followers.

sanskrit_iast:
eko yo yodhayeddevān sahasraṃ vatsarān purā |
śakraṃ ca samatikramya mahāvīraparākramaḥ || 84 ||
meaning:
एको यो योधयेद्देवान् सहस्रं वत्सरान् पुरा |
शक्रं च समतिक्रम्य महावीरपराक्रमः || 84 ||
text_mt: He who alone previously fought the gods for a thousand years, / surpassing even Śakra, having heroic and great valour—

sanskrit_iast:
taṃ jaghāna hayagrīvaṃ samatikramya keśavaḥ |
madhye lauhityasaṃjñasya bhagavān devakīsutaḥ || 85 ||
meaning:
तं जघान हयग्रीवं समतिक्रम्य केशवः |
मध्ये लौहित्यसंज्ञस्य भगवान् देवकीसुतः || 85 ||
text_mt: surpassing him, the blessed Keśava, the son of Devakī, / slew that Hayagrīva in the midst of the [river] named Lauhitya.

sanskrit_iast:
audakāyāṃ virūpākṣaṃ sundaṃ hatvā mahābalaḥ |
tataḥ pañcajana vīra jaghāna parameśvaraḥ || 86 ||
meaning:
औदकायां विरूपाक्षं सुन्दं हत्वा महाबलः |
ततः पञ्चजन वीर जघान परमेश्वरः || 86 ||
text_mt: Having killed Virūpākṣa and Sunda in water, the mighty one, / the supreme lord, then slew the heroic Pañcajana.

sanskrit_iast:
etān hatvā mahākāyān mahāvīryān durāsadān |
āsasāda jagannāthaḥ pura prāgjyotiṣāhvayam || 87 ||
meaning:
एतान् हत्वा महाकायान् महावीर्यान् दुरासदान् |
आससाद जगन्नाथः पुर प्राग्ज्योतिषाह्वयम् || 87 ||
text_mt: Having slain these huge-bodied, exceedingly valiant, unapproachable ones, / the lord of the universe reached the city named Prāgjyotiṣa.

sanskrit_iast:
viyatsthairdaivataiḥ sarvairnāradena mahātmanā |
jayaśabdaiḥ stūyāmānaḥ praviveśa yatheśvaraḥ || 88 ||
meaning:
वियत्स्थैर्दैवतैः सर्वैर्नारदेन महात्मना |
जयशब्दैः स्तूयामानः प्रविवेश यथेश्वरः || 88 ||
text_mt: Being praised with cries of victory by all the deities stationed in the sky / and by the great-souled Nārada, he entered like a supreme lord.

sanskrit_iast:
śriyā yuktāṃ dīpyamānāṃ prākāśāṭṭālabhūṣitām |
sa mene nagarīṃ viṣṇuḥ kimindrasyāmarāvatī || 89 ||
meaning:
श्रिया युक्तां दीप्यमानां प्राकाशाट्टालभूषिताम् |
स मेने नगरीं विष्णुः किमिन्द्रस्यामरावती || 89 ||
text_mt: Endowed with beauty, blazing, adorned with bright ramparts and watchtowers, / Viṣṇu thought of that city: ‘Is this Indra’s Amarāvatī?’

sanskrit_iast:
tatra yuddhaṃ mahadbhūta nānāpraharaṇodyatam |
bhīrūṇāṃ trāsajananaṃ śūrāṇāṃ harṣavardhanam |
yathā devāsuraṃ yuddhaṃ tathaiva samapadyata || 90 ||
meaning:
तत्र युद्धं महद्भूत नानाप्रहरणोद्यतम् |
भीरूणां त्रासजननं शूराणां हर्षवर्धनम् |
यथा देवासुरं युद्धं तथैव समपद्यत || 90 ||
text_mt: There a great battle took place, raised with various weapons, / causing terror to cowards and swelling the joy of the heroic; / it occurred just like the battle between gods and asuras.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ śārṅga vinirmuktairbāṇaistān dānavān bahūn |
nijaghāna mahābāhurgaruḍastho janārdanaḥ || 91 ||
meaning:
ततः शार्ङ्ग विनिर्मुक्तैर्बाणैस्तान् दानवान् बहून् |
निजघान महाबाहुर्गरुडस्थो जनार्दनः || 91 ||
text_mt: Then the mighty-armed Janārdana, mounted upon Garuḍa, / struck down those many Dānavas with arrows discharged from the Śārṅga bow.

sanskrit_iast:
aṣṭau śatasahasrāṇi aṣṭau śataśatāni ca |
hatvāsurān mahābāhurnarakaṃ taṃ samāsadat || 92 ||
meaning:
अष्टौ शतसहस्राणि अष्टौ शतशतानि च |
हत्वासुरान् महाबाहुर्नरकं तं समासदत् || 92 ||
text_mt: Having slain eight hundred thousand and eighty thousand asuras, / the mighty-armed one approached that Naraka.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ śrutvā sa narakaḥ patitānasurān bahūn |
dṛṣṭvā kṛṣṇaṃ mahābāhuṃ garuḍasthaṃ mahābalam || 93 ||
meaning:
ततः श्रुत्वा स नरकः पतितानसुरान् बहून् |
दृष्ट्वा कृष्णं महाबाहुं गरुडस्थं महाबलम् || 93 ||
text_mt: Then, having heard that many asuras had fallen, / and seeing the mighty-armed, greatly powerful Kṛṣṇa mounted upon Garuḍa,

sanskrit_iast:
vasiṣṭhaśāpaṃ sasmāra samayaṃ mādhavasya ca |
nāradasya vacaścāpi varacchidraṃ tathā vidheḥ || 94 ||
meaning:
वसिष्ठशापं सस्मार समयं माधवस्य च |
नारदस्य वचश्चापि वरच्छिद्रं तथा विधेः || 94 ||
text_mt: Naraka remembered the curse of Vasiṣṭha, and the agreement with Mādhava, / and the words of Nārada, as well as the loophole in Vidhi's boon.

sanskrit_iast:
sa prāptakālaśca tathā keśavena samāgataḥ |
yuddhameva paraṃ mene smaran bāṇavacastadā || 95 ||
meaning:
स प्राप्तकालश्च तथा केशवेन समागतः |
युद्धमेव परं मेने स्मरन् बाणवचस्तदा || 95 ||
text_mt: His time having arrived, thus confronted by Keśava, / he deemed battle alone supreme, remembering the advice of Bāṇa then.

sanskrit_iast:
sa kāñcanaṃ samāruhya rathaṃ vajradhvajaṃ varam |
lauhaścakrāṣṭasaṃyuktaṃ trinalvapramitaṃ ratham || 96 ||
meaning:
स काञ्चनं समारुह्य रथं वज्रध्वजं वरम् |
लौहश्चक्राष्टसंयुक्तं त्रिनल्वप्रमितं रथम् || 96 ||
text_mt: Mounting an excellent golden chariot bearing an adamantine banner, / furnished with eight iron wheels and measuring three nalvas,

sanskrit_iast:
yuktamaśvasahasraistu vajradhvajavirājitam |
nānāpraharaṇopetaṃ bahutūṇīrasaṃyutam |
agacchat samārāyāśu narakaḥ pṛthivīsutaḥ || 97 ||
meaning:
युक्तमश्वसहस्रैस्तु वज्रध्वजविराजितम् |
नानाप्रहरणोपेतं बहुतूणीरसंयुतम् |
अगच्छत् समारायाशु नरकः पृथिवीसुतः || 97 ||
text_mt: yoked to a thousand horses, resplendent with its adamantine banner, / equipped with various weapons and provided with many quivers, / Naraka, the son of the earth, swiftly advanced to battle.

sanskrit_iast:
sa gacchan samarāyāśu mānuṣaṃ bhāvamarcitam |
nindyaṃ tathāsuraṃ mene smaran pūrvavaco hareḥ || 98 ||
meaning:
स गच्छन् समरायाशु मानुषं भावमर्चितम् |
निन्द्यं तथासुरं मेने स्मरन् पूर्ववचो हरेः || 98 ||
text_mt: Advancing quickly to battle, he deemed the human state venerable / and the asura state contemptible, remembering the former words of Hari.

sanskrit_iast:
kṣaṇāt kṛṣṇaṃ sa dadarśa garuḍopari saṃsthitam |
śaṅkhacakragadāśārṅgavarāsidharamacyutam || 99 ||
meaning:
क्षणात् कृष्णं स ददर्श गरुडोपरि संस्थितम् |
शङ्खचक्रगदाशार्ङ्गवरासिधरमच्युतम् || 99 ||
text_mt: In a moment he saw Kṛṣṇa standing upon Garuḍa, / Acyuta bearing the conch, discus, mace, Śārṅga bow, and an excellent sword,

sanskrit_iast:
kirīṭakuṇḍalayutaṃ śrīvatsavakṣasaṃ harim |
kaustubhodbhāsitoraskaṃ pītāmbaradharaṃ param || 100 ||
meaning:
किरीटकुण्डलयुतं श्रीवत्सवक्षसं हरिम् |
कौस्तुभोद्भासितोरस्कं पीताम्बरधरं परम् || 100 ||
text_mt: Hari, adorned with a diadem and earrings, with the Śrīvatsa on his chest, / his chest illuminated by the Kaustubha jewel, wearing yellow garments, supreme.

sanskrit_iast:
sa tena yuyudhe vīro viṣṇunā prabhaviṣṇunā |
prāgjyotiṣādhipo vīro narakaḥ pṛthivīsutaḥ || 101 ||
meaning:
स तेन युयुधे वीरो विष्णुना प्रभविष्णुना |
प्राग्ज्योतिषाधिपो वीरो नरकः पृथिवीसुतः || 101 ||
text_mt: The heroic Naraka, the lord of Prāgjyotiṣa, the son of the earth, / fought with that mighty Viṣṇu.

sanskrit_iast:
sa yudhyat kṛṣṇanikaṭe kālikāṃ kālikopamām |
raktāsyanayanāṃ dīrghāṃ khaḍgaśaktidharā tadā || 102 ||
meaning:
स युध्यत् कृष्णनिकटे कालिकां कालिकोपमाम् |
रक्तास्यनयनां दीर्घां खड्गशक्तिधरा तदा || 102 ||
text_mt: Fighting then near Kṛṣṇa, he [saw] Kālikā, resembling a dark raincloud, / with red mouth and eyes, tall, bearing a sword and a spear;

sanskrit_iast: apaśyajjagatāṃ dhātrīṃ kāmākhyāmapi mohinīm || 103 ||
meaning: अपश्यज्जगतां धात्रीं कामाख्यामपि मोहिनीम् || 103 ||
text_mt: he beheld Kāmākhyā, the enchantress, the supporter of the worlds.

sanskrit_iast:
sa vismitastadā bhītastāṃ dṛṣṭvā jagatāṃ prasūm |
yoddhavyamityeva tadā yuyudhe narako'suraḥ || 104 ||
meaning:
स विस्मितस्तदा भीतस्तां दृष्ट्वा जगतां प्रसूम् |
योद्धव्यमित्येव तदा युयुधे नरकोऽसुरः || 104 ||
text_mt: Astonished and terrified then upon seeing that mother of the worlds, / thinking, “I must fight,” the asura Naraka then fought on.

sanskrit_iast:
tena sārdhaṃ tadā kṛṣṇaḥ kṛtvā sumahadadbhutam |
yuddhaṃ yādṛk purā bhūtaṃ na deve na ca mānuṣe || 105 ||
meaning:
तेन सार्धं तदा कृष्णः कृत्वा सुमहदद्भुतम् |
युद्धं यादृक् पुरा भूतं न देवे न च मानुषे || 105 ||
text_mt: With him Kṛṣṇa then engaged in a wondrous and great battle, / such as had never before occurred among gods or men.

sanskrit_iast:
tatastenātha bhaumena yuddhakeliṃ sa mādhavaḥ |
ciraṃ kṛtvā jaghānātha devendraṃ pratiharṣayan || 106 ||
meaning:
ततस्तेनाथ भौमेन युद्धकेलिं स माधवः |
चिरं कृत्वा जघानाथ देवेन्द्रं प्रतिहर्षयन् || 106 ||
text_mt: Then, having engaged in a long sport of battle with that son of the Earth, / Mādhava slew him, gladdening the king of the gods.

sanskrit_iast:
sudarśanena cakreṇa madhyadeśe tadā hariḥ |
dvidhā ciccheda narakaṃkhaṇḍito'bhyapatad bhuvi || 107 ||
meaning:
सुदर्शनेन चक्रेण मध्यदेशे तदा हरिः |
द्विधा चिच्छेद नरकंखण्डितोऽभ्यपतद् भुवि || 107 ||
text_mt: Hari then cut Naraka in two at the waist / with the Sudarśana discus; cleaved apart, he fell to the earth.

sanskrit_iast:
vibhaktataccharīraṃ tu bhūmau nipatitaṃ tadā |
virājante vajrabhinnau yathā gaurikaparvataḥ || 108 ||
meaning:
विभक्ततच्छरीरं तु भूमौ निपतितं तदा |
विराजन्ते वज्रभिन्नौ यथा गौरिकपर्वतः || 108 ||
text_mt: His divided body, having fallen to the ground then, / shone like the Gaurika mountain split by the thunderbolt.

sanskrit_iast:
patite tanaye devī pṛthvī dṛṣṭvā śarīrakam |
śokavegaṃ tadā sehe jñātvā kālaṃ tadāgatam || 109 ||
meaning:
पतिते तनये देवी पृथ्वी दृष्ट्वा शरीरकम् |
शोकवेगं तदा सेहे ज्ञात्वा कालं तदागतम् || 109 ||
text_mt: Her son having fallen, the goddess Earth, seeing his body, / then endured the surge of grief, knowing that his time had arrived.

sanskrit_iast:
aditeḥ kuṇḍalayugaṃ svayamādāya kāśyapī |
upātiṣṭhata govindaṃ vacanaṃ cedamabravīt || 110 ||
meaning:
अदितेः कुण्डलयुगं स्वयमादाय काश्यपी |
उपातिष्ठत गोविन्दं वचनं चेदमब्रवीत् || 110 ||
text_mt: Kāśyapī, taking Aditi’s pair of earrings herself, / approached Govinda and spoke these words:

sanskrit_iast: pṛthivyuvāca
meaning: पृथिव्युवाच

sanskrit_iast:
tvayā varāharūpeṇa yadāhaṃ coddhṛtā purā |
tadā tvadgātrasaṃsparśāt putro me narakaḥ sthitaḥ |
so'yaṃ tvayā pālitaśca pātitaścādhunā sutaḥ || 111 ||
meaning:
त्वया वराहरूपेण यदाहं चोद्धृता पुरा |
तदा त्वद्गात्रसंस्पर्शात् पुत्रो मे नरकः स्थितः |
सोऽयं त्वया पालितश्च पातितश्चाधुना सुतः || 111 ||
text_mt: “When I was formerly raised up by you in the form of the Boar, / then through the contact with your limbs my son Naraka came to be; / that very son was protected by you, and now has been felled by you.

sanskrit_iast:
gṛhāṇa kuṇḍale ceme aditeḥ sarvakāmade |
santatiṃ cāsya govinda pratipālaya nityadā || 112 ||
meaning:
गृहाण कुण्डले चेमे अदितेः सर्वकामदे |
सन्ततिं चास्य गोविन्द प्रतिपालय नित्यदा || 112 ||
text_mt: Take these two earrings of Aditi, which grant all desires, / and constantly protect his lineage, O Govinda!”

sanskrit_iast: śrībhagavānuvāca
meaning: श्रीभगवानुवाच

sanskrit_iast:
bhārāvataraṇe devi narakasya vadhaḥ purāḥ |
tvayaiva prārthito yasmāt tenāsau nihato mayā || 113 ||
meaning:
भारावतरणे देवि नरकस्य वधः पुराः |
त्वयैव प्रार्थितो यस्मात् तेनासौ निहतो मया || 113 ||
text_mt: [The Lord said:] “O goddess, the slaying of Naraka was formerly requested by you yourself / for the removal of the earth’s burden; therefore he has been slain by me.

sanskrit_iast:
pālayiṣye'sya santānaṃ devi tvadvacanādaham |
prāgjyotiṣe'bhiṣekṣyāmi naptāraṃ bhagadattakam || 114 ||
meaning:
पालयिष्येऽस्य सन्तानं देवि त्वद्वचनादहम् |
प्राग्ज्योतिषेऽभिषेक्ष्यामि नप्तारं भगदत्तकम् || 114 ||
text_mt: I shall protect his lineage, O goddess, at your word; / I will consecrate his grandson Bhagadatta in Prāgjyotiṣa.”

sanskrit_iast:
evamuktvā mahābāhurbhagavān madhusūdanaḥ |
antaḥpuraṃ viveśāstha narakasya dhanālayam || 115 ||
meaning:
एवमुक्त्वा महाबाहुर्भगवान् मधुसूदनः |
अन्तःपुरं विवेशास्थ नरकस्य धनालयम् || 115 ||
text_mt: Having spoken thus, the mighty-armed Lord, the slayer of Madhu, / entered the inner quarters, the treasury of Naraka.

sanskrit_iast:
sa tatra dadṛśe vīro ratnāni vividhāni ca |
rāśībhūtāni śuddhāni parvatāniva rājataḥ || 116 ||
meaning:
स तत्र ददृशे वीरो रत्नानि विविधानि च |
राशीभूतानि शुद्धानि पर्वतानिव राजतः || 116 ||
text_mt: There the hero saw various jewels, / piled up and pure, shining like mountains;

sanskrit_iast:
muktāmaṇipravālānāṃ vaidūryasya ca parvatam |
tathā rajatakūṭāni vajrakūṭāni mādhavaḥ || 117 ||
meaning:
मुक्तामणिप्रवालानां वैदूर्यस्य च पर्वतम् |
तथा रजतकूटानि वज्रकूटानि माधवः || 117 ||
text_mt: Mādhava [saw] a mountain of pearls, gems, and corals, and of lapis lazuli, / as well as heaps of silver and heaps of diamonds;

sanskrit_iast:
suvarṇasañcayān rukmadaṇḍān ratnamayadhvajān |
vāhanāni vicitrāṇi yānāni śayanāni ca || 118 ||
meaning:
सुवर्णसञ्चयान् रुक्मदण्डान् रत्नमयध्वजान् |
वाहनानि विचित्राणि यानानि शयनानि च || 118 ||
text_mt: masses of gold, golden rods, banners made of jewels, / various conveyances, vehicles, and beds,

sanskrit_iast:
khacitāni svarṇaratnairmahārhāṇi mahānti ca |
yad yad dṛṣṭaṃ ca yāvacca dhanaṃ ratnaṃ maṇistathā || 119 ||
meaning:
खचितानि स्वर्णरत्नैर्महार्हाणि महान्ति च |
यद् यद् दृष्टं च यावच्च धनं रत्नं मणिस्तथा || 119 ||
text_mt: inlaid with gold and jewels, immensely valuable and great. / Whatever and however much wealth, jewel, or gem was seen,

sanskrit_iast:
bhuvi tādṛk ca no dṛṣṭamanyatra narakālayāt |
na kuberasya narendrasya na yamasyāpyapāṃ pateḥ || 120 ||
meaning:
भुवि तादृक् च नो दृष्टमन्यत्र नरकालयात् |
न कुबेरस्य नरेन्द्रस्य न यमस्याप्यपां पतेः || 120 ||
text_mt: the like was never seen on earth elsewhere than in Naraka’s abode; / not Kubera, nor the lord of men, nor Yama, nor the lord of waters [possessed]

sanskrit_iast:
tāvanti dhanaratnāni yāvanti narakālaye |
keśavo'pyatha tatraiva nāradena ca saṃgataḥ || 121 ||
meaning:
तावन्ति धनरत्नानि यावन्ति नरकालये |
केशवोऽप्यथ तत्रैव नारदेन च संगतः || 121 ||
text_mt: as much wealth and jewels as there were in Naraka's abode. / Then Keśava, joined there by Nārada,

sanskrit_iast:
avekṣyāntaḥpuradhanaṃ sāraṃ sārataraṃ tataḥ |
teṣāṃ samādade grāhyaṃ prabhūtaṃ paravīrahā || 122 ||
meaning:
अवेक्ष्यान्तःपुरधनं सारं सारतरं ततः |
तेषां समाददे ग्राह्यं प्रभूतं परवीरहा || 122 ||
text_mt: inspected the wealth of the inner quarters, and from that, the essence and the finest essence; / the slayer of enemy heroes took an abundance of what was to be taken.

sanskrit_iast:
yā dattā vaiṣṇavīśaktirviṣṇunā prabhaviṣṇunā |
hatvā bhaumaṃ tu tāṃ śaktiṃ jagṛhe devakīsutaḥ || 123 ||
meaning:
या दत्ता वैष्णवीशक्तिर्विष्णुना प्रभविष्णुना |
हत्वा भौमं तु तां शक्तिं जगृहे देवकीसुतः || 123 ||
text_mt: Having slain the son of the Earth, the son of Devakī took back / that Vaiṣṇavī spear which had been given by the mighty Viṣṇu.

sanskrit_iast:
pṛthivyā nāradenaiva sahitaḥ keśavastadā |
bhagadattaṃ bhaumasutaṃ prāgjyotiṣapurottame || 124 ||
meaning:
पृथिव्या नारदेनैव सहितः केशवस्तदा |
भगदत्तं भौमसुतं प्राग्ज्योतिषपुरोत्तमे || 124 ||
text_mt: Together with the Earth and Nārada, Keśava then, / having consecrated Bhagadatta, the son of the son of the Earth, as king

sanskrit_iast:
abhiṣicya tadā bhūpaṃ puramadhye nyaveśayat |
abhiṣiktaṃ tu tāṃ dṛṣṭvā bhagadattaṃ tadā kṣitiḥ || 125 ||
meaning:
अभिषिच्य तदा भूपं पुरमध्ये न्यवेशयत् |
अभिषिक्तं तु तां दृष्ट्वा भगदत्तं तदा क्षितिः || 125 ||
text_mt: in the excellent city of Prāgjyotiṣa, established him within the city. / Seeing that Bhagadatta consecrated,

sanskrit_iast:
napturarthe'tha tāṃ śaktiṃ keśavaṃ samayācata |
keśavo'pi kṣitervākyānnāradānumatena ca |
tāṃ śaktiṃ bhagadattāya suprītamanasā dadau || 126 ||
meaning:
नप्तुरर्थेऽथ तां शक्तिं केशवं समयाचत |
केशवोऽपि क्षितेर्वाक्यान्नारदानुमतेन च |
तां शक्तिं भगदत्ताय सुप्रीतमनसा ददौ || 126 ||
text_mt: the Earth then begged Keśava for that spear for the sake of her grandson. / At the word of the Earth and with the consent of Nārada, / Keśava too gave that spear to Bhagadatta with a well-pleased mind.

sanskrit_iast:
yacchatraṃ varuṇaṃ jitvā kāñcanasrāvisaṃjñakam |
samānayat purā bhaumastacchastraṃ harirādade || 127 ||
meaning:
यच्छत्रं वरुणं जित्वा काञ्चनस्राविसंज्ञकम् |
समानयत् पुरा भौमस्तच्छस्त्रं हरिराददे || 127 ||
text_mt: The umbrella named Kāñcanasrāvī, which the son of the Earth had formerly brought / after conquering Varuṇa—Hari took that weapon [and canopy],

sanskrit_iast:
aṣṭabhārasuvarṇāni yatsaṃsravati cānvaham |
yat krośamātravistīrṇamardhayojanamucchritam || 128 ||
meaning:
अष्टभारसुवर्णानि यत्संस्रवति चान्वहम् |
यत् क्रोशमात्रविस्तीर्णमर्धयोजनमुच्छ्रितम् || 128 ||
text_mt: which continually pours forth eight bhāras of gold, / and which is a krośa wide and half a yojana high.

sanskrit_iast:
ratnottamāni sarvāṇi caturdantāṃstathā gajān |
caturdaśasahasrāṇi pūjitāḥ pramadāstathā || 129 ||
meaning:
रत्नोत्तमानि सर्वाणि चतुर्दन्तांस्तथा गजान् |
चतुर्दशसहस्राणि पूजिताः प्रमदास्तथा || 129 ||
text_mt: All the finest jewels, four-tusked elephants, / and fourteen thousand honoured maidens,

sanskrit_iast: dvārakāṃ prati daityaughairvāhayāmāsa keśavaḥ || 130 ||
meaning: द्वारकां प्रति दैत्यौघैर्वाहयामास केशवः || 130 ||
text_mt: Keśava had transported toward Dvārakā by hosts of Daityas.

sanskrit_iast:
tā devakanyakāḥ pūrvaṃ narakeṇa hṛtā balāt |
tāsāṃ kṛtvā hṛṣīkeśo veṇībandhavimokṣaṇam || 131 ||
meaning:
ता देवकन्यकाः पूर्वं नरकेण हृता बलात् |
तासां कृत्वा हृषीकेशो वेणीबन्धविमोक्षणम् || 131 ||
text_mt: Those daughters of the gods, who had formerly been abducted by force by Naraka— / Hṛṣīkeśa, having untied the braided hair of those [maidens],

sanskrit_iast:
vāsobhirbhūṣaṇerdivyaistāḥ satkṛtya muhurmuhuḥ |
āropya ca vimāne tu rakṣibhirbalibhirdṛḍhaiḥ || 132 ||
meaning:
वासोभिर्भूषणेर्दिव्यैस्ताः सत्कृत्य मुहुर्मुहुः |
आरोप्य च विमाने तु रक्षिभिर्बलिभिर्दृढैः || 132 ||
text_mt: and honoured them repeatedly with divine garments and ornaments, / placed them on a celestial chariot, guarded by strong, mighty guardians;

sanskrit_iast:
nāradādhiṣṭhitāḥ sarvā dvārakāṃ pratyavāhayat |
yaḥ kṛtaḥ surakanyārthe bhaumena maṇiparvataḥ || 133 ||
meaning:
नारदाधिष्ठिताः सर्वा द्वारकां प्रत्यवाहयत् |
यः कृतः सुरकन्यार्थे भौमेन मणिपर्वतः || 133 ||
text_mt: supervised by Nārada, he had all of them conveyed toward Dvārakā, / along with the jewelled mountain that had been made by the son of the Earth for the daughters of the gods.

sanskrit_iast:
maṇiratnaughasampūrṇo divākrasamaprabhaḥ |
utpāṭya taṃ jagannāthastārkṣapṛṣṭhe nyadhāpyat || 134 ||
meaning:
मणिरत्नौघसम्पूर्णो दिवाक्रसमप्रभः |
उत्पाट्य तं जगन्नाथस्तार्क्षपृष्ठे न्यधाप्यत् || 134 ||
text_mt: Uprooting that mountain of jewels, filled with masses of gems and pearls / and shining with the brilliance of the sun, the Lord of the World had it placed upon Garuḍa's back.

sanskrit_iast:
tathaiva vāruṇaṃ chatraṃ garuḍopari mādhavaḥ |
āropya satyayā sārdhamāsīnaḥ sumanā hariḥ || 135 ||
meaning:
तथैव वारुणं छत्रं गरुडोपरि माधवः |
आरोप्य सत्यया सार्धमासीनः सुमना हरिः || 135 ||
text_mt: Likewise, having placed Varuṇa's parasol upon Garuḍa, / Mādhava, glad at heart, sat together with Satyā.

sanskrit_iast:
bhagadattaṃ samābhāṣya pṛthivīṃ ca jagatpatiḥ |
pratasthe dvārakāṃ vīro viyanmārgeṇa vai drutam || 136 ||
meaning:
भगदत्तं समाभाष्य पृथिवीं च जगत्पतिः |
प्रतस्थे द्वारकां वीरो वियन्मार्गेण वै द्रुतम् || 136 ||
text_mt: Having spoken to Bhagadatta and to the Earth, the Lord of the World, / the hero, departed quickly toward Dvārakā by the sky-path.

sanskrit_iast:
suvarṇaṃ kāñcanasrāvicchatraṃ samaṇiparvatam |
keśavaṃ satyayā sārdha helayā khe vahan yayau || 137 ||
meaning:
सुवर्णं काञ्चनस्राविच्छत्रं समणिपर्वतम् |
केशवं सत्यया सार्ध हेलया खे वहन् ययौ || 137 ||
text_mt: Bearing the gold, the parasol showering gold together with the mountain of jewels, / and Keśava with Satyā, he flew effortlessly through the sky.

sanskrit_iast:
kṣaṇena dvārakāṃ prāpya keśavaḥ paravīrahā |
mudaṃ ca lebhe sakalairvāndhavaiśca tathā gaṇaiḥ || 138 ||
meaning:
क्षणेन द्वारकां प्राप्य केशवः परवीरहा |
मुदं च लेभे सकलैर्वान्धवैश्च तथा गणैः || 138 ||
text_mt: Reaching Dvārakā in an instant, Keśava, slayer of enemy heroes, / found joy together with all his kinsmen and his hosts.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ kālī mahāmāyā kālikākhyā jaganmayī |
viṣṇuṃ ca jagatāṃ nāthaṃ parāparapatiṃ harim || 139 ||
meaning:
एवं काली महामाया कालिकाख्या जगन्मयी |
विष्णुं च जगतां नाथं परापरपतिं हरिम् || 139 ||
text_mt: In this way Kālī, the Mahāmāyā known as Kālikā, consisting of the universe, / completely bewitches Viṣṇu, the Lord of the worlds, Hari, master of the high and the low,

sanskrit_iast:
jagatkāraṇakartāraṃ jñānagamayaṃ jaganmayam |
sanmohayatyeva tathā hyanurāgavirāgavān || 140 ||
meaning:
जगत्कारणकर्तारं ज्ञानगमयं जगन्मयम् |
सन्मोहयत्येव तथा ह्यनुरागविरागवान् || 140 ||
text_mt: the agent of the cause of the universe, attainable by wisdom, consisting of the universe, / who has [thus] become subject to passion and dispassion.

sanskrit_iast:
anugṛhṇāti mitrāṇi hyamitrāṇi nihanti ca |
nārīṣu mūḍho ramate dvandvenāpi ca muhyate || 141 ||
meaning:
अनुगृह्णाति मित्राणि ह्यमित्राणि निहन्ति च |
नारीषु मूढो रमते द्वन्द्वेनापि च मुह्यते || 141 ||
text_mt: He shows favor to friends and slays enemies; / infatuated, he delights in women and is deluded by the pairs of opposites.

sanskrit_iast:
iti vaḥ kathitaṃ viprā yathābhūnnarako'suraḥ |
yathā ca varalābho'bhūd yathā cāsya viceṣṭitam || 142 ||
meaning:
इति वः कथितं विप्रा यथाभून्नरकोऽसुरः |
यथा च वरलाभोऽभूद् यथा चास्य विचेष्टितम् || 142 ||
text_mt: Thus it has been related to you, O brahmins, how the asura Naraka came to be, / how he obtained his boons, and what his deeds were;

sanskrit_iast:
ārādhito yathā brahma bāṇabuddhyātha bhauminā |
kimanyaducitaṃ vāsti tadbruvantu dvijottamāḥ || 143 ||
meaning:
आराधितो यथा ब्रह्म बाणबुद्ध्याथ भौमिना |
किमन्यदुचितं वास्ति तद्ब्रुवन्तु द्विजोत्तमाः || 143 ||
text_mt: and how Brahmā was propitiated by the son of the Earth through the counsel of Bāṇa. / What else is fitting [to hear]? Speak, O best of the twice-born!

sanskrit_iast: iti śrīkālikāpurāṇe narakopākhyāne catvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 40 ||
meaning: इति श्रीकालिकापुराणे नरकोपाख्याने चत्वारिंशोऽध्यायः || 40 ||
text_mt: Thus ends the fortieth chapter in the glorious Kālikāpurāṇa, in the story of Naraka.

sanskrit_iast: ekacatvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ
meaning: एकचत्वारिंशोऽध्यायः
text_mt: Chapter Forty-One

sanskrit_iast: ṛṣaya ūcuḥ
meaning: ऋषय ऊचुः

sanskrit_iast:
kathaṃ girisutā kālī babhūva jagatāṃ prasūḥ |
dākṣāyaṇī tyaktatanuḥ kathamāpa haraṃ patim || 1 ||
meaning:
कथं गिरिसुता काली बभूव जगतां प्रसूः |
दाक्षायणी त्यक्ततनुः कथमाप हरं पतिम् || 1 ||
text_mt: How did Kālī, the daughter of the mountain, become the mother of the worlds? / How did Dakṣa's daughter, having cast off her body, gain Hara as her husband?

sanskrit_iast:
kathamardhaśarīraṃ sā jahāra ca piṇākinaḥ |
etannaḥ pṛcchatāṃ samyak kathayasva mahāmate || 2 ||
meaning:
कथमर्धशरीरं सा जहार च पिणाकिनः |
एतन्नः पृच्छतां सम्यक् कथयस्व महामते || 2 ||
text_mt: And how did she take half the body of the wielder of the Pināka? / Tell this to us who ask, in full, O high-minded one!

sanskrit_iast: mārkaṇḍeya uvāca
meaning: मार्कण्डेय उवाच

sanskrit_iast:
śṛṇudhvaṃ muniśārdūlā yathā dākṣāyaṇī satī |
bhūtā girisutā pūrvaṃ yathārdhamaharattanum || 3 ||
meaning:
शृणुध्वं मुनिशार्दूला यथा दाक्षायणी सती |
भूता गिरिसुता पूर्वं यथार्धमहरत्तनुम् || 3 ||
text_mt: Listen, O tigers among sages, how Dakṣa's daughter Satī / previously became the mountain's daughter, and how she took half his body.

sanskrit_iast:
yadā'tyajattanuṃ devī pūrvaṃ dākṣāyaṇī satī |
tadaiva manasāgacchan menakāṃ himavadgirim || 4 ||
meaning:
यदाऽत्यजत्तनुं देवी पूर्वं दाक्षायणी सती |
तदैव मनसागच्छन् मेनकां हिमवद्गिरिम् || 4 ||
text_mt: When the goddess Satī, Dakṣa's daughter, previously abandoned her body, / she immediately went in thought to Menakā and the Himavat mountain.

sanskrit_iast:
yadā hareṇa sahitā dakṣakanyā himācale |
cikrīḍa ca tadā tasyā menakā'bhūd hitaiṣiṇī || 5 ||
meaning:
यदा हरेण सहिता दक्षकन्या हिमाचले |
चिक्रीड च तदा तस्या मेनकाऽभूद् हितैषिणी || 5 ||
text_mt: When Dakṣa's daughter sported together with Hara on the Himālaya, / Menakā had then become well-wishing toward her.

sanskrit_iast:
asyāḥ sutā syāmiti ca ādhāya manasi dvijāḥ |
tyaktaprāṇā tadā devī bhūtā himavataḥ sutā || 6 ||
meaning:
अस्याः सुता स्यामिति च आधाय मनसि द्विजाः |
त्यक्तप्राणा तदा देवी भूता हिमवतः सुता || 6 ||
text_mt: Resolving in her mind, “May I become her daughter,” O twice-born, / the goddess, having cast off her life-breaths, then became the daughter of Himavat.

sanskrit_iast:
yadā dākṣāyaṇī prāṇān dakṣakopājjahau purā |
tadaiva menakā devī ārirādhayiṣuḥ śivam || 7 ||
meaning:
यदा दाक्षायणी प्राणान् दक्षकोपाज्जहौ पुरा |
तदैव मेनका देवी आरिराधयिषुः शिवम् || 7 ||
text_mt: When Dakṣa's daughter formerly gave up her life out of anger at Dakṣa, / at that very time Queen Menakā, desiring to propitiate Śiva,

sanskrit_iast:
mahāmāyāṃ jagaddhātrīṃ yoganidrāṃ sanātanīm |
mohinīṃ sarvabhūtānāṃ śaraṇaṃ sarvanākinām || 8 ||
meaning:
महामायां जगद्धात्रीं योगनिद्रां सनातनीम् |
मोहिनीं सर्वभूतानां शरणं सर्वनाकिनाम् || 8 ||
text_mt: Mahāmāyā, supporter of the world, eternal Yoganidrā, / deluder of all beings, refuge of all gods,

sanskrit_iast:
aṣṭamyāmupavāsaṃ tu kṛtvā sā navamītithau |
modakairvalibhiḥ piṣṭaiḥ pāyasairgandhapuṣpakaiḥ || 9 ||
meaning:
अष्टम्यामुपवासं तु कृत्वा सा नवमीतिथौ |
मोदकैर्वलिभिः पिष्टैः पायसैर्गन्धपुष्पकैः || 9 ||
text_mt: fasted on the eighth day, and on the ninth lunar day / with sweetmeats, offerings, flour cakes, milk-rice, fragrances, and flowers,

sanskrit_iast:
caitre māsi samārabhya saptaviṃśativāsarān |
yāvat sampūjayāmāsa putrārthinyanvahaṃ śuciḥ || 10 ||
meaning:
चैत्रे मासि समारभ्य सप्तविंशतिवासरान् |
यावत् सम्पूजयामास पुत्रार्थिन्यन्वहं शुचिः || 10 ||
text_mt: beginning in the month of Caitra for twenty-seven days, / she worshipped daily, purified and desiring a daughter.

sanskrit_iast:
gaṅgāyāmoṣadhipraśe kṛtvā mūrtiṃ mahīmayīm |
kadācit sā nirāhārā kadācit sā dhṛtavratā || 11 ||
meaning:
गङ्गायामोषधिप्रशे कृत्वा मूर्तिं महीमयीम् |
कदाचित् सा निराहारा कदाचित् सा धृतव्रता || 11 ||
text_mt: Having fashioned an earthen image at Oṣadhiprastha on the Gaṅgā, / sometimes fasting, sometimes observing vows,

sanskrit_iast:
śivāvinyastamanasā saptaviṃśativatsarān |
nināya menakā devī paramāṃ bhūtimicchatī || 12 ||
meaning:
शिवाविन्यस्तमनसा सप्तविंशतिवत्सरान् |
निनाय मेनका देवी परमां भूतिमिच्छती || 12 ||
text_mt: with her mind fixed upon Śivā, Queen Menakā spent twenty-seven years, / desiring the highest prosperity.

sanskrit_iast:
saptaviṃśativarṣānte jaganmātā jaganmayī |
suprītā'bhavadatyarthaṃ prāha pratyakṣatāṃ gatā || 13 ||
meaning:
सप्तविंशतिवर्षान्ते जगन्माता जगन्मयी |
सुप्रीताऽभवदत्यर्थं प्राह प्रत्यक्षतां गता || 13 ||
text_mt: At the end of the twenty-seven years, the mother of the world, consisting of the universe, / was exceedingly pleased, and appearing visibly before her, said:

sanskrit_iast: devyuvāca
meaning: देव्युवाच

sanskrit_iast:
yat prārthitaṃ tvayā devi mattastatprārthayādhunā |
dāsye tavāhaṃ tatsarvaṃ vāñchitaṃ yad hṛdā bhavet || 14 ||
meaning:
यत् प्रार्थितं त्वया देवि मत्तस्तत्प्रार्थयाधुना |
दास्ये तवाहं तत्सर्वं वाञ्छितं यद् हृदा भवेत् || 14 ||
text_mt: Whatever has been desired by you from me, O queen, ask for that now! / I shall grant you all that is wished in your heart.

sanskrit_iast: mārkaṇḍeya uvāca
meaning: मार्कण्डेय उवाच

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ sā menakā devī pratyakṣaṃ kālikāṃ gatām |
dṛṣṭvaiva praṇanāmātha vacanaṃ cedamabravīt || 15 ||
meaning:
ततः सा मेनका देवी प्रत्यक्षं कालिकां गताम् |
दृष्ट्वैव प्रणनामाथ वचनं चेदमब्रवीत् || 15 ||
text_mt: Then Queen Menakā, seeing Kālikā who had appeared visibly before her, / bowed down and spoke these words:

sanskrit_iast:
devī pratyakṣato rūpaṃ tava dṛṣṭaṃ mayā'dhunā |
tvāmahaṃ stotumicchāmi prasannā yadi me śive || 16 ||
meaning:
देवी प्रत्यक्षतो रूपं तव दृष्टं मयाऽधुना |
त्वामहं स्तोतुमिच्छामि प्रसन्ना यदि मे शिवे || 16 ||
text_mt: “O goddess, your form has now been seen by me face to face. / I wish to praise you, if you are pleased with me, O Śivā!”

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ sā mātarityuktvā kālikā sarvamohinī |
bāhubhyāṃ cāruvṛttābhyāṃ menakāṃ pariṣasvaje || 17 ||
meaning:
ततः सा मातरित्युक्त्वा कालिका सर्वमोहिनी |
बाहुभ्यां चारुवृत्ताभ्यां मेनकां परिषस्वजे || 17 ||
text_mt: Then Kālikā, deluder of all, saying “O mother!”, / embraced Menakā with both her beautifully rounded arms.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ sā menakā devī kālikāṃ parameśvarīm |
tuṣṭāva vāgbhiriṣṭābhiḥ śivāṃ pratyakṣataḥ sthitām || 18 ||
meaning:
ततः सा मेनका देवी कालिकां परमेश्वरीम् |
तुष्टाव वाग्भिरिष्टाभिः शिवां प्रत्यक्षतः स्थिताम् || 18 ||
text_mt: Then Queen Menakā praised the supreme ruler Kālikā, / Śivā who stood visibly before her, with favored words.

sanskrit_iast: menakovāca
meaning: मेनकोवाच

sanskrit_iast:
prerayantīṃ jagaddhāma caṇḍikāṃ lokadhāriṇīm |
praṇamāmi jagaddhātrīṃ sarvakāmārthasādhinīm || 19 ||
meaning:
प्रेरयन्तीं जगद्धाम चण्डिकां लोकधारिणीम् |
प्रणमामि जगद्धात्रीं सर्वकामार्थसाधिनीम् || 19 ||
text_mt: I bow to the supporter of the world, Caṇḍikā who upholds the realms, / the impeller of the cosmic dwelling, who fulfills all desires and aims.

sanskrit_iast:
ityānandāṃ jñānamayīṃ yoganidrāṃ jagatprasūm |
praṇamāmi śivāṃ śuddhāṃ vidhiśauriśivātmikām || 20 ||
meaning:
इत्यानन्दां ज्ञानमयीं योगनिद्रां जगत्प्रसूम् |
प्रणमामि शिवां शुद्धां विधिशौरिशिवात्मिकाम् || 20 ||
text_mt: I bow to Śivā, pure, consisting of bliss and wisdom, Yoganidrā, mother of the world, / whose self is Vidhi, Śauri, and Śiva.

sanskrit_iast:
māyāmayīṃ mahāmāyāṃ bhaktaśokavināśinīm |
kāmasya vanitaṃ bhadrāṃ namāmi tvāṃ citti śivām || 21 ||
meaning:
मायामयीं महामायां भक्तशोकविनाशिनीम् |
कामस्य वनितं भद्रां नमामि त्वां चित्ति शिवाम् || 21 ||
text_mt: Composed of Māyā, Mahāmāyā, destroyer of her devotees’ grief, / beloved of Kāma, auspicious one, I bow to you, pure consciousness, Śivā!

sanskrit_iast:
sattvodrekād yā bhavitrīha nityā
nityā cāpi prāṇināṃ buddhirūpā |
sā tvaṃ bandhacchedaheturyatīnāṃ
kaste gadyo mādṛśībhiḥ prabhāvaḥ || 22 ||
meaning:
सत्त्वोद्रेकाद् या भवित्रीह नित्या
नित्या चापि प्राणिनां बुद्धिरूपा |
सा त्वं बन्धच्छेदहेतुर्यतीनां
कस्ते गद्यो मादृशीभिः प्रभावः || 22 ||
text_mt: You who, from the excess of sattva, are eternal here, / and are the eternal form of intellect in living beings; / you are the cause of severing bondage for ascetics: / how can your majesty be described in words by women like me?

sanskrit_iast:
yā tvaṃ sāmnāṃ siddhirukthistathārcā
yā vṛttiryā yajuṣāṃ dīrgharūpā |
hiṃsā yā vā'tharvavedasya sā tvaṃ
nityaṃ kāmaṃ tvaṃ mameṣta vidhehi || 23 ||
meaning:
या त्वं साम्नां सिद्धिरुक्थिस्तथार्चा
या वृत्तिर्या यजुषां दीर्घरूपा |
हिंसा या वाऽथर्ववेदस्य सा त्वं
नित्यं कामं त्वं ममेष्त विधेहि || 23 ||
text_mt: You who are the siddhi of the Sāmans, the Uktha and the Ṛc, / who are the meter, who are the extensive form of the Yajuses, / or who are the violence of the Atharvaveda—that is you; / grant my cherished desire forever!

sanskrit_iast:
nityānityarbhāgahīnaiḥ purasthai stanmātrairyairyatyate bhūtavargaḥ |
teṣāṃ śaktistvaṃ sadā nityarūpā
kā te yoṣā yogyaṃ vaktuṃ samarthā || 24 ||
meaning:
नित्यानित्यर्भागहीनैः पुरस्थै स्तन्मात्रैर्यैर्यत्यते भूतवर्गः |
तेषां शक्तिस्त्वं सदा नित्यरूपा
का ते योषा योग्यं वक्तुं समर्था || 24 ||
text_mt: By which indivisible, present tanmātras, eternal and non-eternal, / the collection of elements is controlled— / you are their ever-eternal power: / what woman is capable of speaking [praise] worthy of you?

sanskrit_iast:
kṣitirdharitrī jagatāṃ tvameva
tvameva nityā prakṛtisvarūpā |
yayā vaśaḥ kriyate brahmarūpaḥ
sā tvaṃ nityā me prasīdāstu mātaḥ || 25 ||
meaning:
क्षितिर्धरित्री जगतां त्वमेव
त्वमेव नित्या प्रकृतिस्वरूपा |
यया वशः क्रियते ब्रह्मरूपः
सा त्वं नित्या मे प्रसीदास्तु मातः || 25 ||
text_mt: You alone are the earth, the supporter of the worlds; / you alone are the eternal nature of Prakṛti, / by whom he whose form is Brahman is brought under control. / That very eternal one are you; be gracious to me, O Mother!

sanskrit_iast:
tvaṃ jātavedogataśaktirūpā tvaṃ dāhikā sūryakarasya śaktiḥ |
āhlādikā tvaṃ bahu candrikāyā-
stāṃ tāmahaṃ staumi namāmi cāmbikām || 26 ||
meaning:
त्वं जातवेदोगतशक्तिरूपा त्वं दाहिका सूर्यकरस्य शक्तिः |
आह्लादिका त्वं बहु चन्द्रिकाया-
स्तां तामहं स्तौमि नमामि चाम्बिकाम् || 26 ||
text_mt: You are the form of power residing in fire; you are the burning power of the sun’s ray; / you are the abundant delighting power of moonlight; / to that Ambikā I offer praise and bow down.

sanskrit_iast:
yoṣā yoṣitpriyāṇāṃ tvaṃ vidyā tvaṃ cordhva retasām |
vāñchā tvaṃ sarvajagatāṃ māyā ca tvaṃ tathā hareḥ || 27 ||
meaning:
योषा योषित्प्रियाणां त्वं विद्या त्वं चोर्ध्व रेतसाम् |
वाञ्छा त्वं सर्वजगतां माया च त्वं तथा हरेः || 27 ||
text_mt: You are woman to those who cherish women; you are wisdom to those of upward-drawn seed; / you are the desire of all worlds, and you are the Māyā of Hari.

sanskrit_iast:
yā'nekarūpāṇi vidhāya nityaṃ
sṛṣṭiṃ sthitiṃ hānimapīha kartrī |
brahmācyutasthāṇuśarīrahetuḥ
sā tvaṃ prasīdādya punarnamaste || 28 ||
meaning:
याऽनेकरूपाणि विधाय नित्यं
सृष्टिं स्थितिं हानिमपीह कर्त्री |
ब्रह्माच्युतस्थाणुशरीरहेतुः
सा त्वं प्रसीदाद्य पुनर्नमस्ते || 28 ||
text_mt: You who, assuming manifold forms, eternally / bring about creation, preservation, and destruction here, / the cause of the bodies of Brahmā, Acyuta, and Sthāṇu: / be pleased today! Homage again to you!

sanskrit_iast: mārkaṇḍeya uvāca
meaning: मार्कण्डेय उवाच

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ sā jagatāṃ mātā kālikā punareva hi |
uvāca menakāṃ devīṃ vāñchitaṃ varayetyuta || 29 ||
meaning:
ततः सा जगतां माता कालिका पुनरेव हि |
उवाच मेनकां देवीं वाञ्छितं वरयेत्युत || 29 ||
text_mt: Then Kālikā, mother of the worlds, once again / spoke to Queen Menakā: “Choose your desired boon!”

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ sā prathamaṃ putraśataṃ vabre yaśasvinī |
vīryavaccāyuṣā yuktamṛddhisiddhisamanvitam || 30 ||
meaning:
ततः सा प्रथमं पुत्रशतं वब्रे यशस्विनी |
वीर्यवच्चायुषा युक्तमृद्धिसिद्धिसमन्वितम् || 30 ||
text_mt: Then the illustrious lady first chose one hundred sons, / endowed with valor and long life, and blessed with prosperity and perfection;

sanskrit_iast:
paścāt tathaikāṃ tanayāṃ surūpāṃ guṇaśālinīm |
kuladvayānandakarīṃ bhuvanatradurlabhām || 31 ||
meaning:
पश्चात् तथैकां तनयां सुरूपां गुणशालिनीम् |
कुलद्वयानन्दकरीं भुवनत्रदुर्लभाम् || 31 ||
text_mt: and then one daughter, beautiful and full of virtues, / bringing joy to both families, rare to find in the three worlds.

sanskrit_iast:
tato bhagavatī prāha menakāṃ munisannibhām |
smitapūrvaṃ tadā tasyāḥ pūrayantī manoratham || 32 ||
meaning:
ततो भगवती प्राह मेनकां मुनिसन्निभाम् |
स्मितपूर्वं तदा तस्याः पूरयन्ती मनोरथम् || 32 ||
text_mt: Then the goddess said to Menakā, who was like a sage, / smiling first, as she fulfilled her wish:

sanskrit_iast: devyuvāca
meaning: देव्युवाच

sanskrit_iast:
śataṃ putrāḥ sambhavantu bhavatyā vīryasaṃyutāḥ |
tatraiko balavānmukhyaḥ prathamaṃ sambhaviṣyati || 33 ||
meaning:
शतं पुत्राः सम्भवन्तु भवत्या वीर्यसंयुताः |
तत्रैको बलवान्मुख्यः प्रथमं सम्भविष्यति || 33 ||
text_mt: Let a hundred sons, endowed with valor, be born to you; / among them, one who is strong and preeminent will be born first.

sanskrit_iast:
sutā ca tava devānāṃ mānuṣāṇāṃ ca rakṣasām |
hitāya sarvajagatāṃ bhaviṣyāmyahameva te || 34 ||
meaning:
सुता च तव देवानां मानुषाणां च रक्षसाम् |
हिताय सर्वजगतां भविष्याम्यहमेव ते || 34 ||
text_mt: And as for your daughter, for the benefit of the gods, humans, and rākṣasas, / and of all the worlds, I myself shall become [her] for you.

sanskrit_iast:
vaṃ sukhaprasavā nityaṃ tathā nityaṃ pativratā |
amlānā rūpasamnā subhagā ca bhaviṣyasi || 35 ||
meaning:
वं सुखप्रसवा नित्यं तथा नित्यं पतिव्रता |
अम्लाना रूपसम्ना सुभगा च भविष्यसि || 35 ||
text_mt: You shall always have easy childbirth, and always be a pativratā; / you shall remain unfading, endowed with beauty, and fortunate.

sanskrit_iast: mārkaṇḍeya uvāca
meaning: मार्कण्डेय उवाच

sanskrit_iast:
evamuktā jagaddhātrī tatraivāntaradhīyata |
menakā ca mudaṃ labdhā svasthānaṃ praviveśa ha || 36 ||
meaning:
एवमुक्ता जगद्धात्री तत्रैवान्तरधीयत |
मेनका च मुदं लब्धा स्वस्थानं प्रविवेश ह || 36 ||
text_mt: Having spoken thus, the sustainer of the world disappeared right there, / and Menakā, having attained joy, entered her own abode.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ kāle tu samprāpte mainākamacalottamam |
pakṣeṇa saha yo'dyāpi sindhumadhye pravartate || 37 ||
meaning:
ततः काले तु सम्प्राप्ते मैनाकमचलोत्तमम् |
पक्षेण सह योऽद्यापि सिन्धुमध्ये प्रवर्तते || 37 ||
text_mt: Then, when the time arrived, [she gave birth to] Maināka, the best of mountains, / who even today remains in the midst of the ocean together with his wings.

sanskrit_iast:
menakā suṣuve devī devendraṃ spardhayāgatam |
anyānūnaśataṃ putrān kramāt sā suṣuve satī || 38 ||
meaning:
मेनका सुषुवे देवी देवेन्द्रं स्पर्धयागतम् |
अन्यानूनशतं पुत्रान् क्रमात् सा सुषुवे सती || 38 ||
text_mt: Queen Menakā gave birth to [him], who matched the lord of gods in rivalry; / in due course, that virtuous woman gave birth to ninety-nine other sons,

sanskrit_iast:
mahāvīryān mahāsattvān sarvato guṇaiḥ |
tataḥ sā kālikā devī yoganidrā jaganmayī || 39 ||
meaning:
महावीर्यान् महासत्त्वान् सर्वतो गुणैः |
ततः सा कालिका देवी योगनिद्रा जगन्मयी || 39 ||
text_mt: greatly heroic, endowed with great courage, [equipped] on all sides with virtues. / Then that goddess Kālikā, who is Yoganidrā, comprising the universe,

sanskrit_iast:
pūrvatyaktasatīrūpā janmārthaṃ menakāṃ yayau |
samayasyānurūpeṇa menakā jaṭhare śivā || 40 ||
meaning:
पूर्वत्यक्तसतीरूपा जन्मार्थं मेनकां ययौ |
समयस्यानुरूपेण मेनका जठरे शिवा || 40 ||
text_mt: having previously cast off the form of Satī, went to Menakā for the sake of birth. / In accordance with the proper time, auspicious [Kālikā], in the womb of Menakā,

sanskrit_iast:
samudbhūya samutpannā sā lakṣmīriva sāgarāt |
vasantasamaye devī navamyāmṛkṣayogataḥ || 41 ||
meaning:
समुद्भूय समुत्पन्ना सा लक्ष्मीरिव सागरात् |
वसन्तसमये देवी नवम्यामृक्षयोगतः || 41 ||
text_mt: having arisen, was born like Lakṣmī from the ocean. / In the springtime, on the ninth lunar day, in conjunction with the [proper] asterism,

sanskrit_iast:
ardharātre samutpannā gaṅgeva śaśimaṇḍalāt |
tatastasyāṃ tu jātāyāṃ prasannā abhavan diśaḥ || 42 ||
meaning:
अर्धरात्रे समुत्पन्ना गङ्गेव शशिमण्डलात् |
ततस्तस्यां तु जातायां प्रसन्ना अभवन् दिशः || 42 ||
text_mt: the goddess was born at midnight, like the Gaṅgā from the lunar disc. / Then, when she was born, the quarters of the sky became clear.

sanskrit_iast:
anukūlo vavau vāyurgambhīro gandhavāñ śubhaḥ |
vabhūva puṣpavṛṣṭiśca toyavṛṣṭistathāparā || 43 ||
meaning:
अनुकूलो ववौ वायुर्गम्भीरो गन्धवाञ् शुभः |
वभूव पुष्पवृष्टिश्च तोयवृष्टिस्तथापरा || 43 ||
text_mt: A favorable wind blew, deep, fragrant, and auspicious; / there occurred a shower of flowers, and likewise another shower of water.

sanskrit_iast:
jajvaluścāgnyaḥ śāntā jagarjuśca ghanāghanam |
tasyāṃ tu jātamātrāyāṃ sarvaṃ svāsthyamapadyata || 44 ||
meaning:
जज्वलुश्चाग्न्यः शान्ता जगर्जुश्च घनाघनम् |
तस्यां तु जातमात्रायां सर्वं स्वास्थ्यमपद्यत || 44 ||
text_mt: The calm fires flared up, and the rain clouds thundered. / The moment she was born, everything attained well-being.

sanskrit_iast:
tāṃ tu dṛṣṭvā tathā jātāṃ nīlotpaladalānugām |
śyāmāṃ sā menakā devī mudamāpātiharṣitā || 45 ||
meaning:
तां तु दृष्ट्वा तथा जातां नीलोत्पलदलानुगाम् |
श्यामां सा मेनका देवी मुदमापातिहर्षिता || 45 ||
text_mt: Seeing her thus born, resembling the petal of a blue lotus / and dark-complexioned, queen Menakā, overjoyed, attained delight.

sanskrit_iast:
devāśca harṣamatulaṃ prāpustatra muhurmuhuḥ |
tuṣṭuvuścāntarikṣasthā gandharvāpsarasāṃ gaṇāḥ || 46 ||
meaning:
देवाश्च हर्षमतुलं प्रापुस्तत्र मुहुर्मुहुः |
तुष्टुवुश्चान्तरिक्षस्था गन्धर्वाप्सरसां गणाः || 46 ||
text_mt: And the gods there repeatedly attained matchless joy; / and standing in the atmosphere, the hosts of gandharvas and apsarases praised [her].

sanskrit_iast:
tāṃ tu nīlotpaladalaśyāmāṃ himavataḥ sutām |
kālīti nāmnā himavānājuhāva kṛtodane || 47 ||
meaning:
तां तु नीलोत्पलदलश्यामां हिमवतः सुताम् |
कालीति नाम्ना हिमवानाजुहाव कृतोदने || 47 ||
text_mt: Himavat, when the rice-feeding ceremony was performed, called / that daughter of Himavat, who was dark like the petal of a blue lotus, by the name Kālī.

sanskrit_iast:
āndhavaistu samastaistannāmnā sā pārvatīti ca |
kālīti ca tathā nāmnā kīrtitā girinandinī || 48 ||
meaning:
आन्धवैस्तु समस्तैस्तन्नाम्ना सा पार्वतीति च |
कालीति च तथा नाम्ना कीर्तिता गिरिनन्दिनी || 48 ||
text_mt: By all her kinsmen, that daughter of the mountain was celebrated / by that name, and as Pārvatī, and also by the name Kālī.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ sā vavṛdhe devī girirājagṛhe śubhā |
gaṅgeva varṣāsamaye śaradīvātha candrikā || 49 ||
meaning:
ततः सा ववृधे देवी गिरिराजगृहे शुभा |
गङ्गेव वर्षासमये शरदीवाथ चन्द्रिका || 49 ||
text_mt: Then that auspicious goddess grew up in the house of the king of mountains, / like the Gaṅgā in the rainy season, or moonlight in autumn.

sanskrit_iast:
dhamānānudivasaṃ cārvaṅgī cārutāṃ muhuḥ |
aghre sānudinaṃ kālī candrabimbaṃ kalāmiva || 50 ||
meaning:
धमानानुदिवसं चार्वङ्गी चारुतां मुहुः |
अघ्रे सानुदिनं काली चन्द्रबिम्बं कलामिव || 50 ||
text_mt: Growing day by day, fair-limbed, her loveliness repeatedly / increased day after day, as Kālī [grew] like the disc of the moon with its digit.

sanskrit_iast:
sā bālabhāvamāpannā krīḍantī kālikā mudam |
sakhībhiḥ prāpa vipulāṃ kālindīva saridvrajaiḥ || 51 ||
meaning:
सा बालभावमापन्ना क्रीडन्ती कालिका मुदम् |
सखीभिः प्राप विपुलां कालिन्दीव सरिद्व्रजैः || 51 ||
text_mt: Attaining childhood, playing, Kālikā attained abundant joy / with her female companions, like the Kālindī with streams of rivers.

sanskrit_iast:
ṣaḍguṇāstāṃ svayaṃ devīṃ pūrvajanmavaśīkṛtāḥ |
svayamīyurdvijaśreṣṭhāḥ prāvṛṣaṃ kālikā yathā || 52 ||
meaning:
षड्गुणास्तां स्वयं देवीं पूर्वजन्मवशीकृताः |
स्वयमीयुर्द्विजश्रेष्ठाः प्रावृषं कालिका यथा || 52 ||
text_mt: The six virtues, subjugated by her in a previous birth, / approached that goddess of their own accord, O best of the twice-born, just as a dark cloud approaches the rainy season.

sanskrit_iast:
aticakrāma svaguṇaiḥ sā devī devakanyakāḥ |
rūpairapsarasaḥ sarvā gītairgandharvakanyakāḥ || 53 ||
meaning:
अतिचक्राम स्वगुणैः सा देवी देवकन्यकाः |
रूपैरप्सरसः सर्वा गीतैर्गन्धर्वकन्यकाः || 53 ||
text_mt: With her own qualities, that goddess surpassed the daughters of the gods, / with her beauty all the apsarases, and with her songs the daughters of the gandharvas.

sanskrit_iast:
sā bālya eva satataṃ bandhuvargapriyā śubhā |
guṇaiḥ svabandhūn pitaraṃ mātaraṃ cāpyatoṣayat || 54 ||
meaning:
सा बाल्य एव सततं बन्धुवर्गप्रिया शुभा |
गुणैः स्वबन्धून् पितरं मातरं चाप्यतोषयत् || 54 ||
text_mt: Ever dear to her circle of kinsmen even in childhood, the auspicious one / pleased her kinsmen, her father, and her mother with her virtues.

sanskrit_iast:
mātuḥ stutikarī nityaṃ pitṛpūjanatatparā |
sarvadā bhrātṛsahitā jaganmātā'bhavattadā || 55 ||
meaning:
मातुः स्तुतिकरी नित्यं पितृपूजनतत्परा |
सर्वदा भ्रातृसहिता जगन्माताऽभवत्तदा || 55 ||
text_mt: Constantly praising her mother, dedicated to honoring her father, / and always in the company of her brothers, she was then the mother of the universe.

sanskrit_iast:
sarvadā sā jaganmātā kanyā sā samupasthitā |
pituḥ samīpe vasati kālindīva vibhāvasoḥ || 56 ||
meaning:
सर्वदा सा जगन्माता कन्या सा समुपस्थिता |
पितुः समीपे वसति कालिन्दीव विभावसोः || 56 ||
text_mt: That mother of the universe, remaining as a maiden, / always dwelt near her father, like the Kālindī near the sun.

sanskrit_iast:
athaikadā tāṃ nikaṭe nidhāya himavadgiriḥ |
tanayaiḥ saha saṅgamya sthitaḥ paramakautukāt || 57 ||
meaning:
अथैकदा तां निकटे निधाय हिमवद्गिरिः |
तनयैः सह सङ्गम्य स्थितः परमकौतुकात् || 57 ||
text_mt: Then once, placing her near him and assembling with his sons, / Mount Himavat sat down out of great curiosity.

sanskrit_iast:
athāgatastatra munirnārado devalokataḥ |
himavantaṃ sukhāsīnaṃ sutaiḥ sārdhaṃ dadarśa saḥ || 58 ||
meaning:
अथागतस्तत्र मुनिर्नारदो देवलोकतः |
हिमवन्तं सुखासीनं सुतैः सार्धं ददर्श सः || 58 ||
text_mt: Then the sage Nārada arrived there from the world of the gods; / he saw Himavat seated comfortably together with his sons.

sanskrit_iast:
apaśyannikaṭe kālīṃ ālikāmiva sūryataḥ |
jyotsnāmiva sudhāṃśostu samyagvṛddhāṃ śaranniśi || 59 ||
meaning:
अपश्यन्निकटे कालीं आलिकामिव सूर्यतः |
ज्योत्स्नामिव सुधांशोस्तु सम्यग्वृद्धां शरन्निशि || 59 ||
text_mt: He saw Kālī near him, like a row of rays from the sun, / or like moonlight from the moon, fully grown in an autumn night.

sanskrit_iast:
pūjitastena giriṇā kṛtāsana-parigrahaḥ |
nāradaḥ prathamaṃ śailaṃ vṛttānta paryapṛcchata || 60 ||
meaning:
पूजितस्तेन गिरिणा कृतासन-परिग्रहः |
नारदः प्रथमं शैलं वृत्तान्त पर्यपृच्छत || 60 ||
text_mt: Honored by that mountain and having accepted a seat, / Nārada first questioned the mountain about the news.

sanskrit_iast:
tato viditavṛttānto nārado menakāṃ prati |
uvāca harṣayan vākyaṃ munirvākyaviśāradaḥ || 61 ||
meaning:
ततो विदितवृत्तान्तो नारदो मेनकां प्रति |
उवाच हर्षयन् वाक्यं मुनिर्वाक्यविशारदः || 61 ||
text_mt: Then, having learned the news, the sage Nārada, skilled in speech, / spoke gladdening words toward Menakā:

sanskrit_iast: nārada uvāca
meaning: नारद उवाच

sanskrit_iast:
eṣā te tanayā rucyā śuddhāṃśoriva vardhitā |
ādyā kalā śailarāja sarvalakṣaṇaśālinī || 62 ||
meaning:
एषा ते तनया रुच्या शुद्धांशोरिव वर्धिता |
आद्या कला शैलराज सर्वलक्षणशालिनी || 62 ||
text_mt: O king of mountains, this daughter of yours, who has grown with charm like the pure moon's / first digit, is endowed with all auspicious marks.

sanskrit_iast:
śambhorbhavitrī dayitā sānukūlā sadā hareḥ |
tasya cittaṃ vaśe caiṣā kariṣyati tapasvinī || 63 ||
meaning:
शम्भोर्भवित्री दयिता सानुकूला सदा हरेः |
तस्य चित्तं वशे चैषा करिष्यति तपस्विनी || 63 ||
text_mt: She will be the beloved wife of Śambhu, always favorably disposed to Hara; / and this ascetic woman will bring his mind under control.

sanskrit_iast:
sa cāpyenāmṛte jāyāṃ nānyāmudvāhayiṣyati |
etayoryādṛśaḥ premā kayościnnaiva tādṛśaḥ || 64 ||
meaning:
स चाप्येनामृते जायां नान्यामुद्वाहयिष्यति |
एतयोर्यादृशः प्रेमा कयोश्चिन्नैव तादृशः || 64 ||
text_mt: And he, apart from her, will not marry any other wife; / the love of these two is such as has never belonged to any couple,

sanskrit_iast:
bhūto vā bhavitā vāpi nādhunā ca pravartate |
anayā surakāryāṇi kartavyāni bahūni ca || 65 ||
meaning:
भूतो वा भविता वापि नाधुना च प्रवर्तते |
अनया सुरकार्याणि कर्तव्यानि बहूनि च || 65 ||
text_mt: nor was it in the past, nor will it ever be, nor does it exist now; / many tasks for the gods are to be performed by her.

sanskrit_iast:
anayaiva giriśreṣṭha ardhanārīśvaro haraḥ |
bhaviṣyati ca sauhārdājyotsnayaivāmṛtātmanaḥ || 66 ||
meaning:
अनयैव गिरिश्रेष्ठ अर्धनारीश्वरो हरः |
भविष्यति च सौहार्दाज्योत्स्नयैवामृतात्मनः || 66 ||
text_mt: Because of her alone, O best of mountains, Hara will become the Lord Who Is Half Woman, / through affection, just as the nectar-natured [moon becomes united] with moonlight.

sanskrit_iast:
śarīrārdhaṃ harasyaiṣā kariṣyati nijāspade |
svarṇagaurī suvarṇābhā tapasā toṣite hare || 67 ||
meaning:
शरीरार्धं हरस्यैषा करिष्यति निजास्पदे |
स्वर्णगौरी सुवर्णाभा तपसा तोषिते हरे || 67 ||
text_mt: She will make half of Hara's body her own dwelling-place, / as Svarṇagaurī, shining like gold, when Hara is pleased by her asceticism.

sanskrit_iast:
vidyudgaurī tviyaṃ kālī tava putrī bhaviṣyati |
gaurīti nāmnā paścāttu khyātimeṣā gamiṣyati || 68 ||
meaning:
विद्युद्गौरी त्वियं काली तव पुत्री भविष्यति |
गौरीति नाम्ना पश्चात्तु ख्यातिमेषा गमिष्यति || 68 ||
text_mt: Indeed, this Kālī, your daughter, will become fair as lightning; / later she will attain renown under the name Gaurī.

sanskrit_iast:
nānyasmai tvamimāṃ dātuṃ manaḥ kartumihārhasi |
idaṃ copāṃśu devānāṃ na prakāśaṃ kariṣyasi || 69 ||
meaning:
नान्यस्मै त्वमिमां दातुं मनः कर्तुमिहार्हसि |
इदं चोपांशु देवानां न प्रकाशं करिष्यसि || 69 ||
text_mt: You ought not set your mind on giving her to anyone else here; / and this is a secret of the gods; you must not disclose it.

sanskrit_iast: mārkaṇḍeya uvāca
meaning: मार्कण्डेय उवाच

sanskrit_iast:
iti tasya vacaḥ śrutvā devarṣernāradasya ca |
uvāca himavān vākyaṃ muniṃ prati viśāradaḥ || 70 ||
meaning:
इति तस्य वचः श्रुत्वा देवर्षेर्नारदस्य च |
उवाच हिमवान् वाक्यं मुनिं प्रति विशारदः || 70 ||
text_mt: Having heard those words of that divine seer Nārada, / Himavat, who was wise, spoke words to the sage:

sanskrit_iast: himavānuvāca
meaning: हिमवानुवाच

sanskrit_iast:
śrūyate tyaktasaṃgaḥ sa mahādevo yatātmavān |
tapaśopāṃśu tapati devānāmapyagocaraḥ || 71 ||
meaning:
श्रूयते त्यक्तसंगः स महादेवो यतात्मवान् |
तपशोपांशु तपति देवानामप्यगोचरः || 71 ||
text_mt: It is heard that Mahādevo, having abandoned attachment and controlled his self, / performs asceticism in secret, beyond the reach of even the gods.

sanskrit_iast:
sa kathaṃ dhyānamārgasthaḥ parabrahārpitaṃ manaḥ |
bhraṃśayiṣyati devarṣe tatra me saṃśayo mahān || 72 ||
meaning:
स कथं ध्यानमार्गस्थः परब्रहार्पितं मनः |
भ्रंशयिष्यति देवर्षे तत्र मे संशयो महान् || 72 ||
text_mt: How will he, abiding on the path of meditation with a mind dedicated to the Supreme Brahman, / divert [it], O divine seer? In that matter I have great doubt.

sanskrit_iast:
akṣaraṃ paramaṃ brahma pradīpakalikopamam |
so'ntaḥ paśyati sarvatra na tu bāhyaṃ nirīkṣate || 73 ||
meaning:
अक्षरं परमं ब्रह्म प्रदीपकलिकोपमम् |
सोऽन्तः पश्यति सर्वत्र न तु बाह्यं निरीक्षते || 73 ||
text_mt: He sees internally everywhere the imperishable Supreme Brahman, / resembling the flame of a lamp, and does not look upon what is external.

sanskrit_iast:
iti sma śrūyate nityaṃ kinnarāṇāṃ mukhād dvija |
sa kathaṃ tādṛśaṃ svāntaṃ śakto bhraṃśayituṃ haraḥ || 74 ||
meaning:
इति स्म श्रूयते नित्यं किन्नराणां मुखाद् द्विज |
स कथं तादृशं स्वान्तं शक्तो भ्रंशयितुं हरः || 74 ||
text_mt: Thus it is constantly heard from the mouth of the kinnaras, O twice-born; / how can Hara be capable of diverting such a mind?

sanskrit_iast:
viśeṣataḥ śrūyate sma dākṣāyaṇyā samaṃ haraḥ |
samayaṃ jñātavān pūrvaṃ tanme nigadataḥ śṛṇu || 75 ||
meaning:
विशेषतः श्रूयते स्म दाक्षायण्या समं हरः |
समयं ज्ञातवान् पूर्वं तन्मे निगदतः शृणु || 75 ||
text_mt: Moreover, it was heard that Hara previously made an agreement / with Dākṣāyaṇī; listen to that as I relate it:

sanskrit_iast:
tvāmṛte'nyāṃ na vanitāṃ dākṣāyaṇi sati priye |
bhāryārthe saṅgrahīṣyāmi satyametad bravīmi te || 76 ||
meaning:
त्वामृतेऽन्यां न वनितां दाक्षायणि सति प्रिये |
भार्यार्थे सङ्ग्रहीष्यामि सत्यमेतद् ब्रवीमि ते || 76 ||
text_mt: 'Except for you, O Dākṣāyaṇī, O Satī, my beloved, / I shall not accept any other woman as a wife; I tell you this as the truth.'

sanskrit_iast:
iti satyā samaṃ tena puraiva samayaḥ kṛtaḥ |
tasyāṃ mṛtāyāṃ sa kathaṃ striyamanyāṃ grahīṣyati || 77 ||
meaning:
इति सत्या समं तेन पुरैव समयः कृतः |
तस्यां मृतायां स कथं स्त्रियमन्यां ग्रहीष्यति || 77 ||
text_mt: In this way an agreement was made by him with Satī long ago; / she being dead, how can he take another woman?

sanskrit_iast: nārada uvāca
meaning: नारद उवाच

sanskrit_iast:
nātrā kāryā tvayā cintā girirāja bhavatsutā |
eṣā satī samutpannā harāyaiva na saṃśayaḥ || 78 ||
meaning:
नात्रा कार्या त्वया चिन्ता गिरिराज भवत्सुता |
एषा सती समुत्पन्ना हरायैव न संशयः || 78 ||
text_mt: You need have no anxiety here, O king of mountains: your daughter / is this very Satī reborn for Hara alone, there is no doubt.

sanskrit_iast: mārkaṇḍeya uvāca
meaning: मार्कण्डेय उवाच

sanskrit_iast:
ityuktvā sa tu devarṣirnāradastu yathā satī |
menakāyāṃ samutpannā sarvaṃ tat proktavān girau || 79 ||
meaning:
इत्युक्त्वा स तु देवर्षिर्नारदस्तु यथा सती |
मेनकायां समुत्पन्ना सर्वं तत् प्रोक्तवान् गिरौ || 79 ||
text_mt: Having spoken thus, the celestial sage Nārada then related / everything to the mountain about how Satī was born of Menakā.

sanskrit_iast:
tatsarvaṃ pūrvavṛttāntaṃ nāradasya mukhād giriḥ |
śrutvā saputradāraḥ sa tadā niḥsaṃśayo'bhavat || 80 ||
meaning:
तत्सर्वं पूर्ववृत्तान्तं नारदस्य मुखाद् गिरिः |
श्रुत्वा सपुत्रदारः स तदा निःसंशयोऽभवत् || 80 ||
text_mt: Hearing all that previous history from Nārada’s mouth, / the mountain, together with his wife and sons, was then free from doubt.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ kālī kathāṃ śrutvā nāradasya mukhāt tadā |
lajjayā'dhomukhī bhūtvā smitavistāritānanā || 81 ||
meaning:
ततः काली कथां श्रुत्वा नारदस्य मुखात् तदा |
लज्जयाऽधोमुखी भूत्वा स्मितविस्तारितानना || 81 ||
text_mt: Then, hearing the discourse from Nārada’s mouth at that time, / Kālī lowered her face with bashfulness, her mouth broadened with a smile.

sanskrit_iast:
kareṇa tāṃ tu saṃgṛhya pronnamayya mukhaṃ giriḥ |
mūrdhni samyagupāghrāya svāsane saṃnyaveśayat || 82 ||
meaning:
करेण तां तु संगृह्य प्रोन्नमय्य मुखं गिरिः |
मूर्ध्नि सम्यगुपाघ्राय स्वासने संन्यवेशयत् || 82 ||
text_mt: Taking hold of her with his hand and lifting up her face, / the mountain kissed her gently on the head and seated her on his own seat.

sanskrit_iast:
tatastāṃ punarevāha nāradaḥ śailaputrikām |
harṣayan girirājaṃ tu menakāṃ tanayaiḥ saha || 83 ||
meaning:
ततस्तां पुनरेवाह नारदः शैलपुत्रिकाम् |
हर्षयन् गिरिराजं तु मेनकां तनयैः सह || 83 ||
text_mt: Then Nārada spoke once more to that daughter of the mountain, / bringing joy to the king of mountains and Menakā together with their sons.

sanskrit_iast: nārada uvāca
meaning: नारद उवाच

sanskrit_iast:
siṃhāsanena kiṃ svasyāḥ śailarāja bhavet tava |
śambhorūruḥ sadaivāsyā āsanaṃ tu bhaviṣyati || 84 ||
meaning:
सिंहासनेन किं स्वस्याः शैलराज भवेत् तव |
शम्भोरूरुः सदैवास्या आसनं तु भविष्यति || 84 ||
text_mt: O king of mountains, of what use will your throne be to her? / Śambhu's lap will forever be her seat.

sanskrit_iast:
harorumāsanaṃ prāpya tanayā tava saṃtatam |
nānyatra kutracittuṣṭimāsane prāpyate gire || 85 ||
meaning:
हरोरुमासनं प्राप्य तनया तव संततम् |
नान्यत्र कुत्रचित्तुष्टिमासने प्राप्यते गिरे || 85 ||
text_mt: Having obtained Hara's lap as her seat continually, / your daughter will find satisfaction on no other seat anywhere, O mountain.

sanskrit_iast: mārkaṇḍeya uvāca
meaning: मार्कण्डेय उवाच

sanskrit_iast:
iti vacanamudāraṃ nāradaḥ śailarājaṃ
tridivamagamaduktvā tatkṣaṇād devayānaiḥ |
giripatirapi cintāharṣasanmohayuktaḥ
praviśadacalayāsau svāntaraṃ padmagarbham || 86 ||
meaning:
इति वचनमुदारं नारदः शैलराजं
त्रिदिवमगमदुक्त्वा तत्क्षणाद् देवयानैः |
गिरिपतिरपि चिन्ताहर्षसन्मोहयुक्तः
प्रविशदचलयासौ स्वान्तरं पद्मगर्भम् || 86 ||
text_mt: Having spoken this noble speech to the king of mountains, Nārada / went instantly to heaven in celestial chariots; / and the lord of the mountain also, filled with wonder, joy, and delusion, / entered into the lotus-interior of his own mountain home.

sanskrit_iast:
iti śrīkālikāpurāṇe nāradāgamane ekacatvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 41 ||
dvicatrāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ
meaning:
इति श्रीकालिकापुराणे नारदागमने एकचत्वारिंशोऽध्यायः || 41 ||
द्विचत्रारिंशोऽध्यायः
text_mt: Thus ends the forty-first chapter, on the arrival of Nārada, in the glorious Kālikāpurāṇa. / Chapter Forty-Two

sanskrit_iast: mārkaṇḍeya uvāca
meaning: मार्कण्डेय उवाच

sanskrit_iast:
etasminnantare śambhuḥ kṣipraṃ tyaktvā tadā saraḥ |
gaṅgāvatāramagamad himavatprasthamuttama || 1 ||
meaning:
एतस्मिन्नन्तरे शम्भुः क्षिप्रं त्यक्त्वा तदा सरः |
गङ्गावतारमगमद् हिमवत्प्रस्थमुत्तम || 1 ||
text_mt: Meanwhile, Śambhu quickly left that lake at that time / and went to the descent of the Gaṅgā, the excellent plateau of the Himavat,

sanskrit_iast:
yatra gaṅgā nipatitā purā brahmapurāt sṛtā |
oṣadhīprasthanagarasyādūre sānuruttamaḥ || 2 ||
meaning:
यत्र गङ्गा निपतिता पुरा ब्रह्मपुरात् सृता |
ओषधीप्रस्थनगरस्यादूरे सानुरुत्तमः || 2 ||
text_mt: where the Gaṅgā fell long ago, issuing forth from the city of Brahmā— / an excellent summit not far from the city of Oṣadhīprastha.

sanskrit_iast:
tatra bhargaḥ svamātmānamakṣaraṃ paramātparam |
ceto jñānamayaṃ nityaṃ jyotīrūpaṃ nirākulam || 3 ||
meaning:
तत्र भर्गः स्वमात्मानमक्षरं परमात्परम् |
चेतो ज्ञानमयं नित्यं ज्योतीरूपं निराकुलम् || 3 ||
text_mt: There Bharga [meditated upon] his own self: imperishable, higher than the highest, / consciousness consisting of knowledge, eternal, having the form of light, untroubled,

sanskrit_iast:
jaganmayaṃ pradīpābhaṃ dvaitahīnāviśeṣakam |
ekāgraṃ cintayāmāsa bhagavān vṛṣabhadhvajaḥ || 4 ||
meaning:
जगन्मयं प्रदीपाभं द्वैतहीनाविशेषकम् |
एकाग्रं चिन्तयामास भगवान् वृषभध्वजः || 4 ||
text_mt: imbuing the universe, shining like a lamp, devoid of duality and without distinctions; / the blessed Lord whose banner bears a bull meditated with one-pointed focus.

sanskrit_iast:
hare dhyānapare tasmin pramathā dhyānatatparāḥ |
abhavan kecidapare nandibhṛṅgyādayo gaṇāḥ || 5 ||
meaning:
हरे ध्यानपरे तस्मिन् प्रमथा ध्यानतत्पराः |
अभवन् केचिदपरे नन्दिभृङ्ग्यादयो गणाः || 5 ||
text_mt: While Hara was devoted to meditation, some Pramathas became absorbed in meditation, / and other attendants such as Nandin, Bhṛṅgin, and the rest,

sanskrit_iast:
dvāḥsthā bhūtā mahābhāgā ye pūrvadvāri yojitāḥ |
tāvanto'pi gaṇāstatra naiva kiṃcanaṃ kūjitam || 6 ||
meaning:
द्वाःस्था भूता महाभागा ये पूर्वद्वारि योजिताः |
तावन्तोऽपि गणास्तत्र नैव किंचनं कूजितम् || 6 ||
text_mt: who were stationed at the eastern gate as door-keepers, the fortunate ones; / however many attendants were there, no sound at all

sanskrit_iast:
teṣāṃ saṃśrūyate sarve niḥśabdāḥ saṃsthitāstataḥ |
anye tu tatra krīḍanti gaṇā dūrāntarasthitāḥ || 7 ||
meaning:
तेषां संश्रूयते सर्वे निःशब्दाः संस्थितास्ततः |
अन्ये तु तत्र क्रीडन्ति गणा दूरान्तरस्थिताः || 7 ||
text_mt: of their uttering was heard; all remained silent there. / Other attendants, however, staying further off, disported there,

sanskrit_iast:
kusumaiśca dalairbhaktairgiriprasravaṇodakaiḥ |
ratnāni ca vicinvanto bhūṣitā gairkaistathā || 8 ||
meaning:
कुसुमैश्च दलैर्भक्तैर्गिरिप्रस्रवणोदकैः |
रत्नानि च विचिन्वन्तो भूषिता गैर्कैस्तथा || 8 ||
text_mt: with flowers, leaves, cooked foods, and mountain-cascade waters, / gathering gems and adorned with red chalk.

sanskrit_iast:
sagaṇaṃ tu tathā dṛṣṭvā girirājo gataṃ haram |
svasthānamoṣadhiprasthānniḥsṛtya sahito gaṇaiḥ || 9 ||
meaning:
सगणं तु तथा दृष्ट्वा गिरिराजो गतं हरम् |
स्वस्थानमोषधिप्रस्थान्निःसृत्य सहितो गणैः || 9 ||
text_mt: Seeing Hara with his attendants thus arrived at his own abode, / the king of mountains, going forth from Oṣadhiprastha accompanied by his hosts,

sanskrit_iast:
pūjārthamupatasthe sa yathāyogyaṃ tathārcayat |
sa cāpi śambhustasyārccāṃ parayā śraddhayā yutaḥ |
pratijagrāha kūṭastho gaṅgāśīrṣe yathā purā || 10 ||
meaning:
पूजार्थमुपतस्थे स यथायोग्यं तथार्चयत् |
स चापि शम्भुस्तस्यार्च्चां परया श्रद्धया युतः |
प्रतिजग्राह कूटस्थो गङ्गाशीर्षे यथा पुरा || 10 ||
text_mt: approached in order to worship, and honored him appropriately. / And Śambhu too, motionless, accepted his worship / with the utmost faith, just as formerly on the head of the Gaṅgā.

sanskrit_iast:
pūjitastena sahasā girirājaṃ vṛṣadhvajaḥ |
uvāca dhyānayogasthaḥ smayanniva jagatpatiḥ || 11 ||
meaning:
पूजितस्तेन सहसा गिरिराजं वृषध्वजः |
उवाच ध्यानयोगस्थः स्मयन्निव जगत्पतिः || 11 ||
text_mt: Having been worshiped by him, the Lord whose banner bears a bull, established in meditative union, / the lord of the universe suddenly spoke to the king of mountains as if smiling:

sanskrit_iast: īśvara uvāca
meaning: ईश्वर उवाच

sanskrit_iast:
tava prasthe tapastaptuṃ rahasyamahamāgataḥ |
na yathā ko'pi nikaṭaṃ samāyāti tathā kuru || 12 ||
meaning:
तव प्रस्थे तपस्तप्तुं रहस्यमहमागतः |
न यथा कोऽपि निकटं समायाति तथा कुरु || 12 ||
text_mt: "I have come to your plateau in secret to practice austerities; / see to it that no one comes near.

sanskrit_iast:
tvaṃ mahātmā jagaddhām munīnāṃ ca sadāśrayaḥ |
devānāṃ rākṣasānāṃ ca yakṣāṇāṃ kinnarasya ca || 13 ||
meaning:
त्वं महात्मा जगद्धाम् मुनीनां च सदाश्रयः |
देवानां राक्षसानां च यक्षाणां किन्नरस्य च || 13 ||
text_mt: You are a great soul, an abode of the world, and a constant refuge for sages, / for gods, rākṣasas, yakṣas, and kinnaras,

sanskrit_iast:
sadāvāso dvijātīnāṃ gaṅgāpūtaśca nityadā |
tvatpurasyāsya nikaṭe prasthaṃ gaṅgāvatāraṇam || 14 ||
meaning:
सदावासो द्विजातीनां गङ्गापूतश्च नित्यदा |
त्वत्पुरस्यास्य निकटे प्रस्थं गङ्गावतारणम् || 14 ||
text_mt: the eternal dwelling of the twice-born, and perpetually purified by the Gaṅgā. / Near this city of yours is the plateau where the Gaṅgā descends;

sanskrit_iast: āśrito'haṃ giriśreṣṭha tadyogyaṃ kuru sāmpratam || 15 ||
meaning: आश्रितोऽहं गिरिश्रेष्ठ तद्योग्यं कुरु साम्प्रतम् || 15 ||
text_mt: I have taken refuge [here], O best of mountains: do what is proper now."

sanskrit_iast:
ityuktvā jagatāṃ nāthastūṣṇīmāsa vṛṣadhvajaḥ |
girirājastadā śambhuṃ praṇayādidamabravīt || 16 ||
meaning:
इत्युक्त्वा जगतां नाथस्तूष्णीमास वृषध्वजः |
गिरिराजस्तदा शम्भुं प्रणयादिदमब्रवीत् || 16 ||
text_mt: Having spoken thus, the Lord of the worlds whose banner bears a bull became silent. / Then the king of mountains said this out of affection to Śambhu:

sanskrit_iast: himavānuvāca
meaning: हिमवानुवाच

sanskrit_iast:
pūto'smi jagatāṃ nātha tvayā'haṃ parameśvara |
āgatenādya viṣayamitaḥ kṛtyaṃ kimasti me || 17 ||
meaning:
पूतोऽस्मि जगतां नाथ त्वयाऽहं परमेश्वर |
आगतेनाद्य विषयमितः कृत्यं किमस्ति मे || 17 ||
text_mt: "I am purified, O Lord of the worlds, by you, O supreme Lord, / who have come to my realm today; what duty remains for me beyond this?

sanskrit_iast:
tapasā mahatā tvaṃ hi devairyatnaparasthitai |
na prāpyase jagannātha sa tvaṃ svayamupasthitaḥ || 18 ||
meaning:
तपसा महता त्वं हि देवैर्यत्नपरस्थितै |
न प्राप्यसे जगन्नाथ स त्वं स्वयमुपस्थितः || 18 ||
text_mt: For even by great austerity, through diligent efforts, you are not / attained by the gods, O Lord of the universe, yet you have appeared in person.

sanskrit_iast:
matto dhanyataro nāsti na matto'nyo'sti puṇyavān |
yadbhavān himavatprasthe tapase samupasthitaḥ || 19 ||
meaning:
मत्तो धन्यतरो नास्ति न मत्तोऽन्योऽस्ति पुण्यवान् |
यद्भवान् हिमवत्प्रस्थे तपसे समुपस्थितः || 19 ||
text_mt: None is more blessed than I, none is more meritorious than I, / in that you have arrived on the plateau of Himavat to practice austerities.

sanskrit_iast:
devendrādadhikaṃ manye ātmānaṃ parameśvara |
sagaṇena tvayā prāpto yadā'haṃ kāmacārataḥ || 20 ||
meaning:
देवेन्द्रादधिकं मन्ये आत्मानं परमेश्वर |
सगणेन त्वया प्राप्तो यदाऽहं कामचारतः || 20 ||
text_mt: I consider myself greater than the lord of the gods, O supreme Lord, / since I have been reached by you together with your host, of your own free will."

sanskrit_iast:
ityuktvā girirājo'tha svaveśma punarāgamat |
niyamāya parivārān gaṇānapyavadat svakān || 21 ||
meaning:
इत्युक्त्वा गिरिराजोऽथ स्ववेश्म पुनरागमत् |
नियमाय परिवारान् गणानप्यवदत् स्वकान् || 21 ||
text_mt: Having spoken thus, the king of mountains returned to his own home; / to restrain his retinue, he also spoke to his own hosts:

sanskrit_iast:
adya prabhṛti no gantā ko'pi gaṅgāvatāraṇam |
macchāsanaṃ na hi vinā yo gantā daṇḍaye hyaham || 22 ||
meaning:
अद्य प्रभृति नो गन्ता कोऽपि गङ्गावतारणम् |
मच्छासनं न हि विना यो गन्ता दण्डये ह्यहम् || 22 ||
text_mt: "From today onwards no one shall go to the descent of the Gaṅgā; / whoever goes without my command, him I shall surely punish."

sanskrit_iast:
iti svān sa niyamyāśu tilapuṣpakuśān phalam |
samādāyāśu tanayāsahito'gād harāntikam || 23 ||
meaning:
इति स्वान् स नियम्याशु तिलपुष्पकुशान् फलम् |
समादायाशु तनयासहितोऽगाद् हरान्तिकम् || 23 ||
text_mt: Having thus restrained his people, he quickly took sesamum, flowers, kuśa grass, and fruit, / and went at once into Hara's presence together with his daughter.

sanskrit_iast:
atha gatvā jagannāthaṃ haraṃ dhyānaparaṃ tadā |
namayāmāsa tanayāṃ kālīṃ sarvaguṇānvitām || 24 ||
meaning:
अथ गत्वा जगन्नाथं हरं ध्यानपरं तदा |
नमयामास तनयां कालीं सर्वगुणान्विताम् || 24 ||
text_mt: Then, having approached Hara, the lord of the universe who was absorbed in meditation, / he made his daughter Kālī, endowed with all virtues, bow down.

sanskrit_iast:
