krameṇa tu tadā parṇaṃ nirasya himavatsutā || 35 ||
meaning:
तृतीयं तु स्वयम्पाति-वृक्षपल्लव-भोजनम् |
क्रमेण तु तदा पर्णं निरस्य हिमवत्सुता || 35 ||
text_mt: and thirdly on tree leaves that had fallen of themselves; / then, gradually giving up leaves, the daughter of Himavat

sanskrit_iast:
nirāhāravratā bhūtvā tapaścaraṇakhinnikā |
āhāre tyaktaparṇābhūdyasmāddhimavataḥ sutā || 36 ||
meaning:
निराहारव्रता भूत्वा तपश्चरणखिन्निका |
आहारे त्यक्तपर्णाभूद्यस्माद्धिमवतः सुता || 36 ||
text_mt: undertook the vow of fasting, weary with the practice of austerities. / Because the daughter of Himavat abandoned leaves as food,

sanskrit_iast:
tena devairaparṇeti kathitā pṛthivītale |
pañcātapavratenaiva toyānāñca praveśanaiḥ || 37 ||
meaning:
तेन देवैरपर्णेति कथिता पृथिवीतले |
पञ्चातपव्रतेनैव तोयानाञ्च प्रवेशनैः || 37 ||
text_mt: she was called Aparṇā by the gods on the earth. / By the vow of the five fires and by standing in water,

sanskrit_iast:
ekapādasthitā sa tu vasante himavatsutā |
ṣaḍakṣaraṃ japantī sā ciraṃ tepe tapo mahat || 38 ||
meaning:
एकपादस्थिता स तु वसन्ते हिमवत्सुता |
षडक्षरं जपन्ती सा चिरं तेपे तपो महत् || 38 ||
text_mt: standing on one foot in the spring, the daughter of Himavat, / reciting the six-syllable [mantra], performed great austerities for a long time.

sanskrit_iast:
cīrabalkalasaṃvītā jaṭāsaṃghātadhāriṇī |
kṛśāṅgī cintane śaktā jigāya tapasā munīn || 39 ||
meaning:
चीरबल्कलसंवीता जटासंघातधारिणी |
कृशाङ्गी चिन्तने शक्ता जिगाय तपसा मुनीन् || 39 ||
text_mt: Clad in rags and bark, bearing a mass of matted hair, / emaciated in body, concentrated in meditation, she surpassed the sages through austerities.

sanskrit_iast:
tāṃ tapaścaraṇe śaktāṃ rarakṣa śaṃkaraḥ svayam |
āpyāyati sma sa tadā bhayādrakṣati harṣitaḥ || 40 ||
meaning:
तां तपश्चरणे शक्तां ररक्ष शंकरः स्वयम् |
आप्यायति स्म स तदा भयाद्रक्षति हर्षितः || 40 ||
text_mt: Śaṃkara himself protected her who was intent upon the practice of austerities; / he nurtured her then, and, delighted, protected her from danger.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ tasyāstapasyantyāścintayantyā maheśvaram |
trīṇi varṣasahasrāṇi jagmuḥ kālyāstapovane || 41 ||
meaning:
एवं तस्यास्तपस्यन्त्याश्चिन्तयन्त्या महेश्वरम् |
त्रीणि वर्षसहस्राणि जग्मुः काल्यास्तपोवने || 41 ||
text_mt: In this way, as she practiced austerities and contemplated Maheśvara, / three thousand years passed for Kālī in the penance grove.

sanskrit_iast:
ṣaṭtrivarṣasahasrāṇi saṃskṛtā vīkṣaṇāt svayam |
daivena vidhinā devī harayogyā tathābhavat || 42 ||
meaning:
षट्त्रिवर्षसहस्राणि संस्कृता वीक्षणात् स्वयम् |
दैवेन विधिना देवी हरयोग्या तथाभवत् || 42 ||
text_mt: Purified through his own sight by divine ordinance / for eighteen thousand years, the goddess became fit for Hara.

sanskrit_iast:
ṣaṭtrivarṣasahasrāntre yatra tepe tapo haraḥ |
tatra kṣaṇamathoṣitvā cintayāmāsa bhāminī || 43 ||
meaning:
षट्त्रिवर्षसहस्रान्त्रे यत्र तेपे तपो हरः |
तत्र क्षणमथोषित्वा चिन्तयामास भामिनी || 43 ||
text_mt: At the end of eighteen thousand years, staying for a moment / where Hara had practiced austerities, the beautiful lady reflected:

sanskrit_iast: kālyuvāca
meaning: काल्युवाच

sanskrit_iast:
niyamasthāṃ mahādevaḥ kiṃ māṃ jānāti nādhunā |
yenāhaṃ suciraṃ tena nānujñātā taporatā || 44 ||
meaning:
नियमस्थां महादेवः किं मां जानाति नाधुना |
येनाहं सुचिरं तेन नानुज्ञाता तपोरता || 44 ||
text_mt: "Does Mahādeva not know me now, who am steadfast in vows, / since for so long I have not been acknowledged by him, though devoted to austerities?"

sanskrit_iast:
loke nāstyatra giriśaḥ kiṃ tatra munibhiḥ stutaḥ |
sarvajñaḥ sarvago devo haro devairnigadyate || 45 ||
meaning:
लोके नास्त्यत्र गिरिशः किं तत्र मुनिभिः स्तुतः |
सर्वज्ञः सर्वगो देवो हरो देवैर्निगद्यते || 45 ||
text_mt: Is Giriśa not present here in the world, or why is he praised by the sages there? / The god Hara is proclaimed by the gods to be omniscient and all-pervading.

sanskrit_iast: sa sarvagastu sarvajñaḥ sarvātmā sarvahṛdgataḥ |
meaning: स सर्वगस्तु सर्वज्ञः सर्वात्मा सर्वहृद्गतः |
text_mt: Indeed he is all-pervading, omniscient, the Self of all, dwelling in the heart of all,

sanskrit_iast: sarvabhūtiprado devaḥ sarvabhāvanabhāvanaḥ || 46 ||
meaning: सर्वभूतिप्रदो देवः सर्वभावनभावनः || 46 ||
text_mt: the god who bestows all prosperity, the creator of all beings.

sanskrit_iast:
satī ca menakā mātā yadi cāhaṃ vṛṣadhvaje |
sānuraktā na cānyasmin sa prasīdatu śaṃkaraḥ || 47 ||
meaning:
सती च मेनका माता यदि चाहं वृषध्वजे |
सानुरक्ता न चान्यस्मिन् स प्रसीदतु शंकरः || 47 ||
text_mt: If Menakā is a virtuous mother, and if I am devoted / to the Bull-bannered Lord and to no other, may that Śaṅkara be pleased.

sanskrit_iast:
yadi nāradavaktrottho mantro'yaṃ syātṣaḍakṣaraḥ |
yadi bhaktyā mayā japtaṃ harastena prasīdatu || 48 ||
meaning:
यदि नारदवक्त्रोत्थो मन्त्रोऽयं स्यात्षडक्षरः |
यदि भक्त्या मया जप्तं हरस्तेन प्रसीदतु || 48 ||
text_mt: If this six-syllabled mantra has arisen from Nārada's mouth, / [and] if it has been chanted by me with devotion, by that may Hara be pleased.

sanskrit_iast:
satyaṃ yadi tapastaptaṃ satyaṃ cārādhito haraḥ |
satyaṃ bhaved yadi tapo harastena prasīdatu || 49 ||
meaning:
सत्यं यदि तपस्तप्तं सत्यं चाराधितो हरः |
सत्यं भवेद् यदि तपो हरस्तेन प्रसीदतु || 49 ||
text_mt: If my performed austerity is genuine, and if Hara has been truly worshiped, / if my asceticism is true, by that may Hara be pleased.

sanskrit_iast: mārkaṇḍeya uvāca
meaning: मार्कण्डेय उवाच

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ vicintayantī sā yadātiṣṭhaddharāśrame |
adhomukhī dīnaveśā jaṭābalkalamaṇḍitā || 50 ||
meaning:
एवं विचिन्तयन्ती सा यदातिष्ठद्धराश्रमे |
अधोमुखी दीनवेशा जटाबल्कलमण्डिता || 50 ||
text_mt: While she remained thus reflecting in Hara's hermitage, / with downcast face, poorly clad, adorned with matted locks and bark garments,

sanskrit_iast:
tadaiva brāhmaṇaḥ kaścid brahmacārī dhṛtavrataḥ |
kṛṣṇājinottarīyeṇa dhṛtadaṇḍakamaṇḍaluḥ || 51 ||
meaning:
तदैव ब्राह्मणः कश्चिद् ब्रह्मचारी धृतव्रतः |
कृष्णाजिनोत्तरीयेण धृतदण्डकमण्डलुः || 51 ||
text_mt: just then a certain brāhmaṇa, a brahmacārin observing his vows, / with a black-antelope skin as an upper garment, holding a staff and water pot,

sanskrit_iast:
brāhmyā śriyā dīpyamānaḥ svarṇagauraḥ suśobhanaḥ |
jaṭābhiḥ parivītābhirudriktastanudehabhṛt || 52 ||
meaning:
ब्राह्म्या श्रिया दीप्यमानः स्वर्णगौरः सुशोभनः |
जटाभिः परिवीताभिरुद्रिक्तस्तनुदेहभृत् || 52 ||
text_mt: blazing with the radiance of Brahman, golden-fair, very handsome, / with twisted matted locks, bearing a majestic and slender frame,

sanskrit_iast:
upasthitastadā kālīṃ śambhurbrāhmaṇarūpadhṛk |
āsādya prathamaṃ kālīṃ samābhāṣya tadā dvijaḥ || 53 ||
meaning:
उपस्थितस्तदा कालीं शम्भुर्ब्राह्मणरूपधृक् |
आसाद्य प्रथमं कालीं समाभाष्य तदा द्विजः || 53 ||
text_mt: approached Kālī then—Śambhu wearing the form of a brāhmaṇa. / Having first reached Kālī and addressed her, the twice-born then,

sanskrit_iast:
jñātuṃ pratyakṣato rāgaṃ śrītumicchaṃśca tadvacaḥ |
vāgmī vicitravākyena papraccha girijāṃ tadā || 54 ||
meaning:
ज्ञातुं प्रत्यक्षतो रागं श्रीतुमिच्छंश्च तद्वचः |
वाग्मी विचित्रवाक्येन पप्रच्छ गिरिजां तदा || 54 ||
text_mt: wishing to know her passion directly and desiring to hear her words, / eloquent, questioned Girijā with wonderful speech:

sanskrit_iast: brāhmaṇa uvāca
meaning: ब्राह्मण उवाच

sanskrit_iast:
kā tvaṃ kasyāsi kalyāṇi kimarthaṃ vijane vane |
tapaścarasi durdharṣaṃ munibhiḥ prayatātmabhiḥ || 55 ||
meaning:
का त्वं कस्यासि कल्याणि किमर्थं विजने वने |
तपश्चरसि दुर्धर्षं मुनिभिः प्रयतात्मभिः || 55 ||
text_mt: "Who are you, whose [daughter] are you, blessed lady? Why in this solitary forest / do you practice an austerity formidable [even] for sages of restrained mind?

sanskrit_iast:
na bālā tvaṃ nāpi vṛddhā taruṇī cātiśobhanā |
kathaṃ patiṃ vinābhīkṣṇaṃ tapaścarasi sāmpratam || 56 ||
meaning:
न बाला त्वं नापि वृद्धा तरुणी चातिशोभना |
कथं पतिं विनाभीक्ष्णं तपश्चरसि साम्प्रतम् || 56 ||
text_mt: You are not a child, nor are you old; you are a young woman and exceedingly beautiful. / Why are you now constantly performing austerity without a husband?

sanskrit_iast:
kiṃvā tapasvinī bhadre kasyacit sahacāriṇī |
tapasvinaḥ sa puṣpādi samāhartuṃ gato'nyataḥ || 57 ||
meaning:
किंवा तपस्विनी भद्रे कस्यचित् सहचारिणी |
तपस्विनः स पुष्पादि समाहर्तुं गतोऽन्यतः || 57 ||
text_mt: Or are you an ascetic woman, auspicious lady, the companion of some / ascetic, and has he gone elsewhere to gather flowers and the like?

sanskrit_iast:
etanmama samācakṣva yadi guhyaṃ bhavenna te |
yadi te hṛdaye manyuḥ kaccidvasati samprati |
tadācakṣva samartho'smi tamahaṃ cāpi vāritum || 58 ||
meaning:
एतन्मम समाचक्ष्व यदि गुह्यं भवेन्न ते |
यदि ते हृदये मन्युः कच्चिद्वसति सम्प्रति |
तदाचक्ष्व समर्थोऽस्मि तमहं चापि वारितुम् || 58 ||
text_mt: Tell me this, if it is not a secret to you. / If some grief currently dwells in your heart, / then tell me; I am capable of removing it."

sanskrit_iast:
ityuktā tena vipreṇa girijā'tha nijāṃ sakhīm |
tasyottarapradānāya kaṭākṣeṇa nyayojayat || 59 ||
meaning:
इत्युक्ता तेन विप्रेण गिरिजाऽथ निजां सखीम् |
तस्योत्तरप्रदानाय कटाक्षेण न्ययोजयत् || 59 ||
text_mt: Addressed thus by that brāhmaṇa, Girijā then / directed her female friend with a side-glance to give him an answer.

sanskrit_iast: sā sakhī vijayā tasyā vacanād brāhmaṇaṃ tadā |
meaning: सा सखी विजया तस्या वचनाद् ब्राह्मणं तदा |
text_mt: That friend Vijayā, at her word, then

sanskrit_iast: provācedaṃ yathātathyaṃ vīkṣantī girijāmukham || 60 ||
meaning: प्रोवाचेदं यथातथ्यं वीक्षन्ती गिरिजामुखम् || 60 ||
text_mt: spoke this truthfully to the brāhmaṇa, looking at Girijā's face:

sanskrit_iast:
etasya girirājasya tanayeyaṃ dvijottama |
khyātā ca pārvatīnāmnā kālīti ca suśobhanā || 61 ||
meaning:
एतस्य गिरिराजस्य तनयेयं द्विजोत्तम |
ख्याता च पार्वतीनाम्ना कालीति च सुशोभना || 61 ||
text_mt: "This is the daughter of this king of mountains, O best of the twice-born, / known by the name Pārvatī and as the lovely Kālī.

sanskrit_iast:
ūce yanna ca kenāpi śaṃkaraṃ vṛṣabhadhvajam |
vāñchantī dayitaṃ tīvraṃ tapaścarati vai patim || 62 ||
meaning:
ऊचे यन्न च केनापि शंकरं वृषभध्वजम् |
वाञ्छन्ती दयितं तीव्रं तपश्चरति वै पतिम् || 62 ||
text_mt: She said what no one has said: desiring Śaṅkara, the Bull-bannered, / as her beloved husband, she is indeed performing severe austerity.

sanskrit_iast:
trīṇi varṣasahasrāṇi tapastapati bhāminī |
na śaṃkaro girisutāmadyāpyabhyupapadyate || 63 ||
meaning:
त्रीणि वर्षसहस्राणि तपस्तपति भामिनी |
न शंकरो गिरिसुतामद्याप्यभ्युपपद्यते || 63 ||
text_mt: For three thousand years this passionate lady has been performing austerity, / [yet] Śaṅkara does not accept the mountain's daughter even today.

sanskrit_iast:
śaṃkaroṃ giriśo devaḥ sarvagaḥ parameśvaraḥ |
iti sma gadyate devairmunibhiśca tapodhanaiḥ || 64 ||
meaning:
शंकरों गिरिशो देवः सर्वगः परमेश्वरः |
इति स्म गद्यते देवैर्मुनिभिश्च तपोधनैः || 64 ||
text_mt: 'Śaṅkara is the god Giriśa, all-pervading, the supreme lord'— / so it has been declared by the gods and by the sages rich in austerity.

sanskrit_iast:
kimenāṃ sa na jānāti kiṃ sānau nāsti vā gireḥ |
iti cintāviṣaṇṇeyamadya no labhate sukham || 65 ||
meaning:
किमेनां स न जानाति किं सानौ नास्ति वा गिरेः |
इति चिन्ताविषण्णेयमद्य नो लभते सुखम् || 65 ||
text_mt: Does he not know her, or is he not on the mountain peak? / Despondent with this worry, she finds no joy today.

sanskrit_iast:
aprārthitastvamanayā dayase yadi vā sukham |
tadaināṃ śaṃkareṇādya tvaṃ saṃgamaya suvrata || 66 ||
meaning:
अप्रार्थितस्त्वमनया दयसे यदि वा सुखम् |
तदैनां शंकरेणाद्य त्वं संगमय सुव्रत || 66 ||
text_mt: Even unasked by her, if you grant happiness out of compassion, / then, O you of good vows, unite her today with Śaṅkara."

sanskrit_iast:
iti tasyā vacaḥ śrutvā brahmacārī tadā dvijaḥ |
smayamāna idaṃ vākyaṃ helayovāca pārvatīm || 67 ||
meaning:
इति तस्या वचः श्रुत्वा ब्रह्मचारी तदा द्विजः |
स्मयमान इदं वाक्यं हेलयोवाच पार्वतीम् || 67 ||
text_mt: Having heard her words, the twice-born brahmacārin then, / smiling, playfully spoke these words to Pārvatī:

sanskrit_iast: brāhmaṇa uvāca
meaning: ब्राह्मण उवाच

sanskrit_iast:
amoghadarśanaścāsmi haraṃ cānayituṃ kṣamaḥ |
kintvekaṃ nigadāmyadya niścitaṃ manmataṃ śṛṇu || 68 ||
meaning:
अमोघदर्शनश्चास्मि हरं चानयितुं क्षमः |
किन्त्वेकं निगदाम्यद्य निश्चितं मन्मतं शृणु || 68 ||
text_mt: "My sight is unfailing, and I am able to bring Hara; / but I will say one thing today, listen to my considered opinion.

sanskrit_iast:
jānāmyahaṃ mahādevaṃ taṃ vadāmi śṛṇuṣva me |
vṛṣadhvajo mahādevo bhūtilepī jaṭādharaḥ || 69 ||
meaning:
जानाम्यहं महादेवं तं वदामि शृणुष्व मे |
वृषध्वजो महादेवो भूतिलेपी जटाधरः || 69 ||
text_mt: I know Mahādeva; listen to me as I describe him. / Mahādeva is bull-bannered, smeared with ashes, wearing matted hair,

sanskrit_iast:
vyāghracarmāṃśukaścaikaḥ saṃvīto gajakṛttinā |
kapāladhārī sarpaughaiḥ sarvagātreṣu veṣṭitaḥ || 70 ||
meaning:
व्याघ्रचर्मांशुकश्चैकः संवीतो गजकृत्तिना |
कपालधारी सर्पौघैः सर्वगात्रेषु वेष्टितः || 70 ||
text_mt: clothed only in a tiger skin, wrapped in an elephant hide, / bearing a skull, encircled on all his limbs by hosts of serpents,

sanskrit_iast:
viṣadagdhagalastryakṣo virūpākṣo vibhīṣaṇaḥ |
avyaktajanmā satataṃ gṛhabhogyavivarjitaḥ || 71 ||
meaning:
विषदग्धगलस्त्र्यक्षो विरूपाक्षो विभीषणः |
अव्यक्तजन्मा सततं गृहभोग्यविवर्जितः || 71 ||
text_mt: his throat burnt by poison, three-eyed, having odd eyes, terrifying, / of unmanifest origin, constantly devoid of a home and pleasures,

sanskrit_iast:
jñātibhirbāndhavairhīno bhakṣyabhojyavivarjitaḥ |
śmaśānavāsī satataṃ tatsaṃgaparivarjitaḥ || 72 ||
meaning:
ज्ञातिभिर्बान्धवैर्हीनो भक्ष्यभोज्यविवर्जितः |
श्मशानवासी सततं तत्संगपरिवर्जितः || 72 ||
text_mt: destitute of kinsmen and relatives, deprived of foods and beverages, / constantly dwelling in the cremation ground, devoid of good company,

sanskrit_iast:
garjadbhirvikaṭaistīkṣṇairbhūtaughaiḥ parivāritaḥ |
śṛṃgārarasahīnaśca bhāryāputravivarjitaḥ || 73 ||
meaning:
गर्जद्भिर्विकटैस्तीक्ष्णैर्भूतौघैः परिवारितः |
शृंगाररसहीनश्च भार्यापुत्रविवर्जितः || 73 ||
text_mt: surrounded by roaring, hideous, fierce hordes of spirits, / devoid of erotic sentiment, and bereft of wife and son.

sanskrit_iast:
kena vā kāraṇena tvaṃ bhartāraṃ taṃ samīhase |
pūrvaṃ śrutaṃ mayā caiva tasyāparamidaṃ kṛtam || 74 ||
meaning:
केन वा कारणेन त्वं भर्तारं तं समीहसे |
पूर्वं श्रुतं मया चैव तस्यापरमिदं कृतम् || 74 ||
text_mt: For what reason do you desire him as a husband? / Moreover, I have heard before of another deed of his:

sanskrit_iast:
śṛṇu te nigadāmyadya yadi te gṛhṇa rocate |
dakṣasya duhitā sādhvī satī vṛṣabhavāhanam || 75 ||
meaning:
शृणु ते निगदाम्यद्य यदि ते गृह्ण रोचते |
दक्षस्य दुहिता साध्वी सती वृषभवाहनम् || 75 ||
text_mt: Listen, I will tell you now if you care to receive it. / Dakṣa's virtuous daughter Satī formerly by fate chose the bull-riding lord,

sanskrit_iast:
vavre patiṃ purā daivāt sambhogaparivarjitam |
kapālijāyeti satī dakṣeṇa parivarjitā || 76 ||
meaning:
वव्रे पतिं पुरा दैवात् सम्भोगपरिवर्जितम् |
कपालिजायेति सती दक्षेण परिवर्जिता || 76 ||
text_mt: who is devoid of enjoyment, as her husband. / Saying, 'She is the skull-bearer's wife,' Satī was cast out by Dakṣa,

sanskrit_iast:
yajñabhāgapradānāya śambhuścāpi vivarjitaḥ |
sātha tenāpamānena bhṛśaṃ śokākulā satī || 77 ||
meaning:
यज्ञभागप्रदानाय शम्भुश्चापि विवर्जितः |
साथ तेनापमानेन भृशं शोकाकुला सती || 77 ||
text_mt: and Śambhu was also excluded from the giving of a share in the sacrifice. / Then, deeply afflicted with sorrow by that insult, Satī

sanskrit_iast:
tatyāja svān priyān prāṇāṃstayā tyaktaśca śaṃkaraḥ |
tvaṃ strīratnaṃ tava pitā rājā nikhilabhūbhṛtām || 78 ||
meaning:
तत्याज स्वान् प्रियान् प्राणांस्तया त्यक्तश्च शंकरः |
त्वं स्त्रीरत्नं तव पिता राजा निखिलभूभृताम् || 78 ||
text_mt: abandoned her own dear life, and Śaṅkara was abandoned by her. / You are a jewel among women; your father is the king of all mountains.

sanskrit_iast:
tathāvidhaṃ patiṃ kasmādugreṇa tapasehase |
devendro vā dhaneśo vā pavano vāpyapāṃpatiḥ || 79 ||
meaning:
तथाविधं पतिं कस्मादुग्रेण तपसेहसे |
देवेन्द्रो वा धनेशो वा पवनो वाप्यपांपतिः || 79 ||
text_mt: Why do you seek such a husband through fierce austerity? / Either the king of gods, or the lord of wealth, or the wind, or the lord of waters,

sanskrit_iast:
agnirvā'nyaḥ suro vāpi svarvaidyāvaśvināvapi |
vidyādharo vā gandharvo nāgo vā mānuṣo'tha vā || 80 ||
meaning:
अग्निर्वाऽन्यः सुरो वापि स्वर्वैद्यावश्विनावपि |
विद्याधरो वा गन्धर्वो नागो वा मानुषोऽथ वा || 80 ||
text_mt: or Agni, or another god, or even the physicians of heaven, the two Aśvins, / or a vidyādhara, or a gandharva, or a nāga, or a mortal,

sanskrit_iast:
rūpayauvanasampannaḥ samastaguṇasaṃyutaḥ |
sa te yogyaḥ patiḥ śrīmānudārakulasambhavaḥ || 81 ||
meaning:
रूपयौवनसम्पन्नः समस्तगुणसंयुतः |
स ते योग्यः पतिः श्रीमानुदारकुलसम्भवः || 81 ||
text_mt: endowed with beauty and youth, possessed of all good qualities, / splendid, born of a noble family—he would be a suitable husband for you,

sanskrit_iast:
yena tvaṃ bahuratnaugha-pūrite'narghavistṛte |
mālyapravarasaṃyukte dhūpacūrṇaiḥ suvāsite || 82 ||
meaning:
येन त्वं बहुरत्नौघ-पूरितेऽनर्घविस्तृते |
माल्यप्रवरसंयुक्ते धूपचूर्णैः सुवासिते || 82 ||
text_mt: with whom, on a couch filled with an abundance of many jewels, of priceless breadth, / adorned with excellent garlands, well-fragranced with incense powders,

sanskrit_iast:
mṛdvāstaraṇasaṃyukte vistṛte sumanohare |
cāruprāsādagarbhasthe jāmbūnadavicitrite || 83 ||
meaning:
मृद्वास्तरणसंयुक्ते विस्तृते सुमनोहरे |
चारुप्रासादगर्भस्थे जाम्बूनदविचित्रिते || 83 ||
text_mt: furnished with a soft coverlet, spacious, charming, / set inside a beautiful palace, decorated with gold—

sanskrit_iast:
śayyātale samāsādya sa yogyaste bhavet patiḥ |
evaṃ jñātvā'dya subhage yadi vāñchasi śaṃkaram |
kiṃ te tapobhiḥ sutarāmahaṃ taṃ yojaye tvayā || 84 ||
meaning:
शय्यातले समासाद्य स योग्यस्ते भवेत् पतिः |
एवं ज्ञात्वाऽद्य सुभगे यदि वाञ्छसि शंकरम् |
किं ते तपोभिः सुतरामहं तं योजये त्वया || 84 ||
text_mt: finding you on that bed, he would be a suitable husband for you. / Knowing this, O fortunate lady, if you still desire Śaṅkara today, / what need is there for austerities? I myself will unite him with you."

sanskrit_iast: mārkaṇḍeya uvāca
meaning: मार्कण्डेय उवाच

sanskrit_iast:
iti śrutvā tadā kālī brāhmaṇasyottaraṃ tadā |
mitaṃ tathyaṃ jagādainaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ kopasaṃyuktā || 85 ||
meaning:
इति श्रुत्वा तदा काली ब्राह्मणस्योत्तरं तदा |
मितं तथ्यं जगादैनं ब्राह्मणं कोपसंयुक्ता || 85 ||
text_mt: Hearing this, Kālī then, filled with anger, / spoke measured and true words in reply to this brāhmaṇa:

sanskrit_iast: kālyuvāca
meaning: काल्युवाच

sanskrit_iast:
na jānāsi haraṃ devaṃ tvaṃ jānāmīti bhāṣase |
vahiryad dṛśyate tatte kathitaṃ dvijanandana || 86 ||
meaning:
न जानासि हरं देवं त्वं जानामीति भाषसे |
वहिर्यद् दृश्यते तत्ते कथितं द्विजनन्दन || 86 ||
text_mt: "You do not know the god Hara, yet you say, 'I know him.' / What is seen on the outside, that has been told by you, O son of a twice-born.

sanskrit_iast:
yasya bhāvaṃ na jānanti sendrā brahmādayaḥ surāḥ |
tasya tvaṃ vipratanaya śiśurjñāsyasi kiṃ bhavam || 87 ||
meaning:
यस्य भावं न जानन्ति सेन्द्रा ब्रह्मादयः सुराः |
तस्य त्वं विप्रतनय शिशुर्ज्ञास्यसि किं भवम् || 87 ||
text_mt: Whose true nature the gods headed by Brahmā, including Indra, do not know— / how will you, a child of a brāhmaṇa, know that Bhava?"

sanskrit_iast:
yacchrutaṃ bhavatā nīcavadanād bhāṣitaṃ laghu |
itastatastu śrutvaiva bhāṣase tvaṃ na dṛṣṭavān || 88 ||
meaning:
यच्छ्रुतं भवता नीचवदनाद् भाषितं लघु |
इतस्ततस्तु श्रुत्वैव भाषसे त्वं न दृष्टवान् || 88 ||
text_mt: What you have heard spoken lightly from the mouth of a vile person, / having heard it merely here and there, you speak, though you have not seen it.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmāt tvatto varaṃ nāhaṃ vāñchaye nāpi vā patim |
anyad vada na ca tvatto vāñchaye harasaṃgamam || 89 ||
meaning:
तस्मात् त्वत्तो वरं नाहं वाञ्छये नापि वा पतिम् |
अन्यद् वद न च त्वत्तो वाञ्छये हरसंगमम् || 89 ||
text_mt: Therefore, I desire no boon from you, nor a husband; / speak of something else, and I do not desire union with Hara from you.

sanskrit_iast:
ityuktvā girijā vipramavalokya sakhīmukham |
idamāha tadā kālī saṃśayārūḍhacetanā || 90 ||
meaning:
इत्युक्त्वा गिरिजा विप्रमवलोक्य सखीमुखम् |
इदमाह तदा काली संशयारूढचेतना || 90 ||
text_mt: Having spoken thus to the twice-born, the mountain's daughter looked at the face of her friend; / then Kālī, her mind mounted by doubt, said this:

sanskrit_iast:
mahatā cintaneneha tapasārādhito haraḥ |
tanmamāgre viprasuto nindituṃ vākyamuktavān || 91 ||
meaning:
महता चिन्तनेनेह तपसाराधितो हरः |
तन्ममाग्रे विप्रसुतो निन्दितुं वाक्यमुक्तवान् || 91 ||
text_mt: "With intense contemplation and austerity, Hara has been propitiated here; / yet before me, the son of a twice-born has spoken words of censure.

sanskrit_iast:
tadahaṃ cāpaneṣyāmi stutivākyena sāmpratam |
mahātmanāṃ ca yo nindāṃ śṛṇoti kurute'thavā || 92 ||
meaning:
तदहं चापनेष्यामि स्तुतिवाक्येन साम्प्रतम् |
महात्मनां च यो निन्दां शृणोति कुरुतेऽथवा || 92 ||
text_mt: Therefore, I shall now remove [that sin] with words of praise. / Whoever hears the censure of great-souled beings, or commits it,

sanskrit_iast:
tayorāgaḥ samaṃ pūrvaṃ mayā tātamukhācchrutam |
tasmāttadapaneṣye'haṃ tanniṣedhaya viprakam || 93 ||
meaning:
तयोरागः समं पूर्वं मया तातमुखाच्छ्रुतम् |
तस्मात्तदपनेष्येऽहं तन्निषेधय विप्रकम् || 93 ||
text_mt: their fault is equal; thus I heard previously from the mouth of my father. / Therefore, I shall wipe it away; restrain that twice-born!"

sanskrit_iast: mārkaṇḍeya uvāca
meaning: मार्कण्डेय उवाच

sanskrit_iast:
ityuktvā sā sakhīṃ kālī śambhusaṃgatamānasā |
āgaḥsaṃmārjanāyāśu haraṃ stotumupākramat || 94 ||
meaning:
इत्युक्त्वा सा सखीं काली शम्भुसंगतमानसा |
आगःसंमार्जनायाशु हरं स्तोतुमुपाक्रमत् || 94 ||
text_mt: Having spoken thus to her friend, Kālī, her mind absorbed in Śambhu, / immediately began to praise Hara in order to wipe away the fault:

sanskrit_iast:
namaḥ śivāya śāntāya kāraṇatrayahetave |
nivedayāmi cātmānaṃ tvaṃ gatiḥ parameśvaraḥ || 95 ||
meaning:
नमः शिवाय शान्ताय कारणत्रयहेतवे |
निवेदयामि चात्मानं त्वं गतिः परमेश्वरः || 95 ||
text_mt: "Homage to Śiva, peaceful, the cause of the threefold cause! / I offer myself [to you]; you are the refuge, the supreme Lord!

sanskrit_iast:
vijñānasaubhāgyasuhṛdgatāya te
prapañcahīnāya hiraṇyabāhave |
namo'stu nārāyaṇa padmasambhava
pradhānabījāya jagaddhitāya te || 96 ||
meaning:
विज्ञानसौभाग्यसुहृद्गताय ते
प्रपञ्चहीनाय हिरण्यबाहवे |
नमोऽस्तु नारायण पद्मसम्भव
प्रधानबीजाय जगद्धिताय ते || 96 ||
text_mt: To you, who have attained the state of friend to knowledge and good fortune, / free from worldly manifoldness, golden-armed! / Homage be to you, Nārāyaṇa, born from the lotus, / the seed of pradhāna, who work the welfare of the world!"

sanskrit_iast:
iti stuvantīṃ punareva sa dvija-
stadā vacaḥ kiṃcidudīrituṃ punaḥ |
samīkṣya kālīmakarot sayatnakaṃ
buddhvā samācaṣṭa sakhīṃ gireḥ sutā || 97 ||
meaning:
इति स्तुवन्तीं पुनरेव स द्विज-
स्तदा वचः किंचिदुदीरितुं पुनः |
समीक्ष्य कालीमकरोत् सयत्नकं
बुद्ध्वा समाचष्ट सखीं गिरेः सुता || 97 ||
text_mt: As she was thus praising him, that twice-born made an effort / to speak some word again, looking at Kālī; / observing this, the mountain's daughter said to her friend:

sanskrit_iast:
ayaṃ dvijaḥ kiṃcana vaktumiccha-
tyugraṃ haraṃ cāpi na saṃvidānaḥ |
nindannahi prāṇaharīṃ harasya
nindāmahaṃ śrotumiha kṣamāmi || 98 ||
meaning:
अयं द्विजः किंचन वक्तुमिच्छ-
त्युग्रं हरं चापि न संविदानः |
निन्दन्नहि प्राणहरीं हरस्य
निन्दामहं श्रोतुमिह क्षमामि || 98 ||
text_mt: "This twice-born wishes to say something, / not knowing fierce Hara and censuring him; / I am not able to hear here censure of Hara that robs one of life.

sanskrit_iast:
yāvad bhūrivaco'syāhaṃ na śṛṇomyadhunā sakhi |
gacchāmi tāvad dūrāya samuttiṣṭhāmi matpriye || 99 ||
meaning:
यावद् भूरिवचोऽस्याहं न शृणोम्यधुना सखि |
गच्छामि तावद् दूराय समुत्तिष्ठामि मत्प्रिये || 99 ||
text_mt: Before I hear more of his words now, friend, / I will go far away; I am rising up, my dear!"

sanskrit_iast:
ityuktvā sā tayā sakhyā sahitā himavatsutā |
pratasthe'tha samutthāya tamutsṛjya dvijaṃ haṭhāt || 100 ||
meaning:
इत्युक्त्वा सा तया सख्या सहिता हिमवत्सुता |
प्रतस्थेऽथ समुत्थाय तमुत्सृज्य द्विजं हठात् || 100 ||
text_mt: Having spoken thus, Himavat's daughter, accompanied by that friend, / then arose and departed, suddenly abandoning that twice-born.

sanskrit_iast:
atha śambhurnijaṃ rūpamāsthāya himavatsutām |
taṃ samutsṛjya gacchantīṃ haraḥ smeramukho'nvayāt || 101 ||
meaning:
अथ शम्भुर्निजं रूपमास्थाय हिमवत्सुताम् |
तं समुत्सृज्य गच्छन्तीं हरः स्मेरमुखोऽन्वयात् || 101 ||
text_mt: Then Śambhu, assuming his own form, / followed Himavat's daughter, who was leaving having abandoned him, his face smiling:

sanskrit_iast:
ahaṃ haro mahādevo māṃ saṃstauṣi na cādhunā |
sammukhībhava he kāli samāśvāsaya śāṃkari || 102 ||
meaning:
अहं हरो महादेवो मां संस्तौषि न चाधुना |
सम्मुखीभव हे कालि समाश्वासय शांकरि || 102 ||
text_mt: "I am Hara, Mahādeva; do you not praise me now? / Face me, O Kālī! Take comfort, O Śāṅkarī!"

sanskrit_iast:
ityuktvā sa mahādevo gacchantyāḥ purato gataḥ |
prasārya hastau kālyāstu gatiṃ tasya virodhayan || 103 ||
meaning:
इत्युक्त्वा स महादेवो गच्छन्त्याः पुरतो गतः |
प्रसार्य हस्तौ काल्यास्तु गतिं तस्य विरोधयन् || 103 ||
text_mt: Having spoken thus, Mahādeva went before her as she walked, / and spreading out both hands, blocked the path of Kālī.

sanskrit_iast:
sā vīkṣya śambhuvadanaṃ tatkṣaṇādabhavaddhaṭhāt |
adhomukhī taḍidvātacakiteva gireḥ sutā || 104 ||
meaning:
सा वीक्ष्य शम्भुवदनं तत्क्षणादभवद्धठात् |
अधोमुखी तडिद्वातचकितेव गिरेः सुता || 104 ||
text_mt: Beholding the face of Śambhu, in that moment, the mountain's daughter / suddenly cast down her face, like one startled by lightning and wind.

sanskrit_iast:
mandākṣaṃ prītilajjābhiḥ sā jaḍeva tadābhavat |
vaktuṃ ca nāśakat kiṃcidvivakṣurapi bhāminī || 105 ||
meaning:
मन्दाक्षं प्रीतिलज्जाभिः सा जडेव तदाभवत् |
वक्तुं च नाशकत् किंचिद्विवक्षुरपि भामिनी || 105 ||
text_mt: Downcast with love and shame, she then became as if stunned; / though wishing to speak, the beautiful woman was unable to say anything.

sanskrit_iast:
manorathānāṃ siddhyā tu sudhābhiriva pūritam |
śarīramabhavattasyā mudā pūrṇaṃ dvijottamāḥ || 106 ||
meaning:
मनोरथानां सिद्ध्या तु सुधाभिरिव पूरितम् |
शरीरमभवत्तस्या मुदा पूर्णं द्विजोत्तमाः || 106 ||
text_mt: Through the fulfillment of her desires, her body became as if filled with nectar, / filled with joy, O best of the twice-born.

sanskrit_iast:
ṣaṭtrivarṣasahasraistu tapaḥkleśamavindata |
yattaṃ kṣaṇāt samutsṛjya sammodamuditābhavat || 107 ||
meaning:
षट्त्रिवर्षसहस्रैस्तु तपःक्लेशमविन्दत |
यत्तं क्षणात् समुत्सृज्य सम्मोदमुदिताभवत् || 107 ||
text_mt: The suffering of austerity she had endured for thirty-six thousand years, / she cast away in an instant and became elated with great delight.

sanskrit_iast:
tāṃ ca vīkṣya tathābhūtāṃ praṇayād vṛṣabhadhvajaḥ |
kāmena bhasmarūpeṇa gātrasthena ca mohitaḥ || 108 ||
meaning:
तां च वीक्ष्य तथाभूतां प्रणयाद् वृषभध्वजः |
कामेन भस्मरूपेण गात्रस्थेन च मोहितः || 108 ||
text_mt: And beholding her in such a state, Vṛṣabhadhvaja, out of love, / was enchanted by Kāma, who remained in the form of ashes on his limbs.

sanskrit_iast:
atha tāṃ virahodriktaḥ sametya vṛṣabhadhvajaḥ |
sambodhayannidaṃ cāṭuvacanaṃ proktavān mudā || 109 ||
meaning:
अथ तां विरहोद्रिक्तः समेत्य वृषभध्वजः |
सम्बोधयन्निदं चाटुवचनं प्रोक्तवान् मुदा || 109 ||
text_mt: Then Vṛṣabhadhvaja, overcome by [the pain of] separation, approached her / and, addressing her with joy, spoke this flattering speech:

sanskrit_iast:
na tu sundari māṃ vaktuṃ kiṃcanāpi tvamīhase |
tapaḥkleśaṃ smarayantī kiṃ mahyaṃ kupyasi sāmpratam || 110 ||
meaning:
न तु सुन्दरि मां वक्तुं किंचनापि त्वमीहसे |
तपःक्लेशं स्मरयन्ती किं मह्यं कुप्यसि साम्प्रतम् || 110 ||
text_mt: "You do not wish to say anything at all to me, O lovely one; / remembering the suffering of austerity, are you angry with me now?

sanskrit_iast:
ahaṃ ca paritapyāmi tvāmṛte subhage mama |
samayād yat samārabdhaṃ tapastaptuṃ tvayā samam || 111 ||
meaning:
अहं च परितप्यामि त्वामृते सुभगे मम |
समयाद् यत् समारब्धं तपस्तप्तुं त्वया समम् || 111 ||
text_mt: And I burn with grief without you, O fortunate one! / In accordance with the pact that was made by me to practice austerity together with you,

sanskrit_iast:
sānurakto'tha saṃskṛtya bhaviṣyāmi tvayā priye |
adhunā samatīto me yaḥ kṛtaḥ samayo mayā || 112 ||
meaning:
सानुरक्तोऽथ संस्कृत्य भविष्यामि त्वया प्रिये |
अधुना समतीतो मे यः कृतः समयो मया || 112 ||
text_mt: I, full of love and purified, will be with you, O beloved! / Now the compact made by me has passed.

sanskrit_iast:
tapase bhavatī cāpi tapasaiva susaṃskṛtā |
saṃcintanena japyena tīvreṇa tapasā tadā |
mūlyena mahatā krīto dāso'haṃ māṃ niyojaya || 113 ||
meaning:
तपसे भवती चापि तपसैव सुसंस्कृता |
संचिन्तनेन जप्येन तीव्रेण तपसा तदा |
मूल्येन महता क्रीतो दासोऽहं मां नियोजय || 113 ||
text_mt: You were also prepared for austerity through austerity alone. / By contemplation, by recitation, by intense austerity, / I am bought as a slave with a great price; employ me!

sanskrit_iast:
tvadaṅgānāṃ saṃskaraṇe jaṭānāṃ ca prasādhane |
pramucya balkalaṃ gātrāccārvaṃśukaniveśane || 114 ||
meaning:
त्वदङ्गानां संस्करणे जटानां च प्रसाधने |
प्रमुच्य बल्कलं गात्राच्चार्वंशुकनिवेशने || 114 ||
text_mt: In adorning your limbs and dressing your matted hair, / in stripping the bark garment from your body and putting on lovely garments,

sanskrit_iast:
hāranūpurakeyūrakāñcyādiparidhāpane |
drutaṃ niyojaya śubhe yadi sneho'sti mādṛśi || 115 ||
meaning:
हारनूपुरकेयूरकाञ्च्यादिपरिधापने |
द्रुतं नियोजय शुभे यदि स्नेहोऽस्ति मादृशि || 115 ||
text_mt: in putting on necklaces, anklets, bracelets, waistbands, and the like, / employ me swiftly, O auspicious one, if you have affection for someone like me!

sanskrit_iast:
nirdagdho yo mayā kāmo bhasmarūpeṇa mattanau |
sthito māṃ pratikṛtyeva tvadagre dagdhumicchati || 116 ||
meaning:
निर्दग्धो यो मया कामो भस्मरूपेण मत्तनौ |
स्थितो मां प्रतिकृत्येव त्वदग्रे दग्धुमिच्छति || 116 ||
text_mt: The Kāma who was burned up by me, dwelling in the form of ashes on my body, / wishes to burn me in front of you, as if in revenge.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmāduddhara māṃ kāmādagneriva manohare |
tvadaṅgāmṛtadānena prasīda dayite mama || 117 ||
meaning:
तस्मादुद्धर मां कामादग्नेरिव मनोहरे |
त्वदङ्गामृतदानेन प्रसीद दयिते मम || 117 ||
text_mt: Therefore rescue me from Kāma as from fire, O charming one! / Be gracious, my beloved, by bestowing the nectar of your limbs!"

sanskrit_iast:
iti kālikāpurāṇe tricatvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 43 ||
catuścatvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ
meaning:
इति कालिकापुराणे त्रिचत्वारिंशोऽध्यायः || 43 ||
चतुश्चत्वारिंशोऽध्यायः
text_mt: Thus ends the forty-third chapter in the Kālikāpurāṇa. / The forty-fourth chapter.

sanskrit_iast: mārkaṇḍeya uvāca
meaning: मार्कण्डेय उवाच

sanskrit_iast:
atha śrutvā vacaḥ śambhorgirijātīva harṣitā |
mene prāptaṃ tadā śambhuṃ sundaraṃ dayitaṃ patim || 1 ||
meaning:
अथ श्रुत्वा वचः शम्भोर्गिरिजातीव हर्षिता |
मेने प्राप्तं तदा शम्भुं सुन्दरं दयितं पतिम् || 1 ||
text_mt: Then, having heard the words of Śambhu, the mountain's daughter was exceedingly gladdened; / she then considered Śambhu won as her handsome, beloved husband.

sanskrit_iast:
atha prāha tadā kālī sakhīvaktreṇa śaṃkaram |
yathā sa śṛṇute vākyaṃ śrotumicchaṃśca śaṃkaraḥ || 2 ||
meaning:
अथ प्राह तदा काली सखीवक्त्रेण शंकरम् |
यथा स शृणुते वाक्यं श्रोतुमिच्छंश्च शंकरः || 2 ||
text_mt: Then Kālī addressed Śaṅkara through the mouth of her friend, / so that Śaṅkara, desiring to hear, heard the speech:

sanskrit_iast:
na sandhāvatibhedena pravartante'tra sajjanāḥ |
maryādayā harastaṃ me pāṇiṃ gṛhṇātu śaṃkaraḥ || 3 ||
meaning:
न सन्धावतिभेदेन प्रवर्तन्तेऽत्र सज्जनाः |
मर्यादया हरस्तं मे पाणिं गृह्णातु शंकरः || 3 ||
text_mt: "Good people in this world do not act in violation of propriety; / let Hara, Śaṅkara, take my hand according to customary practice.

sanskrit_iast:
pitṛdattā bhavet kanyā tapodattā bhavennahi |
tapasā cet pradattāhaṃ māṃ tātaśca pradāsyati || 4 ||
meaning:
पितृदत्ता भवेत् कन्या तपोदत्ता भवेन्नहि |
तपसा चेत् प्रदत्ताहं मां तातश्च प्रदास्यति || 4 ||
text_mt: A maiden should be given by her father; she is not given by austerity. / If I am won through austerity, my father will give me.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmāt samprārthya pitaraṃ himavantaṃ nageśvaram |
vaivāhikena vidhinā pāṇiṃ gṛhṇātu me haraḥ || 5 ||
meaning:
तस्मात् सम्प्रार्थ्य पितरं हिमवन्तं नगेश्वरम् |
वैवाहिकेन विधिना पाणिं गृह्णातु मे हरः || 5 ||
text_mt: Therefore, having asked my father, Himavat, the lord of mountains, / let Hara take my hand according to the nuptial rite."

sanskrit_iast: mārkaṇḍeya uvāca
meaning: मार्कण्डेय उवाच

sanskrit_iast:
ityuktvā virarāmātha kālī lajjāsamanvitā |
harā'pi tadvacaḥ satyaṃ tathyaṃ yogyaṃ tadāgrahīt || 6 ||
meaning:
इत्युक्त्वा विररामाथ काली लज्जासमन्विता |
हराऽपि तद्वचः सत्यं तथ्यं योग्यं तदाग्रहीत् || 6 ||
text_mt: Having spoken thus, Kālī, filled with modest shame, fell silent; / Hara too then accepted that speech as true, correct, and proper.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ sa sagaṇaḥ śambhustatra vāsaṃ tadākarot |
gaṅgāvataraṇe sānau yathāpūrvaṃ tathādhunā || 7 ||
meaning:
ततः स सगणः शम्भुस्तत्र वासं तदाकरोत् |
गङ्गावतरणे सानौ यथापूर्वं तथाधुना || 7 ||
text_mt: Then Śambhu, with his attendants, made his dwelling there, / on the slope at Gaṅgāvataraṇa, now as before.

sanskrit_iast:
kālī piturgṛhaṃ yātā sakhībhiḥ parivāritā |
nālokayantī sā dīnā gurūṇāṃ vadanaṃ satī || 8 ||
meaning:
काली पितुर्गृहं याता सखीभिः परिवारिता |
नालोकयन्ती सा दीना गुरूणां वदनं सती || 8 ||
text_mt: Kālī went to her father's house surrounded by her friends; / humble, the virtuous woman did not look upon the faces of her elders.

sanskrit_iast:
etasminnantare sapta marīcipramukhān munīn |
cintayāmāsa śaśibhṛt kālīṃ prārthayituṃ tadā || 9 ||
meaning:
एतस्मिन्नन्तरे सप्त मरीचिप्रमुखान् मुनीन् |
चिन्तयामास शशिभृत् कालीं प्रार्थयितुं तदा || 9 ||
text_mt: Meanwhile, the Moon-bearer then thought upon the seven sages, / Marīci and the others, in order to make a request for Kālī.

sanskrit_iast:
cintitāḥ sapta munayastatkṣaṇānmadanāriṇā |
ākṛṣṭā iva kenāpi tatsakāśamupāgatāḥ || 10 ||
meaning:
चिन्तिताः सप्त मुनयस्तत्क्षणान्मदनारिणा |
आकृष्टा इव केनापि तत्सकाशमुपागताः || 10 ||
text_mt: Contemplated in that instant by the enemy of Madana, / the seven sages came into his presence as though drawn by someone.

sanskrit_iast:
tān munīn dadṛśe śambhuḥ saptāgnīniva dīpitān |
arundhatīṃ vasiṣṭhasya sakāśe dadṛśe satīm || 11 ||
meaning:
तान् मुनीन् ददृशे शम्भुः सप्ताग्नीनिव दीपितान् |
अरुन्धतीं वसिष्ठस्य सकाशे ददृशे सतीम् || 11 ||
text_mt: Śambhu saw those sages blazing like seven fires; / he saw Arundhatī, the virtuous wife, in the presence of Vasiṣṭha.

sanskrit_iast:
arundhatīṃ tato dṛṣṭvā vasiṣṭhasya samīpataḥ |
mene yoṣidgrahaṃ dharmaṃ munibhiścāpyavarjitam || 12 ||
meaning:
अरुन्धतीं ततो दृष्ट्वा वसिष्ठस्य समीपतः |
मेने योषिद्ग्रहं धर्मं मुनिभिश्चाप्यवर्जितम् || 12 ||
text_mt: Then, having seen Arundhatī beside Vasiṣṭha, / he considered the taking of a wife to be a duty not avoided even by sages.

sanskrit_iast:
tataste munayaḥ sarve sampūjya vṛṣabhadhvajam |
idamūcuḥ praharṣeṇa smaraṇākarṣitāḥ priyam || 13 ||
meaning:
ततस्ते मुनयः सर्वे सम्पूज्य वृषभध्वजम् |
इदमूचुः प्रहर्षेण स्मरणाकर्षिताः प्रियम् || 13 ||
text_mt: Then all those sages, having worshipped Vṛṣabhadhvaja, / drawn by his remembrance, spoke this agreeable [speech] with great joy:

sanskrit_iast: ṛṣayaḥ ūcuḥ
meaning: ऋषयः ऊचुः

sanskrit_iast:
yat pratyakṣaṃ dṛśyate śuddharūpaṃ
candraprakhya candrakhaṇḍopaśobhi |
antaḥprajñaṃ bhāvitaṃ tanmunīnāṃ
bhāgyaṃ dṛṣṭaṃ bhāgadheyena muktaiḥ || 14 ||
meaning:
यत् प्रत्यक्षं दृश्यते शुद्धरूपं
चन्द्रप्रख्य चन्द्रखण्डोपशोभि |
अन्तःप्रज्ञं भावितं तन्मुनीनां
भाग्यं दृष्टं भागधेयेन मुक्तैः || 14 ||
text_mt: That which is seen visibly, whose form is pure, / resembling the moon and adorned with a crescent moon, / inwardly conscious, contemplated by sages, / is the good fortune seen by the liberated through their destiny.

sanskrit_iast:
prajñātantraṃ dhyānatantraṃ purastā-
nnityaṃ dhyeyaṃ dhyāyināṃ svaprakāśam |
puñjībhūtaṃ bāhyatattvena śaśvad
yogyaprāpyaṃ dhāma śambhorudāram || 15 ||
meaning:
प्रज्ञातन्त्रं ध्यानतन्त्रं पुरस्ता-
न्नित्यं ध्येयं ध्यायिनां स्वप्रकाशम् |
पुञ्जीभूतं बाह्यतत्त्वेन शश्वद्
योग्यप्राप्यं धाम शम्भोरुदारम् || 15 ||
text_mt: Governed by wisdom, governed by meditation, standing before [us], / ever to be meditated upon by meditators, self-luminous, / massed together by the external reality, ever / attainable by the worthy—the noble splendour of Śambhu.

sanskrit_iast:
dṛṣṭvā yasyaivāgrabhāgaṃ sa netraṃ
trāṇāya syād darśanaṃ sūryatulyam |
taddhāmedaṃ sthānasarvasya nityaṃ
bhaktyā stutyaṃ taṃ namaḥ śambhudeham || 16 ||
meaning:
दृष्ट्वा यस्यैवाग्रभागं स नेत्रं
त्राणाय स्याद् दर्शनं सूर्यतुल्यम् |
तद्धामेदं स्थानसर्वस्य नित्यं
भक्त्या स्तुत्यं तं नमः शम्भुदेहम् || 16 ||
text_mt: Having seen the very forefront of which, that eye / resembling the sun would become a vision for protection; / this splendour, the eternal [source] of all abiding, / is to be praised with devotion; homage to that body of Śambhu!

sanskrit_iast:
prakāśate yaḥ prathamādibhāgataḥ
sthitaḥ sa vāme ya ihaiva netā |
so'smākamastu prathamaṃ svasiddhyai
harasya śaktyā vidhṛto lalāṭe || 17 ||
meaning:
प्रकाशते यः प्रथमादिभागतः
स्थितः स वामे य इहैव नेता |
सोऽस्माकमस्तु प्रथमं स्वसिद्ध्यै
हरस्य शक्त्या विधृतो ललाटे || 17 ||
text_mt: He who shines forth from the foremost and initial part, / he who stands on the left, who is the guide right here, / may he first of all be for our success, / held on the forehead of Hara by his power.

sanskrit_iast:
yaḥ pradhānātmakaḥ sattvarajobhyāṃ tamasānvitaḥ |
puruṣaḥ sarvajagatāṃ sa haro naḥ prasīdatu || 18 ||
meaning:
यः प्रधानात्मकः सत्त्वरजोभ्यां तमसान्वितः |
पुरुषः सर्वजगतां स हरो नः प्रसीदतु || 18 ||
text_mt: He who consists of pradhāna, endowed with sattva, rajas, and tamas, / the puruṣa of all the worlds—may that Hara be gracious to us.

sanskrit_iast: mārkaṇḍeya uvāca
meaning: मार्कण्डेय उवाच

sanskrit_iast:
iti saṃstutya deveśaṃ munayo vinayānatāḥ |
ūcuḥ kimarthaṃ bhavatā smṛtāstanno nigadyatām || 19 ||
meaning:
इति संस्तुत्य देवेशं मुनयो विनयानताः |
ऊचुः किमर्थं भवता स्मृतास्तन्नो निगद्यताम् || 19 ||
text_mt: Having thus praised the lord of the gods, the sages, bowed in modesty, / said: "For what purpose were we remembered by you? Let that be told to us."

sanskrit_iast:
teṣāṃ tadvacanaṃ śrutvā śaṃkaraḥ prahasanniva |
jagāda tānmunīn sarvānābhāṣya pṛthak pṛthak || 20 ||
meaning:
तेषां तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा शंकरः प्रहसन्निव |
जगाद तान्मुनीन् सर्वानाभाष्य पृथक् पृथक् || 20 ||
text_mt: Hearing that speech of theirs, Śaṃkara, smiling as it were, / addressed all those sages, speaking to each one separately:

sanskrit_iast: īśvara uvāca
meaning: ईश्वर उवाच

sanskrit_iast:
hitāya sarvajagatāṃ sambhogāyātmanastathā |
dārān grahītumicchāmi tathā santānavṛddhaye || 21 ||
meaning:
हिताय सर्वजगतां सम्भोगायात्मनस्तथा |
दारान् ग्रहीतुमिच्छामि तथा सन्तानवृद्धये || 21 ||
text_mt: "For the welfare of all the worlds, and likewise for my own pleasure, / and also for the increase of offspring, I wish to take a wife.

sanskrit_iast:
sahāyaṃ tatra kurvantu bhavanto mama sāmpratam |
madarthe ca tataḥ kālīṃ yācantāṃ tuhinācalam || 22 ||
meaning:
सहायं तत्र कुर्वन्तु भवन्तो मम साम्प्रतम् |
मदर्थे च ततः कालीं याचन्तां तुहिनाचलम् || 22 ||
text_mt: Therefore, render assistance to me now; / and for my sake, ask the Snow Mountain for Kālī.

sanskrit_iast:
mahatā tapasā kālī māṃ patiṃ laghu vindatām |
kintu grahīṣye vidhinā tasmād yācantu taṃ girim || 23 ||
meaning:
महता तपसा काली मां पतिं लघु विन्दताम् |
किन्तु ग्रहीष्ये विधिना तस्माद् याचन्तु तं गिरिम् || 23 ||
text_mt: Through great asceticism Kālī would easily find me as her husband, / but I shall take [her] according to rule; therefore, ask that mountain.

sanskrit_iast:
yathā yathā svayaṃ kālīṃ śailo dātuṃ samutsahet |
tathā tathā vidadhvaṃ hi yūyaṃ vāgvibhavānvitāḥ || 24 ||
meaning:
यथा यथा स्वयं कालीं शैलो दातुं समुत्सहेत् |
तथा तथा विदध्वं हि यूयं वाग्विभवान्विताः || 24 ||
text_mt: In whatever way the mountain himself may be willing to give Kālī, / in that very way arrange it, endowed as you are with the power of speech."

sanskrit_iast: mārkaṇḍeya uvāca
meaning: मार्कण्डेय उवाच

sanskrit_iast:
haraṃ sambodhya munayo hyagacchan girirāḍgṛham |
tena prapūjitāste tu procustaṃ munayo girim || 25 ||
meaning:
हरं सम्बोध्य मुनयो ह्यगच्छन् गिरिराड्गृहम् |
तेन प्रपूजितास्ते तु प्रोचुस्तं मुनयो गिरिम् || 25 ||
text_mt: Having taken leave of Hara, the sages went to the home of the king of mountains; / honoured by him, the sages said to that mountain:

sanskrit_iast:
yaścandraśekharo devo devadevaśca yo mataḥ |
śāpānugrahaṇe śakto ya eko jagatāṃ patiḥ || 26 ||
meaning:
यश्चन्द्रशेखरो देवो देवदेवश्च यो मतः |
शापानुग्रहणे शक्तो य एको जगतां पतिः || 26 ||
text_mt: "The god who is Candraśekhara, who is regarded as the god of gods, / capable of cursing and bestowing grace, who is the one lord of the worlds,

sanskrit_iast:
yaḥ saṃharati sarvāṇi jaganti prayalodbhave |
yo vibhūtiprado bhakte nānārūpo manoharaḥ || 27 ||
meaning:
यः संहरति सर्वाणि जगन्ति प्रयलोद्भवे |
यो विभूतिप्रदो भक्ते नानारूपो मनोहरः || 27 ||
text_mt: who dissolves all worlds at the onset of dissolution, / who grants sovereign power to a devotee, multiform and captivating—

sanskrit_iast:
sa te duhitaraṃ kālīṃ bhāryāmādātumicchati |
yadi paśyasi tvaṃ yogyaṃ varaṃ taṃ duhituḥ samam || 28 ||
meaning:
स ते दुहितरं कालीं भार्यामादातुमिच्छति |
यदि पश्यसि त्वं योग्यं वरं तं दुहितुः समम् || 28 ||
text_mt: he wishes to take your daughter Kālī as his wife. / If you consider him a suitable groom, equal to your daughter,

sanskrit_iast: tadā prayaccha tanayāṃ kālīṃ śaśibhṛte gire |
meaning: तदा प्रयच्छ तनयां कालीं शशिभृते गिरे |
text_mt: then give your daughter Kālī to the moon-bearer, O mountain!"

sanskrit_iast: ityuktastairgiripatiściraṃ svahṛdayasthitam || 29 ||
meaning: इत्युक्तस्तैर्गिरिपतिश्चिरं स्वहृदयस्थितम् || 29 ||
text_mt: Thus addressed by them, the lord of mountains, [knowing] what had long dwelled in his own heart

sanskrit_iast:
duhituśca priyaṃ jñātvā prāpya sadvacanānmudam |
āha cedaṃ prakāśena yuṣmābhistvahamāgataiḥ || 30 ||
meaning:
दुहितुश्च प्रियं ज्ञात्वा प्राप्य सद्वचनान्मुदम् |
आह चेदं प्रकाशेन युष्माभिस्त्वहमागतैः || 30 ||
text_mt: and knowing his daughter's wish, gained joy from their excellent words, / and said this openly: "By you who have arrived,

sanskrit_iast:
pāvito muniśārdūlaiḥ pūritaśca manorathaḥ |
dāsyāmi śambhave putrīṃ yuṣmābhiḥ prārthitastvaham || 31 ||
meaning:
पावितो मुनिशार्दूलैः पूरितश्च मनोरथः |
दास्यामि शम्भवे पुत्रीं युष्माभिः प्रार्थितस्त्वहम् || 31 ||
text_mt: O best of sages, I am purified and my desire is fulfilled. / Being requested by you, I shall give my daughter to Śambhu.

sanskrit_iast:
pūrvameva tapastaptvā tayeśaḥ patirīhitaḥ |
dhāturniyojanamidaṃ ko'nyathā kartumutsahet || 32 ||
meaning:
पूर्वमेव तपस्तप्त्वा तयेशः पतिरीहितः |
धातुर्नियोजनमिदं कोऽन्यथा कर्तुमुत्सहेत् || 32 ||
text_mt: Having performed asceticism previously, Īśa was sought by her as a husband. / This is the arrangement of Dhātṛ; who would venture to make it otherwise?

sanskrit_iast:
ko'nyaḥ prārthayituṃ śakt'h sutāṃ mama vinā harāt |
hareṇāvagṛhītā yā tāmanyaḥ kaḥ samutsahet || 33 ||
meaning:
कोऽन्यः प्रार्थयितुं शक्त्ऽह् सुतां मम विना हरात् |
हरेणावगृहीता या तामन्यः कः समुत्सहेत् || 33 ||
text_mt: Who else, without Hara, is capable of asking for my daughter? / Who else would dare to take her who has been accepted by Hara?

sanskrit_iast:
haraṃ gṛhītvā manasā nānyaṃ sāpīha vāñchati |
ityuktvā menayā sārdhaṃ sutāṃ dātuṃ ca śambhave || 34 ||
meaning:
हरं गृहीत्वा मनसा नान्यं सापीह वाञ्छति |
इत्युक्त्वा मेनया सार्धं सुतां दातुं च शम्भवे || 34 ||
text_mt: Having accepted Hara in her mind, she too desires no other in this world." / Having spoken thus, and having agreed together with Menā to give their daughter to Śambhu,

sanskrit_iast:
aṅgīkṛtya visṛṣṭāste hyanuprāpurmaheśvaram |
te gatvā munayaḥ sarve marīcipramukhā dvijāḥ || 35 ||
meaning:
अङ्गीकृत्य विसृष्टास्ते ह्यनुप्रापुर्महेश्वरम् |
ते गत्वा मुनयः सर्वे मरीचिप्रमुखा द्विजाः || 35 ||
text_mt: they were sent away and went back to Maheśvara. / All those sages having gone, the twice-born led by Marīci,

sanskrit_iast:
śailarājo yadācaṣṭa tadūcurmadanāraye |
himavāṃstanayāṃ dātuṃ tubhyamutsahate haraḥ || 36 ||
meaning:
शैलराजो यदाचष्ट तदूचुर्मदनारये |
हिमवांस्तनयां दातुं तुभ्यमुत्सहते हरः || 36 ||
text_mt: spoke to Madanāri what the king of mountains had said: / "Himavat is eager to give his daughter to you, O Hara.

sanskrit_iast:
yadidānīṃ tvayā kartuṃ yujyate kriyatāṃ tu tat |
asmāṃścāpyanujānīhi hara gantuṃ nijāspadam || 37 ||
meaning:
यदिदानीं त्वया कर्तुं युज्यते क्रियतां तु तत् |
अस्मांश्चाप्यनुजानीहि हर गन्तुं निजास्पदम् || 37 ||
text_mt: What is now fit to be done by you, let that be done; / and grant us leave, O Hara, to go to our own abode."

sanskrit_iast:
siddhaṃ jñātvā haraḥ sādhyaṃ muditastān visṛṣṭavān |
yathāyogyaṃ samābhāṣya kramādekaikaśo munīn || 38 ||
meaning:
सिद्धं ज्ञात्वा हरः साध्यं मुदितस्तान् विसृष्टवान् |
यथायोग्यं समाभाष्य क्रमादेकैकशो मुनीन् || 38 ||
text_mt: Knowing that what was to be accomplished was achieved, Hara, delighted, dismissed them, / having addressed the sages one by one in turn, as was appropriate:

sanskrit_iast:
kālīvivāhāvasare yūyamāyāta māṃ prati |
iti te vai hareṇoktaṃ pratiśrutyarṣayo yayuḥ || 39 ||
meaning:
कालीविवाहावसरे यूयमायात मां प्रति |
इति ते वै हरेणोक्तं प्रतिश्रुत्यर्षयो ययुः || 39 ||
text_mt: "At the time of Kālī's wedding, come to me." / Having promised [to do] what was spoken by Hara, the sages departed.

sanskrit_iast:
athānyonyapriyatayā kṛtvā kṛtvā gatāgatam |
samayaṃ kārayāmāsa vivāhāya haro girim || 40 ||
meaning:
अथान्योन्यप्रियतया कृत्वा कृत्वा गतागतम् |
समयं कारयामास विवाहाय हरो गिरिम् || 40 ||
text_mt: Then, having made visits back and forth through mutual affection, / Hara made an agreement with the mountain for the marriage.

sanskrit_iast:
mādhave māsi pañcamyāṃ site pakṣe gurordine |
candre cottaraphālgunyāṃ bharaṇyādau sthite ravau || 41 ||
meaning:
माधवे मासि पञ्चम्यां सिते पक्षे गुरोर्दिने |
चन्द्रे चोत्तरफाल्गुन्यां भरण्यादौ स्थिते रवौ || 41 ||
text_mt: In the month of Mādhava, on the fifth day in the bright fortnight, on the day of Guru, / when the moon was in Uttaraphālgunī and the sun was in the beginning of Bharaṇī,

sanskrit_iast:
āgatā munayastatra marīcipramukhā muhuḥ |
hareṇa cintitāḥ sarve tathā brahmādayaḥ surāḥ || 42 ||
meaning:
आगता मुनयस्तत्र मरीचिप्रमुखा मुहुः |
हरेण चिन्तिताः सर्वे तथा ब्रह्मादयः सुराः || 42 ||
text_mt: the sages led by Marīci arrived there repeatedly, / all called to mind by Hara, as well as the gods led by Brahmā,

sanskrit_iast:
tathā ca sarve dikpālā munayaśca tapodhanā |
śacyā saha tathā śakro brahmāṇyādyāstu mātaraḥ || 43 ||
meaning:
तथा च सर्वे दिक्पाला मुनयश्च तपोधना |
शच्या सह तथा शक्रो ब्रह्माण्याद्यास्तु मातरः || 43 ||
text_mt: and likewise all the guardians of the directions, and the sages rich in asceticism, / and Śakra together with Śacī, and the Mothers headed by Brahmāṇī.

sanskrit_iast: nāradaśca gatastatra devarṣirbrahmaṇaḥ sutaḥ |
meaning: नारदश्च गतस्तत्र देवर्षिर्ब्रह्मणः सुतः |
text_mt: And Nārada, the divine sage, the son of Brahmā, went there.

sanskrit_iast: etaiḥ paricaraiḥ sārdhaṃ gaṇairāpyāyitaḥ svakaiḥ || 44 ||
meaning: एतैः परिचरैः सार्धं गणैराप्यायितः स्वकैः || 44 ||
text_mt: Together with these attendants, gratified by his own gaṇas,

sanskrit_iast:
vaivāhikena vidhinā giriputrīṃ haro'grahīn |
vivāhe girijā śambhoḥ sarpā ye'ṣṭau tanau sthitāḥ || 45 ||
meaning:
वैवाहिकेन विधिना गिरिपुत्रीं हरोऽग्रहीन् |
विवाहे गिरिजा शम्भोः सर्पा येऽष्टौ तनौ स्थिताः || 45 ||
text_mt: Hara took the daughter of the mountain according to the marriage rite. / At the wedding of Śambhu and the mountain-born goddess, the eight serpents that were on his body

sanskrit_iast:
te jāmbunadasaṃnaddhā alaṃkārāstadābhavan |
dvibhujo'bhūnmahādevo jaṭāḥ keśatvamāgatāḥ || 46 ||
meaning:
ते जाम्बुनदसंनद्धा अलंकारास्तदाभवन् |
द्विभुजोऽभून्महादेवो जटाः केशत्वमागताः || 46 ||
text_mt: then became ornaments overlaid with gold; / Mahādeva became two-armed, and his matted locks turned into hair;

sanskrit_iast: śirasthitaścandrakhaṇḍaḥ so'rciṣāṃ jvalito'bhavat || 47 ||
meaning: शिरस्थितश्चन्द्रखण्डः सोऽर्चिषां ज्वलितोऽभवत् || 47 ||
text_mt: the crescent moon resting on his head blazed with rays of light;

sanskrit_iast:
vicitravasanaṃ vyāghrakṛttirāsīttadā dvijāḥ |
vibhūtilepo hyasyābhūt sugandhimalayodbhavaḥ || 48 ||
meaning:
विचित्रवसनं व्याघ्रकृत्तिरासीत्तदा द्विजाः |
विभूतिलेपो ह्यस्याभूत् सुगन्धिमलयोद्भवः || 48 ||
text_mt: the tiger skin became a variegated garment then, O twice-born ones; / the smearing of ashes became fragrant sandalwood paste born of the Malaya [mountains];

sanskrit_iast:
gaurarūpo harastatra babhūvādbhutadarśanaḥ |
tato devāḥ sagandharvāḥ siddhavidyādharoragāḥ || 49 ||
meaning:
गौररूपो हरस्तत्र बभूवाद्भुतदर्शनः |
ततो देवाः सगन्धर्वाः सिद्धविद्याधरोरगाः || 49 ||
text_mt: there Hara became fair-complexioned, wonderful to behold. / Then the gods together with Gandharvas, Siddhas, Vidyādharas, and Uragas

sanskrit_iast:
vismayaṃ paramaṃ jagmurharaṃ dṛṣṭvā tathāvidham |
himavān muditaścāsīt sahaputraiśca menayā || 50 ||
meaning:
विस्मयं परमं जग्मुर्हरं दृष्ट्वा तथाविधम् |
हिमवान् मुदितश्चासीत् सहपुत्रैश्च मेनया || 50 ||
text_mt: fell into supreme astonishment upon seeing Hara in such a state. / Himavat was delighted, together with his sons and Menā,

sanskrit_iast:
jñātayaścāsya mumuhurharaṃ dṛṣṭvā tathāvidham |
idaṃ brahmā tatra jagau haraṃ dṛṣṭvā manoharam || 51 ||
meaning:
ज्ञातयश्चास्य मुमुहुर्हरं दृष्ट्वा तथाविधम् |
इदं ब्रह्मा तत्र जगौ हरं दृष्ट्वा मनोहरम् || 51 ||
text_mt: and his kinsmen were enchanted upon seeing Hara in such a state. / Seeing the captivating Hara there, Brahmā proclaimed this:

sanskrit_iast:
sarva śivakaraṃ yasmāt suveśamabhavatsurāḥ |
tasmācchivo'yaṃ lokeṣu nāmnākhyāto'dhikaḥ śivaḥ || 52 ||
meaning:
सर्व शिवकरं यस्मात् सुवेशमभवत्सुराः |
तस्माच्छिवोऽयं लोकेषु नाम्नाख्यातोऽधिकः शिवः || 52 ||
text_mt: "Because his handsome attire became auspicious for all, O gods, / therefore he is named Śiva, the exceedingly auspicious one, in the worlds.

sanskrit_iast:
maheśvaramumāyuktamīdṛśaṃ yaḥ smareddhṛdā |
satataṃ tasya kalyāṇaṃ vāñchitaṃ ca bhaviṣyati || 53 ||
meaning:
महेश्वरमुमायुक्तमीदृशं यः स्मरेद्धृदा |
सततं तस्य कल्याणं वाञ्छितं च भविष्यति || 53 ||
text_mt: Whoever remembers with his heart Maheśvara endowed with Umā in this form, / for him there will always be well-being and what is desired."

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ kālī mahāmāyā yoganidrā jagatprasūḥ |
pūrvaṃ dākṣāyaṇī bhūtvā paścād girisutā'bhavat || 54 ||
meaning:
एवं काली महामाया योगनिद्रा जगत्प्रसूः |
पूर्वं दाक्षायणी भूत्वा पश्चाद् गिरिसुताऽभवत् || 54 ||
text_mt: Thus Kālī, Mahāmāyā, Yoganidrā, mother of the universe, / having previously become Dākṣāyaṇī, later became the daughter of the mountain.

sanskrit_iast:
svayaṃ samarthāpi satī kālī sammohituṃ haram |
tathāpyugraṃ tapastepe hitāya jagatāṃ śivā |
evaṃ sammohayāmāsa kālikā candraśekharam || 55 ||
meaning:
स्वयं समर्थापि सती काली सम्मोहितुं हरम् |
तथाप्युग्रं तपस्तेपे हिताय जगतां शिवा |
एवं सम्मोहयामास कालिका चन्द्रशेखरम् || 55 ||
text_mt: Even though Kālī was herself capable of completely bewitching Hara, / the auspicious Satī nonetheless performed fierce austerities for the welfare of the worlds; / in this way did Kālikā enchant Candraśekhara.

sanskrit_iast:
ityetat kathitaṃ sarvaṃ tyaktadehā satī yathā |
himavattanayā bhūtvā punaḥ prāpa maheśvaram || 56 ||
meaning:
इत्येतत् कथितं सर्वं त्यक्तदेहा सती यथा |
हिमवत्तनया भूत्वा पुनः प्राप महेश्वरम् || 56 ||
text_mt: Thus all of this has been recounted—how Satī abandoned her body / and, becoming the daughter of Himavat, obtained Maheśvara once again.

sanskrit_iast:
idaṃ yaḥ kīrtayet puṇyaṃ kālikācaritaṃ dvijāḥ |
nādhayo vyādhayastasya dīrghāyuḥ sa ca jāyate || 57 ||
meaning:
इदं यः कीर्तयेत् पुण्यं कालिकाचरितं द्विजाः |
नाधयो व्याधयस्तस्य दीर्घायुः स च जायते || 57 ||
text_mt: Whoever proclaims this holy story of Kālikā, O twice-born ones, / is free from mental agonies and bodily illnesses, and is granted a long life.

sanskrit_iast:
idaṃ pavitraṃ paramamidaṃ kalyāṇavardhanam |
śrutvāpi sakṛdevedaṃ śivalokāya gacchati || 58 ||
meaning:
इदं पवित्रं परममिदं कल्याणवर्धनम् |
श्रुत्वापि सकृदेवेदं शिवलोकाय गच्छति || 58 ||
text_mt: This is supremely purifying, this increases all prosperity; / even by hearing it just once, one goes to the world of Śiva.

sanskrit_iast:
yaḥ śrāddhe śrāvayedviprān kālikācaritaṃ mahat |
pitarastasya kaivalyamāpnuvanti na saṃśayaḥ || 59 ||
meaning:
यः श्राद्धे श्रावयेद्विप्रान् कालिकाचरितं महत् |
पितरस्तस्य कैवल्यमाप्नुवन्ति न संशयः || 59 ||
text_mt: Whoever causes the brāhmaṇas to hear this great story of Kālikā at a śrāddha, / their ancestors attain liberation; of this there is no doubt.

sanskrit_iast:
yaḥ śrāvayed brāhmaṇānāṃ sannidhau vā samāyataḥ |
tatra svayaṃ haro gatvā śṛṇoti saha māyayā || 60 ||
meaning:
यः श्रावयेद् ब्राह्मणानां सन्निधौ वा समायतः |
तत्र स्वयं हरो गत्वा शृणोति सह मायया || 60 ||
text_mt: Or whoever recites it with collected mind in the presence of brāhmaṇas, / Hara himself goes there and listens together with Māyā.

sanskrit_iast:
iti vaḥ kathitaṃ puṇyaṃ sarvapāpapraṇāśanam |
yuṣmabhyaṃ rocate cānyadyattat pṛcchantu sattamāḥ || 61 ||
meaning:
इति वः कथितं पुण्यं सर्वपापप्रणाशनम् |
युष्मभ्यं रोचते चान्यद्यत्तत् पृच्छन्तु सत्तमाः || 61 ||
text_mt: Thus has this sacred tale that destroys all sins been related to you; / O best of men, ask what else pleases you.

sanskrit_iast:
iti śrīkālikāpurāṇe kālīharasamāgamo nāma catuścatvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ ||
44 ||
pañcacatvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ
meaning:
इति श्रीकालिकापुराणे कालीहरसमागमो नाम चतुश्चत्वारिंशोऽध्यायः ||
44 ||
पञ्चचत्वारिंशोऽध्यायः
text_mt:
Thus ends the forty-fourth chapter, named 'The Union of Kālī and Hara', in the glorious Kālikāpurāṇa.
44
Forty-fifth chapter.

sanskrit_iast: ṛṣayaḥ ūcuḥ
meaning: ऋषयः ऊचुः

sanskrit_iast:
vicitramidamākhyātaṃ brahman kālīharāgamam |
puṇyaṃ pāpaharaṃ nityaṃ śrutisaukhyapradaṃ varam || 1 ||
meaning:
विचित्रमिदमाख्यातं ब्रह्मन् कालीहरागमम् |
पुण्यं पापहरं नित्यं श्रुतिसौख्यप्रदं वरम् || 1 ||
text_mt: Wondrous is this account that has been told, O holy one—the union of Kālī and Hara, / sacred, sin-destroying, eternal, granting delight to the ear, supreme.

sanskrit_iast:
bhūyaḥ kathaya śarvasya kālītanvardhamuttamam |
kathaṃ jahāra gaurī vā kathambhūtātha kālikā || 2 ||
meaning:
भूयः कथय शर्वस्य कालीतन्वर्धमुत्तमम् |
कथं जहार गौरी वा कथम्भूताथ कालिका || 2 ||
text_mt: Tell further: how did Gaurī take half of Śarva's excellent body? / Or how was Kālikā [transformed]?

sanskrit_iast:
kena vā kāraṇenāśu kṛṣṇā gaurītvamāgatā |
tannaḥ kathaya tattvena muniśreṣṭha dvijottama || 3 ||
meaning:
केन वा कारणेनाशु कृष्णा गौरीत्वमागता |
तन्नः कथय तत्त्वेन मुनिश्रेष्ठ द्विजोत्तम || 3 ||
text_mt: And for what reason did the dark one swiftly attain the state of Gaurī? / Tell us that accurately, O best of ascetics, best of the twice-born!

sanskrit_iast: mārkaṇḍeya uvāca
meaning: मार्कण्डेय उवाच

sanskrit_iast:
idaṃ tu mahadākhyānaṃ kathayiṣyāmi vo'dhunā |
maharṣayastacchṛṇvantu tattvena śubhadaṃ param || 4 ||
meaning:
इदं तु महदाख्यानं कथयिष्यामि वोऽधुना |
महर्षयस्तच्छृण्वन्तु तत्त्वेन शुभदं परम् || 4 ||
text_mt: Now I shall tell you this great narrative; / let the great sages hear it accurately—it bestows supreme fortune.

sanskrit_iast:
etadaurva purā rājā sagaraḥ pṛṣṭavānmunim |
sa taṃ yathā samācaṣṭa tadvo'tha nigadāmyaham || 5 ||
meaning:
एतदौर्व पुरा राजा सगरः पृष्टवान्मुनिम् |
स तं यथा समाचष्ट तद्वोऽथ निगदाम्यहम् || 5 ||
text_mt: In ancient times, King Sagara asked this of the sage Aurva; / as he explained it to him, so I shall now relate it to you.

sanskrit_iast:
purābhūt somavaṃśe ca sagaro nāma pārthivaḥ |
sa śrīmān balavān dakṣaḥ sarvaśāstrārthapāragaḥ || 6 ||
meaning:
पुराभूत् सोमवंशे च सगरो नाम पार्थिवः |
स श्रीमान् बलवान् दक्षः सर्वशास्त्रार्थपारगः || 6 ||
text_mt: Formerly, in the lineage of Soma, there was a king named Sagara; / he was glorious, mighty, skilled, and fully conversant with the meaning of all treatises.

sanskrit_iast:
so'bhūdekarathenaiva jitvā sarvān mahībhujaḥ |
sārvabhaumo narapatiḥ sarvarājaguṇairyutaḥ || 7 ||
meaning:
सोऽभूदेकरथेनैव जित्वा सर्वान् महीभुजः |
सार्वभौमो नरपतिः सर्वराजगुणैर्युतः || 7 ||
text_mt: Having conquered all monarchs with just a single chariot, he became / a universal sovereign, a king endowed with all royal virtues.

sanskrit_iast:
taṃ prāptarājyaṃ rājānaṃ sagaraṃ pārthivottamam |
sabhājayitumatyarthaṃ munayaḥ samupāgatāḥ || 8 ||
meaning:
तं प्राप्तराज्यं राजानं सगरं पार्थिवोत्तमम् |
सभाजयितुमत्यर्थं मुनयः समुपागताः || 8 ||
text_mt: To pay him high honor, when King Sagara, the best of monarchs, / had obtained his realm, sages arrived from all around.

sanskrit_iast:
prācyodīcyā mahātmāno dākṣiṇātyāstathottarāḥ |
munayo brāhmaṇāścaiva nṛpaṃ draṣṭuṃ samāgaman || 9 ||
meaning:
प्राच्योदीच्या महात्मानो दाक्षिणात्यास्तथोत्तराः |
मुनयो ब्राह्मणाश्चैव नृपं द्रष्टुं समागमन् || 9 ||
text_mt: From the east, the north, the south, and the higher north, / high-souled sages and brāhmaṇas came to see the king.

sanskrit_iast:
āgateṣvatha sarveṣu mahātmā jvalanopamaḥ |
aurvo nāma muniḥ śrīmānāgato nandituṃ nṛpam || 10 ||
meaning:
आगतेष्वथ सर्वेषु महात्मा ज्वलनोपमः |
और्वो नाम मुनिः श्रीमानागतो नन्दितुं नृपम् || 10 ||
text_mt: When all had arrived, the high-souled and glorious sage named Aurva, / blazing like fire, arrived to rejoice with the king.

sanskrit_iast:
tamāgataṃ muniṃ dṛṣṭvā jvalantamiva pāvakam |
saparyayā mahatyā tu sagarastamapūjayat || 11 ||
meaning:
तमागतं मुनिं दृष्ट्वा ज्वलन्तमिव पावकम् |
सपर्यया महत्या तु सगरस्तमपूजयत् || 11 ||
text_mt: Seeing that sage arrive, blazing like fire, / Sagara worshipped him with great homage.

sanskrit_iast:
pādyamācamanīyaṃ ca dattvaivārdhapurogamam |
niveśayāmāsa ca taṃ muniśreṣṭhaṃ varāsane || 12 ||
meaning:
पाद्यमाचमनीयं च दत्त्वैवार्धपुरोगमम् |
निवेशयामास च तं मुनिश्रेष्ठं वरासने || 12 ||
text_mt: Having offered water for the feet, sipping water, and respectful offerings, / he seated that best of sages on an excellent throne.

sanskrit_iast:
uvāca ca mahātmānamaurvaṃ sa sagaro nṛpaḥ |
praṇamya ca yathāyogyaṃ kuśalaṃ ta iti dvijam || 13 ||
meaning:
उवाच च महात्मानमौर्वं स सगरो नृपः |
प्रणम्य च यथायोग्यं कुशलं त इति द्विजम् || 13 ||
text_mt: And bowing down appropriately, King Sagara addressed / that high-souled twice-born Aurva: 'Is it well with you?'

sanskrit_iast:
sa ca prāha muniśreṣṭho nararāja sadā mama |
sarvatra kuśalaṃ tvāṃ tu draṣṭuṃ kuśalamutsahe || 14 ||
meaning:
स च प्राह मुनिश्रेष्ठो नरराज सदा मम |
सर्वत्र कुशलं त्वां तु द्रष्टुं कुशलमुत्सहे || 14 ||
text_mt: And that best of sages said: 'O king of men, / all is always well with me; but I desire to see well-being in you.

sanskrit_iast:
tvattaḥ ko'nyo'sti kuśalī pṛthivyāṃ sarvarājasu |
ya ekaḥ sañjigāyāśu bhavān sakalapārthivān || 15 ||
meaning:
त्वत्तः कोऽन्योऽस्ति कुशली पृथिव्यां सर्वराजसु |
य एकः सञ्जिगायाशु भवान् सकलपार्थिवान् || 15 ||
text_mt: Who else on earth among all kings is more prosperous than you, / you who alone have swiftly conquered all the monarchs?

sanskrit_iast:
kuśalaṃ vardhatāṃ nityaṃ tava rājavarottama |
yathā nītyā sadācāraiḥ pṛthivīṃ śādhi bhūpate || 16 ||
meaning:
कुशलं वर्धतां नित्यं तव राजवरोत्तम |
यथा नीत्या सदाचारैः पृथिवीं शाधि भूपते || 16 ||
text_mt: May your welfare always increase, O supreme among excellent kings! / Rule the earth according to policy and righteous conduct, O lord of the earth!

sanskrit_iast:
tava vṛddhau jagadvṛddhirvṛddhau ceṣṭāṃ tat'h kuru |
śubhrāṃśuvṛddhau satataṃ sāgarasyeva vardhanam || 17 ||
meaning:
तव वृद्धौ जगद्वृद्धिर्वृद्धौ चेष्टां तत्ऽह् कुरु |
शुभ्रांशुवृद्धौ सततं सागरस्येव वर्धनम् || 17 ||
text_mt: In your flourishing is the flourishing of the world; therefore exert yourself toward flourishing, / like the constant swelling of the ocean with the waxing of the moon.

sanskrit_iast:
prathamaṃ sadguṇairātmā kriyatāṃ nṛpa yojanam |
tataḥ svabhāryā mahiṣī kriyatāṃ tadguṇairyutā || 18 ||
meaning:
प्रथमं सद्गुणैरात्मा क्रियतां नृप योजनम् |
ततः स्वभार्या महिषी क्रियतां तद्गुणैर्युता || 18 ||
text_mt: First, O king, let oneself be joined with noble virtues; / then let one's wife, the chief queen, be endowed with those virtues.

sanskrit_iast:
nityā saṃyojitā cet syādvanitā svayameva hi |
svaguṇeṣu pravekṣyantī mahatyapi dhṛtavratā || 19 ||
meaning:
नित्या संयोजिता चेत् स्याद्वनिता स्वयमेव हि |
स्वगुणेषु प्रवेक्ष्यन्ती महत्यपि धृतव्रता || 19 ||
text_mt: For if a woman is constantly united [with virtues] of her own accord, / she, entering into his virtues, will become exalted, steadfast in her vows.

sanskrit_iast:
śrūyate himavatputrī śambhusaṃgatamānasā |
kriyābhyupāyairbahubhiḥ śambhunā sā prayojitā || 20 ||
meaning:
श्रूयते हिमवत्पुत्री शम्भुसंगतमानसा |
क्रियाभ्युपायैर्बहुभिः शम्भुना सा प्रयोजिता || 20 ||
text_mt: It is heard that the daughter of Himavat, whose heart was fixed upon Śambhu, / was engaged by Śambhu through many methods of action.

sanskrit_iast:
tato'timahatā premṇā śaṃkarasyātha pārvatī |
śarīramardhamaharattasyaivānumate satī || 21 ||
meaning:
ततोऽतिमहता प्रेम्णा शंकरस्याथ पार्वती |
शरीरमर्धमहरत्तस्यैवानुमते सती || 21 ||
text_mt: Then out of immense love, the virtuous Pārvatī / took half of Śaṅkara's body, with his very consent.

sanskrit_iast:
ardhanārīśvarastena tadā prabhṛti śaṅkaraḥ |
abhavan nṛpaśārdūla nānyāṃ bhāryāṃ gṛhītavān || 22 ||
meaning:
अर्धनारीश्वरस्तेन तदा प्रभृति शङ्करः |
अभवन् नृपशार्दूल नान्यां भार्यां गृहीतवान् || 22 ||
text_mt: From that time forth, O tiger among kings, Śaṅkara became / the Lord Who is Half Woman; he took no other wife.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmāt tvamapi rājendra svajāyāmātmanottare |
guṇaiḥ saṃyojaya laghuṃ saṃyojaya tataḥ sutam || 23 ||
meaning:
तस्मात् त्वमपि राजेन्द्र स्वजायामात्मनोत्तरे |
गुणैः संयोजय लघुं संयोजय ततः सुतम् || 23 ||
text_mt: Therefore, O king of kings, unite your own wife, following yourself, / with virtues; swiftly thereafter, unite your son.'

sanskrit_iast: mārkaṇḍeya uvāca
meaning: मार्कण्डेय उवाच

sanskrit_iast:
ityaurvabhāṣita śrutvā sagaro'pi mudānvitaḥ |
ida munimapṛcchat sa nṛpatiḥ smitasantataḥ || 24 ||
meaning:
इत्यौर्वभाषित श्रुत्वा सगरोऽपि मुदान्वितः |
इद मुनिमपृच्छत् स नृपतिः स्मितसन्ततः || 24 ||
text_mt: Hearing these words of Aurva, Sagara was filled with joy, / and with a perpetual smile, the monarch questioned the sage:

sanskrit_iast: sagara uvāca
meaning: सगर उवाच

sanskrit_iast:
kathaṃ sā girijā devī kāyārdhamaharat satī |
śaṅkarasya dvijaśreṣṭha tadahaṃ śrotumutsahe || 25 ||
meaning:
कथं सा गिरिजा देवी कायार्धमहरत् सती |
शङ्करस्य द्विजश्रेष्ठ तदहं श्रोतुमुत्सहे || 25 ||
text_mt: How did that virtuous goddess, the Mountain's Daughter, take half of Śaṅkara's / body, O best of the twice-born? I desire to hear that.

sanskrit_iast:
nītyā yayā vā yoktavyā svātmā bhāryā suto'thavā |
tāṃ nītiṃ ca sadācārasaṃhitāṃ śrotumutsahe || 26 ||
meaning:
नीत्या यया वा योक्तव्या स्वात्मा भार्या सुतोऽथवा |
तां नीतिं च सदाचारसंहितां श्रोतुमुत्सहे || 26 ||
text_mt: And by what policy one should train oneself, one's wife, or one's son— / I desire to hear that policy and the collection of righteous conduct.

sanskrit_iast:
rājanītiṃ satāṃ nītimanyeṣāṃ ca kṛtātmanām |
pṛthak pṛthak śrotumicchurahaṃ tvāṃ nāthaye dvija || 27 ||
meaning:
राजनीतिं सतां नीतिमन्येषां च कृतात्मनाम् |
पृथक् पृथक् श्रोतुमिच्छुरहं त्वां नाथये द्विज || 27 ||
text_mt: The policy of kings, the conduct of the virtuous, and of other disciplined souls— / desiring to hear these one by one, I make my request of you, O twice-born.

sanskrit_iast:
yadi guhyamidaṃ brahmanna tadā śrotumutsahe |
tathā nājñāpayāmi tvāṃ śrotumicchuśca tatsamam ||
kṛpayā kathanīyaṃ cettadā kathaya tanmune || 28 ||
meaning:
यदि गुह्यमिदं ब्रह्मन्न तदा श्रोतुमुत्सहे |
तथा नाज्ञापयामि त्वां श्रोतुमिच्छुश्च तत्समम् ||
कृपया कथनीयं चेत्तदा कथय तन्मुने || 28 ||
text_mt: If this is a secret, O holy one, then I do not desire to hear it; / I do not command you, though I desire to hear as much as is fitting; / if it may be told out of grace, then relate it, O sage!

sanskrit_iast: mārkaṇḍeya uvāca
meaning: मार्कण्डेय उवाच

sanskrit_iast:
ityevaṃ sagareṇoktamaurvo'pi dvijasattama |
pratyuvāca mahātmānaṃ kṛpālustatra bhūpatau || 29 ||
meaning:
इत्येवं सगरेणोक्तमौर्वोऽपि द्विजसत्तम |
प्रत्युवाच महात्मानं कृपालुस्तत्र भूपतौ || 29 ||
text_mt: When addressed thus by Sagara, O best of the twice-born, Aurva too, / compassionate toward the monarch, replied to the high-souled king:

sanskrit_iast: aurva uvāca
meaning: और्व उवाच

sanskrit_iast:
śṛṇu rājan pravakṣyāmi yad yat pṛṣṭamiha tvayā |
yathā harasya tanvarthaṃ bhūbhṛtputrī purāharat || 30 ||
meaning:
शृणु राजन् प्रवक्ष्यामि यद् यत् पृष्टमिह त्वया |
यथा हरस्य तन्वर्थं भूभृत्पुत्री पुराहरत् || 30 ||
text_mt: 'Listen, O king, I shall declare whatever you have asked here: / how the Mountain's Daughter took half of Hara's body in ancient times,

sanskrit_iast:
yathā nītistvayā kāryā yatra yatra nṛpottama |
sarveṣāṃ ca sadācāraṃ kramād vakṣyāmi tacchṛṇu || 31 ||
meaning:
यथा नीतिस्त्वया कार्या यत्र यत्र नृपोत्तम |
सर्वेषां च सदाचारं क्रमाद् वक्ष्यामि तच्छृणु || 31 ||
text_mt: how policy should be carried out by you wherever applicable, O best of kings, / and the righteous conduct of all in due order; listen to that!

sanskrit_iast:
yadoḍhā himavatputrī śaṅkareṇa mahātmanā |
kiyantaṃ sa tadā kālaṃ tatra ninye sahomayā || 32 ||
meaning:
यदोढा हिमवत्पुत्री शङ्करेण महात्मना |
कियन्तं स तदा कालं तत्र निन्ये सहोमया || 32 ||
text_mt: When the daughter of Himavat was wedded by high-souled Śaṅkara, / he then spent some time there together with Umā.

sanskrit_iast:
ramamāṇastayā sārdhaṃ sānau kuñje darīṣu ca |
vijahāra ciraṃ tatra pārvatīṃ modayan haraḥ || 33 ||
meaning:
रममाणस्तया सार्धं सानौ कुञ्जे दरीषु च |
विजहार चिरं तत्र पार्वतीं मोदयन् हरः || 33 ||
text_mt: Sporting with her on the ridge, in the bower, and in the caves, / Hara roamed there for a long time, delighting Pārvatī.

sanskrit_iast:
atha kāle tu samprāpte śambhuḥ kailāsaparvatam |
sagaṇo bhāryayā sārdhamagacchattridivopamam || 34 ||
meaning:
अथ काले तु सम्प्राप्ते शम्भुः कैलासपर्वतम् |
सगणो भार्यया सार्धमगच्छत्त्रिदिवोपमम् || 34 ||
text_mt: Then, when the time had arrived, Śambhu, accompanied by his retinue / and along with his wife, went to Mount Kailāsa, which resembles heaven.

sanskrit_iast:
sa tvayā krīḍamānaśca tyaktadhyānātmacintanaḥ |
tadvaktracandre netrāṇi cakorāniva cākarot || 35 ||
meaning:
स त्वया क्रीडमानश्च त्यक्तध्यानात्मचिन्तनः |
तद्वक्त्रचन्द्रे नेत्राणि चकोरानिव चाकरोत् || 35 ||
text_mt: Sporting with her, he abandoned meditation and contemplation on the Self, / and turned his eyes toward the moon of her face like cakora birds.'

sanskrit_iast:
puṣpāṇi kvacidāhṛtya girijāṃ prati śaṅkaraḥ |
sarvāṅgasaṅginīṃ mālāṃ vidadhe'timanoharām || 36 ||
meaning:
पुष्पाणि क्वचिदाहृत्य गिरिजां प्रति शङ्करः |
सर्वाङ्गसङ्गिनीं मालां विदधेऽतिमनोहराम् || 36 ||
text_mt: Gathering flowers somewhere, Śaṅkara fashioned for Girijā / an exceedingly delightful garland that draped over her entire body.

sanskrit_iast:
kadācidādarśatale yugapaccātmano mukham |
mukhaṃ tathaivāparṇāyā vīkṣāñcakre vṛṣadhavajaḥ || 37 ||
meaning:
कदाचिदादर्शतले युगपच्चात्मनो मुखम् |
मुखं तथैवापर्णाया वीक्षाञ्चक्रे वृषधवजः || 37 ||
text_mt: At times, in the surface of a mirror, the bull-bannered [god] / gazed upon his own face and likewise Aparṇā's face at the same time.

sanskrit_iast:
kadācinmṛganābhīnāṃ vilepairgandhapatrakam |
tasyā ghanastanayuge vililekha smarāntakaḥ || 38 ||
meaning:
कदाचिन्मृगनाभीनां विलेपैर्गन्धपत्रकम् |
तस्या घनस्तनयुगे विलिलेख स्मरान्तकः || 38 ||
text_mt: At times, with ointments of musk, Smarāntaka painted / fragrant leaf-designs upon her pair of firm breasts.

sanskrit_iast:
gandhasāravilepena tilakānyambikātanau |
lalāṭe cākaroccāru candravadghanasandhiṣu || 39 ||
meaning:
गन्धसारविलेपेन तिलकान्यम्बिकातनौ |
ललाटे चाकरोच्चारु चन्द्रवद्घनसन्धिषु || 39 ||
text_mt: With an ointment of sandalwood paste he made lovely tilakas / on the body of Ambikā, on her forehead like the moon, and at the joints of her firm [limbs].

sanskrit_iast:
umāniryāsasaṃsaktakeśapāśeṣu citrakam |
candanāgurukastūrīkuṅkumasya vilepanaiḥ || 40 ||
meaning:
उमानिर्याससंसक्तकेशपाशेषु चित्रकम् |
चन्दनागुरुकस्तूरीकुङ्कुमस्य विलेपनैः || 40 ||
text_mt: With ointments of sandalwood, agallochum, musk, and saffron, / he made variegated patterns on the masses of hair perfumed with excellent scents,

sanskrit_iast:
cakāra yena tasyāstu keśapāśo vyarājata |
nartanāyāvatīrṇasya śikhipucchasya sāmyadhṛk || 41 ||
meaning:
चकार येन तस्यास्तु केशपाशो व्यराजत |
नर्तनायावतीर्णस्य शिखिपुच्छस्य साम्यधृक् || 41 ||
text_mt: Whereby her mass of hair shone, / bearing a likeness to the tail of a peacock descended to dance.

sanskrit_iast:
jāmbūnadamayāñ śuddhān kuṇḍalādyān manoharān |
alaṅkārānumā dehe samākārṣīd vṛṣadhvajaḥ || 42 ||
meaning:
जाम्बूनदमयाञ् शुद्धान् कुण्डलाद्यान् मनोहरान् |
अलङ्कारानुमा देहे समाकार्षीद् वृषध्वजः || 42 ||
text_mt: The bull-bannered [god] placed charming ornaments / of pure gold, earrings and the like, upon Umā's body.

sanskrit_iast:
tairjāmbūnadasambhūtairyojitairgirijātanuḥ |
vibhāti jaladāpūrṇe kālikeva taḍidgaṇaiḥ || 43 ||
meaning:
तैर्जाम्बूनदसम्भूतैर्योजितैर्गिरिजातनुः |
विभाति जलदापूर्णे कालिकेव तडिद्गणैः || 43 ||
text_mt: Adorned with those golden [ornaments], Girijā's body / shone like a dark cloud-bank filled with water [and flashing] with lightning-streaks.

sanskrit_iast:
sarvairdivyairalaṅkārairnānāratnaiḥ sadaṃśukaiḥ |
sampūrṇamaṇḍitā kālī sādṛśyaṃ prakṛterdadhau || 44 ||
meaning:
सर्वैर्दिव्यैरलङ्कारैर्नानारत्नैः सदंशुकैः |
सम्पूर्णमण्डिता काली सादृश्यं प्रकृतेर्दधौ || 44 ||
text_mt: Fully decorated with all divine ornaments, / various gems, and fine garments, Kālī bore the likeness of Prakṛti.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ sadā sānurāgastasyāṃ śambhurjagatpatiḥ |
jagaddhitāya cikrīḍa kālyā dayitayā saha || 45 |
meaning:
एवं सदा सानुरागस्तस्यां शम्भुर्जगत्पतिः |
जगद्धिताय चिक्रीड काल्या दयितया सह || 45 |
text_mt: Thus Śambhu, the lord of the world, constantly full of love for her, / sported with his beloved Kālī for the welfare of the world.

sanskrit_iast:
kālī ca jagatāṃ mātā mahāmāyā jaganmayī |
yoganidrā jagadbuddhirvidyāvidyātmikākhilā || 46 ||
meaning:
काली च जगतां माता महामाया जगन्मयी |
योगनिद्रा जगद्बुद्धिर्विद्याविद्यात्मिकाखिला || 46 ||
text_mt: And Kālī is the mother of the worlds, Mahāmāyā, composed of the universe, / Yoganidrā, the intellect of the universe, consisting of all knowledge and ignorance,

sanskrit_iast:
prakṛtiḥ paramā mūrtiḥ sargāntasthitikāriṇī |
sammohya śaṅkaraṃ yatrājjagatāṃ ca hiteṣiṇī |
reme tena samaṃ devī candrikeva sudhāṃśunā || 47 ||
meaning:
प्रकृतिः परमा मूर्तिः सर्गान्तस्थितिकारिणी |
सम्मोह्य शङ्करं यत्राज्जगतां च हितेषिणी |
रेमे तेन समं देवी चन्द्रिकेव सुधांशुना || 47 ||
text_mt: Prakṛti, the supreme form, the agent of creation, dissolution, and maintenance. / Having bewitched Śaṅkara with effort, desirous of the welfare of the worlds, / the goddess sported with him as moonlight with the moon.

sanskrit_iast:
athaikadā smaraharaḥ kailāsāgre sahomayā |
ramamāṇo mudā yukto dadṛśe'psarasaḥ śubhāḥ || 48 ||
meaning:
अथैकदा स्मरहरः कैलासाग्रे सहोमया |
रममाणो मुदा युक्तो ददृशेऽप्सरसः शुभाः || 48 ||
text_mt: Then one day Smarahara, sporting with Umā / on the peak of Kailāsa and filled with joy, saw the auspicious apsarases,

sanskrit_iast:
rūpayauvanasampannāḥ sarvalakṣaṇasaṃyutāḥ |
tāsāṃ madhyagatā veśyā urvaśī ca manoharā || 49 ||
meaning:
रूपयौवनसम्पन्नाः सर्वलक्षणसंयुताः |
तासां मध्यगता वेश्या उर्वशी च मनोहरा || 49 ||
text_mt: Endowed with beauty and youth, possessed of all auspicious marks; / and in their midst was the charming courtesan Urvaśī.

sanskrit_iast:
tāḥ sarvā raktagaurāṃgyaḥ sarvālaṅkārabhūṣitāḥ |
munīnāṃ ca mano'tyarthaṃ śaktā mohayituṃ haṭhāt || 50 ||
meaning:
ताः सर्वा रक्तगौरांग्यः सर्वालङ्कारभूषिताः |
मुनीनां च मनोऽत्यर्थं शक्ता मोहयितुं हठात् || 50 ||
text_mt: They were all fair with a rosy complexion, adorned with all ornaments, / and powerfully capable of utterly bewildering the minds of sages.

sanskrit_iast:
tāḥ praṇamya haraṃ dṛṣṭvā girijāṃ ca manoramām |
agre prāñjalayastasthustadbhītinatamastakāḥ || 51 ||
meaning:
ताः प्रणम्य हरं दृष्ट्वा गिरिजां च मनोरमाम् |
अग्रे प्राञ्जलयस्तस्थुस्तद्भीतिनतमस्तकाः || 51 ||
text_mt: Having bowed down upon seeing Hara and delightful Girijā, / they stood before them with joined palms, their heads bent low in awe of them.

sanskrit_iast:
atha prāha tadā bhargaḥ pārvatīmidamadbhutam |
tāsāṃ samakṣaṃ tasyāṃ tu bhāṣituṃ syād yadapriyam || 52 ||
meaning:
अथ प्राह तदा भर्गः पार्वतीमिदमद्भुतम् |
तासां समक्षं तस्यां तु भाषितुं स्याद् यदप्रियम् || 52 ||
text_mt: Then Bharga said this astonishing thing to Pārvatī / in their presence, which would prove displeasing to her when spoken:

sanskrit_iast:
kāli bhinnāñjanaśyāme urvaśyādyapsarogaṇaiḥ |
tvayeha strīsvabhāvena saṃlāpaḥ kriyatāmiti || 53 ||
meaning:
कालि भिन्नाञ्जनश्यामे उर्वश्याद्यप्सरोगणैः |
त्वयेह स्त्रीस्वभावेन संलापः क्रियतामिति || 53 ||
text_mt: "O Kālī, dark as crushed collyrium! / By womanly nature, converse here with Urvaśī and the assembly of apsarases!"

sanskrit_iast:
tacchrutvā vacanaṃ tasya yathāyogyaṃ ca sorvaśī |
apsarasaḥ samābhāṣya visṛṣṭā girijā tayā || 54 ||
meaning:
तच्छ्रुत्वा वचनं तस्य यथायोग्यं च सोर्वशी |
अप्सरसः समाभाष्य विसृष्टा गिरिजा तया || 54 ||
text_mt: Having heard that speech of his, Girijā / conversed fittingly with that Urvaśī and the apsarases, and dismissed them.

sanskrit_iast:
atha sā krodhavaśagā pārvatī bhargabhāvitāt |
kālī bhinnāñjanaśyāmetyuditā hyabhavat kṣaṇāt || 55 ||
meaning:
अथ सा क्रोधवशगा पार्वती भर्गभावितात् |
काली भिन्नाञ्जनश्यामेत्युदिता ह्यभवत् क्षणात् || 55 ||
text_mt: Then Pārvatī fell under the sway of anger because Bharga / had thoughtlessly addressed her in that moment as "O Kālī, dark as crushed collyrium!"

sanskrit_iast:
sā cāpsarasāṃ purato varṇoddeśavikatthanam |
na sehe manyunā yuktā girijendukalābhṛtaḥ || 56 ||
meaning:
सा चाप्सरसां पुरतो वर्णोद्देशविकत्थनम् |
न सेहे मन्युना युक्ता गिरिजेन्दुकलाभृतः || 56 ||
text_mt: In the presence of the apsarases, Girijā, overcome with indignation, / could not bear that mockery regarding her complexion by the crescent-moon-bearer.

sanskrit_iast:
atha sā roṣasaṃyuktā tyaktvā vṛṣavāhanam |
apahnute śailasānau roṣāpahnutimāgatā || 57 ||
meaning:
अथ सा रोषसंयुक्ता त्यक्त्वा वृषवाहनम् |
अपह्नुते शैलसानौ रोषापह्नुतिमागता || 57 ||
text_mt: Then, filled with wrath, she left the bull-rider / and concealed herself on a mountain ridge, having entered into hiding out of anger.

sanskrit_iast:
mārgamāṇo'tha virahavyākulo vṛṣavāhanaḥ |
nāsasāda kiyatkālaṃ pārvatīṃ parvatottame || 58 ||
meaning:
मार्गमाणोऽथ विरहव्याकुलो वृषवाहनः |
नाससाद कियत्कालं पार्वतीं पर्वतोत्तमे || 58 ||
text_mt: Then the bull-rider, searching and agitated by separation, / did not find Pārvatī on the excellent mountain for some time.

sanskrit_iast:
virahavyākulaṃ jñātvā svaya sā pārvatī haram |
ātmānaṃ darśayāmāsa girisānāvapahnute || 59 ||
meaning:
विरहव्याकुलं ज्ञात्वा स्वय सा पार्वती हरम् |
आत्मानं दर्शयामास गिरिसानावपह्नुते || 59 ||
text_mt: Knowing Hara to be agitated by separation, / Pārvatī herself revealed herself on the hidden mountain ridge.

sanskrit_iast:
tāmāsādya tataḥ śambhuḥ kimarthamabhajaḥ priye |
mānaṃ manonudaṃ devi viśīrṇa iva cābravīt || 60 ||
meaning:
तामासाद्य ततः शम्भुः किमर्थमभजः प्रिये |
मानं मनोनुदं देवि विशीर्ण इव चाब्रवीत् || 60 ||
text_mt: Then, having approached her, Śambhu said, as if broken: / "Why, O beloved goddess, have you resorted to injured pride, which torments the heart?

sanskrit_iast:
bharturāgaḥ purandhrīṇāṃ mānagrahaṇakāraṇam |
tadvinā grahaṇāttasya bhīru prāpnoti vācyatām || 61 ||
meaning:
भर्तुरागः पुरन्ध्रीणां मानग्रहणकारणम् |
तद्विना ग्रहणात्तस्य भीरु प्राप्नोति वाच्यताम् || 61 ||
text_mt: An offense by the husband is the cause of women taking to injured pride; / taking to it without that, O timid one, incurs blame.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmāt kimarthamakaro roṣaṃ tvaṃ jalajānane |
tadācakṣva drutaṃ kānte mano me na prasīdati || 62 ||
meaning:
तस्मात् किमर्थमकरो रोषं त्वं जलजानने |
तदाचक्ष्व द्रुतं कान्ते मनो मे न प्रसीदति || 62 ||
text_mt: Therefore why did you display anger, O lotus-faced one? / Tell me quickly, O beloved; my heart finds no peace."

sanskrit_iast:
ityuktvā śaṅkaro devīṃ tāmāliṅgitumudyataḥ |
kālī taṃ vārayāmāsa vacanaṃ cābravīdidam || 63 ||
meaning:
इत्युक्त्वा शङ्करो देवीं तामालिङ्गितुमुद्यतः |
काली तं वारयामास वचनं चाब्रवीदिदम् || 63 ||
text_mt: Having spoken thus, Śaṅkara prepared to embrace the goddess; / Kālī checked him and spoke these words:

sanskrit_iast:
na dṛṣṭapūrvā kimahaṃ yena bhinnāñjanopamā |
kriyate mayi bhūteśa bhavatāpsarasāṃ puraḥ || 64 ||
meaning:
न दृष्टपूर्वा किमहं येन भिन्नाञ्जनोपमा |
क्रियते मयि भूतेश भवताप्सरसां पुरः || 64 ||
text_mt: "Have I not been seen before, that I am compared / to crushed collyrium by you, O lord of beings, before the apsarases?

sanskrit_iast:
jātihīnaṃ vṛttihīnaṃ rūpahīnamadakṣiṇam |
hīnāṅgamatiriktāṅgaṃ tena doṣeṇa nākṣipet || 65 ||
meaning:
जातिहीनं वृत्तिहीनं रूपहीनमदक्षिणम् |
हीनाङ्गमतिरिक्ताङ्गं तेन दोषेण नाक्षिपेत् || 65 ||
text_mt: One should not insult by means of their defect someone lacking caste, / lacking livelihood, lacking beauty, lacking skill, / lacking a limb, or having an extra limb.

sanskrit_iast:
iti brahmā purā prāha vedaughārthāvaniścayam |
taṃ cāvamanya bhavatā parihāso'bhyabhāṣyate || 66 ||
meaning:
इति ब्रह्मा पुरा प्राह वेदौघार्थावनिश्चयम् |
तं चावमन्य भवता परिहासोऽभ्यभाष्यते || 66 ||
text_mt: So Brahmā said of old, settling the meaning of the multitude of Vedas; / and despising that [precept], you uttered mockery!

sanskrit_iast:
yāvanna me śarīrasya bhavitrī svarṇagauratā |
na sameṣye tvayā tāvaditi satyaṃ bravīmi te || 67 ||
meaning:
यावन्न मे शरीरस्य भवित्री स्वर्णगौरता |
न समेष्ये त्वया तावदिति सत्यं ब्रवीमि ते || 67 ||
text_mt: As long as my body does not become fair as gold, / so long will I not unite with you; this I tell you in truth.

sanskrit_iast:
śarīragauratāṃ śambho na sameṣye tvayā vinā |
tatra me śṛṇu sandhāya ātmanaḥ śirasā śape || 68 ||
meaning:
शरीरगौरतां शम्भो न समेष्ये त्वया विना |
तत्र मे शृणु सन्धाय आत्मनः शिरसा शपे || 68 ||
text_mt: Without the fairness of body, O Śambhu, I will not unite with you; / hear my solemn vow in this regard: I swear by my own head!"

sanskrit_iast:
ityuktvā sā tadā devī tasyaiva purato yayau |
mahākoṣīprapātākhyaṃ himavatsāumuttamam || 69 ||
meaning:
इत्युक्त्वा सा तदा देवी तस्यैव पुरतो ययौ |
महाकोषीप्रपाताख्यं हिमवत्साउमुत्तमम् || 69 ||
text_mt: Having spoken thus, the goddess then departed from before him / to the excellent peak of Himavat called the cataract of the Mahākoṣī.

sanskrit_iast:
mahādevo'pi taṃ bhāvyaṃ jñānena kṛtaniścayam |
arthaṃ jñātvā tadāparṇāṃ sarvajño nāpyavārayat || 70 ||
meaning:
महादेवोऽपि तं भाव्यं ज्ञानेन कृतनिश्चयम् |
अर्थं ज्ञात्वा तदापर्णां सर्वज्ञो नाप्यवारयत् || 70 ||
text_mt: Mahādeva too, the omniscient, knowing through wisdom that inevitable matter / which had been firmly decided, did not prevent Aparṇā.

sanskrit_iast:
sā gatvā pūrvavattatra śambhusaṅgatamānasā |
śatamārādhayāmāsa varṣāṇi vṛṣabhadhvajam || 71 ||
meaning:
सा गत्वा पूर्ववत्तत्र शम्भुसङ्गतमानसा |
शतमाराधयामास वर्षाणि वृषभध्वजम् || 71 ||
text_mt: Having gone there as before, her mind fixed on Śambhu, / she worshiped the bull-bannered [god] for a hundred years.

sanskrit_iast:
ekaṃ pādaṃ samutkṣipya vāmenākramya sā kṣitim |
uttarābhimukhī bhūtvā nirāhārā nirantaram || 72 ||
meaning:
एकं पादं समुत्क्षिप्य वामेनाक्रम्य सा क्षितिम् |
उत्तराभिमुखी भूत्वा निराहारा निरन्तरम् || 72 ||
