text_mt: Grown very large, bearing a spear, endowed with great strength and valor, / nurtured quickly by Śaṅkara, he became the commander of the army of gods.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ surāriṃ sagaṇaṃ tārakaṃ lokatārakam |
śaktihasto harasutaḥ pramamātha mahābalam || 91 ||
meaning:
ततः सुरारिं सगणं तारकं लोकतारकम् |
शक्तिहस्तो हरसुतः प्रममाथ महाबलम् || 91 ||
text_mt: Then Hara's son, spear in hand, crushed the mighty enemy of the gods, / Tāraka, the terror of the worlds, along with his host.

sanskrit_iast:
evamagnau samutsṛṣṭaṃ tejo bhargeṇa saṅgatam |
yathā vṛttaṃ tathā te'dya kathitaṃ nṛpasattama || 92 ||
meaning:
एवमग्नौ समुत्सृष्टं तेजो भर्गेण सङ्गतम् |
यथा वृत्तं तथा तेऽद्य कथितं नृपसत्तम || 92 ||
text_mt: Thus the splendor joined with Bharga that was discharged into the fire— / how it transpired has today been told to you, O best of kings.

sanskrit_iast:
sāmprataṃ prastutuaṃ śrāvyaṃ mahākālasya bhṛṅgiṇaḥ |
vṛttāntaṃ śṛṇu rājendra tau bhūtau manujau yathā || 93 ||
meaning:
साम्प्रतं प्रस्तुतुअं श्राव्यं महाकालस्य भृङ्गिणः |
वृत्तान्तं शृणु राजेन्द्र तौ भूतौ मनुजौ यथा || 93 ||
text_mt: Now hear the present narration, worthy to be heard, / of Mahākāla and Bhṛṅgin, O lord of kings, [and] how they became human.

sanskrit_iast:
iti śrīkālikāpurāṇesaṭcatvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 46 ||
saptacatvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ
meaning:
इति श्रीकालिकापुराणेसट्चत्वारिंशोऽध्यायः || 46 ||
सप्तचत्वारिंशोऽध्यायः
text_mt: Thus ends the forty-sixth chapter in the glorious Kālikāpurāṇa. / The forty-seventh chapter.

sanskrit_iast: aurvya uvāca
meaning: और्व्य उवाच

sanskrit_iast:
haro yāvad jagatyarthe devavargaiḥ prasāditaḥ |
tāvanmahāmaithunena hīno'bhūdumayā saha || 1 ||
meaning:
हरो यावद् जगत्यर्थे देववर्गैः प्रसादितः |
तावन्महामैथुनेन हीनोऽभूदुमया सह || 1 ||
text_mt: While Hara was propitiated by the groups of gods for the sake of the world, / he remained deprived of great intercourse with Umā.

sanskrit_iast:
vartate ratimātreṇa svecchāṃ sampūrayan sadā |
yathā manorathaṃ devyāḥ satataṃ pūrayanmṛḍaḥ || 2 ||
meaning:
वर्तते रतिमात्रेण स्वेच्छां सम्पूरयन् सदा |
यथा मनोरथं देव्याः सततं पूरयन्मृडः || 2 ||
text_mt: He engaged solely in amorous dalliance, constantly fulfilling his own desire, / as Mṛḍa continually fulfilled the wish of the goddess.

sanskrit_iast:
athaikadomayā sārdhaṃ nigūḍhe ratimandire |
narmākaronmahādevo modayukto ratipriyaḥ || 3 ||
meaning:
अथैकदोमया सार्धं निगूढे रतिमन्दिरे |
नर्माकरोन्महादेवो मोदयुक्तो रतिप्रियः || 3 ||
text_mt: Then, one day, in a secluded chamber of love, Mahādeva, / full of delight and fond of amorous play, engaged in playful intimacy with Umā.

sanskrit_iast:
yadā sā narmaṇe yātā gaurī smaraharāntikam |
tadā bhṛṅgimahākālau dvāḥsthau dvāri pratiṣṭhitau || 4 ||
meaning:
यदा सा नर्मणे याता गौरी स्मरहरान्तिकम् |
तदा भृङ्गिमहाकालौ द्वाःस्थौ द्वारि प्रतिष्ठितौ || 4 ||
text_mt: When Gaurī had gone to Smarahara for love-play, / Bhṛṅgin and Mahākāla stood stationed at the door as gatekeepers.

sanskrit_iast:
narmāvasāne sā devī muktadhammillabandhanā |
bandhahīnaṃ galadgātrādvastramālambya pāṇinā || 5 ||
meaning:
नर्मावसाने सा देवी मुक्तधम्मिल्लबन्धना |
बन्धहीनं गलद्गात्राद्वस्त्रमालम्ब्य पाणिना || 5 ||
text_mt: At the conclusion of the love-play, the goddess, the binding of her braided hair loosed, / supporting with her hand her loosened garment slipping from her body,

sanskrit_iast:
vyastahārā gandhapuṣpairākulairnātiśobhanā |
viluptakuṅkumā daṣṭadaśanacchadavibhramā || 6 ||
meaning:
व्यस्तहारा गन्धपुष्पैराकुलैर्नातिशोभना |
विलुप्तकुङ्कुमा दष्टदशनच्छदविभ्रमा || 6 ||
text_mt: her garland disarranged, not overly adorned because of disheveled fragrant flowers, / her saffron paste wiped away, bearing the charms of bitten lips,

sanskrit_iast:
niḥṣṛtā ratisaṅkelinilayājjalajānanā |
īṣadāghūrṇanayanā nicitā svedabindubhiḥ || 7 ||
meaning:
निःषृता रतिसङ्केलिनिलयाज्जलजानना |
ईषदाघूर्णनयना निचिता स्वेदबिन्दुभिः || 7 ||
text_mt: her lotus face with slightly rolling eyes, covered with drops of sweat, / emerged from the abode of erotic play.

sanskrit_iast:
tāṃ niḥsarantīṃ sadanāt tathābhūtāmaninditām |
ayogyāṃ vīkṣituñcanyairvṛṣadhvajamṛte patim || 8 ||
meaning:
तां निःसरन्तीं सदनात् तथाभूतामनिन्दिताम् |
अयोग्यां वीक्षितुञ्चन्यैर्वृषध्वजमृते पतिम् || 8 ||
text_mt: As that blameless lady was emerging from the chamber in such a state, / unfit to be seen by others except her husband, the bull-bannered god,

sanskrit_iast:
dadaśṛturmahātmānau nātihṛṣṭātmamānasau |
bhṛṅgī cāpi mahākālaḥ prāptakālaṃ cukopatuḥ || 9 ||
meaning:
ददशृतुर्महात्मानौ नातिहृष्टात्ममानसौ |
भृङ्गी चापि महाकालः प्राप्तकालं चुकोपतुः || 9 ||
text_mt: those two noble ones, their minds not overly pleased, / Bhṛṅgin and Mahākāla, saw her and grew angry at that untimely moment.

sanskrit_iast:
dṛṣṭvā tāṃ mātaraṃ dīnau tathābhūtāvadhomukhau |
cintāṃ ca jagmatustīvrāṃ niśaśvasaturuttamau || 10 ||
meaning:
दृष्ट्वा तां मातरं दीनौ तथाभूतावधोमुखौ |
चिन्तां च जग्मतुस्तीव्रां निशश्वसतुरुत्तमौ || 10 ||
text_mt: Seeing their mother in such a state, both distressed, with downcast faces, / the two noble ones fell into deep anxiety and sighed heavily.

sanskrit_iast:
tau paśyantau tadā devī dadarśa himavatsutā |
cukopa ca tadāparṇā vākyaṃ caitaduvāca ha || 11 ||
meaning:
तौ पश्यन्तौ तदा देवी ददर्श हिमवत्सुता |
चुकोप च तदापर्णा वाक्यं चैतदुवाच ह || 11 ||
text_mt: Then the goddess, the daughter of Himavat, saw them looking; / Aparṇā became enraged, and she spoke these words:

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃbhūtāṃ ca māṃ kasmādasambaddhāvapaśyatām |
bhavantau tanayau śuddhau hnīmaryādāvivarjitau || 12 ||
meaning:
एवंभूतां च मां कस्मादसम्बद्धावपश्यताम् |
भवन्तौ तनयौ शुद्धौ ह्नीमर्यादाविवर्जितौ || 12 ||
text_mt: "Why did you two look upon me in such a state, unfittingly? / You are sons, pure, [yet] devoid of the bounds of shame!

sanskrit_iast:
yaṣmādimāmamaryādaṃ bhavantau nirapatrapau |
akurvatāṃ tato bhūyād savatorjanma mānuṣe || 13 ||
meaning:
यष्मादिमाममर्यादं भवन्तौ निरपत्रपौ |
अकुर्वतां ततो भूयाद् सवतोर्जन्म मानुषे || 13 ||
text_mt: Because you two, shameless ones, breached this propriety, / therefore may your birth take place among humans!

sanskrit_iast:
mānuṣīṃ yonimāsādya madavekṣaṇadoṣataḥ |
bhaviṣyantau bhavantau tu śākhāmṛgamukhau bhuvi || 14 ||
meaning:
मानुषीं योनिमासाद्य मदवेक्षणदोषतः |
भविष्यन्तौ भवन्तौ तु शाखामृगमुखौ भुवि || 14 ||
text_mt: Having entered a human womb through the fault of gazing at me, / you two shall have monkey-faces on the earth!"

sanskrit_iast:
iti tāvumayā śaptau haraputrau mahāmatī |
bhṛṅgī caiva mahākālaḥ svamāturantikaṃ tadā || 15 ||
meaning:
इति तावुमया शप्तौ हरपुत्रौ महामती |
भृङ्गी चैव महाकालः स्वमातुरन्तिकं तदा || 15 ||
text_mt: Thus cursed by Umā, the two wise sons of Hara, / Bhṛṅgin and Mahākāla, then [approached] their mother's presence.

sanskrit_iast:
tau prāptaduḥkhau tu tadā durmanaskau harātmajau |
śāpaṃ tasyā na sehāte procatuścedamadvijām || 16 ||
meaning:
तौ प्राप्तदुःखौ तु तदा दुर्मनस्कौ हरात्मजौ |
शापं तस्या न सेहाते प्रोचतुश्चेदमद्विजाम् || 16 ||
text_mt: Those two sons of Hara, filled with grief and dejected in mind, / could not bear her curse, and they spoke thus to the goddess:

sanskrit_iast:
anāgasau sadaivāvāṃ bhavatyā himavatsute |
kathaṃ śaptau tvayā mātarhaṭhādevaṃ prakopayā || 17 ||
meaning:
अनागसौ सदैवावां भवत्या हिमवत्सुते |
कथं शप्तौ त्वया मातर्हठादेवं प्रकोपया || 17 ||
text_mt: "We two are always blameless, O daughter of Himavat! / Why were we cursed by you, Mother, in this way out of sheer wrath?

sanskrit_iast:
niyojitau yathā dvāri maheśena tvayā saha |
tathā niyogaṃ kurvanto tiṣṭhāvo dvāri saṃyatau || 18 ||
meaning:
नियोजितौ यथा द्वारि महेशेन त्वया सह |
तथा नियोगं कुर्वन्तो तिष्ठावो द्वारि संयतौ || 18 ||
text_mt: As we were stationed at the door by Maheśa along with you, / so we stand at the door, restrained, carrying out our duty.

sanskrit_iast:
haṭhānniḥsaraṇaṃ gehāt tavaiva na hi yujyate |
āgacchantyā bhavatyā tu dṛṣṭāvāvāṃ susaṃyatau || 19 ||
meaning:
हठान्निःसरणं गेहात् तवैव न हि युज्यते |
आगच्छन्त्या भवत्या तु दृष्टावावां सुसंयतौ || 19 ||
text_mt: Your emerging from the house impulsively was indeed not proper; / you, coming out, saw us two well restrained.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmānnirarthakaḥ kopaḥ ko doṣastatra cāvayoḥ |
tasmāt tatra pratīkāraṃ śṛṇu mātaranindite || 20 ||
meaning:
तस्मान्निरर्थकः कोपः को दोषस्तत्र चावयोः |
तस्मात् तत्र प्रतीकारं शृणु मातरनिन्दिते || 20 ||
text_mt: Therefore your anger is groundless; and what is our fault in this? / Therefore hear the counter-measure to it, O irreproachable mother!

sanskrit_iast:
tvaṃ mānuṣī kṣitau bhūyā haro bhavatu mānuṣaḥ |
mānuṣasya harasyātha jāyāyāṃ haratejasā || 21 ||
meaning:
त्वं मानुषी क्षितौ भूया हरो भवतु मानुषः |
मानुषस्य हरस्याथ जायायां हरतेजसा || 21 ||
text_mt: May you become a mortal woman on earth! May Hara become a mortal man! / Then, in the wife of mortal Hara, by the fiery energy of Hara,

sanskrit_iast:
bhavatyāścāpi mānuṣyāṃ bhaviṣyāvastathodare |
yadi satyaṃ harasutāvāvāṃ yadi nirāgasau || 22 ||
meaning:
भवत्याश्चापि मानुष्यां भविष्यावस्तथोदरे |
यदि सत्यं हरसुतावावां यदि निरागसौ || 22 ||
text_mt: and in your human womb we two shall likewise come to be, / if we are truly the sons of Hara, if we are blameless!

sanskrit_iast:
tadāvayoridaṃ vākyaṃ satyamastu gireḥ sute |
ityanyonyamatho śāpaṃ dattā dattvā sudāruṇam || 23 ||
meaning:
तदावयोरिदं वाक्यं सत्यमस्तु गिरेः सुते |
इत्यन्योन्यमथो शापं दत्ता दत्त्वा सुदारुणम् || 23 ||
text_mt: Then let this word of ours come true, O daughter of the Mountain!" / Having thus given a very dreadful curse to one another,

sanskrit_iast:
iviśurnṛpaśārdūla gaurī harasutau ca tau |
atha kāle vyatīte tu sarvajño vṛṣabhadhvajaḥ || 24 ||
meaning:
इविशुर्नृपशार्दूल गौरी हरसुतौ च तौ |
अथ काले व्यतीते तु सर्वज्ञो वृषभध्वजः || 24 ||
text_mt: Gaurī and those two sons of Hara entered [the house], O tiger among kings. / Then, when time had passed, the all-knowing Bull-bannered [god],

sanskrit_iast:
tadbhāvi karma jñātvaiva mānuṣo hyabhavat svayam |
brahmaṇo dakṣiṇāṅguṣṭhād dakṣo brahmasuto'bhavat || 25 ||
meaning:
तद्भावि कर्म ज्ञात्वैव मानुषो ह्यभवत् स्वयम् |
ब्रह्मणो दक्षिणाङ्गुष्ठाद् दक्षो ब्रह्मसुतोऽभवत् || 25 ||
text_mt: knowing that future deed itself, himself became human. / Dakṣa, the son of Brahmā, was born from Brahmā's right thumb.

sanskrit_iast:
aditistatsutā jātā tataḥ pūṣāhvayo'bhavat |
ūṣṇaḥputro'bhavat pauṣyaḥ sarvaśāstrārthapāragaḥ || 26 ||
meaning:
अदितिस्तत्सुता जाता ततः पूषाह्वयोऽभवत् |
ऊष्णःपुत्रोऽभवत् पौष्यः सर्वशास्त्रार्थपारगः || 26 ||
text_mt: Aditi was born as his daughter; from her came he who is named Pūṣan. / The son of Pūṣan was Pauṣya, who had traversed the meaning of all śāstras,

sanskrit_iast:
yasya tulyo nṛpo na bhūmau na bhūto na bhaviṣyati |
sa putrahīno rājābhūt pauṣyo nṛpatisattamaḥ || 27 ||
meaning:
यस्य तुल्यो नृपो न भूमौ न भूतो न भविष्यति |
स पुत्रहीनो राजाभूत् पौष्यो नृपतिसत्तमः || 27 ||
text_mt: a king to whom an equal on earth has never been, nor ever will be. / Pauṣya, the best of monarchs, was a childless king.

sanskrit_iast:
śeṣe vayasi saṃprāpte bhāryābhistisṛbhiḥ saha |
pauṣyaḥ paramayā bhaktyā brahmāṇaṃ paryatoṣayat || 28 ||
meaning:
शेषे वयसि संप्राप्ते भार्याभिस्तिसृभिः सह |
पौष्यः परमया भक्त्या ब्रह्माणं पर्यतोषयत् || 28 ||
text_mt: When he had reached old age, along with his three wives, / Pauṣya propitiated Brahmā with supreme devotion.

sanskrit_iast: brahmovāca
meaning: ब्रह्मोवाच

sanskrit_iast:
tasya prasanno bhagavān brahmā lokapitāmahaḥ |
tamuvāca ca rājānaṃ kimicchasi vadasva me || 29 ||
meaning:
तस्य प्रसन्नो भगवान् ब्रह्मा लोकपितामहः |
तमुवाच च राजानं किमिच्छसि वदस्व मे || 29 ||
text_mt: Pleased with him, the blessed Brahmā, the grandfather of the worlds, / spoke to that king: "Tell me, what do you desire?

sanskrit_iast:
prasanno'smi nṛpaśreṣṭha pradāsyāmi yathepsitam |
yadiṣṭaṃ tava jāyānāṃ tadvadiṣyasi sāmpratam || 30 ||
meaning:
प्रसन्नोऽस्मि नृपश्रेष्ठ प्रदास्यामि यथेप्सितम् |
यदिष्टं तव जायानां तद्वदिष्यसि साम्प्रतम् || 30 ||
text_mt: I am pleased, O best of kings! I will grant whatever is desired. / Whatever is wished by you and your wives, you may speak it now."

sanskrit_iast: pauṣya uvāca
meaning: पौष्य उवाच

sanskrit_iast:
iraṇyagarbhaputro'haṃ putrārthī tvāmupāsmahe |
tvayi prasanne putro me mūyāllakṣaṇasaṃyutaḥ || 31 ||
meaning:
इरण्यगर्भपुत्रोऽहं पुत्रार्थी त्वामुपास्महे |
त्वयि प्रसन्ने पुत्रो मे मूयाल्लक्षणसंयुतः || 31 ||
text_mt: "I, a son of Hiraṇyagarbha, worship you, desiring a son. / When you are pleased, may a son endowed with auspicious marks be born to me.

sanskrit_iast:
etadarthe sabhāryo'haṃ bhaktyā tvāṃ samupasthitaḥ |
yathā me jāyate putrastathā kuru jagatpate || 32 ||
meaning:
एतदर्थे सभार्योऽहं भक्त्या त्वां समुपस्थितः |
यथा मे जायते पुत्रस्तथा कुरु जगत्पते || 32 ||
text_mt: For this purpose I, accompanied by my wives, have approached you with devotion. / Act, O Lord of the world, in such a way that a son is born to me!

sanskrit_iast:
punnāmno narakāt putrastrāyate pitaraṃ prasūm |
atastasmād bhayaṃ brhamaṃstvaṃ nāśayitemarhasi || 33 ||
meaning:
पुन्नाम्नो नरकात् पुत्रस्त्रायते पितरं प्रसूम् |
अतस्तस्माद् भयं ब्र्हमंस्त्वं नाशयितेमर्हसि || 33 ||
text_mt: A son saves the father and the mother from the hell named Put; / therefore you ought, O Brahmā, to destroy that fear."

sanskrit_iast: brahmovāca
meaning: ब्रह्मोवाच

sanskrit_iast:
śṛṇu pauṣya yathā bhāvī putrastava kulodvahaḥ |
tadahaṃ te vadāmyaha bhāryābhistat samācāra || 34 ||
meaning:
शृणु पौष्य यथा भावी पुत्रस्तव कुलोद्वहः |
तदहं ते वदाम्यह भार्याभिस्तत् समाचार || 34 ||
text_mt: "Hear, O Pauṣya, how a son who exalts your lineage will come to be! / I tell you that now; practice it together with your wives.

sanskrit_iast:
idaṃ phalaṃ gṛhāṇa tvaṃ mayā dattaṃ nṛpottama |
ajīrṇaṃ bahule kāle prāpte'pi surasaṃ sadā || 35 ||
meaning:
इदं फलं गृहाण त्वं मया दत्तं नृपोत्तम |
अजीर्णं बहुले काले प्राप्तेऽपि सुरसं सदा || 35 ||
text_mt: Take this fruit given by me, O best of kings; / it will never rot, remaining sweet in taste forever, even when a long time passes.

sanskrit_iast:
phalametat samādāya tāvat saṃvatsaratrayam |
ārādhaya mahādevaṃ sa prasanno bhaviṣyati || 36 ||
meaning:
फलमेतत् समादाय तावत् संवत्सरत्रयम् |
आराधय महादेवं स प्रसन्नो भविष्यति || 36 ||
text_mt: Taking this fruit, worship Mahādeva / for three years; he will become pleased.

sanskrit_iast:
yathā sambhāṣate bhargaḥ phalametat tathā bhavān |
kariṣyati phala rājan bhāryābhistisṛbhiḥ saha || 37 ||
meaning:
यथा सम्भाषते भर्गः फलमेतत् तथा भवान् |
करिष्यति फल राजन् भार्याभिस्तिसृभिः सह || 37 ||
text_mt: As Bharga commands, thus you / shall dispose of the fruit, O king, together with your three wives.

sanskrit_iast:
tataste lakṣaṇopetastanayaḥ kulavardhanaḥ |
bhaviṣyati svayaṃ śāstā cakravartī vasundharām || 38 ||
meaning:
ततस्ते लक्षणोपेतस्तनयः कुलवर्धनः |
भविष्यति स्वयं शास्ता चक्रवर्ती वसुन्धराम् || 38 ||
text_mt: Then a son endowed with auspicious marks, an enhancer of the lineage, / will be born to you, who will himself rule the earth as a universal monarch."

sanskrit_iast: aurvya uvāca
meaning: और्व्य उवाच

sanskrit_iast:
ityuktvā prayayau brahmā rājāpi saha bhīrubhiḥ |
haraṃ yaṣṭuṃ samārebhe bhaktyā paramayā yutaḥ || 39 ||
meaning:
इत्युक्त्वा प्रययौ ब्रह्मा राजापि सह भीरुभिः |
हरं यष्टुं समारेभे भक्त्या परमया युतः || 39 ||
text_mt: Having spoken thus, Brahmā departed; and the king too, along with his timid [wives], / endowed with supreme devotion, began to sacrifice to Hara.

sanskrit_iast:
nirāśīḥ saṃyatāhāraḥ kadācit phalabhojanaḥ |
dṛṣadvatīnadītīre phalaṃ saṃsthāpya cāgrataḥ || 40 ||
meaning:
निराशीः संयताहारः कदाचित् फलभोजनः |
दृषद्वतीनदीतीरे फलं संस्थाप्य चाग्रतः || 40 ||
text_mt: Free from desires, with restricted diet, sometimes eating only fruit, / on the bank of the river Dṛṣadvatī, placing the fruit in front,

sanskrit_iast:
puṣpārghadīpadhūpaiśca vṛṣabhadhvajamatarpayat |
sa tu varṣatraye'tīte mahādevo jagatpatiḥ || 41 ||
meaning:
पुष्पार्घदीपधूपैश्च वृषभध्वजमतर्पयत् |
स तु वर्षत्रयेऽतीते महादेवो जगत्पतिः || 41 ||
text_mt: he satisfied the Bull-bannered [god] with flowers, offerings of water, lamps, and incense. / When three years had elapsed, Mahādeva, the Lord of the world,

sanskrit_iast:
pauṣyasya nṛpateḥ samyak prasasādārthasiddhaye |
prasannaḥ prāha nṛpatiṃ mahādevo hasanniva |
upāsase kimarthaṃ māṃ tanme vada dadāmi te || 42 ||
meaning:
पौष्यस्य नृपतेः सम्यक् प्रससादार्थसिद्धये |
प्रसन्नः प्राह नृपतिं महादेवो हसन्निव |
उपाससे किमर्थं मां तन्मे वद ददामि ते || 42 ||
text_mt: became completely pleased with King Pauṣya for the attainment of his goal. / Pleased, Mahādeva spoke to the king, smiling as it were: / 'For what purpose do you worship me? Tell me that; I grant it to you.'

sanskrit_iast: pauṣya uvāca
meaning: पौष्य उवाच

sanskrit_iast:
aputro'haṃ putrakāmastacchṛṇusva vṛṣadhvaja |
yathāhaṃ putravān vai syāṃ vṛṣadhvaja tathā kuru || 43 ||
meaning:
अपुत्रोऽहं पुत्रकामस्तच्छृणुस्व वृषध्वज |
यथाहं पुत्रवान् वै स्यां वृषध्वज तथा कुरु || 43 ||
text_mt: "I am childless, desiring a son; hear that, O Bull-bannered one! / Act, O Bull-bannered one, in such a way that I may indeed have a son."

sanskrit_iast: aurva uvāca
meaning: और्व उवाच

sanskrit_iast:
iti sa nyagadadrājā bhāryābhiḥ saha harṣitaḥ | praṇamya stutipūrveṇa
bhaktinamrātmamānasaḥ || 44 ||
meaning:
इति स न्यगदद्राजा भार्याभिः सह हर्षितः | प्रणम्य स्तुतिपूर्वेण
भक्तिनम्रात्ममानसः || 44 ||
text_mt: Thus the king, delighted, spoke together with his wives, / bowing down after a hymn of praise, his mind bowed with devotion.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ putrārthinaṃ bhūpaṃ prasanno vṛṣabhadhvajaḥ | brahmadattaṃ phalaṃ
haste kṛtvedaṃ tamuvāca ha || 45 ||
meaning:
ततः पुत्रार्थिनं भूपं प्रसन्नो वृषभध्वजः | ब्रह्मदत्तं फलं
हस्ते कृत्वेदं तमुवाच ह || 45 ||
text_mt: Then the Bull-bannered god, pleased with the king who desired a son, / took in his hand the fruit given by Brahmā and spoke this to him:

sanskrit_iast: īśvara uvāca
meaning: ईश्वर उवाच

sanskrit_iast:
idaṃ phalaṃ brahmadattaṃ vibhajya nṛpate tridhā |
bhojayethā svajāyāstvaṃ prahṛṣṭaḥ susthamānasaḥ || 46 ||
meaning:
इदं फलं ब्रह्मदत्तं विभज्य नृपते त्रिधा |
भोजयेथा स्वजायास्त्वं प्रहृष्टः सुस्थमानसः || 46 ||
text_mt: "Having divided this fruit given by Brahmā into three parts, O king, / you should feed your wives, delighted and calm in mind.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ pravṛtte bhavata etāsu ṛtusaṅgame |
ādhāsyanti tu garbhāstu bhāryāste yugapannṛpa || 47 ||
meaning:
ततः प्रवृत्ते भवत एतासु ऋतुसङ्गमे |
आधास्यन्ति तु गर्भास्तु भार्यास्ते युगपन्नृप || 47 ||
text_mt: Then, when your union during their fertile periods takes place, / your wives will indeed conceive simultaneously, O king.

sanskrit_iast:
kālaṃ prāpte ca yugapt prasavo yoṣitāṃ tava |
bhaviṣyati nṛpaśreṣṭha tatretthaṃ tvaṃ kariṣyasi || 48 ||
meaning:
कालं प्राप्ते च युगप्त् प्रसवो योषितां तव |
भविष्यति नृपश्रेष्ठ तत्रेत्थं त्वं करिष्यसि || 48 ||
text_mt: And when the time arrives, the delivery of your women / will happen simultaneously, O best of kings; then you must act in this way:

sanskrit_iast:
ekasyā jaṭhare śīrṣabhāgaste sambhaviṣyati |
aparasyāstadā kukṣermadhyabhāgo bhaviṣyati || 49 ||
meaning:
एकस्या जठरे शीर्षभागस्ते सम्भविष्यति |
अपरस्यास्तदा कुक्षेर्मध्यभागो भविष्यति || 49 ||
text_mt: In the womb of one, the head portion will be born for you; / then in the belly of another, the middle portion will come to be;

sanskrit_iast:
adho nābhyāstu yo bhāgaḥ so'parasyāṃ bhaviṣati |
tacca khaṇḍatrayaṃ bhūpa yathāsthānaṃ pṛthak pṛthak || 50 ||
meaning:
अधो नाभ्यास्तु यो भागः सोऽपरस्यां भविषति |
तच्च खण्डत्रयं भूप यथास्थानं पृथक् पृथक् || 50 ||
text_mt: and the portion below the navel will be in the other. / And those three pieces, O king, according to their proper place, separately,

sanskrit_iast:
yojayiṣyasi paścāt te putra eko bhaviṣyati |
tasya śīrṣe candrarekhā sahajā sambhaviṣyati || 51 ||
meaning:
योजयिष्यसि पश्चात् ते पुत्र एको भविष्यति |
तस्य शीर्षे चन्द्ररेखा सहजा सम्भविष्यति || 51 ||
text_mt: you shall join together; afterwards, you will have one son. / On his head a crescent moon will naturally be present.

sanskrit_iast: tenaiva nāmnā sa khyātiṃ gamiṣyati ca bhūtale |
meaning: तेनैव नाम्ना स ख्यातिं गमिष्यति च भूतले |
text_mt: By that very name he shall attain renown on earth."

sanskrit_iast: aurva uvāca
meaning: और्व उवाच

sanskrit_iast: ityuktvā sa mahādevastāsāṃ garbhān svayaṃ tadā || 52 ||
meaning: इत्युक्त्वा स महादेवस्तासां गर्भान् स्वयं तदा || 52 ||
text_mt: Having spoken thus, Mahādeva himself then, / in order to purify their wombs,

sanskrit_iast:
saṃskartuṃ āhnavītoyamātmavāsāya vai jyadhāt |
tataḥ phale svayaṃ devaḥ praviveśa vṛṣadhvajaḥ || 53 ||
meaning:
संस्कर्तुं आह्नवीतोयमात्मवासाय वै ज्यधात् |
ततः फले स्वयं देवः प्रविवेश वृषध्वजः || 53 ||
text_mt: arranged water of the Gaṅgā for his own dwelling; / then the Bull-bannered god entered the fruit himself.

sanskrit_iast:
tatkṣaṇāt tatphalaṃ bhūtaṃ tribhāgaṃ svayameva hi |
pauṣyastatphalamādāya muditaḥ saha bhāryayā || 54 ||
meaning:
तत्क्षणात् तत्फलं भूतं त्रिभागं स्वयमेव हि |
पौष्यस्तत्फलमादाय मुदितः सह भार्यया || 54 ||
text_mt: At that very moment that fruit spontaneously divided into three parts. / Taking that fruit, Pauṣya was delighted together with his wife.

sanskrit_iast:
prayayau mandiraṃ hṛṣṭo anujñāpya vṛṣadhvajam |
tataḥ samucite kāle prāpte tābhistu bhakṣitam || 55 ||
meaning:
प्रययौ मन्दिरं हृष्टो अनुज्ञाप्य वृषध्वजम् |
ततः समुचिते काले प्राप्ते ताभिस्तु भक्षितम् || 55 ||
text_mt: Taking leave of Vṛṣadhvaja, he returned joyfully to his palace. / Then, when the proper time arrived, it was eaten by them,

sanskrit_iast:
tatphalaṃ nṛpaśārdūla garbhāścāpyāyitāḥ śubhāḥ |
sampūrṇe garbhakāle tu garbhebhyaḥ samajāyata || 56 ||
meaning:
तत्फलं नृपशार्दूल गर्भाश्चाप्यायिताः शुभाः |
सम्पूर्णे गर्भकाले तु गर्भेभ्यः समजायत || 56 ||
text_mt: that fruit, O tiger among kings, and their auspicious wombs were nourished. / When the full term of gestation was complete, there was born from the wombs

sanskrit_iast:
khaṇḍatrayaṃ pṛthagrājaṃstathā bhargeṇa bhāṣitam |
tacca khaṇḍatrayaṃ pauṣyau yathāsthānaṃ niyojya ca || 57 ||
meaning:
खण्डत्रयं पृथग्राजंस्तथा भर्गेण भाषितम् |
तच्च खण्डत्रयं पौष्यौ यथास्थानं नियोज्य च || 57 ||
text_mt: three separate pieces, O king, just as had been spoken by Bharga. / And joining those three pieces together in their proper places,

sanskrit_iast:
ekapiṇḍaṃ cakārāśu tatra putro vyajāyata |
tasya śīrṣe tadā rājan sahajendukalā śubhā || 59 ||
meaning:
एकपिण्डं चकाराशु तत्र पुत्रो व्यजायत |
तस्य शीर्षे तदा राजन् सहजेन्दुकला शुभा || 59 ||
text_mt: Pauṣya quickly made them into a single lump; therein a son was born. / On his head then, O king, an auspicious natural crescent moon

sanskrit_iast:
virarāja yathā svasthā śaratkāle kalā vidhoḥ |
taṃ sarvalakṣaṇopetaṃ pīnoraskaṃ sunāsikam || 59 ||
meaning:
विरराज यथा स्वस्था शरत्काले कला विधोः |
तं सर्वलक्षणोपेतं पीनोरस्कं सुनासिकम् || 59 ||
text_mt: shone, like the crescent of the moon abiding in its own place in the autumn season. / Seeing him endowed with all auspicious marks, broad-chested, fair-nosed,

sanskrit_iast:
siṃhagrīvaṃ viśālākṣaṃ dīrghāyatabhujaṃ tadā |
dṛṣṭvā pauṣyo'tha bhāryābhistisṛbhiḥ saha sammudam || 60 ||
meaning:
सिंहग्रीवं विशालाक्षं दीर्घायतभुजं तदा |
दृष्ट्वा पौष्योऽथ भार्याभिस्तिसृभिः सह सम्मुदम् || 60 ||
text_mt: lion-necked, large-eyed, and long-armed, / Pauṣya then, together with his three wives, attained great joy,

sanskrit_iast:
lebhe daridraḥ satkoṣaṃ prāpyea vipulaṃ tataḥ |
tasya nāmākarodrājā brāhmaṇaiḥ svaiḥ purohitaiḥ || 61 ||
meaning:
लेभे दरिद्रः सत्कोषं प्राप्येअ विपुलं ततः |
तस्य नामाकरोद्राजा ब्राह्मणैः स्वैः पुरोहितैः || 61 ||
text_mt: just as a poor man [rejoices] upon obtaining an abundant, fine treasure. / Then the king gave him a name through his own brāhmaṇas and family priests,

sanskrit_iast: candraśekhara ityeva kāntyā candramasaḥ samaḥ |
meaning: चन्द्रशेखर इत्येव कान्त्या चन्द्रमसः समः |
text_mt: [naming him] 'Candraśekhara' indeed, as he was equal to the moon in splendor.

sanskrit_iast: vavṛdhe sa mahābhāgaḥ pratyahaṃ candravat sutaḥ || 62 ||
meaning: ववृधे स महाभागः प्रत्यहं चन्द्रवत् सुतः || 62 ||
text_mt: That illustrious son grew day by day like the moon,

sanskrit_iast:
kalābhiriva tejasvī śaradīva niśākaraḥ |
evaṃ tisṛṇāmambānāṃ garbhe jāto yato haraḥ || 63 ||
meaning:
कलाभिरिव तेजस्वी शरदीव निशाकरः |
एवं तिसृणामम्बानां गर्भे जातो यतो हरः || 63 ||
text_mt: full of radiance, as if with its digits, like the night-maker in autumn. / Since Hara was thus born in the womb of three mothers,

sanskrit_iast:
atastryambaka nāmābhūt prathito lokavedayoḥ |
sa rājaputraḥ kaumārīmavasthāṃ prāpayat tadā || 64 ||
meaning:
अतस्त्र्यम्बक नामाभूत् प्रथितो लोकवेदयोः |
स राजपुत्रः कौमारीमवस्थां प्रापयत् तदा || 64 ||
text_mt: he therefore became renowned by the name Tryambaka in the world and in the Vedas. / Then that prince attained the age of youth;

sanskrit_iast:
sarvaśāstrārtha tattvajño viṣṇostulyo babhūva ha |
bale vīrye praharaṇe śāstre śīle ca tatsamaḥ || 65 ||
meaning:
सर्वशास्त्रार्थ तत्त्वज्ञो विष्णोस्तुल्यो बभूव ह |
बले वीर्ये प्रहरणे शास्त्रे शीले च तत्समः || 65 ||
text_mt: knowing the truth of the meaning of all treatises, he became equal to Viṣṇu. / Equal to him in strength, heroism, weapons, scripture, and conduct,

sanskrit_iast:
nānyo'bhūd nṛpaśārdūla no vā bhūmau bhaviṣyati |
abhiṣicyātha taṃ rākhye kumāraṃ balavattaram || 66 ||
meaning:
नान्योऽभूद् नृपशार्दूल नो वा भूमौ भविष्यति |
अभिषिच्याथ तं राख्ये कुमारं बलवत्तरम् || 66 ||
text_mt: there was no other, O tiger among kings, nor will there be on earth. / Then, having consecrated that exceedingly powerful prince into kingship,

sanskrit_iast:
daśapañcaikavarṣīyaṃ sarvarājaguṇairyutam |
tisṛbhiḥ sahabhāryābhirvanaṃ pauṣyo viveśa ha |
vṛddhocitakriyāṃ kartuṃ rājā paramadhārmikaḥ || 67 ||
meaning:
दशपञ्चैकवर्षीयं सर्वराजगुणैर्युतम् |
तिसृभिः सहभार्याभिर्वनं पौष्यो विवेश ह |
वृद्धोचितक्रियां कर्तुं राजा परमधार्मिकः || 67 ||
text_mt: who was sixteen years old and endowed with all royal virtues, / Pauṣya entered the forest together with his three wives, / the exceedingly righteous king, in order to perform the duties suited to old age.

sanskrit_iast: gate pitari rājā sa vanavāsaṃ mahābalaḥ || 68 ||
meaning: गते पितरि राजा स वनवासं महाबलः || 68 ||
text_mt: When his father had gone to reside in the forest, that mighty king,

sanskrit_iast:
sarvāṃ kṣitiṃ vaśe cakre āmātyaścandraśekharaḥ |
sārvabhaumo nṛpo bhūtvā rājabhiḥ parisevitaḥ || 69 ||
meaning:
सर्वां क्षितिं वशे चक्रे आमात्यश्चन्द्रशेखरः |
सार्वभौमो नृपो भूत्वा राजभिः परिसेवितः || 69 ||
text_mt: Candraśekhara, together with his ministers, brought the whole earth under his control. / Having become a universal monarch, served by kings,

sanskrit_iast:
amarairiva devendro vijahāra śriyā yutaḥ |
evaṃ pauṣyasuto bhūtvā tryambakaḥ puṇyanirvṛtaḥ || 70 ||
meaning:
अमरैरिव देवेन्द्रो विजहार श्रिया युतः |
एवं पौष्यसुतो भूत्वा त्र्यम्बकः पुण्यनिर्वृतः || 70 ||
text_mt: he sported endowed with fortune, like Devendra among the immortals. / Having thus become the son of Pauṣya, Tryambaka, filled with merit,

sanskrit_iast:
brahmāvartāhvaye ramye karavīrāhvaye pure |
dṛṣadvatīnadītīre rājā bhūtvā mumoda ha || 71 ||
meaning:
ब्रह्मावर्ताह्वये रम्ये करवीराह्वये पुरे |
दृषद्वतीनदीतीरे राजा भूत्वा मुमोद ह || 71 ||
text_mt: rejoiced as king in the charming city named Karavīra, in the land called Brahmāvarta, / on the bank of the river Dṛṣadvatī.

sanskrit_iast:
athaikadā sa pitara vanavāsagataṃ svayam |
mātṛścāpi nṛpaśreṣṭha draṣṭukāmo'bhavannṛpaḥ || 72 ||
meaning:
अथैकदा स पितर वनवासगतं स्वयम् |
मातृश्चापि नृपश्रेष्ठ द्रष्टुकामोऽभवन्नृपः || 72 ||
text_mt: Now once that king, O best of kings, / wished to see his father who had gone to live in the forest, and his mothers as well.

sanskrit_iast:
sa ekasyandanenaiva ekākī candraśekharaḥ |
vipulaṃ dhanurādāya samārgaṇagaṇaṃ tadā || 73 ||
meaning:
स एकस्यन्दनेनैव एकाकी चन्द्रशेखरः |
विपुलं धनुरादाय समार्गणगणं तदा || 73 ||
text_mt: In a single chariot, all alone, Candraśekhara, / taking a great bow together with a multitude of arrows,

sanskrit_iast:
tapovanaṃ puṇyamayaṃ viṣayānte vyavasthitam |
āsasāda didṛkṣuḥ sa tātaṃ vṛddhaṃ samātṛkam || 74 ||
meaning:
तपोवनं पुण्यमयं विषयान्ते व्यवस्थितम् |
आससाद दिदृक्षुः स तातं वृद्धं समातृकम् || 74 ||
text_mt: arrived at the holy penance grove situated at the edge of his realm, / wishing to see his aged father together with his mothers.

sanskrit_iast:
sa gacchan piturabhyāśaṃ nṛpatiṃ candraśekharaḥ |
dadarśa namucaṃ nāma tapasyantaṃ mahāmunim || 75 ||
meaning:
स गच्छन् पितुरभ्याशं नृपतिं चन्द्रशेखरः |
ददर्श नमुचं नाम तपस्यन्तं महामुनिम् || 75 ||
text_mt: Going near his father, King Candraśekhara / saw a great sage named Namuca performing austerities,

sanskrit_iast:
kṛṣṇājinottarīyeṇa saṃvītaṃ sūryasannibham |
ūrdhvagābhirjaṭābhiśca saṃyuta dhyāninaṃ kṛśam || 76 ||
meaning:
कृष्णाजिनोत्तरीयेण संवीतं सूर्यसन्निभम् |
ऊर्ध्वगाभिर्जटाभिश्च संयुत ध्यानिनं कृशम् || 76 ||
text_mt: wrapped in an upper garment of black antelope skin, resembling the sun, / endowed with matted locks pointing upward, meditating, and emaciated,

sanskrit_iast:
tapasā dyotitatanuṃ niścalaṃ kuśajāsanam |
taṃ dṛṣṭvā dūrato vīro rathopasthādavātarat || 77 ||
meaning:
तपसा द्योतिततनुं निश्चलं कुशजासनम् |
तं दृष्ट्वा दूरतो वीरो रथोपस्थादवातरत् || 77 ||
text_mt: his body illumined by penance, motionless, seated upon kuśa grass. / Seeing him from afar, the hero stepped down from the chariot floor,

sanskrit_iast:
upatasthe ca viprendraṃ vinayānatakandharaḥ |
praṇanāma muniṃ taṃ ca vākyametadudīrayan || 78 ||
meaning:
उपतस्थे च विप्रेन्द्रं विनयानतकन्धरः |
प्रणनाम मुनिं तं च वाक्यमेतदुदीरयन् || 78 ||
text_mt: and approached the foremost of the twice-born with his neck bowed in humility. / He bowed down to that sage, uttering these words:

sanskrit_iast:
pauṣyasya tanayo brahman nāmnāhaṃ candraśekharaḥ |
praṇamāmi mahābhaktyā bhavantaṃ munisattamam || 79 ||
meaning:
पौष्यस्य तनयो ब्रह्मन् नाम्नाहं चन्द्रशेखरः |
प्रणमामि महाभक्त्या भवन्तं मुनिसत्तमम् || 79 ||
text_mt: "I am the son of Pauṣya, O brāhmaṇa, named Candraśekhara. / With great devotion I bow to you, the best of sages."

sanskrit_iast:
ityuktvā prāñjalistasthau munestasyāgrato nṛpaḥ |
namucasya mukhaṃ vīkṣya bhaktinamrātmamānasaḥ || 80 ||
meaning:
इत्युक्त्वा प्राञ्जलिस्तस्थौ मुनेस्तस्याग्रतो नृपः |
नमुचस्य मुखं वीक्ष्य भक्तिनम्रात्ममानसः || 80 ||
text_mt: Having spoken thus, the king stood before that sage with folded hands, / gazing upon Namuca's face, his mind bowed in devotion.

sanskrit_iast:
pūrvameva yadā rājā prāviśat tapase vanam |
tadaiva saha bhāryābhistaṃ muniṃ pratyapūjayat || 81 ||
meaning:
पूर्वमेव यदा राजा प्राविशत् तपसे वनम् |
तदैव सह भार्याभिस्तं मुनिं प्रत्यपूजयत् || 81 ||
text_mt: Earlier, when the king had entered the forest for penance, / at that time together with his wives he had worshipped that sage.

sanskrit_iast:
ciramārādhya namucaṃ pauṣyaḥ paramapaṇḍitaḥ |
prasādayāmāsa muniṃ putrārthe sūnṛtākṣaraḥ || 82 ||
meaning:
चिरमाराध्य नमुचं पौष्यः परमपण्डितः |
प्रसादयामास मुनिं पुत्रार्थे सूनृताक्षरः || 82 ||
text_mt: Having long venerated Namuca, Pauṣya, who was supremely learned, / pleased the sage for the sake of his son with agreeable words:

sanskrit_iast:
viṣayānte tapaḥ kurvan muniśreṣṭheha tiṣṭhasi |
ekantu prārthaye tvatto yadi māṃ dayase mune || 83 ||
meaning:
विषयान्ते तपः कुर्वन् मुनिश्रेष्ठेह तिष्ठसि |
एकन्तु प्रार्थये त्वत्तो यदि मां दयसे मुने || 83 ||
text_mt: "Performing penance at the border of my realm, you reside here, O best of sages. / I request one thing from you, if you have compassion for me, O sage.

sanskrit_iast:
śiśurme tanayo rājā candraśekharasaṃjñakaḥ |
sahajendukalāyukto bālabhāvācca cañcalaḥ || 84 ||
meaning:
शिशुर्मे तनयो राजा चन्द्रशेखरसंज्ञकः |
सहजेन्दुकलायुक्तो बालभावाच्च चञ्चलः || 84 ||
text_mt: My son is a child, the king named Candraśekhara, / endowed with a natural crescent moon and fickle due to his youth.

sanskrit_iast:
sa ced bhavantamāsādya karācidaparādhyati |
tadā kṣamiṣyasi mune mayaitat prārthitaṃ tvayi || 85 ||
meaning:
स चेद् भवन्तमासाद्य कराचिदपराध्यति |
तदा क्षमिष्यसि मुने मयैतत् प्रार्थितं त्वयि || 85 ||
text_mt: If, coming before you, he should ever commit an offense, / then you must forgive him, O sage; this is requested by me of you."

sanskrit_iast:
pauṣyasya vacanaṃ śrutvā muniścāṅgīcakāra ha |
dṛṣṭvā tattanayaṃ vipraḥ pauṣyavākyamathāsmarat || 86 ||
meaning:
पौष्यस्य वचनं श्रुत्वा मुनिश्चाङ्गीचकार ह |
दृष्ट्वा तत्तनयं विप्रः पौष्यवाक्यमथास्मरत् || 86 ||
text_mt: Hearing Pauṣya's word, the sage had agreed. / Seeing his son, the twice-born then remembered Pauṣya's word.

sanskrit_iast:
smṛtvāgrataḥ sthitaṃ namraṃ suciraṃ candraśekharam |
idaṃ provāca sa munirdayāvānnamucāhvayaḥ || 87 ||
meaning:
स्मृत्वाग्रतः स्थितं नम्रं सुचिरं चन्द्रशेखरम् |
इदं प्रोवाच स मुनिर्दयावान्नमुचाह्वयः || 87 ||
text_mt: Remembering [it] as Candraśekhara stood humble before him for a long time, / that compassionate sage named Namuca spoke this:

sanskrit_iast:
vinayenādya tuṣṭo'smi bhavataḥ candraśekhara |
varaṃ varaya dāsyāmi vāñchitaṃ me mahattaram || 88 ||
meaning:
विनयेनाद्य तुष्टोऽस्मि भवतः चन्द्रशेखर |
वरं वरय दास्यामि वाञ्छितं मे महत्तरम् || 88 ||
text_mt: "I am pleased today with your humility, Candraśekhara. / Choose a boon; I will grant whatever great thing is desired by you."

sanskrit_iast:
tasya śrutvā tato vākyaṃ nṛpatiścandraśekharaḥ |
punaḥ praṇamya namucamidamāhātisūnṛtam || 89 ||
meaning:
तस्य श्रुत्वा ततो वाक्यं नृपतिश्चन्द्रशेखरः |
पुनः प्रणम्य नमुचमिदमाहातिसूनृतम् || 89 ||
text_mt: Hearing his word, King Candraśekhara / bowed down again to Namuca and spoke this most truthful and pleasant [speech]:

sanskrit_iast:
kāyena manasā vācā yadatyarthaṃ dvijottama |
tatsarvaṃ viṣaye me'sti tvādṛśā yasya dakṣiṇāḥ || 90 ||
meaning:
कायेन मनसा वाचा यदत्यर्थं द्विजोत्तम |
तत्सर्वं विषये मेऽस्ति त्वादृशा यस्य दक्षिणाः || 90 ||
text_mt: "Whatever is greatly desired in body, mind, or speech, O best of the twice-born, / all that exists in my realm, to which people like you are favorable.

sanskrit_iast:
manogataṃ me duṣprāpaṃ vāñchanīyaṃ na vidyate |
tadeva varaṇīyaṃ me yad dadāti svayaṃ bhavān || 91 ||
meaning:
मनोगतं मे दुष्प्रापं वाञ्छनीयं न विद्यते |
तदेव वरणीयं मे यद् ददाति स्वयं भवान् || 91 ||
text_mt: There is nothing in my mind that is difficult to attain or to be desired; / that alone is to be chosen by me which you yourself bestow."

sanskrit_iast: namuca uvāca
meaning: नमुच उवाच

sanskrit_iast:
tvaṃ saptadaśavarṣāṇāṃ prāpte saṃvatsare pare |
bhaviṣyasi nṛpaśreṣṭha vararāmāpatiḥ vayam || 92 ||
meaning:
त्वं सप्तदशवर्षाणां प्राप्ते संवत्सरे परे |
भविष्यसि नृपश्रेष्ठ वररामापतिः वयम् || 92 ||
text_mt: "When the next year arrives, as you reach seventeen years of age, / O best of kings, you shall become the husband of an excellent woman.

sanskrit_iast:
yathā girisutā śambhoryathā lakṣmīrgadābhṛtaḥ |
yathā sureśasya śacī tathā te'pi bhaviṣyati || 93 ||
meaning:
यथा गिरिसुता शम्भोर्यथा लक्ष्मीर्गदाभृतः |
यथा सुरेशस्य शची तथा तेऽपि भविष्यति || 93 ||
text_mt: As the mountain's daughter is to Śambhu, as Lakṣmī is to the mace-bearer, / as Śacī is to the lord of the gods, so shall [a wife] be to you."

sanskrit_iast:
ityuktvā sa munirbhūpaṃ namucastapasāṃ nidhiḥ |
visarjayāmāsa tadā sa cāpi mudito yayau || 94 ||
meaning:
इत्युक्त्वा स मुनिर्भूपं नमुचस्तपसां निधिः |
विसर्जयामास तदा स चापि मुदितो ययौ || 94 ||
text_mt: Having spoken thus to the king, that sage Namuca, a treasure of austerities, / then dismissed him, and he too departed rejoiced.

sanskrit_iast:
sa gatvā pitaraṃ prāpya mātṛśca candraśekharaḥ |
apūjayad yathārhantu tairapyāśvāsitaḥ sutaḥ || 95 ||
meaning:
स गत्वा पितरं प्राप्य मातृश्च चन्द्रशेखरः |
अपूजयद् यथार्हन्तु तैरप्याश्वासितः सुतः || 95 ||
text_mt: Having gone and reached his father and mothers, Candraśekhara / worshipped them appropriately, and the son was consoled by them.

sanskrit_iast:
athāgato nṛpaḥ svīyāṃ karavīrapurīṃ prati |
muditaḥ sacivai sārdhaṃ reme devendrasannibhaḥ || 96 ||
meaning:
अथागतो नृपः स्वीयां करवीरपुरीं प्रति |
मुदितः सचिवै सार्धं रेमे देवेन्द्रसन्निभः || 96 ||
text_mt: Then the king returned to his own city Karavīrapura; / delighted, he took pleasure together with his ministers, resembling Devendra.

sanskrit_iast:
iti śrīkālikāpurāṇe saptacatvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 47 ||
aṣṭacatvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ
meaning:
इति श्रीकालिकापुराणे सप्तचत्वारिंशोऽध्यायः || 47 ||
अष्टचत्वारिंशोऽध्यायः
text_mt: Thus ends the forty-seventh chapter in the glorious Kālikāpurāṇa. / The forty-eighth chapter.

sanskrit_iast: aurva uvāca
meaning: और्व उवाच

sanskrit_iast:
avatīrṇe mahādeve pauṣyajāyāsukhecchayā |
mānuṣeṇa pramāṇena gate saṃvatsaratraye || 1 ||
meaning:
अवतीर्णे महादेवे पौष्यजायासुखेच्छया |
मानुषेण प्रमाणेन गते संवत्सरत्रये || 1 ||
text_mt: When Mahādeva had descended out of a desire for the happiness of the wife of Pauṣya, / and when three years had passed by human measure,

sanskrit_iast:
girijāpi kakutsthasya rājño bhāryāsvajāyata |
menakāyāṃ yathāpūrvaṃ svecchayā parameśvarī || 2 ||
meaning:
गिरिजापि ककुत्स्थस्य राज्ञो भार्यास्वजायत |
मेनकायां यथापूर्वं स्वेच्छया परमेश्वरी || 2 ||
text_mt: Girijā also, the supreme goddess, was born by her own will / from the wives of King Kakutstha, just as formerly from Menakā.

sanskrit_iast:
athāryāvartaviṣaye brahmaṇyaḥ śūrasattamaḥ |
ikṣvākuvaṃśajo rājā kakutstho nāma dhārmikaḥ || 3 ||
meaning:
अथार्यावर्तविषये ब्रह्मण्यः शूरसत्तमः |
इक्ष्वाकुवंशजो राजा ककुत्स्थो नाम धार्मिकः || 3 ||
text_mt: Now in the region of Āryāvarta there was a king born of the lineage of Ikṣvāku, / devoted to the Brahmins, foremost of heroes, righteous, named Kakutstha.

sanskrit_iast:
bhogavatyāhvayāyāṃ tu puryāṃ ripuniṣūdanaḥ |
sarvalakṣaṇasampanno bhūpālaguṇasaṃyutaḥ || 4 ||
meaning:
भोगवत्याह्वयायां तु पुर्यां रिपुनिषूदनः |
सर्वलक्षणसम्पन्नो भूपालगुणसंयुतः || 4 ||
text_mt: In the city called Bhogavatī, [he was] a destroyer of foes, / endowed with all auspicious marks, possessing the virtues of a protector of the earth.

sanskrit_iast:
tasya bhāryā mahābhāgā bhargadevasya putrikā |
sā manonmathinī nāmnā pūjitā pativallabhā || 5 ||
meaning:
तस्य भार्या महाभागा भर्गदेवस्य पुत्रिका |
सा मनोन्मथिनी नाम्ना पूजिता पतिवल्लभा || 5 ||
text_mt: His illustrious wife was the daughter of Bhargadeva; / named Manonmathinī, she was honored and beloved of her husband.

sanskrit_iast:
tasyāḥ putraśataṃ yajñe devagarbhābhamacyutam |
balavīryasamāyuktaṃ kakutsthanṛpasattamāt || 6 ||
meaning:
तस्याः पुत्रशतं यज्ञे देवगर्भाभमच्युतम् |
बलवीर्यसमायुक्तं ककुत्स्थनृपसत्तमात् || 6 ||
text_mt: From Kakutstha, foremost of kings, one hundred sons were born to her, / resembling divine embryos, unfailing, endowed with strength and valor.

sanskrit_iast:
putrī na vidyate tasyāstadarthaṃ sā gṛhāntare |
nibhṛtaṃ sthaṇḍilaṃ kṛtvā caṇḍikāṃ samapūjayat || 7 ||
meaning:
पुत्री न विद्यते तस्यास्तदर्थं सा गृहान्तरे |
निभृतं स्थण्डिलं कृत्वा चण्डिकां समपूजयत् || 7 ||
text_mt: She had no daughter. For that purpose, inside the house, / having secretly prepared a sacrificial ground, she worshipped Caṇḍikā.

sanskrit_iast:
pūjyamānā mahādevī caṇḍikā rājabhāryayā |
prasannā sā tribhirvarṣaistāṃ svapne cābravīdidam || 8 ||
meaning:
पूज्यमाना महादेवी चण्डिका राजभार्यया |
प्रसन्ना सा त्रिभिर्वर्षैस्तां स्वप्ने चाब्रवीदिदम् || 8 ||
text_mt: Being worshipped by the king's wife, the great goddess Caṇḍikā / was pleased after three years and spoke this to her in a dream:

sanskrit_iast:
yoṣillakṣaṇasampannā sārvabhaumasya bhāminī |
nakṣatramālayā yuktā putrī tava bhaviṣyati || 9 ||
meaning:
योषिल्लक्षणसम्पन्ना सार्वभौमस्य भामिनी |
नक्षत्रमालया युक्ता पुत्री तव भविष्यति || 9 ||
text_mt: "Endowed with the auspicious marks of women, [destined to be] the lady of an emperor, / adorned with a garland of stars, a daughter shall be born to you."

sanskrit_iast:
sāpi svapne varaṃ prāpya muditābhūnnṛpāṅganā |
sāpi svapne varaṃ prāpya muditābhūnnapāṅganā || 10 ||
meaning:
सापि स्वप्ने वरं प्राप्य मुदिताभून्नृपाङ्गना |
सापि स्वप्ने वरं प्राप्य मुदिताभून्नपाङ्गना || 10 ||
text_mt: Having obtained the boon in a dream, that king's wife rejoiced; / having obtained the boon in a dream, that king's wife rejoiced.

sanskrit_iast:
pārvatyapi svayaṃ tasyā garbhe kāle viveśa ha |
sā manonmathinī devī pravṛtte ṛtusaṃgame |
garbhaṃ dadhau mahāsattvaṃ candrikevāmṛtotkaram || 11 ||
meaning:
पार्वत्यपि स्वयं तस्या गर्भे काले विवेश ह |
सा मनोन्मथिनी देवी प्रवृत्ते ऋतुसंगमे |
गर्भं दधौ महासत्त्वं चन्द्रिकेवामृतोत्करम् || 11 ||
text_mt: Pārvatī herself entered her womb in due time. / When union during her season occurred, Queen Manonmathinī / bore a womb of great vitality, like moonlight bearing a mass of nectar.

sanskrit_iast:
sampūrṇe tu tataḥ kāle prāpte nakṣatramālinīm |
sā manonmathinī devī suṣuve tanayāṃ śubhām || 12 ||
meaning:
सम्पूर्णे तु ततः काले प्राप्ते नक्षत्रमालिनीम् |
सा मनोन्मथिनी देवी सुषुवे तनयां शुभाम् || 12 ||
text_mt: Then, when the time was complete, Queen Manonmathinī / gave birth to an auspicious daughter adorned with a garland of stars.

sanskrit_iast:
tāṃ dṛṣṭvā hārasaṃyuktāṃ śarajjyotsnopamāṃ śubhām |
kakutstho bhāryayā sārdhamatyarthamudito'bhavat || 13 ||
meaning:
तां दृष्ट्वा हारसंयुक्तां शरज्ज्योत्स्नोपमां शुभाम् |
ककुत्स्थो भार्यया सार्धमत्यर्थमुदितोऽभवत् || 13 ||
text_mt: Seeing her adorned with a necklace, auspicious, resembling autumn moonlight, / Kakutstha, along with his wife, became exceedingly delighted.

sanskrit_iast:
sahajenātha hāreṇa bhūṣitā tu kakutsthajā |
vavṛdhe mandire tasya varṣāsviva surāpagā || 14 ||
meaning:
सहजेनाथ हारेण भूषिता तु ककुत्स्थजा |
ववृधे मन्दिरे तस्य वर्षास्विव सुरापगा || 14 ||
text_mt: Adorned with the innate necklace, the daughter of Kakutstha / grew in his palace like the river of the gods in the rainy season.

sanskrit_iast:
tenaiva hāracihnena tasyāstārāvatīti vai |
nāmākarota pitā kāle yathokte nṛpasattama || 15 ||
meaning:
तेनैव हारचिह्नेन तस्यास्तारावतीति वै |
नामाकरोत पिता काले यथोक्ते नृपसत्तम || 15 ||
text_mt: Because of that very mark of a necklace, her father, O best of kings, / gave her the name Tārāvatī at the proper time, as prescribed.

sanskrit_iast:
kālakrameṇa sā bālyaṃ vyatītā varavarṇinī |
mañjulaṃ yauvanodbhedaṃ prāpa śrīriva mādhave || 16 ||
meaning:
कालक्रमेण सा बाल्यं व्यतीता वरवर्णिनी |
मञ्जुलं यौवनोद्भेदं प्राप श्रीरिव माधवे || 16 ||
text_mt: In the course of time, that fair-complexioned girl passed beyond childhood / and reached a charming bloom of youth, like Śrī in the month of Mādhava.

sanskrit_iast:
sā śriyā śriyamanveti śaucenātha satī śubhā |
suśīlāṃ śīlacaritaiḥ svarūpeṇa ca pārvatīm || 17 ||
meaning:
सा श्रिया श्रियमन्वेति शौचेनाथ सती शुभा |
सुशीलां शीलचरितैः स्वरूपेण च पार्वतीम् || 17 ||
text_mt: She followed Śrī in beauty, the auspicious Satī in purity, / Suśīlā in the conduct of good character, and Pārvatī in form.

sanskrit_iast:
tasyāstu yauvanodbhedaṃ dṛṣṭvā rājā sutaiḥ saha |
kakutsthaḥ kārayāmāsa samaye'tha svayaṃvaram || 18 ||
meaning:
तस्यास्तु यौवनोद्भेदं दृष्ट्वा राजा सुतैः सह |
ककुत्स्थः कारयामास समयेऽथ स्वयंवरम् || 18 ||
text_mt: Seeing her bloom of youth, King Kakutstha together with his sons / then arranged a svayaṃvara at the proper time.

sanskrit_iast:
mādhave māsi samprāpte candravṛddhau śubhe dine |
svayaṃvarasabhāṃ cakre tārāvatyāḥ pitā sutaiḥ || 19 ||
meaning:
माधवे मासि सम्प्राप्ते चन्द्रवृद्धौ शुभे दिने |
स्वयंवरसभां चक्रे तारावत्याः पिता सुतैः || 19 ||
text_mt: When the month of Mādhava arrived, on an auspicious day of the waxing moon, / Tārāvatī's father together with his sons set up the assembly hall for the svayaṃvara.

sanskrit_iast:
vārtikāṃstu bahūn rājā vaḍavābhiḥ kramelakaiḥ |
tūrṇaṃ praśtāpayāmāsa nānādeśanṛpān prati || 20 ||
meaning:
वार्तिकांस्तु बहून् राजा वडवाभिः क्रमेलकैः |
तूर्णं प्रश्तापयामास नानादेशनृपान् प्रति || 20 ||
text_mt: The king quickly dispatched many messengers / on mares and camels to the kings of various regions.

sanskrit_iast:
te rājānastadā śrutvā vārtā vai vārtikānanāt |
tūrṇameva samājagmustārāvatyāḥ svayaṃvaram || 21 ||
meaning:
ते राजानस्तदा श्रुत्वा वार्ता वै वार्तिकाननात् |
तूर्णमेव समाजग्मुस्तारावत्याः स्वयंवरम् || 21 ||
text_mt: Having heard the news from the mouths of the messengers, those kings / came swiftly to Tārāvatī's svayaṃvara.

sanskrit_iast:
taṃ śrutvā pauṣyatanayaścaturaṅgabalairyutaḥ |
svayaṃvaraṃ jagāmāśu divyālaṅkārasaṃyutaḥ || 22 ||
meaning:
तं श्रुत्वा पौष्यतनयश्चतुरङ्गबलैर्युतः |
स्वयंवरं जगामाशु दिव्यालङ्कारसंयुतः || 22 ||
text_mt: Hearing of it, the son of Pauṣya, accompanied by fourfold forces / and adorned with celestial ornaments, went quickly to the svayaṃvara.

sanskrit_iast:
tatra gatvā nṛpaśreṣṭhāḥ kakutsthena vinirmite |
svayaṃvarasabhāmadhye yathāyogyamupasthitāḥ || 23 ||
meaning:
तत्र गत्वा नृपश्रेष्ठाः ककुत्स्थेन विनिर्मिते |
स्वयंवरसभामध्ये यथायोग्यमुपस्थिताः || 23 ||
text_mt: Having arrived there, the best of kings took their seats as befitted them / in the midst of the svayaṃvara hall built by Kakutstha.

sanskrit_iast:
āsīneṣvatha bhūpeṣu kakutsthastanayāṃ svakām |
śubhe muhūrte samprāpte sabhāṃ netuṃ mano'karot || 24 ||
meaning:
आसीनेष्वथ भूपेषु ककुत्स्थस्तनयां स्वकाम् |
शुभे मुहूर्ते सम्प्राप्ते सभां नेतुं मनोऽकरोत् || 24 ||
text_mt: When the kings were seated, and the auspicious moment arrived, / Kakutstha resolved to bring his daughter to the assembly.

sanskrit_iast:
etasminnantare rājñaḥ kumārī varavarṇinī |
vṛddhāṃ dhātrīṃ nijāṃ samyaksampūrṇajñānaśālinīm || 25 ||
meaning:
एतस्मिन्नन्तरे राज्ञः कुमारी वरवर्णिनी |
वृद्धां धात्रीं निजां सम्यक्सम्पूर्णज्ञानशालिनीम् || 25 ||
text_mt: In the meantime, the fair-complexioned princess [sent] / her elderly nurse, thoroughly endowed with complete knowledge,

sanskrit_iast:
svayaṃvarasabhāṃ draṣṭuṃ prāhiṇot sadasaṃ prati |
uvāca ca tadā dhātrīṃ rājaputrī sumaṅgalām || 26 ||
meaning:
स्वयंवरसभां द्रष्टुं प्राहिणोत् सदसं प्रति |
उवाच च तदा धात्रीं राजपुत्री सुमङ्गलाम् || 26 ||
text_mt: to see the svayaṃvara assembly; she sent her to the hall, / and the princess then spoke to the very auspicious nurse:

sanskrit_iast:
svayaṃvarasabhāṃ gatvā cārurūpaṃ sulakṣaṇam |
nṛpaṃ nirūpya bho dhātri samakṣaṃ me nivedaya || 27 ||
meaning:
स्वयंवरसभां गत्वा चारुरूपं सुलक्षणम् |
नृपं निरूप्य भो धात्रि समक्षं मे निवेदय || 27 ||
text_mt: "Go to the svayaṃvara assembly, look over a handsome king / endowed with auspicious marks, O nurse, and report to me in person.

sanskrit_iast:
tvaṃ mātarmama kalyāṇaṃ saubhāgyamapi vācchasi |
yathā saubhāgyadaḥ svāmī mama syāt tvaṃ tathā kuru || 28 ||
meaning:
त्वं मातर्मम कल्याणं सौभाग्यमपि वाच्छसि |
यथा सौभाग्यदः स्वामी मम स्यात् त्वं तथा कुरु || 28 ||
text_mt: You, mother, desire my welfare and good fortune; / act in such a way that I may have a husband who grants good fortune."

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ tāṃ preṣayitvātha dhātrīṃ tāṃ nṛpaputrikā |
sā manonmathinī yatra prārādhayata caṇḍikām || 29 ||
meaning:
एवं तां प्रेषयित्वाथ धात्रीं तां नृपपुत्रिका |
सा मनोन्मथिनी यत्र प्राराधयत चण्डिकाम् || 29 ||
text_mt: Having thus sent that nurse, the king's daughter / went then, auspicious, illustrious Tārāvatī,

sanskrit_iast:
tatra prāyān mahābhāgā śubhā tārāvatī tadā |
tatra gatvā mahādevīṃ praṇamya kālikāhvayām || 30 ||
meaning:
तत्र प्रायान् महाभागा शुभा तारावती तदा |
तत्र गत्वा महादेवीं प्रणम्य कालिकाह्वयाम् || 30 ||
text_mt: to the place where Manonmathinī had worshipped Caṇḍikā. / Having gone there and bowed to the great goddess named Kālikā,

sanskrit_iast:
mānuṣeṇātha bhāvena tāṃ jñātvātmānamātmanā |
praṇanāma mahāśaktyā vākyaṃ caitaduvāca ha || 31 ||
meaning:
मानुषेणाथ भावेन तां ज्ञात्वात्मानमात्मना |
प्रणनाम महाशक्त्या वाक्यं चैतदुवाच ह || 31 ||
text_mt: knowing her through a human disposition, and knowing herself by herself, / she bowed with great devotion and spoke these words:

sanskrit_iast:
praṇamāmi mahāmāyāṃ yoganidrāṃ jaganmayīm |
sā me prasīdatāṃ gaurī caṇḍikā bhaktavatsalā || 32 ||
meaning:
प्रणमामि महामायां योगनिद्रां जगन्मयीम् |
सा मे प्रसीदतां गौरी चण्डिका भक्तवत्सला || 32 ||
text_mt: "I bow to Mahāmāyā, Yoganidrā, who consists of the universe; / may Gaurī, Caṇḍikā, who is affectionate to her devotees, be pleased with me.

sanskrit_iast:
yadi satyaṃ jananyā me madarthe tvaṃ prapūjitā |
tena satyena subhagaḥ patirmama nṛpottamaḥ || 33 ||
meaning:
यदि सत्यं जनन्या मे मदर्थे त्वं प्रपूजिता |
तेन सत्येन सुभगः पतिर्मम नृपोत्तमः || 33 ||
text_mt: If it is true that you were worshipped by my mother for my sake, / by that truth, may a fortunate best of kings

sanskrit_iast:
svayaṃvare'dya bhavatu prasīda haravallabhe |
iti tasyā vacaḥ śrutvā caṇḍikā haramohinī || 34 ||
meaning:
स्वयंवरेऽद्य भवतु प्रसीद हरवल्लभे |
इति तस्या वचः श्रुत्वा चण्डिका हरमोहिनी || 34 ||
text_mt: become my husband today at the svayaṃvara; be gracious, O beloved of Hara!" / Hearing her words, Caṇḍikā, who enchants Hara,

sanskrit_iast:
mohayanti nṛpasutāṃ yathātmānaṃ na vetti ca |
tathā prāhādṛśyamūrtiridaṃ sā sūnṛtaṃ vacaḥ || 35 ||
meaning:
मोहयन्ति नृपसुतां यथात्मानं न वेत्ति च |
तथा प्राहादृश्यमूर्तिरिदं सा सूनृतं वचः || 35 ||
text_mt: bewitching the princess so that she did not even know herself, / spoke this truthful speech, remaining invisible in form.

sanskrit_iast: devyuvāca
meaning: देव्युवाच

sanskrit_iast:
pauṣyasya tanayo yo'sau nāmnābhūccandraśekharaḥ |
sa manohararūpaste priyaḥ svāmī bhaviṣyati || 36 ||
meaning:
पौष्यस्य तनयो योऽसौ नाम्नाभूच्चन्द्रशेखरः |
स मनोहररूपस्ते प्रियः स्वामी भविष्यति || 36 ||
text_mt: "He who is the son of Pauṣya, who became known by the name of Candraśekhara, / he, of captivating form, shall be your beloved husband.

sanskrit_iast:
tamindukalayā śīrṣe cihnitaṃ nṛpasattamam |
varayasva varārohe pārvatīva vṛṣadhvajam || 37 ||
meaning:
तमिन्दुकलया शीर्षे चिह्नितं नृपसत्तमम् |
वरयस्व वरारोहे पार्वतीव वृषध्वजम् || 37 ||
text_mt: Choose that best of kings, marked on his head by a crescent moon, / O woman of fair hips, just as Pārvatī chose Vṛṣadhvaja."

sanskrit_iast:
ityuktvā vivarāmāśu pārvatī nṛpaputrikām |
sāpi natvā tathādṛśyāṃ harṣotphullavilocanā || 38 ||
meaning:
इत्युक्त्वा विवरामाशु पार्वती नृपपुत्रिकाम् |
सापि नत्वा तथादृश्यां हर्षोत्फुल्लविलोचना || 38 ||
text_mt: Having said this, Pārvatī immediately ceased speaking to the princess; / she too bowed to the invisible goddess, her eyes blossoming with joy,

sanskrit_iast:
jagāma maṅgalagṛhaṃ jananyā yatra vāsitā |
athājagāma sā dhātrī nirūpya sadṛśaṃ patim || 39 ||
meaning:
जगाम मङ्गलगृहं जनन्या यत्र वासिता |
अथाजगाम सा धात्री निरूप्य सदृशं पतिम् || 39 ||
text_mt: and went to the auspicious chamber where she had been housed by her mother. / Then the nurse returned, having selected a suitable husband.

sanskrit_iast: tārāvatyāstadācaṣṭa rahasyaṃ nṛpasattama |
meaning: तारावत्यास्तदाचष्ट रहस्यं नृपसत्तम |
text_mt: She then told Tārāvatī the secret, O best of kings.

sanskrit_iast: dṛṣṭvā tāmagrato dhātrīṃ prahṛṣṭāṃ nṛpate sutā || 40 ||
meaning: दृष्ट्वा तामग्रतो धात्रीं प्रहृष्टां नृपते सुता || 40 ||
text_mt: Seeing the nurse before her, joyful, the king's daughter

sanskrit_iast:
papraccha nibhṛtaṃ kīdṛk ko vā dṛṣṭastvayā nṛpaḥ |
dṛṣṭvā tāmagrato dhātrīṃ prahṛṣṭāṃ nṛpate sutā || 40 ||
meaning:
पप्रच्छ निभृतं कीदृक् को वा दृष्टस्त्वया नृपः |
दृष्ट्वा तामग्रतो धात्रीं प्रहृष्टां नृपते सुता || 40 ||
text_mt: secretly asked, "What kind of king, or who, was seen by you?" / Seeing the nurse before her, joyful, the king's daughter

sanskrit_iast:
papraccha nibhṛtaṃ kīdṛk ko vā dṛṣṭastvayā nṛpaḥ |
sā prāha dhātrī vacanāt tava bhūpā vilokitāḥ || 41 ||
meaning:
पप्रच्छ निभृतं कीदृक् को वा दृष्टस्त्वया नृपः |
सा प्राह धात्री वचनात् तव भूपा विलोकिताः || 41 ||
text_mt: secretly asked, "What kind of king, or who, was seen by you?" / The nurse said, "At your word, the kings have been observed [by me].

sanskrit_iast:
cārurūpāḥ kulīnāśca śāstrai śastre ca pāragāḥ |
teṣāmahaṃ na śaknomi pravaktuṃ subahūn guṇān || 42 ||
meaning:
चारुरूपाः कुलीनाश्च शास्त्रै शस्त्रे च पारगाः |
तेषामहं न शक्नोमि प्रवक्तुं सुबहून् गुणान् || 42 ||
text_mt: They are handsome, of noble family, and masters of sacred lore and weapons; / I am not able to describe their exceedingly numerous virtues.

sanskrit_iast:
yeṣu me rocate tāṃstu kathayāmi śubhaprabhe |
cārurūpā mayā teṣu catvāraḥ puruṣāḥ śubhe || 43 ||
meaning:
येषु मे रोचते तांस्तु कथयामि शुभप्रभे |
चारुरूपा मया तेषु चत्वारः पुरुषाः शुभे || 43 ||
text_mt: Among those who please me, I shall tell you of them, O fair-radiant one: / four men among them, O auspicious one, were seen by me as handsome;

sanskrit_iast:
dṛṣṭāstatrāpi nāsatyau devau dvāvaparau narau |
devayoḥ kathane kṛtyaṃ kiṃcinnāpi na vidyate || 44 ||
meaning:
दृष्टास्तत्रापि नासत्यौ देवौ द्वावपरौ नरौ |
देवयोः कथने कृत्यं किंचिन्नापि न विद्यते || 44 ||
text_mt: and among them, two were the divine Nāsatyas, and two others were mortals. / Concerning the two gods, there is no need to speak at all."

sanskrit_iast:
yau punaḥ pṛthivīpālau tayorekaḥ sadārakaḥ |
nāmnā sarvāṃgakalyāṇo'thāparaścandraśekharaḥ || 45 ||
meaning:
यौ पुनः पृथिवीपालौ तयोरेकः सदारकः |
नाम्ना सर्वांगकल्याणोऽथापरश्चन्द्रशेखरः || 45 ||
text_mt: As for the two kings, one has a wife, / named Sarvāṅgakalyāṇa; the other is Candraśekhara.

sanskrit_iast:
nāsatyayoretayostu viśeṣo nāsti kaścana |
rūpe śarīrasaubhāgye sarve cātimanoharāḥ || 46 ||
meaning:
नासत्ययोरेतयोस्तु विशेषो नास्ति कश्चन |
रूपे शरीरसौभाग्ये सर्वे चातिमनोहराः || 46 ||
text_mt: Between these two and the Nāsatyas there is no difference at all; / in beauty and bodily charm, all of them are exceedingly captivating.

sanskrit_iast:
nṛpau punarmahāsattvau siṃhaskandhau mahābhujau |
āraktapāṇinayanamukhapādakarodbhavau || 47 ||
meaning:
नृपौ पुनर्महासत्त्वौ सिंहस्कन्धौ महाभुजौ |
आरक्तपाणिनयनमुखपादकरोद्भवौ || 47 ||
text_mt: Yet the two kings are of immense might, with lion-shoulders and long arms, / with reddened hands, eyes, face, feet, and palms.

sanskrit_iast:
pīnoraskau viśālākṣau lagnabhrūyugalāvubhau |
sarvalakṣaṇasampūrṇau devālaṅkāramaṇḍitau || 48 ||
meaning:
पीनोरस्कौ विशालाक्षौ लग्नभ्रूयुगलावुभौ |
सर्वलक्षणसम्पूर्णौ देवालङ्कारमण्डितौ || 48 ||
text_mt: Broad-chested, large-eyed, both with meeting eyebrows, / endowed with all auspicious marks, adorned with divine ornaments.

sanskrit_iast:
tayorapi vayaḥsthatvāt praśastaścandraśekharaḥ |
suśīlaḥ sūnṛtavacāḥ śāstre śastre ca sammataḥ || 49 ||
meaning:
तयोरपि वयःस्थत्वात् प्रशस्तश्चन्द्रशेखरः |
सुशीलः सूनृतवचाः शास्त्रे शस्त्रे च सम्मतः || 49 ||
text_mt: Even between the two, because of his prime of youth, Candraśekhara is superior: / of good character, speaking truthful and pleasant words, esteemed in sacred lore and weapons.

sanskrit_iast:
īṣadudbhinnaromṇā tu nīlena cāru nirmalam |
rājate vadanaṃ tasya lakṣmaṇeva niśākaraḥ || 50 ||
meaning:
ईषदुद्भिन्नरोम्णा तु नीलेन चारु निर्मलम् |
राजते वदनं तस्य लक्ष्मणेव निशाकरः || 50 ||
text_mt: With hair just sprouting, dark, handsome, and spotless, / his face shines like the moon with its hare-mark.

sanskrit_iast:
dīptimatyāpi kalayā rājate sa niśāpateḥ |
sahajena śirasthena sākṣāt sa candraśekharaḥ || 51 ||
meaning:
दीप्तिमत्यापि कलया राजते स निशापतेः |
सहजेन शिरस्थेन साक्षात् स चन्द्रशेखरः || 51 ||
text_mt: He shines too with a radiant digit of the moon / naturally placed upon his head; he is Candraśekhara manifest.

sanskrit_iast:
sa eva te patiryogyaścihnenānena sundari |
taṃ tvaṃ varaya rājānaṃ tava yīgyaṃ śubhodayam || 52 ||
meaning:
स एव ते पतिर्योग्यश्चिह्नेनानेन सुन्दरि |
तं त्वं वरय राजानं तव यीग्यं शुभोदयम् || 52 ||
text_mt: He alone, by this token, is a fitting husband for you, O beautiful one; / choose that king, who is suited to you and brings auspicious fortune.

sanskrit_iast:
dhātryāścaivaṃ vacaḥ śrutvā rājaputrī jagāda tām |
matpārśvacāriṇī bhūtvā nidśaya nṛpottamam || 53 ||
meaning:
धात्र्याश्चैवं वचः श्रुत्वा राजपुत्री जगाद ताम् |
मत्पार्श्वचारिणी भूत्वा निद्शय नृपोत्तमम् || 53 ||
text_mt: Hearing the nurse's words, the princess said to her: / 'Accompany me at my side, and point out that best of kings,

sanskrit_iast:
dhātri sayaṃvarasabhāpravśasamaye mama |
tayorāyāttadā rājā tvanyonyaṃ bhāṣamāṇayoḥ || 54 ||
meaning:
धात्रि सयंवरसभाप्रव्शसमये मम |
तयोरायात्तदा राजा त्वन्योन्यं भाषमाणयोः || 54 ||
text_mt: O nurse, at the time I enter the svayaṃvara hall.' / While the two were thus speaking to one another, the king arrived

sanskrit_iast:
sutāṃ svayaṃvarasabhāṃ netuṃ kāle śubhodaye |
svayaṃ tadā kakutsthastu sutāyā maṅgalālaye || 55 ||
meaning:
सुतां स्वयंवरसभां नेतुं काले शुभोदये |
स्वयं तदा ककुत्स्थस्तु सुताया मङ्गलालये || 55 ||
text_mt: at that auspicious, favorable moment to lead his daughter to the svayaṃvara assembly; / Kakutstha himself then went to his daughter's auspicious chamber.

sanskrit_iast:
āsādya putrīṃ dayitāṃ yoṣidbhiḥ kṛtamaṅgalām |
mālyaṃ sugandhipuṣpāṇāṃ kareṇādāya tatkare || 56 ||
meaning:
आसाद्य पुत्रीं दयितां योषिद्भिः कृतमङ्गलाम् |
माल्यं सुगन्धिपुष्पाणां करेणादाय तत्करे || 56 ||
text_mt: Approaching his beloved daughter, whose auspicious rites had been performed by the women, / taking a garland of fragrant flowers in his hand, into her hand

sanskrit_iast:
dattvā cedamuvācāśu prāpayan maṅgalālayāt |
praviśya samitau mātarmālyenānyena sattamam || 57 ||
meaning:
दत्त्वा चेदमुवाचाशु प्रापयन् मङ्गलालयात् |
प्रविश्य समितौ मातर्माल्येनान्येन सत्तमम् || 57 ||
text_mt: he placed it, and bringing her forth from the auspicious chamber, spoke these words at once: / 'Entering the assembly, child, with another garland [choose] the best,

sanskrit_iast:
yaṃ tvamicchasi rājānaṃ dvijaṃ vā tvaṃ variṣyasi |
evamuktvā śivikayā svāptairvṛddhaiśca pūruṣaiḥ || 58 ||
meaning:
यं त्वमिच्छसि राजानं द्विजं वा त्वं वरिष्यसि |
एवमुक्त्वा शिविकया स्वाप्तैर्वृद्धैश्च पूरुषैः || 58 ||
text_mt: whichever king you desire, or a twice-born man shall you choose.' / Having spoken thus, [conveyed] in a palanquin by his own trusted and elder men,

sanskrit_iast: tāmāgatāṃ sabhāṃ dṛṣṭvā śakrādyāstridaśāstadā || 59 ||
meaning: तामागतां सभां दृष्ट्वा शक्राद्यास्त्रिदशास्तदा || 59 ||
text_mt: seeing her arrived at the assembly, the thirty gods led by Śakra,

sanskrit_iast:
anye dikpatayaścāpi sabhāṃ tatkṣaṇamāgatāḥ |
sāvatīrya tadāvāpya yānāt tārāvatī mudā || 60 ||
meaning:
अन्ये दिक्पतयश्चापि सभां तत्क्षणमागताः |
सावतीर्य तदावाप्य यानात् तारावती मुदा || 60 ||
text_mt: and the other guardians of the directions, came to the assembly at that moment. / She then, descending and stepping down from the conveyance with joy, Tārāvatī,

sanskrit_iast:
dhātryā cānugayā yuktā vyacarat sadaso'ntare |
sabhāmadhye ciraṃ sā tu vihṛtya varavarṇinī || 61 ||
meaning:
धात्र्या चानुगया युक्ता व्यचरत् सदसोऽन्तरे |
सभामध्ये चिरं सा तु विहृत्य वरवर्णिनी || 61 ||
text_mt: accompanied by her nurse as attendant, walked through the interior of the assembly. / Having moved for a long time amidst the assembly, that fair-complexioned lady,

sanskrit_iast:
bhāvitvānniyateryogāccaṇḍikāyāḥ prasādataḥ |
tayoḥ samatvādekatvāttayā dhātryā vibodhitā || 62 ||
meaning:
भावित्वान्नियतेर्योगाच्चण्डिकायाः प्रसादतः |
तयोः समत्वादेकत्वात्तया धात्र्या विबोधिता || 62 ||
text_mt: through the inevitability of destiny and by the grace of Caṇḍikā, / and having been informed by the nurse because the two [forms] were equal and identical,

sanskrit_iast:
gatisvedajaharmāmbhaḥ kaṇikānicitānanā |
patiṃ pūrvataraṃ putrī rājñastārāvatī satī || 63 ||
meaning:
गतिस्वेदजहर्माम्भः कणिकानिचितानना |
पतिं पूर्वतरं पुत्री राज्ञस्तारावती सती || 63 ||
text_mt: her face covered with droplets of sweat born from exertion, / the king's daughter, the virtuous Tārāvatī, [recognized] her former husband;

sanskrit_iast:
svayaṃ sā pārvatī devī vavre ca candraśekharam |
vṛtaṃ dṛṣṭvā tadā tantu brāhmaṇāḥ sāmagītibhiḥ || 64 ||
meaning:
स्वयं सा पार्वती देवी वव्रे च चन्द्रशेखरम् |
वृतं दृष्ट्वा तदा तन्तु ब्राह्मणाः सामगीतिभिः || 64 ||
text_mt: she, the goddess Pārvatī herself, chose Candraśekhara. / Seeing that he was chosen, the brāhmaṇas then with Sāman chants,

sanskrit_iast:
tayorvaivāhikaṃ cakrurmaṅgalaṃ yatamānasāḥ |
vaitālikā gāyakāśca tathā tauryatrikā nṛpa || 65 ||
meaning:
तयोर्वैवाहिकं चक्रुर्मङ्गलं यतमानसाः |
वैतालिका गायकाश्च तथा तौर्यत्रिका नृप || 65 ||
text_mt: restraining their minds, performed their auspicious wedding ceremony. / Bards, singers, and three-fold musicians, O king,

sanskrit_iast:
praśaṃsanti sma gāyanti vādayanti ca kautukāt |
sarve ca tridaśā modamavāpuścandraśekhare || 66 ||
meaning:
प्रशंसन्ति स्म गायन्ति वादयन्ति च कौतुकात् |
सर्वे च त्रिदशा मोदमवापुश्चन्द्रशेखरे || 66 ||
text_mt: praised, sang, and played instruments with delight. / And all the thirty gods experienced joy when Candraśekhara was chosen

sanskrit_iast:
tārāvatyā vṛte cātha kakutstho'pyatiharṣitaḥ |
vṛttāntaṃ vīkṣya ye bhūpāḥ subāhupramukhāḥ pare || 67 ||
meaning:
तारावत्या वृते चाथ ककुत्स्थोऽप्यतिहर्षितः |
वृत्तान्तं वीक्ष्य ये भूपाः सुबाहुप्रमुखाः परे || 67 ||
text_mt: by Tārāvatī, and Kakutstha was also overjoyed. / Seeing what had happened, the other kings led by Subāhu

sanskrit_iast:
ruṣṭāstān vārayāmāsa samitau candraśekharaḥ |
tato yāteṣu deveṣu tridivaṃ prati svecchayā || 68 ||
meaning:
रुष्टास्तान् वारयामास समितौ चन्द्रशेखरः |
ततो यातेषु देवेषु त्रिदिवं प्रति स्वेच्छया || 68 ||
text_mt: became enraged, but Candraśekhara held them off in the assembly. / Then, when the gods had returned to heaven at their pleasure

sanskrit_iast:
bhūpeṣu ca prayāteṣu kakutsthenārciteṣu ca |
vaivāhikena vidhinā sa rājā candraśekharaḥ || 69 ||
meaning:
भूपेषु च प्रयातेषु ककुत्स्थेनार्चितेषु च |
वैवाहिकेन विधिना स राजा चन्द्रशेखरः || 69 ||
text_mt: and the kings had departed after being honored by Kakutstha, / King Candraśekhara, according to the wedding rites,

sanskrit_iast:
tārāvatīṃ tadā bhāryāṃ kakutsthānumate punaḥ |
saṃskṛtya jñāpayāmāsa devebhyo vaidikairmakhaiḥ || 70 ||
meaning:
तारावतीं तदा भार्यां ककुत्स्थानुमते पुनः |
संस्कृत्य ज्ञापयामास देवेभ्यो वैदिकैर्मखैः || 70 ||
text_mt: consecrated Tārāvatī then as his wife with the permission of Kakutstha, / and announced it to the gods through Vedic sacrifices.

sanskrit_iast:
pāṇigrahaṇasaṃskārān kṛtvā tāṃ sahacāriṇīm |
karavīrapurāyāśu prayayau candraśekharaḥ || 71 ||
meaning:
पाणिग्रहणसंस्कारान् कृत्वा तां सहचारिणीम् |
करवीरपुरायाशु प्रययौ चन्द्रशेखरः || 71 ||
text_mt: Having performed the wedding rites with her as his companion, / Candraśekhara quickly set out for Karavīrapura.

sanskrit_iast:
dvāviṃśat tu sahasrāṇi dāsīnāṃ pradadau punaḥ |
kakutsthākhyo viṭpataye tasminnudvāhakarmaṇi || 72 ||
meaning:
द्वाविंशत् तु सहस्राणि दासीनां प्रददौ पुनः |
ककुत्स्थाख्यो विट्पतये तस्मिन्नुद्वाहकर्मणि || 72 ||
text_mt: Moreover, twenty-two thousand female servants / the king named Kakutstha gave to the son-in-law in that wedding ritual.

sanskrit_iast:
gavāṃ ṣaṣṭisahasrāṇi saurabhīṇāṃ tathaiva ca |
duhitre pradadau dāyaṃ dāsān dāsīḥ pramāṇataḥ || 73 ||
meaning:
गवां षष्टिसहस्राणि सौरभीणां तथैव च |
दुहित्रे प्रददौ दायं दासान् दासीः प्रमाणतः || 73 ||
text_mt: Sixty thousand fragrant Surabhi cows likewise, / he gave as dowry to his daughter, along with male and female servants in proper measure.

sanskrit_iast:
aparā yā nijā putrī kakutsthākhyasya bhūpateḥ |
nāmnā citrāṅgadā khyātā rūpaistārāvatī samā || 74 ||
meaning:
अपरा या निजा पुत्री ककुत्स्थाख्यस्य भूपतेः |
नाम्ना चित्राङ्गदा ख्याता रूपैस्तारावती समा || 74 ||
text_mt: Another daughter of King Kakutstha, / celebrated by the name Citrāṅgadā, equal to Tārāvatī in beauty,

sanskrit_iast:
dāsīnāmadhipā bhūtvā svayaṃ cānuyayau tadā |
tārāvatīṃ bhūpasutāṃ jyeṣṭhāṃ svāṃ bhaginīṃ śubhām || 75 ||
meaning:
दासीनामधिपा भूत्वा स्वयं चानुययौ तदा |
तारावतीं भूपसुतां ज्येष्ठां स्वां भगिनीं शुभाम् || 75 ||
text_mt: became the leader of the female servants and personally followed then / the auspicious king's daughter Tārāvatī, her elder sister.

sanskrit_iast:
tān dāsān susamādāya kakutsthatanayo mahān |
jyeṣṭho viśvāvasurnāma gacchantaṃ candraśekharam || 76 ||
meaning:
तान् दासान् सुसमादाय ककुत्स्थतनयो महान् |
ज्येष्ठो विश्वावसुर्नाम गच्छन्तं चन्द्रशेखरम् || 76 ||
text_mt: Gathering well those servants, the great son of Kakutstha, / the eldest, named Viśvāvasu, [followed] Candraśekhara as he was departing

sanskrit_iast:
tārāvatyā ca sahitaṃ syandanenāśugāminā |
dhīmānanuyayau paścāt karavīrapuraṃ prati || 77 ||
meaning:
तारावत्या च सहितं स्यन्दनेनाशुगामिना |
धीमाननुययौ पश्चात् करवीरपुरं प्रति || 77 ||
text_mt: accompanied by Tārāvatī; / the wise prince followed behind in a swift chariot toward Karavīrapura.

sanskrit_iast:
tārāvatyā sama rājā pauṣyajaścandraśekharaḥ |
karavīrapure ramye reme nṛpatiśekharaḥ || 78 ||
meaning:
तारावत्या सम राजा पौष्यजश्चन्द्रशेखरः |
करवीरपुरे रम्ये रेमे नृपतिशेखरः || 78 ||
text_mt: Together with Tārāvatī, the king, Pauṣyaja Candraśekhara, / that crest-jewel of rulers, made love in delightful Karavīrapura.

sanskrit_iast:
iti svayaṃ mahādevo mānuṣīṃ yonimāśritaḥ |
pārvatī ca svayaṃ jātā narayonimaninditā || 79 ||
meaning:
इति स्वयं महादेवो मानुषीं योनिमाश्रितः |
पार्वती च स्वयं जाता नरयोनिमनिन्दिता || 79 ||
text_mt: Thus Mahādeva himself entered a human womb, / and Pārvatī herself was born blameless in a human womb.

sanskrit_iast:
tathā bhṛṅgī mahākāla etayorabhavat sutaḥ |
tathā tvaṃ śṛṇu rājendra kathayāmi samudbhavam || 80 ||
meaning:
तथा भृङ्गी महाकाल एतयोरभवत् सुतः |
तथा त्वं शृणु राजेन्द्र कथयामि समुद्भवम् || 80 ||
text_mt: Moreover, Bhṛṅgin and Mahākāla became their two sons; / listen, O king of kings, as I tell of their birth.

sanskrit_iast:
iti śrīkālikāpurāṇe'ṣṭacatvāriṃśodhyāyaḥ || 48 ||
ekonapañcāśo'dhyāyaḥ
meaning:
इति श्रीकालिकापुराणेऽष्टचत्वारिंशोध्यायः || 48 ||
एकोनपञ्चाशोऽध्यायः
text_mt: Thus ends the forty-eighth chapter in the glorious Kālikāpurāṇa. / Forty-ninth chapter.

sanskrit_iast: mārkaṇḍeya uvāca
meaning: मार्कण्डेय उवाच

sanskrit_iast:
atha kāle vyatīte tu kakutsthatanayā satī |
vidhātumārtavaṃ snānaṃ yoṣidbhiḥ parivāritā || 1 ||
meaning:
अथ काले व्यतीते तु ककुत्स्थतनया सती |
विधातुमार्तवं स्नानं योषिद्भिः परिवारिता || 1 ||
text_mt: Now, after some time had passed, the virtuous daughter of Kakutstha, / surrounded by women to perform the post-menstrual ablution,

sanskrit_iast:
śītāmalajalāṃ hṛdyāṃ kaluṣadhvaṃsakovidām |
prabhinnāñjanasaṅkāśāṃ kaluṣadhvaṃsakovidām || 2 ||
meaning:
शीतामलजलां हृद्यां कलुषध्वंसकोविदाम् |
प्रभिन्नाञ्जनसङ्काशां कलुषध्वंसकोविदाम् || 2 ||
text_mt: in [a river of] cool, pure water, charming, skilled at destroying impurities, / resembling crushed collyrium, skilled at destroying impurities,

sanskrit_iast:
kṛtasnānāmanuttirṇāmardhamagnāṃ mahāsatīm |
dadṛśe svarṇagaurāṅgīṃ kapoto munisattamaḥ || 3 ||
meaning:
कृतस्नानामनुत्तिर्णामर्धमग्नां महासतीम् |
ददृशे स्वर्णगौराङ्गीं कपोतो मुनिसत्तमः || 3 ||
text_mt: having bathed, not yet stepped out, half-immersed, that great virtuous lady / of golden-fair limbs was seen by Kapota, the best of sages.

sanskrit_iast:
kāpotaṃ vapurāsthāya prāṇināṃ vadhaśaṅkayā |
vicacāra yataḥ pūrvaṃ kapotastena sa smṛtaḥ || 4 ||
meaning:
कापोतं वपुरास्थाय प्राणिनां वधशङ्कया |
विचचार यतः पूर्वं कपोतस्तेन स स्मृतः || 4 ||
text_mt: Because he had previously roamed about having assumed the body of a pigeon (kapota) / for fear of the killing of living beings, he was known as Kapota.

sanskrit_iast:
tāṃ dṛṣṭvā hemagarbhābhāṃ candrikāṃ śāradīmiva |
kapotaḥ kāmayāmāsa kāmabāṇādito bhṛśam || 5 ||
meaning:
तां दृष्ट्वा हेमगर्भाभां चन्द्रिकां शारदीमिव |
कपोतः कामयामास कामबाणादितो भृशम् || 5 ||
text_mt: Seeing her shining like molten gold, like autumn moonlight, / Kapota desired her, intensely tormented by the arrows of love.

sanskrit_iast:
kāmāgniparitaptaḥ sa kakutsthatanayāṃ muniḥ |
abhigamyātha kalyāṇīmidaṃ vacanamabravīt || 6 ||
meaning:
कामाग्निपरितप्तः स ककुत्स्थतनयां मुनिः |
अभिगम्याथ कल्याणीमिदं वचनमब्रवीत् || 6 ||
text_mt: Burned by the fire of passion, that sage / approached the auspicious daughter of Kakutstha and spoke these words:

sanskrit_iast: kapota uvāca
meaning: कपोत उवाच

sanskrit_iast:
kā tvaṃ kasyāsi vanitā putrī vā kasya sundari |
kasmāt samāgatā vā tvamupāṃśu taṭinījalam || 7 ||
meaning:
का त्वं कस्यासि वनिता पुत्री वा कस्य सुन्दरि |
कस्मात् समागता वा त्वमुपांशु तटिनीजलम् || 7 ||
text_mt: Who are you, whose wife are you, or whose daughter are you, O beautiful one? / Why have you secretly come to the water of the river?

sanskrit_iast:
rūpaṃ te saumyamāhlādi pūrṇacandranibhaṃ mukham |
tilapuṣpapratīkāśaṃ nāsikāyugalaṃ tava || 8 ||
meaning:
रूपं ते सौम्यमाह्लादि पूर्णचन्द्रनिभं मुखम् |
तिलपुष्पप्रतीकाशं नासिकायुगलं तव || 8 ||
text_mt: Your form is gentle and delighting, your face resembles the full moon; / your nostrils resemble the blossom of the sesame flower;

sanskrit_iast:
vātakampitanīlābjasadṛśe locane tava |
bāhū manoharau vṛttau mṛṇālamṛdulāyatau |
ūrū gajakaraprakhyau madhyaṃ vedivilagnakam || 9 ||
meaning:
वातकम्पितनीलाब्जसदृशे लोचने तव |
बाहू मनोहरौ वृत्तौ मृणालमृदुलायतौ |
ऊरू गजकरप्रख्यौ मध्यं वेदिविलग्नकम् || 9 ||
text_mt: your eyes resemble blue lotuses stirred by the wind; / your arms are enchanting, round, soft and long as lotus fibers; / your thighs resemble the trunk of an elephant, your waist is slender as an altar.

sanskrit_iast:
īdṛśena tu rūpeṇa na tvaṃ mānuṣabhāminī |
devī vā dānavī vā tvamapsaroguṇaśālinī || 10 ||
meaning:
ईदृशेन तु रूपेण न त्वं मानुषभामिनी |
देवी वा दानवी वा त्वमप्सरोगुणशालिनी || 10 ||
text_mt: With such beauty, you are no human woman; / you must be a goddess, a dānavī, or an apsaras rich in virtues.

sanskrit_iast:
athavā bhogyabhogāya śrīstvaṃ nārītvamāgatā |
aparṇā vā śacī vā tvaṃ tanme vada manohare || 11 ||
meaning:
अथवा भोग्यभोगाय श्रीस्त्वं नारीत्वमागता |
अपर्णा वा शची वा त्वं तन्मे वद मनोहरे || 11 ||
text_mt: Or perhaps you are Śrī come into womanhood to enjoy pleasures, / or Aparṇā, or Śacī—tell me that, fair one!

sanskrit_iast: aurva uvāca
meaning: और्व उवाच

sanskrit_iast:
iti vākyaṃ muneḥ śrutvā jalāduttīrya bhāminī |
praṇamya taṃ muniṃ namrā vacanaṃ cedamabravīt || 12 ||
meaning:
इति वाक्यं मुनेः श्रुत्वा जलादुत्तीर्य भामिनी |
प्रणम्य तं मुनिं नम्रा वचनं चेदमब्रवीत् || 12 ||
text_mt: Hearing this speech of the sage, the woman stepped out of the water, / bowed to that sage, and, humble, spoke these words:

sanskrit_iast:
ahaṃ tārāvatī nāmnā kakutsthasya sutā satī |
candraśekharabhūpasya bhāryāṃ jānīhi māṃ mune || 13 ||
meaning:
अहं तारावती नाम्ना ककुत्स्थस्य सुता सती |
चन्द्रशेखरभूपस्य भार्यां जानीहि मां मुने || 13 ||
text_mt: "I am Tārāvatī by name, daughter of Kakutstha, a virtuous wife; / know me, O sage, as the wife of King Candraśekhara.

sanskrit_iast:
nāhaṃ devī na gandharvī na yakṣī na ca rākṣasī |
mānuṣyahaṃ nṛpasutā cāritravratadhāriṇī || 14 ||
meaning:
नाहं देवी न गन्धर्वी न यक्षी न च राक्षसी |
मानुष्यहं नृपसुता चारित्रव्रतधारिणी || 14 ||
text_mt: I am no goddess, no gandharvī, no yakṣī, and no rākṣasī; / I am a human woman, a king's daughter, holding fast to the vow of good conduct."

sanskrit_iast: kapota uvāca
meaning: कपोत उवाच

sanskrit_iast:
tvāṃ dṛṣṭvā māṃ svayaṃ kāmaḥ saṅgataḥ saṅgamāya te |
pīḍitaścāpi tenāhaṃ tvayā śaktyā samakṣayā || 15 ||
meaning:
त्वां दृष्ट्वा मां स्वयं कामः सङ्गतः सङ्गमाय ते |
पीडितश्चापि तेनाहं त्वया शक्त्या समक्षया || 15 ||
text_mt: "Seeing you, Kāma himself has come upon me for union with you; / and I am tormented by him through your power directly before me.

sanskrit_iast:
smarasāgarakallolapatitaṃ māṃ nirākulam |
tvadūrutariṇā trāhi tūrṇaṃ tvaṃ mṛdubhāṣiṇī || 16 ||
meaning:
स्मरसागरकल्लोलपतितं मां निराकुलम् |
त्वदूरुतरिणा त्राहि तूर्णं त्वं मृदुभाषिणी || 16 ||
text_mt: Save me quickly, O sweet-speaking woman, fallen into the waves / of the ocean of Smara and distraught, using the raft of your thighs!

sanskrit_iast:
mattaḥ putradvayaṃ cāru rūpalakṣaṇasaṃyutam |
bhaviṣyati mahābhāge balavīryayutaṃ mahat || 17 ||
meaning:
मत्तः पुत्रद्वयं चारु रूपलक्षणसंयुतम् |
भविष्यति महाभागे बलवीर्ययुतं महत् || 17 ||
text_mt: From me will come two handsome sons endowed with beauty and auspicious marks, / possessed of great strength and valor, O noble lady."

sanskrit_iast: mārkaṇḍeya uvāca
meaning: मार्कण्डेय उवाच

sanskrit_iast:
kapotasya vacaḥ śrutvā bhayaduḥkhasamākulā |
jagāda gadgadaṃ vākyaṃ vāgminyatha kakutsthajā || 18 ||
meaning:
कपोतस्य वचः श्रुत्वा भयदुःखसमाकुला |
जगाद गद्गदं वाक्यं वाग्मिन्यथ ककुत्स्थजा || 18 ||
text_mt: Hearing the words of Kapota, the eloquent daughter of Kakutstha, / overwhelmed with fear and grief, then spoke in a faltering voice.

sanskrit_iast: tārāvatyuvāca
meaning: तारावत्युवाच

sanskrit_iast:
vākyamanyanmayā kāryaṃ na kāryamatininditam |
tasmānmā vada māmitthaṃ praṇamya tvāṃ prasādaye || 19 ||
meaning:
वाक्यमन्यन्मया कार्यं न कार्यमतिनिन्दितम् |
तस्मान्मा वद मामित्थं प्रणम्य त्वां प्रसादये || 19 ||
text_mt: "I must do what is other; I must not commit a deeply blameworthy deed. / Therefore, do not speak thus to me; bowing down, I propitiate you.

sanskrit_iast:
tavāpi naitad yogyaṃ syānmuneriha tapodhana |
tapaḥkṣayakaraṃ garhyaṃ satītvabhraṃśakaṃ mama || 20 ||
meaning:
तवापि नैतद् योग्यं स्यान्मुनेरिह तपोधन |
तपःक्षयकरं गर्ह्यं सतीत्वभ्रंशकं मम || 20 ||
text_mt: This would not be proper even for you, a sage whose wealth is asceticism; / it destroys ascetic merit, is contemptible, and would ruin my chastity."

sanskrit_iast: kapota uvāca
meaning: कपोत उवाच

sanskrit_iast:
tapovyayo vā cānyadvā dūṣaṇa tanmamāstviha |
tathāpi tvāmahaṃ tyaktuṃ necchāmi suratau śubhe || 21 ||
meaning:
तपोव्ययो वा चान्यद्वा दूषण तन्ममास्त्विह |
तथापि त्वामहं त्यक्तुं नेच्छामि सुरतौ शुभे || 21 ||
text_mt: "Whether it be the loss of ascetic merit or some other fault, let it be mine here; / even so, I do not wish to abandon you in lovemaking, O fair one.

sanskrit_iast:
avaśyaṃ mama kāmebhyastrāṇaṃ kartumihārhasi |
anyathā kāmadagdho'haṃ tvayā tyakto manohare || 22 ||
meaning:
अवश्यं मम कामेभ्यस्त्राणं कर्तुमिहार्हसि |
अन्यथा कामदग्धोऽहं त्वया त्यक्तो मनोहरे || 22 ||
text_mt: You ought certainly to protect me from desire here; / otherwise, burnt by Kāma and abandoned by you, O lovely woman,

sanskrit_iast:
bhavatīṃ ca kariṣyāmi śāpadagdhāṃ sabāndhavām |
tatastadvacanaṃ śrutvā devī tārāvatī tadā |
ṛṣiśāpabhayāt sādhvī na kiñciccottaraṃ dadau || 23 ||
meaning:
भवतीं च करिष्यामि शापदग्धां सबान्धवाम् |
ततस्तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा देवी तारावती तदा |
ऋषिशापभयात् साध्वी न किञ्चिच्चोत्तरं ददौ || 23 ||
text_mt: I shall make you burnt by a curse, together with your kin." / Then, hearing his words, Queen Tārāvatī, / the virtuous wife, terrified of the sage’s curse, gave no answer at all,

sanskrit_iast: sambhāṣaye'haṃ svasakhīriha tiṣṭha mahāmune || 24 ||
meaning: सम्भाषयेऽहं स्वसखीरिह तिष्ठ महामुने || 24 ||
text_mt: [saying only:] "I will speak with my friends; stay here, O great sage."

sanskrit_iast: evamuktvā tadā devī dāsīnāṃ madhyamāgatā |
meaning: एवमुक्त्वा तदा देवी दासीनां मध्यमागता |
text_mt: Having spoken thus, the queen then went among her handmaidens.

sanskrit_iast: citrāṅgadāṃ samāhūya vacanaṃ cedamabravīta || 25 ||
meaning: चित्राङ्गदां समाहूय वचनं चेदमब्रवीत || 25 ||
text_mt: Calling Citrāṅgadā, she spoke these words:

sanskrit_iast:
citrāṅgade minirasau māṃ vai kāmayate bhṛśam |
kiṃ kariṣye satībhāvānna bhraṣṭā syāmahaṃ katham || 26 ||
meaning:
चित्राङ्गदे मिनिरसौ मां वै कामयते भृशम् |
किं करिष्ये सतीभावान्न भ्रष्टा स्यामहं कथम् || 26 ||
text_mt: "O Citrāṅgadā, this sage desires me intensely! / What shall I do? How might I not fall from my state of a faithful wife?

sanskrit_iast:
patiṃ bandhūṃśca kapotaḥ sadyaḥ śāpāgninā dahet |
nāhaṃ muniṃ kāmaye cet saṃśaye patitā tvaham || 27 ||
meaning:
पतिं बन्धूंश्च कपोतः सद्यः शापाग्निना दहेत् |
नाहं मुनिं कामये चेत् संशये पतिता त्वहम् || 27 ||
text_mt: Kapota would instantly burn my husband and kin with the fire of his curse / if I do not desire the sage; I have fallen into doubt!"

sanskrit_iast:
tataścitrāṅgadā prāha mā bhaistvaṃ satyabhāṣiṇi |
tatropāyamahaṃ vakṣye yatkṛtvā tvaṃ pramokṣyase || 28 ||
meaning:
ततश्चित्राङ्गदा प्राह मा भैस्त्वं सत्यभाषिणि |
तत्रोपायमहं वक्ष्ये यत्कृत्वा त्वं प्रमोक्ष्यसे || 28 ||
text_mt: Then Citrāṅgadā said: "Do not fear, O truth-speaking lady! / I shall tell you a means by doing which you will be delivered.

sanskrit_iast:
na jahāti muniścettvāṃ dāsīmekāṃ manoharām |
subhūṣaṇairbhūṣayitvā munaye tvaṃ niyojaya || 29 ||
meaning:
न जहाति मुनिश्चेत्त्वां दासीमेकां मनोहराम् |
सुभूषणैर्भूषयित्वा मुनये त्वं नियोजय || 29 ||
text_mt: If the sage does not let you go, adorn one lovely handmaiden / with fine ornaments and send her to the sage.

sanskrit_iast:
kāmāturo munirmohāt kṛpaṇo jñāsyate na hi |
dāsīṃ tvadbhūṣaṇācchannāṃ jyotsnācchannāṃ mṛgīmiva || 30 ||
meaning:
कामातुरो मुनिर्मोहात् कृपणो ज्ञास्यते न हि |
दासीं त्वद्भूषणाच्छन्नां ज्योत्स्नाच्छन्नां मृगीमिव || 30 ||
text_mt: Frenzied with passion, out of delusion the wretched sage will not know / a handmaiden covered in your ornaments, like a doe covered by moonlight.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ kuru mahābhāge mā tvaṃ cintāṃ gamaḥ śubhe |
tvaṃ cet satīti niyataṃ na jñāsyati tadā muniḥ || 31 ||
meaning:
एवं कुरु महाभागे मा त्वं चिन्तां गमः शुभे |
त्वं चेत् सतीति नियतं न ज्ञास्यति तदा मुनिः || 31 ||
text_mt: Do this, O noble lady; do not yield to anxiety, O fair one! / If you are chaste, the sage will certainly not realize it then."

sanskrit_iast:
tatastārāvatī prāha tāṃ rūpaguṇaśālinīm |
citrāṅgadāṃ bhūpaputrīṃ śaśvadvinayasūnṛtām || 32 ||
meaning:
ततस्तारावती प्राह तां रूपगुणशालिनीम् |
चित्राङ्गदां भूपपुत्रीं शश्वद्विनयसूनृताम् || 32 ||
text_mt: Then Tārāvatī spoke to that princess Citrāṅgadā, / who was endowed with beauty and virtues and was ever modest and sweet of speech:

sanskrit_iast:
tvameva gaccha bhaginī apotākhyamanindite |
madbhūṣaṇairbhūṣayitvā svaśarīraṃ manasvini || 33 ||
meaning:
त्वमेव गच्छ भगिनी अपोताख्यमनिन्दिते |
मद्भूषणैर्भूषयित्वा स्वशरीरं मनस्विनि || 33 ||
text_mt: "You yourself go, sister, to the one named Kapota, O blameless one, / having adorned your body with my ornaments, O high-minded woman!

sanskrit_iast:
anyāṃ prasthāpitāṃ vipraḥ sambudhya krodhavahninā |
dhakṣyatyavaśyaṃ sakulāṃ māṃ tasmād gaccha sundari || 34 ||
meaning:
अन्यां प्रस्थापितां विप्रः सम्बुध्य क्रोधवह्निना |
धक्ष्यत्यवश्यं सकुलां मां तस्माद् गच्छ सुन्दरि || 34 ||
text_mt: If another is sent, the brāhmaṇa, discerning it, will surely burn me / together with my family with the fire of his anger; therefore, you go, fair lady!

sanskrit_iast:
tvaṃ matsamā sarvaguṇaiḥ sarvabhūṣaṇabhūṣitā |
muniṃ saṅgamayasvādya rakṣa māṃ sakulāṃ śubhe || 35 ||
meaning:
त्वं मत्समा सर्वगुणैः सर्वभूषणभूषिता |
मुनिं सङ्गमयस्वाद्य रक्ष मां सकुलां शुभे || 35 ||
text_mt: You are equal to me in all virtues, adorned with all ornaments; / unite with the sage today, and save me together with my family, O auspicious one!"

sanskrit_iast:
tatastasyā vacaḥ śrutvā vinayaṃ ca sakātaram |
tūṣṇīṃ bhūtvā kṣaṇaṃ tasthau nātihṛṣṭamanā iva || 36 ||
meaning:
ततस्तस्या वचः श्रुत्वा विनयं च सकातरम् |
तूष्णीं भूत्वा क्षणं तस्थौ नातिहृष्टमना इव || 36 ||
text_mt: Then, hearing her words and anxious entreaty, / she stood silent for a moment, as if not very pleased at heart.

sanskrit_iast:
jagāda ca mahābhāgāṃ citrāṅgadā kakutsthajām |
kariṣye vacanaṃ te'dya samaye māṃ smariṣyasi || 37 ||
meaning:
जगाद च महाभागां चित्राङ्गदा ककुत्स्थजाम् |
करिष्ये वचनं तेऽद्य समये मां स्मरिष्यसि || 37 ||
text_mt: And the illustrious Citrāṅgadā spoke to the daughter of Kakutstha: / "I shall do your bidding today; you must remember me at the proper time,

sanskrit_iast:
yadarthe pitaraṃ cemaṃ bhūpaṃ ca candraśekharam |
āśvāsayiṣyati tathā samastāṃ ca sakhīgaṇān || 38 ||
meaning:
यदर्थे पितरं चेमं भूपं च चन्द्रशेखरम् |
आश्वासयिष्यति तथा समस्तां च सखीगणान् || 38 ||
text_mt: so that she will comfort this father, and King Candraśekhara, / and likewise the entire host of female friends."

sanskrit_iast:
evamuktvā bhūṣaṇāni tārāvatyāḥ pidhāya sā |
citrāṅgadā jagāmāśu muneḥ kāmotsavāya ca || 39 ||
meaning:
एवमुक्त्वा भूषणानि तारावत्याः पिधाय सा |
चित्राङ्गदा जगामाशु मुनेः कामोत्सवाय च || 39 ||
text_mt: Having spoken thus and put on Tārāvatī's ornaments, / Citrāṅgadā went swiftly for the sage’s festival of love.

sanskrit_iast:
tārāvatī tadā dīna vastrālaṅkāravarjitā |
dāsīmadhyagatā bhūtvā tāmevānuyayau priyām || 40 ||
meaning:
