text_mt: Then, with her two sons and with those abundant riches, / with the approval of Citrāṅgadā and the consent of the two sons as well,

sanskrit_iast:
suvarcasaṃ tumburuṃ ca tathā citrāṅgadāmapi |
āmantrya muniśārdūlaḥ karavīrapuraṃ yayau || 26 ||
meaning:
सुवर्चसं तुम्बुरुं च तथा चित्राङ्गदामपि |
आमन्त्र्य मुनिशार्दूलः करवीरपुरं ययौ || 26 ||
text_mt: taking leave of Suvarcas, Tumburu, and Citrāṅgadā, / the tiger among sages went to Karavīrapura.

sanskrit_iast:
tatra gatvā sa apoto rājānaṃ candraśekharam |
rājoparicaraṃ caiva vākyametaduvāca ha || 27 ||
meaning:
तत्र गत्वा स अपोतो राजानं चन्द्रशेखरम् |
राजोपरिचरं चैव वाक्यमेतदुवाच ह || 27 ||
text_mt: Having gone there, Kapota spoke / these words to King Candraśekhara and to King Uparicara:

sanskrit_iast:
iyaṃ kakutsthajā bhūpa tavaiva viditā purā |
sadyojātau tathaivāsyāmetau me tanayau śucī || 28 ||
meaning:
इयं ककुत्स्थजा भूप तवैव विदिता पुरा |
सद्योजातौ तथैवास्यामेतौ मे तनयौ शुची || 28 ||
text_mt: "This woman born of Kakutstha's lineage was already known to you, O king; / and born at that very time from her are these two pure sons of mine.

sanskrit_iast:
ebhirvittaiḥ samaṃ putrau mama tvaṃ pratipālaya |
rājoparicaraścāpi pālayatviha me sutau || 29 ||
meaning:
एभिर्वित्तैः समं पुत्रौ मम त्वं प्रतिपालय |
राजोपरिचरश्चापि पालयत्विह मे सुतौ || 29 ||
text_mt: Protect my two sons along with these riches; / and let King Uparicara also protect my two sons here.

sanskrit_iast:
aputrasya nṛpaḥ putro nirdhanasya dhanaṃ nṛpaḥ |
amāturjananī rājā hyatātasya pitā nṛpaḥ || 30 ||
meaning:
अपुत्रस्य नृपः पुत्रो निर्धनस्य धनं नृपः |
अमातुर्जननी राजा ह्यतातस्य पिता नृपः || 30 ||
text_mt: To the sonless the king is a son; to the poor the king is wealth; / to the motherless the king is a mother; to the fatherless the king is a father.

sanskrit_iast:
anāthasya nṛpo nātho hyabhartuḥ pārthivaḥ patiḥ |
abhṛtyasya nṛpo bhṛtyo nṛpa eva nṛṇāṃ sakhā |
sarvadevamayo rājā tasmāt tvāmarthaye nṛpa || 31 ||
meaning:
अनाथस्य नृपो नाथो ह्यभर्तुः पार्थिवः पतिः |
अभृत्यस्य नृपो भृत्यो नृप एव नृणां सखा |
सर्वदेवमयो राजा तस्मात् त्वामर्थये नृप || 31 ||
text_mt: To the helpless the king is a protector; to the husbandless the king is a husband; / to the servantless the king is a servant; the king alone is a friend to men; / the king embodies all the gods; therefore I make this request of you, O king."

sanskrit_iast: aurva uvāca
meaning: और्व उवाच

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ sa rājā taṃ prāha munimevaṃ dvijottamam |
kariṣye tvadvacaścāhaṃ rājoparicaraśca saḥ || 32 ||
meaning:
ततः स राजा तं प्राह मुनिमेवं द्विजोत्तमम् |
करिष्ये त्वद्वचश्चाहं राजोपरिचरश्च सः || 32 ||
text_mt: Then the king said to that sage, the best of the twice-born: / "I shall do your bidding, and so shall King Uparicara."

sanskrit_iast:
atha citrāṅgadā rājā jagrāha munisammate |
sutau ca tasya sadhanau jyāyase sūnave dadau || 33 ||
meaning:
अथ चित्राङ्गदा राजा जग्राह मुनिसम्मते |
सुतौ च तस्य सधनौ ज्यायसे सूनवे ददौ || 33 ||
text_mt: Then, with the approval of the sage, the king received Citrāṅgadā, / and gave her two sons along with their wealth to his eldest son.

sanskrit_iast:
sa coparicaraḥ prādādrājyamardhaṃ suvarcase |
tathaiva sacivādhyakṣamakarottumburuṃ tadā || 34 ||
meaning:
स चोपरिचरः प्रादाद्राज्यमर्धं सुवर्चसे |
तथैव सचिवाध्यक्षमकरोत्तुम्बुरुं तदा || 34 ||
text_mt: And Uparicara gave half the kingdom to Suvarcas, / and likewise made Tumburu the chief minister then.

sanskrit_iast:
kapotascāpi suprītaḥ putrārdhaṃ samavekṣya ca |
jagāmāmantrya nṛpatiṃ tapase ca tapovanam || 35 ||
meaning:
कपोतस्चापि सुप्रीतः पुत्रार्धं समवेक्ष्य च |
जगामामन्त्र्य नृपतिं तपसे च तपोवनम् || 35 ||
text_mt: Kapota too, exceedingly pleased upon seeing the welfare of his sons, / took leave of the king and went to the penance grove for austerities.

sanskrit_iast:
pathi gacchan sa kapotaḥ śambhuputrau manoharau |
ekākinau carantau tu sūryācandramasāviba || 36 ||
meaning:
पथि गच्छन् स कपोतः शम्भुपुत्रौ मनोहरौ |
एकाकिनौ चरन्तौ तु सूर्याचन्द्रमसाविब || 36 ||
text_mt: Going on the road, Kapota saw Śambhu's two charming sons / wandering alone, like the sun and the moon.

sanskrit_iast:
tayordadṛdarśa ca tadā vadane vānarākṛtī |
smṛtvā pūrvakathāṃ dṛṣṭvā tāvapṛcchat tapodhanaḥ || 37 ||
meaning:
तयोर्ददृदर्श च तदा वदने वानराकृती |
स्मृत्वा पूर्वकथां दृष्ट्वा तावपृच्छत् तपोधनः || 37 ||
text_mt: He then saw that their two faces had the form of monkeys; / remembering the previous story upon seeing them, the ascetic questioned them.

sanskrit_iast:
kau yuvāṃ devagarbhābhau carantau vijane pathi |
ekākinau naraśreṣṭhau tanme vadatamīritam || 38 ||
meaning:
कौ युवां देवगर्भाभौ चरन्तौ विजने पथि |
एकाकिनौ नरश्रेष्ठौ तन्मे वदतमीरितम् || 38 ||
text_mt: "Who are you two, shining like divine offspring, wandering on a lonely path, / solitary, foremost of men? Tell me that which I ask."

sanskrit_iast:
atha tau praṇipatyainaṃ sambhāṣya ca samañjasam |
kapotākhyaṃ muniśreṣṭhamūcatuḥ śaṅkarātmajau || 39 ||
meaning:
अथ तौ प्रणिपत्यैनं सम्भाष्य च समञ्जसम् |
कपोताख्यं मुनिश्रेष्ठमूचतुः शङ्करात्मजौ || 39 ||
text_mt: Then the two sons of Śaṅkara, bowing down to him and addressing him / appropriately, spoke to that foremost of sages named Kapota:

sanskrit_iast:
candraśekharaputrau nau tārāvatyāṃ samudgatau |
viddhi tvaṃ muniśārdūla praṇamāvaḥ padaṃ tava || 40 ||
meaning:
चन्द्रशेखरपुत्रौ नौ तारावत्यां समुद्गतौ |
विद्धि त्वं मुनिशार्दूल प्रणमावः पदं तव || 40 ||
text_mt: "Know us to be the sons of Candraśekhara, born from Tārāvatī, / O tiger among sages; we bow down to your feet.

sanskrit_iast:
avajñāṃ vīkṣya nṛpaterāvayoḥ satataṃ mune |
ekākinau nirjaneṣu bhrabhāvo manyunā sadā || 41 ||
meaning:
अवज्ञां वीक्ष्य नृपतेरावयोः सततं मुने |
एकाकिनौ निर्जनेषु भ्रभावो मन्युना सदा || 41 ||
text_mt: Seeing the king's constant disdain for us, O sage, / we two, solitary, wander always in deserted places out of grief.

sanskrit_iast:
kimarthamātmajau putrau praṇatau satataṃ nṛpaḥ |
avajñāya mahābhāga dāyamātraṃ na ditsati || 42 ||
meaning:
किमर्थमात्मजौ पुत्रौ प्रणतौ सततं नृपः |
अवज्ञाय महाभाग दायमात्रं न दित्सति || 42 ||
text_mt: Why does the king, disregarding his own two sons who are ever obedient, / O illustrious one, refuse to give even their inheritance?

sanskrit_iast:
tasmādāvāṃ tapastaptumicchāvo dvijasattama |
upadeśapradānena cānugṛhṇāti cedbhavān || 43 ||
meaning:
तस्मादावां तपस्तप्तुमिच्छावो द्विजसत्तम |
उपदेशप्रदानेन चानुगृह्णाति चेद्भवान् || 43 ||
text_mt: Therefore, O best of the twice-born, we two wish to perform ascetic penance, / if you would favor [us] by bestowing instruction."

sanskrit_iast:
tatastayorvacaḥ śrutvā prahasya munisattamaḥ |
bhūtabhavyabhavajjñānastāvidaṃ munirabravīt || 44 ||
meaning:
ततस्तयोर्वचः श्रुत्वा प्रहस्य मुनिसत्तमः |
भूतभव्यभवज्ज्ञानस्ताविदं मुनिरब्रवीत् || 44 ||
text_mt: Then, having heard their words and smiling, that best of sages, / who knew the past, future, and present, spoke this to the two:

sanskrit_iast: muniruvāca
meaning: मुनिरुवाच

sanskrit_iast:
na yuvāṃ tanayau tasya candraśekharabhūpateḥ |
tārāvatyāṃ samutpannau bhavantau śaṅkarātmajau || 45 ||
meaning:
न युवां तनयौ तस्य चन्द्रशेखरभूपतेः |
तारावत्यां समुत्पन्नौ भवन्तौ शङ्करात्मजौ || 45 ||
text_mt: "You two are not the sons of that King Candraśekhara; / though born of Tārāvatī, you are the sons of Śaṅkara.

sanskrit_iast:
sadyau jātau mahāvīryau vetālatve ca sammatau |
bhṛṅgimahākālasaṃjñau śāpād dharaṇimāgatau || 46 ||
meaning:
सद्यौ जातौ महावीर्यौ वेतालत्वे च सम्मतौ |
भृङ्गिमहाकालसंज्ञौ शापाद् धरणिमागतौ || 46 ||
text_mt: Born as adults, of great valor, known as Vetālas, / named Bhṛṅgin and Mahākāla, you came to the earth because of a curse.

sanskrit_iast:
yuvayoratra tenaiva na dāyaṃ ditsati priyam |
gacchataṃ śaraṇaṃ tātaṃ śaṅkaraṃ vṛṣabhadhvajam || 47 ||
meaning:
युवयोरत्र तेनैव न दायं दित्सति प्रियम् |
गच्छतं शरणं तातं शङ्करं वृषभध्वजम् || 47 ||
text_mt: For that very reason he does not wish to give you your cherished inheritance here; / go for refuge to your father, Śaṅkara, who bears the bull on his banner.

sanskrit_iast:
sa eva yuvayoḥ sarvaṃ kariṣyati maheśvaraḥ |
kiṃ vātyugreṇa tapasā cirakālaphalena vai || 48 ||
meaning:
स एव युवयोः सर्वं करिष्यति महेश्वरः |
किं वात्युग्रेण तपसा चिरकालफलेन वै || 48 ||
text_mt: That Maheśvara himself will accomplish everything for you; / what need is there of exceedingly fierce penance whose fruit takes a long time?"

sanskrit_iast:
ityuktvā muniśārdūlaḥ apotaḥ paramātmadhṛk |
bhūtabhavyabhavajajñānantābhyāṃ sarvamathocivān || 49 ||
meaning:
इत्युक्त्वा मुनिशार्दूलः अपोतः परमात्मधृक् |
भूतभव्यभवजज्ञानन्ताभ्यां सर्वमथोचिवान् || 49 ||
text_mt: Having spoken thus, Kapota, that tiger among sages who possessed the supreme self, / knowing the past, future, and present, then told everything to the two:

sanskrit_iast:
yathā bhṛṅgimahākālau śaptāvavanimāgatau |
yathā haraśca gaurī ca pṛthivīmāgatau nṛpa || 50 ||
meaning:
यथा भृङ्गिमहाकालौ शप्ताववनिमागतौ |
यथा हरश्च गौरी च पृथिवीमागतौ नृप || 50 ||
text_mt: how Bhṛṅgin and Mahākāla, having been cursed, came to the earth; / how Hara and Gaurī came to the earth, O king;

sanskrit_iast:
tārāvatī yathā śaptā tenaiva muninā purā |
yathā tau ca samutpannau tārāvatyudare purā || 51 ||
meaning:
तारावती यथा शप्ता तेनैव मुनिना पुरा |
यथा तौ च समुत्पन्नौ तारावत्युदरे पुरा || 51 ||
text_mt: how Tārāvatī had formerly been cursed by that very sage; / how the two had formerly been born in Tārāvatī's womb;

sanskrit_iast:
yathā vā nāradenaiva saṃśayacchedanaṃ nṛpe |
tatsarvaṃ kathayāmāsa putrābhyāṃ giriśasya tu || 52 ||
meaning:
यथा वा नारदेनैव संशयच्छेदनं नृपे |
तत्सर्वं कथयामास पुत्राभ्यां गिरिशस्य तु || 52 ||
text_mt: and how Nārada resolved the doubt of the king. / He told all of that to the two sons of Giriśa.

sanskrit_iast:
tacchrutvā tau mahātmānau tadā vetālabhairavau |
mudā paramayā yuktau babhūvaturaninditau || 53 ||
meaning:
तच्छ्रुत्वा तौ महात्मानौ तदा वेतालभैरवौ |
मुदा परमया युक्तौ बभूवतुरनिन्दितौ || 53 ||
text_mt: Having heard that, those two great-souled ones, Vetāla and Bhairava, / blameless, were then filled with supreme joy.

sanskrit_iast:
modapūrṇau tadā bhūtvā siktvāviva sudhārasaiḥ |
punaḥ papraccha kapotaṃ vetālo bhairavo'pi ca || 54 ||
meaning:
मोदपूर्णौ तदा भूत्वा सिक्त्वाविव सुधारसैः |
पुनः पप्रच्छ कपोतं वेतालो भैरवोऽपि च || 54 ||
text_mt: Filled then with delight, as if sprinkled with the essence of nectar, / Vetāla and Bhairava asked Kapota again:

sanskrit_iast:
pitāvayormahādevastvayā satyamitīritam |
so'rcanīyo yathāvābhyāṃ siddhaye munisattama || 55 ||
meaning:
पितावयोर्महादेवस्त्वया सत्यमितीरितम् |
सोऽर्चनीयो यथावाभ्यां सिद्धये मुनिसत्तम || 55 ||
text_mt: "You have spoken the truth that Mahādeva is our father; / how he is to be worshiped by us for the sake of attainment, O best of sages,

sanskrit_iast:
āvābhyāṃ ca yathārādhyo yatra vārādhito haraḥ |
prasādameṣyatyacirāt tanno vada mahāmate || 56 ||
meaning:
आवाभ्यां च यथाराध्यो यत्र वाराधितो हरः |
प्रसादमेष्यत्यचिरात् तन्नो वद महामते || 56 ||
text_mt: and how Hara is to be propitiated by us, or where, having been propitiated, / he will soon become gracious—tell us that, O noble-minded one.

sanskrit_iast:
dhanyāvanugṛhitau nau yat tvayā munisattama |
vijñāpitamidaṃ sarvaṃ hṛcchalyaṃ coddhṛtaṃ ca nau || 57 ||
meaning:
धन्यावनुगृहितौ नौ यत् त्वया मुनिसत्तम |
विज्ञापितमिदं सर्वं हृच्छल्यं चोद्धृतं च नौ || 57 ||
text_mt: Fortunate and favored are we two, since by you, O best of sages, / all this has been made known and the dart in our hearts has been drawn out.

sanskrit_iast:
punarāvāṃ dayasva tvaṃ kṛpāmaya munīśvara |
prāpsyāvo na cirād bhargaṃ yathā vada tathaiva nau || 58 ||
meaning:
पुनरावां दयस्व त्वं कृपामय मुनीश्वर |
प्राप्स्यावो न चिराद् भर्गं यथा वद तथैव नौ || 58 ||
text_mt: Have compassion on us again, O compassionate lord of sages; / tell us how we two may attain Bharga without delay."

sanskrit_iast: muniruvāca
meaning: मुनिरुवाच

sanskrit_iast:
śṛṇu tvaṃ kathayāmyadya yatra cārādhito haraḥ |
nacirādeva bhavatorāyāsyati samakṣatām || 59 ||
meaning:
शृणु त्वं कथयाम्यद्य यत्र चाराधितो हरः |
नचिरादेव भवतोरायास्यति समक्षताम् || 59 ||
text_mt: "Listen, I shall tell you today where Hara, when propitiated, / will come into your presence without delay.

sanskrit_iast:
nityaṃ yatra mahādevo vasan bhavati tuṣṭaye |
yuvāṃ tat sampravakṣyāmi sthānaṃ guhyaṃ prakāśitam || 60 ||
meaning:
नित्यं यत्र महादेवो वसन् भवति तुष्टये |
युवां तत् सम्प्रवक्ष्यामि स्थानं गुह्यं प्रकाशितम् || 60 ||
text_mt: Where Mahādeva, dwelling continually, is well pleased, / that secret, revealed place I shall describe to you.

sanskrit_iast:
vārāṇasī nāma purī gaṅgātīre manohare |
araṇāyāstathā cāsermadhye cāpākṛtiḥ sadā || 61 ||
meaning:
वाराणसी नाम पुरी गङ्गातीरे मनोहरे |
अरणायास्तथा चासेर्मध्ये चापाकृतिः सदा || 61 ||
text_mt: There is a city named Vārāṇasī on the charming bank of the Gaṅgā, / situated between the Varaṇā and the Asī, ever shaped like a bow.

sanskrit_iast:
svayaṃ vṛṣadhvajastatra nityaṃ vasati yoginām |
sadā prītikaro yogī svayaṃ cāpyātmacintakaḥ || 62 ||
meaning:
स्वयं वृषध्वजस्तत्र नित्यं वसति योगिनाम् |
सदा प्रीतिकरो योगी स्वयं चाप्यात्मचिन्तकः || 62 ||
text_mt: He who bears the bull on his banner dwells there himself eternally, / always giving pleasure to yogins, himself a yogin contemplating the Self.

sanskrit_iast:
viyatsthā sā purī nityaṃ bhargayogabalād dhṛtā |
divyajñānaṃ dadātyeṣā tatra yo mriyate naraḥ || 63 ||
meaning:
वियत्स्था सा पुरी नित्यं भर्गयोगबलाद् धृता |
दिव्यज्ञानं ददात्येषा तत्र यो म्रियते नरः || 63 ||
text_mt: Resting in the sky, that city is held continually by the power of Bharga's yoga; / it grants divine knowledge to that man who dies there.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmai svayaṃ mahādevaḥ saṃsāra-granthimuktaye |
sa bhūtvā paramo yogī mṛtastatra bhavāntare || 64 ||
meaning:
तस्मै स्वयं महादेवः संसार-ग्रन्थिमुक्तये |
स भूत्वा परमो योगी मृतस्तत्र भवान्तरे || 64 ||
text_mt: To him Mahādeva himself [appears] for liberation from the knot of worldly existence; / having become a supreme yogin, he who has died there in another birth

sanskrit_iast:
sulabhenaiva nirvāṇamāpnoti harasammataḥ |
yogayukto mahādevaḥ pārvatyā sahitaḥ sadā || 65 ||
meaning:
सुलभेनैव निर्वाणमाप्नोति हरसम्मतः |
योगयुक्तो महादेवः पार्वत्या सहितः सदा || 65 ||
text_mt: attains nirvāṇa very easily, favored by Hara. / Mahādeva, joined with yoga, is there always together with Pārvatī.

sanskrit_iast:
devagandharvayakṣāṇāṃ mānuṣāṇāṃ ca nityaśaḥ |
jñeyo haraḥ prakāśaśca kṣetraṃ tacca prakāśitam || 66 ||
meaning:
देवगन्धर्वयक्षाणां मानुषाणां च नित्यशः |
ज्ञेयो हरः प्रकाशश्च क्षेत्रं तच्च प्रकाशितम् || 66 ||
text_mt: Hara is always to be known and manifest to gods, gandharvas, yakṣas, / and human beings, and that sacred field is celebrated.

sanskrit_iast:
na tatra kāmado devo nacirācca prasīdati |
ārādhitaściraṃ prītyā nirvāṇāya prasīdati || 67 ||
meaning:
न तत्र कामदो देवो नचिराच्च प्रसीदति |
आराधितश्चिरं प्रीत्या निर्वाणाय प्रसीदति || 67 ||
text_mt: There the god does not fulfill desires, nor is he quickly pleased; / propitiated for a long time with devotion, he is pleased to grant nirvāṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
gauryā vivajitā sā tu purī tatra na gacchati |
yogasthānaṃ mahākṣetraṃ kadācidapi śāṅkarī || 68 ||
meaning:
गौर्या विवजिता सा तु पुरी तत्र न गच्छति |
योगस्थानं महाक्षेत्रं कदाचिदपि शाङ्करी || 68 ||
text_mt: That city, however, is abandoned by Gaurī; Śāṅkarī never goes / to that place of yoga, that great sacred field.

sanskrit_iast:
āsannaṃ yuvayoḥ kṣetramidaṃ vārāṇasī tu yat |
kathitaṃ nātidūre ca vartate narasattamau || 69 ||
meaning:
आसन्नं युवयोः क्षेत्रमिदं वाराणसी तु यत् |
कथितं नातिदूरे च वर्तते नरसत्तमौ || 69 ||
text_mt: This sacred field which has been described as Vārāṇasī / is near to you two, and not very far away, O best of men.

sanskrit_iast:
aparaṃ tu pravakṣyāmi guhyaṃ pīṭhaṃ sadārcitam |
haragaurīsamāyuktaṃ paraṃ dharmārthakāmadam || 70 ||
meaning:
अपरं तु प्रवक्ष्यामि गुह्यं पीठं सदार्चितम् |
हरगौरीसमायुक्तं परं धर्मार्थकामदम् || 70 ||
text_mt: I shall tell of another secret pīṭha, ever worshiped, / joined with Hara and Gaurī, supreme, bestowing dharma, wealth, and desires.

sanskrit_iast:
tapasā cāti tīvreṇa cirād bhavati mokṣadam |
nacirāt kāmadaṃ puṇyaṃ kṣetraṃ pīṭhaṃ nigadyate || 71 ||
meaning:
तपसा चाति तीव्रेण चिराद् भवति मोक्षदम् |
नचिरात् कामदं पुण्यं क्षेत्रं पीठं निगद्यते || 71 ||
text_mt: And through exceedingly severe penance, it grants liberation after a long time; / granting desires without delay, that holy field is called a pīṭha.

sanskrit_iast:
cirāt tu kāmado devo na cirād yatra jñānadaḥ |
tatkṣetramiti lokeṣu gadyate pūrvavandibhiḥ || 72 ||
meaning:
चिरात् तु कामदो देवो न चिराद् यत्र ज्ञानदः |
तत्क्षेत्रमिति लोकेषु गद्यते पूर्ववन्दिभिः || 72 ||
text_mt: Where the god fulfills desires only after a long time, but grants knowledge without delay, / that is spoken of as a kṣetra in the worlds by the ancient praisers.

sanskrit_iast:
kāmarūpaṃ mahāpīṭhaṃ guhyād guhyatamaṃ param |
sadā sannihitastatra pārvatyā saha śaṅkaraḥ || 73 ||
meaning:
कामरूपं महापीठं गुह्याद् गुह्यतमं परम् |
सदा सन्निहितस्तत्र पार्वत्या सह शङ्करः || 73 ||
text_mt: The great pīṭha Kāmarūpa is the supreme secret of secrets; / there Śaṅkara is ever present together with Pārvatī.

sanskrit_iast:
na cirāt pūjito devastasmin pīṭhe prasīdati |
pārvatī cānugṛhṇāti bhargabhaktaṃ tu tatra vai || 74 ||
meaning:
न चिरात् पूजितो देवस्तस्मिन् पीठे प्रसीदति |
पार्वती चानुगृह्णाति भर्गभक्तं तु तत्र वै || 74 ||
text_mt: Worshiped in that pīṭha, the god is pleased without delay, / and Pārvatī indeed favors the devotee of Bharga there.

sanskrit_iast:
dadāti nacirāt kāmaṃ bhaktāya parameśvaraḥ |
tat tu pīṭhaṃ pravakṣyāmi śṛṇuta sāmprataṃ yuvām || 75 ||
meaning:
ददाति नचिरात् कामं भक्ताय परमेश्वरः |
तत् तु पीठं प्रवक्ष्यामि शृणुत साम्प्रतं युवाम् || 75 ||
text_mt: The supreme lord grants desires without delay to his devotee; / I shall now tell of that pīṭha, listen, you two.

sanskrit_iast:
karatoyā nadīpūrvaṃ yāvad dikkaravāsinīm |
triṃśadyojanavistīrṇaṃ yojanaikaśatāyatam || 76 ||
meaning:
करतोया नदीपूर्वं यावद् दिक्करवासिनीम् |
त्रिंशद्योजनविस्तीर्णं योजनैकशतायतम् || 76 ||
text_mt: From the Karatoyā river in the west as far as Dikkaravāsinī, / it is thirty yojanas wide and one hundred yojanas in length.

sanskrit_iast:
trikoṇaṃ kṛṣṇavarṇaṃ ca prabhūtācalapūritam |
nadīśatasamāyuktaṃ kāmarūpaṃ prakīrtitam || 77 ||
meaning:
त्रिकोणं कृष्णवर्णं च प्रभूताचलपूरितम् |
नदीशतसमायुक्तं कामरूपं प्रकीर्तितम् || 77 ||
text_mt: Triangular, dark in color, filled with abundant mountains, / and endowed with a hundred rivers—such is Kāmarūpa celebrated.

sanskrit_iast:
śambhunetrāgninirdagdhaḥ kāmaḥ śambhoranugrahāt |
tatra rūpaṃ yataḥ prāpa kāmarūpaṃ tato'bhavat || 78 ||
meaning:
शम्भुनेत्राग्निनिर्दग्धः कामः शम्भोरनुग्रहात् |
तत्र रूपं यतः प्राप कामरूपं ततोऽभवत् || 78 ||
text_mt: Because Kāma, burnt by the fire of Śambhu's eye, through Śambhu's grace / regained his form (rūpa) there, it therefore became Kāmarūpa.

sanskrit_iast:
tasya pīṭhasya vāyavyāṃ nair-ṛtyāṃ madhyabhāgataḥ |
aiśānyāṃ ca tathāgneyyāṃ madhye pārśve ca śaṅkaraḥ || 79 ||
meaning:
तस्य पीठस्य वायव्यां नैर्-ऋत्यां मध्यभागतः |
ऐशान्यां च तथाग्नेय्यां मध्ये पार्श्वे च शङ्करः || 79 ||
text_mt: In the northwest, in the southwest, in the central region of that pīṭha, / in the northeast, and in the southeast, in the center and on the sides, Śaṅkara,

sanskrit_iast:
svamāśramapadaṃ kṛtvā ṣaṭsu sthāneṣu śobhanam |
nityaṃ vasati tatrāpi pārvatyā saha narmabhiḥ || 80 ||
meaning:
स्वमाश्रमपदं कृत्वा षट्सु स्थानेषु शोभनम् |
नित्यं वसति तत्रापि पार्वत्या सह नर्मभिः || 80 ||
text_mt: having made his own splendid hermitage in six places, / dwells there continually, in playful dalliance with Pārvatī.

sanskrit_iast:
madhye devīgṛhaṃ tatra tadadhīnaṃ tu śaṅkaraḥ |
nīlākhye parvataśreṣṭhe pārvatī tatra tiṣṭhati || 81 ||
meaning:
मध्ये देवीगृहं तत्र तदधीनं तु शङ्करः |
नीलाख्ये पर्वतश्रेष्ठे पार्वती तत्र तिष्ठति || 81 ||
text_mt: In the center is the dwelling of the goddess, and Śaṅkara is subordinate to her; / on that foremost mountain named Nīla, Pārvatī abides.

sanskrit_iast:
aiśānyāṃ nāṭake śaile śaṅkarasya mahāśramaḥ |
nityaṃ vasati tatreśastadadhīnā ca pārvatī || 82 ||
meaning:
ऐशान्यां नाटके शैले शङ्करस्य महाश्रमः |
नित्यं वसति तत्रेशस्तदधीना च पार्वती || 82 ||
text_mt: In the northeast, on Mount Nāṭaka, is the great hermitage of Śaṅkara; / there the Lord dwells continually, and Pārvatī is subordinate to him.

sanskrit_iast:
apare cāśramāḥ santi haragauryoḥ sadātanāḥ |
naitayoḥ sadṛśaḥ ko'pi vidyate śaṅkarāśramaḥ || 83 ||
meaning:
अपरे चाश्रमाः सन्ति हरगौर्योः सदातनाः |
नैतयोः सदृशः कोऽपि विद्यते शङ्कराश्रमः || 83 ||
text_mt: And there are other eternal hermitages of Hara and Gaurī; / there exists no hermitage of Śaṅkara equal to these two.

sanskrit_iast:
atrārādhyo mahādevo bhavadbhayāṃ narasattamau |
tatsthānaṃ manasādāya prasādaya vṛṣadhvajam || 84 ||
meaning:
अत्राराध्यो महादेवो भवद्भयां नरसत्तमौ |
तत्स्थानं मनसादाय प्रसादय वृषध्वजम् || 84 ||
text_mt: Mahādeva is to be propitiated here by the two of you, O best of men; / directing your minds to that place, propitiate Vṛṣadhvaja.

sanskrit_iast: etālabhairavāvūcatuḥ
meaning: एतालभैरवावूचतुः
text_mt: Vetāla and Bhairava said:

sanskrit_iast:
kāmarūpaṃ gamiṣyāvau rahasyaṃ nāṭakācalam |
gaurīharau sthitau yatra nityaṃ sannihitau mune || 85 ||
meaning:
कामरूपं गमिष्यावौ रहस्यं नाटकाचलम् |
गौरीहरौ स्थितौ यत्र नित्यं सन्निहितौ मुने || 85 ||
text_mt: We shall go to Kāmarūpa, to the secret Nāṭaka mountain, / where Gaurī and Hara dwell, ever present, O sage.

sanskrit_iast:
ārādhanīyo bhūteśo hyavaśyamiha cāvayoḥ |
yathaivārādhayiṣyāvastathācakṣva dvijottama || 86 ||
meaning:
आराधनीयो भूतेशो ह्यवश्यमिह चावयोः |
यथैवाराधयिष्यावस्तथाचक्ष्व द्विजोत्तम || 86 ||
text_mt: The Lord of Beings must indeed be propitiated by the two of us here; / tell us, O best of the twice-born, how we should propitiate him.

sanskrit_iast:
yena mantreṇa vā devo nacirāt tu prasīdati |
tat tvaṃ vada mahābhāgānugraho'styāvayoryadi || 87 ||
meaning:
येन मन्त्रेण वा देवो नचिरात् तु प्रसीदति |
तत् त्वं वद महाभागानुग्रहोऽस्त्यावयोर्यदि || 87 ||
text_mt: Or by what mantra the god is pleased without delay; / tell us that, O fortunate one, if you have favor toward the two of us.

sanskrit_iast: ṛṣiruvāca
meaning: ऋषिरुवाच

sanskrit_iast:
nāṭakaṃ parvataśreṣṭhaṃ gacchataṃ narasattamau |
tatra nityaṃ mahādevī amate'parṇayā saha || 88 ||
meaning:
नाटकं पर्वतश्रेष्ठं गच्छतं नरसत्तमौ |
तत्र नित्यं महादेवी अमतेऽपर्णया सह || 88 ||
text_mt: Go to the excellent Nāṭaka mountain, O best of men; / there the great god ever delights together with Aparṇā.

sanskrit_iast:
sandhyācale tatra munirārādhayati śaṅkaram |
vaśiṣṭho brahmaṇaḥ putrastaṃ yuvāmanugacchatam || 89 ||
meaning:
सन्ध्याचले तत्र मुनिराराधयति शङ्करम् |
वशिष्ठो ब्रह्मणः पुत्रस्तं युवामनुगच्छतम् || 89 ||
text_mt: On Sandhyācala there, a sage propitiates Śaṅkara, / Vasiṣṭha, the son of Brahmā; go to him, the two of you.

sanskrit_iast:
sa ca mantraṃ satantraṃ ca harārādhanakarmaṇi |
jñāpayiṣyati vāṃ pṛṣṭaḥ kila vetālabhairavau || 90 ||
meaning:
स च मन्त्रं सतन्त्रं च हराराधनकर्मणि |
ज्ञापयिष्यति वां पृष्टः किल वेतालभैरवौ || 90 ||
text_mt: And he, when questioned, will instruct you in the mantra and the tantra / in the rite of propitiating Hara, O Vetāla and Bhairava.

sanskrit_iast:
tapase gantumicchāmi nedānīṃ kālayāpanā |
yujyate mama tasmānmāṃ tyajataṃ vīrasattamau || 91 ||
meaning:
तपसे गन्तुमिच्छामि नेदानीं कालयापना |
युज्यते मम तस्मान्मां त्यजतं वीरसत्तमौ || 91 ||
text_mt: I wish to go for austerity; now it is not fitting / for me to waste time; therefore release me, O best of heroes.

sanskrit_iast:
evamuktvā muniśreṣṭhaḥ apotaḥ prayayau vanam |
tau taṃ muniṃ namaskṛtya jagmaturbhavanaṃ nijam || 92 ||
meaning:
एवमुक्त्वा मुनिश्रेष्ठः अपोतः प्रययौ वनम् |
तौ तं मुनिं नमस्कृत्य जग्मतुर्भवनं निजम् || 92 ||
text_mt: Having spoken thus, the best of sages, Kapota, went to the forest; / having bowed to that sage, the two went to their own abode.

sanskrit_iast:
atha tau samayaṃ kṛtvā dīkṣitau tapase tadā |
pitarāvapyanujñāpya bhrātṛnanyāṃśca bāndhavān |
prasthānaṃ kāmarūpāya cakratustau mahāmatī || 93 ||
meaning:
अथ तौ समयं कृत्वा दीक्षितौ तपसे तदा |
पितरावप्यनुज्ञाप्य भ्रातृनन्यांश्च बान्धवान् |
प्रस्थानं कामरूपाय चक्रतुस्तौ महामती || 93 ||
text_mt: Then the two, having made an agreement, consecrated then for austerity, / having also taken leave of their parents, their brothers, and their other relatives, / set out for Kāmarūpa, those two highly intelligent ones.

sanskrit_iast:
tau gacchantau parijñāya śaṅkaro'pi sahomayā |
devān sarvānuvācedaṃ sāntvayanniva sendrakān || 94 ||
meaning:
तौ गच्छन्तौ परिज्ञाय शङ्करोऽपि सहोमया |
देवान् सर्वानुवाचेदं सान्त्वयन्निव सेन्द्रकान् || 94 ||
text_mt: Perceiving that the two were departing, Śaṅkara too, together with Umā, / spoke this to all the gods, as if consoling those with Indra at their head:

sanskrit_iast: īśvara uvāca
meaning: ईश्वर उवाच

sanskrit_iast:
putrau me tapase yātaḥ sāmprataṃ surasattamāḥ |
mamārādhanacittau tu tau dayadhvaṃ sureśvarāḥ || 95 ||
meaning:
पुत्रौ मे तपसे यातः साम्प्रतं सुरसत्तमाः |
ममाराधनचित्तौ तु तौ दयध्वं सुरेश्वराः || 95 ||
text_mt: My two sons have now gone for austerity, O best of gods; / their minds intent on propitiating me, have compassion on them, O lords of gods.

sanskrit_iast:
saṃskṛtya tapasā catau putrau vetālabhairavau |
gāṇapatye niyokṣyāmi tau saṃskurvantu nirjarāḥ || 96 ||
meaning:
संस्कृत्य तपसा चतौ पुत्रौ वेतालभैरवौ |
गाणपत्ये नियोक्ष्यामि तौ संस्कुर्वन्तु निर्जराः || 96 ||
text_mt: And having purified these two sons, Vetāla and Bhairava, with austerity, / I shall appoint them to the status of Gaṇa-lords; let the immortals purify them.

sanskrit_iast:
anenaiva śarīreṇa tau gaṇeśatvamāpsyataḥ |
tapasā tu tayoḥ kāyau bhāvaṃ tyaktvā tu mānuṣam || 97 ||
meaning:
अनेनैव शरीरेण तौ गणेशत्वमाप्स्यतः |
तपसा तु तयोः कायौ भावं त्यक्त्वा तु मानुषम् || 97 ||
text_mt: With this very body the two shall attain the state of lords of the Gaṇas; / but through austerity their two bodies, having abandoned their human state,

sanskrit_iast:
yathāpnutaḥ saurabhāvaṃ vidhāsyāmi hyahaṃ tathā |
ityuktvā vāmadevo'pi pārvatyā saha putrakau |
gacchantau viyatā snehāt paścādanuyayau śivaḥ || 98 ||
meaning:
यथाप्नुतः सौरभावं विधास्यामि ह्यहं तथा |
इत्युक्त्वा वामदेवोऽपि पार्वत्या सह पुत्रकौ |
गच्छन्तौ वियता स्नेहात् पश्चादनुययौ शिवः || 98 ||
text_mt: shall attain the divine state; I shall indeed bring that about. / Having spoken thus, Vāmadeva too, Śiva, together with Pārvatī, / out of affection followed behind his two sons as they went through the sky,

sanskrit_iast: śakrādyāstridaśāḥ sarve dikpālāśca tathāpare || 99 ||
meaning: शक्राद्यास्त्रिदशाः सर्वे दिक्पालाश्च तथापरे || 99 ||
text_mt: and all the thirty [gods] beginning with Śakra, and likewise the other guardians of the directions.

sanskrit_iast:
sarve haraṃ cānujagmuranugacchantamātmajau |
atha tau tu nadīṃ prāpya kṛṣṇājinadharau tadā || 100 ||
meaning:
सर्वे हरं चानुजग्मुरनुगच्छन्तमात्मजौ |
अथ तौ तु नदीं प्राप्य कृष्णाजिनधरौ तदा || 100 ||
text_mt: They all followed Hara as he followed his two sons. / Then the two, having reached a river, wearing black antelopeskins then,

sanskrit_iast:
adāya tāpasaṃ bhāvaṃ gaṅgātulyāṃ dṛṣadvatīm |
tapasvinau tu devena tryambakeṇātha pālitau || 101 ||
meaning:
अदाय तापसं भावं गङ्गातुल्यां दृषद्वतीम् |
तपस्विनौ तु देवेन त्र्यम्बकेणाथ पालितौ || 101 ||
text_mt: assuming the state of ascetics at the Dṛṣadvatī equal to the Gaṅgā, / the two ascetics were then protected by the god Tryambaka.

sanskrit_iast:
devaiḥ saha tadāyātau kāmarūpāhvayāśramam |
āsādya kāmarūpaṃ tu karatoyānadījale || 102 ||
meaning:
देवैः सह तदायातौ कामरूपाह्वयाश्रमम् |
आसाद्य कामरूपं तु करतोयानदीजले || 102 ||
text_mt: Together with the gods, he then arrived at the hermitage called Kāmarūpa. / And having reached Kāmarūpa, in the waters of the Karatoyā river,

sanskrit_iast:
upaspṛśya tatastau tu nandikuṇḍaṃ nṛpottama |
tatra snātvāpyupaspṛśya nadīṃ gatvā jaṭodbhavām || 103 ||
meaning:
उपस्पृश्य ततस्तौ तु नन्दिकुण्डं नृपोत्तम |
तत्र स्नात्वाप्युपस्पृश्य नदीं गत्वा जटोद्भवाम् || 103 ||
text_mt: having sipped water, then the two, O best of kings, [went to] Nandikuṇḍa; / having bathed there and sipped water, having gone to the river born of [Śiva's] matted hair,

sanskrit_iast:
paspṛśya ca tau tatra nandinaṃ tapasā dhṛtam |
praṇamya jalpiśaṃ devaṃ jagmaturnāṭakācalam || 104 ||
meaning:
पस्पृश्य च तौ तत्र नन्दिनं तपसा धृतम् |
प्रणम्य जल्पिशं देवं जग्मतुर्नाटकाचलम् || 104 ||
text_mt: and having touched Nandin there, who was sustained by austerity, / having bowed to the god Jalpiśa, they went to the Nāṭaka mountain.

sanskrit_iast:
nāṭakācalamāsādya praṇamya vṛṣabhadhvajam |
ārādhanopadeśāya kapotakavacaḥsmarau || 105 ||
meaning:
नाटकाचलमासाद्य प्रणम्य वृषभध्वजम् |
आराधनोपदेशाय कपोतकवचःस्मरौ || 105 ||
text_mt: Having reached the Nāṭaka mountain, having bowed to Vṛṣabhadhvaja, / remembering the words of Kapotaka for instruction in propitiation,

sanskrit_iast:
jagmaturdakṣiṇāṃ kāṣṭhāṃ yatra sandhyācalaḥ sthitaḥ |
kāntā nāma nadī tatra vaśiṣṭhenāvatāritā || 106 ||
meaning:
जग्मतुर्दक्षिणां काष्ठां यत्र सन्ध्याचलः स्थितः |
कान्ता नाम नदी तत्र वशिष्ठेनावतारिता || 106 ||
text_mt: the two went to the southern quarter, where Sandhyācala stands. / There a river named Kāntā was brought down by Vasiṣṭha.

sanskrit_iast:
tasyāstīre mahāśailaḥ snigdhacchāyalatātaruḥ |
sandhyāṃ vaśiṣṭhaḥ kṛtavāṃstatra yasmād vidheḥ sutaḥ || 107 ||
meaning:
तस्यास्तीरे महाशैलः स्निग्धच्छायलतातरुः |
सन्ध्यां वशिष्ठः कृतवांस्तत्र यस्माद् विधेः सुतः || 107 ||
text_mt: On its bank is a great mountain with trees and creepers of soft shade; / because Vasiṣṭha, the son of Vidhi, performed his twilight worship there,

sanskrit_iast:
ataḥ sandhyācalaṃ nāma tasya gāyanti devatāḥ |
tatrāsādya vaśiṣṭhaṃ tu sākṣādiva hutāśanam || 108 ||
meaning:
अतः सन्ध्याचलं नाम तस्य गायन्ति देवताः |
तत्रासाद्य वशिष्ठं तु साक्षादिव हुताशनम् || 108 ||
text_mt: therefore the gods sing its name as Sandhyācala. / Having approached Vasiṣṭha there, who was like the sacrificial fire in visible form,

sanskrit_iast:
ārādhayantaṃ giriśaṃ dhyānasaṃyuktamānasam |
tapaḥśriyā dīpyamānaṃ dvitīyamiva bhāskaram || 109 ||
meaning:
आराधयन्तं गिरिशं ध्यानसंयुक्तमानसम् |
तपःश्रिया दीप्यमानं द्वितीयमिव भास्करम् || 109 ||
text_mt: propitiating Giriśa, his mind absorbed in meditation, / blazing with the splendor of austerity like a second sun,

sanskrit_iast:
praṇamya puratastasya tadā vetālabhairavau |
prāñjalī tasthaturbhūpa vinayānatakandharau || 110 ||
meaning:
प्रणम्य पुरतस्तस्य तदा वेतालभैरवौ |
प्राञ्जली तस्थतुर्भूप विनयानतकन्धरौ || 110 ||
text_mt: having bowed before him, then Vetāla and Bhairava / stood with folded hands, O king, their necks bent in humility.

sanskrit_iast:
idaṃ cāpyūcatustau tu praṇamantau vidheḥ sutam |
tārāvatyāṃ samutpannau candraśekharabhūbhṛtaḥ || 111 ||
meaning:
इदं चाप्यूचतुस्तौ तु प्रणमन्तौ विधेः सुतम् |
तारावत्यां समुत्पन्नौ चन्द्रशेखरभूभृतः || 111 ||
text_mt: And bowing to the son of Vidhi, the two spoke this: / Born of Tārāvatī in the field of King Candraśekhara,

sanskrit_iast:
kṣetre bhargasya tanayāvāvāṃ jānīhi mānuṣau |
ārādhayitumicchāvo haraṃ kāryasya siddhaye || 112 ||
meaning:
क्षेत्रे भर्गस्य तनयावावां जानीहि मानुषौ |
आराधयितुमिच्छावो हरं कार्यस्य सिद्धये || 112 ||
text_mt: know us to be the sons of Bharga in human form. / We wish to propitiate Hara for the accomplishment of our purpose,

sanskrit_iast:
vāñchitasya yadi tvaṃ nāvanugṛhṇāsi suvrata |
tayostad vacanaṃ śrutvā vaśiṣṭho munisattamaḥ || 113 ||
meaning:
वाञ्छितस्य यदि त्वं नावनुगृह्णासि सुव्रत |
तयोस्तद् वचनं श्रुत्वा वशिष्ठो मुनिसत्तमः || 113 ||
text_mt: if you, O one of good vows, will show grace to the two of us in what is desired. / Hearing those words of the two, Vasiṣṭha, the best of sages,

sanskrit_iast:
uvāceti yuvāṃ jñātau mayā satyaṃ harātmajau |
harasyārādhanaṃ āryaṃ yuvayornarasattamau || 114 ||
meaning:
उवाचेति युवां ज्ञातौ मया सत्यं हरात्मजौ |
हरस्याराधनं आर्यं युवयोर्नरसत्तमौ || 114 ||
text_mt: spoke thus: Truly, you two are known by me as the sons of Hara; / the propitiation of Hara is noble for the two of you, O best of men.

sanskrit_iast:
tatrāsti mama kṛtyaṃ kiṃ tadbhāṣatamaninditau |
vṛṣadhvajārādhanāya yuvayostu prayojanam |
vidyate tannimittaṃ yat tat siddhamiti cintyatām || 115 ||
meaning:
तत्रास्ति मम कृत्यं किं तद्भाषतमनिन्दितौ |
वृषध्वजाराधनाय युवयोस्तु प्रयोजनम् |
विद्यते तन्निमित्तं यत् तत् सिद्धमिति चिन्त्यताम् || 115 ||
text_mt: What is my task in that? Speak, O blameless ones! / The purpose that exists for the two of you to propitiate Vṛṣadhvaja, / that object for which it exists, consider it accomplished.

sanskrit_iast: vetālabhairavāvūcatuḥ
meaning: वेतालभैरवावूचतुः
text_mt: Vetāla and Bhairava said:

sanskrit_iast:
yena mantreṇa nacirāt samyagārādhito haraḥ |
prasādameṣyatyavanau tanno vada mahāmune || 116 ||
meaning:
येन मन्त्रेण नचिरात् सम्यगाराधितो हरः |
प्रसादमेष्यत्यवनौ तन्नो वद महामुने || 116 ||
text_mt: By what mantra Hara, properly propitiated, / will without delay grant favor on earth, tell us that, O great sage.

sanskrit_iast:
yathā cārādhayiṣyāvastantraṃ yad yādṛśaḥ kramaḥ |
tatsarvaṃ muniśārdūla vaktumarhasi cottaram || 117 ||
meaning:
यथा चाराधयिष्यावस्तन्त्रं यद् यादृशः क्रमः |
तत्सर्वं मुनिशार्दूल वक्तुमर्हसि चोत्तरम् || 117 ||
text_mt: And how we should propitiate him, what the tantra is, what kind the procedure is, / all that, O tiger among sages, you ought to speak as the reply.

sanskrit_iast:
yathā tvadupadeśena prāpsyāvo nacirād haram |
athā ācāṃ muniśreṣṭha hyanuśādhi natau tvayi || 118 ||
meaning:
यथा त्वदुपदेशेन प्राप्स्यावो नचिराद् हरम् |
अथा आचां मुनिश्रेष्ठ ह्यनुशाधि नतौ त्वयि || 118 ||
text_mt: So that by your instruction we two may without delay attain Hara, / instruct us, O best of sages, as we bow before you.

sanskrit_iast: vasiṣṭha uvāca
meaning: वसिष्ठ उवाच

sanskrit_iast:
prasanna eva bhavatorvṛṣaketuḥ sahomayā |
nacirāt svayamevātra prasādaṃ ca sameṣyati || 119 ||
meaning:
प्रसन्न एव भवतोर्वृषकेतुः सहोमया |
नचिरात् स्वयमेवात्र प्रसादं च समेष्यति || 119 ||
text_mt: Vṛṣaketu, together with Umā, is indeed pleased with you two; / without delay he will himself come here to show favor.

sanskrit_iast:
sarvairdevagaṇaiḥ sārdhaṃ sabhāryo vṛṣabhadhvajaḥ |
ākāśamārgeṇāyātaḥ ālayan svasutau gṛhāt || 120 ||
meaning:
सर्वैर्देवगणैः सार्धं सभार्यो वृषभध्वजः |
आकाशमार्गेणायातः आलयन् स्वसुतौ गृहात् || 120 ||
text_mt: Together with all the hosts of gods, accompanied by his wife, Vṛṣabhadhvaja / has come by the path of the sky, watching his two sons from their home.

sanskrit_iast:
kintu mānuṣadehau vāmadhivāsya tapovrataiḥ |
svayanneṣyati kailāsaṃ gāṇapatye niyojya vām || 121 ||
meaning:
किन्तु मानुषदेहौ वामधिवास्य तपोव्रतैः |
स्वयन्नेष्यति कैलासं गाणपत्ये नियोज्य वाम् || 121 ||
text_mt: Having seasoned your human bodies with the vows of austerity, / he will himself lead you to Kailāsa, having appointed you to the status of Gaṇa-lords.

sanskrit_iast:
ahaṃ cāpyupadekṣyāmi yathā bhargaṃ yuvāṃ drutam |
prāpsyathaḥ pārvatīputravekāgraṃ śṛṇutaṃ tu tat || 122 ||
meaning:
अहं चाप्युपदेक्ष्यामि यथा भर्गं युवां द्रुतम् |
प्राप्स्यथः पार्वतीपुत्रवेकाग्रं शृणुतं तु तत् || 122 ||
text_mt: And I shall also instruct you how you two may swiftly / attain Bharga, O sons of Pārvatī; listen to that with one-pointed attention.

sanskrit_iast:
cirāt prasīdati dhyānānnacirād dhyānapūjanāt |
tasmād dhyānaṃ pūjanaṃ ca kathayāmyadya tattvataḥ || 123 ||
meaning:
चिरात् प्रसीदति ध्यानान्नचिराद् ध्यानपूजनात् |
तस्माद् ध्यानं पूजनं च कथयाम्यद्य तत्त्वतः || 123 ||
text_mt: He is pleased after a long time by meditation, but without delay by meditation and worship; / therefore I shall declare meditation and worship today in its true nature.

sanskrit_iast:
tejomayaḥ sadā śuddho jñānāmṛtavivardhitaḥ |
jaganmayaścidānandaḥ śauribrahmasvarūpadhṛk || 124 ||
meaning:
तेजोमयः सदा शुद्धो ज्ञानामृतविवर्धितः |
जगन्मयश्चिदानन्दः शौरिब्रह्मस्वरूपधृक् || 124 ||
text_mt: He consists of fiery energy, ever pure, increased by the nectar of knowledge, / composed of the universe, consciousness and bliss, bearing the essential nature of Śauri and Brahmā,

sanskrit_iast:
mahādevo mahāmūrtirmahāyogayutaḥ sadā |
jaganti tasya rūpāṇi tāni ko gadituṃ kṣamaḥ || 125 ||
meaning:
महादेवो महामूर्तिर्महायोगयुतः सदा |
जगन्ति तस्य रूपाणि तानि को गदितुं क्षमः || 125 ||
text_mt: Mahādeva, of great form, ever united with supreme yoga; / the worlds are his forms—who is able to describe them?

sanskrit_iast:
kintu yairiha rūpaistu iharatyeṣa śaṅkaraḥ |
teṣāṃ yanme jñānagamyaṃ tatreṣṭaṃ nigadāmi vām || 126 ||
meaning:
किन्तु यैरिह रूपैस्तु इहरत्येष शङ्करः |
तेषां यन्मे ज्ञानगम्यं तत्रेष्टं निगदामि वाम् || 126 ||
text_mt: However, of those forms by which Śaṅkara abides here, / I shall tell you both what is accessible to my knowledge, that which is desired there.

sanskrit_iast:
prathamaṃ śṛṇutaṃ mantraṃ tato'nudhyānagocaram |
tataḥ kramaṃ tu pūjāyāḥ kramād vṛttaṃ nararṣabhau || 127 ||
meaning:
प्रथमं शृणुतं मन्त्रं ततोऽनुध्यानगोचरम् |
ततः क्रमं तु पूजायाः क्रमाद् वृत्तं नरर्षभौ || 127 ||
text_mt: First listen to the mantra, then to what is the object of meditation, / and then the sequence of worship, the procedure in due order, O best of men.

sanskrit_iast:
samastānāṃ svarāṇāṃ tu dīrghāḥ śeṣāḥ sabindukāḥ |
ṛḷśūnyāḥ sārdhacandrā upāntenābhisaṃhitāḥ || 128 ||
meaning:
समस्तानां स्वराणां तु दीर्घाः शेषाः सबिन्दुकाः |
ऋऌशून्याः सार्धचन्द्रा उपान्तेनाभिसंहिताः || 128 ||
text_mt: Of all the vowels, the long ones, the remaining ones with the bindu, / devoid of ṛ and ḷ, with the half-moon, combined with the penultimate [consonant],

sanskrit_iast:
ebhiḥ pañcākṣarairmantraṃ pañcavaktrasya kīrtitam |
kramāt sammadasandoha-nādagaurava-saṃjñakāḥ || 129 ||
meaning:
एभिः पञ्चाक्षरैर्मन्त्रं पञ्चवक्त्रस्य कीर्तितम् |
क्रमात् सम्मदसन्दोह-नादगौरव-संज्ञकाः || 129 ||
text_mt: with these five syllables, the mantra of the five-faced [god] is proclaimed. / In order, they are called Sammada, Sandoha, Nāda, Gaurava,

sanskrit_iast:
prāsādastu bhaveccheṣaḥ pañcamantrāḥ prakīrtitāḥ |
ekaikena tathaikaikaṃ vaktraṃ devaṃ prapūjayet || 130 ||
meaning:
प्रासादस्तु भवेच्छेषः पञ्चमन्त्राः प्रकीर्तिताः |
एकैकेन तथैकैकं वक्त्रं देवं प्रपूजयेत् || 130 ||
text_mt: and the last is Prāsāda; these five mantras are proclaimed. / With each one, he should worship each single face of the god.

sanskrit_iast:
ekaṃ samuditaṃ kṛtvā pañcabhirvā prapūjayet |
prasādenātha vā pañcavaktraṃ devaṃ prapūjayet || 131 ||
meaning:
एकं समुदितं कृत्वा पञ्चभिर्वा प्रपूजयेत् |
प्रसादेनाथ वा पञ्चवक्त्रं देवं प्रपूजयेत् || 131 ||
text_mt: Or having brought them together as one, he may worship with the five; / or with Prāsāda he may worship the five-faced god.

sanskrit_iast:
sammadādiṣu mantreṣu prāsādastu praśasyate |
śambhoḥ prasādanenaiṣa yasmād vṛttastu mantrakaḥ || 132 ||
meaning:
सम्मदादिषु मन्त्रेषु प्रासादस्तु प्रशस्यते |
शम्भोः प्रसादनेनैष यस्माद् वृत्तस्तु मन्त्रकः || 132 ||
text_mt: Among the mantras beginning with Sammada, Prāsāda is praised the most, / because this mantra arose from the propitiation of Śambhu.

sanskrit_iast:
tena prāsādasaṃjño'yaṃ kathyate munisattamaiḥ |
tasmāt sarveṣu mantreṣu prāsādaḥ prītidaḥ paraḥ || 133 ||
meaning:
तेन प्रासादसंज्ञोऽयं कथ्यते मुनिसत्तमैः |
तस्मात् सर्वेषु मन्त्रेषु प्रासादः प्रीतिदः परः || 133 ||
text_mt: Therefore, it is called Prāsāda by the best of sages; / hence, among all mantras, Prāsāda is supreme in granting delight.

sanskrit_iast:
āmodakārakaḥ śambhormantraḥ sammada ucyate |
manaḥprapūraṇāccāpi sandohaḥ parikīrtitaḥ || 134 ||
meaning:
आमोदकारकः शम्भोर्मन्त्रः सम्मद उच्यते |
मनःप्रपूरणाच्चापि सन्दोहः परिकीर्तितः || 134 ||
text_mt: The mantra of Śambhu that causes delight is called Sammada, / and it is proclaimed as Sandoha because it fulfills the mind.

sanskrit_iast:
ākarṣako bhavennādo gurutvād gauravāhvayaḥ |
etadvyastaṃ samastaṃ ca mantraṃ śambhoḥ prakīrtitam || 135 ||
meaning:
आकर्षको भवेन्नादो गुरुत्वाद् गौरवाह्वयः |
एतद्व्यस्तं समस्तं च मन्त्रं शम्भोः प्रकीर्तितम् || 135 ||
text_mt: Nāda is attractive, and by its weightiness it is named Gaurava. / This mantra of Śambhu is proclaimed as separate and as united.

sanskrit_iast:
pañcākṣaraṃ tu yanmantraṃ pañcavaktrasya kīrtitam |
yuvāṃ tenaiva mantreṇa ārādhayatamīśvaram || 136 ||
meaning:
पञ्चाक्षरं तु यन्मन्त्रं पञ्चवक्त्रस्य कीर्तितम् |
युवां तेनैव मन्त्रेण आराधयतमीश्वरम् || 136 ||
text_mt: That which is proclaimed as the five-syllable mantra of the five-faced [god], / with that very mantra you two should worship Īśvara.

sanskrit_iast:
dhyānaṃ vakṣyāmi sṛṇutaṃ samyag vetālabhairavau |
pañcavaktraṃ mahākāyaṃ jaṭājūṭavibhūṣitam || 137 ||
meaning:
ध्यानं वक्ष्यामि सृणुतं सम्यग् वेतालभैरवौ |
पञ्चवक्त्रं महाकायं जटाजूटविभूषितम् || 137 ||
text_mt: I will tell you the meditation; listen well, O Vetāla and Bhairava: / five-faced, of huge body, adorned with matted locks,

sanskrit_iast:
cārucandrakalāyuktaṃ mūrdhni bālaughabhūṣitam |
bāhubhirdaśabhiryuktaṃ vyāghracarmāmarāmbaram || 138 ||
meaning:
चारुचन्द्रकलायुक्तं मूर्ध्नि बालौघभूषितम् |
बाहुभिर्दशभिर्युक्तं व्याघ्रचर्मामराम्बरम् || 138 ||
text_mt: bearing the lovely crescent moon, adorned on the head with the flood of young [streams of Gaṅgā], / endowed with ten arms, clothed in the divine garment of tiger skin,

sanskrit_iast:
kālakūṭadharaṃ kaṇṭhe nāgahāropaśobhitam |
kirīṭabandhanaṃ bāhubhūṣaṇaṃ ca bhujaṅgamān || 139 ||
meaning:
कालकूटधरं कण्ठे नागहारोपशोभितम् |
किरीटबन्धनं बाहुभूषणं च भुजङ्गमान् || 139 ||
text_mt: bearing the kālakūṭa poison in his throat, adorned with a necklace of serpents, / wearing serpents as his crown-binding and armlets,

sanskrit_iast:
bibhrataṃ sarvagātreṣu jyotsnārpitasurociṣam |
bhūtisaṃliptasarvāṅgamekaikatra tribhistribhiḥ || 140 ||
meaning:
बिभ्रतं सर्वगात्रेषु ज्योत्स्नार्पितसुरोचिषम् |
भूतिसंलिप्तसर्वाङ्गमेकैकत्र त्रिभिस्त्रिभिः || 140 ||
text_mt: bearing on all his limbs a beautiful radiance bestowed by moonlight, / his entire body smeared with ashes, having three eyes on each face,

sanskrit_iast:
netraistu pañcadaśabhirjyortiṣmadbhirvirājitam |
vṛṣabhopari saṃsthaṃ tu gajakṛttiparicchadam || 141 ||
meaning:
नेत्रैस्तु पञ्चदशभिर्ज्योर्तिष्मद्भिर्विराजितम् |
वृषभोपरि संस्थं तु गजकृत्तिपरिच्छदम् || 141 ||
text_mt: shining with fifteen luminous eyes, / mounted upon a bull, covered with an elephant-skin garment,

sanskrit_iast:
sadyojātaṃ vāmadevamaghoraṃ ca tataḥ param |
tatpuruṣaṃ tatheśānaṃ pañcavaktraṃ prakīrtitam || 142 ||
meaning:
सद्योजातं वामदेवमघोरं च ततः परम् |
तत्पुरुषं तथेशानं पञ्चवक्त्रं प्रकीर्तितम् || 142 ||
text_mt: Sadyojāta, Vāmadeva, and beyond that Aghora, / Tatpuruṣa, and likewise Īśāna: thus the five faces are proclaimed.

sanskrit_iast:
sadyojātaṃ bhavecchuklaṃ śuddhasphaṭikasaṃnibham |
pītavarṇaṃ tathā saumyaṃ vāmadevaṃ manoharam || 143 ||
meaning:
सद्योजातं भवेच्छुक्लं शुद्धस्फटिकसंनिभम् |
पीतवर्णं तथा सौम्यं वामदेवं मनोहरम् || 143 ||
text_mt: Sadyojāta should be white, resembling pure crystal; / Vāmadeva is yellow, gentle, and enchanting;

sanskrit_iast:
nīlavarṇamaghoraṃ tu daṃṣṭvā bhītivivardhanam |
raktaṃ tatpuruṣaṃ devaṃ divyamūrti manoharam || 144 ||
meaning:
नीलवर्णमघोरं तु दंष्ट्वा भीतिविवर्धनम् |
रक्तं तत्पुरुषं देवं दिव्यमूर्ति मनोहरम् || 144 ||
text_mt: Aghora is blue in color, increasing fear with its fangs; / the divine Tatpuruṣa is red, of celestial form and enchanting;

sanskrit_iast:
śyāmalaṃ ca tatheśānaṃ sarvadaiva śivātmakam |
cintayet paścime tvādyaṃ dvitīyaṃ tu tathottare || 145 ||
meaning:
श्यामलं च तथेशानं सर्वदैव शिवात्मकम् |
चिन्तयेत् पश्चिमे त्वाद्यं द्वितीयं तु तथोत्तरे || 145 ||
text_mt: and Īśāna is dark, always of the nature of Śiva. / One should meditate on the first in the west, and on the second in the north,

sanskrit_iast:
aghoraṃ dakṣiṇe devaṃ pūrve tatpuruṣaṃ tathā |
īśānaṃ madhyato jñeyaṃ cintayed bhaktitatparaḥ || 146 ||
meaning:
अघोरं दक्षिणे देवं पूर्वे तत्पुरुषं तथा |
ईशानं मध्यतो ज्ञेयं चिन्तयेद् भक्तितत्परः || 146 ||
text_mt: on the god Aghora in the south, and likewise Tatpuruṣa in the east; / Īśāna is to be known in the center: one devoted to bhakti should meditate [thus].

sanskrit_iast:
śaktitriśūlakhaṭvāṅgavaradābhayadaṃ śivam |
dakṣiṇeṣvatha hasteṣu vāmeṣvapi tataḥ subham || 147 ||
meaning:
शक्तित्रिशूलखट्वाङ्गवरदाभयदं शिवम् |
दक्षिणेष्वथ हस्तेषु वामेष्वपि ततः सुभम् || 147 ||
text_mt: [Meditating on] Śiva granting boons and fearlessness, holding the spear, trident, and skull-topped staff, / in his right hands, and then, in the auspicious left ones,

sanskrit_iast:
akṣasūtraṃ bījapūraṃ bhujagaṃ ḍamarūtpalam |
aṣṭaiśvaryasamāyuktaṃ dhyāyet tu hṛdgataṃ śivam || 148 ||
meaning:
अक्षसूत्रं बीजपूरं भुजगं डमरूत्पलम् |
अष्टैश्वर्यसमायुक्तं ध्यायेत् तु हृद्गतं शिवम् || 148 ||
text_mt: a rosary, a citron, a serpent, a ḍamaru, and a lotus; / endowed with the eight powers, one should meditate on Śiva situated in the heart.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ vicintayed dhyāne mahādevaṃ jagatpatim |
cintayitvā dvārapālān gaṇeśādīn prapūjayet || 149 ||
meaning:
एवं विचिन्तयेद् ध्याने महादेवं जगत्पतिम् |
चिन्तयित्वा द्वारपालान् गणेशादीन् प्रपूजयेत् || 149 ||
text_mt: Thus one should contemplate in meditation Mahādeva, the lord of the universe. / Having contemplated, one should worship the door-keepers, Gaṇeśa and the others.

sanskrit_iast:
viśuddhiṃ pañcabhūtānāṃ cintayitvā tato muhuḥ |
aṣṭamūrtīstataḥ paścāt pūjayedaṣṭanāmabhiḥ || 150 ||
meaning:
विशुद्धिं पञ्चभूतानां चिन्तयित्वा ततो मुहुः |
अष्टमूर्तीस्ततः पश्चात् पूजयेदष्टनामभिः || 150 ||
text_mt: Then, having repeatedly meditated on the purification of the five elements, / one should worship thereafter the eight forms with their eight names.

sanskrit_iast:
āsanāni ca tasyātha pūjayet sakalāni tu |
bhāvādīnyaṣṭapuṣpāṇi hṛdaiva viniyojayet || 151 ||
meaning:
आसनानि च तस्याथ पूजयेत् सकलानि तु |
भावादीन्यष्टपुष्पाणि हृदैव विनियोजयेत् || 151 ||
text_mt: And one should worship all his seats; / with the heart itself, one should offer the eight flowers of inner disposition and the rest.

sanskrit_iast:
nārācamudrayā tasya tāḍanaṃ parikīrtitam |
visarjanaṃ dhenumudrāṃ darśayitvā vidhānataḥ || 152 ||
meaning:
नाराचमुद्रया तस्य ताडनं परिकीर्तितम् |
विसर्जनं धेनुमुद्रां दर्शयित्वा विधानतः || 152 ||
text_mt: Striking with the nārāca mudrā is prescribed for him; / the dismissal [is done] after showing the dhenu mudrā according to rule.

sanskrit_iast: nirmālyadhāraṇaṃ kuryāt sadā caṇḍeśvaraṃ dhiyā |
meaning: निर्माल्यधारणं कुर्यात् सदा चण्डेश्वरं धिया |
text_mt: One should always mentally dedicate the wearing of the nirmālya [remnants] to Caṇḍeśvara.

sanskrit_iast: pratyekaṃ pañcabhirmantrairaṅgādīni pramārjayet || 153 ||
meaning: प्रत्येकं पञ्चभिर्मन्त्रैरङ्गादीनि प्रमार्जयेत् || 153 ||
text_mt: One should cleanse the limbs and other parts individually with the five mantras.

sanskrit_iast:
sammadādibhiretasya pūrvoktairnarasattamau |
bālāṃ jyeṣṭhāṃ tathā raudrīṃ kālīṃ ca tadanantaram || 154 ||
meaning:
सम्मदादिभिरेतस्य पूर्वोक्तैर्नरसत्तमौ |
बालां ज्येष्ठां तथा रौद्रीं कालीं च तदनन्तरम् || 154 ||
text_mt: With these mantras beginning with Sammada, previously mentioned, O best of men, / [one should worship] Bālā, Jyeṣṭhā, Raudrī, and then Kālī,

sanskrit_iast:
kalavikariṇīṃ devīṃ balapramathinīṃ tathā |
damanīṃ sarvabhūtānāṃ manonmathinīṃ tathaiva ca || 155 ||
meaning:
कलविकरिणीं देवीं बलप्रमथिनीं तथा |
दमनीं सर्वभूतानां मनोन्मथिनीं तथैव च || 155 ||
text_mt: the goddess Kalavikariṇī, and Balapramathinī, / Damanī of all beings, and likewise Manonmathinī.

sanskrit_iast:
aṣṭau tāḥ pūjayed devīḥ kramācchambhośca prītaye |
evaṃ śivaṃ pūjayitvā dhyānatatparamānasaḥ || 156 ||
meaning:
अष्टौ ताः पूजयेद् देवीः क्रमाच्छम्भोश्च प्रीतये |
एवं शिवं पूजयित्वा ध्यानतत्परमानसः || 156 ||
text_mt: One should worship those eight goddesses in order for the pleasure of Śambhu. / Having thus worshipped Śiva, with his mind intent on meditation,

sanskrit_iast:
japenmālāṃ samādāya mantraṃ dhyātvā tathā gurum |
ekaṃ pañcākṣaraṃ mantramekaṃ prāsādameva vā || 157 ||
meaning:
जपेन्मालां समादाय मन्त्रं ध्यात्वा तथा गुरुम् |
एकं पञ्चाक्षरं मन्त्रमेकं प्रासादमेव वा || 157 ||
text_mt: he should take up his rosary and recite, having meditated on the mantra and the guru: / either the single five-syllable mantra, or the single Prāsāda.

sanskrit_iast:
tatsaktamanasau japtvā śīghraṃ siddhimavāpsyathaḥ |
iti vāṃ kathitaṃ mantraṃ dhyānapūjākramaṃ tathā |
gacchataṃ nāṭakaṃ śailaṃ tatrārādhayataṃ haram || 158 ||
meaning:
तत्सक्तमनसौ जप्त्वा शीघ्रं सिद्धिमवाप्स्यथः |
इति वां कथितं मन्त्रं ध्यानपूजाक्रमं तथा |
गच्छतं नाटकं शैलं तत्राराधयतं हरम् || 158 ||
text_mt: Reciting with your minds attached to that, you will quickly attain perfection. / Thus the mantra has been told to you both, as well as the procedure of meditation and worship. / Go to the Nāṭaka mountain; worship Hara there.

sanskrit_iast: vetālabhairavāvūcatuḥ
meaning: वेतालभैरवावूचतुः
text_mt: Vetāla and Bhairava said:

sanskrit_iast:
pañcākṣarastu mantro'yaṃ dhṛtastvatsammate mune |
anenaiva haraṃ devaṃ pūjayiṣyāvahe mudā || 159 ||
meaning:
पञ्चाक्षरस्तु मन्त्रोऽयं धृतस्त्वत्सम्मते मुने |
अनेनैव हरं देवं पूजयिष्यावहे मुदा || 159 ||
text_mt: "This five-syllable mantra has been received with your consent, O sage. / With this alone we two will gladly worship the god Hara."

sanskrit_iast:
ityuktvā tannamaskṛtya tadā vetālabhairavau |
jagmuturnāṭakaṃ śailaṃ vaśiṣṭhānumate nṛpa || 160 ||
meaning:
इत्युक्त्वा तन्नमस्कृत्य तदा वेतालभैरवौ |
जग्मुतुर्नाटकं शैलं वशिष्ठानुमते नृप || 160 ||
text_mt: Having spoken thus and bowed to him, Vetāla and Bhairava then / went to the Nāṭaka mountain with the permission of Vasiṣṭha, O king.

sanskrit_iast:
tatrāsti sarasī ramyā susampūrṇamanīharā |
sarvadā svacchasalilā praphullakamalotpalā || 161 ||
meaning:
तत्रास्ति सरसी रम्या सुसम्पूर्णमनीहरा |
सर्वदा स्वच्छसलिला प्रफुल्लकमलोत्पला || 161 ||
text_mt: There is a delightful lake there, fully filled and captivating, / always of clear water, with blossoming lotuses and water-lilies.

sanskrit_iast:
tasyāstīre tu vipulaḥ sumanojño harāśramaḥ |
sarvadā dānavairdevaiḥ kinnaraiḥ pramathaistathā || 162 ||
meaning:
तस्यास्तीरे तु विपुलः सुमनोज्ञो हराश्रमः |
सर्वदा दानवैर्देवैः किन्नरैः प्रमथैस्तथा || 162 ||
text_mt: On its shore is the extensive, most charming hermitage of Hara, / always by Dānavas, gods, Kinnaras, and Pramathas

sanskrit_iast:
rakṣyate nṛpaśārdūla nṛtyavādanatatparaiḥ |
yasmānnaṭati tatreśo nityaṃ kautukatatparaḥ || 163 ||
meaning:
रक्ष्यते नृपशार्दूल नृत्यवादनतत्परैः |
यस्मान्नटति तत्रेशो नित्यं कौतुकतत्परः || 163 ||
text_mt: protected, O tiger among kings, intent upon dancing and musical instruments. / Because the Lord, always devoted to sport, dances there,

sanskrit_iast:
tasmānnāṭakanānnasau śailarājaḥ pragīyate |
chatrākāraṃ tu taṃ śailaṃ manojñaṃ śaṅkarapriyam || 164 ||
meaning:
तस्मान्नाटकनान्नसौ शैलराजः प्रगीयते |
छत्राकारं तु तं शैलं मनोज्ञं शङ्करप्रियम् || 164 ||
text_mt: therefore that king of mountains is celebrated by the name Nāṭaka. / Approaching that umbrella-shaped, charming mountain dear to Śaṅkara,

sanskrit_iast:
āsādya yatra sarasī tatra gatvā tu tau tadā |
na caivāpaśyatāṃ tatra harāśramamanuttamam || 165 ||
meaning:
आसाद्य यत्र सरसी तत्र गत्वा तु तौ तदा |
न चैवापश्यतां तत्र हराश्रममनुत्तमम् || 165 ||
text_mt: having gone there where the lake is, the two of them then / could not see the peerless hermitage of Hara there.

sanskrit_iast:
gantuṃ caivāśramasthānaṃ tau naivāśakatāṃ nṛpa |
tato haraṃ praṇamyāśu tasyaiva sarasastaṭe || 166 ||
meaning:
गन्तुं चैवाश्रमस्थानं तौ नैवाशकतां नृप |
ततो हरं प्रणम्याशु तस्यैव सरसस्तटे || 166 ||
text_mt: And the two could not even reach the site of the hermitage, O king. / Then, having quickly bowed to Hara on the bank of that very lake,

sanskrit_iast:
nirmāya sthaṇḍilaṃ cāru vaśiṣṭhoktakrameṇa tu |
haramārāddhumārebhe vetālo bhairavo'pi ca || 167 ||
meaning:
निर्माय स्थण्डिलं चारु वशिष्ठोक्तक्रमेण तु |
हरमाराद्धुमारेभे वेतालो भैरवोऽपि च || 167 ||
text_mt: and having prepared a beautiful sacrificial ground according to the procedure stated by Vasiṣṭha, / Vetāla and Bhairava began to worship Hara.

sanskrit_iast:
ārādhayantau bhūteśaṃ tau tadā śaṅkarātmajau |
dṛṣṭvā haro devagaṇaiḥ sārdhaṃ tasmiṃstu parvate |
adhityakāyāṃ nyavasat svāśrame'parṇayā saha || 168 ||
meaning:
आराधयन्तौ भूतेशं तौ तदा शङ्करात्मजौ |
दृष्ट्वा हरो देवगणैः सार्धं तस्मिंस्तु पर्वते |
अधित्यकायां न्यवसत् स्वाश्रमेऽपर्णया सह || 168 ||
text_mt: Seeing those two sons of Śaṅkara worshipping the lord of spirits, / Hara then dwelt with the hosts of gods and with Aparṇā / in his own hermitage on the tableland of that mountain.

sanskrit_iast:
adhobhāge sarastīre tapasyantau harātmajau |
sthitau dṛṣṭvā devagaṇaiḥ sahitaḥ śaṅkaraḥ sthitaḥ || 169 ||
meaning:
अधोभागे सरस्तीरे तपस्यन्तौ हरात्मजौ |
स्थितौ दृष्ट्वा देवगणैः सहितः शङ्करः स्थितः || 169 ||
text_mt: Seeing Hara's two sons engaged in austerities and standing / on the lower slopes by the lake's shore, Śaṅkara stayed there with the hosts of gods.

sanskrit_iast:
nṛtyamardalaśabdo yo harasya satataṃ bhavet |
śṛṇutastau tadā śabdaṃ gantuṃ draṣṭuṃ na labhyate || 170 ||
meaning:
नृत्यमर्दलशब्दो यो हरस्य सततं भवेत् |
शृणुतस्तौ तदा शब्दं गन्तुं द्रष्टुं न लभ्यते || 170 ||
text_mt: Whenever the sound of Hara's dance and drums arose, / the two would hear the sound, but could neither go nor see.

sanskrit_iast:
hareṇādhiṣṭhitaḥ śailaḥ sarvadevagaṇaiḥ saha |
rājate sma tadā bhūpa sudharmā vāsavī yathā || 171 ||
meaning:
हरेणाधिष्ठितः शैलः सर्वदेवगणैः सह |
राजते स्म तदा भूप सुधर्मा वासवी यथा || 171 ||
text_mt: Inhabited by Hara together with all the hosts of gods, / the mountain shone then, O king, like Indra's assembly hall, Sudharmā.

sanskrit_iast:
dhyāyatostu tadā tatra bhagavān vṛṣabhadhvajaḥ |
nacirādeva tasyābhūd dhyānamārgeṣu niścalaḥ || 172 ||
meaning:
ध्यायतोस्तु तदा तत्र भगवान् वृषभध्वजः |
नचिरादेव तस्याभूद् ध्यानमार्गेषु निश्चलः || 172 ||
text_mt: As the two meditated there, the blessed Lord who bears a bull upon his banner / soon became steady in their pathways of meditation.

sanskrit_iast:
tau pujayantau gacchantau sthitau vā candraśekharam |
naiva atyajatuścittaiḥ kadācidapi bhūmipa || 173 ||
meaning:
तौ पुजयन्तौ गच्छन्तौ स्थितौ वा चन्द्रशेखरम् |
नैव अत्यजतुश्चित्तैः कदाचिदपि भूमिप || 173 ||
text_mt: Whether worshipping, walking, or standing, O king, / they never abandoned Candraśekhara with their minds at any time.

sanskrit_iast:
pañcākṣareṇa mantreṇa pūjayantau vṛṣadhvajam |
vyaticakramatustau tu sahasraṃ parivatsarān || 174 ||
meaning:
पञ्चाक्षरेण मन्त्रेण पूजयन्तौ वृषध्वजम् |
व्यतिचक्रमतुस्तौ तु सहस्रं परिवत्सरान् || 174 ||
text_mt: Worshipping the bull-bannered god with the five-syllable mantra, / they spent a thousand years.

sanskrit_iast:
nirāhārau yatāhārau harasaṃsaktamānasau |
tapasā ninyaturvarṣān sahasraṃ caikavarṣavat || 175 ||
meaning:
निराहारौ यताहारौ हरसंसक्तमानसौ |
तपसा निन्यतुर्वर्षान् सहस्रं चैकवर्षवत् || 175 ||
text_mt: Fasting and restrained in food, their minds fixed on Hara, / through austerity they passed a thousand years as if it were a single year.

sanskrit_iast:
gate varṣasahasre tu svayameva vṛṣadhvajaḥ |
prasaṅgastu tayorbhūtvā pratyakṣatvamupāgataḥ || 176 ||
meaning:
गते वर्षसहस्रे तु स्वयमेव वृषध्वजः |
प्रसङ्गस्तु तयोर्भूत्वा प्रत्यक्षत्वमुपागतः || 176 ||
text_mt: When the thousand years had elapsed, the bull-bannered god himself, / becoming favourably inclined to the two, appeared visibly.

sanskrit_iast:
taṃ tu pratyakṣato dṛṣṭvā tadā vetālabhairavau |
vṛṣadhvajaṃ tuṣṭuvaturdhyānagamyaṃ puraḥsthitam || 177 ||
meaning:
तं तु प्रत्यक्षतो दृष्ट्वा तदा वेतालभैरवौ |
वृषध्वजं तुष्टुवतुर्ध्यानगम्यं पुरःस्थितम् || 177 ||
text_mt: Seeing him before their eyes, Vetāla and Bhairava then / praised the bull-bannered god, who, reachable through meditation, stood before them.

sanskrit_iast:
hararūpaṃ yathādhyātaṃ hṛdgataṃ tejasojjvalam |
tathā dṛṣṭvā tatastābhyāṃ aśiṣṭhasyānumānataḥ || 178 ||
meaning:
हररूपं यथाध्यातं हृद्गतं तेजसोज्ज्वलम् |
तथा दृष्ट्वा ततस्ताभ्यां अशिष्ठस्यानुमानतः || 178 ||
text_mt: Seeing Hara's form blazing with splendour, / just as meditated in the heart, through the teaching of Vasiṣṭha,

sanskrit_iast: vetālabhairavāvūcatuḥ
meaning: वेतालभैरवावूचतुः
text_mt: Vetāla and Bhairava said:

sanskrit_iast:
pañcavaktraṃ mahākāvyaṃ sarvajñānamayaṃ param |
saṃsārasāgaratrāṇaṃ praṇamāvo vṛṣadhvajam || 179 ||
meaning:
पञ्चवक्त्रं महाकाव्यं सर्वज्ञानमयं परम् |
संसारसागरत्राणं प्रणमावो वृषध्वजम् || 179 ||
text_mt: To the five-faced one, the great poet, composed of all knowledge, supreme, / the salvation from the ocean of worldly existence, the bull-bannered god, we bow.

sanskrit_iast:
tvaṃ paraḥ paramātmā ca pareśaḥ puruṣottamaḥ |
tvaṃ kūṭastho jagadvyāpī pradhānaḥ parameśvaraḥ || 180 ||
meaning:
त्वं परः परमात्मा च परेशः पुरुषोत्तमः |
त्वं कूटस्थो जगद्व्यापी प्रधानः परमेश्वरः || 180 ||
text_mt: You are supreme, the supreme self, the supreme lord, Puruṣottama; / you are immutable, all-pervading, pradhāna, the supreme lord.

sanskrit_iast:
rūpātmā tvaṃ mahātattvaṃ tattvajñānālayaḥ prabhuḥ |
sāṃkhyayogālayaḥ śuddho guṇatrayavibhāgavit || 181 ||
meaning:
रूपात्मा त्वं महातत्त्वं तत्त्वज्ञानालयः प्रभुः |
सांख्ययोगालयः शुद्धो गुणत्रयविभागवित् || 181 ||
text_mt: You are the self of form, the great principle, the abode of knowledge of reality, the master; / the abode of Sāṃkhya and Yoga, pure, the knower of the distinctions of the three guṇas.

sanskrit_iast:
tvaṃ nityastvamanityaśca jagatkartā layaḥ smṛtaḥ |
eko'nekasvarūpaśca śāntaceṣṭo jaganmayaḥ || 182 ||
meaning:
त्वं नित्यस्त्वमनित्यश्च जगत्कर्ता लयः स्मृतः |
एकोऽनेकस्वरूपश्च शान्तचेष्टो जगन्मयः || 182 ||
text_mt: You are eternal and non-eternal, creator of the world, remembered as dissolution; / one and of manifold form, of tranquil activity, composed of the world.

sanskrit_iast:
nirvikāro nirādhāro nityānandaḥ sanātanaḥ |
tvaṃ viṣṇustvaṃ mahendrastvaṃ brahmā tvaṃ jagatāṃ patiḥ || 183 ||
meaning:
निर्विकारो निराधारो नित्यानन्दः सनातनः |
त्वं विष्णुस्त्वं महेन्द्रस्त्वं ब्रह्मा त्वं जगतां पतिः || 183 ||
text_mt: Free from change, without support, eternal bliss, timeless; / you are Viṣṇu, you are great Indra, you are Brahmā, the lord of the worlds.

sanskrit_iast:
yo rūparūpeśvararatnamālaḥ
sambhūtibhūto niravagrahaśca |
kākṣyāvatīrṇāvagatapramāthī
yogeśvaro jñānagatistvagamyaḥ || 184 ||
meaning:
यो रूपरूपेश्वररत्नमालः
सम्भूतिभूतो निरवग्रहश्च |
काक्ष्यावतीर्णावगतप्रमाथी
योगेश्वरो ज्ञानगतिस्त्वगम्यः || 184 ||
text_mt: He who wears a jewel-garland of forms and masters of forms, / who is existence itself and unchecked; / the tormentor of obstacles descending upon desire, / lord of yoga, path of wisdom, unapproachable.

sanskrit_iast:
prameyarūpātmadharādharābho
bhogīndrabaddhāmṛtabhogatantraḥ |
sūkṣmākṣarastattvavidapramāthī
tvaṃ devadevaḥ śaraṇaṃ surāṇām || 185 ||
meaning:
प्रमेयरूपात्मधराधराभो
भोगीन्द्रबद्धामृतभोगतन्त्रः |
सूक्ष्माक्षरस्तत्त्वविदप्रमाथी
त्वं देवदेवः शरणं सुराणाम् || 185 ||
text_mt: Bearing the likeness of mountains that hold the objects of cognition, / whose ritual of nectar-enjoyment is bound by the serpent king, / subtle syllable, knower of reality, unagitated, / you are the god of gods, the refuge of the celestials.

sanskrit_iast:
vikalpamānāparihīnadehaḥ
śuddhāntadhāmānugataikavidyaḥ |
vardhiṣṇurugraḥ puruṣaḥ parātmā
tvamindriyaughasya vicārabuddhi || 186 ||
meaning:
विकल्पमानापरिहीनदेहः
शुद्धान्तधामानुगतैकविद्यः |
वर्धिष्णुरुग्रः पुरुषः परात्मा
त्वमिन्द्रियौघस्य विचारबुद्धि || 186 ||
text_mt: Whose body is untouched by doubt or pride, / who possess the singular wisdom following the innermost light, / growing, fierce, Puruṣa, the supreme self, / you are the discerning intellect of the multitude of senses.

sanskrit_iast:
tvaṃ nāthanātha prabhavaḥ pareṣāṃ
gatirmunīnāṃ parayogigamyaḥ |
tvaṃbhūdharo bhāgadharo hyananto
viśvātmanaste bahavaḥ prapañcāḥ || 187 ||
meaning:
त्वं नाथनाथ प्रभवः परेषां
गतिर्मुनीनां परयोगिगम्यः |
त्वंभूधरो भागधरो ह्यनन्तो
विश्वात्मनस्ते बहवः प्रपञ्चाः || 187 ||
text_mt: You are the master of masters, origin of the highest, / the refuge of sages, attainable by supreme yogins; / you are the supporter of the earth, the holder of fortunes, endless; / of you, the universal self, manifold are the expansions.

sanskrit_iast:
jñānāmṛtasyandakapūrṇacandro
mohāndhakārasya paraḥ pradīpaḥ |
bhaktātmajānāṃ paramaḥ pitā tva
kāme ca pañcānanarūpadhārī || 188 ||
meaning:
ज्ञानामृतस्यन्दकपूर्णचन्द्रो
मोहान्धकारस्य परः प्रदीपः |
भक्तात्मजानां परमः पिता त्व
कामे च पञ्चाननरूपधारी || 188 ||
text_mt: A full moon shedding the nectar of knowledge, / the supreme lamp against the darkness of delusion, / you are the supreme father of devoted sons, / and in love you bear a five-faced form.

sanskrit_iast:
śāstrākhilānāṃ prathamo vivasvāṃ-
stanūnapāt tvaṃ tanuṣe guṇaudhān |
tvaṃ brahmarūpeṇa karoṣi sṛṣṭiṃ
viṣṇusvarūpaiḥ satataṃ sthitiṃ ca || 189 ||
meaning:
शास्त्राखिलानां प्रथमो विवस्वां-
स्तनूनपात् त्वं तनुषे गुणौधान् |
त्वं ब्रह्मरूपेण करोषि सृष्टिं
विष्णुस्वरूपैः सततं स्थितिं च || 189 ||
text_mt: The first sun of all scriptures, / Tanūnapāt, you spread the floods of virtues; / you carry out creation in the form of Brahmā, / and maintenance constantly in the forms of Viṣṇu.

sanskrit_iast:
tvaṃ rudrarūpī kuruṣe tathāntaṃ
tvatto na cānyajjagatīha vastu |
tvaṃ rātrinātho divaseśvaraśca
tvamagnirāpaḥ pavano dharitrī || 190 ||
meaning:
त्वं रुद्ररूपी कुरुषे तथान्तं
त्वत्तो न चान्यज्जगतीह वस्तु |
त्वं रात्रिनाथो दिवसेश्वरश्च
त्वमग्निरापः पवनो धरित्री || 190 ||
text_mt: Bearing the form of Rudra, you likewise bring about dissolution; / there is no entity in this world other than you; / you are the lord of night and the ruler of day; / you are fire, water, wind, and the earth.

sanskrit_iast:
nabhastathā tvaṃ kratutantrahotā
tvamaṣṭamūrtirbhavato na cānyat |
anantamūrtistviha mukhyabhāvā-
nnigadyate cāṣṭamayī trimūrtiḥ || 191 ||
meaning:
नभस्तथा त्वं क्रतुतन्त्रहोता
त्वमष्टमूर्तिर्भवतो न चान्यत् |
अनन्तमूर्तिस्त्विह मुख्यभावा-
न्निगद्यते चाष्टमयी त्रिमूर्तिः || 191 ||
text_mt: And space you are, the sacrificer of the ritual system; / you are of eight forms, there is nothing apart from you; / having endless forms, yet in this world, due to preeminence, / your three forms are declared to comprise eight.

sanskrit_iast:
anantamūrte kathamanyathā te
saṃkhyāsti rūpasya yadaṣṭamūrtiḥ |
tvaṃ tryambakastvaṃ tripurāntakaśca
tva śambhurīśaḥ śamano vidhātā || 192 ||
meaning:
अनन्तमूर्ते कथमन्यथा ते
संख्यास्ति रूपस्य यदष्टमूर्तिः |
त्वं त्र्यम्बकस्त्वं त्रिपुरान्तकश्च
त्व शम्भुरीशः शमनो विधाता || 192 ||
text_mt: O one of infinite forms, how else could there be / a count of your forms when you are eight-formed? / You are Tryambaka, and you are the destroyer of Tripura; / you are Śambhu, the lord, the ender, the creator.

sanskrit_iast:
sahasrabāhuśca hiraṇyabāhuḥ
sahasramūrtistviha pañcavaktraḥ |
prabhūtanetrastu ṣaḍarddhanetraḥ
prabhūtabāhurdaśabāhurīśaḥ || 193 ||
meaning:
सहस्रबाहुश्च हिरण्यबाहुः
सहस्रमूर्तिस्त्विह पञ्चवक्त्रः |
प्रभूतनेत्रस्तु षडर्द्धनेत्रः
प्रभूतबाहुर्दशबाहुरीशः || 193 ||
text_mt: You have a thousand arms and golden arms; / you have a thousand forms, yet here five faces; / having many eyes, yet having three eyes; / having many arms, the lord with ten arms.

sanskrit_iast:
prabhūtabhogī mitabhogayukto
bhogyānusāro niravagrahaśca || 194 ||
meaning:
प्रभूतभोगी मितभोगयुक्तो
भोग्यानुसारो निरवग्रहश्च || 194 ||
text_mt: Possessed of abundant enjoyment, possessing measured enjoyment, / conforming to objects of enjoyment, and unchecked.

sanskrit_iast:
nityānityasvarūpāya nityadhāmasvarūpiṇe |
paratattvasvarūpāya namastubhyaṃ śivātmane || 195 ||
meaning:
नित्यानित्यस्वरूपाय नित्यधामस्वरूपिणे |
परतत्त्वस्वरूपाय नमस्तुभ्यं शिवात्मने || 195 ||
text_mt: To the one whose nature is eternal and non-eternal, whose nature is the eternal abode, / whose nature is the supreme reality, homage to you, the self of Śiva.

sanskrit_iast:
nāntaṃ liṅgasya yasyāptaṃ viṣṇunā brahmaṇā tava |
tasyāvāṃ ki vidhāsyāvaḥ stutivākyaṃ vṛṣadhvajaḥ || 196 ||
meaning:
नान्तं लिङ्गस्य यस्याप्तं विष्णुना ब्रह्मणा तव |
तस्यावां कि विधास्यावः स्तुतिवाक्यं वृषध्वजः || 196 ||
text_mt: The end of whose liṅga was not reached by Viṣṇu or Brahmā, / to him, the bull-bannered god, what word of praise can we two offer?

sanskrit_iast:
svarūpaṃ yasya jānanti na devā nāpi dānavāḥ |
ālāvāvāṃ kathantu tvāṃ stoṣyāvaḥ parameśvaraḥ || 197 ||
meaning:
स्वरूपं यस्य जानन्ति न देवा नापि दानवाः |
आलावावां कथन्तु त्वां स्तोष्यावः परमेश्वरः || 197 ||
text_mt: Whose essential nature neither gods nor Dānavas know, / alas, how shall we two praise you, O supreme lord?

sanskrit_iast:
bhaktimātreṇa deveśa avāvāṃ vṛṣabhadhvaja |
kurvaḥ praṇāmaṃ gaurīśa bhūyastubhyaṃ namo namaḥ || 198 ||
meaning:
भक्तिमात्रेण देवेश अवावां वृषभध्वज |
कुर्वः प्रणामं गौरीश भूयस्तुभ्यं नमो नमः || 198 ||
text_mt: Solely through devotion, O god of gods, bull-bannered one, / we offer our prostration; O lord of Gaurī, homage, homage again to you.

sanskrit_iast: aurva uvāca
meaning: और्व उवाच

sanskrit_iast:
iti stuto mahādevo vetālena mahātmanā |
bhairaveṇāpi rājendra prasannaḥ prāha tau tadā || 199 ||
meaning:
इति स्तुतो महादेवो वेतालेन महात्मना |
भैरवेणापि राजेन्द्र प्रसन्नः प्राह तौ तदा || 199 ||
text_mt: Thus praised by the great-souled Vetāla / and Bhairava, O king of kings, Mahādeva, pleased, said to them then:

sanskrit_iast: śrī bhagavānuvāca
meaning: श्री भगवानुवाच

sanskrit_iast:
tuṣṭo'smi yuvayoḥ putrau vṛṇutaṃ vāñchitaṃ varam |
dāsyāmi yuvayoriṣṭaṃ prasanno'haṃ tapovrataiḥ || 200 ||
meaning:
तुष्टोऽस्मि युवयोः पुत्रौ वृणुतं वाञ्छितं वरम् |
दास्यामि युवयोरिष्टं प्रसन्नोऽहं तपोव्रतैः || 200 ||
text_mt: "I am pleased with you both, my sons; choose the desired boon! / I shall give what you wish, pleased as I am by your vows of austerity,

sanskrit_iast:
stutibhistu damaiścāpi tathaikāntāucintanaiḥ |
muhurmuhuḥ suprasanna iṣṭaṃ dāsyāmi vāṃ sutau || 201 ||
meaning:
स्तुतिभिस्तु दमैश्चापि तथैकान्ताउचिन्तनैः |
मुहुर्मुहुः सुप्रसन्न इष्टं दास्यामि वां सुतौ || 201 ||
text_mt: by your hymns of praise, self-restraint, and solitary contemplation; / again and again well-pleased, I shall grant what is desired, O sons."

sanskrit_iast: vetālabhairavāvūcatuḥ
meaning: वेतालभैरवावूचतुः
text_mt: Vetāla and Bhairava said:

sanskrit_iast:
tuṣṭo'si yadi satyaṃ nau satyamāvāṃ sutau yadi |
vṛṣadhvaja tavaiveha tadeṣṭaṃ dehi nau varam || 202 ||
meaning:
तुष्टोऽसि यदि सत्यं नौ सत्यमावां सुतौ यदि |
वृषध्वज तवैवेह तदेष्टं देहि नौ वरम् || 202 ||
text_mt: "If truly you are pleased with us, if truly we two / are your sons, O bull-bannered god, then grant us the boon we desire:

sanskrit_iast:
sutabhāvena pitaraṃ bhavantaṃ jagatāṃ patim |
nityaṃ yathāvagacchāvastathā dehi varaṃ tu nau || 203 ||
meaning:
सुतभावेन पितरं भवन्तं जगतां पतिम् |
नित्यं यथावगच्छावस्तथा देहि वरं तु नौ || 203 ||
text_mt: grant us such a boon that with the feeling of sons / we may always know you, our father, the lord of the worlds.

sanskrit_iast:
na rājyamabhikāṃkṣāvo na dhanaṃ nānyadeva vā |
tvadbhaktyā sevanaṃ kartuṃ tavecchāvo vṛṣadhvaja || 204 ||
meaning:
न राज्यमभिकांक्षावो न धनं नान्यदेव वा |
त्वद्भक्त्या सेवनं कर्तुं तवेच्छावो वृषध्वज || 204 ||
text_mt: We do not desire a kingdom, nor wealth, nor anything else; / through devotion to you, O bull-bannered god, we wish to perform service to you.

sanskrit_iast:
tvatpādapaṅkajadvandve nityaṃ madhukarātmatām |
tvayi prasanne netrāṇāṃ yugale prāpnutāṃ sadā || 205 ||
meaning:
त्वत्पादपङ्कजद्वन्द्वे नित्यं मधुकरात्मताम् |
त्वयि प्रसन्ने नेत्राणां युगले प्राप्नुतां सदा || 205 ||
text_mt: May the pair of our eyes, with you pleased, / always attain the nature of bees upon the pair of your lotus feet.

sanskrit_iast:
ito'nyathā tvaccintābhistvaddyānaistvatprapūjanaiḥ |
kalpakoṭisahasrāṇi yāntu samyaktathāvayoḥ || 206 ||
meaning:
इतोऽन्यथा त्वच्चिन्ताभिस्त्वद्द्यानैस्त्वत्प्रपूजनैः |
कल्पकोटिसहस्राणि यान्तु सम्यक्तथावयोः || 206 ||
text_mt: Otherwise, let thousands of crores of aeons / pass fully for us two in thoughts of you, meditation on you, and worship of you."

sanskrit_iast: aurva uvāca
meaning: और्व उवाच

sanskrit_iast:
tatastad vacanaṃ śrutvā mahādevo hasanniva |
sarvairdevagaṇaiḥ sārdhaṃ devatvamakarottayoḥ || 207 ||
meaning:
ततस्तद् वचनं श्रुत्वा महादेवो हसन्निव |
सर्वैर्देवगणैः सार्धं देवत्वमकरोत्तयोः || 207 ||
text_mt: Then hearing their word, Mahādeva, as if smiling, / conferred divinity upon the two together with all the hosts of gods.

sanskrit_iast:
devendrasammatenaiva sudhāmānīya nākataḥ |
vetālabhairavau tāntu pāyayāmāsa śaṅkaraḥ || 208 ||
meaning:
देवेन्द्रसम्मतेनैव सुधामानीय नाकतः |
वेतालभैरवौ तान्तु पाययामास शङ्करः || 208 ||
text_mt: Bringing nectar from heaven with the consent of the lord of the gods, / Śaṅkara made Vetāla and Bhairava drink it.

sanskrit_iast:
pīte'mṛte tatastau tu martyatāṃ narasattamau |
amartyatāṃ parityajya prāpatuḥ śivaśaktitaḥ || 209 ||
meaning:
पीतेऽमृते ततस्तौ तु मर्त्यतां नरसत्तमौ |
अमर्त्यतां परित्यज्य प्रापतुः शिवशक्तितः || 209 ||
text_mt: When the nectar was drunk, the two best of men then / abandoned mortality and attained immortality through Śiva's power.

sanskrit_iast:
tasminkāle svapantau tu divyajñānabalānvitau |
divyarūpopasampannau babhūvaturarindamau || 210 ||
meaning:
तस्मिन्काले स्वपन्तौ तु दिव्यज्ञानबलान्वितौ |
दिव्यरूपोपसम्पन्नौ बभूवतुररिन्दमौ || 210 ||
text_mt: Sleeping at that time, endowed with divine knowledge and strength, / the two subduers of foes became endowed with divine form.

sanskrit_iast:
abhinnenaiva dehena devatvaṃ gatayostayoḥ |
prāha śambhustadā tau tu sutau paramaharṣitau || 211 ||
meaning:
अभिन्नेनैव देहेन देवत्वं गतयोस्तयोः |
प्राह शम्भुस्तदा तौ तु सुतौ परमहर्षितौ || 211 ||
text_mt: When the two had attained divinity in their very same bodies, / Śambhu then spoke to those two greatly delighted sons:

sanskrit_iast: bhagavānuvāca
meaning: भगवानुवाच

sanskrit_iast:
ahaṃ tuṣṭastu yuvayoḥ pārvatīṃ dayitāṃ mama |
maddattaṃ kāmamicchantāvārādhayatamīśvarīm || 212 ||
meaning:
अहं तुष्टस्तु युवयोः पार्वतीं दयितां मम |
मद्दत्तं काममिच्छन्तावाराधयतमीश्वरीम् || 212 ||
text_mt: “I am pleased with you two. Desiring the wish granted by me, / worship Īśvarī, my beloved Pārvatī.

sanskrit_iast: tāmṛte tu na śaknomi dātumiṣṭaṃ sanātanam |
meaning: तामृते तु न शक्नोमि दातुमिष्टं सनातनम् |
text_mt: Without her, I cannot grant what is eternally desired.

sanskrit_iast: sevituṃ ca sutau nityaṃ śaraṇaṃ vrajataṃ śivām || 213 ||
meaning: सेवितुं च सुतौ नित्यं शरणं व्रजतं शिवाम् || 213 ||
text_mt: To serve [her], O sons, always take refuge in Śivā.

sanskrit_iast:
acirād yena bhāvena prītiṃ devī gamiṣyati |
tra vā tatra vā gatvā tena bhāvena cāryatām || 214 ||
meaning:
अचिराद् येन भावेन प्रीतिं देवी गमिष्यति |
त्र वा तत्र वा गत्वा तेन भावेन चार्यताम् || 214 ||
text_mt: Going here or there, practice with that disposition / by which the goddess will soon be pleased.”

sanskrit_iast:
iti śrīkālikāpurāṇe vetāla-bhairavotpattikathane kapañcāśo'dhyāyaḥ || 51 ||
dvipañcāśo'dhyāyaḥ
meaning:
इति श्रीकालिकापुराणे वेताल-भैरवोत्पत्तिकथने कपञ्चाशोऽध्यायः || 51 ||
द्विपञ्चाशोऽध्यायः
text_mt:
Thus ends the fifty-first chapter in the glorious Kālikāpurāṇa, in the narration of the origin of Vetāla and Bhairava.
Chapter fifty-two.

sanskrit_iast: aurva uvāca
meaning: और्व उवाच

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ vadati bhūteśe tadā vetālabhairavau |
prāhaturvyomakeśaṃ tau harṣotphullavilocanau || 1 ||
meaning:
एवं वदति भूतेशे तदा वेतालभैरवौ |
प्राहतुर्व्योमकेशं तौ हर्षोत्फुल्लविलोचनौ || 1 ||
text_mt: When the lord of beings spoke thus, Vetāla and Bhairava / then said to Vyomakeśa, their eyes wide with joy:

sanskrit_iast: vetālabhairavāvūcatuḥ
meaning: वेतालभैरवावूचतुः
text_mt: Vetāla and Bhairava said:

sanskrit_iast:
pārvatyā na hi jānīvo dhyānaṃ mantraṃ vidhiṃ tathā |
kathamārādhayiṣyāvo bhagavan samyagucyatām || 2 ||
meaning:
पार्वत्या न हि जानीवो ध्यानं मन्त्रं विधिं तथा |
कथमाराधयिष्यावो भगवन् सम्यगुच्यताम् || 2 ||
text_mt: “We two do not know the meditation, mantra, or rite of Pārvatī. / How shall we worship [her], O Blessed One? Tell us fully.”

sanskrit_iast: śrībhagavānuvāca
meaning: श्रीभगवानुवाच

sanskrit_iast:
mahāmāyāvidhiṃ mantraṃ kalpaṃ ca bhavatoḥ sutau |
upadekṣyāmi tattvena yena sarvaṃ bhaviṣyati || 3 ||
meaning:
महामायाविधिं मन्त्रं कल्पं च भवतोः सुतौ |
उपदेक्ष्यामि तत्त्वेन येन सर्वं भविष्यति || 3 ||
text_mt: “I shall teach you two sons properly the rite, mantra, / and ritual manual of Mahāmāyā, through which everything will be accomplished.”

sanskrit_iast: aurva uvāca
meaning: और्व उवाच

sanskrit_iast:
ityuktvā sa mahāmāyādhyānaṃ mantraṃ vidhiṃ tathā |
kathayāmāsa giriśastayoḥ samyaṅ nṛpottama || 4 ||
meaning:
इत्युक्त्वा स महामायाध्यानं मन्त्रं विधिं तथा |
कथयामास गिरिशस्तयोः सम्यङ् नृपोत्तम || 4 ||
text_mt: Having spoken thus, Giriśa fully told them the meditation, / mantra, and rite of Mahāmāyā, O best of kings,

sanskrit_iast:
yadaṣṭādaśabhiḥ paścātpaṭalaiśca sa bhairavaḥ |
sa nirṇayavidhiṃ kalpaṃ nibabandha śivāmṛte || 5 ||
meaning:
यदष्टादशभिः पश्चात्पटलैश्च स भैरवः |
स निर्णयविधिं कल्पं निबबन्ध शिवामृते || 5 ||
text_mt: which Bhairava later composed in eighteen chapters, / the ritual manual setting forth the determination, in the nectar of Śivā.

sanskrit_iast: sagara uvāca
meaning: सगर उवाच

sanskrit_iast:
kīdṛṅ mantraṃ purā śambhuravocadubhayostayoḥ |
yenārādhya mahāmāyāṃ tau gaṇeśatvamāpatuḥ || 6 ||
meaning:
कीदृङ् मन्त्रं पुरा शम्भुरवोचदुभयोस्तयोः |
येनाराध्य महामायां तौ गणेशत्वमापतुः || 6 ||
text_mt: “What kind of mantra did Śambhu formerly speak to both of them, / having worshipped Mahāmāyā with which they attained the status of leaders of gaṇas?

sanskrit_iast:
sakalpaṃ sarahasyaṃ ca sāṅgaṃ tacchrotumutsahe |
daśāṣṭapaṭalairyat tu nibabandha sa bhairavaḥ || 7 ||
meaning:
सकल्पं सरहस्यं च साङ्गं तच्छ्रोतुमुत्सहे |
दशाष्टपटलैर्यत् तु निबबन्ध स भैरवः || 7 ||
text_mt: I desire to hear that along with the manual, secret teachings, and auxiliary limbs, / which Bhairava composed in eighteen chapters.”

sanskrit_iast: aurva uvāca
meaning: और्व उवाच

sanskrit_iast:
bahutvād vadituṃ tasya cireṇaiva tu śakyate |
tasmāt sadyaḥ samuddhṛtya yanmahādevabhāṣitam |
saṃkṣepāt kathaye tattvaṃ tacchṛṇuṣva nṛpottama || 8 ||
meaning:
बहुत्वाद् वदितुं तस्य चिरेणैव तु शक्यते |
तस्मात् सद्यः समुद्धृत्य यन्महादेवभाषितम् |
संक्षेपात् कथये तत्त्वं तच्छृणुष्व नृपोत्तम || 8 ||
text_mt: “Because of its vastness, it can only be told over a long time. / Therefore, extracting immediately what Mahādeva spoke, / I shall tell the truth in brief; listen to that, O best of kings.

sanskrit_iast:
pṛcchantau pārvatī mantraṃ tadā vetālabhairavau |
jagāda sa mahādevaḥ śṛṇuta mantrakalpakau || 9 ||
meaning:
पृच्छन्तौ पार्वती मन्त्रं तदा वेतालभैरवौ |
जगाद स महादेवः शृणुत मन्त्रकल्पकौ || 9 ||
text_mt: When Vetāla and Bhairava then asked for Pārvatī’s mantra, / Mahādeva said: ‘Listen to the mantra and the ritual manual.

sanskrit_iast: śrībhagavānuvāca
meaning: श्रीभगवानुवाच

sanskrit_iast:
śṛṇu mantraṃ pravakṣyāmi guhyād guhyatamaṃ param |
aṣṭākṣaraṃ tu vaiṣṇavyā mahāmāyāmahotsavam || 10 ||
meaning:
शृणु मन्त्रं प्रवक्ष्यामि गुह्याद् गुह्यतमं परम् |
अष्टाक्षरं तु वैष्णव्या महामायामहोत्सवम् || 10 ||
text_mt: Listen, I shall speak the supreme mantra, the secret of secrets, / the eight-syllabled one of Vaiṣṇavī, the great festival of Mahāmāyā.

sanskrit_iast:
asya śrīvaiṣṇavīmantrasya nārada ṛṣiḥ śambhurdevatā |
anuṣṭup chandaḥ sarvārthasādhane viniyogaḥ || 11 ||
meaning:
अस्य श्रीवैष्णवीमन्त्रस्य नारद ऋषिः शम्भुर्देवता |
अनुष्टुप् छन्दः सर्वार्थसाधने विनियोगः || 11 ||
text_mt: Of this glorious Vaiṣṇavī mantra, the seer is Nārada, the deity is Śambhu, / the metre is anuṣṭubh, and the ritual application is for accomplishing all aims.

sanskrit_iast:
hāntāntayurvo rāntaśca nānto ṇāntastathaiva ca |
kaikādaśāṣṭādiṣaṣṭhaḥ khānto viṣṇupuraḥsaraḥ || 12 ||
meaning:
हान्तान्तयुर्वो रान्तश्च नान्तो णान्तस्तथैव च |
कैकादशाष्टादिषष्ठः खान्तो विष्णुपुरःसरः || 12 ||
text_mt: Ending in ha, then [ending in] ya, ending in ra, ending in na, and likewise ending in ṇa, / the sixth from the eleventh and eighth [vowels] with ka, ending in kha, preceded by Viṣṇu.

sanskrit_iast:
ebhiraṣṭākṣarairmantraṃ śoṇapatrasamaprabham |
oṃkāraṃ pūrvataḥ kṛtvā japyaṃ sarvaistu sādhakaiḥ || 13 ||
meaning:
एभिरष्टाक्षरैर्मन्त्रं शोणपत्रसमप्रभम् |
ओंकारं पूर्वतः कृत्वा जप्यं सर्वैस्तु साधकैः || 13 ||
text_mt: With these eight syllables, resembling the splendour of a red lotus petal, / placing the syllable Oṃ first, it is to be recited by all practitioners.

sanskrit_iast:
mahāmantramidaṃ guhyaṃ vaiṣṇavīmantrasaṃjñakam |
mantraṃ kalevaragataṃ tasmādaṅgaṃ prakīrtitam || 14 ||
meaning:
महामन्त्रमिदं गुह्यं वैष्णवीमन्त्रसंज्ञकम् |
मन्त्रं कलेवरगतं तस्मादङ्गं प्रकीर्तितम् || 14 ||
text_mt: This secret great mantra is called the Vaiṣṇavī mantra. / The mantra resides in the body; therefore it is proclaimed as an auxiliary limb.

sanskrit_iast:
mahādevasyordhvamukhaṃ bījametat prakīrtitam |
oṃkārākṣarabījaṃ ca yakāraḥ śaktirucyate || 15 ||
meaning:
महादेवस्योर्ध्वमुखं बीजमेतत् प्रकीर्तितम् |
ओंकाराक्षरबीजं च यकारः शक्तिरुच्यते || 15 ||
text_mt: This upward-facing mouth of Mahādeva is proclaimed as the seed-syllable; / the syllable Oṃ is the seed-syllable, and the syllable Ya is called the śakti.

sanskrit_iast:
sabījaṃ kathitaṃ mantraṃ kalpaṃ ca śṛṇu bhairava |
tīrthe nadyāṃ devakhāte gartaprasravaṇādike || 16 ||
meaning:
सबीजं कथितं मन्त्रं कल्पं च शृणु भैरव |
तीर्थे नद्यां देवखाते गर्तप्रस्रवणादिके || 16 ||
text_mt: The mantra along with its seed-syllable has been told. Hear the ritual manual, O Bhairava: / at a sacred ford, a river, a divine pool, a pit, a spring, or such,

sanskrit_iast:
parakīyetare toye snānaṃ pūrvaṃ samācaret |
ācāntaḥ śucitāṃ prāptaḥ kṛtāsanaparigrahaḥ || 17 ||
meaning:
परकीयेतरे तोये स्नानं पूर्वं समाचरेत् |
आचान्तः शुचितां प्राप्तः कृतासनपरिग्रहः || 17 ||
text_mt: in another’s water or elsewhere, one should first take a bath. / Having sipped water, purified, and taken one’s seat,

sanskrit_iast:
uttarābhimukho bhūtvā sthaṇḍilaṃ mārjayet tataḥ |
kareṇānena mantreṇa yūṃ sahaḥ kṣityā iti svayam || 18 ||
meaning:
उत्तराभिमुखो भूत्वा स्थण्डिलं मार्जयेत् ततः |
करेणानेन मन्त्रेण यूं सहः क्षित्या इति स्वयम् || 18 ||
text_mt: facing north, one should then clean the sacrificial ground / by hand with this mantra: “yūṃ sahaḥ kṣityai” oneself.

sanskrit_iast:
oṃ hrīṃ sa iti mantreṇa āśāpūraṇakena ca |
toyairabhyukṣayet sthānaṃ bhūtānāmapasāraṇe || 19 ||
meaning:
ओं ह्रीं स इति मन्त्रेण आशापूरणकेन च |
तोयैरभ्युक्षयेत् स्थानं भूतानामपसारणे || 19 ||
text_mt: With the mantra “oṃ hrīṃ saḥ”, which fulfills desires, / one should sprinkle the place with waters for driving away spirits.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ savyena hastena gṛhītvā sthaṇḍilaṃ śuciḥ |
mantraṃ likhet suvarṇena yājñikena kuśena vā || 20 ||
meaning:
ततः सव्येन हस्तेन गृहीत्वा स्थण्डिलं शुचिः |
मन्त्रं लिखेत् सुवर्णेन याज्ञिकेन कुशेन वा || 20 ||
text_mt: Then, touching the ground with the right hand, purified, / one should write the mantra with gold or with sacrificial kuśa grass:

sanskrit_iast:
oṃ vaiṣṇavyai namaḥ iti mantrarājamathāpi vā |
tatastrimaṇḍalaṃ kuryāt tenaiva samarekhayā || 21 ||
meaning:
ओं वैष्णव्यै नमः इति मन्त्रराजमथापि वा |
ततस्त्रिमण्डलं कुर्यात् तेनैव समरेखया || 21 ||
text_mt: “oṃ vaiṣṇavyai namaḥ”—or with this king of mantras. / Then one should make three circles with even lines using that [instrument].

sanskrit_iast:
nityāsu na hi pūjāsu rajobhirmaṇḍalaṃ likhet |
puraścaraṇakāryeṣu tatkāmyeṣu prayojayet || 22 ||
meaning:
नित्यासु न हि पूजासु रजोभिर्मण्डलं लिखेत् |
पुरश्चरणकार्येषु तत्काम्येषु प्रयोजयेत् || 22 ||
text_mt: In daily worship, one must not draw the maṇḍala with powders; / one should use that in preliminary rites and optional rituals.

sanskrit_iast:
rekhāmudīcyāṃ prathamaṃ paścime tadanantaram |
dakṣiṇe tu tataḥ paścāt pūrvabhāge tu śeṣataḥ || 23 ||
meaning:
रेखामुदीच्यां प्रथमं पश्चिमे तदनन्तरम् |
दक्षिणे तु ततः पश्चात् पूर्वभागे तु शेषतः || 23 ||
