text_mt: First the line in the north, immediately after in the west, / then after that in the south, and finally in the eastern direction.

sanskrit_iast:
varṇānāṃ ca sahadvārairevameva kramo bhavet |
oṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ sa iti mantreṇa maṇḍalaṃ pūjayet tataḥ || 24 ||
meaning:
वर्णानां च सहद्वारैरेवमेव क्रमो भवेत् |
ओं ह्रीं श्रीं स इति मन्त्रेण मण्डलं पूजयेत् ततः || 24 ||
text_mt: Such should be the order of the syllables along with the doors. / Then one should worship the maṇḍala with the mantra “oṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ saḥ”.

sanskrit_iast:
hastena maṇḍalaṃ kṛtvā kuryād digbandhanaṃ tataḥ |
āśābandhanamantreṇa pūrvoktena yathākramam || 25 ||
meaning:
हस्तेन मण्डलं कृत्वा कुर्याद् दिग्बन्धनं ततः |
आशाबन्धनमन्त्रेण पूर्वोक्तेन यथाक्रमम् || 25 ||
text_mt: Having made the maṇḍala by hand, one should then perform the binding of the directions / with the previously mentioned mantra for binding the directions, in due order.

sanskrit_iast:
phaḍantenātmanāpyatra kareṇaiva nibandhayet |
yavānāṃ aṇḍalairekamaṅgulaṃ cāṣṭabhirbhavet || 26 ||
meaning:
फडन्तेनात्मनाप्यत्र करेणैव निबन्धयेत् |
यवानां अण्डलैरेकमङ्गुलं चाष्टभिर्भवेत् || 26 ||
text_mt: Here one should bind oneself with [a mantra] ending in phaṭ, using the hand alone. / Eight grains of barley make one finger’s breadth.

sanskrit_iast:
adīrghayojitairhastaiscaturviṃśatiraṅgulaiḥ |
tatpramāṇena hastena hastaikaṃ tasya maṇḍalam || 27 ||
meaning:
अदीर्घयोजितैर्हस्तैस्चतुर्विंशतिरङ्गुलैः |
तत्प्रमाणेन हस्तेन हस्तैकं तस्य मण्डलम् || 27 ||
text_mt: A cubit is made of twenty-four fingers’ breadth without stretching; / by the measure of that cubit, its maṇḍala should be one cubit.

sanskrit_iast:
padmaṃ vitastimātraṃ syāt karṇikāraṃ tadardhakam |
dalānyanyonyasaktāni hyāyatāni niyojayet || 28 ||
meaning:
पद्मं वितस्तिमात्रं स्यात् कर्णिकारं तदर्धकम् |
दलान्यन्योन्यसक्तानि ह्यायतानि नियोजयेत् || 28 ||
text_mt: The lotus should be a span in size, the pericarp half of that. / One should arrange the petals joined to one another and elongated,

sanskrit_iast:
na nyūnādhikabhāgāni sabahirveṣṭitāni ca |
madhyabhāge nyased dvāraṃ na nyūne nādhike tathā |
subaddhaṃ maṇḍalaṃ tacca raktavarṇaṃ vicintayet || 29 ||
meaning:
न न्यूनाधिकभागानि सबहिर्वेष्टितानि च |
मध्यभागे न्यसेद् द्वारं न न्यूने नाधिके तथा |
सुबद्धं मण्डलं तच्च रक्तवर्णं विचिन्तयेत् || 29 ||
text_mt: with parts neither deficient nor excessive, encircled on the outside. / One should place an entrance in the middle part, neither deficient nor excessive. / One should visualize that firmly bound maṇḍala as red in colour.

sanskrit_iast:
ito'nyathā maṇḍalamugramasyāḥ
karoti yo lakṣaṇabhāgahīnam |
phalaṃ na cāpnoti na kāmamiṣṭaṃ
tasmādidaṃ maṇḍalamatra lekhyam || 30 ||
meaning:
इतोऽन्यथा मण्डलमुग्रमस्याः
करोति यो लक्षणभागहीनम् |
फलं न चाप्नोति न काममिष्टं
तस्मादिदं मण्डलमत्र लेख्यम् || 30 ||
text_mt: Whoever makes her fierce maṇḍala otherwise than this, / devoid of the proper characteristics and proportions, / gains neither fruit nor desired wish; / therefore, this maṇḍala is to be drawn here.’

sanskrit_iast:
iti śrīkālikāpurāṇe mahāmāyākalpe'ṣṭādaśapaṭale
ipañcāśattamo'dhyāyaḥ || 52 ||
tripañcāśo'dhyāyaḥ
meaning:
इति श्रीकालिकापुराणे महामायाकल्पेऽष्टादशपटले
इपञ्चाशत्तमोऽध्यायः || 52 ||
त्रिपञ्चाशोऽध्यायः
text_mt:
Thus ends the fifty-second chapter in the glorious Kālikāpurāṇa, in the eighteen-chapter ritual manual of Mahāmāyā.
Chapter fifty-three.

sanskrit_iast: śrībhagavānuvāca
meaning: श्रीभगवानुवाच

sanskrit_iast:
tato lamiti mantreṇa arghapātrasya maṇḍalam |
catuṣkoṇaṃ vidhāyāśu dvārapadmavivarjitam || 1 ||
meaning:
ततो लमिति मन्त्रेण अर्घपात्रस्य मण्डलम् |
चतुष्कोणं विधायाशु द्वारपद्मविवर्जितम् || 1 ||
text_mt: Then, having swiftly made a four-cornered maṇḍala for the argha vessel / with the mantra “laṃ”, devoid of doors and lotus,

sanskrit_iast:
oṃ hrīṃ śrīmitimantreṇa arghapātraṃ tu maṇḍale |
vinyaset prathamaṃ tatra pūjayitvā samidhyati || 2 ||
meaning:
ओं ह्रीं श्रीमितिमन्त्रेण अर्घपात्रं तु मण्डले |
विन्यसेत् प्रथमं तत्र पूजयित्वा समिध्यति || 2 ||
text_mt: one should place the argha vessel on the maṇḍala with the mantra “oṃ hrīṃ śrīm”; / having first worshipped it there, it is consecrated.

sanskrit_iast:
oṃ hrī hraumitimantreṇa gandhapuṣpe tathā jalam |
arghapātre kṣipet tatra maṇḍalaṃ vinyaset tataḥ || 3 ||
meaning:
ओं ह्री ह्रौमितिमन्त्रेण गन्धपुष्पे तथा जलम् |
अर्घपात्रे क्षिपेत् तत्र मण्डलं विन्यसेत् ततः || 3 ||
text_mt: With the mantra “oṃ hrīṃ hrauṃ”, one should throw perfume, flowers, / and water into the argha vessel; then one should lay out the maṇḍala there.

sanskrit_iast:
pūrvavanmaṇḍalaṃ kṛtvā arghapātre tato jalaiḥ |
tribhāgaiḥ pūrayet pātraṃ puṣpaṃ tatra viniḥkṣipet || 4 ||
meaning:
पूर्ववन्मण्डलं कृत्वा अर्घपात्रे ततो जलैः |
त्रिभागैः पूरयेत् पात्रं पुष्पं तत्र विनिःक्षिपेत् || 4 ||
text_mt: Having made the maṇḍala as before, one should then fill the vessel / with three parts of water in the argha vessel, and toss a flower therein.

sanskrit_iast:
tato hrīmiti mantreṇa āsanaṃ pūjayet svakam |
tataḥ kṣaumitimantreṇa ātmānaṃ pūjayed budhaḥ || 5 ||
meaning:
ततो ह्रीमिति मन्त्रेण आसनं पूजयेत् स्वकम् |
ततः क्षौमितिमन्त्रेण आत्मानं पूजयेद् बुधः || 5 ||
text_mt: Then one should worship one's seat with the mantra “hrīṃ”. / Then the wise person should worship oneself with the mantra “kṣauṃ”.

sanskrit_iast:
gandhaiḥ puṣpaiḥ śirodeśe tataḥ pūjāṃ samācaret |
oṃ hrīṃ sa iti mantreṇa puṣpaṃ hastatalasthitam || 6 ||
meaning:
गन्धैः पुष्पैः शिरोदेशे ततः पूजां समाचरेत् |
ओं ह्रीं स इति मन्त्रेण पुष्पं हस्ततलस्थितम् || 6 ||
text_mt: Then, one should perform worship upon the head with fragrant pastes and flowers. / With the mantra 'oṃ hrīṃ saḥ', the flower resting in the palm of the hand,

sanskrit_iast:
saṃmṛjya savyahastena ghrātvā vāmakareṇa tu |
aiśānyāṃ nikṣipedetat pūrvamantreṇa kovidaḥ || 7 ||
meaning:
संमृज्य सव्यहस्तेन घ्रात्वा वामकरेण तु |
ऐशान्यां निक्षिपेदेतत् पूर्वमन्त्रेण कोविदः || 7 ||
text_mt: having rubbed it with the right hand and smelled it with the left hand, / the learned one should throw it into the north-eastern direction with the preceding mantra.

sanskrit_iast:
raktaṃ puṣpaṃ gṛhītvā tu karābhyāṃ pāṇikacchapam |
baddhvā kuryāt tataḥ paścād dahanaplavanādikam || 8 ||
meaning:
रक्तं पुष्पं गृहीत्वा तु कराभ्यां पाणिकच्छपम् |
बद्ध्वा कुर्यात् ततः पश्चाद् दहनप्लवनादिकम् || 8 ||
text_mt: Taking a red flower in both hands, / forming the turtle-hand gesture, he should then perform the burning and inundation, and the rest.

sanskrit_iast:
vāmahastasya tarjanyāṃ dakṣiṇasya kaniṣṭhikām |
tathā dakṣiṇatarjanyāṃ vāmāṅguṣṭhaṃ niyojayet || 9 ||
meaning:
वामहस्तस्य तर्जन्यां दक्षिणस्य कनिष्ठिकाम् |
तथा दक्षिणतर्जन्यां वामाङ्गुष्ठं नियोजयेत् || 9 ||
text_mt: One should place the little finger of the right hand on the forefinger of the left hand, / and similarly place the left thumb on the right forefinger.

sanskrit_iast:
unnataṃ dakṣiṇāṅguṣṭhaṃ vāmasya madhyamādikāḥ |
aṅgulīryojayet pṛṣṭhe dakṣiṇasya karasya ca || 10 ||
meaning:
उन्नतं दक्षिणाङ्गुष्ठं वामस्य मध्यमादिकाः |
अङ्गुलीर्योजयेत् पृष्ठे दक्षिणस्य करस्य च || 10 ||
text_mt: Keeping the right thumb raised, one should place the middle and other fingers of the left hand / on the back of the right hand.

sanskrit_iast:
vāmasya pitṛtīrthena madhyamānāmike tathā |
adhomukhe tu te kuryād dakṣiṇasya karasya ca || 11 ||
meaning:
वामस्य पितृतीर्थेन मध्यमानामिके तथा |
अधोमुखे तु ते कुर्याद् दक्षिणस्य करस्य च || 11 ||
text_mt: With the pitṛtīrtha of the left hand, one should turn down / the middle and ring fingers of the right hand.

sanskrit_iast:
kūrmapṛṣṭhasamaṃ pṛṣṭhaṃ kuryād dakṣiṇahastataḥ |
evaṃ baddhaḥ sarvasiddhiṃ dadāti pāṇikacchapaḥ || 12 ||
meaning:
कूर्मपृष्ठसमं पृष्ठं कुर्याद् दक्षिणहस्ततः |
एवं बद्धः सर्वसिद्धिं ददाति पाणिकच्छपः || 12 ||
text_mt: With the right hand, one should make the back resemble the back of a tortoise; / formed in this way, the turtle-hand gesture bestows all magical accomplishments.

sanskrit_iast:
kuryāt taddhṛdayāsannaṃ nimīlya nayanadvayam |
samaṃ kāyaśirogrīvaṃ kṛtvā sthiramanā budhaḥ || 13 ||
meaning:
कुर्यात् तद्धृदयासन्नं निमील्य नयनद्वयम् |
समं कायशिरोग्रीवं कृत्वा स्थिरमना बुधः || 13 ||
text_mt: The wise one, bringing it near the heart, closing both eyes, / keeping body, head, and neck aligned, with a steady mind,

sanskrit_iast:
dhyānaṃ samārabhed devyā dāhaplavanapūrvakam |
agniṃ vāyau vinikṣipya vāyuṃ toye jalaṃ hṛdi || 14 ||
meaning:
ध्यानं समारभेद् देव्या दाहप्लवनपूर्वकम् |
अग्निं वायौ विनिक्षिप्य वायुं तोये जलं हृदि || 14 ||
text_mt: should begin the meditation on the Goddess, preceded by burning and inundation. / Having dissolved fire into wind, wind into water, and water in the heart,

sanskrit_iast:
hṛdayaṃ niścale dattvā ākāśe nikṣipetsvanam |
oṃ hūṃ phaḍiti mantreṇa bhittvā randhraṃ tu mastake || 15 ||
meaning:
हृदयं निश्चले दत्त्वा आकाशे निक्षिपेत्स्वनम् |
ओं हूं फडिति मन्त्रेण भित्त्वा रन्ध्रं तु मस्तके || 15 ||
text_mt: placing the heart in the motionless [element], he should project sound into space. / Having pierced the aperture in the head with the mantra 'oṃ hūṃ phaṭ',

sanskrit_iast:
śabdena sahitaṃ jīvamākāśe sthāpayet tataḥ |
vāyvagniyamaśakrāṇāṃ bījena varuṇasya ca || 16 ||
meaning:
शब्देन सहितं जीवमाकाशे स्थापयेत् ततः |
वाय्वग्नियमशक्राणां बीजेन वरुणस्य च || 16 ||
text_mt: he should then establish the individual soul, accompanied by sound, in space. / With the seed-syllables of wind, fire, Yama, Śakra, and Varuṇa,

sanskrit_iast:
parāsthānaparāścaitaiḥ sārdhacandraiḥ sabindukaiḥ |
śoṣaṃ dāhaṃ tathocchādaṃ pīyūṣāsevanaṃ param || 17 ||
meaning:
परास्थानपराश्चैतैः सार्धचन्द्रैः सबिन्दुकैः |
शोषं दाहं तथोच्छादं पीयूषासेवनं परम् || 17 ||
text_mt: which are the supreme abode of the highest [realities], endowed with the crescent moon and the dot, / desiccation, burning, eradication, and the supreme imbibing of nectar

sanskrit_iast: yathākrameṇa kartavyaṃ cintāmātraṃ viśuddhaye |
meaning: यथाक्रमेण कर्तव्यं चिन्तामात्रं विशुद्धये |
text_mt: are to be performed in proper order, purely by visualization, for the sake of purification.

sanskrit_iast: tatastu devībījena aṇuṃ jāmbūnadākṛtim || 18 ||
meaning: ततस्तु देवीबीजेन अणुं जाम्बूनदाकृतिम् || 18 ||
text_mt: Then, through the Goddess's seed-syllable, [visualizing] an atom resembling jambūnada gold,

sanskrit_iast:
tatrāsādya dvidhā kuryāt um hrīṃ śrīmiti mantrakāḥ |
tadūrdhvabhāgeṣu hṛdlokaṃ svargaṃ ca khaṃ tathā || 19 ||
meaning:
तत्रासाद्य द्विधा कुर्यात् उम् ह्रीं श्रीमिति मन्त्रकाः |
तदूर्ध्वभागेषु हृद्लोकं स्वर्गं च खं तथा || 19 ||
text_mt: reaching there, he should divide it into two parts with the mantras 'oṃ hrīṃ śrīm'. / In the upper portions thereof, [he visualizes] the realm of the heart, heaven, and space;

sanskrit_iast:
niṣpādya śeṣabhāgena bhuvaṃ pātālavāriṇi |
cintayettatra sarvāṇi saptadvīpāṃ ca medinīm || 20 ||
meaning:
निष्पाद्य शेषभागेन भुवं पातालवारिणि |
चिन्तयेत्तत्र सर्वाणि सप्तद्वीपां च मेदिनीम् || 20 ||
text_mt: having produced them, with the remaining portion [he visualizes] the earth upon the waters of the netherworld. / There he should visualize all things, and the earth with its seven continents;

sanskrit_iast:
tatteṣu sāgarāṃstāṃstu svarṇadvīpaṃ vicintayet |
tanmadhye ratnapayaṅka ratnamaṇḍapasaṃsthitam || 21 ||
meaning:
तत्तेषु सागरांस्तांस्तु स्वर्णद्वीपं विचिन्तयेत् |
तन्मध्ये रत्नपयङ्क रत्नमण्डपसंस्थितम् || 21 ||
text_mt: and among them, the oceans, and he should contemplate the Golden Island. / In its center, situated within a jewel pavilion, a jewel couch,

sanskrit_iast:
ākāśagaṅgātoyodhaiḥ sadaiva sevitaṃ śubham |
tatparyaṅke raktapadmaṃ prasannaṃ sarvadāśivam || 22 ||
meaning:
आकाशगङ्गातोयोधैः सदैव सेवितं शुभम् |
तत्पर्यङ्के रक्तपद्मं प्रसन्नं सर्वदाशिवम् || 22 ||
text_mt: auspicious, ever attended by floods of water from the heavenly Gaṅgā. / On that couch, a red lotus, placid and ever auspicious,

sanskrit_iast:
cintayet svarṇamānāṅkaṃ saptapātālanālakam |
ābrahmabhuvanasparśi uvarṇācalakarṇikam || 23 ||
meaning:
चिन्तयेत् स्वर्णमानाङ्कं सप्तपातालनालकम् |
आब्रह्मभुवनस्पर्शि उवर्णाचलकर्णिकम् || 23 ||
text_mt: he should visualize, marked with the measure of gold, having the seven netherworlds as its stalk, / reaching up to the world of Brahmā, with a pericarp like the Golden Mountain.

sanskrit_iast:
tatrasthitāṃ mahāmāyāṃ dhyāyedekāgramānasaḥ |
śoṇapadmapratīkāśāṃ muktamūrdhajalambinīṃ || 24 ||
meaning:
तत्रस्थितां महामायां ध्यायेदेकाग्रमानसः |
शोणपद्मप्रतीकाशां मुक्तमूर्धजलम्बिनीं || 24 ||
text_mt: With one-pointed mind he should meditate upon Mahāmāyā seated there: / resembling a red lotus, her loosened hair hanging down,

sanskrit_iast:
calatkāñcanāmāruhya kuṇḍalojjvalaśālinīm |
suvarṇaratnasampanna kirīṭavayadhāriṇīm || 25 ||
meaning:
चलत्काञ्चनामारुह्य कुण्डलोज्ज्वलशालिनीम् |
सुवर्णरत्नसम्पन्न किरीटवयधारिणीम् || 25 ||
text_mt: mounted upon a moving golden [seat], shining with brilliant earrings, / wearing a diadem adorned with gold and jewels,

sanskrit_iast:
śuklakṛṣṇāruṇairnetraistribhiścāruvibhūṣitām |
sandhyācandrasamaprakhya-kapolāṃ lolalocanām || 26 ||
meaning:
शुक्लकृष्णारुणैर्नेत्रैस्त्रिभिश्चारुविभूषिताम् |
सन्ध्याचन्द्रसमप्रख्य-कपोलां लोललोचनाम् || 26 ||
text_mt: handsomely adorned with three eyes—white, black, and crimson— / with cheeks radiant like the evening moon, and rolling eyes,

sanskrit_iast:
vipakvāaḍimībījadantān subhrūogojjvalām |
bandhūkadantavasanāṃ śirīṣaprabhanāsikām || 27 ||
meaning:
विपक्वाअडिमीबीजदन्तान् सुभ्रूओगोज्ज्वलाम् |
बन्धूकदन्तवसनां शिरीषप्रभनासिकाम् || 27 ||
text_mt: with teeth like ripe pomegranate seeds, radiant with beautiful eyebrows, / whose lips are like bandhūka blossoms, whose nose has the splendor of a śirīṣa flower,

sanskrit_iast:
kambugrīvāṃ viśālākṣīṃ sūryakoṭisamaprabhām |
caturbhujā vivasanāṃ pīnonnatapayodharām || 28 ||
meaning:
कम्बुग्रीवां विशालाक्षीं सूर्यकोटिसमप्रभाम् |
चतुर्भुजा विवसनां पीनोन्नतपयोधराम् || 28 ||
text_mt: conch-necked, large-eyed, possessing the brilliance of ten million suns, / four-armed, unclothed, with full, elevated breasts,

sanskrit_iast:
dakṣiṇordhvena nistriṃśatpareṇa siddhasūtrakam |
bibhratīṃ vāmahastābhyāmabhītiṃ varadāyinīm || 29 ||
meaning:
दक्षिणोर्ध्वेन निस्त्रिंशत्परेण सिद्धसूत्रकम् |
बिभ्रतीं वामहस्ताभ्यामभीतिं वरदायिनीम् || 29 ||
text_mt: bearing a sword with the upper right hand and a rosary with the other, / and granting fearlessness and boons with the two left hands,

sanskrit_iast:
nimnābhiramāyātāṃ kṣīṇamadhyāṃ manoharām |
ānamannāgapāśorūṃ guptagulphāṃ supārṣṇikām || 30 ||
meaning:
निम्नाभिरमायातां क्षीणमध्यां मनोहराम् |
आनमन्नागपाशोरूं गुप्तगुल्फां सुपार्ष्णिकाम् || 30 ||
text_mt: charming with a deep navel, slender-waisted, captivating, / thighs sloping like an elephant's trunk, hidden ankles, and beautiful heels,

sanskrit_iast:
baddhaparyaṅkasaṅkalpāṃ nivīrāsanarājitām |
gātreṇa ratnasaṃstambhaṃ samyagālambya saṃsthitām || 31 ||
meaning:
बद्धपर्यङ्कसङ्कल्पां निवीरासनराजिताम् |
गात्रेण रत्नसंस्तम्भं सम्यगालम्ब्य संस्थिताम् || 31 ||
text_mt: assuming the firm cross-legged posture, resplendent in the heroic seated posture, / seated while firmly leaning against a jewel pillar with her body,

sanskrit_iast:
kimicchasīti vacanaṃ vyāharantīṃ muhurmuhuḥ |
pancānanaṃ puraḥsaṃsthaṃ nirīkṣantīṃ suvāhanam || 32 ||
meaning:
किमिच्छसीति वचनं व्याहरन्तीं मुहुर्मुहुः |
पन्चाननं पुरःसंस्थं निरीक्षन्तीं सुवाहनम् || 32 ||
text_mt: uttering again and again the words, 'What do you desire?' / gazing upon the five-faced one standing in front, her excellent mount,

sanskrit_iast:
muktāvalī svarṇaratnahāakaṅkaṇādibhiḥ |
sarvairalaṅkāragaṇairujjvalāṃ sasmitānanām || 33 ||
meaning:
मुक्तावली स्वर्णरत्नहाअकङ्कणादिभिः |
सर्वैरलङ्कारगणैरुज्ज्वलां सस्मिताननाम् || 33 ||
text_mt: radiant with all varieties of ornaments—strings of pearls, necklaces of gold and gems, bracelets, and the like— / with a smiling face,

sanskrit_iast:
sūryakoṭipratīkāśāṃ sarvalakṣaṇasaṃyutām |
navayauvanasampannāṃ tathā sarvāṅgasundarīm || 34 ||
meaning:
सूर्यकोटिप्रतीकाशां सर्वलक्षणसंयुताम् |
नवयौवनसम्पन्नां तथा सर्वाङ्गसुन्दरीम् || 34 ||
text_mt: resembling ten million suns, endowed with all auspicious marks, / possessed of youthful beauty, and lovely in every limb.

sanskrit_iast:
īdṛśīmambikāṃ dhyātvā namaḥ phaḍiti mastake |
svakīye prathamaṃ dadyāt sā'hameva vicintya ca || 35 ||
meaning:
ईदृशीमम्बिकां ध्यात्वा नमः फडिति मस्तके |
स्वकीये प्रथमं दद्यात् साऽहमेव विचिन्त्य च || 35 ||
text_mt: Having meditated upon Ambikā in this way, thinking 'I am indeed She', / one should first place [the mantra] 'namaḥ phaṭ' upon one's own head.

sanskrit_iast:
aṅganyāsakaranyāsau tataḥ kuryāt krameṇa ca |
ebhirmantraiḥ svaraiḥ aha sṛmīsūmaiḥ kramānvitaiḥ || 36 ||
meaning:
अङ्गन्यासकरन्यासौ ततः कुर्यात् क्रमेण च |
एभिर्मन्त्रैः स्वरैः अह सृमीसूमैः क्रमान्वितैः || 36 ||
text_mt: Then one should perform the placement on the limbs and the hands in proper order, / with these mantras, with the vowels [...] in successive sequence,

sanskrit_iast:
om kṣaum caite sapraṇavāṃ raktavarṇā manoharām |
aṅguṣṭhādikaniṣṭhāntamantrasaṃbeṣṭanaṃ phaṭ || 37 ||
meaning:
ओम् क्षौम् चैते सप्रणवां रक्तवर्णा मनोहराम् |
अङ्गुष्ठादिकनिष्ठान्तमन्त्रसंबेष्टनं फट् || 37 ||
text_mt: and with 'oṃ kṣauṃ', accompanied by the praṇava, red-colored, captivating; / the enveloping of the mantras from the thumb to the little finger with 'phaṭ'.

sanskrit_iast:
prāntena kuryād vinyāsaṃ pūrvaṃ karataladvaye |
hṛcchiraḥśikhākavacanetreṣu ramato nyaset || 38 ||
meaning:
प्रान्तेन कुर्याद् विन्यासं पूर्वं करतलद्वये |
हृच्छिरःशिखाकवचनेत्रेषु रमतो न्यसेत् || 38 ||
text_mt: One should first make the placement on both palms, ending [with phaṭ]; / then one should deposit them in order upon the heart, head, tuft, armor, and eyes.

sanskrit_iast:
tatastu mūlamantrasya vaktre pṛṣṭhe tathodare |
bāhvorguhye pādayośca jaṅghayorjaghane kramāt || 39 ||
meaning:
ततस्तु मूलमन्त्रस्य वक्त्रे पृष्ठे तथोदरे |
बाह्वोर्गुह्ये पादयोश्च जङ्घयोर्जघने क्रमात् || 39 ||
text_mt: Then, one should deposit the eight syllables of the root mantra in order / on the face, the back, also the abdomen, the two arms, the private parts, the two feet, the calves, and the hips,

sanskrit_iast:
vinyasedakṣarāṇyaṣṭau oṃkāraṃ ca tathā smaran |
ebhiḥ prakārairatisuddhadehaḥ pūjāṃ sadaivārhati nānyathā hi |
śarīraśuddhiṃ manaso niveśaṃ bhūtaprasāraṃ kurute nṛṇāṃ tat || 40 ||
meaning:
विन्यसेदक्षराण्यष्टौ ओंकारं च तथा स्मरन् |
एभिः प्रकारैरतिसुद्धदेहः पूजां सदैवार्हति नान्यथा हि |
शरीरशुद्धिं मनसो निवेशं भूतप्रसारं कुरुते नृणां तत् || 40 ||
text_mt: while likewise calling to mind the syllable Oṃ. / A man whose body is made utterly pure by these methods is always worthy of worship, never otherwise; / for that effects the purification of the body, concentration of the mind, and the expansion of the elements.

sanskrit_iast:
iti śrīkālikāpurāṇe mahāmāyākalpe ripañcāśo'dhyāyaḥ || 53 ||
catuḥpañcāśo'dhyāyaḥ
meaning:
इति श्रीकालिकापुराणे महामायाकल्पे रिपञ्चाशोऽध्यायः || 53 ||
चतुःपञ्चाशोऽध्यायः
text_mt: Thus ends the fifty-third chapter in the glorious Kālikāpurāṇa, in the rite of Mahāmāyā. / The fifty-fourth chapter.

sanskrit_iast: śrībhagavānuvāca
meaning: श्रीभगवानुवाच

sanskrit_iast:
tato'rghapātre tanmantramaṣṭadhākṛtya sañjajapet |
tena toyāni puṣpāṇi svaṃ maṇḍalamathāsanam || 1 ||
meaning:
ततोऽर्घपात्रे तन्मन्त्रमष्टधाकृत्य सञ्जजपेत् |
तेन तोयानि पुष्पाणि स्वं मण्डलमथासनम् || 1 ||
text_mt: Then, having divided that mantra into eight parts, he should recite it over the argha-vessel. / With that [water], the waters, flowers, his own maṇḍala, and seat

sanskrit_iast:
āśodhayet tataḥ paścāt pūjopakaraṇaṃ samam |
oṃ aiṃ hrīṃ hrauṃiti mantreṇa śabdaprāṃśuvivarjitam || 2 ||
meaning:
आशोधयेत् ततः पश्चात् पूजोपकरणं समम् |
ओं ऐं ह्रीं ह्रौंइति मन्त्रेण शब्दप्रांशुविवर्जितम् || 2 ||
text_mt: he should thoroughly purify; and after that, all the implements of worship together, / with the mantra 'oṃ aiṃ hrīṃ hrauṃ', avoiding loud sound.

sanskrit_iast:
dvārapālaṃ tato devyā āsanāni ca pūjayet |
nandibhṛṅgimahākālagaṇeśā dvārapālakāḥ |
uttarādikramāt pūjyā āsanāni ca madhyataḥ || 3 ||
meaning:
द्वारपालं ततो देव्या आसनानि च पूजयेत् |
नन्दिभृङ्गिमहाकालगणेशा द्वारपालकाः |
उत्तरादिक्रमात् पूज्या आसनानि च मध्यतः || 3 ||
text_mt: Then one should worship the doorkeepers of the Goddess and the seats: / Nandin, Bhṛṅgin, Mahākāla, and Gaṇeśa are the doorkeepers, / to be worshipped in order starting from the north, and the seats in the center.

sanskrit_iast:
ādhāraśaktiprabhṛti emādyantāt prapūjayet |
prasiddhān sarvatantreṣu pūjākalpeṣu bhairava || 4 ||
meaning:
आधारशक्तिप्रभृति एमाद्यन्तात् प्रपूजयेत् |
प्रसिद्धान् सर्वतन्त्रेषु पूजाकल्पेषु भैरव || 4 ||
text_mt: One should worship from the foundation-power onwards up to the end of [...], / which are renowned in all tantras and ritual handbooks of worship, O Bhairava,

sanskrit_iast:
daśadikpālasahitān dharmādharmādikāṃstathā |
maṇḍalāgnyādikoṇeṣu pūjayet pārśvadeśataḥ || 5 ||
meaning:
दशदिक्पालसहितान् धर्माधर्मादिकांस्तथा |
मण्डलाग्न्यादिकोणेषु पूजयेत् पार्श्वदेशतः || 5 ||
text_mt: along with the guardians of the ten directions, as well as righteousness, unrighteousness, and the rest; / one should worship them on the sides in the corners of the maṇḍala, beginning with the south-east.

sanskrit_iast:
sūryāgnisomamarutāṃ maṇḍalāni ca padmakam |
rajastathā tamaḥ sattvaṃ yogapīṭhaṃ guroḥ padam || 6 ||
meaning:
सूर्याग्निसोममरुतां मण्डलानि च पद्मकम् |
रजस्तथा तमः सत्त्वं योगपीठं गुरोः पदम् || 6 ||
text_mt: The discs of the sun, fire, moon, and winds, and the lotus, / the qualities of rajas, tamas, and sattva, the yogic throne, and the seat of the Guru,

sanskrit_iast:
sārādīn bhadrapīṭhāntān sāṅgopāṅgān prapūjayet |
brahmāṇḍaṃ svarṇaḍimbaṃ ca brahmaviṣṇumaheśvarān || 7 ||
meaning:
सारादीन् भद्रपीठान्तान् साङ्गोपाङ्गान् प्रपूजयेत् |
ब्रह्माण्डं स्वर्णडिम्बं च ब्रह्मविष्णुमहेश्वरान् || 7 ||
text_mt: beginning with Sāra and ending with the auspicious seat, along with their primary and secondary limbs, one should worship: / the cosmic egg and the golden womb, Brahmā, Viṣṇu, and Maheśvara,

sanskrit_iast:
sasāgarān saptadvīpān svarṇadvīpaṃ samaṇḍapam |
ratnapadmaṃ saparyaṅkaṃ ratnastambhaṃ tathaiva ca || 8 ||
meaning:
ससागरान् सप्तद्वीपान् स्वर्णद्वीपं समण्डपम् |
रत्नपद्मं सपर्यङ्कं रत्नस्तम्भं तथैव च || 8 ||
text_mt: the seven continents along with the oceans, the Golden Island along with its pavilion, / the jewel lotus along with the couch, and likewise the jewel pillar.

sanskrit_iast:
pañcānanaṃ maṇḍalasya madhye'vaśyaṃ prapūjayet |
rīṃ mantreṇa tataḥ kūrmapṛṣṭhaṃ pāṇyornibadhya ca || 9 ||
meaning:
पञ्चाननं मण्डलस्य मध्येऽवश्यं प्रपूजयेत् |
रीं मन्त्रेण ततः कूर्मपृष्ठं पाण्योर्निबध्य च || 9 ||
text_mt: One must by all means worship the five-faced [Śiva] in the center of the maṇḍala. / Then, having formed the turtle-back [mudrā] with the hands with the mantra rīṃ,

sanskrit_iast:
dhyāyecca pūrvavad devīmāsādyāsanamuttamam |
hṛnmadhye cintayet svarṇadvīpaṃ paryaṅkasambhṛtam || 10 ||
meaning:
ध्यायेच्च पूर्ववद् देवीमासाद्यासनमुत्तमम् |
हृन्मध्ये चिन्तयेत् स्वर्णद्वीपं पर्यङ्कसम्भृतम् || 10 ||
text_mt: having reached the excellent seat, one should meditate on the Goddess as before. / In the center of the heart, one should visualize a golden island provided with a couch.

sanskrit_iast:
paśyanniva tato devīmekāgramanasā smaret |
pratyakṣīkṛtya hṛdaye mānasairupacārakaiḥ || 11 ||
meaning:
पश्यन्निव ततो देवीमेकाग्रमनसा स्मरेत् |
प्रत्यक्षीकृत्य हृदये मानसैरुपचारकैः || 11 ||
text_mt: Then, as if seeing [Her], one should remember the Goddess with a one-pointed mind. / Having made [Her] directly manifest in the heart, with mental offerings,

sanskrit_iast: soḍaśānāṃ prakāraistu hṛdisthāṃ pūjayecchivām |
meaning: सोडशानां प्रकारैस्तु हृदिस्थां पूजयेच्छिवाम् |
text_mt: with sixteen kinds of [offerings] indeed, one should worship Śivā who resides in the heart.

sanskrit_iast: tatastu vāyubījena dakṣiṇe ca puṭena ca || 12 ||
meaning: ततस्तु वायुबीजेन दक्षिणे च पुटेन च || 12 ||
text_mt: Then, with the wind seed-syllable and through the right nostril,

sanskrit_iast:
nāsikāyā viniḥsārya krīṃ mantreṇa ca bhairava |
sthāpayet padmamadhye tu taddhastaṃ na viyojayet || 13 ||
meaning:
नासिकाया विनिःसार्य क्रीं मन्त्रेण च भैरव |
स्थापयेत् पद्ममध्ये तु तद्धस्तं न वियोजयेत् || 13 ||
text_mt: bringing [Her] out of the nose with the mantra krīṃ, O Bhairava, / one should install [Her] in the center of the lotus, and one must not remove that hand.

sanskrit_iast:
kṛte viyoge hastasya puṣpāt tasmācca bhairava |
gandharvaiḥ pūjyate devī pūjakairnāpyate phalam || 14 ||
meaning:
कृते वियोगे हस्तस्य पुष्पात् तस्माच्च भैरव |
गन्धर्वैः पूज्यते देवी पूजकैर्नाप्यते फलम् || 14 ||
text_mt: If the hand is removed from that flower, O Bhairava, / the Goddess is worshipped by the Gandharvas, and the fruit is not attained by the worshippers.

sanskrit_iast:
āvāhanaṃ tataḥ kuryād gāyatryā śirasā saha |
mahāmāyāyai vidmahe tvāṃ caṇḍikākhyāṃ dhīmahi || 15 ||
meaning:
आवाहनं ततः कुर्याद् गायत्र्या शिरसा सह |
महामायायै विद्महे त्वां चण्डिकाख्यां धीमहि || 15 ||
text_mt: Then one should perform the invocation with the Gāyatrī together with the head: / “We know Mahāmāyā; we meditate on You who are called Caṇḍikā;

sanskrit_iast:
taduktvā tataḥ paścād dhiyo yo naḥ pracodayāt |
snānīyaṃ devi te tubhyaṃ oṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ nama ityataḥ || 16 ||
meaning:
तदुक्त्वा ततः पश्चाद् धियो यो नः प्रचोदयात् |
स्नानीयं देवि ते तुभ्यं ओं ह्रीं श्रीं नम इत्यतः || 16 ||
text_mt: having uttered that, then afterwards: “may [She] inspire our thoughts.” / “Bath water for You, O Goddess; oṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ namaḥ” — after this,

sanskrit_iast:
snānīyaṃ ca tato devyai dadyāllakṣaṇalakṣitam |
tatastu mūlamantreṇa gandhapuṣpaṃ sadīpakam || 17 ||
meaning:
स्नानीयं च ततो देव्यै दद्याल्लक्षणलक्षितम् |
ततस्तु मूलमन्त्रेण गन्धपुष्पं सदीपकम् || 17 ||
text_mt: one should then give bath water marked with its characteristics to the Goddess. / Then, with the root-mantra, perfume and flowers together with a lamp,

sanskrit_iast:
dhūpādikaṃ pradadyāt tu modakaṃ pāyasaṃ tathā |
sitāṃ guḍaṃ dadhi-kṣīraṃ sarpirnānāvidhaiḥ phalaiḥ || 18 ||
meaning:
धूपादिकं प्रदद्यात् तु मोदकं पायसं तथा |
सितां गुडं दधि-क्षीरं सर्पिर्नानाविधैः फलैः || 18 ||
text_mt: one should indeed offer incense and the rest, sweetmeat and rice pudding as well, / white sugar, jaggery, curd, milk, and clarified butter, along with various fruits,

sanskrit_iast:
raktapuṣpaṃ puṣpamālāṃ suvarṇarajatādikam |
naivedyamuttamaṃ devyā lāṅgalaṃ modakaṃ sitām || 19 ||
meaning:
रक्तपुष्पं पुष्पमालां सुवर्णरजतादिकम् |
नैवेद्यमुत्तमं देव्या लाङ्गलं मोदकं सिताम् || 19 ||
text_mt: red flowers, a flower garland, gold, silver, and the like. / An excellent food-offering for the Goddess: lāṅgala, sweetmeat, white sugar,

sanskrit_iast:
śāṇḍilyakaratāmrākhya-kūṣmāṇḍānāṃ phalāni ca |
harītakīphalaṃ cāpi nāgaraṅgakamelakam || 20 ||
meaning:
शाण्डिल्यकरताम्राख्य-कूष्माण्डानां फलानि च |
हरीतकीफलं चापि नागरङ्गकमेलकम् || 20 ||
text_mt: fruits of pumpkin called śāṇḍilyaka and ratatāmra, / myrobalan fruit as well, orange, and kamelaka,

sanskrit_iast:
bālapriyaṃ ca yad dravyaṃ kaserukabisādikam |
toyaṃ ca nārikelasya devyai deyaṃ prayatnataḥ || 21 ||
meaning:
बालप्रियं च यद् द्रव्यं कसेरुकबिसादिकम् |
तोयं च नारिकेलस्य देव्यै देयं प्रयत्नतः || 21 ||
text_mt: and whatever substance is dear to children, such as kaseruka, lotus fibers, and the like, / and coconut water must be offered to the Goddess with effort.

sanskrit_iast:
raktaṃ kauśeyavastaṃ ca deyaṃ nīlaṃ kadāpi na |
devyāḥ priyāṇi puṣpāṇi bakulaṃ keśaraṃ tathā || 22 ||
meaning:
रक्तं कौशेयवस्तं च देयं नीलं कदापि न |
देव्याः प्रियाणि पुष्पाणि बकुलं केशरं तथा || 22 ||
text_mt: Red silk cloth is to be offered, and blue never. / The flowers dear to the Goddess: bakula and keśara,

sanskrit_iast:
mādhyaṃ kahlāravajrāṇi karavīrakuruṇṭakān |
arkapuṣpaṃ śālmalakaṃdūrvāṅkuraṃ sukomalam || 23 ||
meaning:
माध्यं कह्लारवज्राणि करवीरकुरुण्टकान् |
अर्कपुष्पं शाल्मलकंदूर्वाङ्कुरं सुकोमलम् || 23 ||
text_mt: mādhya, kahlāra, vajra, karavīra, and kuruṇṭaka, / arka flower, śālmalaka, and very tender dūrvā grass shoots,

sanskrit_iast:
kuśamañjarikā darbhā bandhūkakamale tathā |
mālūrapatraṃ puṣpaṃca trisandhyāraktaparṇake || 24 ||
meaning:
कुशमञ्जरिका दर्भा बन्धूककमले तथा |
मालूरपत्रं पुष्पंच त्रिसन्ध्यारक्तपर्णके || 24 ||
text_mt: kuśa sprouts, darbha grass, bandhūka, and lotus as well, / bilva leaves, flowers, and the red petals of trisandhyā.

sanskrit_iast: sumanāṃsi priyāṇyetānyambikāyāśca bhairava |
meaning: सुमनांसि प्रियाण्येतान्यम्बिकायाश्च भैरव |
text_mt: These flowers are dear to Ambikā, O Bhairava:

sanskrit_iast: bandhūkaṃ bakulaṃ mādhyaṃ bilvapatrāṇi sandhyakam || 25 ||
meaning: बन्धूकं बकुलं माध्यं बिल्वपत्राणि सन्ध्यकम् || 25 ||
text_mt: bandhūka, bakula, mādhya, bilva leaves, sandhyaka.

sanskrit_iast:
uttamaṃ sarvapuṣpeṣu dravye pāyasamodakau |
mālyaṃ bandhūkapuṣpasya śivāyai bakulasya vā || 26 ||
meaning:
उत्तमं सर्वपुष्पेषु द्रव्ये पायसमोदकौ |
माल्यं बन्धूकपुष्पस्य शिवायै बकुलस्य वा || 26 ||
text_mt: The best among all flowers, and among food offerings, rice pudding and sweetmeat. / A garland of bandhūka flowers for Śivā, or of bakula,

sanskrit_iast:
karavīrasya mādhyasya sahasrāṇāṃ dadāti yaḥ |
sa kāmān prāpya cābhīṣṭān mama loke pramodate || 27 ||
meaning:
करवीरस्य माध्यस्य सहस्राणां ददाति यः |
स कामान् प्राप्य चाभीष्टान् मम लोके प्रमोदते || 27 ||
text_mt: of karavīra, or of mādhya: he who offers thousands [of these] / attains his desired wishes and rejoices in my world.

sanskrit_iast:
candanaṃ śītalaṃ caiva kālīyakasamanvitam |
anulepanamukhyaṃ tu devyai dadyāt prayatnataḥ || 28 ||
meaning:
चन्दनं शीतलं चैव कालीयकसमन्वितम् |
अनुलेपनमुख्यं तु देव्यै दद्यात् प्रयत्नतः || 28 ||
text_mt: Cool sandalwood combined with yellow sandalwood / is the chief ointment; one should give it to the Goddess with effort.

sanskrit_iast:
karpūraṃ kuṅkumaṃ kūrcaṃ mṛganābhiṃ sugandhikam |
kālīyakaṃ sugandheṣu devyāḥ prītikaraṃ param || 29 ||
meaning:
कर्पूरं कुङ्कुमं कूर्चं मृगनाभिं सुगन्धिकम् |
कालीयकं सुगन्धेषु देव्याः प्रीतिकरं परम् || 29 ||
text_mt: Camphor, saffron, kūrca, fragrant musk, / and yellow sandalwood are among the perfumes that bring supreme delight to the Goddess.

sanskrit_iast:
yakṣadhūpaḥ pratīvāhaḥ piṇḍadhūpaḥ sagolakaḥ |
aguruḥ sindhuvāraśca dhūpāḥ prītikarā matāḥ || 30 ||
meaning:
यक्षधूपः प्रतीवाहः पिण्डधूपः सगोलकः |
अगुरुः सिन्धुवारश्च धूपाः प्रीतिकरा मताः || 30 ||
text_mt: Yakṣa incense, pratīvāha, lump-incense with balls, / agallochum, and sindhuvāra are considered pleasing incenses.

sanskrit_iast:
aṅgarāgeṣu sindūraṃ devyāḥ prītikaraṃ param |
sugandhi śālijaṃ cānnaṃ madhumāṃsasamanvitam || 31 ||
meaning:
अङ्गरागेषु सिन्दूरं देव्याः प्रीतिकरं परम् |
सुगन्धि शालिजं चान्नं मधुमांससमन्वितम् || 31 ||
text_mt: Among cosmetics, vermilion brings supreme delight to the Goddess. / Fragrant rice-food made of śāli grain, combined with honey and meat,

sanskrit_iast:
apūpaṃ pāyasaṃ kṣīramannaṃ devyāḥ praśasyate |
ratnodakaṃ sakarpūraṃ piṇḍītakakumārakau || 32 ||
meaning:
अपूपं पायसं क्षीरमन्नं देव्याः प्रशस्यते |
रत्नोदकं सकर्पूरं पिण्डीतककुमारकौ || 32 ||
text_mt: cake, rice pudding, and milk-rice are praised for the Goddess. / Water with gems accompanied by camphor, piṇḍītaka, and kumāraka,

sanskrit_iast:
rocanaṃ puṣpakaṃ devyāḥ snānīyaṃ parikīrtitam |
ghṛtapradīpo dīpeṣu praśastaḥ parikīrtitaḥ || 33 ||
meaning:
रोचनं पुष्पकं देव्याः स्नानीयं परिकीर्तितम् |
घृतप्रदीपो दीपेषु प्रशस्तः परिकीर्तितः || 33 ||
text_mt: rocana, and puṣpaka are declared to be the bath water for the Goddess. / A ghee lamp is declared to be the most praised among lamps.

sanskrit_iast:
puṣpāñjalitrayaṃ dadyād mūlamantreṇa śobhanam |
dattvopacārānakhilānmadhye caitāḥ prapūjayet || 34 ||
meaning:
पुष्पाञ्जलित्रयं दद्याद् मूलमन्त्रेण शोभनम् |
दत्त्वोपचारानखिलान्मध्ये चैताः प्रपूजयेत् || 34 ||
text_mt: One should offer three beautiful handfuls of flowers with the root-mantra. / Having given all the offerings, one should worship these [deities] in the center:

sanskrit_iast:
kāmeśvarīṃ guptadurgāṃ vindhyakandaravāsinīm |
koṭeśvarīṃ dīrghikākhyāṃ prakaṭīṃ bhuvaneśvarīm || 35 ||
meaning:
कामेश्वरीं गुप्तदुर्गां विन्ध्यकन्दरवासिनीम् |
कोटेश्वरीं दीर्घिकाख्यां प्रकटीं भुवनेश्वरीम् || 35 ||
text_mt: Kāmeśvarī, Guptadurgā, Vindhyakandaravāsinī, / Koṭeśvarī, Dīrghikā, the manifest Bhuvaneśvarī,

sanskrit_iast:
ākāśagaṅgāṃ kāmākhyāṃ yadā dikkaravāsinīm |
mātaṅgīṃ lalitāṃ durgāṃ bhairavī siddhidāṃ tathā || 36 ||
meaning:
आकाशगङ्गां कामाख्यां यदा दिक्करवासिनीम् |
मातङ्गीं ललितां दुर्गां भैरवी सिद्धिदां तथा || 36 ||
text_mt: Ākāśagaṅgā, Kāmākhyā, then Dikkaravāsinī, / Mātaṅgī, Lalitā, Durgā, Bhairavī, and Siddhidā,

sanskrit_iast:
balapramathinīṃ caṇḍīṃ caṇḍogrāṃ caṇḍanāyikām |
grāṃ bhīmāṃ śivāṃ śāntāṃ jayantīṃ kālikāṃ tathā || 37 ||
meaning:
बलप्रमथिनीं चण्डीं चण्डोग्रां चण्डनायिकाम् |
ग्रां भीमां शिवां शान्तां जयन्तीं कालिकां तथा || 37 ||
text_mt: Balapramathinī, Caṇḍī, Caṇḍogrā, Caṇḍanāyikā, / Grāṃ, Bhīmā, Śivā, Śāntā, Jayantī, and Kālikā,

sanskrit_iast:
maṅgalāṃ bhadrakālīṃ ca śivāṃ dhātrīṃ kapālinīm |
svāhāṃ svadhāmaparṇāṃ ca pañcapuṣkariṇīṃ tathā || 38 ||
meaning:
मङ्गलां भद्रकालीं च शिवां धात्रीं कपालिनीम् |
स्वाहां स्वधामपर्णां च पञ्चपुष्करिणीं तथा || 38 ||
text_mt: Maṅgalā, Bhadrakālī, Śivā, Dhātrī, Kapālinī, / Svāhā, Svadhā, Aparṇā, and Pañcapuṣkariṇī,

sanskrit_iast:
madanīṃ sarvabhūtānāṃ manaḥprotsāhakāriṇīm |
damanīṃ sarvabhūtānāṃ catuḥṣaṣṭiṃ ca yoginīḥ || 39 ||
meaning:
मदनीं सर्वभूतानां मनःप्रोत्साहकारिणीम् |
दमनीं सर्वभूतानां चतुःषष्टिं च योगिनीः || 39 ||
text_mt: Madanī, the exciter of the minds of all beings, / Damanī, and the sixty-four yoginīs of all beings.

sanskrit_iast:
etāḥ sampūjya madhye tu mantreṇāṅgāni pūjayet |
hṛcchirastu śikhāvarmanetrabāhupadāni ca || 40 ||
meaning:
एताः सम्पूज्य मध्ये तु मन्त्रेणाङ्गानि पूजयेत् |
हृच्छिरस्तु शिखावर्मनेत्रबाहुपदानि च || 40 ||
text_mt: Having worshipped these in the center, one should worship the limbs with the mantra: / the heart, head, crest, armor, eyes, arms, and feet.

sanskrit_iast:
mūlamantrādyakṣaraistu tribhirādyaṅgapūjanam |
ekaikaṃ varddhayet paścānmantrāṇyaṅgaughapūjane || 41 ||
meaning:
मूलमन्त्राद्यक्षरैस्तु त्रिभिराद्यङ्गपूजनम् |
एकैकं वर्द्धयेत् पश्चान्मन्त्राण्यङ्गौघपूजने || 41 ||
text_mt: The worship of the primary limbs is done with the first three syllables of the root-mantra; / one should subsequently add one [syllable] each in the worship of the collection of limbs.

sanskrit_iast:
siddhasūtraṃ ca khaḍgaṃ ca khaḍgamantreṇa pūjayet |
tato'ṣṭapatramadhye tu pūjayedaṣṭayoginīḥ || 42 ||
meaning:
सिद्धसूत्रं च खड्गं च खड्गमन्त्रेण पूजयेत् |
ततोऽष्टपत्रमध्ये तु पूजयेदष्टयोगिनीः || 42 ||
text_mt: One should worship the accomplished thread and the sword with the sword-mantra. / Then, in the middle of the eight petals, one should worship the eight yoginīs:

sanskrit_iast:
śailaputrīṃ caṇḍaghaṇṭāṃ skandamātarameva ca |
kālarātriṃ ca pūrvādicaturdikṣu prapūjayet || 43 ||
meaning:
शैलपुत्रीं चण्डघण्टां स्कन्दमातरमेव च |
कालरात्रिं च पूर्वादिचतुर्दिक्षु प्रपूजयेत् || 43 ||
text_mt: Śailaputrī, Caṇḍaghaṇṭā, Skandamātṛ, / and Kālarātri in the four directions starting with the east.

sanskrit_iast:
caṇḍikāmatha kūṣmāṇḍīṃ tathā kātyāyanīṃ śubhām |
mahāgaurīṃ cāgnikoṇe nai-ṛtyādiṣu pūjayet || 44 ||
meaning:
चण्डिकामथ कूष्माण्डीं तथा कात्यायनीं शुभाम् |
महागौरीं चाग्निकोणे नै-ऋत्यादिषु पूजयेत् || 44 ||
text_mt: Then Caṇḍikā, Kūṣmāṇḍī, auspicious Kātyāyanī, / and Mahāgaurī in the southeast, southwest, and the other [corners].

sanskrit_iast:
mahāmāyāṃ ṣamasveti mūlamantreṇa cāṣṭadhā |
pūjayet padmamadhye tu balidānaṃ tataḥ param || 45 ||
meaning:
महामायां षमस्वेति मूलमन्त्रेण चाष्टधा |
पूजयेत् पद्ममध्ये तु बलिदानं ततः परम् || 45 ||
text_mt: One should worship Mahāmāyā eightfold in the center of the lotus with the root-mantra saying: “Be pleased.” / After that comes the offering of sacrifice.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ yadā kalpavidhānamānaiḥ
sampūjyate bhairava kāmadevī |
tadā svayaṃ maṇḍalametya deyaṃ
gṛhṇāti kāmaṃ ca dadāti samyak || 46 ||
meaning:
एवं यदा कल्पविधानमानैः
सम्पूज्यते भैरव कामदेवी |
तदा स्वयं मण्डलमेत्य देयं
गृह्णाति कामं च ददाति सम्यक् || 46 ||
text_mt: When, in this way, with the standards of ritual ordinance, / the Goddess of Desire is thoroughly worshipped, O Bhairava, / then She comes in person to the maṇḍala, accepts what is to be offered, / and completely bestows desired wishes.

sanskrit_iast:
iti śrīkālikāpurāṇe aṣṭādaśapaṭaloddhāre
mahāmāyākalpacatuḥpañcāśo'dhyāyaḥ || 54 ||
pañcapañcāśo'dhyāyaḥ
meaning:
इति श्रीकालिकापुराणे अष्टादशपटलोद्धारे
महामायाकल्पचतुःपञ्चाशोऽध्यायः || 54 ||
पञ्चपञ्चाशोऽध्यायः
text_mt:
Thus ends the fifty-fourth chapter, on the ritual procedure of Mahāmāyā, in the extraction of eighteen sections in the glorious Kālikāpurāṇa.
Fifty-fifth chapter.

sanskrit_iast: śrībhagavānuvāca
meaning: श्रीभगवानुवाच

sanskrit_iast:
balidānaṃ tataḥ paścāt kuryād devyāḥ pramodakam |
modakairgajavaktraṃ ca haviṣā toṣayedravim || 1 ||
meaning:
बलिदानं ततः पश्चात् कुर्याद् देव्याः प्रमोदकम् |
मोदकैर्गजवक्त्रं च हविषा तोषयेद्रविम् || 1 ||
text_mt: Thereafter, one should perform the animal sacrifice, which gladdens the Goddess. / One should satisfy the Elephant-faced with sweetmeats, and the Sun with sacrificial oblations.

sanskrit_iast:
tauryatrikaiśca niyamaiḥ śaṅkaraṃ toṣayeddharim |
caṇḍikāṃ balidānena toṣayet sādhakaḥ sadā || 2 ||
meaning:
तौर्यत्रिकैश्च नियमैः शङ्करं तोषयेद्धरिम् |
चण्डिकां बलिदानेन तोषयेत् साधकः सदा || 2 ||
text_mt: With song, dance, instrumental music, and observances, one should satisfy Śaṅkara and Hari. / The practitioner should always satisfy Caṇḍikā with an animal sacrifice:

sanskrit_iast:
pakṣiṇaḥ kacchapā grāhāśchāgalāśca varāhakāḥ |
mahiṣo godhikāśoṣā tathā navavidhā mṛgāḥ || 3 ||
meaning:
पक्षिणः कच्छपा ग्राहाश्छागलाश्च वराहकाः |
महिषो गोधिकाशोषा तथा नवविधा मृगाः || 3 ||
text_mt: birds, tortoises, crocodiles, he-goats, boars, / buffalo, monitor lizards, and nine kinds of deer,

sanskrit_iast:
cāmaraḥ kṛṣṇasāraśca śaśaḥ pañcānanastathā |
matsyāḥ svagātrarudhiraiścāṣṭadhā balayo matāḥ || 4 ||
meaning:
चामरः कृष्णसारश्च शशः पञ्चाननस्तथा |
मत्स्याः स्वगात्ररुधिरैश्चाष्टधा बलयो मताः || 4 ||
text_mt: the yak, blackbuck, hare, lion, / and fishes, together with blood from one's own body, are considered the eightfold sacrifices.

sanskrit_iast:
abhāve ca tathaivaiṣāṃ kadāciddhayahastinau |
chāgalāḥ śarabhāścaiva naraścaiva yathākramāt || 5 ||
meaning:
अभावे च तथैवैषां कदाचिद्धयहस्तिनौ |
छागलाः शरभाश्चैव नरश्चैव यथाक्रमात् || 5 ||
text_mt: In the absence of these, sometimes horses and elephants, / goats, śarabhas, and human beings in succession:

sanskrit_iast: balirmahābaliriti balayaḥ parikīrtitāḥ |
meaning: बलिर्महाबलिरिति बलयः परिकीर्तिताः |
text_mt: these sacrifices are celebrated as sacrifice and great sacrifice.

sanskrit_iast: snāpayitvā baliṃ tatra puṣpacandanadhūpakaiḥ || 6 ||
meaning: स्नापयित्वा बलिं तत्र पुष्पचन्दनधूपकैः || 6 ||
text_mt: Having bathed the victim there with flowers, sandalwood paste, and incense,

sanskrit_iast:
pūjayet sādhako devīṃ balimantrairmuhurmuhuḥ |
uttarābhimukho bhūtvā baliṃ pūrvamukhaṃ tathā || 7 ||
meaning:
पूजयेत् साधको देवीं बलिमन्त्रैर्मुहुर्मुहुः |
उत्तराभिमुखो भूत्वा बलिं पूर्वमुखं तथा || 7 ||
text_mt: the practitioner should repeatedly worship the Goddess with mantras for the victim. / Having turned his face to the north, and [turning] the victim to face the east,

sanskrit_iast:
nirīkṣya sādhakaḥ paścādimaṃ mantramudīrayet |
varastvaṃ balirūpeṇa mama bhāgyādupasthitaḥ || 8 ||
meaning:
निरीक्ष्य साधकः पश्चादिमं मन्त्रमुदीरयेत् |
वरस्त्वं बलिरूपेण मम भाग्यादुपस्थितः || 8 ||
text_mt: and having looked at it, the practitioner should then utter this mantra: / 'As an excellent being in the form of a victim, you have appeared through my good fortune.

sanskrit_iast:
praṇamāmi tataḥ sarvarūpiṇaṃ balirūpiṇam |
caṇḍikāṃ prītidānena dāturāpadvināśanaḥ || 9 ||
meaning:
प्रणमामि ततः सर्वरूपिणं बलिरूपिणम् |
चण्डिकां प्रीतिदानेन दातुरापद्विनाशनः || 9 ||
text_mt: Therefore I bow to you, who embody all forms and the form of the victim; / by giving delight to Caṇḍikā, [you are] the destroyer of the sacrificer's misfortune.

sanskrit_iast:
vaiṣṇavībalirūpāya bale tubhyaṃ namo namaḥ |
yajñārthe paśavaḥ sṛṣṭāḥ svayameva svayambhuvā || 10 ||
meaning:
वैष्णवीबलिरूपाय बले तुभ्यं नमो नमः |
यज्ञार्थे पशवः सृष्टाः स्वयमेव स्वयम्भुवा || 10 ||
text_mt: O victim who has assumed the form of an offering to Vaiṣṇavī, homage, homage to you! / For the sake of sacrifice, animals were created by the Self-born One himself.

sanskrit_iast: atastvāṃ ghātayāmyadya tasmād yajñe vadho'vadhaḥ |
meaning: अतस्त्वां घातयाम्यद्य तस्माद् यज्ञे वधोऽवधः |
text_mt: Therefore I slay you today; thus in a sacrifice, slaughter is not slaughter.'

sanskrit_iast: (oṃ) aiṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ iti mantreṇa taṃ baliṃ kāmarūpiṇam || 11 ||
meaning: (ओं) ऐं ह्रीं श्रीं इति मन्त्रेण तं बलिं कामरूपिणम् || 11 ||
text_mt: With the mantra 'Oṃ aiṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ', having meditated upon that victim as changing form at will,

sanskrit_iast:
cintayitvā nyaset puṣpaṃ mūrdhni tasya ca bhairava |
tato devīṃ samuddiśya kāmamuddiśya cātmanaḥ || 12 ||
meaning:
चिन्तयित्वा न्यसेत् पुष्पं मूर्ध्नि तस्य च भैरव |
ततो देवीं समुद्दिश्य काममुद्दिश्य चात्मनः || 12 ||
text_mt: he should place a flower upon its head, O Bhairava. / Then, directing it toward the Goddess and toward his own desire,

sanskrit_iast:
abhiṣicya baliṃ paścāt karavālaṃ prapūjayet |
rasanā tvaṃ caṇḍikāyāḥ suralokaprasādhakaḥ || 13 ||
meaning:
अभिषिच्य बलिं पश्चात् करवालं प्रपूजयेत् |
रसना त्वं चण्डिकायाः सुरलोकप्रसाधकः || 13 ||
text_mt: and having consecrated the victim, he should then worship the sword: / 'You are the tongue of Caṇḍikā, the accomplisher of the world of the gods.'

sanskrit_iast:
iṃ hrīṃ śrīmiti mantreṇa dhyātvā khaḍgaṃ prapūjayet |
kṛṣṇaṃ pinākapāṇiṃ ca kālarātrisvarūpiṇam || 14 ||
meaning:
इं ह्रीं श्रीमिति मन्त्रेण ध्यात्वा खड्गं प्रपूजयेत् |
कृष्णं पिनाकपाणिं च कालरात्रिस्वरूपिणम् || 14 ||
text_mt: With the mantra 'Iṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ', having visualized [it], he should worship the sword / as black, holding a Pināka bow, embodying the Night of Time,

sanskrit_iast:
ugraṃ raktāsyanayanaṃ raktamālyānulepanam |
raktāmbaradharaṃ caikaṃ pāśahastaṃ kuṭumbinam || 15 ||
meaning:
उग्रं रक्तास्यनयनं रक्तमाल्यानुलेपनम् |
रक्ताम्बरधरं चैकं पाशहस्तं कुटुम्बिनम् || 15 ||
text_mt: fierce, with red mouth and eyes, having red garlands and ointment, / wearing red garments, solitary, with a noose in hand, supporting a family,

sanskrit_iast: pīyamānaṃ ca rudhiraṃ bhuñjānaṃ kravyasaṃhatim |
meaning: पीयमानं च रुधिरं भुञ्जानं क्रव्यसंहतिम् |
text_mt: drinking blood, and consuming a mass of flesh:

sanskrit_iast: asirviśasanaḥ khaḍgastīkṣṇadharo durāsadaḥ || 16 ||
meaning: असिर्विशसनः खड्गस्तीक्ष्णधरो दुरासदः || 16 ||
text_mt: 'Sword, slaughterer, scimitar, sharp-edged, difficult to approach,

sanskrit_iast:
srīgarvo vijayaścaiva dharmapāla namo'stu te |
pūjayitvā tataḥ khaḍgaṃ oṃ aṃ hrīṃ phaḍitimantrakaiḥ || 17 ||
meaning:
स्रीगर्वो विजयश्चैव धर्मपाल नमोऽस्तु ते |
पूजयित्वा ततः खड्गं ओं अं ह्रीं फडितिमन्त्रकैः || 17 ||
text_mt: proud of fortune, victory itself, protector of dharma, homage be to you!' / Having then worshipped the sword with the mantra 'Oṃ aṃ hrīṃ phaṭ',

sanskrit_iast:
gṛhītvā vimalaṃ khaḍgaṃ chedayed balimuttamam |
tato balīnāṃ rudhiraṃ toyasaindhavasatphalaiḥ || 18 ||
meaning:
गृहीत्वा विमलं खड्गं छेदयेद् बलिमुत्तमम् |
ततो बलीनां रुधिरं तोयसैन्धवसत्फलैः || 18 ||
text_mt: and having taken up the spotless sword, he should decapitate the excellent victim. / Then, having perfumed with care the blood of the victims with water, rock salt, fine fruits,

sanskrit_iast:
madhubhirgandhapuṣpaiśca adhivāsya prayatnataḥ |
oṃ aiṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ kauśikīti rudhiraṃ dāpayāmi te || 19 ||
meaning:
मधुभिर्गन्धपुष्पैश्च अधिवास्य प्रयत्नतः |
ओं ऐं ह्रीं श्रीं कौशिकीति रुधिरं दापयामि ते || 19 ||
text_mt: honey, and fragrant flowers, [saying,] / 'Oṃ aiṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ Kauśikī, I offer this blood to you,'

sanskrit_iast:
sthāne niyojayedraktaṃ śiraśca sapradīpakam |
evaṃ dattvā baliṃ pūrṇaṃ phalaṃ prāpnoti sādhakaḥ || 20 ||
meaning:
स्थाने नियोजयेद्रक्तं शिरश्च सप्रदीपकम् |
एवं दत्त्वा बलिं पूर्णं फलं प्राप्नोति साधकः || 20 ||
text_mt: he should deposit the blood in its place, and the head with a burning lamp. / Having thus given the victim, the practitioner attains the complete fruit.

sanskrit_iast:
hīnaṃ syāddhīnatāmūlaṃ niṣphalaṃ syād viparyayāt |
balidāne tu durgāyā anyatrāpi vidhiḥ sadā || 21 ||
meaning:
हीनं स्याद्धीनतामूलं निष्फलं स्याद् विपर्ययात् |
बलिदाने तु दुर्गाया अन्यत्रापि विधिः सदा || 21 ||
text_mt: Deficiency results in ruin, and by inversion it becomes fruitless. / In the sacrifice of a victim to Durgā, or even elsewhere, this rule

sanskrit_iast:
ayameva prayoktavyaḥ sadbhirvetālabhairavau |
japaṃ samārabhet paścāt pūrvavaddhyānamāsthitaḥ || 22 ||
meaning:
अयमेव प्रयोक्तव्यः सद्भिर्वेतालभैरवौ |
जपं समारभेत् पश्चात् पूर्ववद्ध्यानमास्थितः || 22 ||
text_mt: is always to be applied by the righteous, O Vetāla and Bhairava. / Then he should begin recitation, established in meditation as before.

sanskrit_iast:
hastena srajamādāya cintayenmanasā śivām |
cintayitvā guruṃ mūrdhni yathā varṇādikaṃ bhavet || 23 ||
meaning:
हस्तेन स्रजमादाय चिन्तयेन्मनसा शिवाम् |
चिन्तयित्वा गुरुं मूर्ध्नि यथा वर्णादिकं भवेत् || 23 ||
text_mt: Taking a rosary in hand, he should contemplate Śivā in his mind. / Having contemplated the guru on his head, according to his color and other attributes,

sanskrit_iast:
mantraṃ ca kaṇṭhato dhyātvā sitavarṇaṃ hiraṇmayam |
mahāmāyāṃ ca hṛdaye ātmānaṃ gurupādayoḥ || 24 ||
meaning:
मन्त्रं च कण्ठतो ध्यात्वा सितवर्णं हिरण्मयम् |
महामायां च हृदये आत्मानं गुरुपादयोः || 24 ||
text_mt: and having meditated upon the mantra in his throat as white and golden, / and Mahāmāyā in his heart, and himself at the feet of the guru,

sanskrit_iast:
acakṣeta tataḥ paścād gurormantrasya cātmanaḥ |
devyāścāpyekatāṃ dhyātvā suṣumnāvartmanā tataḥ || 25 ||
meaning:
अचक्षेत ततः पश्चाद् गुरोर्मन्त्रस्य चात्मनः |
देव्याश्चाप्येकतां ध्यात्वा सुषुम्नावर्त्मना ततः || 25 ||
text_mt: he should then perceive the oneness of the guru, the mantra, himself, / and the Goddess; and then, by the pathway of the suṣumnā,

sanskrit_iast:
tattvasvarūpamekaṃ tu ṣaṭcakraṃ prati lambayet |
ṣaṭcakre'pi mahāmāyāṃ kṣaṇaṃ dhyātvā prayatnataḥ || 26 ||
meaning:
तत्त्वस्वरूपमेकं तु षट्चक्रं प्रति लम्बयेत् |
षट्चक्रेऽपि महामायां क्षणं ध्यात्वा प्रयत्नतः || 26 ||
text_mt: he should suspend the single essence of reality toward the sixfold cakra. / Having meditated intently upon Mahāmāyā in the sixfold cakra for a moment,

sanskrit_iast: lambayenmūlamātreṇa vādiṣoḍaśacakrakam |
meaning: लम्बयेन्मूलमात्रेण वादिषोडशचक्रकम् |
text_mt: he should suspend [her] through the root alone [to] the primordial sixteen-spoked cakra.

sanskrit_iast: ādiṣoḍaśacakrasthāṃ sādhakānandakāriṇīm || 27 ||
meaning: आदिषोडशचक्रस्थां साधकानन्दकारिणीम् || 27 ||
text_mt: Residing in the primordial sixteen-spoked cakra, causing bliss to the practitioner,

sanskrit_iast:
intayan sādhako devīṃ japakarma samārabhet |
bhravorupari nāḍīnāṃ trayāṇāṃ prānta ucyate || 28 ||
meaning:
इन्तयन् साधको देवीं जपकर्म समारभेत् |
भ्रवोरुपरि नाडीनां त्रयाणां प्रान्त उच्यते || 28 ||
text_mt: contemplating the Goddess, the practitioner should begin the rite of recitation. / Above the eyebrows is declared the termination of the three channels;

sanskrit_iast:
tatprāntaṃ tripathasthānaṃ ṣaṭkoṇaṃ caturaṅgulam |
raktavarṇaṃ tu yogajñairājñācakramitīryate || 29 ||
meaning:
तत्प्रान्तं त्रिपथस्थानं षट्कोणं चतुरङ्गुलम् |
रक्तवर्णं तु योगज्ञैराज्ञाचक्रमितीर्यते || 29 ||
text_mt: that terminal place where three paths meet is hexagonal, measuring four finger-breadths, / red in color, and is called the ājñācakra by knowers of yoga.

sanskrit_iast:
kaṇṭhe trayāṇāṃ nāḍīnāṃ veṣṭhanaṃ vidyate nṛṇām |
suṣumneḍāpiṅgalānāṃ ṣaṭkoṇaṃ tatṣaḍaṅgulam || 30 ||
meaning:
कण्ठे त्रयाणां नाडीनां वेष्ठनं विद्यते नृणाम् |
सुषुम्नेडापिङ्गलानां षट्कोणं तत्षडङ्गुलम् || 30 ||
text_mt: In the throat of men there is the entwining of the three channels— / of the suṣumnā, iḍā, and piṅgalā; it is hexagonal, measuring six finger-breadths.

sanskrit_iast:
tat ṣaṭcakramiti proktaṃ śuklaṃ kaṇṭhasya madhyagam |
trayāṇāmatha nāḍīnāṃ hṛdaye caikatā bhavet || 31 ||
meaning:
तत् षट्चक्रमिति प्रोक्तं शुक्लं कण्ठस्य मध्यगम् |
त्रयाणामथ नाडीनां हृदये चैकता भवेत् || 31 ||
text_mt: That is proclaimed the sixfold cakra, white, located in the middle of the throat. / Moreover, the union of the three channels occurs in the heart;

sanskrit_iast:
tatsthānaṃ ṣoḍaśāraṃ syāt saptāṅgulapramāṇataḥ |
atprayuktaṃ tu yojajñairādiṣoḍaśacakrakam || 32 ||
meaning:
तत्स्थानं षोडशारं स्यात् सप्ताङ्गुलप्रमाणतः |
अत्प्रयुक्तं तु योजज्ञैरादिषोडशचक्रकम् || 32 ||
text_mt: that place has sixteen spokes, measuring seven finger-breadths. / That is designated the primordial sixteen-spoked cakra by knowers of yoga.

sanskrit_iast:
dhyānānāmatha mantrāṇāṃ cintanasya japasya ca |
yasmādādyaṃ tu hṛdayaṃ tasmādādīti gadyate || 33 ||
meaning:
ध्यानानामथ मन्त्राणां चिन्तनस्य जपस्य च |
यस्मादाद्यं तु हृदयं तस्मादादीति गद्यते || 33 ||
text_mt: Because the heart is the primary [seat] of meditations, of mantras, / of contemplation, and of recitation, it is declared to be 'primordial'.

sanskrit_iast:
japādau pūjayenmālāṃ toyairabhyukṣya yatnataḥ |
nidhāya maṇḍalasyāntaḥ savyahastagatāṃ ca vā || 34 ||
meaning:
जपादौ पूजयेन्मालां तोयैरभ्युक्ष्य यत्नतः |
निधाय मण्डलस्यान्तः सव्यहस्तगतां च वा || 34 ||
text_mt: At the beginning of recitation, he should worship the rosary, having sprinkled it carefully with water, / either placing it within the maṇḍala or holding it in his right hand:

sanskrit_iast:
oṃ māle māle mahāmāye sarvaśaktisvarūpiṇi |
caturvargastvayi nyastastasmānme siddhidā bhava || 35 ||
meaning:
ओं माले माले महामाये सर्वशक्तिस्वरूपिणि |
चतुर्वर्गस्त्वयि न्यस्तस्तस्मान्मे सिद्धिदा भव || 35 ||
text_mt: 'Oṃ, O rosary, O rosary, O Mahāmāyā, O you whose nature is all power! / In you the four goals of life are established; therefore, grant me success!'

sanskrit_iast:
pūjayitvā tato mālāṃ ṛhṇīyād dakṣiṇe kare |
madhyamāyā madhyabhāge varjayitvātha tarjanīm || 36 ||
meaning:
पूजयित्वा ततो मालां ऋह्णीयाद् दक्षिणे करे |
मध्यमाया मध्यभागे वर्जयित्वाथ तर्जनीम् || 36 ||
text_mt: Having then worshipped the rosary, he should hold it in his right hand / on the middle part of the middle finger, excluding the forefinger,

sanskrit_iast:
anāmikākaniṣṭhābhyāṃ yutāyā namrabhāgataḥ |
sthāpayitvā tatra mālāmaṅguṣṭhāgreṇa tadgatam || 37 ||
meaning:
अनामिकाकनिष्ठाभ्यां युताया नम्रभागतः |
स्थापयित्वा तत्र मालामङ्गुष्ठाग्रेण तद्गतम् || 37 ||
text_mt: joined with the ring finger and the little finger from its bent position. / Having placed the rosary there, with the tip of the thumb upon it,

sanskrit_iast:
pratyekaṃ bījamādāya japyādardhena bhairava |
prativāraṃ paṭhenmantraṃ śanairoṣṭhaṃ ca cālayet || 38 ||
meaning:
प्रत्येकं बीजमादाय जप्यादर्धेन भैरव |
प्रतिवारं पठेन्मन्त्रं शनैरोष्ठं च चालयेत् || 38 ||
text_mt: taking each bead, he should recite with [the middle] half [of the finger], O Bhairava. / Each time he should utter the mantra and move his lip softly.

sanskrit_iast:
mālābījaṃ tu japtavyaṃ spṛśennahi parasparam |
pūrvajāpaprayuktena naivāṅguṣṭhena bhairava || 39 ||
meaning:
मालाबीजं तु जप्तव्यं स्पृशेन्नहि परस्परम् |
पूर्वजापप्रयुक्तेन नैवाङ्गुष्ठेन भैरव || 39 ||
text_mt: The beads of the rosary are to be recited without touching one another, / nor, O Bhairava, with the thumb previously employed in recitation.

sanskrit_iast:
pūrvabījaṃ japan yastu parabījaṃ ca saṃspṛśet |
aṅguṣṭhena bhavet tasya niṣphalastasya tajjapaḥ || 40 ||
meaning:
पूर्वबीजं जपन् यस्तु परबीजं च संस्पृशेत् |
अङ्गुष्ठेन भवेत् तस्य निष्फलस्तस्य तज्जपः || 40 ||
text_mt: He who, while reciting the preceding bead, should touch the next bead / with his thumb, his recitation becomes fruitless.

sanskrit_iast:
mālāṃ svahṛdayāsanne dhṛtvā dakṣiṇapāṇinā |
devīṃ vicintayan japyaṃ kuryād vāmena na spṛśet || 41 ||
meaning:
मालां स्वहृदयासन्ने धृत्वा दक्षिणपाणिना |
देवीं विचिन्तयन् जप्यं कुर्याद् वामेन न स्पृशेत् || 41 ||
text_mt: Holding the rosary near his heart with his right hand, / he should perform the recitation contemplating the Goddess; he must not touch it with his left [hand].

sanskrit_iast:
sphaṭikendrākṣarudrākṣaiḥ putrañjīvasamudbhavaiḥ |
suvarṇamaṇibhiḥ samyak pravālairathavābjajaiḥ || 42 ||
meaning:
स्फटिकेन्द्राक्षरुद्राक्षैः पुत्रञ्जीवसमुद्भवैः |
सुवर्णमणिभिः सम्यक् प्रवालैरथवाब्जजैः || 42 ||
text_mt: With crystal, indrākṣa, rudrākṣa, or seeds produced from putrañjīva, / with golden gems properly, or with corals, or lotus-seeds,

sanskrit_iast:
akṣamālā tu kartavyā devīprītikarī parā |
japedupāṃśu satataṃ kuśagranthyātha pāṇinā || 43 ||
meaning:
अक्षमाला तु कर्तव्या देवीप्रीतिकरी परा |
जपेदुपांशु सततं कुशग्रन्थ्याथ पाणिना || 43 ||
text_mt: a rosary of beads should be made, which is supreme and brings delight to the Goddess. / He should constantly recite in a whisper, [holding] a knot of kuśa grass in his hand.

sanskrit_iast:
mālābījeṣu sarveṣu rudrākṣo matpriyāpriyaḥ |
rudraprītikarī yasmāt tena rudrākṣarocanī || 44 ||
meaning:
मालाबीजेषु सर्वेषु रुद्राक्षो मत्प्रियाप्रियः |
रुद्रप्रीतिकरी यस्मात् तेन रुद्राक्षरोचनी || 44 ||
text_mt: Among all rosary beads, rudrākṣa is beloved to my beloved; / because it pleases Rudra, therefore she is delighted by rudrākṣa.

sanskrit_iast:
pravālairathavā kuryādaṣṭāviṃśatibījakaiḥ |
pañcapañcāśatā vāpi na nyūnairadhikaiśca vā || 45 ||
meaning:
प्रवालैरथवा कुर्यादष्टाविंशतिबीजकैः |
पञ्चपञ्चाशता वापि न न्यूनैरधिकैश्च वा || 45 ||
text_mt: Or he should make [a rosary] of corals with twenty-eight beads, / or with fifty-five, neither fewer nor more.

sanskrit_iast:
rudrākṣaryadi japyeta indrākṣaiḥ phaṭikaistathā |
nānyaṃ madhye prayoktavyaṃ putrañjīvādikaṃ ca yat || 46 ||
meaning:
रुद्राक्षर्यदि जप्येत इन्द्राक्षैः फटिकैस्तथा |
नान्यं मध्ये प्रयोक्तव्यं पुत्रञ्जीवादिकं च यत् || 46 ||
text_mt: If recitation is performed with rudrākṣa, or with indrākṣa and crystal, / nothing else should be used in their midst, such as putrañjīva and the like.

sanskrit_iast:
yadyanyat tu prayujyeta mālāyāṃ japakarmaṇi |
tasya kāmaṃ ca mokṣaṃ ca dadāti na priyaṅkarī || 47 ||
meaning:
यद्यन्यत् तु प्रयुज्येत मालायां जपकर्मणि |
तस्य कामं च मोक्षं च ददाति न प्रियङ्करी || 47 ||
text_mt: If anything else is used in the rosary for the rite of recitation, / she who brings pleasure grants him neither desired enjoyment nor liberation.

sanskrit_iast:
miśrībhāvaṃ tato yāti cāṇḍālaiḥ pāpakarmabhiḥ |
janmāntare jāyate sa vedavedāṅgapāragaḥ || 48 ||
meaning:
मिश्रीभावं ततो याति चाण्डालैः पापकर्मभिः |
जन्मान्तरे जायते स वेदवेदाङ्गपारगः || 48 ||
text_mt: He then undergoes mixture with outcasts who perform evil deeds; / [only] in another birth is he born as one who has mastered the Vedas and their auxiliary branches.

sanskrit_iast:
eko merustatra deyaḥ sarvebhyaḥ sthūlasambhavaḥ |
ādyaṃ sthūlaṃ tatastasmād nyūnaṃ nyūnataraṃ tathā || 49 ||
meaning:
एको मेरुस्तत्र देयः सर्वेभ्यः स्थूलसम्भवः |
आद्यं स्थूलं ततस्तस्माद् न्यूनं न्यूनतरं तथा || 49 ||
text_mt: A single meru bead is to be placed there, made thicker than all [the others]; / the first is thick, and then from that [each is] smaller and smaller.

sanskrit_iast:
vinyaset kratastasmāt sarpākārā hi sā yataḥ |
brahmagranthiyutaṃ kuryāt pratibījaṃ yathāśtitam || 50 ||
meaning:
विन्यसेत् क्रतस्तस्मात् सर्पाकारा हि सा यतः |
ब्रह्मग्रन्थियुतं कुर्यात् प्रतिबीजं यथाश्तितम् || 50 ||
text_mt: He should arrange it properly, because it is serpentine in form; / he should provide it with a Brahma-knot at each bead as established.

sanskrit_iast:
athavā granthirahitaṃ dṛḍharajjusamanvitam |
virāvṛtyātha madhyena cārdhavṛtyāntadeśataḥ || 51 ||
meaning:
अथवा ग्रन्थिरहितं दृढरज्जुसमन्वितम् |
विरावृत्याथ मध्येन चार्धवृत्यान्तदेशतः || 51 ||
text_mt: Or without knots, bound with a strong cord, / winding around through the middle and with a half-turn from the end,

sanskrit_iast:
granthiḥ pradakṣiṇāvartaḥ sa brahmagranthisaṃjñakaḥ |
atmanā yojayenmālāṃ nāmantro yojayennaraḥ || 52 ||
meaning:
ग्रन्थिः प्रदक्षिणावर्तः स ब्रह्मग्रन्थिसंज्ञकः |
अत्मना योजयेन्मालां नामन्त्रो योजयेन्नरः || 52 ||
text_mt: a clockwise knot is designated the 'knot of Brahmā.' / A person should string the rosary by himself; he should not string it without [reciting] a mantra.

sanskrit_iast:
dṛḍhaṃ sūtraṃ niyuñjīta jape truṭyati no yathā |
yathā hastānna cyaveta japataḥ srak tamācaret || 53 ||
meaning:
दृढं सूत्रं नियुञ्जीत जपे त्रुट्यति नो यथा |
यथा हस्तान्न च्यवेत जपतः स्रक् तमाचरेत् || 53 ||
text_mt: He should attach a strong thread, so that it does not break during recitation. / He should handle it such that the garland does not slip from his hand while reciting.

sanskrit_iast:
hastacyutāyāṃ vighnaṃ syācchinnāyāṃ maraṇaṃ bhavet |
evaṃ yaḥ kurute mālāṃ japaṃ ca japakovidaḥ || 54 ||
meaning:
हस्तच्युतायां विघ्नं स्याच्छिन्नायां मरणं भवेत् |
एवं यः कुरुते मालां जपं च जपकोविदः || 54 ||
text_mt: If it falls from the hand, there will be an obstacle; if it breaks, there will be death. / The one skilled in recitation who makes his rosary and performs recitation in this way,

sanskrit_iast:
sa prāpnotīpsitaṃ kāmaṃ hīne syāt tu viparyayaḥ |
anyatrāpi japenmālāṃ japyaṃ devamanoharam || 55 ||
meaning:
स प्राप्नोतीप्सितं कामं हीने स्यात् तु विपर्ययः |
अन्यत्रापि जपेन्मालां जप्यं देवमनोहरम् || 55 ||
text_mt: he attains his desired wish; if it is deficient, the reverse occurs. / Elsewhere, too, he should recite with the rosary what is to be recited, delightful to the deity.

sanskrit_iast:
tādṛśaḥ sādhakaḥ kuryānnānyathā tu kadācana |
yathāśakti japaṃ kuryāt saṅkhyayaiva prayatnataḥ || 56 ||
meaning:
तादृशः साधकः कुर्यान्नान्यथा तु कदाचन |
यथाशक्ति जपं कुर्यात् सङ्ख्ययैव प्रयत्नतः || 56 ||
text_mt: Such a practitioner should act [thus], and never otherwise. / He should diligently perform the recitation with counting according to his capacity.

sanskrit_iast:
asaṅkhyātaṃ ca yajjaptaṃ tasya tanniṣphalaṃ bhavet |
japtvā mālāṃ śirodeśe prāṃśusthāne'tha vā nyaset || 57 ||
meaning:
असङ्ख्यातं च यज्जप्तं तस्य तन्निष्फलं भवेत् |
जप्त्वा मालां शिरोदेशे प्रांशुस्थानेऽथ वा न्यसेत् || 57 ||
text_mt: And whatever is recited without counting becomes fruitless for him. / Having recited, he should place the rosary on his head or in an elevated spot.

sanskrit_iast:
stutipāṭhaṃ tataḥ kuryādiṣṭaṃ kāmaṃ nivedya ca |
stutiścāpi mahāmantraṃ sādhanaṃ sarvakarmaṇām || 58 ||
meaning:
स्तुतिपाठं ततः कुर्यादिष्टं कामं निवेद्य च |
स्तुतिश्चापि महामन्त्रं साधनं सर्वकर्मणाम् || 58 ||
text_mt: Then, having dedicated his desired wish, he should recite a hymn of praise. / The hymn of praise is also a great mantra, an instrument for accomplishing all actions.

sanskrit_iast:
vakṣye yuvāṃ mahābhāgau sarvasiddhipradāyakam |
sarvamaṅgalamaṅgalye śive sarvārthasādhike || 59 ||
meaning:
वक्ष्ये युवां महाभागौ सर्वसिद्धिप्रदायकम् |
सर्वमङ्गलमङ्गल्ये शिवे सर्वार्थसाधिके || 59 ||
text_mt: I shall declare to you two, O fortunate ones, that which grants all accomplishments: / 'O auspiciousness of all that is auspicious, O Śivā, O accomplisher of all ends,

sanskrit_iast:
śaraṇye tryambake gauri nārāyaṇi namo'stu te |
saptadhāvartanaṃ kṛtvā stutimenāṃ ca sādhakaḥ || 60 ||
meaning:
शरण्ये त्र्यम्बके गौरि नारायणि नमोऽस्तु ते |
सप्तधावर्तनं कृत्वा स्तुतिमेनां च साधकः || 60 ||
text_mt: O refuge, O Tryambakā, O Gaurī, O Nārāyaṇī, praise be to you!' / The practitioner, having repeated this hymn of praise seven times,

sanskrit_iast:
pañcapraṇāmān kṛtvātha aiṃ hrīṃ śrīmitimantrakaiḥ |
anyeṣāṃ purataścaiva adhikaṃ vā yathecchayā || 61 ||
meaning:
पञ्चप्रणामान् कृत्वाथ ऐं ह्रीं श्रीमितिमन्त्रकैः |
अन्येषां पुरतश्चैव अधिकं वा यथेच्छया || 61 ||
text_mt: and then having made five prostrations with the mantras 'aim', 'hrīm', [and] 'śrīm', / or even more, according to his wish, before the others,

sanskrit_iast:
yonimudrāṃ tataḥ paścād darśayitvā visarjayet |
dvau pāṇī prasṛtīkṛtya kṛtvā cottānamañjalim || 62 ||
meaning:
योनिमुद्रां ततः पश्चाद् दर्शयित्वा विसर्जयेत् |
द्वौ पाणी प्रसृतीकृत्य कृत्वा चोत्तानमञ्जलिम् || 62 ||
text_mt: and having then displayed the yoni seal, should take leave [of the deity]. / Having outstretched both hands and formed an open-palmed hollow,

sanskrit_iast:
aṅguṣṭhāgradvayaṃ nyasya kaniṣṭhāgradvayostataḥ |
anāmikāyāṃ vāmasya tatkaniṣṭhāṃ puro nyaset || 63 ||
meaning:
अङ्गुष्ठाग्रद्वयं न्यस्य कनिष्ठाग्रद्वयोस्ततः |
अनामिकायां वामस्य तत्कनिष्ठां पुरो न्यसेत् || 63 ||
text_mt: and then placing the two tips of the thumbs at the tips of the two little fingers, / he should place the left little finger forward onto the [left] ring finger,

sanskrit_iast:
dakṣiṇasyānāmikāyāṃ kaniṣṭhāṃ dakṣiṇasya ca |
anāmikāyāḥ pṛṣṭhe tu madhyame dve niveśayet || 64 ||
meaning:
दक्षिणस्यानामिकायां कनिष्ठां दक्षिणस्य च |
अनामिकायाः पृष्ठे तु मध्यमे द्वे निवेशयेत् || 64 ||
text_mt: and the right little finger onto the right ring finger. / Then he should place the two middle fingers behind the ring fingers,

sanskrit_iast:
dve tarjanyau kaniṣṭhāgre tadagreṇaiva yojayet |
yonimudrā samākhyātā devyāḥ prītikarī matā || 65 ||
meaning:
द्वे तर्जन्यौ कनिष्ठाग्रे तदग्रेणैव योजयेत् |
योनिमुद्रा समाख्याता देव्याः प्रीतिकरी मता || 65 ||
text_mt: and join the two index fingers to the tip of the little finger by their very tips. / This is declared as the yoni seal, considered pleasing to the Goddess.

sanskrit_iast:
trivāraṃ darśayet tāṃ tu mūlamantreṇa sādhakaḥ |
tāṃ mudrāṃ śirasi nyasya maṇḍalaṃ vinyaset tataḥ || 66 ||
meaning:
त्रिवारं दर्शयेत् तां तु मूलमन्त्रेण साधकः |
तां मुद्रां शिरसि न्यस्य मण्डलं विन्यसेत् ततः || 66 ||
text_mt: The practitioner should display it three times with the root mantra. / Having placed that mudrā on his head, he should then lay out a mandala

sanskrit_iast:
aiśānyāmagrahastena dvārapadmavivarjitam |
tatra natvā raktacaṇḍāṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ mantreṇa sādhakaḥ || 67 ||
meaning:
ऐशान्यामग्रहस्तेन द्वारपद्मविवर्जितम् |
तत्र नत्वा रक्तचण्डां ह्रीं श्रीं मन्त्रेण साधकः || 67 ||
text_mt: in the north-eastern direction with the tip of his hand, devoid of a door and lotus. / Bowing there to Raktacaṇḍā with the mantra 'hrīm śrīm',

sanskrit_iast:
raktacaṇḍāyai nama iti nirmālyaṃ tatra nikṣipet |
udake tarumūle vā nirmālyaṃ tatra saṃtyajet || 68 ||
meaning:
रक्तचण्डायै नम इति निर्माल्यं तत्र निक्षिपेत् |
उदके तरुमूले वा निर्माल्यं तत्र संत्यजेत् || 68 ||
text_mt: with [the words] 'homage to Raktacaṇḍā,' he should cast the floral remains there. / Or he should discard the floral remains there in water or at the root of a tree.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ yaḥ pūjayed devīṃ vidhānena śivāṃ naraḥ |
so'cireṇa labhetkāmān sarvāneva manogatān || 69 ||
meaning:
एवं यः पूजयेद् देवीं विधानेन शिवां नरः |
सोऽचिरेण लभेत्कामान् सर्वानेव मनोगतान् || 69 ||
text_mt: A man who thus worships the auspicious Goddess according to the rule / will soon attain all the desires present in his mind.

sanskrit_iast:
ardhalakṣajapaṃ japtvā prathamaṃ caiva sādhakaḥ |
puraścared viśeṣeṇa nānānaivedyavedanaiḥ || 70 ||
meaning:
अर्धलक्षजपं जप्त्वा प्रथमं चैव साधकः |
पुरश्चरेद् विशेषेण नानानैवेद्यवेदनैः || 70 ||
text_mt: First reciting a recitation of fifty thousand, the practitioner / should especially perform the preparatory rite with offerings of various food-oblations.

sanskrit_iast:
kuṇḍaṃ maṇḍalavat kṛtvā cāṣṭamyāṃ samupoṣitaḥ |
navamyāṃ śuklapakṣasya rajobhiḥ pañcabhirnaraḥ || 71 ||
meaning:
कुण्डं मण्डलवत् कृत्वा चाष्टम्यां समुपोषितः |
नवम्यां शुक्लपक्षस्य रजोभिः पञ्चभिर्नरः || 71 ||
text_mt: Having made a sacrificial pit like a mandala, fasting on the eighth [day], / on the ninth [day] of the bright fortnight, a man, using the five colored powders,

sanskrit_iast:
pūrvavanmaṇḍalaṃ kṛtvā gurupitrośca sannidhau |
anenaiva vidhānena pūjayitvā tu caṇḍikām || 72 ||
meaning:
पूर्ववन्मण्डलं कृत्वा गुरुपित्रोश्च सन्निधौ |
अनेनैव विधानेन पूजयित्वा तु चण्डिकाम् || 72 ||
text_mt: having made a mandala as before in the presence of his guru and parents, / and having worshiped Caṇḍikā by this very rule,

sanskrit_iast:
sahitairbilvapatraiśca aṣṭottaraśatatrayam |
tilairhomaṃ caret tasyāṃ sahasratritayaṃ japet || 73 ||
meaning:
सहितैर्बिल्वपत्रैश्च अष्टोत्तरशतत्रयम् |
तिलैर्होमं चरेत् तस्यां सहस्रत्रितयं जपेत् || 73 ||
text_mt: should perform a fire offering on it with three hundred and eight bilva leaves / along with sesame seeds, and recite three thousand [times].

sanskrit_iast:
naivedyaṃ gandhapuṣpe ca vastraṃ dadyācca atpriyam |
pūrvoktaṃ cānyadapyasyai pradadyāt pāyasaṃ tathā || 74 ||
meaning:
नैवेद्यं गन्धपुष्पे च वस्त्रं दद्याच्च अत्प्रियम् |
पूर्वोक्तं चान्यदप्यस्यै प्रदद्यात् पायसं तथा || 74 ||
text_mt: He should offer food, perfume and flowers, and clothing very dear to her; / he should also present to her the aforesaid and other [offerings], as well as rice-pudding.

sanskrit_iast:
pūjāvasāne deyaṃ syāt tajjātīyaṃ balitrayam |
sindūraṃ svarṇaratnāni adyat strīṇāṃ vibhūṣaṇam || 77 ||
meaning:
पूजावसाने देयं स्यात् तज्जातीयं बलित्रयम् |
सिन्दूरं स्वर्णरत्नानि अद्यत् स्त्रीणां विभूषणम् || 77 ||
text_mt: At the conclusion of the worship, three offerings of its kind should be given. / He should present vermilion, gold, jewels, the ornament of women,

sanskrit_iast:
nivedayed yathāśaktyā puṣpamālyaṃ ca bhūriśaḥ |
mahāśaktuṃ saśālyannaṃ gavyavyañjanasaṃyutam || 76 ||
meaning:
निवेदयेद् यथाशक्त्या पुष्पमाल्यं च भूरिशः |
महाशक्तुं सशाल्यन्नं गव्यव्यञ्जनसंयुतम् || 76 ||
text_mt: and, according to his capacity, abundant flower garlands, / barley meal mixed with rice together with condiments of cow's milk.

sanskrit_iast:
devyai navamyāṃ sampūrṇaṃ baliṃ dadyād ghṛtādibhiḥ |
dakṣiṇāṃ gurave dadyāt suvarṇaṃ gāṃ tathā tilam || 77 ||
meaning:
देव्यै नवम्यां सम्पूर्णं बलिं दद्याद् घृतादिभिः |
दक्षिणां गुरवे दद्यात् सुवर्णं गां तथा तिलम् || 77 ||
text_mt: On the ninth [day], he should present a complete animal offering with ghee and other substances to the Goddess. / He should give a gift of honor to the guru: gold, a cow, and sesame.

sanskrit_iast:
abhiśaptamaputraṃ ca sāvadyaṃ kitava tathā |
kriyāhīnamakalpajñaṃ vāmanaṃ gurunindakam || 78 ||
meaning:
अभिशप्तमपुत्रं च सावद्यं कितव तथा |
क्रियाहीनमकल्पज्ञं वामनं गुरुनिन्दकम् || 78 ||
text_mt: One who is cursed, sonless, blameworthy, a gambler, / devoid of rites, ignorant of ritual rules, dwarfish, a slanderer of his guru,

sanskrit_iast:
sadā matsarasaṃyuktaṃ guruṃ mantreṣu varjayet |
gururmantrasya mūlaṃ syānmūlaśuddhau tadudgatam || 79 ||
meaning:
सदा मत्सरसंयुक्तं गुरुं मन्त्रेषु वर्जयेत् |
गुरुर्मन्त्रस्य मूलं स्यान्मूलशुद्धौ तदुद्गतम् || 79 ||
text_mt: and always full of envy—one should avoid [such a] guru with respect to mantras. / The guru is the root of the mantra; when the root is pure, what arises from it

sanskrit_iast:
saphalaṃ jāyate yasmānmantraṃ yatnātparīkṣayet |
śāṭhyāt krodhāttu mohādvā āsanmatyā gurormukhāt || 80 ||
meaning:
सफलं जायते यस्मान्मन्त्रं यत्नात्परीक्षयेत् |
शाठ्यात् क्रोधात्तु मोहाद्वा आसन्मत्या गुरोर्मुखात् || 80 ||
text_mt: becomes fruitful; therefore one should examine the mantra with effort. / If from deceit, anger, delusion, or through proximity to the guru's mouth,

sanskrit_iast:
kalpeṣu dṛṣṭvā vā mantraṃ gṛhṇīyācchadmanā'tha vā |
sa mantrasteya pāpena tāmisre narake naraḥ || 81 ||
meaning:
कल्पेषु दृष्ट्वा वा मन्त्रं गृह्णीयाच्छद्मनाऽथ वा |
स मन्त्रस्तेय पापेन तामिस्रे नरके नरः || 81 ||
text_mt: or seeing it in manual texts, one takes a mantra by guile, / that man, through the sin of mantra-theft, [goes] to the Tāmisra hell.

sanskrit_iast:
manvantaratrayaṃ sthitvā pāpayoniṣu jāyate |
śaṭhe krūre ca mūrkhe ca chadmakāriṇyabhaktike || 82 ||
meaning:
मन्वन्तरत्रयं स्थित्वा पापयोनिषु जायते |
शठे क्रूरे च मूर्खे च छद्मकारिण्यभक्तिके || 82 ||
text_mt: Remaining [there] for three manvantaras, he is born in sinful wombs. / To one who is dishonest, cruel, foolish, deceitful, and devoid of devotion,

sanskrit_iast:
mantraṃ na dūṣite dadyāt subīja vipine tathā |
lakṣeṇa sādhayeta kāmaṃ puraścaraṇapūrvakam || 83 ||
meaning:
मन्त्रं न दूषिते दद्यात् सुबीज विपिने तथा |
लक्षेण साधयेत कामं पुरश्चरणपूर्वकम् || 83 ||
text_mt: and to one who is corrupted, he should not give the mantra, [just as one would not cast] good seed in a barren land. / With one hundred thousand [repetitions] preceded by the preparatory rite, he should accomplish his desire.

sanskrit_iast:
pāpakṣayo bhaved yasmāt puraścaraṇakarmaṇā |
lakṣadvayena mantrasya japena narasattamau || 84 ||
meaning:
पापक्षयो भवेद् यस्मात् पुरश्चरणकर्मणा |
लक्षद्वयेन मन्त्रस्य जपेन नरसत्तमौ || 84 ||
text_mt: Because destruction of sins occurs through the rite of preparation, / by the recitation of two hundred thousand of the mantra, O two best of men,

sanskrit_iast:
trisandhyāsu pratidinaṃ bījasaṃghātakena ca |
kavirvāgmī paṇḍitaśca yaśasvī ca prajāyate || 85 ||
meaning:
त्रिसन्ध्यासु प्रतिदिनं बीजसंघातकेन च |
कविर्वाग्मी पण्डितश्च यशस्वी च प्रजायते || 85 ||
text_mt: at the three junctures of the day, daily, with the combination of seed syllables, / he becomes a poet, eloquent, learned, and renowned.

sanskrit_iast:
sādhakaḥ sādhakaśreṣṭha pūjāsthānaṃ tataḥ śṛṇu |
yatra yatra naraḥ pūjāṃ nirjane kurute ca yaḥ || 86 ||
meaning:
साधकः साधकश्रेष्ठ पूजास्थानं ततः शृणु |
यत्र यत्र नरः पूजां निर्जने कुरुते च यः || 86 ||
text_mt: O practitioner, O best of practitioners, hear next about the place of worship. / Wherever a man performs worship in solitude,

sanskrit_iast:
tasyādatte svayaṃ devī patraṃ puṣpaṃ phalaṃ jalam |
śilā praśastā pūjāyāṃ sthaṇḍilaṃ nirjanaṃ tathā || 87 ||
meaning:
तस्यादत्ते स्वयं देवी पत्रं पुष्पं फलं जलम् |
शिला प्रशस्ता पूजायां स्थण्डिलं निर्जनं तथा || 87 ||
text_mt: the Goddess herself accepts his leaf, flower, fruit, and water. / A rock is praised for worship, as is a bare plot of ground in solitude.

sanskrit_iast:
japaścopāṃśu sarveṣāmuttamaḥ parikīrtitaḥ |
aśucirna mahāmāyāṃ pūjayet tu kadācana || 88 ||
meaning:
जपश्चोपांशु सर्वेषामुत्तमः परिकीर्तितः |
अशुचिर्न महामायां पूजयेत् तु कदाचन || 88 ||
text_mt: And inaudible recitation is proclaimed the highest of all. / An impure person should never worship Mahāmāyā.

sanskrit_iast:
avaśyaṃ tu smarenmantraṃ yo'tibhaktiyuto naraḥ |
dantarakte samutpanne smaraṇaṃ ca na vidyate || 89 ||
meaning:
अवश्यं तु स्मरेन्मन्त्रं योऽतिभक्तियुतो नरः |
दन्तरक्ते समुत्पन्ने स्मरणं च न विद्यते || 89 ||
text_mt: A man who is endowed with supreme devotion should certainly remember the mantra. / When blood from the teeth has arisen, remembrance [of the mantra] is not [to be done].

sanskrit_iast: sarveṣāmeva mantrāṇāṃ smaraṇannarakaṃ vrajet |
meaning: सर्वेषामेव मन्त्राणां स्मरणन्नरकं व्रजेत् |
text_mt: Through the remembrance of all mantras [then], he would go to hell.

sanskrit_iast: jānūrdhve kṣataje jāte nityaṃ karma na cācaret || 90 ||
meaning: जानूर्ध्वे क्षतजे जाते नित्यं कर्म न चाचरेत् || 90 ||
text_mt: When blood has arisen above the knee, he should not perform his daily rite.

sanskrit_iast:
namittikaṃ ca tadadhaḥ sravadrakto na cācaret |
sūtake ca samutpanne kṣurakarmaṇi maithune || 91 ||
meaning:
नमित्तिकं च तदधः स्रवद्रक्तो न चाचरेत् |
सूतके च समुत्पन्ने क्षुरकर्मणि मैथुने || 91 ||
text_mt: And when blood is flowing below that, he should not perform occasional rites. / When pollution of birth has arisen, during shaving, [or] in sexual intercourse,

sanskrit_iast:
dhūmodgāre tathā vānte nityakarmāṇi saṃtyajet |
dravye bhukte tvajīrṇe ca na vai bhuktvā ca kiñcana || 92 ||
meaning:
धूमोद्गारे तथा वान्ते नित्यकर्माणि संत्यजेत् |
द्रव्ये भुक्ते त्वजीर्णे च न वै भुक्त्वा च किञ्चन || 92 ||
text_mt: at smoky belching, and likewise when vomiting, he should abandon his daily rites. / When food has been eaten and is undigested, and indeed having eaten anything,

sanskrit_iast:
karma kuryānnaro nityaṃ sūtake mṛtake tathā |
patraṃ puṣpaṃ ca tāmbūlaṃ bheṣajatvena kalpitam || 93 ||
meaning:
कर्म कुर्यान्नरो नित्यं सूतके मृतके तथा |
पत्रं पुष्पं च ताम्बूलं भेषजत्वेन कल्पितम् || 93 ||
text_mt: a man should not perform his daily rite, nor during pollution from birth or death. / Having eaten a leaf, flower, and betel designated as medicine,

sanskrit_iast:
kaṇādipippalyantaṃ ca phalaṃ bhuktvā na cācaret |
jalasyāpi naraśreṣṭha bhojanād bheṣajādṛte || 94 ||
meaning:
कणादिपिप्पल्यन्तं च फलं भुक्त्वा न चाचरेत् |
जलस्यापि नरश्रेष्ठ भोजनाद् भेषजादृते || 94 ||
text_mt: grains up to long pepper, and fruit, he should not perform [it], / nor after drinking water, O best of men, except as medicine.

sanskrit_iast:
nityakriyā nivarteta saha naimittikaiḥ sadā |
jalaukāṃ gūḍhapādaṃ ca kṛmigaṇḍūpadādikam || 95 ||
meaning:
नित्यक्रिया निवर्तेत सह नैमित्तिकैः सदा |
जलौकां गूढपादं च कृमिगण्डूपदादिकम् || 95 ||
text_mt: The regular rites should cease along with the occasional ones at all times / [if] a leech, an insect, a worm, an earthworm, and the like,

sanskrit_iast:
kāmāddhastena saṃspṛśya nityakarmāṇi saṃtyajet |
viśeṣataḥ śivāpūjāṃ pramītapitṛko naraḥ || 96 ||
meaning:
कामाद्धस्तेन संस्पृश्य नित्यकर्माणि संत्यजेत् |
विशेषतः शिवापूजां प्रमीतपितृको नरः || 96 ||
text_mt: touching intentionally with the hand, one should abandon the regular rites. / In particular, a man whose father has died [should abandon] the worship of Śivā.

sanskrit_iast:
yāvad vatsaraparyantaṃ manasāpi na ācaret |
mahāgurunipāte tu kāmyaṃ kiñcinna cācaret || 97 ||
meaning:
यावद् वत्सरपर्यन्तं मनसापि न आचरेत् |
महागुरुनिपाते तु काम्यं किञ्चिन्न चाचरेत् || 97 ||
text_mt: For up to one full year he should not perform it even in thought. / But upon the death of one's supreme elder (mahāguru), one should perform no elective rites at all:

sanskrit_iast: ārtvijyaṃ brahmayajñaṃ ca śrāddhaṃ devayajaṃ ca yat |
meaning: आर्त्विज्यं ब्रह्मयज्ञं च श्राद्धं देवयजं च यत् |
text_mt: officiating as a priest, the recitation of the Veda (brahmayajña), the ancestral rite (śrāddha), and that which is sacrifice to the gods.

sanskrit_iast: gurumākṣipya vipraṃ ca prahṛtyaiva ca pāṇinā || 98 ||
meaning: गुरुमाक्षिप्य विप्रं च प्रहृत्यैव च पाणिना || 98 ||
text_mt: Having insulted a guru or a brahmin, and having struck [them] with the hand,

sanskrit_iast:
na kuryānnityakarmāṇi retaḥpāte ca bhairava |
āsanaṃ cārghyapātraṃ ca bhagnamāsādayennatu || 99 ||
meaning:
न कुर्यान्नित्यकर्माणि रेतःपाते च भैरव |
आसनं चार्घ्यपात्रं च भग्नमासादयेन्नतु || 99 ||
text_mt: one must not perform regular rites, and [similarly] upon the emission of semen, O Bhairava. / Nor should one use a broken seat or arghya vessel.

sanskrit_iast:
ūṣare kṛmisaṃyukte sthāne mṛṣṭe'pi nārcayet |
nīcairāsanamāsādya śuciḥ prayatamānasaḥ || 100 ||
meaning:
ऊषरे कृमिसंयुक्ते स्थाने मृष्टेऽपि नार्चयेत् |
नीचैरासनमासाद्य शुचिः प्रयतमानसः || 100 ||
text_mt: In a barren ground infested with worms, even if swept clean, one must not worship. / Having taken a low seat, pure, with restrained mind,

sanskrit_iast:
arcayeccaṇḍikāṃ devīṃ devamanyaṃ ca bhairava |
digvibhāge tu kauberī dik chivā pratidāyinī || 101 ||
meaning:
अर्चयेच्चण्डिकां देवीं देवमन्यं च भैरव |
दिग्विभागे तु कौबेरी दिक् छिवा प्रतिदायिनी || 101 ||
text_mt: he should worship the goddess Caṇḍikā, and other deities, O Bhairava. / In the division of directions, the northern quarter is auspicious and bestows [results].

sanskrit_iast:
tasmāt tanmkha āsīnaḥ pūjayeccaṇḍikāṃ sadā |
puṣpaṃ ca kṛmisaṃmiśraṃ viśīrṇaṃ bhagnamṛdgate || 102 ||
meaning:
तस्मात् तन्म्ख आसीनः पूजयेच्चण्डिकां सदा |
पुष्पं च कृमिसंमिश्रं विशीर्णं भग्नमृद्गते || 102 ||
text_mt: Therefore, seated facing that direction, he should constantly worship Caṇḍikā. / And a flower mixed with worms, withered, fallen onto broken clay,

sanskrit_iast:
sakeśa mūṣikoddhūtaṃ yatnena parivarjayet |
yācitaṃ parakīyaṃ ca tathā paryuṣitaṃ ca yat |
antyasṛṣṭaṃ padā spṛṣṭaṃ yatnena parivarjayet || 103 ||
meaning:
सकेश मूषिकोद्धूतं यत्नेन परिवर्जयेत् |
याचितं परकीयं च तथा पर्युषितं च यत् |
अन्त्यसृष्टं पदा स्पृष्टं यत्नेन परिवर्जयेत् || 103 ||
text_mt: with hair, or thrown about by mice, he must assiduously avoid; / what is begged, what belongs to another, and that which is stale, / touched by an outcaste, or touched with the foot, he must assiduously avoid.

sanskrit_iast:
idaṃ śivāyāḥ paramaṃ manoharaṃ
karoti yo'nena tadīyapūjanam |
sa vāñchitārthaṃ samavāpya caṇḍikā-
gṛhaṃ prayātā nacireṇa bhairava || 104 ||
meaning:
इदं शिवायाः परमं मनोहरं
करोति योऽनेन तदीयपूजनम् |
स वाञ्छितार्थं समवाप्य चण्डिका-
गृहं प्रयाता नचिरेण भैरव || 104 ||
text_mt: Whoever performs this most charming worship of hers for Śivā, / having obtained his desired object, he goes before long to Caṇḍikā's abode, O Bhairava.

sanskrit_iast:
iti śrīkālikāpurāṇe aurvasagarasaṃvāde mahāmāyākalpaḥ
añcapañcāśo'dhyāyaḥ || 55 ||
ṣaṭpañcāśo'dhyāyaḥ
meaning:
इति श्रीकालिकापुराणे और्वसगरसंवादे महामायाकल्पः
अञ्चपञ्चाशोऽध्यायः || 55 ||
षट्पञ्चाशोऽध्यायः
text_mt: Thus ends the Mahāmāyā ritual, the fifty-fifth chapter in the glorious Kālikāpurāṇa, in the dialogue between Aurva and Sagara. / Chapter Fifty-Six

sanskrit_iast: śrībhagavānuvāca
meaning: श्रीभगवानुवाच

sanskrit_iast:
asya mantrasya kavacaṃ śṛṇu vetālabhairava |
vaiṣṇavītantrasaṃjñasya vaiṣṇavyāśca viśeṣataḥ || 1 ||
meaning:
अस्य मन्त्रस्य कवचं शृणु वेतालभैरव |
वैष्णवीतन्त्रसंज्ञस्य वैष्णव्याश्च विशेषतः || 1 ||
text_mt: Hear the armor (kavaca) of this mantra, O Vetālabhairava, / belonging to what is called the Vaiṣṇavītantra, and especially of Vaiṣṇavī.

sanskrit_iast:
tatra mantrādyakṣaraṃ tu vāsudevasvarūpadhṛk |
varṇo dvitīyo brahmaiva tṛtīyaścandraśekharaḥ || 2 ||
meaning:
तत्र मन्त्राद्यक्षरं तु वासुदेवस्वरूपधृक् |
वर्णो द्वितीयो ब्रह्मैव तृतीयश्चन्द्रशेखरः || 2 ||
text_mt: Therein, the first syllable of the mantra takes the form of Vāsudeva; / the second syllable is Brahman himself, and the third is Candraśekhara;

sanskrit_iast:
caturtho gajavaktraśca pañcamastu divākaraḥ |
śaktiḥ svayaṃ pakāraśca mahāmāyā jaganmayī || 3 ||
meaning:
चतुर्थो गजवक्त्रश्च पञ्चमस्तु दिवाकरः |
शक्तिः स्वयं पकारश्च महामाया जगन्मयी || 3 ||
text_mt: the fourth is Gajavaktra, and the fifth is the Sun; / the letter Pa is Śakti herself, Mahāmāyā consisting of the universe;

sanskrit_iast:
yakārastu mahālakṣmīḥ śeṣavarṇaḥ sarasvato |
yoginīpūrvavarṇasya śailaputrī prakīrtitā || 4 ||
meaning:
यकारस्तु महालक्ष्मीः शेषवर्णः सरस्वतो |
योगिनीपूर्ववर्णस्य शैलपुत्री प्रकीर्तिता || 4 ||
text_mt: the letter Ya is Mahālakṣmī, and the remaining syllable is Sarasvatī. / Of the first syllable, the yoginī is declared to be Śailaputrī;

sanskrit_iast:
dvitīyasya tu varṇasya caṇḍikā yoginī matā |
candraghaṇṭā tṛtīyasya kuṣmāṇḍī tat parasya ca || 5 ||
meaning:
द्वितीयस्य तु वर्णस्य चण्डिका योगिनी मता |
चन्द्रघण्टा तृतीयस्य कुष्माण्डी तत् परस्य च || 5 ||
text_mt: of the second syllable, Caṇḍikā is held to be the yoginī; / Candraghaṇṭā of the third, and Kuṣmāṇḍī of the one beyond that;

sanskrit_iast:
skandamātā takārasya pasya kātyāyanī svayam |
kālarātriḥ saptamasya mahādevīti saṃsthitā || 6 ||
meaning:
स्कन्दमाता तकारस्य पस्य कात्यायनी स्वयम् |
कालरात्रिः सप्तमस्य महादेवीति संस्थिता || 6 ||
text_mt: Skandamātā of the letter Ta; of Pa, Kātyāyanī herself; / Kālarātri of the seventh; she is situated as the Great Goddess (Mahādevī).

sanskrit_iast:
prathamaṃ varṇakavacaṃ yoginīkavacaṃ tathā |
devaughakavacaṃ paścād devīdikkavacaṃ tathā || 7 ||
meaning:
प्रथमं वर्णकवचं योगिनीकवचं तथा |
देवौघकवचं पश्चाद् देवीदिक्कवचं तथा || 7 ||
text_mt: First the letter-armor (varṇakavaca), and then the yoginī-armor (yoginīkavaca), / next the host-of-gods armor (devaughakavaca), and then the goddess-directions armor (devīdikkavaca);

sanskrit_iast:
tatastu pārśvakavacaṃ dvitīyāntāvyayasya ca |
kavacaṃ tu tataḥ paścāt ṣaḍvarṇaṃ kavacaṃ tathā || 8 ||
meaning:
ततस्तु पार्श्वकवचं द्वितीयान्ताव्ययस्य च |
कवचं तु ततः पश्चात् षड्वर्णं कवचं तथा || 8 ||
text_mt: then the flank-armor (pārśvakavaca), and the armor of the indeclinable ending in the accusative (dvitīyāntāvyaya); / after that the six-syllable armor (ṣaḍvarṇakavaca);

sanskrit_iast:
abhedyakavacaṃ ceti sarvatrāṇaparāyaṇam |
imāni kavacānyaṣṭau yo jānāti narottamaḥ || 9 ||
meaning:
अभेद्यकवचं चेति सर्वत्राणपरायणम् |
इमानि कवचान्यष्टौ यो जानाति नरोत्तमः || 9 ||
