he should offer the pavitra onto [the deity's] head with its own bīja-mantra.
Whoever offers a pavitra to me and a pavitra to the gods,

sanskrit_iast:
sarveṣāmeva devānāṃ sampūrṇārthaśca bhairava |
agnirbrahmā bhavānī ca gajavaktro mahoragaḥ || 81 ||
meaning:
सर्वेषामेव देवानां सम्पूर्णार्थश्च भैरव |
अग्निर्ब्रह्मा भवानी च गजवक्त्रो महोरगः || 81 ||
text_mt:
his purpose with all the gods is fulfilled, O Bhairava.
Agni, Brahmā, Bhavānī, Gajavaktra, the great serpent,

sanskrit_iast:
skando bhānurmātṛgaṇo dikpālāśca navagrahāḥ |
etān ghaṭeṣu pratyekaṃ pūjayitvā yathāvidhi || 82 ||
meaning:
स्कन्दो भानुर्मातृगणो दिक्पालाश्च नवग्रहाः |
एतान् घटेषु प्रत्येकं पूजयित्वा यथाविधि || 82 ||
text_mt:
Skanda, the Sun, the host of the Mothers, the guardians of the directions, and the nine planets—
having worshipped these individually in jars according to the rule,

sanskrit_iast:
pavitraṃ mūrdhni caikaikaṃ dadyādebhyaḥ samāhitaḥ |
pañcagavyacaruṃ kṛtvā devyai dattvāhutitrayam || 83 ||
meaning:
पवित्रं मूर्ध्नि चैकैकं दद्यादेभ्यः समाहितः |
पञ्चगव्यचरुं कृत्वा देव्यै दत्त्वाहुतित्रयम् || 83 ||
text_mt:
collected in mind, he should place a pavitra on the head of each of them.
Having prepared a caru with the five products of the cow, and having offered three oblations to the Goddess,

sanskrit_iast:
tenaiva viṣṇave dattvā śambhave ca yathāvidhi |
ājyairaṣṭottaraśataṃ tilairājyaistathaiva ca || 84 ||
meaning:
तेनैव विष्णवे दत्त्वा शम्भवे च यथाविधि |
आज्यैरष्टोत्तरशतं तिलैराज्यैस्तथैव च || 84 ||
text_mt:
and having offered [oblations] in the same manner to Viṣṇu and Śambhu according to the rule,
[offering] one hundred and eight [oblations] with ghee, and likewise one hundred and eight with sesamum and ghee,

sanskrit_iast:
aṣṭottaraśataṃ dadyānmahādevyai ca sādhakaḥ |
evameva vidhānena viṣṇvādīnāṃ ca sādhakaḥ || 85 ||
meaning:
अष्टोत्तरशतं दद्यान्महादेव्यै च साधकः |
एवमेव विधानेन विष्ण्वादीनां च साधकः || 85 ||
text_mt:
the practitioner should give [these] to the Great Goddess.
Following this very procedure, the practitioner should perform

sanskrit_iast:
pavitrāropaṇaṃ kuryād dharmakāmārthasiddhaye |
naivedyairvividhaiḥ peyairvaṭapiṣṭakamodakaiḥ || 86 ||
meaning:
पवित्रारोपणं कुर्याद् धर्मकामार्थसिद्धये |
नैवेद्यैर्विविधैः पेयैर्वटपिष्टकमोदकैः || 86 ||
text_mt:
the investiture of the pavitra for Viṣṇu and the others, for the attainment of virtue, desire, and wealth.
With diverse offerings of food, beverages, vaṭas, cakes, and sweetmeats,

sanskrit_iast:
kūṣmāṇḍairnārikelaiśca kharjūraiḥ panasaistathā |
āmradāḍimakarkārudrākṣādivividhaiḥ phalaiḥ || 87 ||
meaning:
कूष्माण्डैर्नारिकेलैश्च खर्जूरैः पनसैस्तथा |
आम्रदाडिमकर्कारुद्राक्षादिविविधैः फलैः || 87 ||
text_mt:
with ash gourds, coconuts, dates, and jackfruits,
with diverse fruits such as mangoes, pomegranates, melons, and grapes,

sanskrit_iast:
bhakṣyabhojyādibhiḥ sarvairmatsyairmāṃsaistathaudanaiḥ |
gandhaiḥ puṣpaistathā dhūpairdīpaiśca sumanoharaiḥ || 88 ||
meaning:
भक्ष्यभोज्यादिभिः सर्वैर्मत्स्यैर्मांसैस्तथौदनैः |
गन्धैः पुष्पैस्तथा धूपैर्दीपैश्च सुमनोहरैः || 88 ||
text_mt:
with all kinds of foods to chew and eat, with fish, meat, and rice,
with perfumes, flowers, incenses, and captivating lamps,

sanskrit_iast:
vāsobhirbhūṣaṇaiścaiva bhavānīsādhako yajet |
naṭanartakasaṅghaiśca veśyābhiścaiva bhairava || 89 ||
meaning:
वासोभिर्भूषणैश्चैव भवानीसाधको यजेत् |
नटनर्तकसङ्घैश्च वेश्याभिश्चैव भैरव || 89 ||
text_mt:
with garments and ornaments, the worshipper of Bhavānī should worship [her].
And with troupes of actors and dancers, and with courtesans, O Bhairava,

sanskrit_iast:
nṛtyagītaḥ samudito jāgaraṃ kārayenniśi |
bhojayed brāhmaṇāṃścāpi jñātīnapi dvijātibhiḥ || 90 ||
meaning:
नृत्यगीतः समुदितो जागरं कारयेन्निशि |
भोजयेद् ब्राह्मणांश्चापि ज्ञातीनपि द्विजातिभिः || 90 ||
text_mt:
resounding with dance and song, he should hold a night vigil.
He should feed Brāhmaṇas, and also his kinsmen, through twice-born men.

sanskrit_iast:
pavitrāropaṇe vṛtte dakṣiṇāmupadāpayet |
hiraṇyaṃ gāṃ tilaghṛtaṃ vāso vā śākameva vā || 91 ||
meaning:
पवित्रारोपणे वृत्ते दक्षिणामुपदापयेत् |
हिरण्यं गां तिलघृतं वासो वा शाकमेव वा || 91 ||
text_mt:
When the investiture of the pavitra is concluded, he should offer a priestly fee:
gold, a cow, sesamum, ghee, a garment, or vegetables.

sanskrit_iast:
imaṃ mantraṃ tataḥ paścāt sādhakaḥ samudīrayet |
maṇividrumamālābhirmandārakusumādibhiḥ || 92 ||
meaning:
इमं मन्त्रं ततः पश्चात् साधकः समुदीरयेत् |
मणिविद्रुममालाभिर्मन्दारकुसुमादिभिः || 92 ||
text_mt:
Then the practitioner should recite this mantra:
‘With garlands of gems and corals, with mandāra flowers and the like,

sanskrit_iast:
iyaṃ sāṃvatsarī pūjā tavāstu parameśvari |
tato visarjayed devīṃ pūjābhiḥ pratipattibhiḥ || 93 ||
meaning:
इयं सांवत्सरी पूजा तवास्तु परमेश्वरि |
ततो विसर्जयेद् देवीं पूजाभिः प्रतिपत्तिभिः || 93 ||
text_mt:
may this annual worship be yours, O Supreme Goddess!’
Then he should dismiss the Goddess with acts of worship and marks of respect.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ kṛte pavitrāṇāṃ dāne devyā yathāvidhi |
saṃvatsarasya yā pūjā sampūrṇā vatsarād bhavet || 94 ||
meaning:
एवं कृते पवित्राणां दाने देव्या यथाविधि |
संवत्सरस्य या पूजा सम्पूर्णा वत्सराद् भवेत् || 94 ||
text_mt:
When the offering of the pavitras to the Goddess is performed thus according to the rule,
the worship of a year becomes complete through the course of that year.

sanskrit_iast:
kalpakoṭiśataṃ yāvad devīgehe vasennaraḥ |
tatrāpi sukhasaubhāgyasamṛddhiratulā bhavet || 95 ||
meaning:
कल्पकोटिशतं यावद् देवीगेहे वसेन्नरः |
तत्रापि सुखसौभाग्यसमृद्धिरतुला भवेत् || 95 ||
text_mt:
A man shall dwell in the abode of the Goddess for a hundred crores of kalpas,
and even there he will obtain unequaled happiness, good fortune, and prosperity.

sanskrit_iast:
iti śrīkālikāpurāṇe konaṣaṣṭitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 59 ||
ṣaṣṭitamo'dhyāyaḥ
meaning:
इति श्रीकालिकापुराणे कोनषष्टितमोऽध्यायः || 59 ||
षष्टितमोऽध्यायः
text_mt:
Thus ends the fifty-ninth chapter in the glorious Kālikāpurāṇa.
Chapter Sixty

sanskrit_iast: śrībhagavānuvāca
meaning: श्रीभगवानुवाच

sanskrit_iast:
durgātantreṇa mantreṇa kuryād durgāmahotsavam |
mahānavamyāṃ śaradi balidānaṃ nṛpādayaḥ || 1 ||
meaning:
दुर्गातन्त्रेण मन्त्रेण कुर्याद् दुर्गामहोत्सवम् |
महानवम्यां शरदि बलिदानं नृपादयः || 1 ||
text_mt:
With the tantra and mantra of Durgā, one should celebrate the great festival of Durgā;
kings and others [should perform] animal sacrifice on Mahānavamī in autumn.

sanskrit_iast:
āśvanasya tu śuklasya bhaved yā aṣṭamī tithiḥ |
mahāṣṭamīti sā proktā devyāḥ prītikarī parā || 2 ||
meaning:
आश्वनस्य तु शुक्लस्य भवेद् या अष्टमी तिथिः |
महाष्टमीति सा प्रोक्ता देव्याः प्रीतिकरी परा || 2 ||
text_mt:
The eighth lunar day of the bright fortnight of Āśvina
is called Mahāṣṭamī; it brings supreme delight to the Goddess.

sanskrit_iast:
tano'nu navamī yā syāt sā mahānavamī smṛtā |
sā tithiḥ sarvalokānāṃ pūjanīyā śivapriyā || 3 ||
meaning:
तनोऽनु नवमी या स्यात् सा महानवमी स्मृता |
सा तिथिः सर्वलोकानां पूजनीया शिवप्रिया || 3 ||
text_mt:
The ninth that comes after it is known as Mahānavamī;
that lunar day, beloved of Śiva, is to be worshipped by all people.

sanskrit_iast:
anayorvatsa pūjāyāṃ viśeṣaṃ śṛṇu bhairava |
sampūjya maṇḍale devīṃ vidhivat prayato naraḥ || 4 ||
meaning:
अनयोर्वत्स पूजायां विशेषं शृणु भैरव |
सम्पूज्य मण्डले देवीं विधिवत् प्रयतो नरः || 4 ||
text_mt:
Hear, my child Bhairava, the specific rule for worship on these two [days].
Having worshipped the Goddess in a maṇḍala according to the rule, a restrained man,

sanskrit_iast:
vaiṣṇavītantramantreṇa durgātankṣeṇa bhairava |
mūrtibhede yathā devī pūjāṃ gṛhṇāti bhūtaye || 5 ||
meaning:
वैष्णवीतन्त्रमन्त्रेण दुर्गातन्क्षेण भैरव |
मूर्तिभेदे यथा देवी पूजां गृह्णाति भूतये || 5 ||
text_mt:
with the tantra and mantra of Vaiṣṇavī or with the tantra of Durgā, O Bhairava,
[shall worship] according to each distinct form, as the Goddess receives worship for prosperity.

sanskrit_iast:
kanyāsaṃsthe ravau vatsa śuklāmārabhya nandikām |
ayācitāśī naktāśī ekāśī tvatha cāpadaḥ || 6 ||
meaning:
कन्यासंस्थे रवौ वत्स शुक्लामारभ्य नन्दिकाम् |
अयाचिताशी नक्ताशी एकाशी त्वथ चापदः || 6 ||
text_mt:
When the sun is in the sign of Virgo, my child, starting from the bright Nandikā,
eating only unasked food, or eating at night, or eating once a day, without misfortune,

sanskrit_iast:
prātaḥsnāyī jitadvandvastrikālaṃ śivapūjakaḥ |
japahomasamāyukto bhojayecca kumārikāḥ || 7 ||
meaning:
प्रातःस्नायी जितद्वन्द्वस्त्रिकालं शिवपूजकः |
जपहोमसमायुक्तो भोजयेच्च कुमारिकाः || 7 ||
text_mt:
bathing at dawn, victorious over the pairs of opposites, worshipping Śiva at the three twilights,
engaged in japa and homa, he should feed young maidens.

sanskrit_iast:
bodhayed bilvaśākhāsu ṣaṣṭyāṃ devīphaleṣu ca |
saptamyāṃ bilvaśākhāṃ tāmāhṛtya pratipūjayet || 8 ||
meaning:
बोधयेद् बिल्वशाखासु षष्ट्यां देवीफलेषु च |
सप्तम्यां बिल्वशाखां तामाहृत्य प्रतिपूजयेत् || 8 ||
text_mt:
On the sixth [day] he should awaken the Goddess in the bilva branches and fruits;
on the seventh, having brought that bilva branch, he should worship [her].

sanskrit_iast:
punaḥ pūjāṃ tathāṣṭamyāṃ viśeṣeṇa samācaret |
jāgaraṃ ca svayaṃ kuryād balidānaṃ mahāniśi || 9 ||
meaning:
पुनः पूजां तथाष्टम्यां विशेषेण समाचरेत् |
जागरं च स्वयं कुर्याद् बलिदानं महानिशि || 9 ||
text_mt:
Likewise on the eighth he should perform worship with special care;
he should himself keep a vigil, and offer animal sacrifice at midnight.

sanskrit_iast:
prabhūtabalidānaṃ tu navamyāṃ vidhivaccaret |
dhyāyed daśabhujāṃ devīṃ durgātantreṇa pūjayet || 10 ||
meaning:
प्रभूतबलिदानं तु नवम्यां विधिवच्चरेत् |
ध्यायेद् दशभुजां देवीं दुर्गातन्त्रेण पूजयेत् || 10 ||
text_mt:
On the ninth he should offer abundant animal sacrifice according to the rule;
he should meditate on the ten-armed Goddess and worship her with the tantra of Durgā.

sanskrit_iast:
visarjanaṃ daśamyāṃ tu kuryād vai sādhakottamaḥ |
kṛtvā visarjanaṃ tasyāṃ tithau naktaṃ samācaret || 11 ||
meaning:
विसर्जनं दशम्यां तु कुर्याद् वै साधकोत्तमः |
कृत्वा विसर्जनं तस्यां तिथौ नक्तं समाचरेत् || 11 ||
text_mt:
On the tenth, the excellent practitioner should perform the dismissal;
having performed the dismissal on that lunar day, he should eat at night.

sanskrit_iast:
yadā tu ṣoḍaśabhujāṃ mahāmāyāṃ prapūjayet |
durgātantreṇa mantreṇa viśeṣaṃ tatra vai śṛṇu || 12 ||
meaning:
यदा तु षोडशभुजां महामायां प्रपूजयेत् |
दुर्गातन्त्रेण मन्त्रेण विशेषं तत्र वै शृणु || 12 ||
text_mt:
When, however, he worships the sixteen-armed Mahāmāyā
with the tantra and mantra of Durgā, hear the specific rule in that case:

sanskrit_iast:
kanyāyāṃ kṛṣṇapakṣasya ekādaśyāmupoṣitaḥ |
dvādaśyāmekabhaktaṃ tu naktaṃ kuryāt pare'hani || 13 ||
meaning:
कन्यायां कृष्णपक्षस्य एकादश्यामुपोषितः |
द्वादश्यामेकभक्तं तु नक्तं कुर्यात् परेऽहनि || 13 ||
text_mt:
having fasted on the eleventh of the dark fortnight when [the sun] is in Virgo,
he should take only one meal on the twelfth, and eat at night on the following day.

sanskrit_iast:
caturdaśyāṃ mahāmāyāṃ bodhayitvā vidhānataḥ |
gītavāditranirghoṣairnānānaivedyavedanaiḥ || 14 ||
meaning:
चतुर्दश्यां महामायां बोधयित्वा विधानतः |
गीतवादित्रनिर्घोषैर्नानानैवेद्यवेदनैः || 14 ||
text_mt:
Having awakened Mahāmāyā on the fourteenth according to the injunction,
with the sound of songs and musical instruments, and the presentation of diverse offerings of food,

sanskrit_iast:
ayācitaṃ budhaḥ kuryādupavāsaṃ pare'hani |
evameva vrataṃ kuryād yāvadvai navamī bhavet || 15 ||
meaning:
अयाचितं बुधः कुर्यादुपवासं परेऽहनि |
एवमेव व्रतं कुर्याद् यावद्वै नवमी भवेत् || 15 ||
text_mt:
the wise man should eat only unasked food, [and] fast on the following day;
in this manner he should observe the vow until the ninth arrives.

sanskrit_iast:
jyeṣṭhāyāṃ ca samabhyarcya mūlena pratipūjayet |
uttareṇārcanaṃ kṛtvā śravaṇānte visarjayet || 16 ||
meaning:
ज्येष्ठायां च समभ्यर्च्य मूलेन प्रतिपूजयेत् |
उत्तरेणार्चनं कृत्वा श्रवणान्ते विसर्जयेत् || 16 ||
text_mt:
Having worshipped [her] under Jyeṣṭhā, he should worship her under Mūla;
having performed the worship under Uttarāṣāḍhā, he should dismiss [her] at the end of Śravaṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
yadā tvaṣṭādaśabhujāṃ mahāmāyāṃ prapūjayet |
durgātantreṇa mantreṇa tatrāpi śṛṇu bhairava || 17 ||
meaning:
यदा त्वष्टादशभुजां महामायां प्रपूजयेत् |
दुर्गातन्त्रेण मन्त्रेण तत्रापि शृणु भैरव || 17 ||
text_mt:
When, however, he worships the eighteen-armed Mahāmāyā
with the tantra and mantra of Durgā, hear that also, O Bhairava:

sanskrit_iast:
kanyāyāṃ kṛṣṇapakṣasya pūjayitvārdrabhe divā |
navamyāṃ bodhayed devīṃ gītavāditranisvanaiḥ || 18 ||
meaning:
कन्यायां कृष्णपक्षस्य पूजयित्वार्द्रभे दिवा |
नवम्यां बोधयेद् देवीं गीतवादित्रनिस्वनैः || 18 ||
text_mt:
in the dark fortnight when [the sun] is in Virgo, having worshipped during the day under the asterism Ārdrā,
he should awaken the Goddess on the ninth with the sounds of songs and musical instruments.

sanskrit_iast:
śuklapakṣe caturthyāṃ tu devīkeśavimocanam |
prātareva tu pañcamyāṃ snāpayet tu śubhairjalaiḥ || 19 ||
meaning:
शुक्लपक्षे चतुर्थ्यां तु देवीकेशविमोचनम् |
प्रातरेव तु पञ्चम्यां स्नापयेत् तु शुभैर्जलैः || 19 ||
text_mt:
On the fourth of the bright fortnight [takes place] the untying of the Goddess's hair,
and in the morning of the fifth he should bathe her with auspicious waters.

sanskrit_iast:
saptamyāṃ patrikāpūjā aṣṭamyāṃ cāpyupoṣaṇam |
pūjājāgaraṇaṃ caiva navamyāṃ vidhivadbaliḥ || 20 ||
meaning:
सप्तम्यां पत्रिकापूजा अष्टम्यां चाप्युपोषणम् |
पूजाजागरणं चैव नवम्यां विधिवद्बलिः || 20 ||
text_mt:
On the seventh is the worship of the plant-twigs, and on the eighth is fasting,
worship, and keeping vigil; on the ninth is animal sacrifice according to the rule.

sanskrit_iast:
sampreṣaṇaṃ daśamyāṃ tu krīḍākautukamaṅgalaiḥ |
nīrājanaṃ daśamyāṃ tu balavṛddhikaraṃ mahat || 21 ||
meaning:
सम्प्रेषणं दशम्यां तु क्रीडाकौतुकमङ्गलैः |
नीराजनं दशम्यां तु बलवृद्धिकरं महत् || 21 ||
text_mt:
On the tenth is the sending forth [of the Goddess] with joyful sports and festivities;
the waving of lights on the tenth brings great increase of strength.

sanskrit_iast:
yadā vai vaiṣṇavī devīṃ mahāmāyāṃ jaganmayīm |
pūjayet tatra ca tadā viśeṣaṃ śṛṇu bhairava || 22 ||
meaning:
यदा वै वैष्णवी देवीं महामायां जगन्मयीम् |
पूजयेत् तत्र च तदा विशेषं शृणु भैरव || 22 ||
text_mt:
When he worships the goddess Vaiṣṇavī, Mahāmāyā, who consists of the universe,
hear then the specific rule in that case, O Bhairava:

sanskrit_iast:
kanyāsaṃsthe ravau pūjā yā śuklā tithiraṣṭamī |
tasyāṃ rātrau pūjitavyā mahāvibhavavistaraiḥ || 23 ||
meaning:
कन्यासंस्थे रवौ पूजा या शुक्ला तिथिरष्टमी |
तस्यां रात्रौ पूजितव्या महाविभवविस्तरैः || 23 ||
text_mt:
when the sun is in Virgo, on the bright eighth lunar day,
she should be worshipped at night with the vast displays of great opulence.

sanskrit_iast:
navamyāṃ balidānaṃ tu kartavyaṃ vai yathāvidhi |
japaṃ homaṃ ca vidhivat kuryāt tatra vibhūtaye || 24 ||
meaning:
नवम्यां बलिदानं तु कर्तव्यं वै यथाविधि |
जपं होमं च विधिवत् कुर्यात् तत्र विभूतये || 24 ||
text_mt:
On the ninth animal sacrifice should indeed be performed according to the rule;
there he should perform japa and homa according to the injunction for prosperity.

sanskrit_iast:
sampūjayenmahādevīmaṣṭapuṣpikayā naraḥ |
rāmasyānugrahārthāya rāvaṇasya vadhāya ca || 25 ||
meaning:
सम्पूजयेन्महादेवीमष्टपुष्पिकया नरः |
रामस्यानुग्रहार्थाय रावणस्य वधाय च || 25 ||
text_mt:
A man should worship the Great Goddess with the offering of eight flowers.
In former times, for the sake of favoring Rāma and slaying Rāvaṇa,

sanskrit_iast:
rātrāveva mahādevī brahmaṇā bodhitā purā |
tatastu tyaktanidrā sā nandāyāmāśvine site || 26 ||
meaning:
रात्रावेव महादेवी ब्रह्मणा बोधिता पुरा |
ततस्तु त्यक्तनिद्रा सा नन्दायामाश्विने सिते || 26 ||
text_mt:
the Great Goddess was awakened at night by Brahmā.
Then, abandoning her sleep on the Nandā [tithi] in the bright fortnight of Āśvina,

sanskrit_iast:
jagāma nagarīṃ laṅkāṃ yatrāsīdrāghavaḥ purā |
tatra gatvā mahādevī tadā tau rāmarāvaṇau || 27 ||
meaning:
जगाम नगरीं लङ्कां यत्रासीद्राघवः पुरा |
तत्र गत्वा महादेवी तदा तौ रामरावणौ || 27 ||
text_mt:
she went to the city of Laṅkā where Rāghava was in ancient times.
Having gone there, the Great Goddess Ambikā, remaining herself invisible,

sanskrit_iast:
yuddhaṃ niyojayāmāsa svayamantarhitāmbikā |
rakṣasāṃ vānarāṇāṃ ca jagdhvā sā māṃsaśoṇite || 28 ||
meaning:
युद्धं नियोजयामास स्वयमन्तर्हिताम्बिका |
रक्षसां वानराणां च जग्ध्वा सा मांसशोणिते || 28 ||
text_mt:
impelled those two, Rāma and Rāvaṇa, to battle;
and having consumed the flesh and blood of the rākṣasas and the monkeys,

sanskrit_iast:
rāmarāvaṇayoryuddhaṃ saptāhaṃ sā nyayojayat |
vyatīte saptame rātrau navamyāṃ rāvaṇaṃ tataḥ || 29 ||
meaning:
रामरावणयोर्युद्धं सप्ताहं सा न्ययोजयत् |
व्यतीते सप्तमे रात्रौ नवम्यां रावणं ततः || 29 ||
text_mt: She directed the battle between Rāma and Rāvaṇa for seven days. / Then, when the seventh [day] had passed, on the night of the ninth [tithi],

sanskrit_iast:
rāmeṇa ghātayāmāsa mahāmāyā jaganmayī |
yāvattayoḥ svayaṃ devī yuddhakelimudaikṣata || 30 ||
meaning:
रामेण घातयामास महामाया जगन्मयी |
यावत्तयोः स्वयं देवी युद्धकेलिमुदैक्षत || 30 ||
text_mt: Mahāmāyā, who consists of the universe, had Rāvaṇa slain by Rāma. / As long as the Goddess herself watched their play of battle,

sanskrit_iast:
tāvat tu saptarātrāṇi saiva devaiḥ supūjitā |
nihate rāvaṇe vīre navamyāṃ sakalaiḥ suraiḥ || 31 ||
meaning:
तावत् तु सप्तरात्राणि सैव देवैः सुपूजिता |
निहते रावणे वीरे नवम्यां सकलैः सुरैः || 31 ||
text_mt: so long, for seven nights, she was worshipped well by the gods. / When the heroic Rāvaṇa was slain on the ninth [tithi], by all the gods,

sanskrit_iast:
viśeṣapūjāṃ durgāyāścakre lokapitāmahaḥ |
tataḥ sampreṣitā devī daśamyāṃ śārvarotsavaiḥ || 32 ||
meaning:
विशेषपूजां दुर्गायाश्चक्रे लोकपितामहः |
ततः सम्प्रेषिता देवी दशम्यां शार्वरोत्सवैः || 32 ||
text_mt: the Grandfather of the Worlds performed a special worship of Durgā. / Then the Goddess was sent away on the tenth [tithi] with nocturnal festivities.

sanskrit_iast:
śākro'pi devasenāyā nīrājanamathākarot |
śāntyarthaṃ surasainyānāṃ devarājyasya vṛddhaye || 33 ||
meaning:
शाक्रोऽपि देवसेनाया नीराजनमथाकरोत् |
शान्त्यर्थं सुरसैन्यानां देवराज्यस्य वृद्धये || 33 ||
text_mt: Śakra, too, then performed the lustrative waving of lights over the army of the gods, / for the peace of the host of gods, and for the increase of the kingdom of the gods.

sanskrit_iast:
rāmarāvaṇabāṇena yuddhaṃ cāvekṣya bhotidam |
tṛtīyāyāṃ tu laṅkāyāḥ pūrvottaradiśi sthitam || 34 ||
meaning:
रामरावणबाणेन युद्धं चावेक्ष्य भोतिदम् |
तृतीयायां तु लङ्कायाः पूर्वोत्तरदिशि स्थितम् || 34 ||
text_mt: And seeing the terrifying battle [waged] with arrows of Rāma and Rāvaṇa, / on the third [tithi], stationed in the northeastern direction from Laṅkā,

sanskrit_iast:
svātīnakṣatrayuktāyāṃ bhītaṃ surabalaṃ mahat |
śāntyarthaṃ varayāmāsa devendro vacanād hareḥ || 35 ||
meaning:
स्वातीनक्षत्रयुक्तायां भीतं सुरबलं महत् |
शान्त्यर्थं वरयामास देवेन्द्रो वचनाद् हरेः || 35 ||
text_mt: on [the day] joined with the asterism Svātī, when the great army of the gods was terrified, / the lord of the gods, on the word of Hari, performed [rites] for [their] appeasement.

sanskrit_iast:
tatastu śravaṇenātha daśamyāṃ caṇḍikāṃ śubhām |
visṛjya cakre śāntyarthaṃ balanīrājanaṃ hariḥ || 36 ||
meaning:
ततस्तु श्रवणेनाथ दशम्यां चण्डिकां शुभाम् |
विसृज्य चक्रे शान्त्यर्थं बलनीराजनं हरिः || 36 ||
text_mt: Then, having dismissed the auspicious Caṇḍikā on the tenth [tithi] with [the asterism] Śravaṇa, / Hari performed the waving of lights over the army for the sake of peace.

sanskrit_iast:
nīrājitabalaḥ śakrastatra rāmaṃ ca rāghavam |
samprāpya prayayau svargaṃ saha devaiḥ śacīpatiḥ || 37 ||
meaning:
नीराजितबलः शक्रस्तत्र रामं च राघवम् |
सम्प्राप्य प्रययौ स्वर्गं सह देवैः शचीपतिः || 37 ||
text_mt: His army purified by the waving of lights, Śakra, the husband of Śacī, approached Rāma, the scion of Raghu, there / and departed to heaven along with the gods.

sanskrit_iast:
itivṛttaṃ purākalpe manoḥ svāyambhuve'ntare |
prādurbhūtā daśabhujā devī devahitāya vai || 38 ||
meaning:
इतिवृत्तं पुराकल्पे मनोः स्वायम्भुवेऽन्तरे |
प्रादुर्भूता दशभुजा देवी देवहिताय वै || 38 ||
text_mt: Such was the event in a previous kalpa, in the interval of the Svāyambhuva Manu: / the ten-armed Goddess became manifest indeed for the benefit of the gods,

sanskrit_iast:
nṛṇāṃ tretāyugasyādau jagatāṃ hitakāmyayā |
purākalpe yathāvṛttaṃ pratikalpaṃ tathā tathā || 39 ||
meaning:
नृणां त्रेतायुगस्यादौ जगतां हितकाम्यया |
पुराकल्पे यथावृत्तं प्रतिकल्पं तथा तथा || 39 ||
text_mt: at the beginning of the Tretāyuga of men, desiring the welfare of the worlds. / Just as it occurred in a previous kalpa, so it does in each kalpa;

sanskrit_iast:
pravartate svayaṃ devī daityānāṃ nāśanāya vai |
pratikalpaṃ bhavedrāmo rāvaṇaścāpi rākṣasaḥ || 40 ||
meaning:
प्रवर्तते स्वयं देवी दैत्यानां नाशनाय वै |
प्रतिकल्पं भवेद्रामो रावणश्चापि राक्षसः || 40 ||
text_mt: the Goddess herself proceeds indeed for the destruction of the Daityas. / In every kalpa there is a Rāma, and a Rākṣasa Rāvaṇa as well;

sanskrit_iast:
tathaiva jāyate yuddhaṃ tathā tridaśasaṃgamaḥ |
evaṃ rāmasahasrāṇi rāvaṇānāṃ sahasraśaḥ || 41 ||
meaning:
तथैव जायते युद्धं तथा त्रिदशसंगमः |
एवं रामसहस्राणि रावणानां सहस्रशः || 41 ||
text_mt: in the very same way the battle arises, and likewise the assembly of the gods. / In this way thousands of Rāmas and thousands of Rāvaṇas

sanskrit_iast:
bhavitavyāni bhūtāni tathā devī pravartate |
pūjayanti surāḥ sarve balaṃ nīrājayantyapi || 42 ||
meaning:
भवितव्यानि भूतानि तथा देवी प्रवर्तते |
पूजयन्ति सुराः सर्वे बलं नीराजयन्त्यपि || 42 ||
text_mt: have been and will be, and so the Goddess proceeds. / All the gods worship [her] and also wave lights over their army.

sanskrit_iast:
tathaiva ca narāḥ sarve kuryuḥ pūjāṃ yathāvidhi |
balanīrajanaṃ rājā kuryād balavivṛddhaye || 43 ||
meaning:
तथैव च नराः सर्वे कुर्युः पूजां यथाविधि |
बलनीरजनं राजा कुर्याद् बलविवृद्धये || 43 ||
text_mt: In the very same manner, all men should perform the worship according to rule; / a king should perform the waving of lights over his army for the increase of strength.

sanskrit_iast:
divyālaṅkārayuktābhirvāruṇībhiḥ pravartanam |
kartavyaṃ nṛtyagītāni krīḍākautukamaṅgalaiḥ || 44 ||
meaning:
दिव्यालङ्कारयुक्ताभिर्वारुणीभिः प्रवर्तनम् |
कर्तव्यं नृत्यगीतानि क्रीडाकौतुकमङ्गलैः || 44 ||
text_mt: The performance should be carried out with women drunk with liquor, adorned with divine ornaments, / accompanied by dances, songs, playful amusements, and auspicious ceremonies;

sanskrit_iast:
modakaiḥ piṣṭakaiḥ peyairbhakṣyabhojyairanekaśaḥ |
kūṣmāṇḍairnārikelaiśca kharjūraiḥ panasaistathā || 45 ||
meaning:
मोदकैः पिष्टकैः पेयैर्भक्ष्यभोज्यैरनेकशः |
कूष्माण्डैर्नारिकेलैश्च खर्जूरैः पनसैस्तथा || 45 ||
text_mt: with sweetmeats, cakes, drinks, foods to be chewed and foods to be eaten of many kinds; / with white gourds, coconuts, dates, and jackfruits;

sanskrit_iast:
drākṣāmalakaśāḍilyaiḥ plīhaiśca karuṇaistathā |
kaśerukramukairmūlaiḥ sajambutindukādibhiḥ || 46 ||
meaning:
द्राक्षामलकशाडिल्यैः प्लीहैश्च करुणैस्तथा |
कशेरुक्रमुकैर्मूलैः सजम्बुतिन्दुकादिभिः || 46 ||
text_mt: with grapes, āmalakas, bel fruits, plīhas, and citron limes; / with kaśeru roots, betel nuts, edible roots, along with jambu fruits, tindukas, and others;

sanskrit_iast:
gavyairguḍaistathā māṃsairmadyairmadhubhireva ca |
bālapriyaiśca naivedyairlājākṣataphalādibhiḥ || 47 ||
meaning:
गव्यैर्गुडैस्तथा मांसैर्मद्यैर्मधुभिरेव च |
बालप्रियैश्च नैवेद्यैर्लाजाक्षतफलादिभिः || 47 ||
text_mt: with products of cows, jaggery, meats, spirituous liquors, and honey; / with offerings beloved of children, parched grain, unhusked rice, fruits, and so forth;

sanskrit_iast:
ikṣudaṇḍaiḥ sitābhiśca lavalīnāgaraṅgakai |
ajābhirmahiṣairmeṣairātmaśoṇitasañcayaiḥ || 48 ||
meaning:
इक्षुदण्डैः सिताभिश्च लवलीनागरङ्गकै |
अजाभिर्महिषैर्मेषैरात्मशोणितसञ्चयैः || 48 ||
text_mt: with sugarcane stalks, white candies, lavalī fruits, and oranges; / with goats, buffaloes, sheep, and heaps of one's own blood;

sanskrit_iast:
pakṣyādibalijātīyaistathā nānāvidhairmṛgaiḥ |
pūjayecca jagaddhātrīṃ māṃsaśoṇitakardamaiḥ || 49 ||
meaning:
पक्ष्यादिबलिजातीयैस्तथा नानाविधैर्मृगैः |
पूजयेच्च जगद्धात्रीं मांसशोणितकर्दमैः || 49 ||
text_mt: with victims of the bird class, and likewise with various kinds of wild animals, / and with mires of flesh and blood, one should worship the Bearer of the Universe.

sanskrit_iast:
rātrau skandaviśākhasya kṛtvā piṣṭakaputrikām |
pūjayecchatrunāśāya durgāyāḥ prītaye tathā || 50 ||
meaning:
रात्रौ स्कन्दविशाखस्य कृत्वा पिष्टकपुत्रिकाम् |
पूजयेच्छत्रुनाशाय दुर्गायाः प्रीतये तथा || 50 ||
text_mt: Having made at night a dough effigy of Skanda-Viśākha, / one should worship it for the destruction of enemies and for the pleasure of Durgā.

sanskrit_iast:
homaṃ ca satilairājyairmāṃsairapi tathā caret |
ugracaṇḍādikāḥ pūjyāstathāṣṭau yoginīḥ śubhāḥ || 51 ||
meaning:
होमं च सतिलैराज्यैर्मांसैरपि तथा चरेत् |
उग्रचण्डादिकाः पूज्यास्तथाष्टौ योगिनीः शुभाः || 51 ||
text_mt: One should also perform the fire offering with sesame, clarified butter, and meats. / Ugracaṇḍā and the others, the eight auspicious yoginīs, are to be worshipped,

sanskrit_iast:
yoginyaśca catuḥṣaṣṭhistathā vai koṭiyoginīḥ |
navadurgāstathā pūjyā devyāḥ sannihitāḥ śubhāḥ || 52 ||
meaning:
योगिन्यश्च चतुःषष्ठिस्तथा वै कोटियोगिनीः |
नवदुर्गास्तथा पूज्या देव्याः सन्निहिताः शुभाः || 52 ||
text_mt: and the sixty-four yoginīs, and the millions of yoginīs; / likewise, the nine auspicious Durgās near to the Goddess are to be worshipped,

sanskrit_iast:
jayantyādirgandhapuṣpaistā devyā mūrtayo yataḥ |
devyaḥ sarvāṇi cāstrāṇi bhūṣaṇāni tathaiva ca || 53 ||
meaning:
जयन्त्यादिर्गन्धपुष्पैस्ता देव्या मूर्तयो यतः |
देव्यः सर्वाणि चास्त्राणि भूषणानि तथैव च || 53 ||
text_mt: beginning with Jayantī, with perfumes and flowers, since they are forms of the Goddess. / All the weapons of the Goddess, and likewise all the ornaments,

sanskrit_iast:
aṅgapratyaṅgayuktāni vāhanaṃ siṃhameva ca |
mahiṣāsuramardinyāḥ pūjayed bhūtaye sadā || 54 ||
meaning:
अङ्गप्रत्यङ्गयुक्तानि वाहनं सिंहमेव च |
महिषासुरमर्दिन्याः पूजयेद् भूतये सदा || 54 ||
text_mt: endowed with major and minor parts, and her mount, the lion itself, / of Mahiṣāsuramardinī one should always worship for prosperity.

sanskrit_iast:
purākalpe mahādevī manoḥ svāyambhuve'ntare |
nṛṇāṃ kṛtayugasyādau sarvadevaiḥ stutā sadā || 55 ||
meaning:
पुराकल्पे महादेवी मनोः स्वायम्भुवेऽन्तरे |
नृणां कृतयुगस्यादौ सर्वदेवैः स्तुता सदा || 55 ||
text_mt: In a previous kalpa, in the interval of the Svāyambhuva Manu, / at the beginning of the Kṛtayuga of men, the Great Goddess was always praised by all the gods,

sanskrit_iast:
mahiṣāsuranāśāya jagatāṃ hitakāmyayā |
yoganidrā mahāmāyā jagaddhātrī jaganmayī || 56 ||
meaning:
महिषासुरनाशाय जगतां हितकाम्यया |
योगनिद्रा महामाया जगद्धात्री जगन्मयी || 56 ||
text_mt: for the destruction of Mahiṣāsura, out of a desire for the welfare of the worlds: / Yoganidrā, Mahāmāyā, the Bearer of the Universe, who consists of the universe,

sanskrit_iast:
bhujaiḥ ṣoḍaśabhiryuktyā bhadrakālīti viśrutā |
kṣīrodasyottare tīre bibhratī vipulāṃ tanum || 57 ||
meaning:
भुजैः षोडशभिर्युक्त्या भद्रकालीति विश्रुता |
क्षीरोदस्योत्तरे तीरे बिभ्रती विपुलां तनुम् || 57 ||
text_mt: endowed fittingly with sixteen arms, renowned as Bhadrakālī, / sustaining a vast body on the northern shore of the Milk Ocean,

sanskrit_iast:
atasīpuṣpavarṇābhā jvalatkāñcanakuṇḍalā |
jaṭājūṭasakhaṇḍendukuṭatrayabhūṣitā || 58 ||
meaning:
अतसीपुष्पवर्णाभा ज्वलत्काञ्चनकुण्डला |
जटाजूटसखण्डेन्दुकुटत्रयभूषिता || 58 ||
text_mt: possessing the radiance of the colour of an atasī flower, with shining golden earrings, / adorned with three diadems bearing a crescent moon in her matted locks,

sanskrit_iast:
nāgahāreṇa sahitā svarṇahāravibhūṣitā |
śūlaṃ cakraṃ ca khaḍgaṃ śaṅkhaṃ bāṇaṃ tathaiva ca || 59 ||
meaning:
नागहारेण सहिता स्वर्णहारविभूषिता |
शूलं चक्रं च खड्गं शङ्खं बाणं तथैव च || 59 ||
text_mt: accompanied by a serpent necklace, decorated with a golden necklace, / [holding] a trident, a discus, a sword, a conch, and likewise an arrow,

sanskrit_iast:
śaktiṃ vajraṃ ca daṇḍaṃ ca nityaṃ dakṣiṇabāhubhiḥ |
bibhratī satataṃ devī vikāśidaśanojjvalā || 60 ||
meaning:
शक्तिं वज्रं च दण्डं च नित्यं दक्षिणबाहुभिः |
बिभ्रती सततं देवी विकाशिदशनोज्ज्वला || 60 ||
text_mt: a spear, a thunderbolt, and a staff perpetually in her right arms; / the Goddess ever holding [these], gleaming with smiling teeth,

sanskrit_iast:
kheṭakaṃ carma cāpaṃ ca pāśaṃ cāṅkuśameva ca |
ghaṇṭāṃ parśuṃ ca muṣalaṃ bibhratī vāmapāṇibhiḥ || 61 ||
meaning:
खेटकं चर्म चापं च पाशं चाङ्कुशमेव च |
घण्टां पर्शुं च मुषलं बिभ्रती वामपाणिभिः || 61 ||
text_mt: holding a shield, a buckler, a bow, a noose, and a goad, / a bell, an axe, and a pestle in her left hands,

sanskrit_iast:
siṃhasthā nayanai raktavarṇaistribhiratijvalā |
śūlena mahiṣaṃ bhittvā tiṣṭhantī parameśvarī || 62 ||
meaning:
सिंहस्था नयनै रक्तवर्णैस्त्रिभिरतिज्वला |
शूलेन महिषं भित्त्वा तिष्ठन्ती परमेश्वरी || 62 ||
text_mt: standing upon a lion, blazing intensely with three red-coloured eyes, / piercing the buffalo with her trident, the Supreme Mistress standing [there],

sanskrit_iast:
vāmapadena cākramya tatra devī jaganmayī |
tāṃ dṛṣṭvā sakalā devāḥ praṇamya parameśvarīm || 63 ||
meaning:
वामपदेन चाक्रम्य तत्र देवी जगन्मयी |
तां दृष्ट्वा सकला देवाः प्रणम्य परमेश्वरीम् || 63 ||
text_mt: having trampled him with her left foot—there, seeing that Goddess who consists of the universe, / all the gods, having bowed down to the Supreme Mistress,

sanskrit_iast:
nocuḥ kiñcana taṃ dṛṣṭvā nihataṃ mahiṣāsuram |
tataḥ provāca devāṃstān brahmādīn parameśvarī || 64 ||
meaning:
नोचुः किञ्चन तं दृष्ट्वा निहतं महिषासुरम् |
ततः प्रोवाच देवांस्तान् ब्रह्मादीन् परमेश्वरी || 64 ||
text_mt: said nothing, seeing that Mahiṣāsura slain. / Then the Supreme Mistress spoke to those gods, Brahmā and the others,

sanskrit_iast:
smitaprabhinnavadanā vikāśivadanojjvalā |
gacchantu bhoḥ suragaṇā jambudvīpāntaraṃ prati || 65 ||
meaning:
स्मितप्रभिन्नवदना विकाशिवदनोज्ज्वला |
गच्छन्तु भोः सुरगणा जम्बुद्वीपान्तरं प्रति || 65 ||
text_mt: her face breaking into a smile, radiant with an open countenance: / 'Go, O hosts of gods, towards the midst of Jambudvīpa,

sanskrit_iast:
himavat parvatāsanne varaṃ kātyāyanāśramam |
tatraiva bhavatāṃ sādhyaṃ bhaviṣyati na saṃśayaḥ || 66 ||
meaning:
हिमवत् पर्वतासन्ने वरं कात्यायनाश्रमम् |
तत्रैव भवतां साध्यं भविष्यति न संशयः || 66 ||
text_mt: to the excellent hermitage of Kātyāyana near Mount Himavat; / there indeed your purpose will be accomplished, without a doubt.'

sanskrit_iast:
ityuktvā sā mahādevī tatraivāntaradhīyata |
devā api tadā jagmuḥ kātyāyanamuneḥ puram || 67 ||
meaning:
इत्युक्त्वा सा महादेवी तत्रैवान्तरधीयत |
देवा अपि तदा जग्मुः कात्यायनमुनेः पुरम् || 67 ||
text_mt: Having spoken thus, that Great Goddess vanished right there; / the gods also then went to the abode of the sage Kātyāyana.

sanskrit_iast:
āśramaṃ prati te gatvā vismayāviṣṭamānasāḥ |
nihato mahiṣo devyā diṣṭo'smābhiryadarthataḥ || 68 ||
meaning:
आश्रमं प्रति ते गत्वा विस्मयाविष्टमानसाः |
निहतो महिषो देव्या दिष्टोऽस्माभिर्यदर्थतः || 68 ||
text_mt: Having gone toward the hermitage, their minds filled with astonishment, [they wondered]: / 'Mahiṣa, on whose account we were directed, has been slain by the Goddess,

sanskrit_iast:
stutā caiṣā mahādevī jagaddhātrī jaganmayī |
kimarthamāha sā devī gantuṃ kātyāyanāśramam || 69 ||
meaning:
स्तुता चैषा महादेवी जगद्धात्री जगन्मयी |
किमर्थमाह सा देवी गन्तुं कात्यायनाश्रमम् || 69 ||
text_mt: and this Great Goddess, the Bearer of the Universe, who consists of the universe, has been praised. / Why did that Goddess tell [us] to go to Kātyāyana's hermitage?

sanskrit_iast:
kimanyad vāñchitaṃ kāryamasmākaṃ vā bhaviṣyati |
iti bruvantaste sarve gacchanti sma parasparam || 70 ||
meaning:
किमन्यद् वाञ्छितं कार्यमस्माकं वा भविष्यति |
इति ब्रुवन्तस्ते सर्वे गच्छन्ति स्म परस्परम् || 70 ||
text_mt: What other desired task will there be for us?' / Saying this to one another, they all proceeded

sanskrit_iast:
himavat-parvatāsannaṃ muni-kātyāyanāśramam |
tataḥ sendrāḥ sadikpālā brahmaviṣṇuśivāstathā || 71 ||
meaning:
हिमवत्-पर्वतासन्नं मुनि-कात्यायनाश्रमम् |
ततः सेन्द्राः सदिक्पाला ब्रह्मविष्णुशिवास्तथा || 71 ||
text_mt: to the hermitage of the sage Kātyāyana near Mount Himavat. / Then, together with Indra, the guardians of the directions, and Brahmā, Viṣṇu, and Śiva,

sanskrit_iast:
niṣeduḥ suciraṃ prītā durgādarśanalālasāḥ |
tato rudragaṇāḥ sarve mahiṣāsuraceṣṭitam || 72 ||
meaning:
निषेदुः सुचिरं प्रीता दुर्गादर्शनलालसाः |
ततो रुद्रगणाः सर्वे महिषासुरचेष्टितम् || 72 ||
text_mt: they sat down for a long time, delighted, longing for a sight of Durgā. / Then all the troops of Rudras, having arrived,

sanskrit_iast:
āgatya kathayāmāsurdevalokaparābhavam |
tatastatra mahākopaṃ brahmaviṣṇuśivādayaḥ || 73 ||
meaning:
आगत्य कथयामासुर्देवलोकपराभवम् |
ततस्तत्र महाकोपं ब्रह्मविष्णुशिवादयः || 73 ||
text_mt: told of the actions of Mahiṣāsura and the defeat of the realm of the gods. / Then Brahmā, Viṣṇu, Śiva, and the others [conceived] great wrath there.

sanskrit_iast:
cakruḥ ko'nyo'sti mahiṣo hato devyā sa dānavaḥ |
punaryeneha kriyate jagadvidhvaṃsanaṃ bhṛśam || 74 ||
meaning:
चक्रुः कोऽन्योऽस्ति महिषो हतो देव्या स दानवः |
पुनर्येनेह क्रियते जगद्विध्वंसनं भृशम् || 74 ||
text_mt: They became enraged: "What other Mahiṣa is there? That Dānava was slain by the Goddess! / Who is it that again intensely destroys the universe here?"

sanskrit_iast:
iti prakupyatāṃ teṣāṃ śarīrebhyaḥ pṛthak pṛthak |
niścakramuśca tejāṃsi śaktirūpāṇi tatkṣaṇāt || 75 ||
meaning:
इति प्रकुप्यतां तेषां शरीरेभ्यः पृथक् पृथक् |
निश्चक्रमुश्च तेजांसि शक्तिरूपाणि तत्क्षणात् || 75 ||
text_mt: As they were thus enraged, from their bodies separately, / at that very moment, splendors in the form of Śaktis emerged.

sanskrit_iast:
tattejobhirdhṛtavapurdevī kātyāyanena vai |
sandhukṣitā pūjitā ca tena kātyāyanī smṛtā || 76 ||
meaning:
तत्तेजोभिर्धृतवपुर्देवी कात्यायनेन वै |
सन्धुक्षिता पूजिता च तेन कात्यायनी स्मृता || 76 ||
text_mt: The Goddess, assuming a physical form from those splendors, was indeed / kindled and worshipped by Kātyāyana; therefore she is remembered as Kātyāyanī.

sanskrit_iast:
tatastenaiva mantreṇa daśabāhuyutena vai |
paścājjaghāna mahiṣaṃ jagaddhātrī jaganmayī || 77 ||
meaning:
ततस्तेनैव मन्त्रेण दशबाहुयुतेन वै |
पश्चाज्जघान महिषं जगद्धात्री जगन्मयी || 77 ||
text_mt: Then, by that very mantra endowed with ten arms, / the maintainer of the universe, who embodies the world, later slew Mahiṣa.

sanskrit_iast:
yadā stutā mahādevī bodhitā cāśvinasya ca |
caturdaśī kṛṣṇapakṣe prādurbhūtā jaganmayī || 78 ||
meaning:
यदा स्तुता महादेवी बोधिता चाश्विनस्य च |
चतुर्दशी कृष्णपक्षे प्रादुर्भूता जगन्मयी || 78 ||
text_mt: When the Great Goddess was praised and awakened on the fourteenth day / of the dark fortnight of Āśvina, the embodiment of the universe appeared.

sanskrit_iast:
devānāṃ tejasāṃ mūrtiḥ śuklapakṣe suśobhane |
saptamyāṃ sā'karod devī aṣṭamyāṃ tairalaṅkṛtā || 79 ||
meaning:
देवानां तेजसां मूर्तिः शुक्लपक्षे सुशोभने |
सप्तम्यां साऽकरोद् देवी अष्टम्यां तैरलङ्कृता || 79 ||
text_mt: On the most auspicious seventh day of the bright fortnight, the Goddess / took on the form made of the splendors of the gods; on the eighth, she was adorned by them.

sanskrit_iast:
navamyāmupahāraistu pūjitā mahiṣāsuram |
nijaghāna daśamyāṃ tu visṛṣṭāntarhitā śivā || 80 ||
meaning:
नवम्यामुपहारैस्तु पूजिता महिषासुरम् |
निजघान दशम्यां तु विसृष्टान्तर्हिता शिवा || 80 ||
text_mt: On the ninth day, she was worshipped with offerings and slew the demon Mahiṣa; / but on the tenth day, having been dismissed, the auspicious one vanished.

sanskrit_iast: mārkaṇḍeya uvāca
meaning: मार्कण्डेय उवाच

sanskrit_iast:
śrutvemāṃ sagaro rājā devyāḥ saṅgatimuttamām |
saṃśayāluśca tadrūpe punaraurvamapṛcchat || 81 ||
meaning:
श्रुत्वेमां सगरो राजा देव्याः सङ्गतिमुत्तमाम् |
संशयालुश्च तद्रूपे पुनरौर्वमपृच्छत् || 81 ||
text_mt: Having heard this supreme account of the Goddess, King Sagara, / feeling doubtful regarding her form, asked Aurva again:

sanskrit_iast: sagara uvāca
meaning: सगर उवाच

sanskrit_iast:
yadi paścānmahādevī jaghāna mahiṣāsuram |
kathaṃ pūrvaṃ hadrakālī-rūpābhūnmahiṣāsuram || 82 ||
meaning:
यदि पश्चान्महादेवी जघान महिषासुरम् |
कथं पूर्वं हद्रकाली-रूपाभून्महिषासुरम् || 82 ||
text_mt: "If the Great Goddess killed the demon Mahiṣa later, / how did she previously assume the form of Bhadrakālī [concerning] the demon Mahiṣa?

sanskrit_iast:
tathāhi darśanaṃ tasyāḥ pādākrāntaścakāra ca |
hṛdiśūlena nirbhinnaṃ dadṛśuḥ sakalāḥ surāḥ |
evaṃ tu saṃśayaṃ chindhi muniśreṣṭha samādhunā || 83 ||
meaning:
तथाहि दर्शनं तस्याः पादाक्रान्तश्चकार च |
हृदिशूलेन निर्भिन्नं ददृशुः सकलाः सुराः |
एवं तु संशयं छिन्धि मुनिश्रेष्ठ समाधुना || 83 ||
text_mt: For she was seen by all the gods / standing on him with her foot, having pierced his heart with her trident. / Cut away this doubt, O best of sages, right now!"

sanskrit_iast: aurva uvāca
meaning: और्व उवाच

sanskrit_iast:
śṛṇu tvaṃ nṛpaśārdūla bhadrakālī yathā purā |
prādurbhūtā mahāmāyā mahiṣeṇa sahaiva tu || 84 ||
meaning:
शृणु त्वं नृपशार्दूल भद्रकाली यथा पुरा |
प्रादुर्भूता महामाया महिषेण सहैव तु || 84 ||
text_mt: "Listen, O tiger among kings, how Mahāmāyā formerly appeared / as Bhadrakālī along with Mahiṣa himself.

sanskrit_iast:
mahiṣāsura evāsau nidrāyāṃ niśi parvate |
svapnaṃ pradadṛśe vīro dāruṇaṃ ghoradarśanam || 85 ||
meaning:
महिषासुर एवासौ निद्रायां निशि पर्वते |
स्वप्नं प्रददृशे वीरो दारुणं घोरदर्शनम् || 85 ||
text_mt: That very demon Mahiṣa, asleep at night on a mountain, / that heroic one saw a cruel dream of dreadful sight:

sanskrit_iast:
mahāmāyā bhadrakālī chittvā khaḍgena me śiraḥ |
papau tasya ca raktāni vyāditāsyātibhīṣaṇā || 86 ||
meaning:
महामाया भद्रकाली छित्त्वा खड्गेन मे शिरः |
पपौ तस्य च रक्तानि व्यादितास्यातिभीषणा || 86 ||
text_mt: Mahāmāyā Bhadrakālī, having severed my head with a sword, / drank its blood, having opened her mouth, exceedingly terrifying.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ prātarbhayayutaḥ sa daityo mahiṣāsuraḥ |
tāmeva pūjayāmāsa suciraṃ sānugastadā || 87 ||
meaning:
ततः प्रातर्भययुतः स दैत्यो महिषासुरः |
तामेव पूजयामास सुचिरं सानुगस्तदा || 87 ||
text_mt: Then in the morning, filled with fear, that Daitya, the demon Mahiṣa, / along with his followers, worshipped that very goddess for a long time.

sanskrit_iast:
ārādhitā tadā devī mahiṣeṇāsureṇa vai |
prādurbhūtā bhadrakālī bhujaiḥ ṣoḍaśabhiryutā || 88 ||
meaning:
आराधिता तदा देवी महिषेणासुरेण वै |
प्रादुर्भूता भद्रकाली भुजैः षोडशभिर्युता || 88 ||
text_mt: Then the Goddess, propitiated by the demon Mahiṣa, / appeared as Bhadrakālī endowed with sixteen arms.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ praṇamya mahiṣo mahāmāyāṃ jaganmayīm |
uvācedaṃ vaco namramūrtirbhaktiyuto'suraḥ || 89 ||
meaning:
ततः प्रणम्य महिषो महामायां जगन्मयीम् |
उवाचेदं वचो नम्रमूर्तिर्भक्तियुतोऽसुरः || 89 ||
text_mt: Then, bowing down to Mahāmāyā who embodies the universe, / Mahiṣa, the Asura of humble demeanor, spoke these words with devotion."

sanskrit_iast: mahiṣa uvāca
meaning: महिष उवाच

sanskrit_iast:
devi khaḍgena sañchidya śoṇitāni śiro mama |
tvayā muktāni dṛṣṭāni mayā svapnena niścitam || 90 ||
meaning:
देवि खड्गेन सञ्छिद्य शोणितानि शिरो मम |
त्वया मुक्तानि दृष्टानि मया स्वप्नेन निश्चितम् || 90 ||
text_mt: "O Goddess, severing my head with a sword, the blood / released by you was seen definitely by me in a dream.

sanskrit_iast:
avaśyaṃ tu tvayā kāryaṃ mayā jñātaṃ pramāṇataḥ |
etadrudhirapāaṃ me tatraikaṃ dehi me varam || 91 ||
meaning:
अवश्यं तु त्वया कार्यं मया ज्ञातं प्रमाणतः |
एतद्रुधिरपाअं मे तत्रैकं देहि मे वरम् || 91 ||
text_mt: It must inevitably be done by you; this is known to me with certainty, / this drinking of my blood. In regard to that, grant me a single boon!

sanskrit_iast:
vadhyastavāhaṃ nātrāsti saṃśayaḥ parameśvari |
mamāpi tatra no duḥkhaṃ niyatiḥ kena laṅghyate || 92 ||
meaning:
वध्यस्तवाहं नात्रास्ति संशयः परमेश्वरि |
ममापि तत्र नो दुःखं नियतिः केन लङ्घ्यते || 92 ||
text_mt: I am to be slain by you, there is no doubt about this, O Supreme Goddess! / Nor do I feel sorrow in that; who can transgress destiny?

sanskrit_iast:
kintu tvayaiva sahitaḥ śambhurārādhitaḥ purā |
mama pitrā madarthena jātaḥ paścādahaṃ tataḥ || 93 ||
meaning:
किन्तु त्वयैव सहितः शम्भुराराधितः पुरा |
मम पित्रा मदर्थेन जातः पश्चादहं ततः || 93 ||
text_mt: Yet formerly Śambhu was worshipped together with you / by my father for my sake, and I was born from that afterwards.

sanskrit_iast:
mayāpyārādhitaḥ śambhuḥ prāptāśceṣṭāstathāvidhāḥ |
manvantaratrayaṃ yāvadāsuraṃ rājyamuttamam || 94 ||
meaning:
मयाप्याराधितः शम्भुः प्राप्ताश्चेष्टास्तथाविधाः |
मन्वन्तरत्रयं यावदासुरं राज्यमुत्तमम् || 94 ||
text_mt: Śambhu was worshipped by me also, and such desired things were obtained: / an excellent demonic sovereignty lasting for three Manvantaras

sanskrit_iast:
akaṇṭakaṃ mayā bhuktamanutāpo na vidyate |
kātyāyanena muninā śapto'haṃ śiṣyakāraṇāt || 95 ||
meaning:
अकण्टकं मया भुक्तमनुतापो न विद्यते |
कात्यायनेन मुनिना शप्तोऽहं शिष्यकारणात् || 95 ||
text_mt: has been enjoyed by me without a thorn; there is no regret. / [Yet] I was cursed by the sage Kātyāyana on account of a disciple:

sanskrit_iast:
sīmantinī vināśaṃ te kariṣyati na saṃśayaḥ |
purā muniṃ tapasyantaṃ raudrāśvaṃ nāma sattamam || 96 ||
meaning:
सीमन्तिनी विनाशं ते करिष्यति न संशयः |
पुरा मुनिं तपस्यन्तं रौद्राश्वं नाम सत्तमम् || 96 ||
text_mt: 'A woman will bring about your destruction, there is no doubt.' / Formerly, when the sage, the excellent one named Raudrāśva,

sanskrit_iast:
muneḥ kātyāyanākhyasya śiṣyaṃ himavadantike |
divyastrīrūpamatulaṃ kṛtvāhaṃ kautukāt tadā || 97 ||
meaning:
मुनेः कात्यायनाख्यस्य शिष्यं हिमवदन्तिके |
दिव्यस्त्रीरूपमतुलं कृत्वाहं कौतुकात् तदा || 97 ||
text_mt: the disciple of the sage named Kātyāyana, was practicing austerities near the Himavat, / I, assuming an incomparable divine female form in jest at that time,

sanskrit_iast:
mayā sammohito vipro'tyajat sadyastadā tapaḥ |
nadūrāt saṃsthitenāhaṃ muninā kātyasūnunā || 97 ||
meaning:
मया सम्मोहितो विप्रोऽत्यजत् सद्यस्तदा तपः |
नदूरात् संस्थितेनाहं मुनिना कात्यसूनुना || 97 ||
text_mt: beguiled that Vipra, who then immediately abandoned his austerities. / By the sage, the son of Katya, residing not far away,

sanskrit_iast:
jñātvā māyāṃ tadā śaptaḥ śiṣyārthe krodhavahninā |
yasmāt tvayā me śiṣyo'yaṃ mohitastapasaścyutaḥ || 99 ||
meaning:
ज्ञात्वा मायां तदा शप्तः शिष्यार्थे क्रोधवह्निना |
यस्मात् त्वया मे शिष्योऽयं मोहितस्तपसश्च्युतः || 99 ||
text_mt: perceiving the illusion, I was cursed with the fire of wrath on account of his disciple: / 'Because this disciple of mine was bewitched by you and caused to fall from austerity,

sanskrit_iast:
kṛtastvayā strīrūpeṇa tat tvāṃ strī nihaniṣyati |
iti māṃ śaptavān pūrvaṃ muniḥ kātyāyanaḥ svayam || 100 ||
meaning:
कृतस्त्वया स्त्रीरूपेण तत् त्वां स्त्री निहनिष्यति |
इति मां शप्तवान् पूर्वं मुनिः कात्यायनः स्वयम् || 100 ||
text_mt: having been done by you in the form of a woman, therefore a woman shall kill you.' / Thus the sage Kātyāyana himself formerly cursed me.

sanskrit_iast:
tasya śāpasya kālo'yamāgatya samupasthitaḥ |
devendratvaṃ mayā prāptaṃ bhuktaṃ tribhuvanaṃ samam || 101 ||
meaning:
तस्य शापस्य कालोऽयमागत्य समुपस्थितः |
देवेन्द्रत्वं मया प्राप्तं भुक्तं त्रिभुवनं समम् || 101 ||
text_mt: The time for that curse has arrived and is at hand. / Sovereignty over the gods was attained by me; the three worlds were enjoyed equally.

sanskrit_iast:
kiñcinna śocyaṃ me'trāsti vāñchanīyaṃ hi yanmayā |
tasmāt tvāṃ vai prapanno'haṃ prārthyaṃ śeṣaṃ hi yanmama |
yadūdehi devi durge tvaṃ bhūyastubhyaṃ namo namaḥ || 102 ||
meaning:
किञ्चिन्न शोच्यं मेऽत्रास्ति वाञ्छनीयं हि यन्मया |
तस्मात् त्वां वै प्रपन्नोऽहं प्रार्थ्यं शेषं हि यन्मम |
यदूदेहि देवि दुर्गे त्वं भूयस्तुभ्यं नमो नमः || 102 ||
text_mt: There is nothing here for me to grieve over, for whatever I desired / [has been obtained]. Therefore I take refuge in you. For whatever remains to be asked by me, / grant that, O Goddess Durgā! Obeisance, obeisance to you again!"

sanskrit_iast: devyuvāca
meaning: देव्युवाच

sanskrit_iast:
prārthanīyo varo yaste taṃ vṛṇuṣva mahāsura |
dāsyāmi te varaṃ prārthyaṃ saṃśayo nātra vidyate || 103 ||
meaning:
प्रार्थनीयो वरो यस्ते तं वृणुष्व महासुर |
दास्यामि ते वरं प्रार्थ्यं संशयो नात्र विद्यते || 103 ||
text_mt: "Choose the boon that is to be requested by you, O great Asura! / I will grant you the requested boon; there is no doubt in this."

sanskrit_iast: mahiṣa uvāca
meaning: महिष उवाच

sanskrit_iast:
yajñabhāgamahaṃ bhoktumicchāmi tvatprasādataḥ |
yathā makheṣu sarveṣu pūjyo'haṃ syāṃ tathā kuru || 104 ||
meaning:
यज्ञभागमहं भोक्तुमिच्छामि त्वत्प्रसादतः |
यथा मखेषु सर्वेषु पूज्योऽहं स्यां तथा कुरु || 104 ||
text_mt: "I wish to enjoy a share of the sacrifice through your grace. / Act so that I may be worthy of worship in all sacrifices!

sanskrit_iast:
tvatpādasevāṃ na tyakṣye yāvatsūryaḥ pravartate |
evaṃ varadvayaṃ dehi yadi deyo varo mama || 105 ||
meaning:
त्वत्पादसेवां न त्यक्ष्ये यावत्सूर्यः प्रवर्तते |
एवं वरद्वयं देहि यदि देयो वरो मम || 105 ||
text_mt: I shall not abandon service to your feet as long as the sun continues [to shine]. / Thus grant this pair of boons, if a boon is to be given to me."

sanskrit_iast: devyuvāca
meaning: देव्युवाच

sanskrit_iast:
yajñabhāgāḥ surebhyastu kalpitā vai pṛthak pṛthak |
bhāgo na vidyate cānyo yaṃ dāsyāmi tavādhunā || 106 ||
meaning:
यज्ञभागाः सुरेभ्यस्तु कल्पिता वै पृथक् पृथक् |
भागो न विद्यते चान्यो यं दास्यामि तवाधुना || 106 ||
text_mt: "Shares of sacrifice have indeed been apportioned separately to the gods; / there is no other share that I might give to you now.

sanskrit_iast:
kintu tvayi mayā yuddhe nihate mahiṣāsura |
naiva tyakṣyasi matpādaṃ satataṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ || 107 ||
meaning:
किन्तु त्वयि मया युद्धे निहते महिषासुर |
नैव त्यक्ष्यसि मत्पादं सततं नात्र संशयः || 107 ||
text_mt: However, when you are slain by me in battle, O demon Mahiṣa, / you shall certainly never leave my feet constantly; there is no doubt in this.

sanskrit_iast:
mama pravartate pūjā yatra yatra ca tatra te |
pūjyaścintyaśca tatraiva kāyo'yaṃ tava dānava || 108 ||
meaning:
मम प्रवर्तते पूजा यत्र यत्र च तत्र ते |
पूज्यश्चिन्त्यश्च तत्रैव कायोऽयं तव दानव || 108 ||
text_mt: Wherever my worship is performed, right there this body / of yours, O Dānava, is to be worshipped and meditated upon."

sanskrit_iast:
iti śrutvā vacastasyāḥ pratyūṣe mahiṣāsuraḥ |
varaṃ prāpyeha muditaḥ prasannavadanastadā || 109 ||
meaning:
इति श्रुत्वा वचस्तस्याः प्रत्यूषे महिषासुरः |
वरं प्राप्येह मुदितः प्रसन्नवदनस्तदा || 109 ||
text_mt: Having heard her word, at daybreak the demon Mahiṣa, / having obtained the boon here, became delighted, with a joyful face then.

sanskrit_iast:
ugracaṇḍe bhadrakāli durge devi namo'stute |
prabhūtā mūrtayā devi bhavatyā sakalātmikāḥ || 110 ||
meaning:
उग्रचण्डे भद्रकालि दुर्गे देवि नमोऽस्तुते |
प्रभूता मूर्तया देवि भवत्या सकलात्मिकाः || 110 ||
text_mt: "O Ugracaṇḍā, O Bhadrakālī, O Goddess Durgā, obeisance be to you! / Manifold are your forms, O Goddess, comprising all.

sanskrit_iast:
kābhiste mūrtibhiḥ pūjyo yajñe'haṃ parameśvari |
tat samācakṣva yadi me bhavatyeha kṛpā kṛtā || 111 ||
meaning:
काभिस्ते मूर्तिभिः पूज्यो यज्ञेऽहं परमेश्वरि |
तत् समाचक्ष्व यदि मे भवत्येह कृपा कृता || 111 ||
text_mt: Through which of your forms am I to be worshipped in sacrifice, O Supreme Goddess? / Tell me that, if grace has been shown to me by you here!"

sanskrit_iast: devyuvāca
meaning: देव्युवाच

sanskrit_iast:
yāni nāmāni proktāni tvayeha mahiṣāsura |
tāsu mūrtiṣu saṃpṛṣṭaḥ pūjyo loke bhaviṣyasi || 112 ||
meaning:
यानि नामानि प्रोक्तानि त्वयेह महिषासुर |
तासु मूर्तिषु संपृष्टः पूज्यो लोके भविष्यसि || 112 ||
text_mt: "Those names that have been spoken here by you, O demon Mahiṣa, / joined to those forms, you will be worshipped in the world.

sanskrit_iast:
ugracaṇḍeti yā mūrtirbhadrakālī hyahaṃ punaḥ |
yayā mūrtyā tvāṃ haniṣye sā durgeti prakīrtitā || 113 ||
meaning:
उग्रचण्डेति या मूर्तिर्भद्रकाली ह्यहं पुनः |
यया मूर्त्या त्वां हनिष्ये सा दुर्गेति प्रकीर्तिता || 113 ||
text_mt: The form which is Ugracaṇḍā, and then I am Bhadrakālī; / and by which form I shall kill you, that is proclaimed as Durgā.

sanskrit_iast:
etāsu mūrtiṣu sadā pādalagno nṛṇāṃ bhavān |
pūjyo bhaviṣyati svarge devānāmapi rakṣasām || 114 ||
meaning:
एतासु मूर्तिषु सदा पादलग्नो नृणां भवान् |
पूज्यो भविष्यति स्वर्गे देवानामपि रक्षसाम् || 114 ||
text_mt: Attached to my feet in these forms, you will always be / worshipped by men, in heaven even by gods, and by Rakṣases.

sanskrit_iast:
ādisṛṣṭāvugracaṇḍāmūrtyā tvaṃ nihitaḥ purā |
dvitīyasṛṣṭau tu bhavān bhadrakālyā mayā hataḥ || 115 ||
meaning:
आदिसृष्टावुग्रचण्डामूर्त्या त्वं निहितः पुरा |
द्वितीयसृष्टौ तु भवान् भद्रकाल्या मया हतः || 115 ||
text_mt: In the primeval creation, you were slain formerly by the form of Ugracaṇḍā; / in the second creation, you were killed by me as Bhadrakālī.

sanskrit_iast:
durgārūpeṇādhunā tvāṃ haniṣvāmi sahānugam |
kintu pūrva na gṛhītastvaṃ mayā pādayostale || 116 ||
meaning:
दुर्गारूपेणाधुना त्वां हनिष्वामि सहानुगम् |
किन्तु पूर्व न गृहीतस्त्वं मया पादयोस्तले || 116 ||
text_mt: Now in the form of Durgā I shall slay you along with your followers; / but previously you were not held by me beneath my feet."

sanskrit_iast:
adhunā prārthitavaro grahītaḥ pūrvakāmayoḥ |
grahītavyaśca paścāt tvaṃ yajñabhāgopabhuktaye || 117 ||
meaning:
अधुना प्रार्थितवरो ग्रहीतः पूर्वकामयोः |
ग्रहीतव्यश्च पश्चात् त्वं यज्ञभागोपभुक्तये || 117 ||
text_mt: Now the boon requested is granted in accordance with your two former desires; / and you must be taken beneath [my feet] afterwards so that you may enjoy a share of the sacrifice.

sanskrit_iast: aurva uvāca
meaning: और्व उवाच

sanskrit_iast:
ityuktvā sā mahāmāyā ugracaṇḍāhvayāṃ tanum |
darśayāmāsa ca tadā mahiṣāyāsurāya vai || 118 ||
meaning:
इत्युक्त्वा सा महामाया उग्रचण्डाह्वयां तनुम् |
दर्शयामास च तदा महिषायासुराय वै || 118 ||
text_mt: Having spoken thus, that Mahāmāyā revealed her form named Ugracaṇḍā / to the asura Mahiṣa.

sanskrit_iast:
yā mūrtiḥ ṣoḍaśabhujā bhadrakālīti viśrutā |
tathaiva mūrti bāhubhyāmaparābhyāṃ tu bibhratī || 119 ||
meaning:
या मूर्तिः षोडशभुजा भद्रकालीति विश्रुता |
तथैव मूर्ति बाहुभ्यामपराभ्यां तु बिभ्रती || 119 ||
text_mt: That form which has sixteen arms, celebrated as Bhadrakālī, / holding [weapons] in that manner, but with two additional arms,

sanskrit_iast:
dakṣiṇādho gadāṃ vāmapāṇinā pānapātrakam |
surāpūrṇaṃ ca śirasā muṇḍamālāṃ vileśayam || 120 ||
meaning:
दक्षिणाधो गदां वामपाणिना पानपात्रकम् |
सुरापूर्णं च शिरसा मुण्डमालां विलेशयम् || 120 ||
text_mt: [holding] a club in the lower right hand and a drinking cup in the left hand / filled with liquor, and bearing on her head a garland of severed heads and a serpent,

sanskrit_iast:
bhinnāñjanacayaprakhyā pracaṇḍā siṃhavāhinī |
raktanetrā mahākāyā yuktā'ṣṭādaśabāhubhiḥ || 121 ||
meaning:
भिन्नाञ्जनचयप्रख्या प्रचण्डा सिंहवाहिनी |
रक्तनेत्रा महाकाया युक्ताऽष्टादशबाहुभिः || 121 ||
text_mt: resembling a mass of split collyrium, fierce, riding a lion, / red-eyed, of gigantic body, endowed with eighteen arms—

sanskrit_iast:
ugracaṇḍā bhadrakālī devyā mūrtidvayaṃ tathā |
mahiṣaḥ praṇanāmāśu dṛṣṭvā vismayamāgataḥ || 122 ||
meaning:
उग्रचण्डा भद्रकाली देव्या मूर्तिद्वयं तथा |
महिषः प्रणनामाशु दृष्ट्वा विस्मयमागतः || 122 ||
text_mt: Ugracaṇḍā and Bhadrakālī, the two forms of the Goddess: / upon seeing them Mahiṣa was struck with wonder and swiftly bowed down.

sanskrit_iast:
tato yathā padākramya nihato mahiṣāsuraḥ |
tathaiva jagṛhe pādatale devīdvayaṃ tu tam || 123 ||
meaning:
ततो यथा पदाक्रम्य निहतो महिषासुरः |
तथैव जगृहे पादतले देवीद्वयं तु तम् || 123 ||
text_mt: Then, just as the asura Mahiṣa had been slain having been trampled by her foot, / so indeed the two Goddesses seized him beneath their feet.

sanskrit_iast:
hṛdi śūlena nirbhinnaṃ māhiṣaṃ viśiraskakam |
guhītakeśaṃ devyā tu iryadantravibhūṣitam || 124 ||
meaning:
हृदि शूलेन निर्भिन्नं माहिषं विशिरस्ककम् |
गुहीतकेशं देव्या तु इर्यदन्त्रविभूषितम् || 124 ||
text_mt: Pierced in the chest with a trident, the buffalo [demon] beheaded, / his hair seized by the Goddess, adorned with spilled entrails,

sanskrit_iast:
vamadraktaṃ mahākāyaṃ dṛṣṭvā pūrvatanuṃ svakam |
bhayaṃ prāpyāsuraḥ so'tha śuśoca ca mumoha ca || 125 ||
meaning:
वमद्रक्तं महाकायं दृष्ट्वा पूर्वतनुं स्वकम् |
भयं प्राप्यासुरः सोऽथ शुशोच च मुमोह च || 125 ||
text_mt: vomiting blood, gigantic—seeing his own former body, / that asura then felt fear, and he grieved and swooned.

sanskrit_iast:
tatastu kṣaṇamātmānaṃ saṃstabhya sa tu dānavaḥ |
praṇamya vacanaṃ devīmidamāha sa gadgadam || 126 ||
meaning:
ततस्तु क्षणमात्मानं संस्तभ्य स तु दानवः |
प्रणम्य वचनं देवीमिदमाह स गद्गदम् || 126 ||
text_mt: Then, steadying himself for a moment, that dānava, / having bowed, spoke these words to the Goddess in a choked voice:

sanskrit_iast: mahiṣa uvāca
meaning: महिष उवाच

sanskrit_iast:
yadi devi prasannāsi yajñabhāgāśca kalpitāḥ |
tadā mamānyadā nāśa evametad bhavenna hi || 127 ||
meaning:
यदि देवि प्रसन्नासि यज्ञभागाश्च कल्पिताः |
तदा ममान्यदा नाश एवमेतद् भवेन्न हि || 127 ||
text_mt: “If you are pleased, O Goddess, and shares of the sacrifice have been assigned, / then at any other time may my destruction not happen like this!

sanskrit_iast:
yathāhaṃ na suraiḥ sārdhaṃ kariṣye vairamadbhutam |
tathā māṃ kuru bho devi na janma pralabhe yathā || 128 ||
meaning:
यथाहं न सुरैः सार्धं करिष्ये वैरमद्भुतम् |
तथा मां कुरु भो देवि न जन्म प्रलभे यथा || 128 ||
text_mt: Make it so, O Goddess, that I will not enter into wondrous enmity with the gods, / and in such a way that I may not take birth again.”

sanskrit_iast: devyuvāca
meaning: देव्युवाच

sanskrit_iast:
ārādhitā'haṃ bhavatā varo datto mayā tava |
vadhyaśca tvaṃ mamaiveha nātra kāryā vicāraṇā || 129 ||
meaning:
आराधिताऽहं भवता वरो दत्तो मया तव |
वध्यश्च त्वं ममैवेह नात्र कार्या विचारणा || 129 ||
text_mt: “I have been worshipped by you, and a boon has been granted by me to you; / but you must be slain here only by me, there is no deliberation needed here.

sanskrit_iast:
yat tvayā prārthitaṃ cāpi sarvaiḥ suragaṇaiḥ saha |
virodho me sadā mā bhūditi cāpi bhaviṣyati || 130 ||
meaning:
यत् त्वया प्रार्थितं चापि सर्वैः सुरगणैः सह |
विरोधो मे सदा मा भूदिति चापि भविष्यति || 130 ||
text_mt: And what you prayed for: ‘May there never be enmity between me / and all the hosts of gods’—that too shall come to pass.

sanskrit_iast:
matpādatalasaṃsparśāccharīraṃ tava dānava |
yajñabhāgopabhogāya viśīrṇaṃ na bhaviṣyati || 131 ||
meaning:
मत्पादतलसंस्पर्शाच्छरीरं तव दानव |
यज्ञभागोपभोगाय विशीर्णं न भविष्यति || 131 ||
text_mt: From the contact with the soles of my feet, O dānava, your body / will not decay, so that you may enjoy a share of the sacrifice.

sanskrit_iast:
tava jīvātmabhiḥ prāṇāḥ sarva eva mahāsuraḥ |
harasya pādasaṃyogācciraṃ sthāsyati kevalam || 132 ||
meaning:
तव जीवात्मभिः प्राणाः सर्व एव महासुरः |
हरस्य पादसंयोगाच्चिरं स्थास्यति केवलम् || 132 ||
text_mt: All the vital breaths with your individual souls, O great asura, / shall remain enduringly solely through contact with the foot of Hara.

sanskrit_iast:
kalpakoṭisahasrāṇi triṃśat tvaṃ mahiṣāsura |
śatāni cāṣṭāvanyāni janma te na bhaviṣyati || 133 ||
meaning:
कल्पकोटिसहस्राणि त्रिंशत् त्वं महिषासुर |
शतानि चाष्टावन्यानि जन्म ते न भविष्यति || 133 ||
text_mt: For thirty thousand crores of kalpas, O asura Mahiṣa, / and another eight hundred, you will have no rebirth.”

sanskrit_iast:
iti devī varaṃ dattvā mahiṣāyāsurāya vai |
praṇatā tena śirasā tatraivāntaradhīyata || 134 ||
meaning:
इति देवी वरं दत्त्वा महिषायासुराय वै |
प्रणता तेन शिरसा तत्रैवान्तरधीयत || 134 ||
text_mt: Having thus granted the boon to the asura Mahiṣa, the Goddess, / bowed to by him with his head, vanished right there.

sanskrit_iast:
mahiṣo'pi nijasthānaṃ ayau saṃmohitaḥ punaḥ |
māyayā cāsuraṃ bhāvamādāya nṛpa pūrvavat || 135 ||
meaning:
महिषोऽपि निजस्थानं अयौ संमोहितः पुनः |
मायया चासुरं भावमादाय नृप पूर्ववत् || 135 ||
text_mt: Mahiṣa too went to his own abode, deluded again / by Māyā, adopting his demonic nature as before, O king.

sanskrit_iast: sagara uvāca
meaning: सगर उवाच

sanskrit_iast:
aneke nihitā daityā māyayā lokabhūtaye |
na te punaḥ pragṛhītāstebhyo dattvā varāñ śubhān |
ena vā kāraṇenāyaṃ pragṛhīto varaḥ katham |
dattāstasmai samācakṣva mama samyag dvijottama || 136 ||
meaning:
अनेके निहिता दैत्या मायया लोकभूतये |
न ते पुनः प्रगृहीतास्तेभ्यो दत्त्वा वराञ् शुभान् |
एन वा कारणेनायं प्रगृहीतो वरः कथम् |
दत्तास्तस्मै समाचक्ष्व मम सम्यग् द्विजोत्तम || 136 ||
text_mt: “Many daityas were slain by Māyā for the welfare of the world, / but they were not taken [under her feet] again after granting them auspicious boons. / For what reason was this one accepted, and why were boons / granted to him? Explain this to me properly, O best of the twice-born.”

sanskrit_iast: aurva uvāca
meaning: और्व उवाच

sanskrit_iast:
ārādhito mahādevo rambheṇa suravairiṇā |
cireṇa sa ca suprītastapasā tasya śaṅkaraḥ || 137 ||
meaning:
आराधितो महादेवो रम्भेण सुरवैरिणा |
चिरेण स च सुप्रीतस्तपसा तस्य शङ्करः || 137 ||
text_mt: Mahādeva was worshipped by Rambha, the enemy of the gods; / after a long time Śaṅkara was well pleased with his ascetic penance.

sanskrit_iast:
atha tuṣṭo mahādevaḥ pratyakṣaṃ rambhamucivān |
prīto'smi te varaṃ rambha varayasva yathepsitam || 138 ||
meaning:
अथ तुष्टो महादेवः प्रत्यक्षं रम्भमुचिवान् |
प्रीतोऽस्मि ते वरं रम्भ वरयस्व यथेप्सितम् || 138 ||
text_mt: Then, being satisfied, Mahādeva spoke visibly to Rambha: / ‘I am pleased with you, Rambha! Choose a boon as you desire.’

sanskrit_iast:
evamuktaḥ pratyuvāca rambhastaṃ candraśekharam |
aputro'ha mahādeva yadi te mayyanugrahaḥ || 139 ||
meaning:
एवमुक्तः प्रत्युवाच रम्भस्तं चन्द्रशेखरम् |
अपुत्रोऽह महादेव यदि ते मय्यनुग्रहः || 139 ||
text_mt: Being addressed thus, Rambha answered that Candraśekhara: / ‘I am sonless, O Mahādeva, if you have favor toward me,

sanskrit_iast:
mama janmatraye putro bhavān bhavatu śaṅkara |
avadhyaḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ jetā ca tridivaukasām || 140 ||
meaning:
मम जन्मत्रये पुत्रो भवान् भवतु शङ्कर |
अवध्यः सर्वभूतानां जेता च त्रिदिवौकसाम् || 140 ||
text_mt: may you, O Śaṅkara, become my son in three births, / invulnerable to all beings, and a conqueror of the dwellers of heaven,

sanskrit_iast:
cirāyuśca yaśasvī ca lakṣmīvān sa ca śaṅkara |
evamuktastu daityena pratyuvāca vṛṣadhvajaḥ || 141 ||
meaning:
चिरायुश्च यशस्वी च लक्ष्मीवान् स च शङ्कर |
एवमुक्तस्तु दैत्येन प्रत्युवाच वृषध्वजः || 141 ||
text_mt: long-lived, renowned, and prosperous, O Śaṅkara!’ / Being spoken to thus by the daitya, the bull-bannered [god] replied:

sanskrit_iast:
bhavatvetadvāñchitaṃ te bhaviṣyāmi sutastava |
ityuktvā sa mahādevastatraivāntaradhīyata || 142 ||
meaning:
भवत्वेतद्वाञ्छितं ते भविष्यामि सुतस्तव |
इत्युक्त्वा स महादेवस्तत्रैवान्तरधीयत || 142 ||
text_mt: ‘Let this desired wish of yours be so; I will become your son.’ / Having said this, that Mahādeva vanished right there.

sanskrit_iast:
rambho'pi yātaḥ svasthānaṃ harṣotphullavilocanaḥ |
pathi gacchan sa rambho'tha dadarśa mahiṣīṃ śubhām || 143 ||
meaning:
रम्भोऽपि यातः स्वस्थानं हर्षोत्फुल्लविलोचनः |
पथि गच्छन् स रम्भोऽथ ददर्श महिषीं शुभाम् || 143 ||
text_mt: Rambha too went to his own place, his eyes blooming with joy. / Then, going along the road, Rambha saw an auspicious she-buffalo,

sanskrit_iast:
trihāyaṇīṃ citravarṇāṃ sundarīmṛtuśālinīm |
sa tāṃ dṛṣṭvātha mahiṣīṃ rambhaḥ kāmena mohitaḥ || 144 ||
meaning:
त्रिहायणीं चित्रवर्णां सुन्दरीमृतुशालिनीम् |
स तां दृष्ट्वाथ महिषीं रम्भः कामेन मोहितः || 144 ||
text_mt: three years old, of variegated color, beautiful, and in her mating season. / Seeing that she-buffalo, Rambha was deluded with desire.

sanskrit_iast:
dorbhyāṃ gṛhitvā ca tadā cakāra suratotsavam |
tayoḥ pravṛtte surate tadā sā tasya tejasā || 145 ||
meaning:
दोर्भ्यां गृहित्वा च तदा चकार सुरतोत्सवम् |
तयोः प्रवृत्ते सुरते तदा सा तस्य तेजसा || 145 ||
text_mt: Taking hold of her with his two arms, he engaged in the festival of mating; / and when their mating began, then by his seed

sanskrit_iast:
dadhāra mahiṣī garbhaṃ tadā'bhūnmahiṣāsuraḥ |
tasyāṃ svāṃśena giriśastatputratvamavāptavān || 146 ||
meaning:
दधार महिषी गर्भं तदाऽभून्महिषासुरः |
तस्यां स्वांशेन गिरिशस्तत्पुत्रत्वमवाप्तवान् || 146 ||
text_mt: the she-buffalo conceived a womb; then the asura Mahiṣa was born. / In her, Giriśa attained the state of being his son through a portion of himself.

sanskrit_iast:
vavṛdhe sa tadā rāmbhiḥ śuklapakṣaśaśāṅkavat |
taṃ ca kātyāyanamuniḥ śaptavānmahiṣāsuram || 147 ||
meaning:
ववृधे स तदा राम्भिः शुक्लपक्षशशाङ्कवत् |
तं च कात्यायनमुनिः शप्तवान्महिषासुरम् || 147 ||
text_mt: Then that son of Rambha grew like the moon in the bright fortnight; / and the sage Kātyāyana cursed that asura Mahiṣa.

sanskrit_iast:
durnayaṃ vīkṣya śiṣyārthe śiṣyānugrahakārakaḥ |
kātyāyanena śaptaṃ taṃ vijñāya mahiṣāsuram || 148 ||
meaning:
दुर्नयं वीक्ष्य शिष्यार्थे शिष्यानुग्रहकारकः |
कात्यायनेन शप्तं तं विज्ञाय महिषासुरम् || 148 ||
text_mt: Seeing his misconduct toward a disciple, the sage, acting with grace toward the disciple, / cursed him; and knowing that the asura Mahiṣa had been cursed by Kātyāyana,

sanskrit_iast: īśvara uvāca
meaning: ईश्वर उवाच

sanskrit_iast:
devī kātyāyanenāyaṃ śapto'dya mahiṣāsuraḥ |
yoṣidvināśakrtrīti bhaviteti jaganmaye || 149 ||
meaning:
देवी कात्यायनेनायं शप्तोऽद्य महिषासुरः |
योषिद्विनाशक्र्त्रीति भवितेति जगन्मये || 149 ||
text_mt: [Mahādeva said:] ‘O Goddess, this asura Mahiṣa has today been cursed by Kātyāyana, / saying, “A woman shall be your destroyer,” O you whose embodiment is the universe!

sanskrit_iast:
niḥsaṃśayamṛṣervākyaṃ bhaviṣyati na saṃśayaḥ |
madīyo māhiṣaḥ āyo devi kāryastvayā tvayi || 150 ||
meaning:
निःसंशयमृषेर्वाक्यं भविष्यति न संशयः |
मदीयो माहिषः आयो देवि कार्यस्त्वया त्वयि || 150 ||
text_mt: The sage's word will undoubtedly come to pass, there is no doubt. / My buffalo body must be received by you onto yourself, O Goddess.

sanskrit_iast:
hantavyaḥ satataṃ yogayuktaḥ pūrve pare'pi ca |
harirharisvarūpeṇa na tvāṃ voḍhuṃ kṣamo'dhunā || 151 ||
meaning:
हन्तव्यः सततं योगयुक्तः पूर्वे परेऽपि च |
हरिर्हरिस्वरूपेण न त्वां वोढुं क्षमोऽधुना || 151 ||
text_mt: It must be constantly slain, united in yoga, in the earlier and in the later [birth]; / Hari in the form of a lion is now unable to carry you.

sanskrit_iast:
mamāyaṃ māhiṣaḥ kāyastava voḍhā bhaviṣyati |
iti pūrvaṃ mahādevo devīṃ prārthitavān purā || 152 ||
meaning:
ममायं माहिषः कायस्तव वोढा भविष्यति |
इति पूर्वं महादेवो देवीं प्रार्थितवान् पुरा || 152 ||
text_mt: This buffalo body of mine will become your bearer.’ / Thus formerly did Mahādeva pray to the Goddess in ancient times.

sanskrit_iast:
tena devī mahādevaṃ jagrāha mahiṣāsuram |
triṣu janmasu putro'bhūdrambhasya bhagavān haraḥ || 153 ||
meaning:
तेन देवी महादेवं जग्राह महिषासुरम् |
त्रिषु जन्मसु पुत्रोऽभूद्रम्भस्य भगवान् हरः || 153 ||
text_mt: For that reason the Goddess accepted Mahādeva as the asura Mahiṣa; / the Blessed Lord Hara became the son of Rambha in three births.

sanskrit_iast:
sṛṣṭitraye sa rambho'pi rambha eva vyajāyata |
āsura tādṛśaṃ tepe tapah paramadāruṇam || 154 ||
meaning:
सृष्टित्रये स रम्भोऽपि रम्भ एव व्यजायत |
आसुर तादृशं तेपे तपह् परमदारुणम् || 154 ||
text_mt: In the three creations that Rambha too was born as Rambha alone; / the asura performed such extremely severe ascetic penance.

sanskrit_iast:
tathaivārādhitaḥ śambhuḥ putrārthe pradadau varam |
tathaiva mahiṣīṃ bheje prathamaṃ suratāya saḥ || 155 ||
meaning:
तथैवाराधितः शम्भुः पुत्रार्थे प्रददौ वरम् |
तथैव महिषीं भेजे प्रथमं सुरताय सः || 155 ||
text_mt: In the same way, Śambhu was worshipped and granted a boon for the sake of a son; / in the same way he first approached a she-buffalo for mating.

sanskrit_iast:
tasyāṃ tathā'bhavadvīro dānavo mahiṣāsuraḥ |
tathaiva śepe bhagavān muniḥ kātyāyanastu tam || 156 ||
meaning:
तस्यां तथाऽभवद्वीरो दानवो महिषासुरः |
तथैव शेपे भगवान् मुनिः कात्यायनस्तु तम् || 156 ||
text_mt: In her was born, in like manner, the heroic dānava, the asura Mahiṣa; / in the same way the blessed sage Kātyāyana cursed him.

sanskrit_iast:
iti pravṛtte pūrve'smin parasmin sa tu janmani |
mahiṣaḥ pūjayitvā'tha devīṃ varamayācata || 157 ||
meaning:
इति प्रवृत्ते पूर्वेऽस्मिन् परस्मिन् स तु जन्मनि |
महिषः पूजयित्वाऽथ देवीं वरमयाचत || 157 ||
text_mt: When this had occurred in that earlier [birth], then in the subsequent birth / Mahiṣa, having worshipped the Goddess, begged for a boon.

sanskrit_iast:
tṛtīye janmani varaṃ prāpya kalpānaśeṣataḥ |
neha me janma bhavitetyevaṃ varamayācata || 158 ||
meaning:
तृतीये जन्मनि वरं प्राप्य कल्पानशेषतः |
नेह मे जन्म भवितेत्येवं वरमयाचत || 158 ||
text_mt: Having obtained a boon in the third birth: ‘May there be no rebirth for me here / for all the kalpas without remainder,’ he thus begged for a boon.

sanskrit_iast:
tena devīpādatale tiṣṭhatyeṣo'suro'dhunā |
notpattirapi tasyātha saṃvartāntādabhūnnṛpa || 159 ||
meaning:
तेन देवीपादतले तिष्ठत्येषोऽसुरोऽधुना |
नोत्पत्तिरपि तस्याथ संवर्तान्तादभून्नृप || 159 ||
text_mt: For that reason this asura now stands under the feet of the Goddess; / nor did his rebirth occur until the end of the cosmic dissolution, O king.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ devīprasādena mahādevāṃśasambhavaḥ |
parāmavāpa satataṃ pratipattiṃ mahāsuraḥ || 160 ||
meaning:
एवं देवीप्रसादेन महादेवांशसम्भवः |
परामवाप सततं प्रतिपत्तिं महासुरः || 160 ||
text_mt: Thus by the grace of the Goddess, the great asura, / born from a portion of Mahādeva, obtained supreme status forever.

sanskrit_iast:
iti te kathitaṃ rājan yathā sa mahiṣāsuraḥ |
devīpādatalaṃ prāpya yathā so'dyāpi modate |
prastutaṃ śṛṇu bho rājan kathayāmi nṛpottama || 161 ||
meaning:
इति ते कथितं राजन् यथा स महिषासुरः |
देवीपादतलं प्राप्य यथा सोऽद्यापि मोदते |
प्रस्तुतं शृणु भो राजन् कथयामि नृपोत्तम || 161 ||
text_mt: Thus it has been told to you, O king, how that Mahiṣāsura, / having reached the soles of the Goddess's feet, rejoices even today. / Hear now what is to the point, O king, which I shall tell, O best of monarchs.

sanskrit_iast: mārkaṇḍeya uvāca
meaning: मार्कण्डेय उवाच

sanskrit_iast:
iti vaḥ kathitaṃ rājā sagaraḥ sahito yathā |
aurveṇa cakre saṃvādaṃ devīmahiṣayojane || 162 ||
meaning:
इति वः कथितं राजा सगरः सहितो यथा |
और्वेण चक्रे संवादं देवीमहिषयोजने || 162 ||
text_mt: Thus it was recounted to you, how King Sagara, accompanied [by him], / held conversation with Aurva regarding the union of the Goddess and the buffalo.

sanskrit_iast:
punaryadāha bhūyo'pi sagarāya mahātmane |
tacchṛṇvantu muniśreṣṭhā guhyād guhyataraṃ param || 163 ||
meaning:
पुनर्यदाह भूयोऽपि सगराय महात्मने |
तच्छृण्वन्तु मुनिश्रेष्ठा गुह्याद् गुह्यतरं परम् || 163 ||
text_mt: Hear further, O best of sages, what he spoke yet again / to high-souled Sagara—the supreme secret more secret than the secret.

sanskrit_iast:
iti śrīkālikāpurāṇe mahiṣāsuropākhyāno nāmasaṣṭitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 60 ||
ekaṣaṣṭitamo'dhyāyaḥ
meaning:
इति श्रीकालिकापुराणे महिषासुरोपाख्यानो नामसष्टितमोऽध्यायः || 60 ||
एकषष्टितमोऽध्यायः
text_mt: Thus ends the sixtieth chapter, named the Episode of Mahiṣāsura, in the glorious Kālikāpurāṇa. / Sixty-first chapter.

sanskrit_iast: aurva uvāca
meaning: और्व उवाच

sanskrit_iast:
yathāha bhagavān devo bhairavāya mahātmane |
vetālāya nṛpaśreṣṭha tathā tvaṃ prastutaṃ śṛṇu || 1 ||
meaning:
यथाह भगवान् देवो भैरवाय महात्मने |
वेतालाय नृपश्रेष्ठ तथा त्वं प्रस्तुतं शृणु || 1 ||
text_mt: Hear now that subject, O best of kings, / as the blessed God spoke to the high-souled Bhairava and Vetāla:

sanskrit_iast: śrībhagavānuvāca
meaning: श्रीभगवानुवाच

sanskrit_iast:
ugracaṇḍā ca yā mūrtiraṣṭādaśabhujā'bhavat |
sā navamyāṃ purā kṛṣṇapakṣe kanyāṃ gate ravau || 2 ||
meaning:
उग्रचण्डा च या मूर्तिरष्टादशभुजाऽभवत् |
सा नवम्यां पुरा कृष्णपक्षे कन्यां गते रवौ || 2 ||
text_mt: And that eighteen-armed form which became Ugracaṇḍā, / she in ancient times, on the ninth day of the dark fortnight when the sun entered Virgo,

sanskrit_iast:
prādurbhūtā mahāmāyā yoginīkoṭibhiḥ saha |
āṣāḍhasya tu pūrṇāyāṃ satraṃ dvādaśavārṣikam || 3 ||
meaning:
प्रादुर्भूता महामाया योगिनीकोटिभिः सह |
आषाढस्य तु पूर्णायां सत्रं द्वादशवार्षिकम् || 3 ||
text_mt: manifested as Mahāmāyā together with ten million Yoginīs. / On the full moon of Āṣāḍha, Dakṣa began to perform

sanskrit_iast:
dakṣaḥ kartuṃ samārebhe vṛtāḥ sarve divaukasaḥ |
tato'haṃ na vṛtastena dakṣeṇa sumahātmanā || 4 ||
meaning:
दक्षः कर्तुं समारेभे वृताः सर्वे दिवौकसः |
ततोऽहं न वृतस्तेन दक्षेण सुमहात्मना || 4 ||
text_mt: a twelve-year sacrificial session; all the celestials were invited. / Then I was not chosen by that great-souled Dakṣa,

sanskrit_iast:
kapālīti satī cāpi tajjāyeti ca no vṛtā |
tato roṣasamāyuktā prāṇāstatyāja sā satī || 5 ||
meaning:
कपालीति सती चापि तज्जायेति च नो वृता |
ततो रोषसमायुक्ता प्राणास्तत्याज सा सती || 5 ||
text_mt: thinking, 'He is a skull-bearer,' and Satī too, thinking, 'She is his wife,' was not invited. / Thereupon, overcome with wrath, that Satī abandoned her life-breaths.

sanskrit_iast:
tyaktadehā satī cāpi caṇḍamūrtistadā'bhavat |
tataḥ pravṛtte yajñe'pi tasmin dvādaśavārṣike || 6 ||
meaning:
त्यक्तदेहा सती चापि चण्डमूर्तिस्तदाऽभवत् |
ततः प्रवृत्ते यज्ञेऽपि तस्मिन् द्वादशवार्षिके || 6 ||
text_mt: And having abandoned her body, Satī then assumed a fierce form (Caṇḍamūrti). / Then, when that twelve-year sacrifice was underway,

sanskrit_iast:
navamyāṃ kṛṣṇapakṣe tu kanyāyāṃ caṇḍamūrtidhṛk |
yoganidrā mahāmāyā yoginīkoṭibhiḥ saha || 7 ||
meaning:
नवम्यां कृष्णपक्षे तु कन्यायां चण्डमूर्तिधृक् |
योगनिद्रा महामाया योगिनीकोटिभिः सह || 7 ||
text_mt: on the ninth day of the dark fortnight in Virgo, bearing the fierce form, / Yoganidrā, Mahāmāyā, together with ten million Yoginīs,

sanskrit_iast:
satīrūpaṃ parityajya yajñabhaṅgamathākarot |
śaṅkarasya gaṇaiḥ sarvaiḥ sahitā śaṅkareṇa ca || 8 ||
meaning:
सतीरूपं परित्यज्य यज्ञभङ्गमथाकरोत् |
शङ्करस्य गणैः सर्वैः सहिता शङ्करेण च || 8 ||
text_mt: abandoning the form of Satī, destroyed the sacrifice, / accompanied by all the attendants of Śaṅkara and by Śaṅkara himself.

sanskrit_iast:
svayaṃ babhañja sā devī mahāsatraṃ mahātmanaḥ |
tato devyā mahākrodhe vyatīte tridivaukasaḥ || 9 ||
meaning:
स्वयं बभञ्ज सा देवी महासत्रं महात्मनः |
ततो देव्या महाक्रोधे व्यतीते त्रिदिवौकसः || 9 ||
text_mt: The Goddess herself smashed the great sacrifice of that great-souled one. / Then, when the great wrath of the Goddess had passed away, the dwellers of heaven

sanskrit_iast:
pūjayāñcakruratulāṃ devīṃ pūrvoditena vai |
pūrvoditavidhānena pūjāmasyā divaukasaḥ || 10 ||
meaning:
पूजयाञ्चक्रुरतुलां देवीं पूर्वोदितेन वै |
पूर्वोदितविधानेन पूजामस्या दिवौकसः || 10 ||
text_mt: worshiped the peerless Goddess in the manner declared before. / By performing her worship according to the previously described ritual, the gods

sanskrit_iast:
kṛtvaiva paramāmāpurnivṛtiṃ duḥkhahānaye |
evamanyairapi sadā kāryaṃ devyāḥ prapūjanam || 11 ||
meaning:
कृत्वैव परमामापुर्निवृतिं दुःखहानये |
एवमन्यैरपि सदा कार्यं देव्याः प्रपूजनम् || 11 ||
text_mt: attained supreme peace for the cessation of suffering. / In the same manner, worship of the Goddess should always be performed by others too,

sanskrit_iast:
vibhūtimatulāṃ prāptuṃ caturvargapradāyikām |
yo mohādathavā'lasyād devīṃ durgāṃ mahotsave || 12 ||
meaning:
विभूतिमतुलां प्राप्तुं चतुर्वर्गप्रदायिकाम् |
यो मोहादथवाऽलस्याद् देवीं दुर्गां महोत्सवे || 12 ||
text_mt: in order to attain peerless prosperity that yields the four goals of life. / Whoever, through delusion or laziness, at the great festival,

sanskrit_iast:
na pūjayati dambhād vā dveṣādvā'pyatha bhairava |
kruddhā bhagavatī tasya kāmāniṣṭānnihanti vai || 13 ||
meaning:
न पूजयति दम्भाद् वा द्वेषाद्वाऽप्यथ भैरव |
क्रुद्धा भगवती तस्य कामानिष्टान्निहन्ति वै || 13 ||
text_mt: does not worship Goddess Durgā, or out of deceit or malice, O Bhairava, / the wrathful Lady destroys his cherished desires,

sanskrit_iast:
paratra ca mahāmāyā - balirbhūtvā prajāyate |
aṣṭamyāṃ rudhiraiścaiva mahāmāṃsaiḥ sugandhibhiḥ || 14 ||
meaning:
परत्र च महामाया - बलिर्भूत्वा प्रजायते |
अष्टम्यां रुधिरैश्चैव महामांसैः सुगन्धिभिः || 14 ||
text_mt: and in the next world he is born as an offering to Mahāmāyā. / On the eighth day, with blood and fragrant great meats,

sanskrit_iast:
pūjayedbahujātīyairbalibhirbhojanaiḥ śivām |
sindūraiḥ paṭṭavāsobhirnānāvidhavilepanaiḥ || 15 ||
meaning:
पूजयेद्बहुजातीयैर्बलिभिर्भोजनैः शिवाम् |
सिन्दूरैः पट्टवासोभिर्नानाविधविलेपनैः || 15 ||
text_mt: with manifold kinds of animal offerings and foods, one should worship Śivā, / with vermilion, silk garments, diverse unguents,

sanskrit_iast:
puṣpairanekajātīyaiḥ phalairbahuvidharapi |
upavāsaṃ mahāṣṭamyāṃ putravān na samācaret || 16 ||
meaning:
पुष्पैरनेकजातीयैः फलैर्बहुविधरपि |
उपवासं महाष्टम्यां पुत्रवान् न समाचरेत् || 16 ||
text_mt: flowers of multiple kinds, and varied fruits. / One who has a son should not observe a fast on the Mahāṣṭamī.

sanskrit_iast:
yathā tathaiva pūtātmā vratī devīṃ prapūjayet |
pūjayitvā mahāṣṭamyāṃ navamyāṃ balibhistathā || 17 ||
meaning:
यथा तथैव पूतात्मा व्रती देवीं प्रपूजयेत् |
पूजयित्वा महाष्टम्यां नवम्यां बलिभिस्तथा || 17 ||
text_mt: Purifying himself in that very manner, the votary should worship the Goddess. / Having worshiped on the Mahāṣṭamī, and likewise on the ninth day with offerings,

sanskrit_iast:
visarjayed daśamyāṃ tu śravaṇe śāvarotsavaiḥ |
antyapādo divābhāge śravaṇasya yadā bhavet || 18 ||
meaning:
विसर्जयेद् दशम्यां तु श्रवणे शावरोत्सवैः |
अन्त्यपादो दिवाभागे श्रवणस्य यदा भवेत् || 18 ||
text_mt: on the tenth day under [the asterism of] Śravaṇa he should dismiss her with Śāvara festivities. / When the final quarter of Śravaṇa occurs during the daytime,

sanskrit_iast:
tadā sampreṣaṇaṃ devyā daśamyāṃ kārayed budhaḥ |
suvāsinī kumārībhirveśyābhirnartakaistathā || 19 ||
meaning:
तदा सम्प्रेषणं देव्या दशम्यां कारयेद् बुधः |
सुवासिनी कुमारीभिर्वेश्याभिर्नर्तकैस्तथा || 19 ||
text_mt: then the wise person should carry out the dismissal of the Goddess on the tenth day / accompanied by married women, young girls, courtesans, and dancers,

sanskrit_iast:
śaṅkhatūryaninādaiśca mṛdaṅgaiḥ paṭahaistathā |
dhvajairvastrairbahuvidhairlājapuṣpaprakīrṇakaiḥ || 20 ||
meaning:
शङ्खतूर्यनिनादैश्च मृदङ्गैः पटहैस्तथा |
ध्वजैर्वस्त्रैर्बहुविधैर्लाजपुष्पप्रकीर्णकैः || 20 ||
text_mt: with sounds of conches and horns, mṛdaṅgas and drums, / with banners, various fabrics, and strewn parched grain and flowers,

sanskrit_iast:
dhūlikardamavikṣepaiḥ krīḍākautukamaṅgalaiḥ |
bhagaliṅgābhidhānaiśca bhagaliṅgapragītakaiḥ || 21 ||
meaning:
धूलिकर्दमविक्षेपैः क्रीडाकौतुकमङ्गलैः |
भगलिङ्गाभिधानैश्च भगलिङ्गप्रगीतकैः || 21 ||
text_mt: with throwing of dust and mud, playful amusements and blessings, / with the mention of the female and male genitals, with songs celebrating the vulva and phallus,

sanskrit_iast:
bhagaliṅgādiśabdaiśca krīd'yeyuralaṃ janāḥ |
parairnākṣipyate yastu yaḥ parānnakṣiped yadi || 22 ||
meaning:
भगलिङ्गादिशब्दैश्च क्रीद्ऽयेयुरलं जनाः |
परैर्नाक्षिप्यते यस्तु यः परान्नक्षिपेद् यदि || 22 ||
text_mt: and with words denoting the vulva and phallus, the people should sport exceedingly. / Whoever is not reviled by others, or if one does not revile others,

sanskrit_iast:
kruddhā bhagavatī tasya śāpaṃ dadyāt sudāruṇam |
ādipādo niśābhāge śravaṇasya yadā bhavet || 23 ||
meaning:
क्रुद्धा भगवती तस्य शापं दद्यात् सुदारुणम् |
आदिपादो निशाभागे श्रवणस्य यदा भवेत् || 23 ||
text_mt: the enraged Lady shall pronounce a most dreadful curse upon him. / When the first quarter of Śravaṇa occurs during the night,

sanskrit_iast:
tadā devyāḥ samutthānaṃ navamyāṃ na punardivā |
antyapādo niśābhāge śravaṇasya yadā bhavet || 24 ||
meaning:
तदा देव्याः समुत्थानं नवम्यां न पुनर्दिवा |
अन्त्यपादो निशाभागे श्रवणस्य यदा भवेत् || 24 ||
text_mt: then the Goddess's departure takes place on the ninth day, but not by day. / When the final quarter of Śravaṇa occurs during the night,

sanskrit_iast:
tadā devyāḥ samutthānaṃ navamyāṃ dinabhāgataḥ |
visarjanamanenaiva mantreṇa vatsa bhairava || 24 ||
meaning:
तदा देव्याः समुत्थानं नवम्यां दिनभागतः |
विसर्जनमनेनैव मन्त्रेण वत्स भैरव || 24 ||
text_mt: then the Goddess's departure is on the ninth day from the daytime period. / The dismissal, O dear Bhairava, with this very mantra

sanskrit_iast:
kartavyamambhasi sthāpya visṛjya ca vibhūtaye |
uttiṣṭha devi caṇḍeśe śubhāṃ pūjāṃ pragṛhya ca || 26 ||
meaning:
कर्तव्यमम्भसि स्थाप्य विसृज्य च विभूतये |
उत्तिष्ठ देवि चण्डेशे शुभां पूजां प्रगृह्य च || 26 ||
text_mt: is to be performed, placing [her] in water and releasing [her] for prosperity: / 'Arise, O Goddess Caṇḍeśī, and having accepted the auspicious worship,

sanskrit_iast:
kuruṣva mama kalyāṇamaṣṭabhiḥ śaktibhiḥ saha |
gaccha gaccha paraṃ sthānaṃ svasthānaṃ devi caṇḍike || 27 ||
meaning:
कुरुष्व मम कल्याणमष्टभिः शक्तिभिः सह |
गच्छ गच्छ परं स्थानं स्वस्थानं देवि चण्डिके || 27 ||
text_mt: bring about my welfare along with the eight Śaktis. / Go, go to the supreme abode, to your own abode, O Goddess Caṇḍikā;

sanskrit_iast:
yat pūjitaṃ mayā devi paripūrṇaṃ tadastu me |
vraja tvaṃ srotasi jale tiṣṭha gehe ca bhūtaye || 28 ||
meaning:
यत् पूजितं मया देवि परिपूर्णं तदस्तु मे |
व्रज त्वं स्रोतसि जले तिष्ठ गेहे च भूतये || 28 ||
text_mt: let what was worshiped by me, O Goddess, be complete for me. / Go into the flowing water, and remain in the home for prosperity.'

sanskrit_iast:
nimajjyāmbhasi santyajya patrikāvajite jale |
putrāyurdhanavṛddhyarthaṃ sthāpitāsi jale mayā || 29 ||
meaning:
निमज्ज्याम्भसि सन्त्यज्य पत्रिकावजिते जले |
पुत्रायुर्धनवृद्ध्यर्थं स्थापितासि जले मया || 29 ||
text_mt: 'Submerging in the water, abandoning [the icon] in the water devoid of the patrikā, / you have been placed in the water by me for the increase of sons, longevity, and wealth.'

sanskrit_iast:
ityanena tu mantreṇa devīṃ saṃsthāpayejjale |
sarvaloka-hitārthāya sarvalokavibhūtaye || 30 ||
meaning:
इत्यनेन तु मन्त्रेण देवीं संस्थापयेज्जले |
सर्वलोक-हितार्थाय सर्वलोकविभूतये || 30 ||
text_mt: With this mantra one should consign the Goddess to the water / for the welfare of all the world and the prosperity of all people.

sanskrit_iast:
durgā-tantreṇa mantreṇa pūjitavye ubhe api |
bhadrakālīmugracaṇḍāṃ mahāmāyāṃ mahotsave || 31 ||
meaning:
दुर्गा-तन्त्रेण मन्त्रेण पूजितव्ये उभे अपि |
भद्रकालीमुग्रचण्डां महामायां महोत्सवे || 31 ||
text_mt: With the mantra according to the Durgā-tantra, both Bhadrakālī and / Ugracaṇḍā, Mahāmāyā, are to be worshiped during the great festival.

sanskrit_iast:
netrabījaṃ tu sarvāsāṃ pūjane parikīrtitam |
yoginīnāṃ tu sarvāsāṃ mūlamūrtestathaiva ca || 32 ||
meaning:
नेत्रबीजं तु सर्वासां पूजने परिकीर्तितम् |
योगिनीनां तु सर्वासां मूलमूर्तेस्तथैव च || 32 ||
text_mt: The Netrabīja is prescribed in the worship of all of them, / for all the Yoginīs as well as for the root form.

sanskrit_iast:
mantraṃ tathogracaṇḍāyāḥ pṛthak tvaṃ śṛṇu bhairava |
ādyadvayaṃ netrabījaṃ mantrasyopāntamantare || 33 ||
meaning:
मन्त्रं तथोग्रचण्डायाः पृथक् त्वं शृणु भैरव |
आद्यद्वयं नेत्रबीजं मन्त्रस्योपान्तमन्तरे || 33 ||
text_mt: Listen separately, O Bhairava, to the mantra of Ugracaṇḍā: / The first pair is the Netrabīja, placed at the end of the mantra's interior;

sanskrit_iast:
vahninā'ntaḥsvareṇendubindubhyāṃ tantramaugrakam |
netrabījaṃ dvitīyaṃ tu dvidhāvartitamucyate || 34 ||
meaning:
वह्निनाऽन्तःस्वरेणेन्दुबिन्दुभ्यां तन्त्रमौग्रकम् |
नेत्रबीजं द्वितीयं तु द्विधावर्तितमुच्यते || 34 ||
text_mt: with fire, the internal vowel, the crescent moon and dot, the tantric formula of Ugrā [is formed]. / The second Netrabīja is declared to be repeated twice.

sanskrit_iast:
bhadrakālyāstu mantro'yaṃ dharmakāmārthasiddhaye |
yadā tu vaiṣṇavī devī mahāmāyā jaganmayī || 35 ||
meaning:
भद्रकाल्यास्तु मन्त्रोऽयं धर्मकामार्थसिद्धये |
यदा तु वैष्णवी देवी महामाया जगन्मयी || 35 ||
text_mt: This is the mantra of Bhadrakālī for the attainment of dharma, kāma, and artha. / When the Vaiṣṇavī Devī, Mahāmāyā, who is identical with the universe,

sanskrit_iast:
