text_mt: in the sacred seat it is renowned by the name Bhuvaneśvara, O Bhairava. / The cavern of Bhuvaneśa is called Bhuvanānanda.

sanskrit_iast:
tasyāsanne tu surabhiḥ śilārūpeṇa saṃsthitā |
kāmadhenuriti khyātā pīṭhe kāmapradāyinī || 119 ||
meaning:
तस्यासन्ने तु सुरभिः शिलारूपेण संस्थिता |
कामधेनुरिति ख्याता पीठे कामप्रदायिनी || 119 ||
text_mt: Near it Surabhi is situated in the form of a rock; / known as Kāmadhenu in the sacred seat, she grants desires.

sanskrit_iast:
yo'sau śarabhamūrtirme madhyakhaṇḍapracaṇḍakaḥ |
mahābhairavanāmābhūt koṭiliṅgāhvayastu saḥ || 120 ||
meaning:
योऽसौ शरभमूर्तिर्मे मध्यखण्डप्रचण्डकः |
महाभैरवनामाभूत् कोटिलिङ्गाह्वयस्तु सः || 120 ||
text_mt: That fierce middle portion of my Śarabha form / became known as Mahābhairava, designated as Koṭiliṅga.

sanskrit_iast:
mūrtibhiḥ pañcabhiḥ pañcabhāgeṣu samavasthitaḥ |
ahaṃ paścādatiprātyā bhairavākhyaḥ sthito dhare || 121 ||
meaning:
मूर्तिभिः पञ्चभिः पञ्चभागेषु समवस्थितः |
अहं पश्चादतिप्रात्या भैरवाख्यः स्थितो धरे || 121 ||
text_mt: Stationed in five divisions by means of five forms, / out of great love I subsequently remained on earth bearing the name Bhairava.

sanskrit_iast:
mahāgaurī tu yā devī yoginī siddharūpiṇī |
sā brahmaparvate cāste śilārūpeṇa cordhvataḥ || 122 ||
meaning:
महागौरी तु या देवी योगिनी सिद्धरूपिणी |
सा ब्रह्मपर्वते चास्ते शिलारूपेण चोर्ध्वतः || 122 ||
text_mt: The goddess Mahāgaurī, the yoginī whose nature is perfection, / dwells on the mountain of Brahmā above, in the form of a stone.

sanskrit_iast:
atīvarūpasampannā nāmnā sā bhuvaneśvarī |
yatra brahmā tu saṃsakto mayi parvatarūpiṇi || 123 ||
meaning:
अतीवरूपसम्पन्ना नाम्ना सा भुवनेश्वरी |
यत्र ब्रह्मा तु संसक्तो मयि पर्वतरूपिणि || 123 ||
text_mt: Exceedingly endowed with beauty, she is named Bhuvaneśvarī, / where Brahmā was attached to me when I had assumed the form of a mountain.

sanskrit_iast:
kalpavallī tu tatrāste nāmnā sā tvaparājitā |
kāmadhenuradūrasthā pūrvabhāge maheśvarī || 124 ||
meaning:
कल्पवल्ली तु तत्रास्ते नाम्ना सा त्वपराजिता |
कामधेनुरदूरस्था पूर्वभागे महेश्वरी || 124 ||
text_mt: There the wish-fulfilling creeper named Aparājitā is present; / not far away, in the eastern region, stays Kāmadhenu, the great goddess.

sanskrit_iast:
śrīkāmākhyā yonirūpā caṇḍikā sā tu yoginī |
āgneyyāṃ viddhi tāṃ saṃsthāṃ sarvakāmapradāṃ śubhām || 125 ||
meaning:
श्रीकामाख्या योनिरूपा चण्डिका सा तु योगिनी |
आग्नेय्यां विद्धि तां संस्थां सर्वकामप्रदां शुभाम् || 125 ||
text_mt: Glorious Kāmākhyā has the form of a yoni; she is Caṇḍikā, that yoginī. / Know her to be situated in the south-east, the auspicious granter of all desires.

sanskrit_iast:
yoginī caṇḍaghaṇṭākhyā pīṭhe'bhūd vindhyavāsinī |
yoginī skandamātā tatpīṭhe'bhūd vanavāsinī || 126 ||
meaning:
योगिनी चण्डघण्टाख्या पीठेऽभूद् विन्ध्यवासिनी |
योगिनी स्कन्दमाता तत्पीठेऽभूद् वनवासिनी || 126 ||
text_mt: The yoginī named Caṇḍaghaṇṭā became Vindhyavāsinī at this seat; / the yoginī Skandamātā became Vanavāsinī at this seat.

sanskrit_iast:
kātyāyanī pīṭhanāmnā pādadurgeti gadyate |
nair-ṛtyāṃ nīlaśailasya prānte sā saṃsthitā śivā || 127 ||
meaning:
कात्यायनी पीठनाम्ना पाददुर्गेति गद्यते |
नैर्-ऋत्यां नीलशैलस्य प्रान्ते सा संस्थिता शिवा || 127 ||
text_mt: Kātyāyanī is named Pādadurgā according to the name of the seat; / in the south-west, on the edge of the Blue Mountain, that auspicious goddess is situated.

sanskrit_iast:
yo'sau nandī mama tanuḥ sa tu pāṣāṇarūpadhṛk |
saṃsthitaḥ paścimadvāri hanumān pīṭhanāmataḥ || 128 ||
meaning:
योऽसौ नन्दी मम तनुः स तु पाषाणरूपधृक् |
संस्थितः पश्चिमद्वारि हनुमान् पीठनामतः || 128 ||
text_mt: Nandin, who is my own body, assumed the form of stone / and stands at the western gate, [called] Hanūmat after the seat.

sanskrit_iast: aurva uvāca
meaning: और्व उवाच

sanskrit_iast:
iti tasya vacaḥ śrutvā śambhoramitatejasaḥ |
bhairavasya tu papraccha vetālo'pi samutsukaḥ || 129 ||
vetālabhairavāvūcatuḥ
meaning:
इति तस्य वचः श्रुत्वा शम्भोरमिततेजसः |
भैरवस्य तु पप्रच्छ वेतालोऽपि समुत्सुकः || 129 ||
वेतालभैरवावूचतुः
text_mt:
Having heard these words of Śambhu of boundless splendour, / Vetāla, accompanied by Bhairava, eagerly asked him:
Vetāla and Bhairava said:

sanskrit_iast:
śrutaḥ pīṭhakramastāta devyāḥ pūjākramastathā |
śrotumicchāmi mūrtīnāṃ pañcānāmapi śaṅkara || 130 ||
meaning:
श्रुतः पीठक्रमस्तात देव्याः पूजाक्रमस्तथा |
श्रोतुमिच्छामि मूर्तीनां पञ्चानामपि शङ्कर || 130 ||
text_mt: "Father, the procedure for the seat has been heard, as well as the procedure for worship of the Goddess; / I wish to hear, O Śaṅkara, about the five forms as well:

sanskrit_iast:
rūpāṇi pañcamūrtīnāṃ mantrāṇi ca samantataḥ |
tatra mantrāṇi tantrāṇi vada nau vṛṣabhadhvaja || 131 ||
meaning:
रूपाणि पञ्चमूर्तीनां मन्त्राणि च समन्ततः |
तत्र मन्त्राणि तन्त्राणि वद नौ वृषभध्वज || 131 ||
text_mt: the appearances of the five forms and the mantras on all sides; / tell us the mantras and the tantras in that regard, O bull-bannered god!"

sanskrit_iast: īśvara uvāca
meaning: ईश्वर उवाच

sanskrit_iast:
śṛṇu vakṣyāmi vetāla mantraṃ tantraṃ pṛthak pṛthak |
kāmākhyāpañcamūrtīnāṃ rūpaṃ kalpaṃ ca bhairava || 132 ||
meaning:
शृणु वक्ष्यामि वेताल मन्त्रं तन्त्रं पृथक् पृथक् |
कामाख्यापञ्चमूर्तीनां रूपं कल्पं च भैरव || 132 ||
text_mt: "Listen, O Vetāla, O Bhairava, I shall explain the mantra and the tantra, each separately, / and the form and ritual procedure of the five manifestations of Kāmākhyā.

sanskrit_iast:
kāmasthaṃ kāmamadhyasthaṃ kāmadevapuṭīkṛtam |
kāmena kāmayet kāmī kāmaṃ kāme niyojayet || 133 ||
meaning:
कामस्थं काममध्यस्थं कामदेवपुटीकृतम् |
कामेन कामयेत् कामी कामं कामे नियोजयेत् || 133 ||
text_mt: Residing in desire, seated in the centre of desire, enveloped by the god of desire, / the desirous person should desire desire through desire, and should direct desire into desire.

sanskrit_iast:
jyeṣṭhaṃ tu vyañjanaṃ brahman paraḥ śāntaṃ taducyate |
prathamaṃ kramataḥ kuryāttatsaṃsaktaṃ sudhāmayam || 134 ||
meaning:
ज्येष्ठं तु व्यञ्जनं ब्रह्मन् परः शान्तं तदुच्यते |
प्रथमं क्रमतः कुर्यात्तत्संसक्तं सुधामयम् || 134 ||
text_mt: The first consonant, O Brahman, is followed by what is called tranquil; / first, in proper order, one should make it connected with that which consists of nectar.

sanskrit_iast:
prajāpatistathā śakrabījaṃ saṃsthādisaṃyutam |
candrārdhasahitaṃ bījaṃ kāmākhyāyāḥ pracakṣyate || 135 ||
meaning:
प्रजापतिस्तथा शक्रबीजं संस्थादिसंयुतम् |
चन्द्रार्धसहितं बीजं कामाख्यायाः प्रचक्ष्यते || 135 ||
text_mt: Prajāpati, and likewise the seed-syllable of Śakra joined with the resting place and so forth, / accompanied by the half-moon: this is declared to be the seed-syllable of Kāmākhyā.

sanskrit_iast:
idaṃ dharmapradaṃ kāmamokṣārthānāṃ pradāyakam |
idaṃ rahasyaṃ paramamanyatra tu sudurlabham || 136 ||
meaning:
इदं धर्मप्रदं काममोक्षार्थानां प्रदायकम् |
इदं रहस्यं परममन्यत्र तु सुदुर्लभम् || 136 ||
text_mt: This bestows dharma, and grants the goals of desire and liberation; / this is the supreme secret, extremely difficult to obtain elsewhere.

sanskrit_iast:
śrotreṇodyamya śṛṇuyād guruvaktrānnarottamaḥ |
sa kāmānakhilān prāpya śivaloke mahīyate || 137 ||
meaning:
श्रोत्रेणोद्यम्य शृणुयाद् गुरुवक्त्रान्नरोत्तमः |
स कामानखिलान् प्राप्य शिवलोके महीयते || 137 ||
text_mt: If the best of men listens attentively with his ear [to it] from the mouth of the guru, / he obtains all desires and is glorified in the world of Śiva.

sanskrit_iast:
śrutisakalitasāraṃ devakaṇṭhaughahāraṃ
sakalakaluṣahāri śrīdharānandakāri |
sunayasubhagagobhibhrājayedyadyaśobhi-
stadiha śivasamastaṃ vighnahantrīṅgitārtham || 138 ||
meaning:
श्रुतिसकलितसारं देवकण्ठौघहारं
सकलकलुषहारि श्रीधरानन्दकारि |
सुनयसुभगगोभिभ्राजयेद्यद्यशोभि-
स्तदिह शिवसमस्तं विघ्नहन्त्रीङ्गितार्थम् || 138 ||
text_mt: The extracted essence of the scriptures, a necklace for the assembly of the throats of the gods, / dispelling all impurities, causing joy to the bearer of Śrī, / which shines with glories through the lovely rays of sound doctrine, / that is all Śiva here, with the intended purpose of destroying obstacles.

sanskrit_iast:
nayanakarabhakāri dhyānināṃ copakāri
praṇayisunayasaṃsthaṃ devasatyāhnikastham |
paramapadaviśīrṇaṃ sarvadaurbhāgyajīrṇaṃ śṛṇu śivapadarūpaṃ
kāmadevyāḥ svarūpam || 139 ||
meaning:
नयनकरभकारि ध्यानिनां चोपकारि
प्रणयिसुनयसंस्थं देवसत्याह्निकस्थम् |
परमपदविशीर्णं सर्वदौर्भाग्यजीर्णं शृणु शिवपदरूपं
कामदेव्याः स्वरूपम् || 139 ||
text_mt: Pleasing to the eyes, helping practitioners of meditation, / abiding in loving good conduct, established in the true daily rites of the gods, / spread across the supreme state, consuming all misfortune—hear the essential nature / of the Goddess of Desire, whose form is the state of Śiva:

sanskrit_iast:
śravaṇagaganamātrā cārditaṃ yasya nāma
prabhavati bahubhūtyai nītimārgaikadhāma |
suragaṇagaṇanāyāṃ kuṇḍalī yasya śakti-
stadiha paramarūpaṃ cintanīyaṃ hatāśaiḥ || 140 ||
meaning:
श्रवणगगनमात्रा चार्दितं यस्य नाम
प्रभवति बहुभूत्यै नीतिमार्गैकधाम |
सुरगणगणनायां कुण्डली यस्य शक्ति-
स्तदिह परमरूपं चिन्तनीयं हताशैः || 140 ||
text_mt: Whose name, praised with mere hearing and space, / brings forth great abundance, the sole abode of the path of wisdom; / whose coiled power is reckoned in the numbering of the hosts of gods— / that supreme form here is to be contemplated by those whose hopes are destroyed.

sanskrit_iast:
raviśaśiyutakarṇā kuṅkumāpītavarṇā
maṇikanakavicitrā lolakarṇā trinetrā |
abhayavaradahastā sākṣasūtrapraśastā
praṇatasuranareśā siddhakāmeśvarī sā || 141 ||
meaning:
रविशशियुतकर्णा कुङ्कुमापीतवर्णा
मणिकनकविचित्रा लोलकर्णा त्रिनेत्रा |
अभयवरदहस्ता साक्षसूत्रप्रशस्ता
प्रणतसुरनरेशा सिद्धकामेश्वरी सा || 141 ||
text_mt: Her ears adorned with the sun and moon, her colour yellowish with saffron, / diverse with jewels and gold, with trembling earrings, three-eyed, / her hands granting fearlessness and boons, praised as holding a rosary, / bowed to by gods and kings of men: she is Siddhakāmeśvarī.

sanskrit_iast:
aruṇakamalasaṃsthā raktapadmāsanasthā
navataruṇaśarīrā muktakeśī suhārā |
śavahṛdi pṛthutuṅgastana yugmā manojñā
śiśuravisamavastrā arvakāmeśvarī sā || 142 ||
meaning:
अरुणकमलसंस्था रक्तपद्मासनस्था
नवतरुणशरीरा मुक्तकेशी सुहारा |
शवहृदि पृथुतुङ्गस्तन युग्मा मनोज्ञा
शिशुरविसमवस्त्रा अर्वकामेश्वरी सा || 142 ||
text_mt: Standing upon a red lotus, seated upon a red lotus seat, / with the body of a fresh youth, with dishevelled hair, wearing a lovely garland, / on the chest of a corpse, charming with a pair of broad and high breasts, / with garments resembling the morning sun: she is this Kāmeśvarī.

sanskrit_iast:
vipulavibhavadātrī smeravaktrā sukeśī
alitanakharadantā sāmicandrāvanamrā |
manasijadṛṣadisthā yonimudrālasantī
avanagamanaśaktā saṃśrutasthānahāgā || 143 ||
meaning:
विपुलविभवदात्री स्मेरवक्त्रा सुकेशी
अलितनखरदन्ता सामिचन्द्रावनम्रा |
मनसिजदृषदिस्था योनिमुद्रालसन्ती
अवनगमनशक्ता संश्रुतस्थानहागा || 143 ||
text_mt: Bestowing vast prosperity, smiling-faced, with beautiful hair, / with teeth and nails like bees, slightly bent like the crescent moon, / standing on the stone of the mind-born [god], shining with the yoni-mudrā, / capable of descending to earth, having a share in the sacred dwelling places.

sanskrit_iast:
cintyā caivaṃ vidyudagniprakāśā
dharmārthādyaṃ sādhakairvāñchitārthaiḥ |
kalpyantu trīṇyaryatadaṃ samyagaryaṃ
vetāla tvaṃ bhairava śrīpratiṣṭham || 144 ||
meaning:
चिन्त्या चैवं विद्युदग्निप्रकाशा
धर्मार्थाद्यं साधकैर्वाञ्छितार्थैः |
कल्प्यन्तु त्रीण्यर्यतदं सम्यगर्यं
वेताल त्वं भैरव श्रीप्रतिष्ठम् || 144 ||
text_mt: Thus is she to be meditated upon, with the brilliance of lightning and fire, / by practitioners desiring the goals of dharma, wealth, and the rest; / three offerings should be prepared, perfectly honourable, / O Vetāla, O Bhairava, establishing good fortune.

sanskrit_iast:
tasminnardhaṃ maṇḍalaṃ yaddhi paścāt
kāryaṃ caitaccandanaiḥ puṣpayuktaiḥ |
paryāyo yo lekhane pūrvamukto devītantre so'tra pūrva vidheyaḥ || 145 ||
meaning:
तस्मिन्नर्धं मण्डलं यद्धि पश्चात्
कार्यं चैतच्चन्दनैः पुष्पयुक्तैः |
पर्यायो यो लेखने पूर्वमुक्तो देवीतन्त्रे सोऽत्र पूर्व विधेयः || 145 ||
text_mt: On it, half a maṇḍala is to be made afterwards / with sandalpastes joined with flowers; / the sequence in drawing that was previously spoken in the Devītantra is to be performed here first."

sanskrit_iast:
iti śrīkālikāpurāṇe kāmākhyāpūjātantre viṣaṣṭitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 62 ||
triṣaṣṭitamo'dhyāyaḥ
meaning:
इति श्रीकालिकापुराणे कामाख्यापूजातन्त्रे विषष्टितमोऽध्यायः || 62 ||
त्रिषष्टितमोऽध्यायः
text_mt:
Thus ends the sixty-second chapter in the glorious Kālikāpurāṇa, in the ritual tantra of the worship of Kāmākhyā.
Chapter sixty-three.

sanskrit_iast: īśvara uvāca
meaning: ईश्वर उवाच

sanskrit_iast:
vaiṣṇavītantramantrasya yathāpūrvaṃ mayoditam |
maṇḍalaṃ pratipattyā tu paryāyo maṇḍalasya yaḥ || 1 ||
meaning:
वैष्णवीतन्त्रमन्त्रस्य यथापूर्वं मयोदितम् |
मण्डलं प्रतिपत्त्या तु पर्यायो मण्डलस्य यः || 1 ||
text_mt: "As was previously spoken by me regarding the mantra of the Vaiṣṇavītantra, / the maṇḍala and the sequence of the maṇḍala in its ritual application—

sanskrit_iast:
sa evaṃ prathamaṃ kāryaḥ śilāyāṃ puṣpacandanaiḥ |
pātrādīnāṃ pratiṣthānaṃ tathaivātrāpi yojayet || 2 ||
meaning:
स एवं प्रथमं कार्यः शिलायां पुष्पचन्दनैः |
पात्रादीनां प्रतिष्थानं तथैवात्रापि योजयेत् || 2 ||
text_mt: that should first be made in this manner on the stone with flowers and sandalpaste; / in the same way here too, one should carry out the establishment of the vessels and other items.

sanskrit_iast:
vaiṣṇavītantramantrasya proktā yāḥ pratipattayaḥ |
atra tāḥ sakalā yojyā āsanādyaiśca pūjanam || 3 ||
meaning:
वैष्णवीतन्त्रमन्त्रस्य प्रोक्ता याः प्रतिपत्तयः |
अत्र ताः सकला योज्या आसनाद्यैश्च पूजनम् || 3 ||
text_mt: The ritual applications that were declared for the mantra of the Vaiṣṇavītantra / are all to be employed here, as well as the worship with seats and the rest.

sanskrit_iast:
tebhyo'nyo yo viśaṣo'tra tad vakṣye śṛṇu bhairava |
prathamaṃ bhāskarāyārghyaṃ pradadyācśvetasarṣapaiḥ || 4 ||
meaning:
तेभ्योऽन्यो यो विशषोऽत्र तद् वक्ष्ये शृणु भैरव |
प्रथमं भास्करायार्घ्यं प्रदद्याच्श्वेतसर्षपैः || 4 ||
text_mt: Listen, O Bhairava, I shall speak of the specific detail here that is distinct from them: / first one should offer an arghya of white mustard seeds to the sun,

sanskrit_iast:
puṣpacandanasaṃvītaiḥ sagaṇāya mahātmane |
āsanārcanaśeṣe tu paṭhoktāḥ sarvadevatāḥ || 5 ||
meaning:
पुष्पचन्दनसंवीतैः सगणाय महात्मने |
आसनार्चनशेषे तु पठोक्ताः सर्वदेवताः || 5 ||
text_mt: enveloped with flowers and sandalpaste, for the great-souled one along with his retinue; / but at the conclusion of the worship of the seat, all the deities mentioned in the recitation

sanskrit_iast: pīṭhanāmnā tu saṃyojyā maṇḍalasya tu madhyataḥ |
meaning: पीठनाम्ना तु संयोज्या मण्डलस्य तु मध्यतः |
text_mt: are to be joined by the name of the seat in the centre of the maṇḍala.

sanskrit_iast: dhyānasvarūpaṃ bhinnaṃ tad vaiṣṇavyā saha bhairava || 6 ||
meaning: ध्यानस्वरूपं भिन्नं तद् वैष्णव्या सह भैरव || 6 ||
text_mt: The form for meditation is different from that of Vaiṣṇavī, O Bhairava.

sanskrit_iast:
kāmāyāḥ sarvamanyat tu mahāmāyāstavoditam |
yoginīstu catuḥṣaṣṭiḥ pūjayecca pṛthak pṛthak || 7 ||
meaning:
कामायाः सर्वमन्यत् तु महामायास्तवोदितम् |
योगिनीस्तु चतुःषष्टिः पूजयेच्च पृथक् पृथक् || 7 ||
text_mt: Everything else for Kāmā is as declared in the Mahāmāyā hymn; / and one should worship the sixty-four yoginīs, each individually,

sanskrit_iast:
guhāṃ manobhavāṃ cāpi mahotsāhāṃ tathā sakhīm |
anantaraṃ pūjayet tu dikpālāṃśca navagrahān || 8 ||
meaning:
गुहां मनोभवां चापि महोत्साहां तथा सखीम् |
अनन्तरं पूजयेत् तु दिक्पालांश्च नवग्रहान् || 8 ||
text_mt: as well as Guhā, Manobhavā, Mahotsāhā, and Sakhī; / immediately afterwards, one should worship the guardians of the directions and the nine planets.

sanskrit_iast:
rūpatastān samuddiśya pūjayediṣṭasiddhaye |
pūrvadvāre gaṇapatiṃ prathamaṃ tu prapūjayet || 9 ||
meaning:
रूपतस्तान् समुद्दिश्य पूजयेदिष्टसिद्धये |
पूर्वद्वारे गणपतिं प्रथमं तु प्रपूजयेत् || 9 ||
text_mt: Having designated them according to their forms, one should worship them for the attainment of desired success; / first of all, one should worship Gaṇapati at the eastern gate,

sanskrit_iast:
nandinaṃ ca hanūmantaṃ paścimadvāri pūjayet |
bhṛṅgī cottarataḥ pūjyo mahākālastu dakṣiṇe || 10 ||
meaning:
नन्दिनं च हनूमन्तं पश्चिमद्वारि पूजयेत् |
भृङ्गी चोत्तरतः पूज्यो महाकालस्तु दक्षिणे || 10 ||
text_mt: and worship Nandin and Hanūmat at the western gate; / Bhṛṅgin is to be worshipped in the north, and Mahākāla in the south.

sanskrit_iast:
ete mama dvārapālā devyā dvāre prapūjayet |
pātrāmṛtīkṛtividhau kuryād vai kāmamudrayā || 11 ||
meaning:
एते मम द्वारपाला देव्या द्वारे प्रपूजयेत् |
पात्रामृतीकृतिविधौ कुर्याद् वै काममुद्रया || 11 ||
text_mt: These are my gatekeepers; one should worship them at the door of the Goddess; / in the rite of converting the vessels into nectar, one should do so indeed with the kāmamudrā.

sanskrit_iast:
bhūtāpasāraṇaṃ kuryāt pūrvaṃ tālatrayeṇa tu |
vāmahaste dakṣiṇena pāṇinā tālamāharet || 12 ||
meaning:
भूतापसारणं कुर्यात् पूर्वं तालत्रयेण तु |
वामहस्ते दक्षिणेन पाणिना तालमाहरेत् || 12 ||
text_mt: One should first perform the expulsion of spirits with three claps; / one should strike a clap on the left hand with the right hand.

sanskrit_iast:
hūṁ hūṁ phaḍitimantreṇa vetālādīṃśca sārayet |
sarvamuttaratantroktaṃ tantraṃ kuryāt tu sādhakaḥ || 13 ||
meaning:
हूṁ हूṁ फडितिमन्त्रेण वेतालादींश्च सारयेत् |
सर्वमुत्तरतन्त्रोक्तं तन्त्रं कुर्यात् तु साधकः || 13 ||
text_mt: With the mantra 'hūṁ hūṁ phaṭ', one should drive away the vetālas and other spirits; / the practitioner should perform the entire ritual procedure as stated in the Uttaratantra.

sanskrit_iast:
atroktena svarūpeṇa prāṇāyāmaṃ tathā caret |
snāpayet prathamaṃ devīṃ mūlamantreṇa pūjakaḥ || 14 ||
meaning:
अत्रोक्तेन स्वरूपेण प्राणायामं तथा चरेत् |
स्नापयेत् प्रथमं देवीं मूलमन्त्रेण पूजकः || 14 ||
text_mt: One should likewise perform breath-control according to the form stated here; / the worshipper should first bathe the Goddess with the root mantra."

sanskrit_iast:
madhukṣīrājyadadhibhirgomūtrairgomayaistathā |
ratnodakaiḥ śarkarābhirguḍaratnakuśodakaiḥ || 15 ||
meaning:
मधुक्षीराज्यदधिभिर्गोमूत्रैर्गोमयैस्तथा |
रत्नोदकैः शर्कराभिर्गुडरत्नकुशोदकैः || 15 ||
text_mt: With honey, milk, clarified butter, and curd, likewise with cow's urine and cow dung, / with water with jewels, sugars, jaggery, gems, and kuśa-water,

sanskrit_iast:
sitasarṣapamudgābhyāṃ tilakṣīraistathā yavaiḥ |
raktacandanapuṣpaiśca dūrvābhī rocanāyutaiḥ || 16 ||
meaning:
सितसर्षपमुद्गाभ्यां तिलक्षीरैस्तथा यवैः |
रक्तचन्दनपुष्पैश्च दूर्वाभी रोचनायुतैः || 16 ||
text_mt: with white mustard and mung beans, with sesame, milk, and likewise barley, / and with red sandalwood and flowers, [and] dūrvā-grass mixed with yellow pigment,

sanskrit_iast:
navabhirvitaredarghyaṃ śilāyāṃ yonisannidhau |
āsanaṃ pādyamarghyaṃ ca tata ācamanīyakam || 17 ||
meaning:
नवभिर्वितरेदर्घ्यं शिलायां योनिसन्निधौ |
आसनं पाद्यमर्घ्यं च तत आचमनीयकम् || 17 ||
text_mt: he should offer ninefold arghya upon the stone in the presence of the yoni: / a seat, water for washing the feet, arghya, and then water for rinsing the mouth,

sanskrit_iast:
madhuparkaṃ snānajalaṃ vastraṃ candanabhūṣaṇam |
puṣpaṃ dhūpaṃ ca dīpaṃ ca netrāñjanamataḥ param || 18 ||
meaning:
मधुपर्कं स्नानजलं वस्त्रं चन्दनभूषणम् |
पुष्पं धूपं च दीपं च नेत्राञ्जनमतः परम् || 18 ||
text_mt: madhuparka, water for bathing, cloth, sandalwood, ornaments, / a flower, incense, and a lamp, and after this eye-salve,

sanskrit_iast:
naivedyācamanīye ca pradakṣiṇanamaskṛtī |
ete ṣoḍaśa nirdiṣṭā upacārāstu pīṭhataḥ || 19 ||
meaning:
नैवेद्याचमनीये च प्रदक्षिणनमस्कृती |
एते षोडश निर्दिष्टा उपचारास्तु पीठतः || 19 ||
text_mt: a food-offering, water for rinsing the mouth, circumambulation, and salutation: / these sixteen offerings are prescribed for the pīṭha.

sanskrit_iast:
āvāhayenmahādevīṃ gāyatryā kāmayogayā |
tāmeva viddhi vetāla guhyaṃ bhairavadaivatam || 20 ||
meaning:
आवाहयेन्महादेवीं गायत्र्या कामयोगया |
तामेव विद्धि वेताल गुह्यं भैरवदैवतम् || 20 ||
text_mt: He should summon the great goddess with the Gāyatrī joined with desire; / know that to be the secret deity of Bhairava, O Vetāla:

sanskrit_iast:
kāmākhye tvamihāgaccha yathāvanmama sannidhau |
pūjākaraṇi sānnidhyamiha kalpaya kāmini || 21 ||
meaning:
कामाख्ये त्वमिहागच्छ यथावन्मम सन्निधौ |
पूजाकरणि सान्निध्यमिह कल्पय कामिनि || 21 ||
text_mt: "O Kāmākhyā, come here in the proper manner before me; / O passionate goddess, cause your presence to be here as the maker of the rite!"

sanskrit_iast:
kāmākhyāyai ca vidmahe kāmeśvaryai tu dhīmahi |
tataḥ kuryānmahādevī tataścānu pracodayāt || 22 ||
meaning:
कामाख्यायै च विद्महे कामेश्वर्यै तु धीमहि |
ततः कुर्यान्महादेवी ततश्चानु प्रचोदयात् || 22 ||
text_mt: He should recite: "We know Kāmākhyā; we meditate upon Kāmeśvarī; / may the Great Goddess thereafter stimulate [us]."

sanskrit_iast:
eṣā tu kāmagāyatrī pūjayedanayā śubhām |
pūjāvasāne ca balīndevyāḥ prītyai nivedayet || 23 ||
meaning:
एषा तु कामगायत्री पूजयेदनया शुभाम् |
पूजावसाने च बलीन्देव्याः प्रीत्यै निवेदयेत् || 23 ||
text_mt: This is the Kāmagāyatrī; with this he should worship the auspicious goddess, / and at the conclusion of worship he should offer animal-sacrifices for the pleasure of the goddess.

sanskrit_iast:
rudrākṣamālayā jāpyamādāyaiva samācaret |
trayakṣarairmūlamantrasya tridhā vṛttaḥ prapūjayet || 24 ||
meaning:
रुद्राक्षमालया जाप्यमादायैव समाचरेत् |
त्रयक्षरैर्मूलमन्त्रस्य त्रिधा वृत्तः प्रपूजयेत् || 24 ||
text_mt: Taking a rosary of rudrākṣa-seeds, he should perform the recitation; / turning it three times, he should worship with the three syllables of the root mantra.

sanskrit_iast:
kāmākhyāyāḥ ṣaḍaṅgāni āhvānānantare tathā |
vaiṣṇavītantramantrasya karāṅganyāsayośca ye || 25 ||
meaning:
कामाख्यायाः षडङ्गानि आह्वानानन्तरे तथा |
वैष्णवीतन्त्रमन्त्रस्य कराङ्गन्यासयोश्च ये || 25 ||
text_mt: Likewise, after the invocation of Kāmākhyā's six limbs, / and whichever vowels are spoken for the hand and limb nyāsa of the Vaiṣṇavī-tantra mantra,

sanskrit_iast:
svarāḥ proktāstaiḥ svaraistu sārdhacandraiḥ sabindukaiḥ |
mūlamantrādyakṣarābhyāṃ yugapattu niyojitaiḥ || 26 ||
meaning:
स्वराः प्रोक्तास्तैः स्वरैस्तु सार्धचन्द्रैः सबिन्दुकैः |
मूलमन्त्राद्यक्षराभ्यां युगपत्तु नियोजितैः || 26 ||
text_mt: with those vowels joined with the crescent moon and the dot, / united at the same time with the initial syllables of the root mantra,

sanskrit_iast:
kaniṣṭhādikrameṇaiva hyaṅganyāsaṃ samācaret |
aṅganyāsakaranyāsau kṛtvā paścāttu sādhakaḥ || 27 ||
meaning:
कनिष्ठादिक्रमेणैव ह्यङ्गन्यासं समाचरेत् |
अङ्गन्यासकरन्यासौ कृत्वा पश्चात्तु साधकः || 27 ||
text_mt: he should perform the limb nyāsa in the order beginning with the little finger; / having performed the limb nyāsa and the hand nyāsa, the adept thereafter

sanskrit_iast:
hṛcchirastu śikhāvarmanetrāsyodarapṛṣṭhataḥ |
bāhvoḥ pāṇyorjaṅghayośca pādayoścāpi vinyaset || 28 ||
meaning:
हृच्छिरस्तु शिखावर्मनेत्रास्योदरपृष्ठतः |
बाह्वोः पाण्योर्जङ्घयोश्च पादयोश्चापि विन्यसेत् || 28 ||
text_mt: should place [them] on the heart, the head, the crest, the armor, the eyes, the mouth, the belly, the back, / the arms, the hands, the shanks, and on the feet.

sanskrit_iast:
abhayaṃ varadaṃ hastamakṣamālāṃ ca sūtrakam |
pūjayecchaśinaṃ sūryaṃ śiraścāndrakalāṃ tathā || 29 ||
meaning:
अभयं वरदं हस्तमक्षमालां च सूत्रकम् |
पूजयेच्छशिनं सूर्यं शिरश्चान्द्रकलां तथा || 29 ||
text_mt: The hand granting freedom from fear and bestowing boons, the rosary, and the cord: / he should worship the moon, the sun, the head, and the crescent moon,

sanskrit_iast:
raktapadmaṃ śavaṃ caiva lauhityaṃ brahmaputrakam |
manobhavāṃ śilāṃ tatra śaktisthāṃ śavamadhyataḥ || 30 ||
meaning:
रक्तपद्मं शवं चैव लौहित्यं ब्रह्मपुत्रकम् |
मनोभवां शिलां तत्र शक्तिस्थां शवमध्यतः || 30 ||
text_mt: the red lotus, the corpse, and the Lauhitya, the son of Brahmā, / the stone of Manobhava there, standing on the Śakti in the middle of the corpse;

sanskrit_iast:
devyāḥ prapūjayedbhaktaḥ kāravālaṃ ca pārśvataḥ |
pīṭhādidevatāstatra yajet kāmeśvarīṃ śubhām || 31 ||
meaning:
देव्याः प्रपूजयेद्भक्तः कारवालं च पार्श्वतः |
पीठादिदेवतास्तत्र यजेत् कामेश्वरीं शुभाम् || 31 ||
text_mt: the devotee should worship the goddess's sword at the side; / there he should worship the deities of the pīṭha [and] the auspicious Kāmeśvarī.

sanskrit_iast:
tripurāṃ pūjayenmadhye pīṭhapratyadhidevatām |
śāradāṃ ca mahotsāhāṃ madhya eva prapūjayet || 32 ||
meaning:
त्रिपुरां पूजयेन्मध्ये पीठप्रत्यधिदेवताम् |
शारदां च महोत्साहां मध्य एव प्रपूजयेत् || 32 ||
text_mt: He should worship Tripurā in the center, the presiding deity of the pīṭha, / and he should worship Śāradā of great energy right in the center.

sanskrit_iast:
caṇḍeśvarī mahādevī devyā nirmālyadhāriṇī |
yonimudrā samākhyātā kāmākhyā visarjane || 33 ||
meaning:
चण्डेश्वरी महादेवी देव्या निर्माल्यधारिणी |
योनिमुद्रा समाख्याता कामाख्या विसर्जने || 33 ||
text_mt: The great goddess Caṇḍeśvarī wears the goddess's used offerings; / the yoni gesture is prescribed in the dismissal of Kāmākhyā.

sanskrit_iast:
idaṃ dravyaṃ tu sindūracandanāgurukuṅkumaiḥ |
iti yo hi mayā prokto viśeṣaḥ paripūjane || 34 ||
meaning:
इदं द्रव्यं तु सिन्दूरचन्दनागुरुकुङ्कुमैः |
इति यो हि मया प्रोक्तो विशेषः परिपूजने || 34 ||
text_mt: This substance [is prepared] with vermilion, sandalwood, aloe, and saffron: / thus what is declared by me as the specific rule in full worship,

sanskrit_iast:
ebhirviśeṣaiḥ sahitaṃ vaiṣṇavītantragocaram |
sarvaṃ kalpaṃ samāsādya kāmākhyāṃ paripūjayet || 35 ||
meaning:
एभिर्विशेषैः सहितं वैष्णवीतन्त्रगोचरम् |
सर्वं कल्पं समासाद्य कामाख्यां परिपूजयेत् || 35 ||
text_mt: together with these specific rules belonging to the Vaiṣṇavī-tantra, / having undertaken the entire ritual procedure, he should worship Kāmākhyā completely.

sanskrit_iast:
anenaiva vidhānena kāmākhyāṃ yastu pūjayet |
manobhavaguhāmadhye sa yāti paramāṃ gatim || 36 ||
meaning:
अनेनैव विधानेन कामाख्यां यस्तु पूजयेत् |
मनोभवगुहामध्ये स याति परमां गतिम् || 36 ||
text_mt: Whoever worships Kāmākhyā within the cave of Manobhava / according to this very procedure goes to the supreme state.

sanskrit_iast:
brahmāṇī caṇḍikā raudrī gaurīndrāṇī tathaiva ca |
kaumārī vaiṣṇavī durgā narasiṃhī ca kālikā || 37 ||
meaning:
ब्रह्माणी चण्डिका रौद्री गौरीन्द्राणी तथैव च |
कौमारी वैष्णवी दुर्गा नरसिंही च कालिका || 37 ||
text_mt: Brahmāṇī, Caṇḍikā, Raudrī, Gaurī, Indrāṇī, and likewise / Kaumārī, Vaiṣṇavī, Durgā, Narasiṃhī, and Kālikā,

sanskrit_iast:
cāmuṇḍā śivadūtī ca vārāhī kauśikī tathā |
māheśvarī śāṅkarī ca jayantī sarvamaṅgalā || 38 ||
meaning:
चामुण्डा शिवदूती च वाराही कौशिकी तथा |
माहेश्वरी शाङ्करी च जयन्ती सर्वमङ्गला || 38 ||
text_mt: Cāmuṇḍā, Śivadūtī, Vārāhī, Kauśikī, / Māheśvarī, Śāṅkarī, Jayantī, Sarvamaṅgalā,

sanskrit_iast:
kālī kapālinī medhā śivā śākambharī tathā |
bhīmā śāntā bhrāmarī ca rudrāṇī cāmbikā tathā || 39 ||
meaning:
काली कपालिनी मेधा शिवा शाकम्भरी तथा |
भीमा शान्ता भ्रामरी च रुद्राणी चाम्बिका तथा || 39 ||
text_mt: Kālī, Kapālinī, Medhā, Śivā, Śākambharī, / Bhīmā, Śāntā, Bhrāmarī, Rudrāṇī, Ambikā,

sanskrit_iast:
kṣamā dhātrī tathā svāhā svadhāparṇā mahodarī |
ghorarūpā mahākālī bhadrakālī bhayaṅkarī || 40 ||
meaning:
क्षमा धात्री तथा स्वाहा स्वधापर्णा महोदरी |
घोररूपा महाकाली भद्रकाली भयङ्करी || 40 ||
text_mt: Kṣamā, Dhātrī, Svāhā, Svadhā, Aparṇā, Mahodarī, / Ghorarūpā, Mahākālī, Bhadrakālī, Bhayaṅkarī,

sanskrit_iast:
kṣemakarī cogracaṇḍā caṇdogrā caṇḍanāyikā |
caṇḍā caṇḍavatī caṇḍī mahāmohā priyaṅkarī || 41 ||
meaning:
क्षेमकरी चोग्रचण्डा चण्दोग्रा चण्डनायिका |
चण्डा चण्डवती चण्डी महामोहा प्रियङ्करी || 41 ||
text_mt: Kṣemakarī, Ugracaṇḍā, Caṇḍogrā, Caṇḍanāyikā, / Caṇḍā, Caṇḍavatī, Caṇḍī, Mahāmohā, Priyaṅkarī,

sanskrit_iast:
kalavikariṇī devī balapramathinī tathā |
madanonmathinī devī sarvabhūtasya dāmanī || 42 ||
meaning:
कलविकरिणी देवी बलप्रमथिनी तथा |
मदनोन्मथिनी देवी सर्वभूतस्य दामनी || 42 ||
text_mt: the goddess Kalavikariṇī, Balapramathinī, / the goddess Madanonmathinī, the subduer of all beings,

sanskrit_iast:
umā tārā mahānidrā vijayā ca jayā tathā |
pūrvoktāḥ śailaputryādyā yoginyaṣṭau ca yāḥ kramāt || 43 ||
meaning:
उमा तारा महानिद्रा विजया च जया तथा |
पूर्वोक्ताः शैलपुत्र्याद्या योगिन्यष्टौ च याः क्रमात् || 43 ||
text_mt: Umā, Tārā, Mahānidrā, Vijayā, and Jayā; / those beginning with Śailaputrī mentioned earlier and the eight yoginīs in succession:

sanskrit_iast:
tābhirebhiśca sahitāḥ catuḥṣaṣṭiṃ ca yoginīḥ |
pūjayenmaṇḍalasyāntaḥ sarvakāmārthasiddhaye || 44 ||
meaning:
ताभिरेभिश्च सहिताः चतुःषष्टिं च योगिनीः |
पूजयेन्मण्डलस्यान्तः सर्वकामार्थसिद्धये || 44 ||
text_mt: with those and with these, he should worship the sixty-four yoginīs / inside the maṇḍala for the attainment of all desires and aims.

sanskrit_iast:
nānāvidhaṃ tu naivedyaṃ pānaṃ pāyasameva ca |
modakāpūpapiṣṭādi devyai samyak pradāpayet || 45 ||
meaning:
नानाविधं तु नैवेद्यं पानं पायसमेव च |
मोदकापूपपिष्टादि देव्यै सम्यक् प्रदापयेत् || 45 ||
text_mt: Food-offerings of various kinds, drinks, rice boiled in milk, / modakas, cakes, flour-pastries, and the like, he should properly present to the goddess.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ tu pūjayed devīṃ kāmākhyāṃ varadāyinīm |
bhaktiyukto naro yastu sarvān labhate priyān || 46 ||
meaning:
एवं तु पूजयेद् देवीं कामाख्यां वरदायिनीम् |
भक्तियुक्तो नरो यस्तु सर्वान् लभते प्रियान् || 46 ||
text_mt: The man who, endowed with devotion, worships the boon-granting goddess Kāmākhyā thus, / obtains all desired things.

sanskrit_iast:
mahotsāhā tu yā devī mahāmāyā tu sā smṛtā |
vaiṣṇavītantramantreṇa sā pūjyā yonimaṇḍale || 47 ||
meaning:
महोत्साहा तु या देवी महामाया तु सा स्मृता |
वैष्णवीतन्त्रमन्त्रेण सा पूज्या योनिमण्डले || 47 ||
text_mt: The goddess of great energy is considered to be Mahāmāyā; / she is to be worshipped in the yoni-maṇḍala with the mantra of the Vaiṣṇavī-tantra.

sanskrit_iast:
tadeva maṇḍalaṃ cāsya hyaṅganyāsaṃ tathaiva ca |
sā eva pūjāparyāye taddhyānaṃ saiva daivatā || 48 ||
meaning:
तदेव मण्डलं चास्य ह्यङ्गन्यासं तथैव च |
सा एव पूजापर्याये तद्ध्यानं सैव दैवता || 48 ||
text_mt: Her maṇḍala is that very one, and the limb nyāsa is likewise; / in the course of worship, that is her visualization and she is that deity.

sanskrit_iast:
tantraṃ tadevamuktaṃ tu tasmānnānyaṃ tu kiñcana |
maṇḍalādivisṛṣṭyarthaṃ mahāmāyāmahotsave || 49 ||
meaning:
तन्त्रं तदेवमुक्तं तु तस्मान्नान्यं तु किञ्चन |
मण्डलादिविसृष्ट्यर्थं महामायामहोत्सवे || 49 ||
text_mt: That tantra has thus been spoken, nor is there anything other than it, / for the creation of the maṇḍala and so forth in the great festival of Mahāmāyā.

sanskrit_iast:
yatproktaṃ tena tāṃ devīṃ mahotsāhāṃ tu maṇḍale |
snānapūrvaṃ pūjayettu madhvājyādibhirāsavaiḥ || 50 ||
meaning:
यत्प्रोक्तं तेन तां देवीं महोत्साहां तु मण्डले |
स्नानपूर्वं पूजयेत्तु मध्वाज्यादिभिरासवैः || 50 ||
text_mt: By what has been declared, he should worship that goddess of great energy in the maṇḍala, / preceded by bathing, with honey, clarified butter, and other fermented drinks.

sanskrit_iast:
śṛṇutaṃ tripurāmūrteḥ kāmākhyāyāḥ prapūjanam |
etasyā mūlamantraṃ tu pūrvamuttaratantrake || 51 ||
meaning:
शृणुतं त्रिपुरामूर्तेः कामाख्यायाः प्रपूजनम् |
एतस्या मूलमन्त्रं तु पूर्वमुत्तरतन्त्रके || 51 ||
text_mt: Listen to the worship of Kāmākhyā in the form of Tripurā; / her root mantra, previously in the Uttaratantra,

sanskrit_iast:
yuvayoriṣṭayoḥ samyak kramāt tat pratipāditam |
vāgbhavaṃ kāmabījaṃ tu ḍāmaraṃ ceti tattrayam || 52 ||
meaning:
युवयोरिष्टयोः सम्यक् क्रमात् तत् प्रतिपादितम् |
वाग्भवं कामबीजं तु डामरं चेति तत्त्रयम् || 52 ||
text_mt: was properly set forth in succession for both of you who desire it: / the vāgbhava, the kāma-seed, and the ḍāmara: that triad,

sanskrit_iast:
sarvadharmāthakāmādisādhakaṃ kuṇḍalīyutam |
trīṇyasmāt purato dadyād durgā dhyātā maheśvarī || 53 ||
meaning:
सर्वधर्माथकामादिसाधकं कुण्डलीयुतम् |
त्रीण्यस्मात् पुरतो दद्याद् दुर्गा ध्याता महेश्वरी || 53 ||
text_mt: granting all religious duty, wealth, desire, and so forth, joined with the Kuṇḍalī; / before this he should place three [syllables]; Durgā, the Great Goddess, is visualized.

sanskrit_iast:
tripureti tataḥ khyātā kāmākhyā kāmarūpiṇī |
tasyāstu snāpanaṃ yādṛkkāmākhyāyāḥ prakīrtitam || 54 ||
meaning:
त्रिपुरेति ततः ख्याता कामाख्या कामरूपिणी |
तस्यास्तु स्नापनं यादृक्कामाख्यायाः प्रकीर्तितम् || 54 ||
text_mt: From this, Kāmākhyā who assumes any form at will is celebrated as Tripurā; / the kind of bathing that has been proclaimed for Kāmākhyā,

sanskrit_iast:
tenaiva snāpanaṃ kuryānmūlamantreṇa pūjakaḥ |
rikoṇaṃ maṇḍalaṃ cāsyāstripuraṃ tu trirekhakam || 55 ||
meaning:
तेनैव स्नापनं कुर्यान्मूलमन्त्रेण पूजकः |
रिकोणं मण्डलं चास्यास्त्रिपुरं तु त्रिरेखकम् || 55 ||
text_mt: with that very same root mantra the worshipper should perform the bathing; / her maṇḍala is triangular, consisting of three cities and having three lines.

sanskrit_iast:
mantraṃ tu akṣaraṃ jñeyaṃ tathā rūpaṃ trayaṃ punaḥ |
trividhā kuṇḍalī śaktistridevānāṃ ca sṛṣṭaye || 56 ||
meaning:
मन्त्रं तु अक्षरं ज्ञेयं तथा रूपं त्रयं पुनः |
त्रिविधा कुण्डली शक्तिस्त्रिदेवानां च सृष्टये || 56 ||
text_mt: The mantra is known to have [three] syllables, and its forms are three again; / the Kuṇḍalī power is threefold for the creation of the three gods.

sanskrit_iast:
sarvaṃ trayaṃ trayaṃ yasmāt tripurā tena sā smṛtā |
udīcyādyatha pūrvāntā rekhāḥ kāryāstu maṇḍale || 57 ||
meaning:
सर्वं त्रयं त्रयं यस्मात् त्रिपुरा तेन सा स्मृता |
उदीच्याद्यथ पूर्वान्ता रेखाः कार्यास्तु मण्डले || 57 ||
text_mt: Because everything is in triads, therefore she is called Tripurā; / lines are to be drawn on the maṇḍala from the north ending in the east.

sanskrit_iast:
tristrirekhāstu kartavyāstā eva puṣpacandanaiḥ |
aiśānyamatha nair-ṛtyāṃ mantraṃ kṛtvā tu saṃlikhet || 58 ||
meaning:
त्रिस्त्रिरेखास्तु कर्तव्यास्ता एव पुष्पचन्दनैः |
ऐशान्यमथ नैर्-ऋत्यां मन्त्रं कृत्वा तु संलिखेत् || 58 ||
text_mt: Three sets of three lines are to be made with flowers and sandalwood; / then, having formed the mantra in the northeast and in the southwest, he should draw:

sanskrit_iast:
nai-ṛtyāṃ caiva vāyavyāṃ tato hyaiśānyagāṃ punaḥ |
evaṃ trikoṇaṃ vilikhenmaṇḍalasyāntare punaḥ || 59 ||
meaning:
नै-ऋत्यां चैव वायव्यां ततो ह्यैशान्यगां पुनः |
एवं त्रिकोणं विलिखेन्मण्डलस्यान्तरे पुनः || 59 ||
text_mt: in the southwest, in the northwest, and then going again to the northeast; / in this way he should draw a triangle inside the maṇḍala again.

sanskrit_iast:
iśānyādyāstu yā rekhā sā tu śaktirnigadyate |
nair-ṛtyāṃ vāyavīṃ yātā tato hyaiśānyagā tu yā || 60 ||
meaning:
इशान्याद्यास्तु या रेखा सा तु शक्तिर्निगद्यते |
नैर्-ऋत्यां वायवीं याता ततो ह्यैशान्यगा तु या || 60 ||
text_mt:
The line that begins in the north-east is declared to be Śakti;
that which goes from the south-west to the north-west, and then goes to the north-east,

sanskrit_iast:
sā tu śambhuḥ samākhyātā śaktyā śambhuṃ vibhedayet |
śaktyā vibhinnaṃ bhūteśaṃ veṣṭayet kamalena tu || 61 ||
meaning:
सा तु शम्भुः समाख्याता शक्त्या शम्भुं विभेदयेत् |
शक्त्या विभिन्नं भूतेशं वेष्टयेत् कमलेन तु || 61 ||
text_mt:
is declared to be Śambhu. One should intersect Śambhu with Śakti;
one should surround the Lord of Ghosts, intersected by Śakti, with a lotus.

sanskrit_iast:
aṣṭapatreṇa tāṃ dhyātvā trivarṇāṃ prāk prapūjayet |
tribhistribhistu rekhābhiḥ śaktiṃ śambhuṃ ca veṣṭayet || 62 ||
meaning:
अष्टपत्रेण तां ध्यात्वा त्रिवर्णां प्राक् प्रपूजयेत् |
त्रिभिस्त्रिभिस्तु रेखाभिः शक्तिं शम्भुं च वेष्टयेत् || 62 ||
text_mt:
Having meditated on her as eight-petalled and having three colours, one should first worship her;
and with sets of three lines each, one should encircle Śakti and Śambhu.

sanskrit_iast:
sthānasyābhyukṣaṇaṃ samyaddha mārjanaṃ likhanaṃ tathā |
astramantraprayogāṇāṃ bhūtānāmapasāraṇam || 63 ||
meaning:
स्थानस्याभ्युक्षणं सम्यद्ध मार्जनं लिखनं तथा |
अस्त्रमन्त्रप्रयोगाणां भूतानामपसारणम् || 63 ||
text_mt:
The proper sprinkling of the site, wiping, and drawing,
and the driving away of spirits by applications of the weapon-mantra,

sanskrit_iast:
vaiṣṇavītantramantroktaṃ tathaivottaratantrake |
yat proktaṃ tat tu sāmānyaṃ prāk kuryāt sādhako naraḥ || 64 ||
meaning:
वैष्णवीतन्त्रमन्त्रोक्तं तथैवोत्तरतन्त्रके |
यत् प्रोक्तं तत् तु सामान्यं प्राक् कुर्यात् साधको नरः || 64 ||
text_mt:
as taught in the mantra of the Vaiṣṇavī Tantra, and likewise in the Uttara Tantra:
that which is taught as common [to both], the practicing adept should perform first.

sanskrit_iast:
tripurāyā viśeṣeṇa sahitaṃ pūjanakramam |
etat trikoṇaṃ devānāṃ trayāṇāṃ sthānamiṣyate || 65 ||
meaning:
त्रिपुराया विशेषेण सहितं पूजनक्रमम् |
एतत् त्रिकोणं देवानां त्रयाणां स्थानमिष्यते || 65 ||
text_mt:
The sequence of worship accompanied especially by [that of] Tripurā [is now taught].
This triangle is held to be the seat of the three gods.

sanskrit_iast:
aiśānyāṃ tu tatheśāno nair-ṛtyāṃ caturānanaḥ |
vāyavyāṃ tu tathā brahmā ṣaṭkoṇeṣu prakīrtitāḥ || 66 ||
meaning:
ऐशान्यां तु तथेशानो नैर्-ऋत्यां चतुराननः |
वायव्यां तु तथा ब्रह्मा षट्कोणेषु प्रकीर्तिताः || 66 ||
text_mt:
Iśāna is in the north-east, the Four-Faced in the south-west,
and Brahmā in the north-west: they are proclaimed in the six angles.

sanskrit_iast:
dalaṃ tvekapuraṃ proktaṃ keśaraṃ cāparaṃ puram |
puraṃ śeṣaṃ trikoṇaṃ tu trikoṇaṃ maṇḍalaṃ smṛtam || 67 ||
meaning:
दलं त्वेकपुरं प्रोक्तं केशरं चापरं पुरम् |
पुरं शेषं त्रिकोणं तु त्रिकोणं मण्डलं स्मृतम् || 67 ||
text_mt:
A petal is declared to be one city, and a filament another city;
the remaining city is the triangle: the maṇḍala is recorded as a triangle.

sanskrit_iast:
daleṣu keśare cāpi trikoṇe ca tridhā tridhā |
rekhāstu vihitāḥ samyak kuryāt tatra punaḥ punaḥ || 68 ||
meaning:
दलेषु केशरे चापि त्रिकोणे च त्रिधा त्रिधा |
रेखास्तु विहिताः सम्यक् कुर्यात् तत्र पुनः पुनः || 68 ||
text_mt:
On the petals, on the filaments, and on the triangle, threefold lines
are prescribed; he should draw them there properly, again and again.

sanskrit_iast:
uttaraṃ tad bhaved dvāraṃ tasya vai dhanurākṛtiḥ |
pūrvadvāraṃ tu ṣaṭkoṇaṃ catuṣkoṇaṃ tu dakṣiṇe || 69 ||
meaning:
उत्तरं तद् भवेद् द्वारं तस्य वै धनुराकृतिः |
पूर्वद्वारं तु षट्कोणं चतुष्कोणं तु दक्षिणे || 69 ||
text_mt:
The north is its gate, having the shape of a bow;
the eastern gate is a hexagon, and there is a square in the south.

sanskrit_iast:
paścimaṃ toraṇākāraṃ yathā cānyatra maṇḍale |
aiśānyāṃ pañcabāṇāṃstu likhed vahnau ca taddhanuḥ || 70 ||
meaning:
पश्चिमं तोरणाकारं यथा चान्यत्र मण्डले |
ऐशान्यां पञ्चबाणांस्तु लिखेद् वह्नौ च तद्धनुः || 70 ||
text_mt:
The west has the form of an archway, as in another maṇḍala;
one should draw five arrows in the north-east and that bow in the south-east,

sanskrit_iast:
nair-ṛtyāṃ pustakaṃ cāpi vāyavyāmakṣamālikām |
evaṃ kṛtvā maṇḍalaṃ tu dhṛtvā vāmena pāṇinā || 71 ||
meaning:
नैर्-ऋत्यां पुस्तकं चापि वायव्यामक्षमालिकाम् |
एवं कृत्वा मण्डलं तु धृत्वा वामेन पाणिना || 71 ||
text_mt:
a book in the south-west, and a rosary of beads in the north-west.
Having thus made the maṇḍala, holding it with the left hand,

sanskrit_iast:
vāgveśmane nama iti maṇḍalaṃ pūjayet tataḥ |
pūjayitvā tato bhūtān nālikātritayena tu || 72 ||
meaning:
वाग्वेश्मने नम इति मण्डलं पूजयेत् ततः |
पूजयित्वा ततो भूतान् नालिकात्रितयेन तु || 72 ||
text_mt:
one should then worship the maṇḍala, saying: 'Obeisance to the abode of speech.'
Having then worshipped the spirits with three stalks,

sanskrit_iast:
mūlamantreṇa pūrvoktairmantrairapi amācaret |
navabhiśchoṭikābhistu tridhā kṛtvā tu veṣṭanam || 73 ||
meaning:
मूलमन्त्रेण पूर्वोक्तैर्मन्त्रैरपि अमाचरेत् |
नवभिश्छोटिकाभिस्तु त्रिधा कृत्वा तु वेष्टनम् || 73 ||
text_mt:
one should proceed with the root-mantra and also with the previously declared mantras.
Making an encirclement threefold with nine snaps of the fingers,

sanskrit_iast:
abhyukṣaṇaṃ tataḥ kuryād bhūtānāmapasāraṇam |
pratipattistu pātrasya arghyārthaṃ navadhā punaḥ || 74 ||
meaning:
अभ्युक्षणं ततः कुर्याद् भूतानामपसारणम् |
प्रतिपत्तिस्तु पात्रस्य अर्घ्यार्थं नवधा पुनः || 74 ||
text_mt:
one should then perform sprinkling, and the driving away of spirits;
the assignment of the vessel for the sake of the arghya should be done ninefold again.

sanskrit_iast:
pūrvavat sādhakaḥ kuryād dahanaṃ plavanaṃ tathā |
amṛtīkaraṇaṃ kuryāt prathamaṃ dhenumudrayā || 75 ||
meaning:
पूर्ववत् साधकः कुर्याद् दहनं प्लवनं तथा |
अमृतीकरणं कुर्यात् प्रथमं धेनुमुद्रया || 75 ||
text_mt:
The adept should perform burning and flooding as before;
first he should perform the nectar-making with the cow-mudrā.

sanskrit_iast:
yonimudrāṃ tataḥ kuryāt pātratoyaṃ tu triḥ spṛśet |
mārtaṇḍabhairavāyārghyaṃ dūrvābhiḥ siddhasarṣapaiḥ || 76 ||
meaning:
योनिमुद्रां ततः कुर्यात् पात्रतोयं तु त्रिः स्पृशेत् |
मार्तण्डभैरवायार्घ्यं दूर्वाभिः सिद्धसर्षपैः || 76 ||
text_mt:
Then he should form the yoni-mudrā, and touch the vessel's water three times.
One should present arghya to Mārtaṇḍabhairava with dūrvā grass, white mustard seeds,

sanskrit_iast:
raktapuṣpaiścandanaiśca sagaṇāya nivedayet |
pāṇikacchapikāṃ kṛtvā cintanaṃ yonimudrayā || 77 ||
meaning:
रक्तपुष्पैश्चन्दनैश्च सगणाय निवेदयेत् |
पाणिकच्छपिकां कृत्वा चिन्तनं योनिमुद्रया || 77 ||
text_mt:
red flowers, and sandal-pastes, along with his troop.
Making the hand into the tortoise-posture, contemplation [is done] with the yoni-mudrā,

sanskrit_iast:
ādau madhye ca kartavyaṃ kramād vetālabhairava |
astramantreṇa pātrasya sthāpanārthaṃ tu maṇḍalam || 78 ||
meaning:
आदौ मध्ये च कर्तव्यं क्रमाद् वेतालभैरव |
अस्त्रमन्त्रेण पात्रस्य स्थापनार्थं तु मण्डलम् || 78 ||
text_mt:
to be performed at the beginning and in the middle in sequence, O Vetālabhairava!
For the installation of the vessel with the weapon-mantra, a maṇḍala

sanskrit_iast:
ṣaṭkoṇaṃ tu likhet pūrvaṃ tanmantrasthāpane'pi ca |
aiṁ āṁ klīmiti mantreṇa tridhā pātre jalaṃ kṣipet || 79 ||
meaning:
षट्कोणं तु लिखेत् पूर्वं तन्मन्त्रस्थापनेऽपि च |
ऐṁ आṁ क्लीमिति मन्त्रेण त्रिधा पात्रे जलं क्षिपेत् || 79 ||
text_mt:
in the form of a hexagon should be drawn first, and also for installing its mantra.
With the mantra 'aiṁ āṁ klīm', he should pour water into the vessel three times,

sanskrit_iast:
tridhā gandhaṃ ca puṣpaṃ ca tridhā dūrvākṣataṃ punaḥ |
rāṁ hrīṁ hrūṁ hraiṁ hraumiti ca aṅguṣṭhādi kramānnyaset || 80 ||
meaning:
त्रिधा गन्धं च पुष्पं च त्रिधा दूर्वाक्षतं पुनः |
राṁ ह्रीṁ ह्रूṁ ह्रैṁ ह्रौमिति च अङ्गुष्ठादि क्रमान्न्यसेत् || 80 ||
text_mt:
sandal-paste and flowers three times, and dūrvā grass with unhusked grain three times again.
With 'rāṁ hrīṁ hrūṁ hraiṁ hrauḥ', he should place [them] in order from the thumb onward.

sanskrit_iast:
oṃ hra ityastramantreṇa pāṇipṛṣṭhatale tathā |
hṛdayādikramāt paścānnyāsaṃ kuryāt tridhā tridhā || 81 ||
meaning:
ओं ह्र इत्यस्त्रमन्त्रेण पाणिपृष्ठतले तथा |
हृदयादिक्रमात् पश्चान्न्यासं कुर्यात् त्रिधा त्रिधा || 81 ||
text_mt:
With the weapon-mantra 'oṃ hraḥ', on the back and palm of the hand,
and then in order from the heart onward, he should perform nyāsa three times each.

sanskrit_iast:
saṃyojya pāṇyoḥ kramataścāṅguṣṭhādi dvayaṃ dvayam |
tridhā tridhā pṛthak kuryāccheṣāṅgāni ca vinyaset || 82 ||
meaning:
संयोज्य पाण्योः क्रमतश्चाङ्गुष्ठादि द्वयं द्वयम् |
त्रिधा त्रिधा पृथक् कुर्याच्छेषाङ्गानि च विन्यसेत् || 82 ||
text_mt:
Joining both hands, in sequence, two by two from the thumbs onward,
he should do this three times each separately, and place [the nyāsa on] the remaining limbs:

sanskrit_iast:
karṇarandhre tathā brahmadvāraṃ keśatalaṃ tathā |
nāsikārandhrayugalaṃ jānuyugmaṃ padadvayam || 83 ||
meaning:
कर्णरन्ध्रे तथा ब्रह्मद्वारं केशतलं तथा |
नासिकारन्ध्रयुगलं जानुयुग्मं पदद्वयम् || 83 ||
text_mt:
the ear-cavities, the aperture of Brahman, the base of the hair,
the pair of nostrils, the pair of knees, and the two feet.

sanskrit_iast:
tridhā tridhā nyasedebhiḥ ṣaḍbhirmantraiḥ pṛthak pṛthak |
prāṇāyāmaṃ tataḥ kuryāt pūrakaiḥ stambhakaistathā || 84 ||
meaning:
त्रिधा त्रिधा न्यसेदेभिः षड्भिर्मन्त्रैः पृथक् पृथक् |
प्राणायामं ततः कुर्यात् पूरकैः स्तम्भकैस्तथा || 84 ||
text_mt:
He should place [them] three times each separately with these six mantras.
Then he should perform breath-control with inhalations, retentions,

sanskrit_iast:
recakenāpi tripurāmūrtiṃ devīṃ vicintayet |
dahanaplavanaṃ kṛtvā ādyāṃ mūrtiṃ vicintayet || 85 ||
meaning:
रेचकेनापि त्रिपुरामूर्तिं देवीं विचिन्तयेत् |
दहनप्लवनं कृत्वा आद्यां मूर्तिं विचिन्तयेत् || 85 ||
text_mt:
and with exhalations; and he should contemplate the goddess in the form of Tripurā.
Having performed the burning and the flooding, he should contemplate the primal form.

sanskrit_iast:
tridhādṛtyātha hṛdaye tāṃ mūrtiṃ śṛṇu bhairava |
sindūrapuñjasaṃkāśāṃ trinetrāṃ tu caturbhujām || 86 ||
meaning:
त्रिधादृत्याथ हृदये तां मूर्तिं शृणु भैरव |
सिन्दूरपुञ्जसंकाशां त्रिनेत्रां तु चतुर्भुजाम् || 86 ||
text_mt:
Honouring it three times in the heart, hear of that form, O Bhairava!
Resembling a heap of vermilion, three-eyed and four-armed,

sanskrit_iast:
vāmordhve puṣpakodaṇḍaṃ dhṛtvādhaḥ pustakaṃ tathā |
dakṣiṇordhve pañcabāṇānakṣamālāṃ dadhātyadhaḥ || 87 ||
meaning:
वामोर्ध्वे पुष्पकोदण्डं धृत्वाधः पुस्तकं तथा |
दक्षिणोर्ध्वे पञ्चबाणानक्षमालां दधात्यधः || 87 ||
text_mt:
holding a flower-bow in the upper left hand and a book below,
she bears five arrows in the upper right hand and a rosary of beads below.

sanskrit_iast:
caturṇāṃ kuṇapānāṃ tu pṛṣṭhe'nyaṃ kuṇapāntaram |
nidhāya tasya pṛṣṭhe tu samapādena saṃsthitām || 88 ||
meaning:
चतुर्णां कुणपानां तु पृष्ठेऽन्यं कुणपान्तरम् |
निधाय तस्य पृष्ठे तु समपादेन संस्थिताम् || 88 ||
text_mt:
Upon the backs of four corpses, having placed another corpse,
she stands upon its back with evenly placed feet,

sanskrit_iast:
jaṭājūṭārdhacandreṇa samābaddhaśirodharām |
nagnāṃ trivalibhedena cārumadhyāṃ manoharām || 89 ||
meaning:
जटाजूटार्धचन्द्रेण समाबद्धशिरोधराम् |
नग्नां त्रिवलिभेदेन चारुमध्यां मनोहराम् || 89 ||
text_mt:
her neck held upright, adorned with a mass of matted hair and a half-moon,
naked, slender-waisted with three folds of skin, captivating,

sanskrit_iast:
sarvālaṅkārasampūrṇāṃ sarvāṅgasundarī śubhām |
sravaddraviṇasandohāṃ sarvalakṣaṇasaṃyutām || 90 ||
meaning:
सर्वालङ्कारसम्पूर्णां सर्वाङ्गसुन्दरी शुभाम् |
स्रवद्द्रविणसन्दोहां सर्वलक्षणसंयुताम् || 90 ||
text_mt:
adorned with all ornaments, beautiful in every limb, auspicious,
flowing with an abundance of fluid, endowed with all auspicious marks.

sanskrit_iast:
enāṃ tu prathamaṃ dhyātvā tridhātmānaṃ tu cintayet |
adrūpaṃ ca tataḥ paścāt puṣpaṃ tadvāgbhavena tu || 91 ||
meaning:
एनां तु प्रथमं ध्यात्वा त्रिधात्मानं तु चिन्तयेत् |
अद्रूपं च ततः पश्चात् पुष्पं तद्वाग्भवेन तु || 91 ||
text_mt:
Having first meditated upon her, he should contemplate himself threefold
as having her form, and then thereafter [place] a flower with the syllable of speech

sanskrit_iast:
svamastake punardadyādaṅganyāsaṃ punastathā |
mantradvayaṃ tridhā japtvā vāgbhavādyaṃ tu sādhakaḥ || 92 ||
meaning:
स्वमस्तके पुनर्दद्यादङ्गन्यासं पुनस्तथा |
मन्त्रद्वयं त्रिधा जप्त्वा वाग्भवाद्यं तु साधकः || 92 ||
text_mt:
upon his own head again, and likewise perform the nyāsa on the limbs again.
Having chanted the pair of mantras beginning with the syllable of speech three times, the adept

sanskrit_iast:
arghyapātrasya toyeṣu taistoyaiḥ secayecchiraḥ |
pajopakaraṇaṃ cāpi trirabhyukṣya tathaiva tu || 93 ||
meaning:
अर्घ्यपात्रस्य तोयेषु तैस्तोयैः सेचयेच्छिरः |
पजोपकरणं चापि त्रिरभ्युक्ष्य तथैव तु || 93 ||
text_mt:
should sprinkle his head with the waters of the arghya vessel;
and having sprinkled the worship implements three times in the same way,

sanskrit_iast:
kāmapīṭhaṃ tato dhyātvā pūjayet kramatastvimān |
gaṇeśaṃ ca gaṇādhyakṣaṃ gaṇanāthaṃ tathaiva ca || 94 ||
meaning:
कामपीठं ततो ध्यात्वा पूजयेत् क्रमतस्त्विमान् |
गणेशं च गणाध्यक्षं गणनाथं तथैव च || 94 ||
text_mt:
and then having meditated on the Kāmapīṭha, he should worship these in sequence:
Gaṇeśa, Gaṇādhyakṣa, and likewise Gaṇanātha,

sanskrit_iast:
gaṇakrīḍaṃ ca pūrvādidvāre mantreṇa pūjayet |
hairambabījameteṣāṃ mantrastu parikīrtitaḥ || 95 ||
meaning:
गणक्रीडं च पूर्वादिद्वारे मन्त्रेण पूजयेत् |
हैरम्बबीजमेतेषां मन्त्रस्तु परिकीर्तितः || 95 ||
text_mt:
and Gaṇakrīḍa at the gates beginning with the east with [their] mantra.
The seed-syllable of Heramba is proclaimed to be their mantra.

sanskrit_iast:
vidyāśāntinivṛttiśca pratiṣṭhā dvārapālakāḥ |
kalāntāḥ pūjayet samyak pūrvādikramatastathā || 69 ||
meaning:
विद्याशान्तिनिवृत्तिश्च प्रतिष्ठा द्वारपालकाः |
कलान्ताः पूजयेत् सम्यक् पूर्वादिक्रमतस्तथा || 69 ||
text_mt:
Vidyā, Śānti, Nivṛtti, and Pratiṣṭhā are the gatekeepers,
ending with the kalās: he should worship them properly in sequence starting with the east.

sanskrit_iast:
siddhaputraṃ jñānaputraṃ tathā sahajaputrakam |
śeṣaṃ samayaputraṃ tu pūjayed baṭukānimān || 97 ||
meaning:
सिद्धपुत्रं ज्ञानपुत्रं तथा सहजपुत्रकम् |
शेषं समयपुत्रं तु पूजयेद् बटुकानिमान् || 97 ||
text_mt:
Siddhaputra, Jñānaputra, and likewise Sahajaputra,
and the remaining Samayaputra: he should worship these baṭukas.

sanskrit_iast:
pratyekaṃ tu śriyaṃ devīṃ baṭukānāṃ pare vare |
śrīmityanena mantreṇa pūrvādau pūjayet kramāt || 98 ||
meaning:
प्रत्येकं तु श्रियं देवीं बटुकानां परे वरे |
श्रीमित्यनेन मन्त्रेण पूर्वादौ पूजयेत् क्रमात् || 98 ||
text_mt:
To each of the baṭukas' Śrī devīs in the excellent beyond,
he should worship in order beginning in the east with this mantra: 'śrīm'.

sanskrit_iast:
siddhasya sahajasyātha jñānasya samayasya ca |
kumārīṃ pūjayet koṇe aiśānyādau tu maṇḍale || 99 ||
meaning:
सिद्धस्य सहजस्याथ ज्ञानस्य समयस्य च |
कुमारीं पूजयेत् कोणे ऐशान्यादौ तु मण्डले || 99 ||
text_mt:
Of Siddha, of Sahaja, of Jñāna, and of Samaya,
he should worship the maiden in the corners of the maṇḍala, beginning with the north-east.

sanskrit_iast:
yoraṭaṃ ḍāmaraṃ caiva lohajaṅghaṃ tathaiva ca |
bhūtanāthaṃ kṣetrapālamīśānādau prapūjayet || 100 ||
meaning:
योरटं डामरं चैव लोहजङ्घं तथैव च |
भूतनाथं क्षेत्रपालमीशानादौ प्रपूजयेत् || 100 ||
text_mt:
Yoraṭa, Ḍāmara, and likewise Lohajaṅgha,
and Bhūtanātha, the guardian of the field, he should worship beginning with the north-east.

sanskrit_iast:
maṇḍalasya ca madhye tu pañcabāṇān prapūjayet |
drāvaṇaṃ śoṣaṇaṃ caiva bandhanaṃ mohanaṃ tathā || 101 ||
meaning:
मण्डलस्य च मध्ये तु पञ्चबाणान् प्रपूजयेत् |
द्रावणं शोषणं चैव बन्धनं मोहनं तथा || 101 ||
text_mt:
In the middle of the maṇḍala, he should worship the five arrows:
Drāvaṇa, Śoṣaṇa, and Bandhana, Mohana,

sanskrit_iast:
ākarṣaṇaṃ ca madhyena mantreṇaiva prapūjayet |
tatastriṣvatha koṇeṣu pūjayet tu triyoginīḥ || 102 ||
meaning:
आकर्षणं च मध्येन मन्त्रेणैव प्रपूजयेत् |
ततस्त्रिष्वथ कोणेषु पूजयेत् तु त्रियोगिनीः || 102 ||
text_mt:
and Ākarṣaṇa: he should worship them with the central mantra;
then in the three corners, he should worship the three yoginīs.

sanskrit_iast:
bhagaṃ ca bhagajihvāṃ ca bhagāsyāmuttarādikam |
kramāttu pūjyāstisro'nyā anyā madhye trikoṇake || 103 ||
meaning:
भगं च भगजिह्वां च भगास्यामुत्तरादिकम् |
क्रमात्तु पूज्यास्तिस्रोऽन्या अन्या मध्ये त्रिकोणके || 103 ||
text_mt: Bhagā, Bhagajihvā, and Bhagāsyā, beginning with the north, / should be worshipped in sequence; three others [should be worshipped] in the central triangle:

sanskrit_iast:
bhāgamālinīṃ tu prathame dvitīye tu bhagodarīm |
tṛtīye bhagarohāṃ tu yoginīṃ kāmarūpiṇīm || 104 ||
meaning:
भागमालिनीं तु प्रथमे द्वितीये तु भगोदरीम् |
तृतीये भगरोहां तु योगिनीं कामरूपिणीम् || 104 ||
text_mt: Bhagamālinī in the first, Bhagodarī in the second, / and in the third, Bhagarohā, the yoginī who assumes any form at will;

sanskrit_iast:
anaṅgakusumāṃ devīṃ tathaivānaṅgamekhalām |
anaṅgamadanāṃ caiva hyanaṅgamadanāturām || 105 ||
meaning:
अनङ्गकुसुमां देवीं तथैवानङ्गमेखलाम् |
अनङ्गमदनां चैव ह्यनङ्गमदनातुराम् || 105 ||
text_mt: the goddess Anaṅgakusumā, and likewise Anaṅgamekhalā, / Anaṅgamadanā, and Anaṅgamadanāturā,

sanskrit_iast:
anaṅgaveśāṃ cānaṅgamālinīṃ madanāturām |
dalakeśaramadhye tu hyaṣṭamīṃ madanāṅgakuśām || 106 ||
meaning:
अनङ्गवेशां चानङ्गमालिनीं मदनातुराम् |
दलकेशरमध्ये तु ह्यष्टमीं मदनाङ्गकुशाम् || 106 ||
text_mt: Anaṅgaveśā, Anaṅgamālinī, and Madanāturā, / and as the eighth, Madanāṅkuśā, in the middle of the petals and filaments.

sanskrit_iast:
śailaputryādayaścāṣṭau tripurāpūjanakrame |
etannāmabhiravyagrā babhūvuḥ kāmayoginīḥ || 107 ||
meaning:
शैलपुत्र्यादयश्चाष्टौ त्रिपुरापूजनक्रमे |
एतन्नामभिरव्यग्रा बभूवुः कामयोगिनीः || 107 ||
text_mt: In the rite of worshipping Tripurā, the eight goddesses beginning with Śailaputrī / calmly became these kāmayoginīs under these names.

sanskrit_iast:
vāgbhavena tathā durgāṃ netrabījāntakena tu |
aṅganyāsaṃ samantraistu ṣaḍbhiraṣṭāvimān punaḥ || 108 ||
meaning:
वाग्भवेन तथा दुर्गां नेत्रबीजान्तकेन तु |
अङ्गन्यासं समन्त्रैस्तु षड्भिरष्टाविमान् पुनः || 108 ||
text_mt: Likewise, [one should worship] Durgā with the vāgbhava-[bīja] ending with the eye-bīja. / One should perform the placing of the limbs (aṅganyāsa) with the six mantras, and then these eight

sanskrit_iast:
pūjayet kṣetrapālāṃstu mavye kiñjalkapatrayoḥ |
hetukaṃ vipuraghnaṃ ca agnijihvaṃ tathaiva ca || 109 ||
meaning:
पूजयेत् क्षेत्रपालांस्तु मव्ये किञ्जल्कपत्रयोः |
हेतुकं विपुरघ्नं च अग्निजिह्वं तथैव च || 109 ||
text_mt: Kṣetrapālas one should worship between the filaments and the petals: / Hetuka, Tripuraghna, and likewise Agnijihva,

sanskrit_iast:
agnivetālasaṃjñaṃ ca kālaṃ cātha karālakam |
ekapādaṃ bhīmanāthamuttarādikrameṇa tu || 110 ||
meaning:
अग्निवेतालसंज्ञं च कालं चाथ करालकम् |
एकपादं भीमनाथमुत्तरादिक्रमेण तु || 110 ||
text_mt: the one named Agnivetāla, Kāla, and Karālaka, / Ekapāda, and Bhīmanātha, in order beginning with the north.

sanskrit_iast:
ebhirevāṣṭabhirmantraiḥ kāmarājena saṃyutaiḥ |
navaitānasitāṅgādīn nāyakān pūjayet kramāt || 111 ||
meaning:
एभिरेवाष्टभिर्मन्त्रैः कामराजेन संयुतैः |
नवैतानसिताङ्गादीन् नायकान् पूजयेत् क्रमात् || 111 ||
text_mt: With these eight mantras joined with the kāmarāja-[bīja], / one should worship in order these nine leaders (nāyaka) beginning with Asitāṅga:

sanskrit_iast:
maṇḍalasya caturdikṣu dvau dvau pūrvādiṣu kramāt |
padmamaṇḍalayormadhye śeṣamekaṃ tu pūjayet || 112 ||
meaning:
मण्डलस्य चतुर्दिक्षु द्वौ द्वौ पूर्वादिषु क्रमात् |
पद्ममण्डलयोर्मध्ये शेषमेकं तु पूजयेत् || 112 ||
text_mt: two in each of the four directions of the maṇḍala, beginning with the east, in order; / and one should worship the remaining one between the lotus and the maṇḍala:

sanskrit_iast:
asitāṅgī ruruścaṇḍaḥ krodhonmattau bhayaṅkaraḥ |
kapālī bhīṣaṇaścaiva aṃhāraśceti vai nava || 113 ||
meaning:
असिताङ्गी रुरुश्चण्डः क्रोधोन्मत्तौ भयङ्करः |
कपाली भीषणश्चैव अंहारश्चेति वै नव || 113 ||
text_mt: Asitāṅga, Ruru, Caṇḍa, Krodha, Unmatta, Bhayaṅkara, / Kapālin, Bhīṣaṇa, and Saṃhāra—these are the nine.

sanskrit_iast:
aiśānyādikramād dve dve nāyikāṃ pūjayennaraḥ |
padmamaṇḍalayormadhye agnau dve ca prapūjayet || 114 ||
meaning:
ऐशान्यादिक्रमाद् द्वे द्वे नायिकां पूजयेन्नरः |
पद्ममण्डलयोर्मध्ये अग्नौ द्वे च प्रपूजयेत् || 114 ||
text_mt: A man should worship two nāyikās [in each direction] in order beginning with the northeast; / and between the lotus and the maṇḍala, in the southeast, he should worship two:

sanskrit_iast:
brahmāṇīṃ bhairavīṃ caiva tathā māheśvarīmapi |
kaumārīṃ vaiṣṇavīṃ caiva nārasiṃhīṃ tathaiva ca || 115 ||
meaning:
ब्रह्माणीं भैरवीं चैव तथा माहेश्वरीमपि |
कौमारीं वैष्णवीं चैव नारसिंहीं तथैव च || 115 ||
text_mt: Brahmāṇī and Bhairavī, and likewise Māheśvarī, / Kaumārī, Vaiṣṇavī, and likewise Nārasiṃhī,

sanskrit_iast:
vārāhīṃ ca tathendrāṇīṃ cāmuṇḍāṃ caṇḍikāṃ tathā |
ādhāraśaktiprabhṛtīn maṇḍalasya tu madhyataḥ || 116 ||
meaning:
वाराहीं च तथेन्द्राणीं चामुण्डां चण्डिकां तथा |
आधारशक्तिप्रभृतीन् मण्डलस्य तु मध्यतः || 116 ||
text_mt: Vārāhī, and then Indrāṇī, Cāmuṇḍā, and Caṇḍikā; / and in the center of the maṇḍala, [the deities] beginning with Ādhāraśakti.

sanskrit_iast:
vaiṣṇavī tantrakalpoktān sarvān bhairava pūjayet |
śivasya pañca yāḥ proktāḥ sadyojātādayaḥ purā || 117 ||
meaning:
वैष्णवी तन्त्रकल्पोक्तान् सर्वान् भैरव पूजयेत् |
शिवस्य पञ्च याः प्रोक्ताः सद्योजातादयः पुरा || 117 ||
text_mt: O Bhairava, one should worship all those declared in the ritual manual of the Vaiṣṇavī-tantra. / Those five forms of Śiva that were proclaimed of old, beginning with Sadyojāta,

sanskrit_iast:
mūrtayastāḥ padmamadhye pañcapretatvamāgatāḥ |
tāḥ pañca pūjayenmadhye raktapadmaṃ śavaṃ tathā || 118 ||
meaning:
मूर्तयस्ताः पद्ममध्ये पञ्चप्रेतत्वमागताः |
ताः पञ्च पूजयेन्मध्ये रक्तपद्मं शवं तथा || 118 ||
text_mt: have attained the state of the five corpses (pañcapreta) in the middle of the lotus. / In the middle, one should worship those five, the red lotus, and the corpse.

sanskrit_iast:
siṃhaṃ ca pūjayet tatra jagadādhārasaṃjñitam |
jayantīṃ maṅgalāṃ kālīṃ bhadrakālīṃ kapālinīm || 119 ||
meaning:
सिंहं च पूजयेत् तत्र जगदाधारसंज्ञितम् |
जयन्तीं मङ्गलां कालीं भद्रकालीं कपालिनीम् || 119 ||
text_mt: And there one should worship the lion named the support of the world. / One should worship Jayantī, Maṅgalā, Kālī, Bhadrakālī, Kapālinī,

sanskrit_iast: durgāṃ kṣamāṃ śivāṃ dhātrīṃ svadhāṃ svāhāṃ ca pūjayet |
meaning: दुर्गां क्षमां शिवां धात्रीं स्वधां स्वाहां च पूजयेत् |
text_mt: Durgā, Kṣamā, Śivā, Dhātrī, Svadhā, and Svāhā.

sanskrit_iast: ugracaṇḍā pracaṇḍā caṇḍogrā caṇḍanāyikā || 120 ||
meaning: उग्रचण्डा प्रचण्डा चण्डोग्रा चण्डनायिका || 120 ||
text_mt: Ugracaṇḍā, Pracaṇḍā, Caṇḍogrā, Caṇḍanāyikā,

sanskrit_iast:
caṇḍā caṇḍavatī caiva aṇḍarūpāticaṇḍikā |
etāḥ sampūjayenmadhye maṇḍalasya viśeṣataḥ || 121 ||
meaning:
चण्डा चण्डवती चैव अण्डरूपातिचण्डिका |
एताः सम्पूजयेन्मध्ये मण्डलस्य विशेषतः || 121 ||
text_mt: Caṇḍā, Caṇḍavatī, Caṇḍarūpā, and Aticaṇḍikā— / these one should worship especially in the middle of the maṇḍala.

sanskrit_iast:
ādityādīn grahān sarvān rūpato hyastrasaṃyutān |
kramāt pratyekamuddiśya pārśve pārśve prapūjayet || 122 ||
meaning:
आदित्यादीन् ग्रहान् सर्वान् रूपतो ह्यस्त्रसंयुतान् |
क्रमात् प्रत्येकमुद्दिश्य पार्श्वे पार्श्वे प्रपूजयेत् || 122 ||
text_mt: All the planets beginning with the Sun, according to their forms and equipped with their weapons, / one should worship on each side, addressing each one in sequence;

sanskrit_iast:
dikpālānāṃ tu mantreṇa tathā sarvāṃstu dikpatīn |
astramantraistu tān sarvāṃsteṣāṃ mantrāṇi bhairava || 123 ||
meaning:
दिक्पालानां तु मन्त्रेण तथा सर्वांस्तु दिक्पतीन् |
अस्त्रमन्त्रैस्तु तान् सर्वांस्तेषां मन्त्राणि भैरव || 123 ||
text_mt: and all the guardians of the directions with the mantra of the guardians of the directions, / and all of them with the weapon-mantras. Their mantras, O Bhairava—

sanskrit_iast:
nāthaṃ kāmeśvaraṃ tatra ekavatraṃ caturbhujam |
bhasmaśvetaṃ madhyahṛdi raktapuṣpaistu kuṅkumaiḥ || 124 ||
meaning:
नाथं कामेश्वरं तत्र एकवत्रं चतुर्भुजम् |
भस्मश्वेतं मध्यहृदि रक्तपुष्पैस्तु कुङ्कुमैः || 124 ||
text_mt: There [one should worship] Lord Kāmeśvara, single-faced and four-armed, / white with ashes, in the center of the heart, with red flowers and saffron,

sanskrit_iast:
triśūlaṃ ca pinākaṃ ca vāmahastadvaye sthitam |
utpalaṃ bījapūraṃ ca dakṣiṇadvitaye tathā || 125 ||
meaning:
त्रिशूलं च पिनाकं च वामहस्तद्वये स्थितम् |
उत्पलं बीजपूरं च दक्षिणद्वितये तथा || 125 ||
text_mt: holding a trident and the Pināka bow in his two left hands, / and a blue lotus and a citron in his two right hands.

sanskrit_iast:
śvetapadmoparisthaṃ ca dhyātvā madhye prapūjayet |
kāmākhyāṃ mūrtito dhyātvā kāmākhyāmapi pūjayet || 126 ||
meaning:
श्वेतपद्मोपरिस्थं च ध्यात्वा मध्ये प्रपूजयेत् |
कामाख्यां मूर्तितो ध्यात्वा कामाख्यामपि पूजयेत् || 126 ||
text_mt: Having meditated upon him seated upon a white lotus, one should worship him in the middle. / Having meditated upon Kāmākhyā in her bodily form, one should also worship Kāmākhyā.

sanskrit_iast:
kāmeśvarīṃ tatra devīṃ pūjayet parameśvarīm |
vakṣyamāṇena rūpeṇa tatra vetālabhairavī || 127 ||
meaning:
कामेश्वरीं तत्र देवीं पूजयेत् परमेश्वरीम् |
वक्ष्यमाणेन रूपेण तत्र वेतालभैरवी || 127 ||
text_mt: There one should worship the goddess Kāmeśvarī, the supreme mistress, / in the form that will be described. There, Vetāla and Bhairava,

sanskrit_iast:
karālaṃ kṣetrapālaṃ ca kartrikharparadhāriṇam |
pūjayedīśamatyarthaṃ daṃṣtrābhinnādharaṃ bhayam || 128 ||
meaning:
करालं क्षेत्रपालं च कर्त्रिखर्परधारिणम् |
पूजयेदीशमत्यर्थं दंष्त्राभिन्नाधरं भयम् || 128 ||
text_mt: and the fierce Kṣetrapāla, holding a chopper and a skull-bowl, / one should worship the lord intensely, his lower lip split by fangs, terrifying.

sanskrit_iast:
tintiḍīṃ kalpavṛkṣaṃ ca succhāyaṃ ratnabhūṣitam |
trikūṭaṃ kṛṣṇavarṇaṃ ca nīlaśailaṃ mahādyutim || 129 ||
meaning:
तिन्तिडीं कल्पवृक्षं च सुच्छायं रत्नभूषितम् |
त्रिकूटं कृष्णवर्णं च नीलशैलं महाद्युतिम् || 129 ||
text_mt: The tamarind tree (tintiḍī), the wish-granting tree offering good shade and adorned with gems, / and the three-peaked, black-hued, greatly lustrous Blue Mountain (Nīlaśaila);

sanskrit_iast:
manobhavāṃ guhāṃ tatra pañcavyāmāyatāṃ śubhām |
ratnamaṇḍalasaṃyuktāṃ raktavarṇāṃ suvartulām || 130 ||
meaning:
मनोभवां गुहां तत्र पञ्चव्यामायतां शुभाम् |
रत्नमण्डलसंयुक्तां रक्तवर्णां सुवर्तुलाम् || 130 ||
text_mt: there, the auspicious cave Manobhavā, five fathoms long, / endowed with a circle of gems, red-colored, and perfectly circular;

sanskrit_iast:
aparājitāṃ ca vallīṃ ca vyāmatrayasuvistṛtām |
āraktavarṇāṃ satataṃ kusumairūpaśobhitām || 131 ||
meaning:
अपराजितां च वल्लीं च व्यामत्रयसुविस्तृताम् |
आरक्तवर्णां सततं कुसुमैरूपशोभिताम् || 131 ||
text_mt: and the Aparājitā creeper, three fathoms wide, / reddish in color and constantly beautified with flowers.

sanskrit_iast:
baṭukaṃ kambalākhyaṃ tu svarṇagauraṃ gajāsanam |
dvibhujaṃ dakṣiṇe daṇḍapāṇiṃ vāme kapālakam || 132 ||
meaning:
बटुकं कम्बलाख्यं तु स्वर्णगौरं गजासनम् |
द्विभुजं दक्षिणे दण्डपाणिं वामे कपालकम् || 132 ||
text_mt: The youth (baṭuka) named Kambala, fair as gold, seated upon an elephant, / two-armed, with a staff in his right hand and a skull-bowl in his left,

sanskrit_iast:
bibhrataṃ purato devyāḥ pūjyo vighnavipattaye |
bhairavaḥ pāṇḍunāthaśca raktagauścaturbhujaḥ || 133 ||
meaning:
बिभ्रतं पुरतो देव्याः पूज्यो विघ्नविपत्तये |
भैरवः पाण्डुनाथश्च रक्तगौश्चतुर्भुजः || 133 ||
text_mt: bearing [these] before the goddess, is to be worshipped for the destruction of obstacles. / And the Bhairava Pāṇḍunātha, red-fair and four-armed,

sanskrit_iast:
gadāṃ padmaṃ ca śaktiṃ ca cakraṃ cāpi kareṣu ca |
bibhrad devyāḥ purobhāge pūjyo'yaṃ viṣṇurūpadhṛk || 134 ||
meaning:
गदां पद्मं च शक्तिं च चक्रं चापि करेषु च |
बिभ्रद् देव्याः पुरोभागे पूज्योऽयं विष्णुरूपधृक् || 134 ||
text_mt: bearing a mace, a lotus, a spear, and a discus in his hands, / is to be worshipped in front of the goddess, bearing the form of Viṣṇu.

sanskrit_iast:
śmaśānaṃ herukākhyaṃ ca raktavarṇaṃ bhayaṅkaram |
asicarmadharaṃ raudraṃ bhuñjānaṃ manujāmiṣam || 135 ||
meaning:
श्मशानं हेरुकाख्यं च रक्तवर्णं भयङ्करम् |
असिचर्मधरं रौद्रं भुञ्जानं मनुजामिषम् || 135 ||
text_mt: The cremation ground named Heruka, red-colored and terrifying, / wielding a sword and shield, ferocious, eating human flesh,

sanskrit_iast:
tisṛbhirmuṇḍamālābhirgaladraktābhirājitam |
agninirdagdhavigaladdantapretoparisthitam || 136 ||
meaning:
तिसृभिर्मुण्डमालाभिर्गलद्रक्ताभिराजितम् |
अग्निनिर्दग्धविगलद्दन्तप्रेतोपरिस्थितम् || 136 ||
text_mt: adorned with three garlands of severed heads dripping with blood, / standing upon a corpse whose teeth are falling out, scorched by fire,

sanskrit_iast:
pūjayeccintanenaiva śatrasvāhanabhūṣaṇam |
mahotsāhāṃ yoginīṃ tu mahāmāyāsvarūpiṇīm || 137 ||
meaning:
पूजयेच्चिन्तनेनैव शत्रस्वाहनभूषणम् |
महोत्साहां योगिनीं तु महामायास्वरूपिणीम् || 137 ||
text_mt: one should worship through meditation alone, along with his weapons, mount, and ornaments; / and the yoginī of great energy, whose nature is Mahāmāyā,

sanskrit_iast:
dhyānato rūpatastāṃ tu devyā agre prapūjayet |
purīṃ candravatīṃ devyā nīlaparvatapūrvataḥ || 138 ||
meaning:
ध्यानतो रूपतस्तां तु देव्या अग्रे प्रपूजयेत् |
पुरीं चन्द्रवतीं देव्या नीलपर्वतपूर्वतः || 138 ||
text_mt: one should worship before the goddess through meditation according to her form. / The goddess's city, Candravatī, to the east of the Blue Mountain,

sanskrit_iast:
yojanadvayavistīrṇāmardhayojanamāyatām |
uccairanekaprāsāda saudhasadmavibhūṣitām || 139 ||
meaning:
योजनद्वयविस्तीर्णामर्धयोजनमायताम् |
उच्चैरनेकप्रासाद सौधसद्मविभूषिताम् || 139 ||
text_mt: two yojanas wide and half a yojana long, / adorned with many lofty palaces and mansions,

sanskrit_iast:
maṇiratnasuvarṇaughajātaprāsādavistṛtām |
krīḍāsarovaraiḥ sadbhiḥ sañchannāṃ vikacaiḥ kacaiḥ || 140 ||
meaning:
मणिरत्नसुवर्णौघजातप्रासादविस्तृताम् |
क्रीडासरोवरैः सद्भिः सञ्छन्नां विकचैः कचैः || 140 ||
text_mt: spread with palaces made of heaps of jewels, gems, and gold, / covered with pleasant pleasure-lakes with blooming [water-lilies],

sanskrit_iast:
saṃyutāṃ pūjayet tatra devyā agre samantrakam |
lauhityaṃ raktagaurāṅgaṃ nīlavastravibhūṣitam || 141 ||
meaning:
संयुतां पूजयेत् तत्र देव्या अग्रे समन्त्रकम् |
लौहित्यं रक्तगौराङ्गं नीलवस्त्रविभूषितम् || 141 ||
text_mt: endowed [with these], one should worship there before the goddess with mantras. / Lauhitya, whose body is red and fair, adorned with blue garments,

sanskrit_iast:
ratnamālāsamāyuktaṃ caturbāhusamanvitam |
pustakaṃ śvetapadmaṃ ca bibhrataṃ dakṣiṇe kare || 142 ||
meaning:
रत्नमालासमायुक्तं चतुर्बाहुसमन्वितम् |
पुस्तकं श्वेतपद्मं च बिभ्रतं दक्षिणे करे || 142 ||
text_mt: adorned with a garland of gems, endowed with four arms, / holding a book and a white lotus in his right hands,

sanskrit_iast:
vāme śaktidhvajaṃ caiva śiśumārasthitaṃ śubham |
pīṭheśvarānimān madhye mantreretaiḥ prapūjayet || 143 ||
meaning:
वामे शक्तिध्वजं चैव शिशुमारस्थितं शुभम् |
पीठेश्वरानिमान् मध्ये मन्त्रेरेतैः प्रपूजयेत् || 143 ||
text_mt: and in his left a spear and a banner, seated upon an auspicious dolphin (śiśumāra)— / one should worship these lords of the sacred seat (pīṭheśvara) in the middle with these mantras.

sanskrit_iast:
nātha kāmeśvaraṃ devaṃ prāsādena prapūjayet |
kāmeśvaryāstu mantreṇa yajet kāmeśvarī śubhām || 144 ||
meaning:
नाथ कामेश्वरं देवं प्रासादेन प्रपूजयेत् |
कामेश्वर्यास्तु मन्त्रेण यजेत् कामेश्वरी शुभाम् || 144 ||
text_mt: One should worship the god Lord Kāmeśvara with the prāsāda-[mantra]; / with the mantra of Kāmeśvarī, one should worship auspicious Kāmeśvarī.

sanskrit_iast:
dvāvupāntau balenaiva madanānte ca tatkramāt |
yojayennādabindubhyāṃ āyākaraṇamantrakam || 145 ||
meaning:
द्वावुपान्तौ बलेनैव मदनान्ते च तत्क्रमात् |
योजयेन्नादबिन्दुभ्यां आयाकरणमन्त्रकम् || 145 ||
text_mt: By means of [the letter] ba, one should join the two penultimate [vowels] after the madana-[bīja] in that order / with nāda and bindu; [this is] the mantra for summoning.

sanskrit_iast:
caṇḍikānetrabījasya yaccheṣamakṣaraṃ tu tat |
kalpaṃ tintiḍikāvṛkṣamantrametat prakīrtitam || 146 ||
meaning:
चण्डिकानेत्रबीजस्य यच्छेषमक्षरं तु तत् |
कल्पं तिन्तिडिकावृक्षमन्त्रमेतत् प्रकीर्तितम् || 146 ||
text_mt: That which is the remaining syllable of Caṇḍikā's eye-bīja / is proclaimed as the ritual mantra for the tamarind tree.

sanskrit_iast:
ugrāyā madhyabījaṃ tu nīlaśailasya mantrakam |
manobhavasya bījaṃ tu mahādevena saṃhitam || 147 ||
meaning:
उग्राया मध्यबीजं तु नीलशैलस्य मन्त्रकम् |
मनोभवस्य बीजं तु महादेवेन संहितम् || 147 ||
text_mt: The middle seed-syllable of Ugrā is the mantra of Nīlaśaila. / But the seed-syllable of Manobhava is joined with Mahādeva.

sanskrit_iast:
adisthenendunā binduyuktaṃ vāntena yojitam |
manobhavaguhāyāṃ tu mantrametat prakīrtitam || 148 ||
meaning:
अदिस्थेनेन्दुना बिन्दुयुक्तं वान्तेन योजितम् |
मनोभवगुहायां तु मन्त्रमेतत् प्रकीर्तितम् || 148 ||
text_mt: Endowed with the moon situated on the first, joined with a bindu, and attached to the end of "va"— / this is proclaimed as the mantra in the cave of Manobhava.

sanskrit_iast:
vaiṣṇavītantramantrasya yaccheṣaṃ bījamasvaram |
tadadho vāntasaṃśliṣṭaṃ caturthasvarasaṃyutam || 149 ||
meaning:
वैष्णवीतन्त्रमन्त्रस्य यच्छेषं बीजमस्वरम् |
तदधो वान्तसंश्लिष्टं चतुर्थस्वरसंयुतम् || 149 ||
text_mt: The remaining vowel-less seed-syllable of the Vaiṣṇavī-tantra-mantra, / joined below it with "va", and endowed with the fourth vowel,

sanskrit_iast:
candrabindusamāyuktaṃ tanmantrañcāparājitam |
hayagrīvasvarūpasya viṣṇoryadbījamuttamam || 150 ||
meaning:
चन्द्रबिन्दुसमायुक्तं तन्मन्त्रञ्चापराजितम् |
हयग्रीवस्वरूपस्य विष्णोर्यद्बीजमुत्तमम् || 150 ||
text_mt: equipped with the candrabindu, is the mantra of Aparājitā. / The supreme seed-syllable of Viṣṇu who has the form of Hayagrīva,

sanskrit_iast:
kambalasya tu tanmantraṃ pūjanaṃ parikīrtitam |
kevalaḥ saprarohādiṣaṣṭhasvarasamanvitaḥ || 151 ||
meaning:
कम्बलस्य तु तन्मन्त्रं पूजनं परिकीर्तितम् |
केवलः सप्ररोहादिषष्ठस्वरसमन्वितः || 151 ||
text_mt: is proclaimed as that mantra for the worship of Kambala. / The simple [consonant] alone, beginning with the sprout, endowed with the sixth vowel,

sanskrit_iast:
candrabindusamāyuktaṃ hayagrīvasya bījakam |
bhairavaṃ pāṇḍunāthaṃ ca vanamālisvarūpiṇam || 152 ||
meaning:
चन्द्रबिन्दुसमायुक्तं हयग्रीवस्य बीजकम् |
भैरवं पाण्डुनाथं च वनमालिस्वरूपिणम् || 152 ||
text_mt: and equipped with the candrabindu, is the seed-syllable of Hayagrīva. / One should worship Bhairava, Pāṇḍunātha, and he who has the form of Vanamālin,

sanskrit_iast:
vārāheṇa tu bījena pūjayet tu vidhānataḥ |
saparau dvāvanusvāravisargābhyāṃ tu saṃyutau || 153 ||
meaning:
वाराहेण तु बीजेन पूजयेत् तु विधानतः |
सपरौ द्वावनुस्वारविसर्गाभ्यां तु संयुतौ || 153 ||
text_mt: according to the rules, using the Vārāha seed-syllable. / Two [letters] having "pa" and "ra", endowed with an anusvāra and a visarga,

sanskrit_iast:
mahābhairavamantreṇa bhairavāntena pūjayet |
mahotsāhāṃ mahāmāyāṃ dvitīyāṣṭākṣareṇa tu || 154 ||
meaning:
महाभैरवमन्त्रेण भैरवान्तेन पूजयेत् |
महोत्साहां महामायां द्वितीयाष्टाक्षरेण तु || 154 ||
text_mt: one should worship with the Mahābhairava mantra ending in "bhairava". / [One should worship] the highly energetic Mahāmāyā with the second eight-syllabled [mantra],

sanskrit_iast:
devītantroditenaiva pūjayed bhūtivṛddhaye |
ādyākṣaraṃ tu sāmīndubindubhyāṃ samalaṅkṛtam || 155 ||
meaning:
देवीतन्त्रोदितेनैव पूजयेद् भूतिवृद्धये |
आद्याक्षरं तु सामीन्दुबिन्दुभ्यां समलङ्कृतम् || 155 ||
text_mt: taught in the Devītantra, for the increase of prosperity. / The first syllable adorned with the half-moon and the bindu

sanskrit_iast:
svanāmnaścandravatyāstu pūjāmantraṃ prakīrtitam |
sarvalakṣaṇasampūrṇaṃ sarvālaṅkārabhūṣitam || 156 ||
meaning:
स्वनाम्नश्चन्द्रवत्यास्तु पूजामन्त्रं प्रकीर्तितम् |
सर्वलक्षणसम्पूर्णं सर्वालङ्कारभूषितम् || 156 ||
text_mt: from her own name is proclaimed as the worship mantra of Candravatī. / Endowed with all auspicious marks, adorned with all ornaments,

sanskrit_iast:
lauhityanadarājasya brahmaputrasya bhūtidam |
brahmabījaṃ tu manmatraṃ vahnibhāryāntamiṣyate || 157 ||
meaning:
लौहित्यनदराजस्य ब्रह्मपुत्रस्य भूतिदम् |
ब्रह्मबीजं तु मन्मत्रं वह्निभार्यान्तमिष्यते || 157 ||
text_mt: bestowing prosperity upon the Lauhitya, king of rivers, the son of Brahmā; / the seed-syllable of Brahmā is desired as the mantra ending with the wife of Agni [Svāhā].

sanskrit_iast:
dvitīyaṃ tripurārūpaṃ tathaiva tu tṛtīyakam |
āvāhanārthaṃ devyāstu cintayed yonimudrayā || 158 ||
meaning:
द्वितीयं त्रिपुरारूपं तथैव तु तृतीयकम् |
आवाहनार्थं देव्यास्तु चिन्तयेद् योनिमुद्रया || 158 ||
text_mt: The second form is Tripura, and likewise the third. / For the invocation of the goddess, one should meditate [on her] with the yoni-mudrā:

sanskrit_iast:
bandhūkapuṣpasaṅkāśāṃ jaṭājūṭendumaṇḍitām |
sarvalakṣaṇasampūrṇāṃ sarvālaṅkārabhūṣitām || 159 ||
meaning:
बन्धूकपुष्पसङ्काशां जटाजूटेन्दुमण्डिताम् |
सर्वलक्षणसम्पूर्णां सर्वालङ्कारभूषिताम् || 159 ||
text_mt: Resembling the bandhūka flower, adorned with matted locks and the moon, / endowed with all auspicious marks, adorned with all ornaments,

sanskrit_iast:
udyadraviprabhāṃ admaparyaṅkeṣu susaṃsthitām |
muktāratnāvalīyuktāṃ pīnonnatapayodharām || 160 ||
meaning:
उद्यद्रविप्रभां अद्मपर्यङ्केषु सुसंस्थिताम् |
मुक्तारत्नावलीयुक्तां पीनोन्नतपयोधराम् || 160 ||
text_mt: having the radiance of the rising sun, well-seated upon a lotus couch, / endowed with a garland of pearls and gems, having full and high breasts,

sanskrit_iast:
valivibhaṅgacaturāmāsavāmodamoditām |
netrāhlādakarīṃ śubhrāṃ kṣomaṇīṃ jagatāṃ tathā || 161 ||
meaning:
वलिविभङ्गचतुरामासवामोदमोदिताम् |
नेत्राह्लादकरीं शुभ्रां क्षोमणीं जगतां तथा || 161 ||
text_mt: charming with the three folds of the belly, gladdened by the fragrance of wine, / gladdening the eyes, radiant, and causing the worlds to tremble,

sanskrit_iast:
trinetrāṃ yonimudrāyāmīṣaddhāsasamāyutām |
navayauvanasampannāṃ ṛṇālābhacaturbhujām || 162 ||
meaning:
त्रिनेत्रां योनिमुद्रायामीषद्धाससमायुताम् |
नवयौवनसम्पन्नां ऋणालाभचतुर्भुजाम् || 162 ||
text_mt: having three eyes, in the yoni-mudrā, endowed with a gentle smile, / endowed with fresh youth, having four arms resembling lotus stalks;

sanskrit_iast:
vāmārdhe pustakaṃ dhatte akṣamālāṃ tu dakṣiṇe |
vāmenābhayadāṃ devīṃ dakṣiṇārdhe varapradām || 163 ||
meaning:
वामार्धे पुस्तकं धत्ते अक्षमालां तु दक्षिणे |
वामेनाभयदां देवीं दक्षिणार्धे वरप्रदाम् || 163 ||
text_mt: on the left side she holds a book, and on the right a rosary; / on the left the goddess grants fearlessness, and on the right she bestows boons;

sanskrit_iast:
sravadraktaughasūryābhāṃ śiromālāṃ tu bibhratīm |
āpādalambinīṃ kalpadrumamāsādya saṃsthitām || 164 ||
meaning:
स्रवद्रक्तौघसूर्याभां शिरोमालां तु बिभ्रतीम् |
आपादलम्बिनीं कल्पद्रुममासाद्य संस्थिताम् || 164 ||
text_mt: wearing a garland of severed heads that shines like the sun with streams of flowing blood, / hanging down to her feet, seated having reached the wish-fulfilling tree,

sanskrit_iast:
kadambopavanāntasthāṃ kāmāhlādakarīṃ śubhām |
dvitīyāṃ tripurāṃ dhyāyedevaṃrūpāṃ manoharām || 165 ||
meaning:
कदम्बोपवनान्तस्थां कामाह्लादकरीं शुभाम् |
द्वितीयां त्रिपुरां ध्यायेदेवंरूपां मनोहराम् || 165 ||
text_mt: standing within a grove of kadamba trees, gladdening desire, auspicious— / one should thus meditate upon the enchanting second Tripura.

sanskrit_iast:
tṛtīyaṃ tripurārūpaṃ śṛṇu vetālabhairava |
javākusumasaṅkāśāṃ muktakeśīṃ śubhānanām || 166 ||
meaning:
तृतीयं त्रिपुरारूपं शृणु वेतालभैरव |
जवाकुसुमसङ्काशां मुक्तकेशीं शुभाननाम् || 166 ||
text_mt: Listen, O Vetālabhairava, to the third form of Tripura: / Resembling the hibiscus flower, with disheveled hair, of auspicious face,

sanskrit_iast:
sadāśivaṃ hasantaṃ tu pretavad vinidhāya vai |
hṛdaye tasya devasya hyarddhapadmāsanasthitām || 167 ||
meaning:
सदाशिवं हसन्तं तु प्रेतवद् विनिधाय वै |
हृदये तस्य देवस्य ह्यर्द्धपद्मासनस्थिताम् || 167 ||
text_mt: having placed the smiling Sadāśiva like a corpse, / seated in the half-lotus posture upon the heart of that god,

sanskrit_iast:
raktotpalairmiśritāṃ tu muṇḍamālāṃ padānugām |
grīvāyāṃ dhārayantīṃ tu pīnonnatapayodharām || 168 ||
meaning:
रक्तोत्पलैर्मिश्रितां तु मुण्डमालां पदानुगाम् |
ग्रीवायां धारयन्तीं तु पीनोन्नतपयोधराम् || 168 ||
text_mt: wearing on her neck a garland of severed heads reaching down to her feet, mixed with red lotuses, / having full and high breasts,

sanskrit_iast:
caturbhujāṃ tathā nagnāṃ dakṣiṇārdhe'kṣamālinīm |
varadāṃ tadadho vāme jaganmāyāṃ tathābhayām || 169 ||
meaning:
चतुर्भुजां तथा नग्नां दक्षिणार्धेऽक्षमालिनीम् |
वरदां तदधो वामे जगन्मायां तथाभयाम् || 169 ||
text_mt: four-armed and naked, holding a rosary in the [upper] right side, / granting boons below that, and on the left the Māyā of the universe bestowing fearlessness,

sanskrit_iast:
adhastu pustakaṃ dhatte trinetrāṃ hasitānanām |
sravadrudhirabhogārtāṃ tathā sarvāṅgasundarīm || 170 ||
meaning:
अधस्तु पुस्तकं धत्ते त्रिनेत्रां हसिताननाम् |
स्रवद्रुधिरभोगार्तां तथा सर्वाङ्गसुन्दरीम् || 170 ||
text_mt: and below she holds a book, three-eyed, with a smiling face, / eager for the enjoyment of flowing blood, and beautiful in all her limbs—

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃvidhaṃ tṛtīyaṃ tu rūpaṃ dhyāyet tu pūjakaḥ |
ādyaṃ tu vāgbhavaṃ rūpaṃ dvitīyaṃ kāmarājakam || 171 ||
meaning:
एवंविधं तृतीयं तु रूपं ध्यायेत् तु पूजकः |
आद्यं तु वाग्भवं रूपं द्वितीयं कामराजकम् || 171 ||
text_mt: the worshipper should meditate upon such a third form. / The first is the Vāgbhava form, the second is Kāmarāja,

sanskrit_iast:
ḍāmaraṃ mohanaṃ cāpi tṛtīyaṃ parikīrtitam |
ekaikaṃ tu trirūpāṇi prāgvicintyārthasādhakaḥ || 172 ||
meaning:
डामरं मोहनं चापि तृतीयं परिकीर्तितम् |
एकैकं तु त्रिरूपाणि प्राग्विचिन्त्यार्थसाधकः || 172 ||
text_mt: and the third is proclaimed as Ḍāmara and Mohana. / Having first meditated on each of these three forms, the practitioner,

sanskrit_iast:
mantratrayeṇa pratyekaṃ hṛdi ṣoḍaśakaistathā |
pūjayedupacāraistu bahiryadvattathaiva ca || 173 ||
meaning:
मन्त्रत्रयेण प्रत्येकं हृदि षोडशकैस्तथा |
पूजयेदुपचारैस्तु बहिर्यद्वत्तथैव च || 173 ||
text_mt: with the three mantras respectively in his heart with sixteen / services, should worship just as [he would] outside.

sanskrit_iast:
mantratrayaṃ tathaikatra kṛtvā ca manamūrtayaḥ |
kartavyā ekatastatra madhyarūpe niveśayet || 174 ||
meaning:
मन्त्रत्रयं तथैकत्र कृत्वा च मनमूर्तयः |
कर्तव्या एकतस्तत्र मध्यरूपे निवेशयेत् || 174 ||
text_mt: Having united the three mantras, the mental images / should be made in one place, and he should place them there into the central form.

sanskrit_iast:
nāsāpuṭena niḥsārya dakṣiṇenātha tāṃ punaḥ |
avatārya karābhyāṃ tu devīmāvāhayet tridhā || 175 ||
meaning:
नासापुटेन निःसार्य दक्षिणेनाथ तां पुनः |
अवतार्य कराभ्यां तु देवीमावाहयेत् त्रिधा || 175 ||
text_mt: Then, bringing it out through the right nostril, / and lowering [her] with both hands, he should invoke the goddess in a threefold manner.

sanskrit_iast:
gāyatrītrayamucārya snāpayet prathamaṃ tu tām |
āvāhane tu mantro'yaṃ paṭhitavyaśca sādhakaiḥ || 176 ||
meaning:
गायत्रीत्रयमुचार्य स्नापयेत् प्रथमं तु ताम् |
आवाहने तु मन्त्रोऽयं पठितव्यश्च साधकैः || 176 ||
text_mt: Having recited the three Gāyatrīs, he should first bathe her. / And this mantra should be recited by practitioners during invocation:

sanskrit_iast:
ehi devi śubhāvarte yajñe'smin mama sannidhau |
avyucchinnāṃ tataḥ śubhrāṃ vācaṃ kaṇṭhasya dehi me || 177 ||
meaning:
एहि देवि शुभावर्ते यज्ञेऽस्मिन् मम सन्निधौ |
अव्युच्छिन्नां ततः शुभ्रां वाचं कण्ठस्य देहि मे || 177 ||
text_mt: "Come, O Goddess of auspicious whirlpools, into my presence at this sacrifice; / then grant me speech for my throat that is unbroken and pure."

sanskrit_iast:
ehyehi bhagavatyamba tripure kāmadāyini |
imaṃ bhāgabaliṃ gṛhya sānnidhyamiha kalpaya || 178 ||
meaning:
एह्येहि भगवत्यम्ब त्रिपुरे कामदायिनि |
इमं भागबलिं गृह्य सान्निध्यमिह कल्पय || 178 ||
text_mt: "Come, come, O Blessed Mother Tripura, bestower of desires; / taking this portion of the offering, make your presence here."

sanskrit_iast:
nārāyaṇyai ca vidmahe āgmayāyai ca dhīmahi |
evamuktvā tataḥ paścāt tanno devī pracodayāt || 179 ||
meaning:
नारायण्यै च विद्महे आग्मयायै च धीमहि |
एवमुक्त्वा ततः पश्चात् तन्नो देवी प्रचोदयात् || 179 ||
text_mt: "We know Nārāyaṇī, and we meditate upon Vāṅmayī; / having spoken thus, then: 'May that Goddess impel us.'"

sanskrit_iast:
nārāyaṇyai vidmahe tvāṃ caṇḍikāya ca dhīmahi |
śeṣabhāge prayuñjīta tannaḥ kubji pracodayāt || 180 ||
meaning:
नारायण्यै विद्महे त्वां चण्डिकाय च धीमहि |
शेषभागे प्रयुञ्जीत तन्नः कुब्जि प्रचोदयात् || 180 ||
text_mt: "We know you as Nārāyaṇī, and we meditate upon Caṇḍikā; / in the final portion one should use: 'May that Kubjikā impel us.'"

sanskrit_iast:
mahāmāyāyai vidmahe tvāṃ sammohinyai ca dhīmahi |
paścādevaṃ prayuñjīta tannāścaṇḍi pracodayāt || 181 ||
meaning:
महामायायै विद्महे त्वां सम्मोहिन्यै च धीमहि |
पश्चादेवं प्रयुञ्जीत तन्नाश्चण्डि प्रचोदयात् || 181 ||
text_mt: "We know you as Mahāmāyā, and we meditate upon Sammohinī; / afterward, one should use thus: 'May that Caṇḍī impel us.'"

sanskrit_iast:
etāstu tripurādevyā gāyatryaḥ parikīrtitāḥ |
pratyekaṃ snāpanaṃ kuryāt tripurāṇāṃ ca tisṛbhiḥ || 182 ||
meaning:
एतास्तु त्रिपुरादेव्या गायत्र्यः परिकीर्तिताः |
प्रत्येकं स्नापनं कुर्यात् त्रिपुराणां च तिसृभिः || 182 ||
