sanskrit_iast:
madhyaśūnyaḥ puṭākāraḥ prāñjaliḥ parikīrtitaḥ |
aṅguṣṭhamantaraṃ kṛtvā pāṇyomuṣṭiṃ vidhāya ca || 42 ||
meaning:
मध्यशून्यः पुटाकारः प्राञ्जलिः परिकीर्तितः |
अङ्गुष्ठमन्तरं कृत्वा पाण्योमुष्टिं विधाय च || 42 ||
text_mt: empty in the middle, having the shape of a cup, it is proclaimed as Hollow Hands (Prāñjali). / Having placed the thumb inside and formed a fist of both hands,

sanskrit_iast:
saṃyojya bilvavatte tu bilvamudrā prakīrtitā |
maṇibandhādākarabhaṃ saṃyojya karayordayoḥ || 43 ||
meaning:
संयोज्य बिल्ववत्ते तु बिल्वमुद्रा प्रकीर्तिता |
मणिबन्धादाकरभं संयोज्य करयोर्दयोः || 43 ||
text_mt: joining them like a bilva fruit, they are proclaimed as the Bilva Mudrā. / Joining both hands from the wrist to the base of the fingers,

sanskrit_iast:
aṅguṣṭhe cāpi saṃyojya tathaiva ca kaniṣṭhike |
tisrastisrastayoḥ pāṇyoraṅgulorviralāstathā || 44 ||
meaning:
अङ्गुष्ठे चापि संयोज्य तथैव च कनिष्ठिके |
तिस्रस्तिस्रस्तयोः पाण्योरङ्गुलोर्विरलास्तथा || 44 ||
text_mt: and joining both thumbs, and likewise both little fingers, / three fingers of both hands are spread apart:

sanskrit_iast:
padmamudrā samākhyātā caturvargaphalā nṛṇām |
aṅguṣṭhāgreṇa tarjanyā saṃyojyāthordhvarekhayā || 45 ||
meaning:
पद्ममुद्रा समाख्याता चतुर्वर्गफला नृणाम् |
अङ्गुष्ठाग्रेण तर्जन्या संयोज्याथोर्ध्वरेखया || 45 ||
text_mt: this is declared to be the Lotus Mudrā (Padmamudrā), bearing the fruit of the four ends of life for men. / Joining the tip of the thumb to the index finger in an upward line,

sanskrit_iast:
anyāṅgulīstathānamya nārācaḥ syāt prasārya te |
mama caiva śivāyāśca prītideyaṃ priyaṅkarī || 46 ||
meaning:
अन्याङ्गुलीस्तथानम्य नाराचः स्यात् प्रसार्य ते |
मम चैव शिवायाश्च प्रीतिदेयं प्रियङ्करी || 46 ||
text_mt: and bending the other fingers, then extending them, it becomes the Iron Arrow (Nārāca). / It gives pleasure to me and to Śivā; it brings what is dear.

sanskrit_iast:
nārācamudrā satataṃ prītyai vetālabhairava |
antarāṅguṣṭhamuṣṭiṃ ca kṛtvā vāmakarasya tu || 47 ||
meaning:
नाराचमुद्रा सततं प्रीत्यै वेतालभैरव |
अन्तराङ्गुष्ठमुष्टिं च कृत्वा वामकरस्य तु || 47 ||
text_mt: The Iron Arrow Mudrā is always for [our] pleasure, O Vetāla and Bhairava! / Having made a fist with the thumb inside on the left hand,

sanskrit_iast:
madhyamāyā dakṣiṇasya tathānamya prayatnataḥ |
madhyamenātha tarjanyā aṅguṣṭhāgraṃ niyojya ca || 48 ||
meaning:
मध्यमाया दक्षिणस्य तथानम्य प्रयत्नतः |
मध्यमेनाथ तर्जन्या अङ्गुष्ठाग्रं नियोज्य च || 48 ||
text_mt: carefully bending the middle finger of the right hand, / and joining the tip of the thumb with the middle and index finger,

sanskrit_iast:
dakṣiṇaṃ yojayet pāṇiṃ vāmamuṣṭau ca sādhakaḥ |
darśayed dakṣiṇe bhāge muṇḍamudreyamiṣyate || 49 ||
meaning:
दक्षिणं योजयेत् पाणिं वाममुष्टौ च साधकः |
दर्शयेद् दक्षिणे भागे मुण्डमुद्रेयमिष्यते || 49 ||
text_mt: the practitioner should join the right hand onto the left fist, / and display it on the right side: this is considered the Head Mudrā (Muṇḍamudrā).

sanskrit_iast:
iyaṃ tu gaṇanāthasya prītidā mudrikottamā |
sarveṣāmapi devānāṃ tuṣṭidā sarvakarmasu || 50 ||
meaning:
इयं तु गणनाथस्य प्रीतिदा मुद्रिकोत्तमा |
सर्वेषामपि देवानां तुष्टिदा सर्वकर्मसु || 50 ||
text_mt: This supreme mudrā gives pleasure to the Lord of Gaṇas, / and brings satisfaction to all the gods in all rites.

sanskrit_iast:
aṅguṣṭamadhyamādīṃśca samyagānamya tarjanīm |
prasārya daṇḍamudreti dakṣiṇasya karasya ca || 51 ||
meaning:
अङ्गुष्टमध्यमादींश्च सम्यगानम्य तर्जनीम् |
प्रसार्य दण्डमुद्रेति दक्षिणस्य करस्य च || 51 ||
text_mt: Properly bending the thumb, middle finger, and others, and extending / the index finger of the right hand, it is the Staff Mudrā (Daṇḍamudrā).

sanskrit_iast:
sarvāṅgulīstu saṃyojya karayorubhayorapi |
saṃveṣṭya rajjuvad veti pāṇyorapi kaniṣṭhike || 52 ||
meaning:
सर्वाङ्गुलीस्तु संयोज्य करयोरुभयोरपि |
संवेष्ट्य रज्जुवद् वेति पाण्योरपि कनिष्ठिके || 52 ||
text_mt: Joining all the fingers of both hands, / wrapping them around like a rope, and the two little fingers of the hands,

sanskrit_iast:
vāmasyānāmamūle vai udagraṃ viniyojayet |
dakṣasya madhyamāmūle tathāgraṃ vāmameva ca || 53 ||
meaning:
वामस्यानाममूले वै उदग्रं विनियोजयेत् |
दक्षस्य मध्यमामूले तथाग्रं वाममेव च || 53 ||
text_mt: he should join the upright [finger] at the base of the left ring finger, / and likewise the left tip at the base of the right middle finger,

sanskrit_iast:
yojayed yojanāt paścādāvartya karaśākhikāḥ |
yonyākāraṃ tu tanmadhyaṃ yonimudrā prakīrtitā || 54 ||
meaning:
योजयेद् योजनात् पश्चादावर्त्य करशाखिकाः |
योन्याकारं तु तन्मध्यं योनिमुद्रा प्रकीर्तिता || 54 ||
text_mt: he should join; after joining, having turned the finger-branches, / the middle having the shape of a yoni is proclaimed as the Yoni Mudrā.

sanskrit_iast:
kāmākhyāyāḥ pañcamūrterdugāyā api bhairava |
prītidā yonimudreyaṃ mama kāmasya ca priyā || 55 ||
meaning:
कामाख्यायाः पञ्चमूर्तेर्दुगाया अपि भैरव |
प्रीतिदा योनिमुद्रेयं मम कामस्य च प्रिया || 55 ||
text_mt: To Kāmākhyā of fivefold form, and to Durgā, O Bhairava, / this Yoni Mudrā gives pleasure, and is dear to me and to Kāma.

sanskrit_iast:
saṃsaktā aṅgulīḥ sarvāḥ prasāryāṅguṣṭhaparvaṇā |
agreṇa ca kaniṣṭhāyā agreṇāpi ca yojayet || 56 ||
meaning:
संसक्ता अङ्गुलीः सर्वाः प्रसार्याङ्गुष्ठपर्वणा |
अग्रेण च कनिष्ठाया अग्रेणापि च योजयेत् || 56 ||
text_mt: Extending all the fingers held close together, with the joint of the thumb / and with its tip, he should also join it with the tip of the little finger

sanskrit_iast:
karasya dakṣiṇasyaivamardhayoniḥ prakīrtitā |
mahāyonistu kathitā vaiṣṇavītantraṇe vare || 57 ||
meaning:
करस्य दक्षिणस्यैवमर्धयोनिः प्रकीर्तिता |
महायोनिस्तु कथिता वैष्णवीतन्त्रणे वरे || 57 ||
text_mt: of the right hand: thus is proclaimed the Half-Yoni (Ardhayoni). / The Great Yoni (Mahāyoni) is taught in the excellent Vaiṣṇava system.

sanskrit_iast:
sampuṭaṃ prāñjaliṃ vāpi yadi śīrṣe pradarśayet |
vandanīyā samakhyātā mudrā viṣṇupramodinī || 58 ||
meaning:
सम्पुटं प्राञ्जलिं वापि यदि शीर्षे प्रदर्शयेत् |
वन्दनीया समख्याता मुद्रा विष्णुप्रमोदिनी || 58 ||
text_mt: If one displays the Casket or the Hollow Hands on the head, / it is declared as Greeting (Vandanīyā), the mudrā delighting Viṣṇu.

sanskrit_iast:
saiva cecchravaṇāsaktā mahāmudrā prakīrtitā |
dakṣiṇāṅge tu sā saktā vaiṣṇavī parikīrtitā || 59 ||
meaning:
सैव चेच्छ्रवणासक्ता महामुद्रा प्रकीर्तिता |
दक्षिणाङ्गे तु सा सक्ता वैष्णवी परिकीर्तिता || 59 ||
text_mt: If that same [mudrā] touches the ear, it is proclaimed as the Great Mudrā (Mahāmudrā); / applied to the right side of the body, it is proclaimed as Vaiṣṇavī.

sanskrit_iast:
mahāyonistu kathitā vaiṣṇavī tantragocare |
dvayostu mūle'ṅguṣṭhāgramaṅgulīṃ ca kaniṣṭhayoḥ || 60 ||
meaning:
महायोनिस्तु कथिता वैष्णवी तन्त्रगोचरे |
द्वयोस्तु मूलेऽङ्गुष्ठाग्रमङ्गुलीं च कनिष्ठयोः || 60 ||
text_mt: The Great Yoni is taught as Vaiṣṇavī within the scope of the tantras. / At the base of the two [hands], having joined the tip of the thumb and the finger to the little fingers,

sanskrit_iast:
niyojya prasṛtīkṛtya dau pāṇī yojayet punaḥ |
bhagamudrā samākhyātā lakṣmīvāṇīśivapriyā || 61 ||
meaning:
नियोज्य प्रसृतीकृत्य दौ पाणी योजयेत् पुनः |
भगमुद्रा समाख्याता लक्ष्मीवाणीशिवप्रिया || 61 ||
text_mt: and having opened both hands wide, he should join them again: / this is declared to be the Vulva Mudrā (Bhagamudrā), dear to Lakṣmī, Vāṇī, and Śivā.

sanskrit_iast:
sarvāṅgulīnāmagraughaṃ dakṣiṇasya ca |
saṃyojyaikatra purato nirdeśaḥ puṭakaḥ smṛtaḥ || 62 ||
meaning:
सर्वाङ्गुलीनामग्रौघं दक्षिणस्य च |
संयोज्यैकत्र पुरतो निर्देशः पुटकः स्मृतः || 62 ||
text_mt: Bringing together all the tips of the fingers of the right [hand] / into one place, pointing forward, is known as the puṭaka [mudrā].

sanskrit_iast:
kaniṣṭhānāmikāṅguṣṭhāṅgulīnā yojayed budhaḥ |
agrāṇyekatra madhyāṃ tu tarjanīṃ ca prasārya vai || 63 ||
meaning:
कनिष्ठानामिकाङ्गुष्ठाङ्गुलीना योजयेद् बुधः |
अग्राण्येकत्र मध्यां तु तर्जनीं च प्रसार्य वै || 63 ||
text_mt: The wise one should join together the tips / of the little finger, the ring finger, and the thumb into one place, but extending the middle and forefinger,

sanskrit_iast:
kubjikṛtya karadvandvaṃ pṛthagagre nidarśayet |
niḥsaṅganāmamudreyaṃ narasiṃhavarāhayoḥ || 64 ||
meaning:
कुब्जिकृत्य करद्वन्द्वं पृथगग्रे निदर्शयेत् |
निःसङ्गनाममुद्रेयं नरसिंहवराहयोः || 64 ||
text_mt: and bending both hands, one should display them separately in front. / This is the mudrā named niḥsaṅga, belonging to Narasiṃha and Varāha.

sanskrit_iast:
kaniṣṭhānāmikādhyamākuñcan dakṣiṇena tu |
karasya tarjanyaṅguṣṭhe prasārya kriyate tu yā || 65 ||
meaning:
कनिष्ठानामिकाध्यमाकुञ्चन् दक्षिणेन तु |
करस्य तर्जन्यङ्गुष्ठे प्रसार्य क्रियते तु या || 65 ||
text_mt: Contracting the little, ring, and middle [fingers] of the right / hand, that which is made by extending the forefinger and thumb,

sanskrit_iast:
sā mudrā hyardhacandrākhyā grahāṇāṃ prītidāyinī |
ūrdhvīkṛtya tathāṅguṣṭhaṃ karasya dakṣiṇasya tu || 66 ||
meaning:
सा मुद्रा ह्यर्धचन्द्राख्या ग्रहाणां प्रीतिदायिनी |
ऊर्ध्वीकृत्य तथाङ्गुष्ठं करस्य दक्षिणस्य तु || 66 ||
text_mt: that mudrā is named ardhacandra, which grants delight to the planets. / Having raised upright the thumb of the right hand,

sanskrit_iast:
kṛtvā madhyāṃ tadaṅguṣṭhaṃ vāmamuṣṭiṃ tathordhvataḥ |
ūrdhvāṅguṣṭhāṃ tathā kuryādaṅgamudrā prakīrtitā || 67 ||
meaning:
कृत्वा मध्यां तदङ्गुष्ठं वाममुष्टिं तथोर्ध्वतः |
ऊर्ध्वाङ्गुष्ठां तथा कुर्यादङ्गमुद्रा प्रकीर्तिता || 67 ||
text_mt: and making the middle [finger touch] its thumb, and likewise the left fist above / with its thumb upright, one should make it: this is celebrated as the aṅgamudrā.

sanskrit_iast:
etasyā eva mudrāyāḥ kaniṣṭhādiviyogataḥ |
aṣṭau mudrāḥ samākhyātā nāma tāsāṃ pṛthak śṛṇu || 68 ||
meaning:
एतस्या एव मुद्रायाः कनिष्ठादिवियोगतः |
अष्टौ मुद्राः समाख्याता नाम तासां पृथक् शृणु || 68 ||
text_mt: From this very mudrā, by detaching the little finger and the rest, / eight mudrās are proclaimed; hear their names individually:

sanskrit_iast:
dvimukhaṃ caiva muṣṭiṃ ca vajramābaddhameva ca |
vimalaśca ghaṭaścaiva tuṅgaḥ puṇḍrastathaiva ca || 69 ||
meaning:
द्विमुखं चैव मुष्टिं च वज्रमाबद्धमेव च |
विमलश्च घटश्चैव तुङ्गः पुण्ड्रस्तथैव च || 69 ||
text_mt: dvimukha, muṣṭi, vajra, and ābaddha, / vimala, ghaṭa, tuṅga, and puṇḍra.

sanskrit_iast:
navānāṃ viṣṇumūrtināṃ sārdhasaṅgena mudrikāḥ |
kramānnava samākhyātā nāyikānāṃ tathaiva ca || 70 ||
meaning:
नवानां विष्णुमूर्तिनां सार्धसङ्गेन मुद्रिकाः |
क्रमान्नव समाख्याता नायिकानां तथैव च || 70 ||
text_mt: Together with [the original mudrā], these are proclaimed in order as the nine / mudrās of the nine forms of Viṣṇu, and likewise of the Nāyikās.

sanskrit_iast:
saṃyojya karayoḥ pṛṣṭhe tathāvartya tu vai samam |
prasārya tarjanīyugmaṃ saṃyuktaṃ sarvataḥ punaḥ || 71 ||
meaning:
संयोज्य करयोः पृष्ठे तथावर्त्य तु वै समम् |
प्रसार्य तर्जनीयुग्मं संयुक्तं सर्वतः पुनः || 71 ||
text_mt: Having joined the backs of the two hands, and turning them equally, / having extended both forefingers joined completely,

sanskrit_iast:
aṅguṣṭhau ca tathāsaktau śaṅkhamudrā prakīrtitā |
uttānamañjaliṃ kṛtvā aṅguṣṭhe dve kaniṣṭhayoḥ || 72 ||
meaning:
अङ्गुष्ठौ च तथासक्तौ शङ्खमुद्रा प्रकीर्तिता |
उत्तानमञ्जलिं कृत्वा अङ्गुष्ठे द्वे कनिष्ठयोः || 72 ||
text_mt: and both thumbs likewise attached, it is celebrated as the śaṅkhamudrā. / Having made an open hollowed palm (añjali), placing the two thumbs at the root

sanskrit_iast:
mūle nikṣipya tu karau saṃyojyātha pradarśayet |
sā yoniriti vikhyātā mudrā devaughatuṣṭidā || 73 ||
meaning:
मूले निक्षिप्य तु करौ संयोज्याथ प्रदर्शयेत् |
सा योनिरिति विख्याता मुद्रा देवौघतुष्टिदा || 73 ||
text_mt: of the two little fingers, and joining the two hands, one should display it; / that is renowned as the yoni mudrā, giving delight to the host of deities.

sanskrit_iast:
muṣṭirdakṣiṇahastasya yadordhāṅguṣṭhikā bhavet |
sā syāñchikhariṇīmudrā brāhmīsūryapriyā ca sā || 74 ||
meaning:
मुष्टिर्दक्षिणहस्तस्य यदोर्धाङ्गुष्ठिका भवेत् |
सा स्याञ्छिखरिणीमुद्रा ब्राह्मीसूर्यप्रिया च सा || 74 ||
text_mt: When the fist of the right hand has the thumb upright, / that is the śikhariṇī mudrā, beloved of Brāhmī and Sūrya.

sanskrit_iast:
anāmike kaniṣṭhe ca saṃyojya vāyunā punaḥ |
madhyamā tarjanīnāṃ tu dhenumudreva bandhanam || 75 ||
meaning:
अनामिके कनिष्ठे च संयोज्य वायुना पुनः |
मध्यमा तर्जनीनां तु धेनुमुद्रेव बन्धनम् || 75 ||
text_mt: Having joined the ring fingers and the little fingers, and again by means of the wind [finger] / of the middle and forefingers, bound like the dhenumudrā,

sanskrit_iast:
sārdhadhenuriti khyātā candraprīti vivardhinī |
karayoraṅgulīnāṃ tu sarvāgrāṇyekataḥ sthitā || 76 ||
meaning:
सार्धधेनुरिति ख्याता चन्द्रप्रीति विवर्धिनी |
करयोरङ्गुलीनां तु सर्वाग्राण्येकतः स्थिता || 76 ||
text_mt: it is renowned as the ardhadhenu, increasing the delight of Candra. / All the tips of the fingers of both hands resting together,

sanskrit_iast: niyojya dve tale caiva tadadho'pi niyojya ca |
meaning: नियोज्य द्वे तले चैव तदधोऽपि नियोज्य च |
text_mt: joining both palms, and joining [them] below as well,

sanskrit_iast:
kaniṣṭhānāmikāṅguṣṭhāṅgulīnā yojayed budhaḥ |
agrāṇyekatra madhyāṃ tu tarjanīṃ ca prasārya vai || 63 ||
meaning:
कनिष्ठानामिकाङ्गुष्ठाङ्गुलीना योजयेद् बुधः |
अग्राण्येकत्र मध्यां तु तर्जनीं च प्रसार्य वै || 63 ||
text_mt: The wise one should join together the tips / of the little finger, the ring finger, and the thumb into one place, but extending the middle and forefinger,

kubjīkṛtya karadvandvaṃ pṛthagagre nidarśayet |
niḥsaṅganāmamudreyaṃ narasiṃhavarāhayoḥ || 64 ||
meaning:
कुब्जीकृत्य करद्वन्द्वं पृथगग्रे निदर्शयेत् |
निःसङ्गनाममुद्रेयं नरसिंहवराहयोः || 64 ||
text_mt: and bending both hands, one should display them separately in front. / This is the mudrā named niḥsaṅga, belonging to Narasiṃha and Varāha.

sanskrit_iast:
kaniṣṭhānāmikādhyamākuñcan dakṣiṇena tu |

meaning:
कनिष्ठानामिकाध्यमाकुञ्चन् दक्षिणेन तु |
करस्य तर्जन्यङ्गुष्ठे प्रसार्य क्रियते तु या || 65 ||
text_mt: Contracting the little, ring, and middle [fingers] of the right / hand, that which is made by extending the forefinger and thumb,

aṣṭau mudrāḥ samākhyātā nāma tāsāṃ pṛthak śṛṇu || 68 ||
meaning:
एतस्या एव मुद्रायाः कनिष्ठादिवियोगतः |
अष्टौ मुद्राः समाख्याता नाम तासां पृथक् शृणु || 68 ||

text_mt: dvimukha, muṣṭi, vajra, and ābaddha, / vimala, ghaṭa, tuṅga, and puṇḍra.

kramānnava samākhyātā nāyikānāṃ tathaiva ca || 70 ||
meaning:
नवानां विष्णुमूर्तिनां सार्धसङ्गेन मुद्रिकाः |
क्रमान्नव समाख्याता नायिकानां तथैव च || 70 ||
text_mt: Together with [the original mudrā], these are proclaimed in order as the nine / mudrās of the nine forms of Viṣṇu, and likewise of the Nāyikās.

prasārya tarjanīyugmaṃ saṃyuktaṃ sarvataḥ punaḥ || 71 ||
meaning:
संयोज्य करयोः पृष्ठे तथावर्त्य तु वै समम् |

aṅguṣṭhauca tathāsaktau śaṅkhamudrā prakīrtitā |
uttānamañjaliṃ kṛtvā aṅguṣṭhe dve kaniṣṭhayoḥ || 72 ||
meaning:
अङ्गुष्ठौच तथासक्तौ शङ्खमुद्रा प्रकीर्तिता |

text_mt: and both thumbs likewise attached, it is celebrated as the śaṅkhamudrā. / Having made an open hollowed palm, placing the two thumbs at the root

sanskrit_iast:
mūle nikṣipya tu karau saṃyojyātha pradarśayet |
sā yoniriti vikhyātā mudrā devaughatuṣṭidā || 73 ||
meaning:
मूले निक्षिप्य तु करौ संयोज्याथ प्रदर्शयेत् |
सा योनिरिति विख्याता मुद्रा देवौघतुष्टिदा || 73 ||

मुष्टिर्दक्षिणहस्तस्य यदोर्धाङ्गुष्ठिका भवेत् |

करयोरङ्गुलीनां तु सर्वाग्राण्येकतः स्थिता || 76 ||

sanskrit_iast:

agrairagraiyojayet tu mudrā sammīlanī tu sā || 77 ||
meaning:
नियोज्य द्वे तले चैव तदधोऽपि नियोज्य च |
अग्रैरग्रैयोजयेत् तु मुद्रा सम्मीलनी तु सा || 77 ||
text_mt: joining both palms, and joining [them] below as well, / one should join them tip to tip; that is the sammīlanī mudrā.

sanskrit_iast:
bhaumabhūmimunīśānāmiyaṃ prītivivardhinī |
sarvāṅgulīstu saṃyojya dakṣisya karasya ca || 78 ||

सर्वाङ्गुलीस्तु संयोज्य दक्षिस्य करस्य च || 78 ||
text_mt: This increases the delight of Bhauma, the Earth, and the Lord of sages. / Having joined all the fingers of the right hand,

sanskrit_iast:
kiyadbhāgaṃ tathānamya talaṃ kuryāt tu kuṇḍavat |
samākhyātā kuṇḍamudrā budhavāṇīśivapriyā || 79 ||
meaning:
कियद्भागं तथानम्य तलं कुर्यात् तु कुण्डवत् |
समाख्याता कुण्डमुद्रा बुधवाणीशिवप्रिया || 79 ||
text_mt: and bending [them] somewhat, one should make the palm like a pit (kuṇḍa); / this is proclaimed as the kuṇḍamudrā, beloved of Budha, Vāṇī, and Śiva.

sanskrit_iast:
sarvāṅgulīnāṃ madhyaṃ tu vāmahastasya cāṅgulīḥ |
prasāryāṅguṣṭhayugalaṃ saṃyojyāgreṇa bhairava || 80 ||
meaning:
सर्वाङ्गुलीनां मध्यं तु वामहस्तस्य चाङ्गुलीः |
प्रसार्याङ्गुष्ठयुगलं संयोज्याग्रेण भैरव || 80 ||
text_mt: Extending all the fingers of the left hand, and joining both thumbs / at their tips in the middle of all the fingers, O Bhairava,

sanskrit_iast:
tadaṅguṣṭhadvayaṃ kārya sammukhaṃ vitarem tataḥ |
cakramudrā samākhyātā guruviṣṇuśivapriyā || 81 ||
meaning:
तदङ्गुष्ठद्वयं कार्य सम्मुखं वितरेम् ततः |
चक्रमुद्रा समाख्याता गुरुविष्णुशिवप्रिया || 81 ||
text_mt: those two thumbs should then be held facing each other; / this is proclaimed as the cakramudrā, beloved of Guru, Viṣṇu, and Śiva.

sanskrit_iast:
aṅguṣṭhaṃ madhyamāṃ caiva nāmayitvā karasya tu |
dakṣiṇasya parāstisro yojayedagrataḥ punaḥ || 82 ||
meaning:
अङ्गुष्ठं मध्यमां चैव नामयित्वा करस्य तु |
दक्षिणस्य परास्तिस्रो योजयेदग्रतः पुनः || 82 ||
text_mt: Having bent the thumb and the middle finger of the right / hand, one should then join the other three at the front.

sanskrit_iast:
śūlamudrā samākhyātā mama śukragrahapriyā |
nikubjīkṛtya tu karau vāmaṅguligaṇasya tu || 83 ||
meaning:
शूलमुद्रा समाख्याता मम शुक्रग्रहप्रिया |
निकुब्जीकृत्य तु करौ वामङ्गुलिगणस्य तु || 83 ||
text_mt: This is proclaimed as the śūlamudrā, beloved of me and of the planet Śukra. / Having inverted both hands, one should join the tips of the fingers

sanskrit_iast:
agrāṇi yojayenmadhye talasyāsavyahastataḥ |
adhaḥkṛtvā vāmahastaṃ mudrā siṃhamukhī smṛtā || 84 ||
meaning:
अग्राणि योजयेन्मध्ये तलस्यासव्यहस्ततः |
अधःकृत्वा वामहस्तं मुद्रा सिंहमुखी स्मृता || 84 ||
text_mt: of the left [hand] to the middle of the palm of the right hand; / holding the left hand beneath, the mudrā is known as siṃhamukhī.

sanskrit_iast:
iyaṃ prītyai tu durgāyāḥ sūryaputrasya cakriṇaḥ |
bhagamudrā karṇamūle gomukhākhyā prakīrtitā || 85 ||
meaning:
इयं प्रीत्यै तु दुर्गायाः सूर्यपुत्रस्य चक्रिणः |
भगमुद्रा कर्णमूले गोमुखाख्या प्रकीर्तिता || 85 ||
text_mt: This is for the delight of Durgā, of Sūrya's son [Śani], and of the Discus-bearer. / The bhagamudrā at the root of the ear is proclaimed as gomukha.

sanskrit_iast:
mama viṣṇostathā rāhoḥ sarvadā prītidāyinī |
muṣṭidvayamathottānaṃ kṛtvā saṃyojya pārśvataḥ || 86 ||
meaning:
मम विष्णोस्तथा राहोः सर्वदा प्रीतिदायिनी |
मुष्टिद्वयमथोत्तानं कृत्वा संयोज्य पार्श्वतः || 86 ||
text_mt: It always grants delight to me, to Viṣṇu, and to Rāhu. / Then, making both fists turned upward and joining them side by side,

sanskrit_iast:
dakṣiṇasya kaniṣṭhādīna prasārya kramataḥ punaḥ |
tathā vāmakaniṣṭhābhyāmekaikena prasārayet || 87 ||
meaning:
दक्षिणस्य कनिष्ठादीन प्रसार्य क्रमतः पुनः |
तथा वामकनिष्ठाभ्यामेकैकेन प्रसारयेत् || 87 ||
text_mt: and extending the little and other fingers of the right in succession, / one should likewise extend each one with the two little fingers of the left.

sanskrit_iast:
aṣṭau mudrāḥ samākhyātā nāmataḥ kramataḥ śṛṇu |
prollāsonnamanaṃ caiva vimbaṃ pāśupataṃ tathā || 88 ||
meaning:
अष्टौ मुद्राः समाख्याता नामतः क्रमतः शृणु |
प्रोल्लासोन्नमनं चैव विम्बं पाशुपतं तथा || 88 ||
text_mt: Eight mudrās are proclaimed; hear them in order by name: / prollāsa, unnamana, bimba, and pāśupata,

sanskrit_iast:
śuddhaṃ tyāgaḥ sāraṇī ca tathā caiva prasāraṇī |
ākuñcakaraśākhāstu dakṣiṇā sā tu mudrikā || 89 ||
meaning:
शुद्धं त्यागः सारणी च तथा चैव प्रसारणी |
आकुञ्चकरशाखास्तु दक्षिणा सा तु मुद्रिका || 89 ||
text_mt: śuddha, tyāga, sāraṇī, and also prasāraṇī. / Contracting the fingers of the right hand is that mudrā,

sanskrit_iast:
ugramudrā samākhyātā svahastasya viparyayāt |
indrādilokapālānāṃ daśamudrāḥ prakīrtitāḥ || 90 ||
meaning:
उग्रमुद्रा समाख्याता स्वहस्तस्य विपर्ययात् |
इन्द्रादिलोकपालानां दशमुद्राः प्रकीर्तिताः || 90 ||
text_mt: which is proclaimed as the ugramudrā by inverting one's own hand. / Ten mudrās are proclaimed for the world-guardians beginning with Indra,

sanskrit_iast:
sarveṣāmeva devānāṃ paramaprītivardhanāḥ |
aṅguṣṭhāgraṃ tu tarjanyā agre bhāgena yojayet || 91 ||
meaning:
सर्वेषामेव देवानां परमप्रीतिवर्धनाः |
अङ्गुष्ठाग्रं तु तर्जन्या अग्रे भागेन योजयेत् || 91 ||
text_mt: supremely increasing the delight of all the gods. / One should join the tip of the thumb to the front part of the forefinger.

sanskrit_iast:
ākuñcamadhyamādyāstu dakṣahastasya cāṅgulīḥ |
daśayet kuṇḍalākāraṃ kuṇḍalīśaktituṣṭidam || 92 ||
meaning:
आकुञ्चमध्यमाद्यास्तु दक्षहस्तस्य चाङ्गुलीः |
दशयेत् कुण्डलाकारं कुण्डलीशक्तितुष्टिदम् || 92 ||
text_mt: One should bend the middle and other fingers of the right hand / [and] form a circular shape; it pleases Kuṇḍalīśakti,

sanskrit_iast:
sarveṣāmapi devānāṃ yathā tuṣṭikaraṃ mahat |
aṅguṣṭhatarjnīmadhyā agrabhāgaṃ niyojya ca || 93 ||
meaning:
सर्वेषामपि देवानां यथा तुष्टिकरं महत् |
अङ्गुष्ठतर्ज्नीमध्या अग्रभागं नियोज्य च || 93 ||
text_mt: just as it causes great satisfaction to all gods. / Joining the tip of the thumb to the middle of the forefinger,

sanskrit_iast:
madhyamāṃ ca kaniṣṭhāṃ ca ākuñcya dakṣiṇe kare |
trimukhākhyā samākhyātā viśvadevapriyā sadā || 94 ||
meaning:
मध्यमां च कनिष्ठां च आकुञ्च्य दक्षिणे करे |
त्रिमुखाख्या समाख्याता विश्वदेवप्रिया सदा || 94 ||
text_mt: and bending the middle and the little finger of the right hand, / is known as the Trimukhā, ever beloved of the Viśvedevas.

sanskrit_iast:
ketoḥ priyeyaṃ satata mātṛṇāmapi tuṣṭidā |
tarjanyaṅguṣṭhayoragrabhāgau saṃyojya cā"gulīḥ || 95 ||
meaning:
केतोः प्रियेयं सतत मातृणामपि तुष्टिदा |
तर्जन्यङ्गुष्ठयोरग्रभागौ संयोज्य चा"गुलीः || 95 ||
text_mt: This is constantly pleasing to Ketu and brings satisfaction to the Mothers. / Joining the tips of the forefinger and thumb, and [curling] the fingers,

sanskrit_iast:
anyā ākuñcayet tisraḥ sā'sivallī prakīrtitā |
pitṛṇāmatha sādhyānāṃ rudrāṇāṃ viśvakarmaṇaḥ || 96 ||
meaning:
अन्या आकुञ्चयेत् तिस्रः साऽसिवल्ली प्रकीर्तिता |
पितृणामथ साध्यानां रुद्राणां विश्वकर्मणः || 96 ||
text_mt: one should bend the other three; that is proclaimed as the Asivallī. / To the ancestors, the Sādhyas, the Rudras, and to Viśvakarman,

sanskrit_iast:
sarvadā prītijananī sā'sivallī prakīrtitā |
pādau talābhyāṃ saṃyojya tadaṅguṣṭhadvayaṃ yataḥ || 97 ||
meaning:
सर्वदा प्रीतिजननी साऽसिवल्ली प्रकीर्तिता |
पादौ तलाभ्यां संयोज्य तदङ्गुष्ठद्वयं यतः || 97 ||
text_mt: it always produces delight; that is proclaimed as the Asivallī. / Joining the two feet by their soles, while both thumbs thereof

sanskrit_iast:
ūrdhvaṃ saṃyojayennābhau tasyopari tathāñjaliḥ |
yogamudrā samākhyātā yogināṃ tattvadāyinī || 98 ||
meaning:
ऊर्ध्वं संयोजयेन्नाभौ तस्योपरि तथाञ्जलिः |
योगमुद्रा समाख्याता योगिनां तत्त्वदायिनी || 98 ||
text_mt: are brought upward to the navel, and forming the añjali gesture above it: / this is proclaimed as the Yogamudrā, which grants truth to yogins.

sanskrit_iast:
sarveṣāmapi devānāṃ pūjane cintane tathā |
yogamudrā samākhyātā tuṣṭaprītikarī sadā || 99 ||
meaning:
सर्वेषामपि देवानां पूजने चिन्तने तथा |
योगमुद्रा समाख्याता तुष्टप्रीतिकरी सदा || 99 ||
text_mt: In the worship as well as contemplation of all gods, / the Yogamudrā is proclaimed as ever conferring contentment and love.

sanskrit_iast:
prāñjalirnām mudrā tu ūrdhvādho bhāvayojitā |
vibhidya darśayeddhastau ūrdhvādhaḥ prasṛtīkṛtau || 100 ||
meaning:
प्राञ्जलिर्नाम् मुद्रा तु ऊर्ध्वाधो भावयोजिता |
विभिद्य दर्शयेद्धस्तौ ऊर्ध्वाधः प्रसृतीकृतौ || 100 ||
text_mt: When the mudrā called Prāñjali is arranged in an upward and downward disposition, / one should separate the two hands and display them stretched above and below.

sanskrit_iast:
bhedamudrā samākhyātā mama viṣṇovidheḥ priyā |
aṅguṣṭhe dve tu nikṣipya karayorubhayorapi || 101 ||
meaning:
भेदमुद्रा समाख्याता मम विष्णोविधेः प्रिया |
अङ्गुष्ठे द्वे तु निक्षिप्य करयोरुभयोरपि || 101 ||
text_mt: This is proclaimed as the Bhedamudrā, beloved of me, of Viṣṇu, and of Vidhi. / Having cast both thumbs into each hand,

sanskrit_iast:
agreṇa yojayet paścāt kaniṣṭhāyugalaṃ tataḥ |
ubhayorhastayoścānyāstarjanyādyāśca yojayet || 102 ||
meaning:
अग्रेण योजयेत् पश्चात् कनिष्ठायुगलं ततः |
उभयोर्हस्तयोश्चान्यास्तर्जन्याद्याश्च योजयेत् || 102 ||
text_mt: one should then join them at the tip, and then the pair of little fingers. / And one should join the other [fingers] of both hands, beginning with the forefingers,

sanskrit_iast:
agrāgraistu pṛthakkṛtya darśayet tu kaniṣṭhikām |
mudrā sammohanaṃ nāma kāmadurgāramāpriyā || 103 ||
meaning:
अग्राग्रैस्तु पृथक्कृत्य दर्शयेत् तु कनिष्ठिकाम् |
मुद्रा सम्मोहनं नाम कामदुर्गारमाप्रिया || 103 ||
text_mt: and, separating them tip by tip, should display the little finger. / This is the mudrā named Sammohana, beloved of Kāma, Durgā, and Ramā.

sanskrit_iast:
sarveṣāmiha devānāṃ mohanaṃ prītidaṃ smṛtam |
ānamyāsavyahastasya madhyamānāmike tathā || 104 ||
meaning:
सर्वेषामिह देवानां मोहनं प्रीतिदं स्मृतम् |
आनम्यासव्यहस्तस्य मध्यमानामिके तथा || 104 ||
text_mt: It is remembered as enchanting all the gods here and granting delight. / Having bent the middle and ring fingers of the left hand,

sanskrit_iast:
tayoḥ pṛṣṭhe susaṃyojya aṅguṣṭhāgraṃ tataḥ param |
kaniṣṭhāṃ tarjanīṃ caiva agreṇāyojayet tataḥ || 105 ||
meaning:
तयोः पृष्ठे सुसंयोज्य अङ्गुष्ठाग्रं ततः परम् |
कनिष्ठां तर्जनीं चैव अग्रेणायोजयेत् ततः || 105 ||
text_mt: and placed the tip of the thumb firmly upon their back, / one should then join the little finger and the forefinger at their tips.

sanskrit_iast:
bāṇamudrā samākhyātā sarvadevasya tuṣṭidā |
sarvāṅgulīstu saṅkocya aṅguṣṭhamatha tarjanīm || 106 ||
meaning:
बाणमुद्रा समाख्याता सर्वदेवस्य तुष्टिदा |
सर्वाङ्गुलीस्तु सङ्कोच्य अङ्गुष्ठमथ तर्जनीम् || 106 ||
text_mt: This is proclaimed as the Bāṇamudrā, giving satisfaction to all gods. / Contracting all the fingers, and then extending the thumb

sanskrit_iast:
prasārya karayoḥ paścādaṅguṣṭhāgraṃ tu yojayet |
achguṣṭhāgreṇa tarjanyā agreṇāpi ca tarjanīm || 107 ||
meaning:
प्रसार्य करयोः पश्चादङ्गुष्ठाग्रं तु योजयेत् |
अछ्गुष्ठाग्रेण तर्जन्या अग्रेणापि च तर्जनीम् || 107 ||
text_mt: and the forefinger of both hands, one should join the tip of the thumb / with the tip of the thumb, and the forefinger with the tip of the forefinger.

sanskrit_iast:
yathāśakti prasāryāpi dhenumudrā prakīrtitā |
sarvāṅgulīnāmagrāṇibrāhme tīrthe niyojayet || 108 ||
meaning:
यथाशक्ति प्रसार्यापि धेनुमुद्रा प्रकीर्तिता |
सर्वाङ्गुलीनामग्राणिब्राह्मे तीर्थे नियोजयेत् || 108 ||
text_mt: Extended according to one's capacity, this is proclaimed as the Dhenumudrā. / One should place the tips of all the fingers in the Brāhma-tīrtha,

sanskrit_iast:
anāmikāyāḥ pṛṣṭhe tu aṅguṣṭhāgraṃ niyojya ca |
śūnyaṃ tūṇīravat kṛtvā teṣāmantastu bhairava || 109 ||
meaning:
अनामिकायाः पृष्ठे तु अङ्गुष्ठाग्रं नियोज्य च |
शून्यं तूणीरवत् कृत्वा तेषामन्तस्तु भैरव || 109 ||
text_mt: and having placed the tip of the thumb upon the back of the ring finger, / making an empty space like a quiver within them, O Bhairava,

sanskrit_iast:
tūṇīramudrā cākhyātā sarveṣāṃ prītivardhinī |
mudrāsu saṃsthitā pūjā sarveṣu paricintanam || 110 ||
meaning:
तूणीरमुद्रा चाख्याता सर्वेषां प्रीतिवर्धिनी |
मुद्रासु संस्थिता पूजा सर्वेषु परिचिन्तनम् || 110 ||
text_mt:
it is called the Tūṇīramudrā, increasing the joy of all. / Worship is grounded in mudrās, and in all [rites] meditation [rests in them].

Yogas are established upon mudrās; therefore mudrās produce delight. / Whenever in rituals of worship, contemplation, or meditation,

sanskrit_iast:
mudrāsu saṃsthitā yogā mudrā modakarāstataḥ |
yadā yadā pujaneṣu cintane dhyānakarmaṇi || 111 ||
meaning:
मुद्रासु संस्थिता योगा मुद्रा मोदकरास्ततः |
यदा यदा पुजनेषु चिन्तने ध्यानकर्मणि || 111 ||

sanskrit_iast:
yajñādau stavane vāpi hastakṛtyaṃ na vidyate |
tadā mudrānvitaṃ kuryādiṣṭāpūrte karadvayam || 112 ||
meaning:
यज्ञादौ स्तवने वापि हस्तकृत्यं न विद्यते |
तदा मुद्रान्वितं कुर्यादिष्टापूर्ते करद्वयम् || 112 ||
text_mt: or in a sacrifice and hymn of praise, there is no assigned action for the hands, / then, in sacrificial rites and charitable works, one should keep both hands joined in a mudrā.

sanskrit_iast:
yajñakṛtyeṣu cecchakto hasto mudrāsu ca kṣamaḥ |
tadā mudrāṃ vidhāyaiva tattat kṛtyaṃ samācaret || 113 ||
meaning:
यज्ञकृत्येषु चेच्छक्तो हस्तो मुद्रासु च क्षमः |
तदा मुद्रां विधायैव तत्तत् कृत्यं समाचरेत् || 113 ||
text_mt: If a hand is occupied in the acts of sacrifice and capable of mudrās, / then, only after forming a mudrā, should one perform each respective act.

sanskrit_iast:
mudrāvimuktahastaṃ tu kriyate karma daivikam |
kṛtvā tanniṣphalaṃ yasmāt tanmānmudrānvito bhavet || 114 ||
meaning:
मुद्राविमुक्तहस्तं तु क्रियते कर्म दैविकम् |
कृत्वा तन्निष्फलं यस्मात् तन्मान्मुद्रान्वितो भवेत् || 114 ||
text_mt: A rite for the gods that is performed with hands free of mudrās / becomes fruitless because of that; therefore one should be endowed with mudrās.

sanskrit_iast:
visarjane tu devānāṃ yasya yā parikīrtitā |
mudrāṃ tāṃ pūjanādau tu tasya naiva prayojayet || 115 ||
meaning:
विसर्जने तु देवानां यस्य या परिकीर्तिता |
मुद्रां तां पूजनादौ तु तस्य नैव प्रयोजयेत् || 115 ||
text_mt: Whichever mudrā is prescribed for the dismissal of each particular deity, / one should never employ that mudrā in their worship and preliminary rites.

sanskrit_iast:
visṛjyoktāmṛte mudrāṃ mudrāyuktaḥ samācaret |
pūjanādi samastaṃ tu karmavṛddhau vicakṣaṇaḥ || 116 ||
meaning:
विसृज्योक्तामृते मुद्रां मुद्रायुक्तः समाचरेत् |
पूजनादि समस्तं तु कर्मवृद्धौ विचक्षणः || 116 ||
text_mt: Setting aside the mudrā prescribed [for dismissal], a wise practitioner should perform / all rites such as worship endowed with mudrās, for the increase of his works.

sanskrit_iast:
ato mudrā paraṃ nāma mudrā puṇyapradāyinī |
devānāṃ modadā mudrā tasmāt tāṃ yatnataścaret || 117 ||
meaning:
अतो मुद्रा परं नाम मुद्रा पुण्यप्रदायिनी |
देवानां मोददा मुद्रा तस्मात् तां यत्नतश्चरेत् || 117 ||
text_mt: Therefore 'mudrā' is the supreme designation; the mudrā bestows merit. / A mudrā gives joy to the gods; therefore one should diligently employ it.

sanskrit_iast:
ardhayonirmahāyoniryonirbrāhmī ca vaiṣṇavaḥ |
mudrā visarjane proktā śivātripurayoḥ sadā || 118 ||
meaning:
अर्धयोनिर्महायोनिर्योनिर्ब्राह्मी च वैष्णवः |
मुद्रा विसर्जने प्रोक्ता शिवात्रिपुरयोः सदा || 118 ||
text_mt: The Ardhayoni, Mahāyoni, Yoni, Brāhmī, and Vaiṣṇavī: / these mudrās are prescribed for the dismissal of Śivā and Tripurā at all times.

sanskrit_iast:
durgāyāḥ sarvarūpeṣu mudrā etāḥ prakīrtitāḥ |
yoniṃ ca sampuṭaṃ caiva mahāyoniṃ tathaiva ca || 119 ||
meaning:
दुर्गायाः सर्वरूपेषु मुद्रा एताः प्रकीर्तिताः |
योनिं च सम्पुटं चैव महायोनिं तथैव च || 119 ||
text_mt: These mudrās are proclaimed for all forms of Durgā. / Excepting the Yoni, the Sampuṭa, and the Mahāyoni,

sanskrit_iast:
varjayitvā vyastabhāvāduktādanyatra yojayet |
bhaved yāstu tripañcāśadanyā mudrāḥ samantataḥ || 120 ||
meaning:
वर्जयित्वा व्यस्तभावादुक्तादन्यत्र योजयेत् |
भवेद् यास्तु त्रिपञ्चाशदन्या मुद्राः समन्ततः || 120 ||
text_mt: one should employ them elsewhere from their inverted form. / The other fifty-three mudrās all around

sanskrit_iast:
tā vyastabhāvād vāmāḥ syurmudrā modakarāḥ parāḥ |
evaṃ vāṃ kathitā mudrāḥ pūjane pūjyatuṣṭidā |
kramastu balidānasya śṛṇu vetālabhairava || 12 ||
meaning:
ता व्यस्तभावाद् वामाः स्युर्मुद्रा मोदकराः पराः |
एवं वां कथिता मुद्राः पूजने पूज्यतुष्टिदा |
क्रमस्तु बलिदानस्य शृणु वेतालभैरव || 12 ||
text_mt: become inverted on the left side, supreme mudrās that grant delight. / Thus the mudrās have been spoken of to both of you, which please the worshipful in worship. / Listen, O Vetāla and Bhairava, to the procedure of blood-offering.

sanskrit_iast:
iti śrīkālikāpurāṇe mudrākathane ṣaṭṣaṣṭitamo'dhyāyāḥ || 66 ||
saptaṣaṣṭitamo'dhyāyaḥ
meaning:
इति श्रीकालिकापुराणे मुद्राकथने षट्षष्टितमोऽध्यायाः || 66 ||
सप्तषष्टितमोऽध्यायः
text_mt: Thus ends the sixty-sixth chapter in the venerable Kālikāpurāṇa, on the exposition of mudrās. / Sixty-seventh chapter.

sanskrit_iast: śrībhagavānuvāca
meaning: श्रीभगवानुवाच

sanskrit_iast:
kramastu balidānasya svarūpaṃ rudhirāditaḥ |
yathā syāt prītaye samyak tad vāṃ vakṣyāmi putrako || 1 ||
meaning:
क्रमस्तु बलिदानस्य स्वरूपं रुधिरादितः |
यथा स्यात् प्रीतये सम्यक् तद् वां वक्ष्यामि पुत्रको || 1 ||
text_mt: The procedure of blood-offering, according to its true nature, through blood and the rest, / in order that it may bring complete pleasure, I will explain to you two, my sons.

sanskrit_iast:
vaiṣṇavītantrakalpoktaḥ kramaḥ sarvatraḥ sarvadā |
sādhakairbalidānasya grāhyaḥ sarvasurasya ca || 2 ||
meaning:
वैष्णवीतन्त्रकल्पोक्तः क्रमः सर्वत्रः सर्वदा |
साधकैर्बलिदानस्य ग्राह्यः सर्वसुरस्य च || 2 ||
text_mt: The procedure declared in the ritual manual of the Vaiṣṇavītantra is everywhere and always / to be adopted by practitioners for blood-offering to every deity.

sanskrit_iast:
pakṣiṇaḥ kacchapā grāhā matsyā navavidhā mṛgāḥ |
mahiṣo godhikā gāvaśchāgo ruruśca śūkaraḥ || 3 ||
meaning:
पक्षिणः कच्छपा ग्राहा मत्स्या नवविधा मृगाः |
महिषो गोधिका गावश्छागो रुरुश्च शूकरः || 3 ||
text_mt: Birds, turtles, crocodiles, fish, nine kinds of deer, / buffalo, monitor lizards, cattle, goats, ruru deer, and boars,

sanskrit_iast:
khaḍgaśca kṛṣṇasāraśca godhikā śarabho hariḥ |
śārdūlaśca naraścaiva svagātrarudhiraṃ tathā || 4 ||
meaning:
खड्गश्च कृष्णसारश्च गोधिका शरभो हरिः |
शार्दूलश्च नरश्चैव स्वगात्ररुधिरं तथा || 4 ||
text_mt: rhinoceroses, blackbucks, iguanas, śarabhas, lions, / tigers, humans, and the blood of one's own body:

sanskrit_iast:
caṇḍikābhairavādīnāṃ balayaḥ parikīrtitāḥ |
balibhiḥ sādhyate muktirbalibhiḥ sādhyate divam || 5 ||
meaning:
चण्डिकाभैरवादीनां बलयः परिकीर्तिताः |
बलिभिः साध्यते मुक्तिर्बलिभिः साध्यते दिवम् || 5 ||
text_mt: these are proclaimed as the offerings for Caṇḍikā, Bhairava, and others. / Liberation is accomplished by offerings; heaven is accomplished by offerings.

sanskrit_iast:
balidānena satataṃ jayecchatrūnnṛpān nṛpaḥ |
matsyānāṃ kacchapānāṃ tu rudhiraiḥ satataṃ śivā || 6 ||
meaning:
बलिदानेन सततं जयेच्छत्रून्नृपान् नृपः |
मत्स्यानां कच्छपानां तु रुधिरैः सततं शिवा || 6 ||
text_mt: By making blood-offerings, a king may constantly conquer enemy kings. / With the blood of fish and turtles, Śivā

sanskrit_iast:
māsaikaṃ tṛptimāpnoti grāhairmāsāṃstu trīnatha |
mṛgāṇāṃ śoṇitairdevī narāṇāmapi śoṇitaiḥ || 7 ||
meaning:
मासैकं तृप्तिमाप्नोति ग्राहैर्मासांस्तु त्रीनथ |
मृगाणां शोणितैर्देवी नराणामपि शोणितैः || 7 ||
text_mt: attains satisfaction for one month, and with crocodiles for three months. / With the blood of deer and with the blood of humans,

sanskrit_iast:
aṣṭau māsānavāpnoti tṛptiṃ kalyāṇadā ca sā |
godhikānāṃ orudhirairvāṣikīṃ tṛptimāpnuyāt || 8 ||
meaning:
अष्टौ मासानवाप्नोति तृप्तिं कल्याणदा च सा |
गोधिकानां ओरुधिरैर्वाषिकीं तृप्तिमाप्नुयात् || 8 ||
text_mt: she attains satisfaction for eight months, and she bestows well-being. / With the blood of monitor lizards, she attains satisfaction for a whole year.

sanskrit_iast:
kṛṣṇasārasya rudhiraiḥ śūkarasya ca śoṇitaiḥ |
prāpnoti satataṃ devī tṛptiṃ dvādaśavārṣikīm || 9 ||
meaning:
कृष्णसारस्य रुधिरैः शूकरस्य च शोणितैः |
प्राप्नोति सततं देवी तृप्तिं द्वादशवार्षिकीम् || 9 ||
text_mt: With the blood of the blackbuck and with the blood of the boar, / the goddess constantly attains satisfaction for twelve years.

sanskrit_iast:
ajāvikānāṃ rudhiraiḥ pañcaviṃśativārṣikīm |
mahiṣāṇāṃ ca khaḍgānāṃ rudhiraiḥ śatavārṣikīm || 10 ||
meaning:
अजाविकानां रुधिरैः पञ्चविंशतिवार्षिकीम् |
महिषाणां च खड्गानां रुधिरैः शतवार्षिकीम् || 10 ||
text_mt: With the blood of goats and sheep, for twenty-five years; / with the blood of buffaloes and rhinoceroses, for one hundred years.

sanskrit_iast:
tṛptimāpnoti paramāṃ śārdūlarudhiraistathā |
siṃhasya śarabhasyātha svagātrasya ca śoṇitaiḥ || 11 ||
meaning:
तृप्तिमाप्नोति परमां शार्दूलरुधिरैस्तथा |
सिंहस्य शरभस्याथ स्वगात्रस्य च शोणितैः || 11 ||
text_mt: She attains supreme satisfaction with the blood of tigers, / of the lion, of the śarabha, and with the blood of one's own body;

sanskrit_iast:
devī tṛptimavāpnoti sahasraṃ parivatsarān |
māṃsairapi tathā prīti rudhirairyasya yāvatī || 12 ||
meaning:
देवी तृप्तिमवाप्नोति सहस्रं परिवत्सरान् |
मांसैरपि तथा प्रीति रुधिरैर्यस्य यावती || 12 ||
text_mt: the goddess attains satisfaction for a thousand years. / Whatever pleasure is derived from [an animal's] blood is also derived from its meat.

sanskrit_iast:
kṛṣṇasāraṃ mṛgaṃ khaḍgaṃ tathā matsyaṃ ca rohitam |
vārdhīṇasayugaṃ cāpi phalaṃ teṣāṃ pṛthak pṛthak || 13 ||
meaning:
कृष्णसारं मृगं खड्गं तथा मत्स्यं च रोहितम् |
वार्धीणसयुगं चापि फलं तेषां पृथक् पृथक् || 13 ||
text_mt: The blackbuck deer, the rhinoceros, the rohita fish, / and the pair of vārdhrīṇasa birds: each of these yields a distinct fruit.

sanskrit_iast:
kṛṣṇasārasya māṃsena tathā khaḍgena caṇḍikā |
varṣāṇāṃ ca śatānyeva tṛptimāpnoti kevalam || 14 ||
meaning:
कृष्णसारस्य मांसेन तथा खड्गेन चण्डिका |
वर्षाणां च शतान्येव तृप्तिमाप्नोति केवलम् || 14 ||
text_mt: By the flesh of a blackbuck and likewise of a rhinoceros, Caṇḍikā / achieves satisfaction for full hundreds of years.

sanskrit_iast:
rohitasya tu matsyasya māṃsairvārdhrīṇasasya ca |
tṛptiṃ prāpnoti varṣāṇāṃ śatāni trīṇi matpriyā || 15 ||
meaning:
रोहितस्य तु मत्स्यस्य मांसैर्वार्ध्रीणसस्य च |
तृप्तिं प्राप्नोति वर्षाणां शतानि त्रीणि मत्प्रिया || 15 ||
text_mt: By the flesh of the rohita fish and of a vārdhrīṇasa, / my beloved achieves satisfaction for three hundred years.

sanskrit_iast:
ṛpnuvantvindriyakṣīṇaṃ svetaṃ vṛddhamajāpatim |
vārdhrīṇasaḥ procyate'sau havye kavye ca satkṛtaḥ || 16 ||
meaning:
ऋप्नुवन्त्विन्द्रियक्षीणं स्वेतं वृद्धमजापतिम् |
वार्ध्रीणसः प्रोच्यतेऽसौ हव्ये कव्ये च सत्कृतः || 16 ||
text_mt: Attaining [old age], with senses weakened, a white, old he-goat / is declared to be a vārdhrīṇasa, honored in offerings to gods and ancestors.

sanskrit_iast:
nīlagrīvo raktaśīrṣaḥ kṛṣṇapādaḥ sitacchadaḥ |
vārdhrīṇasaḥ syātpakṣī ca mama viṣṇorapi priyaḥ || 17 ||
meaning:
नीलग्रीवो रक्तशीर्षः कृष्णपादः सितच्छदः |
वार्ध्रीणसः स्यात्पक्षी च मम विष्णोरपि प्रियः || 17 ||
text_mt: A bird with a blue neck, red head, black feet, and white wings / is also a vārdhrīṇasa, dear to me and to Viṣṇu.

sanskrit_iast:
nareṇa balinā devī sahasraṃ parivatsarān |
vidhidattena cāpnoti tṛptiṃ lakṣaṃ tribhirnaraiḥ || 18 ||
meaning:
नरेण बलिना देवी सहस्रं परिवत्सरान् |
विधिदत्तेन चाप्नोति तृप्तिं लक्षं त्रिभिर्नरैः || 18 ||
text_mt: By a human victim given according to rule, the goddess achieves satisfaction / for a thousand years, and with three humans, for a hundred thousand.

sanskrit_iast:
nareṇevātha māṃsena trisahasraṃ ca vatsarān |
tṛptimāpnoti kāmākhyā bhairavī mama rūpadhṛk || 19 ||
meaning:
नरेणेवाथ मांसेन त्रिसहस्रं च वत्सरान् |
तृप्तिमाप्नोति कामाख्या भैरवी मम रूपधृक् || 19 ||
text_mt: By human flesh, Kāmākhyā, the Bhairavī who bears my form, / achieves satisfaction for three thousand years.

sanskrit_iast:
mantrapūtaṃ śoṇitaṃ tu pīyūṣaṃ jāyate sadā |
mastakaṃ cāpi tasyātti māṃsaṃ cāpi tathā śivā || 20 ||
meaning:
मन्त्रपूतं शोणितं तु पीयूषं जायते सदा |
मस्तकं चापि तस्यात्ति मांसं चापि तथा शिवा || 20 ||
text_mt: The blood purified by mantra always becomes nectar, / and the auspicious goddess also eats its head and its flesh.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmāt tu pūjane dadyād baleḥ śīrṣaṃ ca lohitam |
bhojye home ca māṃsāni niyuñjīyād vicakṣaṇaḥ || 21 ||
meaning:
तस्मात् तु पूजने दद्याद् बलेः शीर्षं च लोहितम् |
भोज्ये होमे च मांसानि नियुञ्जीयाद् विचक्षणः || 21 ||
text_mt: Therefore, in worship one should offer the head and the blood of the victim; / the wise man should employ the meats for food and oblation.

sanskrit_iast:
pūjāsu nāmamāṃsāni dadyād vai sādhakaḥ kvacit |
ṛte tu lohitaṃ śīrṣamamṛtaṃ tattu jāyate || 22 ||
meaning:
पूजासु नाममांसानि दद्याद् वै साधकः क्वचित् |
ऋते तु लोहितं शीर्षममृतं तत्तु जायते || 22 ||
text_mt: A practitioner should never offer raw meats in rituals of worship, / except for the blood and the head; for that becomes nectar.

sanskrit_iast:
kūṣmāṇḍabhikṣudaṇḍaṃ ca madyamāsavameva ca |
ete balisamāḥ proktāstṛptau chāgasamāḥ sadā || 23 ||
meaning:
कूष्माण्डभिक्षुदण्डं च मद्यमासवमेव च |
एते बलिसमाः प्रोक्तास्तृप्तौ छागसमाः सदा || 23 ||
text_mt: Gourd, sugar-cane, liquor, and fermented spirits / are said to be equal to victims, always equal to goats in satisfying [her].

sanskrit_iast:
candrahāsena kartryā vā chedanaṃ mukhyamiṣyate |
dātrāsidhenukrakacaśaṃkulābhistu madhyamam || 24 ||
meaning:
चन्द्रहासेन कर्त्र्या वा छेदनं मुख्यमिष्यते |
दात्रासिधेनुक्रकचशंकुलाभिस्तु मध्यमम् || 24 ||
text_mt: Decapitation with a scimitar or a cleaver is regarded as the best; / with a sickle, a dagger, a saw, or a stake, it is middling;

sanskrit_iast:
kṣurakṣuraprabhallaiśca vādhama parikīrtitam |
ebhyo'nyaḥ śaktibāṇādyairbaliśchedyaḥ kadāpi na || 25 ||
meaning:
क्षुरक्षुरप्रभल्लैश्च वाधम परिकीर्तितम् |
एभ्योऽन्यः शक्तिबाणाद्यैर्बलिश्छेद्यः कदापि न || 25 ||
text_mt: and with a razor, a curved knife, or a spear, it is proclaimed to be the worst. / The victim should never be cut down by anything other than these, such as javelins or arrows.

sanskrit_iast:
nātti devī bali tattu dātā mṛtyumavāpnuyāt |
hastena chedayed yastu prokṣita sādhakaḥ paśum || 26 ||
meaning:
नात्ति देवी बलि तत्तु दाता मृत्युमवाप्नुयात् |
हस्तेन छेदयेद् यस्तु प्रोक्षित साधकः पशुम् || 26 ||
text_mt: The goddess does not eat that victim, and the giver meets death, / if the practitioner should cut down the consecrated animal with his bare hand;

sanskrit_iast:
akṣiṇaṃ vā brahmavadhyāmavāpnoti suduḥsahām |
nāmantrya khaṇḍaṃ tu baliṃ niyuñjīta vicakṣaṇaḥ || 27 ||
meaning:
अक्षिणं वा ब्रह्मवध्यामवाप्नोति सुदुःसहाम् |
नामन्त्र्य खण्डं तु बलिं नियुञ्जीत विचक्षणः || 27 ||
text_mt: or he incurs the intolerable sin of killing a brahmin, without diminish. / The wise man should never offer a victim that is mutilated without consecration.

sanskrit_iast:
khaḍgasyāmantraṇe mantrā yāvantaḥ kathitāḥ purā |
mahāmāyābalau te vai yojyāstatroditā budhaiḥ || 28 ||
meaning:
खड्गस्यामन्त्रणे मन्त्रा यावन्तः कथिताः पुरा |
महामायाबलौ ते वै योज्यास्तत्रोदिता बुधैः || 28 ||
text_mt: All the mantras that were previously proclaimed for consecrating the sword, / those indeed are to be employed in the sacrifice to Mahāmāyā, as stated by the wise.

sanskrit_iast:
taiḥ sārdhamete mantrāstu yojyāḥ khaḍgādimantraṇe |
pūjane śāradādīnāṃ kāmākhyāyā viśeṣataḥ || 29 ||
meaning:
तैः सार्धमेते मन्त्रास्तु योज्याः खड्गादिमन्त्रणे |
पूजने शारदादीनां कामाख्याया विशेषतः || 29 ||
text_mt: Together with them, these mantras are to be employed in consecrating the sword and [other weapons] / in the worship of Śāradā and the others, and especially of Kāmākhyā:

sanskrit_iast:
dviḥ kālīti tato devyā vajreśvaripadaṃ tataḥ |
tato'nu lauhadaṇḍāyai namaḥ śeṣe tu yojayet || 30 ||
meaning:
द्विः कालीति ततो देव्या वज्रेश्वरिपदं ततः |
ततोऽनु लौहदण्डायै नमः शेषे तु योजयेत् || 30 ||
text_mt: "Kālī" twice, then "of the goddess", then the word "Vajreśvarī", / following which one should append "to Lauhadaṇḍā, obeisance" at the end.

sanskrit_iast:
sampūjyānena mantreṇa khaḍgamādāya pāṇinā |
kālarātryāstu mantreṇa taṃ khaḍgamabhimantrayet || 31 ||
meaning:
सम्पूज्यानेन मन्त्रेण खड्गमादाय पाणिना |
कालरात्र्यास्तु मन्त्रेण तं खड्गमभिमन्त्रयेत् || 31 ||
text_mt: Having worshipped with this mantra and taken the sword in hand, / one should consecrate that sword with the mantra of Kālarātrī:

sanskrit_iast:
netrabījasya madhyaṃ tu dvirāvartya prayojayet |
tato'nu kālikālīti karāloṣṭhī tataḥ parama || 32 ||
meaning:
नेत्रबीजस्य मध्यं तु द्विरावर्त्य प्रयोजयेत् |
ततोऽनु कालिकालीति करालोष्ठी ततः परम || 32 ||
text_mt: Repeating the middle of the netra-bīja twice, one should employ it; / then "kālikālī", then "karāloṣṭhī", and next:

sanskrit_iast:
hāntādīṃśca tṛtīyena svareṇaikādaśena vai |
yojitā nādabindubhyāṃ dvau tat paścānniyojayet || 33 ||
meaning:
हान्तादींश्च तृतीयेन स्वरेणैकादशेन वै |
योजिता नादबिन्दुभ्यां द्वौ तत् पश्चान्नियोजयेत् || 33 ||
text_mt: the letter ha and following, joined with the third vowel and the eleventh, / along with nāda and bindu—one should place the two thereafter;

sanskrit_iast:
phetkāriṇipadaṃ tasmāt khādayacchedayetyataḥ |
sarvān duṣṭāniti tato dvirmāraya lulāyakam || 34 ||
meaning:
फेत्कारिणिपदं तस्मात् खादयच्छेदयेत्यतः |
सर्वान् दुष्टानिति ततो द्विर्मारय लुलायकम् || 34 ||
text_mt: then the word "phetkāriṇī", then "khādaya chedaya", / then "sarvān duṣṭān", then "māraya lulāyakam" twice;

sanskrit_iast:
khaḍgena chindhi chindhīti tataḥ kilakileti vai |
tataḥ cikicikītyevaṃ tataḥ pibapibeti ca || 35 ||
meaning:
खड्गेन छिन्धि छिन्धीति ततः किलकिलेति वै |
ततः चिकिचिकीत्येवं ततः पिबपिबेति च || 35 ||
text_mt: "chindhi chindhi with the sword", then "kilakila", / then "cikiciki", and then "piba piba";

sanskrit_iast:
tato'nu rudhiraṃ ceti sphaiṃ sphaiṃkiri kirīti ca |
kālikāyai nama iti kāla rātryāstu mantrakam || 36 ||
meaning:
ततोऽनु रुधिरं चेति स्फैं स्फैंकिरि किरीति च |
कालिकायै नम इति काल रात्र्यास्तु मन्त्रकम् || 36 ||
text_mt: then "the blood", and "sphaiṃ sphaiṃ kiri kiri", / "obeisance to Kālikā"—such is the mantra of Kālarātrī.

sanskrit_iast:
ityanena tu mantreṇa karavāle'bhimantrite |
kālarātrī svayaṃ tatra prasīdatyarihānaye || 37 ||
meaning:
इत्यनेन तु मन्त्रेण करवालेऽभिमन्त्रिते |
कालरात्री स्वयं तत्र प्रसीदत्यरिहानये || 37 ||
text_mt: When the sword is consecrated with this mantra, / Kālarātrī herself is pleased to destroy the enemies.

sanskrit_iast:
baleḥ pūrvoditā mantrā nityaṃ guhyāstu sādhakaiḥ |
ayaṃ mantrastu vaktavyastasya hatyāvihānaye || 38 ||
meaning:
बलेः पूर्वोदिता मन्त्रा नित्यं गुह्यास्तु साधकैः |
अयं मन्त्रस्तु वक्तव्यस्तस्य हत्याविहानये || 38 ||
text_mt: The mantras previously uttered for the victim must always be kept secret by practitioners; / and this mantra is to be recited to remove the guilt of slaughtering it:

sanskrit_iast:
yajñārthe paśavaḥ sṛṣṭāḥ svayameva svayambhuvā |
atastvāṃ dhātayiṣyāmi tasmād yajñe vadho'vadhaḥ || 39 ||
meaning:
यज्ञार्थे पशवः सृष्टाः स्वयमेव स्वयम्भुवा |
अतस्त्वां धातयिष्यामि तस्माद् यज्ञे वधोऽवधः || 39 ||
text_mt: "Animals were created for sacrifice by the Self-born himself; / therefore I will strike you down; hence killing in a sacrifice is non-killing."

sanskrit_iast:
tato daivatamuddiśya kāmamuddiśya cātmanaḥ |
chedayet tena khaḍgena baliṃ pūrvānanaṃ tu tam || 40 ||
meaning:
ततो दैवतमुद्दिश्य काममुद्दिश्य चात्मनः |
छेदयेत् तेन खड्गेन बलिं पूर्वाननं तु तम् || 40 ||
text_mt: Then, dedicating it to the deity and to one's own desire, / one should sever with that sword the victim, which is turned toward the east,

sanskrit_iast:
athavottaravaktraṃ taṃ svayaṃ pūrvamukhastathā |
pūrvoktān saindhavādīṃstu vakttre'vaśyaṃ niyojayet || 41 ||
meaning:
अथवोत्तरवक्त्रं तं स्वयं पूर्वमुखस्तथा |
पूर्वोक्तान् सैन्धवादींस्तु वक्त्त्रेऽवश्यं नियोजयेत् || 41 ||
text_mt: or turned toward the north, while one faces east oneself. / One must certainly place rock-salt and the other previously mentioned items into its mouth.

sanskrit_iast:
sauvarṇaṃ rājata tāmraṃ raityaṃ patrapuṭa ca vā |
māheyaṃ kāṃsyamathavā yajñakāṣṭhamayaṃ ca vā || 42 ||
meaning:
सौवर्णं राजत ताम्रं रैत्यं पत्रपुट च वा |
माहेयं कांस्यमथवा यज्ञकाष्ठमयं च वा || 42 ||
text_mt: A vessel of gold, silver, copper, brass, or a folded leaf, / of terracotta, bronze, or sacrificial wood,

sanskrit_iast:
pātraṃ rudhiradānāya kartavyaṃ vibhavāvadhi |
na lauhe valkale vāpi vaitre rāṅge'tha saisake || 43 ||
meaning:
पात्रं रुधिरदानाय कर्तव्यं विभवावधि |
न लौहे वल्कले वापि वैत्रे राङ्गेऽथ सैसके || 43 ||
text_mt: should be made according to one's means for offering the blood. / But never in iron, bark, cane, tin, or lead;

sanskrit_iast:
dadyādraktaṃ balīnāṃ tu bhūmau sruci sruve tathā |
na ghaṭe bhūtale vāpi deyaṃ kṣudre na bhājane || 44 ||
meaning:
दद्याद्रक्तं बलीनां तु भूमौ स्रुचि स्रुवे तथा |
न घटे भूतले वापि देयं क्षुद्रे न भाजने || 44 ||
text_mt: nor should he offer the blood of victims on the bare ground, nor on a sruc or a sruva ladle; / it must not be given in a jar, nor on the surface of the earth, nor in a small vessel.

sanskrit_iast:
rudhirāṇi pradadyāttu bhūtikāmo narottamaḥ |
narasya tu sadā raktaṃ māhaiye taijase'tha vā || 45 ||
meaning:
रुधिराणि प्रदद्यात्तु भूतिकामो नरोत्तमः |
नरस्य तु सदा रक्तं माहैये तैजसेऽथ वा || 45 ||
text_mt: The best of men desiring prosperity should offer the blood. / Human blood, however, a king should always offer

sanskrit_iast:
dadyānnarapatistattu na patrādau kadācana |
hayamedhamṛte dadyānna kadāciddhayaṃ balim || 46 ||
meaning:
दद्यान्नरपतिस्तत्तु न पत्रादौ कदाचन |
हयमेधमृते दद्यान्न कदाचिद्धयं बलिम् || 46 ||
text_mt: in an earthen or metallic vessel, never on a leaf or the like. / Except in a horse sacrifice, he should never offer a horse as a victim;

sanskrit_iast:
tathā dikpālamedhe tu gajaṃ dadyānnarādhipaḥ |
na kadācit tadā devyai pradadyāddhayahastinau || 47 ||
meaning:
तथा दिक्पालमेधे तु गजं दद्यान्नराधिपः |
न कदाचित् तदा देव्यै प्रदद्याद्धयहस्तिनौ || 47 ||
text_mt: likewise, a king may offer an elephant in an offering to the guardians of the directions, / but at no time should he offer a horse or an elephant to the goddess.

sanskrit_iast:
hayākarṣe cāmaraṃ tu baliṃ dadyānnarādhipaḥ |
siṃhaṃ vyāghraṃ naraṃ cāpi svagātrarudhiraṃ tathā || 48 ||
meaning:
हयाकर्षे चामरं तु बलिं दद्यान्नराधिपः |
सिंहं व्याघ्रं नरं चापि स्वगात्ररुधिरं तथा || 48 ||
text_mt: In the rite of attracting horses, a king may offer a yak. / A lion, a tiger, a human, and blood from one's own body—

sanskrit_iast:
na dadyāt brāhmaṇo madyaṃ mahādevyai kadācana |
siṃhaṃ vyāghrannaraṃ datvā brāhmaṇo narakaṃ vrajet || 49 ||
meaning:
न दद्यात् ब्राह्मणो मद्यं महादेव्यै कदाचन |
सिंहं व्याघ्रन्नरं दत्वा ब्राह्मणो नरकं व्रजेत् || 49 ||
text_mt: a brahmin should never offer these, nor liquor, to the Mahādevī. / Having offered a lion, a tiger, or a human, a brahmin goes to hell;

sanskrit_iast:
ihāpi syāt sa hīnāyuḥ sukhasaubhāgyavarjitaḥ |
svagātrarudhiraṃ dadyāccātmavadhyāmavāpnuyāt || 50 ||
meaning:
इहापि स्यात् स हीनायुः सुखसौभाग्यवर्जितः |
स्वगात्ररुधिरं दद्याच्चात्मवध्यामवाप्नुयात् || 50 ||
text_mt: here in this world too, his lifespan is shortened, and he is deprived of happiness and good fortune; / if he offers blood from his own body, he incurs the sin of suicide;

sanskrit_iast:
madyaṃ dattvā brāhmaṇastu brāhmaṇyādeva hīyate |
na kṛṣṇāsāraṃ vitared baliṃ tu kṣatriyādikaḥ || 51 ||
meaning:
मद्यं दत्त्वा ब्राह्मणस्तु ब्राह्मण्यादेव हीयते |
न कृष्णासारं वितरेद् बलिं तु क्षत्रियादिकः || 51 ||
text_mt: and by offering liquor, a brahmin falls from his status as a brahmin. / A kṣatriya or other should not offer a blackbuck as a victim;

sanskrit_iast:
dadataḥ kṛṣṇasāraṃ tu brahmahatyā bhaved yataḥ |
yatra siṃhasya vyāghrasya narasya vihito vadhaḥ || 52 ||
meaning:
ददतः कृष्णसारं तु ब्रह्महत्या भवेद् यतः |
यत्र सिंहस्य व्याघ्रस्य नरस्य विहितो वधः || 52 ||
text_mt: for to the one who gives a blackbuck, the sin of killing a brahmin accrues. / Where the slaughter of a lion, a tiger, or a human is prescribed

sanskrit_iast:
brahmaṇoktā tu balyādau tatrāyaṃ vihitaḥ kramaḥ |
kṛtvā ghṛtamayaṃ vyāghraṃ naraṃ siṃhaṃ ca bhairava || 53 ||
meaning:
ब्रह्मणोक्ता तु बल्यादौ तत्रायं विहितः क्रमः |
कृत्वा घृतमयं व्याघ्रं नरं सिंहं च भैरव || 53 ||
text_mt: for a brahmin in sacrifices and other rites, this is the rule enjoined there, O Bhairava: / having fashioned a tiger, a human, and a lion made of clarified butter,

sanskrit_iast:
athavā pūpavikṛtaṃ yavakṣodamayaṃ ca vā |
ghātayeccandahāsena tena mantreṇa saṃskṛtam || 54 ||
meaning:
अथवा पूपविकृतं यवक्षोदमयं च वा |
घातयेच्चन्दहासेन तेन मन्त्रेण संस्कृतम् || 54 ||
text_mt: or made of baked flour cake, or of barley meal, / he should strike it down with a scimitar, consecrated with that mantra.

sanskrit_iast:
prabhūtabalidāne tu dvau vā trīn vāgrataḥ kṛtān |
pūjayet pramukhān kṛtvā sarvān mantreṇa sādhakaḥ || 55 ||
meaning:
प्रभूतबलिदाने तु द्वौ वा त्रीन् वाग्रतः कृतान् |
पूजयेत् प्रमुखान् कृत्वा सर्वान् मन्त्रेण साधकः || 55 ||
text_mt: When many victims are to be offered, having placed two or three in front, / the practitioner, making all of them face forward, should worship them with the mantra.

sanskrit_iast:
sāmānyapūjā kathitā balīnāṃ pūrvato mayā |
viśeṣo yatraḥ yatrāsti tanmattaḥ śṛṇu bhairava || 56 ||
meaning:
सामान्यपूजा कथिता बलीनां पूर्वतो मया |
विशेषो यत्रः यत्रास्ति तन्मत्तः शृणु भैरव || 56 ||
text_mt: The general worship of victims was told by me previously; / wherever there is a particular detail, hear that from me, O Bhairava.

sanskrit_iast:
mahiṣaṃ pradaded devyai bhairavyai bhairavāya vā |
anenaiva tu mantreṇa tadā taṃ pūjayed balim || 57 ||
meaning:
महिषं प्रददेद् देव्यै भैरव्यै भैरवाय वा |
अनेनैव तु मन्त्रेण तदा तं पूजयेद् बलिम् || 57 ||
text_mt: When one offers a buffalo to the goddess, to Bhairavī, or to Bhairava, / one should worship that victim with this very mantra:

sanskrit_iast:
yathā vāhaṃ bhavān dveṣṭi yathā vahasi caṇḍikām |
tathā mama ripūn hiṃsa śubhaṃ vaha lulāyaka || 58 ||
meaning:
यथा वाहं भवान् द्वेष्टि यथा वहसि चण्डिकाम् |
तथा मम रिपून् हिंस शुभं वह लुलायक || 58 ||
text_mt:
Just as you hate your rider, and just as you carry Caṇḍikā,
so destroy my enemies, and bring good fortune, O buffalo!

sanskrit_iast:
yamasya vāhanastvaṃ tu vararūpadharāvyaya |
āyurvittaṃ yaśo dehi kāsarāya namo'stu te || 59 ||
meaning:
यमस्य वाहनस्त्वं तु वररूपधराव्यय |
आयुर्वित्तं यशो देहि कासराय नमोऽस्तु ते || 59 ||
text_mt:
You are the mount of Yama, O imperishable one assuming an excellent form;
grant longevity, wealth, and renown; homage be to you, O buffalo!

sanskrit_iast:
khaḍgasya tu yadā dānaṃ kriyate tantramantrakam |
jalenābhyukṣya kurvīta guhājāteti bhāṣayan || 60 ||
meaning:
खड्गस्य तु यदा दानं क्रियते तन्त्रमन्त्रकम् |
जलेनाभ्युक्ष्य कुर्वीत गुहाजातेति भाषयन् || 60 ||
text_mt:
When the offering of the rhinoceros is performed with ritual and mantra,
one should perform it by sprinkling it with water, speaking thus: “O born in a cave...”:

sanskrit_iast:
daive paitre ca śubhagaḥ khaḍgastvaṃ khaḍgasannibhaḥ |
chindhi vighnān mahābhāge guhājāta namo'stu te || 61 ||
meaning:
दैवे पैत्रे च शुभगः खड्गस्त्वं खड्गसन्निभः |
छिन्धि विघ्नान् महाभागे गुहाजात नमोऽस्तु ते || 61 ||
text_mt:
“Auspicious in rites for the gods and for the ancestors, you are a rhinoceros resembling a sword;
sever my obstacles, O blessed one born in a cave, homage be to you!”

sanskrit_iast:
pradāne kṛṣṇasārasya mantro'yaṃ parikīrtitaḥ |
kṛṣṇasāra brahmamūrte brahmatejovivardhana || 62 ||
meaning:
प्रदाने कृष्णसारस्य मन्त्रोऽयं परिकीर्तितः |
कृष्णसार ब्रह्ममूर्ते ब्रह्मतेजोविवर्धन || 62 ||
text_mt:
In the offering of the blackbuck, this mantra is proclaimed:
“O blackbuck, embodiment of Brahman, enhancer of the splendor of Brahman,

sanskrit_iast:
caturvedamayaṃ prājña prajñāṃ dehi yaśo mahat |
tathā śarabhapūjāyāṃ mantrametat prakīrtitam || 63 ||
meaning:
चतुर्वेदमयं प्राज्ञ प्रज्ञां देहि यशो महत् |
तथा शरभपूजायां मन्त्रमेतत् प्रकीर्तितम् || 63 ||
text_mt:
composed of the four Vedas, O wise one, grant wisdom and great renown!”
Likewise, in the worship of the śarabha, this mantra is proclaimed:

sanskrit_iast:
tvamaṣṭapādo vibhraṣṭacandrabhāgasamudbhava |
aṣṭamūrte mahābāho bhairavākhya namo'stu te || 64 ||
meaning:
त्वमष्टपादो विभ्रष्टचन्द्रभागसमुद्भव |
अष्टमूर्ते महाबाहो भैरवाख्य नमोऽस्तु ते || 64 ||
text_mt:
“You have eight legs, born from a fallen portion of the moon;
O eight-formed one of mighty arms, named Bhairava, homage be to you!

sanskrit_iast:
yathā bhairavarūpeṇa varāho nihatastvayā |
tathā śarabharūpeṇa ripūn vighnān niṣūdaya || 65 ||
meaning:
यथा भैरवरूपेण वराहो निहतस्त्वया |
तथा शरभरूपेण रिपून् विघ्नान् निषूदय || 65 ||
text_mt:
Just as the boar was slain by you in the form of Bhairava,
so in the form of a śarabha slay my enemies and obstacles!

sanskrit_iast:
haristvaṃ hararūpeṇa yathā vahasi caṇḍikām |
tathā śubhāni me nityaṃ bahuvighnāṃśca sūdaya || 66 ||
meaning:
हरिस्त्वं हररूपेण यथा वहसि चण्डिकाम् |
तथा शुभानि मे नित्यं बहुविघ्नांश्च सूदय || 66 ||
text_mt:
You are Hari in the form of Hara; just as you carry Caṇḍikā,
so always bring me blessings and slay my many obstacles!”

sanskrit_iast:
tvaṃ hariḥ siṃharūpeṇa jagatpratyūharūpiṇam |
jaghāna yena satyena hiraṇyakaśipuṃ haran || 67 ||
meaning:
त्वं हरिः सिंहरूपेण जगत्प्रत्यूहरूपिणम् |
जघान येन सत्येन हिरण्यकशिपुं हरन् || 67 ||
text_mt:
“You are Hari in the form of a lion, who, destroying [him],
slew Hiraṇyakaśipu, the embodiment of obstacles to the world, by virtue of which truth—”

sanskrit_iast:
ityevaṃ siṃhapūjāyāṃ krama ukto mayānagha |
nare svagātrarudhire paryāyaṃ śṛṇu bhairava || 68 ||
meaning:
इत्येवं सिंहपूजायां क्रम उक्तो मयानघ |
नरे स्वगात्ररुधिरे पर्यायं शृणु भैरव || 68 ||
text_mt:
Thus has the procedure for the worship of the lion been spoken by me, O sinless one.
Listen now, O Bhairava, to the procedure regarding a human being and blood from one’s own body.

sanskrit_iast:
pīṭhe ced dīyate martyo baliṃ dadyāt śmaśānake |
śmaśānaṃ herukākhyaṃ tu tatpūrvaṃ pratipāditam || 69 ||
meaning:
पीठे चेद् दीयते मर्त्यो बलिं दद्यात् श्मशानके |
श्मशानं हेरुकाख्यं तु तत्पूर्वं प्रतिपादितम् || 69 ||
text_mt:
If a mortal is offered at a sacred seat, one should offer the victim in a cremation ground.
The cremation ground named Heruka was previously explained.

sanskrit_iast:
kāmākhyānilaye śaile oḍādau viddhi tat kramam |
mama rūpaṃ śmaśānaṃ tad bhairavākhyaṃ ca kathyate || 70 ||
meaning:
कामाख्यानिलये शैले ओडादौ विद्धि तत् क्रमम् |
मम रूपं श्मशानं तद् भैरवाख्यं च कथ्यते || 70 ||
text_mt:
Know that sequence on the mountain that is the abode of Kāmākhyā, in Oḍa and so forth.
That cremation ground is my own form, and it is called Bhairava.

sanskrit_iast:
tatrāṅgatvaṃ tapaḥsiddhau tribhāgāṃ tu bhaviṣyati |
pūrvāṅge bhairavākhye tu samutsṛṣṭirnarasya tu || 71 ||
meaning:
तत्राङ्गत्वं तपःसिद्धौ त्रिभागां तु भविष्यति |
पूर्वाङ्गे भैरवाख्ये तु समुत्सृष्टिर्नरस्य तु || 71 ||
text_mt:
Its being a constituent part will be divided into three portions for the attainment of ascetic power;
in the eastern part, called Bhairava, the release of the man [takes place].

sanskrit_iast:
dakṣiṇāṅge śiro dadyād bhairavyā muṇḍamālayā |
rudhiraṃ paścimāṅge tu herukākhye niyojayet || 72 ||
meaning:
दक्षिणाङ्गे शिरो दद्याद् भैरव्या मुण्डमालया |
रुधिरं पश्चिमाङ्गे तु हेरुकाख्ये नियोजयेत् || 72 ||
text_mt:
In the southern part one should offer the head to Bhairavī with a garland of skulls;
in the western part, called Heruka, one should direct the blood.

sanskrit_iast:
dattvā sampūjya tu naraṃ visṛjyāgamanakrame |
pīṭhaśmaśāneṣu baliṃ nekṣettu balidīpakam || 73 ||
meaning:
दत्त्वा सम्पूज्य तु नरं विसृज्यागमनक्रमे |
पीठश्मशानेषु बलिं नेक्षेत्तु बलिदीपकम् || 73 ||
text_mt:
Having offered and worshiped the man, having released him in the order of his departure,
one must not look upon the victim in the cremation grounds of the sacred seats, nor upon the lamp for the victim.

sanskrit_iast:
anyatrāpi yato yatra dīyate yanmahābaliḥ |
tatrāpyanyatra cotsṛjyacchitvānyatra śiro'mṛtam || 74 ||
meaning:
अन्यत्रापि यतो यत्र दीयते यन्महाबलिः |
तत्राप्यन्यत्र चोत्सृज्यच्छित्वान्यत्र शिरोऽमृतम् || 74 ||
text_mt:
Elsewhere as well, wherever that great victim is offered,
having released it there too in another place, having severed its immortal head in another place,

sanskrit_iast:
niyojayet sādhakastu visṛjya na vilokayet |
sasnātaṃ manujaṃ dīptaṃ pūrvāhṇaniyatāśanam || 75 ||
meaning:
नियोजयेत् साधकस्तु विसृज्य न विलोकयेत् |
सस्नातं मनुजं दीप्तं पूर्वाह्णनियताशनम् || 75 ||
text_mt:
the practitioner should offer it, and having released it, must not look [back].
A human being who has bathed, is radiant, who ate a restricted meal in the forenoon,

sanskrit_iast:
māṃsamaithunabhogyena hīnaṃ srakcandanokṣitam |
kṛtvottarāmukhaṃ taṃ tu tadaṅgeṣvaṅgadevatāḥ || 76 ||
meaning:
मांसमैथुनभोग्येन हीनं स्रक्चन्दनोक्षितम् |
कृत्वोत्तरामुखं तं तु तदङ्गेष्वङ्गदेवताः || 76 ||
text_mt:
free from indulgence in meat and sexual intercourse, sprinkled with garlands and sandalwood paste—
having made him face the north, upon his limbs [one should worship] the subordinate deities.

sanskrit_iast:
pūjayet taṃ tu nāmnā tu daivatena ca mānuṣam |
tadbrahmarandhre brahmāṇaṃ tannāsāyāṃ ca medinīm || 77 ||
meaning:
पूजयेत् तं तु नाम्ना तु दैवतेन च मानुषम् |
तद्ब्रह्मरन्ध्रे ब्रह्माणं तन्नासायां च मेदिनीम् || 77 ||
text_mt:
One should worship that human being with the name and the deity:
Brahmā in his cranial aperture, and the earth in his nose,

sanskrit_iast:
karṇayostu tathākāśaṃ jihvāyāṃ sarvatomukham |
jyotīṃṣi netrayorviṣṇuṃ vadane paripūjayet || 78 ||
meaning:
कर्णयोस्तु तथाकाशं जिह्वायां सर्वतोमुखम् |
ज्योतींषि नेत्रयोर्विष्णुं वदने परिपूजयेत् || 78 ||
text_mt:
space in his ears, Sarvatomukha on his tongue,
the luminaries in his eyes, and Viṣṇu in his mouth one should worship.

sanskrit_iast:
lalāṭe pūjayeccandraṃ śakraṃ dakṣiṇagaṇḍataḥ |
vāmagaṇḍe tathā vahniṃ grīvāyāṃ samavartinam || 79 ||
meaning:
ललाटे पूजयेच्चन्द्रं शक्रं दक्षिणगण्डतः |
वामगण्डे तथा वह्निं ग्रीवायां समवर्तिनम् || 79 ||
text_mt:
On his forehead one should worship the moon, Indra on his right cheek,
likewise Agni on his left cheek, and Yama on his neck.

sanskrit_iast:
keśāgre nir-ṛtiṃ madhye bhrūvoścāpi pracetasam |
nāsāmūle tu śvasanaṃ skandha cāpi dhaneśvaram || 80 ||
meaning:
केशाग्रे निर्-ऋतिं मध्ये भ्रूवोश्चापि प्रचेतसम् |
नासामूले तु श्वसनं स्कन्ध चापि धनेश्वरम् || 80 ||
text_mt:
Nirṛti at the tip of his hair, Pracetas between his eyebrows,
Vāyu at the root of his nose, and Kubera on his shoulder.

sanskrit_iast:
hṛdaye sarparājaṃ tu pūjayitvā paṭhedidam |
naravaryaṃ mahābhāga sarvadevamayottama || 81 ||
meaning:
हृदये सर्पराजं तु पूजयित्वा पठेदिदम् |
नरवर्यं महाभाग सर्वदेवमयोत्तम || 81 ||
text_mt:
Having worshiped the king of serpents in his heart, one should recite this:
“O best of men, O blessed one, supreme one embodying all the gods,

sanskrit_iast:
rakṣa māṃ śaraṇāpannaṃ saputrapaśubāndhavam |
sarājyaṃ māṃ sahāmātyaṃ caturaṅga samanvitam || 82 ||
meaning:
रक्ष मां शरणापन्नं सपुत्रपशुबान्धवम् |
सराज्यं मां सहामात्यं चतुरङ्ग समन्वितम् || 82 ||
text_mt:
protect me who have sought refuge, together with my sons, cattle, and kin,
together with my kingdom, with my ministers, endowed with the fourfold army!

sanskrit_iast:
rakṣa parityajya prāṇānmaraṇe niyate sati |
mahātapobhirjñānaiśca yajñairyat sādhyate'mṛtam || 83 ||
meaning:
रक्ष परित्यज्य प्राणान्मरणे नियते सति |
महातपोभिर्ज्ञानैश्च यज्ञैर्यत् साध्यतेऽमृतम् || 83 ||
text_mt:
Protect [me], abandoning your vital breaths when death is predetermined!
That immortality which is attained by great austerities, by knowledge, and by sacrifices,

sanskrit_iast:
tanme dehi mahābhāga tvaṃ cāpi prāpnuhi śriyam |
rākṣasāśca piśācāśca vetālādyāḥ sarīsṛpāḥ || 84 ||
meaning:
तन्मे देहि महाभाग त्वं चापि प्राप्नुहि श्रियम् |
राक्षसाश्च पिशाचाश्च वेतालाद्याः सरीसृपाः || 84 ||
text_mt:
grant that to me, O fortunate one, and do you also attain glory!
Let rākṣasas, piśācas, vetālas and the like, reptiles,

sanskrit_iast:
nṛpāśca ripavaścānye na māṃ te dhnantu tvatkṛte |
tvatkaṇṭhanālagalitaiḥ śoṇitairaṅgasaṃyutaiḥ || 85 ||
meaning:
नृपाश्च रिपवश्चान्ये न मां ते ध्नन्तु त्वत्कृते |
त्वत्कण्ठनालगलितैः शोणितैरङ्गसंयुतैः || 85 ||
text_mt:
kings, and other enemies not slay me, for your sake!
By the blood flowing from your throat, united with your limbs,

sanskrit_iast:
āpyāyasvātmavanmṛtvā maraṇe niyate sati |
evaṃ sampūjya vidhivat pūrvatantraiśca pūjayet || 86 ||
meaning:
आप्यायस्वात्मवन्मृत्वा मरणे नियते सति |
एवं सम्पूज्य विधिवत् पूर्वतन्त्रैश्च पूजयेत् || 86 ||
text_mt:
rejoice, possessing yourself, having died when death is predetermined!”
Having thus worshiped him according to rule, one should worship him with the earlier procedures.

sanskrit_iast:
pūjito matsvarūpo'yaṃ dikpālādhiṣṭhito bhavet |
adhiṣṭhitastathānyaiśca brahmādyaiḥ sakalaiḥ suraiḥ || 87 ||
meaning:
पूजितो मत्स्वरूपोऽयं दिक्पालाधिष्ठितो भवेत् |
अधिष्ठितस्तथान्यैश्च ब्रह्माद्यैः सकलैः सुरैः || 87 ||
text_mt:
Worshiped, he becomes my own form, presided over by the guardians of the directions,
and presided over by all the other gods, Brahmā and the rest.

sanskrit_iast:
kṛtapāpo'pi manujo niṣpāpmā sa tu jāyate |
tasya niṣkaluṣasyāśu pīyūṣaṃ śoṇitaṃ bhavet || 88 ||
meaning:
कृतपापोऽपि मनुजो निष्पाप्मा स तु जायते |
तस्य निष्कलुषस्याशु पीयूषं शोणितं भवेत् || 88 ||
text_mt:
Even if he has committed sin, that human being becomes sinless;
and for him who is purified, his blood immediately becomes nectar.

sanskrit_iast:
prīṇāti ca mahādevī jaganmātā jaganmayī |
so'pi kāyaṃ parityajya mānuṣaṃ nacirānmṛtaḥ || 89 ||
meaning:
प्रीणाति च महादेवी जगन्माता जगन्मयी |
सोऽपि कायं परित्यज्य मानुषं नचिरान्मृतः || 89 ||
text_mt:
And the Great Goddess, the mother of the universe, who consists of the universe, is pleased;
he too, having abandoned his human body, dead before long,

sanskrit_iast:
bhaved gaṇānāmadhipo mayāpi bahusatkṛtaḥ |
ito'nyathā pāpayuktaṃ malamūtravasāyutam || 90 ||
meaning:
भवेद् गणानामधिपो मयापि बहुसत्कृतः |
इतोऽन्यथा पापयुक्तं मलमूत्रवसायुतम् || 90 ||
text_mt:
becomes a lord of the gaṇas, greatly honored even by me.
Otherwise than this, full of sin, filled with feces, urine, and fat,

sanskrit_iast:
taṃ baliṃ na hi gṛhṇāti kāmākhyānyāpi nāmataḥ |
anyeṣāṃ mahiṣādīnāṃ balīnāmatha pūjanāt || 91 ||
meaning:
तं बलिं न हि गृह्णाति कामाख्यान्यापि नामतः |
अन्येषां महिषादीनां बलीनामथ पूजनात् || 91 ||
text_mt:
Kāmākhyā or any other [goddess] by name does not accept that victim.
However, from the worship of other victims, beginning with buffaloes,

sanskrit_iast:
kāyo medhyatvamāyāti raktaṃ gṛhṇāti vai śivā |
anyebhyo'pi ca devebhyo yadā yattu pradīyate || 92 ||
meaning:
कायो मेध्यत्वमायाति रक्तं गृह्णाति वै शिवा |
अन्येभ्योऽपि च देवेभ्यो यदा यत्तु प्रदीयते || 92 ||
text_mt:
the body attains sacrificial purity, and Śivā indeed accepts the blood.
Furthermore, whatever is offered to other deities,

sanskrit_iast:
tadarcitaṃ rpadadyāt tu pūjitāya surāya vai |
kāṇaṃ paṅguṃ cātivṛddhaṃ rogiṇaṃ ca galadvraṇam || 93 ||
meaning:
तदर्चितं र्पदद्यात् तु पूजिताय सुराय वै |
काणं पङ्गुं चातिवृद्धं रोगिणं च गलद्व्रणम् || 93 ||
text_mt:
one should offer that consecrated to the worshiped deity.
One who is blind in one eye, lame, very old, diseased, or with a running sore,

sanskrit_iast:
klībaṃ hīnāṅgamathavā vṛddhaliṅgaṃ kulakṣaṇam |
śvitriṇaṃ cātihrasvaṃ ca mahāpātakinaṃ tathā || 94 ||
meaning:
क्लीबं हीनाङ्गमथवा वृद्धलिङ्गं कुलक्षणम् |
श्वित्रिणं चातिह्रस्वं च महापातकिनं तथा || 94 ||
text_mt:
impotent, deficient in limb, or with an enlarged phallus, of inauspicious marks,
affected by white leprosy, extremely dwarfish, or guilty of a mortal sin,

sanskrit_iast:
advādaśakavarṣīyaṃ śiśu sūtakasaṃyutam |
ūrdhvaṃ saṃvatsarāccāpi mahāgurunipātinam || 95 ||
meaning:
अद्वादशकवर्षीयं शिशु सूतकसंयुतम् |
ऊर्ध्वं संवत्सराच्चापि महागुरुनिपातिनम् || 95 ||
text_mt:
under twelve years of age, a child affected by birth pollution,
or even after one year, one who has slain a supreme elder—

sanskrit_iast:
balikarmaṇi cetāṃstu varjayet pūjitānapi |
paśūnāṃ pakṣiṇāṃ vāpi narāṇāṃ ca viśeṣataḥ || 96 ||
meaning:
बलिकर्मणि चेतांस्तु वर्जयेत् पूजितानपि |
पशूनां पक्षिणां वापि नराणां च विशेषतः || 96 ||
text_mt:
these one must avoid in the sacrificial rite, even if they have been worshiped,
among beasts or birds, and especially among human beings.

sanskrit_iast:
striyaṃ na dadyāt tu balīn dattvā narakamāpnuyāt |
saṅghātavalidāneṣu yoṣitaṃ paśupakṣiṇaḥ || 97 ||
meaning:
स्त्रियं न दद्यात् तु बलीन् दत्त्वा नरकमाप्नुयात् |
सङ्घातवलिदानेषु योषितं पशुपक्षिणः || 97 ||
text_mt:
One must not offer a female as a victim; by offering [one], a person would attain hell.
In collective offerings of victims, a female beast or bird

sanskrit_iast:
baliṃ dadyānmānuṣīṃ tu tyaktvā saṅghātapūjitam |
na trimāsīyakānyūnaṃ paśuṃ dadyācchivābalim || 98 ||
meaning:
बलिं दद्यान्मानुषीं तु त्यक्त्वा सङ्घातपूजितम् |
न त्रिमासीयकान्यूनं पशुं दद्याच्छिवाबलिम् || 98 ||
text_mt:
one may offer as a victim, but leaving aside a human female worshiped in a group.
One must not offer a beast less than three months old as a sacrifice to Śivā,

sanskrit_iast:
na ca traipakṣikān nyūna pradadyād vai patattriṇam |
kāṇavyaṅgādiduṣṭaṃ tu na paśuṃ pakṣiṇaṃ tathā || 99 ||
meaning:
न च त्रैपक्षिकान् न्यून प्रदद्याद् वै पतत्त्रिणम् |
काणव्यङ्गादिदुष्टं तु न पशुं पक्षिणं तथा || 99 ||
text_mt:
nor should one offer a bird less than three fortnights old.
A beast or a bird that is defective, such as being blind in one eye or mutilated,

sanskrit_iast:
devyai dadyāt tathā martyaṃ tathaiva paśupakṣiṇau |
chinnalāṅgūlakarṇādīn bhagnadantāṃstathaiva ca || 100 ||
meaning:
देव्यै दद्यात् तथा मर्त्यं तथैव पशुपक्षिणौ |
छिन्नलाङ्गूलकर्णादीन् भग्नदन्तांस्तथैव च || 100 ||
text_mt:
one should not offer to the Goddess, nor such a mortal, nor such a beast or bird;
likewise those with severed tails, ears, and so forth, and those with broken teeth,

sanskrit_iast:
bhagnaśṛṅgādikaṃ vāpi na dadyāt tu kadācana |
na brāhmaṇaṃ baliṃ dadyāccāṇḍālamapi pārthiva || 101 ||
meaning:
भग्नशृङ्गादिकं वापि न दद्यात् तु कदाचन |
न ब्राह्मणं बलिं दद्याच्चाण्डालमपि पार्थिव || 101 ||
text_mt:
or those with broken horns and the like, one must never offer.
One must not offer a brāhmaṇa as a victim, nor a cāṇḍāla, O king,

sanskrit_iast:
notsṛṣṭaṃ dvijadevebhyo bhūpatestanayaṃ tathā |
raṇena vijitaṃ dadyāttanayaṃ ripubhūbhṛtaḥ || 102 ||
meaning:
नोत्सृष्टं द्विजदेवेभ्यो भूपतेस्तनयं तथा |
रणेन विजितं दद्यात्तनयं रिपुभूभृतः || 102 ||
text_mt:
nor one dedicated to the twice-born or to the gods, nor the son of a king;
one may, however, offer the son of an enemy king conquered in battle.

sanskrit_iast:
svaputraṃ bhrātaraṃ vāpi pitaraṃ cāvirodhinam |
viṭpatiṃ ca na dadyāttu bhāgineyaṃ ca mātulam || 103 ||
meaning:
स्वपुत्रं भ्रातरं वापि पितरं चाविरोधिनम् |
विट्पतिं च न दद्यात्तु भागिनेयं च मातुलम् || 103 ||
text_mt: Nor should one give one's own son, brother, or harmless father; / one should not give the householder, one's sister's son, or maternal uncle.

sanskrit_iast:
anuktānnāpi dadyāt tu tathājñātān mṛgadvijān |
uktālābhe pradadyāttu gardabhaṃ coṣṭrameva ca || 104 ||
meaning:
अनुक्तान्नापि दद्यात् तु तथाज्ञातान् मृगद्विजान् |
उक्तालाभे प्रदद्यात्तु गर्दभं चोष्ट्रमेव च || 104 ||
text_mt: Nor should one give unprescribed beasts and birds, or those unknown; / in the absence of prescribed ones, however, one may offer a donkey or camel.

sanskrit_iast:
lābhe'nyeṣāṃ na vitared vyāghramuṣṭraṃ kharaṃ tathā |
sampūjya vidhivanmartyaṃ paśuṃ pakṣiṇameva vā || 105 ||
meaning:
लाभेऽन्येषां न वितरेद् व्याघ्रमुष्ट्रं खरं तथा |
सम्पूज्य विधिवन्मर्त्यं पशुं पक्षिणमेव वा || 105 ||
text_mt: If others are available, one should not offer a tiger, camel, or donkey. / Having properly worshipped a human, animal, or bird,

sanskrit_iast:
sañchinnaṃ cāpi mantreṇa mantreṇaiva nivedayet |
nāraṃ martyaśiroraktaṃ devyāḥ samyag nivedayet || 106 ||
meaning:
सञ्छिन्नं चापि मन्त्रेण मन्त्रेणैव निवेदयेत् |
नारं मर्त्यशिरोरक्तं देव्याः सम्यग् निवेदयेत् || 106 ||
text_mt: severed with the mantra, one should offer it with the mantra itself. / One should properly offer human blood from a man's head to the goddess.

sanskrit_iast:
chāgaṃ tu vāmato dadyānmāhiṣaṃ vitaret puraḥ |
pakṣiṇaṃ vāmato dadyādagrato dehaśoṇitam || 107 ||
meaning:
छागं तु वामतो दद्यान्माहिषं वितरेत् पुरः |
पक्षिणं वामतो दद्यादग्रतो देहशोणितम् || 107 ||
text_mt: One should offer a goat on the left, and present a buffalo in front; / one should offer a bird on the left, and bodily blood directly in front.

sanskrit_iast:
kravyādānāṃ paśūnāṃ tu pakṣiṇāṃ tu śiro'sṛjam |
vāme nivedayet pārśve jalajānāṃ ca sarvaśaḥ || 108 ||
meaning:
क्रव्यादानां पशूनां तु पक्षिणां तु शिरोऽसृजम् |
वामे निवेदयेत् पार्श्वे जलजानां च सर्वशः || 108 ||
text_mt: The head-blood of carnivorous animals and of birds, / and of aquatic creatures, one should offer entirely on the left side.

sanskrit_iast:
kṛṣṇasārasya kūrmasya khaḍgasya śaśakasya ca |
grāhāṇāmatha matsyānāmagra eva nivedayet || 109 ||
meaning:
कृष्णसारस्य कूर्मस्य खड्गस्य शशकस्य च |
ग्राहाणामथ मत्स्यानामग्र एव निवेदयेत् || 109 ||
text_mt: For the blackbuck, turtle, rhinoceros, and hare, / and for alligators and fish, one should offer it only in front.

sanskrit_iast:
siṃhasya dakṣiṇe dadyāt khaḍgino'pi ca dakṣiṇe |
pṛṣṭhadeśe na dadyāt tu śiro vā rudhiraṃ valeḥ || 110 ||
meaning:
सिंहस्य दक्षिणे दद्यात् खड्गिनोऽपि च दक्षिणे |
पृष्ठदेशे न दद्यात् तु शिरो वा रुधिरं वलेः || 110 ||
text_mt: For a lion one should offer on the right, and for a rhinoceros also on the right; / one should not place the head or blood of the victim behind.

sanskrit_iast:
naivedyaṃ dakṣiṇe vāme purato ne tu pṛṣṭhataḥ |
dīpaṃ dakṣiṇato dadyāt purato vā na vāmataḥ || 111 ||
meaning:
नैवेद्यं दक्षिणे वामे पुरतो ने तु पृष्ठतः |
दीपं दक्षिणतो दद्यात् पुरतो वा न वामतः || 111 ||
text_mt: Food offering is on the right, on the left, or in front, but not behind; / one should place a lamp on the right or in front, not on the left.

sanskrit_iast:
vāmatastu tathā dhūpamagre vā na tu dakṣiṇe |
nivedayeta purobhāge gandhaṃ puṣpaṃ ca bhūṣaṇam || 112 ||
meaning:
वामतस्तु तथा धूपमग्रे वा न तु दक्षिणे |
निवेदयेत पुरोभागे गन्धं पुष्पं च भूषणम् || 112 ||
text_mt: Incense likewise on the left or in front, but not on the right; / one should offer perfume, flowers, and ornaments in front.

sanskrit_iast:
maṇḍale cenmadhyabhāge vāmadakṣādipūrvavat |
madirāṃ pṛṣṭhato dadyādanyat pānaṃ tu vāmataḥ || 113 ||
meaning:
मण्डले चेन्मध्यभागे वामदक्षादिपूर्ववत् |
मदिरां पृष्ठतो दद्यादन्यत् पानं तु वामतः || 113 ||
text_mt: If in a maṇḍala, [it is] in the central part, with left and right as before; / one should place wine behind, but any other drink on the left.

sanskrit_iast:
avaśyaṃ vihita yatra madyaṃ tatra dvijaḥ punaḥ |
nārikelajalaṃ kāṃsye tāmre vā visṛjenmadhu || 114 ||
meaning:
अवश्यं विहित यत्र मद्यं तत्र द्विजः पुनः |
नारिकेलजलं कांस्ये ताम्रे वा विसृजेन्मधु || 114 ||
text_mt: Where liquor is strictly enjoined, there a twice-born [worshipper] / should offer coconut water in bell-metal, or honey in copper.

sanskrit_iast:
nāpadyapi dvijo madyaṃ kadācid visṛjedapi |
ṛte puṣpāsavāduktāda gṛñjanād vā viśeṣataḥ || 115 ||
meaning:
नापद्यपि द्विजो मद्यं कदाचिद् विसृजेदपि |
ऋते पुष्पासवादुक्ताद गृञ्जनाद् वा विशेषतः || 115 ||
text_mt: Even in an emergency, a twice-born should never offer liquor, / except flower-liquor as prescribed, or especially [liquor] made from carrots.

sanskrit_iast:
rājaputrastathāmātyaḥ sacivaḥ sauptikādayaḥ |
dadyurnarabaliṃ bhūpa sampattyai vibhavāya ca || 116 ||
meaning:
राजपुत्रस्तथामात्यः सचिवः सौप्तिकादयः |
दद्युर्नरबलिं भूप सम्पत्त्यै विभवाय च || 116 ||
text_mt: A prince, minister, counselor, superintendent of the bedchamber, and the like, / may offer a human sacrifice, O king, for prosperity and power.

sanskrit_iast:
nṛpānanumate martyaṃ dattvā pāpamavāpnuyāt |
upaplave raṇe vāpi yathecchaṃ vitarennaram || 117 ||
meaning:
नृपाननुमते मर्त्यं दत्त्वा पापमवाप्नुयात् |
उपप्लवे रणे वापि यथेच्छं वितरेन्नरम् || 117 ||
text_mt: By offering a human without the king's permission, one incurs sin; / during a calamity or in war, however, one may offer a human as desired.

sanskrit_iast:
yaḥ kaścidrājapuruṣo nānyastvapi kadācana |
balidānadināt pūrvaṃ divase tu baliṃ naram || 118 ||
meaning:
यः कश्चिद्राजपुरुषो नान्यस्त्वपि कदाचन |
बलिदानदिनात् पूर्वं दिवसे तु बलिं नरम् || 118 ||
text_mt: Whosoever is a king's man, and never any other, [may do so]. / On the day prior to the day of offering the victim, the human victim,

sanskrit_iast:
mānastoketi mantreṇa devīsūktena yena ca |
gandhadvāretyanenāpi khaḍgaṃ śīrṣe nidhāya ca || 119 ||
meaning:
मानस्तोकेति मन्त्रेण देवीसूक्तेन येन च |
गन्धद्वारेत्यनेनापि खड्गं शीर्षे निधाय च || 119 ||
text_mt: with the mantra 'Mā nastoke', and with the Devīsūkta, / and with 'Gandhadvārā', placing the sword upon his head,

sanskrit_iast:
tasmin khaḍge sugandhādi dattvā tenādhivāsayet |
gandhādikaṃ tu khaḍgasthaṃ gale tasya pradāpayet || 120 ||
meaning:
तस्मिन् खड्गे सुगन्धादि दत्त्वा तेनाधिवासयेत् |
गन्धादिकं तु खड्गस्थं गले तस्य प्रदापयेत् || 120 ||
text_mt: and applying sweet perfume to that sword, one should consecrate [him] with it; / one should apply perfume and the like from the sword onto his neck,

sanskrit_iast:
ambe'mbiketi mantreṇa raudreṇa bhairavasya ca |
evaṃ tu saṃskṛte martye devī rakṣati taṃ balim || 121 ||
meaning:
अम्बेऽम्बिकेति मन्त्रेण रौद्रेण भैरवस्य च |
एवं तु संस्कृते मर्त्ये देवी रक्षति तं बलिम् || 121 ||
text_mt: with the mantra 'Ambe ambike' and the Raudra mantra of Bhairava. / When the human is thus consecrated, the goddess protects that victim.

sanskrit_iast:
na tasya vyādhayaścāpi kṣuṇṇatārajasī na ca |
na sūtakaṃ dūṣayettajjñātyutpattimṛtādikam || 122 ||
meaning:
न तस्य व्याधयश्चापि क्षुण्णतारजसी न च |
न सूतकं दूषयेत्तज्ज्ञात्युत्पत्तिमृतादिकम् || 122 ||
text_mt: Neither diseases nor trampled dust [afflict] him, / nor does ritual impurity, such as the birth or death of kin, defile him.

sanskrit_iast:
chinnaṃ narasya śīrṣaṃ tu patitaṃ yatra yatra ca |
yacchubhaṃ cāśubhaṃ vāpi paśvādīnāṃ ca tacchṛṇu || 123 ||
meaning:
छिन्नं नरस्य शीर्षं तु पतितं यत्र यत्र च |
यच्छुभं चाशुभं वापि पश्वादीनां च तच्छृणु || 123 ||
text_mt: Wherever the severed head of the human falls, / hear the good or evil [indicated], and likewise for beasts and the rest.

sanskrit_iast:
chinnaṃ śirastathaiśānyāṃ nāraṃ diśyatha rākṣase |
patitaṃ rājyahāniṃ ca vināśaṃ ca vinirdiśet || 124 ||
meaning:
छिन्नं शिरस्तथैशान्यां नारं दिश्यथ राक्षसे |
पतितं राज्यहानिं च विनाशं च विनिर्दिशेत् || 124 ||
text_mt: If the severed human head falls in the north-east or south-west direction, / one should foretell loss of the kingdom and destruction.

sanskrit_iast:
pūrvāgniyāmyavāruṇya-vāyavyādigataṃ kramāt |
śriyaṃ puṣṭiṃ bhayaṃ lābhaṃ putralābhaṃ dhanaṃ tathā || 125 ||
meaning:
पूर्वाग्नियाम्यवारुण्य-वायव्यादिगतं क्रमात् |
श्रियं पुष्टिं भयं लाभं पुत्रलाभं धनं तथा || 125 ||
text_mt: Falling in the east, south-east, south, west, / and north-west sequentially, [it portends] / prosperity, nourishment, fear, gain, obtainment of a son, and wealth.

sanskrit_iast:
kramād vinirdiśennāraṃ chinnaśīrṣaṃ tu bhairava |
uttarādikramādeva mahiṣasyāpi mastakaḥ || 126 ||
meaning:
क्रमाद् विनिर्दिशेन्नारं छिन्नशीर्षं तु भैरव |
उत्तरादिक्रमादेव महिषस्यापि मस्तकः || 126 ||
text_mt: One should sequentially foretell [these] from the severed human head, O Bhairava. / Likewise, for the head of a buffalo, beginning from the north,

sanskrit_iast:
patito vāyukāṣṭhānte sūcayed yacchṛṇuṣva tat |
bhāgyaṃ hānintathaiśvarya vittaṃ ripujayaṃ bhayam || 127 ||
meaning:
पतितो वायुकाष्ठान्ते सूचयेद् यच्छृणुष्व तत् |
भाग्यं हानिन्तथैश्वर्य वित्तं रिपुजयं भयम् || 127 ||
text_mt: ending at the north-west quarter, hear what it indicates when fallen: / good fortune, loss, sovereignty, wealth, victory over enemies, fear,

sanskrit_iast:
rājyalābhaṃ śriyaṃ cāpi kramād viddhi tu bhairava |
paśūnāṃ caiva sarveṣāṃ chāgādīnāmaśeṣataḥ || 128 ||
meaning:
राज्यलाभं श्रियं चापि क्रमाद् विद्धि तु भैरव |
पशूनां चैव सर्वेषां छागादीनामशेषतः || 128 ||
text_mt: gain of a kingdom, and prosperity sequentially, know this, O Bhairava. / For all animals, goats and all the rest without exception,

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ phalaṃ kramād vidyādṛte jalajavāṇḍajau |
jalajānāṃ pakṣiṇāṃ tu yāmyanair-ṛtyayorbhayam || 129 ||
meaning:
एवं फलं क्रमाद् विद्यादृते जलजवाण्डजौ |
जलजानां पक्षिणां तु याम्यनैर्-ऋत्ययोर्भयम् || 129 ||
text_mt: one should know the result sequentially in this manner, except for aquatic and oviparous [creatures]. / For aquatic creatures and birds, in the south and south-west [it brings] fear;

sanskrit_iast:
anyatra tu śriyaṃ dadyāt patitaṃ śātitaṃ śiraḥ |
yaḥ syāt kaṭakaṭāśabdo dantānāṃ chinnamastake || 130 ||
meaning:
अन्यत्र तु श्रियं दद्यात् पतितं शातितं शिरः |
यः स्यात् कटकटाशब्दो दन्तानां छिन्नमस्तके || 130 ||
