सिरः कामेश्वरी देवी कामाख्या चक्षुषी मम |
सारदा कर्णयुगलं त्रिपुरावदनं तथा || 47 ||
text_mt: May the goddess Kāmeśvarī protect my head, Kāmākhyā my two eyes, / Śāradā my two ears, and Tripurā my face.

sanskrit_iast:
kaṇṭhe pātu mahāmāyā hṛdi kāmeśvarī punaḥ |
kāmākhyā jaṭhare pātu śāradā māṃ tu nābhitaḥ || 48 ||
meaning:
कण्ठे पातु महामाया हृदि कामेश्वरी पुनः |
कामाख्या जठरे पातु शारदा मां तु नाभितः || 48 ||
text_mt: May Mahāmāyā protect [me] at the throat, Kāmeśvarī again at the heart, / Kāmākhyā in the belly, and Śāradā protect me from the navel.

sanskrit_iast:
tripurā pārśvayoḥ pātu mahāmāyā tu mehane |
gude kāmeśvarī pātu kāmākhyoruddhaye tu mām || 49 ||
meaning:
त्रिपुरा पार्श्वयोः पातु महामाया तु मेहने |
गुदे कामेश्वरी पातु कामाख्योरुद्धये तु माम् || 49 ||
text_mt: May Tripurā protect both flanks, and Mahāmāyā at the urinary organ; / may Kāmeśvarī protect at the anus, and Kāmākhyā me in both thighs.

sanskrit_iast:
jānunoḥ śāradā pātu tripurā pātu jaṅghayoḥ |
mahāmāyā pādayuge nityaṃ rakṣatu kāmadā || 50 ||
meaning:
जानुनोः शारदा पातु त्रिपुरा पातु जङ्घयोः |
महामाया पादयुगे नित्यं रक्षतु कामदा || 50 ||
text_mt: May Śāradā protect the two knees; may Tripurā protect both shanks; / may Mahāmāyā, grantor of desires, constantly protect both feet.

sanskrit_iast:
keśe koṭeśvarī pātu nāsāyāṃ pātu dīrghikā |
bhairavī dantasaṃghāte mātaṃgyavatu cāṅgayoḥ || 51 ||
meaning:
केशे कोटेश्वरी पातु नासायां पातु दीर्घिका |
भैरवी दन्तसंघाते मातंग्यवतु चाङ्गयोः || 51 ||
text_mt: May Koṭeśvarī protect [me] in the hair, may Dīrghikā protect in the nose, / Bhairavī in the rows of teeth, and may Mātaṅgī protect in both limbs.

sanskrit_iast:
bāhvormāṃ lalitā pātu pāṇyostu vanavāsinī |
vindhyavāsinyaṅguliṣu śrīkāmā nakhakoṭiṣu || 52 ||
meaning:
बाह्वोर्मां ललिता पातु पाण्योस्तु वनवासिनी |
विन्ध्यवासिन्यङ्गुलिषु श्रीकामा नखकोटिषु || 52 ||
text_mt: May Lalitā protect me in both arms, and Vanavāsinī in both hands; / Vindhyavāsinī in the fingers, Śrīkāmā on the tips of the nails.

sanskrit_iast:
romakūpeṣu sarveṣu guptakamā sadāvatu |
pādāṅgulipārṣṇibhāge pātu māṃ bhuvaneśvarī || 53 ||
meaning:
रोमकूपेषु सर्वेषु गुप्तकमा सदावतु |
पादाङ्गुलिपार्ष्णिभागे पातु मां भुवनेश्वरी || 53 ||
text_mt: May Guptakāmā always protect in all the pores of the skin; / may Bhuvaneśvarī protect me in the toes and the heels.

sanskrit_iast:
jihvāyāṃ pātu māṃ setuḥ kaḥ kaṇṭhābhyantare'vatu |
laḥ pātu cāntare vakṣa haḥ pātu jaṭharāntare || 54 ||
meaning:
जिह्वायां पातु मां सेतुः कः कण्ठाभ्यन्तरेऽवतु |
लः पातु चान्तरे वक्ष हः पातु जठरान्तरे || 54 ||
text_mt: May the Setu protect me on the tongue; may 'ka' protect inside the throat; / may 'la' protect inside the chest, and 'ha' inside the belly;

sanskrit_iast:
sāmīnduḥ pātu māṃ astāvindubindvantare'vatu |
akārastvaci māṃ pātu rakāro'sthiṣu sarvadā || 55 ||
meaning:
सामीन्दुः पातु मां अस्ताविन्दुबिन्द्वन्तरेऽवतु |
अकारस्त्वचि मां पातु रकारोऽस्थिषु सर्वदा || 55 ||
text_mt: may the half-moon protect me at sunset; may it protect inside the moon and bindu; / may the letter 'a' protect me in the skin, and the letter 'ra' always in the bones;

sanskrit_iast:
lakāraḥ sarvanāḍīṣu īkāraḥ sarvasandhiṣu |
candraḥ snāyuṣu māṃ pātu vindumajjāsu santatam || 56 ||
meaning:
लकारः सर्वनाडीषु ईकारः सर्वसन्धिषु |
चन्द्रः स्नायुषु मां पातु विन्दुमज्जासु सन्ततम् || 56 ||
text_mt: the letter 'la' in all the channels, the letter 'ī' in all the joints; / may the moon protect me in the sinews, and the bindu constantly in the marrow.

sanskrit_iast:
pūrvasyāṃ diśi cāgneyyāṃ dakṣiṇe nair-ṛte tathā |
vāru.en caiva vāyavyāṃ kaubere haramandire || 57 ||
meaning:
पूर्वस्यां दिशि चाग्नेय्यां दक्षिणे नैर्-ऋते तथा |
वारु.एन् चैव वायव्यां कौबेरे हरमन्दिरे || 57 ||
text_mt: In the eastern direction, in the southeast, in the south, in the southwest, / in the west, in the northwest, in the north, in the abode of Hara,

sanskrit_iast:
akārādyāstu vaiṣṇavyā aṣṭau varṇāstu mantragāḥ |
pāntu tiṣṭhantu satataṃ samudbhavavivṛddhaye || 58 ||
meaning:
अकाराद्यास्तु वैष्णव्या अष्टौ वर्णास्तु मन्त्रगाः |
पान्तु तिष्ठन्तु सततं समुद्भवविवृद्धये || 58 ||
text_mt: may the eight letters of Vaiṣṇavī, beginning with 'a', dwelling in the mantra, / protect [and] remain always for the increase of prosperity.

sanskrit_iast:
ūrdhvādhaḥ pātu satataṃ māṃ tu setudvayaṃ sadā |
navākṣarāṇi mantreṣu śāradāmantragocare || 59 ||
meaning:
ऊर्ध्वाधः पातु सततं मां तु सेतुद्वयं सदा |
नवाक्षराणि मन्त्रेषु शारदामन्त्रगोचरे || 59 ||
text_mt: May the two Setus always protect me above and below; / may the nine syllables in the mantras within the scope of the Śāradā mantra,

sanskrit_iast:
navasvaraṃ tu māṃ nityaṃ nāsādiṣu samantataḥ |
vātapittakaphebhyastu tripurāyāstu tryakṣaram || 60 ||
meaning:
नवस्वरं तु मां नित्यं नासादिषु समन्ततः |
वातपित्तकफेभ्यस्तु त्रिपुरायास्तु त्र्यक्षरम् || 60 ||
text_mt: the nine vowels constantly [protect] me on all sides, in the nose and other [organs], / from wind, bile, and phlegm; and may the three syllables of Tripurā

sanskrit_iast:
nityaṃ rakṣatu bhūtebhyaḥ piśācebhyastathaiva ca |
tatsetū satataṃpātāṃ kravyādbhyo mānnivārakau || 61 ||
meaning:
नित्यं रक्षतु भूतेभ्यः पिशाचेभ्यस्तथैव च |
तत्सेतू सततंपातां क्रव्याद्भ्यो मान्निवारकौ || 61 ||
text_mt: always protect from ghosts and likewise from piśācas; / may those two Setus, turning them away, constantly protect me from flesh-eating demons.

sanskrit_iast:
namaḥ kāmeśvarī devīṃ mahāmāyāṃ jaganmayīm |
yā bhūtvā prakṛtirnityaṃ tanoti jagadādyatām || 62 ||
meaning:
नमः कामेश्वरी देवीं महामायां जगन्मयीम् |
या भूत्वा प्रकृतिर्नित्यं तनोति जगदाद्यताम् || 62 ||
text_mt: Obeisance to the goddess Kāmeśvarī, Mahāmāyā, whose nature is the universe, / who, having become Prakṛti, constantly unfolds the primordial state of the world.

sanskrit_iast:
kāmākhyāmakṣamālābhayavaradakarāṃ siddhasūtraikahastāṃ-
śvetapretoparisthāṃ maṇikanakayutāṃ kuṅkumāpītavarṇām |
jñānadhyānapratiṣṭhāmatiśayavinayāṃ brahmaśakrādivandyāmagnau
bindvantamantrapriyatamaviṣayāṃ naumi siddhyai ratisthām || 63 ||
meaning:
कामाख्यामक्षमालाभयवरदकरां सिद्धसूत्रैकहस्तां-
श्वेतप्रेतोपरिस्थां मणिकनकयुतां कुङ्कुमापीतवर्णाम् |
ज्ञानध्यानप्रतिष्ठामतिशयविनयां ब्रह्मशक्रादिवन्द्यामग्नौ
बिन्द्वन्तमन्त्रप्रियतमविषयां नौमि सिद्ध्यै रतिस्थाम् || 63 ||
text_mt: To Kāmākhyā, whose hands hold a rosary, grant safety and boons, and whose single hand holds a thread of attainments, / who stands on a white corpse, adorned with jewels and gold, saffron-yellow in complexion, / established in knowledge and meditation, supremely modest, praised by Brahmā, Śakra, and others, / whose most beloved sphere is the mantra ending with bindu in fire, seated on Rati—I bow for attainment.

sanskrit_iast:
madhye madhyasya bhāge satatavinamitā bhāvahāvāvalīyā- līlā lokasya koṣṭhe
sakalaguṇayutā vyaktarūpaikanamrā |
vidyāvidyaikaśāntā śamanaśamakarī kṣemakartrī varāsyā
nityaṃ pātāt pavitrapraṇavavarakarā kāmapūrvaiśvarī naḥ || 64 ||
meaning:
मध्ये मध्यस्य भागे सततविनमिता भावहावावलीया- लीला लोकस्य कोष्ठे
सकलगुणयुता व्यक्तरूपैकनम्रा |
विद्याविद्यैकशान्ता शमनशमकरी क्षेमकर्त्री वरास्या
नित्यं पातात् पवित्रप्रणववरकरा कामपूर्वैश्वरी नः || 64 ||
text_mt: Ever bowing down in the center of the middle part, whose sport consists of rows of emotions and gestures in the chamber of the world, / endowed with all qualities, bowed only before the manifest form, / whose single peace is knowledge and ignorance, who pacifies Death, who creates welfare, of auspicious face, / holding the pure, supreme praṇava in her hand—may the goddess preceded by Kāma constantly protect us."

sanskrit_iast:
iti harakavacaṃ tanusthitaṃ śamayati vai śamanaṃ tathā yadi |
iha gṛhāṇa yatasva vimokṣaṇe sahita eṣa vidhiḥ saha cāmaraiḥ || 65 ||
meaning:
इति हरकवचं तनुस्थितं शमयति वै शमनं तथा यदि |
इह गृहाण यतस्व विमोक्षणे सहित एष विधिः सह चामरैः || 65 ||
text_mt: "Thus, if this armor of Hara placed upon the body truly pacifies even Death, / receive it here, strive for liberation together with Vidhi and the immortals."

sanskrit_iast:
ityayaṃ kavacaṃ yastu kāmākhyāyāḥ paṭhed budhaḥ |
sakṛt taṃ tu mahādevī tvanuvrajati nityadā || 66 ||
meaning:
इत्ययं कवचं यस्तु कामाख्यायाः पठेद् बुधः |
सकृत् तं तु महादेवी त्वनुव्रजति नित्यदा || 66 ||
text_mt: Whatever wise person recites this armor of Kāmākhyā / even once, the great goddess constantly follows after him.

sanskrit_iast:
nādhivyādhibhayaṃ tasya na kravyādbhyo bhayaṃ tathā |
nāgnito nāpi toyebhyo na ripubhyo na rājataḥ || 67 ||
meaning:
नाधिव्याधिभयं तस्य न क्रव्याद्भ्यो भयं तथा |
नाग्नितो नापि तोयेभ्यो न रिपुभ्यो न राजतः || 67 ||
text_mt: He has no fear of mental agony or bodily disease, and no fear of flesh-eating monsters, / nor from fire, nor from water, nor from enemies, nor from kings.

sanskrit_iast:
dīrghāyurbahubhogī ca putrapautrasamanvitaḥ |
āvartayañchataṃ devī-mandire modate pare || 68 ||
meaning:
दीर्घायुर्बहुभोगी च पुत्रपौत्रसमन्वितः |
आवर्तयञ्छतं देवी-मन्दिरे मोदते परे || 68 ||
text_mt: Long-lived, enjoying many pleasures, and endowed with sons and grandsons, / repeating [it] a hundred times, he rejoices in the supreme temple of the Goddess.

sanskrit_iast:
yathā tathā bhaved baddhaḥ saṃgrāme'nyatra vā budhaḥ |
tat kṣaṇādeva muktaḥ syāt smaraṇāt kavacasya tu || 69 ||
meaning:
यथा तथा भवेद् बद्धः संग्रामेऽन्यत्र वा बुधः |
तत् क्षणादेव मुक्तः स्यात् स्मरणात् कवचस्य तु || 69 ||
text_mt: No matter how a wise man may be bound in battle or elsewhere, / in that very instant he is freed merely by remembering the armor.

sanskrit_iast: īśvara uvāca
meaning: ईश्वर उवाच

sanskrit_iast:
iti śrutvā tu kavacaṃ harirbrahmā surāstathā |
śakro'pi kavaca dehe nyāsaṃ cakruḥ pṛthak pṛthak || 70 ||
meaning:
इति श्रुत्वा तु कवचं हरिर्ब्रह्मा सुरास्तथा |
शक्रोऽपि कवच देहे न्यासं चक्रुः पृथक् पृथक् || 70 ||
text_mt: Having heard this armor, Hari, Brahmā, the gods, / and even Śakra performed the ritual placement of the armor upon their bodies, each separately.

sanskrit_iast:
te tu vinyastakavacā mahāmāyāprabhāvataḥ |
utplupya sāgarasyāmbha āseduḥ kṣitimañjasā || 71 ||
meaning:
ते तु विन्यस्तकवचा महामायाप्रभावतः |
उत्प्लुप्य सागरस्याम्भ आसेदुः क्षितिमञ्जसा || 71 ||
text_mt: Having placed the armor upon themselves, by the power of Mahāmāyā, / leaping up from the water of the ocean, they swiftly reached the earth.

sanskrit_iast:
āsādya pṛthivīṃ sarve brahmaviṣṇavādayaḥ surāḥ |
nīlakūṭaṃ samāsādya kāmākhyāṃ draṣṭumāgatāḥ || 72 ||
meaning:
आसाद्य पृथिवीं सर्वे ब्रह्मविष्णवादयः सुराः |
नीलकूटं समासाद्य कामाख्यां द्रष्टुमागताः || 72 ||
text_mt: Having reached the earth, all the gods, Brahmā, Viṣṇu, and the others, / having arrived at Nīlakūṭa, came to see Kāmākhyā.

sanskrit_iast:
dṛṣṭvā kāmeśvarīṃ devī keśavastāṃ jaganmayīm |
idamāha svayaṃ jñātvā prabhāvaṃ tat pratiṣṭhitam || 73 ||
meaning:
दृष्ट्वा कामेश्वरीं देवी केशवस्तां जगन्मयीम् |
इदमाह स्वयं ज्ञात्वा प्रभावं तत् प्रतिष्ठितम् || 73 ||
text_mt: Seeing the goddess Kāmeśvarī, who consists of the universe, / Keśava, knowing by himself that established majesty, said this:

sanskrit_iast:
tvameva prakṛtirdevī tvameva pṛthivī jalam |
tvameva jagatāṃ mātā tvameva ca jaganmayī || 74 ||
meaning:
त्वमेव प्रकृतिर्देवी त्वमेव पृथिवी जलम् |
त्वमेव जगतां माता त्वमेव च जगन्मयी || 74 ||
text_mt: “You alone are the Goddess Prakṛti; you alone are the earth and the water; / you alone are the mother of the worlds, and you alone consist of the universe.

sanskrit_iast:
tvaṃ kartrī sarvajagatāṃ vidyā tvaṃ muktidāyinī |
parāparātmikā devī sthūlasūkṣmātmikā tathā || 75 ||
meaning:
त्वं कर्त्री सर्वजगतां विद्या त्वं मुक्तिदायिनी |
परापरात्मिका देवी स्थूलसूक्ष्मात्मिका तथा || 75 ||
text_mt: You are the creator of all the worlds; you are knowledge that bestows liberation; / you are the Goddess whose nature is the higher and the lower, as well as the gross and the subtle.

sanskrit_iast:
prasīda tvaṃ mahādevi prasannāyāṃ śubhe tvayi |
devāḥ sarve prasīdanti caturvargaprade'naghe || 76 ||
meaning:
प्रसीद त्वं महादेवि प्रसन्नायां शुभे त्वयि |
देवाः सर्वे प्रसीदन्ति चतुर्वर्गप्रदेऽनघे || 76 ||
text_mt: Be gracious, O Mahādevī! When you, the auspicious one, are pleased, / all the gods are pleased, O sinless one, bestower of the fourfold aim of life!”

sanskrit_iast:
ratyakṣarūpā kāmākhyā keśavasya mahātmanaḥ |
pratyakṣarūpā kāmākhyā harimābhāṣya cābravīt || 77 ||
meaning:
रत्यक्षरूपा कामाख्या केशवस्य महात्मनः |
प्रत्यक्षरूपा कामाख्या हरिमाभाष्य चाब्रवीत् || 77 ||
text_mt: Kāmākhyā, whose form is visible to the high-souled Keśava, / appearing directly, addressed Hari and spoke:

sanskrit_iast: devyuvāca -
meaning: देव्युवाच -

sanskrit_iast:
keśava brahmaṇā sārdhaṃ sarvairdevaistathā gaṇaiḥ |
madyonisalileṣvadya snānaṃ pānaṃ kuru drutam || 78 ||
meaning:
केशव ब्रह्मणा सार्धं सर्वैर्देवैस्तथा गणैः |
मद्योनिसलिलेष्वद्य स्नानं पानं कुरु द्रुतम् || 78 ||
text_mt: “O Keśava, together with Brahmā, all the gods, and the hosts, / bathe and drink at once today in the waters of my yoni!

sanskrit_iast:
tatastvaṃ nirahaṅkāraḥ paravīryasamanvitaḥ |
āruhya garuḍaṃ yāhi tridivaṃ saha vedhasā || 79 ||
meaning:
ततस्त्वं निरहङ्कारः परवीर्यसमन्वितः |
आरुह्य गरुडं याहि त्रिदिवं सह वेधसा || 79 ||
text_mt: Then, free of egoism and endowed with supreme vigor, / mount Garuḍa and go to heaven together with Vedhas!”

sanskrit_iast:
evamukto mahādevyā keśavaḥ saha edhasā |
yonimaṇḍalatoyeṣu snānaṃ pānaṃ cakāra ha || 80 ||
meaning:
एवमुक्तो महादेव्या केशवः सह एधसा |
योनिमण्डलतोयेषु स्नानं पानं चकार ह || 80 ||
text_mt: Thus addressed by the Mahādevī, Keśava together with Vedhas / bathed and drank in the waters of the yoni-circle.

sanskrit_iast:
kṛtaplāvāstato devāḥ kṛtasnānaśca keśavaḥ |
gatā devyāśca sammatyā tridivaṃ prati harṣitāḥ || 81 ||
meaning:
कृतप्लावास्ततो देवाः कृतस्नानश्च केशवः |
गता देव्याश्च सम्मत्या त्रिदिवं प्रति हर्षिताः || 81 ||
text_mt: Having bathed, the gods, and Keśava having bathed, / went toward heaven, delighted, with the permission of the Goddess.

sanskrit_iast:
gacchantaste devagaṇāḥ sahitāḥ keśavena ca |
brahmaṇā ca tadādrākṣuḥ kāmākhyāṃ tāṃ viyadgatām || 82 ||
meaning:
गच्छन्तस्ते देवगणाः सहिताः केशवेन च |
ब्रह्मणा च तदाद्राक्षुः कामाख्यां तां वियद्गताम् || 82 ||
text_mt: As they were going, those hosts of gods, accompanied by Keśava / and by Brahmā, then saw that Kāmākhyā standing in the sky.

sanskrit_iast:
nīlakūṭasahasrāṇi yonibhiḥ saha tadgatai |
ūrdhvādhobhāgayogena dadṛśuḥ saṃsthitāni ca || 83 ||
meaning:
नीलकूटसहस्राणि योनिभिः सह तद्गतै |
ऊर्ध्वाधोभागयोगेन ददृशुः संस्थितानि च || 83 ||
text_mt: They saw thousands of Nīlakūṭas along with the yonis situated upon them, / standing arranged above and below.

sanskrit_iast:
tāni pratyekato devā āruhyāruhya tatkṣaṇāt |
apuḥ sasnuḥ pūrvavat te prītimāpustathātulām || 84 ||
meaning:
तानि प्रत्येकतो देवा आरुह्यारुह्य तत्क्षणात् |
अपुः सस्नुः पूर्ववत् ते प्रीतिमापुस्तथातुलाम् || 84 ||
text_mt: Mounting each of them again and again, in that very instant the gods / drank and bathed as before, and obtained peerless joy.

sanskrit_iast:
nirāmayāstathā jagmurvismayākliṣṭacetanāḥ |
stuvantaḥ prastuvantaśca kāmākhyāyonimaṇḍalam || 85 ||
meaning:
निरामयास्तथा जग्मुर्विस्मयाक्लिष्टचेतनाः |
स्तुवन्तः प्रस्तुवन्तश्च कामाख्यायोनिमण्डलम् || 85 ||
text_mt: Free from illness, with minds unaffected by bewilderment, they went, / praising and glorifying the yoni-circle of Kāmākhyā.

sanskrit_iast:
tato devaguruṃ natvā māṃ stutvā ca mayā punaḥ |
visṛṣṭāstridivaṃ yātā harṣotphullavilocanāḥ || 86 ||
meaning:
ततो देवगुरुं नत्वा मां स्तुत्वा च मया पुनः |
विसृष्टास्त्रिदिवं याता हर्षोत्फुल्लविलोचनाः || 86 ||
text_mt: Then, bowing to the teacher of the gods and praising me, dismissed again / by me, they went to heaven with eyes blooming with joy.

sanskrit_iast:
māhātmyamīdṛśaṃ devyāḥ kāmākhyāstu bhairava |
kavacaṃ cedṛśaṃ proktaṃ tattvamāsādya putraka || 87 ||
meaning:
माहात्म्यमीदृशं देव्याः कामाख्यास्तु भैरव |
कवचं चेदृशं प्रोक्तं तत्त्वमासाद्य पुत्रक || 87 ||
text_mt: Such is the majesty of the goddess Kāmākhyā, O Bhairava! / And such an armor has been declared: reach that truth, O son!

sanskrit_iast:
yatheṣṭaviniyogena tamāsādya sukhī bhava |
kāmākhyāyāśca māhātmyaṃ kimanyat kathayāmi te ||
yasyā yoniśilāyogāllohādyā yānti svarṇatām || 88 ||
meaning:
यथेष्टविनियोगेन तमासाद्य सुखी भव |
कामाख्यायाश्च माहात्म्यं किमन्यत् कथयामि ते ||
यस्या योनिशिलायोगाल्लोहाद्या यान्ति स्वर्णताम् || 88 ||
text_mt: Having obtained it by using it according to your wish, be happy! / What else shall I tell you of the majesty of Kāmākhyā, / through contact with whose yoni-stone iron and other metals turn to gold?

sanskrit_iast:
yadyonimaṇḍale snātvā sakṛt pītvā ca mānavaḥ |
nehotpattimavāpnoti paraṃ nirvāṇamāpnuyāt || 89 ||
meaning:
यद्योनिमण्डले स्नात्वा सकृत् पीत्वा च मानवः |
नेहोत्पत्तिमवाप्नोति परं निर्वाणमाप्नुयात् || 89 ||
text_mt: Having bathed in her yoni-circle and drunk [its waters] once, a man / does not obtain rebirth here; he attains supreme nirvāṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
iti śrīkālikāpurāṇe kāmākhyākavacamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma
visaptatitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 72 ||
trisaptatitamo'dhyāyaḥ
meaning:
इति श्रीकालिकापुराणे कामाख्याकवचमाहात्म्यवर्णनं नाम
विसप्ततितमोऽध्यायः || 72 ||
त्रिसप्ततितमोऽध्यायः
text_mt: Thus ends the seventy-second chapter in the glorious Kālikāpurāṇa, called ‘The Description of the Majesty of the Armor of Kāmākhyā.’ / Chapter seventy-three.

sanskrit_iast: śrībhagavānuvāca -
meaning: श्रीभगवानुवाच -

sanskrit_iast:
mātṛkānyāsamadhunā śṛṇu vetāla bhairava |
yena devatvamāyāti naro'pi vihitena vai || 1 ||
meaning:
मातृकान्यासमधुना शृणु वेताल भैरव |
येन देवत्वमायाति नरोऽपि विहितेन वै || 1 ||
text_mt: Now hear the placement of the letters of the alphabet, O Vetāla and Bhairava, / by performing which even a mortal attains godhood.

sanskrit_iast:
vāg brahmāṇīmukhā devyo mātṛkāḥ parikīrtitāḥ |
tāsāṃ mantrāṇi sarvāṇi vyañjanāni svarāstathā || 2 ||
meaning:
वाग् ब्रह्माणीमुखा देव्यो मातृकाः परिकीर्तिताः |
तासां मन्त्राणि सर्वाणि व्यञ्जनानि स्वरास्तथा || 2 ||
text_mt: The goddesses whose heads are Brahmāṇī and the rest are celebrated as the Mātṛkās; / all their mantras are the consonants and the vowels,

sanskrit_iast:
candrabinduprayuktāni sarvakāma pradāni ca |
ṛṣistu mātṛmantrāṇāṃ brahmaiva parikīrtitaḥ || 3 ||
meaning:
चन्द्रबिन्दुप्रयुक्तानि सर्वकाम प्रदानि च |
ऋषिस्तु मातृमन्त्राणां ब्रह्मैव परिकीर्तितः || 3 ||
text_mt: joined with the candrabindu, granting all desires. / The seer of the mother-mantras is declared to be Brahmā himself;

sanskrit_iast:
proktaśchandaśca gāyatrī devatā ca sarasvatī |
śarīraśuddhimukhye tu sarvakāmārthasādhane || 4 ||
meaning:
प्रोक्तश्छन्दश्च गायत्री देवता च सरस्वती |
शरीरशुद्धिमुख्ये तु सर्वकामार्थसाधने || 4 ||
text_mt: the meter is said to be Gāyatrī, and the deity is Sarasvatī. / In the chief purification of the body and in accomplishing all desires and aims,

sanskrit_iast:
viniyogaḥ samuddiṣṭo mantrāṇāṃ nyūnapūraṇe |
akāreṇa samaṃ kādirvargo yaḥ prathamaḥ smṛtaḥ || 5 ||
meaning:
विनियोगः समुद्दिष्टो मन्त्राणां न्यूनपूरणे |
अकारेण समं कादिर्वर्गो यः प्रथमः स्मृतः || 5 ||
text_mt: its application is directed for completing any deficiency in mantras. / The group beginning with ka, which is remembered as the first [consonant class], together with the letter a,

sanskrit_iast:
taiścandrabindusaṃyuktaistatrasthairakṣarairbahiḥ |
ākāraṃ ca tathoccārya aṅguṣṭhābhyāṃ namastathā ||
prathamaṃ mātṛkāmantramaṅguṣṭhadvayato nyaset || 6 ||
meaning:
तैश्चन्द्रबिन्दुसंयुक्तैस्तत्रस्थैरक्षरैर्बहिः |
आकारं च तथोच्चार्य अङ्गुष्ठाभ्यां नमस्तथा ||
प्रथमं मातृकामन्त्रमङ्गुष्ठद्वयतो न्यसेत् || 6 ||
text_mt: by those letters situated there, joined with the candrabindu, outwardly, / and having pronounced the letter ā and ‘aṅguṣṭhābhyāṃ namaḥ,’ / one should place the first mother-mantra with both thumbs.

sanskrit_iast:
pare vargāḥ svaraiḥ sārdhaṃ ye vānye nyāsakarmaṇi |
te sarve candrabindubhyāṃ yuktāḥ kāryāstu sarvataḥ || 7 ||
meaning:
परे वर्गाः स्वरैः सार्धं ये वान्ये न्यासकर्मणि |
ते सर्वे चन्द्रबिन्दुभ्यां युक्ताः कार्यास्तु सर्वतः || 7 ||
text_mt: The other classes along with the vowels, or whatever others are in the rite of nyāsa, / all of them are to be made everywhere joined with the candrabindu.

sanskrit_iast: hrasvekāraścavargeṇa dīrghekārāntakena tu || 8 ||
meaning: ह्रस्वेकारश्चवर्गेण दीर्घेकारान्तकेन तु || 8 ||
text_mt: With the short vowel i and the ca-class, ending with the long vowel ī,

sanskrit_iast:
tarjanyorvinyaset samyak svāhāntena tu pūrvavat |
hrasvokāraṣṭavargeṇa dīrgokārāntakena tu || 9 ||
meaning:
तर्जन्योर्विन्यसेत् सम्यक् स्वाहान्तेन तु पूर्ववत् |
ह्रस्वोकारष्टवर्गेण दीर्गोकारान्तकेन तु || 9 ||
text_mt: one should place [them] properly on the forefingers, ending with svāhā, as before. / With the short vowel u, the ṭa-class, ending with the long vowel ū,

sanskrit_iast:
madhyamāyugale samyagvaṣaḍanten vinyaset |
ekārāditavargantu aikārāntena caiva hum || 10 ||
meaning:
मध्यमायुगले सम्यग्वषडन्तेन् विन्यसेत् |
एकारादितवर्गन्तु ऐकारान्तेन चैव हुम् || 10 ||
text_mt: one should place [them] properly on the pair of middle fingers, ending with vaṣaṭ. / With the ta-class beginning with the vowel e, ending with the vowel ai, and hum,

sanskrit_iast:
nyasedanāmikāyugme niyataṃ tatra bhairava |
kārādipavargaṃ tu aukārāntamaśeṣataḥ || 11 ||
meaning:
न्यसेदनामिकायुग्मे नियतं तत्र भैरव |
कारादिपवर्गं तु औकारान्तमशेषतः || 11 ||
text_mt: one should place [them] constantly on the pair of ring fingers there, O Bhairava. / With the pa-class beginning with the vowel o, completely ending with the vowel au,

sanskrit_iast:
vauṣaḍantaṃ kaniṣṭhāyāṃ vinyaset kāryasiddhaye |
aṃkārādiyakārādivargeṇa kṣāntakena tu || 12 ||
meaning:
वौषडन्तं कनिष्ठायां विन्यसेत् कार्यसिद्धये |
अंकारादियकारादिवर्गेण क्षान्तकेन तु || 12 ||
text_mt: one should place [them] on the little finger, ending with vauṣaṭ, for the success of the undertaking. / With the class beginning with ya, starting with the sound aṃ and ending with kṣa,

sanskrit_iast:
a ityantena valayorvinyaset pāṇipṛṣṭhayoḥ |
vaṣaṭkāraṃ śeṣabhāge aṃgatranyāse niyojayet || 13 ||
meaning:
अ इत्यन्तेन वलयोर्विन्यसेत् पाणिपृष्ठयोः |
वषट्कारं शेषभागे अंगत्रन्यासे नियोजयेत् || 13 ||
text_mt: ending with the sound aḥ, one should place [them] on the palms and the backs of the hands. / One should employ the word vaṣaṭ in the concluding part during the nyāsa on the limbs.

sanskrit_iast:
hṛdayādiṣaḍaṅgeṣu pūrvavat kramato nyaset |
aṅguṣṭhādyuktavargaistu kramāt ṣaḍbhistathāvidhaiḥ || 14 ||
meaning:
हृदयादिषडङ्गेषु पूर्ववत् क्रमतो न्यसेत् |
अङ्गुष्ठाद्युक्तवर्गैस्तु क्रमात् षड्भिस्तथाविधैः || 14 ||
text_mt: One should place [them] on the six limbs such as the heart in order, as before, / with the classes stated from the thumbs onward, six such [groups] in sequence.

sanskrit_iast:
punastathā pādajānusakthiguhyeṣu pārśvayoḥ |
vastau ca vinyasenmantrān kramāt pūrvavadakṣaraiḥ || 15 ||
meaning:
पुनस्तथा पादजानुसक्थिगुह्येषु पार्श्वयोः |
वस्तौ च विन्यसेन्मन्त्रान् क्रमात् पूर्ववदक्षरैः || 15 ||
text_mt: Again, one should likewise place the mantras on the feet, knees, thighs, genitals, flanks, / and bladder, with the letters in sequence as before.

sanskrit_iast:
bāhvoḥ pāṇyostathā kaṭyāṃ nābhau ca jaṭhare tathā |
stanayorapi vinyāsaṃ tathā ṣaḍbhiḥ samācaret || 16 ||
meaning:
बाह्वोः पाण्योस्तथा कट्यां नाभौ च जठरे तथा |
स्तनयोरपि विन्यासं तथा षड्भिः समाचरेत् || 16 ||
text_mt: One should likewise perform the placement with the six [groups] / on the arms, hands, waist, navel, belly, and breasts.

sanskrit_iast:
vaktre ca civuke gaṇḍe karṇayośca lalāṭake |
aṃse kakṣe ca ṣaḍvargaiḥ pūrvavannyāsamācaret || 17 ||
meaning:
वक्त्रे च चिवुके गण्डे कर्णयोश्च ललाटके |
अंसे कक्षे च षड्वर्गैः पूर्ववन्न्यासमाचरेत् || 17 ||
text_mt: One should perform the placement with the six classes as before / on the face, chin, cheek, ears, forehead, shoulder, and armpit.

sanskrit_iast:
romakūpe brahmarandhre gude jaṅghāyuge tathā |
nakheṣu pādapārṣṇyośca tathā pūrvavadācaret || 18 ||
meaning:
रोमकूपे ब्रह्मरन्ध्रे गुदे जङ्घायुगे तथा |
नखेषु पादपार्ष्ण्योश्च तथा पूर्ववदाचरेत् || 18 ||
text_mt: One should perform [it] as before on the hair pores, the aperture of Brahmā, the anus, the pair of shanks, / the nails, and the feet and heels.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ tu mātṛkānyāsaṃ yaḥ kuryānnarasattamaḥ |
sa sarvayajñapūjāsu pūto yogyastu jāyate || 19 ||
meaning:
एवं तु मातृकान्यासं यः कुर्यान्नरसत्तमः |
स सर्वयज्ञपूजासु पूतो योग्यस्तु जायते || 19 ||
text_mt: The best of men who performs this placement of the letters of the alphabet / becomes purified and worthy in all sacrifices and worships.

sanskrit_iast:
nātaḥ parataraṃ mantraṃ vidyate kvacideva hi |
yatsarvakāmadaṃ puṇyaṃ caturvargapradaṃ param || 20 ||
meaning:
नातः परतरं मन्त्रं विद्यते क्वचिदेव हि |
यत्सर्वकामदं पुण्यं चतुर्वर्गप्रदं परम् || 20 ||
text_mt: Indeed, no mantra anywhere is superior to this, / which grants all desires, is meritorious, and bestows the supreme fourfold aim of life.

sanskrit_iast:
vāgdevatāṃ hṛdi dhyātvā mūrtisarvākṣarāṇi ca |
tridhā ca mātṛkāmantraiḥ sakramaiśca pibejjalam || 21 ||
meaning:
वाग्देवतां हृदि ध्यात्वा मूर्तिसर्वाक्षराणि च |
त्रिधा च मातृकामन्त्रैः सक्रमैश्च पिबेज्जलम् || 21 ||
text_mt: Meditating in the heart on the goddess of speech and all the phonemes in bodily form, / one should drink water three times with the mātṛkā mantras in proper order.

sanskrit_iast:
sa vāgmī paṇḍito dhīmān jāyate ca varaḥ kaviḥ |
candrabindusamāyuktān svarān pūrvaṃ paṭhed budhaḥ || 22 ||
meaning:
स वाग्मी पण्डितो धीमान् जायते च वरः कविः |
चन्द्रबिन्दुसमायुक्तान् स्वरान् पूर्वं पठेद् बुधः || 22 ||
text_mt: He becomes eloquent, learned, wise, and an excellent poet. / The wise man should first recite the vowels combined with candrabindu,

sanskrit_iast:
vyañjanāni tu sarvāṇi kevalāni paṭhet tataḥ |
akārādikṣakārāntānyevaṃ śvāsaiśca pūrakaiḥ || 23 ||
meaning:
व्यञ्जनानि तु सर्वाणि केवलानि पठेत् ततः |
अकारादिक्षकारान्तान्येवं श्वासैश्च पूरकैः || 23 ||
text_mt: and then recite all the consonants alone, / from the letter 'a' to the letter 'kṣa', in this manner, with inhalations of breath.

sanskrit_iast:
jalaṃ karatale gṛhya paṭhitvākṣarasaṃkhyakam |
abhimantrya tu tat toyaṃ prathamaṃ pūrakaiḥ pibet || 24 ||
meaning:
जलं करतले गृह्य पठित्वाक्षरसंख्यकम् |
अभिमन्त्र्य तु तत् तोयं प्रथमं पूरकैः पिबेत् || 24 ||
text_mt: Taking water in the palm of the hand and reciting the number of letters, / having consecrated that water, he should drink it first during the inhalation,

sanskrit_iast:
kumbhakena dvitīyaṃ tu tṛtīyantvatha recakaiḥ |
evaṃ sakṛt trivāraṃ tu pītvā toyaṃ vicakṣaṇaḥ || 25 ||
meaning:
कुम्भकेन द्वितीयं तु तृतीयन्त्वथ रेचकैः |
एवं सकृत् त्रिवारं तु पीत्वा तोयं विचक्षणः || 25 ||
text_mt: the second during retention of breath, and the third during exhalation. / Thus having drunk the water three times at once, the discerning man

sanskrit_iast:
dṛḍhāṅgaḥ paṇḍito bhūyāt putrapautrasamanvitaḥ |
trisandhyamatha pītvaiva mātṛkāmantramantritam || 26 ||
meaning:
दृढाङ्गः पण्डितो भूयात् पुत्रपौत्रसमन्वितः |
त्रिसन्ध्यमथ पीत्वैव मातृकामन्त्रमन्त्रितम् || 26 ||
text_mt: becomes strong-limbed, learned, and endowed with sons and grandsons. / Drinking [water] consecrated with the mātṛkā mantra at the three junctures of the day,

sanskrit_iast:
toyaṃ kavitvamāpnoti sarvān kāmāṃstathaiva ca |
satataṃ kuruta yastu mātṛkāmantramantritam || 27 ||
meaning:
तोयं कवित्वमाप्नोति सर्वान् कामांस्तथैव च |
सततं कुरुत यस्तु मातृकामन्त्रमन्त्रितम् || 27 ||
text_mt: he attains poetic power and all his desires as well. / But he who constantly performs the drinking of water

sanskrit_iast:
toyapānaṃ mahābhāga pūrakumbhakarecakaiḥ |
sa sarvakāmān saṃprāpya putrapautrasamṛddhimān || 28 ||
meaning:
तोयपानं महाभाग पूरकुम्भकरेचकैः |
स सर्वकामान् संप्राप्य पुत्रपौत्रसमृद्धिमान् || 28 ||
text_mt: consecrated by the mātṛkā mantra, O fortunate one, through inhalation, retention, and exhalation, / having attained all desires and prospering with sons and grandsons,

sanskrit_iast:
bhūtvā mahākavirloke balavān satyavikramaḥ |
sarvatra vallabho bhūtvā cānte mokṣamavāpnuyāt || 29 ||
meaning:
भूत्वा महाकविर्लोके बलवान् सत्यविक्रमः |
सर्वत्र वल्लभो भूत्वा चान्ते मोक्षमवाप्नुयात् || 29 ||
text_mt: becomes a great poet in the world, mighty and of unfailing valor; / becoming beloved everywhere, he attains liberation at the end.

sanskrit_iast:
rājānamathavā rājaputraṃ bhāryāmathāpi vā |
vaśīkaroti nacirānmātṛkāmantrapānataḥ || 30 ||
meaning:
राजानमथवा राजपुत्रं भार्यामथापि वा |
वशीकरोति नचिरान्मातृकामन्त्रपानतः || 30 ||
text_mt: He quickly subjugates a king, a prince, / or even a wife, by drinking [with] the mātṛkā mantra.

sanskrit_iast:
nyāsakrame kramaḥ prokto vargakrama ihaiva tu |
akṣarāṇāṃ krameṇātha toyapānaṃ samācaret || 31 ||
meaning:
न्यासक्रमे क्रमः प्रोक्तो वर्गक्रम इहैव तु |
अक्षराणां क्रमेणाथ तोयपानं समाचरेत् || 31 ||
text_mt: In the order of nyāsa the sequence has been declared, and here the sequence of classes [is meant]; / one should then perform the drinking of water according to the order of the letters.

sanskrit_iast:
ye ye mantrā devatānāmṛṣīṇāmatha rakṣasām |
te mantrā mātṛkāmantrai rnityameva pratiṣṭhitāḥ || 32 ||
meaning:
ये ये मन्त्रा देवतानामृषीणामथ रक्षसाम् |
ते मन्त्रा मातृकामन्त्रै र्नित्यमेव प्रतिष्ठिताः || 32 ||
text_mt: Whatever mantras belong to deities, ṛṣis, or rakṣases, / those mantras are always established through the mātṛkā mantras.

sanskrit_iast:
sarvamantramayaścāyaṃ sarvavedamayastathā |
caturvargapradaścāyaṃ mātṛkāmantra ucyate || 33 ||
meaning:
सर्वमन्त्रमयश्चायं सर्ववेदमयस्तथा |
चतुर्वर्गप्रदश्चायं मातृकामन्त्र उच्यते || 33 ||
text_mt: This mātṛkā mantra is said to consist of all mantras, to consist of all the Vedas, / and to bestow the four aims of life.

sanskrit_iast:
iti te kathitaṃ putra mātṛkānyāsamadbhutam |
vibhāgamatha mudrāṇāṃ śṛṇu vetāla bhairava || 34 ||
meaning:
इति ते कथितं पुत्र मातृकान्यासमद्भुतम् |
विभागमथ मुद्राणां शृणु वेताल भैरव || 34 ||
text_mt: Thus has the wondrous mātṛkānyāsa been told to you, my son; / now hear the classification of mudrās, O Vetāla and Bhairava.

sanskrit_iast:
iti śrīkālikāpurāṇe mātṛkānyāsavarṇane risaptatitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 73 ||
catuḥsaptatitamo'dhyāyaḥ
meaning:
इति श्रीकालिकापुराणे मातृकान्यासवर्णने रिसप्ततितमोऽध्यायः || 73 ||
चतुःसप्ततितमोऽध्यायः
text_mt:
Thus ends the seventy-third chapter, on the description of mātṛkānyāsa, in the glorious Kālikāpurāṇa.
Chapter Seventy-Four

sanskrit_iast: śrībhagavānuvāca -
meaning: श्रीभगवानुवाच -

sanskrit_iast:
yā yonimudrā kathitā mudrāvibhajane purā |
aṣṭadhā yonimudrā syāt prathamā sā tu kīrtitā || 1 ||
meaning:
या योनिमुद्रा कथिता मुद्राविभजने पुरा |
अष्टधा योनिमुद्रा स्यात् प्रथमा सा तु कीर्तिता || 1 ||
text_mt: The yonimudrā that was described previously in the division of mudrās— / that yonimudrā is eightfold, and it was celebrated as the first.

sanskrit_iast:
dvitīyā khecarī mudrā kāmākhyāyāstu bhairava |
tāṃ viddhi cādbhutaṃ guhyaṃ yena tuṣyati caṇḍikā || 2 ||
meaning:
द्वितीया खेचरी मुद्रा कामाख्यायास्तु भैरव |
तां विद्धि चाद्भुतं गुह्यं येन तुष्यति चण्डिका || 2 ||
text_mt: The second is the khecarī mudrā of Kāmākhyā, O Bhairava; / know it as wondrous and secret, by which Caṇḍikā is pleased.

sanskrit_iast:
anāmikāṃ dakṣiṇasya tarjanyāṃ vāmato nyaset |
vāmānāmāṃ dakṣiṇasya tarjanyāṃ viniveśayet || 3 ||
meaning:
अनामिकां दक्षिणस्य तर्जन्यां वामतो न्यसेत् |
वामानामां दक्षिणस्य तर्जन्यां विनिवेशयेत् || 3 ||
text_mt: One should place the ring finger of the right hand on the forefinger of the left; / one should place the left ring finger on the forefinger of the right.

sanskrit_iast:
te dve tathā tarjanībhyāṃ veṣṭayedagrato'grataḥ |
madhye dvayaṃ tu vinyasya cordhvabhāge tvanāmayoḥ || 4 ||
meaning:
ते द्वे तथा तर्जनीभ्यां वेष्टयेदग्रतोऽग्रतः |
मध्ये द्वयं तु विन्यस्य चोर्ध्वभागे त्वनामयोः || 4 ||
text_mt: One should entwine those two in front with both forefingers; / having placed both middle fingers in the center, and on the upper part of the two ring fingers,

sanskrit_iast:
tadagrāgreṇa saṃyogāt tathaiva ca kaniṣṭhike |
agreṇaiva ca saṃyukte tanmūle'ṅguṣṭhake nyaset || 5 ||
meaning:
तदग्राग्रेण संयोगात् तथैव च कनिष्ठिके |
अग्रेणैव च संयुक्ते तन्मूलेऽङ्गुष्ठके न्यसेत् || 5 ||
text_mt: by the joining of tip to tip, and likewise both little fingers / joined at the tip, one should place the two thumbs at their bases.

sanskrit_iast:
iyaṃ te khecarī yoniryonimudrā tu kāmadā |
eṣaivādhaḥ kaniṣṭhe dve niyojya yadi yujyate || 6 ||
meaning:
इयं ते खेचरी योनिर्योनिमुद्रा तु कामदा |
एषैवाधः कनिष्ठे द्वे नियोज्य यदि युज्यते || 6 ||
text_mt: This is your khecarī yoni, the yonimudrā that grants desires. / If this same [mudrā] is formed by joining the two little fingers below,

sanskrit_iast:
uhyayonistu sā khyātā kāmeśvaryāstu tuṣṭidā |
saṃveṣṭya pūrvavat pāṇyordve kaniṣṭhe tvanāmike || 7 ||
meaning:
उह्ययोनिस्तु सा ख्याता कामेश्वर्यास्तु तुष्टिदा |
संवेष्ट्य पूर्ववत् पाण्योर्द्वे कनिष्ठे त्वनामिके || 7 ||
text_mt: it is celebrated as the guhyayoni, which gives pleasure to Kāmeśvarī. / Having entwined the two little fingers and the two ring fingers of both hands as before,

sanskrit_iast:
adhobhāge niyojyātha madhyame cordhvatastathā |
tāsāṃ parasparaścāgrairanyo'nyaṃ yojayed yadi || 8 ||
meaning:
अधोभागे नियोज्याथ मध्यमे चोर्ध्वतस्तथा |
तासां परस्परश्चाग्रैरन्योऽन्यं योजयेद् यदि || 8 ||
text_mt: and then joining [them] below, and the two middle fingers above, / if one joins them mutually with one another by their tips,

sanskrit_iast:
madhyāṃ madhye tathāṅguṣṭhe niḥkṣipyāgre niyojayet |
onistriśāṅkarī proktā tripurā tuṣṭidā sadā || 9 ||
meaning:
मध्यां मध्ये तथाङ्गुष्ठे निःक्षिप्याग्रे नियोजयेत् |
ओनिस्त्रिशाङ्करी प्रोक्ता त्रिपुरा तुष्टिदा सदा || 9 ||
text_mt: and casting the middle finger in the center, joins the thumbs in front, / this yoni is called triśāṅkarī, which always gives pleasure to Tripurā.

sanskrit_iast:
madhye dve ca tathā veṣṭyā pūrvavaccāpyanāmikā |
kaniṣṭhābhyāṃ puro nyasya aṅguṣṭhau mūlayostayoḥ || 10 ||
meaning:
मध्ये द्वे च तथा वेष्ट्या पूर्ववच्चाप्यनामिका |
कनिष्ठाभ्यां पुरो न्यस्य अङ्गुष्ठौ मूलयोस्तयोः || 10 ||
text_mt: The two middle fingers are to be entwined, and likewise the ring finger as before; / placing [them] in front of the little fingers, with both thumbs at their bases,

sanskrit_iast:
mudreyaṃ śāradī proktā śāradāyāstu tuṣṭidā |
mūlayonistu kathitā vaiṣṇavītantragocare || 11 ||
meaning:
मुद्रेयं शारदी प्रोक्ता शारदायास्तु तुष्टिदा |
मूलयोनिस्तु कथिता वैष्णवीतन्त्रगोचरे || 11 ||
text_mt: this mudrā is called śāradī, which gives pleasure to Śāradā. / The mūlayoni has been taught within the sphere of the Vaiṣṇava tantra.

sanskrit_iast:
tarjanyanāmikaṃ madhye kaniṣṭhe'pi kramādapi |
karayoryojayitvaiva kaniṣṭhāmūladeśataḥ || 12 ||
meaning:
तर्जन्यनामिकं मध्ये कनिष्ठेऽपि क्रमादपि |
करयोर्योजयित्वैव कनिष्ठामूलदेशतः || 12 ||
text_mt: Having joined the forefinger, ring finger, middle finger, and little finger in succession / on both hands, and from the base of the little finger

sanskrit_iast:
aṅguṣṭhāgraṃ tu niḥkṣipya mahāyoniḥ prakīrtitā |
aṅguṣṭhau cātha saṃveṣṭhya saṃyujyātha karāṅgulīḥ || 13 ||
meaning:
अङ्गुष्ठाग्रं तु निःक्षिप्य महायोनिः प्रकीर्तिता |
अङ्गुष्ठौ चाथ संवेष्ठ्य संयुज्याथ कराङ्गुलीः || 13 ||
text_mt: inserting the tip of the thumb, it is declared to be the mahāyoni. / Having entwined both thumbs and joined the fingers of the hands,

sanskrit_iast:
agrabhāgairmadhyaśūnyaṃ tatra kuryāt karadvayam |
iyaṃ tu yoginīyoniryoginīnāṃ priyaṃkarī || 14 ||
meaning:
अग्रभागैर्मध्यशून्यं तत्र कुर्यात् करद्वयम् |
इयं तु योगिनीयोनिर्योगिनीनां प्रियंकरी || 14 ||
text_mt: with their tips, one should make the two hands empty in the middle: / this is the yoginīyoni, dear to the yoginīs.

sanskrit_iast:
etā aṣṭau samākhyātā yonyaḥ kāmeśvarīpriyāḥ |
mūrtibhedena cānyeṣāṃ devānāmapi tuṣṭidāḥ || 15 ||
meaning:
एता अष्टौ समाख्याता योन्यः कामेश्वरीप्रियाः |
मूर्तिभेदेन चान्येषां देवानामपि तुष्टिदाः || 15 ||
text_mt: These eight yonis have been proclaimed, dear to Kāmeśvarī, / and granting pleasure to other deities according to their different forms.

sanskrit_iast:
yātrāyāṃ yuddhaviṣaye vāgvāde kalahe tathā |
aṣṭau yonyaḥ smared yastu jayastasya sanātanaḥ || 16 ||
meaning:
यात्रायां युद्धविषये वाग्वादे कलहे तथा |
अष्टौ योन्यः स्मरेद् यस्तु जयस्तस्य सनातनः || 16 ||
text_mt: In a journey, on the field of battle, in a debate, or in a quarrel, / whoever remembers these eight yonis attains eternal victory.

sanskrit_iast:
visarjane pūjane ca smaraṇe karmabhedataḥ |
etā yonyaḥ samākhyātāścaṇḍikāpūjaneṣu ca || 17 ||
meaning:
विसर्जने पूजने च स्मरणे कर्मभेदतः |
एता योन्यः समाख्याताश्चण्डिकापूजनेषु च || 17 ||
text_mt: In dismissal, worship, and remembrance according to the different rites, / these yonis have been proclaimed, and in the rituals of Caṇḍikā.

sanskrit_iast:
etāstu kathitā yonyaḥ kramāt kramavisarjane |
rahasya vāmadākṣiṇyaṃ mantraśuddhiṃ śṛṇuṣva me || 18 ||
meaning:
एतास्तु कथिता योन्यः क्रमात् क्रमविसर्जने |
रहस्य वामदाक्षिण्यं मन्त्रशुद्धिं शृणुष्व मे || 18 ||
text_mt: These yonis have been described in sequence for the gradual dismissal. / Now hear from me the secret, the left and right sides, and the purification of mantras.

sanskrit_iast:
mantreṇa kriyate yat tu śārīraṃ mantramuttamam |
tadrahasyamiti prāhurmantreṣu mantrakovidāḥ || 19 ||
meaning:
मन्त्रेण क्रियते यत् तु शारीरं मन्त्रमुत्तमम् |
तद्रहस्यमिति प्राहुर्मन्त्रेषु मन्त्रकोविदाः || 19 ||
text_mt: That which is performed bodily with a mantra, an excellent mantra, / experts in mantras call that 'secret' among mantras.

sanskrit_iast:
kāmākhyāyāstu ṣaṭkoṇaṃ maṇḍalasya dalāntare |
tridhā likhenmūlamantramūrdhvaṃ triṣvapi sandhiṣu || 20 ||
meaning:
कामाख्यायास्तु षट्कोणं मण्डलस्य दलान्तरे |
त्रिधा लिखेन्मूलमन्त्रमूर्ध्वं त्रिष्वपि सन्धिषु || 20 ||
text_mt: Inside the petals of the six-pointed diagram of Kāmākhyā, / one should write the mūlamantra three times, and above on all three junctions.

sanskrit_iast:
adhastrisandhiṣu punarvidhiṃ śakraṃ haraṃ tathā |
sahitaṃ madanenaiva likhed bhūrjatvaci tridhā || 21 ||
meaning:
अधस्त्रिसन्धिषु पुनर्विधिं शक्रं हरं तथा |
सहितं मदनेनैव लिखेद् भूर्जत्वचि त्रिधा || 21 ||
text_mt: Then, on the three lower junctions, one should write Vidhi, Śakra, and Hara, / together with Madana, three times on birch bark.

sanskrit_iast:
antumādāya sāhasraṃ dakṣiṇena kareṇa vai |
mālāmapi samādāya saṃjapeduttarāmukhaḥ || 22 ||
meaning:
अन्तुमादाय साहस्रं दक्षिणेन करेण वै |
मालामपि समादाय संजपेदुत्तरामुखः || 22 ||
text_mt: Taking a thousand [beads?] in the right hand / and also taking the rosary, he should recite facing north.

sanskrit_iast:
adbhuje dakṣiṇe dhāryaṃ bāhau vā sādhakottamaiḥ |
japānte likhitaṃ yantraṃ tena sarvajayī bhavet || 23 ||
meaning:
अद्भुजे दक्षिणे धार्यं बाहौ वा साधकोत्तमैः |
जपान्ते लिखितं यन्त्रं तेन सर्वजयी भवेत् || 23 ||
text_mt: The written yantra should be worn on the right arm by the best of practitioners at the end of recitation; / thereby he becomes victorious over all,

sanskrit_iast:
dīrghāyuḥ sarvavaśakṛdghanadhānyasamṛddhimān |
mṛto devīgṛhe yāti yantrayantritabuddhimān || 24 ||
meaning:
दीर्घायुः सर्ववशकृद्घनधान्यसमृद्धिमान् |
मृतो देवीगृहे याति यन्त्रयन्त्रितबुद्धिमान् || 24 ||
text_mt: long-lived, subjugating everyone, and rich in wealth and grain; / upon death, the wise man restrained by the yantra goes to the abode of the goddess.

sanskrit_iast:
ṣaṭkoṇānantarakṛtaṃ veṣṭitāṣṭakaleṣvatha |
likhitvā bhūrjapatreṣu vilīnairyāvakodakaiḥ || 25 ||
meaning:
षट्कोणानन्तरकृतं वेष्टिताष्टकलेष्वथ |
लिखित्वा भूर्जपत्रेषु विलीनैर्यावकोदकैः || 25 ||
text_mt: Having written on birch bark with red lac-water dissolved, / on the eight petals surrounded by what is made after the hexagon,

sanskrit_iast:
uttarādikrameṇaiva vaiṣṇavītantrasaṅgatān |
aṣṭau varṇānmadhyabhāge pūrvavat kāmarājakam || 26 ||
meaning:
उत्तरादिक्रमेणैव वैष्णवीतन्त्रसङ्गतान् |
अष्टौ वर्णान्मध्यभागे पूर्ववत् कामराजकम् || 26 ||
text_mt: the eight syllables belonging to the Vaiṣṇava tantra, beginning from the north, / and in the middle part the Kāmarāja [bīja] as before,

sanskrit_iast:
trīn varṇān netrabījasya trikoṇasyāgrato likhet |
evaṃ tridhākṛtaṃ yantraṃ kṛtvā vāmakare sthitaḥ || 27 ||
meaning:
त्रीन् वर्णान् नेत्रबीजस्य त्रिकोणस्याग्रतो लिखेत् |
एवं त्रिधाकृतं यन्त्रं कृत्वा वामकरे स्थितः || 27 ||
text_mt: one should write the three syllables of the eye-seed in front of the triangle. / Having made the yantra threefold in this way, holding it in the left hand,

sanskrit_iast:
japet trīṇi sahasrāṇi mālāmādāya dakṣiṇe |
japānte vaiṣṇavīrūpadhyānaṃ kuryādatandritaḥ || 28 ||
meaning:
जपेत् त्रीणि सहस्राणि मालामादाय दक्षिणे |
जपान्ते वैष्णवीरूपध्यानं कुर्यादतन्द्रितः || 28 ||
text_mt: he should recite three thousand times, taking the rosary in his right [hand]. / At the end of the recitation, he should unweariedly perform meditation on the form of Vaiṣṇavī.

sanskrit_iast:
prāṇāyāmasahasraṃ tu tatastaṃ likhitottamam |
grīvāyāṃ dhārayed yantraṃ tena sarvajayī bhavet || 29 ||
meaning:
प्राणायामसहस्रं तु ततस्तं लिखितोत्तमम् |
ग्रीवायां धारयेद् यन्त्रं तेन सर्वजयी भवेत् || 29 ||
text_mt: Then, having performed a thousand breath-controls, he should wear that best written yantra / on his neck; thereby he becomes victorious over all.

sanskrit_iast:
rājaputro bhavedrājā tadanyaḥ sacivo bhavet |
dvijarājo bhaved vidvān kavirvāgmī ca vā bhavet || 30 ||
meaning:
राजपुत्रो भवेद्राजा तदन्यः सचिवो भवेत् |
द्विजराजो भवेद् विद्वान् कविर्वाग्मी च वा भवेत् || 30 ||
text_mt: A prince becomes a king, another becomes a minister, / a twice-born becomes a learned scholar, or an eloquent poet.

sanskrit_iast:
rākṣasebhyaḥ piśācebhyo bhūtebhyaścāpi cānyataḥ |
sādhu saṃvidyate tasya na kadācit parājayaḥ || 31 ||
meaning:
राक्षसेभ्यः पिशाचेभ्यो भूतेभ्यश्चापि चान्यतः |
साधु संविद्यते तस्य न कदाचित् पराजयः || 31 ||
text_mt: From rākṣasas, piśācas, bhūtas, and indeed from any other source, / defeat never truly befalls him.

sanskrit_iast:
dīrghāyurbalavān prājño mṛte mokṣamavāpnuyāt |
sampūrṇaṃ maṇḍalaṃ kṛtvā aṣṭapatrasamanvitam || 32 ||
meaning:
दीर्घायुर्बलवान् प्राज्ञो मृते मोक्षमवाप्नुयात् |
सम्पूर्णं मण्डलं कृत्वा अष्टपत्रसमन्वितम् || 32 ||
text_mt: Long-lived, mighty, and wise, upon death he attains liberation. / Having drawn a complete maṇḍala endowed with eight petals,

sanskrit_iast:
bhūrjatvaci śrīphalasya niryāsaistasya madhyataḥ |
ṣaṭkoṇaṃ vilikhet tasya prāgagreṣvatha triṣvapi || 33 ||
meaning:
भूर्जत्वचि श्रीफलस्य निर्यासैस्तस्य मध्यतः |
षट्कोणं विलिखेत् तस्य प्रागग्रेष्वथ त्रिष्वपि || 33 ||
text_mt: upon birch bark with the sap of the bilva fruit, in the middle of it / one should draw a hexagon; then on its three eastward-facing points,

sanskrit_iast:
vilikhet tripurāvarṇānadho bījaṃ tu netrakam |
daleṣvaṣṭāsu tu punarvaiṣṇavītantrasaṅgatān || 34 ||
meaning:
विलिखेत् त्रिपुरावर्णानधो बीजं तु नेत्रकम् |
दलेष्वष्टासु तु पुनर्वैष्णवीतन्त्रसङ्गतान् || 34 ||
text_mt: one should write the syllables of Tripura, and below, the seed-syllable Netraka; / and on the eight petals, again, those belonging to the Vaiṣṇavītantra.

sanskrit_iast:
aṣṭau varṇāstu vilikhet tathā dvārṣu caturṣvapi |
ṣaṭkoṇeṣūttarākoṇakrameṇaikāgramānasaḥ || 35 ||
meaning:
अष्टौ वर्णास्तु विलिखेत् तथा द्वार्षु चतुर्ष्वपि |
षट्कोणेषूत्तराकोणक्रमेणैकाग्रमानसः || 35 ||
text_mt: One should write the eight syllables, and likewise at the four gates; / on the hexagon, beginning in order from the northern angle, with concentrated mind,

sanskrit_iast:
taddhṛtvā dakṣiṇakare vaiṣṇavītantramantrakam |
japet trirbhirdinairevāyutaṃ saṃyatamānasaḥ || 36 ||
meaning:
तद्धृत्वा दक्षिणकरे वैष्णवीतन्त्रमन्त्रकम् |
जपेत् त्रिर्भिर्दिनैरेवायुतं संयतमानसः || 36 ||
text_mt: holding that in the right hand, with a controlled mind, / one should recite the mantra of the Vaiṣṇavītantra ten thousand times over three days.

sanskrit_iast:
prāṇāyāmasahasrāṇi trīṇi kṛtvā tu harṣitaḥ |
sandhyākāle navamyāṃ tu śīrṣeṇa dhārayed budhaḥ || 37 ||
meaning:
प्राणायामसहस्राणि त्रीणि कृत्वा तु हर्षितः |
सन्ध्याकाले नवम्यां तु शीर्षेण धारयेद् बुधः || 37 ||
text_mt: Having joyfully performed three thousand breath-controls, / at twilight on the ninth day, the wise man should wear it on his head.

sanskrit_iast:
śatāyuḥ sarvadamano matimān paṇḍitottamaḥ |
balavīryadhanaiśvaryayuktaḥ pārthiva eva vā || 38 ||
meaning:
शतायुः सर्वदमनो मतिमान् पण्डितोत्तमः |
बलवीर्यधनैश्वर्ययुक्तः पार्थिव एव वा || 38 ||
text_mt: Living for a hundred years, subduing everyone, intelligent, the foremost of scholars, / endowed with strength, heroism, wealth, and sovereignty, or even a king,

sanskrit_iast:
pratyakṣato mahāmāyāṃ kāmākhyāṃ tripurāmapi |
nityaṃ paśyati medhāvī mahocchavāsāṃ ca śāradām || 39 ||
meaning:
प्रत्यक्षतो महामायां कामाख्यां त्रिपुरामपि |
नित्यं पश्यति मेधावी महोच्छवासां च शारदाम् || 39 ||
text_mt: the intelligent man visibly beholds every day Mahāmāyā, / Kāmākhyā, and Tripurā, as well as Śāradā of great joy.

sanskrit_iast:
siṃhavyāghrau bhujaṅgo vā ye'nye vā tasya hiṃsakāḥ |
sarve tasya tanuṃ prāpya viṣīdanti na saṃśayaḥ || 40 ||
meaning:
सिंहव्याघ्रौ भुजङ्गो वा येऽन्ये वा तस्य हिंसकाः |
सर्वे तस्य तनुं प्राप्य विषीदन्ति न संशयः || 40 ||
text_mt: A lion, a tiger, a serpent, or whatever other harms him— / all of them, encountering his body, sink down; there is no doubt.

sanskrit_iast:
jayaheturato'nyasmāt saṃgrāme śāstravādataḥ |
na vidyate tribhuvane tasmāt kuryāt tu yantrakam || 41 ||
meaning:
जयहेतुरतोऽन्यस्मात् संग्रामे शास्त्रवादतः |
न विद्यते त्रिभुवने तस्मात् कुर्यात् तु यन्त्रकम् || 41 ||
text_mt: No other cause of victory in battle or in philosophical debate / exists in the three worlds; therefore, one should make this yantra.

sanskrit_iast:
ante devīgṛhaṃ prāpya tato mokṣamavāpnuyāt |
mahāmāyā śāradākhyā kāmākhyā tripurā tathā || 42 ||
meaning:
अन्ते देवीगृहं प्राप्य ततो मोक्षमवाप्नुयात् |
महामाया शारदाख्या कामाख्या त्रिपुरा तथा || 42 ||
text_mt: At the end, reaching the abode of the goddess, he then attains liberation. / Mahāmāyā, known as Śāradā, Kāmākhyā, and likewise Tripurā—

sanskrit_iast:
mahotsāhā tathaiteṣāṃ mantrāṇāṃ yo gaṇo bhavet |
maṇḍalaṃ cāṣṭadalakaṃ tanmadhye vilikhet punaḥ || 43 ||
meaning:
महोत्साहा तथैतेषां मन्त्राणां यो गणो भवेत् |
मण्डलं चाष्टदलकं तन्मध्ये विलिखेत् पुनः || 43 ||
text_mt: and the multitude of mantras belonging to them of great energy: / one should again draw an eight-petaled maṇḍala, and in its center,

sanskrit_iast:
likhitvā pūrvavat pūrvaṃ proktaṃ mantragaṇaṃ samam |
anyadvayaṃ dvāradeśe oṣṭheṣvakṣarato likhet || 44 ||
meaning:
लिखित्वा पूर्ववत् पूर्वं प्रोक्तं मन्त्रगणं समम् |
अन्यद्वयं द्वारदेशे ओष्ठेष्वक्षरतो लिखेत् || 44 ||
text_mt: having written as before the entire set of mantras previously proclaimed, / one should write the other two at the gate, syllable by syllable on the rims.

sanskrit_iast:
śuklakauśaiyavastreṣu rasairvahniśikhasya tu |
uttarīyaṃ tu tadvastraṃ kṛtvā japyaṃ samācaret || 45 ||
meaning:
शुक्लकौशैयवस्त्रेषु रसैर्वह्निशिखस्य तु |
उत्तरीयं तु तद्वस्त्रं कृत्वा जप्यं समाचरेत् || 45 ||
text_mt: On white silk garments, with the juices of the fire-flame plant [gloriosa superba], / having made that garment an upper cloth, one should perform the recitation.

sanskrit_iast:
kṛtopavāsaḥ śuddhaśca mātṛkānyāsapūrvakam |
pañcānāmapi vargāṇāṃ sahasrāṇi tu paṃca vai || 46 ||
meaning:
कृतोपवासः शुद्धश्च मातृकान्यासपूर्वकम् |
पञ्चानामपि वर्गाणां सहस्राणि तु पंच वै || 46 ||
text_mt: Fasting and pure, preceded by the nyāsa of the mātṛkās, / [one should recite] five thousand for each of the five groups,

sanskrit_iast:
divasaiḥ pañcabhirjaptvā tadante ca samācaret |
prāṇāyāmasahasrāṇi paṃca vai paṃcabhirdinaiḥ || 47 ||
meaning:
दिवसैः पञ्चभिर्जप्त्वा तदन्ते च समाचरेत् |
प्राणायामसहस्राणि पंच वै पंचभिर्दिनैः || 47 ||
text_mt: having recited it over five days; and at its end, one should perform / five thousand breath-controls over five days.

sanskrit_iast:
ante tu kavacanyāsaṃ kātyāyanyāḥ samācaret |
tatastu mātṛkāmantraiḥ śvāsarodhanapūrvakam || 48 ||
meaning:
अन्ते तु कवचन्यासं कात्यायन्याः समाचरेत् |
ततस्तु मातृकामन्त्रैः श्वासरोधनपूर्वकम् || 48 ||
text_mt: At the end, one should perform the armor-nyāsa of Kātyāyanī; / then, accompanied by retention of breath, with the mātṛkā mantras,

sanskrit_iast:
triḥ pibet kapilākṣīraṃ jāgṛvāṃśca tadā niśi |
evaṃ yaḥ kurute yantraṃ śarīre śuklavāsasā || 49 ||
meaning:
त्रिः पिबेत् कपिलाक्षीरं जागृवांश्च तदा निशि |
एवं यः कुरुते यन्त्रं शरीरे शुक्लवाससा || 49 ||
text_mt: one should drink the milk of a tawny cow three times, staying awake that night. / Whoever thus prepares the yantra on his body with a white garment,

sanskrit_iast:
so'tra siddhimavāpnoti devīlokaṃ ca gacchati |
ya uttarīyaṃ bibhṛyād vastraṃ mantreṇa mantritam || 50 ||
meaning:
सोऽत्र सिद्धिमवाप्नोति देवीलोकं च गच्छति |
य उत्तरीयं बिभृयाद् वस्त्रं मन्त्रेण मन्त्रितम् || 50 ||
text_mt: he attains perfection here and goes to the realm of the goddess. / Whoever wears as an upper garment the cloth consecrated with the mantra,

sanskrit_iast:
nityameva mahābhāga prabhāvaṃ tasya vai śṛṇu |
na tasya dehe śastrāṇi pravekṣyanti kadācana || 51 ||
meaning:
नित्यमेव महाभाग प्रभावं तस्य वै शृणु |
न तस्य देहे शस्त्राणि प्रवेक्ष्यन्ति कदाचन || 51 ||
text_mt: daily indeed, O fortunate one, hear of his power: / weapons will never penetrate his body.

sanskrit_iast:
nāgnirdahati tatkāyaṃ nāpaḥ saṃkledayanti ca |
rākṣasāśca piśācāśca bhūtādyā ye tu hiṃsakāḥ || 52 ||
meaning:
नाग्निर्दहति तत्कायं नापः संक्लेदयन्ति च |
राक्षसाश्च पिशाचाश्च भूताद्या ये तु हिंसकाः || 52 ||
text_mt: Fire does not burn his body, nor does water wet it; / and rākṣasas, piśācas, and whatever harmful beings [there are] headed by bhūtas,

sanskrit_iast:
te taṃ dṛṣṭvā mahābhāgaṃ bhuvaṃ gacchanti vai bhiyā |
gacchedavāritaḥ so'pi sarvatra sādhakottamaḥ || 53 ||
meaning:
ते तं दृष्ट्वा महाभागं भुवं गच्छन्ति वै भिया |
गच्छेदवारितः सोऽपि सर्वत्र साधकोत्तमः || 53 ||
text_mt: they, seeing that fortunate man, indeed flee to the earth in fear. / He, the best of practitioners, goes unimpeded everywhere;

sanskrit_iast:
vaśīkaroti devāṃśca nṛpānanyāṃśca yoṣitaḥ |
utsahed yadi medhāvī vāgmī rājā ca vai bhavet || 54 ||
meaning:
वशीकरोति देवांश्च नृपानन्यांश्च योषितः |
उत्सहेद् यदि मेधावी वाग्मी राजा च वै भवेत् || 54 ||
text_mt: he subdues gods, kings, and other women; / if the intelligent one strives, he becomes an eloquent speaker and a king.

sanskrit_iast:
cirajīvī mahābhāgo dhanadhānyasamṛddhimān |
kaviḥ prajñāsamāyuktaḥ so'bhedyo jāyate'ribhiḥ || 55 ||
meaning:
चिरजीवी महाभागो धनधान्यसमृद्धिमान् |
कविः प्रज्ञासमायुक्तः सोऽभेद्यो जायतेऽरिभिः || 55 ||
text_mt: Long-lived, highly fortunate, prosperous in wealth and grain, / a poet endowed with wisdom, he becomes impenetrable to enemies.

sanskrit_iast:
yasmin pure sa nivased vajrapāto na tatra vai |
rasaḥ śarīraṃ śastrāṇi dṛḍhahastojjhitānyapi || 56 ||
meaning:
यस्मिन् पुरे स निवसेद् वज्रपातो न तत्र वै |
रसः शरीरं शस्त्राणि दृढहस्तोज्झितान्यपि || 56 ||
text_mt: In whatever city he dwells, lightning does not strike there; / poison, the body, and weapons, even hurled by a firm hand,

sanskrit_iast:
etaṃ na ghnanti satataṃ jayaḥ sarvatra bhairava |
aparādhyanti satataṃ tasya sarvatra bhairava || 57 ||
meaning:
एतं न घ्नन्ति सततं जयः सर्वत्र भैरव |
अपराध्यन्ति सततं तस्य सर्वत्र भैरव || 57 ||
text_mt: never strike him; victory is [his] everywhere, O Bhairava; / [enemies] always fail against him everywhere, O Bhairava.

sanskrit_iast:
nādhayo vyādhayastasya jāyante tu kadācana |
devīputraḥ sa matimān mṛto mokṣamavāpnuyāt || 58 ||
meaning:
नाधयो व्याधयस्तस्य जायन्ते तु कदाचन |
देवीपुत्रः स मतिमान् मृतो मोक्षमवाप्नुयात् || 58 ||
text_mt: Neither mental distress nor diseases ever arise for him. / That wise man is a son of the goddess; upon dying, he attains liberation.

sanskrit_iast:
yantratā svāminā yantraṃ yā dadhāti pativratā |
putraiśvaryamavāpnoti dīrghāyuḥ sā vadhurbhavet || 59 ||
meaning:
यन्त्रता स्वामिना यन्त्रं या दधाति पतिव्रता |
पुत्रैश्वर्यमवाप्नोति दीर्घायुः सा वधुर्भवेत् || 59 ||
text_mt: A pativratā who wears the yantra [given] by her husband as a yantra-bearer / attains sons and prosperity; that woman becomes long-lived.

sanskrit_iast:
pratyekamekaṃ saṃhatyāvardhanāsahitena ca |
kramād viṃśatiyantrāṇi kathitāni mayeha vai || 60 ||
meaning:
प्रत्येकमेकं संहत्यावर्धनासहितेन च |
क्रमाद् विंशतियन्त्राणि कथितानि मयेह वै || 60 ||
text_mt: Individually, taking each one along with the increase, / twenty yantras in sequence have indeed been taught here by me.

sanskrit_iast:
tāni pratyekato buddhvā yo nyaset sarvadā hṛdi |
likhitvā sarvayantrāṇi bibhṛyādyo'tha vā gale || 61 ||
meaning:
तानि प्रत्येकतो बुद्ध्वा यो न्यसेत् सर्वदा हृदि |
लिखित्वा सर्वयन्त्राणि बिभृयाद्योऽथ वा गले || 61 ||
text_mt: Whoever, understanding them individually, places them always in the heart, / or having written all the yantras wears them on the neck,

sanskrit_iast:
devendro jāyate so'tra prabhāveṇeha bhūtale |
pūrvoktāni samastāni phalānyāpnoti tatkṣaṇāt |
pihitaḥ sarvalokāṃstrīnnityameva prapaśyati || 62 ||
meaning:
देवेन्द्रो जायते सोऽत्र प्रभावेणेह भूतले |
पूर्वोक्तानि समस्तानि फलान्याप्नोति तत्क्षणात् |
पिहितः सर्वलोकांस्त्रीन्नित्यमेव प्रपश्यति || 62 ||
text_mt: he becomes a lord of gods here on the earth by this power; / he instantly attains all the results spoken of earlier; / [though] concealed, he constantly beholds all the three worlds.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ sārdhaṃ yantravargaiḥ samastai-
raṣṭābhiryat pūrvamuktaṃ sahasram |
śukle vastre saṃlikhitvā svadehe
dhṛtvā nitya prāpnuyād vai samastam || 63 ||
meaning:
एवं सार्धं यन्त्रवर्गैः समस्तै-
रष्टाभिर्यत् पूर्वमुक्तं सहस्रम् |
शुक्ले वस्त्रे संलिखित्वा स्वदेहे
धृत्वा नित्य प्राप्नुयाद् वै समस्तम् || 63 ||
text_mt: Thus, along with all the groups of yantras, / the eight thousand that was spoken of earlier: / having written it on a white cloth and wearing it / on one's body daily, one obtains everything.

sanskrit_iast:
yaḥ kṣatrajāhirhṛdaye sa kuryāt
saṃgrāmakāle kavaceṣṭadhāmni |
mantrākṣarāṇyādikṛtāni devyā
aṣṭau bahirgātraviśeṣataśca || 64 ||
meaning:
यः क्षत्रजाहिर्हृदये स कुर्यात्
संग्रामकाले कवचेष्टधाम्नि |
मन्त्राक्षराण्यादिकृतानि देव्या
अष्टौ बहिर्गात्रविशेषतश्च || 64 ||
text_mt: He who belongs to the warrior class should place on his heart, / at the time of battle, upon the armor, in the eight abodes, / the letters of the mantra originally made by the goddess, / eight on the outside, specifically upon the limbs:

sanskrit_iast:
gale hari vakṣasi vai likhed vidhiṃ
stanadvaye putrayutaṃ maheśvaram
bāhvaṃgasandhyośca haraṃ ca vaiṣṇavīṃ
bāhvostu lakṣmīṃ ca sarasvatīṃ ca || 65 ||
meaning:
गले हरि वक्षसि वै लिखेद् विधिं
स्तनद्वये पुत्रयुतं महेश्वरम्
बाह्वंगसन्ध्योश्च हरं च वैष्णवीं
बाह्वोस्तु लक्ष्मीं च सरस्वतीं च || 65 ||
text_mt: on the neck he should write Hari; on the chest, Vidhi; / on the two breasts, Maheśvara with his son; / on the joints of the two arms, Hara and Vaiṣṇavī; / and on the two arms, Lakṣmī and Sarasvatī.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ raṇāṣṭāṅgamidaṃ vidhāya
gātre savarmaṇyanucintayecchivām |
meaning:
एवं रणाष्टाङ्गमिदं विधाय
गात्रे सवर्मण्यनुचिन्तयेच्छिवाम् |
text_mt: Having thus arranged this eightfold battle-[nyāsa] / on his body, while wearing armor, he should meditate on Śivā.

sanskrit_iast:
likhellalāṭe tilakāntare naraḥ
samastamantrakṣarayantramuttamam || 66 ||
meaning:
लिखेल्ललाटे तिलकान्तरे नरः
समस्तमन्त्रक्षरयन्त्रमुत्तमम् || 66 ||
text_mt: A man should write on his forehead within the tilaka / the supreme yantra composed of all the syllables of the mantra.

sanskrit_iast:
tato japedaṣṭadhā tu pāṇiṃ dattvāṣṭadhāmasu ca |
vaiṣṇavītantramantraṃ tu tato gacchedraṇājiram || 67 ||
meaning:
ततो जपेदष्टधा तु पाणिं दत्त्वाष्टधामसु च |
वैष्णवीतन्त्रमन्त्रं तु ततो गच्छेद्रणाजिरम् || 67 ||
text_mt: Then, having placed his hand eight times on the eight abodes, / he should recite the mantra of the Vaiṣṇavītantra eight times; then he should go to the battleground.

sanskrit_iast:
sa tu vīro mama samaḥ saṃgrāmeṣu ca jāyate |
tṛṇānīva parāstrāṇi jāyante'gnau tathātmani || 68 ||
meaning:
स तु वीरो मम समः संग्रामेषु च जायते |
तृणानीव परास्त्राणि जायन्तेऽग्नौ तथात्मनि || 68 ||
text_mt: He indeed becomes a hero equal to me in battles; / the enemy's weapons become like blades of grass in fire, so in him.

sanskrit_iast:
viniḥsaranti ripavo yācakā dhanini dhanam |
siṃhāgryānnaraśārdūlo vīryavān balavān bhavet || 69 ||
meaning:
विनिःसरन्ति रिपवो याचका धनिनि धनम् |
सिंहाग्र्यान्नरशार्दूलो वीर्यवान् बलवान् भवेत् || 69 ||
text_mt: Enemies run away, [just as] beggars [leave] a rich man [with] wealth; / he becomes foremost among lions, a tiger among men, heroic and strong.

sanskrit_iast:
idaṃ rahasyaṃ kathitaṃ kāmākhyāyāstu bhairava |
vaiṣṇavavyāstantramukhyeṣu tripurāyāstataḥ śṛṇu || 70 ||
meaning:
इदं रहस्यं कथितं कामाख्यायास्तु भैरव |
वैष्णवव्यास्तन्त्रमुख्येषु त्रिपुरायास्ततः शृणु || 70 ||
text_mt: This secret of Kāmākhyā has been proclaimed, O Bhairava, / foremost among the treatises of the Vaiṣṇava system; now hear that of Tripurā.

sanskrit_iast:
tasyāstu sarvamantrāṇi trayodaśayutāni vai |
viṃśatiṃ tu sahasrāṇāṃ tatrādyaṃ vāgbhavaṃ smṛtam || 71 ||
meaning:
तस्यास्तु सर्वमन्त्राणि त्रयोदशयुतानि वै |
विंशतिं तु सहस्राणां तत्राद्यं वाग्भवं स्मृतम् || 71 ||
text_mt: Her total mantras are indeed twenty / thousand with thirteen added; among them, the first is traditionally known as Vāgbhava.

sanskrit_iast:
dvitīyaṃ kāmarājākhyaṃ mohanaṃ ca tṛtīyakam |
āmreḍitaṃ vāgbhavaṃ tu caturthaṃ parikīrtitam || 72 ||
meaning:
द्वितीयं कामराजाख्यं मोहनं च तृतीयकम् |
आम्रेडितं वाग्भवं तु चतुर्थं परिकीर्तितम् || 72 ||
text_mt: The second is named Kāmarāja, and the third is Mohana; / the repeated Vāgbhava is declared to be the fourth.

sanskrit_iast:
netrabījaṃ dvitīyaṃ tu dviruktaṃ vāgbhavaṃ tathā |
ādyaṃ tatpaṃcamaṃ proktaṃ caturbhirapi cākṣaraiḥ || 73 ||
meaning:
नेत्रबीजं द्वितीयं तु द्विरुक्तं वाग्भवं तथा |
आद्यं तत्पंचमं प्रोक्तं चतुर्भिरपि चाक्षरैः || 73 ||
text_mt:
The second netrabīja, and likewise the vāgbhava spoken twice,
preceded by the first: that fifth [mantra] is declared to have four syllables.

sanskrit_iast:
netrabījaṃ dvitīyaṃ tu prathamaṃ parikīrtitam |
dvitīyaṃ kāmabījaṃ tu tṛtīyaṃ vāgbhavaṃ tathā || 74 ||
meaning:
नेत्रबीजं द्वितीयं तु प्रथमं परिकीर्तितम् |
द्वितीयं कामबीजं तु तृतीयं वाग्भवं तथा || 74 ||
text_mt:
The second netrabīja is declared to be first,
the kāmabīja is second, and likewise the vāgbhava is third;

sanskrit_iast:
ebhistribhistu yanmantraṃ tat ṣaṣṭhaṃ parikīrtitam |
netrabījaṃ dvitīyaṃ tu vāgbhavaṃ tena saptamam || 75 ||
meaning:
एभिस्त्रिभिस्तु यन्मन्त्रं तत् षष्ठं परिकीर्तितम् |
नेत्रबीजं द्वितीयं तु वाग्भवं तेन सप्तमम् || 75 ||
text_mt:
the mantra composed of these three is declared to be the sixth.
The second netrabīja and the vāgbhava form the seventh.

sanskrit_iast:
tadevaṃ vāgbhavādyaṃ tu aṣṭamaṃ parikīrtitam |
vāgbhavaṃ kāmabījaṃ tu netrābhyāṃ navamaṃ smṛtam || 76 ||
meaning:
तदेवं वाग्भवाद्यं तु अष्टमं परिकीर्तितम् |
वाग्भवं कामबीजं तु नेत्राभ्यां नवमं स्मृतम् || 76 ||
text_mt:
Thus the eighth is declared to begin with the vāgbhava.
The vāgbhava, the kāmabīja, and the two netras are taught as the ninth.

sanskrit_iast:
kāmabījaṃ tathaivādyaṃ daśamaṃ caiva mohanam |
ekādaśamidaṃ proktaṃ ḍāmarādyaṃ tu vāgbhavam || 77 ||
meaning:
कामबीजं तथैवाद्यं दशमं चैव मोहनम् |
एकादशमिदं प्रोक्तं डामराद्यं तु वाग्भवम् || 77 ||
text_mt:
Likewise, the kāmabīja first and mohana is the tenth.
This eleventh is declared to be vāgbhava preceded by ḍāmara.

sanskrit_iast:
dvādaśaṃ kīrtitaṃ mantraṃ śeṣatastraipuraṃ mahaḥ |
tanmahastraipuraṃ mantraṃ śṛṇuṣvaikamanāstvidam || 78 ||
meaning:
द्वादशं कीर्तितं मन्त्रं शेषतस्त्रैपुरं महः |
तन्महस्त्रैपुरं मन्त्रं शृणुष्वैकमनास्त्विदम् || 78 ||
text_mt:
The twelfth mantra is proclaimed, and beyond it the splendor of Tripura.
Listen attentively to this mantra which is the splendor of Tripura:

sanskrit_iast:
prāntādistasya cāpyādirvahnirvāgbhavasandhitaḥ |
ādyaṃ tripurabhairavyā bījamādyaṃ prakīrtitam || 79 ||
meaning:
प्रान्तादिस्तस्य चाप्यादिर्वह्निर्वाग्भवसन्धितः |
आद्यं त्रिपुरभैरव्या बीजमाद्यं प्रकीर्तितम् || 79 ||
text_mt:
The letter before the last, and the one before that, fire, conjoined with vāgbhava:
this is proclaimed as the first bīja of Tripurabhairavī.

sanskrit_iast:
upāntaśca tadādiśca vahniśeṣasvarastathā |
caturthasvarabindvinduyutāścaitat dvitīyakam || 80 ||
meaning:
उपान्तश्च तदादिश्च वह्निशेषस्वरस्तथा |
चतुर्थस्वरबिन्द्विन्दुयुताश्चैतत् द्वितीयकम् || 80 ||
text_mt:
The penultimate and the letter before it, fire, the last vowel,
endowed with the fourth vowel, the bindu, and the moon: this is the second.

sanskrit_iast:
upāntaśca tadādiśca vahniśeṣasvarastathā |
samāptirbindusahitā sahitastu tṛtīyakaḥ || 81 ||
meaning:
उपान्तश्च तदादिश्च वह्निशेषस्वरस्तथा |
समाप्तिर्बिन्दुसहिता सहितस्तु तृतीयकः || 81 ||
text_mt:
The penultimate and the letter before it, fire, the last vowel,
with the final letter and endowed with the bindu: this is the third.

sanskrit_iast:
etat tattvaṃ vijānāti yo naro bhuvi bhūmaṇiḥ |
siddhavidyādharebhyastu so'dhikastatsamo bhavet || 82 ||
meaning:
एतत् तत्त्वं विजानाति यो नरो भुवि भूमणिः |
सिद्धविद्याधरेभ्यस्तु सोऽधिकस्तत्समो भवेत् || 82 ||
text_mt:
Whatever man on earth—a jewel among men—knows this truth,
he becomes superior to the Siddhas and Vidyādharas, or becomes their equal.

sanskrit_iast:
ete trayodaśa proktā mantrā mantreṣu cojjvalāḥ |
viṃśatestu sahasrebhyaḥ parāścaite prakīrtitāḥ || 83 ||
meaning:
एते त्रयोदश प्रोक्ता मन्त्रा मन्त्रेषु चोज्ज्वलाः |
विंशतेस्तु सहस्रेभ्यः पराश्चैते प्रकीर्तिताः || 83 ||
text_mt:
These thirteen radiant mantras among mantras are declared;
they are proclaimed to be the highest of the twenty thousand.

sanskrit_iast:
viṃśatestu sahasrāṇāmādyametat prakīrtitam |
tripurāyāstu bālāyā mantraṃ tacchṛṇu bhairava || 84 ||
meaning:
विंशतेस्तु सहस्राणामाद्यमेतत् प्रकीर्तितम् |
त्रिपुरायास्तु बालाया मन्त्रं तच्छृणु भैरव || 84 ||
text_mt:
This is declared to be the foremost of the twenty thousand.
Now hear that mantra of Bālā Tripura, O Bhairava:

sanskrit_iast:
vāgbhavaṃ kāmarājastu upāntādiḥ sabindukaḥ |
śeṣasvarasamāptibhyāṃ mantrametat prakīrtitam || 85 ||
meaning:
वाग्भवं कामराजस्तु उपान्तादिः सबिन्दुकः |
शेषस्वरसमाप्तिभ्यां मन्त्रमेतत् प्रकीर्तितम् || 85 ||
text_mt:
The vāgbhava, kāmarāja, the letter before the last with a bindu,
with the last vowel and the end letter: this mantra is declared.

sanskrit_iast:
eṣā tu tripurā bālā madhyā proktā puraiva hi |
śeṣā tejasvinī proktā yeyaṃ tripurabhairavī || 86 ||
meaning:
एषा तु त्रिपुरा बाला मध्या प्रोक्ता पुरैव हि |
शेषा तेजस्विनी प्रोक्ता येयं त्रिपुरभैरवी || 86 ||
text_mt:
She is the intermediate Tripura called Bālā, declared earlier indeed;
the other, radiant one is proclaimed to be this Tripurabhairavī.

sanskrit_iast:
madhyāyāḥ pūjanaṃ proktaṃ bālāyāḥ śṛṇu sāmpratam |
tathā tripurabhairavyāḥ sarvasiddhipradāyakam || 87 ||
meaning:
मध्यायाः पूजनं प्रोक्तं बालायाः शृणु साम्प्रतम् |
तथा त्रिपुरभैरव्याः सर्वसिद्धिप्रदायकम् || 87 ||
text_mt:
The worship of the intermediate goddess has been proclaimed; now hear that of Bālā,
and likewise of Tripurabhairavī, which grants all accomplishments.

sanskrit_iast:
vibhidya śaktyā śambhuṃ tu śaktiṃ cāpi vibhedayet |
śambhave varṇaṣaṭkoṇaṃ keśaraṃ tatra saṃlikhet || 88 ||
meaning:
विभिद्य शक्त्या शम्भुं तु शक्तिं चापि विभेदयेत् |
शम्भवे वर्णषट्कोणं केशरं तत्र संलिखेत् || 88 ||
text_mt:
Having pierced Śambhu by means of Śakti, one should also pierce Śakti;
for Śambhu, one should draw a six-pointed figure with letters, and the filaments there.

sanskrit_iast:
madhyāyāstripurāyāstu yādṛśe dvāramaṇḍale |
tādṛśe'trāpi kartavyaṃ koṇeṣu likhitaṃ tathā || 89 ||
meaning:
मध्यायास्त्रिपुरायास्तु यादृशे द्वारमण्डले |
तादृशेऽत्रापि कर्तव्यं कोणेषु लिखितं तथा || 89 ||
text_mt:
As is the door-diagram of the intermediate Tripura,
just so must it be made here too, drawn in the corners.

sanskrit_iast:
pāpotsāraṇakarmāṇi bhūmyādīnāṃ viśodhanam |
pūrvamuttaratantroktaṃ tripurāpīṭhabhāṣitam || 90 ||
meaning:
पापोत्सारणकर्माणि भूम्यादीनां विशोधनम् |
पूर्वमुत्तरतन्त्रोक्तं त्रिपुरापीठभाषितम् || 90 ||
text_mt:
The rites of driving away sins, the purification of the ground and the rest,
told earlier in the Uttaratantra, proclaimed in the Tripura seat,

sanskrit_iast:
kāmākhyāpūjane proktaṃ sarvaṃ kuryāt tu sādhakaḥ |
dahanaplavanādīni pratipattiṃ ca pātrake || 91 ||
meaning:
कामाख्यापूजने प्रोक्तं सर्वं कुर्यात् तु साधकः |
दहनप्लवनादीनि प्रतिपत्तिं च पात्रके || 91 ||
text_mt:
and taught in the worship of Kāmākhyā—all that the practitioner should perform,
including burning, inundation, and the assignment to the vessel.

sanskrit_iast:
sarvaṃ tu pūrvavat kāryaṃ kāmākhayāpūjane yathā |
kṛtvā'tra dehanyāsaṃ tu mantravarṇaistathākṣaraiḥ || 92 ||
meaning:
सर्वं तु पूर्ववत् कार्यं कामाखयापूजने यथा |
कृत्वाऽत्र देहन्यासं तु मन्त्रवर्णैस्तथाक्षरैः || 92 ||
text_mt:
All should be done as before, just as in the worship of Kāmākhyā.
Having performed the nyāsa upon the body here with the mantra syllables and phonemes,

sanskrit_iast:
sarvaiḥ svaraistathā kādyaistato rūpaṃ vicintayet |
caturbhujāṃ raktavarṇāṃ raktavastravibhūṣitām || 93 ||
meaning:
सर्वैः स्वरैस्तथा काद्यैस्ततो रूपं विचिन्तयेत् |
चतुर्भुजां रक्तवर्णां रक्तवस्त्रविभूषिताम् || 93 ||
text_mt:
with all the vowels and the consonants beginning with 'ka', he should then visualize her form:
four-armed, red-complexioned, adorned in red garments,

sanskrit_iast:
dakṣiṇordhve srajaṃ cādho bibhratīṃ pustakottamam |
abhayaṃ vāmahastābhyāṃ varaṃ ca dadhatīṃ tathā || 94 ||
meaning:
दक्षिणोर्ध्वे स्रजं चाधो बिभ्रतीं पुस्तकोत्तमम् |
अभयं वामहस्ताभ्यां वरं च दधतीं तथा || 94 ||
text_mt:
holding a rosary in the upper right hand and an excellent book below,
and likewise showing freedom from fear and granting boons with the left hands,

sanskrit_iast:
sahasrasūryasaṃkāśāṃ trinetrāṃ jagagāminīm |
pīnatuṅgastanayugāṃ sitapretāsanasthitām || 95 ||
meaning:
सहस्रसूर्यसंकाशां त्रिनेत्रां जगगामिनीम् |
पीनतुङ्गस्तनयुगां सितप्रेतासनस्थिताम् || 95 ||
text_mt:
resembling a thousand suns, three-eyed, moving through the universe,
with full and elevated breasts, seated upon a white corpse,

sanskrit_iast:
smitaprasannavadanāṃ sarvālaṃkārasaṃyutām |
tisṛbhirmuṇḍamālābhiḥ śirovakṣaḥkaṭīṣu ca || 96 ||
meaning:
स्मितप्रसन्नवदनां सर्वालंकारसंयुताम् |
तिसृभिर्मुण्डमालाभिः शिरोवक्षःकटीषु च || 96 ||
text_mt:
with a smiling and gracious face, endowed with all ornaments,
with three garlands of human heads on her head, chest, and waist,

sanskrit_iast:
triguṇāṃ triguṇībhūtaiḥ pratyekaṃ paribhūṣitām |
madirāghūrṇanayanāṃ raktadantacchadadvayām || 97 ||
meaning:
त्रिगुणां त्रिगुणीभूतैः प्रत्येकं परिभूषिताम् |
मदिराघूर्णनयनां रक्तदन्तच्छदद्वयाम् || 97 ||
text_mt:
having three strands, each adorned by threefold [heads],
with eyes rolling from intoxicating drink, having red lips,

sanskrit_iast:
cintayed varadāṃ devīmevaṃ tripurabhairavīm |
bālāyāstripurāyastu rūpaṃ pūrvaṃ prapūjane || 98 ||
meaning:
चिन्तयेद् वरदां देवीमेवं त्रिपुरभैरवीम् |
बालायास्त्रिपुरायस्तु रूपं पूर्वं प्रपूजने || 98 ||
text_mt:
thus should one meditate upon the goddess Tripurabhairavī, the giver of boons.
The form of Bālā Tripura in earlier worship [was told];

sanskrit_iast:
uktaḥ kramaḥ pīṭhayoge tantrādi śṛṇu bhairava |
puṣpabāṇāṃstu pāśaṃ ca dhatte pauṣpaṃ śarāsanam || 99 ||
meaning:
उक्तः क्रमः पीठयोगे तन्त्रादि शृणु भैरव |
पुष्पबाणांस्तु पाशं च धत्ते पौष्पं शरासनम् || 99 ||
text_mt:
the method in connection with the pīṭha has been spoken; hear the tantra and the rest, O Bhairava:
she holds flower-arrows, a noose, and a bow made of flowers,

sanskrit_iast:
pāśaṃ ca kuṇapārūḍhā sā bālā tripurā smṛtā |
manmathe tripure devīṃ vidmahe padamāditaḥ || 100 ||
meaning:
पाशं च कुणपारूढा सा बाला त्रिपुरा स्मृता |
मन्मथे त्रिपुरे देवीं विद्महे पदमादितः || 100 ||
text_mt:
and a noose, mounted upon a corpse—she is remembered as Bālā Tripura.
'We know the goddess in the Tripura of Manmatha' are the words at the beginning;

sanskrit_iast:
kāmeśvarīṃ dhīmahi tvāṃ tannaḥ klinne pracodayāt |
eṣā tripuragāyatrītyāvāhanaviśeṣataḥ || 101 ||
meaning:
कामेश्वरीं धीमहि त्वां तन्नः क्लिन्ने प्रचोदयात् |
एषा त्रिपुरगायत्रीत्यावाहनविशेषतः || 101 ||
text_mt:
'We meditate on you, Kāmeśvarī; may that wet one inspire us.'
This is the Tripura-Gāyatrī, [recited] especially for the invocation.

sanskrit_iast:
snānādyaiḥ pūjayet samyag bālāmanyāṃ ca bhairavīm |
asyāḥ krame viśeṣo yo nyāse cottarakarmaṇi || 102 ||
meaning:
स्नानाद्यैः पूजयेत् सम्यग् बालामन्यां च भैरवीम् |
अस्याः क्रमे विशेषो यो न्यासे चोत्तरकर्मणि || 102 ||
text_mt:
He should properly worship Bālā and the other Bhairavī with bathings and the rest.
Whatever special rule there is in her procedure, both in nyāsa and the subsequent rites,

sanskrit_iast:
tatsarvaṃ saha mantraughaiḥ śṛṇu vetāla bhairava |
brāhme muhūrte utthāya cintayet paramaṃ gurum || 103 ||
meaning:
तत्सर्वं सह मन्त्रौघैः शृणु वेताल भैरव |
ब्राह्मे मुहूर्ते उत्थाय चिन्तयेत् परमं गुरुम् || 103 ||
text_mt:
hear all that along with the multitudes of mantras, O Vetāla and Bhairava!
Rising at the brāhma-muhūrta, one should meditate upon the supreme guru,

sanskrit_iast:
tato'nu svaguruṃ śuddhaṃ tatastripurabhairavīm |
caturbhujāṃ śuklavarṇāṃ varadābhayapustakām || 104 ||
meaning:
ततोऽनु स्वगुरुं शुद्धं ततस्त्रिपुरभैरवीम् |
चतुर्भुजां शुक्लवर्णां वरदाभयपुस्तकाम् || 104 ||
text_mt:
and after that upon one's own pure guru, and then upon Tripurabhairavī:
four-armed, white-colored, holding [the gestures of] granting boons and fearlessness, and a book,

sanskrit_iast:
akṣamālāṃ ca kramato dhatte vāme ca dakṣiṇe |
suvarṇaratnakhacite saṃsthitāṃ pravarāsane || 105 ||
meaning:
अक्षमालां च क्रमतो धत्ते वामे च दक्षिणे |
सुवर्णरत्नखचिते संस्थितां प्रवरासने || 105 ||
text_mt:
and holding a rosary in sequence in the left and right,
seated upon an excellent seat inlaid with gold and gems,

sanskrit_iast:
sauvarṇamuttarīyaṃ tu dhatte sauvarṇakuṇḍale |
svaguruṃ varṇato dhyānāt tathaiva paricintayet || 106 ||
meaning:
सौवर्णमुत्तरीयं तु धत्ते सौवर्णकुण्डले |
स्वगुरुं वर्णतो ध्यानात् तथैव परिचिन्तयेत् || 106 ||
text_mt:
wearing a golden upper garment and golden earrings;
one should meditate on one's guru in the same manner by color and visualization.

sanskrit_iast:
bhairavīṃ cintayitvā tu tata utthāya cācaret |
maitramācamanaṃ caiva dantānāṃ śodhanaṃ tathā || 107 ||
meaning:
भैरवीं चिन्तयित्वा तु तत उत्थाय चाचरेत् |
मैत्रमाचमनं चैव दन्तानां शोधनं तथा || 107 ||
text_mt:
Having meditated on Bhairavī, he should then rise and perform
the morning sipping of water and the cleaning of the teeth.

sanskrit_iast:
prātaḥsnānaṃ tataḥ kuryāt traipuraṃ yojayan kramam |
sarvatra devīmantreṣu vaidikeṣvapi bhairavīm || 108 ||
meaning:
प्रातःस्नानं ततः कुर्यात् त्रैपुरं योजयन् क्रमम् |
सर्वत्र देवीमन्त्रेषु वैदिकेष्वपि भैरवीम् || 108 ||
text_mt:
Then he should take the morning bath, applying the Tripura rite.
Everywhere, among the mantras of the Goddess and even among the Vedic ones, Bhairavī,

sanskrit_iast:
tripurāṃ cintayennityaṃ devamantreṣu ca kramāt |
tribhistu tripurābījaistridhā majjanamācaret || 109 ||
meaning:
त्रिपुरां चिन्तयेन्नित्यं देवमन्त्रेषु च क्रमात् |
त्रिभिस्तु त्रिपुराबीजैस्त्रिधा मज्जनमाचरेत् || 109 ||
text_mt:
Tripura, he should constantly meditate upon in the mantras of the gods in order.
With the three Tripura seed-syllables he should perform immersion three times.

sanskrit_iast:
devānāmapi sarveṣu bhairaveṣu adaṃ sadā |
kuryād viśeṣaṇaṃ nityaṃ noccāryaṃ nirviśeṣaṇam || 110 ||
meaning:
देवानामपि सर्वेषु भैरवेषु अदं सदा |
कुर्याद् विशेषणं नित्यं नोच्चार्यं निर्विशेषणम् || 110 ||
text_mt:
Even among all the gods, one should always make the designation 'Bhairava'
as a constant qualification; it should never be uttered without the qualification.

sanskrit_iast:
apaḥ punantu pṛthivīmuktvā tripurabhairavīm |
kuryādācamanaṃ vipro drupadāyāṃ tathācaret || 111 ||
meaning:
अपः पुनन्तु पृथिवीमुक्त्वा त्रिपुरभैरवीम् |
कुर्यादाचमनं विप्रो द्रुपदायां तथाचरेत् || 111 ||
text_mt:
Having recited 'May the waters purify the earth,' and Tripurabhairavī,
the twice-born should perform ācamana; he should do likewise with the drupadā [verse].

sanskrit_iast:
idaṃ viṣṇurbhairavastu vicakrama itīritam |
mṛdālambhanakṛtyeṣu nityamevāpyudīrayet || 112 ||
meaning:
इदं विष्णुर्भैरवस्तु विचक्रम इतीरितम् |
मृदालम्भनकृत्येषु नित्यमेवाप्युदीरयेत् || 112 ||
text_mt:
'Through this Viṣṇu [as] Bhairava strode' is spoken;
he should constantly utter this in the rites of handling clay.

sanskrit_iast:
gāyatrīṃ tripurādyāṃ tu bhairavīmāhvayecchivām |
mārtaṇḍabhairavāyeti sūryāyārghyaṃ nivedayet || 113 ||
meaning:
गायत्रीं त्रिपुराद्यां तु भैरवीमाह्वयेच्छिवाम् |
मार्तण्डभैरवायेति सूर्यायार्घ्यं निवेदयेत् || 113 ||
text_mt:
He should invoke the auspicious Bhairavī beginning with the Tripura-Gāyatrī;
saying 'To Mārtaṇḍabhairava,' he should offer the arghya to the sun.

sanskrit_iast:
udutyaṃ jātavedasaṃ devaṃ vahanti ketavaḥ |
dṛśe viśvāya sūryaṃ śeṣe bhairavamīrayet || 114 ||
meaning:
उदुत्यं जातवेदसं देवं वहन्ति केतवः |
दृशे विश्वाय सूर्यं शेषे भैरवमीरयेत् || 114 ||
text_mt:
'The rays carry upward that god who knows all beings,
the sun, for all to see'—at the end of this he should utter 'Bhairava.'

sanskrit_iast:
tarpaṇādau prayuṃjīta tṛpyatāṃ brahmabhairavaḥ |
āvāhane svayaṃ pitṛn bhairavāniti kīrtayet || 115 ||
meaning:
तर्पणादौ प्रयुंजीत तृप्यतां ब्रह्मभैरवः |
आवाहने स्वयं पितृन् भैरवानिति कीर्तयेत् || 115 ||
text_mt:
In the libation and other rites he should use: 'May Brahmā-Bhairava be pleased!'
In invocation, he should himself name the ancestors as Bhairavas:

sanskrit_iast:
tṛpyatāṃ bhairavīmātaḥ pitarbhairava tṛpyatām |
ādau ca tripurāpūrvaṃ tarpaṇe'pi prayojayet || 116 ||
meaning:
तृप्यतां भैरवीमातः पितर्भैरव तृप्यताम् |
आदौ च त्रिपुरापूर्वं तर्पणेऽपि प्रयोजयेत् || 116 ||
text_mt:
'May Bhairavī-Mother be pleased! O Father-Bhairava, be pleased!'
And at the beginning he should also employ 'Tripurā' in the libation.

sanskrit_iast:
jyotiṣṭomāśvamedhādau yatra yaṃ yaṃ prapūjayet |
tatra bhairavarūpeṇa devīmapi ca bhairavīm || 117 ||
meaning:
ज्योतिष्टोमाश्वमेधादौ यत्र यं यं प्रपूजयेत् |
तत्र भैरवरूपेण देवीमपि च भैरवीम् || 117 ||
text_mt: In the Jyotiṣṭoma, Aśvamedha, and other [sacrifices], wherever one worships whatever [deity], / there [one should worship] as Bhairava, and the Goddess as Bhairavī.

sanskrit_iast:
madirāpātramālokya raktavastrāṃ striyaṃ tathā |
śiro narasya dṛṣṭvā tu bhairavīṃ cintayed dvijaḥ || 118 ||
meaning:
मदिरापात्रमालोक्य रक्तवस्त्रां स्त्रियं तथा |
शिरो नरस्य दृष्ट्वा तु भैरवीं चिन्तयेद् द्विजः || 118 ||
text_mt: Beholding a vessel of liquor, likewise a woman in red garments, / or seeing a human head, a twice-born should meditate on Bhairavī.

sanskrit_iast:
striyo dṛṣṭvā hyathaikatra yuvatīḥ sumanoharāḥ |
tābhyastripurabhairavyāḥ prītaye vandanādikam || 119 ||
meaning:
स्त्रियो दृष्ट्वा ह्यथैकत्र युवतीः सुमनोहराः |
ताभ्यस्त्रिपुरभैरव्याः प्रीतये वन्दनादिकम् || 119 ||
text_mt: And seeing women gathered in one place, young and very captivating, / to them, for the pleasure of Tripurabhairavī, salutation and the rest—

sanskrit_iast:
dadyād bhaktyā tu manasā cintayannatha bhairavīm |
bhairavīṃ pratigṛhṇāmi bhairavo'haṃ pratigrahī || 120 ||
meaning:
दद्याद् भक्त्या तु मनसा चिन्तयन्नथ भैरवीम् |
भैरवीं प्रतिगृह्णामि भैरवोऽहं प्रतिग्रही || 120 ||
text_mt: he should offer with devotion, meditating mentally then on Bhairavī: / “I receive Bhairavī; I am Bhairava, the receiver.”

sanskrit_iast:
kanyāyāṃ bhāvayed dhīmāṃstripurāyāḥ prapūjakaḥ |
bhairavāya dadāmyadya devīṃ tripurabhairavīm || 121 ||
meaning:
कन्यायां भावयेद् धीमांस्त्रिपुरायाः प्रपूजकः |
भैरवाय ददाम्यद्य देवीं त्रिपुरभैरवीम् || 121 ||
text_mt: The wise worshipper of Tripurā should mentally envision this regarding a maiden: / “I give today the goddess Tripurabhairavī to Bhairava.”

sanskrit_iast:
itīrayet pradāne tu kanyāyāstripurāṃ tataḥ |
tasyāḥ pūjopakaraṇapātrādi nānyapūjane || 122 ||
meaning:
इतीरयेत् प्रदाने तु कन्यायास्त्रिपुरां ततः |
तस्याः पूजोपकरणपात्रादि नान्यपूजने || 122 ||
text_mt: Thus should he speak at the giving of a maiden, then to Tripurā. / The vessels and other implements for her worship should not be used in the worship of another deity.

sanskrit_iast:
āsavādyaṃ ca satataṃ nopayojyaṃ kadācana |
sakṛt tu dāpayedanyairmadirāṃ sādhako dvijaḥ || 123 ||
meaning:
आसवाद्यं च सततं नोपयोज्यं कदाचन |
सकृत् तु दापयेदन्यैर्मदिरां साधको द्विजः || 123 ||
text_mt: And spirituous liquor and the like must never, under any circumstances, be employed [by him]; / but a twice-born practitioner should cause liquor to be offered once through others.

sanskrit_iast:
śūdrādayastu satataṃ dadayurāsavamuttamam |
evaṃ tu vāmabhāvena yajet tripurabhairavīm || 124 ||
meaning:
शूद्रादयस्तु सततं ददयुरासवमुत्तमम् |
एवं तु वामभावेन यजेत् त्रिपुरभैरवीम् || 124 ||
text_mt: Śūdras and others, however, should continually offer the best spirituous liquor. / Thus, through the left-hand method, one should worship Tripurabhairavī.

sanskrit_iast:
bālāṃ tu vāmadākṣiṇyamārgābhyāmapi pūjayet |
śmaśānabhairavīṃ devīmugratārāṃ tathaiva ca || 125 ||
meaning:
बालां तु वामदाक्षिण्यमार्गाभ्यामपि पूजयेत् |
श्मशानभैरवीं देवीमुग्रतारां तथैव च || 125 ||
text_mt: One may worship Bālā, however, through both the left-hand and right-hand paths, / and likewise the goddess Śmaśānabhairavī and Ugratārā,

sanskrit_iast:
ucchiṣṭabhairavīṃ caṇḍīṃ tathā tripurabhairavīm |
etāstu vāmabhāvena pūjyā dakṣiṇatāṃ vinā || 126 ||
meaning:
उच्छिष्टभैरवीं चण्डीं तथा त्रिपुरभैरवीम् |
एतास्तु वामभावेन पूज्या दक्षिणतां विना || 126 ||
text_mt: Ucchiṣṭabhairavī, Caṇḍī, and likewise Tripurabhairavī. / These, however, are to be worshipped through the left-hand method, without the right-hand [way].

sanskrit_iast:
ṛṣīn devān pitṛścaiva manuṣyān bhutasañcayān |
yajet paṃcabhiryajñair-ṛṇāni pariśodhayet || 127 ||
meaning:
ऋषीन् देवान् पितृश्चैव मनुष्यान् भुतसञ्चयान् |
यजेत् पंचभिर्यज्ञैर्-ऋणानि परिशोधयेत् || 127 ||
text_mt: One should worship the sages, the gods, the ancestors, humans, and the multitudes of beings / by means of the five sacrifices, and discharge one's debts.

sanskrit_iast:
vidhivat snānadānābhyāṃ kurvan yadvidhipūjanam |
kriyate sarahasyaṃ tu tadddākṣiṇyamihocyate || 128 ||
meaning:
विधिवत् स्नानदानाभ्यां कुर्वन् यद्विधिपूजनम् |
क्रियते सरहस्यं तु तद्द्दाक्षिण्यमिहोच्यते || 128 ||
text_mt: Performing the worship according to rule, with bathing and giving according to rule, / what is done with its secret [ritual] is called the right-hand [path] here.

sanskrit_iast:
sarve ca pitṛdevādau yasmād bhavati dakṣiṇaḥ |
devī ca dakṣiṇā yasmāt tasmād dakṣiṇa ucyate || 129 ||
meaning:
सर्वे च पितृदेवादौ यस्माद् भवति दक्षिणः |
देवी च दक्षिणा यस्मात् तस्माद् दक्षिण उच्यते || 129 ||
text_mt: Because it is upright regarding all, beginning with the ancestors and gods, / and because the Goddess is Dakṣiṇā, therefore it is called right-hand.

sanskrit_iast:
yā punaḥ pūjyamānā tu devādīnāṃ ca pūrvataḥ |
yajñabhāgaṃ svayaṃ dhatte sāvāmā tu prakīrtitā || 130 ||
meaning:
या पुनः पूज्यमाना तु देवादीनां च पूर्वतः |
यज्ञभागं स्वयं धत्ते सावामा तु प्रकीर्तिता || 130 ||
text_mt: She, on the other hand, who when worshipped even before the gods and others, / takes the sacrificial portion for herself, is celebrated as Vāmā.

sanskrit_iast:
pūjako'pi bhaved vāmastatraiva satataṃ suta |
paṃcayajñān na vā kuryād yad vā vāmyaprapūjane || 131 ||
meaning:
पूजकोऽपि भवेद् वामस्तत्रैव सततं सुत |
पंचयज्ञान् न वा कुर्याद् यद् वा वाम्यप्रपूजने || 131 ||
text_mt: The worshipper too becomes left-handed in that very case constantly, O son; / or he should not perform the five sacrifices, or whatever else [is omitted] in the left-hand worship,

sanskrit_iast:
anyasya pūjābhāgaṃ hi yato gṛhṇāti vāpikā |
yatpūjayedvāmabhāvairna tat syādṛṇaśodhanam || 132 ||
meaning:
अन्यस्य पूजाभागं हि यतो गृह्णाति वापिका |
यत्पूजयेद्वामभावैर्न तत् स्यादृणशोधनम् || 132 ||
text_mt: for she takes the portion of worship meant for another. / What he worships through left-hand methods does not bring the clearing of debt,

sanskrit_iast:
pitṛdevanarādīnāṃ jāyate ca kadācana |
so'bhyasya tripurāyogaṃ tena yogena saṃyutaḥ || 133 ||
meaning:
पितृदेवनरादीनां जायते च कदाचन |
सोऽभ्यस्य त्रिपुरायोगं तेन योगेन संयुतः || 133 ||
