 ai o au visargaśca bindvādiryājñikastathā || 6 ||
meaning:
आ इ ई उ ऊ ऋ ॠ ऌ ॡ एतेऽदीर्घदीर्घकाः |
 ऐ ओ औ विसर्गश्च बिन्द्वादिर्याज्ञिकस्तथा || 6 ||
text_mt: ā, i, ī, u, ū, ṛ, ṝ, ḷ, ḹ—these are non-long and long; / e, ai, o, au, visarga, and the nasal dot etc. are likewise used in sacrifice.

sanskrit_iast: hvanerantarajāśceti kīrtitāstu svarā amī |
meaning: ह्वनेरन्तरजाश्चेति कीर्तितास्तु स्वरा अमी |
text_mt: Born within sound, these vowels are proclaimed.

sanskrit_iast: khakarāśca gakārāśca gha ṅo vargaḥ prakīrtitaḥ || 7 ||
meaning: खकराश्च गकाराश्च घ ङो वर्गः प्रकीर्तितः || 7 ||
text_mt: The letter kha, the letter ga, gha, and ṅa are declared to be a class.

sanskrit_iast:
yañjanakārādichajau ṭakāraḥ paramasmṛtaḥ |
ukarāśca ḍakāraśca bhairavaśabdādireva ca || 8 ||
meaning:
यञ्जनकारादिछजौ टकारः परमस्मृतः |
उकराश्च डकारश्च भैरवशब्दादिरेव च || 8 ||
text_mt: Consonants beginning with ca, [then] cha, ja, jha; ña is remembered as the next; / then the letter ṭa, the letter ḍha, and that which begins the word 'bhairava' [i.e., ḍa and dha / ḍa and ḍha].

sanskrit_iast:
ṇakārāntastṛtīyo'yaṃ vargoṣṭhādiḥ prakīrtitaḥ |
thakāraśca dakāraśva dharmaśabdādireva ca || 9 ||
meaning:
णकारान्तस्तृतीयोऽयं वर्गोष्ठादिः प्रकीर्तितः |
थकारश्च दकारश्व धर्मशब्दादिरेव च || 9 ||
text_mt: Ending in the letter ṇa, this third class is proclaimed beginning with the lips [and palate]; / and the letter tha, the letter da, and that which begins the word 'dharma' [i.e., dha],

sanskrit_iast:
navaśabdasya caivādiścaturtho varga ucyate |
phalaśabdasya yaścādirbahuśabdādireva ca || 10 ||
meaning:
नवशब्दस्य चैवादिश्चतुर्थो वर्ग उच्यते |
फलशब्दस्य यश्चादिर्बहुशब्दादिरेव च || 10 ||
text_mt: and the beginning of the word 'nava' [i.e., na] is called the fourth class; / and that which is the beginning of the word 'phala' [i.e., pha], that which begins the word 'bahu' [i.e., ba],

sanskrit_iast:
bhakāro manaḥśabdādi pañcamo varga ucyate |
yakāraśca rakāraśca lakāro vastathaiva ca || 11 ||
meaning:
भकारो मनःशब्दादि पञ्चमो वर्ग उच्यते |
यकारश्च रकारश्च लकारो वस्तथैव च || 11 ||
text_mt: the letter bha, and the beginning of the word 'manas' [i.e., ma] is called the fifth class; / and the letter ya, the letter ra, the letter la, and likewise va:

sanskrit_iast:
ebhiścaturbhirvargā'yaṃ ṣaṣṭho bhairava ucyate |
śaṣasā haḥ kṣakāraśca saṃyogaḥ parivedakaḥ || 12 ||
meaning:
एभिश्चतुर्भिर्वर्गाऽयं षष्ठो भैरव उच्यते |
शषसा हः क्षकारश्च संयोगः परिवेदकः || 12 ||
text_mt: composed of these four, O Bhairava, this sixth class is proclaimed; / śa, ṣa, sa, ha, and the letter kṣa is a compound revealing [the rest]:

sanskrit_iast:
pañcabhiḥ śeṣavargo'yaṃ saptamaḥ parikīrtitaḥ |
saṃyogayogasaṃlomapratilomairime suta || 13 ||
meaning:
पञ्चभिः शेषवर्गोऽयं सप्तमः परिकीर्तितः |
संयोगयोगसंलोमप्रतिलोमैरिमे सुत || 13 ||
text_mt: with these five, this remaining seventh class is proclaimed. / By conjunction, disjunction, direct order, and reverse order, O son,

sanskrit_iast:
varṇāḥ syurmantranāmādau vāṅmātre'pi ca bhairava |
caturvargapradā varṇāḥ sukhaduḥkhakarāstathā || 14 ||
meaning:
वर्णाः स्युर्मन्त्रनामादौ वाङ्मात्रेऽपि च भैरव |
चतुर्वर्गप्रदा वर्णाः सुखदुःखकरास्तथा || 14 ||
text_mt: these phonemes occur at the beginning of the name of a mantra and even in mere speech, O Bhairava; / the phonemes grant the four goals of life and cause pleasure and pain.

sanskrit_iast:
rogaṃ ca tejasampūjyapūjakāḥ parikīrtitāḥ |
ahaṃḥ viṣṇuśca brahmā ca gāyatrī brahmamātṛkāḥ || 15 ||
meaning:
रोगं च तेजसम्पूज्यपूजकाः परिकीर्तिताः |
अहंः विष्णुश्च ब्रह्मा च गायत्री ब्रह्ममातृकाः || 15 ||
text_mt: They are proclaimed as disease, splendor, the worshipped, and the worshipper. / I, Viṣṇu, Brahmā, and Gāyatrī are the mothers of Brahman.

sanskrit_iast:
aparaṃ brahmavarṇā ye parabrahmasukhapradam |
aparaṃ brahmakuśalaḥ parabrahmādhigacchati || 16 ||
meaning:
अपरं ब्रह्मवर्णा ये परब्रह्मसुखप्रदम् |
अपरं ब्रह्मकुशलः परब्रह्माधिगच्छति || 16 ||
text_mt: The phonemes of the lower Brahman bestow the bliss of the supreme Brahman; / skilled in the lower Brahman, one attains the supreme Brahman.

sanskrit_iast:
sisṛkṣurīśvaro varṇājja ganti svecchayā punaḥ |
sasarja mama vaktre tāṃ brahmavaktre ca vai nyadhāt || 17 ||
meaning:
सिसृक्षुरीश्वरो वर्णाज्ज गन्ति स्वेच्छया पुनः |
ससर्ज मम वक्त्रे तां ब्रह्मवक्त्रे च वै न्यधात् || 17 ||
text_mt: Desiring to create the worlds again by his own will from the phonemes, the Lord / created them in my mouth and placed them into the mouth of Brahmā.

sanskrit_iast:
ahaṃ tu sakalān varṇān nyasya bhairava tantrakam |
akāra bahulaṃ putra jñānamārgaṃ vivardhayan || 18 ||
meaning:
अहं तु सकलान् वर्णान् न्यस्य भैरव तन्त्रकम् |
अकार बहुलं पुत्र ज्ञानमार्गं विवर्धयन् || 18 ||
text_mt: Having inscribed all the phonemes, O Bhairava, I made the tantra / abundant in the letter a, my son, augmenting the path of knowledge.

sanskrit_iast:
ya ime gaditā varṇā mayā varṇaviniścaye |
mantraśuddhivivekārthaṃ varṇacakraṃ tataḥ śṛṇu || 19 ||
meaning:
य इमे गदिता वर्णा मया वर्णविनिश्चये |
मन्त्रशुद्धिविवेकार्थं वर्णचक्रं ततः शृणु || 19 ||
text_mt: These phonemes which have been spoken by me in the determination of phonemes— / hear now the wheel of phonemes for discerning the purity of a mantra.

sanskrit_iast:
śaktiśambhusvarūpiṇyo rekhe dve prathamaṃ nyaset |
tanmadhyataḥ unārekhe viṣṇulakṣmītale tathā || 20 ||
meaning:
शक्तिशम्भुस्वरूपिण्यो रेखे द्वे प्रथमं न्यसेत् |
तन्मध्यतः उनारेखे विष्णुलक्ष्मीतले तथा || 20 ||
text_mt: First one should draw two lines possessing the nature of Śakti and Śambhu; / between them, two lines underneath, and likewise at the base of Viṣṇu and Lakṣmī.

sanskrit_iast:
tayostu rekhayormadhye dve rekhe samato nyaset |
tasya cakrasya cāreṣu rekhāstu parisaṃkhyayā || 21 ||
meaning:
तयोस्तु रेखयोर्मध्ये द्वे रेखे समतो न्यसेत् |
तस्य चक्रस्य चारेषु रेखास्तु परिसंख्यया || 21 ||
text_mt: Between those two lines, one should draw two lines evenly; / and on the spokes of that wheel, lines in number—

sanskrit_iast:
catasrastu pradātavyāḥ svaramadhye tu bhairava |
bhinnānāṃ ca tathā varṇāḥ sandhayo'ṣṭau prakīrtitāḥ || 22 ||
meaning:
चतस्रस्तु प्रदातव्याः स्वरमध्ये तु भैरव |
भिन्नानां च तथा वर्णाः सन्धयोऽष्टौ प्रकीर्तिताः || 22 ||
text_mt: four lines are to be placed within the vowels, O Bhairava; / and of the distinct phonemes, eight junctions are proclaimed.

sanskrit_iast:
nemayastu catasro'sya sandhimadhyeṣu kīrtitāḥ |
aṣṭārasaṃyutaṃ cakraṃ caturnemisamanvitam || 23 ||
meaning:
नेमयस्तु चतस्रोऽस्य सन्धिमध्येषु कीर्तिताः |
अष्टारसंयुतं चक्रं चतुर्नेमिसमन्वितम् || 23 ||
text_mt: Four rims of this [wheel] are proclaimed between the junctions; / the wheel is endowed with eight spokes and possessed of four rims,

sanskrit_iast:
bahirveṣṭanasaṃyuktaṃ varṇacakraṃ prakīrtitam |
meṣādīnāṃ ca rāśīnāmudayāstapratijñayā || 24 ||
meaning:
बहिर्वेष्टनसंयुक्तं वर्णचक्रं प्रकीर्तितम् |
मेषादीनां च राशीनामुदयास्तप्रतिज्ञया || 24 ||
text_mt: furnished with an outer enclosure: thus is the wheel of phonemes proclaimed. / By the determination of the rising and setting of the zodiacal signs beginning with Aries,

sanskrit_iast:
idameva bhaveccakraṃ jñānaśrīvṛddhi-kārakam |
idaṃ cakraṃ likhitvā tu samabhūmāvudaṅmukhaḥ || 25 ||
meaning:
इदमेव भवेच्चक्रं ज्ञानश्रीवृद्धि-कारकम् |
इदं चक्रं लिखित्वा तु समभूमावुदङ्मुखः || 25 ||
text_mt: this very wheel causes the increase of knowledge and fortune. / Having drawn this wheel on level ground, facing north

sanskrit_iast:
prāṅmukho vā likhed varṇāṃcchuciriṣṭaṃ naman gurum |
pradakṣiṇaṃ likhet tasmin varṇāsteṣveva tu kramāt || 26 ||
meaning:
प्राङ्मुखो वा लिखेद् वर्णांच्छुचिरिष्टं नमन् गुरुम् |
प्रदक्षिणं लिखेत् तस्मिन् वर्णास्तेष्वेव तु क्रमात् || 26 ||
text_mt: or facing east, purified, bowing to his chosen guru, he should write the phonemes; / he should write the phonemes clockwise in them, in regular order.

sanskrit_iast:
uro nemevakāraṃ tu rakāraṃ cāpi vai likhet |
akāraṃ varjayed dīrghamīkāraṃ ca svareṣu vai || 27 ||
meaning:
उरो नेमेवकारं तु रकारं चापि वै लिखेत् |
अकारं वर्जयेद् दीर्घमीकारं च स्वरेषु वै || 27 ||
text_mt: On the breast [and] on the rim, he should write the letter va and indeed the letter ra; / among vowels, he should avoid the long letter a [i.e., ā] and the letter ī.

sanskrit_iast:
akarādikṣakārānta jha ṭa ña ṇa varjitam |
pradakṣiṇakramādeva likhitvā varṇasañcayam || 28 ||
meaning:
अकरादिक्षकारान्त झ ट ञ ण वर्जितम् |
प्रदक्षिणक्रमादेव लिखित्वा वर्णसञ्चयम् || 28 ||
text_mt: From the letter a up to the letter kṣa, excluding jha, ṭa, ña, and ṇa, / having written the collection of phonemes in clockwise order,

sanskrit_iast:
sbanāmādyakṣaraṃ gṛhya kuryāt tu gaṇanakramam |
mantrasyādyakṣaraṃ yāvat siddhādyaṃ tatra yojayet || 29 ||
meaning:
स्बनामाद्यक्षरं गृह्य कुर्यात् तु गणनक्रमम् |
मन्त्रस्याद्यक्षरं यावत् सिद्धाद्यं तत्र योजयेत् || 29 ||
text_mt: taking the first syllable of his own name, he should make the calculation: / up to the first syllable of the mantra, he should apply the [status of] mastered and the rest.

sanskrit_iast:
navaikapañcake siddhaḥ sādhyaḥ ṣaḍyugmapaṅkiṣu |
trisaptaikādaśeṣveva susiddhaḥ parikīrtitaḥ || 30 ||
meaning:
नवैकपञ्चके सिद्धः साध्यः षड्युग्मपङ्किषु |
त्रिसप्तैकादशेष्वेव सुसिद्धः परिकीर्तितः || 30 ||
text_mt: At nine, one, and five it is mastered (siddha); it is to be mastered (sādhya) at six, two, and ten; / at three, seven, and eleven it is declared well-mastered (susiddha);

sanskrit_iast:
dvādaśāṣṭacaturtheṣu hātravaḥ parikīrtitaḥ |
siddhenaivācirāt siddhiḥ sādhyaḥ kālena sidhyati || 31 ||
meaning:
द्वादशाष्टचतुर्थेषु हात्रवः परिकीर्तितः |
सिद्धेनैवाचिरात् सिद्धिः साध्यः कालेन सिध्यति || 31 ||
text_mt: at twelve, eight, and four it is declared hostile (śātrava). / Through the mastered, success comes without delay; the [mantra] to be mastered succeeds in time;

sanskrit_iast:
krāmānnāśayate śatruḥ susiddhaḥ siddhido'cirāt |
yo yo varṇakramaḥ prokto mantre dakṣiṇagocare || 32 ||
meaning:
क्रामान्नाशयते शत्रुः सुसिद्धः सिद्धिदोऽचिरात् |
यो यो वर्णक्रमः प्रोक्तो मन्त्रे दक्षिणगोचरे || 32 ||
text_mt: the hostile destroys by degrees; the well-mastered grants success without delay. / Whatever order of phonemes has been spoken for a mantra in the right-hand domain,

sanskrit_iast:
vāmyārādhanamantreṣu kramaṃ śṛṇviha bhairava |
ṛḷ dvayaṃ ṅa ña ṇa nā varjyāśca varṇagocare || 33 ||
meaning:
वाम्याराधनमन्त्रेषु क्रमं शृण्विह भैरव |
ऋऌ द्वयं ङ ञ ण ना वर्ज्याश्च वर्णगोचरे || 33 ||
text_mt: hear here, O Bhairava, the order for mantras of left-hand worship: / the pairs of ṛ and ḷ, ṅa, ña, ṇa, and na are to be excluded in the domain of phonemes.

sanskrit_iast:
likhed vāmakrameṇaiva tatra varṇāstu mantravit |
nṛsiṃhārkavarāhāṇāṃ prasādapraṇavasya ca || 34 ||
meaning:
लिखेद् वामक्रमेणैव तत्र वर्णास्तु मन्त्रवित् |
नृसिंहार्कवराहाणां प्रसादप्रणवस्य च || 34 ||
text_mt: The knower of mantras should write the phonemes there in counter-clockwise order. / For Nṛsiṃha, Arka, and Varāha, and for the Prasāda [mantra] and Praṇava,

sanskrit_iast:
ekākṣaradvyakṣarāṇāṃ na siddhādivicintanam |
bījeṣu cāpi sarveṣu dīkṣārtheṣu ca bhairava || 35 ||
meaning:
एकाक्षरद्व्यक्षराणां न सिद्धादिविचिन्तनम् |
बीजेषु चापि सर्वेषु दीक्षार्थेषु च भैरव || 35 ||
text_mt: and for one-syllable and two-syllable [mantras], there is no consideration of mastered and the rest; / nor in all seed-syllables, and in matters of initiation, O Bhairava,

sanskrit_iast:
siddhādicintā no kāryā grāhyāstu daśa vaśyakam |
susiddhaṃ kāmadaṃ grāhyaṃ sādhyasiddhavicāraṇāt || 36 ||
meaning:
सिद्धादिचिन्ता नो कार्या ग्राह्यास्तु दश वश्यकम् |
सुसिद्धं कामदं ग्राह्यं साध्यसिद्धविचारणात् || 36 ||
text_mt: should consideration of mastered and the rest be made: the ten [and] subjugation are to be received; / after evaluating what is to be mastered and what is mastered, the well-mastered, which fulfills desires, is to be accepted.

sanskrit_iast:
na grāhyaḥ śātravo dhīrairgṛhītvāpnoti cāpadam |
yo yasyaikākṣaro mantrastannāmnā sa nigadyate || 37 ||
meaning:
न ग्राह्यः शात्रवो धीरैर्गृहीत्वाप्नोति चापदम् |
यो यस्यैकाक्षरो मन्त्रस्तन्नाम्ना स निगद्यते || 37 ||
text_mt: The hostile is not to be accepted by the wise; having received it, one meets with misfortune. / Whatever single-syllable mantra belongs to [a deity] is designated by that name;

sanskrit_iast:
sahitaścandrabindubhyāṃ tadbījamiti gadyate |
tathā śakro sakāraḥ syāt sārdhacandraḥ sabindukaḥ || 38 ||
meaning:
सहितश्चन्द्रबिन्दुभ्यां तद्बीजमिति गद्यते |
तथा शक्रो सकारः स्यात् सार्धचन्द्रः सबिन्दुकः || 38 ||
text_mt: joined with the crescent moon and the dot, it is called its seed-syllable (bīja). / Thus, for Śakra, there would be the letter sa with the half-moon and with the dot:

sanskrit_iast:
sa eva śakrabījaṃ syāt tathānyatrāpi yojayet |
mantroddhāreṣu sarvatra parataḥ parataḥ puraḥ || 39 ||
meaning:
स एव शक्रबीजं स्यात् तथान्यत्रापि योजयेत् |
मन्त्रोद्धारेषु सर्वत्र परतः परतः पुरः || 39 ||
text_mt: that indeed would be the seed-syllable of Śakra; thus one should apply it elsewhere as well. / Everywhere in extractions of mantras, successively one after another,

sanskrit_iast:
pūrvato'pi pare kāryamanuktaḥ pūrvapakṣakaḥ |
yadā ṣoḍaśasāhasraṃ vaiṣṇavyā mantrasañcayam || 40 ||
meaning:
पूर्वतोऽपि परे कार्यमनुक्तः पूर्वपक्षकः |
यदा षोडशसाहस्रं वैष्णव्या मन्त्रसञ्चयम् || 40 ||
text_mt: what is subsequent is to be placed even before what precedes; what has not been mentioned is the prior part. / When the sixteen-thousandfold collection of mantras of Vaiṣṇavī

sanskrit_iast:
cakre nirīkṣyate tatra ṣoḍaśāraṃ tu cakrakam |
viṃśatistu sahasrāṇi tripurāyā yadīkṣate || 41 ||
meaning:
चक्रे निरीक्ष्यते तत्र षोडशारं तु चक्रकम् |
विंशतिस्तु सहस्राणि त्रिपुराया यदीक्षते || 41 ||
text_mt: is examined in the wheel, a sixteen-spoked wheel is [used] there; / if one examines the twenty thousand [mantras] of Tripura,

sanskrit_iast:
dvātriṃśāraṃ tatra cakraṃ lekhanīyaṃ sadā budhaiḥ |
idameva mahācakraṃ ṣoḍaśārādikaṃ kṛtī || 42 ||
meaning:
द्वात्रिंशारं तत्र चक्रं लेखनीयं सदा बुधैः |
इदमेव महाचक्रं षोडशारादिकं कृती || 42 ||
text_mt: a thirty-two-spoked wheel should always be drawn there by the wise; / the adept [makes] this very great wheel, beginning with sixteen spokes.

sanskrit_iast:
kuryādadhikarekhābhirmantraśuddhyantare suta |
iyaṃ te kathitā putra mantrasiddhirabhīṣṭadā || 43 ||
meaning:
कुर्यादधिकरेखाभिर्मन्त्रशुद्ध्यन्तरे सुत |
इयं ते कथिता पुत्र मन्त्रसिद्धिरभीष्टदा || 43 ||
text_mt:
The adept should draw [it] with additional lines for purification of the mantras, O son.
This mantra-attainment, bestowing desired objects, has been described to you, my son.

sanskrit_iast:
jānāti samyak ya imāṃ sa jayī kāmamāpnuyāt |
rahasyaṃ paramaṃ putra prayogādiprakārataḥ || 44 ||
meaning:
जानाति सम्यक् य इमां स जयी काममाप्नुयात् |
रहस्यं परमं पुत्र प्रयोगादिप्रकारतः || 44 ||
text_mt:
Whoever knows this properly becomes victorious and attains his desire.
[Now,] my son, the supreme secret according to the rituals and practices,

sanskrit_iast:
vakṣyāmi tat samāsena śṛṇu vetāla bhairava |
dantaḥ pakṣaviḍālasya tattvacā pariveṣṭitaḥ || 45 ||
meaning:
वक्ष्यामि तत् समासेन शृणु वेताल भैरव |
दन्तः पक्षविडालस्य तत्त्वचा परिवेष्टितः || 45 ||
text_mt:
I shall state in brief; listen, O Vetāla and Bhairava!
A tooth of a flying fox wrapped in its own skin,

sanskrit_iast:
nirmālyena tu vaiṣṇavyā tat saṃveṣṭya guṇatrayam |
tat tad vā vāmasūtrasya tattanmantreṇa mantritam || 46 ||
meaning:
निर्माल्येन तु वैष्णव्या तत् संवेष्ट्य गुणत्रयम् |
तत् तद् वा वामसूत्रस्य तत्तन्मन्त्रेण मन्त्रितम् || 46 ||
text_mt:
and wrapped with the garland remnants offered to Vaiṣṇavī in three strands,
or wrapped with a left-hand thread and consecrated with that mantra,

sanskrit_iast:
gṛhītvā dakṣiṇe pāṇau mantrāṇāṃ śatamāditaḥ |
sañcayedatha vaiṣṇavyā aṣṭamyāṃ niyatendriyaḥ || 47 ||
meaning:
गृहीत्वा दक्षिणे पाणौ मन्त्राणां शतमादितः |
सञ्चयेदथ वैष्णव्या अष्टम्यां नियतेन्द्रियः || 47 ||
text_mt:
taking it in the right hand, with senses controlled,
on the eighth lunar day one should first gather a hundred of the mantras of Vaiṣṇavī;

sanskrit_iast:
tatastu dakṣiṇe bāhau dhāryaṃ yantrottamaṃ budhaiḥ |
tato dvādaśasiddhiḥ syāddhartācennātritittilīm || 48 ||
meaning:
ततस्तु दक्षिणे बाहौ धार्यं यन्त्रोत्तमं बुधैः |
ततो द्वादशसिद्धिः स्याद्धर्ताचेन्नात्रितित्तिलीम् || 48 ||
text_mt:
then the wise should wear this supreme yantra on the right arm;
therefrom twelvefold attainment arises, if the wearer does not cross over a sesame-stem.

sanskrit_iast:
jayaḥ saṃgrāmavādeṣu śarīrasyāpyarogitā |
vaśakṛdrājaputrāṇāṃ rājñāmapi ca santatam || 49 ||
meaning:
जयः संग्रामवादेषु शरीरस्याप्यरोगिता |
वशकृद्राजपुत्राणां राज्ञामपि च सन्ततम् || 49 ||
text_mt:
Victory in battles and debates, freedom from disease for the body,
and continuous subjugation of princes and even kings [ensues].

sanskrit_iast:
bhūtapretapiśācāśca no yānti netragocaram |
yoṣitāṃ samadānāṃ tu vaśakṛccintanāt sakṛt || 50 ||
meaning:
भूतप्रेतपिशाचाश्च नो यान्ति नेत्रगोचरम् |
योषितां समदानां तु वशकृच्चिन्तनात् सकृत् || 50 ||
text_mt:
Ghosts, spirits, and Piśācas do not come within range of his eyes,
and impassioned women are subjugated at once merely by thinking [of them].

sanskrit_iast:
rudhirāṇāṃ śleṣmaṇā ca dhātūnāṃ stambhanaṃ tathā |
tejasāṃ stambhakaṃ caiva cakṣustejaḥpradaṃ tathā || 51 ||
meaning:
रुधिराणां श्लेष्मणा च धातूनां स्तम्भनं तथा |
तेजसां स्तम्भकं चैव चक्षुस्तेजःप्रदं तथा || 51 ||
text_mt:
It causes the stanching of blood, phlegm, and the bodily humours,
the restraining of powers, and the granting of luster to the eyes.

sanskrit_iast:
mūrdhni pakṣaviḍālasya hastaṃ dattvā śatatrayam |
vaiṣṇavītantramantraṃ tu japtvā taṃ sthāpayed gṛhe || 52 ||
meaning:
मूर्ध्नि पक्षविडालस्य हस्तं दत्त्वा शतत्रयम् |
वैष्णवीतन्त्रमन्त्रं तु जप्त्वा तं स्थापयेद् गृहे || 52 ||
text_mt:
Placing the hand on the head of a flying fox, reciting three hundred times
the mantra of the Vaiṣṇavī-tantra, one should keep it in the house.

sanskrit_iast:
taṃ viḍālaṃ tu yā paśyenmalinī vanitā suta |
nāputrā sā bhavitrī tu kadācidapi bhairava || 53 ||
meaning:
तं विडालं तु या पश्येन्मलिनी वनिता सुत |
नापुत्रा सा भवित्री तु कदाचिदपि भैरव || 53 ||
text_mt:
The menstruating woman who gazes upon that fox, O son,
shall never be childless, O Bhairava!

sanskrit_iast:
tādṛk pakṣaviḍālastu yasya tiṣṭhati mandire |
mṛtāpatyāpi tadgehe jīvatputrā prajāyate || 54 ||
meaning:
तादृक् पक्षविडालस्तु यस्य तिष्ठति मन्दिरे |
मृतापत्यापि तद्गेहे जीवत्पुत्रा प्रजायते || 54 ||
text_mt:
In whose house such a flying fox remains,
even a woman whose children have died bears living sons in that dwelling.

sanskrit_iast:
kokilo bhṛṅgarājo vā cakoro vā śuko'thavā |
vaiṣṇavītantramantreṇa mantrito yatra tiṣṭhati || 55 ||
meaning:
कोकिलो भृङ्गराजो वा चकोरो वा शुकोऽथवा |
वैष्णवीतन्त्रमन्त्रेण मन्त्रितो यत्र तिष्ठति || 55 ||
text_mt:
Where a cuckoo, a drongo, a cakora bird, or a parrot,
consecrated with the mantra of the Vaiṣṇavī-tantra, stays,

sanskrit_iast:
vighnaṃ na mandire tasya bhavitṛ suprajā bhavet |
na sarpāstatra gacchanti gatāḥ khādanti no narān |
nārī na bandhakī tasya mandire'pi prajāyate || 56 ||
meaning:
विघ्नं न मन्दिरे तस्य भवितृ सुप्रजा भवेत् |
न सर्पास्तत्र गच्छन्ति गताः खादन्ति नो नरान् |
नारी न बन्धकी तस्य मन्दिरेऽपि प्रजायते || 56 ||

sanskrit_iast: pañcamūrteścaṇḍikāyā nirmālyāni ca pañcamaḥ || 57 ||
meaning: पञ्चमूर्तेश्चण्डिकाया निर्माल्यानि च पञ्चमः || 57 ||
text_mt: And the fifth [offering is] the flower-remnants of five-formed Caṇḍikā;

sanskrit_iast:
teṣāṃ valīnāṃ māṃsena sthālyāṃ paktvā dinatrayam |
aṣṭamyāṃ tatpunardevyai dattvā tanmantramantritaiḥ || 58 ||
meaning:
तेषां वलीनां मांसेन स्थाल्यां पक्त्वा दिनत्रयम् |
अष्टम्यां तत्पुनर्देव्यै दत्त्वा तन्मन्त्रमन्त्रितैः || 58 ||
text_mt:
cooking in a pot with the meat of those animal offerings for three days,
on the eighth lunar day offering it again to the goddess, sprinkling it with waters consecrated with her mantra,

sanskrit_iast:
toyairabhyukṣya bhuñjīyānmanasā cintayecchivām |
tasmin bhukte tu dīrghāyurjarā śokavivarjitaḥ || 59 ||
meaning:
तोयैरभ्युक्ष्य भुञ्जीयान्मनसा चिन्तयेच्छिवाम् |
तस्मिन् भुक्ते तु दीर्घायुर्जरा शोकविवर्जितः || 59 ||
text_mt:
one should consume it while mentally contemplating Śivā.
When that is eaten, one becomes long-lived, free from old age and grief,

sanskrit_iast:
tejasvī śatrudamanaḥ kavirvāgmī ca jāyate |
lalāṭe mūrdhni kaṇṭhe ca bāhvoḥ pāṇyostathā hṛdi || 60 ||
meaning:
तेजस्वी शत्रुदमनः कविर्वाग्मी च जायते |
ललाटे मूर्ध्नि कण्ठे च बाह्वोः पाण्योस्तथा हृदि || 60 ||
text_mt:
radiant, a conqueror of enemies, a poet, and eloquent.
On the forehead, head, throat, the two arms, the two hands, and the heart,

sanskrit_iast:
vaiṣṇavītantramantrasya yāni cāṣṭākṣarāṇi ca |
likhitvā tāni caiteṣu sthāneṣu mantravid budhaḥ || 61 ||
meaning:
वैष्णवीतन्त्रमन्त्रस्य यानि चाष्टाक्षराणि च |
लिखित्वा तानि चैतेषु स्थानेषु मन्त्रविद् बुधः || 61 ||
text_mt:
inscribing the eight syllables of the mantra of the Vaiṣṇavī-tantra
in these places, the wise knower of mantras,

sanskrit_iast:
kuṅkumaṃ kṣīramalayajātapaṅkaḥ suyāvakaiḥ |
aṣṭamyāṃ saṃyato bhūtvā navamyāṃ prathamaṃ naraḥ || 62 ||
meaning:
कुङ्कुमं क्षीरमलयजातपङ्कः सुयावकैः |
अष्टम्यां संयतो भूत्वा नवम्यां प्रथमं नरः || 62 ||
text_mt:
with saffron, milk, sandal-paste, and fine red dye,
having become restrained on the eighth day, a man should first, on the ninth day,

sanskrit_iast:
pratiṣṭhāne nyasya karamaṣṭāvaṣṭau japed budhaḥ |
āvartanena mantrāṇāṃ tato'nu pūjayecchivām || 63 ||
meaning:
प्रतिष्ठाने न्यस्य करमष्टावष्टौ जपेद् बुधः |
आवर्तनेन मन्त्राणां ततोऽनु पूजयेच्छिवाम् || 63 ||
text_mt:
placing his hand on each location, recite [the mantra] in sets of eight, the wise one,
by repetition of the mantras, and subsequently worship Śivā.

sanskrit_iast:
tatastasmin dine devyai vijātīyaṃ valitrayam |
dattvā sahasraṃ mantrasya saṃkhyayā japamārabhet || 64 ||
meaning:
ततस्तस्मिन् दिने देव्यै विजातीयं वलित्रयम् |
दत्त्वा सहस्रं मन्त्रस्य संख्यया जपमारभेत् || 64 ||
text_mt:
Then on that day, having offered three diverse animal offerings to the goddess,
one should commence the recitation to the count of a thousand of the mantra.

sanskrit_iast:
japānte tu havirbhuktvā saṃyato rajanīṃ nayet |
evaṃ sakṛtkṛte putra raṇe tasya parājayaḥ || 65 ||
meaning:
जपान्ते तु हविर्भुक्त्वा संयतो रजनीं नयेत् |
एवं सकृत्कृते पुत्र रणे तस्य पराजयः || 65 ||
text_mt:
At the end of recitation, eating sacrificial food and self-controlled, one should pass the night.
When this is performed once, O son, in battle his defeat

sanskrit_iast:
kadācidapi no bhūyānna ca vādeṣu śāstrataḥ |
idhimevaṃ sakṛtkṛtvā raṇakāle yathā tathā || 66 ||
meaning:
कदाचिदपि नो भूयान्न च वादेषु शास्त्रतः |
इधिमेवं सकृत्कृत्वा रणकाले यथा तथा || 66 ||
text_mt:
shall never take place, nor in debates according to the scriptures.
Having once performed this rite just so at the time of battle,

sanskrit_iast:
sadā likhet kṣatriyastu vijayāya raṇeṣu ca |
aparaṃ tu raṇāṣṭāṅgaṃ guhyametat prakīrtitam || 67 ||
meaning:
सदा लिखेत् क्षत्रियस्तु विजयाय रणेषु च |
अपरं तु रणाष्टाङ्गं गुह्यमेतत् प्रकीर्तितम् || 67 ||
text_mt:
a kṣatriya should always write it for victory in battles.
This other, the secret eightfold battle-rite, is proclaimed;

sanskrit_iast:
anenaiva tu guhyena vijayī tvaṃ bhaviṣyasi |
iti nau kathitaṃ sarvaṃ guhyād guhyataraṃ śubham || 68 ||
meaning:
अनेनैव तु गुह्येन विजयी त्वं भविष्यसि |
इति नौ कथितं सर्वं गुह्याद् गुह्यतरं शुभम् || 68 ||
text_mt:
by this very secret you shall become victorious.
Thus has everything auspicious been declared by us, secret beyond the secret,

sanskrit_iast:
sukhasampatkaraṃ mantraṃ yantratantrasamanvitam |
yacchrotuṃ tridaśāḥ sarve nityaṃ vāñchanti cāmṛtam || 69 ||
meaning:
सुखसम्पत्करं मन्त्रं यन्त्रतन्त्रसमन्वितम् |
यच्छ्रोतुं त्रिदशाः सर्वे नित्यं वाञ्छन्ति चामृतम् || 69 ||
text_mt:
a mantra bestowing happiness and prosperity, equipped with yantra and tantra,
which all the gods always desire to hear like nectar.

sanskrit_iast:
tadidante samākhyātaṃ putra vetāla bhairava |
etat sarvaṃ nado jñātvā tattvataḥ putra bhairava || 70 ||
meaning:
तदिदन्ते समाख्यातं पुत्र वेताल भैरव |
एतत् सर्वं नदो ज्ञात्वा तत्त्वतः पुत्र भैरव || 70 ||
text_mt:
All this has been explained to you, O sons Vetāla and Bhairava.
A man having known all this in truth, O son Bhairava,

sanskrit_iast:
sa kāmānakhilān prāpya nityaṃ kaivalyamāpnuyāt |
śṛṇoti yaḥsakṛdidaṃ kathyamāno divjottamaiḥ || 71 ||
meaning:
स कामानखिलान् प्राप्य नित्यं कैवल्यमाप्नुयात् |
शृणोति यःसकृदिदं कथ्यमानो दिव्जोत्तमैः || 71 ||
text_mt:
obtaining all desires, attains eternal liberation.
He who hears this once when it is recited by the best of the twice-born,

sanskrit_iast:
na tasya vighnā jāyante nāputraḥ sa ca jāyate |
dīrghāyurbalayuktaśca nityaṃ pramuditaḥ kṛtī |
vāñchitārthamavāpnoti devīgṛhamavāpnuyāt || 72 ||
meaning:
न तस्य विघ्ना जायन्ते नापुत्रः स च जायते |
दीर्घायुर्बलयुक्तश्च नित्यं प्रमुदितः कृती |
वाञ्छितार्थमवाप्नोति देवीगृहमवाप्नुयात् || 72 ||

sanskrit_iast: gacchataṃ kāmarūpāntaḥpīṭhaṃ nīlācalāhvayam || 73 ||
meaning: गच्छतं कामरूपान्तःपीठं नीलाचलाह्वयम् || 73 ||
text_mt: Go both of you to the sacred seat within Kāmarūpa, named Nīlācala,

sanskrit_iast:
kāmākhyānilayaṃ guhyaṃ kubjikāpīṭhasaṃjñakam |
ākāśagaṅgā yatrāsti tajjalairabhiṣicya ca || 74 ||
meaning:
कामाख्यानिलयं गुह्यं कुब्जिकापीठसंज्ञकम् |
आकाशगङ्गा यत्रास्ति तज्जलैरभिषिच्य च || 74 ||
text_mt:
the secret dwelling of Kāmākhyā, known as the seat of Kubjikā,
where the heavenly Gaṅgā is, and having bathed with its waters,

sanskrit_iast:
tatrārādhayataṃ putrau mahāmāyāṃ jaganmayīm |
sā prasannācirād devī varadā nau bhaviṣyati || 75 ||
meaning:
तत्राराधयतं पुत्रौ महामायां जगन्मयीम् |
सा प्रसन्नाचिराद् देवी वरदा नौ भविष्यति || 75 ||
text_mt:
there, O two sons, propitiate Mahāmāyā, who comprises the universe!
That goddess, pleased, will soon become the granter of boons to us both."

sanskrit_iast: aurvya uvāca -
meaning: और्व्य उवाच -

sanskrit_iast:
ityuktvā vṛṣabhārūḍhastadā vetālabhairavau |
sa putrau tu parityajya tatraivāntaradhīyata || 76 ||
meaning:
इत्युक्त्वा वृषभारूढस्तदा वेतालभैरवौ |
स पुत्रौ तु परित्यज्य तत्रैवान्तरधीयत || 76 ||
text_mt:
Having spoken thus, the rider of the bull then left Vetāla and Bhairava,
his two sons, and disappeared right there.

sanskrit_iast:
tatastau nāṭakaṃ śailaṃ parityajya tapasvinau |
āsedaturmahātmānaṃ vasiṣṭhaṃ brahmaṇaḥ sutam || 77 ||
meaning:
ततस्तौ नाटकं शैलं परित्यज्य तपस्विनौ |
आसेदतुर्महात्मानं वसिष्ठं ब्रह्मणः सुतम् || 77 ||
text_mt:
Then the two ascetics, having departed from the Nāṭaka mountain,
approached the great-souled Vasiṣṭha, the son of Brahmā.

sanskrit_iast:
sa tu sandhyācalagatastau dṛṣṭvā samupasthitau |
sabhājayāmāsa muniḥ śiṣyavat tau harātmajau || 78 ||
meaning:
स तु सन्ध्याचलगतस्तौ दृष्ट्वा समुपस्थितौ |
सभाजयामास मुनिः शिष्यवत् तौ हरात्मजौ || 78 ||
text_mt:
Residing on the Sandhyācala mountain, seeing those two who had arrived,
the sage honoured those two sons of Hara like disciples.

sanskrit_iast:
tatastasyopadeśena vasiṣṭhasya mahātmanaḥ |
jagmatustau mahāśailaṃ nīlaṃ kāmākhyayāgatam || 79 ||
meaning:
ततस्तस्योपदेशेन वसिष्ठस्य महात्मनः |
जग्मतुस्तौ महाशैलं नीलं कामाख्ययागतम् || 79 ||
text_mt:
Then, by the instruction of that great-souled Vasiṣṭha,
they both went to the great blue mountain that is associated with Kāmākhyā.

sanskrit_iast:
tatra gatvā mahātmānau vaiṣṇavītantragocaram |
ādāya jātāṃ tāṃ devīṃ mahāmāyāṃ jaganmayīm || 80 ||
meaning:
तत्र गत्वा महात्मानौ वैष्णवीतन्त्रगोचरम् |
आदाय जातां तां देवीं महामायां जगन्मयीम् || 80 ||
text_mt:
Having gone there, the two great-souled ones took hold of that goddess,
Mahāmāyā, who comprises the universe, accessible through the Vaiṣṇavī-tantra.

sanskrit_iast:
bhairavākhyasya liṅgasya nik'tasthau śivātmanaḥ |
ākāśagaṅgāmāplāvya sthaṇḍile maṇḍalottamam || 81 ||
meaning:
भैरवाख्यस्य लिङ्गस्य निक्ऽतस्थौ शिवात्मनः |
आकाशगङ्गामाप्लाव्य स्थण्डिले मण्डलोत्तमम् || 81 ||
text_mt:
Standing near the liṅga named Bhairava, which embodies Śiva,
having bathed in the heavenly Gaṅgā, on a bare ground an excellent circle

sanskrit_iast:
vidhāya naraśārdūlau japeturmantramuttamam |
tau japtvā vidhivanmantraṃ siddhamaṣṭākṣarātmakam || 82 ||
meaning:
विधाय नरशार्दूलौ जपेतुर्मन्त्रमुत्तमम् |
तौ जप्त्वा विधिवन्मन्त्रं सिद्धमष्टाक्षरात्मकम् || 82 ||
text_mt:
having formed, those two tigers among men recited the supreme mantra.
Having recited the perfected mantra of eight syllables according to rule,

sanskrit_iast:
vetālasya tathāsādhyamaṣṭalakṣāṇi saṃkhyayā |
tribhirvarṣaistu lakṣāṇāṃ caturṇāmantatastataḥ || 83 ||
meaning:
वेतालस्य तथासाध्यमष्टलक्षाणि संख्यया |
त्रिभिर्वर्षैस्तु लक्षाणां चतुर्णामन्ततस्ततः || 83 ||
text_mt:
eight hundred thousand in number, and likewise for Vetāla's attainment,
thereafter, at the end of four hundred thousand over three years,

sanskrit_iast:
tridhā puraścaraṇaṃ ca tau bhaktyā samakurvatām |
yadyaduttaratantroktaṃ kalpoktaṃ pūjane kṛtam || 84 ||
meaning:
त्रिधा पुरश्चरणं च तौ भक्त्या समकुर्वताम् |
यद्यदुत्तरतन्त्रोक्तं कल्पोक्तं पूजने कृतम् || 84 ||
text_mt:
they both performed the preliminary rites threefold with devotion.
Whatever worship was prescribed in the Uttaratantra and prescribed in the ritual injunctions,

sanskrit_iast:
tatsarvaṃ cakratustau tu taṃ trihāyaṇasaṃvṛtau |
kāmākhyā tripurādīnāmanyāsāmapi pūjanam || 85 ||
meaning:
तत्सर्वं चक्रतुस्तौ तु तं त्रिहायणसंवृतौ |
कामाख्या त्रिपुरादीनामन्यासामपि पूजनम् || 85 ||
text_mt:
they two performed all of that, occupied for those three years.
Having performed the worship of Kāmākhyā, Tripurā, and others,

sanskrit_iast:
sakṛtkṛtvā pīṭhayātrāṃ ceraturvidhivat tadā |
evaṃ tau baddhakavacau kṛtanyāsau harātmajau || 86 ||
meaning:
सकृत्कृत्वा पीठयात्रां चेरतुर्विधिवत् तदा |
एवं तौ बद्धकवचौ कृतन्यासौ हरात्मजौ || 86 ||
text_mt:
they then undertook the pilgrimage to the sacred seats according to rule.
Thus having bound their armor and performed the nyāsa, the two sons of Hara,

sanskrit_iast:
suprītā cānujagrāha mahāmāyāṭha tau tadā |
dhyānasthayostu japatoryajatośca jaganmayo || 87 ||
meaning:
सुप्रीता चानुजग्राह महामायाठ तौ तदा |
ध्यानस्थयोस्तु जपतोर्यजतोश्च जगन्मयो || 87 ||
text_mt: Well-pleased, Mahāmāyā, who comprises the universe, then favored both of them / as they were absorbed in meditation, murmuring [their mantras], and offering sacrifice.

sanskrit_iast:
śivaliṅgaṃ vinirbhidya tadā pratyakṣatāṃ gatā |
tasyāṃ vinirgatāyāṃ tu śivaliṅgaṃ tridhā'bhavat || 88 ||
meaning:
शिवलिङ्गं विनिर्भिद्य तदा प्रत्यक्षतां गता |
तस्यां विनिर्गतायां तु शिवलिङ्गं त्रिधाऽभवत् || 88 ||
text_mt: Splitting open the Śivaliṅga, she then became visible to their eyes; / and when she emerged, the Śivaliṅga split into three parts:

sanskrit_iast:
bhairavo bhairavī ceti herukaśca tathā trayaḥ |
tāṃ dadarśa tadā devīṃ vetālo bhairavastadā || 89 ||
meaning:
भैरवो भैरवी चेति हेरुकश्च तथा त्रयः |
तां ददर्श तदा देवीं वेतालो भैरवस्तदा || 89 ||
text_mt: Bhairava, Bhairavī, and likewise Heruka—the triad. / Then Vetāla and Bhairava beheld that goddess.

sanskrit_iast:
yathā dhyānagatā dṛṣṭā bahiścāpi tathā tathā |
tāṃ dṛṣṭvā cārusarvāṅgī pīnonnatapayodharām || 90 ||
meaning:
यथा ध्यानगता दृष्टा बहिश्चापि तथा तथा |
तां दृष्ट्वा चारुसर्वाङ्गी पीनोन्नतपयोधराम् || 90 ||
text_mt: Just as she had been seen in meditation, exactly so was she outside. / Seeing her, whose limbs were all beautiful, with swollen, high breasts,

sanskrit_iast:
varadābhayahastāṃ ca siddhasūtrāsidhāriṇīm |
raktapadmapratīkāśāṃ sitapretāsanasthitām || 91 ||
meaning:
वरदाभयहस्तां च सिद्धसूत्रासिधारिणीम् |
रक्तपद्मप्रतीकाशां सितप्रेतासनस्थिताम् || 91 ||
text_mt: whose hands granted boons and freedom from fear, holding the ascetic's thread and a sword, / resembling a red lotus, and seated upon a white corpse,

sanskrit_iast:
nimīlya nayanadvandvaṃ tadā vetālabhairavau |
trāhi trāhi mahāmāye ūcatustau muhurmuhuḥ || 92 ||
meaning:
निमील्य नयनद्वन्द्वं तदा वेतालभैरवौ |
त्राहि त्राहि महामाये ऊचतुस्तौ मुहुर्मुहुः || 92 ||
text_mt: closing both their eyes then, Vetāla and Bhairava / spoke repeatedly: “Protect us, protect us, O Mahāmāyā!”

sanskrit_iast:
tatastayā mahādevyā tejasāpyāyitau tu tau |
pasparśa varahastasya cāgrabhāgena vaiṣṇavī || 93 ||
meaning:
ततस्तया महादेव्या तेजसाप्यायितौ तु तौ |
पस्पर्श वरहस्तस्य चाग्रभागेन वैष्णवी || 93 ||
text_mt: Then, having invigorated them both with her radiance, that great goddess, / Vaiṣṇavī, touched them with the tips of the fingers of her boon-granting hand.

sanskrit_iast:
āpyāyitau tatastau tu spṛṣṭāvapi tathā punaḥ |
āsedatuśca devatvaṃ manuṣyatvaṃ vihāya ca || 94 ||
meaning:
आप्यायितौ ततस्तौ तु स्पृष्टावपि तथा पुनः |
आसेदतुश्च देवत्वं मनुष्यत्वं विहाय च || 94 ||
text_mt: Invigorated then, and thus touched once again, / they abandoned their human nature and attained divinity.

sanskrit_iast:
devabhūtau tadā tau tu mahāmāyāṃ jaganmayīm |
stutibhirnatibhiśceti tadā tuṣṭuvatuḥ śivām || 95 ||
meaning:
देवभूतौ तदा तौ तु महामायां जगन्मयीम् |
स्तुतिभिर्नतिभिश्चेति तदा तुष्टुवतुः शिवाम् || 95 ||
text_mt: Having become divine, they then praised Śivā, / Mahāmāyā who comprises the universe, with hymns of praise and prostrations.

sanskrit_iast: vetālabhairavāvūcatuḥ-
meaning: वेतालभैरवावूचतुः-
text_mt: Vetāla and Bhairava said:

sanskrit_iast:
jaya jaya devi suragaṇārcitapaṅkaje viśvasya bhūtibhāvinī śaśimauli-
kelibhāvini girije |
netratrayanirjitavivasvadvidhuvahlikāntitulitakamalaje
madhyanetranatabhrūbhaṅgabhaktaraktamaticayajvāyakavimalaje || 96 ||
meaning:
जय जय देवि सुरगणार्चितपङ्कजे विश्वस्य भूतिभाविनी शशिमौलि-
केलिभाविनि गिरिजे |
नेत्रत्रयनिर्जितविवस्वद्विधुवह्लिकान्तितुलितकमलजे
मध्यनेत्रनतभ्रूभङ्गभक्तरक्तमतिचयज्वायकविमलजे || 96 ||
text_mt: “Victory, victory, O goddess whose lotus-feet are worshipped by the host of gods, who brings forth the prosperity of the universe, who delights in sport with the moon-crested [god], O daughter of the mountain! / Surpassing the splendor of the sun, moon, and fire with your three eyes, matched by the lotus-born [goddess], / who produces a pure store of devotion in those whose minds are devoted to the curve of the brow bent over your central eye!

sanskrit_iast:
ājñācakrāntaśāntanavakoṭi-
karoṭitulyakānta śāntaśaśadhare |
bahumāyakāyabhogayogataraṅga-
ārasya padmavasucare || 97 ||
meaning:
आज्ञाचक्रान्तशान्तनवकोटि-
करोटितुल्यकान्त शान्तशशधरे |
बहुमायकायभोगयोगतरङ्ग-
आरस्य पद्मवसुचरे || 97 ||
text_mt: Whose lovely, tranquil moon bears a brilliance equal to nine hundred million skulls tranquil at the limit of the ājñācakra! / O you who move in the lotus treasure of the essence of the waves of enjoyment and yoga of the body of manifold illusion!

sanskrit_iast:
rināḍinītamadhyabadhaviṣkira-
vallabhaśubhasuṣumnasamādhārapare |
ibudharatnavimodiviśvamūrti-
mahomayānavasi ṣaṭcakradhare || 98 ||
meaning:
रिनाडिनीतमध्यबधविष्किर-
वल्लभशुभसुषुम्नसमाधारपरे |
इबुधरत्नविमोदिविश्वमूर्ति-
महोमयानवसि षट्चक्रधरे || 98 ||
text_mt: O you who are supreme, resting upon the auspicious suṣumṇā channel beloved of the birds that roam the mid-region [of the breath], / who protect the universe with radiant splendor, delighting the jewels among gods, bearer of the six cakras!

sanskrit_iast:
ādiṣoḍaśacakracumbitacārudehapīnatuṅga-
kucācalāliṃgitabhūmimadhyanāgaśākagate |
siddhasūtravarābhayāsiśāntapātaka paṅkajātakamūlamaṇicaturbāhuyute |
jñānatālakamantratantrayogiyoga-
nibaddhasārasūtabhaṅga vinodakṛte |
ātmatattvaparaikaśāraratnahāraka-
muktisūktivivekasitapretarate || 99 ||
meaning:
आदिषोडशचक्रचुम्बितचारुदेहपीनतुङ्ग-
कुचाचलालिंगितभूमिमध्यनागशाकगते |
सिद्धसूत्रवराभयासिशान्तपातक पङ्कजातकमूलमणिचतुर्बाहुयुते |
ज्ञानतालकमन्त्रतन्त्रयोगियोग-
निबद्धसारसूतभङ्ग विनोदकृते |
आत्मतत्त्वपरैकशाररत्नहारक-
मुक्तिसूक्तिविवेकसितप्रेतरते || 99 ||
text_mt: Whose lovely body is touched by the first sixteen cakras, who enter the middle serpent channel of the earth, embraced by swelling, elevated breasts like mountains! / Possessed of four arms holding the ascetic's thread, boon, freedom from fear, and sword, which pacify sin, and the root gem born of a lotus! / You who create delight by breaking the tied core-thread of the yogins' yoga [wrought] by mantras, tantras, and wisdom-rhythms! / O you who delight in the white corpse, the discernment of the pearl oyster of liberation, the gem necklace of the sole essence higher than the truth of the self!

sanskrit_iast:
ratnasārasamastasaṅgataraṃgarāga-
viyogimantraśāntapuraviśeṣakṛte |
yoginīgaṇanṛtyabhṛtyabhāvana-
nibaddhanaddhahārakaṅkaṇamukhyabhūṣaṇapate |
sāṭṭahāsavinodamoditamukta-
keśasureśanibaddhadehapuṭe |
dehi devi śokaśocanabandha-
mocanapāpaśātanaśuddhamate || 100 ||
meaning:
रत्नसारसमस्तसङ्गतरंगराग-
वियोगिमन्त्रशान्तपुरविशेषकृते |
योगिनीगणनृत्यभृत्यभावन-
निबद्धनद्धहारकङ्कणमुख्यभूषणपते |
साट्टहासविनोदमोदितमुक्त-
केशसुरेशनिबद्धदेहपुटे |
देहि देवि शोकशोचनबन्ध-
मोचनपापशातनशुद्धमते || 100 ||
text_mt: O you who fashion the special tranquil city of mantras for those separated from passions, waves of attachment to all jewels and essences! / O supreme ruler of the ornaments—chiefly necklaces and bracelets—clasped and bound in the service of the dancing host of yoginīs! / Whose physical vessel is bound by the lord of gods, with unloosed hair, delighted by the sport of loud laughter! / Grant [us favor], O goddess of pure mind, who destroys sin and looses the bonds of grief and lamentation!

sanskrit_iast:
sarvavidyātmikāṃ guhyāṃ mantrayantramayīṃ śivām |
praṇamāmi mahāmāyāṃ loke vede ca kīrtitām || 101 ||
meaning:
सर्वविद्यात्मिकां गुह्यां मन्त्रयन्त्रमयीं शिवाम् |
प्रणमामि महामायां लोके वेदे च कीर्तिताम् || 101 ||
text_mt: I bow down to Mahāmāyā, auspicious Śivā, whose self consists of all wisdom, who is secret, / who consists of mantras and yantras, celebrated in the world and in the Veda.

sanskrit_iast:
parāparātmikāṃ nityāṁ sādhyādhāraikasaṃsthitām |
kāmāhlādakarīṃ kāntāṃ tvāṃ namāmi jaganmayīm || 102 ||
meaning:
परापरात्मिकां नित्याṁ साध्याधारैकसंस्थिताम् |
कामाह्लादकरीं कान्तां त्वां नमामि जगन्मयीम् || 102 ||
text_mt: I bow to you who are both the transcendent and the immanent, eternal, residing solely in the foundation to be attained, / causing the delight of desire, lovely, comprising the universe.

sanskrit_iast:
prapañcaparamavyaktaṃ jagadekavivardhini |
prabhāvenārdharaktāṃgi devi tubhyaṃ namo'stu te || 103 ||
meaning:
प्रपञ्चपरमव्यक्तं जगदेकविवर्धिनि |
प्रभावेनार्धरक्तांगि देवि तुभ्यं नमोऽस्तु ते || 103 ||
text_mt: The unmanifest, supreme cause of the manifest world, sole nourisher of the universe, / whose body is half-red with majesty—O goddess, homage unto you!

sanskrit_iast:
kāmākhyā nityarūpākhyā mahāmāyā sarasvatī |
yā lakṣmīrviṣṇuvakṣaḥsthā namāvo hyacyutāṃ śivām || 104 ||
meaning:
कामाख्या नित्यरूपाख्या महामाया सरस्वती |
या लक्ष्मीर्विष्णुवक्षःस्था नमावो ह्यच्युतां शिवाम् || 104 ||
text_mt: Known as Kāmākhyā, whose form is eternal, Mahāmāyā, Sarasvatī, / she who is Lakṣmī resting upon Viṣṇu's chest—we bow indeed to Śivā, the imperishable.

sanskrit_iast:
mantrāṇi yasyāstantrāṇi sahasrāṇi ca ṣoḍaśa |
mantrayantrātmake tubhyaṃ namo'stu mama pārvati || 105 ||
meaning:
मन्त्राणि यस्यास्तन्त्राणि सहस्राणि च षोडश |
मन्त्रयन्त्रात्मके तुभ्यं नमोऽस्तु मम पार्वति || 105 ||
text_mt: Whose mantras and tantras are sixteen thousand— / O Pārvatī, whose nature is mantra and yantra, homage unto you from me!”

sanskrit_iast: aurva uvāca -
meaning: और्व उवाच -

sanskrit_iast:
iti stutā tatastābhyāṃ mahāmāyā jagatprasūḥ |
uvāca muditā ceti varaṃ varayataṃ yuvām || 106 ||
meaning:
इति स्तुता ततस्ताभ्यां महामाया जगत्प्रसूः |
उवाच मुदिता चेति वरं वरयतं युवाम् || 106 ||
text_mt: Praised in this way by the two, Mahāmāyā, mother of the world, / rejoiced and spoke thus: “Choose a boon, you two!”

sanskrit_iast:
pratyakṣato mahāmāyāṃ pūrvavad dhyānagocarām |
tau dṛṣṭvā bhargatanayau prāhatuścedamuttamam || 107 ||
meaning:
प्रत्यक्षतो महामायां पूर्ववद् ध्यानगोचराम् |
तौ दृष्ट्वा भर्गतनयौ प्राहतुश्चेदमुत्तमम् || 107 ||
text_mt: Seeing Mahāmāyā directly before their eyes, just as she had appeared within their meditation, / those two sons of Bharga addressed these excellent words:

sanskrit_iast: vaitālabhairavāvūcatuḥ |
meaning: वैतालभैरवावूचतुः |
text_mt: Vetāla and Bhairava said:

sanskrit_iast:
devyanena śarīreṇa bhavatyāḥ śaṅkarasya ca |
prārthaye śāśvatīṃ sevāṃ nityaṃ yāvadraviḥ śaśī || 108 ||
meaning:
देव्यनेन शरीरेण भवत्याः शङ्करस्य च |
प्रार्थये शाश्वतीं सेवां नित्यं यावद्रविः शशी || 108 ||
text_mt: “O goddess, with this very body we request / eternal service to you and to Śaṅkara, continually, as long as the sun and moon endure.

sanskrit_iast:
nānyaṃ varaṃ sodhayāvao māye tvatto jaganmayī |
anyathā tava bhaktyaiva sthāsyāvo girikandare || 109 ||
meaning:
नान्यं वरं सोधयावओ माये त्वत्तो जगन्मयी |
अन्यथा तव भक्त्यैव स्थास्यावो गिरिकन्दरे || 109 ||
text_mt: We ask no other boon from you, O Māyā comprising the universe; / otherwise, through devotion to you alone, we will dwell in a mountain cave.”

sanskrit_iast: aurva uvāca -
meaning: और्व उवाच -

sanskrit_iast:
evamuktā tatastābhyāṃ mahāmāyā jaganmayī |
evamastviti covāca bhavatyevaṃ muhurmuhuḥ || 110 ||
meaning:
एवमुक्ता ततस्ताभ्यां महामाया जगन्मयी |
एवमस्त्विति चोवाच भवत्येवं मुहुर्मुहुः || 110 ||
text_mt: Spoken to thus by the two, Mahāmāyā, who comprises the universe, / said: “Let it be so; so it shall be,” again and again.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ iddhirjagaddhātrī proktā svasyātha cūcuke |
niṣpīḍya ārayāmāsa kṣīradhārādvayaṃ śivā || 111 ||
meaning:
एवं इद्धिर्जगद्धात्री प्रोक्ता स्वस्याथ चूचुके |
निष्पीड्य आरयामास क्षीरधाराद्वयं शिवा || 111 ||
text_mt: Having thus spoken, auspicious Śivā, the maintainer of the world, / squeezed her two nipples and caused two streams of milk to flow.

sanskrit_iast:
tatastu niḥsṛtaṃ kṣīraṃ pāyayāmāsa bhairavam |
vetālaṃ ca mahārāja pibatastau ca tat tadā || 112 ||
meaning:
ततस्तु निःसृतं क्षीरं पाययामास भैरवम् |
वेतालं च महाराज पिबतस्तौ च तत् तदा || 112 ||
text_mt: Then she gave the milk that flowed forth to Bhairava / and to Vetāla to drink, O great king, and the two drank it then.

sanskrit_iast:
pītvā tau ca tadā kṣīraṃ devatvaṃ prāpya śāśvatam |
ajarau cāmarau bhūtau mahātejasvinau śubhau || 113 ||
meaning:
पीत्वा तौ च तदा क्षीरं देवत्वं प्राप्य शाश्वतम् |
अजरौ चामरौ भूतौ महातेजस्विनौ शुभौ || 113 ||
text_mt: Having drunk that milk, and attained eternal divinity, / they became free from old age, immortal, greatly radiant, and auspicious.

sanskrit_iast:
tasyāstu kṣīramamṛtaṃ tat pītvā tau mahābalau |
pīyūṣapānāt sajātau tatastau prāha vaiṣṇavī || 114 ||
meaning:
तस्यास्तु क्षीरममृतं तत् पीत्वा तौ महाबलौ |
पीयूषपानात् सजातौ ततस्तौ प्राह वैष्णवी || 114 ||
text_mt: For her milk was nectar; having drunk it, those two became exceedingly mighty / through drinking that ambrosia. Then Vaiṣṇavī said to them:

sanskrit_iast:
gaṇānāṃ devadevasya bhavatascādhipau yuvām |
dvāḥsthau ca nityamāsannau nandivad bhavataṃ sutau || 115 ||
meaning:
गणानां देवदेवस्य भवतस्चाधिपौ युवाम् |
द्वाःस्थौ च नित्यमासन्नौ नन्दिवद् भवतं सुतौ || 115 ||
text_mt: “You two shall be masters of the hosts of the god of gods, / and stationed at his door, always near him like Nandi, O sons!”

sanskrit_iast:
ityuktvā harasammatyā mahāmāyā jaganmayī |
yoginīgaṇasaṃyuktā tatraivāntaradhīyata || 116 ||
meaning:
इत्युक्त्वा हरसम्मत्या महामाया जगन्मयी |
योगिनीगणसंयुक्ता तत्रैवान्तरधीयत || 116 ||
text_mt: Having spoken thus with the consent of Hara, Mahāmāyā, who comprises the universe, / accompanied by the host of yoginīs, vanished right there.

sanskrit_iast:
antarhitāyāṃ tasyāṃ tu tadā vetālabhairavau |
muditau paramaprītau kṛtakṛtyau babhūvatuḥ || 117 ||
meaning:
अन्तर्हितायां तस्यां तु तदा वेतालभैरवौ |
मुदितौ परमप्रीतौ कृतकृत्यौ बभूवतुः || 117 ||
text_mt: When she had vanished, Vetāla and Bhairava / were delighted, exceedingly pleased, and fulfilled in their purpose.

sanskrit_iast:
athāgacchad devagaṇaiḥ sārdhaṃ sapramatho haraḥ |
sabhājayitumatyarthaṃ putrau vetālabhairavau || 118 ||
meaning:
अथागच्छद् देवगणैः सार्धं सप्रमथो हरः |
सभाजयितुमत्यर्थं पुत्रौ वेतालभैरवौ || 118 ||
text_mt: Then Hara came together with the hosts of gods and with the pramathas / to honor his two sons, Vetāla and Bhairava, with great affection.

sanskrit_iast:
tāvāsādya mahādevastadā nīlāhvayaṃ girim |
sakalaṃ darśayāmāsa pīṭhaṃ tu sthānabhedataḥ || 119 ||
meaning:
तावासाद्य महादेवस्तदा नीलाह्वयं गिरिम् |
सकलं दर्शयामास पीठं तु स्थानभेदतः || 119 ||
text_mt: Approaching them then, Mahādeva showed them the mountain called Nīla / and the entire pīṭha according to its different places.

sanskrit_iast:
pratyakṣato mahāmāyāṃ pūrvavad dhyānagocarām |
tau dṛṣṭvā bhargatanayau prāhatuścedamuttamam || 107 ||
meaning:
प्रत्यक्षतो महामायां पूर्ववद् ध्यानगोचराम् |
तौ दृष्ट्वा भर्गतनयौ प्राहतुश्चेदमुत्तमम् || 107 ||
text_mt: Seeing Mahāmāyā directly before their eyes, just as she had appeared within their meditation, / those two sons of Bharga addressed these excellent words:

sanskrit_iast: vaitālabhairavāvūcatuḥ |
meaning: वैतालभैरवावूचतुः |
text_mt: Vetāla and Bhairava said:

sanskrit_iast:
devyanena śarīreṇa bhavatyāḥ śaṅkarasya ca |
prārthaye śāśvatīṃ sevāṃ nityaṃ yāvadraviḥ śaśī || 108 ||
meaning:
देव्यनेन शरीरेण भवत्याः शङ्करस्य च |
प्रार्थये शाश्वतीं सेवां नित्यं यावद्रविः शशी || 108 ||
text_mt: “O goddess, with this very body we request / eternal service to you and to Śaṅkara, continually, as long as the sun and moon endure.

sanskrit_iast:
nānyaṃ varaṃ sodhayāvo māye tvatto jaganmayi |
anyathā tava bhaktyaiva sthāsyāvo girikandare || 109 ||
meaning:
नान्यं वरं सोधयावो माये त्वत्तो जगन्मयि |
अन्यथा तव भक्त्यैव स्थास्यावो गिरिकन्दरे || 109 ||
text_mt: We ask no other boon from you, O Māyā comprising the universe; / otherwise, through devotion to you alone, we will dwell in a mountain cave.”

sanskrit_iast: aurva uvāca -
meaning: और्व उवाच -

sanskrit_iast:
evamuktā tatastābhyāṃ mahāmāyā jaganmayī |
evamastviti covāca bhavatyevaṃ muhurmuhuḥ || 110 ||
meaning:
एवमुक्ता ततस्ताभ्यां महामाया जगन्मयी |
एवमस्त्विति चोवाच भवत्येवं मुहुर्मुहुः || 110 ||
text_mt: Spoken to thus by the two, Mahāmāyā, who comprises the universe, / said: “Let it be so; so it shall be,” again and again.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ siddhirjagaddhātrī proktā svasyātha cūcuke |
niṣpīḍya ārayāmāsa kṣīradhārādvayaṃ śivā || 111 ||
meaning:
एवं सिद्धिर्जगद्धात्री प्रोक्ता स्वस्याथ चूचुके |
निष्पीड्य आरयामास क्षीरधाराद्वयं शिवा || 111 ||
text_mt: Having thus spoken, auspicious Śivā, the maintainer of the world, / squeezed her two nipples and caused two streams of milk to flow.

sanskrit_iast:
tatastu niḥsṛtaṃ kṣīraṃ pāyayāmāsa bhairavam |
vetālaṃ ca mahārāja pibatastau ca tat tadā || 112 ||
meaning:
ततस्तु निःसृतं क्षीरं पाययामास भैरवम् |
वेतालं च महाराज पिबतस्तौ च तत् तदा || 112 ||
text_mt: Then she gave the milk that flowed forth to Bhairava / and to Vetāla to drink, O great king, and the two drank it then.

sanskrit_iast:
pītvā tau ca tadā kṣīraṃ devatvaṃ prāpya śāśvatam |
ajarau cāmarau bhūtau mahātejasvinau śubhau || 113 ||
meaning:
पीत्वा तौ च तदा क्षीरं देवत्वं प्राप्य शाश्वतम् |
अजरौ चामरौ भूतौ महातेजस्विनौ शुभौ || 113 ||
text_mt:
Having drunk that milk then, and having attained eternal divinity,
they became free of old age and death, endowed with great splendor, and auspicious.

sanskrit_iast:
tasyāstu kṣīramamṛtaṃ tat pītvā tau mahābalau |
pīyūṣapānāt sajātau tatastau prāha vaiṣṇavī || 114 ||
meaning:
तस्यास्तु क्षीरममृतं तत् पीत्वा तौ महाबलौ |
पीयूषपानात् सजातौ ततस्तौ प्राह वैष्णवी || 114 ||
text_mt:
Her milk was indeed nectar; having drunk that, the two mighty ones
became [such] from drinking that nectar. Then the Vaiṣṇavī said to them:

sanskrit_iast:
gaṇānāṃ devadevasya bhavatascādhipau yuvām |
dvāḥsthau ca nityamāsannau nandivad bhavataṃ sutau || 115 ||
meaning:
गणानां देवदेवस्य भवतस्चाधिपौ युवाम् |
द्वाःस्थौ च नित्यमासन्नौ नन्दिवद् भवतं सुतौ || 115 ||
text_mt:
"May you two be the lords of the gaṇas of the God of gods;
and like Nandi, sons, may you be door-keepers, ever near him."

sanskrit_iast:
ityuktvā harasammatyā mahāmāyā jaganmayī |
yoginīgaṇasaṃyuktā tatraivāntaradhīyata || 116 ||
meaning:
इत्युक्त्वा हरसम्मत्या महामाया जगन्मयी |
योगिनीगणसंयुक्ता तत्रैवान्तरधीयत || 116 ||
text_mt:
Having spoken thus with Hara's consent, Mahāmāyā, who comprises the universe,
accompanied by the host of yoginīs, vanished right there.

sanskrit_iast:
antarhitāyāṃ tasyāṃ tu tadā vetālabhairavau |
muditau paramaprītau kṛtakṛtyau babhūvatuḥ || 117 ||
meaning:
अन्तर्हितायां तस्यां तु तदा वेतालभैरवौ |
मुदितौ परमप्रीतौ कृतकृत्यौ बभूवतुः || 117 ||
text_mt:
When she had vanished, Vetāla and Bhairava then
became joyful, deeply pleased, and fulfilled in their purpose.

sanskrit_iast:
athāgacchad devagaṇaiḥ sārdhaṃ sapramatho haraḥ |
sabhājayitumatyarthaṃ putrau vetālabhairavau || 118 ||
meaning:
अथागच्छद् देवगणैः सार्धं सप्रमथो हरः |
सभाजयितुमत्यर्थं पुत्रौ वेतालभैरवौ || 118 ||
text_mt:
Then Hara arrived together with the hosts of gods and with his pramathas,
in order to honor exceedingly his two sons, Vetāla and Bhairava.

sanskrit_iast:
tāvāsādya mahādevastadā nīlāhvayaṃ girim |
sakalaṃ darśayāmāsa pīṭhaṃ tu sthānabhedataḥ || 119 ||
meaning:
तावासाद्य महादेवस्तदा नीलाह्वयं गिरिम् |
सकलं दर्शयामास पीठं तु स्थानभेदतः || 119 ||
text_mt:
Having approached the two, Mahādeva then showed them the mountain named Nīla,
and the entire sacred seat according to its various places.

sanskrit_iast:
kāmākhyāyā guhāṃ tatra darśayitvā manobhavām |
tataḥ svīyāṃ kāmaguhāṃ chāyācchatraṃ svamālayam || 120 ||
meaning:
कामाख्याया गुहां तत्र दर्शयित्वा मनोभवाम् |
ततः स्वीयां कामगुहां छायाच्छत्रं स्वमालयम् || 120 ||
text_mt:
Having shown there the cave of Kāmākhyā, born of desire,
then his own cave of desire, the shadow-parasol, his own abode,

sanskrit_iast:
svakīyaṃ pañcamūrtīnāṃ saṃsthānaṃ cāpyadarśayat |
kāmarūpasya sakalaṃ pīṭhaṃ devamayaṃ tathā || 121 ||
meaning:
स्वकीयं पञ्चमूर्तीनां संस्थानं चाप्यदर्शयत् |
कामरूपस्य सकलं पीठं देवमयं तथा || 121 ||
text_mt:
he also showed the location of his own five forms,
and likewise the entire divine seat of Kāmarūpa.

sanskrit_iast:
pratyekaṃ darśayāmāsa kramatastripurāntakaḥ |
prathamaṃ karatoyākhyāṃ satyagaṅgā sadāśivām || 122 ||
puṇyatoyamayīṃ śuddhāṃ dakṣiṇābdhyekagāminīm |
meaning:
प्रत्येकं दर्शयामास क्रमतस्त्रिपुरान्तकः |
प्रथमं करतोयाख्यां सत्यगङ्गा सदाशिवाम् || 122 ||
पुण्यतोयमयीं शुद्धां दक्षिणाब्ध्येकगामिनीम् |
text_mt:
Tripurāntaka showed [them] each one in order:
first the true Sadāśiva Gaṅgā named Karatoyā,
filled with holy water, pure, flowing solely to the southern sea.

sanskrit_iast:
iti śrīkālikāpurāṇe vetālabhairavayoḥ siddhilābho nāma
ṣaṭsaptatitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 76 ||
meaning:
इति श्रीकालिकापुराणे वेतालभैरवयोः सिद्धिलाभो नाम
षट्सप्ततितमोऽध्यायः || 76 ||
text_mt: Thus ends the seventy-sixth chapter in the glorious Kālikāpurāṇa, entitled 'The Attainment of Perfection by Vetāla and Bhairava'.

sanskrit_iast: saptasaptatitamo'dhyāyaḥ
meaning: सप्तसप्ततितमोऽध्यायः
text_mt: Seventy-seventh chapter.

sanskrit_iast: aurva uvāca -
meaning: और्व उवाच -

sanskrit_iast:
tatastu kāmarūpasya vāyavyāṃ tripurāntakaḥ |
ātmano liṅgamatulaṃ jalpīśākhyaṃ vyadarśayat || 1 ||
meaning:
ततस्तु कामरूपस्य वायव्यां त्रिपुरान्तकः |
आत्मनो लिङ्गमतुलं जल्पीशाख्यं व्यदर्शयत् || 1 ||
text_mt:
Then in the north-west of Kāmarūpa, Tripurāntaka
showed his own incomparable liṅga named Jalpīśa,

sanskrit_iast:
yatra nandī samārādhya mahādevaṃ jagatpatim |
abhinnena śarīreṇa gāṇapatyamavāpnuyāt || 2 ||
meaning:
यत्र नन्दी समाराध्य महादेवं जगत्पतिम् |
अभिन्नेन शरीरेण गाणपत्यमवाप्नुयात् || 2 ||
text_mt:
where Nandī, having propitiated Mahādeva, the Lord of the world,
attained leadership of the gaṇas with his own undivided body,

sanskrit_iast:
nandikuṇḍaṃ mahākuṇḍaṃ yatra nandī purā'karot |
abhiṣekaṃ labdhavaraṃ pītaṃ toyamanuttamam || 3 ||
meaning:
नन्दिकुण्डं महाकुण्डं यत्र नन्दी पुराऽकरोत् |
अभिषेकं लब्धवरं पीतं तोयमनुत्तमम् || 3 ||
text_mt:
and the great pool Nandikuṇḍa, where formerly Nandī performed
his consecration, received a boon, and drank the matchless water.

sanskrit_iast:
tatra snātvā ca pītvā ca kṛtakṛtyo narottamaḥ |
harasya sadanaṃ yāti nandino'pi mahāśriyaḥ || 4 ||
meaning:
तत्र स्नात्वा च पीत्वा च कृतकृत्यो नरोत्तमः |
हरस्य सदनं याति नन्दिनोऽपि महाश्रियः || 4 ||
text_mt:
Having bathed there and drunk [the water], an excellent man attains his purpose
and goes to the abode of Hara, possessing great fortune like Nandī.

sanskrit_iast:
tasyāsanne mahādevīṃ nātidūre vyavasthitām |
siddheśvarīṃ yonirūpāṃ mahāmāyāṃ jaganmayīm || 5 ||
meaning:
तस्यासन्ने महादेवीं नातिदूरे व्यवस्थिताम् |
सिद्धेश्वरीं योनिरूपां महामायां जगन्मयीम् || 5 ||
text_mt:
Near it, situated not very far away, the Mahādevī,
Siddheśvarī, having the form of a yoni, Mahāmāyā, who comprises the universe,

sanskrit_iast:
tryambako darśayāmāsa bhairavāya mahātmane |
yatra nandī mahāmāyāmājñayā śaśidhāriṇaḥ || 6 ||
meaning:
त्र्यम्बको दर्शयामास भैरवाय महात्मने |
यत्र नन्दी महामायामाज्ञया शशिधारिणः || 6 ||
text_mt:
Tryambaka showed to the great-souled Bhairava,
where Nandī, by the command of the Moon-bearer, having worshipped Mahāmāyā

sanskrit_iast:
stutibhirnatibhiḥ pūjya gāṇapatyamavāpnuyāt |
suvarṇamānasastatra nadamukhyo manoharaḥ || 7 ||
meaning:
स्तुतिभिर्नतिभिः पूज्य गाणपत्यमवाप्नुयात् |
सुवर्णमानसस्तत्र नदमुख्यो मनोहरः || 7 ||
text_mt:
with praises and prostrations, attained leadership of the gaṇas.
There is the charming Suvarṇamānasa, the foremost of rivers,

sanskrit_iast:
nandino'nugrahāyāśu mānasākhyaṃ arastu tat |
āgataṃ cājñayā śambhoḥ pūrvameva tapasyataḥ || 8 ||
meaning:
नन्दिनोऽनुग्रहायाशु मानसाख्यं अरस्तु तत् |
आगतं चाज्ञया शम्भोः पूर्वमेव तपस्यतः || 8 ||
text_mt:
and for Nandī's grace that lake named Mānasa swiftly
arrived by the command of Śambhu when he was performing austerities formerly.

sanskrit_iast:
jaṭodbhavā tatra nadī himavatprabhavā śubhā |
yasyāṃ snātvā naraḥpuṇyamāpnoti jāhnavīsamam || 9 ||
meaning:
जटोद्भवा तत्र नदी हिमवत्प्रभवा शुभा |
यस्यां स्नात्वा नरःपुण्यमाप्नोति जाह्नवीसमम् || 9 ||
text_mt:
There is the auspicious river Jaṭodbhavā, originating from the Himavat,
bathing in which a person attains merit equal to that of the Jāhnavī.

sanskrit_iast:
gaurīvivāhasamaye sarvairmātugaṇaiḥ kṛtaḥ |
jalābhiṣeko bhargasya jaṭājūṭeṣu yaḥ purā || 10 ||
meaning:
गौरीविवाहसमये सर्वैर्मातुगणैः कृतः |
जलाभिषेको भर्गस्य जटाजूटेषु यः पुरा || 10 ||
text_mt:
At the time of Gaurī's wedding, the water-consecration performed by all the hosts of mothers
upon Bharga's matted locks in ancient times—

sanskrit_iast:
taistaoyairabhavadyasmājjaṭodākhyā nadī tataḥ |
caitre māsi sitāṣṭamyāṃ snātvā yasyāṃ naro vrajet || 11 ||
meaning:
तैस्तओयैरभवद्यस्माज्जटोदाख्या नदी ततः |
चैत्रे मासि सिताष्टम्यां स्नात्वा यस्यां नरो व्रजेत् || 11 ||
text_mt:
from those waters came into being the river called Jaṭodā;
having bathed in it on the bright eighth day in the month of Caitra, a man goes,

sanskrit_iast:
pūrṇāyurvai naraśreṣṭha śivasya sadanaṃ prati |
dvāparasya tu yā gaṅgā triḥsrotākhyā saridvarā || 12 ||
meaning:
पूर्णायुर्वै नरश्रेष्ठ शिवस्य सदनं प्रति |
द्वापरस्य तु या गङ्गा त्रिःस्रोताख्या सरिद्वरा || 12 ||
text_mt:
having lived out his full span of life, O best of men, to the abode of Śiva.
And that best of rivers named Triḥsrotā, which is the Gaṅgā of the Dvāpara age,

sanskrit_iast:
himavatprabhavā śuddhacandravimbād vinirgatā |
yasyāṃ snātvā mahāmādhyāṃ mātṛyonau na jāyate || 13 ||
meaning:
हिमवत्प्रभवा शुद्धचन्द्रविम्बाद् विनिर्गता |
यस्यां स्नात्वा महामाध्यां मातृयोनौ न जायते || 13 ||
text_mt:
originates from the Himavat and issued from the pure disc of the moon;
having bathed in it on Mahāmāghī, one is not born again from a mother's womb.

sanskrit_iast:
candrasūryagrahe snātvā kaivalyaṃ prāpnuyānnaraḥ |
sitaprabhā nāma nadī mahādevāvatāritā || 14 ||
meaning:
चन्द्रसूर्यग्रहे स्नात्वा कैवल्यं प्राप्नुयान्नरः |
सितप्रभा नाम नदी महादेवावतारिता || 14 ||
text_mt:
Having bathed [in it] during a lunar or solar eclipse, a man attains liberation.
The river named Sitaprabhā, brought down by Mahādeva,

sanskrit_iast:
himavatprabhavā sāpi sitā dakṣa samudragā |
tasyāṃ daśaharāyāṃ tu daśamyāṃ śuklapakṣake || 15 ||
meaning:
हिमवत्प्रभवा सापि सिता दक्ष समुद्रगा |
तस्यां दशहरायां तु दशम्यां शुक्लपक्षके || 15 ||
text_mt:
originates from the Himavat, is white, and flows to the southern ocean.
In it, during Daśaharā, on the tenth day of the bright fortnight,

sanskrit_iast:
snātvā viṣṇugṛhe yāti naro vai muktapātakaḥ |
navatoyā nāma nadī tataḥ pūrvasthitā purā || 16 ||
meaning:
स्नात्वा विष्णुगृहे याति नरो वै मुक्तपातकः |
नवतोया नाम नदी ततः पूर्वस्थिता पुरा || 16 ||
text_mt:
having bathed, a man indeed goes to the house of Viṣṇu, freed from sin.
Formerly, situated to the east of that, is the river named Navatoyā.

sanskrit_iast:
navaṃ navaṃ navaṃ nityaṃ kurvantī sā punāti hi |
navatoyā tataḥ proktā himavatprabhavaiva sā || 17 ||
meaning:
नवं नवं नवं नित्यं कुर्वन्ती सा पुनाति हि |
नवतोया ततः प्रोक्ता हिमवत्प्रभवैव सा || 17 ||
text_mt:
Ever making [everything] new, new, and new, it purifies indeed;
therefore it is declared to be Navatoyā, and it also originates from the Himavat.

sanskrit_iast:
tasyāṃ snātvā mahāmāghyāṃ naro gacchati devatām |
sampūrṇaṃ māghamāsaṃ tu snātvā viṣṇugṛhaṃ vrajet || 18 ||
meaning:
तस्यां स्नात्वा महामाघ्यां नरो गच्छति देवताम् |
सम्पूर्णं माघमासं तु स्नात्वा विष्णुगृहं व्रजेत् || 18 ||
text_mt:
Having bathed in it on Mahāmāghī, a man attains godhood;
and having bathed [in it] for the entire month of Māgha, he goes to the house of Viṣṇu.

sanskrit_iast:
tāsāṃ nadīnāṃ tu patiragado nāma vai nadaḥ |
pīṭhapūrve sthitaḥ puṇyo brahmapādasamudbhavaḥ || 19 ||
meaning:
तासां नदीनां तु पतिरगदो नाम वै नदः |
पीठपूर्वे स्थितः पुण्यो ब्रह्मपादसमुद्भवः || 19 ||
text_mt:
The lord of those rivers is indeed the river named Agada,
situated in the east of the seat, holy, sprung from the foot of Brahmā.

sanskrit_iast:
himavatprabhavaḥ so'pi devagandharvasevitaḥ |
tatra snātvā ca pītvā ca naro brahmagṛhaṃ vrajet || 20 ||
meaning:
हिमवत्प्रभवः सोऽपि देवगन्धर्वसेवितः |
तत्र स्नात्वा च पीत्वा च नरो ब्रह्मगृहं व्रजेत् || 20 ||
text_mt:
It too originates from the Himavat and is frequented by gods and gandharvas;
having bathed in it and drunk [its water], a man goes to the abode of Brahmā.

sanskrit_iast:
kārtikaṃ sakalaṃ māsaṃ yo'gadākhye mahānade |
snānaṃ karoti maujastasya puṇyaphalaṃ śṛṇu || 21 ||
meaning:
कार्तिकं सकलं मासं योऽगदाख्ये महानदे |
स्नानं करोति मौजस्तस्य पुण्यफलं शृणु || 21 ||
text_mt:
Whoever freely performs ablutions during the entire month of Kārtika
in the great river named Agada, hear the meritorious fruit of that:

sanskrit_iast:
iha loke tvarogaḥ sa prāpya caivottamaṃ sukham |
śeṣe brahmagṛhaṃ prāpya tato mokṣamavāpnuyāt || 22 ||
meaning:
इह लोके त्वरोगः स प्राप्य चैवोत्तमं सुखम् |
शेषे ब्रह्मगृहं प्राप्य ततो मोक्षमवाप्नुयात् || 22 ||
text_mt:
In this world he becomes free from disease and attains supreme happiness;
at the end, having attained the abode of Brahmā, he then attains liberation.

sanskrit_iast:
nandikuṇḍe naraḥ snātvā bhaktaṃ kuryāt tadā niśi |
tataḥ parasmin divase gacchejjalpīśamandiram || 23 ||
meaning:
नन्दिकुण्डे नरः स्नात्वा भक्तं कुर्यात् तदा निशि |
ततः परस्मिन् दिवसे गच्छेज्जल्पीशमन्दिरम् || 23 ||
text_mt:
Having bathed in Nandikuṇḍa, a man should eat cooked food that night;
then on the next day he should go to the temple of Jalpīśa.

sanskrit_iast:
tatra snātvā mahānadyāṃ jalpīśaṃ pratipūjya ca |
tasyāṃ niśi haviṣyāśī saṃyatastāṃ niśāṃ nayet || 24 ||
meaning:
तत्र स्नात्वा महानद्यां जल्पीशं प्रतिपूज्य च |
तस्यां निशि हविष्याशी संयतस्तां निशां नयेत् || 24 ||
text_mt:
Having bathed there in the great river and worshipped Jalpīśa,
eating sacrificial food on that night, he should spend the night with self-restraint.

sanskrit_iast:
tato'nudivase prāpte gacchet siddheśvarīṃ śivām |
tāṃ pūjayet tathāṣṭamyāmupavāsaṃ tathācaret || 25 ||
meaning:
ततोऽनुदिवसे प्राप्ते गच्छेत् सिद्धेश्वरीं शिवाम् |
तां पूजयेत् तथाष्टम्यामुपवासं तथाचरेत् || 25 ||
text_mt:
Then, when the next day arrives, he should go to the auspicious Siddheśvarī;
he should worship her thus and observe a fast on the eighth day.

sanskrit_iast:
caturbhujā tu sā devī pīnonnatapayodharā |
sindūrapuñjasaṅkāśā dhatte kartrī ca kharparam || 26 ||
meaning:
चतुर्भुजा तु सा देवी पीनोन्नतपयोधरा |
सिन्दूरपुञ्जसङ्काशा धत्ते कर्त्री च खर्परम् || 26 ||
text_mt:
That goddess is four-armed, with full, elevated breasts,
resembling a heap of red vermilion, and she holds a chopper and a skull-bowl.

sanskrit_iast:
dakṣiṇe vāmabāhubhyāmabhītivaradāyinī |
jaṭāmaṇḍitaśīrṣā ca aktapadmoparisthitā || 27 ||
meaning:
दक्षिणे वामबाहुभ्यामभीतिवरदायिनी |
जटामण्डितशीर्षा च अक्तपद्मोपरिस्थिता || 27 ||
text_mt:
With her right and left hands she grants freedom from fear and boons;
her head is adorned with matted locks, and she stands upon a red lotus.

sanskrit_iast:
paṃcākṣarajapāntādirmantre'syāḥ parikīrtitaḥ |
kāmakhyātantramevāsyāḥ pūjane tantramīritam || 28 ||
meaning:
पंचाक्षरजपान्तादिर्मन्त्रेऽस्याः परिकीर्तितः |
कामख्यातन्त्रमेवास्याः पूजने तन्त्रमीरितम् || 28 ||
text_mt:
Her mantra is declared to begin with the five syllables and end with repetition;
the ritual manual spoken of for her worship is the Kāmākhyātantra itself.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ kṛtvā naro dhīraḥ punaryonau na jāyate |
jāmadagnyabhayād bhītāḥ kṣatriyāḥ pūrvameva ye || 29 ||
meaning:
एवं कृत्वा नरो धीरः पुनर्योनौ न जायते |
जामदग्न्यभयाद् भीताः क्षत्रियाः पूर्वमेव ये || 29 ||
text_mt:
Having done this, a steadfast man is not born in a womb again.
Those kṣatriyas who formerly, frightened by fear of Jāmadagnya,

sanskrit_iast:
lecchacchadmāṇyupādāya jalpīśaṃ śaraṇaṃ gatāḥ |
te mlecchavācaḥ satatamāryavācaśca sarvadā || 30 ||
meaning:
लेच्छच्छद्माण्युपादाय जल्पीशं शरणं गताः |
ते म्लेच्छवाचः सततमार्यवाचश्च सर्वदा || 30 ||
text_mt:
assumed mleccha disguises and took refuge in Jalpīśa,
they speak mleccha speech at all times and Aryan speech always.

sanskrit_iast:
jalpīśaṃ sevamānāste gopāyanti ca taṃ haram |
ta eva tu gaṇāstasya mahārājamanoharāḥ || 31 ||
meaning:
जल्पीशं सेवमानास्ते गोपायन्ति च तं हरम् |
त एव तु गणास्तस्य महाराजमनोहराः || 31 ||
text_mt:
Serving Jalpīśa, they protect that Hara;
they are indeed his charming gaṇas, O great king.

sanskrit_iast:
toṣayitvā tathā sarvān jalpīśaṃ pūjayennaraḥ |
varadābhayahasto'yaṃ dvibhujaḥ kundasannibhaḥ || 32 ||
meaning:
तोषयित्वा तथा सर्वान् जल्पीशं पूजयेन्नरः |
वरदाभयहस्तोऽयं द्विभुजः कुन्दसन्निभः || 32 ||
text_mt:
Having gratified all of them thus, a man should worship Jalpīśa,
who has hands granting boons and freedom from fear, is two-armed, and resembles a kunda flower.

sanskrit_iast:
tatpuruṣasya tu mantreṇa pūjayed devamuttamam |
evaṃ puṇyakaraḥ pīṭho jalpīśasya mahātmanaḥ |
evaṃ jñātvā naro yāti śaṃkarasya paraṃ prati || 33 ||
meaning:
तत्पुरुषस्य तु मन्त्रेण पूजयेद् देवमुत्तमम् |
एवं पुण्यकरः पीठो जल्पीशस्य महात्मनः |
एवं ज्ञात्वा नरो याति शंकरस्य परं प्रति || 33 ||

sanskrit_iast: iti śrīkālikāpurāṇe saptasaptatitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 77 ||
meaning: इति श्रीकालिकापुराणे सप्तसप्ततितमोऽध्यायः || 77 ||
text_mt: Thus ends the seventy-seventh chapter in the glorious Kālikāpurāṇa.

sanskrit_iast: aṣṭasaptatitamo'dhyāyaḥ
meaning: अष्टसप्ततितमोऽध्यायः
text_mt: Seventy-eighth chapter.

sanskrit_iast: mārkaṇḍeya uvāca -
meaning: मार्कण्डेय उवाच -

sanskrit_iast:
etacchrutvā tu saṃvādamuttamaṃ śaṃkarasya ca |
bhairavasya tu vetālasahitasya mahātmanaḥ || 1 ||
meaning:
एतच्छ्रुत्वा तु संवादमुत्तमं शंकरस्य च |
भैरवस्य तु वेतालसहितस्य महात्मनः || 1 ||
text_mt: Having heard this excellent conversation of Śaṃkara / and of the noble Bhairava accompanied by Vetāla,

sanskrit_iast:
bhūyaśca sagaro rājā munimaurvaṃ mahāmatim |
papraccha modasaṃhṛṣṭaḥ sūnṛtaṃ cedamuttamam || 2 ||
meaning:
भूयश्च सगरो राजा मुनिमौर्वं महामतिम् |
पप्रच्छ मोदसंहृष्टः सूनृतं चेदमुत्तमम् || 2 ||
text_mt: King Sagara, filled with joy, once more / asked the high-minded sage Aurva these excellent and truthful words:

sanskrit_iast: sagara uvāca -
meaning: सगर उवाच -

sanskrit_iast:
vicitramidamākhyātaṃ bhagavanmunisattama |
kāmarūpasya pīṭhasya saṃsthānaṃ nirṇayaṃ tathā || 3 ||
meaning:
विचित्रमिदमाख्यातं भगवन्मुनिसत्तम |
कामरूपस्य पीठस्य संस्थानं निर्णयं तथा || 3 ||
text_mt: "Wondrous is this that has been told, O venerable one, best of sages: / the arrangement and determination of the sacred site of Kāmarūpa.

sanskrit_iast:
bhūyaśca śrotumicchāmi vistareṇa mahāmate |
vāyavyasyātha madhyasya pūrvabhāgasya nirṇayam || 4 ||
meaning:
भूयश्च श्रोतुमिच्छामि विस्तरेण महामते |
वायव्यस्याथ मध्यस्य पूर्वभागस्य निर्णयम् || 4 ||
text_mt: I wish to hear again in detail, O high-minded one, / the determination of the north-western, the middle, and the eastern parts,

sanskrit_iast:
yathā yasmin niṣṭhito'sti mahādevo'mbikā tathā |
tatsarvaṃ muniśārdūla kathaya śrotumutsahe || 5 ||
meaning:
यथा यस्मिन् निष्ठितोऽस्ति महादेवोऽम्बिका तथा |
तत्सर्वं मुनिशार्दूल कथय श्रोतुमुत्सहे || 5 ||
text_mt: exactly how and where Mahādeva resides, and likewise Ambikā. / Tell all that, O tiger among sages; I am eager to hear."

sanskrit_iast: aurva uvāca -
meaning: और्व उवाच -

sanskrit_iast:
ukto vāyavyabhāgasya nirṇayo nṛpasattama |
nair-ṛtyottaramadhyādreḥ śṛṇvidānīṃ vinirṇayam || 6 ||
meaning:
उक्तो वायव्यभागस्य निर्णयो नृपसत्तम |
नैर्-ऋत्योत्तरमध्याद्रेः शृण्विदानीं विनिर्णयम् || 6 ||
text_mt: "The determination of the north-western part has been told, O best of kings. / Hear now the determination of the north and middle mountains of the south-west.

sanskrit_iast:
bahuroktā nāma nanī karatoyā pradakṣiṇe |
uttaraśrāvaṇī cāste tat pūrvaṃ kāmarūpakam || 7 ||
meaning:
बहुरोक्ता नाम ननी करतोया प्रदक्षिणे |
उत्तरश्रावणी चास्ते तत् पूर्वं कामरूपकम् || 7 ||
text_mt: There is a river named Bahurokā, south of the Karatoyā, / and flowing towards the north; to its east is Kāmarūpa.

sanskrit_iast:
suraso nāma jīmūtaḥ kāmarūpaṃ tataḥ sthitaḥ |
niḥsṛtā bahuroketi nadī tasmād vṛṣapradā || 8 ||
meaning:
सुरसो नाम जीमूतः कामरूपं ततः स्थितः |
निःसृता बहुरोकेति नदी तस्माद् वृषप्रदा || 8 ||
text_mt: Then there stands a mountain named Surasa in Kāmarūpa; / from it flows the river named Bahurokā, which grants virtue.

sanskrit_iast:
āsanne surasākhyasya śivaliṅgo mahāvṛṣaḥ |
māheśvarī tatra devī yonimaṇḍalarūpiṇī || 9 ||
meaning:
आसन्ने सुरसाख्यस्य शिवलिङ्गो महावृषः |
माहेश्वरी तत्र देवी योनिमण्डलरूपिणी || 9 ||
text_mt: Near the one named Surasa is the Śivaliṅga called Mahāvṛṣa; / there the goddess Māheśvarī dwells in the form of the orb of the yoni.

sanskrit_iast:
snātvā tu bahurokāyāmāruhya surasācalam |
mahāvṛṣaṃ pūjayitvā mahādevīṃ maheśvarīm || 10 ||
meaning:
स्नात्वा तु बहुरोकायामारुह्य सुरसाचलम् |
महावृषं पूजयित्वा महादेवीं महेश्वरीम् || 10 ||
text_mt: Having bathed in the Bahurokā and climbed Mount Surasa, / and having worshipped Mahāvṛṣa and the great goddess Māheśvarī,

sanskrit_iast:
dhūtapāpo jitadvandvaḥ punaryonau na jāyate |
caturbhūjo vṛṣārūḍho varadābhayaśūladhṛk || 11 ||
meaning:
धूतपापो जितद्वन्द्वः पुनर्योनौ न जायते |
चतुर्भूजो वृषारूढो वरदाभयशूलधृक् || 11 ||
text_mt: cleansed of sin, having overcome the pairs of opposites, one is not born again in a womb. / He has four arms, is mounted on a bull, and holds the gesture of granting boons, fearlessness, and a trident.

sanskrit_iast:
śuddhasphaṭikasaṃkāśo jaṭāvān sa mahāvṛṣaḥ |
aghorasya tu mantreṇa pūjā'sya parikīrtitā || 12 ||
meaning:
शुद्धस्फटिकसंकाशो जटावान् स महावृषः |
अघोरस्य तु मन्त्रेण पूजाऽस्य परिकीर्तिता || 12 ||
text_mt: Resembling pure crystal and wearing matted hair is that Mahāvṛṣa; / his worship is proclaimed to be performed with the mantra of Aghora.

sanskrit_iast:
kāmeśvaryāḥ svarūpaṃ tu māheśvaryāḥ prakīrtitam |
pūjāpi yadvadevāsyāstadvatphalapradāyikā || 13 ||
meaning:
कामेश्वर्याः स्वरूपं तु माहेश्वर्याः प्रकीर्तितम् |
पूजापि यद्वदेवास्यास्तद्वत्फलप्रदायिका || 13 ||
text_mt: The form of Māheśvarī is proclaimed to be the very form of Kāmeśvarī; / her worship as well is similarly fruit-bestowing.

sanskrit_iast:
tatra vasiṣṭhakuṇḍaṃ tu vasiṣṭhamunisevitam |
yatra sthito vasiṣṭhastu narakeṇa nivāritaḥ || 14 ||
meaning:
तत्र वसिष्ठकुण्डं तु वसिष्ठमुनिसेवितम् |
यत्र स्थितो वसिष्ठस्तु नरकेण निवारितः || 14 ||
text_mt: There is the Vasiṣṭhakuṇḍa, resorted to by the sage Vasiṣṭha, / where Vasiṣṭha stayed when he was turned away by Naraka.

sanskrit_iast:
aprāpya gantuṃ jīmutaṃ nīlākhyaṃ vāśapattutam |
svasnānārthaṃ kṛtaṃ tatra kuṇḍaṃ devagaṇārcitam || 15 ||
meaning:
अप्राप्य गन्तुं जीमुतं नीलाख्यं वाशपत्तुतम् |
स्वस्नानार्थं कृतं तत्र कुण्डं देवगणार्चितम् || 15 ||
text_mt: Unable to reach the mountain named Nīla, which had been cast down by a curse, / he made a pool there for his own bathing, which is worshipped by the hosts of gods.

sanskrit_iast:
tatra snātvā naro yāti nākapṛṣṭhaṃ yathecchayā |
surasasya ca pūrvasyāṃ kṛttivāsāhvayo giriḥ || 16 ||
meaning:
तत्र स्नात्वा नरो याति नाकपृष्ठं यथेच्छया |
सुरसस्य च पूर्वस्यां कृत्तिवासाह्वयो गिरिः || 16 ||
text_mt: Having bathed there, a man goes to the surface of heaven as he desires. / And to the east of Surasa is the mountain named Kṛttivāsas.

sanskrit_iast:
kṛttivāsāḥ svayaṃ tatra satyā sahāvasat purā |
candrikākhyā nadī yatra tasyāṃ snātvā divaṃ vrajet || 17 ||
meaning:
कृत्तिवासाः स्वयं तत्र सत्या सहावसत् पुरा |
चन्द्रिकाख्या नदी यत्र तस्यां स्नात्वा दिवं व्रजेत् || 17 ||
text_mt: Kṛttivāsas himself dwelt there of old together with Satī, / where there is the river named Candrikā; having bathed in it, one goes to heaven.

sanskrit_iast:
candrikāyāṃ naraḥ snātvā sampūjya kṛttivāsasam |
bhādraśuklacaturthyāṃ tu niṣkalaṅko bhavennaraḥ || 18 ||
meaning:
चन्द्रिकायां नरः स्नात्वा सम्पूज्य कृत्तिवाससम् |
भाद्रशुक्लचतुर्थ्यां तु निष्कलङ्को भवेन्नरः || 18 ||
text_mt: A man who bathes in the Candrikā and fully worships Kṛttivāsas / on the fourth day of the bright fortnight of Bhādrapada becomes free from blemish.

sanskrit_iast:
pūrṇabhādrapadaṃ māsaṃ candrikāyāṃ narottamaḥ |
snātvā gacchati bhūteśaṃ dṛṣṭvai kṛttivāsasam || 19 ||
meaning:
पूर्णभाद्रपदं मासं चन्द्रिकायां नरोत्तमः |
स्नात्वा गच्छति भूतेशं दृष्ट्वै कृत्तिवाससम् || 19 ||
text_mt: Having bathed in the Candrikā for the entire month of Bhādrapada / and having seen Kṛttivāsas, the best of men goes to the Lord of Spirits.

sanskrit_iast:
uttarasrāviṇī nityaṃ candrikākhyā saridvarā |
nātidūre candrikāyāḥ pūrvasyāṃ diśi phenilā || 20 ||
meaning:
उत्तरस्राविणी नित्यं चन्द्रिकाख्या सरिद्वरा |
नातिदूरे चन्द्रिकायाः पूर्वस्यां दिशि फेनिला || 20 ||
text_mt: The excellent river named Candrikā always flows northward; / not very far to the east of the Candrikā is the Phenilā,

sanskrit_iast:
saṃjñayā ca saricchreṣṭhā śatānandāvatāritā |
brahmaṇo duhitā sa tu gaṅgā parvatasambhavā || 21 ||
meaning:
संज्ञया च सरिच्छ्रेष्ठा शतानन्दावतारिता |
ब्रह्मणो दुहिता स तु गङ्गा पर्वतसम्भवा || 21 ||
text_mt: best of rivers by name, brought down by Śatānanda, / the daughter of Brahmā; she is the Gaṅgā born from the mountain.

sanskrit_iast:
phenilāyāṃ naraḥ snātvā brahmotthānadine punaḥ |
phālgune māsi narakaṃ jitvā svargamavāpnuyāt || 22 ||
meaning:
फेनिलायां नरः स्नात्वा ब्रह्मोत्थानदिने पुनः |
फाल्गुने मासि नरकं जित्वा स्वर्गमवाप्नुयात् || 22 ||
text_mt: Having bathed in the Phenilā on the day of Brahmā’s rising / in the month of Phālguna, a man overcomes hell and attains heaven.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ sitāhvayā pūrvaṃ sariduttaragāminī |
tasyāṃ snātvā mahācaitryāṃ gaṅgāsnānaphalaṃ labhet || 23 ||
meaning:
ततः सिताह्वया पूर्वं सरिदुत्तरगामिनी |
तस्यां स्नात्वा महाचैत्र्यां गङ्गास्नानफलं लभेत् || 23 ||
text_mt: East of that is the north-flowing river called Sitā; / having bathed in it on Mahācaitrī, one obtains the fruit of bathing in the Gaṅgā.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ pūrvaṃ sumadanā yojanadvitayāntare |
nadī janakarājena samārādhya vṛṣadhvajam || 24 ||
meaning:
ततः पूर्वं सुमदना योजनद्वितयान्तरे |
नदी जनकराजेन समाराध्य वृषध्वजम् || 24 ||
text_mt: Two yojanas east of that is the river Sumadanā, / brought down from Sutīkṣṇa by King Janaka,

sanskrit_iast:
hitāya bhairavākhyasya sutīkṣṇādavatāritā |
sutīkṣṇaṃ girimāruhya snātvā sumadanājale || 25 ||
meaning:
हिताय भैरवाख्यस्य सुतीक्ष्णादवतारिता |
सुतीक्ष्णं गिरिमारुह्य स्नात्वा सुमदनाजले || 25 ||
text_mt: who had propitiated the bull-bannered [god], for the benefit of the one named Bhairava. / Having climbed Mount Sutīkṣṇa and bathed in the water of the Sumadanā,

sanskrit_iast:
māghaśuklacaturthyāṃ tu pūjayitvā maheśvaram |
saṃprāpya sakalān kāmān śivalokāya gacchati || 26 ||
meaning:
माघशुक्लचतुर्थ्यां तु पूजयित्वा महेश्वरम् |
संप्राप्य सकलान् कामान् शिवलोकाय गच्छति || 26 ||
text_mt: and having worshipped Maheśvara on the fourth day of the bright fortnight of Māgha, / one attains all desires and goes to the world of Śiva.

sanskrit_iast:
etā nadyaḥ kāmarūpe nairṛtyāmuttarasravāḥ |
pīṭhasya pūrvatastatra tripurā yatra pūjyate || 27 ||
meaning:
एता नद्यः कामरूपे नैरृत्यामुत्तरस्रवाः |
पीठस्य पूर्वतस्तत्र त्रिपुरा यत्र पूज्यते || 27 ||
text_mt: These are the rivers in the south-west of Kāmarūpa that flow to the north, / east of the sacred site where Tripurā is worshipped.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ te kathitaṃ rājan mahāpuṇyadamuttamam |
kāmarūpasya nair-ṛtyāṃ yatra śambhuḥ sadāmbikā || 28 ||
meaning:
एवं ते कथितं राजन् महापुण्यदमुत्तमम् |
कामरूपस्य नैर्-ऋत्यां यत्र शम्भुः सदाम्बिका || 28 ||
text_mt: Thus has been told to you, O king, that which is excellent and bestows great merit, / in the south-west of Kāmarūpa, where Śambhu and Ambikā always dwell.

sanskrit_iast:
unareva mahārāja yā nadyo dakṣiṇasravāḥ |
himavatprabhavā yātāḥ kramaśaḥ śṛṇu bhūpate || 29 ||
meaning:
उनरेव महाराज या नद्यो दक्षिणस्रवाः |
हिमवत्प्रभवा याताः क्रमशः शृणु भूपते || 29 ||
text_mt: Listen again in order, O great king, O lord of the earth, to those rivers / that flow to the south, which have originated from the Himavat:

sanskrit_iast:
agadasya nadasyordhvaṃ bhadrākhyā tu mahānadī |
bhādre kṛṣṇacaturdaśyāṃ yasyāṃ snātvā divaṃ vrajet || 30 ||
meaning:
अगदस्य नदस्योर्ध्वं भद्राख्या तु महानदी |
भाद्रे कृष्णचतुर्दश्यां यस्यां स्नात्वा दिवं व्रजेत् || 30 ||
text_mt: Above the river Agada is the great river named Bhadrā, / bathing in which on the fourteenth day of the dark fortnight of Bhādra, one goes to heaven.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ pūrvaṃ subhadrākhyā nadī puṇyatamā sadā |
vaiśākhyasya tṛtīyāyāṃ yasyāṃ snātvā divaṃ vrajet || 31 ||
meaning:
ततः पूर्वं सुभद्राख्या नदी पुण्यतमा सदा |
वैशाख्यस्य तृतीयायां यस्यां स्नात्वा दिवं व्रजेत् || 31 ||
text_mt: East of that is the river named Subhadrā, always most holy, / bathing in which on the third day of Vaiśākha, one goes to heaven.

sanskrit_iast:
tatastu mānasā nāma nadī puṇyatamā matā |
saraso mānasākhyāt tu taṇabindvavatāritā || 32 ||
meaning:
ततस्तु मानसा नाम नदी पुण्यतमा मता |
सरसो मानसाख्यात् तु तणबिन्द्ववतारिता || 32 ||
text_mt: East of that is the river considered most holy, named Mānasā, / brought down from the lake called Mānasa by Tṛṇabindu.

sanskrit_iast:
vaiśākhaṃ sakalaṃ māsaṃ tasyāṃ snātvā narottamaḥ |
viṣṇulokamavāpyaiva tato mokṣamavāpnuyāt || 33 ||
meaning:
वैशाखं सकलं मासं तस्यां स्नात्वा नरोत्तमः |
विष्णुलोकमवाप्यैव ततो मोक्षमवाप्नुयात् || 33 ||
text_mt: Having bathed in it for the entire month of Vaiśākha, the best of men, / having attained the world of Viṣṇu, thereupon obtains liberation.

sanskrit_iast:
himavannikaṭe śailo vibhrāṭaḥ sa mahādyutiḥ |
yasmin vasati bhūteśaḥ sadā bhairavarūpadhṛk || 34 ||
meaning:
हिमवन्निकटे शैलो विभ्राटः स महाद्युतिः |
यस्मिन् वसति भूतेशः सदा भैरवरूपधृक् || 34 ||
text_mt: Near the Himavat is Mount Vibhrāṭ, of great splendor, / upon which the Lord of Spirits always dwells, bearing the form of Bhairava.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmāt tu bhairavī nāma nadī puṇyodakā śubhā |
prāṅ mānasādyā sravati gaṅgeva phaladāyinī || 34 ||
meaning:
तस्मात् तु भैरवी नाम नदी पुण्योदका शुभा |
प्राङ् मानसाद्या स्रवति गङ्गेव फलदायिनी || 34 ||
text_mt: From it flows the river named Bhairavī, of holy and auspicious water, / to the east of the Mānasā and others, bestowing fruit like the Gaṅgā,

sanskrit_iast:
yasyāṃ vasantasamaye snātvā gacchati ve divam |
yasyāṃ sampūjya kāmākhyāmiṣṭaṃ jñānamavāpnuyāt || 36 ||
meaning:
यस्यां वसन्तसमये स्नात्वा गच्छति वे दिवम् |
यस्यां सम्पूज्य कामाख्यामिष्टं ज्ञानमवाप्नुयात् || 36 ||
text_mt: bathing in which in the spring season, one surely goes to heaven; / and worshipping Kāmākhyā at it, one obtains the desired knowledge.

sanskrit_iast:
sampūjyātha mahāmāyāṃ dviguṇaṃ prāpnuyāt phalam |
ūrdhvaṃ tato devagaṅgā varṇāsākhyā saridvarā || 37 ||
meaning:
सम्पूज्याथ महामायां द्विगुणं प्राप्नुयात् फलम् |
ऊर्ध्वं ततो देवगङ्गा वर्णासाख्या सरिद्वरा || 37 ||
text_mt: Moreover, having worshipped Mahāmāyā, one obtains twofold fruit. / Above that is the Devagaṅgā, the excellent river named Varṇāsā,

sanskrit_iast:
himavatprabhavā nityaṃ phaladā mānasopamā |
subhadrādyāstu yāḥ proktā varṇāsāntāḥ saridvarāḥ || 38 ||
meaning:
हिमवत्प्रभवा नित्यं फलदा मानसोपमा |
सुभद्राद्यास्तु याः प्रोक्ता वर्णासान्ताः सरिद्वराः || 38 ||
text_mt: originating from the Himavat, ever fruit-granting and like the Mānasā. / Those excellent rivers that have been described, beginning with the Subhadrā and ending with the Varṇāsā,

sanskrit_iast:
himavatprabhavāstāstu sarvā evottaraplavāḥ |
pūrve tu madanāyāstu brahmakṣetrasya paścime || 39 ||
meaning:
हिमवत्प्रभवास्तास्तु सर्वा एवोत्तरप्लवाः |
पूर्वे तु मदनायास्तु ब्रह्मक्षेत्रस्य पश्चिमे || 39 ||
text_mt: have all originated from the Himavat and all flow northward. / To the east of the Madanā, but to the west of the Brahmakṣetra,

sanskrit_iast:
ravikṣetraṃ yatra deva ādityaḥ satataṃ sthitaḥ |
bhairavasya hitārthāya yatra sarveśvarāḥ sthitāḥ || 40 ||
meaning:
रविक्षेत्रं यत्र देव आदित्यः सततं स्थितः |
भैरवस्य हितार्थाय यत्र सर्वेश्वराः स्थिताः || 40 ||
text_mt: is the Ravikṣetra, where the god Āditya permanently resides. / Where the lords of all have taken their station for the benefit of Bhairava

sanskrit_iast:
kāmarūpe mahāpīṭhe brahmendravaruṇādayaḥ |
tadā attvāhvaye śaile śrī sūryo'pi vyavasthitaḥ || 41 ||
meaning:
कामरूपे महापीठे ब्रह्मेन्द्रवरुणादयः |
तदा अत्त्वाह्वये शैले श्री सूर्योऽपि व्यवस्थितः || 41 ||
text_mt: in the great sacred site of Kāmarūpa—Brahmā, Indra, Varuṇa, and the rest— / there, on the mountain named Tattva, the glorious Sūrya also took his station.

sanskrit_iast:
trisrotā nāma yasyāsti nadī pūrvadiśi sthitā |
kapotakaraṇaṃ paścādasya kuṇḍadvayaṃ sthitam || 42 ||
meaning:
त्रिस्रोता नाम यस्यास्ति नदी पूर्वदिशि स्थिता |
कपोतकरणं पश्चादस्य कुण्डद्वयं स्थितम् || 42 ||
text_mt: The river named Trisrotā is situated in its eastern direction; / to its west are two pools, Kapota and Karaṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
kapotakuṇḍe vidhivat snātvā karaṇakuṇḍake |
tattvācalaṃ samāruhya sampūjya ca divākaram || 43 ||
meaning:
कपोतकुण्डे विधिवत् स्नात्वा करणकुण्डके |
तत्त्वाचलं समारुह्य सम्पूज्य च दिवाकरम् || 43 ||
text_mt: Having duly bathed in the Kapotakuṇḍa and in the Karaṇakuṇḍaka, / having ascended Mount Tattva, and having worshipped the Sun,

sanskrit_iast:
sakṛdeva naro yāti bhāskarasya gṛhaṃ prati |
sūryaraśmisamudbhūtaṃ kapotakaraṇāmṛtam || 44 ||
meaning:
सकृदेव नरो याति भास्करस्य गृहं प्रति |
सूर्यरश्मिसमुद्भूतं कपोतकरणामृतम् || 44 ||
text_mt: even once, a man goes to the abode of the Sun. / The nectar of the Kapota and Karaṇa has arisen from the rays of the Sun.

sanskrit_iast:
puṇyatoyasamākhyātaṃ pāpaṃ kapota me hara |
ityanena tu mantreṇa snātvā kapotapuṣkare || 45 ||
meaning:
पुण्यतोयसमाख्यातं पापं कपोत मे हर |
इत्यनेन तु मन्त्रेण स्नात्वा कपोतपुष्करे || 45 ||
text_mt: "Renowned for sacred waters, remove my sin, O Kapota!" / Having bathed with this mantra in the Kapota-puṣkara,

sanskrit_iast:
karaṇaṃ samupaspṛśya tattvaśaile raviṃ yajet |
trividhaṃ brahmabījaṃ tu sahasrapadamantataḥ || 46 ||
meaning:
करणं समुपस्पृश्य तत्त्वशैले रविं यजेत् |
त्रिविधं ब्रह्मबीजं तु सहस्रपदमन्ततः || 46 ||
text_mt: having sipped water at Karaṇa, one should worship the sun on the Tattva mountain. / The three kinds of seed-syllables of Brahmā followed by the word "thousand",

sanskrit_iast:
raśmaye'pi caturthyaṃ tu devojāyā tu ceṣṭataḥ |
aṅgabījamidaṃ proktamādityasyātikāmadam || 47 ||
meaning:
रश्मयेऽपि चतुर्थ्यं तु देवोजाया तु चेष्टतः |
अङ्गबीजमिदं प्रोक्तमादित्यस्यातिकामदम् || 47 ||
