meaning:
कुलकोटिं समुद्धृत्य स स्वयं स्याज्जनार्दनः |
इदं ते कथितं भूप वासुदेवस्य मन्त्रकम् || 186 ||
text_mt: having delivered ten million members of his family, himself becomes Janārdana. / This has been told to you, O king, regarding the mantra of Vāsudeva,

sanskrit_iast:
pīṭhasya kāmarūpasya saṅkṣepānnirṇayaṃ tathā |
iti sarvaṃ kāmarūpapīṭhaṃ śambhuradaśayat || 187 ||
meaning:
पीठस्य कामरूपस्य सङ्क्षेपान्निर्णयं तथा |
इति सर्वं कामरूपपीठं शम्भुरदशयत् || 187 ||
text_mt: as well as the brief determination of the sacred seat of Kāmarūpa. / Thus Śambhu showed the entire sacred seat of Kāmarūpa.

sanskrit_iast:
putrābhyāṃ sa punastābhyāṃ kailāsaṃ prayayau girim |
tatra gatvā yathāyogaṃ nidhāya tanayau svakau || 188 ||
meaning:
पुत्राभ्यां स पुनस्ताभ्यां कैलासं प्रययौ गिरिम् |
तत्र गत्वा यथायोगं निधाय तनयौ स्वकौ || 188 ||
text_mt: Then, along with those two sons, he set out for Mount Kailāsa. / Having gone there and placed his two sons suitably,

sanskrit_iast:
vimuktaśāpāste jātāḥ śambhurgirisutā tathā |
vetālo bhairavaśceti nṛpasattama nirjarāḥ || 189 ||
meaning:
विमुक्तशापास्ते जाताः शम्भुर्गिरिसुता तथा |
वेतालो भैरवश्चेति नृपसत्तम निर्जराः || 189 ||
text_mt: they became freed from the curse: Śambhu, the mountain's daughter, / Vetāla, and Bhairava, O best of kings, [all] gods.

sanskrit_iast:
idaṃ yo mahadākhyānaṃ śṛṇotyekāgramānasaḥ |
śāpabhītirna tasyāsti vyādhayastasya nādhayaḥ || 190 ||
meaning:
इदं यो महदाख्यानं शृणोत्येकाग्रमानसः |
शापभीतिर्न तस्यास्ति व्याधयस्तस्य नाधयः || 190 ||
text_mt: Whoever listens to this great narrative with a single-pointed mind / has no fear of curses; he has neither physical diseases nor mental afflictions.

sanskrit_iast:
putrapautradhanaiśvaryayuktaḥ sarvatra vallabhaḥ |
sarvakalyāṇasaṃyukto dīrghakālaṃ sa jīvati || 191 ||
meaning:
पुत्रपौत्रधनैश्वर्ययुक्तः सर्वत्र वल्लभः |
सर्वकल्याणसंयुक्तो दीर्घकालं स जीवति || 191 ||
text_mt: Endowed with sons, grandsons, wealth, and sovereignty, beloved everywhere, / accompanied by every good fortune, he lives for a long time.

sanskrit_iast:
kāmarūpaṃ mahāpīṭhaṃ yo jānāti narottamaḥ |
sa divyajñānasampannaḥ paraṃ nirvāṇamāpnuyāt || 192 ||
meaning:
कामरूपं महापीठं यो जानाति नरोत्तमः |
स दिव्यज्ञानसम्पन्नः परं निर्वाणमाप्नुयात् || 192 ||
text_mt: The best of men who knows the great pīṭha of Kāmarūpa, / endowed with divine knowledge, shall attain supreme nirvāṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
yaḥ kāmarūpe sakale pīṭhayātrāṃ samācaret |
āsādya sakalān pīṭhān pūjayet sarvadevatāḥ || 193 ||
meaning:
यः कामरूपे सकले पीठयात्रां समाचरेत् |
आसाद्य सकलान् पीठान् पूजयेत् सर्वदेवताः || 193 ||
text_mt: Whoever performs the pilgrimage of the pīṭhas throughout all of Kāmarūpa, / having reached all the pīṭhas, should worship all the deities.

sanskrit_iast:
daśapūrvān daśa parānātmānaṃ caikaviṃśatim |
divye jñāne vidhāyāśu sarvaṃ muktimiyāt saha || 194 ||
meaning:
दशपूर्वान् दश परानात्मानं चैकविंशतिम् |
दिव्ये ज्ञाने विधायाशु सर्वं मुक्तिमियात् सह || 194 ||
text_mt: Having quickly established ten ancestors, ten descendants, and himself as the twenty-first / in divine knowledge, he attains liberation along with them all.

sanskrit_iast: iti śrīkālikāpurāṇe'śītitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 80 ||
meaning: इति श्रीकालिकापुराणेऽशीतितमोऽध्यायः || 80 ||
text_mt: Thus ends the eightieth chapter in the glorious Kālikāpurāṇa.

sanskrit_iast: ekāśītitamo'dhyāyaḥ
meaning: एकाशीतितमोऽध्यायः

sanskrit_iast: aurva uvāca -
meaning: और्व उवाच -

sanskrit_iast:
kāmarūpe mahāpīṭhe snātvā pītvā ca devatāḥ |
pūjayitvā ca ipulā lokāḥ svargaṃ purā yayuḥ || 1 ||
meaning:
कामरूपे महापीठे स्नात्वा पीत्वा च देवताः |
पूजयित्वा च इपुला लोकाः स्वर्गं पुरा ययुः || 1 ||
text_mt: In ancient times, having bathed, drunk, and worshipped the deities / in the great pīṭha of Kāmarūpa, countless people went to heaven.

sanskrit_iast:
kecid bhejuśca nirvāṇaṃ kecid yānti sma śambhutām |
na yamastān vārayituṃ netuṃ ca nijamandiram || 2 ||
meaning:
केचिद् भेजुश्च निर्वाणं केचिद् यान्ति स्म शम्भुताम् |
न यमस्तान् वारयितुं नेतुं च निजमन्दिरम् || 2 ||
text_mt: Some attained nirvāṇa, and some went to the state of Śambhu; / Yama was not able to restrain them or to lead them to his own abode,

sanskrit_iast:
kṣamo'bhūnnaraśārdūla śivāyā jātasādhvasaḥ |
yamadūtaṃ tatra yāntaṃ bādhante śaṃkarā gaṇāḥ || 3 ||
meaning:
क्षमोऽभून्नरशार्दूल शिवाया जातसाध्वसः |
यमदूतं तत्र यान्तं बाधन्ते शंकरा गणाः || 3 ||
text_mt: O tiger among men, as fear arose [in him] on account of Śivā. / The attendants of Śaṅkara obstruct any messenger of Yama going there.

sanskrit_iast:
na tadbhiyā tatra yānti yamadūtāḥ pracoditāḥ |
tathā dṛṣṭvātha śamanaḥ svakriyāparivarjitaḥ || 4 ||
meaning:
न तद्भिया तत्र यान्ति यमदूताः प्रचोदिताः |
तथा दृष्ट्वाथ शमनः स्वक्रियापरिवर्जितः || 4 ||
text_mt: Out of fear of them, the messengers of Yama do not go there even when commanded. / Seeing this, the Restrainer then became deprived of his own function.

sanskrit_iast:
vidhātāraṃ samāsādya vacanaṃ cedamabravīt |
idhātaḥ kāmarūpe'smin snātvā pītvā ca mānavaḥ || 5 ||
meaning:
विधातारं समासाद्य वचनं चेदमब्रवीत् |
इधातः कामरूपेऽस्मिन् स्नात्वा पीत्वा च मानवः || 5 ||
text_mt: Having approached Vidhātṛ, he spoke these words: / 'O Vidhātṛ, in this Kāmarūpa, having bathed and drunk, a human

sanskrit_iast:
kāmākhyāgaṇatāṃ yāti tathā śambhugaṇeśatām |
tatra me nādhikāro'sti na tān vārayituṃ kṣamaḥ || 6 ||
meaning:
कामाख्यागणतां याति तथा शम्भुगणेशताम् |
तत्र मे नाधिकारोऽस्ति न तान् वारयितुं क्षमः || 6 ||
text_mt: attains the status of Kāmākhyā's attendant, and likewise the status of a lord of Śambhu's attendants. / I have no authority there; I am not able to restrain them.

sanskrit_iast:
vidhatsvātrocitāṃ nītiṃ yujyate yadi gocare |
tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā brahmā lokapitāmahaḥ || 7 ||
meaning:
विधत्स्वात्रोचितां नीतिं युज्यते यदि गोचरे |
तस्य तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा ब्रह्मा लोकपितामहः || 7 ||
text_mt: Devise the proper policy here, if it is appropriate to [your] sphere.' / Having heard those words of his, Brahmā, the grandfather of the worlds,

sanskrit_iast:
jagāma viṣṇubhavanaṃ sahaiva samavartinā |
tamāsādya tathā prāha iṣṇuṃvai yamabhāṣitam || 8 ||
meaning:
जगाम विष्णुभवनं सहैव समवर्तिना |
तमासाद्य तथा प्राह इष्णुंवै यमभाषितम् || 8 ||
text_mt: went to the abode of Viṣṇu together with Samavartin. / Having reached Viṣṇu, he told him what Yama had said.

sanskrit_iast:
yathāvat sarvalokeśaḥ sa ca tadvākyamagrahīt |
saha brahmayamābhyāṃ tu iṣṇuḥ śambhuṃ ayau tataḥ |
satkṛtastatena pṛṣṭaśca prāhedaṃ yamabhāṣitam || 9 ||
meaning:
यथावत् सर्वलोकेशः स च तद्वाक्यमग्रहीत् |
सह ब्रह्मयमाभ्यां तु इष्णुः शम्भुं अयौ ततः |
सत्कृतस्ततेन पृष्टश्च प्राहेदं यमभाषितम् || 9 ||
text_mt: The lord of all worlds duly understood his words. / Then Viṣṇu went to Śambhu along with Brahmā and Yama; / honoured by him and questioned, he told him what Yama had said:

sanskrit_iast: śrībhagavānuvāca -
meaning: श्रीभगवानुवाच -

sanskrit_iast:
sarvadevaiḥ sarvatīrthaiḥ sarvakṣetraistathaiva ca |
etad vyāptaṃ kāmarūpaṃ nāto'nyad vidyate param || 10 ||
meaning:
सर्वदेवैः सर्वतीर्थैः सर्वक्षेत्रैस्तथैव च |
एतद् व्याप्तं कामरूपं नातोऽन्यद् विद्यते परम् || 10 ||
text_mt: 'This Kāmarūpa is pervaded by all the gods, all the sacred fords, / and likewise all the sacred fields; nothing is known to be superior to it.

sanskrit_iast:
idaṃ pīṭhaṃ samāsādya devatvaṃ yānti mānavāḥ |
amṛtatvaṃ gaṇatvaṃ ca tatra śakto yamo nahi || 11 ||
meaning:
इदं पीठं समासाद्य देवत्वं यान्ति मानवाः |
अमृतत्वं गणत्वं च तत्र शक्तो यमो नहि || 11 ||
text_mt: Having reached this pīṭha, humans attain godhood, / immortality, and the status of [divine] attendants; Yama is not capable there.

sanskrit_iast:
athā kuru mahādeva yathā tatra kṣamo yamaḥ |
yamo nirasto yatrāsti maryādā na radṛśyate || 12 ||
meaning:
अथा कुरु महादेव यथा तत्र क्षमो यमः |
यमो निरस्तो यत्रास्ति मर्यादा न रदृश्यते || 12 ||
text_mt: Therefore, O Mahādeva, act so that Yama becomes capable there; / where Yama is repelled, no moral order is observed.'

sanskrit_iast: aurva uvāca -
meaning: और्व उवाच -

sanskrit_iast:
etad viṣṇuvacaḥ śrutvāḥ vidhinā sahitasya tu |
aṅgīcakāra hṛdaye tadvacaḥ sādhyasādhane || 13 ||
meaning:
एतद् विष्णुवचः श्रुत्वाः विधिना सहितस्य तु |
अङ्गीचकार हृदये तद्वचः साध्यसाधने || 13 ||
text_mt: Hearing these words of Viṣṇu, who was accompanied by Vidhi, / he accepted those words in his heart for the accomplishment of what was to be achieved.

sanskrit_iast:
visṛjya tān brahmaviṣṇuyamān vṛṣabhavāhanaḥ |
ādāya svagaṇān sarvān kāmarūpāntaraṃ yamau || 14 ||
meaning:
विसृज्य तान् ब्रह्मविष्णुयमान् वृषभवाहनः |
आदाय स्वगणान् सर्वान् कामरूपान्तरं यमौ || 14 ||
text_mt: Having dismissed Brahmā, Viṣṇu, and Yama, he whose mount is the bull, / taking all his own attendants, went into Kāmarūpa.

sanskrit_iast:
ugratārāṃ tato devīṃ gaṇaṃ ca prāha śaṅkaraḥ |
utsārayantu sakalānnimāṁllokān gaṇā drutam || 15 ||
meaning:
उग्रतारां ततो देवीं गणं च प्राह शङ्करः |
उत्सारयन्तु सकलान्निमाṁल्लोकान् गणा द्रुतम् || 15 ||
text_mt: Then Śaṅkara spoke to the goddess Ugratārā and to the attendants: / 'Let the attendants quickly drive away all these people.

sanskrit_iast:
ugratāre mahādevi tvaṃ cāpyutsāraya drutam |
tato gaṇāḥ kāmarūpād devī cāpyaparājitā || 16 ||
meaning:
उग्रतारे महादेवि त्वं चाप्युत्सारय द्रुतम् |
ततो गणाः कामरूपाद् देवी चाप्यपराजिता || 16 ||
text_mt: O great goddess Ugratārā, you too quickly drive [them] away!' / Then the attendants and the undefeated goddess

sanskrit_iast:
lokānutsārayāmāsuḥ pīṭhaṃ kartuṃ harasyakam |
utsāryamāṇe loke tu caturvarṇadvijātiṣu || 17 ||
meaning:
लोकानुत्सारयामासुः पीठं कर्तुं हरस्यकम् |
उत्सार्यमाणे लोके तु चतुर्वर्णद्विजातिषु || 17 ||
text_mt: drove the people away from Kāmarūpa in order to make the pīṭha Hara's own. / But while the people, the twice-born of the four classes, were being driven away,

sanskrit_iast:
sandhyācalagato vipro vasiṣṭhaḥ kupito muniḥ |
so'pyugratārayā devyā utsārayitumīśayā || 18 ||
meaning:
सन्ध्याचलगतो विप्रो वसिष्ठः कुपितो मुनिः |
सोऽप्युग्रतारया देव्या उत्सारयितुमीशया || 18 ||
text_mt: the sage Vasiṣṭha, a brahmin stationed on the mountain Sandhyācala, became enraged. / As he too was seized by the goddess Ugratārā, the ruler,

sanskrit_iast:
gaṇaiḥ saha dhṛtaḥ prāha śāpaṃ kurvan sudāruṇam |
yasmādahaṃ dhṛto vāme tvayotsārayituṃ muniḥ || 19 ||
meaning:
गणैः सह धृतः प्राह शापं कुर्वन् सुदारुणम् |
यस्मादहं धृतो वामे त्वयोत्सारयितुं मुनिः || 19 ||
text_mt: along with the attendants, in order to drive [him] away, he spoke, uttering a terrible curse: / 'Since I, a sage, have been seized by you, O perverse one, to be driven away,

sanskrit_iast:
tasmāt tvaṃ vāmyabhāvena pūjyā bhava samantrikā |
hramanti mlecchavad yasmād gaṇānāṃ mandabuddhayaḥ || 20 ||
meaning:
तस्मात् त्वं वाम्यभावेन पूज्या भव समन्त्रिका |
ह्रमन्ति म्लेच्छवद् यस्माद् गणानां मन्दबुद्धयः || 20 ||
text_mt: therefore be worshipped according to the left-hand path, along with [your] mantras! / Since the dull-witted among your attendants roam about like barbarians,

sanskrit_iast:
bhavantu mlecchāstasmād vai bhavantaḥ kāmarūpake |
mahādevo'pi yasmānmāṃ niḥsārayitumudyataḥ || 21 ||
meaning:
भवन्तु म्लेच्छास्तस्माद् वै भवन्तः कामरूपके |
महादेवोऽपि यस्मान्मां निःसारयितुमुद्यतः || 21 ||
text_mt: therefore, indeed, let you [all] become barbarians in Kāmarūpa! / And since Mahādeva is bent upon expelling me,

sanskrit_iast:
tapodhanaṃ muniṃ dāntaṃ mlecchavad vedapāragam |
tasmād mlecchapriyo bhūyācchaṅkaraścāsthibhasmadhṛk || 22 ||
meaning:
तपोधनं मुनिं दान्तं म्लेच्छवद् वेदपारगम् |
तस्माद् म्लेच्छप्रियो भूयाच्छङ्करश्चास्थिभस्मधृक् || 22 ||
text_mt: a sage rich in asceticism, subdued, and versed in the Vedas, as if [I were] a barbarian, / therefore let Śaṅkara become fond of barbarians, bearing bones and ashes!

sanskrit_iast:
etat tu kāmarūpākhyaṃ mlecchairguptaṃ madatvaram |
svayaṃ viṣṇurna cāyāti yāvat sthānamidaṃ punaḥ || 23 ||
meaning:
एतत् तु कामरूपाख्यं म्लेच्छैर्गुप्तं मदत्वरम् |
स्वयं विष्णुर्न चायाति यावत् स्थानमिदं पुनः || 23 ||
text_mt: And let this [land] named Kāmarūpa be concealed by barbarians, heedless of pride, / until Viṣṇu himself comes to this place again.

sanskrit_iast:
viralāścāgamāḥ santu ya etatpratipādakāḥ |
viralaṃ yastu jānāti kāmarūpāgamaṃ budhaḥ || 24 ||
meaning:
विरलाश्चागमाः सन्तु य एतत्प्रतिपादकाः |
विरलं यस्तु जानाति कामरूपागमं बुधः || 24 ||
text_mt: And let the scriptures that establish this be rare! / But whatever wise man knows the rare scripture of Kāmarūpa,

sanskrit_iast:
sa eva prāpte kāle'pi sampūrṇaṃ phalabhāpsyati |
evamuktvā vasiṣṭhastu tatraivāntaradhīyata || 25 ||
meaning:
स एव प्राप्ते कालेऽपि सम्पूर्णं फलभाप्स्यति |
एवमुक्त्वा वसिष्ठस्तु तत्रैवान्तरधीयत || 25 ||
text_mt: he alone shall obtain the complete fruit, even when the time arrives.' / Having spoken thus, Vasiṣṭha vanished right there.

sanskrit_iast:
te gaṇā mlecchatāṃ yātāḥ kāmarūpe surālaye |
vāmā'bhūdrugratārāpi śambhurmleccharato'bhavat || 26 ||
meaning:
ते गणा म्लेच्छतां याताः कामरूपे सुरालये |
वामाऽभूद्रुग्रतारापि शम्भुर्म्लेच्छरतोऽभवत् || 26 ||
text_mt: Those attendants went to the state of barbarians in Kāmarūpa, the abode of the gods; / Ugratārā too became left-handed; and Śambhu became devoted to barbarians.

sanskrit_iast:
āgamā viralāścāsan ye ca matpratipādakāḥ |
vedamantravihīnaṃ tu caturvarṇavivarjitam || 27 ||
meaning:
आगमा विरलाश्चासन् ये च मत्प्रतिपादकाः |
वेदमन्त्रविहीनं तु चतुर्वर्णविवर्जितम् || 27 ||
text_mt: And the scriptures that established my [doctrines] became rare. / Devoid of Vedic mantras and abandoned by the four classes,

sanskrit_iast:
kāmarūpaṃ kṣaṇājjātaṃ yad yamenānusāśtim |
āgate'pi harau mukte śāpāt pīṭhe phalaprade || 28 ||
meaning:
कामरूपं क्षणाज्जातं यद् यमेनानुसाश्तिम् |
आगतेऽपि हरौ मुक्ते शापात् पीठे फलप्रदे || 28 ||
text_mt: Kāmarūpa instantly became governed by Yama. / Even when Hari arrived and the fruit-yielding pīṭha was freed from the curse,

sanskrit_iast:
yathā na samyak sthāsyanti tatpīṭhe devamānuṣāḥ |
guptaye sarvakuṇḍānāṃ brahmopāyaṃ tathā'karot || 29 ||
meaning:
यथा न सम्यक् स्थास्यन्ति तत्पीठे देवमानुषाः |
गुप्तये सर्वकुण्डानां ब्रह्मोपायं तथाऽकरोत् || 29 ||
text_mt: so that gods and men would not properly dwell in that pīṭha, / Brahmā devised an expedient for the concealment of all the pools:

sanskrit_iast:
apunarbhavakuṇḍasya somakuṇḍasya cobhayoḥ |
brahmorvaśīkuṇḍayostu nadīnāmapi bhūriśaḥ || 30 ||
meaning:
अपुनर्भवकुण्डस्य सोमकुण्डस्य चोभयोः |
ब्रह्मोर्वशीकुण्डयोस्तु नदीनामपि भूरिशः || 30 ||
text_mt: both of the Apunarbhava pool and of the Soma pool, / of the Brahma pool and the Urvaśī pool, and of the numerous rivers.

sanskrit_iast:
nadīnāṃ pūrvamuktānāmanuktānāṃ ca guptaye |
sarvasyaikaphalajñāne brahmopāyaṃ tathā'karot || 31 ||
meaning:
नदीनां पूर्वमुक्तानामनुक्तानां च गुप्तये |
सर्वस्यैकफलज्ञाने ब्रह्मोपायं तथाऽकरोत् || 31 ||
text_mt: For the concealment of the rivers previously mentioned and unmentioned, / [and] for the recognition of one single fruit for all, Brahmā devised an expedient:

sanskrit_iast:
amoghāyāṃ śāntanostu bhāryāyāṃ tanayaṃ svakam |
jalarūpaṃ samutpādya jāmadagnyena dhīmatā || 32 ||
meaning:
अमोघायां शान्तनोस्तु भार्यायां तनयं स्वकम् |
जलरूपं समुत्पाद्य जामदग्न्येन धीमता || 32 ||
text_mt: Having generated his own son in the form of water in Amoghā, / the wife of Śāntanu, by means of the wise Jāmadagnya,

sanskrit_iast:
avatārayadavyagraṃ plāvayan kāmarūpakam |
sa tu brahmasuto dhīraḥ plāvayan kuṇḍasañcayān || 33 ||
meaning:
अवतारयदव्यग्रं प्लावयन् कामरूपकम् |
स तु ब्रह्मसुतो धीरः प्लावयन् कुण्डसञ्चयान् || 33 ||
text_mt: he brought him down without delay, flooding Kāmarūpa. / That steadfast son of Brahmā, flooding the collections of pools,

sanskrit_iast:
ācchādya sarvatīrthāni bhuvi guptāni cākarot |
lauhityamātraṃ ye kecijjānanti tatra vai narāḥ || 34 ||
meaning:
आच्छाद्य सर्वतीर्थानि भुवि गुप्तानि चाकरोत् |
लौहित्यमात्रं ये केचिज्जानन्ति तत्र वै नराः || 34 ||
text_mt: covering all the sacred fords, concealed them on earth. / Whatever men there know only the Lauhitya,

sanskrit_iast:
te lauhityasnānaphalaṃ prāpnuvanti suniścitam |
na jānanti ca kuṇḍāni nāpi tīrthāni cānyataḥ || 35 ||
meaning:
ते लौहित्यस्नानफलं प्राप्नुवन्ति सुनिश्चितम् |
न जानन्ति च कुण्डानि नापि तीर्थानि चान्यतः || 35 ||
text_mt: they assuredly obtain the fruit of bathing in the Lauhitya, / and they do not know the pools, nor the sacred fords elsewhere.

sanskrit_iast:
vasiṣṭhaśāpādetat tu pravṛttaṃ tīrthagopanam |
yaḥ kaścit tatra jānāti tīrthānāṃ ca viśeṣatām || 36 ||
meaning:
वसिष्ठशापादेतत् तु प्रवृत्तं तीर्थगोपनम् |
यः कश्चित् तत्र जानाति तीर्थानां च विशेषताम् || 36 ||
text_mt: This concealment of the sacred fords indeed took place because of Vasiṣṭha's curse. / Whoever there knows the special nature of the sacred fords

sanskrit_iast:
samavāpnoti tat snānaphalaṃ samyag narottama |
sarvā nadīḥ samāplāvya sarvatīrthāni sarvataḥ |
lauhityo brahmaṇaḥ putro yāti dakṣiṇasāgaram || 37 ||
meaning:
समवाप्नोति तत् स्नानफलं सम्यग् नरोत्तम |
सर्वा नदीः समाप्लाव्य सर्वतीर्थानि सर्वतः |
लौहित्यो ब्रह्मणः पुत्रो याति दक्षिणसागरम् || 37 ||
text_mt: fully obtains the fruit of bathing in them, O best of men. / Completely inundating all the rivers and all the sacred fords on all sides, / the Lauhitya, the son of Brahmā, goes to the southern sea.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ te kathitaṃ rājan kāmarūpasya kīrtanam |
yadanyadrocate tubhyaṃ tat pṛccha nigadāmi te || 38 ||
meaning:
एवं ते कथितं राजन् कामरूपस्य कीर्तनम् |
यदन्यद्रोचते तुभ्यं तत् पृच्छ निगदामि ते || 38 ||
text_mt: Thus has the praise of Kāmarūpa been told to you, O king; / ask whatever else pleases you, and I shall tell it to you.

sanskrit_iast: iti śrīkālikāpurāṇe ekāśītitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 81 ||
meaning: इति श्रीकालिकापुराणे एकाशीतितमोऽध्यायः || 81 ||
text_mt: Thus ends the eighty-first chapter in the glorious Kālikāpurāṇa.

sanskrit_iast: dvyaśītitamo'dhyāyaḥ
meaning: द्व्यशीतितमोऽध्यायः

sanskrit_iast: mārkaṇḍeya uvāca
meaning: मार्कण्डेय उवाच

sanskrit_iast:
aurvasya vacanaṃ śrutvā sagarastaṃ muniṃ punaḥ |
papracchedaṃ dvijaśreṣṭhāṃ harṣasaṃplutamānasaḥ || 1 ||
meaning:
और्वस्य वचनं श्रुत्वा सगरस्तं मुनिं पुनः |
पप्रच्छेदं द्विजश्रेष्ठां हर्षसंप्लुतमानसः || 1 ||
text_mt: Hearing the words of Aurva, Sagara then addressed that best of sages, / his heart overflowing with joy, asking that best of Brahmins this:

sanskrit_iast: sagara uvāca
meaning: सगर उवाच

sanskrit_iast:
amoghāyāṃ kathaṃ yajñe lauhityo brahmaṇaḥ sutaḥ |
kathaṃ śāntanujāyāyāṃ rataḥ sa kamalāsanaḥ || 2 ||
meaning:
अमोघायां कथं यज्ञे लौहित्यो ब्रह्मणः सुतः |
कथं शान्तनुजायायां रतः स कमलासनः || 2 ||
text_mt: "How was the son of Brahmā, Lauhitya, born in Amoghā? / Why was he who sits on the lotus fond of Śāntanu's wife?

sanskrit_iast:
pārastraiṇeyaputro vā kathaṃ jajñe pitāmahāt |
tat sarvaṃ śrotumicchāmi kathayasva dvijottama || 3 ||
meaning:
पारस्त्रैणेयपुत्रो वा कथं जज्ञे पितामहात् |
तत् सर्वं श्रोतुमिच्छामि कथयस्व द्विजोत्तम || 3 ||
text_mt: And how was a son from another's wife born from the Grandfather? / I desire to hear all that; tell me, O best of Brahmins!"

sanskrit_iast:
aurva uvāca
śṛṇu tvaṃ rājaśārdūla kathayāmi mahattaram |
ākhyānaṃ brahmaputrasya lauhityatya mahātmanaḥ || 4 ||
meaning:
और्व उवाच
शृणु त्वं राजशार्दूल कथयामि महत्तरम् |
आख्यानं ब्रह्मपुत्रस्य लौहित्यत्य महात्मनः || 4 ||
text_mt:
Aurva said:
"Listen, O tiger among kings, I shall tell you the great / narrative of the son of Brahmā, the high-souled Lauhitya.

sanskrit_iast:
harivarṣe mahāvarṣe śāntanurnāma nāmataḥ |
munirāsīnmahābhāgo jñānavān sa taporataḥ || 5 ||
meaning:
हरिवर्षे महावर्षे शान्तनुर्नाम नामतः |
मुनिरासीन्महाभागो ज्ञानवान् स तपोरतः || 5 ||
text_mt: In the great continent Harivarṣa, there was a sage named Śāntanu, / very fortunate, wise, and devoted to penance.

sanskrit_iast:
tasya bhāryā mahābhāgā amoghākhyā mahāsatī |
hiraṇyagarbhasya munestṛṇabindvāśramodbhavā || 6 ||
meaning:
तस्य भार्या महाभागा अमोघाख्या महासती |
हिरण्यगर्भस्य मुनेस्तृणबिन्द्वाश्रमोद्भवा || 6 ||
text_mt: His wife was the fortunate and greatly virtuous Amoghā, / born at the hermitage of Tṛṇabindu, daughter of the sage Hiraṇyagarbha.

sanskrit_iast:
tayā sārdhaṃ sa kailāsaṃ maryādāparvate vasan |
lohitākhyasya sarasastīre vai gandhamādane || 7 ||
meaning:
तया सार्धं स कैलासं मर्यादापर्वते वसन् |
लोहिताख्यस्य सरसस्तीरे वै गन्धमादने || 7 ||
text_mt: Living together with her on Kailāsa, on a boundary mountain, / indeed on Gandhamādana, on the shore of the lake named Lohita,

sanskrit_iast:
ekadā sa taponiṣṭho nijapuṣpādigocaram |
jagāma vanamdhyaṃ tu cinvan bahuphalāni ca || 8 ||
meaning:
एकदा स तपोनिष्ठो निजपुष्पादिगोचरम् |
जगाम वनम्ध्यं तु चिन्वन् बहुफलानि च || 8 ||
text_mt: once that sage steadfast in penance, seeking his flowers and such, / went into the forest, gathering many fruits.

sanskrit_iast:
tasminnavasare brahmā sarvalokapitāmahaḥ |
tatrājagāma yatrāsti amoghā śāntanoḥ priyā || 9 ||
meaning:
तस्मिन्नवसरे ब्रह्मा सर्वलोकपितामहः |
तत्राजगाम यत्रास्ति अमोघा शान्तनोः प्रिया || 9 ||
text_mt: At that moment Brahmā, the grandfather of all the worlds, / came there where Amoghā, Śāntanu's beloved, was.

sanskrit_iast:
tāṃ dṛṣṭvā devagarbhāyāṃ yuvatīmatisundarīm |
mohito madanenāśu tadā'bhūd dūṣitendriyaḥ || 10 ||
meaning:
तां दृष्ट्वा देवगर्भायां युवतीमतिसुन्दरीम् |
मोहितो मदनेनाशु तदाऽभूद् दूषितेन्द्रियः || 10 ||
text_mt: Seeing that very beautiful young woman conceived of divine origin, / he was then instantly infatuated by the god of love, his senses corrupted.

sanskrit_iast:
udīritendriyo bhūtvā jighṛkṣustāṁ mahāsatīm |
athādhāvat tato brahmā sammukho madanārditaḥ || 11 ||
meaning:
उदीरितेन्द्रियो भूत्वा जिघृक्षुस्ताṁ महासतीम् |
अथाधावत् ततो ब्रह्मा सम्मुखो मदनार्दितः || 11 ||
text_mt: With his senses aroused, desiring to seize that virtuous woman, / Brahmā then ran facing her, tormented by passion.

sanskrit_iast:
dhāvamānaṃ vidhātāraṃ dṛṣṭvā'moghā mahāsatī |
naivaṃ naivamiti proktvā parṇaśālāṃ vyalīyata || 12 ||
meaning:
धावमानं विधातारं दृष्ट्वाऽमोघा महासती |
नैवं नैवमिति प्रोक्त्वा पर्णशालां व्यलीयत || 12 ||
text_mt: Seeing Vidhātṛ running toward her, the virtuous Amoghā, / saying 'Not like this! Not like this!', hid inside the leaf-hut.

sanskrit_iast:
idaṃ covāca dhātāramamoghā kupitā tadā |
parṇaśālāntaraṃ gatvā dvāramāvṛtya tatkṣaṇāt || 13 ||
meaning:
इदं चोवाच धातारममोघा कुपिता तदा |
पर्णशालान्तरं गत्वा द्वारमावृत्य तत्क्षणात् || 13 ||
text_mt: And going inside the leaf-hut and immediately shutting the door, / the angry Amoghā then said this to Dhātṛ:

sanskrit_iast:
akāryaṃ na mayā kāryaṃ munipatnyā vigarhitam |
balāt pramathyā cahāṃ cet tvayā tvāṃ ca śapāmyaham || 14 ||
meaning:
अकार्यं न मया कार्यं मुनिपत्न्या विगर्हितम् |
बलात् प्रमथ्या चहां चेत् त्वया त्वां च शपाम्यहम् || 14 ||
text_mt: 'An improper, blameworthy deed must not be done by me, the wife of a sage. / If I am forcibly overpowered by you, I shall curse you!'

sanskrit_iast:
amoghayā caivamukte vidhātuśca tadā nṛpa |
retaścaskanda tatraiva āśrame śāntanormuneḥ || 15 ||
meaning:
अमोघया चैवमुक्ते विधातुश्च तदा नृप |
रेतश्चस्कन्द तत्रैव आश्रमे शान्तनोर्मुनेः || 15 ||
text_mt: When Amoghā had spoken thus, O king, / the semen of Vidhātṛ then dropped right there in the hermitage of the sage Śāntanu.

sanskrit_iast:
cyute ratasi dhātāpi haṃsayānaṃ samutthitaḥ |
lajjayā'tiparītātmā drutaṃ vai svāśramaṃ yayau || 16 ||
meaning:
च्युते रतसि धातापि हंसयानं समुत्थितः |
लज्जयाऽतिपरीतात्मा द्रुतं वै स्वाश्रमं ययौ || 16 ||
text_mt: His semen fallen, Dhātṛ too climbed upon his swan-mount / and, his soul entirely filled with shame, swiftly went to his own hermitage.

sanskrit_iast:
gate vedhasi śāntanuśca nijamāśramamāgataḥ |
āgatya dṛṣṭvā haṃsānāṃ padakṣobhaṃ tadā bhuvi || 17 ||
meaning:
गते वेधसि शान्तनुश्च निजमाश्रममागतः |
आगत्य दृष्ट्वा हंसानां पदक्षोभं तदा भुवि || 17 ||
text_mt: When Vedhas was gone, Śāntanu returned to his hermitage. / Having arrived, he then saw the agitation of swans' footsteps on the ground

sanskrit_iast:
tejaśca patitaṃ bhūmau vidhāturjvalanopamam |
amoghāṃ paripapraccha parṇaśālāntarasthitām || 18 ||
meaning:
तेजश्च पतितं भूमौ विधातुर्ज्वलनोपमम् |
अमोघां परिपप्रच्छ पर्णशालान्तरस्थिताम् || 18 ||
text_mt: and the semen of Vidhātṛ fallen on the earth like fire. / He asked Amoghā, who was staying inside the leaf-hut:

sanskrit_iast:
kimetadatra subhage pravṛttaṃ dṛśyate tu yat |
pakṣiṇāṃ ca padakṣobhaṃ tejaścedaṃ ca kīdṛśam || 19 ||
meaning:
किमेतदत्र सुभगे प्रवृत्तं दृश्यते तु यत् |
पक्षिणां च पदक्षोभं तेजश्चेदं च कीदृशम् || 19 ||
text_mt: 'O auspicious one, what is seen to have happened here? / What is this disturbance of birds' footprints, and of what kind is this fiery brilliance?'

sanskrit_iast:
sā tasya vacanaṃ śrutvā śāntanuṃ munisattamam |
amarṣitaiva nyagadadākulā vikalānanāṃ || 20 ||
meaning:
सा तस्य वचनं श्रुत्वा शान्तनुं मुनिसत्तमम् |
अमर्षितैव न्यगददाकुला विकलाननां || 20 ||
text_mt: Hearing his words, she, indignant, / agitated, with her face distressed, told that best of sages, Śāntanu:

sanskrit_iast:
haṃsayuktasyandanena ko'pyāgatya caturmukhaḥ |
kamaṇḍalu karo'tīva ratiṃ māṃ samayācataṃ || 21 ||
meaning:
हंसयुक्तस्यन्दनेन कोऽप्यागत्य चतुर्मुखः |
कमण्डलु करोऽतीव रतिं मां समयाचतं || 21 ||
text_mt: 'Someone with four faces, carrying a water-pot, arriving in a chariot drawn by swans, / vehemently asked me for sexual intercourse.

sanskrit_iast:
ato mayā tarjitaḥ sa uṭajāntaralīnayā |
pracyāvya tejaḥ saṃyāto mama śāpabhayārditaḥ || 22 ||
meaning:
अतो मया तर्जितः स उटजान्तरलीनया |
प्रच्याव्य तेजः संयातो मम शापभयार्दितः || 22 ||
text_mt: Therefore, hiding inside the hut, I rebuked him; / having shed his semen, he fled, afflicted with fear of my curse.

sanskrit_iast:
kuru tatra pratīkāraṃ yadi śaknoṣi śāntano |
na hīmāṃ dharṣaṇāṃ soḍhuṃ kaścicchaknoti jīvabhṛt || 23 ||
meaning:
कुरु तत्र प्रतीकारं यदि शक्नोषि शान्तनो |
न हीमां धर्षणां सोढुं कश्चिच्छक्नोति जीवभृत् || 23 ||
text_mt: Do remedy this if you are able, O Śāntanu! / For no living being can tolerate such an assault.'

sanskrit_iast:
sa tasyā vacanaṃ śrutvā svayaṃ brahmā samāgataḥ |
iti niścitya anasā adā dhyānaparo'bhavat || 24 ||
meaning:
स तस्या वचनं श्रुत्वा स्वयं ब्रह्मा समागतः |
इति निश्चित्य अनसा अदा ध्यानपरोऽभवत् || 24 ||
text_mt: Hearing her words and concluding in his mind, / 'Brahmā himself has come,' he then became absorbed in meditation.

sanskrit_iast:
divyajñānena sa jñātvā devakāryamupasthitam |
tīrthāvataraṇaṃ cāpi hitāya jagatāṃ muniḥ || 25 ||
meaning:
दिव्यज्ञानेन स ज्ञात्वा देवकार्यमुपस्थितम् |
तीर्थावतरणं चापि हिताय जगतां मुनिः || 25 ||
text_mt: Knowing by divine insight that a work of the gods had presented itself, / and also the descent of a holy water for the welfare of the worlds, the sage,

sanskrit_iast:
jñātvodarkaṃ cintayitvā svabhāryāmidamabravīt |
idaṃ tejo brahmaṇastvaṃ pibāmoghaṃ mamājñayā || 26 ||
meaning:
ज्ञात्वोदर्कं चिन्तयित्वा स्वभार्यामिदमब्रवीत् |
इदं तेजो ब्रह्मणस्त्वं पिबामोघं ममाज्ञया || 26 ||
text_mt: knowing the future outcome and reflecting, spoke thus to his wife: / 'Drink this infallible semen of Brahmā at my command!

sanskrit_iast:
hitāya sarvajagatāṃ devakāryārthasiddhaye |
bhavatyā nikaṭaṃ brahmā svayameva samāgataḥ || 27 ||
meaning:
हिताय सर्वजगतां देवकार्यार्थसिद्धये |
भवत्या निकटं ब्रह्मा स्वयमेव समागतः || 27 ||
text_mt: For the welfare of all worlds and for the success of the purpose of the gods, / Brahmā came in person near you.

sanskrit_iast:
tvāmaprāpya mahat kṛtyamāvayoḥ sa samarpya ca |
gato nijāspadaṃ tat tvaṃ kartumarhasi tad vacaḥ || 28 ||
meaning:
त्वामप्राप्य महत् कृत्यमावयोः स समर्प्य च |
गतो निजास्पदं तत् त्वं कर्तुमर्हसि तद् वचः || 28 ||
text_mt: Not having obtained you, yet entrusting a great deed to us two, / he has gone to his abode; therefore, you ought to obey that word.'

sanskrit_iast:
tacchrutvā śāntanorvākyamamoghātīva lajjitā |
sāntvayantīva taṃ prāha patiṃ natvā mahāsatī || 29 ||
meaning:
तच्छ्रुत्वा शान्तनोर्वाक्यममोघातीव लज्जिता |
सान्त्वयन्तीव तं प्राह पतिं नत्वा महासती || 29 ||
text_mt: Hearing those words of Śāntanu, Amoghā was deeply ashamed. / Bowing to her husband, as if consoling him, the virtuous woman said:

sanskrit_iast:
nānyasya tejo dhāsyāmi na ca te vimanaskatā |
avaśyaṃ yadi kartavyaṃ pītvā tvaṃ mayi cotsṛja || 30 ||
meaning:
नान्यस्य तेजो धास्यामि न च ते विमनस्कता |
अवश्यं यदि कर्तव्यं पीत्वा त्वं मयि चोत्सृज || 30 ||
text_mt: 'I will not hold the seed of another, nor should there be dejection in your mind. / If it must certainly be done, drink it yourself and discharge it into me.'

sanskrit_iast:
tatastasyā vacaḥ śrutvā yuktaṃ tathyaṃ ca śāntanuḥ |
svayaṃ pītvā tu tat tejaḥ vabhāryāyāṃ nyase.cayat || 31 ||
meaning:
ततस्तस्या वचः श्रुत्वा युक्तं तथ्यं च शान्तनुः |
स्वयं पीत्वा तु तत् तेजः वभार्यायां न्यसे.चयत् || 31 ||
text_mt: Then, hearing her word, which was fitting and true, Śāntanu, / having drunk that semen himself, deposited it into his wife.

sanskrit_iast:
saṃkrāmitaiḥ śāntanunā tejobhirbrahmaṇaḥ satī |
garbhaṃ dadhārāmoghākhyā hitāya jagatāṃ tataḥ || 32 ||
meaning:
संक्रामितैः शान्तनुना तेजोभिर्ब्रह्मणः सती |
गर्भं दधारामोघाख्या हिताय जगतां ततः || 32 ||
text_mt: Impregnated with the semen of Brahmā transferred by Śāntanu, / the virtuous woman named Amoghā then bore a child for the welfare of the worlds.

sanskrit_iast:
tasyāḥ kāle tu samprāpte nāsāto jalasañcayaḥ |
tanmadhye tanayaścāpi nīlavāsāḥ kīrīṭadhṛk || 33 ||
meaning:
तस्याः काले तु सम्प्राप्ते नासातो जलसञ्चयः |
तन्मध्ये तनयश्चापि नीलवासाः कीरीटधृक् || 33 ||
text_mt: When her time arrived, a mass of water emerged from her nostrils, / and in its midst a son dressed in blue garments, wearing a diadem,

sanskrit_iast:
ratnamālāsamāyukto raktagauraśca brahmavat |
caturbhujaḥ padmavidyādhvajaśaktidharastathā || 34 ||
meaning:
रत्नमालासमायुक्तो रक्तगौरश्च ब्रह्मवत् |
चतुर्भुजः पद्मविद्याध्वजशक्तिधरस्तथा || 34 ||
text_mt: adorned with a necklace of jewels, red-white like Brahmā, / four-armed, holding a lotus, scripture, banner, and spear,

sanskrit_iast:
śiśumāraśirasthaśca tulyakāyo jalotkaraiḥ |
tajjātaṃ ca tathābhūtaṃ śāntanurlokaśāntanuḥ || 35 ||
meaning:
शिशुमारशिरस्थश्च तुल्यकायो जलोत्करैः |
तज्जातं च तथाभूतं शान्तनुर्लोकशान्तनुः || 35 ||
text_mt: standing on the head of a crocodile-dolphin, with a body equal to masses of water. / He was born thus, and Śāntanu, the benefactor of the world,

sanskrit_iast:
caturṇāṃ parvatānāṃ ca madhyadeśe nyavīviśat |
kailāsaścottare pārśve dakṣiṇe gandhamādanaḥ || 36 ||
meaning:
चतुर्णां पर्वतानां च मध्यदेशे न्यवीविशत् |
कैलासश्चोत्तरे पार्श्वे दक्षिणे गन्धमादनः || 36 ||
text_mt: placed him in the middle region of four mountains: / Kailāsa on the northern side, Gandhamādana on the south,

sanskrit_iast:
rārudhiḥ paścime śailaḥ pūrve saṃvartakādvayaḥ |
teṣāṃ madhye svayaṃ kuṇḍaṃ parvatānāṃ vidheḥ sutaḥ || 37 ||
meaning:
रारुधिः पश्चिमे शैलः पूर्वे संवर्तकाद्वयः |
तेषां मध्ये स्वयं कुण्डं पर्वतानां विधेः सुतः || 37 ||
text_mt: the Jarudhi mountain on the west, and the Saṃvartaka mountain on the east. / In their midst, the son of Vidhi, having formed a basin himself,

sanskrit_iast:
kṛtvā'tivavṛdhe nitya śaradīva niśākaraḥ |
taṃ toyamadhyagaṃ putramāsādya druhiṇaḥ sutam || 38 ||
meaning:
कृत्वाऽतिववृधे नित्य शरदीव निशाकरः |
तं तोयमध्यगं पुत्रमासाद्य द्रुहिणः सुतम् || 38 ||
text_mt: grew exceedingly every day like the moon in autumn. / Approaching that son of Druhiṇa, that child situated in the midst of water,

sanskrit_iast:
kramatastasya saṃskārānakarod dehaśuddhaye |
atha kāle bahutithe vyatīte brahmaṇaḥ sutaḥ || 39 ||
meaning:
क्रमतस्तस्य संस्कारानकरोद् देहशुद्धये |
अथ काले बहुतिथे व्यतीते ब्रह्मणः सुतः || 39 ||
text_mt: he performed his life-cycle rites in sequence for bodily purification. / Then, when a long time had passed, the son of Brahmā,

sanskrit_iast:
toyarāśisvarūpeṇa vavṛdhe pañcayojanān |
tasmin devāḥ papuḥ sasnurdvitīya iva sāgare || 40 ||
meaning:
तोयराशिस्वरूपेण ववृधे पञ्चयोजनान् |
तस्मिन् देवाः पपुः सस्नुर्द्वितीय इव सागरे || 40 ||
text_mt: in the form of a mass of water, grew to five yojanas. / In him the gods drank and bathed, as if in a second ocean,

sanskrit_iast:
sitāmalajale hṛdye divyaiścāpsarasāṃ gaṇaiḥ |
tasminnavasare rāmo jāmadagnyaḥ pratāpavān || 41 ||
meaning:
सितामलजले हृद्ये दिव्यैश्चाप्सरसां गणैः |
तस्मिन्नवसरे रामो जामदग्न्यः प्रतापवान् || 41 ||
text_mt: in clear, pure, delightful water, along with hosts of divine apsarases. / At that time, the powerful Rāma, son of Jamadagni,

sanskrit_iast:
cakre mātṛvadhaṃ ghoramayuktaṃ piturājñayā |
tasya pāpasya mokṣāya svapituścopadeśataḥ || 42 ||
meaning:
चक्रे मातृवधं घोरमयुक्तं पितुराज्ञया |
तस्य पापस्य मोक्षाय स्वपितुश्चोपदेशतः || 42 ||
text_mt: committed the horrific and wrongful matricide by order of his father. / To be freed from that sin, by the instruction of his own father,

sanskrit_iast:
sa jagāma mahākuṇḍaṃ brahmākhya snātumicchayā |
tatra snātvā ca pītvā ca mātṛhatyāmapānayan |
vīthīṃ paraśunā kṛtvā taṃ mahyāmavatārayavat || 43 ||
meaning:
स जगाम महाकुण्डं ब्रह्माख्य स्नातुमिच्छया |
तत्र स्नात्वा च पीत्वा च मातृहत्यामपानयन् |
वीथीं परशुना कृत्वा तं मह्यामवतारयवत् || 43 ||
text_mt: he went to the great basin named Brahma[kuṇḍa] desiring to bathe. / Having bathed there and drank, he removed the murder of his mother; / making a channel with his axe, he brought it down onto the earth.

sanskrit_iast: sagara uvāca
meaning: सगर उवाच

sanskrit_iast:
jamadagneḥ suto rāmaḥ kimarthaṃ nijamātaram |
jaghāna tasya mātā ca kinnāmno kasya cātmajā || 44 ||
meaning:
जमदग्नेः सुतो रामः किमर्थं निजमातरम् |
जघान तस्य माता च किन्नाम्नो कस्य चात्मजा || 44 ||
text_mt: "Why did Rāma, the son of Jamadagni, slay his own mother? / And what was the name of his mother, and whose daughter was she?"

sanskrit_iast:
muneḥ putraḥ kathaṃ jātastathā krūro mahābalaḥ |
yo yuddhakuśalo vīro rājanyān samapothayat || 45 ||
meaning:
मुनेः पुत्रः कथं जातस्तथा क्रूरो महाबलः |
यो युद्धकुशलो वीरो राजन्यान् समपोथयत् || 45 ||
text_mt: How was a sage's son born so cruel and mighty, / who, skilled in battle, a hero, crushed the warriors?

sanskrit_iast:
tadahaṃ śrotumicchāmi tattvato munisattama |
kathayasva mahābhāga yadi guhyaṃ tathāpi me || 46 ||
meaning:
तदहं श्रोतुमिच्छामि तत्त्वतो मुनिसत्तम |
कथयस्व महाभाग यदि गुह्यं तथापि मे || 46 ||
text_mt: I desire to hear that according to reality, O best of sages; / tell it, O fortunate one, even if it is a secret to me.

sanskrit_iast: aurva uvāca
meaning: और्व उवाच

sanskrit_iast:
śṛṇu rājannavahito jamadagneḥ sutasya vai |
caritaṃ sa yathā jaghne prasūṃ krūrataraśca saḥ || 47 ||
meaning:
शृणु राजन्नवहितो जमदग्नेः सुतस्य वै |
चरितं स यथा जघ्ने प्रसूं क्रूरतरश्च सः || 47 ||
text_mt: Listen attentively, O king, to the deeds of the son of Jamadagni, / how he slew his mother and how he became exceedingly cruel.

sanskrit_iast:
brahmaputro bhṛgurnāma ṛcīkastatsuto'bhavat |
sa bhāryārthī caran bhūmau kānyakubjaṃ gataḥ purā || 48 ||
meaning:
ब्रह्मपुत्रो भृगुर्नाम ऋचीकस्तत्सुतोऽभवत् |
स भार्यार्थी चरन् भूमौ कान्यकुब्जं गतः पुरा || 48 ||
text_mt: Brahmā's son was named Bhṛgu; Ṛcīka was his son. / Wandering the earth in search of a wife, he went in former times to Kānyakubja.

sanskrit_iast:
dadarśa cāraṇyagataṃ jahnorvaṃśasamudbhavam |
kuśikasya sutaṃ gādhiṃ tapaḥsthaṃ nṛpasattama || 49 ||
meaning:
ददर्श चारण्यगतं जह्नोर्वंशसमुद्भवम् |
कुशिकस्य सुतं गाधिं तपःस्थं नृपसत्तम || 49 ||
text_mt: And he saw dwelling in the forest, born of the lineage of Jahnu, / Kuśika's son Gādhi engaged in austerities, O best of kings.

sanskrit_iast:
araṇyasthasya tasyātha putrakāmasya bhūbhṛtaḥ |
sabhāryasya sutā jajñe devakanyāsamā guṇaiḥ || 50 ||
meaning:
अरण्यस्थस्य तस्याथ पुत्रकामस्य भूभृतः |
सभार्यस्य सुता जज्ञे देवकन्यासमा गुणैः || 50 ||
text_mt: Now to that king dwelling in the forest, desiring a son / and accompanied by his wife, a daughter was born equal to a daughter of the gods in virtues.

sanskrit_iast:
ṛcīko bhṛguputrastāṃ bhāryārthaṃ samayācata |
dātūṃ yogyā sutā me'dya tadvidhāya mahāmune || 51 ||
meaning:
ऋचीको भृगुपुत्रस्तां भार्यार्थं समयाचत |
दातूं योग्या सुता मेऽद्य तद्विधाय महामुने || 51 ||
text_mt: Ṛcīka, the son of Bhṛgu, asked for her as a wife: / 'My daughter is worthy to be given today to such a one as you, O great sage.

sanskrit_iast:
kiṃ tvekaḥ kuladharmo me vidyate śulkasaṃgrahe |
ekatra ṛṣṇavarṇānāmaśvānāṃ candravarcasām |
sahasramekaṃ yo dadyāt tasmai putrī pradīyate || 52 ||
meaning:
किं त्वेकः कुलधर्मो मे विद्यते शुल्कसंग्रहे |
एकत्र ऋष्णवर्णानामश्वानां चन्द्रवर्चसाम् |
सहस्रमेकं यो दद्यात् तस्मै पुत्री प्रदीयते || 52 ||
text_mt: Yet there is one custom of my family regarding the acceptance of a bride-price: / whoever gives one thousand horses, moon-bright, / with one black ear, to him the daughter is given.'

sanskrit_iast: ṛcīka uvāca
meaning: ऋचीक उवाच

sanskrit_iast:
dāsyāmyaśvasahasraṃ vai tava rājaṃstathāvidham |
kiṃcit kālaṃ pratīkṣasva yāvat tadahamānaye || 53 ||
meaning:
दास्याम्यश्वसहस्रं वै तव राजंस्तथाविधम् |
किंचित् कालं प्रतीक्षस्व यावत् तदहमानये || 53 ||
text_mt: 'I will give a thousand horses of that kind to you, O king. / Wait for a little while until I bring them.'

sanskrit_iast:
evamastviti ta gādhiruvāca bhṛgusūnave |
gaṅgātīraṃ kānyakubjaṃ so'gacchaddhayasādhane || 54 ||
meaning:
एवमस्त्विति त गाधिरुवाच भृगुसूनवे |
गङ्गातीरं कान्यकुब्जं सोऽगच्छद्धयसाधने || 54 ||
text_mt: 'So be it,' Gādhi said to the son of Bhṛgu. / To procure the horses, he went to Kānyakubja on the bank of the Gaṅgā.

sanskrit_iast:
tatrārādhya bhṛgoḥ putro varuṇaṃ yādasāṃ patim |
tena dattaṃ tadā lebhe sahasraṃ vājināṃ muniḥ || 55 ||
meaning:
तत्राराध्य भृगोः पुत्रो वरुणं यादसां पतिम् |
तेन दत्तं तदा लेभे सहस्रं वाजिनां मुनिः || 55 ||
text_mt: Having worshipped Varuṇa there, the lord of aquatic creatures, the son of Bhṛgu, / the sage, received a thousand horses given by him then.

sanskrit_iast:
tena yatra tadā labdhā aśvān nṛpatisattama |
tadaśvatīrthaṃ vikhyātaṃ mahāphalakaraṃ param || 56 ||
meaning:
तेन यत्र तदा लब्धा अश्वान् नृपतिसत्तम |
तदश्वतीर्थं विख्यातं महाफलकरं परम् || 56 ||
text_mt: Where the horses were then obtained by him, O best of kings, / that place is renowned as Aśvatīrtha, granting the highest, great reward.

sanskrit_iast:
gaṅgājalādutthitaṃ tu dattaṃ samyak pracetasā |
ādāyāśvasahasraṃ tu munirgādhimathāmyayāt || 57 ||
meaning:
गङ्गाजलादुत्थितं तु दत्तं सम्यक् प्रचेतसा |
आदायाश्वसहस्रं तु मुनिर्गाधिमथाम्ययात् || 57 ||
text_mt: Having taken the thousand horses that arose from the water of the Gaṅgā, / duly given by Pracetas, the sage then went to Gādhi.

sanskrit_iast:
tānaśvān gādhirādāya putrīṃ satyavatīṃ sutām |
ṛcīkāya dadau lakṣmīṃ keśavāyeva sāgaraḥ || 58 ||
meaning:
तानश्वान् गाधिरादाय पुत्रीं सत्यवतीं सुताम् |
ऋचीकाय ददौ लक्ष्मीं केशवायेव सागरः || 58 ||
text_mt: Taking those horses, Gādhi gave his daughter, the girl Satyavatī, / to Ṛcīka, as the ocean gave Lakṣmī to Keśava.

sanskrit_iast:
ṛcīko gādhitanayāṃ labdhvā bhāryāmaninditām |
muditaḥ sa tayā reme yathākāmaṃ svakāśrame || 59 ||
meaning:
ऋचीको गाधितनयां लब्ध्वा भार्यामनिन्दिताम् |
मुदितः स तया रेमे यथाकामं स्वकाश्रमे || 59 ||
text_mt: Having obtained Gādhi's blameless daughter as a wife, / Ṛcīka, delighted, took pleasure with her at will in his hermitage.

sanskrit_iast:
kṛtadāraṃ sutaṃ śrutvā draṣṭuṃ putraṃ snuṣāṃ bhṛguḥ |
athājagāma matimān snuṣāṃ dṛṣṭvā nananda ca || 60 ||
meaning:
कृतदारं सुतं श्रुत्वा द्रष्टुं पुत्रं स्नुषां भृगुः |
अथाजगाम मतिमान् स्नुषां दृष्ट्वा ननन्द च || 60 ||
text_mt: Hearing that his son had taken a wife, the wise Bhṛgu came / to see his son and daughter-in-law, and seeing his daughter-in-law, he rejoiced.

sanskrit_iast:
dampatī taṃ samāsīnaṃ bhṛguṃ devagaṇārcitam |
pūjayitvā yathānyāyaṃ tasthatustau kṛtāñjalī || 61 ||
meaning:
दम्पती तं समासीनं भृगुं देवगणार्चितम् |
पूजयित्वा यथान्यायं तस्थतुस्तौ कृताञ्जली || 61 ||
text_mt: Having properly worshipped Bhṛgu who was seated there, / revered by the hosts of gods, the couple stood with folded hands.

sanskrit_iast:
tato bhṛguḥ snuṣāṃ svīyāṃ suprīta idamabravīt |
varaṃ vṛṇīṣva dāsyāmi vāñchitaṃ varavarṇini || 62 ||
meaning:
ततो भृगुः स्नुषां स्वीयां सुप्रीत इदमब्रवीत् |
वरं वृणीष्व दास्यामि वाञ्छितं वरवर्णिनि || 62 ||
text_mt: Then Bhṛgu, well pleased, said this to his daughter-in-law: / 'Choose a boon, O fair-complexioned one; I will grant your wish,

sanskrit_iast:
adeyaṃ duṣkaraṃ vāpi yatra te vidyate spṛhā |
tataḥ satyavatīṃ putraṃ tapa āmnāya-pāragam || 63 ||
meaning:
अदेयं दुष्करं वापि यत्र ते विद्यते स्पृहा |
ततः सत्यवतीं पुत्रं तप आम्नाय-पारगम् || 63 ||
text_mt: even if not to be given or difficult to accomplish, wherever your longing lies.' / Then Satyavatī [asked for] a son who had mastered austerities and the Vedas,

sanskrit_iast:
mātuśca vīramatulaṃ putraṃ varamayācata |
sa caivamastvityuktvaiva bhūtvā dhyānaparastadā || 64 ||
meaning:
मातुश्च वीरमतुलं पुत्रं वरमयाचत |
स चैवमस्त्वित्युक्त्वैव भूत्वा ध्यानपरस्तदा || 64 ||
text_mt: and for her mother, she asked the boon of an peerless heroic son. / Having said, 'So be it,' he then became absorbed in meditation.

sanskrit_iast:
viśvamādhṛtya manasā yatnācchvāsaṃ sasarja saḥ |
tasya niḥśvāsavātāt tu niḥsṛtaṃ vai carudvayam || 65 ||
meaning:
विश्वमाधृत्य मनसा यत्नाच्छ्वासं ससर्ज सः |
तस्य निःश्वासवातात् तु निःसृतं वै चरुद्वयम् || 65 ||
text_mt: Having grasped the universe with his mind, he drew breath with effort; / from the wind of his exhalation indeed two portions of caru emerged.

sanskrit_iast:
tasyai taddvitayaṃ dattvā bhṛgustāmidamabravīt |
carudvayaṃ gṛhāṇedaṃ snuṣe satyavati svayam || 66 ||
meaning:
तस्यै तद्द्वितयं दत्त्वा भृगुस्तामिदमब्रवीत् |
चरुद्वयं गृहाणेदं स्नुषे सत्यवति स्वयम् || 66 ||
text_mt: Giving that pair to her, Bhṛgu said this to her: / 'Take this pair of caru yourself, O daughter-in-law Satyavatī.

sanskrit_iast:
snātvā ṛtau ṛtau mātā snuṣe tvaṃ ca kariṣyathaḥ |
āliṃgyāśvatthavṛkṣaṃ te mātā puṃsavanāya vai || 67 ||
meaning:
स्नात्वा ऋतौ ऋतौ माता स्नुषे त्वं च करिष्यथः |
आलिंग्याश्वत्थवृक्षं ते माता पुंसवनाय वै || 67 ||
text_mt: Having bathed in your fertile seasons, your mother and you, O daughter-in-law, will act: / having embraced an aśvattha tree, for the sake of conceiving a male,

sanskrit_iast:
carumāraktakaṃ cemaṃ sā bhokṣyati sutastataḥ |
tvaṃ codumbaravṛkṣaṃ tu samāliṃgyāsitaṃ carum || 68 ||
meaning:
चरुमारक्तकं चेमं सा भोक्ष्यति सुतस्ततः |
त्वं चोदुम्बरवृक्षं तु समालिंग्यासितं चरुम् || 68 ||
text_mt: your mother shall eat this reddish caru; from that a son [will be born]. / And you, having embraced an udumbara tree, the dark caru

sanskrit_iast:
bhokṣyase tava putrastu bhaviṣyati sanātanaḥ |
evamuktvā bhṛguryāto yathecchaṃ sāpi saṃmudam || 69 ||
meaning:
भोक्ष्यसे तव पुत्रस्तु भविष्यति सनातनः |
एवमुक्त्वा भृगुर्यातो यथेच्छं सापि संमुदम् || 69 ||
text_mt: shall eat; your son will be eternal.' / Having spoken thus, Bhṛgu departed as he wished, and she experienced joy

sanskrit_iast:
avāpa mātrā sahitā bhartrā pitrā ca bhāminī |
atha snānadine'śvatthamāliṃgyāraktakaṃ carum || 70 ||
meaning:
अवाप मात्रा सहिता भर्त्रा पित्रा च भामिनी |
अथ स्नानदिनेऽश्वत्थमालिंग्यारक्तकं चरुम् || 70 ||
text_mt: together with her mother, husband, and father, the beautiful woman. / Then, on the day of bathing, having embraced the aśvattha, the reddish caru

sanskrit_iast:
ādāt satyavatī tasyā mātā phalguṃ sitaṃ carum |
parivartaṃ tu taj jñātvā divyajñāno bhṛgurmuniḥ || 71 ||
meaning:
आदात् सत्यवती तस्या माता फल्गुं सितं चरुम् |
परिवर्तं तु तज् ज्ञात्वा दिव्यज्ञानो भृगुर्मुनिः || 71 ||
text_mt: Satyavatī ate; her mother [ate] the light, white caru. / Knowing that reversal, the sage Bhṛgu, possessed of divine knowledge,

sanskrit_iast:
athāgatya snuṣāṃ tāṃ tu vacanaṃ cedamabravīt |
viparyayastvayā bhadre vṛkṣāliṅganakarmaṇi || 72 ||
meaning:
अथागत्य स्नुषां तां तु वचनं चेदमब्रवीत् |
विपर्ययस्त्वया भद्रे वृक्षालिङ्गनकर्मणि || 72 ||
text_mt: then came and spoke this word to that daughter-in-law: / 'A reversal was made by you, O auspicious one, in the act of embracing the trees

sanskrit_iast:
tathā aruprāśane tu atredaṃ te bhaviṣyati |
brāhmaṇaḥ kṣatriyācārastava putro bhaviṣyati || 73 ||
meaning:
तथा अरुप्राशने तु अत्रेदं ते भविष्यति |
ब्राह्मणः क्षत्रियाचारस्तव पुत्रो भविष्यति || 73 ||
text_mt: as well as in eating the caru; herein this shall happen to you: / your son will be a brāhmaṇa with the conduct of a kṣatriya;

sanskrit_iast:
kṣatriyo brāhmaṇācāro mātuste bhavitā sutaḥ |
ityuktvā bhṛguṇā sādhvī tadā satyavatī bhṛgum || 74 ||
meaning:
क्षत्रियो ब्राह्मणाचारो मातुस्ते भविता सुतः |
इत्युक्त्वा भृगुणा साध्वी तदा सत्यवती भृगुम् || 74 ||
text_mt: your mother's son will be a kṣatriya with the conduct of a brāhmaṇa.' / Being told this by Bhṛgu, the virtuous Satyavatī then

sanskrit_iast:
punaḥ prasādayāmāsa pautro me'stviti tādṛśaḥ |
evamastviti sa procya tatraivāntardadhe bhṛguḥ || 75 ||
meaning:
पुनः प्रसादयामास पौत्रो मेऽस्त्विति तादृशः |
एवमस्त्विति स प्रोच्य तत्रैवान्तर्दधे भृगुः || 75 ||
text_mt: propitiated Bhṛgu again, [saying,] 'Let my grandson be like that.' / Saying, 'So be it,' Bhṛgu vanished right there.

sanskrit_iast:
atha kāle sutaṃ dīptaṃ jamadagniṃ ca gādhijā |
suṣuve jananī tasyā viśvāmitraṃ taponidhim || 76 ||
meaning:
अथ काले सुतं दीप्तं जमदग्निं च गाधिजा |
सुषुवे जननी तस्या विश्वामित्रं तपोनिधिम् || 76 ||
text_mt: Then in time, Gādhi's daughter gave birth to a radiant son, Jamadagni; / and her mother gave birth to Viśvāmitra, a treasury of austerities.

sanskrit_iast:
jamadagnistato vedāṃścaturaḥ prāpa mā ciram |
prādurāsīd dhanurvedaḥ svayaṃ tasmin mahātmani || 77 ||
meaning:
जमदग्निस्ततो वेदांश्चतुरः प्राप मा चिरम् |
प्रादुरासीद् धनुर्वेदः स्वयं तस्मिन् महात्मनि || 77 ||
text_mt: Then Jamadagni acquired the four Vedas without delay; / the science of archery manifested of its own accord in that great-souled one.

sanskrit_iast:
viśvāmitro'pi sakalān vedānāp tathā'cirāt |
dhanurvedaṃ tathā kṛtsnaṃ vipraścābhūt tapobalāt || 78 ||
meaning:
विश्वामित्रोऽपि सकलान् वेदानाप् तथाऽचिरात् |
धनुर्वेदं तथा कृत्स्नं विप्रश्चाभूत् तपोबलात् || 78 ||
text_mt: Viśvāmitra also quickly attained all the Vedas / as well as the entire science of archery, and became a brāhmaṇa by the power of his austerities.

sanskrit_iast:
jājvalyamānastejasvī jamadagnrmahātapāḥ |
vedaistapobhiḥ sa muninatyakrāmacca sūryavat || 79 ||
meaning:
जाज्वल्यमानस्तेजस्वी जमदग्न्र्महातपाः |
वेदैस्तपोभिः स मुनिनत्यक्रामच्च सूर्यवत् || 79 ||
text_mt: Blazing and full of splendor, Jamadagni of great austerities, / surpassed the sages by his Vedas and austerities, like the sun.

sanskrit_iast: iti śrīkālikāpurāṇe vyaśītitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 82 ||
meaning: इति श्रीकालिकापुराणे व्यशीतितमोऽध्यायः || 82 ||
text_mt: Thus ends the eighty-second chapter in the glorious Kālikāpurāṇa.

sanskrit_iast: tryaśītitamo'dhyāyaḥ |
meaning: त्र्यशीतितमोऽध्यायः |

sanskrit_iast: aurva uvāca
meaning: और्व उवाच

sanskrit_iast:
atha kāle vyatīte tu jamadagnirmahātapāḥ |
vidarbharājasya sutāṃ prayatnena jitāṃ svayam || 1 ||
meaning:
अथ काले व्यतीते तु जमदग्निर्महातपाः |
विदर्भराजस्य सुतां प्रयत्नेन जितां स्वयम् || 1 ||
text_mt: Now after time had passed, Jamadagni of great austerities / took as his wife the daughter of the king of Vidarbha, won by him through effort,

sanskrit_iast:
bhāryārthaṃ pratijagrāha reṇukāṃ lakṣaṇānvitām |
sā tasmāt suṣuve ṣatrāṃścaturo vedasammitān || 2 ||
meaning:
भार्यार्थं प्रतिजग्राह रेणुकां लक्षणान्विताम् |
सा तस्मात् सुषुवे षत्रांश्चतुरो वेदसम्मितान् || 2 ||
text_mt: Reṇukā, endowed with auspicious marks. / From him she gave birth to four sons equal to the Vedas:

sanskrit_iast:
ruṣaṇvantaṃ suṣeṇaṃ ca vasuṃ viśvāvasuṃ tathā |
paścāt tasyāṃ svayaṃ jajñe bhagavān madhusūdanaḥ || 3 ||
meaning:
रुषण्वन्तं सुषेणं च वसुं विश्वावसुं तथा |
पश्चात् तस्यां स्वयं जज्ञे भगवान् मधुसूदनः || 3 ||
text_mt: Ruṣaṇvant, Suṣeṇa, Vasu, and Viśvāvasu. / Later, the blessed Madhusūdana was born from her of his own accord.

sanskrit_iast:
kārtavīryavadhāyāśu śakrādyaiḥ sakalaiḥ suraiḥ |
yācitaḥ paṃcamaḥ so'bhūt teṣāṃ rāmāhvayastu saḥ || 4 ||
meaning:
कार्तवीर्यवधायाशु शक्राद्यैः सकलैः सुरैः |
याचितः पंचमः सोऽभूत् तेषां रामाह्वयस्तु सः || 4 ||
text_mt: Requested by Śakra and all the gods to quickly slay Kārtavīrya, / he became the fifth of them, named Rāma.

sanskrit_iast:
bhārāvataraṇārthāya jātaḥ paraśunā saha |
sahajaṃ paraśuṃ tasya na jahāti kadācana || 5 ||
meaning:
भारावतरणार्थाय जातः परशुना सह |
सहजं परशुं तस्य न जहाति कदाचन || 5 ||
text_mt: Born together with an axe to relieve the burden [of the earth], / his innate axe never left him.

sanskrit_iast:
ayaṃ nijapitāmahyāścarubhuktiviparyayāt |
brāhmaṇaḥ kṣatriyācāro rāmo'bhūta krūrakarmakṛt || 6 ||
meaning:
अयं निजपितामह्याश्चरुभुक्तिविपर्ययात् |
ब्राह्मणः क्षत्रियाचारो रामोऽभूत क्रूरकर्मकृत् || 6 ||
text_mt: Due to the reversal of eating the caru by his own grandmother, / Rāma became a brāhmaṇa of kṣatriya conduct, performing cruel deeds.

sanskrit_iast:
sa vedānakhilān jñātvā dhanurvedaṃ ca sarvaśaḥ |
satataṃ kṛtakṛtyo'bhūd vedavidyāviśāradaḥ || 7 ||
meaning:
स वेदानखिलान् ज्ञात्वा धनुर्वेदं च सर्वशः |
सततं कृतकृत्योऽभूद् वेदविद्याविशारदः || 7 ||
text_mt: Knowing all the Vedas and the science of archery in every way, / he was ever accomplished in his duties, an expert in the knowledge of the Vedas.

sanskrit_iast:
ekadā tasya jananī snānārthaṃ reṇukā gatā |
gaṅgātoye hyathāpaśyannāmnā citrarathaṃ nṛpam || 8 ||
meaning:
एकदा तस्य जननी स्नानार्थं रेणुका गता |
गङ्गातोये ह्यथापश्यन्नाम्ना चित्ररथं नृपम् || 8 ||
text_mt: Once his mother Reṇukā went to bathe / in the waters of the Gaṅgā, and there she saw a king named Citraratha.

sanskrit_iast:
bhāryābhiḥ sadṛśībhiśca talakrīḍārataṃ śubham |
sumālinaṃ suvastraṃ taṃ taruṇaṃ andramālinam || 9 ||
meaning:
भार्याभिः सदृशीभिश्च तलक्रीडारतं शुभम् |
सुमालिनं सुवस्त्रं तं तरुणं अन्द्रमालिनम् || 9 ||
text_mt:
sporting in the water with his well-matched wives, auspicious,
wearing fine garlands and fine garments, that youth adorned with moon-garlands.

sanskrit_iast:
tathāvidhaṃ nṛpaṃ dṛṣṭvā sañjātamadanā bhṛśam |
reṇukā spṛhayāmāsa tasmai rājñe suvarcase || 10 ||
meaning:
तथाविधं नृपं दृष्ट्वा सञ्जातमदना भृशम् |
रेणुका स्पृहयामास तस्मै राज्ञे सुवर्चसे || 10 ||
text_mt:
Seeing the king in such a state, love arose intensely [in her];
Reṇukā desired that king of splendid luster.

sanskrit_iast:
spṛhāyutāyāstasyāstu saṃkledaḥ samajāyata |
vicetanāmbhasā klinnā trastā sā svāśramaṃ yayau || 11 ||
meaning:
स्पृहायुतायास्तस्यास्तु संक्लेदः समजायत |
विचेतनाम्भसा क्लिन्ना त्रस्ता सा स्वाश्रमं ययौ || 11 ||
text_mt:
Filled with desire, moisture arose in her;
she, dampened by the water [and] distracted, terrified, returned to her hermitage.

sanskrit_iast:
abodhi jamadagnistāṃ reṇukāṃ vikṛtāṃ tathā |
dhig dhikkāraratetyevaṃ nininda ca samantataḥ || 12 ||
meaning:
अबोधि जमदग्निस्तां रेणुकां विकृतां तथा |
धिग् धिक्काररतेत्येवं निनिन्द च समन्ततः || 12 ||
text_mt:
Jamadagni perceived her, Reṇukā, thus altered;
saying, “Fie, devoted to what is shameful!” he condemned her severely on all sides.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ sa tanayān prāha caturaḥ prathamaṃ muniḥ |
uṣaṇvatpramukhān sarvānekaikaṃ kramato drutam || 13 ||
meaning:
ततः स तनयान् प्राह चतुरः प्रथमं मुनिः |
उषण्वत्प्रमुखान् सर्वानेकैकं क्रमतो द्रुतम् || 13 ||
text_mt:
Then the sage spoke first to his four sons,
all of them, headed by Uṣaṇvat, one by one in succession, quickly:

sanskrit_iast:
chindhīmāṃ pāpaniratāṃ reṇukāṃ vyabhicāriṇīm |
te tadvaco naiva cakrurmūkāścāsan jaḍā iva || 14 ||
meaning:
छिन्धीमां पापनिरतां रेणुकां व्यभिचारिणीम् |
ते तद्वचो नैव चक्रुर्मूकाश्चासन् जडा इव || 14 ||
text_mt:
“Cut down this unfaithful Reṇukā who is devoted to sin!”
They did not obey his word at all and became dumb, like idiots.

sanskrit_iast:
kupito jamadagnistāñchaśāpeti vicetasaḥ |
(gādhiṃ nṛpatiśārdūlaṃ sa covāca nṛpo munim) || 15 ||
meaning:
कुपितो जमदग्निस्ताञ्छशापेति विचेतसः |
(गाधिं नृपतिशार्दूलं स चोवाच नृपो मुनिम्) || 15 ||
text_mt:
Angered, Jamadagni cursed those senseless ones;
(and that king spoke to the sage, Gādhi, tiger among kings:)

sanskrit_iast:
bhavadhvaṃ ūyamācirājjaḍā gobuddhigardhitāḥ |
athājagāma caramo jāmadagnye'tivīryavān || 16 ||
meaning:
भवध्वं ऊयमाचिराज्जडा गोबुद्धिगर्धिताः |
अथाजगाम चरमो जामदग्न्येऽतिवीर्यवान् || 16 ||
text_mt:
“May you quickly become dull-witted and overcome with bovine intelligence!”
Then arrived the youngest of Jamadagni's sons, exceedingly valorous.

sanskrit_iast:
taṃ ca rāmaṃ pitā prāha pāpiṣṭhāṃ chindhi mātaram |
sa bhrātṛṃśca tathābhūtān dṛṣṭvā jñānavivarjitān || 17 ||
meaning:
तं च रामं पिता प्राह पापिष्ठां छिन्धि मातरम् |
स भ्रातृंश्च तथाभूतान् दृष्ट्वा ज्ञानविवर्जितान् || 17 ||
text_mt:
And his father said to that Rāma: “Cut down your most sinful mother!”
He, seeing his brothers in such a condition, bereft of knowledge,

sanskrit_iast:
pitrā śaptān mahātejāḥ prasūṃ paraśunācchinat |
rāmeṇa reṇukāṃ chinnāṃ dṛṣṭvā vikrodhano'bhavat || 18 ||
meaning:
पित्रा शप्तान् महातेजाः प्रसूं परशुनाच्छिनत् |
रामेण रेणुकां छिन्नां दृष्ट्वा विक्रोधनोऽभवत् || 18 ||
text_mt:
and cursed by his father, the one of great luster cut down his mother with an axe.
Seeing Reṇukā cut down by Rāma, he became free of anger.

sanskrit_iast:
jamadagniḥ prasannaḥ sanniti vācamuvāca ha |
prīto'smi putra bhadra te yat tvayā madvacaḥ kṛtam || 19 ||
meaning:
जमदग्निः प्रसन्नः सन्निति वाचमुवाच ह |
प्रीतोऽस्मि पुत्र भद्र ते यत् त्वया मद्वचः कृतम् || 19 ||
text_mt:
Jamadagni, becoming pleased, indeed spoke these words:
“I am pleased, my son! Good fortune to you, since you have done my bidding.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmādiṣṭān varān kāmāṃstvaṃ vai varaya sāmpratam |
sa tu rāmo varān vavre māturutthānamāditaḥ || 20 ||
meaning:
तस्मादिष्टान् वरान् कामांस्त्वं वै वरय साम्प्रतम् |
स तु रामो वरान् वव्रे मातुरुत्थानमादितः || 20 ||
text_mt:
Therefore choose now the desired boons and wishes.”
Then that Rāma chose boons, beginning with the resurrection of his mother,

sanskrit_iast:
vadhasyāsmaraṇaṃ tasyā bhrātṛṇāṃ śāpamocanam |
mātṛhatyāvyapanayaṃ yuddhe sarvatra vai jayam || 21 ||
meaning:
वधस्यास्मरणं तस्या भ्रातृणां शापमोचनम् |
मातृहत्याव्यपनयं युद्धे सर्वत्र वै जयम् || 21 ||
text_mt:
her lack of recollection of her slaying, the release of his brothers from the curse,
the removal of the sin of matricide, and victory everywhere in battle,

sanskrit_iast:
āyuḥ kalpāntaparyantaṃ kramād vai nṛpasattama |
sarvān varān sa pradadau jamadagnirmahātapāḥ || 22 ||
meaning:
आयुः कल्पान्तपर्यन्तं क्रमाद् वै नृपसत्तम |
सर्वान् वरान् स प्रददौ जमदग्निर्महातपाः || 22 ||
text_mt:
and life until the end of the kalpa, in succession, O best of kings.
Jamadagni of great austerities granted all the boons.

sanskrit_iast:
suptotyiteba jananī reṇukā ca tadābhavat |
vadhaṃ na cāpi sasmāra sahajā prakṛtisthitā || 23 ||
meaning:
सुप्तोत्यितेब जननी रेणुका च तदाभवत् |
वधं न चापि सस्मार सहजा प्रकृतिस्थिता || 23 ||
text_mt:
And his mother Reṇukā then became as if risen from sleep;
nor did she remember the slaying, remaining in her natural state.

sanskrit_iast:
yuddhe jayaṃ cirāyuṣyaṃ lebhe rāmastadaiva hi |
mātṛhatyāvyapohāya pitā taṃ vākyamavravīt || 24 ||
meaning:
युद्धे जयं चिरायुष्यं लेभे रामस्तदैव हि |
मातृहत्याव्यपोहाय पिता तं वाक्यमव्रवीत् || 24 ||
text_mt:
Then indeed Rāma obtained victory in battle and long life.
To remove the sin of matricide, his father addressed these words to him:

sanskrit_iast:
na putra varadānena mātṛhatyāpagacchati |
tasmāt tvaṃ brahmakuṇḍāya gaccha snātuṃ ca tajjale || 25 ||
meaning:
न पुत्र वरदानेन मातृहत्यापगच्छति |
तस्मात् त्वं ब्रह्मकुण्डाय गच्छ स्नातुं च तज्जले || 25 ||
text_mt:
“Not by the giving of a boon, my son, does the sin of matricide depart.
Therefore, go to the Brahmakuṇḍa and bathe in its waters.

sanskrit_iast:
tatra snātvā muktapāpo nacirāt punareṣyasi |
jagaddhitāya putra tvaṃ brahmakuṇḍaṃ vraja drutam || 26 ||
meaning:
तत्र स्नात्वा मुक्तपापो नचिरात् पुनरेष्यसि |
जगद्धिताय पुत्र त्वं ब्रह्मकुण्डं व्रज द्रुतम् || 26 ||
text_mt:
Having bathed there, freed from sin, you will return before long.
For the welfare of the world, my son, go quickly to the Brahmakuṇḍa.”

sanskrit_iast:
sa tasya vacana śrutvā rāmaḥ paraśudhṛk tadā |
upadeśāt piturghāto brahmakuṇḍaṃ vṛṣodakam || 27 ||
meaning:
स तस्य वचन श्रुत्वा रामः परशुधृक् तदा |
उपदेशात् पितुर्घातो ब्रह्मकुण्डं वृषोदकम् || 27 ||
text_mt:
Having heard his word, Rāma the axe-bearer then,
following his father's instruction, the slayer went to the Brahmakuṇḍa of auspicious waters.

sanskrit_iast:
tatra snānaṃ ca vidhivat kṛtvā dhautaparaśvadhaḥ |
śarīrānniḥsṛtāṃ mātṛhatyāṃ samyag vyalokayat || 28 ||
meaning:
तत्र स्नानं च विधिवत् कृत्वा धौतपरश्वधः |
शरीरान्निःसृतां मातृहत्यां सम्यग् व्यलोकयत् || 28 ||
text_mt:
Having performed his bath there according to the rules and washed his axe,
he clearly saw the sin of matricide depart from his body.

sanskrit_iast:
jātasaṃpratyayaḥ so'tha tīrthamāsādya tadvaram |
vīthīṃ paraśunā kṛtvā brahmaputramavāhayat || 29 ||
meaning:
जातसंप्रत्ययः सोऽथ तीर्थमासाद्य तद्वरम् |
वीथीं परशुना कृत्वा ब्रह्मपुत्रमवाहयत् || 29 ||
text_mt:
Gaining firm faith, he then reached that excellent sacred place;
having made a path with his axe, he caused the son of Brahmā to flow.

sanskrit_iast:
brahmakuṇḍāt sṛtaḥ so'tha kāsāre lohitāhvaye |
kailāsopatyakāyāṃ tu nyapatad brahmaṇaḥ sutaḥ || 30 ||
meaning:
ब्रह्मकुण्डात् सृतः सोऽथ कासारे लोहिताह्वये |
कैलासोपत्यकायां तु न्यपतद् ब्रह्मणः सुतः || 30 ||
text_mt:
Flowing forth from the Brahmakuṇḍa into the lake named Lohita,
the son of Brahmā fell on the slopes of Kailāsa.

sanskrit_iast:
tasyāpi sarasastīre samutthāya mahābalaḥ |
kuṭhāreṇa diśaṃ pūrvāmanayad brahmaṇaḥ sutam || 31 ||
meaning:
तस्यापि सरसस्तीरे समुत्थाय महाबलः |
कुठारेण दिशं पूर्वामनयद् ब्रह्मणः सुतम् || 31 ||
text_mt:
Rising also on the bank of that lake, the mighty one
led the son of Brahmā toward the eastern direction with his axe.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ paratrāpi giriṃ hemaśṛṅgaṃ vibhidya ca |
kāmarūpāntaraṃ pīṭhamāvahadyadamuṃ hariḥ || 32 ||
meaning:
ततः परत्रापि गिरिं हेमशृङ्गं विभिद्य च |
कामरूपान्तरं पीठमावहद्यदमुं हरिः || 32 ||
text_mt:
Then, having split Mount Hemaśṛṅga beyond that,
he brought it into the pīṭha of Kāmarūpa, because Hari [dwells there].

sanskrit_iast:
tasya nāma svayaṃ cakre vidhirlohitagaṅgakam |
lohitāt saraso jāto lohitākhyastato'bhavat || 33 ||
meaning:
तस्य नाम स्वयं चक्रे विधिर्लोहितगङ्गकम् |
लोहितात् सरसो जातो लोहिताख्यस्ततोऽभवत् || 33 ||
text_mt:
Vidhi himself gave it the name Lohitagaṅgaka;
born from the lake Lohita, it thence became known as Lohita.

sanskrit_iast:
sa kāmarūpamakhilaṃ pīṭhamāplāvya vāriṇā |
gopayan sarvatīrthāni dakṣiṇaṃ yāti sāgaram || 34 ||
meaning:
स कामरूपमखिलं पीठमाप्लाव्य वारिणा |
गोपयन् सर्वतीर्थानि दक्षिणं याति सागरम् || 34 ||
text_mt:
Flooding the entire pīṭha of Kāmarūpa with its water,
concealing all the sacred places, it goes to the southern ocean.

sanskrit_iast:
prāgeva divyayamunāṃ sa tyaktvā brahmaṇaḥ sutaḥ |
punaḥ patati lauhitye gatvā dvādaśayojanam || 35 ||
meaning:
प्रागेव दिव्ययमुनां स त्यक्त्वा ब्रह्मणः सुतः |
पुनः पतति लौहित्ये गत्वा द्वादशयोजनम् || 35 ||
text_mt:
Having already left the divine Yamunā, that son of Brahmā,
having gone twelve yojanas, falls again into the Lauhitya.

sanskrit_iast:
caitre māsi sitāṣṭamyāṃ yo naro niyatendriyaḥ |
caitraṃ tu sakalaṃ māsaṃ śuciḥ prayatamānasaḥ || 36 ||
meaning:
चैत्रे मासि सिताष्टम्यां यो नरो नियतेन्द्रियः |
चैत्रं तु सकलं मासं शुचिः प्रयतमानसः || 36 ||
text_mt:
In the month of Caitra, on the eighth day of the bright fortnight, a man with restrained senses,
who is pure and disciplined in mind for the whole month of Caitra,

sanskrit_iast:
snāti lauhityatoye tu sa yāti brahmaṇaḥ padam |
lauhityatoye yaḥ snāti sa kaivalyamavāpnuyāt || 37 ||
meaning:
स्नाति लौहित्यतोये तु स याति ब्रह्मणः पदम् |
लौहित्यतोये यः स्नाति स कैवल्यमवाप्नुयात् || 37 ||
text_mt:
and bathes in the water of the Lauhitya, goes to the abode of Brahmā.
Whoever bathes in the water of the Lauhitya will attain kaivalya.

sanskrit_iast:
iti te kathitaṃ rājan yadarthaṃ mātaraṃ purā |
ahan vīro jāmadagnyo yasmād vā krūrakarmakṛt || 38 ||
meaning:
इति ते कथितं राजन् यदर्थं मातरं पुरा |
अहन् वीरो जामदग्न्यो यस्माद् वा क्रूरकर्मकृत् || 38 ||
text_mt:
Thus it has been related to you, O king, why formerly
the heroic son of Jamadagni struck his mother, and why he performed that cruel deed.

sanskrit_iast:
idaṃ tu mahadākhyānaṃ yaḥ śṛṇoti dine dine |
sa dīrghāyuḥ pramudito balavānabhijāyate || 39 ||
meaning:
इदं तु महदाख्यानं यः शृणोति दिने दिने |
स दीर्घायुः प्रमुदितो बलवानभिजायते || 39 ||
text_mt:
He who listens to this great narrative day by day
is born long-lived, joyful, and strong.

sanskrit_iast:
iti te kathitaṃ rājañcharīrārdhaṃ yathādrijā |
śambhorjahāra vetālabhairavau ca yathāhvayau || 40 ||
meaning:
इति ते कथितं राजञ्छरीरार्धं यथाद्रिजा |
शम्भोर्जहार वेतालभैरवौ च यथाह्वयौ || 40 ||
text_mt:
Thus it has been related to you, O king, how the daughter of the mountain
took half the body of Śambhu, and how they were named Vetāla and Bhairava,

sanskrit_iast:
yasya vā tanayau jātau yathā yātau gaṇeśatām |
kimanyat kathaye tubhyaṃ tadvadasva nṛpottama || 41 ||
meaning:
यस्य वा तनयौ जातौ यथा यातौ गणेशताम् |
किमन्यत् कथये तुभ्यं तद्वदस्व नृपोत्तम || 41 ||
text_mt:
or whose sons they were born to be, and how they attained the state of Gaṇeśas.
What else shall I tell you? Speak that, O best of kings!”

sanskrit_iast: mārkaṇḍeya uvāca
meaning: मार्कण्डेय उवाच

sanskrit_iast:
ityaurvasya ca saṃvādaḥ sagareṇa mahātmanā |
yo'sau kāyārdhaharaṇaṃ śambhorgirijayā kṛtaḥ || 42 ||
meaning:
इत्यौर्वस्य च संवादः सगरेण महात्मना |
योऽसौ कायार्धहरणं शम्भोर्गिरिजया कृतः || 42 ||
text_mt:
“Thus was the conversation of Aurva with the great-souled Sagara,
concerning how that taking of half the body of Śambhu was done by the daughter of the mountain.

sanskrit_iast:
sarvo'dya kathito viprāḥ pṛṣṭaṃ yaccānyaduttamam |
siddhasya bhairavākhyasya pīṭhānāṃ ca vinirṇayam || 43 ||
meaning:
सर्वोऽद्य कथितो विप्राः पृष्टं यच्चान्यदुत्तमम् |
सिद्धस्य भैरवाख्यस्य पीठानां च विनिर्णयम् || 43 ||
text_mt:
All has been told today, O Brahmins, and what else of the highest import was asked:
the determination of the perfected one named Bhairava and of the pīṭhas,

sanskrit_iast:
bhṛṅgiṇaśca yathotpattirmahākālasya caiva hi |
uktaṃ hi vaḥ kimanyat tu pṛcchantu dvijasattamāḥ || 44 ||
meaning:
भृङ्गिणश्च यथोत्पत्तिर्महाकालस्य चैव हि |
उक्तं हि वः किमन्यत् तु पृच्छन्तु द्विजसत्तमाः || 44 ||
text_mt:
and the origin of Bhṛṅgin and also of Mahākāla
have indeed been spoken to you. What else, then, do you ask, O best of the twice-born?

sanskrit_iast:
iti sakalasutantraṃ tantramantrāvadātaṃ
bahutaraphalakāri prājñaviśrāmakalpam |
upaniṣadamavetya jñānamārgaikatānaṃ
sravati sa iha nityaṃ yaḥ paṭhet tantrametat || 45 ||
meaning:
इति सकलसुतन्त्रं तन्त्रमन्त्रावदातं
बहुतरफलकारि प्राज्ञविश्रामकल्पम् |
उपनिषदमवेत्य ज्ञानमार्गैकतानं
स्रवति स इह नित्यं यः पठेत् तन्त्रमेतत् || 45 ||
text_mt:
Thus, whoever recites here constantly this tantra, which is an excellent tantra entirely,
pure with tantras and mantras, yielding abundant fruit, resembling a resting place for the wise,
and having understood the Upaniṣad, devoted solely to the path of knowledge, flows [to liberation].

sanskrit_iast: iti śrīkālikāpurāṇe tryaśītitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 83 ||
meaning: इति श्रीकालिकापुराणे त्र्यशीतितमोऽध्यायः || 83 ||
text_mt: Thus ends the eighty-third chapter in the glorious Kālikāpurāṇa.

sanskrit_iast: caturaśītitamo'dhyāyaḥ
meaning: चतुरशीतितमोऽध्यायः
text_mt: Eighty-fourth chapter.

sanskrit_iast: ṛṣaya ūcuḥ -
meaning: ऋषय ऊचुः -

sanskrit_iast:
kathito bhavatā sargaḥ saṃśayaścāpi śātitāḥ |
tvatprasādānmahābhāga kṛtakṛtyā vayaṃ guro || 1 ||
meaning:
कथितो भवता सर्गः संशयश्चापि शातिताः |
त्वत्प्रसादान्महाभाग कृतकृत्या वयं गुरो || 1 ||
text_mt:
“The creation has been described by you, and our doubts have been dispelled.
By your grace, O fortunate one, our purpose is accomplished, O guru!

sanskrit_iast:
bhūyaśca śrotumicchāmo vayametad dvijottama |
ko'nyo bhṛṅgī mahākāo jātau vetālabhairavau || 2 ||
meaning:
भूयश्च श्रोतुमिच्छामो वयमेतद् द्विजोत्तम |
कोऽन्यो भृङ्गी महाकाओ जातौ वेतालभैरवौ || 2 ||
text_mt:
And we wish to hear this further, O best of the twice-born:
who else was Bhṛṅgin and Mahākāla, born as Vetāla and Bhairava?

sanskrit_iast:
vetālaṃ ca mahākālaṃ bhairavaṃ bhṛṅgiṇaṃ tathā |
śṛṇumo dvijaśārdūla kathameṣāṃ catuṣṭayam || 3 ||
meaning:
वेतालं च महाकालं भैरवं भृङ्गिणं तथा |
शृणुमो द्विजशार्दूल कथमेषां चतुष्टयम् || 3 ||
text_mt:
Of Vetāla and Mahākāla, and Bhairava and Bhṛṅgin,
we would hear, O tiger among the twice-born, how there is a group of four of these.”

sanskrit_iast: mārkaṇḍeya uvāca -
meaning: मार्कण्डेय उवाच -

sanskrit_iast:
bhuvaṃ gate mahākāle mānuṣyasthe ca bhṛṅgiṇi |
vetālabhairavākhye ca tayorbhūte dvijottamāḥ || 4 ||
meaning:
भुवं गते महाकाले मानुष्यस्थे च भृङ्गिणि |
वेतालभैरवाख्ये च तयोर्भूते द्विजोत्तमाः || 4 ||
text_mt:
“When Mahākāla had gone to earth and Bhṛṅgin had assumed human form,
and they both became known as Vetāla and Bhairava, O best of the twice-born,

sanskrit_iast:
varalabdhe ca vetāle bhairave tena saṅgate |
andhakaṃ tapasā yuktaṃ bhṛṅgiṇaṃ cākaroddharaḥ || 5 ||
meaning:
वरलब्धे च वेताले भैरवे तेन सङ्गते |
अन्धकं तपसा युक्तं भृङ्गिणं चाकरोद्धरः || 5 ||
text_mt:
and when Vetāla had obtained a boon and Bhairava was united with him,
Hara made Andhaka, endowed with tapas, into Bhṛṅgin.

sanskrit_iast:
andhakastu haraṃ pūrvaṃ virudhyāpadamāgataḥ |
paścāddharaṃ samārādhya putro'bhūt tasya so'suraḥ || 6 ||
meaning:
अन्धकस्तु हरं पूर्वं विरुध्यापदमागतः |
पश्चाद्धरं समाराध्य पुत्रोऽभूत् तस्य सोऽसुरः || 6 ||
text_mt:
Andhaka, having formerly opposed Hara, met with misfortune;
later, having propitiated Hara, that asura became his son.”

sanskrit_iast:
bhṛṅgisnehād bhṛṅgiṇaṃ taṃ saṃjñayā cākaroddharaḥ |
snehena tu mahākāle bāṇaṃ balisutaṃ haraḥ |
viṣṇunā chinnabāhuṃ tu mahākālamathākarot || 7 ||
meaning:
भृङ्गिस्नेहाद् भृङ्गिणं तं संज्ञया चाकरोद्धरः |
स्नेहेन तु महाकाले बाणं बलिसुतं हरः |
विष्णुना छिन्नबाहुं तु महाकालमथाकरोत् || 7 ||
text_mt: Out of affection for Bhṛṅgin, Hara designated him by the name Bhṛṅgin. / But out of affection for Mahākāla, Hara then made Bāṇa, / the son of Bali whose arms had been severed by Viṣṇu, into Mahākāla.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ munivarasteṣāṃ saṃyataṃ ca catuṣṭayam |
vetālabhairavau bhṛṅgimahākālau hyanukramāt || 8 ||
meaning:
एवं मुनिवरस्तेषां संयतं च चतुष्टयम् |
वेतालभैरवौ भृङ्गिमहाकालौ ह्यनुक्रमात् || 8 ||
text_mt: In this way, O best of sages, the group of four was brought together by them, / namely Vetāla and Bhairava, and Bhṛṅgin and Mahākāla in order.

sanskrit_iast: ṛṣaya uvāca
meaning: ऋषय उवाच

sanskrit_iast:
yat pṛṣṭaṃ sagareṇaiva munimaurva mahādhiyam |
nītyā yojyā yayā bhāryā suta ātmā'thavā guro || 9 ||
meaning:
यत् पृष्टं सगरेणैव मुनिमौर्व महाधियम् |
नीत्या योज्या यया भार्या सुत आत्माऽथवा गुरो || 9 ||
text_mt: That which was asked by Sagara of the wise sage Aurva: / “By what policy should a wife, a son, or oneself be engaged, O preceptor?

sanskrit_iast:
rājanītau satāṃ nītau sadācāre ca ye sthitāḥ |
viśeṣāstena ye proktā aurveṇa sumahātmanā || 10 ||
meaning:
राजनीतौ सतां नीतौ सदाचारे च ये स्थिताः |
विशेषास्तेन ये प्रोक्ता और्वेण सुमहात्मना || 10 ||
text_mt: The specific rules that pertain to royal policy, the policy of the virtuous, and proper conduct, / which were spoken by that high-souled Aurva—

sanskrit_iast:
viśeṣeṇa dvijaśreṣṭha śrotuṃ samyak tapodhana |
icchāmastān mahābhāga kathayasva jagadguro || 11 ||
meaning:
विशेषेण द्विजश्रेष्ठ श्रोतुं सम्यक् तपोधन |
इच्छामस्तान् महाभाग कथयस्व जगद्गुरो || 11 ||
text_mt: we wish to hear those in detail and accurately, O best of the twice-born, O treasure of asceticism. / O fortunate one, speak them, O preceptor of the world!”

sanskrit_iast: mārkaṇḍeya uvāca
meaning: मार्कण्डेय उवाच

sanskrit_iast:
ye ye viśeṣāḥ kathitā aurveṇa sumahātmanā |
tad vaḥ sarvaṃ pravakṣyāmi śṛṇvantu munisattamāḥ || 12 ||
meaning:
ये ये विशेषाः कथिता और्वेण सुमहात्मना |
तद् वः सर्वं प्रवक्ष्यामि शृण्वन्तु मुनिसत्तमाः || 12 ||
text_mt: Whichever specific rules were declared by the high-souled Aurva, / I will tell you all of that; listen, O best of sages.

sanskrit_iast:
śrutvaivaṃ sagaro rājā mantrakalpādikaṃ punaḥ |
viśeṣaṃ paripapraccha nītyādīnāṃ mahāmunim || 13 ||
meaning:
श्रुत्वैवं सगरो राजा मन्त्रकल्पादिकं पुनः |
विशेषं परिपप्रच्छ नीत्यादीनां महामुनिम् || 13 ||
text_mt: Having thus heard the procedure for mantras and so forth, King Sagara / again questioned the great sage about the specifics of policy and the like.

sanskrit_iast: sagara uvāca -
meaning: सगर उवाच -

sanskrit_iast:
yayā nītyā prayoktavyaḥ suta ātmā priyā tathā |
teṣāṁ viśeṣaiḥ sahitaṃ sadācāraṃ vadasva me || 14 ||
meaning:
यया नीत्या प्रयोक्तव्यः सुत आत्मा प्रिया तथा |
तेषाṁ विशेषैः सहितं सदाचारं वदस्व मे || 14 ||
text_mt: By what policy a son, oneself, and a beloved [wife] are to be directed, / tell me that proper conduct along with their specific rules.

sanskrit_iast: aurva uvāca -
meaning: और्व उवाच -

sanskrit_iast:
krameṇa śṛṇu rājendra yayā nītyā niyojitāḥ |
ātmā suto vā bhāryā vā tadviśeṣaṃ śṛṇuṣva me || 15 ||
meaning:
क्रमेण शृणु राजेन्द्र यया नीत्या नियोजिताः |
आत्मा सुतो वा भार्या वा तद्विशेषं शृणुष्व मे || 15 ||
text_mt: Listen in due order, O chief of kings, to the policy by which / oneself, a son, or a wife is guided; hear that specific rule from me.

sanskrit_iast:
jñānavidyātapovṛddhān vayovṛddhān sudakṣiṇān |
seveta prathamaṃ viprānasūyāparivarjitān || 16 ||
meaning:
ज्ञानविद्यातपोवृद्धान् वयोवृद्धान् सुदक्षिणान् |
सेवेत प्रथमं विप्रानसूयापरिवर्जितान् || 16 ||
text_mt: First, one should attend upon Brahmins who are mature in knowledge, learning, and asceticism, / advanced in age, very generous, and free from malice.

sanskrit_iast:
tebhyaśca śṛṇuyāṃnnityaṃ vedaśāstraviniścayam |
yadūcuste ca tat kāryaṃ prājñaṃ caiva nṛpaścaret || 17 ||
meaning:
तेभ्यश्च शृणुयांन्नित्यं वेदशास्त्रविनिश्चयम् |
यदूचुस्ते च तत् कार्यं प्राज्ञं चैव नृपश्चरेत् || 17 ||
text_mt: And from them he should constantly hear the ascertained truths of the Vedas and treatises. / What they say is to be done, and the wise king should act accordingly.

sanskrit_iast:
pañcendriyāṇi pañcāśvāḥ śarīraṃ ratha ucyate |
ātmā rathī kaśā jñānaṃ sārathirmana ucyate || 18 ||
meaning:
पञ्चेन्द्रियाणि पञ्चाश्वाः शरीरं रथ उच्यते |
आत्मा रथी कशा ज्ञानं सारथिर्मन उच्यते || 18 ||
text_mt: The five sense-organs are the five horses, the body is called the chariot, / the self is the charioteer, the whip is knowledge, and the mind is called the driver.

sanskrit_iast:
aśvān sudāntān kurvīta sārathiṃ cātmano vaśam |
kaśā dṛḍhā sadā kāryā śarīrasthiratā tathā || 19 ||
meaning:
अश्वान् सुदान्तान् कुर्वीत सारथिं चात्मनो वशम् |
कशा दृढा सदा कार्या शरीरस्थिरता तथा || 19 ||
text_mt: One should make the horses well-tamed, and the driver subject to one's own will; / the whip should always be made firm, and likewise the stability of the body.

sanskrit_iast:
adāntāṃstu samāruhya saindhavān syandanī yathā |
aśvānāmicchayā gacchannutpathaṃ pratipadyate || 20 ||
meaning:
अदान्तांस्तु समारुह्य सैन्धवान् स्यन्दनी यथा |
अश्वानामिच्छया गच्छन्नुत्पथं प्रतिपद्यते || 20 ||
text_mt: Just as a charioteer who mounts untamed Indus-horses / goes astray according to the will of the horses,

sanskrit_iast:
tatrāvaśaḥ sārathistu svecchayā prerayan hayān |
nayet paravaśaṃ samyag rathitaṃ vīramapyuta || 21 ||
meaning:
तत्रावशः सारथिस्तु स्वेच्छया प्रेरयन् हयान् |
नयेत् परवशं सम्यग् रथितं वीरमप्युत || 21 ||
text_mt: and the helpless driver there, urging the horses on at their own will, / would lead even a heroic chariot-warrior completely into the power of another—

sanskrit_iast:
tathendriyāṇi nṛpatirviṣayāṇāṃ parigrahe |
svavaśyāni prakurvīta mano jñānaṃ dṛḍhaṃ tathā || 22 ||
meaning:
तथेन्द्रियाणि नृपतिर्विषयाणां परिग्रहे |
स्ववश्यानि प्रकुर्वीत मनो ज्ञानं दृढं तथा || 22 ||
text_mt: so the king, in the grasping of sense-objects, / should bring the sense-organs under his own control, and likewise make the mind and knowledge firm.

sanskrit_iast:
jñāne dṛḍhe kaśāyāṃ ca dṛḍhāyāṃ nṛpasattama |
sārathiḥ svavaśo dāntānīśaḥ prerayituṃ hayān || 23 ||
meaning:
ज्ञाने दृढे कशायां च दृढायां नृपसत्तम |
सारथिः स्ववशो दान्तानीशः प्रेरयितुं हयान् || 23 ||
text_mt: When knowledge is firm and the whip is firm, O best of kings, / the driver is under control and able to urge on the tamed horses.

sanskrit_iast:
ato nṛpaḥ svendriyāṇi vaśe kṛtvā manastathā |
jñānamārgamadhiṣṭhāya prakurvītātmano hitam || 24 ||
meaning:
अतो नृपः स्वेन्द्रियाणि वशे कृत्वा मनस्तथा |
ज्ञानमार्गमधिष्ठाय प्रकुर्वीतात्मनो हितम् || 24 ||
text_mt: Therefore the king, having subdued his own sense-organs and likewise the mind, / should abide in the path of knowledge and work for his own welfare.

sanskrit_iast:
bhoktavyaṃ svecchayā bhūyo na kuryāllobhamāsave |
draṣṭavyamiti draṣṭavyaṃ na draṣṭavyaṃ ca svecchayā || 25 ||
meaning:
भोक्तव्यं स्वेच्छया भूयो न कुर्याल्लोभमासवे |
द्रष्टव्यमिति द्रष्टव्यं न द्रष्टव्यं च स्वेच्छया || 25 ||
text_mt: Eating should be done at one's pleasure, but one should not repeatedly greed for liquor; / what ought to be seen should be seen, but one must not look at will.

sanskrit_iast:
śrotavyamiti śrotavyaṃ nādhikaṃ śravaṇe caret |
śāstratattva mṛte dhīraḥ śrutivaśyo bhavenna hi || 26 ||
meaning:
श्रोतव्यमिति श्रोतव्यं नाधिकं श्रवणे चरेत् |
शास्त्रतत्त्व मृते धीरः श्रुतिवश्यो भवेन्न हि || 26 ||
text_mt: What ought to be heard should be heard; he should not indulge excessively in listening. / Except for the essential truth of the treatises, the steadfast [king] should not be swayed by mere hearsay.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ ghrāṇaṃ tvacaṃ cāpi vaśīkṛtyecchayā nṛpaḥ |
svecchayā nopabhuñjīta noddāmaṃ viṣayaṃ vrajet || 27 ||
meaning:
एवं घ्राणं त्वचं चापि वशीकृत्येच्छया नृपः |
स्वेच्छया नोपभुञ्जीत नोद्दामं विषयं व्रजेत् || 27 ||
text_mt: Having thus brought the sense of smell and the skin under control according to his will, the king / should not enjoy things at random, nor pursue unrestrained sense-objects.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ yadi bhavedrājā tadā sa syājjitendriyaḥ |
jitendriyatve hetuśca śāstravṛddhopasevanam || 28 ||
meaning:
एवं यदि भवेद्राजा तदा स स्याज्जितेन्द्रियः |
जितेन्द्रियत्वे हेतुश्च शास्त्रवृद्धोपसेवनम् || 28 ||
text_mt: If a king acts in this way, he will then be one who has subdued his senses; / and the cause of subduing the senses is service to those aged in the treatises.

sanskrit_iast:
avṛddhasevyaśāstrajño nṛpaḥ śatruvaśo bhavet |
tasmācchāstramadhiṣṭhāya bhavedrājā jitendriyaḥ || 29 ||
meaning:
अवृद्धसेव्यशास्त्रज्ञो नृपः शत्रुवशो भवेत् |
तस्माच्छास्त्रमधिष्ठाय भवेद्राजा जितेन्द्रियः || 29 ||
text_mt: A king who knows the treatises but does not serve the aged falls into the power of his enemies; / therefore, taking his stand on the treatises, the king should subdue his senses.

sanskrit_iast:
dhṛtiḥ prāgalbhyamutsāho vākpaṭutvaṃ vivecanam |
dakṣatvaṃ dhārayiṣṇutvaṃ dānamaitrīkṛtajñatā || 30 ||
meaning:
धृतिः प्रागल्भ्यमुत्साहो वाक्पटुत्वं विवेचनम् |
दक्षत्वं धारयिष्णुत्वं दानमैत्रीकृतज्ञता || 30 ||
text_mt: Fortitude, boldness, enthusiasm, eloquence, discernment, / dexterity, retentiveness, generosity, friendliness, gratitude,

sanskrit_iast:
dṛḍhaśāsanatā satyaṃ śaucaṃ mativiniścayamḥ |
parābhiprāyaveditvaṃ caritraṃ dhairyamāpadi || 31 ||
meaning:
दृढशासनता सत्यं शौचं मतिविनिश्चयम्ः |
पराभिप्रायवेदित्वं चरित्रं धैर्यमापदि || 31 ||
text_mt: firmness in governance, truthfulness, purity, certainty of intellect, / knowledge of the intentions of others, good conduct, courage in adversity,

sanskrit_iast:
kleśadhāraṇaśaktiśca gurudevadvijārcanam |
anasūyā hyakopitvaṃ guṇānetānnṛpo'bhyaset || 32 ||
meaning:
क्लेशधारणशक्तिश्च गुरुदेवद्विजार्चनम् |
अनसूया ह्यकोपित्वं गुणानेतान्नृपोऽभ्यसेत् || 32 ||
text_mt: capacity to endure hardship, worship of preceptors, gods, and Brahmins, / freedom from malice, and freedom from anger—the king should cultivate these virtues.

sanskrit_iast:
kāryākāryavibhāgaśca dharmārtho kāma eva ca |
satataṃ pratibudhyeta kuryādavasare'pi tat || 33 ||
meaning:
कार्याकार्यविभागश्च धर्मार्थो काम एव च |
सततं प्रतिबुध्येत कुर्यादवसरेऽपि तत् || 33 ||
text_mt: He should constantly comprehend the distinction between what ought to be done and what ought not to be done, / as well as virtue, wealth, and desire, and he should execute it at the proper opportunity.

sanskrit_iast:
sāmadānaṃ ca bhedaśca daṇḍaśceti catuṣṭayam |
jñātvopāyāṃstu tatkāle tadupāyān prayojayet || 34 ||
meaning:
सामदानं च भेदश्च दण्डश्चेति चतुष्टयम् |
ज्ञात्वोपायांस्तु तत्काले तदुपायान् प्रयोजयेत् || 34 ||
text_mt: Conciliation, gift-giving, sowing dissension, and punishment—these four: / having understood the means, he should employ those means at the appropriate time.

sanskrit_iast:
sāmnastu viṣaye bhedo madhyamaḥ parikīrtitaḥ |
dānasya viṣaye sāma yogyamevopalakṣyate || 35 ||
meaning:
साम्नस्तु विषये भेदो मध्यमः परिकीर्तितः |
दानस्य विषये साम योग्यमेवोपलक्ष्यते || 35 ||
text_mt: Dissension in the sphere of conciliation is proclaimed to be mediocre; / conciliation in the sphere of gift-giving is considered quite suitable.

sanskrit_iast:
dānasya viṣaye daṇḍo hyadhanaḥ parikīrtitaḥ |
daṇḍasya viṣaye dānaṃ tadapyadhamamucyate || 36 ||
meaning:
दानस्य विषये दण्डो ह्यधनः परिकीर्तितः |
दण्डस्य विषये दानं तदप्यधममुच्यते || 36 ||
text_mt: Punishment in the sphere of gift-giving is proclaimed as inferior; / gift-giving in the sphere of punishment is likewise called inferior.

sanskrit_iast:
sāmnastu gocare daṇḍo hyadhamādadhamaḥ smṛtaḥ |
saujanyaṃ satataṃ jñeyaṃ bhūbhṛto bhedadaṇḍayoḥ || 37 ||
meaning:
साम्नस्तु गोचरे दण्डो ह्यधमादधमः स्मृतः |
सौजन्यं सततं ज्ञेयं भूभृतो भेददण्डयोः || 37 ||
text_mt: Punishment in the domain of conciliation is traditionally considered the lowest of the low. / Benevolence is constantly to be understood by the king [even] in dissension and punishment.

sanskrit_iast:
sāmno dānasya ca tathā saujanyaṃ yāti gocare |
kāmaḥ krodhaśca lobhaśca harṣo māno madastathā || 38 ||
meaning:
साम्नो दानस्य च तथा सौजन्यं याति गोचरे |
कामः क्रोधश्च लोभश्च हर्षो मानो मदस्तथा || 38 ||
text_mt: Benevolence likewise falls within the domain of conciliation and gift-giving. / Desire, anger, greed, [frivolous] joy, pride, and arrogance—

sanskrit_iast:
etānatiśayān rājā śatrūniva viśātayet |
sevyāḥ kāle saṃyuktau te lobhagarvau vivarjayet || 39 ||
meaning:
एतानतिशयान् राजा शत्रूनिव विशातयेत् |
सेव्याः काले संयुक्तौ ते लोभगर्वौ विवर्जयेत् || 39 ||
text_mt: the king should cut down these excesses like enemies. / They may be indulged at the proper time when restrained, but one should avoid greed and pride.

sanskrit_iast:
teja eva nṛpāṇāṃ tu tīvraṃ sūryasya vai yathā |
tatra garvaṃ rogayuktaṃ kāyavāṃstaṃ tu saṃtyajet || 40 ||
meaning:
तेज एव नृपाणां तु तीव्रं सूर्यस्य वै यथा |
तत्र गर्वं रोगयुक्तं कायवांस्तं तु संत्यजेत् || 40 ||
text_mt: Indeed, the splendor of kings is fierce like that of the sun; / [yet] the embodied [king] should abandon pride there, which is accompanied by disease.

sanskrit_iast:
ākheṭakākṣau strīsevā pānaṃ caivārthadūṣaṇam |
vāgdaṇḍayośca pāruṣyaṃ saptaitāni vivarjayet || 41 ||
meaning:
आखेटकाक्षौ स्त्रीसेवा पानं चैवार्थदूषणम् |
वाग्दण्डयोश्च पारुष्यं सप्तैतानि विवर्जयेत् || 41 ||
text_mt: Hunting, gambling, addiction to women, drinking, squandering of wealth, / and harshness in speech and punishment—these seven he should avoid.

sanskrit_iast:
parastrīṣu viraktāsu sevāmekāntatastyajet |
satīṣu nijanārīṣu yuktaṃ kuryānniveśanam || 42 ||
meaning:
परस्त्रीषु विरक्तासु सेवामेकान्ततस्त्यजेत् |
सतीषु निजनारीषु युक्तं कुर्यान्निवेशनम् || 42 ||
text_mt: He should completely abandon consorting with other men's wives or with disinterested women; / he should engage suitably with virtuous wives of his own.

sanskrit_iast:
ratiputraphalā dārāstāṃstu naikāntatastyajet |
tayoḥ siddhayai striyaḥ sevyā varjayitvātisaktatām || 43 ||
meaning:
रतिपुत्रफला दारास्तांस्तु नैकान्ततस्त्यजेत् |
तयोः सिद्धयै स्त्रियः सेव्या वर्जयित्वातिसक्तताम् || 43 ||
text_mt: Wives have pleasure and sons as their fruit; one must not abandon them entirely. / Women should be consorted with for the attainment of those two, avoiding excessive attachment.

sanskrit_iast:
mṛgayāṃ tu pramādānāṃ sthānaṃ nityaṃ vivarjayet |
akṣāṃstathā na kurvīta satkāryāsaktināśanam || 44 ||
meaning:
