चूर्णैस्तु मण्डलं कृत्वा सूत्राण्युत्सारयेत् ततः |
उत्सार्य सूत्रं प्रथमं मण्डलं पूजयेत् ततः || 47 ||
text_mt: Having made the maṇḍala with the powders, he should then remove the cords; / having first removed the cord, he should then worship the maṇḍala.

sanskrit_iast:
havanāya nama iti tato hastaṃ viyojayet |
savyāvalambahastaṃ tu rajaḥpātraṃ samācaret || 48 ||
meaning:
हवनाय नम इति ततो हस्तं वियोजयेत् |
सव्यावलम्बहस्तं तु रजःपात्रं समाचरेत् || 48 ||
text_mt: With "Homage to the offering!" he should then apply his hand; / keeping his left hand supporting it, he should manipulate the powder-vessel.

sanskrit_iast:
madhyamānāmikāṅguṣṭhairupariṣṭād yathecchayā |
adhomukhāṅgulīḥ kṛtvā pātayecca vicakṣaṇaḥ || 49 ||
meaning:
मध्यमानामिकाङ्गुष्ठैरुपरिष्टाद् यथेच्छया |
अधोमुखाङ्गुलीः कृत्वा पातयेच्च विचक्षणः || 49 ||
text_mt: With the middle finger, ring finger, and thumb, from above as desired, / having turned his fingers downward, the wise man should let [the powder] fall.

sanskrit_iast:
samārekhā tu kartavyā vicchitrā puṣparañjitā |
aṅguṣṭhaparvanaipuṇyāt samā kāryā vijānatā || 50 ||
meaning:
समारेखा तु कर्तव्या विच्छित्रा पुष्परञ्जिता |
अङ्गुष्ठपर्वनैपुण्यात् समा कार्या विजानता || 50 ||
text_mt: An even line should be made, variegated and colored like flowers; / through skill with the joint of the thumb, an even line must be made by one who knows.

sanskrit_iast:
saṃsaktaviṣamaṃ sthūlaṃ vicchinnaṃ kṛsarakṛtim |
paryantamarpitaṃ hrasvamālikhenna kadācana || 51 ||
meaning:
संसक्तविषमं स्थूलं विच्छिन्नं कृसरकृतिम् |
पर्यन्तमर्पितं ह्रस्वमालिखेन्न कदाचन || 51 ||
text_mt: Overlapping, uneven, too thick, broken, resembling kṛsara, / extended to the edge, or too short—one should never draw such.

sanskrit_iast:
saṃsakte kalahaṃ vidyādūrdhva rekhe tu vigraham |
atisthūle bhaved vyādhirnityaṃ pīḍāvimiśrite || 52 ||
meaning:
संसक्ते कलहं विद्यादूर्ध्व रेखे तु विग्रहम् |
अतिस्थूले भवेद् व्याधिर्नित्यं पीडाविमिश्रिते || 52 ||
text_mt: In overlapping [lines] one should know quarrel, in an upward line conflict, / in one too thick there will be disease, and in a mixed one constant suffering.

sanskrit_iast:
bindubhirbhayamāpnoti śatrupakṣānna saṃśayaḥ |
kṛśāyāṃ cārthahāni syācchinnāyāṃ maraṇaṃ dhruvam || 53 ||
meaning:
बिन्दुभिर्भयमाप्नोति शत्रुपक्षान्न संशयः |
कृशायां चार्थहानि स्याच्छिन्नायां मरणं ध्रुवम् || 53 ||
text_mt: From drops one incurs fear from the enemy's faction, without a doubt; / in a thin [line] there is loss of wealth, and in a broken one, certain death,

sanskrit_iast:
viyogo vā bhavet tasya iṣṭadravyasutasya vā |
aviditvā likhed yastu maṇḍalaṃ tu yathecchayā || 54 ||
meaning:
वियोगो वा भवेत् तस्य इष्टद्रव्यसुतस्य वा |
अविदित्वा लिखेद् यस्तु मण्डलं तु यथेच्छया || 54 ||
text_mt: or there would be separation from a desired object or son. / But he who, without knowing, draws a maṇḍala according to his whim

sanskrit_iast:
sarvadoṣānavāpnoti ye doṣāḥ ūrvamīritāḥ |
sitasarṣapadūrvāyā rekhāḥ kāryā vijānatā || 55 ||
meaning:
सर्वदोषानवाप्नोति ये दोषाः ऊर्वमीरिताः |
सितसर्षपदूर्वाया रेखाः कार्या विजानता || 55 ||
text_mt: incurs all the faults that were spoken of before. / The lines are to be made with white mustard and dūrvā grass by one who knows.

sanskrit_iast:
vimalaṃ vijayaṃ bhadraṃ vimānaṃ śubhadaṃ śivam |
vardhamānaṃ ca devaṃ ca śatākṣaṃ kāmadāyakam || 56 ||
meaning:
विमलं विजयं भद्रं विमानं शुभदं शिवम् |
वर्धमानं च देवं च शताक्षं कामदायकम् || 56 ||
text_mt: Vimala, Vijaya, Bhadra, Vimāna, Śubhada, Śiva, / Vardhamāna, Deva, Śatākṣa, Kāmadāyaka,

sanskrit_iast:
rucikaṃ svastikaṃ caiva dvādaśaite tu maṇḍalāḥ |
yathāsthānaṃ yathāyajñaṃ yojanīyā vicakṣaṇaiḥ || 57 ||
meaning:
रुचिकं स्वस्तिकं चैव द्वादशैते तु मण्डलाः |
यथास्थानं यथायज्ञं योजनीया विचक्षणैः || 57 ||
text_mt: Rucika, and Svastika—these are the twelve maṇḍalas; / according to place and sacrifice, they are to be employed by the wise.

sanskrit_iast:
sāgare madhyamāne tu pīyūṣārthaṃ surotkaraiḥ |
pīyūṣadhāraṇārthāya nirmitā viśvakarmaṇā || 58 ||
meaning:
सागरे मध्यमाने तु पीयूषार्थं सुरोत्करैः |
पीयूषधारणार्थाय निर्मिता विश्वकर्मणा || 58 ||
text_mt: When the ocean was being churned for nectar by the hosts of gods, / for the sake of holding the nectar, [jars] were fashioned by Viśvakarman.

sanskrit_iast:
kalāṃ kalāṃ tu devānāmasitvā te pṛthak pṛthak |
yataḥ kṛtāstu kalasāstataste parikīrtitāḥ || 59 ||
meaning:
कलां कलां तु देवानामसित्वा ते पृथक् पृथक् |
यतः कृतास्तु कलसास्ततस्ते परिकीर्तिताः || 59 ||
text_mt: Drawing a portion from each of the gods separately, / because they were made as portions, they are proclaimed as jars.

sanskrit_iast:
navaiva kalasāḥ proktā nāmatastānnibodhata |
gohyopagohyo maruto mayūkhaśca tathāparaḥ || 60 ||
meaning:
नवैव कलसाः प्रोक्ता नामतस्तान्निबोधत |
गोह्योपगोह्यो मरुतो मयूखश्च तथापरः || 60 ||
text_mt: Nine jars indeed are declared; learn them by name: / Gohya, Upagohya, Marut, and another is Mayūkha,

sanskrit_iast:
manohācāryabhadraśca vijayastanu dūṣakaḥ |
indriyaghno'tha vijayo navamaḥ parikīrtitaḥ || 61 ||
meaning:
मनोहाचार्यभद्रश्च विजयस्तनु दूषकः |
इन्द्रियघ्नोऽथ विजयो नवमः परिकीर्तितः || 61 ||
text_mt: Manoha, Ācārya, Bhadra, Vijaya, Tanudūṣaka, / Indriyaghna, and Vijaya is proclaimed as the ninth.

sanskrit_iast:
teṣāmeva kramād bhūpa nava nāmāni yāni tu |
śṛṇu tānyaparāṇyeva śāntidāni sadaiva hi || 62 ||
meaning:
तेषामेव क्रमाद् भूप नव नामानि यानि तु |
शृणु तान्यपराण्येव शान्तिदानि सदैव हि || 62 ||
text_mt: Hear now, O king, their other nine names in due order, / which indeed always bestow peace:

sanskrit_iast:
kṣitīndraḥ prathamaḥ prokto dvitīyo jalasambhavaḥ |
pavanāgnī tato dve tu yajamanastataḥ paraḥ || 63 ||
meaning:
क्षितीन्द्रः प्रथमः प्रोक्तो द्वितीयो जलसम्भवः |
पवनाग्नी ततो द्वे तु यजमनस्ततः परः || 63 ||
text_mt: The first is called Kṣitīndra, the second is Jalasambhava, / then two are Pavana and Agni, and after that is Yajamāna;

sanskrit_iast:
koṣasambhavāmnā tu ṣaṣṭhaḥ sa parikīrtitaḥ |
somastu saptamaḥ prokta ādityastu tathāṣṭamaḥ || 64 ||
meaning:
कोषसम्भवाम्ना तु षष्ठः स परिकीर्तितः |
सोमस्तु सप्तमः प्रोक्त आदित्यस्तु तथाष्टमः || 64 ||
text_mt: the sixth is celebrated by the name Koṣasambhava, / the seventh is called Soma, and likewise the eighth is Āditya;

sanskrit_iast:
vijayo nāma kalaso yo'sau navama ucyate |
sa tu paṃcamukhaḥ prokto mahādevasvarūpadhṛk || 65 ||
meaning:
विजयो नाम कलसो योऽसौ नवम उच्यते |
स तु पंचमुखः प्रोक्तो महादेवस्वरूपधृक् || 65 ||
text_mt: and the jar named Vijaya, which is designated the ninth, / is said to be five-mouthed, assuming the form of Mahādeva.

sanskrit_iast:
ghaṭasya pañcavaktreṣu pañcavaktraḥ svayaṃ tathā |
yathākāṣṭhāṃ sthitaḥ samyag vāmadevādināmataḥ || 66 ||
meaning:
घटस्य पञ्चवक्त्रेषु पञ्चवक्त्रः स्वयं तथा |
यथाकाष्ठां स्थितः सम्यग् वामदेवादिनामतः || 66 ||
text_mt: On the five mouths of the pot, the five-mouthed one [Śiva] himself is thus / properly positioned according to the quarters, under the names Vāmadeva and the rest.

sanskrit_iast:
maṇḍalasya tu padmānte pañcavaktraṃ ghaṭaṃ nyaset |
kṣitīndraṃ pūrvato nyasya paścime jalasambhavam || 67 ||
meaning:
मण्डलस्य तु पद्मान्ते पञ्चवक्त्रं घटं न्यसेत् |
क्षितीन्द्रं पूर्वतो न्यस्य पश्चिमे जलसम्भवम् || 67 ||
text_mt: At the lotus-tip of the maṇḍala one should place the five-mouthed pot; / having placed Kṣitīndra in the east, and Jalasambhava in the west,

sanskrit_iast:
vāyavye vāyavaṃ nyasya āgneye hyagnisambhavam |
nair-ṛtye yajamānaṃ tu aiśānyāṃ koṣasambhavam || 68 ||
meaning:
वायव्ये वायवं न्यस्य आग्नेये ह्यग्निसम्भवम् |
नैर्-ऋत्ये यजमानं तु ऐशान्यां कोषसम्भवम् || 68 ||
text_mt: having placed Vāyava in the northwest and Agnisambhava in the southeast, / Yajamāna in the southwest, and Koṣasambhava in the northeast,

sanskrit_iast:
somamuttarato yojyaṃ sauraṃ dakṣiṇato nyaset |
nyasyaivaṃ kalasāṃścaiva teṣu caitān vicintayet || 69 ||
meaning:
सोममुत्तरतो योज्यं सौरं दक्षिणतो न्यसेत् |
न्यस्यैवं कलसांश्चैव तेषु चैतान् विचिन्तयेत् || 69 ||
text_mt: one should join Soma in the north and place Saura in the south. / Having thus arranged the jars, one should contemplate these [deities] within them:

sanskrit_iast:
kalasānāṃ mukhe brahmā grīvāyāṃ śaṅkaraḥ sthitaḥ |
mūle tu saṃsthito viṣṇurmadhye mātṛgaṇāḥ sthitāḥ || 70 ||
meaning:
कलसानां मुखे ब्रह्मा ग्रीवायां शङ्करः स्थितः |
मूले तु संस्थितो विष्णुर्मध्ये मातृगणाः स्थिताः || 70 ||
text_mt: Brahmā resides at the mouth of the jars, Śaṅkara at the neck, / Viṣṇu resides at the base, and the host of Mothers resides in the middle;

sanskrit_iast:
dikpālā devatāḥ sarvā veṣṭayanti diśo daśa |
kukṣau tu sāgarāḥ sapta saptadvīpāśca saṃsthitāḥ || 71 ||
meaning:
दिक्पाला देवताः सर्वा वेष्टयन्ति दिशो दश |
कुक्षौ तु सागराः सप्त सप्तद्वीपाश्च संस्थिताः || 71 ||
text_mt: all the gods who are regents of the quarters encompass the ten directions; / in the belly reside the seven oceans and the seven continents;

sanskrit_iast:
nakṣatrāṇi grahāḥ sarve tathaiva kulaparvatāḥ |
gaṅgādyāḥ saritaḥ sarvā vedāścatvāra eva ca || 72 ||
meaning:
नक्षत्राणि ग्रहाः सर्वे तथैव कुलपर्वताः |
गङ्गाद्याः सरितः सर्वा वेदाश्चत्वार एव च || 72 ||
text_mt: all the lunar mansions and planets, and likewise the mountain ranges, / all the rivers beginning with the Gaṅgā, and indeed the four Vedas—

sanskrit_iast:
kalase saṃsthitāḥ sarve teṣu tāni vicintayet |
atnāni sarvabījāni puṣpāṇi ca phalāni ca || 73 ||
meaning:
कलसे संस्थिताः सर्वे तेषु तानि विचिन्तयेत् |
अत्नानि सर्वबीजानि पुष्पाणि च फलानि च || 73 ||
text_mt: all abide in the jar; one should contemplate them within them. / [One should place in them] jewels, all seeds, flowers, and fruits:

sanskrit_iast:
vajramauktikavaidūryamahāpadmendrasphāṭikaiḥ |
sarvadhāmamayaṃ bilvaṃ nāgarodumbara tathā || 74 ||
meaning:
वज्रमौक्तिकवैदूर्यमहापद्मेन्द्रस्फाटिकैः |
सर्वधाममयं बिल्वं नागरोदुम्बर तथा || 74 ||
text_mt: with diamond, pearl, cat's-eye, emerald, and crystal; / bilva possessing all splendour, and likewise nāgara and udumbara;

sanskrit_iast:
bījapūrakajambīrakāśmīrāmrātadāḍimam |
yavaṃ śāliṃ ca nīvāraṃ godhūmaṃ sitasarṣapam || 75 ||
meaning:
बीजपूरकजम्बीरकाश्मीराम्रातदाडिमम् |
यवं शालिं च नीवारं गोधूमं सितसर्षपम् || 75 ||
text_mt: citron, lime, kāśmīra, mango, hog-plum, and pomegranate; / barley, śāli rice, wild rice, wheat, and white mustard;

sanskrit_iast:
kuṅkumāgurukarpūramadanaṃ rocanaṃ tathā |
candanaṃ ca tathā māṃsīmelāṃ kuṣṭhaṃ tathaiva ca || 76 ||
meaning:
कुङ्कुमागुरुकर्पूरमदनं रोचनं तथा |
चन्दनं च तथा मांसीमेलां कुष्ठं तथैव च || 76 ||
text_mt: saffron, aguru, camphor, madana, and rocanā; / sandalwood, and likewise spikenard, cardamom, and costus;

sanskrit_iast:
astūrīpatracūrṇaṃ ca jalaniryāsakāmbudam |
śaileyaṃ badaraṃ jātīpatrapuṣpe tathaiva ca || 77 ||
meaning:
अस्तूरीपत्रचूर्णं च जलनिर्यासकाम्बुदम् |
शैलेयं बदरं जातीपत्रपुष्पे तथैव च || 77 ||
text_mt: musk, powder of tejapatra, and bdellium, and mustā; / lichen, jujube, and likewise nut-meg leaf and flower;

sanskrit_iast:
kālaśākaṃ tathā pṛkkā devīparṇakameva ca |
vacāṃ dhātrīṃ samañjiṣṭhāṃ turuṣkaṃ maṅgalāṣṭakam || 78 ||
meaning:
कालशाकं तथा पृक्का देवीपर्णकमेव च |
वचां धात्रीं समञ्जिष्ठां तुरुष्कं मङ्गलाष्टकम् || 78 ||
text_mt: kālaśāka, and pṛkkā, and devīparṇaka; / sweet flag, emblic myrobalan, madder, turuṣka, the eight auspicious items;

sanskrit_iast:
dūrvāṃ mohanikāṃ bhadrāṃ śatamūlīṃ śatāvarīm |
arṇānāṃ saralāṃ kṣudrāṃ sahadevīṃ gajāhvayām || 79 ||
meaning:
दूर्वां मोहनिकां भद्रां शतमूलीं शतावरीम् |
अर्णानां सरलां क्षुद्रां सहदेवीं गजाह्वयाम् || 79 ||
text_mt: dūrvā grass, mohanikā, bhadrā, śatamūlī, śatāvarī; / arṇānā, saralā, kṣudrā, sahadevī, gajāhvayā;

sanskrit_iast:
pūrṇakoṣāṃ sitāṃ pīṭhāṃ guñjāṃ śirasikānalau |
vyāmakaṃ gajadantaṃ ca śatapuṣpaṃ punarnabām || 80 ||
meaning:
पूर्णकोषां सितां पीठां गुञ्जां शिरसिकानलौ |
व्यामकं गजदन्तं च शतपुष्पं पुनर्नबाम् || 80 ||
text_mt: pūrṇakoṣā, sitā, pīṭhā, guñjā, śirasikā, anala; / vyāmaka, and ivory, dill, and punarnavā;

sanskrit_iast:
brāhmīṃ devīṃ śivāṃ rudrāṃ sarvasandhānikāṃ tathā |
samāhṛtya śubhānetān kalaseṣu nidhārpayet || 81 ||
meaning:
ब्राह्मीं देवीं शिवां रुद्रां सर्वसन्धानिकां तथा |
समाहृत्य शुभानेतान् कलसेषु निधार्पयेत् || 81 ||
text_mt: brāhmī, devī, śivā, rudrā, and likewise sarvasandhānikā— / having gathered these auspicious items, one should deposit them in the jars.

sanskrit_iast:
kalasasya yathādeśaṃ vidhiṃ śambhuṃ gadādharam |
yathākramaṃ pūjayitvā śambhu mukhyatayā yajet || 82 ||
meaning:
कलसस्य यथादेशं विधिं शम्भुं गदाधरम् |
यथाक्रमं पूजयित्वा शम्भु मुख्यतया यजेत् || 82 ||
text_mt: Having worshipped according to their location in the jar, in due order, / Vidhi, Śambhu, and Gadādhara, one should worship Śambhu pre-eminently.

sanskrit_iast:
prāsādena tu mantreṇa śambhuṃ tantreṇa śaṅkaram |
prathamaṃ pūjayenmadhye nānā naivedyavedanaiḥ || 83 ||
meaning:
प्रासादेन तु मन्त्रेण शम्भुं तन्त्रेण शङ्करम् |
प्रथमं पूजयेन्मध्ये नाना नैवेद्यवेदनैः || 83 ||
text_mt: With the prāsāda mantra and with the tantra for Śambhu, / one should first worship Śaṅkara in the centre with offerings of various cooked foods.

sanskrit_iast:
dikpālānāṃ ghaṭeṣveva dikpālānapi pūjayet |
pūrvaṃ bahiḥ sthāpiteṣu grahāṇāṃ kalaseṣu ca || 84 ||
meaning:
दिक्पालानां घटेष्वेव दिक्पालानपि पूजयेत् |
पूर्वं बहिः स्थापितेषु ग्रहाणां कलसेषु च || 84 ||
text_mt: One should worship the regents of the quarters in the pots of the regents of the quarters, / and in the jars of the planets previously stationed outside,

sanskrit_iast:
navagrahān pūjayet tu mātṛrmātṛghaṭeṣu ca |
sarve devā ghaṭe pūjyā ghaṭāsteṣāṃ pṛthak pṛthak || 85 ||
meaning:
नवग्रहान् पूजयेत् तु मातृर्मातृघटेषु च |
सर्वे देवा घटे पूज्या घटास्तेषां पृथक् पृथक् || 85 ||
text_mt: one should worship the nine planets, and the Mothers in the pots of the Mothers; / all gods are to be worshipped in a pot, their pots being separate.

sanskrit_iast:
navaiva tatra pūrvoktāḥ smṛtā mukhyatayā nṛpa |
bhakṣyairbhojyaiśca peyaiśca puṣpairnānāvidhaiḥ phalaiḥ || 86 ||
meaning:
नवैव तत्र पूर्वोक्ताः स्मृता मुख्यतया नृप |
भक्ष्यैर्भोज्यैश्च पेयैश्च पुष्पैर्नानाविधैः फलैः || 86 ||
text_mt: Only nine have been mentioned there as principal, O king. / With chewable foods, eatables, beverages, flowers, and various kinds of fruits,

sanskrit_iast:
yāvakaiḥ pāyasaiścaiva yathāsambhavayojitaiḥ |
puṣyasnānāya nṛpatiḥ pūjayet sakalān surān || 87 ||
meaning:
यावकैः पायसैश्चैव यथासम्भवयोजितैः |
पुष्यस्नानाय नृपतिः पूजयेत् सकलान् सुरान् || 87 ||
text_mt: with barley preparations and milk-rice properly combined as available, / the king should worship all the gods for the bath on Puṣya.

sanskrit_iast:
dakṣiṇe maṇḍalasyātha kuṇḍaṃ nirmāya pāyasaiḥ |
samidbhiḥ śālisiddhārthairghṛtairdūrvākṣataistathā || 88 ||
meaning:
दक्षिणे मण्डलस्याथ कुण्डं निर्माय पायसैः |
समिद्भिः शालिसिद्धार्थैर्घृतैर्दूर्वाक्षतैस्तथा || 88 ||
text_mt: Then, having constructed a fire-pit to the south of the maṇḍala, with milk-rice, / firewood sticks, śāli rice, white mustard, ghee, dūrvā grass, and unbroken grains,

sanskrit_iast:
kevalaiśca tathaivājyaiḥ pūjitān sakalān surān |
homena toṣayed vṛddhyai nṛpaḥ satvikpurohitaḥ || 89 ||
meaning:
केवलैश्च तथैवाज्यैः पूजितान् सकलान् सुरान् |
होमेन तोषयेद् वृद्ध्यै नृपः सत्विक्पुरोहितः || 89 ||
text_mt: and likewise with pure ghee, the king, together with the officiating priest and purohita, / should satisfy all the worshipped gods through fire-sacrifice for prosperity.

sanskrit_iast:
homānte maṇḍalodīcyāṃ vedikāyāṃ sapaṭṭakam |
rocanākhyamalaṃkārāṃstathā sarvān niyojayet || 90 ||
meaning:
होमान्ते मण्डलोदीच्यां वेदिकायां सपट्टकम् |
रोचनाख्यमलंकारांस्तथा सर्वान् नियोजयेत् || 90 ||
text_mt: At the conclusion of the fire-sacrifice, on a platform to the north of the maṇḍala, / he should set out [the board] with silk cloth, rocanā, and all ornaments.

sanskrit_iast:
vṛddhāvaṅgulamaṅgulyā ṣaḍviṃśāṅgulikāvadhi |
vṛttaṃ vā caturasraṃ vā padmaṃ trikoṇasaṃjñakam || 91 ||
meaning:
वृद्धावङ्गुलमङ्गुल्या षड्विंशाङ्गुलिकावधि |
वृत्तं वा चतुरस्रं वा पद्मं त्रिकोणसंज्ञकम् || 91 ||
text_mt: In enlargement, finger-breadth by finger-breadth up to twenty-six finger-breadths, / it may be circular or quadrangular, a lotus, or termed triangular.

sanskrit_iast:
ratneśān padmamadhye tu gomuṣṭikavināyakaiḥ |
śrīśrīvṛkṣavarārohāmumādevīṃ śubhānvitām || 92 ||
meaning:
रत्नेशान् पद्ममध्ये तु गोमुष्टिकविनायकैः |
श्रीश्रीवृक्षवरारोहामुमादेवीं शुभान्विताम् || 92 ||
text_mt: The lords of jewels in the middle of the lotus, with gomuṣṭika and Vināyaka, / the auspicious goddess Umā, beautiful, [adorned with] śrī and the śrīvṛkṣa—

sanskrit_iast:
ratnaiḥ sarvairalaṅkāraiḥ paṭṭaṃ kāryaṃ dvihastakam |
hastavistāramucchrāyaṃ navahastaṃ daśāṅgulam || 93 ||
meaning:
रत्नैः सर्वैरलङ्कारैः पट्टं कार्यं द्विहस्तकम् |
हस्तविस्तारमुच्छ्रायं नवहस्तं दशाङ्गुलम् || 93 ||
text_mt: with all jewels and ornaments, a board of two cubits should be made; / its width is a cubit and its height is nine cubits and ten finger-breadths.

sanskrit_iast:
snānārthaṃ sārdhahastaṃ ca paṭṭaṃ vṛttaṃ guṇānvitam |
śayyā caturguṇā dīrghā dhanurmānaṃ tu pīṭhakam || 94 ||
meaning:
स्नानार्थं सार्धहस्तं च पट्टं वृत्तं गुणान्वितम् |
शय्या चतुर्गुणा दीर्घा धनुर्मानं तु पीठकम् || 94 ||
text_mt: And for the bath, a circular board of one and a half cubits, endowed with qualities; / a bed four times as long, and a stool measuring a bow.

sanskrit_iast:
gajasiṃhakṛtāṭopaṃ hemaratnavibhūṣitam |
siṃhākhyaṃ sārdhavistārād daṇḍāsanamathāpi vā || 95 ||
meaning:
गजसिंहकृताटोपं हेमरत्नविभूषितम् |
सिंहाख्यं सार्धविस्ताराद् दण्डासनमथापि वा || 95 ||
text_mt: Displaying the grandeur of elephants and lions, adorned with gold and jewels, / called a throne, one and a half [cubits] in breadth, or a daṇḍāsana;

sanskrit_iast:
vyāghracitrakapaṭṭairvā upadhānāni kārayet |
anyairvā nirmitāṃ carmamṛdutūlakapūritā || 96 ||
meaning:
व्याघ्रचित्रकपट्टैर्वा उपधानानि कारयेत् |
अन्यैर्वा निर्मितां चर्ममृदुतूलकपूरिता || 96 ||
text_mt: or one should make cushions of tiger-patterned silk / or made of other hides, filled with soft cotton.

sanskrit_iast:
śayyā dīrghārghavistīrṇā caturhastā sulakṣaṇā |
vitastyadhikamicchanti nṛpasya guruvidyayā || 97 ||
meaning:
शय्या दीर्घार्घविस्तीर्णा चतुर्हस्ता सुलक्षणा |
वितस्त्यधिकमिच्छन्ति नृपस्य गुरुविद्यया || 97 ||
text_mt: A bed four cubits long and half as wide, possessing auspicious marks; / according to the wisdom of the king's guru, they desire it longer by a span.

sanskrit_iast:
ardhacandrasamaṃ kuryādāsanaṃ caturasrakam |
upadhānāni śayyāyāḥ karṇādimūlabhedataḥ || 98 ||
meaning:
अर्धचन्द्रसमं कुर्यादासनं चतुरस्रकम् |
उपधानानि शय्यायाः कर्णादिमूलभेदतः || 98 ||
text_mt: One should make the seat four-cornered, resembling a half-moon; / the pillows of the bed, distinguished by head and foot,

sanskrit_iast:
ṣoḍaśaivātra kāryāṇi varṇacitrayutāni ca |
yānaṃ siṃhāsana paṭṭaṃ śayyopakaraṇādikam || 99 ||
meaning:
षोडशैवात्र कार्याणि वर्णचित्रयुतानि च |
यानं सिंहासन पट्टं शय्योपकरणादिकम् || 99 ||
text_mt: are to be made sixteen in number here, endowed with colourful designs. / The vehicle, the lion-throne, the board, the bed furnishings, and so forth,

sanskrit_iast:
rājño nūtanayogyaṃ tad vedyā uttarato nyaset |
teṣāṃ tu paścime svarṇaratnaughakhacite vare || 100 ||
meaning:
राज्ञो नूतनयोग्यं तद् वेद्या उत्तरतो न्यसेत् |
तेषां तु पश्चिमे स्वर्णरत्नौघखचिते वरे || 100 ||
text_mt: suited to be new for the king, he should place to the north of the altar; / and to the west of them, upon an excellent,

sanskrit_iast:
paryaṅke yajñadārvaughanirmite mahadāstare |
rdhācchādanasaṃyukte carmāvṛtacatuṣṭaye || 101 ||
meaning:
पर्यङ्के यज्ञदार्वौघनिर्मिते महदास्तरे |
र्धाच्छादनसंयुक्ते चर्मावृतचतुष्टये || 101 ||
text_mt: spacious couch inlaid with a mass of gold and jewels, / made from a collection of sacrificial timber, provided with half-covering, draped with four skins—

sanskrit_iast:
vṛṣabhasya tathorṇāyāḥ siṃhaśārdulayorapi |
pādapīṭhe ratnayute pādāvāropya pārthivaḥ || 102 ||
meaning:
वृषभस्य तथोर्णायाः सिंहशार्दुलयोरपि |
पादपीठे रत्नयुते पादावारोप्य पार्थिवः || 102 ||
text_mt: of a bull, of wool, and of a lion and a tiger; / having placed both feet upon the footstool adorned with jewels,

sanskrit_iast:
asmin paryaṅkapīṭhasthe carmāvṛtacatuṣṭaya |
nānālaṅkārabhūṣāḍhyaṃ nṛpatiṃ ratnaśālinam || 103 ||
meaning:
अस्मिन् पर्यङ्कपीठस्थे चर्मावृतचतुष्टय |
नानालङ्कारभूषाढ्यं नृपतिं रत्नशालिनम् || 103 ||
text_mt: the king, seated upon this couch-pedestal draped with the four skins, / rich in diverse ornaments and adornments, resplendent with gems,

sanskrit_iast:
snāpayed brāhmaṇaiḥ sārdhaṃ rājānaṃ sukhasaṅgatam |
saṃvitakambalaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ ahuvastraiśca śaubhitam || 104 ||
meaning:
स्नापयेद् ब्राह्मणैः सार्धं राजानं सुखसङ्गतम् |
संवितकम्बलं कृष्णं अहुवस्त्रैश्च शौभितम् || 104 ||
text_mt: should bathe together with the brahmins, attained to ease, / wrapped in a black blanket and graced with many garments.

sanskrit_iast:
kalasevalipuṣpādyaiḥ sālicūrṇaiśca snāpayet |
ṣṭau ṣauḍaśa viṃśāṣṭaśatamadhikaṃ ca vā || 105 ||
meaning:
कलसेवलिपुष्पाद्यैः सालिचूर्णैश्च स्नापयेत् |
ष्टौ षौडश विंशाष्टशतमधिकं च वा || 105 ||
text_mt: He should bathe with jars, offerings, flowers, and powders of śāli rice, / [using] eight, sixteen, twenty-eight, or a hundred [jars], or even more.

sanskrit_iast:
kalasānāṃ samākhyātā adhikasyottarottaram |
jayakalyāṇadairmantrairmaṅgalotthaiśca śāmbhavaiḥ || 106 ||
meaning:
कलसानां समाख्याता अधिकस्योत्तरोत्तरम् |
जयकल्याणदैर्मन्त्रैर्मङ्गलोत्थैश्च शाम्भवैः || 106 ||
text_mt: [The numbers] of jars are declared, each greater [in number bringing] higher and higher [results], / with mantras granting victory and welfare, arising from blessings and dedicated to Śiva,

sanskrit_iast:
vaiṣṇavairatha dikpālairgrahamantraiśca mātṛkaiḥ |
ājyaṃ tejaḥ samuddṛṣṭamājyaṃ pāpaharaṃ param || 107 ||
meaning:
वैष्णवैरथ दिक्पालैर्ग्रहमन्त्रैश्च मातृकैः |
आज्यं तेजः समुद्दृष्टमाज्यं पापहरं परम् || 107 ||
text_mt: dedicated to Viṣṇu, to the guardians of the directions, planetary mantras, and mothers' mantras: / Ghee is declared to be splendor; ghee is the supreme destroyer of sin;

sanskrit_iast:
ājyaṃ surāṇāmāhāraprājye lokāḥ pratiṣṭhitāḥ |
haumāntarikṣaṃ divyaṃ vā yat te kalpamaṣamāgatam || 108 ||
meaning:
आज्यं सुराणामाहारप्राज्ये लोकाः प्रतिष्ठिताः |
हौमान्तरिक्षं दिव्यं वा यत् ते कल्पमषमागतम् || 108 ||
text_mt: ghee is the food of the gods; upon ghee the worlds are established. / Whatever defilement has befallen you—terrestrial, intermediate, or celestial—

sanskrit_iast:
sarvaṃ tadājyasaṃsparśāt praṇāśamupagacchatu |
tato'panīyagātrāt tu kambalaṃ vastrameva ca || 109 ||
meaning:
सर्वं तदाज्यसंस्पर्शात् प्रणाशमुपगच्छतु |
ततोऽपनीयगात्रात् तु कम्बलं वस्त्रमेव च || 109 ||
text_mt: let all that perish through the contact of ghee! / Then, having removed the blanket and cloth from his body,

sanskrit_iast:
kalasaiḥ snāpayed bhūpaṃ puṣpasnānīyapūritaiḥ |
ebhairmantrairnaraśreṣṭha tanutattvārthasādhakaiḥ || 110 ||
meaning:
कलसैः स्नापयेद् भूपं पुष्पस्नानीयपूरितैः |
एभैर्मन्त्रैर्नरश्रेष्ठ तनुतत्त्वार्थसाधकैः || 110 ||
text_mt: he should bathe the king with jars filled with fragrant bath-waters and flowers, / with these mantras, O best of men, which achieve the true reality of the body:

sanskrit_iast:
urāstvāmabhiṣiñcantu ye ca siddhāḥ purātanāḥ |
brahmā viṣṇuśca rudrāśca sādhyāśca samarudgaṇāḥ || 111 ||
meaning:
उरास्त्वामभिषिञ्चन्तु ये च सिद्धाः पुरातनाः |
ब्रह्मा विष्णुश्च रुद्राश्च साध्याश्च समरुद्गणाः || 111 ||
text_mt: ‘Let the gods consecrate you, and those who are ancient Siddhas, / Brahmā, Viṣṇu, and the Rudras, the Sādhyas together with the host of Maruts,

sanskrit_iast:
ādityā vasavo rudrā aśvinau yo bhiṣagvarau |
aditirdevamātā ca svāhā lakṣmīḥ sarasvatī || 112 ||
meaning:
आदित्या वसवो रुद्रा अश्विनौ यो भिषग्वरौ |
अदितिर्देवमाता च स्वाहा लक्ष्मीः सरस्वती || 112 ||
text_mt: the Ādityas, the Vasus, the Rudras, the two Aśvins who are the best of physicians, / Aditi the mother of the gods, Svāhā, Lakṣmī, and Sarasvatī,

sanskrit_iast:
kīrtirlakṣmīrghṛtiḥ śrīśca sinīvālī kuhūstathā |
ditiśca surasā caiva vinatā kadrureva ca || 113 ||
meaning:
कीर्तिर्लक्ष्मीर्घृतिः श्रीश्च सिनीवाली कुहूस्तथा |
दितिश्च सुरसा चैव विनता कद्रुरेव च || 113 ||
text_mt: Kīrti, Lakṣmī, Dhṛti, and Śrī, Sinīvālī and Kuhū, / Diti, Surasā, Vinatā, and Kadrū,

sanskrit_iast:
devapatnayaśca yāḥ proktā devamātara eva ca |
sarvāstvāmaṣiñcantu siddhāścāpsrasāṃ gaṇāḥ || 114 ||
meaning:
देवपत्नयश्च याः प्रोक्ता देवमातर एव च |
सर्वास्त्वामषिञ्चन्तु सिद्धाश्चाप्स्रसां गणाः || 114 ||
text_mt: and those who are declared the wives of the gods, and the mothers of the gods— / let them all consecrate you, and the Siddhas and troops of Apsarases;

sanskrit_iast:
nakṣatrāṇi muhūrtāśca pakṣāhorātrasandhayaḥ |
saṃvatsarā nimeṣāśca kalāḥ kāṣṭhāḥ kṣaṇā lavāḥ || 115 ||
meaning:
नक्षत्राणि मुहूर्ताश्च पक्षाहोरात्रसन्धयः |
संवत्सरा निमेषाश्च कलाः काष्ठाः क्षणा लवाः || 115 ||
text_mt: the lunar mansions, the muhūrtas, the fortnights, the junctions of day and night, / the years, the twinklings of the eye, kalās, kāṣṭhās, kṣaṇas, and lavas—

sanskrit_iast:
sarve tvāmabhiṣiñcantu kālasyāvayavastathā |
vaimānikāḥ suragaṇā manavaḥ sāgaraiḥ saha || 116 ||
meaning:
सर्वे त्वामभिषिञ्चन्तु कालस्यावयवस्तथा |
वैमानिकाः सुरगणा मनवः सागरैः सह || 116 ||
text_mt: let all the divisions of time likewise consecrate you; / the sky-faring hosts of gods, the Manus together with the oceans,

sanskrit_iast:
saritaśca mahānāgā nāgāḥ kiṃpuruṣāstathā |
vaikhānasā mahābhāgā dvijā vaihāyasāśca ye || 117 ||
meaning:
सरितश्च महानागा नागाः किंपुरुषास्तथा |
वैखानसा महाभागा द्विजा वैहायसाश्च ये || 117 ||
text_mt: the rivers, the great Nāgas, the snakes, and the Kimpuruṣas, / the most fortunate Vaikhānasa twice-born, and those who dwell in the sky;

sanskrit_iast:
saptarṣayaḥ sadārāśca dhruvasthānāni yāni tu |
marīciratriḥ pulahaḥ pulastyaḥ kraturaṅgirāḥ || 118 ||
meaning:
सप्तर्षयः सदाराश्च ध्रुवस्थानानि यानि तु |
मरीचिरत्रिः पुलहः पुलस्त्यः क्रतुरङ्गिराः || 118 ||
text_mt: the Seven Rṣis together with their wives, and the fixed stations [of the heavens]: / Marīci, Atri, Pulaha, Pulastya, Kratu, Aṅgiras,

sanskrit_iast:
bhṛguḥ sanatkumāraśca sanakaśca sanandanaḥ |
sanātanaśca dakṣaśca jaigīṣavyo'bhinandanaḥ || 119 ||
meaning:
भृगुः सनत्कुमारश्च सनकश्च सनन्दनः |
सनातनश्च दक्षश्च जैगीषव्योऽभिनन्दनः || 119 ||
text_mt: Bhṛgu, Sanatkumāra, Sanaka, Sanandana, / Sanātana, Dakṣa, Jaigīṣavya, Abhinandana,

sanskrit_iast:
ekataśca dvitaścaiva trito jāvālikāśyapau |
durvāsā durvinītaśca kaṇvaḥ kātyāyanastathā || 120 ||
meaning:
एकतश्च द्वितश्चैव त्रितो जावालिकाश्यपौ |
दुर्वासा दुर्विनीतश्च कण्वः कात्यायनस्तथा || 120 ||
text_mt: Ekata, Dvita, and Trita, Jābāli, Kāśyapa, / Durvāsas, Durvinīta, Kaṇva, and Kātyāyana,

sanskrit_iast:
mārkaṇḍeyo dīrghatamāḥ śunaḥśepho vidūrathaḥ |
aurvaḥ saṃvartakaścaiva cyavano'triḥ parāśaraḥ || 121 ||
meaning:
मार्कण्डेयो दीर्घतमाः शुनःशेफो विदूरथः |
और्वः संवर्तकश्चैव च्यवनोऽत्रिः पराशरः || 121 ||
text_mt: Mārkaṇḍeya, Dīrghatamas, Śunaḥśepha, Vidūratha, / Aurva, Saṃvartaka, Cyavana, Atri, Parāśara,

sanskrit_iast:
dvaipāyano yavakrīto devarātaḥ sahātmajaḥ |
ete cānye ca bahavo vedavrataparāyaṇāḥ || 122 ||
meaning:
द्वैपायनो यवक्रीतो देवरातः सहात्मजः |
एते चान्ये च बहवो वेदव्रतपरायणाः || 122 ||
text_mt: Dvaipāyana, Yavakrīta, and Devarāta with his son— / these and many others devoted to the Vedic vows,

sanskrit_iast:
saśiṣyāste'bhiṣiñcantu sadārāśca tapodhanāḥ |
parvatāstaravo nadyaḥ puṇyānyāyatatanāni ca || 123 ||
meaning:
सशिष्यास्तेऽभिषिञ्चन्तु सदाराश्च तपोधनाः |
पर्वतास्तरवो नद्यः पुण्यान्यायततनानि च || 123 ||
text_mt: rich in austerities, accompanied by disciples and wives, consecrate you! / The mountains, trees, rivers, and holy shrines,

sanskrit_iast:
prajāpatiḥ kṣitiścaiva gāvo viśvasya mātaraḥ |
vāhanāni ca divyāni sarve lokāścarācarāḥ || 124 ||
meaning:
प्रजापतिः क्षितिश्चैव गावो विश्वस्य मातरः |
वाहनानि च दिव्यानि सर्वे लोकाश्चराचराः || 124 ||
text_mt: Prajāpati, the earth, the cows that are the mothers of the universe, / the divine vehicles, and all the worlds moving and unmoving;

sanskrit_iast:
agnayaḥ pitarastārā jīmūtāḥ khaṃ diśo jalam |
ete cānye ca bahavaḥ puṇyasaṃkīrtanāḥ śubhāḥ || 125 ||
meaning:
अग्नयः पितरस्तारा जीमूताः खं दिशो जलम् |
एते चान्ये च बहवः पुण्यसंकीर्तनाः शुभाः || 125 ||
text_mt: the fires, ancestors, stars, rain-clouds, sky, directions, and water— / these and many other auspicious beings of holy renown,

sanskrit_iast:
toyaistvāmabhiṣiñcantu sarvotpātanibarhaṇaiḥ |
ityevaṃ śubhadairetairdivyarmantraistathāparaiḥ || 126 ||
meaning:
तोयैस्त्वामभिषिञ्चन्तु सर्वोत्पातनिबर्हणैः |
इत्येवं शुभदैरेतैर्दिव्यर्मन्त्रैस्तथापरैः || 126 ||
text_mt: consecrate you with waters that destroy all portents!’ / Thus with these auspicious divine mantras and with others,

sanskrit_iast:
sorairnārāyaṇai raudrairbahmaśakrasamudbhavaiḥ |
āpohiṣṭhā hiraṇyeti sambhaveti sureti ca || 127 ||
meaning:
सोरैर्नारायणै रौद्रैर्बह्मशक्रसमुद्भवैः |
आपोहिष्ठा हिरण्येति सम्भवेति सुरेति च || 127 ||
text_mt: addressed to the Sun, to Nārāyaṇa, to Rudra, and those arising from Brahmā and Indra; / with ‘Āpo hi ṣṭhā’, ‘Hiraṇya…’, ‘Saṃbhavet…’, ‘Surā…’,

sanskrit_iast:
mānastoketi mantreṇa gandhadvāretyanena ca |
sarvamaṃgalamāṃgalye śrīśca te grahayogibhiḥ || 118 ||
meaning:
मानस्तोकेति मन्त्रेण गन्धद्वारेत्यनेन च |
सर्वमंगलमांगल्ये श्रीश्च ते ग्रहयोगिभिः || 118 ||
text_mt: with the mantra ‘Mā nas toke…’, and with ‘Gandhadvārā…’, / ‘Sarvamaṅgalamāṅgalye…’, and ‘Śrīś ca te…’, accompanied by planetary rites;

sanskrit_iast:
ityevaṃ snānamāsādya gātramāvṛtya kambalaiḥ |
sarvamaṃgalamantreṇa vastraṃ kārpāsakaṃ dhriyāt || 129 ||
meaning:
इत्येवं स्नानमासाद्य गात्रमावृत्य कम्बलैः |
सर्वमंगलमन्त्रेण वस्त्रं कार्पासकं ध्रियात् || 129 ||
text_mt: thus having performed the bath and covered his body with blankets, / he should put on a cotton garment with the all-auspicious mantra.

sanskrit_iast:
ācamya ca tato devān guruṃ viprāṃśca pūjayet |
dhvajacchatraṃ cāmaraṃ ca ghaṇṭāṃ cāśvān gajāṃstathā || 130 ||
meaning:
आचम्य च ततो देवान् गुरुं विप्रांश्च पूजयेत् |
ध्वजच्छत्रं चामरं च घण्टां चाश्वान् गजांस्तथा || 130 ||
text_mt: Then, having sipped water, he should worship the gods, the guru, and the brāhmaṇas; / and muttering the mantra over the banner, parasol, chowrie, bell, horses, and elephants,

sanskrit_iast:
mantraṃ japtvā dhārayet tu tato gaccheddhutāśanam |
tatra gatvā vahnimadhye vahneḥ śrīrvīkṣya pārthivaḥ || 131 ||
meaning:
मन्त्रं जप्त्वा धारयेत् तु ततो गच्छेद्धुताशनम् |
तत्र गत्वा वह्निमध्ये वह्नेः श्रीर्वीक्ष्य पार्थिवः || 131 ||
text_mt: he should bear them, and then approach the fire. / Having gone there, the king, beholding the glory of the fire within the fire,

sanskrit_iast:
imittānyanimittāni lakṣayet tatra bindubhiḥ |
daivajñakañcukyamātyavandipaurajanairvṛtaḥ || 132 ||
meaning:
इमित्तान्यनिमित्तानि लक्षयेत् तत्र बिन्दुभिः |
दैवज्ञकञ्चुक्यमात्यवन्दिपौरजनैर्वृतः || 132 ||
text_mt: should observe the auspicious and inauspicious omens there by means of the sparks, / surrounded by the astrologer, chamberlains, ministers, bards, and citizens.

sanskrit_iast:
vāditraghoṣaistumalaistathā tauryatrikaiḥ śubhaiḥ |
kṛtvā śeṣe punaḥ śāntimāśīrvācya ca vai dvijān || 133 ||
meaning:
वादित्रघोषैस्तुमलैस्तथा तौर्यत्रिकैः शुभैः |
कृत्वा शेषे पुनः शान्तिमाशीर्वाच्य च वै द्विजान् || 133 ||
text_mt: With tumultuous sounds of musical instruments and auspicious threefold instrumental music, / having performed the pacificatory rite again at the conclusion and had the twice-born pronounce blessings,

sanskrit_iast:
pūrṇāṃ vidhāya vidhivad dakṣiṇāṃ kanakānvitām |
dhānyāni cātha vāsāṃsi dattvā kuryād visarjanam || 134 ||
meaning:
पूर्णां विधाय विधिवद् दक्षिणां कनकान्विताम् |
धान्यानि चाथ वासांसि दत्त्वा कुर्याद् विसर्जनम् || 134 ||
text_mt: having offered the final oblation according to rule, and given the priestly fee along with gold, / grains, and garments, he should perform the dismissal.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ śeṣajalaiḥ sarvānamātyādīn purohitaḥ |
secayeccaturaṅgaṃ ca balaṃ cāpi sarāṣṭrakam || 135 ||
meaning:
ततः शेषजलैः सर्वानमात्यादीन् पुरोहितः |
सेचयेच्चतुरङ्गं च बलं चापि सराष्ट्रकम् || 135 ||
text_mt: Then, with the remaining waters, the royal priest should sprinkle / all the ministers and others, and the fourfold army along with the realm.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ kṛtvā nṛpaḥ paścāt trirātraṃ saṃyato bhavet |
māṃsamaithunahīnaśca kuryānmāṅgalyasevanam || 136 ||
meaning:
एवं कृत्वा नृपः पश्चात् त्रिरात्रं संयतो भवेत् |
मांसमैथुनहीनश्च कुर्यान्माङ्गल्यसेवनम् || 136 ||
text_mt: Having done this, the king should subsequently remain self-restrained for three nights; / refraining from meat and sexual intercourse, he should perform auspicious practices.

sanskrit_iast:
puṣyanakṣatrayuktā tu tṛtīyā yadi labhyate |
tasyāṃ pūjyā sadā devī caṇḍikā śaṃkareṇa ha || 137 ||
meaning:
पुष्यनक्षत्रयुक्ता तु तृतीया यदि लभ्यते |
तस्यां पूज्या सदा देवी चण्डिका शंकरेण ह || 137 ||
text_mt: If the third lunar day is conjoined with the constellation Puṣya, / on that day the goddess Caṇḍikā should always be worshipped together with Śaṅkara.

sanskrit_iast:
pāñcālikāvihārādyaiḥ śiśūnāṃ kautukaistathā |
vaivāhikena vidhinā mohayeccaṇḍikāṃ śivām || 138 ||
meaning:
पाञ्चालिकाविहाराद्यैः शिशूनां कौतुकैस्तथा |
वैवाहिकेन विधिना मोहयेच्चण्डिकां शिवाम् || 138 ||
text_mt: With the play of dolls and the joyful sports of children, / and with the rites of marriage, one should delight Caṇḍikā, who is Śivā.

sanskrit_iast:
catuṣpatheṣu sarveṣu devadevīgaheṣu ca |
patākābhiralaṃ kuryādevaṃ kurvanna sīdati || 139 ||
meaning:
चतुष्पथेषु सर्वेषु देवदेवीगहेषु च |
पताकाभिरलं कुर्यादेवं कुर्वन्न सीदति || 139 ||
text_mt: At all crossroads and in the temples of gods and goddesses, / he should decorate with flags; doing so, he never suffers distress.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ kṛtvā śāntiyāgaṃ tathā puṣyābhiṣecanam |
caturaṅgaiḥ samaṃ rājā bhāryabhistu naraiḥ saha || 140 ||
meaning:
एवं कृत्वा शान्तियागं तथा पुष्याभिषेचनम् |
चतुरङ्गैः समं राजा भार्यभिस्तु नरैः सह || 140 ||
text_mt: Having thus performed the pacificatory sacrifice and the Puṣya-consecration, / the king, together with his fourfold army, his wives, and his men,

sanskrit_iast:
rājyamaṇḍalasaṃyuktaḥ paratreha na sīdati |
nātaḥ parataro yajño nātaḥ paratarotsavaḥ || 141 ||
meaning:
राज्यमण्डलसंयुक्तः परत्रेह न सीदति |
नातः परतरो यज्ञो नातः परतरोत्सवः || 141 ||
text_mt: joined with the circle of his kingdom, does not suffer in the next world or in this. / There is no sacrifice higher than this; there is no festival higher than this;

sanskrit_iast:
nātaḥ paratarā śāntirnātaḥ parataraṃ śivam |
anenaiva vidhānena nṛpaterabhiṣecanam || 142 ||
meaning:
नातः परतरा शान्तिर्नातः परतरं शिवम् |
अनेनैव विधानेन नृपतेरभिषेचनम् || 142 ||
text_mt: there is no appeasement higher than this; there is no welfare higher than this. / Following this very rite, the royal priest should perform

sanskrit_iast:
yuvarājyābhiṣekaṃ ca kuryādrājapurohitaḥ |
nṛpābhiṣekakaraṇamādau yadi samācaret || 143 ||
meaning:
युवराज्याभिषेकं च कुर्याद्राजपुरोहितः |
नृपाभिषेककरणमादौ यदि समाचरेत् || 143 ||
text_mt: the consecration of a king and the consecration to heir-apparency. / If one performs the king's consecration at the outset

sanskrit_iast:
anenaiva vidhānena sthiraḥ syānnṛpatistadā |
ayaṃ yajñaḥ samuddiṣṭaḥ śakrārthaṃ brahmaṇā purā |
evaṃ yajñaṃ nṛpaḥ kṛtvā paratreha na sīdati || 144 ||
meaning:
अनेनैव विधानेन स्थिरः स्यान्नृपतिस्तदा |
अयं यज्ञः समुद्दिष्टः शक्रार्थं ब्रह्मणा पुरा |
एवं यज्ञं नृपः कृत्वा परत्रेह न सीदति || 144 ||
text_mt: by this very rite, then the king becomes established. / This sacrifice was ordained of old by Brahmā for the sake of Indra; / having performed such a sacrifice, a king does not suffer in this world or the next.

sanskrit_iast: iti śrīkālikāpurāṇe ṣaḍaśītitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 86 ||
meaning: इति श्रीकालिकापुराणे षडशीतितमोऽध्यायः || 86 ||
text_mt: Thus ends the eighty-sixth chapter in the glorious Kālikāpurāṇa.

sanskrit_iast: saptāśītitamo'dhyāyaḥ
meaning: सप्ताशीतितमोऽध्यायः
text_mt: Eighty-seventh Chapter

sanskrit_iast: aurva uvāca -
meaning: और्व उवाच -

sanskrit_iast:
athātaḥ śṛṇu rājendra śakotthānaṃ dhvajotsavam |
yat kṛtvā nṛpatiryāti na kadācit parābhavam || 1 ||
meaning:
अथातः शृणु राजेन्द्र शकोत्थानं ध्वजोत्सवम् |
यत् कृत्वा नृपतिर्याति न कदाचित् पराभवम् || 1 ||
text_mt: Now hear, O king of kings, the raising of Indra's staff and the flag festival, / having performed which a king never meets with defeat.

sanskrit_iast:
ravau haristhe dvādaśyāṃ śravaṇena viḍaujasam |
arādhayennapaḥ samyak sarvavighnopaśāntaye || 2 ||
meaning:
रवौ हरिस्थे द्वादश्यां श्रवणेन विडौजसम् |
अराधयेन्नपः सम्यक् सर्वविघ्नोपशान्तये || 2 ||
text_mt: When the sun is in Leo, on the twelfth lunar day with Śravaṇa, / the king should worship Indra properly for the pacification of all obstacles.

sanskrit_iast:
rājoparircaro nāma vasunāmāparastu yaḥ |
nṛpastenāyamatulo yajñaḥ prāvartitaḥ purā || 3 ||
meaning:
राजोपरिर्चरो नाम वसुनामापरस्तु यः |
नृपस्तेनायमतुलो यज्ञः प्रावर्तितः पुरा || 3 ||
text_mt: The king named Uparicara, who was also named Vasu— / by that king this peerless sacrifice was instituted in ancient times.

sanskrit_iast:
prāvṛṭkāle ca nabhasi dvādaśyāmasitetare |
purāhito vahuvidhairvādyastūryaiḥ samanvitaḥ || 4 ||
meaning:
प्रावृट्काले च नभसि द्वादश्यामसितेतरे |
पुराहितो वहुविधैर्वाद्यस्तूर्यैः समन्वितः || 4 ||
text_mt: In the rainy season, in the month of Nabhas, on the bright twelfth lunar day, / the royal priest, accompanied by various musical instruments and trumpets,

sanskrit_iast:
prathamaṃ śakaketvartha vṛkṣamāmantrya vardhayet |
āṃvatsaro vārdhaṃkiśca kṛtamaṅgalakautukaḥ || 5 ||
meaning:
प्रथमं शककेत्वर्थ वृक्षमामन्त्र्य वर्धयेत् |
आंवत्सरो वार्धंकिश्च कृतमङ्गलकौतुकः || 5 ||
text_mt: First, for the purpose of Śakra's banner, the astrologer and the carpenter, / having performed auspicious rites, should address and fell a tree.

sanskrit_iast:
udyāne devatāgāre śmaśāne mārgamadhyataḥ |
ye jātāstaravastāṃstu varjayed vāsavadhvaje || 6 ||
meaning:
उद्याने देवतागारे श्मशाने मार्गमध्यतः |
ये जातास्तरवस्तांस्तु वर्जयेद् वासवध्वजे || 6 ||
text_mt: Trees grown in a pleasure garden, a temple, a cremation ground, or the middle of a road / must be avoided for Vāsava's banner.

sanskrit_iast:
bahuvallīyutaṃ śuṣkaṃ bahukaṇṭakasaṃyutam |
kubjaṃ vṛkṣādanīyuktaṃ latācchannataruaṃ tyajet || 7 ||
meaning:
बहुवल्लीयुतं शुष्कं बहुकण्टकसंयुतम् |
कुब्जं वृक्षादनीयुक्तं लताच्छन्नतरुअं त्यजेत् || 7 ||
text_mt: One should reject a tree covered in many creepers, withered, full of many thorns, / crooked, parasitized by mistletoe, or overgrown with vines.

sanskrit_iast:
pakṣivāsasamākīrṇaṃ koṭarairbahubhiryutam |
pavanānalavidhvastaṃ taruṃ yatnena varjayet || 8 ||
meaning:
पक्षिवाससमाकीर्णं कोटरैर्बहुभिर्युतम् |
पवनानलविध्वस्तं तरुं यत्नेन वर्जयेत् || 8 ||
text_mt: One should diligently avoid a tree filled with birds' nests, / having many hollows, or damaged by wind and fire.

sanskrit_iast:
nārīsaṃjñāśca ye vṛkṣā atihrasvā atikṛśāḥ |
tān sadā varjayed dhīraḥ sarvadā śakrapūjane || 9 ||
meaning:
नारीसंज्ञाश्च ये वृक्षा अतिह्रस्वा अतिकृशाः |
तान् सदा वर्जयेद् धीरः सर्वदा शक्रपूजने || 9 ||
text_mt: And trees with feminine names, very short ones, and very thin ones: / the wise man should always avoid them in the worship of Śakra.

sanskrit_iast:
arjuno'pyaśvakarṇaśca vaṭaḥ priyakoṣaka śca |
audumbaraśca paṃcaite ketvarthe hyuttamāḥ smṛtāḥ || 10 ||
meaning:
अर्जुनोऽप्यश्वकर्णश्च वटः प्रियकोषक श्च |
औदुम्बरश्च पंचैते केत्वर्थे ह्युत्तमाः स्मृताः || 10 ||
text_mt: The arjuna, the aśvakarṇa, the banyan, the priyaka, / and the audumbara—these five are traditionally considered best for the banner.

sanskrit_iast:
anye ca devadārvādyāḥ śālādyāstaravastathā |
praśastāstu parigrāhyā nāpraśastāḥ kadācana || 11 ||
meaning:
अन्ये च देवदार्वाद्याः शालाद्यास्तरवस्तथा |
प्रशस्तास्तु परिग्राह्या नाप्रशस्ताः कदाचन || 11 ||
text_mt: Other trees, such as the devadāru and the śāla, / if commendable, should be taken; uncommendable ones must never be taken.

sanskrit_iast:
dhṛtvā vṛkṣaṃ tato rātrau spṛṣṭvā mantramimaṃ paṭhet |
yāni vṛkṣeṣu bhūtāni tebhyaḥ svasti namo'stu vaḥ || 12 ||
meaning:
धृत्वा वृक्षं ततो रात्रौ स्पृष्ट्वा मन्त्रमिमं पठेत् |
यानि वृक्षेषु भूतानि तेभ्यः स्वस्ति नमोऽस्तु वः || 12 ||
text_mt: Then, having approached the tree at night and touched it, he should recite this mantra: / 'Whatever spirits reside in trees, hail to them; homage be to you!

sanskrit_iast:
upahāraṃ gṛhītvemaṃ kriyatāṃ vāsavadhvajam |
pārthivastvāṃ varayate svasti te'stu nagottama || 13 ||
meaning:
उपहारं गृहीत्वेमं क्रियतां वासवध्वजम् |
पार्थिवस्त्वां वरयते स्वस्ति तेऽस्तु नगोत्तम || 13 ||
text_mt: Accepting this offering, let Vāsava's banner be made! / The king chooses you; may hail be to you, best of trees!

sanskrit_iast:
dhvajārthaṃ devarājasya pūjeyaṃ pratigṛhyatām |
tato'pare'hni taṃ chittvā mūlamaṣṭāṃgulaṃ punaḥ || 14 ||
meaning:
ध्वजार्थं देवराजस्य पूजेयं प्रतिगृह्यताम् |
ततोऽपरेऽह्नि तं छित्त्वा मूलमष्टांगुलं पुनः || 14 ||
text_mt: May this worship be accepted for the banner of the king of gods!' / Then, having felled it on the following day, cutting eight aṅgulas again from the base,

sanskrit_iast:
jale kṣipet tathāgrasya chitvaiva caturaṅgulam |
tato nītvā puradvāraṃ ketuṃ nirmāya tatra vai || 15 ||
meaning:
जले क्षिपेत् तथाग्रस्य छित्वैव चतुरङ्गुलम् |
ततो नीत्वा पुरद्वारं केतुं निर्माय तत्र वै || 15 ||
text_mt: he should throw it into water, having cut four aṅgulas from the tip as well. / Then, bringing it to the city gate and fashioning the banner there,

sanskrit_iast:
śuklāṣṭamyāṃ bhādrapade ketuṃ vedīṃ praveśayet |
dvāviṃśaddhastamānastu adhamaḥ keturucyate || 16 ||
meaning:
शुक्लाष्टम्यां भाद्रपदे केतुं वेदीं प्रवेशयेत् |
द्वाविंशद्धस्तमानस्तु अधमः केतुरुच्यते || 16 ||
text_mt: he should bring the banner to the sacrificial altar on the bright eighth of Bhādrapada. / A banner measuring twenty-two cubits is called the lowest;

sanskrit_iast:
dvātriṃśat tu tato jyāyān dvācatvāriṃśadeva ca |
tato'dhikaḥ samākhyāto dvāpañcāśat tathottamaḥ || 17 ||
meaning:
द्वात्रिंशत् तु ततो ज्यायान् द्वाचत्वारिंशदेव च |
ततोऽधिकः समाख्यातो द्वापञ्चाशत् तथोत्तमः || 17 ||
text_mt: thirty-two cubits is superior to that; forty-two cubits / is declared greater than that; and fifty-two cubits is the best.

sanskrit_iast:
kumāryaḥ pañca kartavyāḥ śakrasya nṛpasattama |
śalamayyastu tāḥ sarvā aparāḥ śakramātṛkāḥ || 18 ||
meaning:
कुमार्यः पञ्च कर्तव्याः शक्रस्य नृपसत्तम |
शलमय्यस्तु ताः सर्वा अपराः शक्रमातृकाः || 18 ||
text_mt: Five maidens should be made for Śakra, O best of kings, / all fashioned of śāla wood; and other figures called the Mothers of Śakra.

sanskrit_iast:
ketoḥ pādapramāṇena kāryāḥ śakrakumārikāḥ |
mātṛkārdhapramāṇāstu yantraṃ hastadvayaṃ tathā || 19 ||
meaning:
केतोः पादप्रमाणेन कार्याः शक्रकुमारिकाः |
मातृकार्धप्रमाणास्तु यन्त्रं हस्तद्वयं तथा || 19 ||
text_mt: The maidens of Śakra should be made one-fourth the size of the banner, / the Mothers half that size, and the mechanism two cubits.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ kṛtvā kumārīśca mātṛkāḥ ketumeva ca |
ekādaśyāṃ site pakṣe yaṣṭiṃ tāmadhivāsayet || 20 ||
meaning:
एवं कृत्वा कुमारीश्च मातृकाः केतुमेव च |
एकादश्यां सिते पक्षे यष्टिं तामधिवासयेत् || 20 ||
text_mt: Having thus made the maidens, the Mothers, and the banner itself, / he should consecrate that pole on the eleventh day of the bright fortnight.

sanskrit_iast:
adhivāsya tato yaṣṭiṃ gandhadvārādimantrakaiḥ |
dvādaśyāṃ maṇḍalaṃ kṛtvā vāsavaṃ vistṛtātmakam || 21 ||
meaning:
अधिवास्य ततो यष्टिं गन्धद्वारादिमन्त्रकैः |
द्वादश्यां मण्डलं कृत्वा वासवं विस्तृतात्मकम् || 21 ||
text_mt: Having then consecrated the pole with the mantras beginning with 'Gandhadvārā,' / and having drawn an extensive diagram of Vāsava on the twelfth,

sanskrit_iast:
acyutaṃ pūjayitvā tu śakraṃ paścāt prapūjayet |
śakrasya pratimāṃ kuryāt kāñcanīṃ dākhīṃ ca vā || 22 ||
meaning:
अच्युतं पूजयित्वा तु शक्रं पश्चात् प्रपूजयेत् |
शक्रस्य प्रतिमां कुर्यात् काञ्चनीं दाखीं च वा || 22 ||
text_mt: he should first worship Acyuta and then worship Śakra. / He should make an image of Śakra out of gold or wood,

sanskrit_iast:
anyataijasasambhūtāṃ sarvābhāve tu mṛnmayīm |
tāṃ maṇḍalasya madhye tu pūjayitvā viśeṣataḥ || 23 ||
meaning:
अन्यतैजससम्भूतां सर्वाभावे तु मृन्मयीम् |
तां मण्डलस्य मध्ये तु पूजयित्वा विशेषतः || 23 ||
text_mt: or produced from another metal, or of clay if none of these are available. / Having worshipped it especially in the center of the diagram,

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ śubhe muhūrte tu ketumutthāpayennṛpaḥ |
vajrahasta surārughna bahunetra purandara |
kṣemārthaṃ sarvalokānāṃ pūjeyaṃ pratigṛhyatām || 24 ||
meaning:
ततः शुभे मुहूर्ते तु केतुमुत्थापयेन्नृपः |
वज्रहस्त सुरारुघ्न बहुनेत्र पुरन्दर |
क्षेमार्थं सर्वलोकानां पूजेयं प्रतिगृह्यताम् || 24 ||
text_mt: the king should then raise the banner at an auspicious moment: / 'O holder of the thunderbolt, destroyer of the enemies of gods, thousand-eyed Purandara! / May this worship be accepted for the welfare of all the worlds.

sanskrit_iast:
ehyehi sarvāmarasiddhasaṅghairabhiṣṭuto vajradharāmareśa |
samutthitastvaṃ śravaṇādyapāde gṛhāṇa pūjāṃ bhagavannamaste || 25 ||
meaning:
एह्येहि सर्वामरसिद्धसङ्घैरभिष्टुतो वज्रधरामरेश |
समुत्थितस्त्वं श्रवणाद्यपादे गृहाण पूजां भगवन्नमस्ते || 25 ||
text_mt: Come, come, O thunderbolt-wielder praised by all assemblies of gods and siddhas, lord of immortals! / Raised during the first quarter of Śravaṇā, accept the worship, O Blessed One; homage to you!'

sanskrit_iast:
evamuttaratantroktairdahanaplavanādibhiḥ |
iti mantreṇa tantreṇa nānāmaivedyavedanaiḥ || 26 ||
meaning:
एवमुत्तरतन्त्रोक्तैर्दहनप्लवनादिभिः |
इति मन्त्रेण तन्त्रेण नानामैवेद्यवेदनैः || 26 ||
text_mt: Thus, with burning, flooding, and so forth as prescribed in the higher tantra, / with this mantra and ritual procedure, with announcements of various offerings,

sanskrit_iast:
apapaiḥ pāyasaiḥ pānairguḍairdhānābhireva ca |
bhakṣyairbhojyaiśca vividhaiḥ pūjayecchrīvivṛddhaye || 27 ||
meaning:
अपपैः पायसैः पानैर्गुडैर्धानाभिरेव च |
भक्ष्यैर्भोज्यैश्च विविधैः पूजयेच्छ्रीविवृद्धये || 27 ||
text_mt: with cakes, milk-rice, drinks, jaggery, parched grains, / and various kinds of edible foods, he should worship for the increase of prosperity.

sanskrit_iast:
ghaṭe tu daśadikpālān grahāṃśca paripūjayet |
sādhyādīn sakalān devān mātṛḥ sarvā anukramāt || 28 ||
meaning:
घटे तु दशदिक्पालान् ग्रहांश्च परिपूजयेत् |
साध्यादीन् सकलान् देवान् मातृः सर्वा अनुक्रमात् || 28 ||
text_mt: In a pot he should worship the guardians of the ten directions and the planets, / all the gods such as the Sādhyas, and all the Mothers in order.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ śubhe muhūrte tu jñānivardhakisaṃyutaḥ |
ketūtthāpanabhūmiṃ tu yajñavedyāstu paścime || 29 ||
meaning:
ततः शुभे मुहूर्ते तु ज्ञानिवर्धकिसंयुतः |
केतूत्थापनभूमिं तु यज्ञवेद्यास्तु पश्चिमे || 29 ||
text_mt: Then, at an auspicious moment, accompanied by wise men and carpenters, / to the ground for raising the banner to the west of the sacrificial altar,

sanskrit_iast:
vipraiḥ purohitaiḥ sārdhaṃ gacchedrājā sumaṃgalaiḥ |
rajjubhiḥ paṃcabhirbaddhaṃ yantraśliṣṭaṃ samātṛkam || 30 ||
meaning:
विप्रैः पुरोहितैः सार्धं गच्छेद्राजा सुमंगलैः |
रज्जुभिः पंचभिर्बद्धं यन्त्रश्लिष्टं समातृकम् || 30 ||
text_mt: the king should go together with brāhmaṇas and priests, amidst auspicious omens. / Bound with five ropes, fitted with the mechanism, accompanied by the Mothers,

sanskrit_iast:
kumārībhistu saṃyuktaṃ dikpālānāṃ ca paṭṭakaiḥ |
bṛhadbhiratikāntaiśca nānādravyaiḥ supūritaiḥ || 31 ||
meaning:
कुमारीभिस्तु संयुक्तं दिक्पालानां च पट्टकैः |
बृहद्भिरतिकान्तैश्च नानाद्रव्यैः सुपूरितैः || 31 ||
text_mt: joined with the maidens, and [bearing] the banners of the guardians of the directions, / large, exceedingly lovely, and fully stocked with various articles,

sanskrit_iast:
yathāvarṇairyathādeśe yojitairvastraveṣṭitaiḥ |
yuktaṃ taṃ kiṅkiṇījālairbṛhadghaṇṭaughacāmarai || 32 ||
meaning:
यथावर्णैर्यथादेशे योजितैर्वस्त्रवेष्टितैः |
युक्तं तं किङ्किणीजालैर्बृहद्घण्टौघचामरै || 32 ||
text_mt: arranged according to their colors in their proper places, wrapped with cloth, / fitted with clusters of small bells, heaps of large bells, and fly-whisks,

sanskrit_iast:
bhūṣitaṃ mukurairucciarmālyairbahuvidhaistathā |
bahupuṣpaiḥ sugandhaiśca bhūṣitaṃ ratnamālayā || 33 ||
meaning:
भूषितं मुकुरैरुच्चिअर्माल्यैर्बहुविधैस्तथा |
बहुपुष्पैः सुगन्धैश्च भूषितं रत्नमालया || 33 ||
text_mt: adorned with mirrors on high, and likewise with various kinds of garlands, / with many fragrant flowers, and adorned with a string of jewels,

sanskrit_iast:
citamālyāmbaraiścaiva caturbhirapi toraṇaiḥ |
utthāpayenmahāketuṃ rājakīyai śanaiḥ śanaiḥ || 34 ||
meaning:
चितमाल्याम्बरैश्चैव चतुर्भिरपि तोरणैः |
उत्थापयेन्महाकेतुं राजकीयै शनैः शनैः || 34 ||
text_mt: and with four archways hung with varied garlands and cloths, / the royal attendants should raise the great banner very slowly.

sanskrit_iast:
tamutthāya mahāketuṃ pūjitaṃ maṇḍalāntare |
pratimāṃ tāṃ nayenmūlaṃ ketoḥ śakraṃ vicintayan || 35 ||
meaning:
तमुत्थाय महाकेतुं पूजितं मण्डलान्तरे |
प्रतिमां तां नयेन्मूलं केतोः शक्रं विचिन्तयन् || 35 ||
text_mt: Having raised that great banner worshipped in the center of the diagram, / he should bring that image to the base of the banner, meditating upon Śakra.

sanskrit_iast:
yajet taṃ pūrvavat tatra śacīṃ mātalimeva ca |
jayantaṃ tanayaṃ tasya vajramairāvataṃ tathā || 36 ||
meaning:
यजेत् तं पूर्ववत् तत्र शचीं मातलिमेव च |
जयन्तं तनयं तस्य वज्रमैरावतं तथा || 36 ||
text_mt: He should worship him there as before, and Śacī, and Mātali, / and his son Jayanta, as well as the thunderbolt and Airāvata,

sanskrit_iast:
grahāṃścāpyatha dikpālān sarvāśca gaṇadevatāḥ |
apūpādyaiḥ pūtayet tu valibhiḥ pāyasādibhiḥ || 37 ||
meaning:
ग्रहांश्चाप्यथ दिक्पालान् सर्वाश्च गणदेवताः |
अपूपाद्यैः पूतयेत् तु वलिभिः पायसादिभिः || 37 ||
text_mt: and the planets, the guardians of the directions, and all the host-deities; / he should purify them with cakes, offerings, milk-rice, and the like.

sanskrit_iast:
pūjitānāṃ ca devānāṃ śaśvaddhomaṃ samācaret |
homānte tu baliṃ dadyād vāsavāya mahātmane || 38 ||
meaning:
पूजितानां च देवानां शश्वद्धोमं समाचरेत् |
होमान्ते तु बलिं दद्याद् वासवाय महात्मने || 38 ||
text_mt: He should continuously perform oblations for the worshipped deities; / at the end of the oblation he should offer a tribute to the great-souled Vāsava.

sanskrit_iast:
tilaṃ ghṛtaṃ cākṣataṃ ca pūṣpaṃ dūrvāṃ tathaiva ca |
etaistu juhuyād devān svaiḥ svairmantrairnarottama || 39 ||
meaning:
तिलं घृतं चाक्षतं च पूष्पं दूर्वां तथैव च |
एतैस्तु जुहुयाद् देवान् स्वैः स्वैर्मन्त्रैर्नरोत्तम || 39 ||
text_mt: With sesamum, clarified butter, unbroken rice, flowers, and dūrvā grass— / with these he should make oblations to the deities with their respective mantras, O best of men.

sanskrit_iast:
tato homāvasāne tu bhojayed brāhmaṇānapi |
evaṃ sampūjayennityaṃ saptarātraṃ dine dine || 40 ||
meaning:
ततो होमावसाने तु भोजयेद् ब्राह्मणानपि |
एवं सम्पूजयेन्नित्यं सप्तरात्रं दिने दिने || 40 ||
text_mt: Then, at the conclusion of the oblation, he should feed the brāhmaṇas. / Thus he should worship regularly day after day for seven nights.

sanskrit_iast:
brāhmaṇaiḥ sahitā rājā vedavedāṃgapāragaiḥ |
sarvatra śakrapūjāsu yajñesu parikīrtitaḥ || 41 ||
meaning:
ब्राह्मणैः सहिता राजा वेदवेदांगपारगैः |
सर्वत्र शक्रपूजासु यज्ञेसु परिकीर्तितः || 41 ||
text_mt: The king, accompanied by brāhmaṇas who have mastered the Vedas and Vedāṅgas, / is proclaimed in all things regarding the worship and sacrifices of Śakra.

sanskrit_iast: trātāramiti mantro'yaṃ vāsavasya priyaḥ paraḥ |
meaning: त्रातारमिति मन्त्रोऽयं वासवस्य प्रियः परः |
text_mt: The mantra beginning with 'Trātāram' is most dear to Vāsava.

sanskrit_iast: evaṃ kṛtvā divābhāge śakrotthāpanamāditaḥ || 42 ||
meaning: एवं कृत्वा दिवाभागे शक्रोत्थापनमादितः || 42 ||
text_mt: Having thus performed the raising of Śakra during the daytime initially,

sanskrit_iast:
śravaṇarkṣayutāyāṃ tu dvādaśyāṃ pārthivaḥ svayam |
antyapāde bharaṇyāṃ tu niśi śakraṃ visarjayet || 43 ||
meaning:
श्रवणर्क्षयुतायां तु द्वादश्यां पार्थिवः स्वयम् |
अन्त्यपादे भरण्यां तु निशि शक्रं विसर्जयेत् || 43 ||
text_mt: on the twelfth day conjoined with the asterism Śravaṇā, the king himself / should dismiss Śakra at night during the final quarter of Bharaṇī,

sanskrit_iast:
supteṣu sarvalokeṣu yathā rājā na paśyati |
ṣaṇmāsānmṛtyumāpnoti rājā dṛṣṭvā visarjanam || 44 ||
meaning:
सुप्तेषु सर्वलोकेषु यथा राजा न पश्यति |
षण्मासान्मृत्युमाप्नोति राजा दृष्ट्वा विसर्जनम् || 44 ||
text_mt: when all people are asleep, in such a way that the king does not see [it]. / If the king sees the dismissal, he incurs death within six months,

sanskrit_iast:
śakrasya nṛpaśārdūla tasmānnekṣeta tannapaḥ |
visarjanasya mantro'yaṃ purāvidbhirudīritaḥ || 45 ||
meaning:
शक्रस्य नृपशार्दूल तस्मान्नेक्षेत तन्नपः |
विसर्जनस्य मन्त्रोऽयं पुराविद्भिरुदीरितः || 45 ||
text_mt: O tiger among kings, on account of Śakra; therefore, the king must not look at it. / This mantra for the dismissal has been uttered by knowers of ancient lore:

sanskrit_iast:
sārdhaṃ surāsuragaṇaiḥ purandara śatakrato |
upahāraṃ gṛhītvema mahendradhvaja gamyatām || 46 ||
meaning:
सार्धं सुरासुरगणैः पुरन्दर शतक्रतो |
उपहारं गृहीत्वेम महेन्द्रध्वज गम्यताम् || 46 ||
text_mt: 'Together with the hosts of gods and asuras, O Purandara, O Śatakratu, / accepting this offering, depart, O banner of Mahendra!'

sanskrit_iast:
sūtake tu samutpanne vāre bhaumasya vā śanaiḥ |
bhūmikampādikotpāte vāsavaṃ na visarjayet || 47 ||
meaning:
सूतके तु समुत्पन्ने वारे भौमस्य वा शनैः |
भूमिकम्पादिकोत्पाते वासवं न विसर्जयेत् || 47 ||
text_mt: If ritual impurity of birth has arisen, or on a Tuesday or a Saturday, / or when an earthquake or similar portent occurs, he should not dismiss Vāsava.

sanskrit_iast:
utpāte saptarātraṃ tu tathopaplavadarśane |
vyatītya śanibhaumau ca hyanyarkṣe'pi visarjayet || 48 ||
meaning:
उत्पाते सप्तरात्रं तु तथोपप्लवदर्शने |
व्यतीत्य शनिभौमौ च ह्यन्यर्क्षेऽपि विसर्जयेत् || 48 ||
text_mt: In the case of a portent, for seven nights, or likewise upon seeing a calamity; / passing over Saturday and Tuesday, he should dismiss [him] even under another asterism.

sanskrit_iast:
sūtake tvatha saṃprāpte vyatīte sūtake punaḥ |
yasmin tasmin dne caiva sūtakānte visarjayet || 49 ||
meaning:
सूतके त्वथ संप्राप्ते व्यतीते सूतके पुनः |
यस्मिन् तस्मिन् द्ने चैव सूतकान्ते विसर्जयेत् || 49 ||
text_mt: When birth-impurity occurs, after the birth-impurity has passed, / on whatever day it may be at the end of the birth-impurity, he should dismiss [the banner].

sanskrit_iast:
tathā ketuṃ nṛpo rakṣet patanti śakunā yathā |
na ketau nṛpaśārdūla yāvannahi visarjanam || 50 ||
meaning:
तथा केतुं नृपो रक्षेत् पतन्ति शकुना यथा |
न केतौ नृपशार्दूल यावन्नहि विसर्जनम् || 50 ||
text_mt: Likewise, the king should guard the banner, so that birds do not alight / upon the banner, O tiger among kings, until the dismissal.

sanskrit_iast:
śanaiḥ śanaiḥ pātayet tu yathotthāpanamāditaḥ |
kṛtaṃ tathā yathā bhagne ketau mṛtyumavāpnuyāt || 51 ||
meaning:
शनैः शनैः पातयेत् तु यथोत्थापनमादितः |
कृतं तथा यथा भग्ने केतौ मृत्युमवाप्नुयात् || 51 ||
text_mt: He should lower it very slowly, in the same manner as its raising / was originally done; if the banner is broken, he would meet with death.

sanskrit_iast:
visṛṣṭaṃ śakraketuṃ tu sālaṅkāraṃ tathā niśi |
kṣipedanena mantreṇa tvagādhe salile nṛpa || 52 ||
meaning:
विसृष्टं शक्रकेतुं तु सालङ्कारं तथा निशि |
क्षिपेदनेन मन्त्रेण त्वगाधे सलिले नृप || 52 ||
text_mt: At night, with its ornaments, he should cast the dismissed banner of Indra / into deep water, O king, with this mantra:

sanskrit_iast:
tiṣṭha keto mahābhāga yāvat saṃvatsaraṃ jale |
bhavāya sarvalokānāmantarāya vināśaka || 53 ||
meaning:
तिष्ठ केतो महाभाग यावत् संवत्सरं जले |
भवाय सर्वलोकानामन्तराय विनाशक || 53 ||
text_mt: “Remain in the water for a year, O illustrious banner, / for the prosperity of all the worlds, O destroyer of obstacles!”

sanskrit_iast:
utthapayet tūryaravaiḥ sarvalokasya vai puraḥ |
raho visarjayet ketuṃ viśeṣo yaḥ prapūjane || 54 ||
meaning:
उत्थपयेत् तूर्यरवैः सर्वलोकस्य वै पुरः |
रहो विसर्जयेत् केतुं विशेषो यः प्रपूजने || 54 ||
text_mt: One should raise it with the sounds of musical instruments before all the people; / in secret one should dismiss the banner—such is the distinction in its worship.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ yaḥ kurute pūjāṃ vāsavasya mahātmanaḥ |
sa ciraṃ pṛthivīṃ bhuktvā vāsavaṃ lokamāpnuyāt || 55 ||
meaning:
एवं यः कुरुते पूजां वासवस्य महात्मनः |
स चिरं पृथिवीं भुक्त्वा वासवं लोकमाप्नुयात् || 55 ||
text_mt: He who thus performs the worship of the magnanimous Vāsava, / having long enjoyed the earth, attains the world of Vāsava.

sanskrit_iast:
na tasya rājye durbhikṣaṃ nādhayo vyādhayaḥ kvacit |
sthāsyanti mṛtyurnākāle janānāṃ tatra jāyate || 56 ||
meaning:
न तस्य राज्ये दुर्भिक्षं नाधयो व्याधयः क्वचित् |
स्थास्यन्ति मृत्युर्नाकाले जनानां तत्र जायते || 56 ||
text_mt: In his realm, famine, mental afflictions, and diseases will never / abide anywhere, nor does untimely death befall people there.

sanskrit_iast:
tattulyaḥ ko'pi nānyo'sti priyaḥ śakrasya pārthiva |
tasya pūjā sarvapūjā keśavādyāśca tatragāḥ || 57 ||
meaning:
तत्तुल्यः कोऽपि नान्योऽस्ति प्रियः शक्रस्य पार्थिव |
तस्य पूजा सर्वपूजा केशवाद्याश्च तत्रगाः || 57 ||
text_mt: There is no other dear to Indra equal to him, O ruler of the earth; / worship of him is worship of all, and Keśava and the rest are present there.

sanskrit_iast:
sakalakaluṣahāri vyādhidurbhikṣanāśaṃ
sakalabhavaniveśaṃ sarvasaubhāgyakāri |
surapatigṛhagābhirvārcanaṃ śakraketoḥ
pratiśaradamanekaiḥ pūjayecchrīvivṛddhayai || 58 ||
meaning:
सकलकलुषहारि व्याधिदुर्भिक्षनाशं
सकलभवनिवेशं सर्वसौभाग्यकारि |
सुरपतिगृहगाभिर्वार्चनं शक्रकेतोः
प्रतिशरदमनेकैः पूजयेच्छ्रीविवृद्धयै || 58 ||
text_mt: Which removes all defilements, destroys disease and famine, / establishes all homes, and produces all good fortune— / the worship of Indra’s banner along with the women of the king of gods’ abode / should be performed every autumn with many [offerings] for the increase of prosperity.

sanskrit_iast: iti śrīkālikāpurāṇe saptāśītitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 87 ||
meaning: इति श्रीकालिकापुराणे सप्ताशीतितमोऽध्यायः || 87 ||
text_mt: Thus ends the eighty-seventh chapter in the glorious Kālikāpurāṇa.

sanskrit_iast: aṣṭāśītitamo'dhyāyaḥ
meaning: अष्टाशीतितमोऽध्यायः

sanskrit_iast: aurva uvāca -
meaning: और्व उवाच -

sanskrit_iast:
jyeṣṭha daśaharāyāṃ tu viṣṇoriṣṭiṃ nṛpa śṛṇu | yena vā vidhinā
kuryādiṣṭiṃ viṣnornṛpaḥ sadā || 1 ||
meaning:
ज्येष्ठ दशहरायां तु विष्णोरिष्टिं नृप शृणु | येन वा विधिना
कुर्यादिष्टिं विष्नोर्नृपः सदा || 1 ||
text_mt: Hear now, O king, of the sacrifice to Viṣṇu on the Daśaharā of Jyeṣṭha, / by which rite the king should always perform the sacrifice to Viṣṇu.

sanskrit_iast:
pratyabdaṃ pārthivaḥ kuryāt pratimāṃ kāñcanīṃ hareḥ |
anyatejīmayīṃ vāpi dāravīṃ vā śilāmayīm || 2 ||
meaning:
प्रत्यब्दं पार्थिवः कुर्यात् प्रतिमां काञ्चनीं हरेः |
अन्यतेजीमयीं वापि दारवीं वा शिलामयीम् || 2 ||
text_mt: Every year the ruler of the earth should make an image of Hari out of gold, / or composed of other metals, or made of wood, or of stone.

sanskrit_iast:
tāṃ pratiṣṭhāpya vidhinā mānonmānaistu śilpibhiḥ |
pratiṣṭhāṃ vidhivat tasyāḥ kuryād vipraiḥ purohitaiḥ || 3 ||
meaning:
तां प्रतिष्ठाप्य विधिना मानोन्मानैस्तु शिल्पिभिः |
प्रतिष्ठां विधिवत् तस्याः कुर्याद् विप्रैः पुरोहितैः || 3 ||
text_mt: Having fashioned it according to rule with proportions and measurements by artisans, / he should perform its consecration according to rule through brāhmaṇas and royal priests.

sanskrit_iast:
tāṃ saṃsthāpya surāgāre svayaṃ vā yatnataḥ kṛte |
vāsudevasya bījena pūrvoktavidhinā tathā || 4 ||
meaning:
तां संस्थाप्य सुरागारे स्वयं वा यत्नतः कृते |
वासुदेवस्य बीजेन पूर्वोक्तविधिना तथा || 4 ||
text_mt: Having installed it in a temple of the gods or one made by himself with effort, / with the seed-syllable of Vāsudeva according to the previously stated rule,

sanskrit_iast:
sarvopacārairbhaktyā nu vāsudevaṃ prapūjayet |
pūjānte saṃskṛte vahnau kuṇḍamadhye sthito dvijaḥ || 5 ||
meaning:
सर्वोपचारैर्भक्त्या नु वासुदेवं प्रपूजयेत् |
पूजान्ते संस्कृते वह्नौ कुण्डमध्ये स्थितो द्विजः || 5 ||
text_mt: he should indeed worship Vāsudeva with devotion with all offerings. / At the end of the worship, standing within the hearth beside the consecrated fire, the twice-born

sanskrit_iast:
ājyaiḥ sahasraṃ juhuyādāhutīnāṃ hareḥ priyam |
saṃpūjya vāsudevaṃ tu homaṃ kṛtvā tato dvijaḥ || 6 ||
meaning:
आज्यैः सहस्रं जुहुयादाहुतीनां हरेः प्रियम् |
संपूज्य वासुदेवं तु होमं कृत्वा ततो द्विजः || 6 ||
text_mt: should offer a thousand oblations with clarified butter, dear to Hari. / Having worshipped Vāsudeva and then made the fire-offering, the twice-born,

sanskrit_iast:
nṛpasyānumate tāṃ tu pratimāṃ maṇḍalaṃ nayet |
pratimāyāḥ kapolau dvau spṛṣṭvā dakṣiṇapāṇinā || 7 ||
meaning:
नृपस्यानुमते तां तु प्रतिमां मण्डलं नयेत् |
प्रतिमायाः कपोलौ द्वौ स्पृष्ट्वा दक्षिणपाणिना || 7 ||
text_mt: with the king’s permission, should bring that image to the maṇḍala. / Touching the two cheeks of the image with his right hand,

sanskrit_iast:
prāṇapratiṣṭhāṃ kurvīta tasyāṃ devasya vai hareḥ |
kṛtāyāṃ tu pratiṣṭhāyāṃ prāṇānāṃ nṛpasattama || 8 ||
meaning:
प्राणप्रतिष्ठां कुर्वीत तस्यां देवस्य वै हरेः |
कृतायां तु प्रतिष्ठायां प्राणानां नृपसत्तम || 8 ||
text_mt: he should perform the installation of the breath of the god Hari in it. / When the installation of the vital breaths has been performed, O best of kings,

sanskrit_iast:
viṣṇuprāṇāstāṃ pratimāmāyānti niyataṃ svayam |
prāṇeṣvathāgateṣvasyāṃ devatvaṃ niyataṃ bhavet || 9 ||
meaning:
विष्णुप्राणास्तां प्रतिमामायान्ति नियतं स्वयम् |
प्राणेष्वथागतेष्वस्यां देवत्वं नियतं भवेत् || 9 ||
text_mt: the vital breaths of Viṣṇu certainly come of themselves to that image; / and when the vital breaths have entered into it, divinity certainly arises.

sanskrit_iast:
akṛtāyāṃ pratiṣṭhāyāṃ prāṇānāṃ pratimāsu ca |
yathāpūrvaṃ tathābhāvaḥ svarṇādīnāṃ na viṣṇutā || 10 ||
meaning:
अकृतायां प्रतिष्ठायां प्राणानां प्रतिमासु च |
यथापूर्वं तथाभावः स्वर्णादीनां न विष्णुता || 10 ||
text_mt: If the installation of the vital breaths is not performed in the images, / the gold and other materials remain just as before, not the state of being Viṣṇu.

sanskrit_iast:
anyeṣāmapi devānāṃ pratimāsvapi pārthiva |
prāṇapratiṣṭhā kartavyā tasyā devatvasiddhaye || 11 ||
meaning:
अन्येषामपि देवानां प्रतिमास्वपि पार्थिव |
प्राणप्रतिष्ठा कर्तव्या तस्या देवत्वसिद्धये || 11 ||
text_mt: In the images of other gods as well, O ruler of the earth, / the installation of the vital breaths must be performed for the accomplishment of their divinity.

sanskrit_iast:
suvarṇaṃ tu suvarṇaṃ syācchilā dāru tathā śilā |
anyacca svasvarūpaṃ syāt prāṇasthānamṛte sadā || 12 ||
meaning:
सुवर्णं तु सुवर्णं स्याच्छिला दारु तथा शिला |
अन्यच्च स्वस्वरूपं स्यात् प्राणस्थानमृते सदा || 12 ||
text_mt: Gold would just be gold, stone [and] wood [would just be] stone, / and other things would remain in their own nature, always without the abode of the vital breaths.

sanskrit_iast:
vāsudevasya bījena tad viṣṇorityanena ca |
tathaivāṅgāṅgimantrābhyāṃ pratiṣṭhāmācareddhareḥ || 13 ||
meaning:
वासुदेवस्य बीजेन तद् विष्णोरित्यनेन च |
तथैवाङ्गाङ्गिमन्त्राभ्यां प्रतिष्ठामाचरेद्धरेः || 13 ||
text_mt: With the seed-syllable of Vāsudeva and with [the verse] "tad viṣṇoḥ [paramam padam]", / and likewise with the limb-mantras and the primary mantra, he should perform the consecration of Hari.

sanskrit_iast:
tathaiva hṛdaye'ṅguṣṭhaṃ dattvā śaśvacca mantravit |
ebhirmantraiḥ pratiṣṭhāpya hṛdaye'pi samācaret || 14 ||
meaning:
तथैव हृदयेऽङ्गुष्ठं दत्त्वा शश्वच्च मन्त्रवित् |
एभिर्मन्त्रैः प्रतिष्ठाप्य हृदयेऽपि समाचरेत् || 14 ||
text_mt: Likewise, placing his thumb on the heart, continuously, the knower of mantras, / having established [the deity] with these mantras, should also perform it upon the heart:

sanskrit_iast:
asyai prāṇāḥ pratiṣṭhantu asyai prāṇāḥ kṣarantu yat |
asau devatvasaṃkhyāyai svāheti yajuruccaran || 15 ||
meaning:
अस्यै प्राणाः प्रतिष्ठन्तु अस्यै प्राणाः क्षरन्तु यत् |
असौ देवत्वसंख्यायै स्वाहेति यजुरुच्चरन् || 15 ||
text_mt: “May the vital breaths be established in this; may the vital breaths stream into this, / so that this may be reckoned as divinity, svāhā!”—uttering this yajus-mantra,

sanskrit_iast:
aṅgamantrairaṅgimantrairvaidikairityanena ca |
prāṇapratiṣṭhāṃ sarvatra pratimāsu samācaret || 16 ||
meaning:
अङ्गमन्त्रैरङ्गिमन्त्रैर्वैदिकैरित्यनेन च |
प्राणप्रतिष्ठां सर्वत्र प्रतिमासु समाचरेत् || 16 ||
text_mt: and with the limb-mantras, the primary mantras, and the Vedic mantras, / he should everywhere perform the installation of the vital breaths in images.

sanskrit_iast:
pratimāpūjane kuryādātmanyapi ca mantravit |
prāṇapratiṣṭhāṃ prathamaṃ pūjābhāgaviśuddhaye || 17 ||
meaning:
प्रतिमापूजने कुर्यादात्मन्यपि च मन्त्रवित् |
प्राणप्रतिष्ठां प्रथमं पूजाभागविशुद्धये || 17 ||
text_mt: In the worship of an image, the knower of mantras should first perform / the installation of the vital breaths in himself as well, for the purification of his share in the worship.

sanskrit_iast:
asmin prāṇapratiṣṭhāṃ tu pratimāpūjanādṛte |
na kaścit tu budhaḥ kuryāt kṛtvā mṛtyumavāpnuyāt || 18 ||
meaning:
अस्मिन् प्राणप्रतिष्ठां तु प्रतिमापूजनादृते |
न कश्चित् तु बुधः कुर्यात् कृत्वा मृत्युमवाप्नुयात् || 18 ||
text_mt: Except in the worship of an image, no wise person / should perform the installation of the vital breaths in this [body]; having done so, he would meet with death.

sanskrit_iast:
viṣṇoriṣṭimimāṃ kṛtvā daśamyāṃ pārthivottamaḥ |
tasyāmeva tu pūrṇāyāṃ pratimāṃ sthāpayet tataḥ || 19 ||
meaning:
विष्णोरिष्टिमिमां कृत्वा दशम्यां पार्थिवोत्तमः |
तस्यामेव तु पूर्णायां प्रतिमां स्थापयेत् ततः || 19 ||
text_mt: Having performed this sacrifice to Viṣṇu on the tenth [day], the best of rulers of the earth / should then install the image on that very full [day].

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ daśaharāyāṃ tu kṛtveṣṭiṃ pārthivo hareḥ |
sarvān kāmānavāpnoti nirvighno'pi sa jāyate || 20 ||
meaning:
एवं दशहरायां तु कृत्वेष्टिं पार्थिवो हरेः |
सर्वान् कामानवाप्नोति निर्विघ्नोऽपि स जायते || 20 ||
text_mt: Having thus performed the sacrifice to Hari on Daśaharā, the ruler of the earth / attains all desires, and he becomes free from obstacles.

sanskrit_iast:
śrīpaṃcamyāṃ śriyaṃ devīṃ kundaiḥ saṃpūjayetsadā |
vāsavaṃ gajarājasthamupahāraistathottamaiḥ || 21 ||
meaning:
श्रीपंचम्यां श्रियं देवीं कुन्दैः संपूजयेत्सदा |
वासवं गजराजस्थमुपहारैस्तथोत्तमैः || 21 ||
text_mt: On Śrīpañcamī he should always worship the goddess Śrī with jasmine flowers, / and Vāsava mounted on the king of elephants with excellent offerings.

sanskrit_iast:
lakṣmyāstantraṃ mahāmantraṃ vāsavasya puroditam |
atrāpi pūjane grāhyaṃ maṇḍalādi yathākramam || 22 ||
meaning:
लक्ष्म्यास्तन्त्रं महामन्त्रं वासवस्य पुरोदितम् |
अत्रापि पूजने ग्राह्यं मण्डलादि यथाक्रमम् || 22 ||
text_mt: The tantra of Lakṣmī and the great mantra of Vāsava were stated earlier; / here too, in worship, they are to be adopted along with the maṇḍala and so forth in due order.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ kṛte pūjane tu śrīpaṃcamyāṃ viśeṣataḥ |
śrīyuto nṛpatirbhūyānna śrīhānimavāpnuyāt || 23 ||
meaning:
एवं कृते पूजने तु श्रीपंचम्यां विशेषतः |
श्रीयुतो नृपतिर्भूयान्न श्रीहानिमवाप्नुयात् || 23 ||
text_mt: When worship is thus performed, especially on Śrīpañcamī, / the king becomes endowed with prosperity and does not suffer the loss of prosperity.

sanskrit_iast:
sadācāraviśeṣo'yaṃ kathitastava pārthiva |
niṣedhe tu viśeṣāṃśca śṛṇu yena śriyeṣyate || 24 ||
meaning:
सदाचारविशेषोऽयं कथितस्तव पार्थिव |
निषेधे तु विशेषांश्च शृणु येन श्रियेष्यते || 24 ||
text_mt: This particular good conduct has been declared to you, O ruler of the earth; / hear also the particulars among prohibitions, by which prosperity is desired:

sanskrit_iast:
asaṃpūjya tathā viṣṇuṁ śivamagniṃ purandaram |
adattvā ca tathā dānaṃ na bhuñjīta nṛpaḥ kvacit || 25 ||
meaning:
असंपूज्य तथा विष्णुṁ शिवमग्निं पुरन्दरम् |
अदत्त्वा च तथा दानं न भुञ्जीत नृपः क्वचित् || 25 ||
text_mt: Without having worshipped Viṣṇu, Śiva, Agni, and Purandara, / and without having given gifts, the king should never eat anywhere.

sanskrit_iast:
hāvayedagnihotraṃ tu nityameva purohitaiḥ |
akṛtvā cāgnihotraṃ tu bhuñjannarakamāpnuyāt || 26 ||
meaning:
हावयेदग्निहोत्रं तु नित्यमेव पुरोहितैः |
अकृत्वा चाग्निहोत्रं तु भुञ्जन्नरकमाप्नुयात् || 26 ||
text_mt: He should have the agnihotra offered constantly by royal priests; / eating without having performed the agnihotra, he would go to hell.

sanskrit_iast:
nārakṣite gṛhe rājā ratnadīpavivarjite |
svapet tathā striyā sārdhaṃ na kadācana saṃviśet || 20 ||
meaning:
नारक्षिते गृहे राजा रत्नदीपविवर्जिते |
स्वपेत् तथा स्त्रिया सार्धं न कदाचन संविशेत् || 20 ||
text_mt: In an unguarded room, devoid of jewel-lamps, the king / should not sleep, nor should he ever lie down with a woman [there].

sanskrit_iast:
bhuktvānnaṃ śrīphalaṃ nādyāt tathā dhātrīphalaṃ nṛpaḥ |
buddhikṣayakarā hyetā māṣa āsavamṛttikāḥ || 28 ||
meaning:
भुक्त्वान्नं श्रीफलं नाद्यात् तथा धात्रीफलं नृपः |
बुद्धिक्षयकरा ह्येता माष आसवमृत्तिकाः || 28 ||
text_mt: Having eaten food, the king should not eat wood-apple or emblic myrobalan; / for these cause the decay of intellect: black gram, fermented liquor, and clay.

sanskrit_iast:
nimbāṭarūṣacyutāśca buddhivṛddhikarā matāḥ |
buddhikṣayakarān nityaṃ tvajedrājā ca bhojane || 29 ||
meaning:
निम्बाटरूषच्युताश्च बुद्धिवृद्धिकरा मताः |
बुद्धिक्षयकरान् नित्यं त्वजेद्राजा च भोजने || 29 ||
text_mt: Leaves fallen from neem and aṭarūṣa are considered enhancers of intellect; / the king should always avoid in his food those things that cause the decay of intellect.

sanskrit_iast:
bhakṣayedanvahaṃ buddhivṛddhihetuṃ nṛpottamaḥ |
na paryāyavihīnaṃ tu prārohedāsanaṃ nṛpaḥ || 30 ||
meaning:
भक्षयेदन्वहं बुद्धिवृद्धिहेतुं नृपोत्तमः |
न पर्यायविहीनं तु प्रारोहेदासनं नृपः || 30 ||
text_mt: The best of kings should daily eat what causes the increase of intellect. / A king should not mount a seat that is out of order,

sanskrit_iast:
na yānaṃ na gajaṃ nāśvamāroheddhīnamāsanaiḥ |
naikastu vicaredrājā kadācidapi nirjane || 31 ||
meaning:
न यानं न गजं नाश्वमारोहेद्धीनमासनैः |
नैकस्तु विचरेद्राजा कदाचिदपि निर्जने || 31 ||
text_mt: nor mount a carriage, an elephant, or a horse lacking seats. / The king should never wander alone in a solitary place.

sanskrit_iast:
madahetuṃ na bhuṃjīyāt kadācidapi bhojane |
kadācinnāpi seveta hyaṣṭamyāṃ māṃsamaithune || 32 ||
meaning:
मदहेतुं न भुंजीयात् कदाचिदपि भोजने |
कदाचिन्नापि सेवेत ह्यष्टम्यां मांसमैथुने || 32 ||
text_mt: He should never eat anything that causes intoxication in his meal; / he should never indulge in meat or sexual intercourse on the eighth [lunar day].

sanskrit_iast:
darśaśrāddhaṃ gayāśrāddhaṃ tilaistarpaṇameva ca |
na jīvatpitṛko bhūpa kuryāt kṛtvāghamāpnuyāt || 33 ||
meaning:
दर्शश्राद्धं गयाश्राद्धं तिलैस्तर्पणमेव च |
न जीवत्पितृको भूप कुर्यात् कृत्वाघमाप्नुयात् || 33 ||
text_mt: The new-moon śrāddha, the Gayā-śrāddha, and the water-libation with sesame seeds— / one whose father is living, O king, should not perform; having performed [them], he incurs sin.

sanskrit_iast:
na kṣetrajādīṃstanayān rājye rājābhiṣecayet |
pitṛṇāṃ śūddhaye nityamaurase tanaye sati || 34 ||
meaning:
न क्षेत्रजादींस्तनयान् राज्ये राजाभिषेचयेत् |
पितृणां शूद्धये नित्यमौरसे तनये सति || 34 ||
text_mt: A king should not consecrate sons such as the kṣetraja for sovereignty / when there is a legitimate son (aurasa), for the constant purification of the ancestors.

sanskrit_iast:
aurasaḥ kṣetrajaścaiva dattaḥ kṛtrima eva ca |
gūḍhotpanno'paviddhaśca bhāgārhāstanayā ime || 35 ||
meaning:
औरसः क्षेत्रजश्चैव दत्तः कृत्रिम एव च |
गूढोत्पन्नोऽपविद्धश्च भागार्हास्तनया इमे || 35 ||
text_mt: The legitimate son (aurasa), the wife's son (kṣetraja), the adopted son (datta), the made son (kṛtrima), / the secretly born (gūḍhotpanna), and the abandoned (apaviddha)—these sons are entitled to a share.

sanskrit_iast:
kāttīnaśca sahoḍhaśca krītaḥ paunarbhavastathā |
svayaṃdattaśca dāsaśca ṣaḍate putrapāṃsulāḥ || 36 ||
meaning:
कात्तीनश्च सहोढश्च क्रीतः पौनर्भवस्तथा |
स्वयंदत्तश्च दासश्च षडते पुत्रपांसुलाः || 36 ||
text_mt: The maiden's son (kānīna), the son received with a pregnant bride (sahoḍha), the bought son (krīta), the son of a remarried woman (paunarbhava), / the self-given son (svayaṃdatta), and the son of a slave woman (dāsa)—these six are base sons (putrapāṃsula).

sanskrit_iast:
abhāve pūrvapurveṣāṃ parānt samabhiṣecaye |
paunarbhavaṃ svayaṃdattaṃ dāsaṃ rājye na yojayet || 37 ||
meaning:
अभावे पूर्वपुर्वेषां परान्त् समभिषेचये |
पौनर्भवं स्वयंदत्तं दासं राज्ये न योजयेत् || 37 ||
text_mt: In the absence of the preceding ones, one should consecrate the later ones. / One must never appoint a paunarbhava, a svayaṃdatta, or a dāsa to the throne.

sanskrit_iast:
dattādyāścāpi tanayā nijagotreṇa saṃskṛtāḥ |
āyānti putratāṃ samyaganyabījasamudbhavāḥ || 38 ||
meaning:
दत्ताद्याश्चापि तनया निजगोत्रेण संस्कृताः |
आयान्ति पुत्रतां सम्यगन्यबीजसमुद्भवाः || 38 ||
text_mt: Sons beginning with the adopted (datta), though arisen from another's seed, / attain full sonship when consecrated with one's own gotra.

sanskrit_iast:
piturgotreṇa yaḥ putraḥ saṃskṛtaḥ pṛthivīpateḥ |
ācūḍāntaṃ pa putraḥ na putratāṃ yāti cānyataḥ || 39 ||
meaning:
पितुर्गोत्रेण यः पुत्रः संस्कृतः पृथिवीपतेः |
आचूडान्तं प पुत्रः न पुत्रतां याति चान्यतः || 39 ||
text_mt: A son who has been consecrated with his father's gotra up to the tonsure ceremony, O ruler of the earth, / is his son; he does not pass into sonship elsewhere.

sanskrit_iast:
cūḍādyā yadi saṃskārā nijagotreṇa saṃsthitāḥ |
dattādyāstanayāste syuranyathā dāsa ucyate || 40 ||
meaning:
चूडाद्या यदि संस्कारा निजगोत्रेण संस्थिताः |
दत्ताद्यास्तनयास्ते स्युरन्यथा दास उच्यते || 40 ||
text_mt: If the rites beginning with tonsure are established with one's own gotra, / then they are sons beginning with the adopted; otherwise, [such a one] is called a slave (dāsa).

sanskrit_iast:
ūrdhvaṃ tu paṃcamād varṣād dattādyāṃśca sutānnṛpa |
gṛhītvā paṃcavarṣīyaṃ putreṣṭiṃ prathamaṃ caret || 41 ||
meaning:
ऊर्ध्वं तु पंचमाद् वर्षाद् दत्ताद्यांश्च सुतान्नृप |
गृहीत्वा पंचवर्षीयं पुत्रेष्टिं प्रथमं चरेत् || 41 ||
text_mt: Beyond the fifth year, O king, having taken sons beginning with the adopted / who are five years old, one should first perform the putreṣṭi sacrifice.

sanskrit_iast:
paunarbhavaṃ tu tanayaṃ jātamātraṃ samānayet |
kṛtvā paunarbhavaṣṭomaṃ jātamātrasya tasya vai || 42 ||
meaning:
पौनर्भवं तु तनयं जातमात्रं समानयेत् |
कृत्वा पौनर्भवष्टोमं जातमात्रस्य तस्य वै || 42 ||
text_mt: One should bring home a son of a remarried woman (paunarbhava) as soon as he is born, / and having performed the paunarbhavaṣṭoma sacrifice for him as soon as he is born,

sanskrit_iast:
sarvāṃstu kuryāt saṃskārān jātakarmādikānnaraḥ |
kṛte paunarbhavaṣṭome sutaḥ paunarbhavaḥ smṛtaḥ || 43 ||
meaning:
सर्वांस्तु कुर्यात् संस्कारान् जातकर्मादिकान्नरः |
कृते पौनर्भवष्टोमे सुतः पौनर्भवः स्मृतः || 43 ||
text_mt: a man should perform all the life-cycle rites beginning with the birth-rite (jātakarman). / When the paunarbhavaṣṭoma has been performed, he is remembered as a paunarbhava son.

sanskrit_iast:
ekoddiṣṭaṃ pituḥ kuryānna śrāddhaṃ pārvaṇādikam |
krītā yā vanitā mūlyaiḥ sā dāsīti nigadyate || 44 ||
meaning:
एकोद्दिष्टं पितुः कुर्यान्न श्राद्धं पार्वणादिकम् |
क्रीता या वनिता मूल्यैः सा दासीति निगद्यते || 44 ||
text_mt: He should perform the ekoddiṣṭa rite for his father, not a śrāddha such as the pārvaṇa. / A woman who has been bought with money is designated a slave woman (dāsī).

sanskrit_iast:
tasyāṃ yo jāyate putro dāsaḥ putrastu sa smṛtaḥ |
na rājño rājyabhāk sa syād viprāṇāṃ nāpi śrāddhakṛt || 45 ||
meaning:
तस्यां यो जायते पुत्रो दासः पुत्रस्तु स स्मृतः |
न राज्ञो राज्यभाक् स स्याद् विप्राणां नापि श्राद्धकृत् || 45 ||
text_mt: A son born of her is remembered as a slave-son (dāsaputra). / He cannot inherit the king's realm, nor can he perform the śrāddha of brāhmaṇas.

sanskrit_iast:
adhamaḥ sarvaputrebhyastaṃ tasmāt parivarjayet |
purāṇaṃ dharmaśāstrāṇi saṃhitāśca munīritāḥ || 46 ||
meaning:
अधमः सर्वपुत्रेभ्यस्तं तस्मात् परिवर्जयेत् |
पुराणं धर्मशास्त्राणि संहिताश्च मुनीरिताः || 46 ||
text_mt: He is the lowest of all sons; therefore, one should avoid him. / The Purāṇa, the dharmaśāstras, and the saṃhitās uttered by sages

sanskrit_iast:
nādhyāpayennṛpaḥ śūdrairvihitāni yadṛcchayā |
yasya rājye sadā śūdrāḥ purāṇaṃ saṃhitāṃ tathā || 47 ||
meaning:
नाध्यापयेन्नृपः शूद्रैर्विहितानि यदृच्छया |
यस्य राज्ये सदा शूद्राः पुराणं संहितां तथा || 47 ||
text_mt: the king must not allow to be taught by śūdras at their own will. / In whose realm śūdras continually recite the Purāṇa

sanskrit_iast:
paṭhanti syāt sa hīnāyuḥ rājā rāṣṭreṇa sānvayaḥ |
mohād vā kāmataḥ śūdraḥ purāṇaṃ saṃhitāṃ smṛtim || 48 ||
meaning:
पठन्ति स्यात् स हीनायुः राजा राष्ट्रेण सान्वयः |
मोहाद् वा कामतः शूद्रः पुराणं संहितां स्मृतिम् || 48 ||
text_mt: and the saṃhitā, that king, along with his realm and his lineage, will have a diminished lifespan. / A śūdra who, out of delusion or desire, recites a Purāṇa, a saṃhitā, or a smṛti,

sanskrit_iast:
paṭhannarakamāpnoti pitṛbhiḥ saha pāpakṛt |
śūdrebhyo vihitaṃ yat tu yaśca mantra urāhṛtaḥ || 49 ||
meaning:
पठन्नरकमाप्नोति पितृभिः सह पापकृत् |
शूद्रेभ्यो विहितं यत् तु यश्च मन्त्र उराहृतः || 49 ||
text_mt: that sinner goes to hell along with his ancestors. / Whatever is prescribed for śūdras, and whatever mantra is taught,

sanskrit_iast:
tadvipravacanād grāhyaṃ dvayaṃ śūdraiḥ sadaiva hi |
ya yojayennṛpaḥ śūdraṃ vyavahārasya darśane || 50 ||
meaning:
तद्विप्रवचनाद् ग्राह्यं द्वयं शूद्रैः सदैव हि |
य योजयेन्नृपः शूद्रं व्यवहारस्य दर्शने || 50 ||
text_mt: those two must always be received by śūdras from the word of a brāhmaṇa. / Whatever king appoints a śūdra to the supervision of legal affairs (vyavahāra),

sanskrit_iast:
niyojya tatra taṃ bhūpastāmisre tena pacyate |
hīnāyuśca bhavelloko rājā vāpi sahāyajaḥ || 51 ||
meaning:
नियोज्य तत्र तं भूपस्तामिस्रे तेन पच्यते |
हीनायुश्च भवेल्लोको राजा वापि सहायजः || 51 ||
text_mt: having appointed him there, the king is boiled in the Tāmisra hell on that account, / and the people, or the king along with his allies, will become short-lived.

sanskrit_iast:
kā.ṅm vyaṅgamaputraṃ yā nābhijñamajitendriyam |
na hrasva vyādhitaṃ vāpi nṛpaḥ kuryāt purohitam || 52 ||
meaning:
का.ङ्म् व्यङ्गमपुत्रं या नाभिज्ञमजितेन्द्रियम् |
न ह्रस्व व्याधितं वापि नृपः कुर्यात् पुरोहितम् || 52 ||
text_mt: A king must not appoint as his royal priest (purohita) one who is one-eyed, deformed, childless, / unlearned, of uncontrolled senses, dwarfish, or diseased.

sanskrit_iast:
kṛpaṇasya ghanaṃ rājā na gṛhṇīyāt kadācana |
na dvijānāṃ tathā dadyād dhanāni vipulānyapi || 53 ||
meaning:
कृपणस्य घनं राजा न गृह्णीयात् कदाचन |
न द्विजानां तथा दद्याद् धनानि विपुलान्यपि || 53 ||
text_mt: A king must never take the wealth of a miser, / nor should he give immense wealth to [unworthy] twice-born men.

sanskrit_iast:
nārohet kāmukonmattagajaṃ rājā kadācana |
āruhya kāmukastaṃ tu paratreha viṣīdati || 54 ||
meaning:
नारोहेत् कामुकोन्मत्तगजं राजा कदाचन |
आरुह्य कामुकस्तं तु परत्रेह विषीदति || 54 ||
text_mt: A king must never mount an elephant rutting with lust. / If, lustful, he mounts it, he comes to grief in this world and the next.

sanskrit_iast:
anāyuṣyaṃ na kuryāt karma bhūpaḥ kadācana |
satataṃ cāyuṣo vṛddhyai yateta sakalairdhanaiḥ || 55 ||
meaning:
अनायुष्यं न कुर्यात् कर्म भूपः कदाचन |
सततं चायुषो वृद्ध्यै यतेत सकलैर्धनैः || 55 ||
text_mt: A king should never perform an action that shortens life; / he should continually strive with all his wealth for the prolongation of life.

sanskrit_iast:
na krūravāre nāṣṭamyāṃ na ṣaṣṭhyāṃ ca nṛpottamaḥ |
añjanābhyañjane kuryāt tāmbūlasyāpi bhojanam || 56 ||
meaning:
न क्रूरवारे नाष्टम्यां न षष्ठ्यां च नृपोत्तमः |
अञ्जनाभ्यञ्जने कुर्यात् ताम्बूलस्यापि भोजनम् || 56 ||
text_mt: Not on an inauspicious weekday, nor on the eighth or sixth lunar day, should the best of kings / apply collyrium or body oil, or chew betel.

sanskrit_iast:
atisūkṣmaṃ tathā pūrṇaṃ grahaṇaṃ candrasūryayoḥ |
